TL;DR: 提出诊断驱动的后训练方案，联合优化紧凑VLM的准确率、效率与行为可靠性，产出NanoFull与FlashFull两个变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 亚十亿参数VLM虽适合端侧部署，但模型小并不等于可用：端侧首token延迟可超两分钟。可用性取决于准确率、效率、行为可靠性三轴，而现有基准缺少对第三轴的考察——答案过短无法暴露重复死循环（doom loop），提示过于温和无法探测对抗安全性。

Method: 诊断驱动的后训练配方：由教师VLM对学生施加压力测试，挖掘超出人类先验的失败模式，并将其转化为针对性监督与偏好对齐，以失败驱动优化补充通用数据规模化；同时引入两种视觉token策略，形成两个准确率-效率变体。

Result: NanoFull在17个基准上取得62.3归一化平均分，为公开约0.5B模型中最高，在相同架构与token预算下较基座提升7.4，死循环率不高于最强基线；FlashFull保持61.4，并将Pixel 9上的热启动首token时间从138秒降至6.1秒（23倍加速）。

Conclusion: 通过在三轴上协同优化，该方案推动紧凑VLM走向实用的端侧可用性。

Abstract: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.

</details>


### [57] [The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31747)
*Yao Zhang,Pengyu Dai,Wei Guo,Jian Liang,Jian Song,Yafei Ou,Hongruixuan Chen,Naoto Yokoya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架GazeEarth，将超高分遥感图像理解建模为“固定像素预算如何分配”的问题，通过问题引导区域选择与全场景注视式变形重采样，在最多两次MLLM调用下显著提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在有限视觉输入预算下处理超高分遥感图像时，需在局部细节与场景上下文之间权衡。现有选择式方法（token/图像块剪枝、相关性打分或反复裁剪巡检）都无法在连续全场景视图内直接重新分配像素：前者保留被选token或patch，后者重编码的裁剪脱离周边环境。试点研究还发现，冻结MLLM虽能产生有用的空间请求，但基于裁剪的局部检查并不稳定地改善答案。

Method: GazeEarth为免训练框架。MLLM从带索引的概览图中选出证据单元；随后以确定性、保持拓扑的warp将原图重采样到固定尺寸画布，放大所选单元的共享邻域并压缩边缘区域；同一冻结模型在该聚焦视图上作答。整个流程最多两次MLLM调用，无需外部选择器或迭代搜索。

Result: 在三个超高分遥感基准与四个冻结骨干上，GazeEarth相对直接回答的基准平均精度提升4.6–9.4个百分点，相对概览回答提升3.4–4.3个百分点，并优于任务训练方法。

Conclusion: 现有MLLM能够自主判断在超高分图像中“往哪里看”，而其从所选证据中能推断出什么，取决于证据以何种方式呈现。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.

</details>


### [58] [Fusion Under Component Failure: Negative Results and Failure Modes in Ensemble AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31749)
*Suraj Singh,Tushar Verma,Pragyan Singh,Shaurya Bhav,Shivam Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个AI生成图像检测的堆叠集成（3个开放检测器、5个分数、梯度提升元学习器），部署后补做了三项对照实验，结果推翻了作者此前的部分结论：融合仅在目标域重拟合时才有价值；单一语料不足以构成评测；弃权（缺失分数）是真实、相关且被错误处理的；此外Corpus A存在可仅凭文件头区分类别的类条件JPEG偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的集成检测流程在部署前缺少必要的对照检验：元学习器跨域迁移是否真的优于单模型、单一评测语料是否足以支撑结论、多检测器同时弃权（缺失输入）时融合器的行为是否可靠，以及数据本身是否存在可利用的捷径偏差。作者希望通过补做这些"本应首先面对的对照"来校准自己先前的结论。

Method: 采用普通堆叠集成：3个开放检测器产生5个分数，由梯度提升元学习器融合，并将检测器失效视为缺失数据。随后设置三项对照：(1) 比较跨语料拟合的已发布元学习器与域内重拟合堆叠器，并在2000张StyleGAN人脸（AUC、McNemar检验）及加入事后校准器条件下对比；(2) 用80张截图检验各模型AUC置信区间；(3) 构造缺失/弃权场景（5个检测器中4个静默、存活者报告"real"），检查NaN输入下的评分行为，并测试需要两种不同架构的法定人数（quorum）规则。

Result: 跨域拟合的已发布元学习器在2000张StyleGAN人脸上不敌最佳单成员（AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961，McNemar p=1.000）；域内重拟合堆叠器则优于该成员加事后校准器（ΔAUC=+0.0025，[+0.0014,+0.0038]，p=3.4e-4），据此修正了早期草稿"校准后单检测器胜出"的结论。80张截图上所有模型AUC区间均包含0.5，集成与最佳成员下降之差为[-0.185,+0.115]。弃权场景下，全NaN输入在未见过缺失的元学习器中得分为0.9995，导致系统输出P(AI)=0.9985；三个AIDE检查点共享同一预处理路径因而同时失效；法定人数规则（要求两种不同架构）无需重训练即可同时避免这两类失败。另发现Corpus A存在严重到可仅凭文件头区分类别的类条件JPEG偏差，限制所有域内数值的可信度。

Conclusion: 融合的收益是有条件的，仅在目标域重拟合时才成立；单语料评测不足以支撑模型比较；缺失分数导致的弃权是真实存在、相互关联且被现有流程错误处理的，可通过架构多样性+法定人数规则在无重训练条件下缓解；数据集的类条件压缩偏差会污染域内指标。作者公开代码、测试框架、哈希标识的产物及全部更正。

Abstract: We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions.
  Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here.
  One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115].
  Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining.

*Xiangqian Li*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在静态视觉理解上进展迅速，但在判断自中心任务进展时仍不可靠。给定任务指令与两个视觉观测，模型应基于任务相关物体配置与空间关系判断哪个状态更接近目标，而非依赖时间戳或呈现顺序。该问题在操作任务中尤为关键，因为重试、纠正动作与暂时性倒退使进展本身是非单调的。

Method: EgoTSR包含三部分：（1）SpatialLogic-Bench对每个物理状态对在原始与顺序交换呈现下进行评测，覆盖短时程与长时程设定，揭示模型是基于任务状态证据还是依赖时间顺序捷径；（2）数据构建流程将成功且近似单调的操作与第一人称轨迹转为双向监督信号，LongTag保留中间子任务结构用于长时程比较，失败感知数据将学习扩展至倒退与恢复情形；（3）渐进式CoT-to-Tag课程，先监督基于证据的任务相关状态变化解读，再通过可扩展的仅标签训练固化比较规则。

Result: 实验表明代表性VLM存在明显输入顺序偏置。EgoTSR取得92.4%的长时程准确率，正逆序Gap仅0.1点。失败感知监督使非单调轨迹准确率提升11.8点，恢复准确率提升11.2点，同时保持广泛的视觉与空间能力。

Conclusion: 结果确立了目标条件的状态比较作为自中心时空推理的显式表述，用于任务进度理解，为诊断和提升VLM的顺序鲁棒进度判断提供了统一框架与有效途径。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉触觉传感器依赖物理探针按压标定以获取高精度接触面法向与深度，该过程难以在不同传感器间扩展，且标定复杂度随传感器形状与光学系统变化而增加。

Method: 采用Universal Photometric Stereo神经网络实现免标定接触面法向估计；在3种不同光学系统的传感器上开展真实世界实验，使用金属球进行受控实验，并以标定法作为基线对比；模型仅在合成数据上训练。

This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. </details>


### [62] [Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31755)
*Tianjian Zhou,Yishan Li,Jie Jiang,Yifei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出规范等变相对位置编码（GE-RPE），消除球面Transformer的规范依赖缺陷，并结合教师token置换与iBOT+MAE自监督预训练，构建EquiSSL框架，显著提升全景分割的旋转鲁棒性与低标签性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景360度场景理解日益依赖icosphere transformer，但现有球面模型在相机旋转90度时分割精度损失过半；受控消融实验表明，其相对位置偏置中的规范依赖（gauge dependence）是主要成因。该缺陷还使iBOT+MAE自监督预训练从助力变为负担，限制低标签场景下的性能。

Method: 提出规范等变相对位置编码GE-RPE：对偏置在规范旋转有限循环子群C_n⊂SO(2)上做无参数的Reynolds平均。将其插入SphereUFormer骨干，零新增参数、前向延迟仅增加1.5%–4.4%。进一步用教师token置换π_R将自监督视图对齐到旋转后的学生帧，形成完整框架EquiSSL（GE-RPE + π_R + iBOT + MAE）。理论上证明该构造具有C_n不变性，并以O(n^{-2})逼近连续SO(2)平均。

Result: 相同训练配方下，三随机种子GE-RPE模型在90度旋转压力测试下精度仅降1.3%，而已发布SphereUFormer检查点降幅达53%。EquiSSL进一步将降幅收窄至0.8%，验证集mIoU达68.30%；在N=373测试集上1%标签微调提升+2.39 mIoU（N=40验证集提升+4.10）。该修复同样适用于单目深度估计与零样本Structured3D分割。

Conclusion: GE-RPE以参数无关、计算开销极低的方式消除了球面Transformer的规范依赖缺陷，使模型对相机旋转具备鲁棒性；配合π_R对齐的iBOT+MAE预训练，自监督从负担转为低标签增益杠杆。该方案构成可用的360度视觉计算基元，可推广至全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移。

Abstract: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. </details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Does high image fidelity imply readable screen content in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)? Ten procedural scenes provide fixed multi-view splits, exact cameras, screen masks, text boxes, and transcripts. The protocol separates whole-image fidelity, screen-region fidelity, OCR readability, and edge preservation. In the reported five-method comparison, LightGaussian exceeds Mip-Splatting in screen PSNR by only 0.08 dB, yet trails it in OCR accuracy by 12.7 percentage points. Across all ten method pairs, screen-PSNR and OCR orderings disagree in seven cases. These aggregate results expose a method-selection failure of fidelity-only evaluation. *Bo Liu,Qiuli Luo,Lianrui Nie,Fengli Zhang,Wenjiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HGPTrans——一种结合图同构卷积、物理感知切片注意力与层次化池化的分层图池化网络，可直接从车辆表面网格预测气动阻力系数，在大规模数据集上取得最低误差，并在真实车辆迁移任务中实现约0.293秒/车的推理速度与1.56%–2.12%的相对L1误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆造型早期迭代需评估大量候选几何，而高保真CFD单次计算需数小时至数天，成本过高，难以支撑大规模设计探索；同时车辆气动既依赖局部几何特征，也依赖空间远距表面区域间的长程交互，需兼顾二者进行快速预测。

Result: 在DrivAerNet和DrivAerNet++上，HGPTrans在所列基线中取得最低MAE与MSE；迁移至真实车辆数据集后，轿车相对L1误差1.56%、SUV为2.12%，单车辆推理时间约0.293 s，相较CFD高保真计算加速达数个数量级，预测阻力系数与CFD参考值仅相差数个百分点。消融实验验证了各模块的贡献，并揭示了网络深度与池化比例的影响。

Conclusion: HGPTrans通过局部几何编码、线性复杂度全局注意力与冗余感知层次化池化的协同，实现了从车辆表面网格对气动阻力系数的高精度、快速度预测，在保持与CFD参考值数个百分点差距的同时获得数个数量级加速，适用于早期造型阶段的大规模设计探索。

Abstract: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. </details>


### [65] [UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31766)
*Xinjin Li,Lian Lian,Yuanzhe Yang,Yudi Xia,Calvin Chang Liu,Yeyun Xu,Yu Ma,Jinghan Cao,Yuruo Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种名为UNMATCH的轻量级图文匹配检测方法，通过"方向性多尺度覆盖"紧凑表示刻画图像-文本的局部亲和性，用于识别断章取义式图像误用。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在Fauxtography基准的Snopes子集上，采用防泄漏的三折三随机种子评估，UNMATCH取得69.82 Macro-F1与71.05平衡准确率，较MCOT适配版本分别高出2.60和2.16个百分点。匹配-重分配干预实验显示，打破原有配对会降低覆盖率，并提升差异度与假配对概率。

Conclusion: 方向性多尺度覆盖能以紧凑表示有效捕捉图文间决定性局部不匹配，在轻量分类器下取得优于强基线的性能，且对配对关系具有敏感性。

Abstract: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

</details>


### [66] [Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31780)
*Chika Maduabuchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PSP-DiT，将全景场景程序作为一阶潜变量与图像潜变量联合去噪，显著提升组合式文本到图像生成的计数、属性绑定与关系建模能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型虽能生成高保真图像，但在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间排序及角色敏感关系的组合式提示上表现不佳。

Method: PSP-DiT采用扩散Transformer架构，把全景场景程序视为一阶潜变量而非外部控制信号或事后解析；通过耦合的Transformer流联合去噪图像潜变量与场景程序潜变量，并引入全景接地与循环一致性目标，将对象实例、属性、关系与计数绑定到生成图像的视觉支撑上。

Result: 在匹配的训练与推理设置下，PSP-DiT在GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score和DetailMaster上均优于强纯文本基线，在计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系及长结构化提示上提升最大；同时保持图像质量，推理开销适中，并对不完美的场景程序具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 将全景场景程序作为一阶潜变量并与图像联合去噪，是提升组合式文本到图像生成的有效途径。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

</details>


### [67] [SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31788)
*Renjie Liang,Yang Yang,Jinqian Pan,Zhengkang Fan,Chengkun Sun,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现3D CT报告生成器的隐藏状态已包含报告未写出的信息，但在解码为文本时丢失；提出基于对比解码的SelfCue方法，并通过知识蒸馏得到SelfCue-KD，以低推理成本缩小隐藏态与报告之间的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D CT报告生成研究多依赖更复杂架构与更大训练数据。作者转而发现：模型隐藏状态实际已编码了报告中缺失的信息，但一旦转化为token输出便丢失，存在"隐藏态到报告浮现差距"（hidden-to-report surfacing gap）。在18类CT-RATE异常上，宏观AUROC从隐藏态的0.848降至生成报告的0.739，说明瓶颈在于解码过程而非编码能力。

Method: 提出基于对比解码（contrastive decoding）的SelfCue：强化隐藏状态已支持的内容，抑制其不支持的内容。进一步通过知识蒸馏将这一解码行为内化到模型权重中，得到SelfCue-KD学生模型。

Result: SelfCue将临床效能F1提升至0.481，LLM评判的GREEN分数提升至0.510。SelfCue-KD保留了大部分增益，推理时无需任何额外开销，可直接嵌入已部署基线的任意流程中。

Conclusion: 3D CT报告生成的性能瓶颈更多在于隐藏态到文本的"浮现"环节，而非架构或数据规模。通过对比解码与知识蒸馏可有效缩小该差距，且蒸馏版本具备零额外推理成本与即插即用的实用优势。

Abstract: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/SelfCue-CT.

</details>


### [68] [Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31795)
*Nitiz Khanal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文为LoViF 2026 AIGC图像压缩挑战赛的参赛报告。方案微调AEIC单步扩散编解码器的四个码率专用检查点，配合编码端TTO、rANS熵编码与精确多选背包选择，最终以0.02495 BPP获得31.527739总分、DISTS排名第二、总榜第五。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成图像在0.025 BPP超低码率下具有独特难点：包含渲染文字、合成边缘、重复纹样、类UI布局与风格化微纹理。传统面向失真的编解码器在此码率下会抹除这些结构，而无约束生成式解码器虽能恢复看似合理的细节，却与源几何或符号不符。因此作者将任务重新定义为码率—感知的资源分配问题。

Method: 微调AEIC单步扩散编解码器的四个码率专用检查点；对每张图像由四个检查点生成候选，其中一个隐变量经编码端测试时优化（TTO）并周期性刷新熵条件；所有候选经实用rANS熵编码；在真实编码文件大小上用精确多选背包问题为每图选择一个比特流；解码端另加固定、零额外比特的残差恢复网络。每个提交比特流均可由发布解码器独立解码，不依赖源图或外部信息。

Result: 参赛得分31.527739，PSNR 27.02 dB，MS-SSIM 0.9176，LPIPS 0.0778，DISTS 0.0390，码率0.02495 BPP；DISTS为该榜单第二，最终测试阶段排行榜（2026年8月4日公布）位列第五。

Conclusion: 完整报告了流水线、涵盖77次记录实验的消融历程及一组负面结果，并解释了在该架构下PSNR为何无法与面向率失真的竞品持平，以供后续参赛者参考。作为挑战赛报告，其核心贡献在于系统级工程方案与经验性负面结论。

Abstract: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

</details>


### [69] [A Surgical Foundation Model Reveals Task-Dependent Label Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31821)
*Florian Philipp Stilz,Lorenzo Arboit,Vinkle Srivastav,CAMMA International Surgical Partners,Jacques Marescaux,Sergio Alfieri,Pietro Mascagni,Nassir Navab,Nicolas Padoy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出手术基础模型 SURGE，基于 3 千万帧级的 SurgSpectrum-30M+ 数据集预训练并公开权重，在 5 类任务、15 个基准上系统评估标签效率，揭示任务相关的缩放规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术 AI 中专家标注成本高、数量稀缺，发展标签高效模型是核心挑战。自监督基础模型能以极少数据适配新任务，但标签效率在不同手术任务间的差异尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 构建迄今最大规模的预训练数据集 SurgSpectrum-30M+（超 3000 万帧），训练手术基础模型 SURGE 并公开检查点；在覆盖 5 类任务、15 个基准的体系上系统评估标签效率，任务范围从时序与空间场景理解，到与器械—解剖结构交互相关的细粒度推理，以及安全关键操作。

Result: SURGE 在所有基准上超越此前最优方法，在复杂推理任务上甚至超过任务专用模型。同时发现任务相关的缩放行为：场景理解任务在极少监督下即饱和，而细粒度推理任务在标注预算显著增大时仍持续提升。

Conclusion: 研究为复杂领域中如何分配专家标注投入提供了蓝图，并开源代码与模型检查点以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored.
  Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers.
  SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains.
  Code: https://github.com/CAMMA-public/SURGE

</details>


### [70] [SynDORBench: Evaluating LVLM Perceptual Robustness Under Physically Constrained Visibility Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31823)
*Jeremy Stephen Gabriel Yee,Zhengkui Wang,Zhiyuan Zhang,Avinash Anand,Timothy Liu,Benedict Chan,Aik Beng Ng,Simon See*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出SynDORBench，首个基于DORI物理成像约束的LVLM感知鲁棒性基准，含54000+问答对，揭示感知失败主要由像素密度和物理成像约束而非模型规模决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM评估多假设理想视觉输入，无法刻画相机距离、光照、视角和像素密度等物理成像条件对语义可恢复性的影响，导致对真实约束下感知可靠性的理解不足。

Method: 构建基于DORI校准的可控合成流水线，系统变化观看距离、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，生成54000+问答对；并提出可判别性标注框架，利用掩码条件统计特征与集成学习传播人类感知标签，实现可扩展的低可见度监督。

Result: 在人物存在分类与动作识别任务上评估16个开源LVLM、1个商业LVLM基线和YOLO11x。结果显示LVLM感知失败强烈受像素密度和物理成像约束支配，而非仅由模型规模决定；部分紧凑开源LVLM在远距离和低光条件下优于更大商业基线并显著超过YOLO11x鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SynDORBench建立了物理基础多模态评估的新范式，支持在真实感知约束下系统分析LVLM可靠性，并可直接与人类可见性阈值比较。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

</details>


### [71] [CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31873)
*Weitai Kang,Hanieh Deilamsalehy,Yumo Xu,Dewang Sultania,Serdar Cellat,Yan Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CueKFS：一种无需训练的关键帧选择方法，将问题-帧匹配重构为帧与动态生成视觉线索的对比，通过智能体式线索修正与预算分配实现长视频问答的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于相似度排序的关键帧选择在问题涉及多个主体/时刻或需隐含信息时，单帧得分低；基于子查询分解的方法因静态初始上下文导致分解不准。

Method: 从初始显著帧集将问题分解为视觉线索，每个线索并发探测视频导航到自身证据；推理VLM智能体式依据证据修正线索集并重新探索视频；随后在存活的线索间分配预算，全程无需训练。

Result: 在三个基准、27个可对比设置中全部达到SOTA，预算平均增益最高+4.54%，VLM调用中位数仅2次；行为分析显示线索修正驱动主动重探索，相对相似度增益最高达92%。

Conclusion: CueKFS证明动态线索生成与智能体式修正可有效替代静态相似度排序和子查询分解，在低VLM调用成本下显著提升长视频问答的关键帧选择效果。

Abstract: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

</details>


### [72] [Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31896)
*Rishav Agarwal,Nirshal Chandra Sekar,Anirudh Vemula*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究施工场景中"低位姿态"（跪姿、弯腰）工人的检测问题，发现自动标注流水线中的质量过滤器会优先剔除这类样本，人员检测器也会漏检，说明长尾人体数据筛选不能仅依赖边界框或姿态结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 施工机器人需要检测跪姿或弯腰（低位姿态）的工人。这类样本在自动标注的训练数据集中会丢失，导致数据长尾分布问题，影响下游检测与姿态估计的可靠性，因此需要弄清低位姿态为何稀少。

Method: 搭建并分析一条流水线：先做人员检测，再用 NLF 估计人体关节，最后对相似姿态进行分组。为检验流水线中质量过滤器（剔除检测置信度低或关节估计不确定的样本）的影响，采用四种替代性姿态线索进行验证：边界框形状、垂直身体跨度、与场景垂直方向对齐的姿态分组、图像外观。另外构建受控仿真场景，用公开施工数据集微调的人员检测器进行测试。

Result: 低位姿态仅占保留样本的约 2%。四种替代线索均显示低位姿态被过滤器剔除的频率更高。在受控仿真场景中，即便将边界框高度校正到与站立工人一致，微调后的人员检测器仍会漏检更多处于低位姿态的工人。

Conclusion: 低位姿态在数据中稀缺且难以获取，仅依靠边界框或姿态信息无法胜任长尾人体数据的筛选与策展任务。

Abstract: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

</details>


### [73] [Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31911)
*Denis Musinguzi,Andrew Katumba,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种面向医学报告生成的强化学习框架，通过整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述来验证模型推理过程，并设计空间与事实奖励机制，使推理既具视觉基础又事实准确。实验表明RL可带来超越SFT的增益，且联合验证推理步骤与最终输出效果最佳，同时发现多种奖励黑客模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学报告生成中幻觉问题突出，主要源于监督微调（SFT）偏重与参考报告的词汇相似性而非临床正确性。强化学习在数学、代码等可验证奖励领域表现优异，但在开放式医学任务中应用有限；现有工作仅评估最终答案而忽视推理过程，而有证据表明错误推理会降低整体性能。

Method: 提出一个通过整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述来验证模型推理过程的框架；设计空间奖励与事实奖励机制，确保推理既具视觉基础又事实准确。以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基座模型，先用SFT适配医学领域，再通过冷启动SFT阶段引入推理能力，最后用强化学习进行精炼。

Result: 强化学习带来超越单独SFT所能达到的性能增益；联合验证推理步骤与最终输出比单独验证任一者带来更大提升；在RL阶段识别出多种奖励黑客（reward hacking）模式；模型的结构化思维链增强了可解释性，使输出更易审计以用于临床。

Conclusion: 通过验证推理过程并联合优化推理步骤与最终输出，可有效缓解医学报告生成中的幻觉问题，提升性能与可解释性；同时需警惕RL阶段的奖励黑客风险。

Abstract: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

</details>


### [74] [PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31912)
*Jianhai Zhang,Pattarawut Charatpangoon,Donghao Zhang,Bijoy K. Menon,Wu Qiu,M. Ethan MacDonald,Aravind Ganesh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PredRA框架，将确定性预测作为稳定参考，在生成式精修中从残差提取额外确定性成分，并全局控制残差精修量，实现快速、保真且感知强的医学图像翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中很大部分可由源图像直接预测。纯确定性预测会平滑掉细节，而生成模型虽能恢复细节却可能引入无益甚至有害的变化。需要兼顾保真度与感知质量。

Method: 将整个基于残差的生成过程视为优化问题，以确定性预测为稳定参考，从残差中提取额外确定性成分；机制研究表明有用残差信息呈结构化模式但体素级估计不可靠，因此采用全局控制残差精修量的策略，减少不必要不确定性的累积，并结合受控随机精修。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，受控精修相比完全残差精修提升了与配对目标的保真度，同时保留生成建模的感知收益。PredRA以1.4-11.9倍更少总参数、3.1-26.2倍更少可训练参数达到与更大SOTA模型相当或更优性能，32步流采样器比匹配的1000步DDPM少31.25倍采样步数。

Conclusion: 受控残差精修结合确定性成分提取，可同时实现快速、保真且感知强的医学图像翻译，并以更小模型与更少采样步数取得竞争性或更优的表现。

Abstract: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.

</details>


### [75] [Facial classification Using Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31915)
*Roshan Babu Bandlapalli,Srinivas V Katakam,Jitendra Chougala,Ravi Kumar Kappagantu,Jayasri Dontabhaktuni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种面向资源受限场景的混合量子-经典人脸识别流水线，在标准CPU硬件上运行，于5万张图像上超越CPU训练的FaceNet基线，并在校园考勤部署中验证可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合量子方法在资源受限的人脸生物识别领域研究有限，现有方案多依赖高算力设备，缺少可在普通计算硬件上落地的验证。

Method: 图像经伽马校正、对比度增强与主成分分析（PCA）降维后，将特征编码进8量子比特的变分量子分类器（VQC），再由经典图像匹配完成识别；并在CPU、GPU及量子硬件上分别评测。

Result: 在5万张图像（CelebA的2.5万张人脸 + CIFAR-10的2.5万张非人脸）实验中，准确率与训练效率均优于所报告的CPU训练FaceNet基线；CPU推理每人耗时0.2–0.5秒，且对佩戴眼镜具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该结果表明混合量子方法在现成CPU硬件上部署人脸识别具备可行性，并已在合作方场景的考勤监控中完成实际验证。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. In experiments with 50,000 images, comprising 25,000 faces from CelebA and 25,000 non-face images from CIFAR-10, the method outperformed the reported CPU-trained FaceNet baseline in accuracy and training efficiency. The pipeline was also evaluated on GPU and quantum hardware. In an attendance monitoring deployment at Mahindra University in collaboration with Lloyds Technology Centre, CPU inference took 0.2 to 0.5 seconds per person, and the system remained robust to the use of spectacles. These findings support the feasibility of deploying hybrid quantum methods for facial recognition on existing CPU hardware.

</details>


### [76] [CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31957)
*Zhenhao Zhang,Zhaoyu Fan,Haohan Ying,Jingwen Hu,Hancen Fan,Junhao Zhou,Zitian Chen,Linchao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CaptchaArena——首个大规模、细粒度的交互式 CAPTCHA 求解训练数据集，并基于此训练统一策略 CaptchaAgent，验证了大规模细粒度计算机操作监督的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式 CAPTCHA 对 computer-use agents 仍具挑战，而现有数据集在类型覆盖、交互真实性与轨迹监督之间存在权衡（trade-offs），缺乏兼顾三者的资源。

Method: 构建 CaptchaArena：50K 谜题，覆盖 20 种 CAPTCHA 类型与 5 种交互模式，每道解法均经执行验证；提供 50K 截图-动作轨迹，其中 46K 带逐步推理标注，并含不规则目标的像素级掩码标注。基于该数据训练单一 9B 策略 CaptchaAgent，先监督微调（SFT）再接强化学习（RL），RL 奖励由环境验证器直接提供。

Result: SFT 达到 70.5 Pass@1，RL 进一步提升至 71.7，同时在两个外部基准上也带来性能提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明大规模、细粒度的 computer-use 监督对训练交互式 CAPTCHA agent 具有显著价值；数据集与模型已开源。

Abstract: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.

</details>


### [77] [Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31970)
*Bryce J. Dietrich,Hyein Ko,Myriam Shiran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对CNN和Fox News十年间近70万图像文本片段的识别分析显示，女性国会议员更常以分屏而非单人镜头出现；静态分屏降低其感知政治能力（对男性无效），而动态视频中该惩罚消失，转为暴怒语言大幅拉低女性温暖度评价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 女性在国会的比例长期低于30%，其电视新闻中的能见度亦受限；现有研究多关注女性议员"是否出现"，而非"如何被视觉框定"，因此需要考察视觉框架对女性议员媒介可见度与能力评价的影响。

Method: 1) 面部识别分析CNN与Fox News 2011—2021年间695,464个图像-文本片段，比较男女议员在分屏与单人镜头中的出现比例；2) 两项预注册实验，共6,220名被试，分别检验静态画面中分屏框架对男女议员感知政治能力的影响，以及动态视频中语言情绪（暴怒语言）对温暖度感知的影响，并考察女性观众的外部政治效能感。

Result: 女性议员在分屏镜头中比例偏高；静态分屏降低女性议员的感知政治能力，对男性议员无此效应；动态视频中能力惩罚消失，但暴怒语言使女性议员温暖度下降幅度约为男性的三倍；女性观众观看女性议员单人镜头后外部政治效能感更高的证据具有提示性（p = .057）。

Conclusion: 视觉框架既塑造女性国会议员的媒介可见方式，也影响公众对其能力的感知，凸显镜头形式与语言情绪在性别化媒介呈现中的交互作用。

Abstract: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

</details>


### [78] [Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31985)
*Denis Musinguzi,Andrew Katumba,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过固定编码器与预训练数据、仅改变预训练目标，系统比较9种目标在5项胸部X线任务上的表现，揭示目标粒度与任务粒度的匹配规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这种差异对胸部X线影像解读的影响尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 控制变量研究：固定编码器与预训练数据，训练覆盖全局/局部对比学习、描述生成及其组合的9种目标，并在空间粒度递增的5项胸部X线任务上评估。

Result: (i) 粒度匹配在两端最明显：局部目标擅长异常检测，全局目标擅长分类；(ii) 局部目标在全局级生成与问答任务上出乎意料地有竞争力；(iii) 描述与对比学习的优势随粒度反转；(iv) 组合中，混合描述与对比监督在分类和分布内生成最强，两种描述目标搭配在零样本报告生成上泛化最佳。

Conclusion: 不存在普适最优的预训练目标；目标类型、粒度与任务之间的交互决定下游性能。

Abstract: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

</details>


### [79] [Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31998)
*Weida Zhao,Logan Bellamy,Yazhou Tu,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出联邦学习框架用于指针式模拟电表读数，无需共享原始图像，并发布MeterFL数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟电表广泛部署，环境与表型多样且数据敏感。现有自动抄表需针对每种环境和表型单独开发部署。深度学习方法虽灵活但依赖大量昂贵标注数据，而实际中图像分散于各独立站点、标注有限，且因所有权、治理或隐私限制无法汇集原始图像。

Method: 提出面向视觉模拟电表读数的联邦框架，允许多站点在不共享原始图像的情况下协同训练读数模型。框架为四阶段流水线：(1)表盘定位；(2)薄结构分割，在客户端间联邦训练；(3)极坐标展开；(4)刻度计数解码得到最终读数。并发布MeterFL数据集作系统评估。

Result: 发布MeterFL数据集，含1,382张带掩码标注图像，按视觉属性经确定性规则划分为模拟真实部署的伪客户端，并在分割训练/测试划分间采用dHash近重复控制。评估了分割质量与端到端读数准确率。数据集公开于https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL。

Conclusion: 该联邦框架与配套数据集为跨站点、隐私受限场景下的模拟电表自动读数提供了可行方案与系统评测基准。

Abstract: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

</details>


### [80] [TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32013)
*Quinlan Sykora,Sourav Biswas,Christopher Diehl,Andrew Cunningham,Thomas Gilles,Raquel Urtasun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TriO是一种多模态无监督世界模型，利用相机、LiDAR和RADAR三种传感器作为输入与自监督来源，联合预测4D占据、障碍物分割、光流与LiDAR，在多项3D/4D任务上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放集方法在处理长尾物体时存在局限，且依赖人工标注。作者希望借助多传感器自监督消除标注需求，并提升对长尾障碍物的分割能力。

Method: TriO将相机、LiDAR和RADAR三种模态同时作为输入与自监督信号来源；通过新颖的监督方式，使模型能够从可行驶表面中分割出任意占据区域。

Result: 在多个3D与4D任务上达到SOTA，包括占据预测、光流预测、LiDAR预测，以及在Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected等多个数据集上的零样本道路障碍物分割。

Conclusion: TriO验证了多模态自监督在4D世界建模中的有效性，无需额外人工标注即可实现跨数据集泛化的高性能感知预测。

Abstract: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

</details>


### [81] [Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32027)
*Xiaohao Xu,Xiaonan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对单张图像中射线方向存在多可见表面的问题，提出 Depth Any Seen 方法，将表面建模为图像条件多伯努利深度集合，并设计无辅助任务的 Exact Multi-Bernoulli 目标（ExactMB）联合学习深度与表面存在性；实验表明其显著降低过预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当一条射线方向上存在多个可见表面时，仅凭一张图像恢复可见 3D 结构需要同时估计这些表面的存在性及其度量深度，传统深度估计方法难以处理这种多表面、多分量情形。

Method: Depth Any Seen 将表面表示为一组图像条件多伯努利深度集合，每个分量对应一个深度或保持缺失；其 Exact Multi-Bernoulli 目标（ExactMB）无需辅助任务，通过对完整且互异目标的一对一分配进行边缘化，学习深度与存在性。作者进一步分析了仅匹配期望计数会导致分量-表面分配不明确的问题，并扩展真实与合成分层深度基准进行评测。

Result: 与 depth stacking 相比，ExactMB 在 LD-Real 上将过预测相对降低 88.2%，在 MD-3K 上降低 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度，并在 LD-Syn 上达到可比的条件下度量深度误差。消融显示，有序分配相比边缘化提升了深度准确召回率与精确率；而计数正则化配置在较低召回率下取得了更高的更深秩精确率。

Conclusion: 结果表明，联合建模深度与表面存在性的多伯努利集合框架及 ExactMB 目标能有效抑制过预测并保持深度估计性能，有序分配与计数正则化在不同指标上各有优势。代码将公开。

Abstract: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [82] [ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32036)
*Chenyue Li,Xiaoxiao Sun,Yubo Deng,Qinlin Zhao,Serena Yeung-Levy,Yuhui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出动态"大海捞针"基准ScreenHaystack，揭示GUI定位模型存在"盲区"，并给出盲区导向的数据增强策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI grounding评测通常将目标固定在特定位置，无法检验模型空间定位的稳定性；模型可能在图像某些空间区域出现系统性失效，但缺乏系统化的诊断手段。

Method: 构建ScreenHaystack基准：将受控目标图标系统性地在多种高分辨率GUI背景中重新放置，测量模型能否一致地定位同一目标。基于该基准对Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus等主流模型进行评测，并配合受控合成实验分析盲区成因，进而提出blind-zone-oriented augmentation（盲区导向增强）策略。

Result: 主流GUI定位模型存在明显盲区：在目标外观与指令不变的情况下，某些空间区域的定位准确率骤降。盲区可迁移至未见过的ScreenSpot-Pro样例，Qwen3-VL-8B在盲区内下降16.1个百分点；受控移动实验显示目标移入盲区准确率下降、移出则提升。合成实验表明训练数据空间覆盖不均会导致盲区。盲区导向增强在Click-100k微调基础上优于原始与随机增强，提升ScreenSpot-Pro准确率。

Conclusion: GUI定位模型存在空间盲区，且根源之一是训练数据空间覆盖不均衡；通过盲区导向的数据增强可有效缓解该问题。

Abstract: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

</details>


### [83] [ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32038)
*Weikai Lin,Junjie Zhao,Carl Marshall,Sushant Kondguli,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 ControlGS，一种面向 XR 的端到端高斯渲染流水线，将渲染输出到人眼之间完整的下游处理建模并纳入优化目标，并可根据下游处理参数动态生成高斯原语，从而在不同骨干网络和数据集上稳定提升端到端视觉质量，且开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XR 用户并不直接感知渲染引擎输出，渲染图像还需经过后处理流水线和显示-光学路径才到达人眼，且这一下游处理会随相机位姿、显示功耗预算等因素在运行时显著变化。传统 3DGS 方法要么隐含假设该下游流程保持图像质量，要么无法适应下游处理的变化，导致端到端视觉质量下降。

Method: ControlGS 将渲染输出与人眼之间整个下游处理过程建模并集成到优化目标中，实现端到端视觉质量优化；为适应运行时下游处理的变化，方法以条件方式根据下游处理参数动态生成高斯原语（conditioned Gaussian primitives）。

Result: 实验表明，ControlGS 在不同神经高斯骨干网络（neural Gaussian backbones）和多个数据集上，均能持续提升端到端“后光学”（post-optics）XR 质量，同时引入的额外开销极小。

Conclusion: ControlGS 通过将下游处理纳入优化并动态条件化生成高斯原语，弥合了渲染引擎输出与人眼感知之间的差距，为 XR 场景下的 3DGS 渲染提供了高质量的端到端解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

</details>


### [84] [ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32068)
*Jingxiang Qu,Lucie Taglienti,Evan Atherton*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReFM：将运动重定向重构为渐进式精修问题，用SO(3)规范化、对比学习跨角色语义编码器与多目标能量引导流，摆脱对高质量配对数据的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重定向方法依赖高质量配对重定向数据来学习源运动语义，且普遍通过"约束预测靠近复制运动"来保持语义，导致不匹配骨骼比例与身体几何引入的伪影同有用的关节运动线索纠缠。同时，把重定向当作单次前向回归过于受限：重定向本质上是欠定的，理想解需在语义保真与目标角色特有的物理、时序约束间权衡，而非匹配唯一的配对目标。因此需回答两问：无高质量配对数据时如何学习可靠源运动语义；无可信配对运动作为明确回归目标时应如何形式化重定向。

Method: ReFM为源网格无关（source-mesh-agnostic）的能量引导模型，将重定向表述为渐进式精修：(1) SO(3)规范化器去除冗余的全局朝向变化；(2) 通过对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器，提供角色不变表示，用于优化引导与语义评估；(3) 以语义一致性、物理合理性、时序连贯性与最小运动修改为导向的学习流，对初始化目标运动逐步精修。框架兼容多种初始化策略，包括直接运动复制与工业级全身逆运动学系统 Autodesk HumanIK。

Result: 摘要未给出定量结果；方法层面表明ReFM可兼容直接运动复制与Autodesk HumanIK两种初始化，并通过多目标能量引导的渐进精修在语义保真、物理合理性与时序连贯性之间取得平衡，而非拟合唯一配对目标。

Conclusion: ReFM以渐进精修替代单次回归、以对比学习语义编码器替代配对监督，为无可靠配对数据的运动重定向提供了新范式，且与既有初始化方法（如HumanIK）互补兼容。

Abstract: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

</details>


### [85] [Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32131)
*Tong Wu,Runze Cheng,Xiaoyue Fan,Kaan Akşit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在2D高斯表示的参数中嵌入信息的隐写方法,通过密钥选择子集参数微调以嵌入8位消息,合成与自然图像实验显示正确密钥可无误恢复、错误密钥接近随机猜测,视觉代价极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D高斯图像表示日益流行,但现有隐写多嵌入于图像像素而非表示本身的参数中。作者希望在保持重建图像高视觉保真度的同时,利用高斯参数作为新的隐写载体。

Method: 先对目标图像拟合高斯表示参数;用密钥选择部分参数子集进行微调以嵌入8位消息,并优先选择扰动最小的编辑;载荷通过三类高斯参数(log-anisotropy、opacity、color luminance)承载。在9次拟合的简化设置中移除color luminance,载荷仅用两类参数(减少33.3%),256个高斯全部保留于表示中。

Result: 三张合成图像30次拟合:正确密钥无误恢复,错误密钥BER=0.543(接近随机);相较按密钥随机选择,选择最小扰动编辑恢复更可靠(单侧p=0.031),平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB。迁移至112张256×256自然图像(4096高斯):正确密钥BER=0.000,错误密钥BER=0.520。简化设置中正确密钥仍无误恢复,但错误密钥BER由0.514升至0.571,更偏离随机猜测。

Conclusion: 在2D高斯参数中嵌入信息可行且具高视觉保真度,密钥机制提供可靠解码与接近随机的错误密钥安全性;减少参数类型虽不影响正确解码,但会削弱错误密钥解码的随机性表现。

Abstract: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

</details>


### [86] [CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32157)
*Narendiran Chembu,Navvrat Rao,Shreedhar Shreeshail Kodate,Gayatri Srujana Banda,Arko Sarkar,Abhinav Khanna,Rajarshee Das,Umesh Kanala,Siddarth Khandelwal,Kumar Aman,Aish Dubey,Kaustubh Beedkar,Arjun Jain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CausalDriveBench：基于 Pearl 因果层级的自动驾驶 VLA 因果推理评测框架，含 7,285 条因果 QA 与 1,000 条反事实轨迹，评测 13 个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶 VLA 模型能输出自然语言推理与轨迹预测，但其推理是否反映场景的因果结构尚未被检验；需区分感知显著性与因果相关性，并从关联、干预、反事实、因果发现四个层级系统评测。

Method: 基于 nuScenes 构建因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体；按 Pearl 因果层级四阶生成结构化视觉问答，并为高阶层级提供指定场景修改下的参考轨迹，实现动作级验证；共 7,285 条经校验的因果 QA 与 1,000 条反事实轨迹，评测 10 个驾驶专用 VLA 与 3 个通用 VLM。

Result: 最优模型 QA 准确率仅 70.6%，13 个模型中 4 个低于随机水平；与共享语言主干的通用 VLM 相比，驾驶微调在因果 QA 上的代价为 2–34 个百分点，差异由后训练设计解释；因果 QA 与轨迹准确率跨模型统计不相关，反事实提示下轨迹要么过度反应要么退化为观测场景基线。

Conclusion: 流畅的推理文本与准确的观测场景轨迹均不能作为因果理解的证据，需从行动与推理两个层面联合评测驾驶 VLA 的因果能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

</details>


### [87] [PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32162)
*Yu-Shan Tai,Amber Yijia Zheng,Raymond A. Yeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PruneForget，将机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解，用遗忘集指导剪枝，使二者相互受益，在减小模型与推理成本的同时去除遗忘样本影响，性能接近"重训后剪枝"的 oracle。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中机器遗忘与模型剪枝常被同时需求：模型既要支持遗忘请求（如安全考量），又要满足延迟与内存预算。但已有工作将两者视为独立问题（如先遗忘再剪枝），忽略了它们的内在联系。作者指出二者本质一致——都要求"删除"编码遗忘样本信息的参数，因此应联合、互相感知地求解。

Method: 提出 PruneForget：以遗忘集（unlearn set）作为剪枝的指导信号，将编码遗忘样本信息的参数视为天然剪枝目标，从而把遗忘与剪枝统一到一个框架中，使二者互为促进。

Result: 在图像分类器与生成模型上的大量实验表明，PruneForget 在移除遗忘样本影响的同时，产出更紧凑、推理成本更低的模型，与"从头重训以遗忘、再剪枝"的 oracle 相比性能差距可忽略。

Conclusion: 机器遗忘与剪枝天然对齐，应联合求解并相互感知；PruneForget 验证了该思路的有效性，能同时实现有效遗忘与高效剪枝。

Abstract: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

</details>


### [88] [PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32163)
*Hui Ye,Yudong Liu,Yiran Chen,Rajshekhar Sunderraman,Shihao Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PQR3D：在参考条件化的时间窗口内进行渐进式查询精炼，摆脱持久查询记忆，实现随机帧采样与独立推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序上下文对纯视觉多视角3D目标检测至关重要。现有流式检测器通过跨帧维护和传播查询状态来利用时序信息，但代价是必须进行序列感知训练与严格按时间顺序推理，灵活性受限。

Method: 提出PQR3D，在参考条件化时间窗口内做渐进式查询精炼。窗口内将早期时间戳中运动对齐的高置信查询逐步传递到目标帧；引入掩码自注意力，规范常规查询、传播查询与去噪查询之间的交互，同时将去噪监督与检测查询隔离；采用阶段解耦锚点嵌入，在自注意力之前注入位置信息，之后注入尺寸、朝向与速度，以减少时间不一致属性的干扰。

Result: 使用ViT-L骨干网络，在nuScenes测试集上取得71.6 NDS与64.9 mAP，刷新最优结果。

Conclusion: PQR3D通过参考条件化时间窗口内的渐进式查询精炼，在无需持久查询记忆的前提下实现随机帧采样与独立推理，兼顾时序上下文利用与推理灵活性，并达到新的SOTA性能。

Abstract: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

</details>


### [89] [OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32175)
*Boseong Jeon,Junhyeop Lee,Juhan Cha,Hayoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OneFixer：面向自动驾驶3DGS仿真的单步自回归视频扩散修复器，采用部署匹配共享 rollout 联合学习保真度与自回归鲁棒性，单步指标领先且训练成本减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 自动驾驶仿真需在低延迟下实现高画质与时间一致性，而单步因果生成中单帧误差会立即成为后续上下文，现有分阶段多模块训练与 rollout 正则仍难达部署要求。

Method: 单阶段任务适配训练；核心为部署匹配的共享 rollout：以模型自身单步预测作为流匹配的因果上下文，暴露部署期误差，同时对同一 rollout 施加像素空间感知监督以保细节；预测既用于当前帧质量又复用为未来上下文，从而联合学习保真度与鲁棒性，无需双向到因果转换或教师-学生蒸馏；并利用车道几何与动态主体状态等驾驶仿真先验提升几何保真度。

Result: Waymo 与私有驾驶场景 900 帧 rollout 下，单步 FVD、LPIPS、DISTS 均为最低，时间一致性匹配或超过多阶段 DMD；相同骨干与条件下训练 GPU 小时不足多阶段 DMD+Self-Forcing 的一半且仍持续提升；闭环仿真中相对原始 3DGS 渲染碰撞率降低三分之一。

Conclusion: 共享 rollout 的单阶段适配可有效提升单步自回归视频扩散修复器的画质、时序一致性与训练效率，并改善闭环驾驶仿真安全性。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

</details>


### [90] [Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32177)
*Guanlin Wu,Chao Hu,Pu Chen,Juyong Zhang,Han Hu,Shuguang Cui,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向无线边缘的资源高效联邦学习框架，用于在严重资源约束下训练大规模场景的3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）模型。通过设备端模型轻量化剪枝与无需相机参数的模型恢复机制，实现高效聚合，显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量并降低训练延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D-GS在大规模场景重建中具备高渲染效率和保真度，但在无线边缘训练大规模3D-GS模型面临多重挑战：边缘设备通信、计算和GPU内存资源受限；局部模型间存在结构不一致问题，阻碍有效聚合；原始视觉内容和相机参数带来隐私泄露风险。

Method: 提出资源高效的联邦学习框架。其一，设备端模型轻量化机制，自适应选择与剪枝高斯点以平衡渲染质量与训练效率，通过量化评估各设备上不同高斯点的重要性进行剪枝，并采用新的重要性-延迟比准则，在GPU内存与计算/通信延迟约束下确定剪枝数量。其二，3D-GS模型恢复机制，在不访问私有相机参数的前提下恢复局部模型间的结构一致性，从而实现向全局模型的有效聚合。

Result: 大量实验表明，与最先进的联邦3D-GS基线相比，该方法显著加速收敛，保持高渲染质量，并降低训练延迟。

Conclusion: 该框架有效缓解了无线边缘训练大规模3D-GS模型所面临的资源受限、结构不一致与隐私泄露问题，在资源严重受限条件下实现了高效且高质量的联邦训练。

Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

</details>


### [91] [Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32180)
*Saijun Wang,Guanfeng Tang,Hongbo Zhao,Zhicheng Lei,Yutong Zhang,Wei Ye,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双耳视听实例分割（BiAVIS）新任务，利用同步双耳音频与视频帧分割发声实例，并构建两个基准与相应模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视听分割（AVS）方法多基于单耳音频设定，主要依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类别中视觉相似的实例。人类自然利用双耳听觉，通过耳间差异及头与耳廓产生的方向相关声学滤波获得具有物理基础的 spatial cues，用于精准声源定位，这为提升实例级分割提供了启发。

Method: 1) 定义 BiAVIS 新任务：结合同步双耳音频和视频帧进行发声实例分割；2) 构建两个基准：对已有双耳视听数据集人工标注，以及采集更具挑战和多样场景的新真实数据集 BiAVIS-Bench；3) 提出 BiAVIS 模型：使用纯音频声源定位网络从双耳音频学习发声实例的空间与语义先验，并通过 query-level 视听融合策略将先验注入实例分割解码器。

Result: 在两个基准上的大量实验表明，BiAVIS 模型优于先前的单耳 AVS 方法，尤其在解决实例级类内歧义方面表现突出。在更具挑战性的 BiAVIS-Bench 上，BiAVIS 模型相较最佳单耳基线分别提升 17.22% mAP 和 7.71% FSLA。

Conclusion: 双耳空间线索为视听实例分割提供了有效补充，BiAVIS 任务、基准与模型能够显著缓解单耳 AVS 的实例级类内歧义，并在困难场景下取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

</details>


### [92] [KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32182)
*Zihan Chen,Xuejian Rong,Xiaojuan Wang,Boqing Gong,Adi Zicher,Yael Pritch,Nikhil Karnad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架 KeyRec，通过构建有界视觉记忆（视觉缓存+结构化事件库）并利用纯文本路由器自适应分配固定读取预算，在仅用 10% 视觉 token 预算下于 13/15 设置取得最佳压缩性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频与连续流的视觉 token 随时长累积，导致长上下文推理成本过高；现有免训练视觉 token 选择方法虽降低成本，但会丢失连贯事件证据，且无法区分细粒度的近期观测与长程历史。

Method: KeyRec 为免训练框架。查询无关写入阶段：在视觉缓存中保留细粒度近期观测，将历史证据组织为结构化事件库；候选事件依据相对已存事件的新颖性提出，并通过在线 add-merge-evict 更新维护。问题到来时，由纯文本路由器在近期记忆与事件记忆间自适应分配固定读取预算，且不重新处理历史帧。方法作用于面向模型的视觉嵌入，兼容模块化 encoder-projector VLM 及无 encoder/projector 的 NEO-ov 架构。

Result: 在四个流式与长视频基准、三种 VLM 骨干上，KeyRec 在 15 个设置中的 13 个取得最佳压缩性能，仅使用 10% 的密集解码器视觉 token 预算；实时问题上超过最强压缩基线 2.21–18.37 分；六个长视频设置中五个取得最佳压缩结果；在全部 NEO-ov 2B 设置中均表现最佳。

Conclusion: KeyRec 以有界视觉记忆与自适应预算分配实现高效长视频理解，在极低 token 预算下兼顾近期细节与长程事件证据，并具备跨架构与多骨干的通用性。

Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture.
