Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoCR是一个通用云去除模型，在单一网络中统一了RGB/多光谱、单/多时相、可选SAR引导等多种配置，通过冻结预训练RGB自编码器主干并扩展紧凑输入输出茎，配合共享潜在接口与流变换器实现跨数据集联合预训练，无需特定数据集微调即可直接推理或通过LoRA高效适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有云去除方法通常针对特定数据集和输入配置专门设计，难以在传感器、光谱波段和观测设置之间复用，缺乏通用性。

Method: 提出GeoCR通用模型：使用紧凑的输入输出茎扩展预训练RGB自编码器，同时冻结其编码器与解码器主干，以兼容不同光谱与传感域；通过共享潜在接口让单一流变换器联合建模干净RGB与非RGB潜在表示，并以独立的多云观测流和可选SAR令牌为条件。在十个数据集训练集（含883,331张无云目标图像）上进行联合预训练，学习跨异构配置的共享云去除先验；支持直接推理与LoRA低秩适配。

Result: 在全波段SEN12MS-CR、Sen2_MTC_New以及仅RGB的CUHK-CR2上取得最佳FID和DISTS，超越现有通用图像复原方法与云去除方法。

Conclusion: GeoCR证明了可复用生成模型在多样化云去除配置下的有效性，同一预训练权重可直接推理并高效适配新设置。

Abstract: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

</details>


### [127] [Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32513)
*Paulo Grane Gabriel Silva,Lorenz Bernard Marqueses,Joel Ilao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对手写数学表达式识别（HMER）中训练数据与真实相机拍摄图像之间的域差异，通过碎片化与笔画宽度分析刻画该差异，并提出面向特定书写者的微调流程（writer-adaptive fine-tuning），在MFH-CoMER模型上验证书写者自适应的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HMER的先进系统无法适应特定个人的书写风格；同时训练图像（数字化或完美二值化）与推理时相机拍摄图像之间存在域差异（domain gap），而这一问题在该任务中受到的关注较少。

Method: 1) 通过碎片化（fragmentation）和笔画宽度（stroke-width）分析刻画域差异；2) 在MFH-CoMER上引入书写者自适应微调流程；3) 构建作者专用数据集，包含来自两位作者的五个手写类别子集；4) 采用适用于小样本的McNemar检验与置换检验（permutation tests）进行评估。

Result: 对数字手写，表达式识别率提升、字符错误率（CER）下降；对物理（相机拍摄）手写结果不一，模型在基座模型已能良好评估的手写文章上表现吃力。尽管如此，自适应模型在五个子集中的四个上取得改进；统计检验显示其中两个作者专用子集的提升具有一致性。

Conclusion: 结果指向书写者自适应（writer adaptation）在HMER任务上的潜在可行性。

Abstract: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

</details>


### [128] [UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32518)
*Youssef Mansour,Enis Simsar,Fadime Sener,Markos Georgopoulos,Albert Pumarola,Ali Thabet,Edgar Schoenfeld*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UnStep——一种无需训练、即插即用的推理加速封装器，通过减少DiT步数、限制注意力KV缓存时间窗并配合两种质量恢复机制及运行时优化，将少步因果视频扩散模型推至实时生成（单H100达50 FPS、GB200达77 FPS）且无质量损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步因果视频扩散模型虽已比其教师模型（双向多步视频扩散Transformer）快很多，但在实时视频生成场景中仍然过慢；同时现有加速往往需要重新训练，代价高。

Method: 训练无关的推理封装：以少于蒸馏阶段的DiT步数运行，并限制注意力KV缓存中的时间窗口。为补偿质量损失，引入两种纯推理机制：(1) 对已生成的潜帧重新加噪至接近干净水平，并复用已有的clean-cache前向进行精修；(2) 对DiT注意力的value与output投影施加截断SVD。此外搭配质量保持的运行时栈优化，包括更高效的注意力调用与KV索引、融合Triton RoPE（缓存系数）、以及优化内存布局、精度和卷积核的VAE解码。

Result: 在单张H100上达到50 FPS，在GB200上达到77 FPS，显著快于现有方法，且无质量损失，全程无需重新训练。

Conclusion: 通过减少计算量并优化运行时栈，UnStep为因果视频扩散确立了新的吞吐量水平，实现免训练的实时流式视频生成。

Abstract: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

</details>


### [129] [SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32529)
*Jinlong Hu,Yi Zhang,Zhiqi Xia,Yikang Zhou,Shunping Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 setopd，从集合视角重构开放提示检测，用 BR 提示将视觉示例分解为 Base 锚点与残差修正，并在候选状态层面通过 PQA 实现显式的文本-视觉协作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放提示检测器对视觉模态利用不足：多个示例被压缩成单一类别级嵌入，导致视觉提示"文本化"，在仅有少量异质示例时表现欠佳；同时现有方法主要在提示或表示空间交互，早于模态特定检测状态的形成。

Method: 提出 setopd：共享提示条件初始化以保留模态特定的解码状态，并在候选状态级进行多模态协作。针对问题一，引入 BR 提示，令每个框选示例在其完整场景上下文中被读取，将池化支持证据分解为 Base 锚点与可学习残差修正，提示容量与示例数量无关，并驱动独立的视觉检测路径；针对问题二，将文本-视觉协作从表示级融合转为候选集合建模问题，由 Paired-Query Arbitration（PQA）在模态特定候选状态形成后进行跨模态状态仲裁。两个读取器共享查询初始化，候选按索引配对，学习门控在每对内仲裁，随后由置换等变模块对融合集合进行推理。

Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或定量结果。

Conclusion: 通过集合视角重新设计开放提示检测，可更充分地利用视觉模态：BR 提示避免视觉信息的文本化压缩，PQA 将跨模态协作推迟至候选状态层面，为开放提示检测提供了新的建模范式。

Abstract: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

</details>


### [130] [DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32534)
*Keyu Wang,Yangyi Huang,Jiale Kang,David González-Martínez,Weiyang Liu,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出受控基准 DepthBench，系统改变宽深比以检验不同架构能否把"架构深度"转化为"有效计算深度"。结果显示深度收益高度依赖架构：Pre-LN 及其多数归一化/缩放变体在深窄形态下收益有限甚至退化，而 HC 与 Full AttnRes 在极端深层形态下仍持续改进，说明残差连接设计是深度成为有效扩展轴的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度是提升 Transformer 计算容量的自然途径，但更深层贡献可能随深度增加而衰减。已有工作通过归一化（如 LayerNorm Scaling）或残差连接（如 mHC、AttnRes）改善信息流与深度利用，但尚不清楚这些方法是否真能把架构深度转化为有效计算深度，其收益是否来自更好的跨层信息访问，还是未被控制的混淆因素。

Method: 提出受控基准 DepthBench：在固定模型规模与预训练配方的前提下，将宽深比 d_model/n_layer 从"浅而宽"系统性变化到"深而窄"，对 10 种代表性架构进行对比评测，并辅以受控的层级分析（layer-level analyses）来考察各层利用情况。

Result: 把更多容量分配给深度的收益强烈依赖架构。标准 Pre-LN 及多数基于归一化和缩放的变体收益很小，且在模型更深更窄时性能可能下降；HC 与 Full AttnRes 即使在极深形态下也持续提升。这些收益不仅体现在预训练损失上，还稳定转化为下游领域性能与有效计算的提升。

Conclusion: 层级分析表明 HC 与 Full AttnRes 的收益与其对额外层更有效的利用相关，揭示不同架构实现计算深度的机制存在差异。总体而言，残差连接设计是决定深度能否作为有意义扩展轴的关键因素，它使增加的架构深度能够真正转化为有效计算。

Abstract: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

</details>


### [131] [Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32551)
*Dawei Guan,Di Yang,Jiangtao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRACE是一个连续潜空间框架，通过将身体、物体、手部分别编码为独立潜变量并耦合其更新，结合解码运动上的几何损失约束接触与相对运动，统一支持HOI生成、单流补全与理解任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本条件的人-物交互（HOI）生成需要身体动作、物体轨迹与旋转、手部关节三者协调一致。然而这些分量在尺度和动力学上差异显著，却必须在接触、相对位姿和时序上保持一致。共享表示会削弱各流独立结构，独立生成又使各流无法响应其他流的变化；仅靠潜空间监督也无法直接约束解码后的接触。

Method: 提出TRACE连续潜空间框架：将身体、物体、手部运动编码为独立潜变量，在保持各流状态分离的同时耦合其更新，即由完整当前交互状态预测每条流的速度；并在解码运动上施加几何损失，以约束接触和物体相对运动随时间的变化。同一模型支持从任意两条流补全缺失的第三条流；此外，冻结的流特征被输入语言模型以支持HOI理解。

Result: 在InterAct、OMOMO和BEHAVE数据集上，联合补全训练提升了生成效果，冻结流特征相比原始运动编码提升了理解性能。在InterAct上，TRACE在接触精确率、召回率和F1上均取得对比方法中的最高值。

Conclusion: 将身体、物体、手部建模为相互耦合的独立潜流，并以几何损失直接约束解码运动，能够同时提升HOI生成与理解性能，并统一支持单流补全，验证了分离表示与耦合更新范式的有效性。

Abstract: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.

</details>


### [132] [Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32555)
*Benjamin Hamm,Yannick Kirchhoff,Maximilian Rokuss,Moritz Langenberg,Constantin Ulrich,Tassilo Wald,Jeremias Traub,Karol Gotkowski,Klaus Maier-Hein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出动态分析潜在表征的DCE-MRI乳腺分类框架，在ODELIA与AMBL上显著超越基线，并获MICCAI ODELIA 2025挑战赛第一名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维4D输入、小病灶以及跨临床中心采集协议异质性，导致健康、良性、恶性病例的自动化分类难以稳健。

Method: 框架动态分析潜在表征以适配协议特性：通过抑制背景摄取混淆、补偿软组织形变导致的错位来缓解空间变异；利用跨期潜在空间关系选择最具信息量的时间特征；并通过大规模监督式病灶分割预训练提升任务特定判别特征。

Result: 在ODELIA数据集留一中心验证与独立AMBL队列上，较微调放射学基础模型及先前方法显著提升，mean AUROC较最强基线高近8点，balanced accuracy高4点。

Conclusion: 该方法在乳腺MRI分类稳健性上有效，获MICCAI ODELIA 2025挑战赛第一名，代码已开源。

Abstract: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor.

</details>


### [133] [CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32559)
*Peng Wang,Haohan Zou,Yanlin Wu,Xueshuo Xie,Yan Wang,Tao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CFCH粗-细协同层次学习框架，通过双分支结构建模解剖区域与疾病语义的层次依赖，并构建最大公开前节图像数据集AS-9K（8975张，12类），在两个数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前节疾病分类对眼科筛查与诊断至关重要，但裂隙灯图像因成像条件差异大、且疾病本身存在"解剖区域—疾病表现"的内在层次结构而难以分析。现有方法多将其视为扁平多分类问题，忽略了角膜、结膜、晶状体等解剖区域与疾病表现之间的结构化依赖关系。

Method: 提出CFCH（Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning）框架：采用双分支架构，显式建模解剖上下文与疾病语义；引入语义注意力一致性与跨粒度注意力一致性约束，实现跨粒度的协同学习，促使两分支学习到既对齐又互补的特征。同时构建AS-9K数据集，含8975张图像、覆盖12种常见疾病类别。

Result: 在两个前节图像数据集上的大量实验表明CFCH优于当前最先进方法；定性可视化显示其激活响应更聚焦、更贴近病灶区域，验证了框架有效性。AS-9K为目前最大的公开前节图像分类数据集。

Conclusion: 通过层次化双分支与跨粒度一致性约束，可有效利用解剖-疾病层次结构提升前节疾病分类性能；AS-9K数据集为该任务提供了大规模公开基准，代码将于GitHub开源。

Abstract: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease manifestations.To address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH.

</details>


### [134] [Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32567)
*Yu-Feng Yen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在完整COCO-Val（5000图，27273检测）上系统诊断LLM+开放词表检测器（OVOD）流水线中CAAP与SNAP分化的成因，发现分化主要源于词表新颖性——尤其是新颖措辞指向与COCO标注不同的物体时——以及COCO闭集标注的非穷尽性，而非真实定位失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LAOD等零训练LLM+OVOD流水线中，类别无关定位精度（CAAP）与语义命名精度（SNAP）持续分化，但此前无人探究原因；且原始工作仅在小子集上评估，结论的代表性存疑。

Method: 在完整COCO-Val划分（5000张图像、27273个检测）上复现并拆解CAAP与SNAP。先检验物体视觉复杂度（小目标、遮挡）是否为分化驱动因素；再检验词表新颖性，将新颖措辞细分为真同义词与语义无关的"噪声"标签分别统计；并进一步分析定位失败子集，区分幻觉与COCO 80类非穷尽标注导致的漏标；最后通过替换检测器骨干（YOLO-World vs. Grounding DINO）和LLM（Gemma-3 vs. Qwen2.5-VL）做稳健性验证。

Result: 物体视觉复杂度并非驱动因素：小目标与遮挡目标的定位反而优于大目标。词表新颖性是关键：措辞超出检测器原生类别集时，定位准确率从80.9%降至31.6%；且该下降分布极不均匀——真同义词仍达89.3%，语义无关"噪声"标签仅12.0%，即几乎全部下降来自新颖措辞实际指代与COCO标注不同的物体。在进一步失败子集中，78%–88%看似完全定位失败实为模型正确找到COCO非穷尽80类方案从未标注的真实物体，而非幻觉。更换检测器骨干或LLM后，该效应及其大致幅度均保持稳定。

Conclusion: CAAP–SNAP差距的很大一部分可归因于闭集标注的固有局限，而非真实的grounding失败；这属于该流水线家族的普遍性质，而非某一模型组合的特例。该结论对grounded多模态系统在开放世界中的幻觉检测、失败模式分析与评估设计具有重要影响。

Abstract: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing. The upshot is that a large share of the apparent CAAP--SNAP gap traces back to closed-category annotation limits rather than a real grounding failure, which matters for how we detect hallucination, analyze failure modes, and design evaluation for grounded multimodal systems meant to work in the open world.

</details>


### [135] [OmniSmartHome: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Smart-Home Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32569)
*Jihoo Jung,Suho Yoo,Jeongsoo Choi,Hyebin Cho,Tae Wook Haam,Hyeonggon Ryu,Sumin Park,Joon Son Chung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniSmartHome——一个多模态智能家居基准，将语音指令与视觉和空间音频上下文配对，以解决语言指代不充分的问题；并给出 PROME 基线智能体，通过程序化记忆编排音视频感知工具，在 16 个 Omni-LLM 上验证了多模态上下文推理的显著性能下降及 PROME 的普遍提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实智能家居交互中，用户常借助周围多模态上下文（指向物体、指代所见所闻）表达需求，导致语言本身欠明确；而现有基准仅以纯语言形式表达请求，忽视了依赖上下文的真实请求，多模态消歧能力未被充分探索。

Method: 构建 OmniSmartHome 基准，每条语音请求均配有视觉与空间音频上下文，作为消歧的互补线索；数据包含 1360 个合成片段与 272 个真实场景片段。评测 16 个全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM），并提出简单智能体基线 PROME（PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering），为智能体配备专用音视频感知工具及程序化记忆，用于编排工具调用流程。

Result: 当语音本身足以传达意图时，Omni-LLM 表现较强；但当需要依据多模态上下文线索进行推理时，性能显著下降。PROME 在六个 Omni-LLM 上总体均带来性能提升。

Conclusion: 现有全模态模型在多模态上下文消歧方面仍有明显不足，OmniSmartHome 为这一方向提供了评测平台，PROME 式的工具编排与程序化记忆是有效的改进路径。演示与样例见 https://omni-smart-home.github.io。

Abstract: Smart-home assistants are expected to handle diverse, realistic requests that arise in daily life. In such interactions, users often rely on the surrounding multimodal context-pointing at objects or referring to what they see or hear, leaving their requests underspecified in language alone. Existing smart-home benchmarks, however, express user requests solely through language, leaving context-dependent real-world requests underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSmartHome, a multimodal smart-home benchmark where each spoken request is paired with the surrounding visual and spatial-audio context, providing complementary cues to disambiguate underspecified requests. OmniSmartHome comprises 1,360 synthetic and 272 real-world episodes. We evaluate 16 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) and reveal that, while they perform strongly when speech alone sufficiently conveys the user's intent, performance drops substantially when resolving it requires reasoning over multimodal contextual cues. As a simple agent baseline, we provide PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering), which equips agents with specialized audio-visual perception tools and procedural memory for orchestrating their use. PROME generally improves performance across six Omni-LLMs. Demos and examples are available at https://omni-smart-home.github.io

</details>


### [136] [SPACE: Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction for Streaming Video Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32592)
*Hongjin Niu,Weizhan Zhang,Shuo Bao,Jiahao Wang,Muyan Jiao,Kairui Wen,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将固定容量流式视频内存的驱逐决策建模为预测状态空间中的反事实控制问题，提出SPACE方法，利用冻结的多步JEPA预测不同驱逐动作诱发的未来表示，并构建MABS-Bench评估预测状态的漂移、响应性与恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频内存驱逐策略主要以保留信息量或下游任务精度为评价指标，忽视了反复驱逐更新如何改变内存所支撑的"未来"（即预测状态），缺乏对长期累积效应的考察。

Method: 作者定义内存的预测状态为被保留历史所支撑的未来表示，将驱逐视为该空间状态转移的反事实控制。提出SPACE（Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction），使用冻结的多步JEPA预测备选驱逐动作诱导的未来表示；以反事实效用识别对未来有用的备选方案，以慢速预测盆地几何判断何时纠正可避免漂移、何时适应持续性预测变化，且无需在线参数更新。同时提出MABS-Bench，在匹配的因果流与内存预算下评估未来任务充分性、同机制内预测稳定性、转移响应性与扰动恢复。

Result: 在多个视频数据集上，SPACE在数据集原生任务性能上取得一致提升，同时降低了预测状态漂移。

Conclusion: 将驱逐决策置于预测状态空间的反事实控制框架下，可在不更新在线参数的情况下实现更稳定的未来任务支撑，表明"预测状态"是评估与设计流式视频内存的有效视角。

Abstract: Fixed-capacity streaming video memory requires repeated eviction decisions whose effects accumulate over time. Yet existing policies are evaluated primarily in terms of retained information or downstream accuracy, leaving how repeated updates alter the futures supported by memory largely unexamined. We define a memory's predictive state as the future representations supported by its retained history and formulate eviction as counterfactual control over transitions in this space. We introduce SPACE (Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction), which uses a frozen multi-horizon JEPA to predict the future representations induced by alternative eviction actions. Counterfactual utility identifies future-useful alternatives, while slow predictive-basin geometry determines when to correct avoidable drift and when to adapt to sustained predictive change, without online parameter updates. We further introduce MABS-Bench, which evaluates future-task sufficiency, within-regime predictive stability, transition responsiveness, and perturbation recovery under matched causal streams and memory budgets. Across multiple video datasets, SPACE yields consistent improvements in dataset-native task performance while reducing predictive-state drift.

</details>


### [137] [GAUGE: Group-Wise View-Inconsistency Rectification for Feed-Forward 4D Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32596)
*Zhuoqian Feng,Weixing Chen,Ziliang Chen,Yang Liu,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出前馈单目视频3D轨迹模型的全局对齐残差集中于视线方向且呈分组尺度差异，提出免训练、模型无关的后处理模块GAUGE，利用方向一致性分组并从少量度量锚点估计每组每帧的径向尺度与平移，显著降低端点误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈模型直接从单目视频回归稠密3D点轨迹，但全局对齐后的残差很大且缺乏结构性解释，现有方法未阐明误差来源，也难以有效消除该系统性误差。

Method: 测量发现残差沿视线方向集中、不同运动组所需尺度修正不同；利用预测位移方向可可靠分组（中位夹角远小于90°随机基线），将残差归结为每组径向自由度，即"分组视线不一致"。GAUGE从方向一致性与空间连通性恢复运动组，再借助1%~5%度量锚点估计每帧径向尺度与组级平移，每组每帧四个自由度，属免训练、模型无关的事后校正。

Result: 在八种跟踪器（含D4RT、4RC、SM4RT）的动态查询点上，GAUGE将端点误差较未校正预测降低15.1%~62.6%；而相同锚点用于梯度微调仅改善-1.1%~15.2%。

Conclusion: 系统性残差可解释为运动组级别的视线方向径向自由度，GAUGE以极少量锚点、免训练方式高效校正，显著优于同等监督下的微调，代码已开源。

Abstract: Feed-forward models regress dense 3D point trajectories directly from monocular video, yet the residual after global alignment is substantial and lacks a structural explanation. Measured on dynamic query points across models and datasets, the error concentrates along the view direction, while the scale correction each motion group requires differs. The predicted displacement direction nevertheless supports reliable grouping, with a median angle far below the 90° random baseline. The systematic part of the residual is therefore a family of radial degrees of freedom per motion group, along directions 2D observations cannot constrain. We call it group-wise view inconsistency. We present GAUGE (Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation), a training-free and model-agnostic post-hoc module. It recovers motion groups from direction consistency and spatial connectivity, then estimates a per-frame radial scale and group-level translation from 1% to 5% metric anchors, four degrees of freedom per group and frame. On dynamic query points of eight trackers, including D4RT, 4RC and SM4RT, our correction lowers endpoint error by 15.1% to 62.6% over the uncorrected predictions, while spending the same anchors on gradient fine-tuning improves the same models by only -1.1% to 15.2%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE.

</details>


### [138] [Levy-Driven Correspondence Estimation for Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32612)
*Qianliang Wu,Jiaqi Yang,Wankou Yang,Le Hui,Jin Xie,Jian Yang,Yaqing Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LevyMatch 提出用 Levy 随机跳跃驱动的软匹配矩阵迭代精化方法,并设计前置 Gamma 时钟策略,在低重叠与非刚性形变点云匹配上取得更优精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当点云重叠度低或发生非刚性形变时,建立可靠的点对应关系十分困难。迭代精化虽可修正不确定匹配,但网络评估代价高昂,限制了更新次数,因此需要在有限评估次数下提升每次更新的有效性。

Method: 方法以软匹配矩阵为状态,每步由网络结合当前匹配状态与几何信息预测目标匹配矩阵;利用布朗参考桥给出朝目标更新的显式公式,并用 Gamma 随机时钟为每次更新设定时间步;更新后的匹配为下一步目标预测提供新的几何反馈。此外提出固定的前置 Gamma 策略,在不重训练、不增加网络评估的前提下,给早期更新分配更多期望时钟时间。通过重排同一组 Gamma 增量验证了“大增量前置”优于后置。

Result: 在 4DMatch 和 4DLoMatch 上,方法在非刚性特征匹配召回率(NFMR)和内点比(IR)上均优于对比方法。前置策略在 4DMatch 上达到 93.09% NFMR 与 92.11% IR,在 4DLoMatch 上达到 82.79% NFMR 与 79.07% IR。

Conclusion: Levy 驱动的随机跳跃精化配合前置 Gamma 时钟策略,可在不增加网络评估成本的情况下显著提升低重叠、非刚性点云匹配的召回率与内点比,且时间步分配顺序对精度有明确影响。

Abstract: Finding reliable point correspondences is difficult when point clouds have low overlap or undergo non-rigid deformation. Iterative refinement can correct uncertain matches, but costly network evaluations limit the number of updates. We present LevyMatch, a Lévy-driven method that uses random jumps to refine a soft matching matrix. At each step, a network uses the current matching state and geometric information to predict a target matching matrix. A Brownian reference bridge gives an explicit formula for the update toward this target. A Gamma random clock sets the time step for each update. The updated matches provide new geometric feedback for the next target prediction. We further propose a fixed front-loaded Gamma policy that assigns more expected clock time to early updates and less to later ones, without retraining or extra network evaluations. Reordering the same sampled Gamma increments shows that placing larger increments early gives higher accuracy than placing them late. On 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch, our method improves both non-rigid feature matching recall (NFMR) and inlier ratio (IR) over the compared methods. The front-loaded policy achieves 93.09% NFMR and 92.11% IR on 4DMatch, and 82.79% NFMR and 79.07% IR on 4DLoMatch.

</details>


### [139] [DraftAttention2: Fast Video Diffusion with Low-Resolution-Guided Mixed-Precision Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32628)
*Rui Ding,Haopeng Li,Weize Ma,Yufa Zhou,Yitong Li,Xiaoling Zhou,Jiashuo Cao,Liyang Li,Hua Geng,Jiuxiang Gu,Jun Lin,Enze Xie,Xuan Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的DraftAttention2框架，利用低分辨率草稿注意力图联合进行注意力块选择与数值精度分配，在视频扩散生成中实现更优的质量-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成中，扩散Transformer随分辨率和时长增加，时空token上的注意力计算代价急剧上升，亟需在保持生成质量的同时降低注意力开销。

Method: 使用低分辨率草稿注意力图，通过空间2D平均池化与最大池化查询和键捕捉互补的区域统计以估计块重要性；共享排序在可配置预算下对重要块分配高精度、对保留的次要块分配低精度、跳过其余块。理论分析将稀疏化误差与注意力加权量化误差解耦，界定用低比特恢复被跳过交互何时收紧输出误差上界。工程上开发融合操作数准备与单一精度分阶段注意力核，跨精度共享数据搬运、softmax统计与输出累加。

Result: 实验表明该方法相比现有高效视频生成方法取得更优的质量-效率权衡；在少步视频扩散中优势尤为显著，联合稀疏与4/8比特混合精度计算显著提升生成质量并保持明显加速。

Conclusion: 通过草稿注意力引导的块级稀疏与混合精度协同设计，配合融合核实现，可在视频扩散生成中获得更好的质量-效率权衡，尤其利于少步扩散场景。

Abstract: Video generation has broad applications in content creation and entertainment. Diffusion transformers have advanced the quality of generated videos, but attention over spatiotemporal tokens becomes increasingly expensive as video resolution and duration increase. We present DraftAttention2, a training-free framework that uses the low-resolution draft attention map to jointly select attention blocks and assign their numerical precision. Specifically, spatial 2D average- and max-pooled queries and keys capture complementary regional statistics to estimate block importance, and a shared ranking assigns higher precision to important blocks, lower precision to less important retained blocks, and skips the rest under configurable budgets. Our analysis separates sparsification error from attention-weighted quantization error, establishing when recovering skipped interactions with low-bit computation tightens the output-error bound. This analysis motivates retaining more interactions at low precision while reserving higher precision for blocks with larger attention mass. To translate these fine-grained assignments into practical speedups, we further develop fused operand preparation and a single attention kernel with precision-specific phases, sharing data movement, softmax statistics, and output accumulation across precisions. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a superior quality-efficiency trade-off over existing efficient video generation methods. Notably, its advantage is particularly pronounced for few-step video diffusion, where jointly combining sparsity with 4- and 8-bit mixed-precision computation substantially improves generation quality while retaining significant acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/anemoi-project/anemoi

</details>


### [140] [InterTab: Interleaved Visual-Structure Alignment for Multi-Modal Table Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32660)
*Hanqian Li,Sirui Huang,Chen Ling,Jungang Li,Yu Huang,Kening Zheng,Yonghua Hei,Xiangrong He,Shiyi Wang,Pengcheng Zhu,Dongnan Liu,Wei Zhou,Linjian Mo,Nai Ding,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 InterTab 框架，通过将思维链与结构对齐的表格区域裁剪工具调用交错进行，实现表格图像的结构感知推理，在九个基准上平均准确率从 68.28% 提升至 73.17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格图像保留的结构信息在文本序列化中常丢失，对表格图像推理需逐步定位相关行、列和单元格。现有多模态大模型在推理前一次性编码整张图像，无法在推理过程中按需获取行、列、单元格级证据；编码器端表格结构与通用交错视觉思维链也未能将每步推理与该结构绑定。

Method: 提出 InterTab——面向表格图像思维链推理的交错结构感知框架，将思维链与裁剪结构对齐表格区域的工具调用交错进行。构建 InterTab-22K 数据集，其推理轨迹每一步都绑定结构位置与边界框。两阶段训练：监督式结构对齐（SSA）在 InterTab-22K 上教会模型以结构对齐裁剪交错推理；主动定位优化（ALO）进一步优化答案正确性、定位 IoU 与输出格式，并惩罚缺失或过多的工具调用。

Result: 在九个表格基准上，InterTab 将其骨干模型平均准确率从 68.28% 提升至 73.17%，并在所有对比方法中取得最佳平均性能。

Conclusion: 结构对齐的裁剪工具调用与推理过程的交错，能有效增强多模态大模型对表格图像的结构级推理能力；代码与数据将开源。

Abstract: Table images preserve structural information that are often lost in text serialization, and reasoning over them requires locating relevant rows, columns, and cells step by step. Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode the whole image once before reasoning, so they cannot pick up row-, column-, and cell-level evidence as the question unfolds. Encoder-side table structure and generic interleaved visual chain-of-thought still do not bind each reasoning step to that structure. We propose \textbf{InterTab}, an \textbf{Inter}leaved structure-aware framework for CoT reasoning over \textbf{Tab}le images, interleaves chain-of-thought with tool calls that crop structure-aligned table regions. First, we build InterTab-22K, includes reasoning trajectories in which each step is tied to both a structural location and a bounding box. InterTab is trained in two stages: supervised structure-aware alignment (SSA) on InterTab-22K teaches the model to interleave reasoning with structure-aligned crops, and active localization optimization (ALO) further optimizes answer correctness, localization IoU, and output format, while penalizing missing or excessive tool calls. Experiments on nine table benchmarks show that InterTab improves the average accuracy of its backbone from 68.28% to 73.17% and achieves the best average performance among all compared methods. Code and data will be released soon.

</details>


### [141] [RCVLA: 4D Radar-Grounded Semantic Reasoning and Trajectory Arbitration for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32681)
*Lianqing Zheng,Xiaokai Bai,Yixuan Luo,Runwei Guan,Minghao Liu,Zhiqiang Wei,Hui-liang Shen,Xichan Zhu,Zhixiong Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出4D雷达-相机VLA框架RCVLA，并构建Cap4DR对齐预训练数据集与OmniHD-QA指令微调数据集，通过语义推理阶段与轨迹仲裁阶段实现雷达-语言对齐及雷达测量引导的轨迹优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D雷达提供的几何与运动线索可补充视觉语义，但将其集成进VLA模型需要同时解决两个问题：一是雷达-语言对齐以支持语义推理，二是显式利用雷达测量进行轨迹精修与选择。现有工作缺乏相应数据集与统一框架来支撑这两种能力。

Method: 1）数据：构建Cap4DR（86,016雷达-图像-文本样本，用于对齐预训练）与OmniHD-QA（520,161问答对，覆盖场景描述、关键物体推理、占据理解、轨迹规划）。2）RCVLA框架：RCVLA-Sem在相机与雷达token间进行门控双向交互，用于驾驶问答与参考轨迹生成，并以辅助头输出物体与占据查询；RCVLA-Phys以这些查询和簇级雷达测量为条件，通过截断扩散精修参考引导的轨迹候选，并用雷达推导的TTC风险校准候选分数。

Result: 在OmniHD-QA上，RCVLA-Sem相比OmniDrive将CIDEr提升9.92分，关键物体速度误差降低21.9%。RCVLA-Phys进一步相对RCVLA-Sem将平均L2误差从0.348 m降至0.259 m，平均开环碰撞率从0.576%降至0.175%。消融实验表明语言对齐的雷达token改善语义推理，簇级雷达测量与风险校准改善轨迹仲裁。

Conclusion: 雷达-语言对齐与显式雷达测量在VLA中具有互补价值：前者提升语义推理，后者提升轨迹仲裁质量，二者结合可显著提升驾驶问答质量与轨迹安全性。代码将开源。

Abstract: 4D radar provides geometric and motion cues that complement visual semantics, but integrating it into vision-language-action (VLA) models requires both radar--language alignment for semantic reasoning and explicit use of radar measurements for trajectory refinement and selection. To support these capabilities, we construct Cap4DR with 86,016 radar-image-text samples for alignment pretraining and OmniHD-QA with 520,161 question-answer pairs for instruction tuning across scene description, key-object reasoning, occupancy understanding, and trajectory planning. Building on these datasets, we propose RCVLA, a radar-camera VLA framework consisting of a radar-grounded semantic reasoning stage (RCVLA-Sem) and a trajectory arbitration stage (RCVLA-Phys). RCVLA-Sem performs gated bidirectional interaction between camera and radar tokens for driving question answering and reference trajectory generation, while auxiliary heads provide object and occupancy queries. RCVLA-Phys refines reference-guided trajectory candidates through truncated diffusion conditioned on these queries and cluster-level radar measurements, then calibrates candidate scores using radar-derived time-to-collision risk. On OmniHD-QA, RCVLA-Sem improves CIDEr by 9.92 points and reduces key-object velocity error by $21.9\%$ relative to OmniDrive. RCVLA-Phys further reduces average L2 error from $0.348$ to $0.259\,\mathrm{m}$ and average open-loop collision rate from $0.576\%$ to $0.175\%$ relative to RCVLA-Sem. Ablation studies further show that language-aligned radar tokens improve semantic reasoning, while cluster-level radar measurements and risk calibration improve trajectory arbitration. Code will be released.

</details>


### [142] [MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32690)
*Jintao Tong,Yujing Lou,Zhanming Shen,Jiaqi Gu,Lubin Fan,Ruixuan Li,Yue Wu,Jieping Ye,Yixiong Zou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现多模态大模型用符号化视图（caption/code）替代图像后性能反而提升10.2%–23.6%，称为"符号视觉差距"，并提出MM-OPD框架（符号到视觉的多模态on-policy自蒸馏）来修复感知到推理之间的证据选择瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前MLLM默认"感知→推理"过程是无缝衔接的，并分别强化感知与推理能力。但作者观察到反直觉现象：在模型、问题、解码固定时，用caption或code等符号视图替换图像会使性能显著提升。这说明尽管感知与推理本身能力不错，感知与推理之间仍存在瓶颈——即如何把感知到的视觉信息选为后续推理的恰当证据。作者称之为Symbolic Visual Gap。

Method: 1) 实验观察：图像输入模型的推理轨迹中虽已出现正确视觉证据，但符号视图输入模型对正确证据的注意力显著更高，说明瓶颈在于"证据选择"。2) 由于符号视图能引导注意力且可规模化获得，可作为无需人工标注证据的监督信号。3) 提出MM-OPD：多模态on-policy自蒸馏框架，进行符号到视觉的纠正，通过残差token级目标将符号条件行为中的指导迁移到图像条件策略，引导模型关注正确视觉证据。

Result: 在多个基准和不同模型规模上，MM-OPD在广泛的多模态能力上取得提升，包括视觉感知、图表与文档理解、数学推理以及通用VQA。

Conclusion: MLLM存在感知与推理之间的证据选择瓶颈（Symbolic Visual Gap）。利用符号视图作为无标注监督信号，通过on-policy自蒸馏（MM-OPD）将符号条件的注意力引导迁移到图像条件策略，可有效纠正视觉证据选择，全面增强多模态能力。

Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning. However, we observe a counterintuitive phenomenon that challenges this assumption: holding the model, question, and decoding fixed, we replace images with their caption or code representations (symbolic views), which seems to be redundant given the clear image structures, but the performance surprisingly improves by 10.2% to 23.6% across model scales and datasets. We term this performance gap as the Symbolic Visual Gap and then take a closer look at it. Through experiments, we find that although the visual evidence can already appear in the reasoning trace for the image-input model, the symbolic-view-input model shows much higher attention to the correct evidence than the image-input model. This suggests that despite good capabilities from current works in perception and reasoning themselves, another bottleneck exists between perception and reasoning in selecting perceived visual information as appropriate evidence for subsequent reasoning. To handle this bottleneck, since the symbolic view steers attention toward correct evidence and is readily obtained at scale, it provides supervision for evidence selection without manually labeled evidence. Building on this, we introduce MM-OPD, a multimodal on-policy self-distillation framework for symbolic-to-visual correction that transfers guidance from symbolic-conditioned behavior to the image-conditioned policy through residual token-level targets, steering the model toward correct visual evidence. Experiments across benchmarks and model scales show that MM-OPD improves a broad range of multimodal abilities, with gains in visual perception, chart and document understanding, mathematical reasoning, and general VQA.

</details>


### [143] [DPAMixerSR: An Efficient Degradation-Pattern-Aware Model for Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32705)
*Song-Li Wu,Haonan Jiang,Jixuan Fan,Yufei Huo,Chubin Zhang,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DPAMixerSR，一种退化模式感知的图像超分框架，通过自适应稀疏计算实现高效超分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内容自适应超分方法主要关注纹理复杂度，忽略内在退化因素（如模糊核、噪声模式），导致计算分配与重建性能不够理想。

Method: 设计轻量级感知退化排序（PDR）模块，将图像划分为严重退化与轻度退化块，分别路由至自适应稀疏处理（ASP）分支和轻量卷积分支。ASP执行结构对齐的多尺度稀疏传播与双向细化，卷积分支提升轻度退化区域的效率。

Result: 在多种超分任务上的大量实验表明，DPAMixerSR在显著降低计算开销的同时，实现了更优的结构恢复与感知保真度。

Conclusion: 通过退化驱动路由与结构对齐稀疏处理的耦合，DPAMixerSR建立了自调节框架，为退化感知、资源高效的超分提供了新颖且可扩展的范式。

Abstract: While content-adaptive schemes have delivered notable advances in image super-resolution (SR), existing approaches typically focus on texture complexity and ignore intrinsic degradation factors (e.g., blur kernels or noise patterns), leading to suboptimal computation allocation and reconstruction performance. To remedy this, we propose DPAMixerSR, a degradation-pattern-aware framework that enables efficient SR through adaptive sparse computation. We design a lightweight Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) module partitions the image into severely and mildly degraded patches, which are routed to the Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) and a lightweight convolutional branch, respectively. ASP performs structure-aligned, multi-scale sparse propagation and bidirectional refinement, while the convolutional branch enhances efficiency in mildly degraded regions. By coupling degradation-driven routing with structure-aligned sparse processing, DPAMixerSR establishes a self-regulating framework that dynamically balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments on various SR tasks demonstrate that our DPAMixerSR achieves superior structural restoration and perceptual fidelity with markedly reduced computational overhead, providing a novel and scalable framework for degradation-aware, resource-efficient SR.

</details>


### [144] [ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32711)
*Ugo Leone Cavalcanti,Fabio Tosi,Matteo Poggi,Andrea Conti,Vladimir Zlokolica,Valerio Cambareri,Stefano Mattoccia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProDyGS：单目静态相机视频下的动态3D高斯泼溅框架，通过深度引导代理图像合成生成合成多视角监督，在DyNeRF数据集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态3D高斯泼溅方法依赖多视角拍摄或显著相机运动来获取几何约束，而单目静态相机视频中多视角监督完全缺失，导致几何约束不足、难以重建动态场景。

Method: 提出ProDyGS框架：用基础单目深度网络估计时间一致的深度图；据此构建3D高斯表示并从任意视角生成代理图像，形成合成的多视角监督；再用变形网络通过在该增广监督下对规范高斯进行形变（warping）来学习时序动态。

Result: 在DyNeRF数据集上取得最先进（SOTA）性能，且仅需单目深度估计作为外部监督，优于依赖场景流等更强先验的方法。

Conclusion: 无需多视角采集或大范围相机运动，仅凭单目深度先验即可实现高质量动态场景新视角合成，降低了对强先验与多视角设置的依赖。

Abstract: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.

</details>


### [145] [Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32716)
*Zhiyuan Ji,Junjun Yin,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出区域-局部copula证据融合方法，在保留区域决策结构的同时引入空间变化的局部依赖异常以提升遥感变化检测的定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超像素copula模型为异质遥感变化检测提供稳定的区域级证据，但每个区域单一标签限制了混合超像素内部的定位能力，因此需要引入局部信息来细化区域内的变化判定。

Method: 独立拟合局部模型以刻画与未变化跨图像关系的偏离，采用参考排序与上尾门控将这些异常转化为可融合形式，并与连续的区域置信度融合；推导了区域相关的局部决策阈值，并给出门控等价于无门控融合重参数化的条件。

Result: 在Lake与UK数据集上，整图优化配置分别取得kappa 0.78136与0.90817，并改善混合区域与边界决策；十训练子集的四折回顾性空间验证证实局部信息的互补性，无门控参考融合使平均kappa分别提升0.00693与0.01793；固定门控在UK提升更大达0.03353，而Lake仅0.00041。

Conclusion: 结果支持区域-局部依赖交互的有效性，同时表明校准与门控的收益具有场景依赖性，需根据具体场景选择是否启用门控策略。

Abstract: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.

</details>


### [146] [REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32734)
*Aleksandr Gushchin,Khaled Abud,Georgii Bychkov,Ekaterina Shumitskaya,Artem Filippov,Sergey Lavrushkin,Dmitriy S. Vatolin,Anastasia Antsiferova*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出REALIS数据集（143万真实/合成图像，来自42个现代文生图模型），并配套REALIS-Expert压力测试子集与涵盖35种变换、5个严重等级的鲁棒性协议，用于统一评测AI图像检测器在生成器迁移与后处理扰动下的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测基准中，真实图像与合成图像在内容、质量或生成伪影上存在系统性差异，检测器易依赖数据集特定线索（shortcut），在面对未见过的生成器或经过处理的图像时性能大幅下降。现有数据集难以在多样视觉内容上联合评估这些挑战。

Method: 构建REALIS数据集：1.43M真实与合成图像，覆盖42个现代文生图模型（含最新专有系统）；通过由真实图像导出的提示词、质量过滤与分层采样来削弱类别特定捷径，同时保留内容多样性。进一步构建REALIS-Expert压力测试子集，使真实与合成样本在语义和视觉特征上紧密匹配。提出鲁棒性协议，涵盖35种图像变换、5个严重等级。基于该基准评测预训练检测器、微调模型以及零样本视觉-语言模型在生成器迁移与后处理迁移下的表现。

Result: 在最难的经处理划分上，最佳预训练传统检测器仅取得0.550 ROC-AUC，而最佳经REALIS训练的检测器达到0.752 ROC-AUC，显示出显著性能差距。

Conclusion: REALIS为在更贴近真实使用场景的条件下衡量并提升AI图像检测器的可靠性提供了统一框架。

Abstract: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REALIS combines prompts derived from real images, quality filtering, and stratified sampling to reduce class-specific shortcuts while preserving content diversity. We further introduce REALIS-Expert, a stress-test subset for high-quality synthetic images, where real and generated samples are selected with closely matched semantic and visual characteristics. We also propose a robustness protocol covering 35 transformations at five severity levels to analyze detector behavior under image processing. Based on REALIS, our benchmark evaluates pretrained detectors, fine-tuned models, and zero-shot vision-language models under generator and post-processing shifts. On the hardest processed split, the best pretrained conventional detector achieves 0.550 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.752 for the best REALIS-trained detector. REALIS provides a unified framework for measuring and improving the reliability of AI-image detectors under conditions that better reflect real-world use.

</details>


### [147] [Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32737)
*Dongdong Wang,Deepak Balakrishnan,Ravi Srinivasan,Shenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出梯度引导解耦适配框架G2DA，通过跨模态解耦、模态专属课程学习和双向回放，解决多任务Geo-VLM优化中的异构梯度问题，在24组基准-模型组合上一致超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地理空间视觉语言模型（Geo-VLM）采用统一多任务适配范式，未显式考虑任务间异构的优化特性。实证发现任务间存在视觉-语言差异、分支内梯度关系及任务干扰等异构梯度特征，阻碍了有效的多任务优化。

Method: G2DA为梯度感知的多任务优化框架，包含三步：①通过梯度引导的跨模态解耦，将任务划分为视觉中心与语言中心两组；②基于任务梯度相似性构建模态专属课程；③采用双向回放缓解顺序优化带来的近因效应。

Result: 在三个Geo-VLM基准上，使用六个InternVL3与Qwen3.5-VL变体，以及GeoChat和GeoLLaVA进行评估。全部24组基准-模型组合中G2DA均优于代表性基线，在UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite、VRS-Bench-VQA上分别较最强竞争者提升3.08、4.30、2.81个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果验证了梯度引导的任务组织对Geo-VLM适配的有效性，为多任务地理空间视觉语言模型优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.

</details>


### [148] [AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32740)
*Ziwei Huang,Qi Gao,Zhe Ji,Yuanyuan Yao,Fengjiang Zhang,Min Yan,Zhongle Xie,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 AnesTRACE 评测套件（含 AnesTRACE-Bench 与 AnesTRACE-Eval），系统评估术中麻醉的多模态证据解读、及时决策与状态变化的决策修正能力，覆盖感知、单点决策与多步决策任务，并结合麻醉医师定义标准评估临床正确性、证据支撑、任务完整性与安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术中麻醉需要系统解读动态演变的多模态证据、给出及时管理建议，并随患者状态变化修正决策；然而现有基准多将感知与单点推理割裂评估，缺乏对纵向、多步、安全与时序一致性的综合考察。

Method: 构建 AnesTRACE-Bench，基于公开围术期数据集并由麻醉医师标注，评测术中感知、单点麻醉决策与多步麻醉决策三类任务；构建 AnesTRACE-Eval，按麻醉医师定义的临床正确性、证据支撑、任务完整性与安全性标准评估开放式回答，并对多步决策引入时序一致性；其领域专用评估器通过监督微调与偏好对齐在专家审核判断上训练。

Result: 在30余个模型上，细粒度视觉定位与干预选择仍是难点：领先模型TEE视觉定位仅达32.2 mIoU，多步管理中仍有17.5%的重大/危重安全错误率；评估器与麻醉医师的一致性在两个训练阶段均提升，而最佳决策质量伴随74.3秒的P95延迟。

Conclusion: 仅凭聚合性能无法证明安全、及时的纵向决策能力；需从感知定位、安全性、时序一致性与延迟等多维度综合评估术中麻醉智能系统。

Abstract: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE.

</details>


### [149] [LoCoVSR: Local Context Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Video Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32742)
*Matan Ben Chorin,Michael Elad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoCoVSR：基于像素空间扩散模型与时空上下文学习的视频超分框架，局部窗口+共享噪声轨迹，避免光流估计与潜空间信息损失，实现长视频并行推理与无误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频超分是病态逆问题，需从带噪低分辨率视频重建高分辨率视频。现有方法依赖显式光流估计或潜空间处理，前者增加复杂度，后者导致信息损失；同时递归处理易造成误差累积并限制长视频处理。

Method: LoCoVSR采用像素空间去噪扩散概率模型，将扩散后验采样（DPS）与时空上下文学习结合，以滑动平均形式运行：用相邻低分帧的局部窗口重建每个中心帧，并对所有帧施加共享噪声轨迹。局部窗口化支持长视频无长度限制处理、并行推理，并防止递归误差累积。

Result: 在VFHQ人脸数据集上训练，LoCoVSR实现准确、时序一致且高质量的上采样，性能与近期基于扩散的视频超分方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: LoCoVSR是一种简单而有效的视频超分方案，避免了显式光流估计和潜空间处理带来的信息损失，兼具长视频处理、并行推理与抗误差累积的优点，在扩散式VSR中具有竞争力。

Abstract: Video super-resolution (VSR) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) video from a noisy, low-resolution (LR) version of it. We present LoCoVSR, a diffusion-based VSR framework that leverages pixel-space denoising diffusion probabilistic models. LoCoVSR integrates the Diffusion Posterior Sampling technique with spatio-temporal context learning, operating in a moving-average form. A localized window of adjacent LR frames is used for recovering each center frame, while applying a shared noise trajectory across all frames. The localized windowing enables processing of long videos without length limitations, supports parallel inference, and prevents error accumulation that may occur in recursive processing. Unlike prior methods, LoCoVSR offers a simple yet very effective VSR solution, avoiding explicit optical flow estimation, or information loss caused by latent space processing. Trained on the VFHQ face dataset, LoCoVSR achieves accurate, temporally consistent and high-quality upscaling with competitive results against recent diffusion-based VSR approaches.

</details>


### [150] [From Feed-Forward to Flow: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation Is Easier Than You Think](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32761)
*Haoru Wang,Qianfan Shen,Kai Ye,Wenzheng Chen,Baoquan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出统一的流匹配（flow-based）框架，将重建与生成纳入同一共享的干净目标预测器：单步端点做直接重建，多步流展开做条件生成，并在外观与几何两类3D任务上实例化为JiT-LVSM与JUSt3R。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间世界模型（如Atlas）说明统一重建与生成价值巨大，但二者长期处于分离范式且失效模式各异：前馈重建将歧义平均为模糊，条件生成则编造合理但与场景不一致的细节。

Method: 提出统一的flow-based重建与生成公式化：共享一个clean-target预测器，单步端点即直接重建，多步流推理实现条件生成；并用受控玩具实验揭示机制——单步时预测器塌缩到条件均值（偏一致性、少多样性），多步时生成细节的保真度随上下文丰富度（观测接近程度）提升而提高。随后在3D外观与几何任务中实例化。

Result: JiT-LVSM在新视角合成中提升感知与分布质量；JUSt3R保持有竞争力的单步几何预测，并具备额外多步推理能力，可减少veil与flying-pixel伪影，在更多测试时计算下产生更干净的表面结构。

Conclusion: 重建与生成可以共享同一公式化与同一骨干网络，其行为由去噪配置（单步/多步）决定，说明统一二者出乎意料地简单。

Abstract: Reconstruct where the images provide evidence, and generate where they do not: recent success of spatial world models such as Atlas (World Labs Team, 2026) highlights the value of unifying reconstruction and generation in one model. Yet the two have long lived in separate paradigms with distinctive failure modes: feed-forward reconstruction averages ambiguity into blur, while conditional generation invents plausible but scene-inconsistent detail. In this work, we present a unified flow-based formulation for reconstruction and generation, where a shared clean-target predictor performs direct reconstruction at its single-step endpoint and unfolds conditional generation through multi-step flow. A controlled toy study reveals the mechanism: with a single step, the predictor collapses to the conditional mean just like feed-forward methods, favoring consistency over diversity. With multi-step inference, the fidelity of generated details grows with context richness: closer observations reduce ambiguity and yield better-matched details. We further instantiate the formulation in appearance and geometry 3D tasks. JiT-LVSM improves perceptual and distributional quality in novel view synthesis, while JUSt3R retains competitive single-step geometry prediction with additional multi-step inference capabilities that reduces veil and flying-pixel artifacts, producing cleaner surface structure with greater test-time compute. Together, they show that reconstruction and generation can share both a formulation and a backbone, with their behavior governed by denoising configuration---making unification surprisingly simple.

</details>


### [151] [OmniMoE-VL: A Sparse Vision-Language Model with Coupled Visual-Depth Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32780)
*Long Qian,Bingke Zhu,Jiaqi Wei,Yingying Chen,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OmniMoE-VL，一种带耦合视觉深度路由投影器的稀疏视觉语言模型，通过为每个图像-提示对稀疏选择中间视觉深度，并复用全局偏好同时引导局部patch融合与动态视觉注入，实现问题相关的视觉访问，在八个图像基准上以28B总参数/9B激活参数取得85.9平均分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏MoE视觉语言模型虽在语言侧扩展计算，但视觉信息通常只在经过固定跨模态接口后才被路由，导致一个关键决策未解决：对给定问题，应暴露哪些中间视觉表示给语言计算。固定接口无法实现问题相关的视觉访问。

Method: 设计耦合视觉深度路由投影器：对每个图像-提示对，稀疏选择一组中间视觉深度，并复用由此得到的全局偏好，同时指导（1）局部patch融合与（2）向语言模型的动态视觉注入。该设计在保留原生视觉token序列的同时实现问题相关的视觉访问，并与视觉、语言栈中的token级专家路由互补。

Result: 在八个图像基准上平均得分85.9，总参数28B、激活参数9B。受控对比显示，路由视觉接口带来主要架构增益；匹配的路由与组件控制、同图路由分析及路由干预进一步支持耦合与问题条件化视觉访问的价值。

Conclusion: 将视觉深度路由与局部融合、动态注入相耦合，是稀疏VLM中有效的架构选择，问题条件化的视觉访问优于固定跨模态接口，并可与token级MoE路由叠加。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly use sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to scale language-side computation, yet visual information is typically routed only after passing through a fixed cross-modal interface. This leaves an important decision unresolved: which intermediate visual representations should be exposed to language computation for a given question? We introduce OmniMoE-VL, a sparse VLM with a coupled visual-depth routed projector. For each image-prompt pair, the projector selects a sparse set of intermediate visual depths and reuses the resulting global preference to guide both local patch fusion and dynamic visual injection into the language model. This design enables question-dependent visual access while preserving the native visual-token sequence, and complements token-level expert routing in the vision and language stacks. Across eight image-based benchmarks, OmniMoE-VL achieves an average score of 85.9 with 28B total and 9B activated parameters. Controlled comparisons show that the routed visual interface provides the dominant architectural gain, while matched route and component controls, same-image route analysis, and route interventions further support the value of coupling and question-conditioned visual access.

</details>


### [152] [CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32781)
*Long Qian,Bingke Zhu,Jiaqi Wei,Yu Li,Yingying Chen,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出反事实轨迹在线策略蒸馏（CT-OPD），将完整教师回答与当前学生模型的轨迹掩码相结合，实现在学生自身揭示决策路径上的连贯token级监督，显著提升扩散视觉语言模型的多模态理解与推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型通过逐步解析被掩码的token来生成答案，因此在部分解析状态下的条件预测能力对后训练至关重要。然而现有方法存在两难：对完整答案施加掩码虽能获得连贯的上下文与目标，但预设掩码无法反映模型自身的揭示决策；而基于轨迹的方法虽捕捉了这些决策，其临时可见token却可能与目标回答相冲突。基于结果强化学习虽能沿轨迹训练，却只提供回答级反馈，当采样奖励相同时会丧失对比信号。

Method: CT-OPD结合完整教师回答与来自当前学生模型的轨迹掩码。具体而言：将每条教师回答按学生词表重新分词，并在学生反向过程的各个阶段提取未解析位置的掩码；对每个掩码，丢弃临时rollout值，从教师端点重建部分状态，使受监督位置遵循当前轨迹，而可见上下文与目标保持与同一回答一致；学生以原生分类损失在这些重建状态上训练，并随模型演进刷新轨迹。

Result: 在稠密与稀疏扩散架构上，CT-OPD持续增强多模态理解与推理能力，在九个基准平均分上提升最高达9.80分。在统一理解与生成架构上，同时改善视觉理解与图像生成，表明同一原理可跨架构与模态迁移。消融实验进一步将增益归因于连贯重建与当前模型轨迹掩码。

Conclusion: CT-OPD通过将连贯的token级监督与模型自身的揭示决策对齐，有效解决了扩散视觉语言模型后训练中掩码与轨迹不一致的问题，在多架构、多模态任务上验证了其通用性与有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion vision-language models generate answers by gradually resolving masked tokens, making accurate conditional prediction in partially resolved states central to post-training. Masking completed answers yields coherent contexts and targets, but prescribed masks do not reflect the model's reveal decisions. Its trajectories capture these decisions, yet their provisional visible tokens can conflict with the target response. Outcome-based reinforcement learning follows these trajectories but provides only response-level feedback, which loses contrast when sampled rewards tie. To align coherent token-level supervision with the model's reveal decisions, we introduce Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD), which combines completed teacher responses with trajectory masks from the current student. CT-OPD retokenizes each teacher response in the student's vocabulary and extracts unresolved-position masks at successive stages of the student's reverse process. For each mask, it discards provisional rollout values and reconstructs the partial state from the teacher endpoint, so the supervised positions follow the current trajectory while the visible context and targets remain consistent with the same response. The student is trained on these reconstructed states with its native categorical loss, and trajectories are refreshed as the model evolves. Across dense and sparse diffusion architectures, CT-OPD consistently enhances multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, with gains of up to 9.80 points on the nine-benchmark average. On the unified understanding-and-generation architecture, it also improves both visual understanding and image generation, showing that the same principle transfers across architectures and modalities. Ablations further attribute these gains to coherent reconstruction and current-model trajectory masks.

</details>


### [153] [Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Compression of Implicit Geometric Representations for Large-Scale Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32789)
*Manlin Yao,Jiabin Liu,Guan Wang,Haixu Liu,Hui Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个统一的点云隐式表示与压缩框架，结合隐式几何场、层级频域压缩与条件高频预测，在超八百万点的复杂点云上实现了优于现有方法的压缩比且重建质量相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模复杂几何点云的显式表示带来极高的计算与内存开销，因此需要压缩的隐式表示来降低存储与计算成本，同时尽量保留精细几何细节。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 隐式几何场表示：将无序点云映射到其物理包围盒内定义的隐式场；(2) 层级频域压缩：构建平滑傅里叶金字塔，用紧凑的低频分量捕获全局几何，并对尺度间高频残差编码以保留重建细节所需的空间信息；(3) 条件高频预测：设计层级三维神经网络恢复压缩中丢失的高频信息，最后通过等值面提取将重建的隐式场转回点云。

Result: 在包含超过800万点的复杂边界点云上实验表明，该方法在保持与现有方法相当重建质量的同时，取得了更高的压缩比。

Conclusion: 该隐式场+频域层级压缩+高频预测的统一框架可有效压缩大规模复杂点云，在压缩效率上优于现有方法并维持可比的重建质量。

Abstract: Large-scale point cloud representations of complex geome tries incur prohibitive computational and memory costs, necessitating compressed implicit representations. To ad dress this, we propose a unified framework comprising im plicit geometric field representation, hierarchical frequency domain compression, and conditional high-frequency predic tion. Specifically, an unordered point cloud is mapped to an implicit field defined within its physical bounding box. A smooth Fourier pyramid is then constructed, where com pact low-frequency components capture the global geometry. Inter-scale high-frequency residuals are encoded to preserve the spatial information required for reconstructing fine geo metric details. To restore the high-frequency information lost during compression, we develop a hierarchical 3D neural net work. The reconstructed implicit field is converted back into a point cloud through isosurface extraction. Experiments on a complex-boundary point cloud with more than eight mil lion points demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a higher compression ratio than existing point cloud compres sion methods while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [154] [Latent Space Is Not Flat: Rethinking Latent Structure for 3D Medical Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32794)
*Haowen Xue,Hao Chen,Hexuan Hu,Qian Huang,Yi Han,Qing Meng,Zaipeng Xie,Chao Li,Haoli Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示潜空间几何的强各向异性并集中于低秩子空间，提出 Latent Structure Flow (LSF) 显式建模潜空间结构，在3D医学图像合成任务上优于所有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜生成模型在压缩空间中生成3D医学图像虽高效，但其隐含的平坦欧氏假设并不准确：潜空间几何高度各向异性，等幅误差会导致差异巨大的解码失真。作者进一步发现这种各向异性具有明确特征——敏感变化集中于低秩子空间，因此需要显式建模该结构。

Method: 作者提出 Latent Structure Flow (LSF)。在每个模块中将潜状态分解为结构分量与残差分量：主低秩成分编码长程、空间协调的整体结构且对局部噪声不敏感（可用全局上下文建模其变化）；正交残差主要刻画局部、图像特异变化（局部预测）；同时为输入结构保留直接通路。方法仅修改生成器，冻结的编解码器与逐点训练目标保持不变。

Result: 在跨模态合成与肿瘤修复两类任务上，LSF 在全局指标和肿瘤特异指标上均超越所有比较基线。

Conclusion: 实验表明，显式建模潜空间结构对3D医学图像合成具有显著收益；低秩结构/残差的非对称分解是一种有效的生成器设计原则。

Abstract: Latent generative models make 3D medical image synthesis computationally practical by generating in a compressed space. However, we show that the common flat Euclidean assumption induced by $\ell_2$ objectives is imprecise: latent-space geometry is so strongly anisotropic that equal-magnitude errors can produce drastically different decoded distortions. We further find that this anisotropy has a clear feature: sensitive variation concentrates in a low-rank subspace. The dominant low-rank components capture the overall structure, encoding long-range, spatially coordinated variation while remaining resistant to local noise. Its orthogonal residual, in contrast, mainly captures local and image-specific variation. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Latent Structure Flow (LSF). At each block, LSF decomposes the latent state into structure and residual, models structural changes with global context, and predicts residual variation locally while preserving a direct path for the input structure. LSF changes only the generator, leaving the frozen codec and pointwise training objective unchanged. Across cross-modality synthesis and tumor inpainting tasks, LSF outperforms all compared baselines on both global and tumor-specific metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling latent-space structure for 3D medical image synthesis.

</details>


### [155] [Progressive Risk Estimation for Accident Anticipation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32811)
*Samet Hicsonmez,Eray Çakar,Nermin Samet,Fatma Güney*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PRE-ACT框架，将事故预判建模为随事故临近而持续上升的风险信号，显式建模时序顺序与距事故距离，并引入Separation Score评估风险曲线的全局行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事故预判方法多将其视为二分类任务，只关注"是否会发生事故"，而忽略"何时发生"，难以刻画事故临近过程中的风险动态变化，也无法有效抑制正常驾驶中的误报。

Method: PRE-ACT将事故风险建模为连续演化的信号；通过显式强制时间排序（temporal ordering）与距事故距离感知（distance-to-accident awareness），使风险在接近事故时逐步升高并抑制过早报警；另提出Separation Score指标，用于评估预测风险曲线在局部时间窗之外的全局行为。

Result: 在MM-AU子集与Nexar数据集上取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 将事故预判从二分类重构为连续风险信号建模是一种有效方案，能兼顾提前预警与误报抑制；Separation Score为风险曲线的全局质量提供了新的评估视角。代码与可视化已开源。

Abstract: Accident anticipation aims to recognize anomalous driving cues before a crash while avoiding false alarms during normal driving. Existing approaches typically formulate this task as binary classification, focusing on whether an accident will occur rather than when it will occur. We propose PRE-ACT, a framework that models accident risk as a continuously evolving signal that increases as the crash approaches. By explicitly enforcing temporal ordering and distance-to-accident awareness, our method progressively raises risk while suppressing premature alarms, leading to significant improvements on MM-AU subsets and Nexar. We further introduce a Separation Score to evaluate the global behavior of predicted risk curves beyond local temporal windows. Code and visualizations are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/PRE-ACT.

</details>


### [156] [USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32813)
*Dongdong Wang,Qingqi Song,Yuzhou Chen,Deepak Balakrishnan,Ravi Shankar Srinivasan,Shenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 USAI-Quant，首个面向建成环境指标的定量遥感推理基准，覆盖美国335个最大城市，通过三级复杂度VQA评测发现现有VLM在数值推理任务上普遍不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在城市与空间AI中应用广泛，但在遥感影像的定量推理上仍存在明显短板。已有基准与算法多基于定性VQA，难以有效评估VLM对建成环境指标的定量推理能力，因此亟需一个定量化的评测基准。

Method: 构建 USAI-Quant 基准：从美国335个最大城市采集高分辨率遥感影像，并与建成环境定量指标对齐；随后对通用VLM与遥感VLM（RS-VLM）进行评测，针对数十个建成环境指标设计三个复杂度层级的VQA任务。

Result: 当前最先进的VLM在数值推理任务上普遍表现不佳、持续未达预期。进一步从模型、问题类型和地理位置等维度开展深入分析，揭示了性能差异性与任务特定挑战。

Conclusion: 现有VLM在遥感影像的定量推理上仍存在显著差距，USAI-Quant为定量评估建成环境指标推理能力提供了首个基准，并为后续模型改进与评测研究提供依据。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.

</details>


### [157] [Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32824)
*Krzysztof Marcin Choromanski,Derek Long,Ananya Parashar,Dwaipayan Saha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EGGroW——一类高效测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离计算方法，借助GenusSink与随机特征理论实现熵正则化Sinkhorn式求解，并应用于3D姿态估计与3D模板检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein距离（GWD）可定量比较定义在不同度量空间上的概率分布，在图匹配、3D目标检测等应用中潜力巨大。然而其实际规模化应用受限于涉及稠密空间内距离矩阵的立方时间复杂度。尽管欧氏度量空间中已有可扩展核方法等技术，但针对流形上一般测地距离或图的离散最短路距离，尚无类似技术。

Method: 提出EGGroW（Efficient Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein）算法族，利用熵正则化的Sinkhorn式方法计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离；方法结合新近提出的GenusSink方法与随机特征理论。在3D模板检测中将部分3D模板恢复建模为分阶段问题：先进行容量约束的场景选择，再进行模板可见性与对应关系的半松弛恢复。

Result: 实验表明EGGroW在标准欧氏方法失效时仍能给出准确解，且计算开销小，与理论分析一致。

Conclusion: EGGroW为一般测地/图距离下的Gromov-Wasserstein问题提供了高效求解途径，适用于3D姿态估计与3D模板检测等下游任务，兼具准确性与轻量计算特性。

Abstract: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.

</details>


### [158] [VCRE-Fib: View-Conditioned Regional Evidence for Fine-Grained Ultrasound Grading of Schistosoma japonicum-Associated Liver Fibrosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32840)
*Ziyang Xu,Shuli An,Hao Zhou,Haitian Zhong,Tingting Wu,Tao Wang,Kun Yang,Tieyong Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VCRE-Fib 框架，将解剖视图条件、区域定位证据与全局评估融合，用于日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化的细粒度超声分级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化的准确评估对疾病管理和长期随访至关重要。超声虽无创，但局部回声模式与解剖结构复杂，细粒度分级困难；现有深度学习方法虽能预测纤维化评分，却难以在保留可供检查的空间信息的同时，将采集视图与区域线索直接纳入分级。

Method: VCRE-Fib 为视图条件化区域证据框架，融合解剖上下文、局部信息与全局图像评估。其在空间池化之前形成视图条件化的局部分级证据，利用弱定位引导证据聚合，并与全局预测结合。仅用图像推理即可同时输出纤维化评分、采集视图和候选异常区域图。

Result: 在来自 35 个中心、6,373 名患者的 108,709 张超声图像再整理队列上开发与评估。在来自 4 个中心、240 名患者的 4,107 张患者不重叠测试集上，相比 SFibAI，复合分级风险相对降低 7.115%；图像级平均绝对误差从 0.391 降至 0.378，患者最大值、患者中位数及中心平衡风险亦更低。完整模型的风险低于分别去除视图条件化或弱定位的变体。

Conclusion: 结果支持在超声分级中纳入解剖上下文与区域证据，并在给出严重度估计的同时输出可供检查的空间预测。

Abstract: Accurate assessment of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis is essential for disease management and long-term follow-up in endemic regions. Ultrasound provides non-invasive imaging, but complex local echogenic patterns and anatomical structures make fine-grained grading challenging. Existing deep learning methods can predict fibrosis scores, yet directly incorporating acquisition views and regional cues into grading while retaining spatial information for inspection remains an open problem. Here we present VCRE-Fib, a view-conditioned regional evidence framework that integrates anatomical context, local information, and global image assessment for fine-grained ultrasound grading. The framework forms view-conditioned local grading evidence before spatial pooling, uses weak localization to guide its aggregation, and combines it with global predictions. Image-only inference jointly returns a fibrosis score, acquisition view, and candidate abnormal-region map. We developed and evaluated the method on a re-curated cohort of 108,709 ultrasound images from 6,373 patients across 35 centers. On a patient-disjoint test set of 4,107 images from 240 patients across four centers, VCRE-Fib reduced the prespecified composite grading risk by 7.115% relative to SFibAI trained and evaluated on the same data split. Image-level mean absolute error decreased from 0.391 to 0.378, alongside lower patient-max, patient-median, and center-balanced risks. The full model also achieved lower composite grading risk than variants that separately removed view conditioning or weak localization. These results support incorporating anatomical context and regional evidence into ultrasound grading while exposing spatial predictions for inspection alongside severity estimates.

</details>


### [159] [Beyond Temporal Smoothing: Spatial Energy Budgets Stabilize One-Step Diffusion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32841)
*Shengxiao Zhou,Lei Luo,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BudEdit 将单步文本引导扩散编辑中的空间能量错配视为一种可测量的失效模式，把不可重复的残差场总能量转化为显式预算，并联合残差能量与交叉注意力重新分配到编辑相关区域，实现训练-free、反转-free 的稳定编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单步文本引导扩散编辑效率高，但更新在空间上易错配，导致被编辑对象扭曲、背景被改变。现有方法多通过在时间步上平均编辑场来提升稳定性，作者认为这掩盖了真正的问题：空间能量错配。

Method: 作者指出，在两次独立噪声采样下，残差场基本不可重复，因此背景场不可靠、无法直接用于传输，但其总能量仍能为当前采样设定可用的幅值。BudEdit 将该幅值变为显式预算，并依据残差能量与交叉注意力联合选择编辑相关区域，把预算重新分配到这些区域，而非在时间步上平均。该方法无需训练、无需反转，将预算用于传输，并在低噪声门控精修中复用该预算来缩放修正项。按构造，预算化注入场精确匹配规定预算，且在识别出的背景支撑上消失。

Result: 在 PIE-Bench 上使用 SD-Turbo 时，BudEdit 在各方法报告的默认设置下于全部 11 项评估指标上优于 ChordEdit：背景 PSNR 提升 2.1 dB、DINO 降低 31%、LPIPS 降低 36%，同时改善全部五项编辑质量指标，并在对比中报告了最低运行时间。

Conclusion: BudEdit 通过将空间能量错配显式建模为可测量失效模式，并以预算化注入场实现精确能量匹配与背景支撑上的零注入，在保持高效单步编辑的同时显著提升背景保持与编辑质量。

Abstract: One-step text-guided diffusion editing is efficient but prone to spatially misallocated updates that distort the edited object and alter the background. Existing methods often improve stability by averaging the editing field across timesteps. We instead identify spatial energy misallocation as a distinct and measurable failure mode: across two independent noise draws, the residual field is essentially unrepeatable, making the background field unreliable for direct transport, while its total energy still sets a usable magnitude for the draw at hand. BudEdit turns that magnitude into an explicit budget and reallocates it to edit-relevant regions selected jointly by residual energy and cross-attention, controlling where editing energy is spent rather than averaging over timesteps. The resulting training-free, inversion-free editor spends the budget on transport and reuses it to scale a correction in a lower-noise gated refinement. The budgeted injection field matches its prescribed budget exactly and vanishes on the identified background support, by construction. On PIE-Bench with SD-Turbo, BudEdit outperforms ChordEdit under each method's reported default settings on all 11 evaluated metrics, including a $2.1$\,dB gain in background PSNR, $31$\% lower DINO, and $36$\% lower LPIPS, while improving all five editing-quality metrics and reporting the lowest runtime in the comparison.

</details>


### [160] [SynCo: Learning Cross-Modal Synergy by Contrasting Interaction Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32846)
*Yavuz Yarici,Ghassan AlRegib*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SynCo，一种通过专门监督交互残差来解决多模态对比学习中协同信息训练不足问题的方法，以极低计算成本提升协同信息捕获。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准多模态对比学习目标主要捕获模态间的冗余信息。根据部分信息分解（PID），任务相关信息包含冗余、唯一性和协同三部分，但现有框架在实践中对协同信息的训练仍然不足。

Method: SynCo拟合一个线性投影器，从独立计算的单模态特征预测融合表示；所得交互残差剔除了线性可预测的单模态成分，并对其施加专门的对比监督，计算开销可忽略。该方法作为即插即用模块，不改变底层融合架构。

Result: 在受控的Trifeature基准上，SynCo实现最优协同信息捕获，较基线提升+5.98%；在MultiBench、DARai和MM-IMDb等真实基准上，跨多种模态组合与任务类型持续超越或持平现有方法，与其他方法结合还可进一步提升协同捕获。
