Conclusion: SynCo通过专门监督交互残差有效缓解协同信息训练不足问题，作为插件兼容现有对比多模态框架，并在合成与真实基准上验证了其有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Multimodal contrastive learning is a dominant paradigm for learning transferable representations from unlabeled data, but standard objectives primarily capture information that is redundant between modalities. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) shows that task-relevant information in multimodal data decomposes into three components: redundancy shared between modalities, uniqueness specific to each modality, and synergy available only from their joint observation. Recent frameworks extend contrastive learning to capture all three components, yet synergy remains undertrained in practice. We propose SynCo (Synergy Contrastive Learning), a method that directly addresses synergy undertraining through dedicated supervision on an interaction residual. SynCo fits a linear projector to predict the fused representation from independently computed unimodal features, and the resulting interaction residual, which removes the linearly unimodal-predictable component, receives dedicated contrastive supervision at negligible computational cost. On the controlled Trifeature benchmark, SynCo achieves state-of-the-art synergy capture with a $+5.98\%$ gain over the baseline, and on real-world benchmarks from MultiBench, DARai, and MM-IMDb, SynCo consistently outperforms or matches prior methods across diverse modality combinations and task types. The method operates as a plug-in to existing contrastive multimodal frameworks without modifying the underlying fusion architecture and can further improve synergy capture when combined with other methods.

</details>


### [161] [PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32856)
*Zeping Liu,Ni Lao,Weiwei Sun,Gil Wolff,Yiqun Xie,Liang Zhao,Junfeng Jiao,Gengchen Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyTopoBench，一个面向遥感图像矢量多边形生成的统一评测框架，重点考察含孔洞等复杂多边形，并对 11 种代表性方法进行基准测试，揭示复杂多边形生成仍是未解决的难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矢量多边形生成（将遥感图像等视觉输入转为矢量化多边形几何）在自动驾驶、矢量地图构建和遥感等应用中很重要。早期"预测栅格掩膜再后处理成多边形"的流程无法端到端优化，可能漏检小目标或产生不准确顶点；近期方法虽直接生成矢量多边形，但大多只针对简单外轮廓，要么无法表示带孔洞的复杂多边形，要么无法保持其拓扑结构。同时，该领域缺少统一、强调复杂多边形的评测基准。

Method: 提出 PolyTopoBench，一个从遥感图像生成矢量多边形的统一评测框架，显式强调复杂多边形。该框架同时评测外环与内环（孔洞）；在两个遥感图像数据集（涵盖建筑、道路、植被和无植被区域）上，对 11 种代表性方法进行基准测试，方法类别包括基于分割的多边形化流水线、视觉基础模型基线和专用矢量多边形生成器。

Result: 实验表明，现有方法通常能较好地恢复简单的外边界，但在带孔洞或多环的多边形上性能显著退化。

Conclusion: 这些结果揭示复杂多边形生成仍是一个未解决的挑战，并推动了拓扑感知的评测基准与模型设计。代码与数据已公开于 https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench。

Abstract: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing. Early pipelines predict raster masks and post-process them into polygons, which prevents end-to-end optimization and may miss small objects or introduce inaccurate vertices. Recent methods directly generate vector polygons, but most focus on simple exterior contours, while they either cannot represent complex polygons with holes or fail to preserve their topology. In this paper, we propose PolyTopoBench, a unified evaluation framework for vector polygon generation from RS images with explicit emphasis on complex polygons. PolyTopoBench evaluates both exterior and interior rings, and benchmarks 11 representative methods, including segmentation-based polygonization pipelines, vision foundation model baselines, and specialized vector polygon generators, on two RS-image datasets covering buildings, roads, vegetation, and unvegetated regions. Experiments show that existing methods often recover simple exterior boundaries but degrade substantially on polygons with holes or multiple rings. These results reveal complex polygon generation as an unresolved challenge and motivate topology-aware benchmarks and model designs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench.

</details>


### [162] [Is H&E Image-to-Spatial Transcriptomics Simpler Than It Looks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32857)
*Duc T. Nguyen,Thanh Ha Do,Phuong M. Cao,Hieu Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文从MSE预测误差结构出发，指出基因间平均表达差异主导了聚合性能，而真正未解决的误差在于切片内变异；据此提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL），其闭式仿射实例CGL-Linear在HEST-1k上取得SOTA，并同样可提升已有神经模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从常规H&E组织学图像预测空间基因表达是实现可扩展空间分子图谱的重要途径。近期研究倾向于使用越来越复杂的架构来捕捉空间上下文和更丰富的表达结构，但已有研究表明简单估计器在多个研究中表现强劲。因此，作者希望厘清：简单估计器已经解决了哪些问题，以及在哪些地方确实需要额外复杂度。为此，作者从MSE目标下的预测误差结构入手，分析误差来源，寻找真正未解决的瓶颈。

Method: 作者将MSE分解为切片级（slide-level）与切片内（within-slide）两个分量，并在受控神经实验中比较两者的参数量级敏感度（residual-normalized parameter sensitivity），发现切片内分量的残差归一化参数敏感度更低。基于这一观察，提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL），通过增加对切片内分量的监督来对齐训练目标与误差结构。其中CGL-Linear是CGL的闭式仿射实例，可解析求解。此外，将相同的切片内监督方式应用于已有神经模型。

Result: 基因间平均表达差异可解释聚合预测性能的相当一部分；关键未解决误差在于恢复每张切片内的变异。切片内分量的残差归一化参数敏感度低于切片级分量。CGL-Linear在HEST-1k各队列及不同基因面板规模上均达到总体SOTA性能；同一within-slide监督也能提升现有神经模型的表现。

Conclusion: 性能的显著提升可以来自让训练目标与预测误差结构对齐，而非单纯增加模型复杂度。该工作为空间基因表达预测提供了以误差结构为导向的损失设计思路，并表明简单闭式方法在该任务上具有强竞争力。

Abstract: Predicting spatial gene expression from routine H&E histology offers a scalable route toward spatial molecular profiling. Recent work has pursued increasingly sophisticated architectures to capture spatial context and richer expression structure. At the same time, simple estimators have shown strong performance in several studies, but what they already solve and where additional complexity is needed remain unclear. We study this behavior through the structure of prediction error under the mean-squared error (MSE) objective. Differences in average expression across genes can account for a substantial part of aggregate prediction performance, while a key unresolved error lies in recovering variation within each slide. Decomposing MSE into slide-level and within-slide components, we find that the within-slide component has lower residual-normalized parameter sensitivity in controlled neural experiments. This motivates Component-Guided Loss (CGL), which increases supervision of the within-slide component. CGL-Linear is a closed-form affine instantiation that achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across HEST-1k cohorts and gene-panel sizes. The same within-slide supervision improves existing neural models. These results suggest that substantial gains can come from aligning the training objective with prediction-error structure rather than increasing model complexity.

</details>


### [163] [SV2V-RSim: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Self-Selective V2V Cooperative Perception with Near-Realistic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32863)
*Yulu Wu,Chao Wei,Jujun Cheng,Zhangkai Ni,Haowen Wang,Dengyang Suo,Cong Chen,Xinyi Liu,Shangce Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出大规模多模态近真实V2V协同感知仿真数据集SV2V-RSim及自适应协作者选择模块SVA，在性能-带宽权衡上取得优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有V2V数据集存在参与车辆少、协作者选择策略固定、仿真与真实环境域差异大等局限，制约协同感知研究与落地。

Method: 基于Unreal Engine 5构建仿真器，融合高保真3D资产、多样环境与复杂交通场景；为自车一定范围内的所有车辆配备传感器套件，支持动态自适应协作者选择；并设计Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA)模块以平衡感知性能与通信带宽。

Result: 数据集覆盖4个地图、4种天气、从日出到夜晚6个时段，包含203K LiDAR帧、402K RGB帧、17类目标的788K 3D标注框；基准测试表明SVA实现更优的性能-带宽权衡，仿真到真实实验与无参考图像质量评估验证了数据集的高真实性与实用性。

Conclusion: SV2V-RSim可支持3D目标检测、分割、深度估计等协同感知任务，数据集与代码将公开，为V2V协同感知研究提供更真实、更大规模的基准平台。

Abstract: Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) cooperative perception enhances autonomous driving by enabling vehicles to share information beyond their direct line of sight. However, existing V2V datasets are limited by a small number of participating agents, static collaborator selection strategies, and a significant domain gap between simulated and real-world environments. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SV2V-RSim, a large-scale, multi-modal, near-realistic simulation dataset engineered to elevate agent diversity and realism. Additionally, we present the Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA) module, which optimizes collaborator selection to balance perception performance against communication bandwidth constraints. Our dataset is generated using the Unreal Engine 5-based simulator that integrates high-fidelity 3D assets, diverse environments, and intricate traffic scenarios. All vehicles within a specified range of the ego vehicle are equipped with sensor suites, enabling dynamic and adaptive collaborator selection. SV2V-RSim encompasses four maps, four weather conditions, six time periods from sunrise to night, 203K LiDAR frames, 402K RGB frames, and 788K annotated 3D bounding boxes across 17 object classes, supporting a range of cooperative perception tasks such as 3D object detection, segmentation, and depth estimation. Benchmarking on recent cooperative perception algorithms demonstrates that SVA achieves a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off, while sim-to-real experiments and No-Reference Image Quality Assessment validate the dataset's high realism and practical effectiveness. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [164] [Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32876)
*Yishu Zhang,Yun Li,Daiwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 病理基础模型在跨切片、跨机构比较时难以保持组织相似性，而通用多模态LLM在跨域组织学相似性判断上持续优于这些专用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型虽在百万级组织学图像块上训练，但跨切片或跨机构比较时无法保持组织相似性；标准域内评测无法发现这一临床危险的失败模式，因此需要揭示并量化该鲁棒性缺口。

Method: 提出相对相似性框架并发布MOSAIC（Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts）基准，在6个数据集上评测17个模型，检验病理编码器与通用多模态LLM在跨域组织学相似性判断上的表现差异，并通过扩展训练数据实验探究原因。

Result: 病理编码器常将同机构、不同疾病的图像块判为比同疾病、不同机构的图像块更相似，这一失败模式在域内评测中不可见；通用多模态LLM对此更不敏感；扩大训练数据并不能解决病理编码器的问题，指向学习目标而非数据覆盖度。

Conclusion: 当前病理基础模型存在根本性的鲁棒性缺口，多模态LLM可作为跨机构检索、数据集协调与多站点质量控制的可行替代方案。

Abstract: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across 6 datasets and find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations. LLMs appear less susceptible to this failure, likely because they perform semantic visual comparison of morphology and tissue architecture rather than relying on shortcut features tied to acquisition context. Scaling training data does not resolve the problem for pathology encoders, implicating the learning objective rather than data coverage. Our results expose a fundamental robustness gap in current pathology foundation models and establish multimodal LLMs as a viable alternative for cross-institutional retrieval, dataset harmonization, and multi-site quality control. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [165] [Improving Video Sparse Attention with Fine-grained Router and Sparse Rebasing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32882)
*Peiyuan Zhang,Guoqiang Wei,Yilong Zhao,Zixiang Zhang,Wei Zhou,Will Lin,Heng Zhang,Xiaonan Nie,Yan Zeng,Hao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VSA2：面向视频DiT的可训练稀疏注意力，通过细粒度路由器、难易课程与训练中替换全注意力，实现精度相当或更优的同时大幅加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频DiT中全注意力计算开销随序列长度急剧增长，成为训练与推理瓶颈。作者希望用可训练的稀疏注意力替代全注意力，在保持甚至提升生成质量的前提下降低计算量。前代VSA在稀疏精度与训练灵活性上仍有不足，因此需要新的架构与训练流程。

Method: 方法上，VSA2在架构上引入细粒度路由器（fine-grained router），提高关键token识别精度，并支持动态计算：每个query可关注可变数量的key-value对。训练方面提出Hard-to-Easy Curriculum：模型在高稀疏度下训练、推理时用较低稀疏度评估，不仅泛化良好，在运动质量上还优于全注意力训练模型。VSA2具备灵活性，可在低到高分辨率渐进预训练的中途替换全注意力，对早期全注意力检查点进行rebasing。该方法应用于DiT开发全周期，含预训练、RL与推理。

Result: 实验显示，VSA2相比VSA将注意力计算减少一半且损失更低。在720p视频上，相比FlashAttention-3基线，注意力加速8.9倍，端到端生成加速4.62倍，同时视频质量相当或更好。

Conclusion: VSA2是一种高效、可训练、可灵活集成的稀疏注意力方案，能在视频DiT中显著降低计算并加速生成，同时保持或提升质量，验证了稀疏注意力替代全注意力的可行性。

Abstract: We present VSA2, a frontier trainable sparse attention for video DiTs. VSA2 includes a variety of new architectural features and training procedures that we apply across all stages of the DiT development cycle, including pretraining, RL, and inference, to produce a DiT with comparable or better quality than a full attention counterpart. Architecturally, VSA2 introduces a fine-grained router that improves the precision of identifying critical tokens and supports dynamic computation by allowing each query to attend to a variable number of key-value pairs. In training, we identify a Hard-to-Easy Curriculum, where models trained under high sparsity and later evaluated with lower sparsity during inference not only generalize effectively, but also outperform models trained with full attention in motion quality. VSA2 is also flexible: it can replace full attention during the middle of progressive low-to-high resolution pretraining, rebasing early-stage full-attention checkpoints. Experiments show that VSA2 reduces attention computation by half over VSA with lower loss. On 720p videos, it accelerates attention by 8.9x and end-to-end generation by 4.62x compared to the FlashAttention-3 baseline, while achieving comparable or better video quality.

</details>


### [166] [Rethinking the Fully Hyperbolic Vision Transformer in Polar Coordinates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32899)
*Ahmad Bdeir,Niels Landwehr*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出极坐标全双曲Transformer块，避免洛伦兹环境坐标的数值不稳定，允许在大半径区域运算，在视觉任务上超越欧氏与双曲基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双曲空间因体积随半径指数增长可低失真嵌入层次结构，但现有洛伦兹Transformer块在环境坐标下公式化，洛伦兹内积在大半径处数值误差急剧增大，导致多数模型限制半径而无法利用真正激励该几何的空间区域。

Method: 以极坐标重访Transformer组件：距离计算与注意力质心在极坐标下可避免环境坐标的数值相消；提出极坐标全连接层，分别映射嵌入的方向与半径，使半径可被学习而非由线性映射范数决定；引入horospherical shifts作为相对位置编码，其查询-键距离随token间隔对数增长；将残差连接重构为平均半径洛伦兹boost。据此构建全双曲Transformer。

Result: 在标准视觉任务上显著优于欧氏与双曲基线；在ImageNet上验证，并可像欧氏对应模型一样利用预训练权重泛化到其他数据集。

Conclusion: 极坐标公式化消除了大半径数值不稳定性，使模型能利用双曲空间远离原点的区域，为构建可扩展、可迁移的全双曲Transformer提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Hyperbolic space can embed intrinsic hierarchies in data with low distortion due to the exponential growth of volume with distance from the origin. However, current Lorentz transformer blocks are formulated in ambient coordinates, where numerical errors increase at large radii due to instability in the Lorentzian inner product, leading many models to limit the radius to avoid this issue. This prevents us from utilizing the regions of hyperbolic space that motivate the geometry. To address this, we revisit the components of the transformer block in polar coordinates, where hyperbolic operations such as distance calculation and attention centroids can be computed without the numerical cancellation in their ambient-coordinate formulations. Specifically, we propose a polar fully connected layer that separately maps an embedding's direction and radius, allowing the radius of a feature to be learned rather than determined by the norm of a linear map. We additionally introduce horospherical shifts as relative positional encodings whose query-key distances grow logarithmically with the token gap. Finally, we reformulate the residual connection as average radius Lorentz boosts. Combining these components, we develop a fully hyperbolic transformer that substantially improves performance over Euclidean and hyperbolic baselines on standard vision tasks. We further evaluate our model on ImageNet and demonstrate its ability to generalize to other datasets using pre-trained weights, similar to Euclidean counterparts.

</details>


### [167] [Synthetic Thermal Image Generation for Real-Time Animal Detection Under Low-Visibility Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32944)
*James Momoh,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究合成热成像图像生成能否作为低能见度条件下实时动物检测的可扩展方案。基于NTLNP数据集的514张可见光动物图像，用CycleGAN-Turbo生成合成热成像图，并对60张真实热成像图进行热成像增广；在合成与真实热数据上分别训练YOLOv8/v9/v10和RT-DETR。结果显示合成热数据性能具竞争力（RT-DETR mAP@0.5达0.9613），增广真实热数据最佳（YOLOv10s mAP@0.5=0.9879、mAP@0.5:0.95=0.9571），轻量YOLO推理时延低，适合实时部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野生动物-车辆碰撞是重要的道路安全问题，夜间及低能见度条件下RGB感知系统不可靠，热成像是有前景的替代方案，但带标注的红外动物数据集稀缺，限制了鲁棒深度学习检测模型的发展。因此需要探索可扩展的数据获取途径。

Method: 1) 从NTLNP数据集选取514张已标注可见光动物图像，用CycleGAN-Turbo进行可见光到合成热成像的转换；2) 对仅60张真实热成像数据集进行面向热成像的增广；3) 在合成热数据与真实热数据上分别独立训练YOLOv8、YOLOv9、YOLOv10、RT-DETR多类检测架构；4) 以precision、recall、mAP@0.5、mAP@0.5:0.95、模型大小和推理时延作为评价指标。

Result: 合成热图像取得有竞争力的检测性能，RT-DETR在合成数据上达到最高mAP@0.5=0.9613；基于增广真实热数据训练的模型整体性能最强，YOLOv10s取得mAP@0.5=0.9879、mAP@0.5:0.95=0.9571。计算分析表明轻量级YOLO变体推理时延更优，具备实时部署潜力。

Conclusion: 合成热成像图像可降低对稀缺红外数据集的依赖，支持为未来车载野生动物碰撞缓解应用开发高效动物检测系统。

Abstract: Wildlife-vehicle collisions remain a significant road safety concern, particularly during nighttime and low-visibility conditions when RGB-based perception systems are often unreliable. Thermal imaging offers a promising alternative for detecting animals under poor illumination. However, the limited availability of annotated infrared animal datasets restricts the development of robust deep learning-based detection models. This paper investigates synthetic thermal image generation as a scalable approach for real-time animal detection under low-visibility conditions. A subset of 514 annotated visible-spectrum animal images from the NTLNP dataset is translated into synthetic thermal representations using CycleGAN-Turbo, while a limited real thermal dataset of 60 images is expanded through thermal-focused augmentation. Multiple object detection architectures, including YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and RT-DETR, are trained independently on synthetic and real thermal datasets and evaluated using precision, recall, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95, model size, and inference latency. Experimental results show that synthetic thermal images provide competitive detection performance, with RT-DETR achieving the highest synthetic-data mAP@0.5 of 0.9613. Models trained on augmented real thermal data achieve the strongest overall performance, with YOLOv10s obtaining 0.9879 mAP@0.5 and 0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95. Computational analysis further indicates that lightweight YOLO variants provide favorable inference latency, supporting their potential for real-time deployment. These findings demonstrate that synthetic thermal imagery can reduce dependence on scarce infrared datasets and support the development of efficient animal detection systems for future vehicle-mounted wildlife collision mitigation applications.

</details>


### [168] [DynamicDx: Evaluating Evidence Acquisition in Video-Based Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32957)
*Jiahui Li,Yutong Guo,Nan Yang,Wenzhan Song,Jin Lu,Fei Dou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynamicDx 基准表明，视频诊断增益主要来自视频触发的检查信息获取，而非征象识别或时序信息；提升检查开单质量是核心瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频诊断任务常被简化为“识别征象”，但真实诊断流程需要模型将所见转化为假设、提问与检查。作者希望厘清视频输入究竟在诊断链条的哪一环节产生增益，并定位瓶颈。

Method: 构建 DynamicDx 基准：71 例神经科会诊、覆盖 11 类征象，将真实患者视频与确诊结果、由同一病例报告构建的固定病历相结合，使所有模型查询相同证据。评估五个视觉-语言模型，并通过轨迹回放、帧打乱、检查结果供给等消融分析增益来源；同时测试两种干预：后训练的 4B 视频描述器与来源干净的文献检索。

Result: 视频输入较盲测提升准确率 9.9–22.5 个百分点；仅靠征象识别或时序顺序无法解释增益，帧打乱也无稳定精度损失。视频触发的检查结果贡献了大部分增益。补充决定性检查可将准确率提升至 73.2–93.0%。4B 视频描述器（尤其基于短时密集采样片段）改善征象描述，文献检索扩展初始假设，二者使模型开单的检查更接近临床医生记录，从而提升准确率。

Conclusion: 视频诊断中“看得更好”只有转化为“问得更好”（更准确的检查开单与证据获取）才能带来准确率提升；检查信息获取是当前瓶颈。

Abstract: Diagnosing a patient from video requires more than recognizing the sign: a vision-language model must turn what it sees into hypotheses, questions and tests. DynamicDx evaluates each step in 71 neurological consultations across 11 sign categories, linking authentic patient videos to confirmed diagnoses and fixed charts built from the same case reports, so that every model queries the same evidence. Across five such models, video improves accuracy by 9.9-22.5 percentage points over blind input, but neither recognition alone nor temporal order explains the gain: the cause is usually missing from the model's video-only differential diagnosis even when the sign is recognized, and shuffling the frames produces no reliable accuracy loss. Instead, a trajectory replay traces most of the gain to the investigation results the video prompts. Evidence acquisition is the bottleneck: supplying the decisive investigations raises accuracy to 73.2-93.0%. Two interventions act on it. A post-trained 4B video describer improves sign descriptions, especially from a short, densely sampled segment, and source-clean literature retrieval expands initial hypotheses; both bring the tests a model orders closer to those the treating clinicians documented and, through them, raise accuracy. For video-based diagnosis, seeing better helps when it leads to asking better.

</details>


### [169] [Distributed Hydrological Modeling in the Feature Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32971)
*Mohamad Hakam Shams Eddin,Maria Luisa Taccari,Yikui Zhang,Shijie Jiang,Juergen Gall,Markus Reichstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"特征空间路由"方法，将河网拓扑感知的状态空间算子嵌入深度学习预测动力学中，实现端到端、考虑上下游连通性的河道流量概率预报，在EFAS与观测数据上取得最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 河道流量与洪水预报困难，因河流动力学受蓄水、气象强迫和不同时空尺度的流量传播影响，需要跨越网格单元与流域的上下游分布式建模与演算。现有深度学习方法或忽略拓扑结构、或仅在集总流域上建模、或将预测物理量经独立的图模型/物理演算模型进行路由，未能将拓扑结构直接融入学习过程。

Method: 引入特征空间路由：一种拓扑感知的状态空间算子，直接嵌入预测动力学中。在每个预测步，算子从上游网格单元收集隐状态，并依据已知河网对下游状态进行因果更新。该方法在保留河系物理连通性的同时，使传播的状态本身可端到端学习，从而兼顾局部动态与邻近上游汇入贡献。为处理不确定性并提供概率预报，采用公平连续排序概率评分（fCRPS）作为训练目标。

Result: 在欧洲洪水预警系统（EFAS）与观测数据上的河道流量预报实验表明，将河网物理结构显式编码于特征空间可显著提升预报技巧，在无测站（ungauged）情形下尤为明显。方法在再分析数据与观测数据上均达到当前最优水平，可输出1弧分、6小时分辨率、最长10天预见期的河道流量空间分布图。

Conclusion: 将物理河网拓扑显式嵌入特征空间的预测框架，可有效提升河道流量与洪水预报能力，特别是在缺乏实测数据的区域，并支持高分辨率、长预见期的概率化流量制图。

Abstract: Accurate forecasting of river discharge and floods is very challenging. River dynamics are affected by storage, meteorological forcing, and flow propagation at different spatial and temporal scales. Forecasting thus requires a framework that considers the upstream-to-downstream flow through river networks across grid cells and catchments. This modeling is known in hydrology as distributed modeling and routing. Existing deep learning approaches either ignore this topology, operate on lumped catchments, or route predicted physical quantities through a separate graph or physical routing model. We instead introduce feature-space routing: a topology-aware state-space operator embedded directly in the forecasting dynamics. At every forecast step, the operator gathers latent states from upstream grid cells and causally updates the downstream state according to the known river network. This preserves the physical connectivity of the river system while allowing the propagated state itself to be learned end-to-end and allows the model to predict river discharge considering both local dynamics and neighboring upstream contributions. To address uncertainty and provide probabilistic forecasts, we minimize the fair continuous ranked probability score (fCRPS) as a training objective. Our experiments on the European Flood Awareness System (EFAS) and observational data for river discharge forecasting demonstrate that encoding the physical structure of river networks explicitly in the feature space substantially improves the forecasting skill, particularly in an ungauged setting. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on both reanalysis and observational data and is able to forecast maps of river discharge at 1 arcminute and 6-hourly resolution up to 10 days lead time.

</details>


### [170] [ReVision3D: Attribution-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement for 3D Medical Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32984)
*Ho Hin Lee,Yuyin Zhou,Yannan Yu,Shi Gu,Yifan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVision3D 是一个面向三维医学影像的递归自我改进（RSI）系统，利用带空间标注的体数据构建可精确重放的验证世界，将失败归因到采集、感知、训练或推理四个层级并递归改进。在腹部CT上，系统归因出"感知"为主要瓶颈，修正后达到肝脏召回79%、肾脏召回83%（每患者假阳性<0.4）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前医学影像智能体视觉能力有限，递归自我改进（RSI）是潜在突破路径。但将RSI用于体成像（volumetric imaging）面临困难：失败可能源自采集、感知、训练配方或下游推理等多个环节，而自生成反馈与日志轨迹无法指示究竟应修改哪个组件，导致改进缺乏方向性。

Method: 提出 ReVision3D：一个基于3D体数据与空间接地标注（spatially grounded annotations）的RSI系统。核心洞察是——带标注的体数据构成一个精确的可重放世界（exact replay world）：未访问视图可按需渲染，局部预测可直接与参考掩膜比对。系统由冻结的语言模型设计器提出对采集/感知/训练/推理的修改方案，验证器与系统级目标保持固定。接地反馈指导定向修正，仅保留超过实测种子噪声的改进；每次被接受的改动触发重新归因（renewed attribution），使主导瓶颈可跨轮次迁移。

Result: 在腹部CT上，归因分析识别出"感知"是剩余的主导性限制。对该层级进行修正后，ReVision3D 在每患者假阳性低于0.4的条件下实现肝脏召回率79%、肾脏召回率83%，优于所评估的冻结多模态基础模型，且在小病灶上增益最大。

Conclusion: 带空间标注的3D体数据可作为可重放的验证环境，为RSI提供接地反馈与可靠的改动筛选（噪声阈值）。通过递归归因定位主导瓶颈并逐层修正，能够有效提升三维医学影像智能体的视觉能力，并在小病灶检测上体现优势。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising path for overcoming the limited visual capability of current medical imaging agents. Yet applying RSI to volumetric imaging remains difficult: failures can arise from acquisition, perception, training recipe, or downstream inference, while self-generated feedback and logged trajectories provide little guidance on which component should change. We introduce ReVision3D, an RSI system that leverages 3D volumes with spatially grounded annotations to determine where visual evidence is lost and recursively improve the corresponding visual capability. A frozen language-model designer proposes revisions to acquisition, perception, training, or inference, while the verifier and system-level objective remain fixed. Our key insight is that an annotated volume forms an exact replay world for view rendering and spatial verification: unvisited views can be rendered on demand, and localized predictions can be checked directly against reference masks. This grounded feedback directs targeted revision, while only changes that improve beyond measured seed noise are retained. Each accepted change triggers renewed attribution, allowing the dominant bottleneck to shift across rounds. On abdominal CT, attribution identifies perception as the dominant remaining limitation. Revising that level enables ReVision3D to achieve 79% liver recall and 83% kidney recall at under 0.4 false positives per patient, outperforming the evaluated frozen multimodal foundation models, with the largest gains on small lesions.

</details>


### [171] [Oracle Gaps in Reliability Coverage: Sampling Noise or Policy Specialization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32996)
*Mert Onur Cakiroglu,Mehmet Dalkilic,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出用"可靠性覆盖率(reliability coverage)"与两类置换检验, 检验多策略间"表观专业化(oracle gap)"是否真实, 并说明即便存在真实oracle优势也未必带来部署收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一基座模型训练出的多个策略看似能解决不同问题, 于是"为每题选最优策略"的oracle会显得远强于任一单策略。但直接取最大估计成功率会同时选中有利的采样误差, 导致表观专业化被高估。作者希望在投入路由(router)等部署成本之前, 先判断这种专业化是否真实存在。

Method: 核心概念为可靠性覆盖率: 成功概率达到给定阈值的问题占比, 用oracle gap(覆盖率之差)度量优势。设计两种检验: (1)在每题内将各策略的存储正确性结果重新分配(redistribute)到策略之间, 打散"策略-问题"的对应关系; (2)在此基础上保留每个策略的总成功数, 以在指定统计模型下控制整体质量差异。在七个十亿参数视觉-语言模型的五个训练随机种子上做检验, 并比较混合(mixtures)、路由、投票与权重平均等方法相对各自单策略基线的表现, 另设不同数据集训练、更强后训练配方与可预测专业化的对照实验。

Result: 阈值0.10下, 重分配检验可复现估计的0.113 oracle gap中的0.096, 两种检验在该阈值均无显著证据, 仅存未解释的小优势; 混合、路由、投票、权重平均相对单策略基线均无可检测提升。轻量后训练下用不同数据集训练策略几乎无专业化, 也无路由收益; 而更强配方确实产生专业化, 两种检验都能检出, 且路由收益仅出现在专家明显分离的高阈值处。可预测专业化的对照中, 路由约恢复一半oracle gap。覆盖率界(coverage bounds)解释了为何真实oracle优势不一定转化为部署收益。

Conclusion: 多策略的表观专业化大量可由采样误差与整体质量差异解释, 未必是真实的任务级分工。所提置换检验可在投资路由前, 直接基于已存储的响应低成本评估表观专业化, 并为"oracle优势≠部署收益"提供覆盖率界解释。代码已开源。

Abstract: Policies trained from the same base model can appear to solve different problems. An oracle that chooses the best policy for each problem may therefore appear much stronger than any single policy. Selecting the largest estimated success rate also selects favorable sampling errors. We study this effect through reliability coverage, the fraction of problems whose success probability reaches a chosen threshold. Our first test redistributes stored correctness outcomes across policies within each problem. A second also preserves each policy's total successes, accounting for overall quality differences under a specified statistical model. For five training seeds of a seven-billion-parameter vision-language model, redistribution reproduces 0.096 of an estimated 0.113 oracle gap at threshold 0.10. Neither test finds significant evidence at this threshold. Small advantages remain unresolved. Mixtures, routers, voting, and weight averaging show no detectable improvement over their corresponding single-policy baselines. Training policies on different datasets shows little detectable specialization under light post-training, and no router gain. A stronger recipe does create it, both tests detect it, and a router gain appears only at the high thresholds where the specialists separate. In a control with predictable specialization, a router recovers about half the oracle gap. Coverage bounds explain why even a genuine oracle advantage need not yield a deployment gain. The tests assess apparent specialization from stored responses before investment in routing. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/oracle-gaps

</details>


### [172] [Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33003)
*Mert Onur Cakiroglu,Elham Buxton,Mehmet Dalkilic,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 AliasForge，利用定点重采样中的零化线性映射构造"别名对"：两图在预处理后的接口张量上逐位相同，却具有相反的步级正确性标签，从而证明仅凭接口信息的验证器与路由器无法区分可修复错误与视觉证据缺失导致的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言验证器与路由器需要区分"更多推理即可修复的错误"与"视觉证据从未到达语言模型导致的错误"，但这一区分缺乏真值标注：标注者看到全分辨率图像，而模型只接收预处理张量。需要一种能证明"相关信息确实不在接口中"的构造方法，以给出可验证的判据。

Method: 提出 AliasForge：通过定点重采样使四舍五入前的缩放成为精确整数线性映射，可将非零整数扰动映射为零；在该映射的零空间中隐藏翻转标签的扰动，生成接口状态逐位相同但标签相反的图像对。证明每个定点降采样器均存在此类零向量，并给出常见缩放比下最小零向量规模的界（界超过 255 时排除 8 位表示）。进一步用格判据从缩放配置直接给出可实现碰撞并证明其不存在性，对 20 个筛选配置完成判定（17 可构造、3 不可构造）。

Result: 在三种架构上构造出经认证的别名对，并额外认证四类处理器：18 对计分样本的决策 logit 差均为零，18 个对照样本全部非零。所有验证器在别名对两成员上的输出分布相同，配对平衡准确率恰为 1/2，语言侧修复收益为零。该样本对同样可用于筛选会在重注意或额外推理上浪费计算的路由器；在自然样本上存在逐项路由余量，但所测试的纯接口路由器均无法优于直接停止，并用纤维上限刻画了接口可恢复的余量上界。

Conclusion: 接口信息本身不足以支撑错误可修复性的判定，存在原理性的别名不可分辨性。AliasForge 提供了从重采样配置出发的可判定格判据与可认证碰撞构造，为验证器/路由器的能力上限给出下界式证据与基准工具。

Abstract: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/aliasforge.

</details>


### [173] [Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33005)
*J. T. Hagbe,Michel Emel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MalariaCascade 两级推理系统：轻量 MobileNetV2 哨兵做低算力初筛，将不确定样本升级给只接收干净图像的 EfficientNet-B3 专家，通过结构隔离而非学习鲁棒性来抵抗传感器噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低成本实验室与智能手机显微成像中，传感器噪声会使在干净图像上高精度的模型严重失效；需要一种在资源受限条件下仍保持临床安全性能的疟疾自动诊断方案。

Method: 两阶段级联推理：MobileNetV2 哨兵（2,225,153 参数）低算力分类，不确定样本升级至 EfficientNet-B3 专家（10,697,769 参数）；专家仅见干净、标准化图像，与输入帧的损坏程度无关。哨兵采用安全分数目标训练，在优化精度前对 Recall(Parasitised)≥0.95、Recall(Uninfected)≥0.40 设下限，使检查点按构造满足临床安全约束。消融实验隔离结构属性。

Result: 在 NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset（27,558 细胞）干净测试集上：Accuracy=0.9736、Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570、Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912、F1=0.9738、AUROC=0.9955。最高强度高斯噪声下，级联 Recall(Parasitised) 仅降 2.4 pp（0.9570→0.9329），单模型基线崩溃 63.0 pp（0.9584→0.3281）；McNemar 检验显著（chi^2=11.14，p=0.00085）。消融显示将干净图像路由至专家带来 16.8 pp 的 Recall(Parasitised) 优势。

Conclusion: 级联结构隔离（而非鲁棒性学习）是抗噪机制的核心；该方法在干净与噪声条件下均维持临床安全水平的诊断性能，显著优于单模型基线。

Abstract: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

</details>


### [174] [Residual Diffusion Implicit Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33020)
*João Guerreiro,Pedro Tomás,Helena Aidos,Jacinto C. Nascimento*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM），通过显式建模高质量与低质量图像间的残差，导出了可跳步的非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，实现少步甚至单步重建，并引入可控方差机制平衡保真度与多样性，在去噪和超分辨率任务上超越桥模型和一致性模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在逆问题中面临三重困境：从纯高斯噪声初始化的生成过程与实际退化过程不匹配；扩散桥方法施加严格的端点约束且需要长反向过程，易产生幻觉；一致性模型虽支持噪声不变的单步映射，但缺乏内在方差建模能力，在严重损坏下性能退化。

Method: 提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM）这一广义框架，显式建模高质量（HQ）与低质量（LQ）图像之间的残差，使前向过程与实际退化对齐；推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，可跳过中间时间步；引入可控方差机制，在确定性与随机采样之间插值；并支持在需要时使用感知损失。

Result: 在去噪和超分辨率基准测试中，RDIM在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上一致优于当前最先进方法（包括桥模型和一致性模型），同时减少幻觉，且仅需少量采样步（通常仅一步）。

Conclusion: RDIM为广泛的图像复原任务提供了一种高效解决方案，兼顾少步重建、高保真度与幻觉抑制。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.

</details>


### [175] [NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33076)
*Aman Kumar,Avinash Anand,Chaitanya Lakhchaura,Ashutosh Kumar,Akshita Abrol,Timothy Liu,Zhengkui Wang,Rajiv Ratn Shah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向单张RGB图像(可选配料表)的营养估计框架NutriVision，用DepthAnything-V3合成深度、CLIP编码配料语义，并通过IC-FAFM、IA-MPH和ISM三模块实现RGB-深度频率融合与配料条件预测，在Nutrition5k上取得13.60±0.10%的平均PMAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 营养估计在消费级饮食追踪、临床营养、慢病管理及运动与医院营养等场景中具有基础性价值，但现有方法沿两条割裂路线发展：基于视觉的模型依赖标定的RGB-D采集，需要专用深度硬件；基于配料的方法虽利用文本线索，却缺乏充分的多模态融合。因此需要一种无需专用深度传感器、又能同时利用几何与语义线索的统一框架。

Method: NutriVision为端到端框架，输入单张RGB图像与可选配料列表，估计热量、质量、脂肪、碳水化合物与蛋白质。其用DepthAnything-V3生成缺失的深度模态，用CLIP编码配料描述，并集成三种机制：(1)配料条件频率对齐融合模块(IC-FAFM)，以文本引导对RGB-深度频率分量重加权与对齐；(2)配料感知掩膜预测头(IA-MPH)，其门控与通道掩膜以食物类别为条件；(3)模态特定的内部语义建模(ISM)块。

Result: 在Nutrition5k数据集上，NutriVision的平均PMAE为13.60±0.10%，较其IGSMNet实现优0.89个百分点，较OmniFood8k优2.90个百分点（均p<0.001）。模块级消融显示，配料感知预测头是主要架构贡献者，使平均PMAE改善1.50±0.17个百分点（p<0.001）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，配料条件预测与频率感知的RGB-深度融合对单图像营养估计带来可量化的提升；NutriVision为无需专用深度传感硬件、即可利用几何与语义线索的营养评估系统提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

</details>


### [176] [Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33077)
*Adham M. Alkhadrawi,Mohammed A. B. Mahmoud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文利用深度可分离卷积从2D扩展到3D时参数量几乎不增长的特性，构建了仅含536,990参数的3D U-Net，在MSD Task03肝脏肿瘤分割任务上超越参数量24倍的稠密3D U-Net及既有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维稠密卷积网络是体素医学图像分割的最强方法，但其参数量随卷积核维数呈立方增长：将k×k卷积扩展到k×k×k会使权重乘以k。作者希望解决3D稠密卷积U-Net参数量膨胀的问题。

Method: 作者观察到深度可分离分解不受该惩罚：立方核项仅作用于depthwise阶段，而主导参数量的pointwise投影保持不变，因此同一架构从2D到3D仅增长5%（稠密卷积U-Net增长200%）。据此构建了一个3D U-Net，仅536,990参数。在MSD Task03 Liver（源自LiTS）上以五折交叉验证逐病例评估全部131个公开体数据；并在LiTS与一个2D内窥镜基准上测试用固定位移替换可学习空间滤波器的效果。

Result: 在MSD Task03 Liver上，肿瘤Dice为0.577（95% CI [0.518, 0.633]），肝脏Dice为0.947（95% CI [0.941, 0.952]），肝脏Dice超过此前报道性能；肿瘤Dice比其低分辨率配置（0.4701）高0.107，超过其2D配置（0.5394），而参数量约为其1/24、平面内分辨率约为其一半。在相同条件下的共同留出划分上，相比稠密3D U-Net肝脏Dice +0.031（配对p=0.006），肿瘤Dice +0.041（95% CI [+0.005, +0.081]，配对p=0.056）。此外，在LiTS和2D内窥镜基准上，大部分可学习空间滤波器可被固定位移替换而不损失精度，但全部替换则明显变差。

Conclusion: 深度可分离分解使3D U-Net参数量大幅降低且性能更优，其分解在小数据医学影像场景中还起到正则化作用；同时，空间容量的“位置”比其“总量”更重要。

Abstract: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

</details>


### [177] [SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33082)
*De Jiang,Shuo Zhang,Kehong Yuan,Hongen Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemReward-VL通过语义奖励与GRPO优化LoRA，使视觉语言模型能从临床结局反向学习描述发育筛查视频中的项目特异性行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发育筛查视频记录了儿童的具体行为表现，但临床记录通常只保存结果（outcome），缺少对行为过程的描述。本文旨在利用这些结局信息，让模型学会生成与项目相关、与临床结局一致的行为描述。

Method: 方法为SemReward-VL：视觉语言模型生成描述，冻结语言模型从四个方面打分——与临床结局的一致性、与筛查项目的相关性、对无关视频-项目对的弃答（abstention）、以及清晰度，构成语义奖励；再以组相对策略优化（GRPO）更新LoRA适配器。

Result: 在覆盖41个项目、13,379段视频的数据集上，该方法提升了总体准确率，并增加了召回率高于0.5的项目数量。仍存在错误，主要体现在时间方向、持续时长以及年龄特异性行为解释上。

Conclusion: 研究表明，借助语义奖励与GRPO，可在仅有临床结局监督的条件下学习项目特异性行为描述，但时间与年龄相关语义仍是待解决的难点。

Abstract: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

</details>


### [178] [dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33083)
*Aditya Bagri,Ashutosh Kumar,Chaitanya Lakhchaura,Avinash Anand,Zhengkui Wang,Rajiv Ratn Shah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究固定帧预算下的稀疏视频理解证据选择问题，指出全局竞争的 Top-K 选择器对时序局部化事件会产生不稳定的证据分配，提出相位结构化的可微选择器 dKFD，在事件前、事件中、事件后三个阶段预留证据容量。实验表明在 DoTA 视频异常识别上，dKFD 在 K=12 时较匹配的 Global Top-K 将 Frame AUC 提升 +30.97（p<0.01），同时保持有竞争力的识别与时序定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视频理解通常需要在固定帧预算下选取少量视觉证据。多数稀疏选择器采用全局竞争式预算分配，让所有帧相互竞争。但对于时序局部化的事件，这种归纳偏置并不合适：有效证据往往分散在事件前上下文、事件本身与事件后后果三个阶段。作者因此研究面向局部化事件视频的固定预算证据分配问题，并揭示全局竞争的 Top-K 选择器虽可保持识别与定位能力，却产生不稳定的事件证据。

Method: 提出 dKFD，一种相位结构化的可微选择器。其做法是在完成全序列时序编码后，在事件前、事件中、事件后三个阶段之间预留证据容量，实现阶段感知的固定预算分配。方法层面强调相位监督的作用，通过消融实验验证其承重性。

Result: 在 DoTA 视频异常识别上，Global Top-K 在 K=12 时获得有竞争力的识别与时序定位，但选择器-事件对齐度低（Frame AUC 51.5±10.8）。在匹配预算、多随机种子评估下，dKFD 在 K=12 时相对匹配的 Global Top-K 将 Frame AUC 提升 +30.97（p<0.01），识别增益适度但统计显著，时序定位相当。机制消融显示相位监督是关键：即使保留相位分区预算，去除相位监督后 Frame AUC 降至 41.1±12.0。在 VRU-Accident 上的下游诊断显示，dKFD 在多个 VLM 家族上相对学习式 Global Top-K 均取得一致增益；而密集描述任务中，均匀采样仍具有竞争力，揭示出方法的边界条件。

Conclusion: 结果表明，相位结构化分配是一种面向事件中心稀疏证据选择的可控固定预算方法，而非通用的视频摘要策略。其有效性依赖于相位监督，在事件中心任务上增益显著，但在密集描述等任务中存在适用边界。

Abstract: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

</details>


### [179] [QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33088)
*Yuan Qian,Jie Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP），支持类别名、同义词与意图句子查询，输出查询专属掩膜与成对时序语义图，在SECOND和WHU-CDC上验证了性能与跨数据集迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统变化检测仅识别双时相影像间的变化，语义变化检测虽可赋予地物类别，但无法满足用户的特定需求；现有类别提示式指代变化检测（RCD）只能以查询类别指定变化的目标端，仅返回二值掩膜，无法回答"什么变成了什么"，也缺少成对的语义图，需要显式的源端与目标端推理。

Method: QSCP将请求解析为意图与语义槽（slot），支持类别名称、同义词以及携带意图的句子；随后组合双向视觉证据（bidirectional visual evidence），并通过查询条件化解码器（query-conditioned decoder）预测两个时相的语义状态，最终输出查询专属掩膜与成对时序语义图。

Result: 在SECOND数据集上，QSCP在同义词查询、句子查询与过渡（transition）查询上均优于RCDNet，并在端到端语义预测上超过所评估的语义基线；WHU-CDC实验进一步验证了在无目标域训练条件下的跨数据集迁移能力与等价表达间的一致性。

Conclusion: QSCP将指代变化检测从目标类定位扩展为查询引导的语义变化解析，兼顾掩膜定位与"从何变为何"的成对语义推理，具备良好的跨数据集泛化与表达鲁棒性。

Abstract: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP

</details>


### [180] [Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33097)
*Zhihao Chen,Yiyuan Ge,Ziyang Wang,Pu Cao,Lu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对视觉语言导航(VLN)模型参数量大、部署成本高的问题，提出两阶段高效VLN方案：先构建显式证据选择的可压缩教师模型，再通过查询瓶颈蒸馏训练紧凑学生模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模VLN模型虽精度高，但参数量与算力需求大，部署成本高，亟需高效方案。

Method: 第一步构建教师模型：引入少量可学习查询槽，经可导航查询生成器从全景观测中提取全局与局部、行动充分的导航证据，再由指令-查询对齐器逐步将证据token与指令接地以预测策略。第二步以该显式查询瓶颈为蒸馏接口，传递“关注何处”与“执行何动作”：用导航感知的token自适应目标蒸馏全局与局部可导航查询，并在微调阶段匹配动作分布。

Result: 在标准VLN基准上，学生模型导航性能几乎与教师相当，同时参数量较教师减少93.65%。

Conclusion: 显式可压缩的查询瓶颈既能提升教师证据选择的显式性，又可作为高效蒸馏接口，实现高精度与低参数量的兼顾。

Abstract: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

</details>


### [181] [Octree-based Video Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33100)
*Rungui Zhou,Chuanzhi Zhou,Yuk-Kit Hou,Peng-Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OctVideo 用八叉树递归划分视频时空体，平滑区保持粗粒、细节区细化，结合 Conv1D VAE 与轻量残差实现高保真且高效的视频表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频模型普遍采用均匀网格，但视觉复杂度在空间与时间上差异显著，均匀采样造成冗余与算力浪费。

Method: 将视频片段建模为八叉树，递归把时空体划分为八个子体，每个叶节点存储局部 RGB 与时空梯度，并辅以轻量学习残差；重建时用 Conv1D VAE 将序列化单元映射到规则潜变量网格，并在解码中按需细化细节。

Result: 在 K400 上以 38.2M 参数、每片段 189.4 GFLOPs 达到 36.12 dB PSNR；零样本泛化到 DAVIS 2016 高分辨率数据，重建质量与最优评估模型相当，且模型 FLOPs 最少、编解码最快；从头训练时以极少输入 token 获得有竞争力的识别性能。

Conclusion: 通过利用视频信号固有冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，OctVideo 提供了高效的视频表示方案。

Abstract: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.

</details>


### [182] [Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33109)
*Tuo Liang,Disheng Liu,Nengbo Wang,Vipin Chaudhary,Yu Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"朝向定位"(orientation grounding)任务,预测被指代物体的6D朝向与轴对称性,构建ReferOri数据集(331K多视图+387K单视图查询),并提出OG-VLM模型,在多项基准上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间视觉语言模型(VLM)的grounding工作大多只关注被指代物体"在哪里",而许多3D任务还需要知道物体"如何朝向"。虽然已有3D VLM可预测带方向的包围盒,但box pose无法显式刻画以物体为中心的朝向,也无法处理对称性带来的歧义。

Method: 1) 定义orientation grounding任务:从语言或box查询出发,在单视图或多视图场景中预测物体的6D朝向和轴对称性。2) 构建ReferOri数据集:通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工验证,获得331K多视图和387K单视图的朝向定位查询。3) 提出OG-VLM:在3D VLM基础上适配结构化box/orientation输出、符号与对称性token,以及几何感知辅助损失。

Result: 在单视图和多视图基准上,OG-VLM大幅优于具备朝向感知能力的VLM基线,并在场景级指代基准上超过物体级朝向基础模型。下游任务结果验证了其对朝向相关空间推理的增益。

Conclusion: 显式朝向定位是超越定位本身的一项独立且可学习的能力,object-centric朝向与对称性建模对空间视觉语言模型具有重要价值,并能提升朝向相关空间推理性能。

Abstract: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [183] [Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33125)
*Zhizhen Zhang,Yuxia Fu,Zijian Wang,Helen Huang,Yadan Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PolicyWeave，通过"合并兼容的后期训练+上下文引导的稀疏合并"，在无需联合后期训练的情况下，将独立训练的多任务 VLA 专家高效融合为统一策略，显著超过已有合并方法与联合 RL 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Co-training 构建多任务 VLA 策略虽简便，但性能往往低于各任务独立训练；而独立专家通过模型合并又难以得到强合并策略。作者识别出关键障碍之一：任务特定的动作接口改动（动作归一化、动作编码器/解码器）造成专家之间不兼容。

Method: 1) 合并兼容的后期训练：所有专家保留共享基座策略的动作接口，任务适配仅限动作模型隐藏层中的 LoRA 更新；2) 上下文引导的稀疏合并：用初始视觉-语言上下文对每个专家的 LoRA 更新打分，通过 leave-one-layer-out 排序稳定性确定专家集合，对选中更新做稀疏加权合并，并在当前任务中保持固定。基于 GR00T N1.5 实现。

Result: 在 RoboCasa365 的 18 个任务上仅用 10% 目标任务示范做 SFT：保留共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从 17.0% 提升至 52.8%；PolicyWeave 达 64.7%，经任务特定 RL 后升至 74.1%，高于联合 RL 的 60.7%。在 LIBERO-10 与 AgileX Piper 上的额外评测支持独立学习技能的长时程与真实世界操作部署。

Conclusion: 任务特定动作接口差异是专家合并失效的重要来源；保持共享动作接口可大幅提升合并兼容性，配合上下文引导的稀疏加权合并，能在不进行联合后期训练的情况下接近甚至超越联合训练/RL 的性能，并具备跨基准与真机泛化能力。

Abstract: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.

</details>


### [184] [DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33148)
*Liang Yao,Fan Liu,Hongbo Lu,Wei Xu,Jianyu Jiang,Yijun Shen,Chuanyi Zhang,Pai Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DroneWAM：一种基于JEPA的高效世界-动作模型，用于无人机视觉导航，通过表征空间预测、Resampler压缩与自适应rollout降低计算并提升轨迹精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机视觉导航中，世界-动作模型需要预测候选动作对观测的影响，但受限于严格的精度与效率约束，显式生成未来图像代价过高。

Method: 采用JEPA架构直接在表征空间建模未来状态，避免显式未来图像生成；用预训练Resampler将稠密编码特征压缩为少量latent token以减少每步imagined rollout的重复计算；引入adaptive rollout，通过偏好训练的Gate按场景自适应分配预测深度；并构建DroneNav-6D数据集（同步RGB观测、6-DoF飞行轨迹、控制指令与随机风扰）。

Result: 在DroneNav-6D上取得对比方法中最佳轨迹精度；adaptive rollout将平均预测深度从8降至4.58，同时提升轨迹精度。

Conclusion: 预测计算可跨场景更有效地分配，表明在效率约束下仍能兼顾无人机导航精度，代码与数据将开源。

Abstract: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.

</details>


### [185] [FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33158)
*David Restrepo,Chenwei Wu,Luis Filipe Nakayama,Miguel L. Martins,Stergios Christodoulidis,Maria Vakalopoulou,Enzo Ferrante*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FOCUS 是一个跨数据集视网膜眼底模型基准，统一三类任务与十个公共数据集，从排序性能、校准、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性多维评估 VM、VLM 与 MLLM，覆盖 532 个基础配置与 228 个 LoRA 微调 MLLM 配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视网膜基础模型多依赖单数据集报告性能，无法反映数据集偏移、临床定义差异和不同患者亚组下的表现。医学影像对鲁棒性、校准与公平性要求高，单榜指标不足以支撑安全部署，因此需要跨数据集、多维度的评估框架。

Method: 提出 FOCUS 基准，涵盖视觉编码器（VM）、视觉-语言双编码器（VLM）与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）；统一糖尿病视网膜病变、需转诊糖尿病视网膜病变和青光眼性视神经病变三类二分类任务，整合十个地理、采集条件和标注协议各异的公共数据集；通过统一分析层评估排序性能、校准、亚组差异与图像质量鲁棒性；开展 532 个基础配置和 228 个经 LoRA 监督微调 MLLM 配置的大规模评测。

Result: 没有任何模型家族在所有任务和数据集上持续占优：通用 VM 编码器平均排序性能最强；医学 MLLM 具竞争力但波动较大；双编码器 VLM 从轻量适配中获益显著。微调提升域内性能，但向外部数据集迁移表现异质，校准方面尤为明显。

Conclusion: 视网膜模型评估本质上是多维的，单数据集排行榜不足以反映泛化、可靠性与鲁棒性。FOCUS 提供实用框架与公开基准，支持超越单数据集榜单的系统评估。

Abstract: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards

</details>


### [186] [FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33167)
*Yiyi Cai,Yuhan Wu,Kunhang Li,Tu Fangyuan,Xiangyue Zhang,Qiaoge Li,Zhixiang Wang,Kaipeng Zhang,Haiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FD2 在流式动作生成模型 FD1 基础上，通过 Partial Attention、Bregman 回归损失准则和精确路径条件化三项改进，实现 4.6× 训练加速、11.29× 去噪加速，并在 SEED 与 HumanML3D 上取得流式方法中最优 FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FD1 虽是先进的流式动作生成模型且能生成合理动作，但存在效率低和可控性差的问题：其注意力设计需对完整历史反复计算，且缺乏面向真实应用的精确轨迹控制。

Method: 提出三项改进：(1) Partial Attention 使已固化的历史表示与活动窗口解耦，支持 KV 缓存推理与共享历史打包训练；(2) 建立回归损失的充分必要 Bregman 准则以保持扩散的条件均值速度场，并据此设计 FK 诱导的二次损失，在无需在线 FK 评估的情况下引入运动几何；(3) 引入精确路径条件化，在保持自然身体动作的同时控制角色根轨迹。

Result: 训练计算量减少 4.6×，去噪加速 11.29×，长序列上每次更新仅 2.303 ms；动作质量优于 FD1，并取得流式方法中最优 FID：SEED 上 0.048，HumanML3D 上 0.053。

Conclusion: FD2 在效率与可控性上显著超越 FD1，同时提升动作质量，证明所提注意力机制、损失准则与路径条件化能有效兼顾高效训练、快速推理与精确根轨迹控制。

Abstract: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.

</details>


### [187] [ABO-Med: Accelerated Bilevel Optimization for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33176)
*Ruoxuan Shi,Sheng Yang,Zhengxing Su,Xiaoyang Hou,Yating Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ABO-Med：将仅需一阶信息的双层优化范式引入 MAML 框架，用于医学图像小样本分类，并配套提出模态感知的数据增强策略 MedRAug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统双层优化算法依赖二阶信息（Hessian/二阶梯度），计算与存储开销大，难以扩展到大规模深度学习任务。尽管近期已有具备近优理论保证的一阶双层优化范式，但尚缺乏面向小样本学习、尤其是医学图像分类的可扩展实例化，且医学图像存在模态差异大、标注稀缺等问题，需要针对性的增强策略。

Method: 1）将一阶双层优化范式嵌入 MAML，构造可扩展的实例化算法 ABO-Med；2）提出 Medical Adaptive RandomAugment（MedRAug），一种面向医学图像的模态感知（modality-aware）自适应增强策略；3）从理论上论证 MAML 类元学习方法的（双层优化意义下的）最优性。

Result: 在多个公开医学数据集上，ABO-Med 相较已有基线取得 1.99%–18.76% 的性能提升；MedRAug 进一步使平均准确率提高 2.20%–6.34%。跨域实验、增强消融、骨干网络消融与训练效率分析均验证了方法的有效性与高效性。

Conclusion: ABO-Med 为一阶双层优化在医学图像小样本分类上的可扩展实践，兼具理论最优性支撑与实证优势，配合 MedRAug 可进一步提升性能，并具有较好训练效率。

Abstract: In recent years, bilevel optimization has been widely used in a variety of machine learning tasks. However, prior bilevel optimization algorithms generally require the computation of second-order information, which limits their practical scalability. Only recently has a first-order paradigm for bilevel optimization been established, attaining near-optimal theoretical guarantees for solving bilevel optimization problems. In this paper, we propose ABO-Med, a scalable instantiation of this paradigm for few-shot learning, by incorporating it into the model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) framework and tailoring it to medical image classification. We also introduce Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug), a modality-aware augmentation strategy designed for medical images. Theoretically, ABO-Med establishes the optimality of MAML-type meta-learning approaches. Empirically, ABO-Med outperforms prior baselines on several public medical datasets, with gains of 1.99% to 18.76%, while MedRAug further improves the average accuracy by 2.20% to 6.34%. Additional cross-domain experiments, augmentation ablation studies, backbone ablation studies, and training efficiency analysis further validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

</details>


### [188] [Can Protein-Derived Knowledge Improve Pathology Foundation Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33178)
*Di Zhang,Zhangpeng Gong,Jiashuai Liu,Zhi Zeng,Jiusong Ge,Chunze Yang,Xitong Ling,Kai Yi,Kai He,Weimiao Yu,Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar,Chen Li,Zeyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三阶段框架ProSlide，将蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移解耦，构建切片级层次化病理基础模型，在乳腺癌、肺癌、肾癌12项下游任务上取得最优平均准确率与AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子引导的病理基础模型（PFM）利用转录组或蛋白质组信息增强全切片图像（WSI）表征，但有效利用大规模独立分子语料库存在两大挑战：其一，现有分子基础模型编码的是蛋白质序列或单细胞状态，而非与WSI配对的患者级bulk表达谱；其二，跨模态监督仅限配对的WSI-组学样本，导致独立分子语料库的知识只能间接到达病理编码器，形成"配对支持瓶颈"。

Method: 提出解耦蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移的三阶段框架。第一阶段：在12,695个样本级bulk蛋白质谱上预训练蛋白质组基础编码器（PFE），采用虚拟谱生成与表达空间多视图预训练以弥合模态差距。第二阶段：预训练ProSlide——一个patch-region-slide层次化编码器，从配对WSI-蛋白质样本中预测蛋白质表达。第三阶段：引入Prot2Path跨模态关系蒸馏目标，对每个配对样本，在共享冻结的PFE编码配对与独立谱库上对齐WSI与其蛋白质谱的相似度分布，以缓解配对支持瓶颈。

Result: 在乳腺癌、肺癌和肾癌共12项下游任务上评估ProSlide。尽管仅用2,229张WSI和12,695个样本级蛋白质谱预训练，ProSlide在每个癌种组内均取得最高平均准确率和AUC。

Conclusion: 通过显式解耦蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移，并以关系蒸馏放松配对支持瓶颈，ProSlide能够以较小的配对数据规模实现高效的分子引导病理表征学习，在各癌种下游任务上表现领先。

Abstract: Molecularly guided pathology foundation models (PFMs) exploit transcriptomic or proteomic information to enrich whole-slide image (WSI) representations, yet effectively leveraging large standalone molecular corpora remains challenging. First, existing molecular foundation models encode protein sequences or single-cell states, not the patient-level bulk expression profiles paired with WSIs. Second, because cross-modal supervision is restricted to paired WSI-omics samples, knowledge from standalone molecular corpora reaches the pathology encoder only indirectly, creating a paired-support bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage framework that decouples proteomic knowledge acquisition from cross-modal transfer, yielding ProSlide, a slide-level hierarchical pathology foundation model. First, to close the modality gap, we pretrain a Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE) on 12,695 sample-level bulk protein profiles using virtual profile generation and expression-space multi-view pretraining. Second, we pretrain ProSlide, a patch-region-slide encoder, to predict protein expression from paired WSI-protein samples. Third, to relax the paired-support bottleneck, we introduce Prot2Path, a cross-modal relational distillation objective. For each paired sample, it aligns the similarity distributions of the WSI and its protein profile over a shared, frozen bank of PFE-encoded paired and standalone profiles. We evaluate ProSlide on 12 downstream tasks across breast, lung, and renal cancers. Despite being pretrained with only 2,229 WSIs and 12,695 sample-level protein profiles, ProSlide achieves the highest mean accuracy and AUC within each cancer group.

</details>


### [189] [FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33190)
*Zhiyuan Liu,Zehong Ke,Yuanxin Tian,Hao Cheng,Jinhao Li,Yining Xing,Yanbo Jiang,Zhenhua Xu,Wenhao Yu,Jianqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FocusDrive框架，将显式视觉焦点（决策相关物体的图像块引用）引入端到端驾驶规划的推理过程，在W3DA和NAVSIM上取得有竞争力的视线预测与规划性能，优于纯文本思维链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶决策同时依赖"关注何处"与"如何基于所见行动"，但纯文本推理链（rationale）难以显式对应到具体视觉证据，缺乏与场景中关键物体位置的明确链接。

Method: 构建结构化多模态推理框架FocusDrive：将决策相关物体的描述与图像块（image-patch）引用配对，把显式视觉焦点纳入生成驾驶计划与轨迹的推理中；先用驾驶视线预测评估该焦点表征，再借助NAVSIM训练场景中的驾驶焦点标注研究其在规划推理中的作用。

Result: 在W3DA和NAVSIM数据集上，视线预测与端到端规划均表现良好，且FocusDrive优于基于文本的思维链方法。

Conclusion: 视觉焦点可作为连接场景理解与驾驶动作的有效纽带，支持以显式视觉焦点组织端到端规划的可行性。

Abstract: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes. Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.

</details>


### [190] [ReAL: Accelerating Flow Matching through Segment Advancement with Shared Lookahead](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33202)
*Xuanhua Yin,Chuanzhi Xu,Haoxian Zhou,Shunqi Mao,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练采样器ReAL，用一次共享lookahead选择跳步跨度，减少flow-matching采样中的模型评估次数，在图像与视频生成上实现约5倍加速且质量保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Flow-matching模型生成质量高，但重复的神经网络评估使采样代价昂贵。通过跳步减少评估虽可降本，但仅靠局部速度一致性无法确定合适的跳步跨度，而逐一检查候选端点又会带来额外模型调用开销。

Method: ReAL利用一个共享lookahead进行跨度选择：其核心洞察是"未校正端点提议"与"lookahead校正后端点提议"之间的差异，可由观测到的速度失配与lookahead之外的候选跨度直接计算得出，从而得到依赖跨度的选择准则而无需额外端点评估。同一lookahead用于选中最长的通过候选跨度、校正被接受的更新，并将其速度作为下一轮起始估计。初始化后每次常规迭代仅需一次新的模型评估。方法只使用预训练速度输出与原始噪声调度，无需额外训练或访问内部特征。

Result: 实验覆盖四个图像生成骨干网、视频生成与图像编辑。在FLUX.1-dev上实测加速4.91倍并保留97.0%的稠密采样ImageReward；在HunyuanVideo上实现5.49倍加速，VBench分数接近稠密采样。

Conclusion: ReAL是一种免训练、通用性强的跳步采样器，通过共享lookahead实现跨度选择与更新校正，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著降低采样成本。

Abstract: Flow-matching models generate high-quality images and videos, but repeated neural network evaluations make sampling expensive. Skipping evaluations reduces this cost by extending an available velocity estimate over a longer span. However, local velocity agreement alone does not determine a suitable span, and checking each candidate endpoint adds costly model calls. We introduce ReAL, a training-free sampler that selects how far to advance using one shared lookahead. Our key insight is that the discrepancy between uncorrected and lookahead-corrected endpoint proposals can be computed directly from the observed velocity mismatch and the candidate span beyond the lookahead. This relation provides a span-dependent selection criterion without additional endpoint evaluations. The same lookahead selects the longest passing candidate span, corrects the accepted update, and supplies its velocity as the next starting estimate. After initialization, each regular iteration requires only one fresh evaluation. ReAL uses the pretrained velocity output and original noise schedule, with no additional training or access to internal features. Experiments cover four image-generation backbones, video generation, and image editing. ReAL achieves 4.91x measured speedup on FLUX.1-dev while retaining 97.0% of dense mean ImageReward. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a 5.49x speedup while maintaining a VBench score close to that of dense sampling.

</details>


### [191] [Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33203)
*Yuhe Liu,Xinyin Ma,Gongfan Fang,Songhua Liu,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作重新审视扩散Transformer的残差连接，将被动求和改为主动检索，用结构化跨深度连接显著提升生成质量且参数开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT采用统一残差流整合所有前层信息，缺乏U-Net式手工跳跃连接的结构化路径，跨层信息复用机制未被充分探索，成为可扩展生成模型中被忽视的改进方向。

Method: 先系统分析DiT内部表示，发现其对早期层特征复用与对称层引导存在潜在偏好；据此设计结构化连接：显式结合局部残差连接与长程通路，使每个Transformer块可选择性"关注"关键早期表示，通过直接可微的跨深度路径动态检索空间与语义线索，而非静态跳跃或稠密全层路由。

Result: 收敛更快，训练迭代最多减少1.73倍；FID与视觉质量显著提升，额外参数不足0.1%；将强基线REPA-XL/2在无引导下FID从5.9降至4.34，配合无分类器引导达1.39 FID。

Conclusion: 自适应跨层连接是扩散Transformer中关键但未被充分挖掘的因素，引入结构化信息通路为提升可扩展生成模型提供了简单有效的方向。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as a scalable backbone for high-fidelity image synthesis. However, unlike U-Net based diffusion models that rely on rigid, hand-crafted skip connections, DiTs predominantly use a uniform residual stream that integrates all preceding layers as a monolithic state. In this work, we rethink residual connections in diffusion transformers and propose to transform them from passive summation into an active retrieval mechanism optimized for image denoising. First, we conduct a systematic analysis of DiT's internal representation, revealing a latent preference for early-layer feature reuse and symmetric layer guidance. Motivated by this, we introduce a structured connectivity design that explicitly integrates local residual connections with long-range pathways. Instead of static skip connections or dense all-layer routing, our method enables each transformer block to selectively ``attend'' to critical earlier representations, dynamically retrieving spatial and semantic cues through direct, differentiable cross-depth paths. Experiments show that our adaptive connectivity leads to faster convergence, with up to $1.73\times$ fewer training iterations, and significant gains in FID and visual quality with less than $0.1\%$ additional parameters, further improving a strong REPA-XL/2 model from $5.9$ to $4.34$ FID without guidance and reaching $1.39$ FID with classifier-free guidance. Our findings suggest that adaptive cross-layer connectivity is a critical yet underexplored factor in diffusion transformers, and that incorporating structured information pathways provides a simple and effective direction for improving scalable generative models.

</details>


### [192] [Background Gradients Shape Memorization in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33210)
*Xuanhua Yin,Boyu Wei,Shuyi Zhang,Shunqi Mao,Chuanzhi Xu,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究类条件流匹配中，目标图像之外的同类背景图像如何影响目标记忆的保持与复制，提出"配对轨迹"框架揭示背景梯度响应的因果机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复与生成模型的记忆高度相关，但其他训练图像如何影响目标的保持与复制尚不清楚。作者希望在类条件流匹配设定下，厘清目标集合之外背景图像的作用。

Method: 采用类条件流匹配，固定目标重复次数与同类背景行数；构建配对轨迹框架，分离目标诱导的参数位移与背景对其的梯度响应，并给出精确的路径积分曲率表示；通过重复与不同背景间的互易响应迁移、移除目标后的响应校正、直接缩放位移等实验进行因果验证。

Result: 在固定目标重复与同类背景行数下，将重复同类图像替换为不同图像使目标提取率从80.7%降至18.0%；互易响应迁移双向改变目标保持与复制，确立响应的因果作用；移除目标后，平行于目标诱导位移的响应校正保留了约90%的复制效应；直接缩放位移无需再训练即可改变复制；上述移除后复制效应在数据集与架构间可复现。

Conclusion: 背景梯度响应是同类训练数据塑造目标学习保持与目标图像复制的机制。

Abstract: Repetition is closely associated with memorization in generative models, but how other training images affect the retention and copying of targets remains unclear. We study this question in class-conditioned flow matching, where images outside the target set form the background. At fixed target repetition and same-class background row count, replacing repeated same-class images with distinct images reduces the target extraction rate from 80.7% to 18.0%. To explain this effect, we develop a paired-trajectory framework that isolates target-induced parameter displacement and the background gradient response to it. This response has an exact path-integrated curvature representation, connecting background loss geometry to target learning. Reciprocal response transfer between repeated and distinct backgrounds changes target retention and copying in both directions, establishing the response's causal role. After target removal, the response correction parallel to the target-induced displacement preserves approximately 90% of the copying effects of full response transfer.
