Conclusion: In-Token Learning为统一框架下的图像复原提供了可行路径，DLG以原生conditioning方式替代可训练控制分支，但跨域泛化（RealLQ250）与高分辨率attention复杂度仍待改进。该技术报告保留了后续Fill2SR真实世界超分方向的早期更广研究基础。

Abstract: We present In-Token Learning, an image restoration framework that adapts a pretrained diffusion transformer using conditional rectified flow matching. Clean targets paired with degraded inputs supervise transport from Gaussian noise to restored images. Spatially aligned degraded-image tokens are fused with evolving latent tokens along the channel dimension, preserving the image-token count at a given resolution. Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG) combines frozen degraded-image embeddings with a fixed task prompt through the native conditioning pathway, without a trainable ControlNet-style branch or image captioning. We evaluate super-resolution and denoising on DIV2K, LSDIR, FFHQ, RealLQ250, and RealPhoto60, and automatic colorization on DIV2K and LSDIR. The tasks use separately trained checkpoints under the same framework. Results show competitive fidelity and perceptual quality under the evaluated protocols, with weaker generalization on RealLQ250. We report full-image QHD ($2560{\times}1440$) inference and a tiled $12$K restoration demonstration of Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Attention cost still increases with resolution. This technical report preserves the early broader study underlying Fill2SR, which subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction.

</details>


### [227] [PGL-3D: Towards Progressive Geometric Learning for 3D Visual Query Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33558)
*Liang Peng,Shizhuo Mu,Bohan Tan,Wenyuan Wang,Chen Zhao,Xingping Dong,Heng Fan,Libo Zhang,Bo Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PGL-3D，一个用于3D视觉查询定位（3DVQL）的"预测—选择—精炼—重预测"框架，利用中间3D边界框几何信息引导查询与候选表示的特征聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DVQL基线在特征建模之后才预测cuboid，中间几何信息未被用于后续特征精炼；且查询独立采集导致其标注位姿与搜索帧中物体的实际外观可能不一致，仅凭关联置信度难以判断目标是否存在及几何是否准确。

Method: 提出PGL-3D框架：共享头先为每个候选预测完整cuboid；Query–Tube–Memory（QTM）模块综合候选关联、cuboid质量、帧响应与目标缺失来选择参考观测；所选cuboid的中心、尺寸与朝向定义软池化权重，对查询条件化的候选特征进行池化以更新查询与候选表示，并再次预测。训练阶段引入ST-D9O目标，在参数回归基础上加入边界、符号距离与软重叠项，对每个阶段的cuboid几何进行监督。

Result: PGL-3D在3DVQL上取得平均stAP为0.270±0.004，而LaF报告值为0.044。消融实验验证了几何引导特征更新的有效性，分阶段分析显示cuboid精度提升。将PROT3D复现中的几何目标替换为ST-D9O后，GSOT3D上的mAO从21.63%提升至25.78%。

Conclusion: 完整中间cuboid可有效改进3DVQL的查询与候选表示，几何引导的特征更新与多阶段几何监督显著提升定位精度，代码与模型将开源。

Abstract: 3D Visual Query Localization (3DVQL) retrieves the latest contiguous occurrence of a queried object in an RGB--point-cloud sequence and predicts a 9-DoF cuboid for every response frame. The query is captured independently of the search sequence, so its annotated pose may differ from how the object appears in the search frames. The benchmark baseline predicts cuboids after feature modeling, leaving their geometry unused for subsequent feature refinement. We investigate whether complete intermediate cuboids can improve query and proposal representations before final decoding. We introduce Progressive Geometric Learning for 3DVQL (PGL-3D), a predict--select--refine--re-predict framework that uses intermediate cuboids to guide the aggregation of search evidence and update query and proposal representations. A shared head first predicts a complete cuboid for every proposal. Query--Tube--Memory (QTM) then selects reference observations by combining proposal association, cuboid quality, frame response, and target absence, since association confidence alone establishes neither target presence nor geometric accuracy. The center, size, and orientation of each selected cuboid define soft pooling weights over query-conditioned proposal features. The pooled memory updates the query and proposal representations, and the head re-predicts from the updated features. A training-only objective, ST-D9O, supervises cuboid geometry at every stage by adding boundary, signed-distance, and soft-overlap terms to parameter regression. PGL-3D achieves a mean stAP of $0.270 \pm 0.004$ on 3DVQL, compared with $0.044$ reported for LaF. Ablations support the benefits of geometry-guided feature updates, while stage-wise analyses show improved cuboid accuracy. Replacing the geometry objective in our PROT3D reproduction with ST-D9O improves mAO on GSOT3D from $21.63\%$ to $25.78\%$. Our code and models will be released.

</details>


### [228] [ForeFly: A Dual-Horizon World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33581)
*Kunhui Wang,Xintong Zhang,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ForeFly，一种双时间尺度的潜空间世界动作模型，通过近端与航路关键两类未来预测并配合 FGAR 机制，提升空中视觉语言导航的指令跟随能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中视觉语言导航（AVLN）方法多为反应式或仅做单一时间尺度的预测，忽略了不同时间尺度上互补的未来线索，导致长轨迹复杂三维环境下的指令跟随不够可靠。

Method: ForeFly 为双时间尺度潜空间世界动作模型，同时预测近端未来（保证局部连续性）与自适应航路关键未来（提供长程引导）；用近期视觉记忆和航路关键视觉记忆分别初始化相应的时间尺度前瞻查询，获得历史感知上下文；提出 FGAR（Foresight-Guided Action Refinement），非对称地利用近端前瞻增强局部动作、利用航路关键前瞻做特征级校正与航路级引导。

Result: 在 TravelUAV 与 UAV-ON 两个基准上，ForeFly 在已见与未见场景下均持续优于强基线，验证了双时间尺度前瞻与 FGAR 学习的有效性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 双时间尺度未来预测与前瞻引导的动作精炼能有效弥补单尺度反应式方法的不足，为 AVLN 提供更可靠的长程指令跟随能力。

Abstract: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) requires UAVs to maintain reliable instruction following over long trajectories in complex 3D environments. However, existing AVLN approaches are predominantly reactive or limited to single-horizon prediction, overlooking complementary future cues across different temporal horizons. To address this limitation, we propose ForeFly, a dual-horizon latent world action model that predicts both a proximal future for local continuity and an adaptive route-critical future for long-range guidance. Horizon-specific foresight queries are primed with recent and route-critical visual memories, providing history-aware context for future prediction. To exploit their distinct roles in action generation, we introduce Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR), which asymmetrically exploits proximal foresight for local action enhancement and route-critical foresight for feature-wise correction and route-level guidance. Experiments on the TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks show that ForeFly consistently outperforms strong baselines across seen and unseen settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-horizon foresight and FGAR learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/kunhuiW/ForeFly

</details>


### [229] [Fill2SR: Repurposing Inpainting Diffusion Transformers for Real-World Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33582)
*Xingfu Yi,Xiaoxue Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Fill2SR 将掩码修复扩散 Transformer 复用为超分辨率模型，通过 IIEA 将低质量图像写入原生掩码槽位，实现无需额外空间分支的混合分辨率训练与推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有真实世界图像超分辨率方法常基于文本到图像骨干添加 ControlNet 式分支或空间条件 token，导致内存与计算随分辨率增长，且训练通常受限于固定尺度。

Method: 提出 Fill2SR，复用掩码修复扩散 Transformer 做 SR。其 Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter（IIEA）在全图掩码下将 LQ 观测写入原生掩码图像槽，把修复转化为反向退化条件的校正流，仅用 LoRA 微调。另引入离线流程 RCDT，从无配对真实图像中蒸馏退化描述子并利用冻结开源模型迁移到干净目标。

Result: 支持最高 QHD 的混合分辨率训练，在 512/1024/2048 输出上表现稳定。合成基准上，带 IIEA 的基础模型在 DIV2K 与 LSDIR 取得最佳 LPIPS；加入 RCDT 后以小幅 LPIPS 下降换取 RealLQ250 与 RealPhoto60 上更强无参考质量。内存可预测，单张 32GB GPU 可运行 1536² 推理，并通过分块恢复扩展到多百万像素输出。

Conclusion: Fill2SR 以最小架构改动实现高效、尺度灵活的真实图像超分辨率，兼顾合成与真实场景质量，并具备良好的显存可控性与高分辨率扩展能力。

Abstract: Recent real-world image super-resolution (SR) methods often adapt text-to-image (T2I) backbones with ControlNet-style branches or spatial conditioning tokens, which increases memory and computes with resolution and often constrains training to a fixed scale. We propose Fill2SR, which repurposes a masked-inpainting Diffusion Transformer for SR without extra spatial branches. Our Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter (IIEA) writes the low-quality (LQ) observation into the native masked-image slot under a full-image mask, turning inpainting into a reverse-degradation conditional rectified flow trained with LoRA-only tuning. We further introduce RCDT, an offline pipeline that distills degradation descriptors from unpaired real images and transfers them onto clean targets using frozen open-source models. Fill2SR supports mixed-resolution training up to QHD and yields stable performance across $512/1024/2048$ outputs. On synthetic benchmarks, our base model with IIEA achieves the best LPIPS on DIV2K and LSDIR; adding RCDT trades a small LPIPS drop for consistently stronger no-reference quality on RealLQ250 and RealPhoto60. Fill2SR remains memory-predictable, running $1536^2$ inference on a single 32GB GPU and extending to multi-megapixel outputs via tiled restoration.

</details>


### [230] [IVT-Guard: All-in-One Reasoning Model for AI-Generated Content Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33585)
*Hongwei Niu,Yunpeng Luo,Hanjun Li,Ziyin Zhou,Jianghang Lin,Ke Yan,Shouhong Ding,Shengchuan Zhang,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 IVT-Set 数据集与 IVT-Guard 框架，实现图像、视频、文本三模态统一且可解释的 AIGC 检测，并通过三阶段训练范式解决推理与检测的优化矛盾，取得跨域 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高度逼真的 AIGC 内容快速扩散，亟需鲁棒且可解释的检测机制。然而现有检测器多局限于单一模态，且仅输出二分类结果而无推理过程。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）虽是有前景的方案，但受限于多模态推理数据稀缺，以及"推理-检测优化困境"——即显式推理监督可能损害检测精度。

Method: 1) 构建 IVT-Set，包含超过 152K 图像、视频、文本样本，并配有多粒度思维链（CoT）推理轨迹；2) 提出 IVT-Guard 框架，实现跨图像、视频、文本模态的统一可解释 AIGC 检测；3) 设计三阶段训练范式：伪影感知预训练、基于伪影感知注入的"伪影到证据"监督微调、以及"证据-判定一致性"组相对策略优化（GRPO）。

Result: 大量实验表明，IVT-Guard 在域内、域外及跨数据集设置下均达到最先进（SOTA）检测性能，同时给出忠实的推理过程。代码与数据将开源。

Conclusion: 该工作通过统一数据集与训练范式，缓解了多模态 AIGC 检测中推理监督与检测精度之间的优化矛盾，实现了可解释且跨模态、跨域的检测能力，为可解释 AIGC 检测提供了新方案。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Content (AIGC) necessitates robust and interpretable detection mechanisms. However, existing detectors are predominantly confined to single modalities and provide binary outputs without reasoning. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) present a promising solution, their development is constrained by the scarcity of multimodal reasoning data and the reasoning-detection optimization dilemma, where explicit reasoning supervision can compromise detection accuracy. To this end, we introduce IVT-Set, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 152K diverse image, video, and text samples equipped with multi-granularity Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Based on it, we propose IVT-Guard, a pioneering framework for unified and interpretable AIGC detection across image, video, and text modalities. Furthermore, to overcome the aforementioned optimization dilemma, we design a novel three-stage training paradigm: Artifact-Aware Pre-training, Artifact-to-Evidence Supervised Fine-Tuning via artifact-aware injection, and Evidence-Verdict Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IVT-Guard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-dataset settings while delivering faithful reasoning. Code and data will be released.

</details>


### [231] [LoopLUT: 3D Lookup Tables with Progressive Region Refinement for Real-Time 4K Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33593)
*Yang Ye,Jiajun Ma,Chen Wu,Wei Wang,Dianjie Lu,Guijuan Zhang,Linwei Fan,Zhuoran Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LoopLUT——区域级联3D LUT与渐进式细化方法，通过全局LUT加K-1次循环迭代，在低分辨率预测待校正区域并构建残差LUT，以门控形成单位分解实现逐像素凸组合融合，4K下仅需K次查表，PSNR最高提升2.81 dB且保持实时吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4K图像色彩增强需在严格算力预算下达到质量目标。3D LUT因低分辨率决策、全分辨率逐像素查表而主导实时增强，但单一全局LUT具有空间不变性，无法对同一像素值的欠曝阴影区与正常曝光区做出差异化校正，难以表达空间异质需求。

Method: 提出LoopLUT，区域级联3D LUT与渐进细化。全局LUT做整体校正，随后进行K-1次循环迭代：每次迭代由门控头在低分辨率预测仍需校正的区域，仅基于该区域色彩统计构建残差LUT。级联门控构成单位分解，输出为K个查表结果的逐像素凸组合。融合由门控自身完成，无需独立融合模块，且不累积跨轮插值误差。决策阶段固定为256×256分辨率，与输出分辨率无关，4K图像仅需K次纯查表。

Result: 在四个基准上大量实验表明，LoopLUT相比最强先前方法PSNR最高提升2.81 dB，同时在4K下保持实时吞吐；该分解在水下增强数据集上同样具有良好泛化性。

Conclusion: LoopLUT以区域级联与渐进细化克服了全局LUT空间不变的局限，用门控单位分解替代独立融合模块、避免插值误差累积，并凭借与输出分辨率无关的固定决策分辨率实现4K实时性能，兼具高质量与泛化能力。

Abstract: Color enhancement of 4K images must meet a quality target under a tight compute budget. Three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) dominate real-time enhancement because they decide at low resolution and apply a per-pixel lookup at full resolution. A single global LUT, however, is spatially invariant, so an underexposed shadow and a well-exposed region that share a pixel value receive identical corrections. Spatially heterogeneous demands cannot be expressed by such a mapping. We propose LoopLUT, a region-cascaded 3D LUT with progressive refinement. A global LUT performs the overall correction, followed by K-1 loop iterations. In each iteration a gating head predicts at low resolution the region that still needs correction, then builds a residual LUT from the color statistics of that region alone. The cascaded gates form a partition of unity, so the output is a per-pixel convex combination of the K lookup results. Fusion is therefore performed by the gates themselves, with no separate fusion module and no interpolation error accumulating across rounds. The decision stage runs at a fixed 256x256 resolution, independent of output resolution, so a 4K image costs only K pure lookups. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks show that LoopLUT improves PSNR by up to 2.81 dB over the strongest prior method, while keeping real-time throughput at 4K. The same decomposition also generalizes well to underwater enhancement datasets.

</details>


### [232] [ViCoR: Reliable Molecular Structure Extraction via Spatially Aligned Verification and Executable Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33603)
*Yujian Yuan,Xin Cai,Yufan Chen,Jiaxin Xu,Mengdi Liu,Zhichao Tan,Long Chen,Hanyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ViCoR，一个"先修复后拒识"的迭代验证与修订框架，用于选择性结构识别（SSR），在保持高覆盖率的同时显著提升OCSR可靠性并惠及下游化学任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学化学结构识别（OCSR）的可靠性至关重要，但即便微小识别错误也会传播到化学数据库和下游模型。实际应用中识别结构常需人工检查修正，导致大规模数据整理成本高、难以扩展。仅靠拒识的选择方法虽能提升可靠性，却无法在基础识别器输出之外产生新的正确结果。

Method: 提出ViCoR框架，核心是显式建立观测-预测对应关系：采用坐标保持渲染在源图像与预测结构间建立空间对应；通过索引锚定将局部视觉差异映射为可执行的图编辑，避免整体结构重新生成；并让共享VLM从验证逐步训练至修订，形成迭代的验证与修订流程。

Result: 在两个真实OCSR基准上，整体准确率分别从73.53%提升至88.26%、从61.83%提升至84.32%；在85–89%覆盖率下达到超过97%的接受准确率。生成的分子数据进一步使反应抽取F1提升15.5点，文献来源反应预测准确率分别提升7.7和5.8点。

Conclusion: ViCoR通过修复-拒识范式实现了自动化可靠性控制，在提升OCSR精度的同时保持高覆盖率，并有效改善下游化学学习任务，证明该方法对科学数据整理与下游化学学习具有重要价值。

Abstract: Reliable optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) is essential for building high-quality chemical data from scientific literature, yet even small recognition errors can propagate into chemical databases and downstream models. In practice, recognized structures often require manual inspection and correction before use, making large-scale data curation costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study Selective Structure Recognition (SSR), a post-recognition setting that automatically produces reliable structured outputs while rejecting unresolved cases. Selection-only approaches can improve reliability by rejection, but cannot create additional correct outputs beyond those produced by the base recognizer. We propose ViCoR, a repair-before-rejection framework for iterative VerIfiCatiOn and Revision. Its key idea is to make observation-prediction correspondence explicit: coordinate-preserving rendering establishes spatial correspondence between the source image and predicted structure, while index anchoring maps localized visual discrepancies to executable graph edits without full-structure regeneration. A shared VLM is progressively trained from verification to revision. On two real-world OCSR benchmarks, ViCoR improves overall accuracy from 73.53\% to 88.26\% and from 61.83\% to 84.32\%, while achieving over 97\% accepted accuracy at 85--89\% coverage. The resulting molecular data further improve reaction-extraction F1 by 15.5 points and literature-sourced reaction prediction accuracy by 7.7 and 5.8 points, demonstrating the value of automated reliability control for scientific data curation and downstream chemical learning.

</details>


### [233] [Anguinus Sculpturae: Compositional Synthesis of Peak-Enhancement Breast DCE-MRI Scans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33611)
*Benjamin Hamm,Nico Albert Disch,Maximilian Rokuss,Yannick Kirchhoff,Constantin Ulrich,Klaus Maier-Hein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将虚拟增强（合成峰值增强乳腺 MRI）简化为沿直线校正路径的单步差值预测，即以预对比图像加预测增强图，在一次前向传播中恢复合成峰值图；并构建由 nnU-Net 分割引导、双生成器与高斯加权融合组成的组合式流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DCE-MRI 富含解剖与灌注信息，但依赖钆基对比剂，存在安全隐患并增加成本；虚拟增强（由预对比图像合成后对比图像）是有前景的替代方案。作者针对 MAMA-SYNTH 挑战赛的峰值增强乳腺 MRI 预测任务展开研究。

Method: 不采用完整的扩散或流匹配框架，而是观察到在直线校正（rectified straight-line）路径下，生成过程退化为单次差值预测：合成峰值图像 = 预对比图像 + 预测的增强图，一次前向传播即可得到。以此为核心构建 Anguinus Sculpturae 组合式流水线：用 nnU-Net 分割病灶、前景与乳腺区域来引导两个生成器——一个优化全局保真度，另一个通过经冻结分割器路由的非对称 Tversky 项优化病灶结构；再按区域进行高斯加权融合。

Result: 在 MAMA-MIA 的留出 Duke 子集上，该模型在所有评估变体中取得最佳的 FRD 与 Dice，表明单步差值预测结合分割引导足以同时恢复全局保真度与病灶结构。

Conclusion: 单步差值预测配合分割引导即可有效实现虚拟对比增强的峰值图像合成，在全局与病灶层面均达到最优表现；代码已开源（https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/AnguinusSculpturae）。

Abstract: Dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is rich in anatomical and perfusion information, but its reliance on gadolinium-based contrast agents raises safety concerns and adds cost. Virtual contrast enhancement, synthesizing post-contrast from pre-contrast images, is a promising alternative. We address the MAMA-SYNTH challenge task of predicting peak-enhancement breast MRI. Rather than adopting the full machinery of diffusion or flow matching, we observe that under a rectified, straight-line path the generative process collapses to a single difference prediction: the synthetic peak image is the pre-contrast image plus a predicted enhancement map, recovered in one forward pass. Around this we build Anguinus Sculpturae, a compositional pipeline in which nnU-Net segmentations of lesion, foreground and breast region guide two generators - one optimized for global fidelity, one for lesion structure through an asymmetric Tversky term routed via a frozen segmenter - composited region-wise with Gaussian-weighted blending. On the held-out Duke subset of MAMA-MIA our model achieves the best FRD and Dice among all evaluated variants, showing that single-step difference prediction with segmentation guidance suffices to recover both global fidelity and lesion structure. Code is available at https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/AnguinusSculpturae.

</details>


### [234] [SpatialSpeak: QA-Native Reconstruction with Local and Global Context for Spatial Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33616)
*Yang Cao,Jiaxin Zhang,Dave Zhenyu Chen,Yingji Zhong,Ruiyuan Gao,Lanqing Hong,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpatialSpeak两阶段框架：先做QA原生多视角重建预训练(QA-RP)，再进行带视觉补偿的空间思维链学习(CoT-VC)，在多视角空间推理基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM可受益于几何先验进行多视角空间推理，但仅用答案监督无法直接监督中间几何估计及其用于推导定量空间答案的过程。

Method: 两阶段框架。阶段I为QA-RP：将标记点3D查询(细粒度局部几何)与物体中心查询(全局场景上下文)统一表述为文本问答，共享自回归输出接口进行重建预训练。阶段II为CoT-VC：训练模型输出与问题相关的几何估计并据此推导答案，辅以可靠性评估与视觉补偿用于答案修正。

Result: 在ReVSI上，QA-RP将CoT-VC的增益从2.6提升至6.9分；消融显示局部与全局重建监督均有收益。在ReVSI、VSI-Bench、SPAR-Bench上达到SOTA，ReVSI得分62.8，超最强基线8.7分。

Conclusion: 联合学习局部几何与全局场景上下文的多视角重建预训练能增强空间CoT监督效果，统一问答接口使几何估计与推理共享输出，显著提升多视角空间推理性能。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can benefit from geometric priors for multi-view spatial reasoning, yet answer-only training does not directly supervise the intermediate geometric estimates and their use in deriving quantitative spatial answers. We hypothesize that spatial chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision becomes more effective when the VLM first jointly learns complementary local geometry and global scene context through multi-view reconstruction. We introduce SpatialSpeak, a two-stage framework that connects QA-native reconstruction pretraining with spatial CoT learning. In Stage I, QA-Native Reconstruction Pretraining (QA-RP) combines marked-point 3D queries for fine-grained local geometry with object-center queries for global scene context across views. Both tasks are formulated as text-based question answering, allowing geometric estimation and subsequent reasoning to share the same autoregressive output interface. In Stage II, spatial CoT with Visual Compensation (CoT-VC) trains the model to express question-relevant geometric estimates and use them to derive answers, with reliability assessment and visual compensation supporting answer refinement when needed. On ReVSI, QA-RP increases the gain from CoT-VC from 2.6 to 6.9 points, and ablations show that both local and global reconstruction supervision are beneficial. SpatialSpeak achieves state-of-the-art results on ReVSI, VSI-Bench, and SPAR-Bench, with a ReVSI score of 62.8 that exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 8.7 points.

</details>


### [235] [StoryEngine: A State-Grounded Agentic Framework for Video Storytelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33627)
*Yingrui Wang,Zeqing Wang,Yeying Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出StoryEngine，一个状态驱动的智能体视频叙事框架：通过分离"权威语义计划"与"不可靠视觉观测"，维护结构化实体与状态表示并传播事件状态变化，结合规范参考与渲染计划及有界评估修复循环，实现连贯一致的长视频故事生成，并在自建基准上全面超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体式多镜头视频生成管线依赖文本分镜计划或已生成像素，缺乏显式的机制来传播故事事件的后果并跨镜头维持视频世界状态。这导致缺失的视觉细节被错误重建，视觉漂移在后续镜头中逐级扩散，损害叙事连贯性与视觉一致性。

Method: StoryEngine将权威语义计划与不可靠视觉观测分离：1) 维护实体布局与故事相关状态的结构化表示，并传播事件引发的状态变化，定义每个镜头的预期起始与结束状态；2) 为反复出现的实体与环境构建规范参考（canonical references），将状态与视觉约束编译为可执行的渲染计划；3) 引入有界评估引导的修复循环，纠正局部状态不一致。

Result: 构建了覆盖多样场景与视觉风格的长篇叙事基准，评估叙事质量、叙事连贯性与视觉一致性。实验表明StoryEngine在所有评估维度上持续优于最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过状态驱动与显式状态传播机制，可有效保持因果故事推进，防止局部视觉错误跨镜头扩散，验证了该框架在连贯一致视频叙事上的有效性。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in agentic multi-shot video generation, producing coherent and consistent long-form stories remains challenging. Existing agentic pipelines typically rely on textual shot plans or previously generated pixels, yet lack an explicit mechanism for propagating the consequences of story events and maintaining the video world state across shots. As a result, missing visual details may be reconstructed inaccurately, while visual drift may propagate across subsequent shots, undermining both narrative coherence and visual consistency. To address these challenges, we propose StoryEngine, a state-grounded agentic framework for video storytelling. StoryEngine establishes a separation between authoritative semantic plans and unreliable visual observations. Specifically, StoryEngine maintains a structured representation of entity placement and story-relevant states, and propagates event-induced changes to define the intended start and end states of each shot. To visually realize these states, StoryEngine constructs canonical references for recurring entities and environments, and compiles state and visual constraints into executable render plans. Meanwhile, to realize these states correctly, a bounded evaluation-guided repair loop further corrects local state inconsistencies. Together, these mechanisms preserve causal story progression and prevent local visual errors from propagating across shots. To comprehensively evaluate long-form storytelling, we construct a benchmark across diverse scenarios and visual styles, with metrics assessing storytelling quality, narrative coherence, and visual consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that StoryEngine consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation dimensions, validating its effectiveness for coherent and consistent video storytelling.

</details>


### [236] [When Noise Meets Long-Tail: Feature-Threshold Dual Calibration for Robust Pseudo-Labeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33668)
*Ping Guo,Zhiqi Huang,Xinran Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FTC-Seg框架，通过特征级与阈值级的双重校准，打破噪声与长尾分布共同导致的伪标签退化恶性循环，在多种噪声模态下显著提升语义分割性能，尤其在尾部类别上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪标签在半监督语义分割中至关重要，但在成像噪声强且类别分布长尾的真实场景下效果急剧下降。作者将这一失败归因于"伪标签退化恶性循环"：成像噪声使前景与背景特征纠缠，降低各类别预测置信度；长尾分布导致尾部类别训练样本极少、置信度天然偏低；在固定高阈值过滤下，尾部类别的预测被系统性滤除，无法获得无标注数据的监督，特征在后续迭代中持续退化。关键在于噪声与长尾并非彼此独立的障碍，而是相互放大，单独解决任一方都不充分。

Method: 提出FTC-Seg，一个基于标准教师-学生框架的特征-阈值双重校准框架：1）特征层面——正交原型重建（OPR，Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction），使用一组可学习的正交原型对逐像素特征进行残差净化，拉大弱前景目标与噪声背景之间的间隔；2）阈值层面——自适应阈值校准（ATC，Adaptive Threshold Calibration），基于学习难度与预测分布偏差动态调整类别特定阈值，将尾部类别的低置信度伪标签从系统性排除中解救出来。

Result: 在涵盖三种不同噪声模态的四个公开基准上，FTC-Seg 相较当前最先进方法取得强劲性能，且在尾部类别上的提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在噪声与类别不平衡叠加的情况下，联合校准特征与阈值对于实现鲁棒的伪标签学习是必不可少的。

Abstract: Pseudo-labeling has become a cornerstone of learning from unlabeled data in semantic segmentation. Yet its effectiveness drops sharply in real-world scenarios where strong imaging noise and long-tailed class distributions occur together. We trace this failure to a vicious cycle of pseudo-label degradation. Imaging noise entangles foreground and background features, lowering prediction confidence across all classes, while long-tailed distributions leave tail classes with far fewer training samples and inherently lower confidence. Under fixed high-threshold filtering, these tail-class predictions are systematically filtered out, so they receive no supervision from unlabeled data and thus features keep degrading in subsequent iterations. Critically, noise and long-tail are not independent obstacles but mutually amplifying ones, and addressing either alone is insufficient. To break this cycle, we propose FTC-Seg, a Feature-Threshold dual-Calibration framework built on a standard teacher-student framework. At the feature level, Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR) uses a set of learnable orthogonal prototypes to residually purify pixel-wise features, widening the margin between weak foreground targets and noisy backgrounds. At the threshold level, Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC) dynamically adjusts class-specific thresholds based on learning difficulty and prediction-distribution bias, rescuing low-confidence pseudo-labels of tail classes from systematic exclusion. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks spanning three distinct noise modalities show that FTC-Seg achieves strong performance against state-of-the-art methods, with particularly substantial gains on tail classes. Our results establish that jointly calibrating features and thresholds is essential for robust pseudo-labeling under compounded noise and class imbalance.

</details>


### [237] [MAD-Guard: Controlled Study of Autoregressive Generation versus Direct Decision Interfaces for Closed Multimodal Forensic Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33683)
*Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 MAD-Guard，在匹配的 Qwen3-VL-8B 主干上系统研究封闭式多模态取证任务的输出决策接口：当输入复杂度高但输出熵低时，自回归生成并非必要，直接决策头可大幅降低延迟并改善校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态基础模型通常采用自回归生成输出，但对封闭式取证决策（高输入复杂度、低输出熵）而言，token 解码可能带来不必要的延迟开销。作者希望厘清何时应生成 token、何时应直接输出决策，并量化不同决策接口在精度、延迟与校准间的权衡。

Method: 在匹配的 Qwen3-VL-8B 主干、2,400 个 FakeClue 训练样本、LoRA（r=16, α=32）及华为昇腾 910C NPU 上，评估一系列决策接口递进：AR-SFT（生成）→ Logit Slice → Binary Direct Head → +choice → +act → CLM-Head；并将延迟分解为主干表示（53.12 ms）、151,643 维词表投影（+85.04 ms → 138.16 ms）与解码（+248.26 ms → 386.42 ms）。

Result: 1-to-1 二元监督（BCE）下，Binary Direct Head 将延迟降低 2.60×–7.27×（53.12 ms），校准误差降低 1.88×（ECE 0.0450 vs. 0.0845），精度仅牺牲 -1.80%（93.10% vs. 94.90%；ROC-AUC 0.9795 vs. 0.9871）。优于 AR-SFT 的增益来自多任务归因与不确定性门控（+choice+act：96.44% 精度、0.9940 ROC-AUC、0.0187 ECE、53.71 ms）或分解式对比头（CLM-Head：96.55% 二元、96.44% 多任务精度、0.0166 ECE、98.79% 七分类归因、54.42 ms），在保留语义先验的同时无需 token 解码。在五个基准的 5,000 张样本外图像上，合成、伪装与文档伪造表现优异（GenImage 96.44%、Chameleon 97.73%、Doc 91.84%），但在压缩人脸篡改上存在明显边界（FF++ ROC-AUC = 0.5913）。

Conclusion: 对于高输入复杂度、低输出熵的封闭式取证决策，直接决策接口比自回归生成更高效且校准更好；通过多任务归因、不确定性门控或分解式对比头可弥补放弃 token 先验带来的精度损失，但方法在压缩人脸篡改场景仍存在适用边界。

Abstract: When should multimodal foundation models generate tokens, and when should they directly output a decision? We present MAD-Guard, a controlled study of output-decision interfaces for closed multimodal forensic tasks. Once a multimodal representation is computed, is autoregressive generation necessary for closed forensic decisions with high input complexity but low output entropy? Under a matched Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, 2,400 FakeClue training samples, and LoRA budget ($r=16, α=32$) on Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, we evaluate a progression of decision interfaces (AR-SFT [generate] $\to$ Logit Slice $\to$ Binary Direct Head $\to$ +choice $\to$ +act $\to$ CLM-Head) and decompose latency into backbone representation (53.12 ms), 151,643-way vocabulary projection (+85.04 ms $\to$ 138.16 ms), and decoding (+248.26 ms $\to$ 386.42 ms). Under 1-to-1 binary supervision ($\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}$), a Binary Direct Head cuts latency by $2.60\times$-$7.27\times$ (53.12 ms) and lowers calibration error by $1.88\times$ (ECE = 0.0450 vs. 0.0845), with a -1.80% accuracy trade-off (93.10% vs. 94.90%; 0.9795 vs. 0.9871 ROC-AUC) from forfeiting token priors. Gains above AR-SFT arise either from multi-task attribution and uncertainty gating (+choice+act: 96.44% accuracy, 0.9940 ROC-AUC, 0.0187 ECE at 53.71 ms) or from a disaggregated contrastive head (CLM-Head: 96.55% binary and 96.44% multi-task accuracy, 0.0166 ECE, 98.79% 7-class attribution at 54.42 ms) retaining semantic priors without token decoding. Across 5,000 out-of-sample images from five benchmarks, our framework excels on synthetic, camouflage, and document forgeries (96.44% GenImage, 97.73% Chameleon, 91.84% Doc) while showing a clear boundary on compressed face manipulation (FF++ ROC-AUC = 0.5913).

</details>


### [238] [Resource-Aware Parameter-Efficient Model Adaptation for Onboard High-Dimensional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33687)
*Qiyang Zhang,Xinhao Li,Lei Shi,Zheng Lin,Jinfeng Wen,Ao Zhou,Shangguang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出NE-LoRA，一种面向带宽受限星载高光谱模型更新的参数高效适配框架，通过主低秩分支与非线性辅助分支结合，并采用差异化训练策略，在仅更新少量参数的情况下取得优于LoRA基线、媲美甚至超越全量微调的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星载卫星模型需要频繁更新，但适应早期数据分布的权重会迅速过时。在轨更新大规模参数面临低轨（LEO）卫星系统上行带宽受限的严峻挑战，高光谱图像的高维光谱-空间输入进一步增大模型规模与更新成本。现有全量微调方法重训练代价高，难以在严格通信约束下部署。因此需要一种参数高效、低部署开销的适配方案。

Method: 提出NE-LoRA框架，包含：1）主低秩分支，用于捕捉整体更新趋势；2）非线性辅助分支，用于捕捉复杂的光谱-空间变化；3）针对多矩阵适配器的差异化训练策略，其动机来自不同适配器矩阵在非对称初始化与梯度动态上的差异。

Result: 在四个高光谱数据集和三个代表性骨干模型上进行实验，NE-LoRA持续优于基于LoRA的基线，并与全量微调相当，在若干情况下甚至更优。在所有评估设置中，NE-LoRA平均仅更新总参数的很小一部分，同时保持低部署开销，实现了良好的精度-通信权衡。

Conclusion: NE-LoRA为星载高光谱模型在带宽约束下的适配提供了一种参数高效方案，兼顾精度与通信开销，优于LoRA类方法并可媲美全量微调，具有良好的在轨部署前景。

Abstract: Onboard satellite models often require frequent updates, but the weights adapted to earlier data distributions can quickly become outdated. However, updating large-scale model parameters in orbit presents significant challenges due to the limited uplink bandwidth of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems, particularly for hyperspectral satellite imagery, where high-dimensional spectral-spatial inputs lead to increased model size and update costs. Existing full fine-tuning methods are thus expensive to retrain and difficult to deploy under strict communication constraints. To address this challenge, we propose NE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for bandwidth-constrained onboard hyperspectral model updates. NE-LoRA combines a primary low-rank branch with a nonlinear auxiliary branch to capture both global update trends and complex spectral-spatial variations. Additionally, we introduce a differentiated training strategy for multi-matrix adapters, motivated by the asymmetric initialization and gradient dynamics of different adapter matrices. Experiments on four hyperspectral datasets and three representative backbone models demonstrate that NE-LoRA consistently outperforms LoRA-based baselines and remains competitive with, and in several cases superior to, full fine-tuning. Across the evaluated settings, NE-LoRA updates only a small fraction of the total parameters on average while preserving low deployment overhead, offering a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off for onboard hyperspectral adaptation.

</details>


### [239] [Seeing and Solving Are Not Enough for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33694)
*Ziheng Wang,Mingxuan Xie,Yilin Liu,Dayan Wu,Yang Li,Pengwen Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现VLM答错多因"组合失败"（提取与求解单独成功但联合失败），提出SRT方法在自回归输出中先产出任务状态再给答案，显著修复该类错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究"错误答案是否必然意味着视觉提取或问题求解失败"这一根本问题。单体答对率无法区分：模型可能在提取与求解两项能力上分别成功，却在原始多模态问题上失败，即组合失败模式被整体准确率掩盖。

Method: 开展问题级实证分析：定义"精确可评分任务状态"（足以求解问题的视觉信息），对同一模型分别测试三件事——能否提取该状态、能否由真值状态求解问题、能否回答原始多模态问题。提出State Realization Tuning (SRT)：冻结预训练VLM权重，仅微调挂在语言模型层上的LoRA适配器，训练模型在单次自回归响应中先输出真值任务状态再输出最终答案。

Result: 在多VLM、多数据集上，组合失败占直接作答错误的17.7%–75.6%。SRT较标准监督微调提升1.7–14.1个百分点，修复92.5%–98.1%已诊断的组合失败；单个SRT训练的LoRA适配器还能跨差异较大的任务状态结构迁移提升性能。

Conclusion: 同时具备视觉提取与问题求解能力并不保证多模态作答正确；要求模型先输出求解问题所需的视觉信息，可弥合这一差距。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) answer visual questions by combining visual information extraction with downstream problem solving. We investigate a fundamental question: Does an incorrect answer necessarily reflect a failure in visual extraction or problem solving? A model may succeed at both abilities when tested separately yet still fail on the original multimodal question, a distinction that overall answer accuracy cannot reveal. To study this, we perform a question-level empirical analysis across multiple VLMs and visual domains. We define an exactly scorable task state (i.e., the visual information sufficient to solve a question) and use it to test whether the same model can extract the required state, solve the question from the ground-truth state, and answer the original multimodal question. We find that composition failures, where extraction and solving both succeed but direct answering fails, account for 17.7% to 75.6% of direct-answering errors across multiple VLMs and datasets. To address this failure mode, we introduce a simple yet effective method, termed State Realization Tuning (SRT). SRT fine-tunes LoRA adapters attached to the language-model layers while keeping the pretrained VLM weights frozen. It trains the model to output the ground-truth task state before the final answer in a single autoregressive response. SRT improves over standard supervised fine-tuning by 1.7 to 14.1 percentage points and repairs 92.5% to 98.1% of diagnosed composition failures. A single LoRA adapter trained with SRT also improves performance across substantially different task-state structures. Our work shows that having both visual extraction and problem-solving capabilities does not guarantee correct multimodal answering. Requiring the model to first output the visual information needed to solve the question can help bridge this gap.

</details>


### [240] [Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation for Biomedical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33701)
*Jingxuan Kang,Qianying Yue,Che Liu,Chen Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA)方法，通过将冻结的prompt预测作为支持集不变的语义锚点，并结合基于支持集的视觉预测，以锚点相对残差的形式实现少样本适应；同时提出重复支持集评测协议，报告平均与最差20%性能。PARA在少样本分类和基类到新类泛化上均达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练生物医学视觉-语言模型虽在零样本分类上表现优异，但下游分类常依赖类别间细微视觉差异，预训练表征难以充分捕捉。少样本适应可缓解这一不匹配，但所选取的少量支持样本仅覆盖目标类内部分视觉变化，导致适应预测高度依赖支持集构成。

Method: 提出PARA：保留冻结的prompt预测作为支持集不变的语义锚点，将支持集学得的视觉预测以锚点相对残差形式融合；该残差步骤基于冻结的支持集嵌入，利用锚点差异度与支持集一致性以闭式解计算。同时提出重复支持集协议，将支持集选择变异与优化随机性分离，并报告平均性能与最差20%性能。

Result: PARA在少样本分类与基类到新类泛化两个任务上均取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: 将冻结prompt预测作为语义锚点并结合锚点相对残差，可有效降低少样本适应对支持集构成的依赖；引入重复支持集评测协议能够提供更可靠的比较，兼顾平均与最差情形表现。

Abstract: Pretrained biomedical vision-language models achieve strong zero-shot performance in biomedical image classification. However, downstream biomedical classification often depends on subtle visual differences between classes that may not be fully captured by pretrained representations. Few-shot adaptation addresses this mismatch by optimizing a task-specific predictor on a small labeled support set. Because the selected examples capture only part of the visual variation within the target classes, the adapted predictions can depend strongly on their composition. We propose Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA), which retains the frozen prompt prediction as a support-invariant semantic anchor and incorporates a visual prediction learned from the support set through an anchor-relative residual. The residual step is computed in a closed form from frozen support embeddings using anchor discrepancy and support agreement. Support-set dependence also limits evaluation: comparisons are fair within a shared draw but remain conditional on its composition. To obtain more reliable comparisons, we introduce a repeated-support protocol that separates support-selection variation from optimization randomness and reports both average and worst-20% performance. PARA achieves state-of-the-art performance in both few-shot classification and base-to-novel generalization.

</details>


### [241] [Revisiting Diffusion Fine-Tuning for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33716)
*Xuan Qi,Yi Wei,Daniele Berardini,Vito Paolo Pastore,Vittorio Murino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MUSE框架，通过解耦语义与风格分支，实现单次源引导扩散微调即可为多个目标域生成合成数据的多目标UDA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的UDA方法主要面向单目标迁移，当源域模型需适配多个无标注目标域时，需为每个源--目标对单独微调扩散模型，导致训练、存储和部署成本随目标数量线性增长。

Method: MUSE采用解耦式适配框架，将源监督的语义适配与目标特定的风格适配分离：使用由有标注源数据更新的共享语义分支，以及针对各目标域的私有风格分支，从而在无需重复源引导微调的前提下实现目标特定的数据生成。

Result: 在标准UDA基准上，MUSE相比逐目标重复扩散适配实现了更优的精度--效率权衡，在降低扩散微调成本的同时提升了目标域平均精度。

Conclusion: 通过解耦共享语义与目标私有风格，MUSE使一次扩散微调可复用于多目标生成，为多目标UDA提供了高效且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Diffusion-based unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) improves cross-domain transfer by generating target-specific synthetic data for downstream adaptation. Existing methods are largely designed for single-target adaptation: when a model trained on one labeled source domain must be adapted to multiple unlabeled target domains, they typically require separate diffusion fine-tuning for each source--target pair, causing training, storage, and deployment costs to grow with the number of targets. In this paper, we study multi-target data generation for diffusion-based UDA, where a single source-guided diffusion fine-tuning process is reused to generate target-specific synthetic data for multiple target domains. We propose MUSE (Multi-target UDA-oriented Synthesis with Efficient diffusion fine-tuning), a decoupled adaptation framework that separates source-supervised semantic adaptation from target-specific style adaptation. MUSE uses a shared semantic branch updated by labeled source data and target-private style branches specialized to individual target domains, enabling target-specific generation while avoiding repeated source-guided fine-tuning for each target. Experiments on standard UDA benchmarks show that MUSE achieves a stronger accuracy--efficiency trade-off than repeated per-target diffusion adaptation, reducing diffusion fine-tuning cost while improving average target-domain accuracy. The project page is available at https://xuanqi99.github.io/MUSE/.

</details>


### [242] [GeoShrink: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Two Lines of Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33723)
*Haosen Li,Wenshuo Chen,Shaofeng Liang,Lei Wang,Bowen Tian,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoShrink：一种免训练的扩散Transformer加速方法，保留原求解器网格，仅在预设锚点处评估模型，在跳过阶段通过几何保留比例的创新项预测输出，实现约5倍加速并显著提升生成保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer推理需沿采样轨迹反复评估模型，推理开销巨大，因此需要一种高效加速手段。

Method: 保留原求解器网格，仅在规定锚点处评估模型；跳过阶段将最新观测创新按几何保留比例加到最近精确输出上预测求解器输出。规则由弦切线传输与往返线投影推导，并建立几何锚点间距准则，在固定覆盖与首跨度下最小化最大相邻间隙扩张；分析刻画了不依赖未来模型输出的预测误差几何闭合与传播。

Result: 在约5倍加速下，FLUX PSNR较最强基线提升3.10 dB；HunyuanVideo上报告4.99倍加速，ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR较最强保真度基线提升5.44 dB；固定评估预算下在运动、音频、音乐与3D生成上均有显著增益，覆盖图像、视频、运动、音频及适配3D后端。

Conclusion: GeoShrink为免训练、跨模态通用的扩散Transformer加速方法，在保持求解器网格的同时大幅降低模型评估次数，实现高倍加速与保真度提升。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers incur substantial inference cost through repeated model evaluations along a sampling trajectory. We introduce GeoShrink, a training-free acceleration method that retains the original solver grid while evaluating the model only at a prescribed set of anchors. At skipped stages, GeoShrink predicts the solver-facing output by adding a geometrically retained fraction of the latest observed innovation to the most recent exact output. We derive this rule from chordal tangent transport and round-trip line projection, and establish a geometric anchor-spacing principle that minimizes the largest adjacent gap expansion under fixed coverage and first span. The analysis characterizes the geometric closure and propagation of prediction errors without assuming access to future model outputs. Experiments cover image, video, motion, and audio generation, together with adapted 3D backends. At approximately $5\times$ acceleration, GeoShrink improves FLUX PSNR by 3.10 dB over the strongest listed baseline. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a reported $4.99\times$ speedup and improves ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR by 5.44 dB over the strongest listed fidelity baseline. Comparisons at fixed evaluation budgets further show substantial gains on motion, audio, music, and 3D generation.

</details>


### [243] [Constrained Edit Fields for Training-Free Flow Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33735)
*Jingxuan Kang,Yinsong Wang,Che Liu,Chen Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Constrained Edit Fields (CEF)，为每个空间位置分配连续编辑责任权重，分解并抑制轨迹诱导的非目标变化，实现免训练文本引导图像编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练 rectified-flow 模型支持免训练编辑，但采样轨迹中非编辑区域也会累积响应并在结果中显现，导致内容保持不佳。

Method: CEF 从源图像直接估计编辑责任；当目标内容在源中缺失时，先生成无约束提案以确定其空间支撑再估计责任。每步将基础编辑场分解为 prompt-induced 与 trajectory-induced 分量，用编辑责任保留指令相关更新、抑制轨迹诱导的无关变化。

Result: 在 PIE-Bench 全部 700 例上，CEF 以 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 与 FLUX 取得最优 Structure Distance、背景 LPIPS 与背景 MSE，同时保持有竞争力的指令对齐。在 SD 3.5 Medium 上，三项指标较此前最优分别降低 10.2%、21.2%、48.0%。

Conclusion: CEF 通过空间编辑责任建模与轨迹分量分解，有效抑制非目标区域累积变化，在结构保持与背景一致性上达到 SOTA。

Abstract: Text-guided image editing aims to perform a desired edit while preserving source content unrelated to it. Pretrained rectified-flow models enable training-free editing of real images through modifications to their sampling trajectories. However, responses at locations unrelated to the desired edit can still accumulate along the editing trajectory and become visible in the final result. To overcome this, we propose Constrained Edit Fields (CEF), which assigns each spatial location a continuous edit responsibility that quantifies its relevance to the desired edit. CEF estimates edit responsibility directly from the source image when the relevant content is present. For edits whose target content is absent from the source, CEF first generates an unconstrained proposal to reveal its realized spatial support and then estimates responsibility from that proposal. At each editing step, CEF decomposes the base edit field into prompt-induced and trajectory-induced components, enabling edit responsibility to preserve instruction-relevant updates while suppressing unintended trajectory-induced changes. Evaluated on all 700 PIE-Bench examples, CEF achieves state-of-the-art Structure Distance, background LPIPS, and background MSE with both Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and FLUX, while retaining competitive instruction alignment. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, it reduces these metrics over the previous best results by 10.2%, 21.2%, and 48.0%, respectively.

</details>


### [244] [ENet-GP: Unified Document Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33758)
*Sujal Burad,Aakanksha,A. N. Rajagopalan,Sumit Shekar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: The paper introduces GutenDoc, a large-scale dataset of high-resolution dense-text documents with physically grounded compound degradations, and a unified single-network restoration framework that jointly corrects geometric and photometric distortions for robust real-world document digitization.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Real captured document images suffer from multiple interacting degradations (geometric warping plus photometric effects such as non-uniform illumination and blurring) simultaneously, yet most existing methods tackle these factors independently and are evaluated on benchmarks with only a single distortion type, limiting real-world applicability.

Method: Using physics-based rendering, the authors build GutenDoc, which jointly models geometric warping and diverse photometric effects to enable systematic evaluation under realistic capture conditions. They also propose a unified restoration framework that corrects both geometric and photometric distortions within a single network and single training setup, requiring no degradation-specific retraining or sequential inference passes.

Result: Extensive experiments show the method remains competitive on established single-distortion benchmarks while substantially improving robustness under compound degradations.

Conclusion: The proposed dataset and unified framework offer a practical solution for real-world document digitization under uncontrolled capture settings.

Abstract: Reliable document digitization in uncontrolled capture settings is challenging because real images exhibit multiple interacting degradations rather than a single isolated distortion. Documents thus captured are affected simultaneously by geometric distortions, like page warping, as well as photometric degradations such as non-uniform illumination, and blurring. However, most existing approaches address these factors independently and are evaluated on benchmarks containing only one distortion type, limiting their real-world applicability. We introduce GutenDoc, a large-scale dataset of high-resolution dense-text documents with physically grounded compound degradations. Using physics-based rendering, our dataset jointly models geometric warping and diverse photometric effects, enabling systematic evaluation under realistic capture conditions. We further propose a unified restoration framework that jointly corrects geometric and photometric distortions within a single-network and single-training setup, without the need for degradation-specific retraining or sequential inference passes. Extensive experiments show that our method remains competitive on established single-distortion benchmarks while substantially improving robustness under compound degradations, providing a practical solution for real-world document digitization.

</details>


### [245] [M3-Score: Fidelity, Memorization and Coverage as Separate Axes for Evaluating Generative Radiology Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33769)
*Sathiyamohan Nishankar,Pubudu Sanjeewani,Asanka Perera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 M3-Score，一种基于放射学预训练视觉 Transformer（RadioDINO-s16）的医学图像生成模型评估框架，从保真度、记忆化和覆盖率三个互补维度进行评价，在 BraTS 脑 MRI 上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型定量评估方法存在不足：临床相关结构通常较小且出现频率低；从自然图像学到的特征空间难以充分表征这些结构；单一汇总分数无法区分保真度有限与多样性不足的问题。因此需要针对放射学领域设计更细致的评估框架。

Method: 提出 Medical Multi-axis Maximum Mean Discrepancy score（M3-Score），基于在放射学图像上预训练的冻结视觉 Transformer（RadioDINO-s16）。在预设的编码器深度上计算三个互补维度：保真度（最终块上的无偏多带宽 RBF MMD²）、记忆化（75% 深度处的最近邻距离）、覆盖率（33% 深度处，真实图像中具有生成近邻且落在其 k 近邻半径内的比例）。参考集跨受试者采样以减少相关切片的影响。

Result: 在 BraTS 脑 MRI 上，保真度轴对五个严重程度递增的比较集实现完美排序（Spearman ρ=1.00）；受试者不相交的真实集得到 MMD²=0（置换检验 p=1）。无条件去噪扩散概率模型 MMD²=0.073（95% CI [0.071, 0.080]），但仅覆盖 38% 的真实分布。渐进式模式丢弃下，k-NN 流形召回在全部十二个编码器块均上升，而所提覆盖率估计量单调下降（ρ=-1.00）。RadioDINO-s16 特征区分真实与生成脑 MRI 的 ROC-AUC 为 0.819，而 InceptionV3 为 0.555、CLIP 为 0.582。在二十倍样本量范围内，M3 均值变化因子为 1.05，而 FID 为 2.52。

Conclusion: M3-Score 通过多轴设计与放射学专用特征，能够有效区分生成模型的保真度与多样性缺陷，对样本量变化稳健，并在排序、覆盖率检测及真实性判别上优于 InceptionV3、CLIP 及 FID 等传统指标，为医学图像生成模型提供了更可靠的评估工具。

Abstract: Quantitative evaluation of generative models for radiology remains challenging. Clinically relevant structures are often small and infrequent, feature spaces learned from natural images may represent them poorly, and a single summary score cannot distinguish limited fidelity from limited diversity. This study proposes the Medical Multi-axis Maximum Mean Discrepancy score (M3-Score), an evaluation framework based on RadioDINO-s16, a frozen vision transformer pretrained on radiology images. M3-Score reports three complementary axes computed at pre-specified encoder depths: \emph{fidelity}, measured by an unbiased multi-bandwidth radial basis function (RBF) MMD$^2$ at the final block; \emph{memorization}, measured by nearest-neighbor distances at 75\% depth; and \emph{coverage}, defined as the fraction of real images with a generated neighbor within their $k$-nearest-neighbor radius at 33\% depth. Reference sets are sampled across subjects to limit the influence of correlated slices. On BraTS brain MRI, the fidelity axis ordered five comparison sets of increasing severity (Spearman $ρ= 1.00$), and a subject-disjoint real set yielded $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0$ (permutation $p = 1$). An unconditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model achieved $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0.073$ (95\% confidence interval $[0.071, 0.080]$) but covered only 38\% of the real distribution. Under progressive mode dropping, $k$-NN manifold recall increased at all twelve encoder blocks, whereas the proposed coverage estimator decreased monotonically ($ρ= -1.00$). RadioDINO-s16 features separated real brain MRI from generated samples with a ROC-AUC of 0.819, compared with 0.555 for InceptionV3 and 0.582 for CLIP. Across a twentyfold range of sample sizes, the mean M3 value varied by a factor of 1.05, compared with 2.52 for the Fréchet Inception Distance.

</details>


### [246] [Eyes on the Road: A Naturalistic Comparison of MTW Rider Gaze in Urban Indian Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33811)
*Prerak Srivastava,Bhaiya Vaibhaw Kumar,Kavita Vemuri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次对印度城市自然驾驶中摩托两轮车(MTW)骑手眼动行为进行大规模分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MTW在印度道路占主导，但驾驶行为研究中长期被忽视；缺乏对异质城市交通中MTW骑手注意力结构的大规模实证分析。

Method: 使用myEye2Wheeler数据集；以YOLOv11+SAM2构建语义分割流水线，提取对象级注视指标，区分直接注视（中央凹重叠）与中央视觉（副中央凹监测）两种注意模式，并对比新手与经验骑手。

Result: 揭示功能性分工：中央视觉支撑广域监测，直接注视实现短暂选择性采样；新手呈“道路锚定”扫描（对象注视间回视道路），经验骑手形成跨多对象的长注意链。

Conclusion: 经验主要优化注意的时间节奏而非改变资源分配策略，并削弱对象类别对注视模式的影响；为MTW行为建模与安全系统提供依据。

Abstract: Motorized two-wheelers (MTW) dominate Indian roads but remain underrepresented in driver behavior research. This study presents the first large-scale analysis of MTW driver gaze behavior in naturalistic, heterogeneous urban traffic, using the \textit{myEye2Wheeler} dataset. A semantic segmentation pipeline (YOLOv11 + SAM2) was used to extract object-level gaze metrics under two attention modes: direct gaze (foveal overlap) and central vision (parafoveal monitoring). Results reveal a functional division: central vision supports broad monitoring, while direct gaze enables brief, selective sampling. Novice riders exhibit road-anchored scanning, returning to the road between object fixations, while experienced riders form longer chains of attention across multiple objects. The findings suggest that experience primarily refines temporal rhythm rather than altering allocation strategy and reduces object-class effects in gaze patterns. These findings offer new insight into MTW attention structures and inform future work on behavior modeling and safety systems.

</details>


### [247] [Augmenting Visual Anomaly Detection with Automated Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33818)
*Antonio De Santis,Arsenio Leo,Marco Brambilla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将PatchCore最近邻残差用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分解为稀疏特征，借助多模态大模型（MLLM）对特征进行语义描述与标注（异常/干扰/不确定），并在SAE隐空间抑制干扰特征、放大异常特征，重编辑表示重构补丁嵌入后重打分。在四个基准40类上宏平均图像级AUROC由0.8724升至0.8857，合成损坏下由0.8066升至0.8210；在3个真实采集偏移类别上由0.8745升至0.9056，真实偏移下由0.6069升至0.6599。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉异常检测器的异常信号中混有真实异常证据与良性视觉变化（干扰），导致误报与鲁棒性不足。作者希望借助自动化可解释性（MLLM）识别并干预信号中的不同成分，从而提升异常检测器性能。

Method: 以PatchCore的最近邻残差为对象，用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将其分解为稀疏特征；向多模态大模型提供高激活与对比性非激活样本，令其描述每个特征并标注为异常、干扰或不确定；依据标注在SAE隐表示中进行干预：抑制干扰特征、放大异常特征；将编辑后的表示重构回补丁嵌入，再用PatchCore重新打分。

Result: 40类四个基准：宏平均图像级AUROC从0.8724提升至0.8857（源数据），合成损坏下从0.8066提升至0.8210。3个真实采集偏移类别：AUROC从0.8745提升至0.9056（源数据），真实采集偏移下从0.6069提升至0.6599。43类的单特征干预显示，MLLM标注在总体上与特征对正常样本和异常样本的不同影响相吻合。

Conclusion: 自动化可解释性能够有效分解并干预异常信号成分，联合施加干扰抑制与异常放大可稳定提升图像级异常检测性能，且在合成损坏与真实采集偏移下均带来鲁棒性增益；MLLM的特征语义标注与特征的判别行为在总体上保持一致，验证了该干预框架的有效性与合理性。

Abstract: Visual anomaly detectors identify deviations from known-normal data, but their anomaly signals may mix evidence of actual anomalies with benign visual variation. We investigate whether automated interpretability can augment visual anomaly detectors by identifying and intervening on different components of this signal. We decompose PatchCore nearest-normal residuals into sparse features using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), and provide high-activation and contrastive non-active examples to a Multimodal LLM, which describes each feature and labels it as anomaly, distractor, or uncertain. These labels guide interventions in the SAE hidden representation, where distractor features are suppressed and anomaly features amplified. The edited representation is then used to reconstruct patch embeddings, which are rescored with PatchCore. Across 40 categories from four benchmarks, applying both interventions jointly improves macro-average image-level AUROC from 0.8724 to 0.8857 on source data and from 0.8066 to 0.8210 under synthetic corruptions. On three additional RobustAD categories with real acquisition shifts, the same interventions improve AUROC from 0.8745 to 0.9056 on source data and from 0.6069 to 0.6599 under real acquisition shifts. Finally, individual feature interventions across all 43 categories show that the MLLM labels are aligned in aggregate with how features differently affect normal and anomalous images.

</details>


### [248] [One Attack to Fool Them All: Highly Transferable Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Frontier MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33833)
*Sen Nie,Jie Zhang,Zhongqi Wang,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出O-Attack黑盒对抗攻击框架，利用代理模型跨模态对齐的高层语义空间提升对前沿多模态大模型的迁移攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）快速演进并广泛部署，其对抗攻击脆弱性评估对安全使用至关重要；本文关注单一对抗图像能否在黑盒设置下稳定误导多种前沿MLLMs。

Method: 基于"代理模型蕴含广泛、高层、跨模态对齐的语义空间"这一洞见，该空间超越最终层输出并提供多种语义一致的表示。O-Attack在该空间内锚定对齐表示、逐步拓宽语义条件，并通过语义共识优化扰动以促进一致的目标对齐；使用与M-Attack相同的代理模型以充分利用该空间。

Result: 攻击成功率显著提升：GPT-5.4（29.1%→77.2%）、Claude-4.6（42.8%→81.6%）、Gemini-3.1（38.2%→80.9%）；在24个MLLMs上的大量实验表明，O-Attack在黑盒迁移性上优于六种SOTA方法，且在不同提示下效果一致，并具有更高的效率与不可感知性。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了黑盒对抗攻击对前沿MLLMs构成的现实安全风险，强调需要更严格的鲁棒性评估与更有效的防御。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks have long posed a fundamental threat to machine learning systems. As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) rapidly evolve and become widely deployed, assessing their vulnerability to such attacks is essential for their safe use. In this work, we investigate whether a single adversarial image can consistently mislead diverse frontier MLLMs in black-box settings. We propose O-Attack, a highly transferable black-box attack framework. This framework builds on our insight that surrogate models contain a broad, high-level, cross-modally aligned semantic space. This space extends beyond final-layer outputs and provides multiple semantically consistent representations that remain underexploited by existing attacks. Within this space, O-Attack anchors aligned representations, progressively broadens semantic conditions, and optimizes perturbations through semantic consensus to promote consistent target alignment. By fully exploiting this space with the same surrogate models as M-Attack, O-Attack raises attack success rates on GPT-5.4 (29.1% to 77.2%), Claude-4.6 (42.8% to 81.6%), and Gemini-3.1 (38.2% to 80.9%). Extensive experiments across 24 MLLMs show that O-Attack outperforms six state-of-the-art methods in black-box transferability, with consistent effectiveness across prompts and improved efficiency and imperceptibility. This work exposes the practical safety risks posed by black-box adversarial attacks against frontier MLLMs, underscoring the need for more rigorous robustness evaluation and more effective defenses.

</details>


### [249] [CLIMB-flow: Coupled Linear Inverse posterior sampling via Multiscale-Based flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33834)
*Zeqiu Yu,Ruizhi Yuan,Mathews Jacob*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLIMB-Flow，一种针对金字塔/级联架构扩散模型定制的后验采样算法，在像素域以由粗到细的分层策略求解贝叶斯逆问题，兼顾计算效率与空间细节恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜扩散模型在大规模成像逆问题中作先验可控制计算复杂度与模型规模，但自编码器压缩导致空间细节丢失，且优化问题被转化为非线性问题，影响重建质量。

Method: 针对金字塔/级联架构设计粗到细的分层后验采样：交替执行三步——从当前粗糙含噪图像进行端点估计、对干净图像做数据一致性更新、再噪声化回网络期望的噪声水平；三步共同通过近似Gibbs采样从两个条件分布中采样该尺度下的后验。

Result: 在ImageNet、CelebA、AFHQ与fastMRI上覆盖inpainting、deblurring、超分辨与加速MRI任务；CelebA上PSNR较最强对比方法提升1.37–7.66 dB，并实现最高512x512的像素域重建。

Conclusion: 在像素域直接采样的分层扩散先验方法能有效规避潜空间压缩带来的细节损失与非线性优化难题，在多种成像逆问题上取得显著定量增益。

Abstract: Diffusion models are now widely used in Bayesian inverse problems in imaging as priors, where latent diffusion models are often used for larger scale problems to keep the computational complexity and model-size manageable. Unfortunately, the auto-encoder based compression results in loss of spatial detail. In addition, the optimization is converted to a non-linear problem. In this paper, we introduce a posterior sampling algorithm customized for the pyramidal/cascaded architecture, which relies on a coarse to fine hierarchical strategy to generate images in the pixel domain. We present CLIMB-Flow which alternates between three steps: an end-point estimation from the current coarse and noisy image, data-consistent update of the clean image, and re-noising it back to the level the network expects. Together these steps sample the posterior at that scale using an approximate Gibbs sampling from two conditional distributions. Experiments on ImageNet, CelebA, AFHQ and fastMRI span inpainting, deblurring, super-resolution and accelerated MRI, with PSNR gains of 1.37-7.66 dB over the strongest competing method on CelebA and pixel-domain reconstruction up to 512x512.

</details>


### [250] [ReDrive: Shaping Representations with World Modeling for End-to-End Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33854)
*Yueting Zhu,Shaoyu Chen,Yuehao Song,Hui Sun,Qian Zhang,Wenyu Liu,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ReDrive 端到端驾驶框架，通过未来表征预测塑造规划导向的视觉表征，无需复杂感知模块或推理期未来预测，在 NAVSIM 上取得 91.0 PDMS (v1) 与 90.8 EPDMS (v2)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型为满足场景理解与未来演化预测需求，通常构建复杂的感知-规划流水线或引入显式预测未来状态的世界模型，导致系统架构冗余、推理负担重。作者受通用视觉表征可迁移性的启发，主张强化视觉表征并结合表征层面的世界建模，即可在推理时无需辅助模块的情况下实现有效规划。

Method: ReDrive 采用三阶段训练流程：(1) 驾驶视频预训练；(2) 世界建模与规划联合训练；(3) 规划器适配（planner adaptation）。通过未来表征预测（future representation prediction）强化规划导向的视觉特征，最终得到强规划表征与高性能规划器，推理阶段仅需简单的编码器-规划器结构。

Result: 在 NAVSIM 基准上取得强劲性能：NAVSIM v1 上 91.0 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 上 90.8 EPDMS。

Conclusion: 以世界建模塑造表征，足以支撑高性能端到端规划，同时保持简洁的编码器-规划器推理流水线，无需辅助感知模块，也无需在推理时进行未来预测。

Abstract: Driving policies require capabilities of scene understanding and future evolution prediction. To achieve this goal, current end-to-end models typically construct complex perception-planning pipelines or introduce world models that explicitly predict future states, resulting in a complex system architecture. Inspired by the transferability of general-purpose visual representations, we argue that combining sufficiently strong visual representations with representation world modeling can support effective planning without relying on complex inference-time auxiliary modules. Based on this insight, we present ReDrive, an end-to-end driving framework that strengthens planning-oriented visual features via future representation prediction. To achieve this, ReDrive adopts a three-stage training pipeline consisting of driving video pretraining, joint world-modeling and planning training, and planner adaptation. This yields a strong planning-oriented representation and a high-performance planner, while requiring neither auxiliary perception modules nor future prediction at inference time. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate strong performance, achieving 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. These results show that shaping representations with world modeling is sufficient to enable high-performance end-to-end planning while retaining a simple encoder-planner inference pipeline.

</details>


### [251] [Residual-Stream Burden Shapes Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33895)
*Tongtong Liang,Siqi Kou,Ziqiao Xi,Esha Singh,Kun Zhou,Zhijie Deng,Alexander Cloninger,Yu-Xiang Wang,Rahul Parhi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"残差流负担"（residual-stream burden）概念，解释扩散模型中噪声/速度预测比干净数据预测更难的机制，并据此设计SiHC结构在ImageNet 256²上达到FID 1.71。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散生成中预测目标（干净数据、噪声、速度）可相互转换且描述同一生成过程，但普通Diffusion Transformer在大块像素patch上使用干净数据预测成功，而噪声或速度预测失败。作者希望解释这种不对称性。

Method: 提出残差流负担假说：噪声目标要求残差流在深度方向上持续保留依赖噪声的输入变化以供最终读出，迫使后续层在含噪表示上计算；而频谱集中的干净目标负担较轻。通过受控实验验证可 exploited 结构为patch空间的频谱集中性，并指出持续残差状态的带宽是噪声预测的关键资源。进一步引入空间索引超连接（SiHC）直接扩展残差流带宽。

Result: 受控实验支持残差流负担假说，且与近期解耦像素空间架构（其多样设计均减轻主路径残差流负担）一致。引入的SiHC在ImageNet 256²上达到FID 1.71。

Conclusion: 残差流负担是预测目标与架构共同塑造Diffusion Transformer表示学习的一种机制，为理解并改进扩散模型架构提供了新视角。

Abstract: In diffusion-based generation, a neural network can be trained to predict the clean data, the noise, or the velocity from a noisy input. These prediction targets are interconvertible and describe the same generative process, yet plain Diffusion Transformers operating on large pixel patches succeed with clean prediction and fail with noise or velocity prediction. We argue that this asymmetry arises because noisy targets require the residual stream to preserve noise-dependent input variation through depth for the final readout, forcing subsequent layers to compute on noisy representations. A spectrally concentrated clean target imposes a lighter demand, leaving greater freedom to organize hidden representations for subsequent computation. We call this preservation requirement *residual-stream burden* and show how it shapes representation learning in Diffusion Transformers. Controlled experiments indicate that the exploitable structure is spectral concentration in patch space and that the bandwidth of the persistent residual state is a key resource for noisy prediction. We further show that this account is consistent with recent decoupled pixel-space architectures, whose diverse designs all reduce the residual-stream burden on the main pathway. To examine this understanding from a complementary direction, we expand and reorganize the residual-stream bandwidth directly, introducing Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC) that reach FID 1.71 on ImageNet $256^2$. Together, these results identify residual-stream burden as a mechanism through which prediction targets and architecture jointly shape representation learning in Diffusion Transformers.

</details>


### [252] [Preserving DEG Rankings for Gene Discovery in Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33928)
*Kaito Shiku,Kazuya Nishimura,Yasuhiro Kojima,Ryoma Bise*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于图像差异表达排序（IDER）任务与可微ID ER目标，用差异表达统计量对齐基因排序，替代传统逐基因空间重构评价，在公共ST数据集上提升了DEG排序一致性与通路富集重叠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从组织学图像预测空间基因表达可将空间转录组学（ST）扩展到仅有图像的队列，但现有基于组织学的ST预测主要在"逐基因空间分布重构"上训练与评估。该目标与ST的关键下游用途——差异表达基因（DEG）发现——并不一致：DEG发现关注的是依据组间表达差异证据对基因排序，而非原始表达幅值或单基因空间相关性。

Method: 作者形式化图像基础差异表达排序（IDER）任务：检验预测表达谱是否保留由实测谱得到的、对比特异的排序基因列表；IDER比较由差异表达统计量诱导的基因排序。进一步提出可微IDER目标，在基因间对齐这些统计量，并可使用形态学导出的代理对比进行训练，无需预设生物学分组标签。

Result: 在公共ST数据集上的实验显示，相较传统重构目标，所提方法在DEG排序一致性以及通路富集重叠度上均有提升，评估涵盖形态学导出与病理学家标注的组织区域。

Conclusion: 将图像到ST的预测评价与优化目标从表达重构转向差异表达排序，更贴合ST的下游分析需求；可微IDER目标在无生物学标签条件下也能通过形态学代理对比实现训练，并提升DEG发现相关指标。

Abstract: Predicting spatial gene expression from histology images could scale spatial transcriptomics (ST) to image-only cohorts, but conventional histology-based ST prediction is trained and evaluated mainly by per-gene spatial-profile reconstruction. This objective is misaligned with a key downstream use of ST: differentially expressed gene (DEG) discovery, where genes are ranked for a biological or morphology-defined contrast by evidence of between-group expression differences. We formulate image-based differential expression ranking (IDER), which asks whether predicted expression profiles preserve the contrast-specific ranked gene list obtained from measured profiles. IDER compares gene rankings induced by differential-expression statistics, rather than raw expression magnitudes or per-gene spatial correlations. We further introduce a differentiable IDER objective that aligns these statistics across genes and can be trained with morphology-derived proxy contrasts without predefined biological group labels. Experiments on public ST datasets show improved DEG-ranking agreement and pathway-enrichment overlap over conventional reconstruction objectives, including morphology-derived and pathologist-annotated tissue-region evaluations.

</details>


### [253] [Video, Ergo Genero: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33935)
*Chia-Hsiang Kao,Belinda Zeng,Bharath Hariharan,Menglin Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ViGeo 框架，通过时空画布补全将视觉上下文学习扩展到视频领域，实现免训练的多任务统一与分布外泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频模型适配新任务通常依赖专门的数据整理与微调；视觉类比虽提供免训练方案，但仅限于图像领域。作者希望探究类比方法能否统一多样化视频任务并泛化至分布外场景。

Method: 将视觉上下文学习扩展至视频领域，采用时空画布补全（spatiotemporal canvas completion）机制构建 ViGeo 框架，将任务以上下文形式指定而非微调。

Result: 在多样化任务分类体系上、采用严格训练-测试划分进行评估，ViGeo 可泛化至未见过的视频操作任务及零样本模态（如事件相机）。

Conclusion: 识别出"任务内化"现象：与预训练任务相关的查询格式会覆盖示范信息，此捷径可通过少量任务无关数据消除，说明需将提示格式与任务身份解耦。

Abstract: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

</details>


### [254] [Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33937)
*Shambhavi Mishra,Omprakash Chakraborty,Julio Silva-Rodriguez,Ismail Ben Ayed,Marco Pedersoli,Jose Dolz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD)新场景，并给出PACT框架，通过原型分配在全无监督的测试时同时实现域适应、已知类识别与新类发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTA假设所有测试类已知，GCD假设已知类有标注训练数据，二者传统上被分离处理，但真实部署往往同时面临分布偏移、仅有文本监督以及需发现新类的情况，现有设定无法覆盖这一现实需求。

Method: PACT是全无监督框架：首先利用高置信度零样本预测，将发生偏移的视觉特征与VLM由文本导出的类表示重新对齐；随后在视觉嵌入空间中，用无标注测试流估计已知类与新类的原型，并将每张测试图像分配给与其视觉特征最相似的类别原型。

Result: 在损坏（corruption）与域偏移（domain-shift）基准上的大量实验表明，PACT优于经过适配的当前最先进TTA与GCD方法。

Conclusion: PACT有效弥合了模型适配与类别发现之间的差距，为TT-GCD这一统一且更现实的场景提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) and Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) are traditionally treated as disjoint problems: the former adapts models to domain shift assuming all test classes are known, while the latter discovers novel categories assuming labeled training data for known classes. However, real-world deployment rarely fits either setting. Motivated by this gap, we introduce Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD), a unified and more realistic scenario where a vision-language model must adapt to distribution shifts, classify known categories using only textual supervision, and discover novel categories, all during test time and without access to labeled data. To address this challenging scenario, we propose PACT (Prototype Assignment for Category discovery at Test time), a fully unsupervised framework that casts known-class recognition and novel-class discovery via prototype assignment. PACT first re-aligns shifted visual features with the text-derived class representations of the VLM using confident zero-shot predictions. Known and novel categories are then both represented by prototypes in the visual embedding space, estimated from the unlabeled test stream, and each test image is assigned to the category whose prototype is most similar to its visual feature. Extensive experiments across corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that PACT outperforms adapted state-of-the-art TTA and GCD methods, effectively bridging the gap between adaptation and discovery.

</details>


### [255] [Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33969)
*Ge Gao,Siyue Teng,Chanqgi Wang,Fan Zhang,Nantheera Anantrasirichai,Jui Chiu Chiang,Wen-Hsiao Peng,David Bull*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SAGA，一种基于稀疏锚点辅助高斯泼溅（Sparse Anchor-assisted Gaussian splatting）的体视频编解码器，通过层级稀疏4D锚点、INR解码器插值生成精细锚点与高斯原语，并利用正交性约束的固定大小记忆槽建模长程依赖，显著提升动态3DGS压缩的率失真性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沉浸式视频通信需要照片级真实、渲染高效且紧凑的动态场景表示。动态3DGS因稠密原语和时空冗余难以压缩；现有基于锚点的方案依赖单一规范骨架的形变，且每个原语仅孤立地以其关联锚点为条件，难以处理非局部动态与去遮挡，并忽视了锚点间相关性，在运动或纹理稠密区域尤为不足。

Method: SAGA用层级组织的稀疏4D锚点表示动态3D场景，坐标型INR解码器通过锚点间插值生成精细锚点和高斯原语，实现跨时空结构的紧凑参数共享；针对非结构化锚点间的长程依赖，引入固定大小记忆槽与正交性导向的更新机制，用于精确的熵上下文建模。

Result: 在Neu3D和MPEG MIV数据集上，SAGA相对GIFStream取得强率失真性能，PSNR BD-rate分别降低80.39%和83.94%。

Conclusion: SAGA通过稀疏锚点层级表示、INR插值生成与记忆槽熵上下文建模，有效缓解动态3DGS的时空冗余与锚点孤立条件化问题，在动态场景压缩中获得显著率失真增益。

Abstract: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, render-efficient, and compact dynamic scene representations. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising representation, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness with sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs often rely on deforming a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive on its associated anchor in isolation, limiting their ability to handle non-local dynamics and disocclusion while under-exploiting inter-anchor correlations, particularly in motion- or texture-dense regions. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built upon Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents dynamic 3D scenes using hierarchically organized sparse 4D anchors, where coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from inter-anchor interpolations, enabling compact parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. For long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors, we further introduce fixed-size memory slots with orthogonality-informed updates for accurate entropy-context modeling. Experiments show that SAGA achieves strong rate-distortion performance against GIFStream, with PSNR BD-rate reductions of 80.39% and 83.94% on Neu3D and MPEG MIV, respectively.

</details>


### [256] [A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of YOLO-Based Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33991)
*Hristina Zdraveska,Vlatko Spasev,Ivica Dimitrovski,Ivan Kitanovski,Petre Lameski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了面向精准农业杂草检测的多数据集基准，重点评测YOLO26系列（n/s/m）在7个公开数据集上的精度、复杂度、延迟、FPS与模型大小，并考察跨域泛化与多源训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习杂草检测研究多依赖单一数据集评估，难以判断模型在不同农业场景下的鲁棒性，缺乏统一的多数据集基准比较。

Method: 在7个覆盖不同作物、杂草种类、田间条件、采集设备与标注规范的公开数据集上评测YOLO26的nano、small、medium三种规模；除数据集内评估外，采用统一单类杂草设置考察跨域泛化，并利用全部数据集训练子集合并进行多源训练。

Result: YOLO26在数据集内表现强，YOLO26m平均精度最高，YOLO26s精度-效率权衡最佳；但跨域性能显著下降，YOLO26s平均域内mAP50:95由0.603降至域外0.148。多源训练在多个数据集上改善性能，但未能完全消除域偏移。

Conclusion: 该基准表明数据集多样性、域相似性与目标域自适应对真实精准农业场景下的鲁棒杂草检测至关重要。

Abstract: Weed detection is an important component of precision agriculture, enabling site-specific weed management and reducing unnecessary herbicide use. Although deep learning methods have achieved strong results for crop and weed detection, many studies rely on single-dataset evaluation, making it difficult to assess robustness across different agricultural domains. This paper presents a multi-dataset benchmark of deep object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, with a focused evaluation of YOLO26 models. We evaluate nano, small, and medium variants on seven public weed-detection datasets covering different crops, weed species, field conditions, acquisition setups, and annotation protocols. The models are compared in terms of detection accuracy, model complexity, inference latency, FPS, and model size. In addition to in-dataset evaluation, we investigate cross-domain generalization using a unified one-class weed setup and evaluate multi-source training using the combined training subsets from all datasets. The results show that YOLO26 achieves strong in-dataset performance, with YOLO26m obtaining the highest average accuracy and YOLO26s providing the best practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off. However, cross-domain performance decreases substantially, with YOLO26s dropping from an average in-domain mAP$_{50:95}$ of 0.603 to 0.148 in the off-domain setting. Multi-source training improves performance on several datasets, but does not fully eliminate domain shift. Overall, the benchmark highlights the importance of dataset diversity, domain similarity, and target-domain adaptation for robust weed detection in real-world precision agriculture applications.

</details>


### [257] [UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33996)
*Chunming He,Rihan Zhang,Lei Xu,Guanyi Qin,Chengyu Fang,Longxiang Tang,Fengyang Xiao,Sina Farsiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UnfoldCRF 将掩码精修建模为像素标签与潜在区域变量上的条件随机场推断，通过共享能量、参数与监督的受控对比，证明结构化设计本身（而非额外容量）带来稳定的分割精度提升与更强的跨数据集、跨掩码源泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习式掩码精修器虽提升分割精度，但难以区分增益来自显式结构化设计还是单纯模型容量；且在掩码生成器或其误差分布变化时，增益能否保持尚不明确。因此需要一个可隔离“结构效应”的对照实验框架。

Method: 将精修视为在像素标签与潜在区域变量上的 CRF 推断：能量函数包含修正的一元项、可学习的局部成对交互项、以及图像条件的潜在区域一致性项；区域一致性项带有空状态（null state），使标签一致性弱的区域可退出该项。推断过程以阻尼平均场更新在该单一能量上展开（unrolling）。为隔离结构效应，与读取相同输入、并获得相同参数预算、阶段数与监督的循环黑盒精修器进行对照。

Result: 在 COD10K 上，UnfoldCRF 比最强匹配对照高 1.0 个 $F^{\omega}_{\beta}$ 点，四项 COD 指标全面改善，使被劣化的图像比例从 11.7% 降至 8.5%。在五个数据集、多种掩码源上的 train-once 协议下，2.6M 参数变体相对对照取得 4.2 的平均 ΔIoU（对照为 2.0）；基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的变体以约七分之一的常驻参数量匹配最强基础模型精修器，并优于自身对照。在训练中未见过的掩码生成器上，增益为 2.0 个 $F^{\omega}_{\beta}$ 点（对照为 0.6）。逐项消融消息表明：成对消息主要修复边界，区域消息主要修复非边界错误。

Conclusion: 结构化 CRF 能量与展开推断带来的增益不能仅由容量解释：在参数、阶段与监督严格匹配下，UnfoldCRF 仍持续优于黑盒精修器，并在跨数据集、跨掩码源与未见生成器场景中保持优势，同时参数效率更高。消息消融进一步明确了不同结构化项的功能分工（边界 vs 非边界错误修正）。

Abstract: Learned mask refiners improve segmentation accuracy, but it is hard to tell how much of the improvement comes from explicit structure rather than from extra capacity, and whether it holds up when the mask generator or its error distribution changes. UnfoldCRF treats refinement as inference in a conditional random field over pixel labels and latent region variables. Its energy has a corrected unary term, learned local pairwise interactions, and image-conditioned latent-region consistency, with a null state that lets a region with weak label agreement withdraw from the consistency term; inference unrolls damped mean-field updates on this one energy. To isolate the effect of structure, we compare against recurrent black-box refiners that read the same inputs and receive the same parameter budget, stage count, and supervision. On COD10K, UnfoldCRF beats the strongest matched control by 1.0 $F^ω_β$ point, improves all four COD metrics, and lowers the fraction of images made worse from 11.7\% to 8.5\%. Under a train-once protocol over five datasets and several mask sources, the 2.6M-parameter variant gains 4.2 mean $Δ$IoU against 2.0 for its control, and a variant built on frozen DINOv2 features matches the strongest foundation-model refiner with about a seventh of its resident parameters while staying ahead of its own control. On mask generators never seen in training, the gain is 2.0 $F^ω_β$ points against 0.6 for the control. Zeroing individual messages shows where the corrections come from: the pairwise messages mostly fix boundaries, the region messages mostly fix non-boundary errors. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

</details>


### [258] [MetaSampling: Making Frame Samplers Efficient for Long-Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33998)
*Ashim Dahal,Bikramjit Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaSampling，一种免训练、即插即用的采样策略，可在现有帧选择器之上动态减少送入 MLLM 的帧数，在保持甚至提升准确率的同时提高长视频问答效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频问答中，帧选择对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）至关重要。现有方法虽优于简单 top-k 嵌入检索与均匀采样，但通常在固定的全局选择预算下运行，缺乏对帧数的动态调节，导致效率与精度难以兼顾。

Method: MetaSampling 是一种免训练、即插即用的采样策略，可叠加在已有帧选择器之上，动态减少传递给 MLLM 的帧数量，从而在保留甚至提升答案准确率的同时改善下游 VQA 效率。

Result: 在 36 组“帧选择器—MLLM 骨干—VQA 基准”配对配置上进行评估：MetaSampling 在全部 36 组配置中均减少了所选帧数，并在其中 25 组中提升了准确率，平均帧数减少 8.9%，整体准确率略有提升。

Conclusion: MetaSampling 作为一种通用、无需训练的后处理采样策略，能够在不牺牲（甚至提升）精度的前提下有效降低长视频问答的计算开销，具有良好的可插拔性与泛化性。

Abstract: Frame selection is an important component of long-video question answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing frame-selection methods improve over simple top-$k$ embedding retrieval and uniform sampling, but are typically applied under a fixed global selection budget. We introduce \textbf{MetaSampling}, a training-free, plug-and-play sampling strategy that can be applied on top of existing frame selectors. MetaSampling improves downstream VQA efficiency by dynamically reducing the number of frames passed to the MLLM while preserving, and in some cases improving, answer accuracy. We evaluate MetaSampling across 36 paired frame-selector--MLLM-backbone--VQA-benchmark configurations. MetaSampling reduces the number of selected frames in all 36 configurations and improves accuracy in 25 of them, yielding an average frame reduction of $8.9\%$ while slightly improving accuracy overall.

</details>


### [259] [Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34021)
*Rajat Modi,Priyank Pathak,Xin Liang,Yogesh Singh Rawat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Layer Query Network (LQN)，一种轻量化的测试时训练方法，仅需冻结VLM的一次前向传播即可完成适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向视觉语言模型（VLM）的测试时训练（TTT）方法需对多个增强视图分别进行前向（常含反向）传播，计算开销巨大。作者观察到，一次前向传播中所有中间层输出所包含的信号，已远多于所有增强视图的最终嵌入。

Method: LQN使用小型学生模型，在冻结VLM（教师）单次前向传播中完成适配。核心为位置感知蒸馏（PAD），通过查询中间层空间token的坐标来模仿教师VLM的中间层空间token；并引入位置一致性正则化（LCR）这一自监督技术，以O(1)的坐标采样替代O(H×W)的图像增强。

Result: 在OOD ImageNet上将零样本CLIP ViT-B/16的Top-1提升9.8%；细粒度分类上以3.9% Top-1超越此前最佳的GS-Bias；对CLIP ResNet-50收敛快于TPS（47分钟 vs 55分钟）；可泛化至SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、CoCa等VLM及MLP、ResNet、VGG等轻量学生模型；并扩展至全景、实例与语义分割任务。

Conclusion: LQN通过单次前向传播中的中间层空间token蒸馏与位置一致性正则化，实现了高效、通用且可扩展的VLM测试时适配，在多种模型、任务与下游场景中验证了其有效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Test-Time Training (TTT) adapts models to incoming test samples (e.g. out-of-distribution, (OOD)) when conventional fine-tuning is infeasible. Existing TTT methods for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create supervision from several augmented views, each requiring forward (and often backward) passes through the entire VLM, incurring substantial computational cost. We observe that one forward pass with all the intermediate layer outputs already yields far more signal than the final embedding from all augmentations. We introduce Layer Query Network (LQN), a lightweight approach that can adapt a frozen VLM (teacher) in a single forward pass of the VLM via a small model (student). LQN uses Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) to mimic the teacher VLM's intermediate-layer spatial tokens by querying spatial coordinates of intermediate tokens. LQN additionally relies on Location Consistency Regularization (LCR), a self-supervision technique, replacing expensive O(H x W) image augmentation with O(1) coordinate sampling.
