The two play a referential game: one sees an object and describes it in a short fixed-length message over a small alphabet; the other must pick that object out of a candidate set. Neither model's weights are updated. Each agent's prompt is rewritten by an isolated prompt optimizer whose reflection model reads that agent's scored interactions. In the positional setting, optimized prompts carry a shared code that generalizes to held-out objects above a measured no-codebook baseline, including when the memory window is removed. In a second setting, independent per-letter blocks no longer fit within the message, although a whole-object place value code does. The base system fails to establish reliable communication: the sender struggles to retain an injective rule, and the receiver has too few confirmed examples in view. A sender collision penalty, retention of successful interactions, and sequential optimization enable successful place value communication in some runs. Outcomes vary across runs and reflection models. In successful runs, the protocol is written into the optimized prompts, where it can be read and audited directly.

</details>


### [496] [Before the Rollout Ends: Early Terminal Reward Prediction for Long-horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31995)
*Jihan Yao,Sihan Zeng,Shangbin Feng,Zhiyuan Fan,Banghua Zhu,Yulia Tsvetkov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出上下文早期奖励（CER），通过轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测终端奖励，在长程编码智能体的测试时扩展与强化学习训练中提升效率与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程编码智能体只在完成昂贵的工具调用序列后才获得可验证奖励，导致推理成本高、早期错误假设被放大、终端奖励稀疏、训练不稳定，因此需要一种能够在轨迹早期提供密集、可解释评估的方法。

Method: CER 基于从相关历史任务中总结的经验，为当前任务与当前阶段合成自适应评分标准（adaptive rubrics），利用轨迹前缀中的行为证据来预测终端奖励。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 的测试时扩展中，CER 在 Nemotron 3 Ultra 上使 RM@8 较最强基线提升 4.2 个百分点，在 Qwen 3.6 27B 上提升 2.0 个百分点；在 Nemotron 上仅用 15.3% 的 token 即达到最佳基线性能。在 RL 训练中，CER 超过完整 rollout 的 TMax 达 1.9 个百分点，同时在线策略与评判 token 减少 52.7%。

Conclusion: CER 为长程编码智能体提供了一种可解释、高效且密集的评估方法。

Abstract: Long-horizon coding agents receive verifiable rewards only after completing expensive sequences of tool calls. This increases inference cost, amplifies early wrong hypotheses, and can lead to sparse terminal reward and unstable training. We introduce Contextual Early Reward (CER), which predicts terminal reward through behavioral evidence in a trajectory prefix. CER synthesizes adaptive rubrics specific to the current task and stage through experiences summarized from related historical tasks. In test-time scaling on SWE-bench Verified, CER improves RM@8 over the strongest baseline by 4.2 percentage points (pp) on Nemotron 3 Ultra and 2.0 pp on Qwen 3.6 27B; on Nemotron, it takes only 15.3% tokens to match the best baseline performance. In RL training experiments, CER exceeds full-rollout TMax by 1.9 pp while using 52.7% fewer online policy-and-judge tokens. Together, CER provides an interpretable, efficient, and dense evaluation method for long-horizon coding agents.

</details>


### [497] [Quantization Thresholds Replicate, Failure Modes Do Not: A Three-Model Study of Agentic Tool Use in Polish from 8-bit to 2-bit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32042)
*Jakub Prejzner*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出波兰语智能体工具使用基准PolAgentBench，考察GGUF量化对工具调用能力的影响。三个模型（11B、7B蒸馏、Llama-PLLuM-8B）在六个精度（Q8_0至Q2_K）下测试：唯一可复现的是3-bit到2-bit之间的能力断崖，而失败模式不可复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化对智能体工具使用能力的影响（尤其是非英语、低资源语言场景）缺乏系统研究。作者要回答两个问题：GGUF量化如何影响波兰语下的智能体工具使用，以及这种影响能否跨模型泛化。

Method: 构建PolAgentBench确定性基准：波兰语提示+英语工具schema，含67任务主套件（15个对抗探针、52个hard任务）与46任务算术隔离阶梯。三模型覆盖两条变异轴：Bielik-11B-v3.0与其剪枝蒸馏子模型Bielik-Minitron-7B隔离模型压缩，Llama-PLLuM-8B引入预训练家族变化。每个模型在六个量化精度下评测，并用配对McNemar检验与多重比较校正做统计推断。

Result: (1) 三模型均在3-bit与2-bit间出现断崖（11B 0.716→0.045，7B 0.463→0.149，PLLuM 0.224→0.015，配对McNemar p<0.001）；(2) 失败模式不可复现：2-bit下7B长程失败（中位9.1k token、4步），11B多在首步给出虚构终答（64次失败中37次），PLLuM则是跨精度内容失败（71.8-92.0%步可解析）；(3) 算术阶梯上，无脚手架档位为地板效应，四次显式调用将8-bit 11B从1/10提到9/10、7B从0/10提到7/10（探索性效应，未过多重校正），order-trap臂在8-bit区分模型（11B 6/6，7B 0/6）；(4) 波英差距与退化或任务族相关。作者另记录四个影响结论的伪影并在严格与修正形式下报告结果。

Conclusion: 量化导致的智能体能力崩塌阈值可跨模型、跨压缩与预训练家族复现，但失败模式高度模型特异；量化研究必须报告失败模式而非仅报告聚合分数。同时强调基准伪影（如未在提示中声明的no-tool规则、舍入敌意金标值）会实质性影响结论，需在严格与修正两种形式下报告。

Abstract: We ask how GGUF quantization affects agentic tool use in Polish and whether the effects generalize across models. We introduce PolAgentBench, a deterministic benchmark with Polish prompts and English tool schemas: a 67-task main suite (15 adversarial probes, 52 hard-tier tasks) and a 46-task arithmetic isolation ladder. Three models span two axes of variation: Bielik-11B-v3.0 and its pruned, distilled child Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0 isolate model compression, and Llama-PLLuM-8B adds a change of pretraining family. Each is measured at six precisions, Q8_0 to Q2_K. Only the collapse threshold replicates. (1) All three models fall off a cliff between 3-bit and 2-bit (11B 0.716 to 0.045, 7B 0.463 to 0.149, PLLuM 0.224 to 0.015; paired McNemar p < 0.001 in each), across a fourfold capability spread and both axes. (2) Failure modes do not replicate: at 2-bit the 7B fails long (median 9.1k tokens, 4 steps) while the 11B mostly answers at the first step with a confabulated final answer (37 of 64 failures); PLLuM fails on content across precisions (71.8-92.0% of steps parse). (3) On the arithmetic ladder the unscaffolded rung is a floor, left standing by a rerun that states the no-tool rule; four explicit calls lift the 8-bit 11B from 1/10 to 9/10 and the 7B from 0/10 to 7/10 after format-only failures with the gold value are forgiven, an exploratory effect with eight distinct baseline inputs that does not survive multiplicity correction, while the order-trap arm separates the models at 8-bit (11B 6/6, 7B 0/6). (4) The Polish-versus-English gap is associated with degradation or with task family. We document four artifacts that shaped our conclusions (rounding-hostile gold values, strict answer typing, a no-tool rule the prompt never stated, priority-ordered failure labels), report affected results in strict and corrected form, and release the benchmark, trajectories and commit-stamped artifacts.

</details>


### [498] [mu-bench: A Multilingual Utterance Transcription Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32082)
*Andrea Li,Soham Ray*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 mu-bench 数据集与 UER 语义评测指标，用于评估面向语音代理的 ASR 在多语种表单字段输入上的表现，并发布公开排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ASR 评测多基于朗读式、以英语为中心的语音，并使用 WER 作为指标，只惩罚表面差异而非语义差异，无法反映真实语音代理场景（尤其是姓名、邮箱、确认码等表单字段输入）中"语义是否被正确保留"的实际需求，也缺乏多语种覆盖。

Method: 构建 mu-bench 数据集：包含来自 250 通 AI 银行代理电话的 4,270 条来电者话语，覆盖英语、西班牙语、土耳其语、越南语和普通话，聚焦表单字段输入。提出 Utterance Error Rate（UER），即由 LLM 判定转录是否保留语义，并以人工标注者进行校准；同时提出 LLM 规范化器，使不同供应商输出格式下的 WER 具备可比性。

Result: 在 1,847 条人工评分转录上，UER 与标注者一致性达 κ = 0.78，而规范化文本上的精确匹配 WER 仅为 κ = 0.53。对六家商业供应商进行排名并发布公开排行榜，最佳供应商达 11.9% UER，普通话对六家供应商均最具挑战性。

Conclusion: UER 作为语义导向的 ASR 评测指标显著优于传统 WER，更贴合语音代理的真实任务需求；mu-bench 与多语种排行榜为跨供应商、跨语言的 ASR 评测提供了统一且可比较的基准。

Abstract: Voice agents depend on accurate automatic speech recognition (ASR) to act on what callers say, yet ASR is evaluated on read, English-centric speech with word error rate (WER), which penalizes surface rather than semantic differences. We introduce mu-bench, a dataset of 4,270 caller utterances from 250 phone calls to an AI banking agent in English, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Mandarin, centered on form-field inputs such as names, email addresses, and confirmation codes. We release Utterance Error Rate (UER), an LLM judge of whether a transcript preserves meaning, calibrated against human raters, together with an LLM normalizer that makes WER comparable across providers' output formats. On 1,847 human-rated transcripts, UER agrees with annotators at $κ$ = 0.78, versus 0.53 for exact-match WER on normalized text. We rank six commercial providers on a public leaderboard; the best reaches 11.9% UER, and Mandarin is hardest for all six.

</details>


### [499] [Using LMs to Model the Effects of Context and Coreference during Sentence Comprehension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32119)
*Kohei Kajikawa,Lin Ai,Tatsuki Kuribayashi,Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统改变 GPT-2 上下文窗口大小，在四个英语阅读时间数据集上验证其与人类心理语言学数据的拟合度，发现呈 U 型关系，并进一步揭示长程指代关系是驱动大窗口优势的关键机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究认为严格限制语言模型上下文窗口以模拟人类工作记忆约束能提升其对心理语言学数据的拟合，但这一记忆衰减视角可能忽略人类对长程结构表征（如篇章结构）的依赖，因此需要重新系统检验上下文窗口的作用。

Method: 作者在四个大规模自然英语阅读时间数据集上系统改变 GPT-2 的上下文窗口大小，比较不同窗口的预测拟合度；并设计反事实推理时实验，通过对重复出现的篇章实体进行代词化以破坏跨句实体链，从而检验长程结构关联对模型预测力的贡献。

Result: 上下文窗口与心理语言学拟合度呈 U 型关系：受限上下文（<20 tokens）能捕捉局部记忆限制，但扩展上下文（500–1000 tokens）总体拟合最优；遮蔽跨句结构关联后，大窗口（500–1000 tokens）的预测力下降 20%–40%。

Conclusion: 跟踪长程共指关系是 LM 惊讶度与人类阅读行为对齐的重要因素，该结果近似刻画了人类理解者在语言处理中依赖全局篇章关系的程度，表明仅用记忆衰减解释上下文窗口效应并不充分。

Abstract: Language models (LMs) are often used as a tool to model human language processing. Recent studies suggest that severely restricting LMs' context window improves their fit to human psycholinguistic data by simulating human working memory constraints. However, it is possible that this strict memory-decay approach overlooks humans' reliance on long-range structural representations, such as discourse structre. In this work, we systematically vary the context window size of GPT-2 across four large-scale naturalistic English reading-time datasets and observe a U-shaped relationship: Although restricted contexts (< 20 tokens) successfully capture local memory limitations, expanded contexts (500--1,000 tokens) ultimately yield the highest overall psycholinguistic fit. To investigate the mechanism driving this benefit, we conduct a counterfactual inference-time experiment that disrupts cross-sentential entity chains by pronominalizing repeated discourse entities. Obscuring these structural linkages significantly degrades the predictive power of larger context windows by 20% to 40%. Our experiments demonstrate that tracking long-range coreference relations is one important factor for the alignment between LM surprisal and human reading behavior, and approximate the extent to which human comprehenders use global discourse relations during language processing.

</details>


### [500] [Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32160)
*Lijuan Tang,Yuemeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文回顾了Jev（2026年9月15日发布的商用typed decision model）发布后九天内出现的28篇评估与复现论文，将其发现与标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准和模型级联等既有工作相联系，并据此提出14项评估清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: typed decision model（TDM）只输出调用方定义选项上的概率分布而不生成文本，Jev作为商用TDM发布后数日内即涌现大量评估与复现工作，但这些证据分散、时效性极强，亟需系统梳理以厘清该模型类的真实能力边界并规范后续研究。

Method: 对2026年9月19日至24日间发布的28篇论文进行综述性回顾，把其结论与标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、置信度校准、模型级联等更早的相关研究方向进行对照；并从这些研究中反复出现的弱点出发，归纳出一份14项评估清单。

Result: 在这一早期文献中，typed readout本身相较可比的标签概率读出并未表现出独立的精度优势；Jev最明显的收益体现在延迟与成本上，而在更难任务上仍存在精度差距。此外，置信度在实践中常被用于决定何时转交给更强模型或人工。

Conclusion: 由于证据仅覆盖单一托管模型发布后的前九天且集中于一个商用系统，本综述应被理解为一张早期证据地图，而非对TDM这一模型类的定论；所提出的14项清单旨在为未来TDM评估工作提供规范。

Abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent accuracy advantage over comparable label-probability readouts. Jev's clearest gains are in latency and cost, while accuracy gaps remain on harder tasks. In practical deployments, confidence is often used to decide when to defer to a stronger model or a human. We use recurring weaknesses in these studies to derive a 14-item evaluation checklist for future TDM work. Because the evidence covers only the first nine days after the release of one hosted model, the review should be read as an early evidence map rather than a settled assessment of the model class.

</details>


### [501] [ScopeIF: Improving Scope-Aware Precise Instruction-Following in Large Language Models via Graded Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32189)
*Bosi Wen,Yilin Niu,Xiaoying Ning,Ying Zhang,Hongning Wang,Minlie Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ScopeIF框架，通过将约束分解为Scope/Target/Range三维度并构造ScopeInstruct数据集与分级奖励建模，实现范围感知的精确指令遵循，性能超越现有方法并可媲美前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化方法在数据构建中忽视约束作用范围，且依赖逐约束的二值奖励，导致数据多样性有限、对复杂约束的监督稀疏。

Method: 提出统一schema将客观约束分解为Scope、Target、Range三个解耦维度；据此构建大规模范围感知指令数据集ScopeInstruct；结合工具化验证与分级奖励建模量化每条约束的违反程度，为策略优化提供稠密监督。

Result: 实验表明ScopeIF持续优于现有方法，尤其在复杂范围感知约束上表现突出，同时保持通用能力；优化后的Qwen3-4B与8B可媲美或超越Gemini-2.5-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2等前沿模型。

Conclusion: ScopeIF为推进范围感知指令遵循建立了一种有效范式，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Precise instruction-following is a fundamental ability of large language models (LLMs), requiring their outputs to strictly satisfy objective constraints in input instructions. In complex application scenarios, these constraints often possess diverse scopes that govern specific response segments rather than the entire output. However, existing optimization methods often neglect constraint scope during data construction and rely on binary per-constraint rewards, yielding limited data diversity and sparse supervision for complex constraints. To this end, we propose ScopeIF, a novel training framework for scope-aware precise instruction-following. We first introduce a unified schema that factorizes objective constraints into three decoupled dimensions: Scope, Target, and Range. Grounded in this schema, we construct ScopeInstruct, a large-scale instruction dataset with diverse scope-aware constraints, and combine tool-grounded verification with graded reward modeling to quantify the violation degree of each constraint, providing dense supervision for policy optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScopeIF consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex scope-aware constraints, while preserving general capabilities. Notably, it enables optimized Qwen3-4B and 8B models to rival or surpass strong frontier models such as Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, establishing an effective paradigm for advancing scope-aware instruction-following. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/ScopeIF.

</details>


### [502] [The Judge Is Not Its Twin: Post-training makes a model's writing more predictable but barely moves its taste, as a judge, toward predictable writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32196)
*Arman Nik Khah,Arvin Bahreini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文追踪 OLMo-2 与 Zephyr 两族 7B 模型的公开训练阶段，分别以"写作者"和"评判者"两种身份测量各阶段模型，发现训练显著提高了模型自身写作的可预测性，但作为自动评判者几乎没有相应地偏向可预测文本——新颖性损失对自动评测几乎不可见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型如今常被其他语言模型评分。若后训练使模型自身写作更可预测，那么同一模型充当评判者时可能也学会奖励可预测的写作，从而使创作力（creativity）方面的真实进步在自动化评测中不可见。作者希望验证这一担忧是否成立。

Method: 采用纵向追踪设计：对 OLMo-2 和 Zephyr（各 7B）两个开放模型族的 base、SFT、DPO 等训练阶段，每个阶段做两项测量，即作为短篇故事写作者与作为故事对评判者。写作侧用困惑度/意外度（surprisal per token）度量各阶段故事的熟悉程度，并跨模型族交叉评估；评判侧让模型回答"哪个更好""哪个更有创造力"，并用"故事 vs 打乱词序的自身文本"作为可识别性检验，估计评判者对可预测故事的倾向；辅以后验单侧 95% 上界与预先设定的质量下限。

Result: 写作侧担忧得到证实：每个家族完全训练后的模型，对 base、SFT、DPO 各阶段故事在全部十个提示下都感到逐阶段更熟悉；另一家族的模型认为训练后故事每 token 意外度降低 7.0–9.2%（OLMo-2）与 24–25%（Zephyr）。评判侧几乎未动：没有任何训练后评判者偏向更可预测故事的估计增幅达到 1 个百分点；单侧 95% 上界为平均故事对 2.7 个百分点，与未训练 OLMo-2 评判者自身倾向相当。问"更有创造力"时，没有训练后评判者比其 base 更偏好可预测故事。训练反而强化了对更长故事的偏好（当问题为创造力时）以及对某一答案位置的偏好，并破坏了"更有创造力"作为问题的有效性——训练后评判者不再可靠地偏好原故事胜过其打乱词序版本。后续尝试无法构造出"可预测性不同但质量相同"的故事对，因为降低可预测性的手段往往同时损坏故事，常达不到事先设定的质量下限。

Conclusion: 后训练确实让模型写作变得更可预测，且这种变化可被其他模型察觉；但自动评判并未同步学会奖励可预测性，因此创造力进步对自动化评测"不可见"的风险在本文测量中未获证据支持。不过训练引入了长度偏好、位置偏好等伪影，并削弱了"更有创造力"这一提问的判别力，提示LLM-as-judge 的评测有效性本身受后训练影响。由于难以在可控条件下分离可预测性与质量，相关因果链条仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Language models are now routinely graded by other language models. If post-training makes a model's own writing more predictable, it may also teach the same model, acting as a judge, to reward predictable writing, so that progress on creativity would be invisible to automated evaluation. We follow two open model families, OLMo-2 and Zephyr (7B parameters each), through their public training stages and measure every stage twice, as a writer of short stories and as a judge of pairs of stories. As writers, the models drift as feared: each family's fully trained model finds the stories of its base, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) and preference-trained (DPO) stages progressively more familiar, in all ten prompts, and a model from the other family finds the trained stories 7.0 to 9.2 percent (OLMo-2) and 24 to 25 percent (Zephyr) less surprising per token. As judges, they barely move toward predictable writing. Asked which story is better, a question every judge can use to tell a story from its own words in scrambled order, no trained judge's estimated tilt toward the more predictable story grows by as much as one point in the probability of picking it. A post hoc one-sided 95% upper bound on that growth is 2.7 points on an average pair, about the size of the untrained OLMo-2 judge's own tilt. Asked which is more creative, no trained judge's estimate favors the predictable story more than its base's does. Training instead strengthens a preference for longer stories when the question is creativity, and for one answer slot, and it breaks "more creative" as a question: trained judges asked it no longer reliably prefer a story to its scrambled words. A follow-up could not build pairs that differ in predictability but not in quality, because the routes that made this writer's stories less predictable also broke some of them, often enough to fail a quality floor set in advance.

</details>


### [503] [Generalization and Memorization along the Learning Trajectory of Neural Language Models: A Geometric Account of Categorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32199)
*Wang Bojun,Holly Jenkins,Elizabeth Wonnacott*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 神经语言模型的泛化能力在学习早期即出现，随后随着训练延长，类别级泛化几何结构逐渐被破坏，模型从基于类别的泛化转向样例特异化的记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究神经语言模型在学习轨迹中泛化与记忆如何发展，以及表征空间几何结构与模型行为的演化关系。

Method: 采用受控的人工合成语法，考察表征空间的几何结构及模型在整个训练过程中的行为变化。

Result: 未被观测词元占据的表征空间连续区域从学习最早期即被系统化结构化，形成支持对未出现组合泛化的类别级几何组织；训练时间延长后，较大模型日益区分已观测与未观测的语法组合，同时支撑类别级泛化的连续几何结构逐渐被破坏。

Conclusion: 神经语言模型最初通过基于类别的泛化进行学习，随后逐渐转向更偏向样例特异化的记忆。

Abstract: We investigate how generalization and memorization develop along the learning trajectory of neural language models. Using controlled synthetic grammars, we examine both the geometry of representation space and model behaviour over training. We find that continuous regions of representation space not occupied by observed tokens become systematically structured from the earliest stages of learning, forming category-level geometric organization that supports generalization to unattested combinations. Generalization therefore emerges from the beginning of learning rather than only after extensive memorization. With prolonged training, larger models increasingly distinguish observed from unobserved grammatical combinations. At the same time, the continuous geometric structure supporting category-level generalization is gradually destructed. Together, these results suggest that neural language models initially learn through categorization-based generalization, followed by a gradual transition toward more exemplar-specific memorization.

</details>


### [504] [A model of rational interlocutors: Unification of comprehension and production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32216)
*Hanlin Wu,Zhenguang G. Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者提出"理性对话者"（RI）模型，将理解中的说话者建模与产出中的受众设计统一为对伙伴模型的同一理性计算，用身份、保真度、知识三个参数刻画伙伴，并据此解释L2成人、儿童与人工伙伴上可检验的差异预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们会根据交际对象调整对他人话语的理解（说话者建模）和自己话语的设计（受众设计），但这两条研究脉络长期各自发展、缺乏统一解释，作者希望说明二者实为同一理性计算的不同方向。

Method: 提出计算模型RI：对话者为伙伴维护一个由三参数定义的模型——身份参数Π设定预期从伙伴处接收的讯息与形式，保真度参数Φ设定其讯息与话语之间的映射可靠程度，知识参数Λ设定其被认为的知识水平。理解与产出被视为在该伙伴模型上的镜像计算：理解选择伙伴最可能意图传达的讯息，权衡各候选讯息与话语的契合度及该伙伴如此表意的概率；产出选择使伙伴最能准确还原讯息的表达，并权衡其表达努力。作者并推测感知到的语言能力由保真度与知识两个量分解而成。

Result: RI模型可解释既有不对称现象：理解者较少依赖语言能力较弱说话者所产出的形式，而产出者反而为其投入更多努力设计表达。保真度与知识在L2成人、儿童与人工伙伴上呈现对比性剖面，产生彼此区分且可检验的预测。

Conclusion: 理解与产出中的伙伴调整可由单一理性计算统一刻画；将感知语言能力分解为保真度与知识，为跨L2成人、儿童和人工伙伴的比较研究提供了统一框架与可检验假设。

Abstract: Who we communicate with influences both our interpretation of their utterances and the design of our own. Such adjustment to the conversational partner is studied as speaker modeling in comprehension and as audience design in production, with the two literatures having developed largely separately. We argue that both adjustments express one rational computation and propose the rational interlocutor (RI) model, a computational account unifying comprehension and production. An interlocutor maintains a model of their partner, defined by three parameters: an identity parameter Π sets the messages and forms expected from the partner; a fidelity parameter Φ sets how reliably messages and utterances map onto each other for them; a knowledge parameter Λ sets how knowledgeable the partner is believed to be. Comprehension and production are thus mirror-image modes of one computation over the partner model. Comprehension chooses the message the partner most likely intends to convey, weighing how well each candidate fits the utterance against how likely this partner is to mean it. Production chooses the utterance from which the partner will best recover the message, weighed against the effort of saying it. This explains why comprehenders appear to rely less on the forms produced by a linguistically less competent speaker, while producers tend to invest more effort in designing forms for them. We conjecture that perceived linguistic competence decomposes into two of these quantities: fidelity and knowledge. Their contrasting profiles across second-language (L2) adults, children, and artificial partners produce distinct and testable predictions.

</details>


### [505] [OptiArena: Can LLMs Improve Executable Algorithms under Fixed Resource Budgets?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32227)
*Wenjun Peng,Xinyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 OptiArena，一个预算可控的测试台，用于研究 LLM 能否在固定最小脚手架下、通过五轮代码编辑改进可执行的博弈算法，并区分弱起点改进与强基线精炼两种优化情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态问答与代码生成基准仅能部分反映 LLM 作为编码智能体与研究工具的实际作用，缺乏对"在有限预算与有限反馈下能否改进可执行算法"这一动态优化能力的评估手段。

Method: 构建 OptiArena 测试台：固定最小脚手架、限定五轮代码编辑、有界评估反馈与固定资源预算；采用两种优化范式（弱起点改进、强基线精炼），设置表层混淆控制、校准参照、留出与压力划分，以及退化与异常失败诊断；LLM API 成本与本地评估器墙钟时间分开报告。实验覆盖 12 个前沿 LLM 与 5 款游戏，考察模型能否弥合弱起点与可编辑强基线之间的校准差距、能否在不损害强基线的前提下精炼它，以及收益能否在表层混淆控制下保持。

Result: 在 12 个前沿 LLM 与 5 款游戏上，模型对指定弱起点的改进比精炼可编辑强基线更为稳定，且游戏间与模型间差异显著。

Conclusion: OptiArena 为在所研究的五轮编辑、固定脚手架设定下测量有界资源算法优化提供了实用测试台，代码已开源。

Abstract: Static QA and code-generation benchmarks only partially capture the role that large language models (LLMs) now play as coding agents and research tools. We introduce OptiArena, a budget-controlled testbed for studying whether LLMs can improve executable game-playing algorithms through five rounds of code edits within a fixed minimal scaffold and under bounded evaluator feedback and fixed resource budgets. The testbed uses two optimization regimes, surface obfuscation controls, calibrated references, held-out/stress splits, and diagnostics for degradation and exceptional failures, with LLM API cost reported separately from local evaluator wall-clock. The empirical study asks three questions: whether models can close the calibrated gap between a designated weak starter and an editable competent baseline, whether they can refine editable competent baselines without damaging them, and whether gains survive surface obfuscation controls. Across twelve frontier LLMs and five games, models improve designated weak starters more consistently than they refine editable competent baselines, with substantial variation across games and models. OptiArena provides a practical testbed for measuring bounded-resource algorithm optimization within the five-edit, fixed-scaffold setting studied here. Code is available at https://github.com/WJ-Peng/OptiArena.

</details>


### [506] [KinyaMed: Seeds, Not Rows -- What a Corpus Requirement Written in the Wrong Unit Fails to Constrain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32234)
*Marius Bayizere*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文报告卢旺达语（Kinyarwanda）患者语音分诊紧急度分类器规格的失败案例：生成语料在9项质量门中4项不达标（按行归属时6项），约束的是廉价的行数而非昂贵的种子句数，故不约束质量；配套检测工具与负结果才是真正贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分诊决定患者就诊顺序，构建患者语音的卢旺达语紧急度分类器有实际需求，但作者发现所设规格可以在不产出其本应保障之物的前提下被"满足"，因此选择报告该现象及检测手段，而非交付分类器。

Method: 面向卢旺达基层卫生中心接收的四种语言设计，每种语言配一套工具：句子在四个分支中以人工撰写，行仅由机器在一个分支生成，因其余三个所需框架槽位不存在。要求生成一百万条样本，实际130秒完成；随后用含9项质量门的规格及按源句归因的变体进行审核。另构建评估集并施加计数去重句的质量门，以及训练统一表层形式的模型，测试大小写与单字符拼写错误下的预测稳定性，并检验未随模型目录一同发布的tokenizer的加载行为。

Result: 生成语料在9项门中失败4项，行归因时失败6项；关键门统计的是不同的人工种子短语数而非行数，在165个种子下任何行数均无法通过。两项缺口分别为：达种子数门还需2,835句，达百万行目标还需19,835句，因另一门限制每种子最多50行。行由机器以7,700行/秒产出，种子由临床医生撰写。基于9个不同句子构建的17,942行评估集无法支持结论，该门拒绝其中38个单元并不作报告。统一表层形式训练的模型在大小写变化下对31.5%输入的紧急度预测改变，单字符拼写错误下为21.0%。模型目录缺失tokenizer仍可无错加载，并对其无法读取的输入给出类别先验，且概率形式良好。

Conclusion: 所有数字均非模型质量证据；贡献在于这套检测机制及其产生的负结果，除标注为不可复现处外，可从干净克隆复现。

Abstract: Triage decides who is seen first. Building an urgency classifier for patient-voice Kinyarwanda, we found our specification could be met without producing anything it was meant to secure. We report that, and the instruments that detect it, instead of a classifier. Designed for the four languages a Rwandan health centre receives, with every instrument per-language: sentences are authored in all four arms and rows generate in one, because the frame slots those three need do not exist. Our requirement asked for one million examples; generation produced them in 130 seconds. It fails four of the nine quality gates in that specification, six when rows are attributed to their source sentence. The binding gate counts distinct authored seed phrases, not rows: at our 165, no corpus passes at any row count. Two shortfalls follow and differ: 2,835 further sentences to pass the seed-count gate, 19,835 to reach the stated million rows, because a separate gate caps a seed at 50 rows. Rows come from a machine at 7,700 per second; seeds from clinicians. A row count constrains the cheap quantity, leaves the expensive one free, and so does not constrain quality at all. Two further negatives follow. An evaluation set of 17,942 rows built from nine distinct sentences supports no verdict: our gate, which counts distinct sentences, refuses 38 of its cells and reports nothing. A model trained on a corpus of uniform surface form changes its predicted urgency for 31.5% of inputs under capitalisation and 21.0% under a single typo, reported as measurement and not attribution. A model directory shipped without its tokenizer loads without error and answers its class prior on input it cannot read, with well-formed probabilities. No figure here is evidence of model quality; the contribution is the apparatus and the negative results it produced, reproducible from a clean clone except where marked NOT REPRODUCIBLE.

</details>


### [507] [Solving Every Step Is Not Enough: Milestone Oracles Reveal a Composition Gap in LLM Math Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32235)
*Zhuohan Wang,Haoran Ma,Tianyu Wu,Yuanlin Duan,Zichun Liao,Jieming Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 OracleLadder 诊断式评测框架，通过逐级注入 oracle 帮助（无帮助→路线图→路线图+里程碑答案→单独里程碑）定位 LLM 数学推理失败环节，发现所有模型最大缺口均为"组合缺口"，占 33-48% 题目。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 能独立求解多步数学题的每一步，却在给出步骤路线图及全部答案的情况下仍失败，说明现有评测只报告最终正确率，无法区分失败源于单步能力不足还是多步组合能力不足，因此需要一种能定位失败环节的诊断工具。

Method: 提出 OracleLadder：教师模型为每题写固定的中间子目标（里程碑）路线图，确定性的符号验证器对每个答案打分；对模型施以四级帮助——无帮助、仅路线图、路线图+里程碑答案、单独每个里程碑，据此将每次失败归入五类推理缺口；在 NuminaMath 354 题及 6 个 8B-671B 模型（Qwen3、gpt-oss、Llama 3.3、DeepSeek-V3.1）上验证，并在 MATH500、AIME 2024/25、代码生成任务上做复现与迁移测试。

Result: 每个模型最大的缺口都是"组合缺口"——组合性缺口的更严格形式，覆盖 33-48% 题目，剔除被 LLM 复核标记为评分错误的题目后为 24-37%；最终正确率与里程碑帮助下的恢复率对两个最强模型的排序不一致；两次精度增益相近的 RLVR 训练对题目的影响不同；路线图效应在 MATH500、AIME 2024/25 上复现，换用第二位独立教师后 83-87% 题目的逐题恢复情况一致，帮助阶梯同样适用于代码生成。

Conclusion: LLM 数学推理的主要瓶颈是多步组合而非单步求解；帮助阶梯可作为跨任务通用的诊断性评测范式，且最终准确率不足以衡量模型真实推理能力。数据、路线图、提示与代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can solve every intermediate step of a multi-step math problem on its own and still fail the full problem, even when given a roadmap of the steps and all of their answers. We introduce OracleLadder, a diagnostic evaluation that locates where LLM math reasoning fails by giving the model increasing levels of oracle help. For each problem, a teacher model writes a fixed roadmap of intermediate sub-goals (milestones), and a deterministic symbolic verifier grades every answer. Testing the model with no help, with the roadmap, with the roadmap plus the milestone answers, and on each milestone alone sorts each failure into one of five reasoning gaps. On 354 NuminaMath problems and six models from 8B to 671B parameters (Qwen3, gpt-oss, Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-V3.1), the largest gap for every model is the composition gap, a stricter form of the compositionality gap. It covers 33-48% of problems, and 24-37% after removing problems that an LLM review flags as grading errors. Accuracy and milestone-help recovery rank the two strongest models differently, and two RLVR runs with similar accuracy gains move problems differently. The roadmap effect replicates on MATH500 and AIME 2024/25, per-problem recovery agrees for 83-87% of problems under an independent second teacher, and the help ladder carries over to code generation. We release the data, roadmaps, prompts, and code at https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder.

</details>


### [508] [LANTERN: Illuminating Hidden Mathematical Knowledge in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32264)
*Pavel Tikhonov,Elena Tutubalina,Ivan Oseledets,Dmitry I. Ignatov,Mikhail Seleznyov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 LANTERN 流水线，利用预训练语言模型激活上的分类器对候选数学关系排序，结合分阶段过滤、假设生成、可执行验证与分析性检查，在 OEIS 中挖掘出 62 条已验证的新关系，其中 4 条为全新发现，全流程耗时不足 8 小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型已能证明定理，但选择研究哪些问题仍依赖人类判断。作者希望探究模型的内部表征能否帮助识别有前景的数学联系，从而辅助研究者发现值得关注的数学关系。

Method: 提出 LANTERN 流水线：基于预训练模型激活训练分类器，对候选关系进行排序；随后进行分阶段过滤、假设生成、可执行验证与分析性检查。在 OEIS 上对 10,000 个高频引用序列间的 5,000 万对进行排序。整个端到端流程（含分类器训练、候选排序、过滤与验证）耗时不足 8 小时，具有快速、低成本的特点。

Result: 在 OEIS 中产生 62 条经证实且此前无交叉引用的序列间关系。内容筛选后保留 13 条值得呈现的关系，其中 9 条具有信息量或洞察力，4 条据作者所知完全新颖，未出现在 OEIS 或其针对性文献检索中。

Conclusion: 模型的内部表征可用于识别有前景的数学联系；LANTERN 以低成本、高效率的方式生成可验证且部分全新的数学关系，表明语言模型可作为数学发现流程中辅助识别研究方向的工具。

Abstract: Language models can now prove theorems, but people still decide which problems to pursue. We ask whether a model's internal representations can help identify promising mathematical connections. We develop LANTERN, a fast, cost-efficient pipeline that uses a classifier over pretrained-model activations to rank candidate relations, followed by staged filtering, hypothesis generation, executable verification, and analytical checking. Applied to the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), LANTERN ranked 50 million pairs among 10,000 frequently referenced sequences and produced 62 verified relations between pairs without an existing OEIS cross-reference. A content screen retained 13 relations worth presenting; nine of these are informative or insightful, including four which are entirely novel to the best of our knowledge: none appears in the OEIS or in our targeted literature search. The entire end-to-end process including classifier training, candidate ranking, filtering and verification took under 8 hours.

</details>


### [509] [Before Answering: Evidence Sufficiency under Size-Matched Memory Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32269)
*Joyanta Jyoti Mondal,Md. Shifatul Ahsan Apurba,Mridul Banik,Md Masud Al Mahmud,Ibne Farabi Shihab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出当前"证据不足"任务基准通过删除支撑段落构造样本，导致记忆规模泄漏标签，使仅统计段落数的分类器在MuSiQue上AUROC达0.979；作者提出规模匹配构造方法消除该捷径，并评估交叉编码器聚合估计器MemSafe。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答来自压缩或检索记忆的问题时，智能体必须识别查询所需证据已不在记忆中。但现有基准通过删除支撑段落构造"证据不足"样本，使记忆规模与标签相关，可能引入捷径，因此需要审查构造方式并设计无泄漏的评测。

Method: 通过实验证明记忆规模仅计数即可检测不安全记忆（MuSiQue上AUROC 0.979，高于词汇估计器）；提出可证明消除该捷径的规模匹配构造；使用该构造在三个多跳问答数据集和五个随机种子上评估MemSafe——将查询与每个记忆单元交叉编码后用set transformer聚合；并对比冻结预训练交叉编码器加逻辑头、词汇基线、特征估计器、7B读者门控、7B LLM判定器等。

Result: MuSiQue和HotpotQA上MemSafe达0.968与0.983 AUROC，比词汇基线高0.26–0.39；2WikiMultiHopQA已饱和。冻结交叉编码器加逻辑头已填补MuSiQue中词汇基线与MemSafe差距的41%。MemSafe在MuSiQue发布的不answerable问题上退化多于弱基线，SQuAD 2.0仅0.639 AUROC，临床数据需数千训练样本才超过特征估计器。作为7B读者门控，5%覆盖率下将已答问题错误率从0.850降至0.631，优于读者置信度和平均而言的真实完整性标签，但10%覆盖率下7B LLM判定器更优。

Conclusion: 证据不足样本的构造方式与检测估计器同等重要；记忆规模泄漏是可被规模匹配构造消除的捷径，MemSafe在多跳QA上有效但存在跨域与不answerable问题上的局限。

Abstract: Agents that answer questions from compressed or retrieved memory must recognize when the evidence a query needs is no longer in memory. Benchmarks for this task usually create insufficient-evidence examples by deleting supporting passages. We show that this construction leaks the label through memory size: on MuSiQue, a classifier that only counts paragraphs reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of $0.979$ for detecting unsafe memory, higher than the lexical estimator we initially evaluated. We propose a size-matched construction that provably removes this shortcut, and use it to study MemSafe, an estimator that cross-encodes the query with each memory unit and aggregates the units with a set transformer. Across three multi-hop question answering datasets and five seeds, MemSafe reaches $0.968$ and $0.983$ AUROC on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, $0.26$ to $0.39$ above a lexical baseline, while the third dataset, 2WikiMultiHopQA, is saturated. A frozen pretrained cross-encoder with a logistic head already closes $41\%$ of the MuSiQue gap between the lexical baseline and MemSafe. At the same time, MemSafe degrades more than a weak baseline on the unanswerable questions released with MuSiQue, reaches only $0.639$ AUROC on SQuAD~2.0, and needs several thousand clinical training examples before it outperforms a feature-based estimator. Used as a gate for a 7B reader, it reduces the error rate on answered questions from $0.850$ to $0.631$ at $5\%$ coverage, outperforming both reader confidence and, on average, the ground-truth integrity label, although a 7B LLM judge is the better gate at $10\%$ coverage. These results indicate that the way insufficient evidence is constructed matters as much as the estimator that detects it.

</details>


### [510] [Supporting and Performing Culture from the Inside](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32281)
*Lea Frermann,Steven Bird*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文借用人类学的emic/etic（内部视角/外部视角）框架，系统审视NLP文化研究在任务选择、数据收集、系统设计与评估各环节中的隐含假设，并指出NLP自身也存在一种"文化"，进而提出通向更具文化适配性AI的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文化研究类学科长期以emic与etic的区分来反思自身的认识论与方法论，而NLP中的文化研究近年虽增多，却缺乏对全流程隐含假设的系统性检视，作者因而希望引入该框架以揭示研究盲点。

Method: 采用概念分析/立场论文的方法，将emic（文化成员视角）与etic（科学分类的外部视角）框架应用于NLP文化研究的完整流程，即任务选择、数据收集、系统设计与评估四个阶段，逐项分析其中的假设。

Result: 识别出各流程环节中被普遍默认的emic/etic偏向与假设，并揭示存在一种形塑本研究领域研究重点与方法的"NLP的文化"（culture of NLP）。

Conclusion: NLP文化研究需要更自觉地处理emic与etic两种视角的张力，并提出若干通向更具文化适配性的AI的发展路径。

Abstract: Anthropology and related disciplines which study culture have often found it useful to consider their epistemological and methodological approaches in terms of emic versus etic. This is the distinction between the insider perspective, how the world is viewed by a member of the culture, versus the outsider perspective, the scientific cataloguing of cultural knowledge and practice. We adopt this framework to systematically analyse assumptions in recent research on culture in NLP along the full pipeline of task selection, data collection, system design and evaluation. We draw attention to the `culture of NLP' which shapes the research focus and approaches of our field, and suggest pathways towards a more culturally attuned AI.

</details>


### [511] [TRAP: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Memorization in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32293)
*Muhammed Ustaomeroglu,Ziyue Xu,Hanshen Xiao,Peter Cnudde,Guannan Qu,Holger R. Roth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出TRA统计信号刻画微调中的记忆化，并提出TRAP惩罚以在不知敏感位置的前提下抑制敏感信息记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调语言模型可能使其复现敏感记录，而现有方法在不知道哪些片段敏感的前提下难以预防这种记忆化。

Method: 以同一语料互补半区训练的模型为参考，定义逐token的Target Reference Advantage (TRA)信号；据此提出TRAP——仅当目标模型概率高于参考模型时施加单侧惩罚。并系统分析记忆化的驱动因素。

Result: 记忆化远超验证集最优继续增长，在小数据集、高学习率、更难任务下更强；早期停止帮助有限，尤其对稀有难预测的敏感片段。在含个人信息的作文和含病人标识的临床案例上，TRAP将记忆化降至接近未训练模型水平且效用损失小，优于通用正则化与差分隐私。

Conclusion: TRA/TRAP提供了一种无需预先标注敏感跨度即可有效抑制微调记忆化的可微、低成本方案。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a language model on sensitive records can leave it able to reproduce them. We ask when this memorization arises and how to prevent it without knowing in advance which spans are sensitive. Our starting point is that most memorization scores and attacks share one statistical core: whether the model assigns a token more probability than some reference would. Taking as the reference a model trained on the complementary half of the same corpus gives the Target Reference Advantage (TRA), a per-token signal that separates what a model fit to a particular record from what it learned across records, and is cheap and differentiable. We then study what drives memorization during fine-tuning: it keeps growing well past the validation minimum, is larger on small datasets and at higher learning rates, and higher when the underlying task is harder. Early stopping removes much of it, but because it is chosen by aggregate validation loss it helps least for rare, hard-to-predict spans embedded in otherwise learnable text, which is exactly what sensitive information tends to be. We therefore introduce TRAP, a one-sided penalty on tokenwise TRA that acts only where the target model pulls ahead of its reference. On student essays with annotated personal information and clinical cases with patient identifiers, TRAP brings memorization near the level of an untrained model at little utility cost, where generic regularizers barely move and differential privacy gives up most of what fine-tuning bought.

</details>


### [512] [Language Distances are Practical for Equitable Cross-Lingual Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32331)
*York Hay Ng,Razan Ahsan Rifandi,Aditya Khan,En-Shiun Annie Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次对跨语言迁移中的源语言排序范式进行公平性评估，比较单语言距离、英语恒选基线、免训练复合距离与训练式排序器在资源级与任务级不平等上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言迁移效果高度依赖源语言选择，但为每个目标语言（尤其低资源语言）逐一确定最佳源语言并不现实。语言距离因与迁移效果相关且适用于资源匮乏场景而被广泛用于源语言排序，但其在不同任务和资源水平下的可靠性尚缺乏系统检验，且现有评估较少关注不同资源层级与任务间的公平性问题。

Method: 构建首个以公平性为核心的源语言排序范式评测：覆盖十项跨语言任务与两个多语言模型，比较单语言距离、英语恒选基线、免训练复合距离以及训练式排序器，并考察资源级不平等与任务级不平等；同时对比基于语言距离的排序器与基于语言模型内部表示的排序器的可靠性。

Result: 资源与任务两方面的不平等在单一语言距离和英语恒选基线下最为突出；免训练复合距离可显著降低这些不平等，而训练式排序器几乎将其消除。基于语言距离的排序器相比基于语言模型内部表示的排序器表现出可靠性。

Conclusion: 语言距离为公平且有效的迁移语言选择提供了可行基础：当可获得任务特定的迁移评估时，推荐使用训练式排序器；否则推荐使用复合距离。

Abstract: Cross-lingual transfer is strongly conditional on how the source language is chosen, but it is impractical to determine the best candidate source for every target language, especially for low-resource target languages. Language distances are widely used to rank candidate sources due to their correlation with transfer efficacy and applicability in resource-sparse settings. However, the reliability of distance-based rankers across tasks and resource levels remains underexplored. We therefore present the first equity-focused evaluation of paradigms for ranking source languages, studying resource-level inequality and task inequality across ten cross-lingual tasks and two multilingual models. While both inequalities are most pronounced for individual language distances and an English-always baseline, they are substantially reduced by training-free composite distances, and nearly eliminated by trained rankers. We further demonstrate the reliability of rankers using language distances compared to rankers using language model internals. Overall, we find that language distances provide a practical basis for equitable and performant transfer language selection. We recommend using trained rankers when task-specific transfer evaluations are available, and composite distances otherwise.

</details>


### [513] [Gradients for Interventions and Activations for Detection: Targeted Feature Learning in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32355)
*Jonathan Drechsel,Steffen Herbold*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究“定向特征学习”设定，即针对预先指定的概念构造单一特征，并在15个任务、3个语言模型上系统比较三种模型信号与两种估计器组合的六种定向方法，同时对比预训练SAE，发现检测性能与干预性能分别由不同方法占据优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型内部特征可通过识别概念的能力与操纵时的因果效应来研究。主流方法Sparse Autoencoders（SAE）学习的是宽泛特征字典，其与特定概念的关系通常在事后才被识别，但许多可解释性问题实际上是假设驱动、需要预先指定概念的，因此需要研究定向特征学习这一设定。

Method: 将定向特征学习形式化为针对预定义概念构造单一特征，并构建受控比较框架：三种模型信号（激活值、激活梯度、参数梯度）× 两种估计器（对比均值、学习式一维编码器-解码器），得到六种定向方法，其中CAA和GRADIEND为已有实例，其余四种为覆盖其他组合的新方法。在15个任务与3个语言模型上与预训练SAE对比，评估检测能力与因果干预效果。

Result: 跨模型结果显示，最强检测性能由对比式激活值方法取得，而最强干预性能由基于梯度的方法取得；定向特征质量同时取决于模型信号与估计器的选择，检测与干预反映的是互补特征属性。

Conclusion: 定向特征学习的效果不能仅由单一信号或估计器决定，而需联合考虑两者；检测与干预为互补评价维度，实践中应根据目标（识别概念或操纵行为）选择相应方法。

Abstract: Model-internal features can be studied through both their ability to identify a specified concept and their causal effect when manipulated, e.g., through steering or weight editing. A prominent approach to feature learning is Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which learn broad feature dictionaries whose relation to particular concepts is typically identified post hoc. However, many interpretability questions are instead hypothesis-driven and concern a concept specified in advance. We study this setting as targeted feature learning, where a single feature is constructed for such a predefined concept. We present a controlled comparison across three model signals (activation values, activation gradients, and parameter gradients) and two estimators (contrastive mean and a learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder), yielding six targeted methods, with CAA and GRADIEND as existing instances and four new methods covering the remaining combinations. We compare these methods against pretrained SAEs across 15 tasks and three language models, evaluating both detection and causal intervention. Across models, the strongest detection performance is achieved by contrastive activation value methods, whereas the strongest intervention performance is achieved by gradient-based methods. Overall, our results show that targeted feature quality depends jointly on the model signal and estimator, with detection and intervention capturing complementary properties.

</details>


### [514] [PlurVA-LLM-2026 Shared Task Track-1: Pluralistic Value Alignment in LLMs via Multilingual Fine-Tuning and Threshold Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32382)
*Vihindi Kotalawala,Nevidu Jayatilleke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了针对 PlurVA-LLM 2026 共享任务 Track-1 的系统方案，通过 QLoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，结合各语种定制化数据增强与阈值校准，取得 0.805 的宏平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该任务关注中国、印度尼西亚和斯里兰卡情境下的多元价值对齐，属于资源受限赛道，需要在小样本、低算力条件下实现有效的跨文化价值对齐。

Method: 采用 4-bit QLoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct。针对不同语种分别设计策略：中文数据使用选项置换增强；印尼语数据使用标注者投票扩展；斯里兰卡数据采用二元重构并结合 SinhalaMMLU 增强；并对斯里兰卡预测结果施加条件阈值校准。

Result: 最终系统准确率：中文 0.785，印尼语 0.715，斯里兰卡语 0.916，整体宏平均准确率为 0.805。

Conclusion: 该方案表明，在资源受限条件下，结合参数高效微调与语种定制化的数据增强及后处理校准，可有效提升多元价值对齐任务的性能。

Abstract: We present our system for the PlurVA-LLM 2026 Shared Task Track-1, which focuses on pluralistic value alignment in the contexts of China, Indonesia, and Sri Lanka. For this resource-constrained track, we fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B Instruct using 4-bit QLoRA. Our approach combines option-permutation augmentation for Chinese data, annotator vote expansion for Indonesian data, and binary reformulation with SinhalaMMLU augmentation for Sri Lankan data. We further applied conditional threshold calibration to the predictions for the Sri Lankan data. The final system achieved accuracies of 0.785 for Chinese, 0.715 for Indonesian, and 0.916 for Sri Lankan, resulting in an overall macro-average accuracy of 0.805.

</details>


### [515] [FA-Bench: A Benchmark for Word-Level and Phone-Level Forced-Alignment and ASR Timestamps Under Clean and Noisy Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32396)
*Wei Chu,Yuanzhe Dong,Ke Tan,Dong Han,Yichao Zhou,Ruchao Fan,Bingshen Mu,Jingbei Li,Vishwas Shetty,Sarthak Bisht,Ziyue Qiu,Massa Baali,Rita Singh,Bhisha Raj*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FA-Bench统一评测框架，固定数据划分、规范化与评分口径，用容差F1和分桶诊断比较21个开源模型与9个商用API的强制对齐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有强制对齐（forced alignment）评测在文本规范化、数据划分、边界匹配方式上各不相同，导致公布的数字无法横向比较；同时常用MAE在识别依赖型系统上会虚高评分，需要统一协议与更合理的指标。

Method: 固定文本规范化、数据划分、音素映射与评分脚本，并定期发布结果。设两个Track：Track 1提供参考转写，Track 2提供识别器输出，二者使用同一音频；音频包含干净与四种退化条件。对每个边界进行评分并核查其相邻两个标签，使识别器漏识或臆造的词被计入惩罚；以容差F1为主指标，并按边界位置与相邻词识别正确数量分桶做误差归因。

Result: 覆盖21个开源模型和9个商用API，统一协议下评测。容差F1消除了标准MAE在会话语音识别依赖型系统上造成的9%–14%评分虚高；分桶分析可定位失分来源；并发现系统性时间偏差：Whisper约提前150 ms，多个商用ASR API延迟超过50 ms。

Conclusion: FA-Bench以开源代码、固定划分与统一评分实现了强制对齐结果的可复现、可比较评测；容差F1与边界分桶提供了更可靠的度量与诊断，并揭示了现有系统存在系统性的时间偏差。

Abstract: Forced alignment aligns speech audio with a text transcript to generate word and phone timestamps. Published comparisons normalize transcripts, split the data and match boundaries differently, so their numbers cannot be read together. We present FA-Bench, an open framework that fixes those choices once and releases the code, splits, phone mapping, text normalization and scoring script, with results published periodically. Track 1 gives every aligner the reference transcript and Track 2 gives it a recognizer's output, on the same audio, clean and degraded four ways, with 21 open models and 9 commercial APIs under a unified protocol. We score every boundary of an utterance and check the two labels beside it, so a word the recognizer missed or invented is charged. Using a tolerance-based F1 as our primary metric eliminates the 9% to 14% score inflation that standard MAE causes on recognition-dependent systems in conversational speech. We then group boundaries by their position and how many adjacent words were recognized correctly, which shows where a system lost the score. We discovered systematic bias in how current systems time words, with Whisper about 150 ms early and several commercial ASR APIs over 50 ms late. Code and results are at https://github.com/olewave/fa-bench

</details>


### [516] [SinBrief: A Hybrid Framework for Abstractive Text Summarisation of Sinhala Legal Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32397)
*Minduli Lasandi,Nevidu Jayatilleke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SinBrief——一种无需人工标注数据的僧伽罗语法律文书混合式生成摘要框架，结合领域感知词图与神经句子打分，在低资源法律NLP任务上验证可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言的法律文书摘要面临标注数据稀缺与领域术语复杂的双重困难，难以获取人工标注训练数据。

Method: SinBrief框架：领域感知词图构建 + 神经句子打分，实现生成式摘要；评估五种句子打分模型（mBert、Llama 3.1、Falcon 7B、Laser，以及在僧伽罗语法律文本上持续预训练的Llama）；在僧伽罗语法律语料上采用无参考指标（Coverage、Density、Compression Ratio、SummaC、Self-BertScore）进行评估。

Result: SinBrief生成的摘要相较抽取式基线具有更低的词汇重叠度，同时保持事实一致性。

Conclusion: 混合式、基本无需标注的生成式摘要方法在低资源法律NLP任务中具有可行性。

Abstract: Legal document summarisation in low-resource languages presents significant challenges due to the scarcity of annotated data and the complexity of domain-specific terminology. This paper presents SinBrief, a hybrid abstractive summarisation framework for Sinhala legal documents that does not require human-annotated training data. The proposed framework combines domain-aware word graph construction with neural sentence scoring to generate abstractive summaries from Sinhala legal text. Five sentence scoring models are evaluated within the framework: mBert, Llama 3.1, Falcon 7B, Laser, and a continually pre-trained Llama model domain-adapted to Sinhala legal text. The framework is evaluated on a Sinhala legal corpus using reference-free metrics, including Coverage, Density, Compression Ratio, SummaC, and Self-BertScore. Experimental results demonstrate that SinBrief produces summaries with lower lexical overlap than extractive baselines while maintaining factual consistency, demonstrating the viability of hybrid, largely annotation-free abstractive summarisation for low-resource legal NLP tasks.

</details>


### [517] [Shared Worlds, Private Minds: Structured Memory for Long-Form Writing as World Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32401)
*Qiuyu Tian,Xiaowen Gu,Hang Su,Jianghan Chao,Haojie Yin,Fan Guo,Xin Zhang,Jinjing Shen,Ewing Luo,Youyong Kong,Yingce Xia,Zequn Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 NarraWorld，一个面向长篇小说的结构化记忆系统，将记忆构建视为"世界创建"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在撰写长篇小说时，需要显式的故事世界记忆来保证新事件与已确立事实一致。这类记忆须区分异构叙事信息、跨粒度整合故事发展、并恢复写作请求中隐含的依赖关系。

Method: NarraWorld 从共享的证据锚定图出发，派生四个相互关联的视图：世界事实、角色信念、未决发展、假设分支（可能世界续写）。采用带原子闭合的层次聚合，将事件整合为场景、情节线和情节，并保持每个高层节点可追溯到其组成源文本片段。检索时采用"计划式重构"，依据当前叙事情境与记忆预览推断查询依赖，再在 token 预算内组装相关记录。

Result: 在三个写作基准上，NarraWorld 取得最优的综合结果；其记忆可迁移至情境化角色扮演，并在通用长期记忆基准上基本保持召回性能。

Conclusion: NarraWorld 为智能体在多样叙事任务中维持连贯故事世界提供了可行路径。

Abstract: LLM agents that write long-form fiction need an explicit memory of the evolving storyworld to keep new events consistent with established facts. Such memory must keep heterogeneous narrative information distinct, integrate story developments across granularities, and recover dependencies that a writing request leaves implicit. We present NarraWorld, a structured memory system for long-form writing that treats memory construction as world creation. From a shared evidence-grounded graph, NarraWorld derives four connected views: world facts, per-character beliefs, open developments, and hypothetical branches (possible-world continuations). Hierarchical aggregation with atomic closure consolidates events into scenes, plotlines, and plots, keeping each higher-level node traceable to its constituent source spans. For retrieval, planned reconstruction infers a query's dependencies from the current narrative situation and a preview of memory, then assembles the relevant records within a token budget. Across three writing benchmarks, NarraWorld achieves the strongest aggregate results. Its memory also transfers to situated role-playing and largely preserves recall on a general-purpose long-term memory benchmark, paving the way for agents that sustain coherent storyworlds across diverse narrative tasks.

</details>


### [518] [Automatic Speech Recognition for the Basaà Language: A Low-Resource Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32408)
*Sophie Gertrude Ngo Mock,Charles Moudina Varmantchaonala,Paul Dayang,Jean Michel Nlong,Christopher Gies*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AI与NLP推动自动语音识别（ASR）取得突破，深度神经网络、Transformer和自监督学习使英语、法语等高资源语言接近人类水平，但全球大多数语言未能受益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示当前ASR技术进步的不均衡性：成果集中惠及少数高资源语言，世界绝大多数语言被边缘化。

Method: 未涉及具体方法，仅综述性提及ASR的主流技术范式（深度神经网络、Transformer架构、自监督学习）。

Result: 英语、法语等高资源语言的ASR性能已接近人类水平。

Conclusion: ASR的快速进展存在明显的语言资源偏差，低资源语言被显著忽视，亟需关注技术普惠与语言覆盖的公平性。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) has revolutionized the way humans interact with machines. Among the most impactful developments is Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), which enables computers to convert spoken language into text. Systems such as those built on deep neural networks, transformer architectures, and self-supervised learning have achieved near-human performance for well-resourced languages such as English and French. Yet, these advances have disproportionately benefited a small fraction of the world's languages.

</details>


### [519] [DualGuard: Dual-Mode Quality Control for Logic-Preserving Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32431)
*Shenghao Li,Lin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DualGuard——一个用于逻辑保持型数据增强的双模式质量控制框架，通过"选择性保留/过滤/归因/定向反馈"与"跨实例历史记录+回溯式异常检测+有界修复"两种模式控制增强数据的保留与修复决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型可用于大规模生成逻辑推理增强数据，但生成量增大并不保证语义、标签或逻辑的可靠性。已有工作通过生成约束、候选验证、过滤和基于反馈的修订来提升质量，然而一旦获得质量判断，如何决定候选数据应被保留、过滤还是修复，仍是一个尚未解决的重要控制问题。

Method: 提出双模式质量控制框架 DualGuard。模式一基于当前实例与候选批次进行选择性保留、过滤、归因和定向反馈；模式二在单样本诊断与归因之上，累积跨实例的增强动作执行记录，将新执行与各动作自身的历史行为对比，支持回溯式异常检查、定向回滚和有界修复。两种模式共享语义验证，并在存在可靠逻辑形式时额外使用符号验证（Z3）。

Result: 在 Two-Stage Transfer 设置下的七个下游任务中，DualGuard 在五个任务上取得最高准确率，并在全部七个任务上优于无增强的 BERT 基线。受控消融实验进一步表明 Memory、Z3 与历史感知异常控制各自发挥互补作用。

Conclusion: 将增强数据质量控制建模为"保留/过滤/修复"的决策控制问题，并通过双模式（实例级+历史级）设计与语义、符号双重验证相结合，可有效提升逻辑推理数据增强的可靠性与下游性能。

Abstract: Large language models provide a practical way to generate augmented data for logical reasoning at scale, but a larger generation volume does not guarantee semantic, label, or logical reliability. Existing work has improved generation quality through generation constraints, candidate validation, filtering, and feedback-based revision; however, once a quality judgment is available, deciding whether a candidate should be retained, filtered, or repaired remains an important control problem. We propose DualGuard, a dual-mode quality-control framework for logic-preserving data augmentation. The first mode uses the current instance and candidate batch for selective retention, filtering, attribution, and targeted feedback. The second mode accumulates cross-instance execution records of augmentation actions on top of per-sample diagnosis and attribution, compares new executions against each action's own historical behavior, and supports retrospective anomaly inspection, targeted rollback, and bounded repair. Both modes share semantic verification and additionally use symbolic verification when a reliable logical form is available. Across seven downstream tasks in the Two-Stage Transfer setting, DualGuard achieves the highest Accuracy on five tasks and outperforms the no-augmentation BERT baseline on all seven. Controlled ablations further show complementary roles for Memory, Z3, and history-aware anomaly control.

</details>


### [520] [Masking Frequent Tokens Sharpens Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32445)
*Harshvardhan Saini,Samyak Jha,Yiming Tang,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现DPO中高频token主导序列评分且偏好区分性低，提出Anisotropic DPO（即Frequency-Hard DPO），通过固定、无标签的词表掩码将高频响应token的隐式奖励置零，以零额外开销提升偏好对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO基于token级隐式奖励差异的序列求和进行优化，但作者识别出一个普遍病理：少量高频token类型主导了累积序列分数，且在偏好与非偏好响应中对称出现。以Qwen分词下的Anthropic HH-RLHF为例，仅69个token类型占全部响应token的55.1%、占配对内共享token质量的85.9%，其偏好侧特异性显著低于其余词表。这种对称普遍性引发梯度纠缠，稀释了目标函数传播的判别性偏好信号。

Method: 提出Anisotropic DPO（ADPO）及其规范实现Frequency-Hard DPO。使用固定的、与标签无关的词表掩码，将高频响应token的隐式奖励贡献置零，同时为信息性位置赋予单位权重，从而抑制梯度干扰；不修改偏好对、不丢弃上下文、不引入可学习参数。此处的"各向异性"指非均匀的token级目标加权，而非表示几何。

Result: 在AlpacaEval、MT-Bench和Arena-Hard上的广泛实证评估表明，Frequency-Hard DPO在Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3-8B-Instruct上均持续优于标准DPO。

Conclusion: 选择性掩码共享的高频token为稳健偏好对齐提供了一种有效且零额外开销的机制，验证了对称高频token稀释偏好信号这一病理诊断的正确性。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models by optimizing over sequence-level sums of token-wise implicit reward differences. However, we identify a pervasive pathology in this formulation: a disproportionately small subset of high-frequency token types dominates cumulative sequence scores while appearing symmetrically across both preferred and dispreferred responses. Specifically, under canonical Qwen tokenization on Anthropic HH-RLHF, merely 69 token types account for $55.1\%$ of all response tokens and $85.9\%$ of within-pair shared token mass, exhibiting substantially lower preference-side specificity than the remaining vocabulary. This symmetric ubiquity induces gradient entanglement and dilutes the discriminative preference signal propagated through the objective. To resolve this issue, we introduce \emph{Anisotropic DPO} (\textsf{ADPO}) and its canonical realization, \emph{Frequency-Hard DPO}. Using a fixed, label-agnostic vocabulary mask, our method zeroes the implicit reward contribution of high-frequency response tokens while assigning unit weight to informative positions, thereby suppressing gradient interference without modifying preference pairs, discarding context, or introducing learned parameters. Here, \emph{anisotropy} designates non-uniform token-level objective weighting rather than representational geometry. Extensive empirical evaluations on AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and Arena-Hard demonstrate that Frequency-Hard DPO consistently outperforms standard DPO across Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct, establishing that selectively masking shared high-frequency tokens offers an effective, zero-overhead mechanism for robust preference alignment.

</details>


### [521] [Self-Reports Do Not Identify Self-Models: An Identifiability Test for Counterfactual Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32449)
*Phongsakon Mark Konrad,Toygar Tanyel,Serkan Ayvaz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 语言模型的自我报告仅是提示环境下的行为证据，而非自我模型的证据；激活干预下的反事实报告在演示环境变化时会偏离命名干预，显式机制绑定可减弱该偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常将语言模型自我报告的准确性直接视为其具备自主自我报告机制（乃至自我模型）的证据，但忽略了报告可能只是对提示环境的敏感性行为，缺乏对环境不变性的检验。

Method: 在三个开源指令模型上，对类情感状态进行反事实报告实验：施加激活干预，并改变演示环境（错误来源演示），考察报告是否仍与所命名的干预相绑定；同时测试显式机制绑定对报告偏移的抑制作用。

Result: 错误来源演示会将报告拉向来源答案家族；显式机制绑定能降低这种拉动效应。

Conclusion: 自我报告基准应在固定干预条件下加入环境迁移不变性测试，之后才能将准确率作为自主报告机制的证据。

Abstract: Language-model self-reports are evidence about behavior in a prompt environment, not by themselves evidence of a self-model. We investigate counterfactual reports about affect-like states under activation interventions and ask whether the report remains bound to the named intervention when the demonstration environment changes. Across three open instruction models, wrong-source demonstrations move reports toward the source answer family, while explicit mechanism binding reduces this pull. Self-report benchmarks should include environment-shift invariance tests under fixed intervention before treating accuracy as evidence for an autonomous report mechanism.

</details>


### [522] [What Should the Reflector See? An Empirical Study of Evidence in Reflective Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32452)
*Xiaofan Zhou,Lu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究在单亲Pareto引导搜索框架下，以Qwen3.5-9B同时作为任务模型与反思器，在5个数据集上比较9种反思策略，考察证据构成、示例可见性、候选选择与领域知识策略，并揭示最终性能、父代改进与校准-测试迁移三者的评估需相互分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反思式提示优化通过模型行为示例来修订指令，但反思器应接收哪些证据尚不明确，因此需要系统研究证据组成等设计因素对优化效果的影响。

Method: 在单亲Pareto引导搜索中，操纵证据构成、示例可见性、候选选择与领域知识策略；使用Qwen3.5-9B同时充当任务模型和反思器，在5个数据集上评估9种反思策略，并从最终性能、反思有效性、过拟合评估三个维度进行排名与对比分析。

Result: 性能提升方面，Failures-only取得最大平均测试增益（+8.0个百分点），Balanced-mix与No-examples+Val并列最佳平均性能排名；反思有效性方面，No-examples在改进采样父代上排名最佳，但平均测试增益仅1.4点；过拟合评估方面，Failures-only与Balanced-mix并列最低平均校准差距排名，而GPQA与IFBench上更大的差距表明校准增益可能高估留出集改进，该差距仅为描述性指标而非过拟合的直接度量。

Conclusion: 反思策略应分别从最终性能、父代改进和校准到测试的迁移三个方面进行评估；局部反思成功并不必然带来更强的最终提示，且校准增益可能高估留出集性能提升。

Abstract: Reflective prompt optimization revises instructions using examples of a model's behavior, but which evidence the reflector should receive remains unclear. We study evidence composition, visibility of examples, candidate selection and domain-knowledge policy within a single-parent Pareto-guided search. Using Qwen3.5-9B as both task model and reflector, we evaluate nine reflection strategies on five datasets. From these experiments, we find three distinct patterns. For performance improvement, Failures-only produces the largest mean test gain (+8.0 percentage points), while Balanced-mix and No-examples+Val share the best mean performance rank. For reflection effectiveness, No-examples achieves the best rank for improving sampled parents, yet yields only a 1.4-point mean test gain: local reflection success does not necessarily produce a stronger final prompt. For overfitting assessment, Failures-only and Balanced-mix share the lowest mean calibration-gap rank, while larger gaps on GPQA and IFBench show that calibration gains can overstate held-out improvement. This gap is a descriptive indicator, not a direct measure of overfitting. Together, these results show why reflection strategies should be assessed separately on final performance, parent improvement and calibration-to-test transfer.

</details>


### [523] [Streamlined Reflective Evolution for Task-Adaptive Self-Refinement Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32458)
*Xiaofan Zhou,Lu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: WDA 框架联合演化提示优化各阶段指令及其顺序结构，通过 SPLIT 机制将冗余指令重新分配到专门阶段，实现任务自适应的自精炼流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反思式提示优化可在不更新模型权重的情况下改进 LLM 系统，但固定架构限制了自精炼的组织方式。作者希望实现任务自适应的自精炼流程的简化反思演化。

Method: 从最小提示出发，联合演化各阶段指令及其序列结构；针对反复修改导致单提示中指令冗余的问题，提出 SPLIT 将冗余指令重分配到专门阶段；三样本反思与局部筛选引导选择性搜索，校准分数引导 Pareto 准入与无效尾部更新的回滚；最终流程的指令与深度由任务数据学习后固定用于该任务的全部测试输入。

Result: 在涵盖知识、数学推理、多跳问答与指令遵循的五个基准上评估。Qwen3.5-9B 上平均 51.24%，较初始求解器提升 8.63 个百分点，较去掉 SPLIT 的变体提升 2.60 个百分点；GPT-4.1-mini 上为 49.00%，对应提升 5.62 与 3.69 个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果支持任务自适应自精炼作为更广泛智能体工作流搜索的互补方向。

Abstract: Reflective prompt optimization improves large language model (LLM) systems without updating model weights, but fixed architectures constrain how self-refinement is organized. We introduce Workflow-Designing Agents (WDA), a framework for streamlined reflective evolution of task-adaptive self-refinement pipelines. Starting from a minimal prompt, WDA jointly evolves stage instructions and their sequential structure. During evolution, we find that repeated revisions can accumulate redundant instructions in a single prompt. In WDA, we propose to address this problem with SPLIT, which redistributes these instructions across specialized stages. Three-example reflection and local screening guide selective search, while calibration scores guide Pareto admission and rollback of unhelpful trailing updates. The resulting pipelines are task-adaptive: their instructions and depth are learned from task data, then fixed for all test inputs within that task. We evaluate WDA on five benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-hop question answering, and instruction following. On Qwen3.5-9B, WDA achieves an average score of 51.24%, improving over the initial solver by 8.63 percentage points and the variant without SPLIT by 2.60 points. On GPT-4.1-mini, it achieves 49.00%, with corresponding gains of 5.62 and 3.69 points. These results support task-adaptive self-refinement as a complementary direction to broader agentic workflow search.

</details>


### [524] [AdaTutoRank: Learning to Rerank Document Sets via Adaptive Tutoring Optimization for RAG and Deep Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32472)
*Kailin Jiang,Lei Liu,Jian Xi,Yangqi Chen,Hui Xu,Hongwei Zhao,Bin Li,Yu Lu,Haibo Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaTutoRank——一个集合式重排序器,采用自适应辅导优化(ATO, Adaptive Tutoring Optimization)训练,在三层九维评分标准体系下,为冷启动提供银标、为强化学习提供奖励、为蒸馏提供提示。ATO 从策略自身的冻结快照中生成三种特异性递增的提示形式(仅评分标准、自选择器选出的兄弟集合、自反思器对 rollout 与兄弟集合的对比反思),并按每个 rollout 的质量匹配相应提示形式;通过在有提示条件的冻结教师与无提示快照下对同一 rollout 重新打分,将提示效果蒸馏为 token 级优势,与组相对结果优势互补。在覆盖 RAG、深度研究与集合式评测的十个基准上,AdaTutoRank 取得最佳整体性能且检索调用更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档重排序器决定 RAG 与深度研究中哪些证据进入下游模型,但主流重排序器按相关性匹配进行选择,而单个相关的文档很少能构成复杂信息需求所要求的完整、互补且非冗余的证据集合。已有工作以集合的聚合评分标准分数作为奖励,将目标从"排序文档"转向"组合集合",但该分数是集合内所有文档共享的单一标量,监督信号稀疏:冗余文档在集合得分高时随其他文档一同受奖,关键文档在集合得分低时随其他文档一同受罚,信用分配无法区分贡献者与搭便车者。在线策略蒸馏本可加密监督,但现有方法对所有 rollout 提供相同固定指导,对强 rollout 过于规定性、对弱 rollout 又过于抽象。因此需要一种按 rollout 质量自适应分配指导强度的训练方法。

Method: 提出 AdaTutoRank,一个集合式重排序器,在九维评分标准的三层层次结构下用自适应辅导优化(ATO, Adaptive Tutoring Optimization)训练;该评分体系为冷启动提供银标、为强化学习提供奖励、为蒸馏提供提示。ATO 从策略自身的冻结快照中抽取三种特异性递增的提示形式:(1)仅评分标准;(2)自选择器在评分标准下选出的兄弟集合;(3)自反思器将 rollout 与该兄弟集合对比所得的反思。每个 rollout 获得与其质量相符的提示形式。随后,在有提示条件的冻结教师与无提示快照下对该 rollout 重新打分,从而将提示的效果蒸馏为 token 级优势,用以补充组相对结果优势。

Result: 在覆盖 RAG、深度研究与集合式评测的十个基准上,AdaTutoRank 取得最佳整体性能,同时检索调用次数更少。

Conclusion: AdaTutoRank 通过自适应辅导优化解决了集合式重排序中集合级标量奖励带来的信用分配稀疏问题,利用策略自身冻结快照生成分级提示并将提示效果蒸馏为 token 级优势,在多个基准上实现最优整体性能并降低检索开销。

Abstract: Document rerankers determine what evidence reaches the downstream model in RAG and deep research, yet mainstream rerankers select by relevance matching, and individually relevant documents rarely constitute the complete, complementary, non-redundant set a complex information need demands. Prior work rewards a set by its aggregate rubric score, shifting the objective from ranking documents to composing sets. Yet that score is one scalar shared by every document in the set, so the supervision is sparse: a redundant document is rewarded with the rest whenever the set scores well, and a decisive one penalized with the rest whenever it does not; credit assignment leaves contributors indistinguishable from free riders. On-policy distillation could densify this supervision, but existing methods give every rollout the same fixed guidance, too prescriptive for strong rollouts and too abstract for weak ones. We therefore propose AdaTutoRank, a setwise reranker trained with Adaptive Tutoring Optimization (ATO) under a three-level hierarchy of nine rubric dimensions, which supplies silver labels for the cold start, rewards for reinforcement learning, and hints for distillation. ATO draws three hint forms of increasing specificity from the policy's own frozen snapshot: the rubrics alone, a self-selector's sibling-set chosen under rubrics, and a self-reflector's reflection contrasting the rollout with that sibling-set; each rollout receives the form matched to its quality. Re-scoring that rollout under the hint-conditioned frozen teacher and the hint-free snapshot distills the hint's effect into a token-level advantage that complements the group-relative outcome advantage. Across ten benchmarks spanning RAG, deep research, and setwise evaluation, AdaTutoRank attains the best overall performance while issuing fewer retrieval calls.

</details>


### [525] [PC-SubMax: Efficient Prompt Compression via Regularized Submodular Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32474)
*Ziyi Zhang,Shuang Cui,Haotian Zhang,Xiaoyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 PC-SubMax，将选择性提示压缩建模为背包约束下的正则化单调子模最大化问题，目标为 U(S)-ℓ(S)，并用 RGM 算法实现理论保证与低开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文场景下，长提示会增加推理成本与延迟，并加剧"lost-in-the-middle"现象。现有选择性提示压缩方法存在两点不足：1）基于固定 token 或句子级重要性分数，忽略内容贡献随所选子集变化，难以刻画句间冗余；2）依赖自回归 LLM 打分会带来显著额外开销。

Method: 将选择性提示压缩形式化为背包约束下的正则化单调子模最大化。目标函数 U(S)-ℓ(S)：单调子模效用 U 融合信息覆盖、查询相关性与对数行列式多样性；非负模惩罚 ℓ 表示 token 成本。利用边际收益递减，使目标评估每句相对于已选内容的贡献。提出 Regularized Greedy+Max (RGM) 算法确定性求解，使用 O(nκ) 次价值预言机查询（n 为候选句数，κ 为最大可行子集规模），基于编码器表示，压缩阶段不使用自回归 LLM 打分。

Result: RGM 确定性返回可行集 Q，满足 U(Q)-ℓ(Q) ≥ 1/2·U(O)-ℓ(O)（O 为最优可行解），即 1/2 近似保证。在七个多样化基准上取得有竞争力的下游性能，且压缩开销低。

Conclusion: PC-SubMax 为提示压缩提供了理论可证、模型无关且低开销的框架，通过子模优化同时建模覆盖、相关性与多样性并显式扣减 token 成本，实验证明其在多基准上性能与效率兼具。

Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-context scenarios, lengthy prompts can increase inference costs and latency and exacerbate the ``lost-in-the-middle'' phenomenon. Selective prompt compression offers a model-agnostic approach to alleviating these issues. However, methods based on fixed token- or sentence-level importance scores may overlook how content contributions change with the selected subset, limiting their ability to account for inter-sentence redundancy. Compression procedures that rely on autoregressive LLM scoring can also introduce substantial overhead. We propose PC-SubMax, a theoretically grounded framework that formulates selective prompt compression as regularized monotone submodular maximization under a knapsack constraint. The objective is $U(S)-\ell(S)$, where the monotone submodular utility $U$ combines information coverage, query relevance, and log-determinant diversity, and the non-negative modular penalty $\ell$ captures token cost. Through diminishing marginal returns, the objective evaluates each sentence's contribution relative to the selected content. To optimize this objective, we develop the Regularized Greedy+Max (RGM) algorithm, which deterministically returns a feasible set $Q$ satisfying $U(Q)-\ell(Q)\geq \frac{1}{2}U(O)-\ell(O)$, where $O$ is an optimal feasible solution to the regularized problem. RGM uses $O(nκ)$ value-oracle queries, where $n$ is the number of candidate sentences and $κ$ is the maximum feasible subset size. PC-SubMax uses encoder representations and avoids autoregressive LLM scoring during compression. Experiments across seven diverse benchmarks demonstrate competitive downstream performance with low compression overhead.

</details>


### [526] [Explaining Textual Entailment with Lexical Entailments: Using LLMs to Supply Lexical Relations for Formal Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32491)
*Jorryt de Jong,Stefan Moraca,Ettore Cesari,Lasha Abzianidze*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估LLM能否识别求解NLI所需的结构化词汇蕴含知识，以及该知识对逻辑型NLI证明搜索的贡献。作者构建了"用词汇蕴含解释句子蕴含"的新任务数据集，并在LangPro定理证明器上进行神经符号实验。结果显示该任务对专有LLM仍具挑战性，生成关系往往仅部分可靠，且易过拟合于具体NLI问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM具备自然语言推理能力并似乎存储大量词汇知识，但不清楚其在推理时实际使用了多少以及是否使用得当；而逻辑型NLI系统推理透明且形式化可靠，却需外部提供丰富词汇知识才能证明超出纯逻辑的推断。因此需考察LLM能否提供所需的词汇知识并量化其价值。

Method: 聚焦结构化词汇蕴含（如chinchilla⊑small animal）作为蕴含标签NLI问题的结构化解释代理。首先构建新任务数据集"用一组词汇蕴含解释句子蕴含"，对LLM生成结构化词汇解释进行内在评估；随后在简单神经符号设置中进行外在评估，检验LLM能否为自然逻辑定理证明器LangPro提供充足词汇关系以支持证明。

Result: 该任务即使对托管型专有LLM仍具挑战性；生成关系对定理证明的贡献中等：关系往往只有部分可靠（sound），且可能针对特定NLI问题定制，而非代表普遍有效的词汇知识。

Conclusion: LLM所存储的词汇知识在逻辑型NLI推理中仅被有限且不完全可靠地利用；将LLM作为神经符号系统的知识供应者仍需改进，以提升其生成关系的可靠性与通用性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are highly capable of natural language reasoning and appear to store a great deal of lexical knowledge, but it is still unclear how much of this knowledge they actually use when reasoning, and whether they use it in the right way. On the other hand, logic-based Natural Language Inference (NLI) systems provide transparent and formally grounded reasoning, but they need to be supplied with rich lexical knowledge to prove inferences beyond purely logical ones. In this paper, we evaluate whether LLMs can identify all lexical knowledge needed to solve NLI problems and how much this knowledge contributes to proof search in a logic-based NLI system. Our research focuses exclusively on structured lexical entailments (e.g., chinchilla$\sqsubseteq$small animal) as a proxy for structured explanations for NLI problems with an entailment label. First, we curate a dataset for a new task of explaining sentential entailments with a set of lexical entailments. The dataset is used to intrinsically evaluate LLMs on generating structured lexical explanations. Then, we use NLI as an extrinsic evaluation in a simple neuro-symbolic setting, assessing whether LLMs can supply sufficient lexical relations to LangPro, a natural-logic theorem prover for natural language. The results show that the proposed task remains challenging even for hosted proprietary LLMs, and that their contribution to theorem proving is moderate: generated relations are often only partially sound and may be tailored to the specific NLI problem rather than representing generally valid lexical knowledge.

</details>


### [527] [Locally Sound, Globally Insufficient: The Local-Global Gap in Multi-Hop Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32496)
*Bohao Chu,Hendrik Damm,Qianli Wang,Hui Wang,Shuning Zhang,Christoph M. Friedrich,Norbert Fuhr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"局部-全局差距"(LGG)失败模式，即推理链每步局部可靠但整体不足以回答问题；通过2598条人工判定诊断发现LGG普遍存在且占全局不充分回答近半，传统忠实性验证器难以捕捉；据此形式化三种依赖关系并引入E-Closure训练监督方法，在三基准三骨干上取得最高平均准确率(92.8%)与推理链可靠性(89.0%)，并将LGG率降至最低(6.2%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳推理的可靠性不能仅靠局部支持：推理链可能每步都由证据与前序步骤支撑（局部可靠），却整体上无法对齐问题并支撑最终答案。作者将这一失败情形命名为局部-全局差距(LGG)。现有忠实性验证器主要检验单条陈述是否被证据支持，因而系统性遗漏此类"局部可靠但全局不充分"的失败，导致评估与优化出现盲区。

Method: 首先通过2598条人工判定响应（覆盖3个多跳QA基准、3个模型）对LGG进行诊断性量化。其次形式化可靠推理的三类依赖：证据到步骤的支持(evidence-to-step support)、问题到推理链的对齐(question-to-trace alignment)、推理链到答案的闭合(trace-to-answer closure)。最后提出E-Closure，不再做事后诊断，而是在训练中直接监督这些依赖：对有支持的原始响应与反事实响应进行生成监督，并施加双向切换约束(bidirectional switching constraints)。

Result: 诊断结果显示LGG在每一个基准-模型组合中均出现，且占全部全局不充分回答近一半；在保留至少95%可靠推理链的阈值下，常规忠实性验证器对LGG样本的召回率显著低于对局部不可靠样本的召回率。在3个基准与3个骨干上的平均表现中，现有微调基线相较基础模型提升了准确率与局部可靠性，但以牺牲全局充分性为代价；E-Closure同时提升二者，在所有微调方法中取得最高平均准确率(92.8%)与推理链可靠性(89.0%)，并实现最低LGG率(6.2%)。

Conclusion: 多跳推理的可靠性评估需从"局部可靠"扩展到"全局充分"，仅检验步骤级证据支持会漏检大量失败。将证据支持、问题对齐与答案闭合三类依赖在训练阶段显式监督，可在不牺牲局部可靠性的前提下提升全局充分性，缓解LGG问题。E-Closure在多项基准与模型上一致优于现有微调方法。

Abstract: Reliable multi-hop reasoning requires more than locally supported steps: a trace can be sound at every reasoning step yet still fail to answer the question as a whole. We call this failure regime the local-global gap (LGG), in which the trace is locally sound yet globally insufficient. Local soundness requires each step to be supported by the available evidence and preceding steps, whereas global sufficiency requires the reasoning trace to align with the question and establish the submitted answer. In a human-adjudicated diagnostic of 2,598 responses across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three models, we find that the LGG occurs in every benchmark-model combination and accounts for nearly half of globally insufficient responses overall. However, conventional faithfulness verifiers that check claims against the evidence largely miss these failures: at thresholds retaining at least 95% of reliable traces, recall for LGG cases is substantially lower than that for locally unsound traces. To address these failures, we formalize three dependencies for reliable reasoning: evidence-to-step support, question-to-trace alignment, and trace-to-answer closure. Instead of post-hoc diagnosis, we introduce E-Closure to supervise these dependencies during training, combining generation supervision on supported original and counterfactual responses with bidirectional switching constraints. Averaged over three benchmarks and three backbones, existing fine-tuning baselines improve accuracy and local soundness over the base models, but at the cost of global sufficiency. E-Closure improves both: among all fine-tuned methods, it achieves the highest average accuracy (92.8%) and trace reliability (89.0%) while yielding the lowest LGG rate (6.2%).

</details>


### [528] [Learning an Anchored Prompt Space for Continual Adaptation of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32499)
*Rongguang Ye,Zhan Zhuang,Yichen Wu,Ming Tang,Kede Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LAPS（Learning an Anchored Prompt Space），通过在更新后的模型上对齐历史提示并构建锚定提示空间来学习任务间关系，从而在持续适应大语言模型时减少遗忘并提升平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续适应大语言模型需要同时获取新知识并保留旧能力。联合调整模型参数与任务特定软提示是一种有前景的方案，但存在两个关键局限：(1) 随着模型演化，历史提示的有效性会下降；(2) 提示之间可迁移的跨任务关系未被显式学习。

Method: LAPS首先通过自蒸馏将历史提示与更新后的模型对齐，以保持其有效性；随后构建一个锚定提示空间，其顶点对应已学习的任务特定软提示，中间几何结构由可学习的Bézier控制提示塑造。空间学习完成后，LAPS在每个任务的验证集上挑选表现最佳的提示，使优化后的提示能够利用从已观察任务中获得的知识。

Result: 在TRACE基准上、三种Qwen3模型规模的实验中，LAPS持续优于基于蒸馏、基于提示以及提示—参数联合适应等基线方法，在提升平均性能的同时减少了遗忘。

Conclusion: 显式对齐历史提示并学习任务间提示空间几何关系，可有效促进正向迁移，是缓解持续适应中灾难性遗忘的有效途径。

Abstract: Continually adapting large language models requires acquiring new knowledge while preserving previously learned capabilities. Jointly adapting model parameters and task-specific soft prompts offers a promising solution, but faces two key limitations: historical prompts may become less effective as the model evolves, while their transferable cross-task relationships are not explicitly learned. We propose Learning an Anchored Prompt Space (LAPS), which preserves historical prompt effectiveness and learns relationships among task-specific soft prompts to facilitate positive transfer. LAPS first aligns historical prompts with the updated model through self-distillation. LAPS then constructs an anchored prompt space whose vertices correspond to learned task-specific soft prompts and whose intermediate geometry is shaped by learnable Bézier control prompts. Once this anchored prompt space is learned, LAPS identifies the best-performing prompt for each task on its validation set, allowing the optimized prompt to draw on knowledge acquired from observed tasks. Experiments on the TRACE benchmark across three Qwen3 model scales show that LAPS consistently outperforms distillation-based, prompt-based, and joint prompt--parameter adaptation baselines, improving average performance while reducing forgetting.

</details>


### [529] [When Users Change Their Minds: Measuring and Repairing Intent Drift in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32520)
*Yanjie Zhang,Bowen Cao,Zixin Chen,Yushi Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究多轮对话中LLM智能体的"意图漂移"失败模式，提出可执行基准IntentFlux进行量化评测，并提出显式状态维护方法StateForge作为部分缓解方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体常在多轮交互中运行，用户意图在执行前会发生变化。然而，被取代或撤回的旧意图可能持续影响最终回答或工具调用，这种"意图漂移"失败模式此前缺乏可量化的评测手段，因此需要构建基准并探索缓解方案。

Method: 提出IntentFlux：将可验证任务转换为受控意图变化的对话，同时保留原有评分器。在627个案例上校准。进一步提出StateForge，在生成前显式维护活跃需求（当前有效意图状态）。

Result: 627案例校准中，随着对话包含更多被取代和撤回的信息，平均任务得分从0.476降至0.384。在八个模型上，需从演化对话中恢复最终任务时的完全正确率显著低于单轮直接给出任务。StateForge在General-Test上将平均任务得分从0.367提升至0.467；提供真实最终状态可进一步提升，但仍无法恢复单轮性能，说明状态估计误差只能解释部分差距。

Conclusion: 研究确立意图漂移为一种可测量的多轮失败模式，并将显式状态维护确认为一种部分有效的缓解手段。

Abstract: LLM agents often operate over multi-turn interactions in which user intent changes before execution. We study intent drift: the failure mode in which superseded parts of the user's intent continue to influence the final answer or tool action. We introduce IntentFlux, an executable benchmark that converts verifiable tasks into dialogues with controlled intent changes while preserving their original graders. In a 627-case calibration, mean task score falls from 0.476 to 0.384 as dialogues contain more superseded and withdrawn information. Across eight models, the rate of fully correct solutions is significantly lower when the same final task must be recovered from an evolving dialogue rather than given directly in a single turn. We further introduce StateForge, which explicitly maintains the active requirements before generation. On General-Test, it improves mean task score from 0.367 to 0.467. Providing the ground-truth final state improves performance further but still does not recover single-turn performance, indicating that state-estimation errors explain only part of the gap. These results establish intent drift as a measurable multi-turn failure mode and explicit state maintenance as a partial mitigation.

</details>


### [530] [Language as an Independent Information Layer: A Conceptual Model of Communication, Cognition and Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32556)
*Anastasiia Alifanova,Elena Benderskaya*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文基于语言在思维与交流中作用的分析，提出一种融合企业词汇概率向量空间与传统本体建模的企业知识库设计新概念，旨在衔接统计与语义（因果）方法，并识别业务流程瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业积累的文档蕴含大量知识，但传统本体建模难以充分反映行业特性、主题、术语与文化等语言层面的动态特征，且统计方法与语义因果方法之间存在割裂，因此需要一种能将二者结合的知识库设计框架。

Method: 将反映行业特点、主题焦点、术语和文化的企业词汇概率向量空间，与传统本体建模相结合；把语言视为信息架构中独立且动态的层级，在词分布概率空间中引入动态成分，建模为面向不同问题表述的多维解空间，并将定义问题条件的输入数据作为动态变换的控制参数。

Result: 该概念可在兼顾具体业务流程的前提下，从企业累积文档中高效提取知识；同时通过分析概率空间投影与因果关系，有助于识别业务逻辑中的瓶颈。

Conclusion: 该概念桥接了统计与语义（因果）方法，为企业知识库设计提供了兼顾语言动态性与业务约束的新思路，并可用于业务逻辑瓶颈的诊断。

Abstract: Based on an analysis of the role of language in thought and communication, this article proposes a new concept for designing corporate knowledge bases. The concept integrates the probabilistic vector space of a corporate vocabulary, reflect-ing industry specifics, subject focus, terminology, and culture, with traditional ontological modeling. This combination enables the efficient extraction of knowledge from accumulated corporate documents while strictly accounting for specific business processes. Consequently, this concept bridges statistical and semantic (cause-and-effect) methodologies. Furthermore, analyzing the projec-tions of probabilistic spaces and causal relationships can help identify bottlenecks in business logic. As a dynamic system, language functions as a separate, inde-pendent layer within the overall information architecture. Introducing a dynamic component into the probabilistic space of word distribution allows it to be mod-eled as a multidimensional solution space for various problem formulations. In this context, input data defining the problem conditions serve as control parame-ters for dynamic transformations.

</details>


### [531] [How to Reduce Whisper Hallucination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32560)
