*Benjamin Léger,Shubham Gupta,Samy Mammeri,Kazem Meidani,Cem Subakan,Christian Gagné*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文指出现有多模态符号回归模型的符号-数值共享嵌入空间仅在整体层面“全局对齐”，无法表征表达式局部子结构对数值行为的贡献；提出组合式对齐方法，通过结构位置编码与多粒度对比目标，将子表达式与其产生的行为对齐，并将该对齐传播至完整表达式，从而显著缩小模态差距并支持局部编辑效应判别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号表达式与其数值行为是同一底层函数的两种视图，连接二者是科学发现的核心。符号回归（SR）正是依赖这种连接：搜索能复现给定行为的表达式。近期多模态模型通过将符号表达式与数值行为嵌入共享表示空间来学习这种连接。但论文发现该嵌入空间仅在全局层面对齐——完整表达式对应完整行为，而表达式各组成部分的贡献未被表征。这种粒度缺失导致模型无法判断对表达式的局部编辑如何改变其行为，而这恰是SR的核心操作。

Method: 提出一种组合式对齐（compositional alignment）方法以弥合上述粒度鸿沟，包含两个关键组件：1）结构性位置编码（structural positional encoding），将表达式的子结构暴露给编码器；2）多粒度对比目标（multi-granularity contrastive objective），将每个子表达式锚定到其产生的行为上，再把这种锚定关系传播至完整表达式。

Result: 所得表示大幅缩小了符号嵌入与数值嵌入之间的模态差距；能够可靠区分原对齐方法无法辨别的局部编辑效应；并可迁移到外部SR语料库。

Conclusion: 现有多模态嵌入空间存在“只全局对齐、不表征局部贡献”的粒度缺陷，限制了SR核心操作（局部编辑行为预测）；通过结构位置编码与多粒度对比学习实现的组合式对齐，可有效弥合该缺陷，提升表示质量与跨语料迁移能力。

Abstract: Mathematical expressions and the numerical behavior they produce are two views of the same underlying function, and connecting them is central to scientific discovery. Symbolic Regression (SR) relies on this connection directly: it searches for an expression that reproduces a given behavior. Recent multi-modal models learn this connection by embedding symbolic expressions and their numerical behavior in a shared representation space. We show that this embedding space is only globally aligned: complete expressions correspond to complete behaviors, but the contribution of individual parts of an expression is not represented. This granularity gap leaves the model unable to tell how a local edit to an expression changes its behavior, the central operation in SR. We introduce a compositional alignment method that closes this gap: a structural positional encoding exposes the substructure of an expression to the encoder, and a multi-granularity contrastive objective grounds each subexpression in the behavior it produces before propagating this grounding to the full expression. The resulting representations close much of the modality gap between symbolic and numerical embeddings, reliably distinguish the effects of local edits that the original alignment cannot, and transfer to external SR corpora.

</details>


### [698] [All On-Board: Fully On-Chip Neuromorphic Q-Learning with Embedded CartPole Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32317)
*Steven C. Nesbit,Giovanni T. Michel,Gerd J. Kunde,Edward Kim,Andrew T. Sornborger*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文在Loihi 2神经形态芯片上实现了完全片上、闭环的强化学习智能体，将Q-learning算法与CartPole-v0环境仿真全部部署于芯片内，训练效率与能效显著优于CPU方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI模型规模和用量的增长，其能耗急剧上升，带来可持续性与经济性方面的担忧。神经形态硬件受大脑能效启发，可为资源受限环境中的控制系统提供低功耗、快处理的替代方案，而这类系统最适合用强化学习训练。因此，作者希望验证在神经形态硬件上运行强化学习的可行性，以构建高能效、实时的嵌入式AI系统。

Method: 设计并实现了一个完全片上、闭环的Loihi 2强化学习智能体。其神经形态电路包含完全嵌入的Q-learning算法，以及在Loihi 2上对CartPole-v0环境的片上仿真。

Result: 该Q-learning算法训练出的成功智能体数量与CPU实现相同，但执行时间仅为其一半，动态功耗降低了两个数量级。实验结果证明了在神经形态硬件上运行强化学习的可行性，并展示了其在构建高能效、实时、嵌入式AI系统方面的潜力。

Conclusion: 神经形态硬件结合强化学习可有效应对AI能耗挑战，为资源受限环境中的低功耗、实时嵌入式智能系统提供了可行路径。

Abstract: As AI models grow in size and usage, their energy demands increase dramatically, raising sustainability and economic concerns. Neuromorphic hardware, inspired by the energy efficiency of the brain, seeks to address this challenge by offering low-power, fast-processing alternatives to conventional computing. Such hardware is particularly well-suited to control systems deployed in resource-constrained environments, which are best trained via reinforcement learning (RL). This contribution presents the design and implementation of a fully on-chip, closed-loop Loihi 2 RL agent. Our neuromorphic circuit consists of a fully embedded Q-learning algorithm and an on-chip simulation of the CartPole-v0 environment on Loihi 2. Our Q-learning algorithm trained the same number of successful agents as the CPU implementation in only half the execution time and with two orders of magnitude less dynamic power. These findings demonstrate the viability of RL on neuromorphic hardware and highlight its promise for building energy-efficient, real-time, embedded AI systems.

</details>


### [699] [ADPTNet: Adaptive with Prescriptive Timescales Non-Linear SSM for Sequence Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34034)
*Matei-Ioan Stan,Oliver Rhodes*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出ADPTNet，通过局部拓扑共轭（线性注意力+Riemannian优化）构造基于固定时间尺度的非线性递归网络，同时满足数据自适应、长程依赖、GPU可并行与非线性递归四项性质，并在多项任务上超越Hawk、Mamba及Transformer，衍生出脉冲版本SpikingADPTNet与两种无Jacobian并行仿真扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类脑计算旨在替代高能耗的Transformer，但现有高效替代方案难以同时具备Transformer在序列建模中的四大优势：数据自适应、长程依赖捕获、GPU可并行以及支持复杂推理的非线性递归。受听觉皮层固定时间尺度证据启发，作者希望找到同时满足这四项性质的新架构。

Method: 提出ADPTNet，其核心是局部拓扑共轭，由线性注意力与Riemannian优化相结合，作用于静态全局动力学，从而在保持非线性长期行为可预测的同时实现参数化控制时间尺度（Lyapunov谱）；并推导动力学系统理论证明提供理论保证。进一步构建脉冲化版本SpikingADPTNet，并提出两种DEER并行仿真扩展（Conv DEER与Forward DEER），保持平均收敛性的同时实现无Jacobian的非线性RNN并行化。

Result: ADPTNet在Selective Copying上优于Hawk，在状态跟踪上优于Mamba等线性SSM；在sequential CIFAR-10上以更少参数达到线性SSM精度并超越包括Transformer在内的现有选择性模型；SpikingADPTNet在Spiking Speech Commands上取得新SOTA（83.56%±0.15）。Conv DEER不增加额外计算开销，首次实现基于迭代卷积的非线性RNN并行化。

Conclusion: ADPTNet是同时满足数据自适应、长程依赖、GPU并行和非线性递归四项性质的可行序列建模方案，其固定时间尺度特性还带来了高效的无Jacobian并行仿真扩展，验证了类脑固定时间尺度机制作为Transformer替代路线的潜力。

Abstract: A central aim of neuromorphic computing is to provide a viable alternative to highly energy-intensive Transformer-based AI. However, efficient alternatives struggle to capture the set of qualities that have secured the Transformer's status as the de facto standard in sequence modelling. Any realistic contender must be data-adaptive, able to capture long-range dependencies, and GPU-parallelisable, but also non-linearly recurrent to enable complex reasoning. Based on evidence suggesting the auditory cortex operates on fixed timescales, this work proposes the ADaptive with Prescriptive Timescales Network (ADPTNet) as a potential solution to achieving all four properties simultaneously. ADPTNet is built around local topological conjugates, obtained by a novel combination of linear attention and Riemannian optimisation, applied to static global dynamics. This enables non-linear yet predictable long-term behaviour. Dynamical systems theory proofs provide theoretical guarantees for the parametric control of ADPTNet's timescales (its Lyapunov spectrum). ADPTNet improves performance on Selective Copying over Hawk, the existing method balancing long-range memory and adaptability, while also improving state tracking over linear SSMs like Mamba. On sequential CIFAR-10, ADPTNet matches linear SSM accuracy and outperforms existing selective models (incl. the Transformer), using fewer parameters. We also introduce a neuromorphic SpikingADPTNet, which achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy on the Spiking Speech Commands dataset ($83.56\%\pm0.15$). Finally, ADPTNet's constant timescales enable two efficient, Jacobian-free extensions to the DEER parallel simulation algorithm (Conv and Forward DEER) that retain the same average convergence. Conv DEER adds no computational overhead beyond the network's forward pass and enables non-linear RNN parallelisation via iterated convolutions for the first time.

</details>


### [700] [CMDO: A Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization Algorithm for Adaptive Population-Based Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35657)
*Mohammed Yusuf Mujawar,Shahram Rahimi,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出认知记忆驱动优化（CMDO），将搜索经验建模为“上下文—行为—结果”三元关系，并按工作、情景、巩固三层记忆组织与相似性检索，正负经验共同指导搜索，在BBOB/COCO、CEC2017及光伏参数估计上取得有竞争力表现，并证明上下文依赖的回忆会改变搜索行为分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有群体优化方法多通过成功解、参数自适应或算子绩效利用历史信息，但很少保留“搜索行为成功或失败时所处上下文”，导致经验难以被有效复用与区分。

Method: CMDO为无导数群体优化器，将经验表示为搜索上下文、搜索行为与观测结果的关系；经验分工作记忆、情景记忆、巩固记忆三类存储，按与当前搜索状态相似性检索，并利用正负证据引导后续搜索；检索经验不重放历史候选位置，而是从当前种群重构探索性、方向性与局部搜索行为，并采用自适应搜索几何。

Result: 在BBOB/COCO及CEC2017部分问题上，与DE、CMA-ES、SHADE、GWO、HHO、ORCA对比，CMDO表现依赖问题但具竞争力，在CEC2017 F10上取得最低中位误差；在七参数光伏模型I-V数据估计中亦得到应用验证；搜索轨迹分析显示上下文依赖回忆改变执行搜索行为的分布，失败经验作为负证据保留并影响后续决策。

Conclusion: 结果表明，显式的“上下文—行为—结果”记忆可作为主动机制控制群体搜索行为，积累经验直接影响后续搜索，支持将上下文记忆纳入群体优化框架。

Abstract: Population-based optimization methods often use previous search information through successful solutions, parameter adaptation, or operator performance, but they rarely retain the context in which a search behavior succeeded or failed. We introduce Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization (CMDO), a derivative-free population-based optimizer that represents experience as the relationship between search context, search behavior, and observed outcome. CMDO organizes these experiences across working, episodic, and consolidated memory, retrieves them according to similarity with the current search state, and uses both positive and negative evidence to guide subsequent search. Retrieved experience does not replay previous candidate locations; instead, it selects search recipes that are reconstructed from the current population through exploratory, directed, and local search behaviors with adaptive search geometry. We evaluate CMDO on selected Blackbox Optimization Benchmarking test suite on COCO (BBOB/COCO) and Congress on Evolutionary Computation 2017 (CEC2017) problems against DE, CMA-ES, SHADE, GWO, HHO, and ORCA, and further study its application to seven-parameter photovoltaic model estimation using measured current--voltage data. The results show problem-dependent but competitive optimization performance, including the lowest median error among the compared methods on CEC2017 F10. More importantly, analysis of the search traces shows that context-dependent recall changes the distribution of executed search behaviors, while unsuccessful experiences remain available as negative evidence for later decisions, showing that accumulated experience directly influences subsequent search behavior. These results support the use of explicit context--behavior--outcome memory as an active mechanism for controlling population-based search.

</details>

### [701] [Learning Through Game: Skewed Transfer of Tabular Knowledge to Strengthen Image Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32272)
*Longfei Huang,Shangdong Yang,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出偏斜知识迁移（SKT）方法，通过在共享参数空间中对模态梯度进行自适应整合，将表格知识非对称地迁移至图像模型，缓解模态不平衡与跨模态非对称关系问题，从而在推理阶段仅用图像即可提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态表格-图像学习面临测试阶段表格数据不可用的挑战。一种实用方案是在训练时将表格知识迁移到图像，以增强推理时的图像模型性能。然而，图像与表格之间的模态不平衡，以及跨模态迁移中两者非对称的模态关系，限制了表格数据的辅助作用，这些被忽视但重要的挑战亟待解决。

Method: 提出偏斜知识迁移（SKT），在共享参数空间中对模态梯度进行自适应整合，实现非对称的表格知识迁移。首先引入多模态共享头，在不增加额外参数的情况下使模型受益于跨模态结构；然后设计两步纳什议价（Nash Bargaining）策略有效利用表格梯度：第一步寻找模态平衡点，第二步利用偏好感知将组合梯度引导至有利于图像的方向。此外，理论分析了SKT的帕累托改进与收敛性。

Result: 在广泛使用的表格-图像数据集上的实证实验表明，SKT利用表格数据作为辅助信息，能够一致地提升图像单模态性能。

Conclusion: SKT通过非对称迁移表格知识增强图像模型，有效解决了模态不平衡与非对称模态关系问题，且理论上有帕累托改进与收敛性保证，实验验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal tabular-image learning is gaining growing attention, yet it faces challenges due to tabular data unavailable at test time. A practical solution involves transferring tabular knowledge to images during training to enhance the performance of image models at inference. However, the overlooked yet important challenges lie in the modality imbalance between images and tables, as well as their asymmetric modality relationship in cross-modal transfer, which limits the auxiliary role of tabular data. To address these issues, we propose Skewed Knowledge Transfer (SKT), which asymmetrically transfers tabular knowledge to improve the image model by adaptive integration of modality gradients in a shared parameter space. Specifically, we first introduce a multimodal shared head, which allows the model to benefit from cross-modal structure without adding additional parameters. We then design a two-step Nash Bargaining strategy to effectively leverage tabular gradients. In the first step, SKT seeks a point of modality balance and uses preference awareness in the second step to steer combined gradients toward image-beneficial directions. Furthermore, we theoretically analyze the Pareto improvement and convergence of SKT. To this end, tabular knowledge is explicitly transferred to enhance image models. Empirical experiments on widely used tabular-image datasets reveal that SKT consistently improves image unimodal performance by using tabular data as auxiliary information.

</details>


### [702] [Getting Motif-ated: Controllable AI Compositions from Injected Motif Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32788)
*Chao Peter Yang,Cynthia Rudin,Yue Jiang,Simon Mak,Stephen Ni-Hahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出MotiGen，一种将预训练符号音乐生成模型改造为可接受"动机(motif)"指令提示的微调方案。通过将动机作为结构化提示行注入、施加标量注意力偏置并采用两阶段课程学习，模型在超过92.3%的生成作品中成功使用了提示动机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于大语言模型范式的符号音乐生成系统（如NotaGen）虽能根据简短提示生成完整的古典乐谱，但几乎不提供对音乐本体的可控接口。从零训练带控制能力的基础模型虽在理论上可行，却受限于大规模高质量标注数据和算力的缺乏，因此需要在已有预训练模型上进行低成本改造。

Method: MotiGen将音乐动机编码为结构化提示行注入模型，并对动机token施加标量注意力偏置以强化其影响；训练采用两阶段课程：第一阶段从训练数据中裁剪围绕动机出现的聚焦片段进行学习，第二阶段使用包含动机的完整乐谱进行训练，从而逐步建立动机与生成内容的关联。

Result: 实验表明，模型在超过92.3%的生成作品中成功围绕所提示的动机进行作曲，验证了该改造方案对动机控制的有效性。多种动机生成的样例已发布于 https://motigen-site.github.io/。

Conclusion: MotiGen证明无需从零训练即可为预训练符号音乐模型赋予指令式动机控制能力，为音乐创作提供了一种实用且数据高效的模型改造范式。

Abstract: Deep learning has transformed symbolic music generation by borrowing the training paradigms of large language models, with systems such as NotaGen now producing complete, stylistically convincing classical scores from a short prompt. These systems could become powerful creative partners, helping musicians generate endless possibilities. However, current systems expose almost no control handles on the music itself. In principle, control handles could be built into a foundation model trained from scratch, but this is rarely practical without massive amounts of quality annotated data and compute resources. We therefore present MotiGen, a recipe for retrofitting pretrained symbolic music models to use new instruction prompts. MotiGen injects a musical motif as a structured prompt line, reinforces it with a scalar attention bias toward the motif tokens, and learns the association with a two-phase curriculum. First, it learns from focused excerpts cropped around motif occurrences in the training data, then full scores including the motifs. Our experiments show that our model composes with the prompted motif in over 92.3\% of generated pieces. Generated pieces using a variety of motifs are included in our sample site: https://motigen-site.github.io/.

</details>


### [703] [Replay in the Silent Degrees of Freedom: Continual Learning Without an Offline Phase](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31630)
*Zhang Yanhai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种完全无需离线阶段的生物约束持续学习机制，利用隔离规则（将重放更新限制在k-WTA下对当前输入不可见的隐藏突触）与不应期轮换规则（刚发放单元跳过下一次竞争），配合稳态压力与相对新颖性门控触发重放爆发和轮换，将过去记忆写入当前批次未使用的自由度中，从而在不干扰当前输入处理的前提下实现在线巩固。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于重放的持续学习通常依赖专门的离线阶段或把重放样本与输入流交错进行，而大脑在清醒状态下可通过局部睡眠（依赖使用的短暂离线期）完成巩固。作者希望探究：受局部生物约束规则训练的网络，能否在完全没有离线阶段的情况下实现巩固。

Method: 方法包含三个核心机制：1）隔离规则，将重放更新仅限制在k-winner-take-all动力学下对当前输入不可见的隐藏突触，优化器状态仅在掩码内更新；2）不应期轮换规则，使刚发放的单元跳过下一次竞争，扩大可巩固集合；3）稳态压力与相对新颖性门控，决定重放爆发何时触发以及轮换何时运行。该机制反转了非干扰持续学习的常规方向：保持当前输入的隐藏计算不变（在已证明通道上精确不变，其他地方每次更新中仅对0.3%的清醒样本例外），同时将过去记忆写入当前批次未使用的自由度。

Result: 在class-incremental split-MNIST上，系统无需离线阶段达到91.6±0.3%，在两个留出划分上达到或超过最佳离线夜间调度；与DER++持平，优于经验重放、ER-ACE、A-GEM及无掩码局部重放。单次遍历中领先DER++（91.8%对90.1%），而夜间调度降至76.9%。优势在小缓冲区时最大，在大缓冲区时让位于反向传播参考方法。在split CIFAR-10上，系统领先离线排练与经验重放，但落后于ER-ACE和DER++。

Conclusion: 轮换规则贡献了大部分增益，隔离规则提供了不变性保证。该机制并不局限于局部规则：在相同调度下，具有k-WTA隐藏层的反向传播网络也能从轮换中受益，且隔离规则在其之上同样可免费叠加。

Abstract: Replay-based continual learning almost always consolidates in a dedicated offline phase or by interleaving replayed samples with the input stream, whereas brains also consolidate during wakefulness through local sleep, brief use-dependent off-periods of individual circuits. We ask whether a network trained by local, biologically constrained rules can consolidate with no offline phase at all. An isolation rule confines replay updates to hidden synapses invisible to the current input under k-winner-take-all dynamics, with optimiser state advanced only inside the mask; a refractory rotation rule makes units that have just fired sit out the next competition, widening the consolidable set; a homeostatic pressure and a relative-novelty gate decide when replay bursts fire and when rotation runs. This inverts the usual direction of non-interfering continual learning: the hidden computation on the current input is held invariant (exactly on the proven channels, and for all but 0.3% of waking samples per update elsewhere) while past memories are written into the degrees of freedom the current batch leaves unused. On class-incremental split-MNIST the system reaches 91.6+-0.3% with no offline phase, at or above the best offline-night schedule on two held-out splits, tied with DER++ and above experience replay, ER-ACE, A-GEM and unmasked local replay; in a single pass it leads DER++ (91.8% against 90.1%) while the night falls to 76.9%. The advantage is largest at small buffers and gives way to the backpropagation references at large ones; on split CIFAR-10 the system leads offline rehearsal and experience replay but trails ER-ACE and DER++. Rotation carries most of the gain; isolation adds the invariance guarantee. The mechanism is not tied to the local rule: under the same schedule a backpropagation network with k-WTA hidden layers gains from rotation, and isolation is again free on top of it.

</details>


### [704] [Analog-Friendly Predictive Coding without Activation Derivatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32350)
*Francesco Innocenti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"激活匹配的Bregman预测编码"（activation-matched Bregman PC），用与激活函数匹配的Bregman散度替代标准平方误差能量，从而消除对激活函数导数的依赖，配合镜像下降推断，得到仅需加权求和、局部预测误差、状态积分和激活函数的局域推断与学习规则，在分类和生成任务上性能媲美标准PC与BP，同时保留PC的学习动力学特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码（PC）是反向传播（BP）的局部、基于能量的替代方案，其迭代推断动力学适合在模拟硬件上实现。然而标准非线性PC在推断和学习过程中都需计算激活函数的导数，这在物理实现上难以实现。因此需要一个更适配模拟硬件的非线性PC形式。

Method: 提出激活匹配的Bregman PC：将标准平方误差能量替换为与激活函数相匹配的Bregman散度，从而消除激活导数项；再结合基于镜像下降（mirror descent）的推断过程，推导出局域的推断与学习规则，这些规则仅依赖加权求和、局部预测误差、状态积分以及激活函数本身。

Result: 在数字实验中，Bregman PC在分类和生成任务上表现与标准PC和BP相当，同时保留了PC的典型学习动力学，并在稳定的大模型参数化条件下收敛于BP。

Conclusion: Bregman PC为非线性预测编码提供了一种更适配模拟硬件的表述形式，同时保留其关键计算特性，是面向类脑/模拟硬件实现的有力方案。

Abstract: Predictive coding (PC) is a local, energy-based alternative to backpropagation (BP) whose iterative inference dynamics make it attractive for implementation on analog hardware. However, standard nonlinear PC requires evaluating the derivative of the activation function during both inference and learning, which can be difficult to realise physically. Here, we introduce \textit{activation-matched Bregman PC}, replacing standard squared-error energies with Bregman divergences matched to the activation function. This formulation eliminates activation derivatives and, when combined with inference via mirror descent, yields local inference and learning rules requiring only weighted sums, local prediction errors, state integration, and the activation function. In digital experiments, Bregman PC performs comparably to standard PC and BP on classification and generative tasks, while preserving characteristic learning dynamics of PC and its convergence to BP under stable large-model parameterisations. These results provide a more analog-friendly formulation of nonlinear PC while retaining its key computational properties.

</details>


### [705] [MTLiquid: Enabling Efficient Multi-Task Learning using Liquid Neural Networks for Lightweight Healthcare Monitoring Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33232)
*Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra,Fahad Abdul Rauf,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MTLiquid，在连续时间网络中以多任务学习实现高效医疗监测，性能接近单任务SOTA而内存降低44%-94%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗监测中生理信号常以不规则时间间隔采样，需连续时间处理；且系统通常需同时完成多任务以全面评估病情。然而现有连续时间神经网络（CTNNs）每个网络仅解决单一任务，限制了效率收益。

Method: MTLiquid包含两方面设计：(1) 采用多个输入与输出头适配不同任务，同时跨任务共享同一骨干网络；(2) 有效训练策略，利用损失加权技术平衡各任务学习更新，并采用比例数据呈现技术应对数据集规模不平衡问题。

Result: 在ICU患者死亡率预测（P12）与脓毒症早期检测（P19）任务上，MTLiquid达到AUROC 0.84（P12）与0.94（P19），与连续时间网络单任务学习（0.84/0.95）及离散时间网络（0.79-0.82/0.92-0.94）性能相当，同时内存开销显著降低44%-94%。

Conclusion: MTLiquid方法能支撑轻量级连续时间医疗监测系统，为更优决策提供可能。

Abstract: Continuous-time sensing and monitoring with timely and accurate decision-making are critical for many real-world applications. In healthcare monitoring systems, physiological signals are often available or sampled at irregular time intervals, hence requiring continuous-time processing to provide accurate prediction. Moreover, such systems often need to solve multiple detection/prediction tasks to provide a comprehensive patient review from different physiological aspects for more accurate decision-making. To solve this, continuous-time neural networks (CTNNs) can be employed. However, state-of-the-art works typically solve only one task at each network, thereby limiting their efficiency gains. To address this limitation, we propose MTLiquid, a novel methodology to enable efficient multi-task learning in continuous-time processing for healthcare monitoring systems through effective network design and training strategy. MTLiquid employs: (1) multiple input and output heads to accommodate different tasks, while sharing the same backbone network across tasks; as well as (2) an effective training strategy that leverages a loss-weighting technique to balance learning updates across different tasks and a proportional data presentation technique to address imbalanced dataset sizes. Experimental results for mortality prediction (P12) and sepsis early detection (P19) tasks for ICU patients show that, MTLiquid achieves strong performance (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.94 for P19) comparable to the state-of-the-art single-task learning in both continuous-time networks (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.95 for P19) and discrete-time networks (AUROC: 0.79-0.82 for P12 and 0.92-0.94 for P19), while incurring significantly smaller memory cost by 44%-94%. These results highlight the potential of our MTLiquid methodology to enable lightweight continuous-time healthcare monitoring systems for better decision-making.

</details>


### [706] [Hidden Activations are not Enough I: Knowledge Matrices as Higher Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34166)
*Marco Armenta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"知识矩阵"作为训练后前馈网络输入的高阶表示，刻画其不变性、决定因素与几何意义，并给出归因与对抗检测应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望找到一种比隐藏激活更本质的网络内部表征：隐藏激活是规范协变且对"芽"（germ）信息不完整的，无法唯一刻画网络在输入处所诱导的表示。因此需要一个对编码变换不变、能恢复局部芽结构的表示。

Method: 将网络视为(箭图表示W, 激活f)的配对，函数经由箭图表示空间分解；每个输入x诱导一个表示，其收缩为知识矩阵M(x)∈R^{C×(d+1)}，行和恰为logits。在局部常斜对角(LCS, 如ReLU)条件下研究其决定因素、不变性与几何。理论上证明M(x)是"已实现芽"的函数，其在正则编码中的稳定子恰为芽稳定子；并证明M(x)=逐类梯度×输入+精确聚合偏置归因，可用C个向量-雅可比积计算。

Result: M(x)可恢复芽，且行和恒等式给出精确的可见/不可见位移分解，其无单位一致性A=(d_Ψ/d_M)^2 显示对抗性芽运动的中位A≤0.23，攻击族排序在六个架构上一致(Kendall W=0.921，全尺度三网络上0.97)。基于固定形状可对ResNet-152/DenseNet-121/GoogLeNet做无需对齐的逐样本距离。两个诚实的负面结果：在AlexNet/CIFAR-10上倒数第二层特征在6个检测器中赢5个、在全部16种攻击上获胜；矩阵方向反事实方法0/54失败。

Conclusion: 知识矩阵为网络内部表示提供了比隐藏激活更完整的刻画，统一了归因理论与对抗几何分析，并给出与架构无关的度量；但其相对优势依赖于具体设置，在部分检测任务上并不优于朴素特征基线。

Abstract: We study the knowledge matrix of a trained feedforward network as a higher representation of its inputs. A network is a pair $(W,f)$, a thin representation $W$ of its quiver and an activation $f$; its function factorizes through the space of quiver representations, each input $x$ inducing a representation, and the knowledge matrix $M(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times(d+1)}$ is the contraction of that representation to one matrix whose rows sum exactly to the logits. At one trained network we ask what determines it, what it is invariant to, what it determines, and what its geometry measures. Under (LCS), a locally constant slope diagonal, as for ReLU, the matrix at a regular input is a function of the realized germ; its stabilizer among encodings regular there is exactly the germ stabilizer at inputs with no vanishing coordinate, neuron permutation a special case; and it recovers the germ, whereas hidden activations, gauge-covariant and germ-incomplete, are not enough. Under (LCS) it equals per-class gradient$\times$input plus an exact aggregate bias attribution, grounding it in attribution theory and computing it by $C$ vector-Jacobian products instead of probing. The fixed shape gives an alignment-free per-sample distance between ResNet-152, DenseNet-121 and GoogLeNet; the row-sum identity gives an exact visible/invisible displacement decomposition whose unit-free coherence $A=(d_Ψ/d_M)^2$ puts adversarial germ motion at median $A\le 0.23$, with an attack-family ordering concordant across six architectures (Kendall $W=0.921$; $0.97$ on the three networks at full scale). Two honest negatives: on AlexNet/CIFAR-10 penultimate features win 5 of 6 detectors and all 16 attacks, and a matrix-direction counterfactual fails 0/54.

</details>


### [707] [EvE: An Alternate Optimizer to Adam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35614)
*Shashank Raj,Kalyanmoy Deb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EvE是一种四人种群的稳态差分进化优化器，仅在DE步失败时回退到短程Adam梯度下降；在等预算下与Adam打赢或打平76%的测试单元，并在真实网络任务与超参搜索中实现1.7-3.9x与3.1-3.5x的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam及其变体主导神经网络训练，但单次运行只有在预算大部分耗尽后才能判断配置好坏，不适合需要低成本排序配置、尽早剪枝的超参数或架构搜索场景。因此需要一种在预算受限、以搜索为核心的层级中，能够快速、梯度感知地代理训练的优化器。

Method: 提出EvE（Evolutionary Explorer）：稳态、种群规模为4的差分进化（DE）优化器，带定向Adam回退。每次迭代通过DE生成一个候选，仅当DE步未能改进当前最优时才运行短程梯度下降。选择采用贪心策略，在确定性目标上best-so-far可证明单调不增；梯度仅作为定向救援使用，因此每迭代成本保持在单次Adam步的常数倍以内，且与维度无关。

Result: 在评估成本匹配的固定预算下，EvE在7个可扩展基准、70个（问题，维度）单元（最高一百万变量）中于76%的单元上胜过或打平Adam。在三个真实神经网络任务（MNIST上的MLP、1.5B参数语言模型在两个数据集上的LoRA微调）上，EvE以相同计费预算快1.7-3.9x完成，最终质量略有损失：MNIST约一个准确率点，两个微调任务相对测试损失高9-11%；GSM8K上Adam准确率高约5个点，且两种方法微调后准确率均低于基座模型。在UCI Adult的逐次减半（successive halving）中，EvE的超参与架构搜索快3.1-3.5x，配置排序与Adam的一致性约等于Adam自身跨随机种子的一致性（Kendall's tau 0.66-0.69）。

Conclusion: EvE并非Adam作为最终阶段训练器的完全替代，而是面向搜索密集、预算受限的上一层级场景的快速、梯度感知代理优化器。

Abstract: Adam and its variants dominate neural network training, but a single run only reveals whether a configuration works well after most of its budget is spent, a poor fit for hyperparameter or architecture search, where configurations must be ranked cheaply and pruned early. We introduce EvE (Evolutionary Explorer), a steady-state, population-of-four differential evolution (DE) optimizer with a targeted Adam fallback: each iteration proposes one candidate via DE, running a short burst of gradient descent only if the DE step fails to improve on the incumbent. Selection is greedy, so on a deterministic objective the best-so-far value is provably monotone non-increasing, and since gradients are used only as a targeted rescue, per-iteration cost stays within a constant factor of a single Adam step regardless of dimension. Under a fixed, evaluation-cost-matched budget, EvE wins or ties Adam on 76% of 70 (problem, dimension) cells across seven scalable benchmarks up to one million variables. On three real neural-network tasks (an MLP on MNIST, and LoRA fine-tuning of a 1.5B-parameter language model on two datasets) EvE finishes the same charged budget 1.7-3.9x faster, at a modest cost in final quality (about one accuracy point on MNIST, 9-11% higher relative test loss on the two fine-tuning tasks; on GSM8K, Adam is about 5 accuracy points more accurate, and fine-tuning lowers accuracy below the base model for both). Inside successive halving on UCI Adult, EvE completes hyperparameter and architecture searches 3.1-3.5x faster, ranking configurations about as consistently with Adam as Adam does with itself across seeds (Kendall's tau 0.66-0.69). EvE is not a total replacement for Adam as a final-stage trainer, but a fast, gradient-aware proxy for the search-heavy, budget-constrained regime one level up.

</details>


### [708] [Arbitrary-Accuracy Neural Approximation with Optimal Neuron Count and Near-Optimal Bit Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35628)
*Zilan Cheng,Li-Lian Wang,Zhongjian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究多元Hölder连续函数任意精度逼近所需的最少隐神经元数及编码复杂度，给出精确下界d+1及显式构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在[0,1]^d上逼近多元Hölder连续函数时，标准前馈网络达到任意精度所需的最少隐神经元数量，以及相应的编码(比特)复杂度下界问题。

Method: 对d≥2构造一个固定的、显式定义的激活函数，使用两隐层(宽度d和1)的闭式网络实现任意精度一致逼近；并给出结合floor与exp的单一初等激活的简化构造(三隐层，宽度d、1、2)；允许跳连时宽度d、1、1即可。构造采用显式网格寻址与量化函数值的整数编码。

Result: 证明在具局部可积激活与仿射输出的标准前馈网络中，d+1是隐神经元总数的精确最小值；简化构造仅比最小值多两个神经元；对α-Hölder类需O(ε^{-d/α}log(1/ε))比特，与度量熵下界在相差对数因子意义下匹配。

Conclusion: 确定了多元Hölder函数逼近所需最少隐神经元数的精确值d+1，并给出接近最优的显式网络构造，其编码比特复杂度与度量熵下界仅差一个对数因子。

Abstract: We study the minimum number of hidden neurons required for arbitrary-accuracy approximation of multivariate Hölder-continuous functions on $[0,1]^d$ and the associated encoding complexity. For $d\geq 2$, we construct a fixed, explicitly defined activation function for which a closed-form network with two hidden layers of widths $d$ and $1$ achieves arbitrary accuracy in the uniform norm. We prove that $d+1$ is the exact minimum total number of hidden neurons among standard feedforward networks with locally integrable activations and affine outputs. We further give a simpler construction using a single elementary activation that combines the floor and exponential functions. This construction requires three hidden layers of widths $d$, $1$, and $2$, only two neurons above the minimum. If a skip connection is allowed, widths $d$, $1$, and $1$ suffice. These constructions use explicit grid addressing and integer encoding of quantized function values. For a bounded $α$-Hölder class, they require $O(\varepsilon^{-d/α}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bits, matching the metric-entropy lower bound up to a logarithmic factor.

</details>


### [709] [From Phase Transition to Systemic Failure: A Decoupled Analytics Framework for GNN Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31656)
*Shuai Yan,Dan Peng,Jie Li,Ke Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个可分别操控标签噪声与特征分布偏移的合成同质图回归基准，通过41种配置、410次运行评估代表性GNN模型，发现模型对中等标签噪声具有较强容忍度（约50%噪声比后性能才急剧下降），而在极端分布偏移下性能严重退化（MSE升高48–316倍，相关性下降73%–89%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据质量是GNN在实际图挖掘任务中可靠部署的主要瓶颈。标签噪声与特征分布偏移是两类常见但本质不同的退化来源，然而在受控条件下分别研究二者影响的工作仍然不足，缺乏可分离操控两种因素的实验基准。

Method: 构建合成同质图回归基准，使标签噪声与特征分布偏移可被独立操控；设计41种配置并执行410次运行，在变化的噪声与偏移条件下评估代表性GNN模型的行为表现。

Result: 呈现两种不同模式：（1）在加性标签损坏下，性能在较宽的噪声范围内保持相对稳定，仅在约50%噪声比的过渡区域之后才急剧恶化；（2）在极端特征分布偏移下，所有被测模型均严重退化，测试MSE增加48倍至316倍，相关性下降73%至89%。

Conclusion: 在当前受控设定下，GNN对中等程度的标签扰动比严重分布不匹配具有更强的容忍度。该研究为理解数据质量如何影响基于GNN的图挖掘系统提供了受控的经验基线，并为面向部署的监控与模型维护提供了实践启示。

Abstract: Data quality is a major bottleneck for the reliable deployment of graph neural networks (GNNs) in real-world graph mining tasks. Among various sources of degradation, label noise and feature distribution shift (hereafter referred to as distribution shift) are two common yet fundamentally different challenges. To study their effects under controlled conditions, this paper constructs a synthetic homophilic graph regression benchmark in which the two factors can be manipulated separately. A total of 41 configurations and 410 runs are conducted to evaluate the behavior of representative GNN models under varying noise and shift conditions. The results show two distinct patterns. First, under additive label corruption, performance remains relatively stable over a broad range of noise settings and begins to deteriorate sharply only after an observed transition region around the 50 percent noise ratio. Second, under extreme feature distribution shift, all tested models suffer substantial degradation, with test MSE increasing by 48 times to 316 times and correlation dropping by 73 percent to 89 percent. These findings suggest that, in the present controlled setting, GNNs are considerably more tolerant to moderate label perturbation than to severe distribution mismatch. The study provides a controlled empirical baseline for understanding how data quality affects GNN-based graph mining systems and offers practical implications for deployment-oriented monitoring and model maintenance.

</details>


### [710] [FARE: Deep Reinforcement Learning For Fair Exposure Constrained Uncertainty Aware Financial Content Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31890)
*Arundeep Chinta,Lucas Vinh Tran,Jay Katukuri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将SOV（Share of Voice）约束排名的重排序问题建模为深度强化学习问题，类似算法金融中的约束交易执行，并将CTR预测不确定性显式纳入状态空间与策略设计，提出模块化执行层FARE，可在不重训CTR模型的前提下输出公平排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融服务内容个性化需保证多样供给的公平曝光，既受合同义务约束，也需避免"富者愈富"：高CTR内容长期垄断首位曝光，其他相关产品曝光极少。SOV约束为每类内容保证目标首位曝光份额，但实践中常见做法是在CTR模型上叠加重排序层，尚未充分利用CTR预测不确定性带来的排序调整空间。

Method: 两项创新：一是把SOV约束排名形式化为深度强化学习问题，类比算法金融中的约束交易执行；二是将CTR预测不确定性显式引入智能体状态空间与策略设计，使高不确定性预测允许更大的排名调整，因为此时偏离CTR最优排序的代价更低。提出FARE（Fair Ranking Executor），模块化、不确定性感知的执行层，可将任意黑盒CTR模型预测转化为SOV公平排名，无需重训底层模型。包括不确定性加权比例控制策略FARE-PC，以及学习型神经策略FARE-ES与FARE-PPO。

Result: 实验表明不确定性感知方法能显著降低相对公平目标的SOV偏差，同时最小化参与度损失。在合成数据上，无梯度进化策略（ES）优于策略梯度方法；在KuaiRand-Pure数据集上排序结果发生反转。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的SOV约束重排序是一种有效且模型无关的方案，可在不牺牲过多CTR收益的情况下提升曝光公平性；不同优化方法（ES与PPO）的相对优势依赖数据分布，需按场景选择策略。

Abstract: Content personalization systems in financial services must ensure fair exposure across diverse offerings-a requirement driven by contractual obligations and the need to prevent "rich-get-richer" dynamics where content with high click-through rate (CTR) dominates while other relevant products receive minimal visibility. Share of Voice (SOV) constraints, which guarantee each content category a target fraction of top-position exposure, address this by promoting product diversity and balanced user discovery. While re-ranking layers atop CTR models are common in practice, we propose two key novelties: (1) framing SOV-constrained ranking as a deep reinforcement learning problem analogous to constrained trade execution in algorithmic finance, and (2) explicitly incorporating CTR prediction uncertainty into the agent's state space and policy design-enabling larger ranking adjustments for high-uncertainty predictions where deviation from CTR-optimal ordering is less costly. We introduce FARE (Fair Ranking Executor), a modular uncertainty-aware execution layer that translates any black-box CTR model's predictions into SOV-fair rankings without retraining the underlying model. Our uncertainty-weighted proportional control policy (FARE-PC) and learned neural policies (FARE-ES, FARE-PPO) demonstrate that uncertainty-aware approaches can substantially reduce SOV deviation from fairness targets while minimizing engagement loss, with gradient-free evolution strategies outperforming policy gradient methods on synthetic data and the ordering reversing on KuaiRand-Pure.

</details>


### [711] [Rethinking Cross-Channel Importance in Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32187)
*Yong-Hoon Choi,Kwang-Hyun Park,Youngjin Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文论证跨通道重要性存在"相关≠有用≠被使用"的三层区分，并指出其随预测步长偏移变化，需结合具体预测机制与问题定义来解读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨通道建模是多变量时间序列预测的核心，但文献常把"统计相关""预测有用""模型实际使用"三种重要性混为一谈。作者希望检验三者是否真的重合，以及这种混同会带来何种后果。

Method: 作者构造随预测步长(horizon)变化的自适应源选择机制，在受控Ridge预测器上测试，并与匹配的非线性预测器、iTransformer做对照；同时对iTransformer、TimesNet与跨通道TimeMixer进行功能干预(functional intervention)，对比各模型的源依赖排序；最后尝试用有界的事后支持(post-hoc support)提升冻结的通道独立预测器。

Result: 步长自适应源选择在32个"数据集—预测长度"条件中的21个上改善受控Ridge预测器，平均增益5.16%，且该信号可迁移到匹配的非线性预测器；但同一逻辑用于iTransformer仅20个中胜11个，平均增益0.208%，与受控增益几乎不对齐。功能干预显示强预测器的确使用跨通道信息，但其源依赖排序与受控效用及彼此之间都很少一致。作为建设性结果，有界事后支持在16个"数据集—步长"条件中的12个上改善冻结的通道独立预测器，聚合bootstrap区间为正。

Conclusion: 跨通道依赖结构随未来步长显著变化，跨通道重要性必须相对于具体预测机制与所设问题来解读：相关、有用、被使用三者并不等价。

Abstract: Cross-channel modeling is central to multivariate time-series forecasting, yet channels that are statistically related, predictively useful, and actually used by a trained forecaster are often treated as if they defined the same notion of importance. We show that they need not coincide. Cross-channel dependency structures change substantially across future offsets, and horizon-adaptive source selection improves a controlled Ridge predictor in 21 of 32 dataset--prediction-length conditions, with a mean gain of $5.16\%$. This selected-set signal also transfers to a matched nonlinear predictor. Yet imposing the same horizon-specific source logic on iTransformer yields only 11 of 20 wins and a mean gain of $0.208\%$, with little alignment between controlled and neural gains. Functional interventions further show that strong forecasters use cross-channel information, while their source-reliance rankings agree little with controlled utility or with one another across iTransformer, TimesNet, and a cross-channel TimeMixer. As a constructive consequence, bounded post-hoc support improves a frozen channel-independent forecaster in 12 of 16 dataset--horizon conditions, with a positive aggregate bootstrap interval. Cross-channel importance should therefore be interpreted relative to the forecasting mechanism and question that define it: related $\neq$ useful $\neq$ used.

</details>


### [712] [DP-Rec: Towards Dynamic Patching for Efficient Long-Sequence Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32215)
*Dwipam Katariya,Thomas Caputo,Akshat Shreemali,Juan Manuel Origgi,Nikita Seleznev,Pranab Mohanty,Kalanand Mishra,Nam Nguyen,James Montgomery*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DP-Rec，一种用于序列推荐的动态潜在分段架构，将物品级建模转为片段级建模，在受限算力下实现对长序列的高效建模并取得更优的效率-精度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 推荐模型以固定速率运行，对用户历史中每个物品分配相近计算量，忽略其信息含量差异，导致长序列计算开销过大且对行为噪声更敏感。常用的有损压缩、分阶段建模或截断会削弱模型在推理时利用完整长历史上下文的能力。

Method: 受 Byte Latent Transformer 启发，DP-Rec 基于对比熵惊讶度（contrastive entropy surprise）对交互序列分段，识别具有信息量的行为边界，实现从物品级到片段级的建模转变。轻量片段编码器将带有时间上下文的片段压缩为少量动态潜在行为向量，再由更大的潜在 Transformer 处理，并解码用于下一物品预测。

Result: 大量实验表明，在受限计算预算下，DP-Rec 能有效扩展至长序列，并在效率-精度权衡上优于非压缩基线和固定大小压缩基线。

Conclusion: 动态潜在分段为序列推荐提供了一种兼顾长历史上下文利用与计算效率的建模范式，可在有限算力下替代有损压缩、截断等权宜方案。

Abstract: Transformers have redefined sequential recommendation by effectively modeling dynamic user behaviors and long-range dependencies. However, they remain inherently inefficient: standard architectures operate at a fixed rate, allocating comparable computation to every item in a user's history regardless of its information content. This leads to prohibitive computational overhead on long sequences and increased sensitivity to behavioral noise. To address this, practitioners often resort to lossy sequence compression, staged modeling, or truncation. This limits the model's ability to leverage the full context of long histories during inference. Inspired by the recent success of Byte Latent Transformer, we propose DP-Rec, a dynamic latent patching architecture for recommendation. DP-Rec shifts from item-level modeling to patch-level modeling by segmenting interaction sequences using contrastive entropy surprise to identify informative behavioral boundaries. A lightweight patch encoder compresses these temporally contextualized segments into a reduced set of dynamic latent behavior vectors, which are then processed by a larger latent transformer and decoded for next-item prediction. Extensive experiments show that, under constrained computational budgets, DP-Rec scales effectively to long sequences and achieves a superior efficiency-accuracy trade-off over both non-compressed and fixed-size compression baselines.

</details>


### [713] [Graph Memory: Spectral Associative Memory via Dirichlet Energy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32365)
*Zhaoyang Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种谱稠密联想记忆（spectral dense associative memory），用于图结构数据的存储与检索，并给出指数级存储容量与检索误差衰减的理论保证，实验验证了图检索与几何保持能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统稠密联想记忆主要针对向量值模式，而许多现代机器学习问题天然具有图结构，需要面向关系模式、图扩散几何、社区结构和图归纳偏置的记忆机制。因此需要将经典向量记忆推广到图数据。

Method: 通过Dirichlet能量与谱范数距离诱导的log-sum-exp能量进行检索，输出存储Laplacian的softmax加权平均，且该结果仍是有效的图Laplacian。理论上证明指数级存储容量与指数衰减的检索误差，并为图学习中的谱量（特征值、特征空间、扩散算子）建立理论保证。实验使用合成图数据、真实航空网络、蛋白质构象数据和可穿戴传感器数据。

Result: 在合成图数据、真实航空网络、蛋白质构象数据与可穿戴传感器数据上实现稳健的图检索，同时保持数据的图几何结构；理论上获得指数级存储容量、指数衰减检索误差，以及特征值、特征空间与扩散算子的保证。

Conclusion: 该框架为图结构数据提供了新的联想记忆范式，将稠密联想记忆与现代图学习和生成式AI相连接。

Abstract: Dense associative memories have traditionally focused on storing and retrieving vector-valued patterns. Many modern machine learning problems, however, are naturally graph-structured, requiring memory mechanisms for relational patterns, graph diffusion geometries, community structures, and graph-based inductive biases. We propose a spectral dense associative memory for storage and retrieval of graph data, extending the classical vector-valued memories. Retrieval is performed through a log-sum-exp energy induced by Dirichlet energy with spectral norm distances, producing a softmax-weighted average of the stored Laplacians that remains a valid graph Laplacian. We prove exponential storage capacity and exponentially decaying retrieval error. Beyond graph retrieval, we establish theoretical guarantees for spectral quantities central to graph learning, including eigenvalues, eigenspaces, and diffusion operators. Experiments on synthetic graph data, real-world airline network, protein conformation data and wearable sensor data demonstrate robust graph retrieval while preserving the graph geometry of the data. Our framework provides a new associative memory paradigm for graph-structured data and bridges dense associative memory with modern graph learning and generative AI.

</details>


### [714] [Algorithmic Harms Associated with Generative Model-Augmented Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33073)
*Christine Herlihy,Xumei Xi,Shloka Desai,Kevin Bannerman Hutchful,Pedro Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对生成模型引入机器学习平台所引发的算法危害，扩展了危害分类体系与威胁模型，新增内生危害（如sanitization/净化）并给出因果分析，以支持危害检测与缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算法危害分类体系与威胁模型不足以覆盖生成模型带来的新问题：一是需要应对已被充分研究的表征类与服务质量类危害背后新出现的因果驱动因素；二是需要预判并缓解内生危害（例如当系统输入与设计者目标或生成模型归纳先验不一致时产生的sanitization）。

Method: 面向非对话式推荐系统中使用生成模型的场景，构建扩展的算法危害分类体系；并对（输入，输出）联合分布中有问题的子集如何产生进行因果分析。

Result: 提出了一个扩展的算法危害分类体系，界定了生成模型在非对话式推荐中的危害类型；给出了问题性子集形成的因果机制分析，为危害检测与缓解提供依据。

Conclusion: 将生成模型纳入机器学习平台需要更新危害分类与威胁模型：既需补充新型因果驱动因素，也需纳入sanitization等内生危害，并通过因果分析指导检测与缓解工作。

Abstract: In this work, we consider algorithmic harms that may arise as generative models are incorporated into machine learning platforms. We argue that existing harm taxonomies and threat models require extension to (1) address novel causal drivers of well-studied representational and quality-of-service harms; and (2) anticipate and mitigate endogenous harms, such as sanitization, which may arise when system inputs are misaligned with the system designer's objectives, or the generative model's inductive priors. To this end, we introduce an expanded taxonomy of algorithmic harms associated with the use of generative models in non-conversational recommendation systems. In addition, we offer a causal analysis of how problematic subsets of the (input, output) joint distribution can arise, in an effort to inform harms detection and mitigation efforts.

</details>


### [715] [Beyond Fixed Features: Architecture-Dependent Sensitivity to Node Representations under Heterophily](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33764)
*Priyanath Maji,Sidharth Gaur,Rajavinoth Paul Durai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过为两个大规模异质图基准（Roman-Empire、Amazon-Ratings）构建并行节点特征变体（从静态fastText到上下文Transformer嵌入），评估七种GNN架构，发现表征对性能的影响依赖架构，且架构的排名在表征变化下仍高度稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异质图GNN评测通常在固定节点特征表征下比较架构，无法判断关于异质性鲁棒性的结论是否随输入表征变化而保持稳定，因此需要探究架构与表征是否为独立评测因素。

Method: 为Roman-Empire和Amazon-Ratings两个大规模异质图基准构建并行特征变体，节点表征涵盖静态fastText向量到上下文Transformer嵌入；在多种表征下评估七种GNN架构，并进行排名相关性分析。

Result: 表征效应因架构而异：Roman-Empire上上下文增益从GCN-sep的2.38个百分点到GAT的13.67个百分点，H2GCN提升8.77个百分点；Amazon-Ratings上GAT从fastText到MPNet提升6.78个百分点，而GCN-sep仅变化0.20个百分点。排名相关性分析显示架构相对排序在表征间高度稳定。

Conclusion: 架构性能条件依赖于节点表征，同一表征变化在不同架构上产生不同幅度的增益，架构与表征不能视为独立评测因素；主要效应是差异化敏感度而非排名不稳定，因为架构相对排序在各表征下保持高度稳定。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) perform well on homophilic graphs but struggle in heterophilic settings, where connected nodes often carry dissimilar labels. Existing evaluations typically compare architectures under a fixed node-feature representation, leaving unclear whether conclusions about heterophily robustness remain stable as the input representation changes. We address this question by constructing parallel feature variants of two large-scale heterophilic benchmarks, Roman-Empire and Amazon-Ratings, pairing each graph with representations ranging from static fastText vectors to contextual Transformer embeddings and evaluating seven GNN architectures across these representations. We find that the effect of representation varies across architectures: on Roman-Empire, the contextual gain ranges from 2.38 percentage points for GCN-sep to 13.67 points for GAT, with H2GCN gaining 8.77 points. On Amazon-Ratings, where node text is limited to short product titles, GAT improves by 6.78 points from fastText to MPNet, while GCN-sep changes by only 0.20 points. These results show that architectural performance is conditional on node representation: the same representation change can produce different magnitudes of performance gain across architectures, so architecture and representation cannot be treated as independent evaluation factors. A rank-correlation analysis on these two benchmarks further shows that the relative ordering of architectures remains highly stable across representations, isolating differential sensitivity, rather than ranking instability, as the primary effect.

</details>


### [716] [VEX-Bench: Benchmarking Verification Complexity of LLM-Generated Misinformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35028)
*Hanxun Huang,Yutao Wu,Qizhou Wang,Silvia Montaña-Niño,Yige Li,Xiang Zheng,Elif Buse Doyuran,Phoebe Matich,Xiao Liu,Xingjun Ma,Sarah Erfani,Christopher Leckie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出VEX-Bench基准与VEX分数,评估LLM生成虚假信息在筛查阶段的验证复杂度,揭示复核资源错配风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM使虚假信息生产廉价而验证昂贵,信息生态出现不对称;媒体、平台与事实核查机构受时间、人力与预算约束,只能依赖筛查来优先决定核查哪些内容,因此亟需量化生成内容在筛查中所感知的验证复杂度。

Method: 构建统一基准VEX-Bench,基于新闻与事实核查实践提炼多维度验证复杂度:可核查性、危害潜力、来源可信度信号、冒充合法性、预期核查成本;定义VEX分数,融合诱导产出与验证复杂度,衡量内容对有限核查能力的消耗。基准覆盖2类虚假信息、6个高风险领域、60个真实议题,评测7个前沿LLM与7种生成方法,共5,880篇文章;采用LLM-as-judge进行可扩展评估,并以内容分析法验证,包括定序Krippendorff α评估标注者间信度,辅以事实核查智能体进行验证。

Result: 没有任何单一生成方法在所有维度上占优,说明多维度评估的必要性;LLM生成高VEX虚假信息的成本比基于智能体的验证低3倍至169倍;此类内容在筛查中常被优先选中,消耗稀缺核查资源,带来资源受限验证系统中的系统性错配风险。

Conclusion: VEX-Bench与VEX分数为跨模型、跨生成方法的虚假信息验证复杂度提供了统一评估框架,揭示了筛查偏好与验证成本不对称导致的核查资源错配;代码已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made misinformation inexpensive to produce but not to verify, creating a growing asymmetry in the information ecosystem. Under tight time, labor, and budget constraints, media organizations, platforms, and fact-checkers rely on screening to prioritize which content to verify. We introduce VEX-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating the verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation, as perceived during screening, across models and generation methods. Verification complexity is assessed along multiple dimensions derived from journalistic and fact-checking practices, capturing checkability, harm potential, source credibility signals, imposter legitimacy, and expected verification effort. We define the VEX score as an integrated measure combining elicitation yield and verification complexity to quantify how generated content consumes limited verification capacity. We construct a benchmark spanning two misinformation categories, 6 high-stakes domains, and 60 real-world topics, and evaluate 7 frontier LLMs and 7 generation methods, yielding 5{,}880 articles. We employ an LLM-as-judge for scalable evaluation and validate it using content-analysis methodology, including ordinal Krippendorff $α$ for inter-annotator reliability, complemented by fact-checking agents for verification. Our findings show that no single method dominates all dimensions, underscoring the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. LLMs can generate high-VEX misinformation at 3$\times$ to 169$\times$ lower cost than agent-based verification. Such content is often prioritized during screening, consuming scarce verification resources and introducing a systematic risk of misallocation in resource-constrained verification systems. The code is publicly available in our \href{https://github.com/HanxunH/VEX-Bench}{GitHub repository}.

</details>


### [717] [Grounding Vision-Language Models in Driving Semantics: A Multi-Dataset Predicate Framework for Explainable Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31636)
*Mohamed Chouai,Fazli Faruk Okumus,Stefan Kugele*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种确定性的多数据集谓词框架，从几何、运动学、时间、地图与交通控制等可测量证据中推导驾驶场景语义，并在 nuPlan 与 nuScenes 上保持谓词定义不变地构建统一谓词知识图谱，实现可验证、可追溯的场景语义表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在驾驶场景理解中应用日益广泛，但其输出所表达的语义关系往往难以与真实交通场景进行核验，缺乏可测、可追溯的语义依据。

Method: 构建确定性的多数据集谓词框架：由几何、运动学、时间、地图与交通控制等可测量证据推导驾驶场景语义；数据集专属接口仅用于还原所需场景信息，谓词定义在 nuPlan 与 nuScenes 上保持一致，并统一物化为公共谓词知识图谱（Predicate KG）。随后用冻结的 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 在九个 NuPlanQA 子任务上评估谓词接地效果。

Result: 对每数据集 200 个场景的人工标注谓词关系进行语义验证，宏 F1 分别为 nuPlan 0.94、nuScenes 0.93，共享谓词的平均跨数据集差异为 0.02。在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 的九个 NuPlanQA 子任务中，谓词接地在 7 个子任务上取得最高准确率，包括交通灯（53.2%→71.5%）、态势评估（76.2%→86.1%）与动作推荐（82.9%→89.0%）；天气/光照基本不变（89.4% vs. 88.8%），与缺乏相应谓词一致；仅输入 Predicate KG 在 9 个子任务中的 8 个优于仅输入元数据。

Conclusion: 确定性谓词能够提供一致且可追溯的语义表示；在 oracle grounding 条件下，可降低谓词词表所覆盖推理任务对视觉输入的依赖。

Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet the semantic relations expressed in their outputs are often difficult to verify against the underlying traffic situation. This paper introduces a deterministic multi-dataset predicate framework that derives driving-scene semantics from measurable geometric, kinematic, temporal, map, and traffic-control evidence. Dataset-specific interfaces are used only to recover the required scene information, while predicate definitions remain unchanged across nuPlan and nuScenes and are materialised in a common Predicate Knowledge Graph. Quantitative semantic validation against manually annotated predicate relations on 200 scenarios from each dataset yields macro F1 scores of 0.94 on nuPlan and 0.93 on nuScenes, with an average cross-dataset difference of 0.02 across the shared predicates. The Predicate KG is further evaluated using a frozen LLaVA-OneVision-7B model on the nine NuPlanQA subtasks. Predicate grounding achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated visual-input conditions in seven of nine NuPlanQA subtasks, including Traffic Light (53.2% to 71.5%), Situation Assessment (76.2% to 86.1%), and Action Recommendation (82.9% to 89.0%). Weather/Lighting remains essentially unchanged (89.4% vs. 88.8%), consistent with the absence of corresponding predicates, while Predicate KG only input outperforms metadata-only input in eight of nine subtasks. The results show that deterministic predicates provide a consistent and traceable semantic representation and, under oracle grounding, can reduce visual dependence for reasoning tasks covered by the predicate vocabulary.

</details>


### [718] [FIDAL: Diversity-Aware Federated Active Learning Under Real-World Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31637)
*David Dueñas Gaviria,Shadi Albarqouni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FIDAL——一种开放集联邦主动学习框架，通过校准的全局-局部证据不确定性、支持集多样性加权和自适应OOD拒绝，在联邦临床场景中高效查询高信息量ID样本并排除无关离群点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习可在不集中数据的情况下跨机构协同训练，但标注成本高、域偏移和类别不平衡仍是主要障碍，尤其当无关的分布外（OOD）样本稀释了标注数据时。现有主动学习方法只关注分布内（ID）数据的不确定性或多样性，忽视了联邦临床场景中的未知样本。

Method: FIDAL结合了三项机制：校准的全局-局部证据不确定性、支持集多样性加权、以及自适应OOD拒绝。其拒绝门控基于基础模型的高斯覆盖信号，按客户端和轮次用Otsu准则自动确定阈值，无需人工调参，从而在查询高信息量ID样本的同时排除无关离群点。

Result: 在三个多中心医学影像基准（皮肤科、组织病理学、含天然伪影的乳腺钼靶）的真实开放集场景下评估，FIDAL相比基于检测器的开放集方法在平衡准确率上最高提升约12个百分点，并且是唯一在三个基准的准确率-ID纯度帕累托前沿上的方法。在相同查询预算下，其对OOD样本的标注消耗比所有准确率匹配的基线至少少1.3倍，在乳腺钼靶基准上估计节省7-29小时专家阅片时间。仅标注数据池的一小部分即可匹配或超越全监督性能。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了在面向医学的开放集联邦主动学习中整合不确定性、多样性和OOD拒绝的价值。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across institutions without centralizing data, yet high annotation costs, domain shifts, and class imbalance remain major obstacles, especially when irrelevant out-of-distribution (OOD) samples dilute the labeled data. Existing active learning methods target uncertainty or diversity within in-distribution (ID) data and overlook unknown samples in federated clinical settings. We propose FIDAL, an open-set federated active learning framework that combines calibrated global-local evidential uncertainty, support-set diversity weighting, and adaptive OOD rejection. The rejection gate thresholds a foundation-model Gaussian-coverage signal per client and per round with Otsu's criterion, so that highly informative ID samples are queried while irrelevant outliers are excluded without any hand-tuned threshold. Evaluated on three multi-center medical imaging benchmarks (dermatology, histopathology, and mammography with organically occurring artifacts) in realistic open-set scenarios, FIDAL outperforms detector-based open-set methods by up to about 12 percentage points of balanced accuracy and is the only method on the accuracy-ID purity Pareto front of all three benchmarks. At an equal query budget it spends at least 1.3 times fewer annotations on OOD samples than every accuracy-matched baseline, saving an estimated 7-29 hours of expert reading on the mammography benchmark. By labeling only a fraction of the data pool, it matches or exceeds fully supervised performance across modalities. These results highlight the value of integrating uncertainty, diversity, and OOD rejection in open-set federated active learning for medicine.

</details>


### [719] [Resource-Aware Federated Mixture-of-Experts with Adaptive Pruning for Onboard Learning in LEO Satellite Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31932)
*Mohamed Shaaban,Mohamed Elmahallawy,Marius Bernahrndt,Tobias Hecking*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: COSMIC-FL是一个面向低轨卫星星座的资源感知联邦学习框架，通过混合专家架构与结构化剪枝，在非独立同分布数据下显著降低通信、计算与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习假设的计算、内存与通信资源超出资源受限的低轨卫星平台能力，且往往需将原始影像传回地面站，因此不适用于卫星在轨学习场景。

Method: 提出两种互补的混合专家（MoE）架构：共享骨干表示并激活任务特定通道子集的Sliced设计，以及用轻量门控将输入路由到物理分离专家网络的Modular设计；通过语义类别到专家的映射使卫星仅训练、更新和通信与其本地数据相关的专家路径；集成分阶段优化与三种结构化剪枝策略（服务器端剪枝、带均值投票聚合的客户端固定比例剪枝、基于聚合重要性和MAD间隙准则的自适应客户端逐层剪枝）。

Result: 在六个高度非独立同分布设置下的图像分类基准上，COSMIC-FL保持有竞争力的精度，同时相较SOTA联邦学习方法将通信、计算与能耗降低最多80%；并在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上验证了嵌入式部署约束下的效率增益。

Conclusion: 语义专家路由与结构化剪枝相结合，可联合适配数据语义与层重要性，从而在异构空间平台上实现有利的精度—效率权衡。

Abstract: Low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites are increasingly expected to perform onboard learning for applications such as disaster response and environmental monitoring. However, conventional federated learning (FL) is ill-suited to onboard satellite learning, as it assumes computational, memory, and communication resources beyond the capabilities of resource-constrained LEO platforms, often necessitating the transmission of raw imagery to ground stations. We present COSMIC-FL, a resource-aware FL framework for efficient onboard learning in LEO satellite constellations. COSMIC-FL introduces two complementary Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures: a Sliced design that shares backbone representations while activating task-specific channel subsets, and a Modular design that employs lightweight gating to route inputs to physically separated expert networks. A semantic class-to-expert mapping enables each satellite to train, update, and communicate only the expert paths relevant to its local data. To further improve efficiency, COSMIC-FL integrates staged optimization with three structured pruning strategies: server-side pruning, client-side fixed-ratio pruning with mean-vote aggregation, and adaptive client-side per-layer pruning based on aggregated importance and a MAD-based gap criterion. Combined with semantic expert routing, these techniques jointly adapt computation and model sparsity to both data semantics and layer importance, yielding a favourable accuracy--efficiency trade-off for heterogeneous space platforms. Experiments on six image classification benchmarks under highly non-i.i.d. settings show that COSMIC-FL maintains competitive accuracy while reducing communication, computation, and energy consumption by up to 80% over SOTA FL methods. We further validate COSMIC-FL on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, confirming its efficiency gains under realistic embedded deployment constraints.

</details>


### [720] [Timestep Weighting: A Hidden Key to Effective ELBO-Based Flow-Matching RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32665)
*Qinwei Ma,Jingzhe Shi,Simin Fan,Ling Li,Mengdi Wang,Alex Lamb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于ELBO的强化学习中时间步加权问题，揭示有效加权取决于奖励景观和学习阶段，并提出静态加权、预算式剖面选择与动态调度以提升流匹配RL性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于ELBO的RL为流匹配模型提供与采样器无关的奖励微调方法，其中时间步加权对性能影响巨大，且能统一理解先前工作中启发式选择的预测损失。然而该问题研究不足，实践中常直接沿用预训练配置。

Method: (1) 在受控CIFAR图像生成及机器人任务上开展实验，考察加权如何影响不同噪声水平下的奖励驱动更新；(2) 通过梯度分析揭示跨噪声协调模式及其在训练中的演化；(3) 依据分析提出静态加权、预算式剖面选择与动态调度策略。

Result: 实验与梯度分析表明，有效加权依赖奖励景观和学习阶段，且跨噪声协调模式随任务和训练进程演变，支持"有用加权取决于策略当前行为与奖励偏好行为之间差距"的假设；所提加权方案性能优于传统目标选择。

Conclusion: 时间步加权是流匹配强化学习中的重要设计选择，本文结果为进一步研究在学习过程中选择与自适应调整加权的方法提供了动机。

Abstract: ELBO-based reinforcement learning offers a sampler-agnostic approach to fine-tuning flow matching models with reward feedback. Timestep weighting in ELBO-based RL has large impact on performance, and it also provides a unified view (as we show in this work) to understand prediction losses heuristically chosen in prior work, yet it remains under-researched and is often chosen to inherit pretrain configs. We investigate impacts and dynamics of timestep weighting in ELBO-based RL. We show that effective weighting depends on both the reward landscape and stage of learning. (1) Through experiments on controlled CIFAR image generation, complemented by robotics, we investigate how weighting impacts reward-driven updates across noise levels. (2) Through gradient analysis, we reveal distinct patterns of cross-noise coordination across tasks and their evolution during training. These findings motivate the hypothesis that useful weighting depends on the gap between the policy's current behavior and the behavior favored by the reward. (3) Guided by this analysis, we study simple static weighting, budgeted profile selection, and dynamic schedules that improve performance beyond conventional target choices. Our results establish timestep weighting as an important design choice for flow-matching RL and motivate further research into methods that choose and adapt it throughout learning.

</details>


### [721] [The GUI Is Not the State: Diagnosing State Aliasing in GUI World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32679)
*Dongsheng Liu,Chao Jin,Wenkui Yang,Hejin Wang,Junwei Yang,Zeren Zhang,Ziwei Chen,Huaibo Huang,Jie Cao,Ran He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文识别出GUI世界模型中的"状态别名"问题，即仅凭当前界面观测与动作无法区分不同的未来状态，并提出轻量级预测状态恢复方法与StateAliasBench基准加以诊断和缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI世界模型（GUI-WMs）大多只以当前GUI观测和动作为条件进行未来状态预测，但可见界面常缺失与状态转移相关的隐藏环境状态，导致相同观测条件对应多个不同的合理未来，即状态别名问题，从而使预测出现系统性失败。

Method: 论文提出StateAliasBench诊断基准，通过严格配对方式显式隔离此类歧义；并设计轻量级预测状态恢复方法，从历史中推断结构化状态，通过确定性状态接口增强原本冻结的GUI-WMs；采用按状态类型划分的族特异性专家进行状态恢复，并通过多教师蒸馏整合为统一估计器。

Result: 实验表明，现有GUI世界模型在仅观测条件下存在系统性失败；引入预测状态增强后，所评估的世界模型在状态敏感预测上显著恢复，生成保真度得以保持，并在AndroidWorld上提升了GUI智能体的下游表现。

Conclusion: 可靠的GUI世界建模不应只关注可见内容，还应建模决定后续演化的隐藏转移状态。

Abstract: GUI World Models (GUI-WMs) are increasingly used to predict future states for agent planning and simulation, yet most existing formulations condition only on the current GUI observation and action. We identify state aliasing, where the vis- ible interface omits transition-relevant environment state, so identical observable conditions can correspond to different valid futures. To diagnose this failure mode, we introduce StateAliasBench, a diagnostic benchmark that explicitly isolates such ambiguities via strict pairing. We further propose lightweight predictive- state recovery that infers structured state from history and augments otherwise frozen GUI-WMs through a deterministic state interface. Family-specific special- ists provide state recovery across heterogeneous state types, and multi-teacher dis- tillation consolidates them into a single unified estimator. Experiments show that existing GUI-WMs exhibit systematic failures under observation-only condition- ing, while predictive-state augmentation substantially restores state-sensitive pre- diction across evaluated WMs, preserves generative fidelity, and improves down- stream performance of GUI agents on AndroidWorld. These results suggest that reliable GUI world modeling should account not only for what is visible, but also for the hidden transition state that determines what happens next.

</details>


### [722] [Learning When to Recur: Token-Adaptive Recursion for Imbalanced Ophthalmic Domain Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32785)
*Nanxi Yu,Kang Li,Ye Du,Xiaowei Hu,Weihua Yang,Shujun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无回放的参数高效框架ToRe，基于冻结的眼科基础模型，通过参数隔离与token自适应递归解决域增量学习中的标签分布偏移和风格变化导致的灾难性遗忘，在9个数据集、3个基准上实现近零遗忘并超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 眼科深度模型需适应顺序到达的临床域并保留诊断能力。现有域增量学习方法主要处理风格变化引起的域偏移，却忽视了真实临床（如转诊系统）中严重的类别不平衡：各机构类别先验剧烈波动，导致标签分布偏移这一关键域偏移形式，并引发严重灾难性遗忘。

Method: ToRe为无回放、参数高效的框架，依托冻结的眼科基础模型。采用参数隔离策略解耦域特定的优化路径，以缓解由标签分布偏移和风格变化共同驱动的灾难性遗忘；同时引入token自适应递归，跨token自适应分配额外计算深度，让简单token提前退出递归循环，而将复杂token（如病灶相关）进行更深递归处理，从而增强少数类特征表示并促进泛化。

Result: 在九个异构数据集上进行广泛评估，ToRe在三个基准上的整体性能持续优于现有最先进方法，同时保持近零遗忘。

Conclusion: 结果表明ToRe适用于动态且不平衡的临床环境，代码已开源于https://github.com/Nancyolo/ToRe。

Abstract: Domain incremental learning is essential for adapting ophthalmic deep learning models to sequential clinical domains while preserving diagnostic expertise. Existing domain incremental learning methods predominantly address the domain shift induced by style variations. However, they often overlook the severe class imbalance inherent in real-world clinical scenarios, such as clinical referral systems. Institutions in these systems encounter drastic fluctuations in class priors, resulting in label distribution shift, a critical form of domain shift that triggers severe catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose ToRe, a rehearsal-free and parameter-efficient framework that leverages frozen ophthalmic foundation models for robust incremental adaptation. ToRe employs a parameter isolation strategy to decouple domain-specific optimization paths, thereby helping mitigate catastrophic forgetting driven by both label distribution shift and style variations. Simultaneously, it introduces token-adaptive recursion that adaptively allocates additional computational depth across tokens, allowing simple tokens to exit the recursion loop early while subjecting complex tokens, such as those associated with lesions, to deeper recursive processing. This mechanism enhances the feature representations for minority classes, thereby supporting generalization throughout the domain incremental learning process. Extensive evaluations on nine heterogeneous datasets demonstrate that ToRe consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall performance across the three benchmarks, while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Together, these results support the applicability of ToRe to dynamic and imbalanced clinical environments. The code is available at https://github.com/Nancyolo/ToRe

</details>


### [723] [Mind the Spike: Mechanisms and Brittleness of Visual Massive Activations in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32808)
*Jonas Ngnawé,Yann Pequignot,Sabyasachi Sahoo,Christian Gagné,Frédéric Precioso,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大型视觉语言模型继承文本基座的巨激活现象；本文系统研究视觉巨激活的形成规律、脆弱性及可干预性，覆盖25个适配器式LVLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本巨激活（massive activations）已有研究，但视觉巨激活是否跨模型遵循一致模式、以及其对图像扰动的响应尚不清楚，需要系统性刻画。

Method: 从模型权重中辨识触发方向，并提出可解释的位置规则：在语言模型解码器运行前，最终巨激活的token主要局限于与图像其余部分共享信息最少的token；据此设计触发引导的巨激活攻击与预防性干预。

Result: 部分LVLM不形成视觉巨激活，其余模型以不同比例在较深层出现；常见图像损坏常制造和迁移巨激活、较少消除它们，从而提升整体发生率；触发引导攻击在1/255的ℓ∞预算下即可在十个出现巨激活的模型中影响九个；预防性干预仅移除触发分量即可消除或显著减少干净与扰动图像上的巨激活，而几乎不改变其他图像token。

Conclusion: 视觉巨激活具有模型依赖性、深层倾向和显著脆弱性，且可通过触发方向进行精准操控与预防性抑制；研究覆盖18个文本基座、10个家族、2B至72B参数共25个适配器式LVLM。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) inherit massive activations from their text-only bases: spikes where a few fixed hidden channels receive values thousands of times above the typical magnitude. The text spike systematically appears in early layers at a fixed initial position, independently of input content. Visual spikes vary across images, but whether their formation follows a consistent pattern across LVLMs and how they respond to image perturbations remain open questions. We find that some LVLMs do not form visual spikes, while others spike at different rates, typically in deeper layers. We identify the trigger direction from model weights and an interpretable location rule: before the language model decoder runs, eventual spike tokens are largely restricted to those sharing least with the rest of the image. Crucially, visual spikes are strikingly brittle. Common corruptions frequently create and relocate spikes, and less often remove them, raising overall incidence. Our trigger-guided spike attack deliberately creates or removes spikes under a small $\ell_\infty$ budget, with 1/255 enough in nine of the ten models that spike. Finally, our preventive intervention removes only the trigger component before spikes erupt, eliminating or substantially reducing spikes on clean and perturbed images while leaving the other image tokens nearly unchanged. Our study spans 25 adapter-based LVLMs built on 18 released text-only bases from 10 families, ranging from 2B to 72B parameters.

</details>


### [724] [Perturb-and-Solve: Efficient Learned-Operator Conditioning for Latent Diffusion Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33171)
*Abduragim Shtanchaev,Arip Asadulaev,Luiza Labazanova,Aidar Alimbayev,Karim Salta,Eric Moulines*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PASEO用小型(1M)学习网络在潜空间对扩散模型预测进行退化，避免反传扩散网络与协方差矩阵求逆，从而在支持任意退化算子的同时实现高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜扩散模型是图像复原逆问题的强先验，但现有求解器在通用性与效率上存在权衡：限定固定退化算子的方法快但泛化差；支持任意退化算子的方法慢且需对扩散网络反向传播梯度。本文旨在打破这一通用性与效率的瓶颈。

Method: 提出PASEO：使用仅1M参数的学习网络在潜空间中对扩散模型预测施加退化。通过加噪并基于该学习网络的局部线性近似求解线性方程组，从近似后验中采样重建，无需对扩散网络反向传播，也无需构建或求逆大协方差矩阵。

Result: 在FFHQ与COCO的超分辨率、去模糊、修复任务上，PASEO取得强感知质量，相比被测基线最高快9倍、峰值内存最多降低34%，且模型评估次数相同或更少。

Conclusion: PASEO在支持学习型任意退化算子的同时兼顾效率，通过潜空间退化网络与线性近似采样，突破了扩散先验求解器中通用性与效率的权衡。

Abstract: Latent diffusion models serve as powerful priors for solving inverse problems in image restoration, such as deblurring, inpainting, and super-resolution. Current methods have a trade-off between generality and efficiency. Solvers that are restricted to a fixed set of degradation operators are fast and efficient. Methods that support arbitrary degradation operators are slow and require gradients through the diffusion network. To break this bottleneck, we introduce PASEO (Perturb-And-Solve for Efficient Operator conditioning), a method that uses a small (1M parameters) learned network to degrade diffusion model predictions in latent space. PASEO supports learned degradation operators without back-propagating through the diffusion network. We efficiently sample reconstructions from an approximate posterior by combining the diffusion model's prediction with the observed image. We do this by adding noise and solving linear equations based on a local linear approximation of the learned network, without building or inverting large covariance matrices. Across super-resolution, deblurring, and inpainting on FFHQ and COCO, PASEO achieves strong perceptual quality while running up to 9x faster and using up to 34% less peak memory than the tested baselines, with the same or fewer model evaluations.

</details>


### [725] [When an Evaluation Rule Writes Training Labels: Measuring Human-Reference Forgiveness in NAVSIM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33189)
*Jiaxuan Guo,Jingxin Yang,Jiaqi Ye,Youran Sun,Shuo Xin,Kejia Zhang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新运行NAVSIM的GTRS-Dense标签生成器并禁用"人类参考分数为零时全列标为通过"的覆盖规则，在全部103,288个navtrain场景上对比发现该规则抹去了训练损失所依赖的候选区分信息，且对已发布的lane-keeping与Hydra-MDP检查点造成可测量的监督退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAVSIM作者引入"人类参考宽恕"机制以避免在单条轨迹评分时惩罚情境合理的机动，但该机制在标签生成中会把整列16,384个候选目标全部标为通过，可能掩盖重要失败。作者本身也警告此风险，因此需要量化其对监督信号的后果。

Method: 禁用覆盖规则重新运行GTRS-Dense生成器，将覆盖前目标与已发布标签在全部103,288个navtrain场景上逐列比较；统计被抹去的候选区分；在hold-out navtest场景上评估已发布的lane-keeping头与Hydra-MDP检查点的中位AUC；用三组配对种子对GTRS-Dense检查点继续训练300步；以禁用宽恕的评分方式评估lane-keeping与EPDMS。

Result: 该规则在11,237个场景（10.8793%）上抹去了训练损失所读取的候选区分；lane keeping占13,042个被宽恕损失列中的9,982个，其中位被宽恕列在覆盖前有14,391/16,384个候选失败。在navtest上被lane keeping宽恕的场景中，已发布lane-keeping头对覆盖前结果的中位AUC为0.7095，而在按失败候选数匹配的未宽恕场景为0.9807；Hydra-MDP对应为0.6627与0.9761。继续训练300步后，宽恕场景AUC在使用覆盖前目标时比发布目标高0.1086-0.1251，匹配组间差距缩小但仍大于零。禁用宽恕评分为lane keeping带来2.478-3.524点的提升，但相邻帧规划一致性更低；EPDMS无法区分两种目标集。

Conclusion: 人类参考宽恕覆盖在标签生成中系统性地抹去了大量候选区分信息，导致已发布检查点在受影响场景上的监督质量显著下降；使用覆盖前目标可部分恢复该区分。该效应集中于lane keeping，且EPDMS对此不敏感，说明评测指标本身可能掩盖标签生成缺陷。

Abstract: When the human reference scores zero on a metric, the released GTRS-Dense label generator for NAVSIM marks every candidate trajectory in the scene as passing it. NAVSIM's authors introduced this human-reference forgiveness to avoid penalizing contextually justified maneuvers when scoring one trajectory, and warned that it could overlook important failures. In label generation it sets a whole column of 16,384 candidate targets to passing. To measure the consequences for supervision, we re-run the generator with the overwrite disabled and compare the pre-overwrite targets with the released labels on all 103,288 navtrain scenes. The rule erases a candidate distinction that the training loss reads on 11,237 of them (10.8793%). Firing usually changes most of a column: lane keeping carries 9,982 of the 13,042 forgiven loss columns, and its median forgiven column had 14,391 of 16,384 candidates failing before the overwrite. On held-out navtest scenes forgiven on lane keeping, the released lane-keeping head's median AUC against the pre-overwrite outcome is 0.7095; on unforgiven scenes matched on failing-candidate count it is 0.9807. For the Hydra-MDP checkpoint released with GTRS, whose configuration takes the same label file, the two values are 0.6627 and 0.9761. Continuing the released GTRS-Dense checkpoint for 300 optimizer steps with three paired seeds, we observe the forgiven-scene AUC 0.1086-0.1251 higher with pre-overwrite than with published targets, and a narrower gap between matched groups, still above zero. Scoring with forgiveness disabled, we observe lane keeping higher by 2.478-3.524 points on navtest scenes forgiven on any of five loss metrics, with lower adjacent-frame plan consistency. Both changes are larger there than on the rest. EPDMS, scored the same way, does not separate the two target sets.

</details>


### [726] [TNF based Spectral Embedding for Effective Application of Supervised Machine Learning Techniques in Automobile Insurance Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33376)
*Rohan Yashraj Gupta,Lalith Srikanth Chintalapati,Satya Sai Mudigonda,Pallav Kumar Baruah,Raghunatha Sarma Rachakonda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对汽车保险欺诈检测，系统比较了决策树、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、GBM五种分类器，MWMOTE与TGAN两种不平衡处理技术，以及TNF谱嵌入、MDS、Isomap、t-SNE等降维方法，共65种组合。结果表明"MWMOTE + TNFSE2 + 随机森林"效果最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保险欺诈带来重大财务损失，欺诈检测模型需要在准确率之外兼顾灵敏度、特异度、精确率、F1、假阳性率、假发现率、AUC等多项指标。单一模型难以同时满足，且数据存在类别不平衡与高维问题，因此需要系统性地探索合适的建模流程。

Method: 采用汽车保险数据集，构建三阶段流水线。阶段一使用MWMOTE和TGAN处理类别不平衡；阶段二使用TNF（拓扑节点特征）谱嵌入及MDS、Isomap、t-SNE等流行嵌入方法进行低维表示；阶段三使用DT、RF、XGBoost、LightGBM、GBM进行分类。共评估65种模型组合。

Result: 在所给数据集上，MWMOTE（阶段一）+ TNFSE2（阶段二）+ 随机森林（阶段三）的组合优于其余所有组合，在准确率及其他指标上表现最佳；TNF谱嵌入在汽车保险数据集上展现出良好有效性。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将不平衡处理、拓扑谱嵌入降维与集成分类器相结合，可有效提升汽车保险欺诈检测性能，且TNF谱嵌入是适用于该类数据的有效低维表示方法。

Abstract: Fraud detection is an important area of research in the insurance business due to its financial implications. The primary aim of a fraud detection model is to identify fraud and non-fraud cases with high accuracy along with other important metrics such as Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1-score, False Positive Rate, False Discovery Rate, AUC etc. To achieve this, we need to explore a suitable classification model to identify fraud and non-fraud cases. In this work, we have used auto insurance data set and explored classification models such as Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost, LightGBM and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM). To overcome the problem of data imbalance, we have employed MWMOTE and TGAN techniques. We have used Topological Node Feature(TNF) based spectral embedding for low dimensional data representation along with some popular embedding methods like MDS, Isomaps and t-SNE. After studying all the 65 possible combinations of these models, we have proposed an innovative method for effective automobile insurance fraud detection. For the given dataset, our results show that using a combination of MWMOTE as a data imbalance handling technique (Phase I), TNFSE2 as data embedding (Phase II) and Random Forest as classification (Phase III) provides the best result in comparison to all other combinations. This work also highlights the efficacy of TNF based spectral embedding in automobile insurance dataset

</details>


### [727] [A Light Bilevel Refinement Aligns Self-Supervised Representations for Stronger Task-Specific Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33424)
*Gustav Wagner Zakarias,Zheng-Hua Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BiSSLight在BiSSL的双层优化框架基础上，结合M-FAC隐式梯度近似与LoRA参数高效微调，使过渡训练阶段高效可扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督预训练表示虽具备广泛迁移性，但直接微调时自监督目标与下游目标不一致，可能破坏对下游有益的特征。BiSSL通过双层优化引入过渡训练阶段来缓解此问题，但其依赖传统双层优化求解技术，隐超梯度近似代价高昂，难以适用于当代模型架构。

Method: 提出BiSSLight：以M-FAC进行隐式梯度近似，替代昂贵的传统隐超梯度近似；并结合LoRA参数高效微调，实现高效、可扩展的过渡训练。

Result: 在多个下游任务和当代模型架构上，BiSSLight持续提升下游性能；随模型规模增大，增益更加明显，即便基线更强亦然。在ViT-H骨干上，计算时间较前作减少十倍以上。

Conclusion: BiSSLight在保持甚至增强下游性能的同时大幅提升计算效率与可扩展性，使双层过渡训练在大规模现代架构上变得实用。

Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining learns representations that are broadly transferable across downstream tasks, yet direct fine-tuning can be suboptimal due to misalignment between self-supervised and downstream task objectives, potentially degrading pretrained features beneficial to the downstream task. The BiSSL framework addressed this by introducing a transitional training stage formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, in which the downstream task objective guides the self-supervised learning process in refining pretrained representations to better facilitate subsequent fine-tuning. However, BiSSL relies on conventional bilevel optimization solving techniques whose costly implicit hypergradient approximations render the method increasingly impractical for contemporary model architectures. To make it efficient and scalable, we introduce BiSSLight, which combines M-FAC-based implicit gradient approximation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA, enabling efficient application at larger scales that were previously impractical. Evaluation across multiple downstream tasks and contemporary model architectures shows that BiSSLight consistently improves downstream performance, with gains becoming more pronounced as model size increases despite stronger baselines. The method is highly computationally efficient, reducing computation time by more than a factor of ten compared to its predecessor on a ViT-H backbone.

</details>


### [728] [Elucidating the Design Space of Regression-based Diffusion Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33444)
*Toyota Li,David Zhao,Alan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文统一了扩散/流模型强化学习中放弃策略梯度、改以加权监督回归为代表的一类方法（DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM），证明它们同属一个散度约束奖励最大化问题的解，仅由定义约束的凸生成函数区分。作者进一步揭示已有方法在构建优势嵌入回归目标时所做的近似（KKT条件与后验归一化项），并提出保留线性倾斜下精确稀疏最大（sparsemax）投影的新模型，最终得到收敛更快、训练更稳定、性能最优的 DiffusionRFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型强化学习中，近年涌现出一类新方法：不再使用策略梯度，而是对监督回归进行重加权。DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM 是其中动机各异但颇具代表性的方案，然其内在联系尚不清楚，也缺乏统一的理论刻画；同时，这类回归式扩散 RL 的训练配方与设计空间仍缺乏系统研究。

Method: 作者建立一个统一建模框架，将上述方法刻画为同一个散度约束奖励最大化问题的解，方法间的差异仅在于定义约束的凸生成函数（convex generator）。在此框架下，他们重新审视先前方法在构造优势嵌入回归目标时所作的松弛：DiffusionNFT 与 FlowAWR 分别针对线性倾斜与指数倾斜形状，近似了 KKT 条件与后验归一化项。作者提出，在线性倾斜下保留对概率单纯形的精确稀疏最大（sparsemax）投影，可得到一类性能更优的新模型；并在此理论基础上对回归式扩散 RL 的设计空间进行实证研究，总结训练配方。

Result: 理论层面，论文证明 DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM 均为同一散度约束奖励最大化问题的特例，仅凸生成函数不同，并厘清了既有方法在优势嵌入回归目标构建中的近似来源。实验层面，作者考察了回归式扩散 RL 的设计空间并给出训练配方，将探索中发现的优势保留下来，得到 DiffusionRFT，其收敛更快、训练更稳定，并取得最优性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为回归式扩散/流模型强化学习提供了统一的理论视角，说明不同方法本质上是同一散度约束优化问题在不同凸生成函数下的实例，并指出精确 sparsemax 投影优于既有近似方案。基于此提出的 DiffusionRFT 在收敛速度、训练稳定性与最终性能上均优于先前方法。

Abstract: A nascent family of methods that forgoes the policy gradient and reweights a supervised regression instead has garnered momentum in reinforcement learning for diffusion and flow models. DiffusionNFT, FlowAWR, and RAM are representative regimes with contrasting motivations. It is yet opaque what, if anything, they share. We substantiate that each is the solution of one divergence-constrained reward-maximization problem, and they are differentiated only by the convex generator that defines the constraint. Under the unified modeling framework, we unravel the relaxations that prior art made during building the advantage-embedded regression target: approximating the KKT condition and posterior normalizer for the linear and exponential tilt shapes DiffusionNFT and FlowAWR respectively, while preserving the exact sparsemax projection onto the probability simplex for linear tilt leads to another superior model type in this work. Beyond the theoretical underpinnings, we further empirically investigate the design space and shed light on the training recipe for regression-style diffusion RL. Retaining the merits discovered during our exploration gives rise to DiffusionRFT, our paradigm that converges faster, trains more stably, and attains the top performance.

</details>


### [729] [Chameleon: Dynamic Format Adapter for Efficient Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33496)
*Arnab Sanyal,Sandeep Chinchali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Chameleon：固定比特宽度，将"数制格式"本身作为离散变量进行训练后量化（PTQ），按权重通道与（层、时间步桶）激活张量自适应选择最优格式，在SDXL/SDXL-Turbo/PixArt-α上取得六种设置下最优FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型PTQ方法均在预先固定数制格式的前提下仅调优scale、零点或逐层位宽。但在固定位宽下，最优格式取决于所编码的分布，而该分布随权重通道、层以及扩散时间步变化——激活分布会从重尾、噪声主导逐渐滑向紧凑聚集且结构化。因此固定单一格式并非最优。

Method: 将位宽固定，把格式视为离散变量，逐权重通道、逐（层，时间步桶）激活张量进行选择。激活格式候选集为{INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}，通过两个廉价统计量（经验峰度与闭式扩散SNR）预先选取并存入查找表；权重格式在8比特下取自{INT8, MXINT8}，在4比特下取自{INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4}，离线按重构误差选择。设计架构分叉，使同一选择层可适配多步UNet、单步蒸馏模型与Diffusion Transformer。

Result: 在COCO-2014上的SDXL、SDXL-Turbo与PixArt-α实验中，Chameleon在全部六种"骨干×位宽"设置下均取得最佳FID；CLIP分数与FP16参考的差距在0.24以内，并在W4A8配置下优于所有量化方法。

Conclusion: 将数制格式作为可选择的离散变量、并面向权重通道与扩散时间步进行细粒度自适应，是扩散模型PTQ的有效方向，可在固定位宽下逼近FP16精度并超越现有量化方案。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the standard way to run modern diffusion models on memory-constrained accelerators, yet every existing diffusion PTQ scheme fixes the $\mathit{number\ format}$ in advance and only tunes the scale, zero point, or per-layer bit-width. At a fixed bit-width the best format depends on the distribution being encoded, and that distribution differs across weight channels, across layers, and along the diffusion timestep, where activation distributions slide from heavy-tailed and noise-dominated to tightly clustered and structured. We propose Chameleon, a PTQ framework that holds the bit-width fixed and treats the format itself as a discrete variable, chosen per weight channel and per (layer, timestep bucket) activation tensor.
