Activation formats come from {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}, selected ahead of time from two cheap statistics (empirical kurtosis and the closed-form diffusion SNR) and stored in a lookup table; weight formats come from {INT8, MXINT8} at 8 bits or {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4} at 4 bits, selected offline by reconstruction error. An architectural fork adapts the same selection layer to multi-step UNets, single-step distilled models, and Diffusion Transformers. Across SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, and PixArt-$α$ on COCO-2014, Chameleon achieves the best FID in all six backbone $\times$ bit-width settings, with CLIP within 0.24 of the FP16 reference and the best of all quantized methods at $W_{4}A_{8}$.

</details>


### [730] [MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33804)
*Yuhao Li,Louie Hong Yao,Tianyi Shi,Hanqun Cao,Hongxia Hao,Zhen Zhao,Shengchao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Minkowski位置编码（MinkowskiPE），用时空联合坐标参数化作用在query与key特征上的Lorentz变换，使注意力分数仅依赖相对时空位移，从而在保持标准点积注意力接口的同时显式建模时空耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空耦合建模是跨尺度（微观到宏观）构建物理智能的关键挑战。现有方法分为物理驱动的动力学建模（先验强但灵活性受限）与学习驱动的架构（灵活但时空耦合隐式），缺少兼顾灵活学习与显式几何偏置的方案。

Method: 提出MinkowskiPE：使用联合的时间与空间坐标参数化Lorentz变换，并作用于query和key特征；使query-key注意力分数仅通过两token间的相对时空位移依赖位置，因而对坐标的全局平移具有不变性。该范式保留标准点积注意力接口，兼容高效注意力实现。

Result: 在微观分子动力学与宏观视频预测任务上评估：在全部九项多轨迹分子评估中取得最佳结果；在KTH视频预测上将MSE相对最佳基线降低9.9%，同时参数量约为其十分之一。

Conclusion: MinkowskiPE以显式几何偏置结合灵活学习，实现平移不变的时空耦合注意力建模，在跨尺度任务上以更少参数取得更优性能，且与现有高效注意力实现兼容。

Abstract: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic. Existing models capture such structure broadly through physics-motivated dynamical formulations or learning-motivated architectures. The former provide stronger priors but may constrain flexibility, whereas the latter are more flexible but leave the spatiotemporal coupling largely implicit. We therefore seek an approach that combines flexible learning with an explicit geometric bias for jointly modeling time and space. To this end, we propose Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE), which uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations applied to query and key features. With MinkowskiPE, the query-key attention score depends on position only through the relative spacetime displacement between the two tokens and is therefore invariant to global translation of the coordinates. This paradigm retains the standard dot-product attention interface and remains compatible with efficient attention implementations. We evaluate MinkowskiPE on microscopic molecular dynamics and macroscopic video prediction tasks, achieving the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reducing KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters.

</details>


### [731] [JIVE: Jacobian-Informed Volume Expansion for Diverse Generative Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33906)
*Guangxun Zhang,Brian Cai,Boxuan Zhang,Chao Chen,Ruixiang Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JIVE：一种免训练框架，通过沿生成器端点雅可比主右奇异子空间注入速度扰动，可证明地最大化终点多样性，同时保持样本质量与较低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型常出现模式崩溃与样本多样性不足的问题。已有的通过联合生成一批样本并排斥其轨迹的方法属于启发式，并未显式地最大化最终生成样本（终点）的多样性。

Method: JIVE 向速度场注入与生成器端点雅可比的主导右奇异子空间对齐的扰动，利用该局部几何结构显式最大化终点多样性；为保持效率，扰动方向通过基于经典数值线性代数的免矩阵迭代计算，仅带来少量额外计算开销。

Result: 在多个基准上，JIVE 在少步与一步生成的场景下均提升了像素级与特征级的多样性。

Conclusion: JIVE 提供了一种免训练、可证明且高效的方式，在不牺牲样本质量的前提下增强生成多样性。

Abstract: Generative models often suffer from mode collapse and limited sample diversity. While prior works attempt to mitigate this by jointly generating a batch of samples and repelling their trajectories, these heuristics do not explicitly maximize the diversity of the resulting endpoints. We introduce JIVE, a training-free framework that enhances generative diversity by injecting velocity perturbations aligned with the leading right singular subspace of the generator's endpoint Jacobian. By leveraging this local geometric structure, JIVE provably maximizes endpoint diversity while preserving sample quality. To maintain practical efficiency, we compute these perturbation directions via matrix-free iterations rooted in classical numerical linear algebra, requiring only a small computational overhead. Across different benchmarks, JIVE boosts both pixel and feature-level diversity in few-step and one-step generation.

</details>


### [732] [Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34025)
*Millend Roy,Soham Samal,Ivan Zelich,Krzysztof Marcin Choromanski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出结构自适应树场积分器（STAD-TFIs），一类在树上高效积分距离依赖核张量场的近线性算法，计算效率优于常规TFI，并在合成树、最优传输Sinkhorn松弛与视觉Transformer任务上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对定义在树结构上、带距离依赖核的一般张量场积分问题，既有的常规高效树场积分器（TFI）未能充分利用树的底层结构，导致计算效率有限。

Method: STAD-TFIs 通过围绕路径主干（path backbones）与单顶点分离器（single vertex separators）构建分解，显式利用树的底层结构，并使用二维快速傅里叶变换（2D FFT）联合计算相互作用。

Result: 理论上给出了详细分析；实证上完成从合成树速度测试、真实网格上基于 Sinkhorn 的最优传输加速松弛，到面向视觉任务的拓扑注意力 Transformer 的全面评估。结果首次表明，可通过快速 TFI 方法获得最优传输问题测地 Sinkhorn 解的高效且准确的松弛。

Conclusion: STAD-TFIs 借助树结构分解与二维FFT，在保持精度的同时实现比常规TFI更高效的积分，并可推广至最优传输求解与视觉任务，为快速TFI方法在测地Sinkhorn松弛中的应用提供了早期证据。

Abstract: We present a new class of near-linear algorithms for efficiently integrating general tensor fields defined on trees with distance dependent kernels, the Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators (STAD-TFIs). STAD-TFIs exploit the tree's underlying structure through decompositions built around path backbones and single vertex separators, and use two-dimensional fast Fourier transforms to compute interactions jointly. By exploiting this structural information, STAD-TFIs achieve more computationally efficient integration than their regular efficient tree field integrators (TFI) counterparts. We provide a detailed theoretical analysis of our proposed approach and complement it with an exhaustive empirical evaluation, ranging from speed tests on synthetic trees, through accelerated Sinkhorn-based relaxations of the Optimal Transport algorithms on real meshes, to Topological Attention Transformers for vision tasks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide some of the first results showing that efficient to compute and accurate relaxations of the geodesic Sinkhorn-based solutions of the Optimal Transport problem can be derived by applying fast TFI methods.

</details>


### [733] [WorldGraph: Graph-Native World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34159)
*Zezhong Ding,Yipeng Li,Xike Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"图世界建模"(GWM)框架，将演化图本身的动态作为被建模的世界，并构建基准GWM-Zero与模型WorldGraph，在节点、边、图三个层级的转移预测上全面超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实环境本质上是关系性的，并以演化图的形式被观测：实体、关系及其属性随时间变化。已有的图相关世界模型仅把图结构用作组织内部状态或支持特定任务推理的工具，而未把演化图本身当作被建模的世界。因此作者转向研究图世界建模，令图的演化直接构成世界动态。

Method: 形式化定义GWM：涵盖观测到的图演化、潜在图状态以及异构图转移预测。基于此构建基准GWM-Zero，覆盖8个时序图数据集上节点级、边级、图级三类转移。提出WorldGraph模型：采用状态感知图Transformer进行多粒度结构建模与转移条件化的演化建模，并结合转移感知GRPO（动态分组与结构感知可验证奖励）进行训练。

Result: 在GWM-Zero上的大量实验表明，WorldGraph在全部三种转移粒度上均一致优于代表性基线，包括图表示学习、时序图学习、图预训练及图世界模型类方法。

Conclusion: 将演化图本身作为世界进行建模是一种有效的新范式；配合专门设计的基准与模型（状态感知图Transformer + 转移感知GRPO），可在多粒度图转移预测上取得稳定且全面的性能提升。

Abstract: World models infer latent states of an environment to capture its underlying dynamics and predict future evolution. Many real-world environments, however, are inherently relational and observed as evolving graphs, where entities, relations, and their properties change over time. Prior graph-related world models use graph structures to organize internal states or support task-specific reasoning, rather than treating an evolving graph itself as the modeled world. We instead study graph world modeling (GWM), where graph evolution itself constitutes the world dynamics. We formulate graph world modeling over observed graph evolution, latent graph states, and heterogeneous graph-transition predictions. Based on this formulation, we construct GWM-Zero, a benchmark covering node-, edge-, and graph-level transitions over eight temporal graph datasets. We propose WorldGraph, which combines a state-aware graph transformer for multi-granularity structural and transition-conditioned evolution modeling with transition-aware GRPO using dynamic grouping and structure-aware verifiable rewards. Extensive experiments on GWM-Zero show that WorldGraph consistently outperforms representative graph representation, temporal graph learning, graph pretraining, and graph world-model baselines across all three transition granularities.

</details>


### [734] [Unlocking Few-Step Diffusion for Faithful Previews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34406)
*Jing Jia,Sifan Liu,Guanyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现少步采样器的低质量输出并非源于重建能力不足：仅优化初始噪声即可让冻结的3-4步采样器近似复现全步输出。作者提出用端点监督学习初始噪声与去噪更新的修正量，生成廉价预览以筛选候选，在保持排序与选择质量的同时显著降低重建误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散工作流中采样延迟累积：用户需生成并丢弃大量候选，最终仅保留一个，代价高昂。标准少步采样器输出质量差，通常被归因于重建能力不足，但作者质疑这一假设，并希望用廉价预览支持候选筛选。

Method: 首先验证：仅优化初始噪声，冻结的3-4步采样器即可紧密复现对应全步输出，说明重建能力并非瓶颈。据此，采用端点监督学习初始噪声与去噪更新的修正量，使少步输出与"同噪声、同提示"下的全步输出对齐。输入修正无需重训练即可跨采样预算迁移。

Result: 在无条件基准上，重建MSE相比重训练的LD3降低53-78%；在SD1.5、SDXL与FLUX.1-dev上，排序保持性与候选选择性能均有提升。

Conclusion: 少步采样器的瓶颈在于噪声与去噪轨迹的失配而非重建容量。通过端点监督学习修正量，可获得高保真预览，实现低成本候选筛选并将全步生成留给有潜力的候选，且修正可跨采样预算迁移。

Abstract: Sampling latency compounds in diffusion workflows, where users generate and discard many candidates before keeping one. Surprisingly, the poor outputs of standard few-step samplers do not reflect a lack of reconstruction capacity: by optimizing only the initial noise, frozen 3-4-step samplers can closely reproduce their corresponding full-step outputs. Building on this finding, we learn corrections to the initial noise and denoising updates using endpoint supervision, improving correspondence with full-step outputs generated from the same noise and prompt. The resulting previews allow users to screen candidates cheaply and reserve full-step generation for promising ones. Input correction also transfers across sampling budgets without retraining. Experiments show substantial improvements in reference fidelity, including 53-78% lower reconstruction MSE than retrained LD3 on unconditional benchmarks, alongside improved ranking preservation and candidate selection on SD1.5, SDXL, and FLUX.1-dev.

</details>


### [735] [KiT: A Foundation Model for Financial Time-Series Forecasting using DiffusionTransformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34507)
*Boyu Zhang,Haorui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KiT 是一个基于流匹配的 K 线扩散 Transformer 基础模型，将未来预测重构为条件路径生成，在三个市场、七种分辨率上取得领先的收益与波动率预测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融 K 线预测因信噪比极低、跨市场与跨品种异质性强而困难；现有方法多采用自回归形式，推理时存在误差累积问题；通用时间序列基础模型未针对 K 线数据结构设计，在下游蜡烛图预测任务上表现欠佳。

Method: 提出 KiT（K-line Diffusion Transformer）基础模型，将未来预测重构为基于流匹配（flow matching）的条件路径生成：给定历史上下文窗口，生成一组合理的未来 OHLCV 轨迹集合（ensemble）；在跨多个市场与时序尺度的数十亿根 K 线上，按多种参数规模进行预训练。

Result: 在三个市场、七种分辨率下，KiT 平均收益 RankIC 达 0.057，平均波动率 RankIC 达 0.66，在所有时间尺度上均取得领先，优于任务专用金融预测模型与通用时间序列基础模型。

Conclusion: 以条件路径生成替代自回归范式，并结合 K 线结构定制的基础模型预训练，可有效缓解误差累积并提升蜡烛图预测性能，验证了扩散/流匹配路线在金融时序建模中的潜力。

Abstract: Financial candlestick forecasting is fundamental to quantitative investment, yet it remains exceptionally challenging due to extremely low signal-to-noise ratios and vast heterogeneity across markets and instruments. Existing approaches have largely attempted to introduce deep learning to capture hidden temporal features, but most adopt an auto-regressive formulation, which leads to error accumulation during inference. Meanwhile, general-purpose time-series foundation models are not tailored to the unique structure of k-line data and yield unsatisfactory performance on downstream candlestick forecasting tasks. To tackle these problems, we introduce KiT, a K-line Diffusion Transformer foundation model, and reformulate future prediction as conditional path generation via flow matching: given a historical context window, the model generates an ensemble of plausible future OHLCV trajectories. We pre-train KiT at multiple parameter scales on billions of candlestick bars spanning multiple markets and timescales. Across three markets and seven resolutions, KiT attains a mean return RankIC of 0.057 and a mean volatility RankIC of 0.66, leading at every timescale and outperforming both task-specific financial forecasters and general time-series foundation models. Code will be available at: https://github.com/Luciferbobo/KiT.

</details>


### [736] [Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34677)
*Beomsu Kim,Chieh-Hsin Lai,Bac Nguyen,Amir Bar,Jong Chul Ye,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Future-Aware Recall（FAR）框架，通过未来感知的预测监督与自适应多线索评分来学习情景记忆召回，使世界模型能自动判断哪些记忆与线索对当前预测有用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型的预测可能依赖于久远的观测，需借助情景记忆保存并召回历史信息。但记忆不断累积后，面临两个关键问题：哪些记忆对当前预测有用，以及应信任哪些可用检索线索来找到它们。基于近因性、位姿重叠或视觉相似度的固定准则在不同环境和查询下并不可靠。

Method: 提出FAR框架，从未来感知的预测监督和自适应多线索评分中学习情景记忆召回。训练时以"给定召回上下文条件下真实未来的条件对数似然"衡量预测效用，并用负扩散预测损失近似该效用，据此训练检索器；该检索器在推理阶段保持"未来盲"（future-blind）。检索器学习线索特定的相关性，并为每个查询自动决定应信任哪些可用检索线索（如时间、位姿、视觉、音频）来选择记忆。

Result: 在三个互补的实验设置中，FAR即使使用相同的检索线索也优于人工设计的召回策略；能够自动适应应信任哪些可用线索；并能在世界发生变化时召回正确的历史。

Conclusion: FAR为世界模型中的情景记忆访问提供了一种灵活、有原则的方法。

Abstract: World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.

</details>


### [737] [A Unifying Framework of Concept-based Explainable AI with Completeness Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34750)
*Vojtěch Kůr,Adam Kukučka,Tomáš Brázdil,Vít Musil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的理论框架，用共同的数学语言描述基于概念的解释方法，并借助概念自编码器视角分析概念发现、模型完备性与归因完备性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于概念的解释领域存在多种方法，它们在概念的定义、表示方式以及与模型预测的连接方式上各不相同，缺乏统一的理论语言，难以对其性质进行共享分析。因此作者希望建立一个通用框架来统一描述并分析这些方法。

Method: 作者引入概念自编码器视角来描述概念发现问题：编码器从训练模型的潜在空间中提取概念表示，解码器利用这些概念表示重建原始潜在表示。以自编码器的重建误差衡量解码器恢复原始潜在表示的准确度，并用该视角统一地定义单个概念归因。

Result: 研究表明，概念的模型不完备性可由自编码器的重建误差来界定上界；同时，作者建立了使各概念归因之和等于模型预测的条件，并在条件不满足时对偏差给出界，从而提供了归因完备性保证。

Conclusion: 该框架为多种基于概念的解释方法提供了统一的数学描述与分析工具，将模型完备性和归因完备性与自编码器重建误差联系起来，为概念解释的理论保证奠定了基础。

Abstract: Concept-based explanations describe neural network predictions through human-understandable properties of inputs called concepts. The field encompasses approaches that differ in how they define and represent concepts and connect them to model predictions. We introduce a theoretical framework that describes these approaches in a common mathematical language and supports a shared analysis of their properties. For concept discovery, which identifies concepts automatically within a latent space of a trained model, we employ a concept autoencoder view. An encoder extracts concept representations from the model's latent space, and a decoder uses them to reconstruct the original latent representation. The autoencoder's reconstruction error measures how accurately its decoder recovers the original latent representation. We revisit model completeness: how well the concepts can reproduce the model's outputs. We show that model incompleteness of the concepts can be bounded by the autoencoder's reconstruction error. The autoencoder view also provides a common way to define individual concept attributions, which measure each concept's contribution to a prediction. We establish when these attributions sum to the model's prediction, and bound the discrepancy otherwise, thus providing attribution completeness guarantees.

</details>


### [738] [Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34944)
*Jeongsol Kim,Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Jangho Park,Kwanyoung Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF)，将轨迹感知的 critic 引导摊销到轻量引导网络，通过最优控制中的协态回归实现，训练与推理均高效，在多个基准上优于或媲美基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于流的 VLA 策略通常用行为克隆训练，不显式优化长期任务回报。现有 critic 引导方法用采样器的一步代理对 critic 求导，并在每个流步反传 critic 集成，计算与内存开销大。

Method: 将 critic 引导的流生成建模为确定性最优控制问题，其最优引导为携带终端 critic 梯度回传的协态；在冻结 VLA 与 critic 的前提下，将轻量引导网络回归到该协态上。推理时每步仅需一次引导网络前向，无需 critic 集成、反向传播或伴随计算。

Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboCasa 和 LIBERO-Pro 上，AGF 持续改进预训练 VLA，与 critic 引导及策略微调基线相当，且在跨任务部署单一引导强度时最鲁棒。相比 QGF，每步引导快 3.6 倍、参数少 7.0 倍，性能相当甚至更好。

Conclusion: AGF 表明 critic 引导可以同时具备轨迹感知与轻量化特性，在保持预训练策略不变的同时实现高效、鲁棒的性能提升。

Abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically trained by behavior cloning and thus do not explicitly optimize long-term task return. Critic guidance steers generation toward higher-value actions, but existing methods differentiate the critic through a one-step surrogate of the sampler and back-propagate a critic ensemble at every flow step. In contrast, here we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network while preserving the pretrained VLA policy. Specifically, we formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, whose optimal guidance is a costate that carries the terminal critic gradient back through the remaining flow, and regress the guidance network onto this costate while keeping both the VLA and critic frozen. This design provides favorable memory and throughput scaling during training, and inference needs one guidance-network forward pass per step, without the critic ensemble, back-propagation, or adjoint computation. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF consistently improves pretrained VLAs, remains competitive with critic-guidance and policy-fine-tuning baselines, and is the most robust method when a single guidance strength is deployed across tasks. Compared with QGF, AGF runs $3.6\times$ faster per guidance step with $7.0\times$ fewer parameters, with comparable and even better performance, showing that critic guidance can be trajectory-aware and lightweight.

</details>


### [739] [Inspector: Conversational and Lightweight Analyzer of Analog Circuit Layouts Using LLM and CNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34976)
*Abril Cano Castro,Giuseppe Chiari,Michele Piccoli,Federico Viola,Davide Zoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合微调LLM与CNN的框架，用于分析模拟集成电路的GDSII文件，并支持设计者与工具之间的对话式交互；在四个真实任务、数千个模拟设计上，性能显著优于通用大型视觉语言模型（最高达81%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI融入计算机辅助设计框架，正推动模拟集成电路设计从手工与基于算法的方案转向自动化、智能化范式。GDSII文件是行业标准数据库，包含模拟电路最终且最精确的信息，涵盖决定流片性能的复杂物理几何与寄生现实。然而，如何高效分析此类文件并便于设计者使用，仍存在需求。

Method: 提出一种新颖框架，将微调后的大语言模型（LLM）与卷积神经网络（CNN）相结合，用于分析模拟电路的GDSII文件，并实现工具与设计者之间的对话式接口。

Result: 在四个真实任务上使用数千个模拟设计进行实验，所提方案显著优于最先进的通用大型视觉语言模型（VLM），提升幅度最高达81%。

Conclusion: 该框架为GDSII分析问题提供了一种轻量级解决方案。

Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes a novel framework that combines fine-tuned LLMs and CNNs to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling a conversational interface between the tool and the designers. Experimental results using thousands of analog designs across four realistic tasks demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose massive VLMs by a significant margin (up to 81%), thus providing a lightweight solution to the problem of GDSII analysis.

</details>


### [740] [eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35269)
*Mansi,Nikhil Raghavan,Zixia Huang,Kai Sheng Ong,Ji Shen Lim,Brandon Siao Xiang Ling,Francesco Leofante*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 eval-unlearn，一个面向文本到图像扩散模型概念遗忘的统一、可复现基准测试框架（开源 Python 库）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型的概念遗忘技术日益增多，但评估条件异质、指标分散，导致难以进行有原则的跨方法比较。

Method: eval-unlearn 采用插件式架构，支持第三方技术与指标自注册而无需修改核心框架；集成十二种已发表遗忘技术（覆盖微调、闭式模型编辑、推理时干预），并提供九项评估指标（涵盖擦除有效性、对抗鲁棒性、生成质量与概念保留）；采用流式、批处理流水线，支持标准 NSFW 概念与任意通用概念的高效评估。

Result: 发布 HuggingFace 公开排行榜及实时评估交互工具；排行榜以裸体概念擦除为案例研究，对十二种技术进行比较，揭示了被异质评估所掩盖的显著“准确性—质量”权衡。项目以 MIT 许可证开源，包含代码、排行榜与文档。

Conclusion: eval-unlearn 为 T2I 扩散模型概念遗忘提供了统一、可复现的基准测试与评估基础设施，有助于揭示并系统分析不同技术间的性能权衡。

Abstract: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time intervention, alongside nine complementary evaluation metrics covering erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, generative quality, and concept retention. Its plugin architecture lets third-party techniques and metrics self-register without modifying the core framework, and its streaming, batched pipeline supports efficient evaluation of both standard NSFW concepts and arbitrary general concepts. As a further contribution, we release a public leaderboard on HuggingFace along with an interactive tool for real-time evaluation of unlearning techniques. The leaderboard compares nudity concept erasure case study across all twelve techniques, exposing significant accuracy-quality trade-offs that are obscured by heterogeneous evaluation. eval-unlearn is released under the MIT license; the package, code, leaderboard, and documentation are all available at https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io.

</details>


### [741] [$λ$-JEPA Spectral Anti-Collapse Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35288)
*Berker Demirel,Clémentine Dominé,Valentino Maiorca,Marco Fumero,Marco Mondelli,Francesco Locatello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对联合嵌入自监督学习中投影头前后目标不一致导致骨干表征维度坍缩的问题，提出谱反坍缩正则化器SACReg，并构建λ-JEPA，在图像与视频自监督学习基准上提升了分类与迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联合嵌入自监督学习通常在增强视图间施加不变性目标，并配合防止表征坍缩的机制，但这些目标多施加于投影头之后，而下游任务使用投影器之前的骨干表征。作者发现这种"目标-使用"错配并不能阻止骨干表征的维度坍缩，骨干仍可能保持较低的有效秩，从而限制下游迁移能力。

Method: 作者基于对λ-balance（刻画跨层权重矩阵相对尺度的指标）的分析，提出谱反坍缩正则化器SACReg，直接作用于骨干表征。在两层线性网络中证明：(i) λ-balance可防止坍缩；(ii) 对骨干施加该正则化可诱导λ-balance。在非线性情形下该正则化同样带来反坍缩效果。随后将SACReg应用于JEPA框架，提出λ-JEPA。

Result: 在ImageNet100等真实架构上，SACReg经验性地提升了表征的秩。λ-JEPA在ImageNet-1k分类以及八个下游图像数据集的平均线性探测迁移性能上优于LeJEPA和VISReg；在视频自监督学习方面，λ-JEPA在Something-Something-v2和Kinetics-400基准上优于LeVJEPA和V-JEPA 2。

Conclusion: 通过在骨干表征层面引入基于λ-balance的谱反坍缩正则化，可有效缓解投影头错配带来的维度坍缩、提升表征秩与迁移能力；λ-JEPA在图像和视频自监督学习任务上均取得一致改进，代码已开源。

Abstract: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning typically combines an invariance objective across augmented views with additional mechanisms to prevent representational collapse. These objectives are often applied after a projection head, while downstream tasks use the backbone representation before the projector. We find that this mismatch does not necessarily prevent dimensional collapse in the backbone, which can retain low effective rank and potentially limit downstream transfer. To address this, we introduce SACReg, a spectral anti-collapse regularizer motivated by an analysis of $λ$-balance, which captures the relative scale of weight matrices across layers. In a two-layer linear network, we show that (i) $λ$-balance prevents collapse, and (ii) our regularizer applied to the backbone induces $λ$-balance. In the nonlinear case, this regularizer leads to anti-collapse as well and, in realistic architectures on ImageNet100, it empirically increases the representations' ranks. We apply SACReg to JEPA and propose $λ$-JEPA, which improves over LeJEPA and VISReg on ImageNet-1k classification and in average linear-probe transfer performance across eight downstream image datasets. On video self-supervised learning, $λ$-JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on the Something-Something-v2 and Kinetics-400 benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa.

</details>


### [742] [Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35291)
*Shunchang Liu,Lukas Fluri,Xin Chen,Francesco Croce*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文定义并研究了视觉语言模型中的涌现性失准（EM），发现窄域多模态微调可引发跨任务蔓延的广泛有害行为，且该现象源于行为偏移而非能力丧失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究证明文本模型在窄任务微调后会出现涌现性失准（EM），但该现象几乎只在纯文本任务中被研究，多模态模型中的表现尚不明确，因此需要界定并分析视觉语言模型中的EM。

Method: 通过在脆弱代码、粗心的家用物品使用、对普通场景的阴谋论解读等窄域多模态任务上进行微调来诱发EM；在15个不同规模的商业与开源模型上测试，并考察数据表面有害性、训练-评估模态对齐、SFT与偏好优化、中间推理传播等因素，同时尝试提示接种、良性持续训练、激活层引导等缓解策略。

Result: 窄域多模态微调可诱发连贯且广泛失准的行为，并迁移到无关任务，表现为失准观点、视觉事实不诚实、不安全图像生成、易受视觉越狱攻击及高风险智能体行为；EM不依赖训练数据的表面有害性，但对训练-评估模态对齐敏感；SFT与偏好优化均可产生EM，并可通过中间推理传播；所提缓解策略只能部分削弱EM。

Conclusion: 多模态EM体现为一种行为偏移而非普遍能力丧失，该现象从文本模态延伸到视觉模态。

Abstract: Modern AI models are aligned through post-training to adapt them to downstream tasks. Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on narrow tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM), causing broadly harmful behaviors beyond the training task. However, EM has been studied almost entirely in text-only tasks, leaving its manifestation in multimodal models unclear. In this paper, we define and analyze EM in the context of vision-language models. We first induce EM via fine-tuning on narrow multimodal tasks targeting vulnerable code, careless household-object use, and conspiratorial interpretations of ordinary scenes. Across fifteen commercial and open-source models with different scales, we find that narrow multimodal fine-tuning can induce coherent and broadly misaligned behavior that transfers to unrelated tasks, including misaligned opinions, visual factual dishonesty, unsafe image generation, vulnerability to visual jailbreaks, and risky agentic actions. We further find that multimodal EM does not depend on the apparent harmfulness of training data but is sensitive to training-evaluation modality alignment. EM can arise under both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization and can propagate through intermediate reasoning. Finally, we explore several mitigation strategies, including prompt inoculation, benign continued training, and activation-level steering, which can partially reduce EM. Overall, our findings suggest that multimodal EM reflects a behavioral shift rather than a general loss of capability, extending beyond text to the visual modality.

</details>


### [743] [Harmonizing Spectral Evolution in Conditional Flow Matching for TTS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34431)
*Isha Pandey Varad Deshpande Abhijat Bharadwaj Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对CFM-TTS推理中频谱演化不协调的问题，提出一种基于离散小波变换（DWT）的无训练频带选择性增强策略，在ODE积分过程中动态调制梅尔频谱子带，降低NFE并大幅改善FAD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFM类TTS模型在推理时存在高低频演化不同步、频谱失衡的问题；其他领域中扩散模型的通用解决方案无法适配CFM固有的不协调声学动态特性。

Method: 提出无需训练的频率选择性增强策略：利用离散小波变换将梅尔频谱分解为子带，在ODE积分过程中动态调制各子带——抑制低频过快增长、增强滞后的高频细节，从而同步频谱演化。

Result: 在Matcha-TTS、F5-TTS、IndicF5等多种架构上验证：NFE由32降至26，FAD最高改善61%，同时平均主观评分（MOS）、说话人相似度和语音可懂度均未下降。

Conclusion: 该无训练、架构无关的DWT频带增强策略可有效缓解CFM-TTS的频谱失衡，在提升生成效率与音质的同时保持感知质量，具有良好的通用性与实用性。

Abstract: Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) models for text-to-speech (TTS) suffer from incoherent frequency evolution during inference. While similar spectral imbalances are addressed in diffusion models for other domains, those generic solutions fail to generalize to the inherently uncoordinated acoustic dynamics of CFM. We demonstrate that this issue can be effectively mitigated by introducing a novel training-free frequency-selective boosting strategy. Using the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), our method dynamically modulates mel-spectrogram sub-bands during ODE integration, synchronizing spectral development by penalizing aggressive low-frequency growth and boosting lagging high-frequency details. Validated across diverse architectures (Matcha-TTS, F5-TTS, IndicF5), our approach reduces the required Number of Function Evaluations (NFE) from 32 to 26 and improves Frechet Audio Distance (FAD) by up to 61%, all without compromising mean opinion scores, speaker similarity, and speech intelligibility.

</details>


### [744] [Symmetry-quotient Flatness and Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31634)
*Taiki Miyagawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在对称商空间框架下建立了一套定理级推导链条：商线性稳定性 ⇒ 商平坦性 ⇒ 输入光滑性 ⇒ 泛化性，为神经网络的平坦性与泛化关系提供了对称不变的理论刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平坦性常被认为与泛化相关，SGD也被视为隐式偏向平坦解；但标准平坦性度量定义在原始参数空间，在正缩放等保函数对称下并不不变，因此需要构建对称感知的商空间平坦性理论。

Method: 针对平方损失与具有保函数群作用的模型，在正则商流形上以经验损失Hessian的迹定义商平坦性；证明商平坦性经由商空间版的平坦到光滑论证控制输入光滑性；证明线性化SGD动力学的一步均方商线性稳定性蕴含以批大小和学习率为显式项的商平坦性界，并推广至高阶张量矩；在局部覆盖与有界性假设下推导总体泛化界。

Result: 建立了商线性稳定性、商平坦性、输入光滑性与泛化性之间的完整蕴含链条；得到商平坦性的显式界（依赖批大小与学习率）；给出以商平坦性及商线性稳定性表示的总体泛化界。

Conclusion: 该工作将平坦性—泛化理论推广到对称商空间，使其在保函数对称下保持不变，并将SGD的隐式偏置、商平坦性与泛化性统一在同一理论框架内。

Abstract: This paper develops a theorem-level pipeline in symmetry-quotient settings: quotient linear stability implies quotient flatness, quotient flatness implies input smoothness, and input smoothness yields generalization under local covering assumptions. Flatness is often associated with generalization, and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is frequently viewed as implicitly biased toward flat solutions. However, standard flatness measures are typically defined in the raw parameter space and are therefore not invariant under function-preserving symmetries such as positive rescaling. We develop a symmetry-aware theory of quotient flatness, quotient linear stability, input smoothness, and generalization on quotient spaces of neural-network parameters. For square loss and models equipped with function-preserving group actions, we define quotient flatness as the trace of the Hessian of the empirical loss on the regular quotient manifold. We show that quotient flatness controls input smoothness through a quotient-space analogue of the flatness-to-smoothness argument. We also prove that one-step mean-square quotient linear stability of the linearized SGD dynamics implies an explicit quotient-flatness bound in terms of the batch size and learning rate, and extend this analysis to higher-order tensor moments. Finally, under local covering and boundedness assumptions, we derive population generalization bounds in terms of quotient flatness and, consequently, in terms of quotient linear stability.

</details>


### [745] [Does Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Pretraining Help Time Series Forecasting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31680)
*Yutong Feng,Bowen Liao,See Kiong Ng,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对一种JEPA实例在9种骨干网络、11个时序与时空预测基准上进行了迄今最大规模的跨架构评估，发现其预训练收益高度依赖下游骨干，部分架构一致提升、部分一致退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA作为时序自监督预训练范式被认为有前景，但已有证据混杂，且多数研究仅测试单一骨干或少量架构，无法判断JEPA预训练是可靠改进还是强烈依赖下游模型，因此存在评估缺口。

Method: 对一种JEPA实例开展大规模评估：覆盖9种骨干网络与11个基准，任务涵盖时序预测和时空预测，是该领域目前最广泛的跨架构JEPA评估。

Result: 该实例的收益在不同骨干间差异显著：在同一数据集上，部分架构获得一致提升，部分架构则一致退化；该模式在两类任务族中均成立。

Conclusion: 这种收益变异性是该JEPA实例的普遍性质，而非数据集特定假象；实际选择骨干网络时需将JEPA预训练与架构的匹配性纳入考量。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) have emerged as a promising self-supervised pretraining paradigm for time series, learning representations by predicting target embeddings in latent space rather than reconstructing raw signals. Yet evidence on their benefits remains mixed, and most studies test only a single backbone or a narrow set of architectures, leaving unclear whether JEPA pretraining is a reliable improvement or one that depends heavily on the downstream model. We address this gap through a large scale evaluation of one JEPA instantiation across nine backbones and eleven benchmarks spanning temporal and spatio-temporal forecasting, the most extensive cross architecture assessment of JEPA for time series to date. We find that the benefit of this instantiation varies sharply across backbones, producing consistent gains for some architectures and consistent degradation for others, even on the same dataset. This pattern holds across both task families, indicating the variability is a general property of this instantiation rather than a dataset specific artifact worth accounting for when choosing a backbone in practice.

</details>


### [746] [Simple Extensions of Single-Objective Acquisition Functions and Hedge Strategies for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31940)
*Haris Moazam Sheikh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作提出通过超体积变换将标准单目标采集函数直接扩展到多目标贝叶斯优化，并提出多目标对冲策略，无需定制化多目标公式即可匹配或超越现有复杂MOBO方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOBO通常依赖专用采集函数或标量化方案以显式处理非偏好目标间的权衡，流程复杂且需对现有BO管线做较大改动，作者希望验证这种复杂性是否必要。

Method: 提出基于超体积的变换，将广泛使用的单目标采集函数以有原则的方式扩展到多目标场景，并将原本仅用于单目标的采集函数对冲策略推广到多目标情形；方法对现有BO流程改动极小，保留直观解释与计算效率。

Result: 在多个合成与真实多目标基准上评估，所提扩展尽管简单，在优化性能与样本效率上一致匹配或优于更复杂的SOTA MOBO方法。

Conclusion: 有效的多目标贝叶斯优化可通过复用并谨慎扩展成熟的单目标采集策略实现，为现有方法提供更简单灵活的替代方案，说明定制化多目标公式并非必要。

Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is commonly approached through specialized acquisition functions or scalarization schemes designed to explicitly account for trade-offs among non-preferential objectives. In this work, we show that such complexity might be unnecessary. We propose a framework that extends standard single-objective acquisition functions directly to the multi-objective setting through a hypervolume-based transformation. We further extend hedge strategies for acquisition functions, which are typically used only in single-objective optimization, to the multi-objective regime. Our approach requires minimal modification to existing Bayesian optimization pipelines and avoids the need for bespoke multi-objective formulations. We demonstrate how a broad class of commonly used single-objective acquisition functions and hedge strategies can be adapted in a principled manner to handle multiple objectives, while preserving their intuitive interpretation and computational efficiency. Empirically, we evaluate the proposed methods across a range of synthetic and real-world multi-objective benchmarks. Despite their simplicity, our extensions consistently match or outperform more complex state-of-the-art MOBO methods in terms of optimization performance and sample efficiency. These results suggest that effective multi-objective Bayesian optimization can be achieved by reusing and carefully extending well-established single-objective acquisition strategies, offering a simpler and more flexible alternative to existing approaches.

</details>


### [747] [Emergent One-Third Scaling Law as Attention Tries to Concentrate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32100)
*Yizhou Liu,Sara Kangaslahti,Jeff Gore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过玩具模型证明任意位置的 softmax 在学习尖峰分布时，其 logit 幅度会以指数 1/3 幂律增长，成为训练瓶颈并使损失以 1/3 幂律衰减；在 LLM 中证实多个 softmax 学习尖峰分布且损失缩放符合 1/3 预测，指出注意力头而非语言建模头是驱动 1/3 损失缩放的关键瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经缩放定律（训练更久性能更好，呈幂律关系）是当今 LLM 的核心，但其起源仍有争议。近期有观点认为幂律可源于单个 softmax 头学习尖峰分布时的强非线性，但 LLM 中存在多个 softmax 函数时会发生什么尚不清楚，因此需要探究多 softmax 情形下的缩放规律来源。

Method: 通过玩具模型（toy models）进行理论分析，考察任意位置 softmax 学习尖峰分布时的 logit 幅度增长动态与损失贡献衰减；随后在真实 LLM 中验证多个 softmax 是否学习尖峰分布，并将 LLM 损失缩放与 1/3 预测进行对比；进一步分析 logit 增长动态以定位瓶颈所在（注意力头 vs. 语言建模头）。

Result: 玩具模型显示：任何学习尖峰分布的 softmax，无论位于模型何处，其 logit 幅度以指数 1/3 的幂律增长，成为训练瓶颈，其损失贡献以相同指数 1/3 的幂律衰减；只要至少一个 softmax 学习尖峰分布，整体损失即服从 1/3 缩放。实验证实 LLM 中许多 softmax 学习尖峰分布，且 LLM 损失缩放与 1/3 预测吻合。logit 增长动态进一步揭示注意力头（而非语言建模头）是驱动 1/3 损失缩放的主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 注意力机制试图聚焦于特定信息——这是 Transformer 的核心——可能同时也是训练神经缩放定律的核心。该工作将神经缩放定律的起源与 softmax 学习尖峰分布导致的 logit 增长瓶颈联系起来，并指出注意力头是关键驱动因素。

Abstract: The neural scaling law relating longer training to better performance through a power law is central to today's large language models (LLMs), yet its origin remains debated. One recent proposal is that power laws can emerge from the strong non-linearity of a single softmax head learning peaked distributions. What happens with multiple softmax functions, as in LLMs, is unclear. Here, we show through toy models that any softmax learning peaked distributions, regardless of its position in the model, can develop logit magnitudes that grow in a power law with exponent $1/3$, becoming a training bottleneck whose loss contribution decays as a power law with the same exponent $1/3$. The overall loss therefore obeys $1/3$ scaling whenever at least one softmax learns peaked distributions. We confirm that many softmax functions in LLMs learn peaked distributions and that LLM loss scaling matches this $1/3$ prediction. Moreover, logit growth dynamics reveal that attention heads, rather than the language modeling head, are the bottleneck likely driving the $1/3$ loss scaling in LLMs. Attention trying to concentrate on specific information, which is the heart of Transformers, may therefore also be the heart of the neural scaling law of training.

</details>


### [748] [How Reusable Are Benchmarks with Richer Feedback?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32109)
*Youssef Allouah,John Duchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在多项指标下自适应选模型时，估计最佳分数所需的测试集规模随指标数指数增长，仅 $O(\log k)$ 个指标即达到 $Θ(\sqrt{k})$ 的自适应查询代价；多任务LLM基准攻击实验验证了严重的重用-留出分数差距与大量假优胜者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者会根据评估反馈在多指标基准上反复调整和选择模型，但基准是否能可靠指导模型选择尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对"多准则反馈"情形下基准重用可靠性的理论刻画与实证检验。

Method: 构建理论分析：在任意准则的凸组合下，推导估计 $k$ 个自适应选择模型的最高分数所需的最坏情形测试集规模，并与 $k$ 次自适应统计查询的 $Θ(\sqrt{k})$ 代价建立联系；同时在含5至10项指标的多任务LLM基准上实施攻击，且反馈仅限非支配（nondominated）任务档案。

Result: 理论上，所需测试集规模随准则数指数增长，固定精度与置信度下仅 $O(\log k)$ 个准则即达到 $Θ(\sqrt{k})$ 自适应查询代价。实验中，反馈被限制为非支配任务档案时出现较大的重用-留出分数差距和频繁的假优胜者。

Conclusion: 研究结果在丰富反馈情形下削弱了"基准可靠重用主要因开发者仅对当前最优的显著改进作出反应"这一流行解释，但对普通模型开发过程实际遭遇该脆弱性的频率仍待确定。

Abstract: We study whether benchmarks reliably guide model selection as developers adapt to evaluation feedback across multiple criteria. We find that the worst-case test-set size needed to estimate the best score among $k$ adaptively chosen models, under any convex combination of the criteria, grows exponentially with the number of criteria, reaching the $Θ(\sqrt{k})$ cost of answering $k$ adaptive statistical queries with only $O(\log k)$ criteria, at fixed accuracy and confidence. In attacks on multi-task large language model benchmarks with five to ten criteria, feedback restricted to nondominated task profiles produces large reused-to-held-out score gaps and frequent false winners. These results challenge a prominent explanation for prior observed reliable benchmark reuse---that developers mainly respond to convincing improvements over the current best---in rich-feedback settings, while leaving open how often ordinary model development encounters this vulnerability.

</details>


### [749] [REALM: Regime-Switching, Explainable, and Activation-Induced Linear Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32141)
*Xiaoran Cheng,Sen Na,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出REALM，一种由神经网络激活模式诱导的线性模型混合体，通过蒸馏深教师网络为宽浅学生网络、二值化并聚类隐藏层激活来定义可解释的制度(regime)，并用解释门复现制度分配，在表格与图像数据上实现了有竞争力的预测性能与稳定的制度级解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReLU网络是分段仿射映射，将输入空间划分为由不同激活模式表征的单元。在每个单元内拟合局部线性模型可在保持预测精度的同时提升可解释性。然而，如何识别稳定、数据自适应且易于解释的制度(regime)仍是挑战，且深层网络的激活单元数量随深度快速增长。

Method: 提出REALM：1) 先将深度教师网络蒸馏为宽浅学生网络(WSSN)；2) 二值化并聚类其隐藏层激活以定义制度，并在每个制度内拟合线性模型；3) 由于制度源自内部结构，路由器不承担预测负担；4) 训练多分类逻辑回归作为"解释门"，复现制度分配以实现可解释。整体两级结构在原始表格特征或学习的卷积特征上均可解释。

Result: 通过分析一个理想化设置，揭示了划分复杂度与稳定性之间的权衡：制度数量增加时，更细的划分可提升近似能力，但可能降低制度分配的稳定性。在表格和图像数据集上的实验表明，REALM相较于其他DNN引导的混合代理模型和固有可解释模型，取得了有竞争力的预测性能，同时产生稳定的制度级解释。

Conclusion: REALM利用神经激活模式诱导的可解释制度，将路由器与预测任务解耦，通过解释门实现两级可解释性，在预测性能与可解释性之间取得平衡，并能提供稳定的制度级解释，验证了激活模式作为可解释结构来源的有效性。

Abstract: Deep ReLU networks are piecewise-affine mappings that partition the input space into cells, each characterized by a distinct activation pattern. This structure motivates fitting a local linear model within each cell to preserve predictive accuracy while improving interpretability. The challenge is to identify regimes that are stable, data-adaptive, and easy to explain. We propose REALM, a mixture of linear models whose regimes are induced by neural activation patterns. Because the number of activation cells in a deep neural network (DNN) can grow rapidly with depth, we first distill a deep teacher into a wide, shallow student network (WSSN), then binarize and cluster its hidden-layer activations to define the regimes and fit a linear model within each regime. Since the regimes are discovered from internal structure, the router does not carry the predictive burden. To make regime assignment interpretable, we train a multiclass logistic regression, the explanatory gate, to reproduce the regime assignments. The two-level structure is interpretable at both stages in terms of raw tabular or learned convolutional features: the gate identifies features that determine regime assignments, while the linear models identify features that drive predictions within each regime. We analyze an idealized setting that illustrates a trade-off between partition complexity and stability: as the number of regimes grows, finer partitions can improve approximation but may reduce regime-assignment stability. Experiments on tabular and image datasets show that REALM achieves competitive predictive performance relative to other DNN-guided mixture surrogates and inherently interpretable models while producing stable regime-level explanations.

</details>


### [750] [Recovery-Directed Symbolic Distillation of Neural Likelihoods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32409)
*Kianté Fernandez,Xinwei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"符号蒸馏"流程，将已训练的摊销神经似然转换为显式、可解释的符号表达式，并以参数恢复为导向优化，从而在保持精度的同时显著提升参数估计效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摊销神经似然虽能对解析不可解或未指定的似然进行昂贵推断，但其黑箱特性限制了可解释性，且计算成本高。

Method: 采用恢复导向目标指导符号回归，使其保留参数恢复精度而非仅逼近似然函数；候选表达式在留出数据集上评估，并依据同时考虑表达式复杂度、参数恢复性能与同所学似然分布距离的准则进行选择。

Result: 在扩散决策模型上验证：恢复导向目标优于标准符号回归目标；所得符号似然相较神经似然及（若可得）精确似然的参数评估速度快100倍以上，精度损失可控；并在实证数据的贝叶斯分层推断中展示了计算优势。

Conclusion: 该流程为将符号蒸馏与现有神经似然估计方法集成提供了轻量接口，可适配多种基于模拟的推断场景。

Abstract: Amortized neural likelihoods enable computationally expensive inference for models with analytically intractable or unspecified likelihoods, but their black-box nature limits interpretability. We introduce a symbolic distillation pipeline that converts trained neural likelihoods into explicit, interpretable expressions optimized for efficient parameter estimation. Our approach uses a recovery-directed objective to guide symbolic regression toward expressions that preserve parameter-recovery accuracy rather than merely approximating the likelihood function. Candidate expressions are evaluated on held-out datasets and selected using a criterion that jointly accounts for expression complexity, parameter-recovery performance, and distributional distance from the learned likelihood. We evaluate the pipeline on the diffusion decision model, a classical cognitive model, whose analytically tractable likelihood provides ground truth for controlled evaluation. The proposed recovery-directed objective improves parameter recovery over standard symbolic-regression objectives. The resulting symbolic likelihoods enable over 100 times faster parameter evaluation than both neural likelihoods and, when available, the exact likelihood, while maintaining a manageable loss in precision. We further demonstrate these computational benefits in Bayesian hierarchical inference on empirical data. Our pipeline provides a lightweight interface for integrating symbolic distillation with existing neural-likelihood estimation methods and can be adapted to a range of simulation-based inference settings.

</details>


### [751] [Distributionally Robust Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning: Finite-Sample Guarantees under Weak Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32727)
*Chenyu Lu,Zijun Chen,Nian Si*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究弱通信条件下平均奖励准则的分布鲁棒强化学习（DR-RL），给出鲁棒最优平均奖励估计与近优策略学习的有限样本保证，覆盖SA/S矩形结构与基于散度/距离的不确定集，并提出免先验知识算法及样本复杂度界，数值实验验证了 $n^{-1/2}$ 收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DR-RL理论多集中于折扣准则，平均奖励准则下的有限样本分析尚不充分；同时弱通信条件比通信条件更一般，且不同不确定集（散度型与距离型）对鲁棒平均奖励Bellman方程常增益解的存在性影响未被系统刻画，亟需建立统一的理论框架与样本复杂度保证。

Method: 在平均奖励、弱通信设定下研究DR-RL，同时处理SA矩形与S矩形结构，以及基于散度和基于距离的不确定集。对KL与 $f_k$-散度球，推导使鲁棒平均奖励Bellman方程存在常增益解的显式半径条件；对全变差与Wasserstein球，证明任意正半径即足够且无需名义MDP弱通信。提出免先验知识算法，并给出 $\operatorname{Span}(u_δ^{\ast})$ 的近紧显式上界。

Result: 算法在估计鲁棒最优平均奖励时达到 $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-1}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$ 的样本复杂度，学习 $ε$-最优策略时为 $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-2}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$；其中 $p_{\wedge}$ 为最小正名义转移概率，$u_δ^{\ast}$ 为鲁棒最优偏差函数。并给出 $\operatorname{Span}(u_δ^{\ast})$ 的几乎紧显式上界，数值实验验证了预测的 $n^{-1/2}$ 收敛率。

Conclusion: 该工作为弱通信平均奖励DR-RL提供了统一的有限样本理论，明确了不同不确定集下常增益解的存在条件，给出了免先验知识算法及其近最优样本复杂度，并通过显式偏差跨度上界与数值实验验证了理论速率。

Abstract: We study distributionally robust reinforcement learning (DR-RL) in the average-reward setting under weak communication. Our main result provides finite-sample guarantees for estimating the robust optimal average reward and learning a near-optimal policy, covering both SA-rectangular and S-rectangular structures with divergence-based and distance-based uncertainty sets. Specifically, for Kullback--Leibler and $f_k$-divergence balls, we establish explicit radius conditions under which the robust average-reward Bellman equation admits a constant-gain solution, while for total variation and Wasserstein balls, any positive radius suffices without requiring the nominal MDP to be weakly communicating. Our algorithm is prior-knowledge-free and achieves sample complexities of $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-1}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$ for estimating the robust optimal average reward and $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-2}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$ for learning an $ε$-optimal policy. Here, $p_{\wedge}$ is the smallest positive nominal transition probability and $u_δ^{\ast}$ is a robust optimal bias function. We further provide an almost-tight explicit upper bound on $\operatorname{Span}(u_δ^{\ast})$. Finally, we validate the predicted $n^{-1/2}$ convergence rate through numerical experiments.

</details>


### [752] [Generative Priors Conditioned on Natural Language for Bayesian Inversion in PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32941)
*Pengyu Zhang,Mark Girolami,Arnaud Vadeboncoeur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用成对的定性文本与定量QoI数据学习自然语言条件的贝叶斯先验，结合少量噪声传感读数进行推理与不确定性量化，提出条件扩散与条件自编码器两条并行路线，并在热方程、Helmholtz方程与英国气象再分析数据上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学工程中推断QoI时常同时拥有定量数据（噪声传感、仿真、再分析）与定性数据（实验设置文本、预期结果、人类感知的系统行为），但如何将定性文本与定量观测协同用于推理和UQ仍缺乏系统方法。

Method: 将问题设定为：给定成对定性文本与定量QoI训练集，学习数据驱动、以自然语言为条件的贝叶斯先验；在新系统上融合训练集、新系统文本描述与少量噪声传感读数执行推理与UQ。采用两条并行方法——条件扩散模型与条件自编码器，并与经典贝叶斯方法、无条件生成模型及确定性监督方法对比。

Result: 条件自编码器具备理论可解性、可快速后验采样且UQ校准更好；条件扩散在表达能力和捕捉不规则QoI场的复杂后验方面更强。两种方法各有优势与权衡。在稳态热方程、阻尼Helmholtz方程和英国气象再分析数据上进行了测试。

Conclusion: 语言条件生成式先验可有效融合文本与稀疏噪声观测，实现可靠的QoI推理与不确定性量化；条件自编码器与条件扩散形成互补，应根据后验复杂度与UQ校准需求权衡选择。

Abstract: Inferring quantities of interest (QoI) from data is a central task in Science and Engineering. In such contexts, we often have access to both quantitative data and qualitative data. Quantitative data may be represented by noisy sensor measurements, simulation data, re-analysis data; qualitative data may be in the form of text descriptions of experimental setups, expected experiment outcomes, and human-perceived system behaviours. The task we address in this paper is the following. Given a training set of paired qualitative text and quantitative QoI data, we learn to exploit the inherent correlation between the two modalities to learn a highly informative data-driven natural-language-conditional Bayesian prior, such that when presented with a new physical system, we can coherently combine (i) the training dataset, (ii) qualitative text describing the new system, and (iii) a small number of noisy sensor readings from that new system, to perform inference and uncertainty quantification (UQ) over the QoI. To achieve this task, we develop two parallel approaches, one uses conditional diffusion and the other conditional autoencoders, and compare both against classical Bayesian methodology, unconditional generative models and deterministic supervised methods. Each approach has specific strengths and tradeoffs; conditional autoencoder offers theoretical tractability, allows for fast posterior sampling, and provides better-calibrated UQ, whereas conditional diffusion is explored for greater expressiveness and capturing complex posteriors with irregular QoI fields. The approach is tested on the steady-state heat equation, damped Helmholtz equation, and UK weather reanalysis data.

</details>


### [753] [Efficient Message Passing for Partial Differential Equation Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32956)
*Anna Kazachkova,Leonhard Hennicke,Rainer Schlosser,Ralf Herbrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用因子图上的概率推断求解偏微分方程（PDE）：以PDE作为显式因子编码先验，观测数据塑造参数后验，基于矩匹配的消息传递进行近似推断，无需后验采样或全局梯度优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实物理量的先验信息最自然地由PDE表达，但如何在求解PDE时融合先验与观测数据并量化不确定性，仍缺乏高效的概率框架。

Method: 将控制PDE作为显式因子编码进因子图，从而约束解空间，观测数据进一步塑造参数后验；采用基于矩匹配的消息传递推断近似参数后验，不进行后验采样或全局梯度优化。

Result: 在一阶平流方程与二阶半线性Fisher-KPP方程上验证：预测精度与标准baseline相当，并能给出结构化的预测不确定性；其后验边缘均值与不确定性结构比所评估的均值场变分推断更接近Hamiltonian Monte Carlo结果，训练时间最多减少10倍，推断速度与变分推断相当。

Conclusion: 因子图上的矩匹配消息传递为PDE求解提供了一种高效的概率推断途径，在保持精度与推断速度的同时，获得更接近采样的不确定性刻画并显著降低训练开销。

Abstract: Prior information for real-world physical quantities is most elegantly expressed via partial differential equations (PDEs). In this paper, we propose a novel way to solve PDEs using probabilistic inference on a factor graph. In general, factor graphs provide a natural way to encode prior knowledge into a model as explicit factors; here, this knowledge is provided by a governing PDE, which narrows the solution space, while observed data further shape the posterior over the parameters. The approximate parameter posterior is inferred using message passing based on moment matching, without posterior sampling or global gradient-based optimization. We demonstrate our approach on the first-order advection and the second-order semi-linear Fisher-KPP equations, where it achieves predictive accuracy comparable to a standard baseline while providing structured predictive uncertainty. Moreover, the inferred posterior marginal means and uncertainty structure match more closely those obtained using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo than the evaluated mean-field variational inference baseline, while requiring up to 10x less training time in our experiments, with inference speed comparable to variational inference.

</details>


### [754] [Low-Rank Single-Index Bandits with Unknown Links: From Matrices to Tensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33025)
*Zhongxuan Liu,Yue Kang,Thomas C. M. Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究未知共享Lipschitz链接函数与低秩索引参数下的随机矩阵/张量bandit问题，提出T-ESTOR（单调链接）与T-BSTOR（非单调链接）算法，分别实现√T级和T^{2/3}级最优遗憾率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩矩阵/张量bandit依赖已知奖励链接函数，而单索引bandit虽可处理未知链接却未直接利用矩阵/张量秩结构，二者之间存在研究空白。

Method: 在已知正则候选分布与有限方差噪声下：(1) 针对单调链接，T-ESTOR将秩自适应鲁棒Stein估计与基于epoch的贪心选择结合；(2) 针对非单调链接，在非零基律Stein信号条件下，T-BSTOR将结构化估计与鲁棒分箱学习结合。

Result: 在精确选中分数访问与一致正选中设计Stein信号下，T-ESTOR达到维度依赖由低秩结构决定的平方根遗憾，且单调下界在大horizon下与其秩、维度、horizon依赖（对数因子内）匹配；T-BSTOR对固定维度、菜单规模与模型/设计常数达到最优Õ(T^{2/3})速率。合成数据与CCLE实验验证了结构化估计优于向量化及竞争性单索引基线。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了未知链接与低秩结构结合的理论空白，为矩阵/张量bandit在未知链接下提供了具有最优遗憾保证的算法框架。

Abstract: Low-rank matrix and tensor bandits exploit structured interactions but typically assume a known reward link. Recent single-index bandit methods accommodate unknown links without directly exploiting matrix or tensor rank. We address this gap by studying stochastic matrix and tensor bandits with an unknown shared Lipschitz link and a low-rank index parameter under known regular candidate distributions and finite-variance noise. For monotone links, T-ESTOR combines robust, rank-adaptive Stein estimation with epoch-based greedy selection. Under exact selected-score access and a uniformly positive selected-design Stein signal, it achieves square-root regret with dimension dependence determined by the low-rank structure. For every admissible design, the monotone lower bound matches the rank, dimension, and horizon dependence up to logarithmic factors at large horizons, for fixed menu size and model/design constants. For nonmonotone links under a nonzero base-law Stein signal, T-BSTOR combines structured estimation with robust bin-based learning and attains the optimal $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ horizon rate for fixed dimensions, menu size, and model/design constants. Synthetic and CCLE-based experiments illustrate the benefits of structured estimation relative to vectorized and competing single-index baseline methods.

</details>


### [755] [Simulation-Free Learning of GP-SDEs from Irregular Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33112)
*Zhidi Lin,Yuhao Liu,Ying Li,Edwin Fong,Petar Djurić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GP-SDE Matching，一种免模拟的变分框架，用于贝叶斯GP漂移学习与连续时间状态平滑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GP-SDE虽能对未知连续时间动态做贝叶斯建模并量化不确定性，但从含噪、不规则观测中学习和推断在计算上仍具挑战性。

Method: 解析边缘化稀疏GP后验，推导可处理的漂移匹配目标，同时考虑未知漂移的后验均值与不确定性；并引入不规则时间感知的变分状态后验，在编码与连续时间边缘查询中纳入真实观测时刻。

Result: 在随机Lorenz-63系统上，不规则观测下的漂移恢复与状态重建显著提升；五个系统辨识基准上，在观测稀疏度递增时保持稳健预测，并与现有latent-SDE及状态空间方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: GP-SDE Matching通过免模拟变分推断与不规则时间建模，有效解决了GP-SDE在含噪不规则观测下的计算与推断难题。

Abstract: Gaussian process stochastic differential equations (GP-SDEs) provide a flexible Bayesian model for unknown continuous-time state dynamics with uncertainty quantification, but learning and inference from noisy and irregular observations remain computationally challenging. To address this issue, we propose GP-SDE Matching, a simulation-free variational framework for Bayesian GP drift learning and continuous-time state smoothing. We analytically marginalize the sparse GP posterior to derive a tractable drift-matching objective that accounts for both the posterior mean and uncertainty of the unknown drift. To handle irregular observations, we further introduce an irregular-time-aware variational state posterior that incorporates the actual observation times during both encoding and continuous-time marginal querying. Experiments on the stochastic Lorenz--63 system demonstrate substantially improved drift recovery and state reconstruction under irregular observations, while five system identification benchmarks show robust forecasting under increasing observation sparsity and competitive performance against existing latent-SDE and state-space methods.

</details>


### [756] [Minimax-Optimality of Posterior Sampling for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33246)
*Taewon Goo,Kihyuk Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了未经修改的朴素 PSRL 在任意相关先验下即可达到极小极大最优的贝叶斯遗憾，无需对先验做结构假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PSRL 是简单有效的探索方法，但"未经修改的 PSRL 是否能在不对先验做结构假设的前提下达到极小极大遗憾"这一基本问题一直悬而未决。

Method: 核心难点在于后验采样的转移模型与其自身延续价值相耦合；作者引入一个公共经验转移参考来隔离由此产生的价值失配，并用基于 Bellman 的方差论证加以控制，且不引入额外的高阶状态空间因子。

Result: 对于有限时域、时间非齐次、带未知随机奖励的表格 MDP，在奖励与转移的任意联合先验下取得 minimax Õ(√(SAH³K)) 遗憾率；同一证明原理对线性混合 MDP 在任意联合参数先验下给出 minimax Õ(d√(H³K)) 遗憾率。

Conclusion: 精确的朴素 PSRL 在任意相关先验下均为极小极大最优（主导阶贝叶斯遗憾），回答了该开放问题。

Abstract: Posterior sampling for reinforcement learning (PSRL) is one of the simplest and most effective exploration methods, but a basic question has remained open: does unmodified PSRL achieve minimax regret without structural assumptions on the prior? We answer yes. Exact vanilla PSRL is minimax optimal in leading-order Bayesian regret under arbitrary correlated priors. The difficulty is that a posterior-sampled transition model is coupled with its own continuation value. We overcome this with a common empirical transition reference that isolates the resulting value mismatch and a Bellman-based variance argument that controls it without an extra leading-order state-space factor. For finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous tabular MDPs with unknown stochastic rewards, this yields the minimax $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$ regret rate under arbitrary joint priors over rewards and transitions. The same proof principle gives the minimax $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{H^3K})$ rate for linear-mixture MDPs under arbitrary joint parameter priors.

</details>


### [757] [SLP-ProbHard: Probabilistic Hard-Constrained Learning via Structural Latent Parameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33515)
*Wondesen Teshome Bekele,Marco D'Oria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SLP-ProbHard框架，以结构化可行潜参数化（SFLP）直接在可行坐标中生成概率预测，保证每次随机实现都严格满足约束，并在仿射、序约束、单纯形、非线性流形及FDC数据上验证其维度、标定与表达能力权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有硬约束概率预测方法先在环境坐标中生成预测，再通过修正或投影使其可行，导致约束仅作为事后包装，未内嵌于预测分布本身；作者希望研究可行坐标与可行映射如何影响随机维度、依赖性、标定、表达能力和计算，并论证仅靠精确可行性并不能唯一确定预测律。

Method: 引入跨族、以表示为中心的SLP-ProbHard框架，其核心为结构可行潜参数化（SFLP）：将结构潜律 Z ~ P^Z_θ(·|x) 与可行映射 Y=h_φ(x,Z) 结合，使约束对每个潜变量实现均成立，从而直接定义预测律（含支撑集与边界概率）。实验采用高斯潜律与固定几何导出映射，覆盖仿射等式、序约束、单纯形、非线性流形，以及七流域水文流量历时曲线（FDC）数据的三种结构表示。

Result: 在官方来源的仿射对比中，SLP-ProbHard与ProbHardE2E/DPPL均实现零实际约束违反；SLP-ProbHard使用8个而非11个随机坐标，改善MSE/MAE，而DPPL获得更好的边缘CRPS和更接近名义的覆盖率；配对检验在十个随机种子上未检测到Energy Score差异。真实仿射与非线性FDC表示分别将环境坐标与计算坐标从13降至7、从14降至8。

Conclusion: 精确可行性本身不足以确定预测律，因此当存在有意义的可行坐标时，应直接进行结构化生成；SFLP通过将约束内嵌于潜生成过程，在保持零约束违反的同时实现维度缩减并影响标定与表达能力。

Abstract: Many probabilistic predictors must satisfy exact structure in every stochastic realization, yet common hard-constraint approaches form predictions in ambient coordinates and then correct or project them. We introduce SLP-ProbHard, a cross-family, representation-centered framework for probabilistic hard-constrained learning when explicit structural parameterizations are available. Its core object, a Structural Feasible Latent Parameterization (SFLP), combines a structural latent law $Z \sim P^Z_θ(\cdot\mid x)$ with a feasible map $Y=h_φ(x,Z)$ that satisfies the constraint for every latent realization. Together these components define the predictive law itself, including its support and boundary probabilities, rather than serving as a final feasibility wrapper. We study how feasible coordinates and maps affect stochastic dimension, dependence, calibration, expressiveness, and computation. Experiments use Gaussian latent laws and fixed geometry-derived maps across affine equalities, ordering and simplex constraints, nonlinear manifolds, and three structural representations of seven-basin hydrological flow-duration-curve (FDC) data. In an official-source affine comparison with ProbHardE2E/DPPL, both methods achieve zero practical constraint violations. SLP-ProbHard uses 8 instead of 11 stochastic coordinates and improves MSE/MAE, while DPPL yields better marginal CRPS and closer-to-nominal coverage; a paired test detects no Energy Score difference across ten seeds. Real-world affine and nonlinear FDC representations reduce 13 to 7 and 14 to 8 ambient versus computational coordinates, respectively. Exact feasibility alone thus does not determine a predictive law, motivating direct structural generation when meaningful feasible coordinates are available.

</details>


### [758] [Correct then Forecast: Observer State-Space Models for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33566)
*Alexis-Raja Brachet,Guillaume Clavier--Frémond,Abdelhakim Ziani,Pierre-Yves Richard,Céline Hudelot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Observer State-Space Models (OSSMs)，将观测时间序列视为对潜在自主动力系统的测量，显式分离状态传播与测量校正，在预测阶段观测缺失时避免动力学突变，统一了多种SSM解释，并在多个基准上以相同参数量取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环预测模型把观测作为直接控制潜在动态的输入，导致在预测时观测不可用时发生动力学“体制切换”（regime change），破坏预测连续性。作者希望从状态估计视角重构循环预测，使观测仅用于校正状态而非驱动动态。

Method: 提出 OSSM 框架：单一状态转移负责上下文与预测区间内的潜在状态传播；观测通过观测器（observer）校正估计状态，显式分离“潜在状态传播”与“测量同化”。框架自然暴露可控性/可观性与估计误差收敛等控制论性质，并证明传统及近期 SSM 均可作为 OSSM 的特例被还原。

Result: 在多个基准实验中，OSSMs 在与对应 SSM 基线相同的参数数量和训练设置下取得显著性能提升；同时给出对既有 SSM 循环动态的统一解释，并揭示其建模不一致性。

Conclusion: 支持一条简单的循环预测原则：观测应校正估计的潜在状态，而非控制用于传播它的动态。

Abstract: Time series forecasting requires extrapolating the dynamics of an observed process beyond the last available measurement. Yet recurrent forecasting models typically treat observations as inputs that directly control their latent dynamics. It leads to a regime change when these observations become unavailable at prediction time. Following a state-estimation perspective, we introduce Observer State-Space Models (OSSMs), a class of recurrent models that interprets the observed input time series as measurements of an underlying autonomous dynamical system. OSSMs explicitly separate latent-state propagation from measurement assimilation: a single transition governs the dynamics across both context and forecasting intervals, while available observations correct the estimated state through an observer. This formulation naturally exposes classical control-theoretic properties, including observability and convergence of the state estimation error. We further show that conventional and recent SSMs can be recovered as particular instances of our OSSM framework, thereby providing a unified interpretation of their recurrent dynamics and revealing modeling inconsistencies. We perform experiments across several benchmarks showing that OSSM achieves substantial improvements while maintaining the same parameter count and training setup as the corresponding SSM baseline. These results support a simple principle for recurrent forecasting: observations should correct the estimated latent state, rather than control the dynamics used to propagate it.

</details>


### [759] [Quantifying Behavioral Tails in Black-Box Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33638)
*Elsayed Eshra,Ali Al-Lawati,Dongwon Lee,Suhang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RareTrap：一种在黑箱大语言模型中估计严重行为概率的框架，通过代理LLM将低维潜空间几何映射到token嵌入空间以构造可复现的提示分布，并结合响应级性能函数进行罕见事件模拟，仅需约200次评估即可估计严重资源消耗行为的概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率估计的关键难题在于：输入空间（提示空间）上的分布难以tractable地定义，而严重行为本身概率极低，直接测量代价高昂甚至不可行。因此需要一种能在明确且可复现的输入分布下、高效集中评估于高严重度行为的方法。

Method: RareTrap使用代理LLM，构造从低维潜参考空间到其token嵌入空间的几何感知映射，从而在提示上诱导出显式且可复现的分布；同时采用响应级性能函数量化行为严重度，并据此进行序贯罕见事件模拟，将评估逐步集中于更严重的行为，同时保持在诱导提示分布下的概率估计无偏。

Result: 在10个开放权重模型和两个前沿模型（GPT-5.4与Claude Sonnet 4.6）上验证，RareTrap能够成功诱导严重资源消耗行为，并以少至200次评估计算出其发生概率。

Conclusion: RareTrap为模型开发者提供了一种在统一分布下评估语言模型的原则性方法，有助于优先分配对齐工作，从而提升安全性并降低风险。

Abstract: We introduce RareTrap, a framework for estimating the probability of severe behaviors in black box large language models (LLMs). A key challenge for probability estimation is defining a tractable distribution over the input space. To accomplish that, RareTrap uses a surrogate LLM and constructs a geometry-aware mapping from a lower-dimensional latent reference space into its token-embedding space to induce an explicit and reproducible distribution over input prompts. A response-level performance function is utilized on the response to quantify behavior severity. This enables sequential rare event simulation that concentrates evaluations on progressively more severe behaviors while preserving probability under the induced prompt distribution, which would otherwise be prohibitive to measure. Across 10 open-weight and two frontier models (GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet 4.6), we find that RareTrap successfully induces severe resource consumption behaviors and computes their probability with as few as 200 evaluations. RareTrap provides model developers a principled approach for evaluating language models under a common distribution, and prioritizing alignment effort to improve safety and mitigate risks. Code is published online: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rare_trap-D7F0.

</details>


### [760] [Benign Overfitting for General Norms and Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33675)
*Daniel Barzilai,Ohad Shamir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了分析线性回归中"良性过拟合"（benign overfitting）的一般方法，适用于任意范数和一般亚高斯分布，突破了此前仅限欧氏范数与高斯分布的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 良性过拟合是理解预测器为何能在插值噪声数据的同时保持泛化的核心问题。现有工作多研究最小2-范数线性回归，反映梯度下降的归纳偏置；而Adam、Muon等现代优化器采用非欧氏更新几何，偏好与其他范数相关的解。然而非欧氏范数的回归分析极为困难，已有结论基本局限于高斯分布。

Method: 作者发展了一套分析线性回归良性过拟合的通用方法，适用于一般范数和一般（亚高斯）分布。其证明核心是分析对偶优化问题的几何结构，利用集中不等式与中心极限定理工具，证明在高维情形下该对偶问题在近似意义上是欧氏的。

Result: 作为特例，论文证明当p>1时，最小p-范数插值在适当条件下即使对非高斯分布也能实现良性过拟合。但令人惊讶的是，对于1-范数，良性过拟合在行为良好（但非高斯）的分布下一般不成立，表明已有的1-范数正面结果关键依赖于高斯性。

Conclusion: 论文将良性过拟合理论从欧氏范数、高斯分布的框架推广到一般范数和亚高斯分布，揭示了范数选择与分布假设之间的深刻联系，特别是1-范数结果的成立与否高度依赖高斯性。

Abstract: Understanding why predictors can generalize despite interpolating noisy training data is a central puzzle in machine learning. Most work on such "benign overfitting" studies minimum-2-norm linear regression, reflecting the inductive bias of gradient descent. However, modern optimizers such as Adam and Muon use non-Euclidean update geometries, favoring solutions associated with other norms. Analyzing regression for non-Euclidean norms is substantially more difficult, with known results essentially limited to Gaussians. In this paper, we develop a method to analyze benign overfitting in linear regression for general norms and general (sub-Gaussian) distributions. As a special case, we prove that minimum-p-norm interpolation with p>1 can benignly overfit even for non-Gaussian distributions, under suitable conditions. Perhaps surprisingly, for the 1-norm, benign overfitting does not hold in general for well-behaved (but non-Gaussian) distributions, showing that existing positive 1-norm results rely crucially on Gaussianity. Our proof analyzes the geometry of the dual optimization problem, using concentration and central limit tools to show it is approximately Euclidean in many high-dimensional cases.

</details>


### [761] [Oracle-Efficient Online Classification with Stochastic Inputs and Adversarial Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33760)
*Gon Buzaglo,Elad Hazan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究带上下文的自适应二分类预测问题，提出一种基于高斯扰动的Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader算法，以每轮一次优化预言机调用、无需显式枚举专家类的方式达到最优期望遗憾界，并解决了Lazaric与Munos (2012)提出的公开问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 背景是上下文二分类预测中专家数N可能极大甚至为无限假设类，传统方法需要显式枚举或多次优化调用，计算代价高。已有结果留下公开问题：混合分类能否在计算上与统计学习同样高效。本文旨在证明混合分类的计算复杂度可与统计学习相匹配，即在不枚举专家类、每轮仅一次优化调用下达到最优遗憾界。

Method: 在i.i.d.上下文、损失自适应选择的设定下，采用简单的Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader算法，对每个观测到的上下文施加高斯扰动。该方法每轮仅需一次优化预言机调用，且不显式枚举专家类。对有限N个专家，分析期望遗憾；对无限假设类H，进一步结合VC维刻画遗憾界。

Result: 对N个专家类，算法达到最优的Õ(√(T log N))期望遗憾；对无限假设类H，达到Õ(√(T·VC(H)))遗憾。算法每轮仅一次优化调用且无需枚举专家类，从而证明混合分类在计算上如统计学习一样容易，解决了Lazaric和Munos (2012)的公开问题。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，借助高斯扰动的Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader，可在计算效率上实现与统计最优相匹配的上下文二分类预测，弥合了混合分类与统计学习之间的计算鸿沟。

Abstract: We consider contextual binary prediction with i.i.d. contexts from an unknown distribution and adaptively chosen losses. We show that a simple Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader algorithm with Gaussian perturbation for each observed context achieves the optimal $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ expected regret for a class of $N$ experts, while requiring one optimization-oracle call per round and no explicit enumeration of the class. For an infinite hypothesis class $\mathcal H$, the algorithm attains $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal H)})$ regret. This resolves an open problem posed by Lazaric and Munos (2012), showing that hybrid classification is computationally as easy as statistical learning.

</details>


### [762] [Posterior Regimes and Latent Deception: Variational Bayesian Inference in Hidden Markov Models for Sequential Fraud Detection in Financial Transactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34031)
*Joseph Uririoghene Obukofe,Anthony O'Hare,Chioma Sandra Dike*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出三级隐马尔可夫模型（Baum-Welch、VBEM、Neural VBEM）来建模客户交易行为轨迹，识别与欺诈相关的潜在行为模式，并揭示模型输出的后验概率常被误当作欺诈概率，从而提出校正评分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交易欺诈检测中需要可解释的潜在行为建模，而非仅依赖判别式排序模型；同时现有方法容易将潜在状态成员后验概率误读为欺诈概率，导致校准错误。

Method: 构建三级HMM递进框架：最大似然（Baum-Welch）、变分贝叶斯（VBEM）及神经变分扩展（Neural VBEM）。Neural VBEM用学习编码器替代固定高斯-多项发射族，将741维交易表示压缩为64维潜在空间，并在其中执行VBEM后验推断；采用UMAP投影分析潜在空间结构。区分批量（平滑）推理与滤波（前向）推理，并提出校正的后验预测评分以缓解“状态成员解释误差”（MRIE）。

Result: 在IEEE-CIS交易数据上，神经层级在其识别出的状态中实现14.4倍欺诈富集；其AUPRC低于判别式XGBoost基线，但作者论证该差距是结构性的而非偶然。UMAP显示发现的状态并非离散簇，而是单一连续行为流形上的有序片段，确认欺诈集中于极端端。

Conclusion: 该模型更适合作为校准的分流（triage）与可解释性层，而非直接替代排序模型；校正的后验预测评分可弥合大部分校准差距。

Abstract: We present a three-tier progression of Hidden Markov Models: maximum-likelihood (Baum-Welch), variational Bayesian (VBEM), and a neural variational extension (Neural VBEM), that model each customer's transaction history as a trajectory through a small number of latent behavioural regimes, one of which is empirically identified as fraud-associated. The Neural VBEM HMM replaces the fixed Gaussian-multinomial emission family with a learned encoder, compressing a 741-dimensional transaction representation into a 64-dimensional latent space in which the VBEM HMM's posterior operates; a UMAP projection of this space reveals that the discovered regimes are not discrete clusters but ordered segments of a single continuous behavioural manifold, with confirmed fraud concentrated at its extreme. We show that the model's natural output, that is, the posterior probability of regime membership, is routinely mistaken for a fraud probability, and quantify the resulting miscalibration (the regime-membership interpretation error, MRIE); a corrected posterior-predictive score, closes most of this gap. We further distinguish batch (smoothed) inference, which uses look-ahead unavailable at deployment time, from filtered (forward-only) inference, and report both. On IEEE-CIS transaction data, the neural tier achieves a 14.4$\times$ fraud enrichment in its identified regime; while its AUPRC trails a discriminative XGBoost baseline, we show this gap is structural and not incidental, and argue the model is best positioned as a calibrated triage and interpretability layer rather than a drop-in ranking replacement.

</details>


### [763] [ABC-Align: Prediction-Powered Alignment with Adaptive Bias Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34374)
*Eric Frankel,Banghua Zhu,Sewoong Oh,Lillian J. Ratliff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ABC-Align，利用大量伪标签信号降低方差，并用小规模人工标注子集进行轻量自适应校正，校正强度通过插件式偏差-方差估计在训练中自动调节，在人工反馈稀缺的 LLM 对齐任务上优于现有半监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型后训练依赖人工偏好数据，成本高、难扩展；RLAIF 等利用伪标签的方法虽数据充足，却引入系统性偏差，损害下游对齐。现有通用半监督方法虽可用少量人工标注校正教师偏差，但在人工标注稀缺时方差很大。

Method: 提出 ABC-Align：借助丰富的伪标签信号最小化方差，同时基于人工标注子集施加轻量、自适应的校正；校正强度在训练过程中通过相关偏差-方差量的插件估计自动调节。

Result: 在人工反馈稀缺条件下，于 RLHF、DPO、GRPO 的 LLM 对齐任务上，随规模递增的一系列实验表明 ABC-Align 性能优于此前的半监督基线。代码已开源。

Conclusion: ABC-Align 通过“伪标签降方差 + 人工子集自适应偏差校正”的框架，有效缓解了稀缺人工反馈下的高方差问题，为可扩展的 LLM 对齐后训练提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Language model post-training is often bottlenecked by the need for human-collected preference data, which is expensive and difficult to scale. Reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) style approaches that leverage pseudo labels offer an abundant alternative but introduce systematic biases that degrade downstream alignment. Recent general-purpose semi-supervised methods correct for teacher bias using a small set of human-labeled examples, but suffer from high variance especially when human annotations are scarce. To this end, we propose ABC-Align, leveraging abundant pseudo label signal to minimize variance and applying a lightweight, adaptive correction grounded in the human-labeled subset. The correction strength is tuned automatically during training using plug-in estimates of the relevant bias--variance quantities. On LLM alignment with RLHF, DPO, and GRPO where human feedback is scarce, we empirically demonstrate that ABC-Align achieves superior performance over prior semi-supervised baselines in a series of experiments on an increasing scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/SewoongLab/abc-align .

</details>


### [764] [On the Relation Between Interval Regret and Dynamic Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34423)
*Yi-Han Wang,Peng Zhao,Zhi-Hua Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明区间遗憾与动态遗憾之间不存在度量层面的蕴含关系，即最优区间遗憾算法未必能达到最优动态遗憾；并提出通过扩大可行域并结合域转换代理损失的归约方法，利用局部自适应性实现最优动态遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳在线学习中，静态遗憾不足以指导变化环境下的算法设计，因此引入了区间遗憾与动态遗憾两种代表性指标。学界长期基于"局部保证应自然诱导全局保证"的直觉，认为区间遗憾是更强的概念，并普遍猜测最优区间遗憾算法会自动获得最优动态遗憾，但二者关系一直不明确。

Method: 首先给出反面结果，构造反例以反驳度量层面的蕴含关系：针对凸函数以及曲率函数（包括exp-concave与强凸函数），证明存在实例使得具有最优区间遗憾的算法仍无法达到最优动态遗憾。随后提出利用局部自适应性获得最优动态遗憾的方法：在一个包含原凸可行域的扩大欧氏球上运行区间遗憾最小化过程，并使用合适的域转换代理损失（domain-converted surrogate loss）。

Result: 证明了最优区间遗憾不蕴含最优动态遗憾这一否定性结论，适用于凸函数与曲率函数；所提出的归约方法在凸函数与曲率函数两类情形下均能实现最优动态遗憾；作为副产品，首次给出了exp-concave函数下具有最优动态遗憾的proper且高效算法，改进了已有结果并显著简化了分析。

Conclusion: 区间遗憾与动态遗憾在度量层面互不蕴含，局部最优区间遗憾保证不足以自动带来全局最优动态遗憾；但通过扩大可行域与域转换代理损失的归约，可借助局部自适应性达到最优动态遗憾，并首次为exp-concave函数提供proper高效的动态遗憾最优算法。

Abstract: Non-stationary online learning has attracted much attention in recent years, as static regret is insufficient to guide algorithm design in changing environments. To address this limitation, interval regret and dynamic regret have been introduced as two representative performance metrics that strengthen static regret in complementary directions. Interval regret requires an online algorithm to achieve competitive static regret over every local time interval, whereas dynamic regret evaluates performance against an arbitrary sequence of time-varying comparators. Despite their importance, the relation between these metrics has long remained unclear. Prior work has often regarded interval regret as the stronger notion, based on the intuition that local guarantees should naturally induce global guarantees. Consequently, it is widely conjectured that an algorithm with optimal interval regret should automatically attain optimal dynamic regret. In this paper, we first establish a negative result that refutes this intuition of a metric-level implication. Specifically, for both convex and curved functions (including exp-concave and strongly convex functions), we show that there exist instances in which an algorithm with optimal interval regret nevertheless fails to achieve optimal dynamic regret. We then show how to leverage local adaptivity to obtain optimal dynamic regret. In particular, optimal dynamic regret can be attained by invoking an interval regret minimization process over an enlarged Euclidean ball containing the original convex feasible domain and using a suitable domain-converted surrogate loss. This reduction applies to both convex and curved functions. As a byproduct, we obtain the first proper and efficient algorithm with optimal dynamic regret for exp-concave functions, improving prior results while significantly simplifying the analysis.

</details>


### [765] [Deep Weighted Bellman Residual Minimization for $Q^*$ Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34593)
*Lican Kang,Jerry Zhijian Yang,Cheng Yuan,Chen Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离线强化学习中的离策略评估问题，提出一种加权Bellman残差最小化框架，通过密度比加权融合专家演示与行为数据，建立了密度比估计的尖锐收敛率及深度Q*估计器超额风险的收敛率，实验表明在数值性能与策略泛化上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习使用预收集数据集评估与优化策略，但常面临分布偏移、Q值高估及样本利用效率低等突出问题，需在理论与方法层面加以解决。

Method: 提出加权Bellman残差最小化框架，采用密度比加权，将专家演示与行为数据有效整合；该加权方案摆脱了深度强化学习理论分析中常设的完备性假设。

Result: 建立了密度比估计的尖锐收敛率，推导出所得深度Q*估计器超额风险的收敛率；大量实验显示，相比现有方法在数值性能与策略泛化上取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 所提方法为专家演示的合理利用提供了具体指导，验证了加权Bellman残差最小化在离线策略评估中的有效性与理论保证。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation is a foundational component of offline reinforcement learning, aiming to assess and optimize policy performance using pre-collected datasets. However, such datasets often suffer from pronounced challenges, including distribution shift, $Q$-value overestimation, and low sample utilization efficiency. To address these issues, this paper introduces a weighted Bellman residual minimization framework that incorporates density ratio weighting by effectively integrating expert demonstrations with behavioral data. The proposed weighting scheme departs from the conventional completeness assumption commonly imposed in the theoretical analysis of deep reinforcement learning. We establish a sharp convergence rate for density ratio estimation and derive the convergence rate for the excess risk of resulting deep $Q^*$ estimator. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that, compared to existing methods, our method achieves significant improvements in numerical performance and policy generalization, providing specific guidance for the rational utilization of expert demonstrations.

</details>


### [766] [Uniform Race: Parameter-Free Approximate Rejection Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34639)
*Seiyun Shin,Juhyeong Pang,Kwang-Sung Jun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究近似采样问题，提出一种无需参数、基于重要性权重的"均匀竞赛"(UR)算法：将每个观测权重除以独立均匀随机变量形成得分，返回得分最大的候选。该算法在任意预算N下同时满足所有固定阈值M的拒绝采样(RS)上界，实现事后最优保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Block与Polyanskiy(2023)给出了近似拒绝采样的有限预算误差界，该界依赖接受阈值M，而最优M取决于目标π与提议μ的性质，这些性质通常无法从观测样本中获得。因此自然的问题是：能否在不将M作为输入的情况下，达到最优的RS保证？

Method: 提出无参数采样的均匀竞赛(UR)算法。利用重要性权重（目标与提议概率或密度之比），将每个观测权重除以一个独立的均匀随机变量构成得分，返回得分最大的候选。理论分析包括：UR的输出分布（在给定最大得分条件下）刻画、与预算校准RS及SIR的TV误差比较，以及唯一性刻画。

Result: 对每个预算N，UR的总变差误差同时满足所有固定阈值M的RS上界，达到事后最优；刻画了其条件输出分布，并识别出何时输出恰为目标π；UR的TV误差不大于Rohatgi等(2025)的自然预算校准RS与SIR；给出UR误差在N上指数级更小的实例；建立唯一性条件，说明欲对所有(π,μ)达到该RS保证，选择概率唯一确定为UR的概率。LLM数学推理任务的测试时扩展实验验证了理论比较，UR在无需阈值选择下仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: UR实现了参数自由的近似采样，事后达到最优RS保证，优于预算校准RS与SIR，并具有唯一性刻画；LLM实验证实其理论与实用价值。

Abstract: We study approximate sampling: given $N$ independent samples from a proposal distribution $μ$, the goal is to select one whose distribution is close to a target $π$ specified only up to a normalizing constant. Block and Polyanskiy (2023) provide finite budget error bounds for approximate rejection sampling (RS) as a function of the acceptance threshold $M$. The threshold $M$ giving the smallest bound, however, depends on properties of $(π,μ)$ that are typically unavailable from the observed sample. This raises a natural question: Can one attain the best RS guarantee without taking $M$ as input? We answer affirmatively by proposing a parameter-free sampling algorithm called uniform race (UR), based on importance weights, which are ratios of target to proposal probabilities (or densities). It divides each observed weight by an independent uniform random variable to form a score and returns the candidate with the largest score.
