For every budget $N$, its total variation error satisfies the RS upper bound for every fixed threshold $M$ simultaneously, thereby achieving the best such bound in hindsight. We also characterize its output distribution conditional on the largest score, identifying when it is exactly the target $π$. Uniform race has no larger total variation error than a natural budget-calibrated RS derived from Rohatgi et al. (2025) and sampling importance resampling (SIR). In particular, we exhibit instances where UR's error is exponentially smaller in $N$ than that of either baseline. Furthermore, we establish conditions under which attaining this RS guarantee for every $(π,μ)$ uniquely determines the selection probabilities as those of UR. Finally, test-time scaling experiments on LLM math-reasoning tasks corroborate the theoretical comparisons and demonstrate that UR remains competitive in ground-truth accuracy without requiring threshold selection.

</details>


### [767] [Fast Learning Rate Transfer in Shallow Linear Networks at Growing Training Horizons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35029)
*Mana Sakai,Masaaki Imaizumi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在 fast hyperparameter transfer 框架下研究增长训练时域下浅层线性网络的学习率迁移，证明当 T=o(√n) 时快速迁移成立，并刻画迁移速率及其极限分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超参数跨模型宽度迁移可显著降低大网络调参成本，但训练时域随宽度增长时的迁移行为尚不清楚，需要给出快速迁移的适用条件。

Method: 在含单个可训练隐矩阵的浅层线性网络上，采用全批量梯度下降，并在额外谱假设下分析有限宽度扰动尺度、损失及其学习率导数的一阶敏感性和局部损失曲率。

Result: (i) 当 n,T→∞ 且 T=o(√n) 时证明快速学习率迁移；(ii) 通过有限宽度扰动尺度、一阶敏感性与局部曲率刻画迁移速率；(iii) 导出最优学习率与优化损失的极限分布，由数据 Gram 矩阵极端特征值的涨落支配。

Conclusion: 谱结构与局部损失敏感性共同决定增长时域下的学习率迁移行为，为宽度增长场景的超参数迁移提供了理论条件与速率刻画。

Abstract: Hyperparameter transfer across model width can substantially reduce the cost of tuning large neural networks, but its behavior when the training horizon grows with width is not fully understood. Building on the framework of fast hyperparameter transfer (Ghosh et al., 2026), which formalizes when transfer is effective, we investigate conditions that ensure fast transfer in the growing-horizon regime. Specifically, we study learning-rate transfer in a shallow linear network with a single trainable hidden matrix, trained by full-batch gradient descent. Under additional spectral assumptions, our main results are threefold. (i) We prove fast learning-rate transfer as $n,T\to\infty$ whenever $T=o(\sqrt{n})$. (ii) We characterize the transfer rates through the finite-width perturbation scale, the first-order sensitivities of the loss and its learning-rate derivative to finite-width perturbations, and the local loss curvature. (iii) We derive limiting distributions for the optimal learning rate and optimized loss, governed by fluctuations associated with the extreme eigenvalues of the data Gram matrix. These results clarify how spectral structure and local loss sensitivities govern learning-rate transfer at growing horizons.

</details>


### [768] [Universality and Generalization of Causal Transformers Across Context Lengths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35055)
*Takashi Furuya,Maarten V. de Hoop,Gabriel Peyré*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究单个掩码Transformer能否用与长度无关的参数，对任意长度序列上的因果token到token映射实现一致逼近，并给出均值场极限下的逼近与泛化界，实验支持Hölder正则token模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表达能力结果通常针对每个固定序列长度选择不同网络，缺乏对同一Transformer在任意长度序列上一致逼近因果映射的分析；需要建立跨采样分辨率的连续性刻画，以判定哪些因果族可被长度无关参数的单Transformer一致逼近。

Method: 用α-Hölder序列或一般连续模刻画token；提出跨分辨率连续性概念，刻画可一致逼近的因果族；推广至无限长均值场极限，将token视为连续曲线、掩码注意力化为因果时间积分；对有界回归与β-光滑稳定性条件，进行定量逼近分析，得到在合适规模有界权重Transformer上精确经验风险最小化的泛化界。

Result: 在固定置信度与同一采样分布下，N个iid带标签序列的均方根预测误差为O((log log N/log N)^{β/(d+2)})，d为token维度，且不含最大长度因子；物理时间序列实验在观测尺度上支持Hölder正则token模型，拟合指数依赖数据集；文本输入嵌入呈现相反情形；原生与稠密采样、打乱对照及细化检验界定了该经验正则性范围。

Conclusion: 单一掩码Transformer可用长度无关参数在紧凑输入类上一致逼近满足跨分辨率连续性的因果因果族，并扩展到无限长均值场极限；该逼近理论给出无最大长度因子的泛化界，实验表明物理时间序列符合Hölder正则假设而文本嵌入不符，需通过采样与细化检验界定适用范围。

Abstract: Long contexts are central to modern transformer systems, but most expressivity results choose a different network for each fixed sequence length. We study whether one masked transformer can approximate causal token-to-token maps uniformly over sequences of arbitrary length sampling a fixed normalized horizon. To relate sampling resolutions, we model tokens by $α$-Hölder sequences or, more generally, a common modulus of continuity. Our notion of continuity across resolutions characterizes the causal families admitting uniform approximation on these compact input classes by a single transformer with length-independent parameters. The result extends to the infinite-length mean-field limit, where tokens form continuous curves and masked attention becomes a causal time integral. For bounded regression with target maps satisfying a $β$-smooth stability condition defined using regular test functions, quantitative approximation yields a generalization bound: exact empirical risk minimization over suitably sized bounded-weight transformers gives root mean-square prediction error $O((\log\log N/\log N)^{β/(d+2)})$ from $N$ iid labeled sequences. The bound holds at fixed confidence on the same sampling distribution, with $d$ the token dimension and no maximum-length factor. Finally, experiments on physical time series support the Hölder-regular token model at observed scales, with dataset-dependent fitted exponents, whereas text input embeddings provide a contrasting case. Native and dense sampling, shuffled controls, and refinement checks delimit this empirical regularity regime.

</details>


### [769] [Propagate, Then Sharpen: Post-Hoc Refinement of Frozen Node Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35080)
*Preben Johnsen Bentdal,Nello Blaser,Xue-Cheng Tai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Propagate, Then Sharpen（PtS），通过Potts能量分解为Dirichlet项与Gini项，交替执行概率传播与保持质量的锐化，在只访问图结构与冻结模型输出分布的条件下提升节点分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究冻结节点分类器的后处理精炼问题：仅有图G与冻结模型预测的类别分布Q，无法访问节点特征、模型参数或梯度，能否仍提升准确率。已有APPNP通过带重启的logit传播最小化锚定Dirichlet能量，仅处理邻居不一致，未显式处理节点自身的不确定性（犹豫）。

Method: 以Potts能量替代Dirichlet能量，将其分解为惩罚邻居不一致的Dirichlet项与惩罚节点内犹豫的Gini项。据此设计PtS：在类别概率传播与逐节点、保持质量的锐化之间交替，仅需一个额外超参数，并通过有标签的验证节点进行选择。

Result: 在九个同配图上，以冻结MLP为骨干，PtS相比各自调优的APPNP，干净输入平均测试准确率提升1.71个百分点，严重高斯特征损坏下提升3.90个百分点；在冻结GCN与GraphSAGE骨干上增益变小但仍为正。锐化还消除了深度传播的大部分精度损失：无重启时，从2步到100步传播，PtS准确率仅下降2.2个点，而APPNP下降33.8个点。

Conclusion: Potts能量的Dirichlet–Gini分解为冻结分类器的后处理提供有效框架，交替传播与锐化可在不访问特征、参数与梯度的条件下显著提升精度并缓解深度传播的过平滑退化。

Abstract: We study post-hoc refinement of frozen node classifiers: given only the graph $G$ and class distributions $Q$ predicted by a frozen model, can we improve accuracy without access to node features, model parameters, or gradients? APPNP answers this by propagating logits with a restart towards the initial predictions, minimizing the anchored Dirichlet energy. Instead, we consider the Potts energy, and decompose it into a Dirichlet term, which penalizes disagreement between neighbouring nodes, and a Gini term, which penalizes indecision within each node. This decomposition motivates Propagate, Then Sharpen (PtS), which alternates between propagation of class probabilities and node-wise, mass-preserving sharpening, with only one additional hyperparameter selected using labelled validation nodes. Across nine homophilic graphs, with a frozen MLP backbone, PtS improves mean test accuracy over independently tuned APPNP by $1.71$ percentage points on clean inputs and $3.90$ under severe Gaussian feature corruption. Gains over APPNP become smaller, but remain positive with frozen GCN and GraphSAGE backbones. Sharpening also removes most of the accuracy loss of deep propagation: on clean inputs without restart, accuracy falls by $2.2$ points between $2$ and $100$ propagation steps under PtS, compared with $33.8$ for APPNP.

</details>


### [770] [Universal Approximation of Measure-to-Measure Operators by Pushforwards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35483)
*Takashi Furuya,Nicholas H. Nelsen,Frank Cole*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究测度相关的推前模型（measure-dependent pushforward，包含测度论 Transformer）能否在概率测度空间之间逼近任意连续算子。作者证明当允许原子输入时普适逼近失败，并引入"一致水平集条件"，在该条件下证明有限 p 阶矩的连续测度间算子可被连续测度相关推前在 p-Wasserstein 距离下一致逼近，进而得到测度论 Transformer 与类交叉注意力模型的普适逼近结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多学习任务可视为输入分布到输出分布的算子；用依赖整个输入分布的连续函数变换每个样本、再取变换后样本的分布，是建模此类算子的自然方式。作者希望回答：这类模型何时能逼近概率测度空间之间的任意连续算子，并厘清哪些情形下逼近会失效。

Method: 首先构造反例，说明允许原子输入时某些分裂或重分配原子质量的连续测度间算子无法被确定性推前模型任意逼近，即普适逼近失败。随后提出"一致水平集条件"：要求存在一个连续、依赖测度的标量化函数，其收缩的水平集邻域在输入族上携带一致趋于零的质量；紧的绝对连续测度族满足该条件。在此条件下的任意紧族上，对输出具有有限 p 阶矩的连续测度间算子，给出用连续测度相关推前进行一致逼近的定理。将定理与已有的测度相关上下文映射的逼近结果结合，得到测度论 Transformer 的普适逼近；并将框架推广到连续变化的源测度，得到与交叉注意力架构相近的一类推前模型的普适性结果。

Result: 证明了原子输入下确定性推前模型的普适逼近存在本质性障碍；在一致水平集条件满足的紧测度族上，任意输出具有限 p 阶矩的连续测度间算子都能在 p-Wasserstein 距离下被连续测度相关推前一致逼近；由此推出测度论 Transformer 以及一类类交叉注意力推前模型的普适逼近定理。

Conclusion: 连续测度相关推前模型的普适逼近能力依赖于输入测度族的性质：原子输入会破坏普适性，而满足一致水平集条件的紧族（如紧的绝对连续测度族）则保证普适逼近。该结果刻画了测度论 Transformer 与交叉注意力式架构的表达能力边界与保证，并为连续变化源测度的推广提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Many learning tasks map an input distribution to an output distribution. A natural way to model such an operator is to transform each input sample using a continuous function that may depend on the entire input distribution, and then take the distribution of the transformed samples. This defines a measure-dependent pushforward model and includes measure-theoretic formulations of transformers. We ask when such models can approximate arbitrary continuous operators between spaces of probability measures. We first show that universal approximation fails when atomic inputs are allowed: some continuous measure-to-measure operators that split or redistribute atomic mass cannot be approximated arbitrarily well by deterministic pushforward models. We then introduce the uniform level set condition, which requires a continuous measure-dependent scalarization whose shrinking level set neighborhoods carry uniformly vanishing mass over the input family. This condition is satisfied, in particular, by compact families of absolutely continuous measures. On every compact family satisfying this condition, we prove that any continuous measure-to-measure operator with outputs of finite $p$-th moment can be uniformly approximated, in the $p$-Wasserstein distance, by continuous measure-dependent pushforwards. Combining our theorem with existing approximation results for measure-dependent in-context maps yields universal approximation by measure-theoretic transformers. We also extend the framework to continuously-varying source measures, yielding a corresponding universality result for a class of pushforward models that are closely aligned with cross-attention architectures.

</details>


### [771] [Simplex Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35553)
*Justin Deschenaux,Alexandre Galashov,Andrew Campbell,Li Kevin Wenliang,James Thornton,Arnaud Doucet,Valentin De Bortoli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Simplex Diffusion Models (SDMs)，将扩散过程提升到概率单纯形上以表示类别信念，缓解离散扩散中间步骤中的信息坍缩问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续数据扩散模型通过逐步精化信念状态取得巨大成功，但离散扩散模型在中间步骤通过类别采样丢弃不确定性，导致信息坍缩，无法继承这种迭代精化能力。

Method: SDMs 将扩散过程提升至概率单纯形以表示类别上的信念分布，具备闭式反向转移的概率路径，并可用简单交叉熵损失训练。区别于需要求解常微分方程的 Dirichlet Flow Matching，作者提出带有可调随机性的 DDIM 式采样器。

Result: 在 OpenWebText 上，SDMs 在 64 步采样下达到 17.0 GenPPL、5.46 unigram entropy，接近真实验证数据，与强离散扩散基线竞争。在 TinyGSM 代码生成上（T=0.1），未使用 Self-Conditioning 也达到 49.0%，优于 masked/uniform diffusion（含 SC 或 predictor-corrector）的 45.8%。蒸馏到 8 步后，SDMs 在 GSM8K 上解决 32.1%，超过 128 步蒸馏离散扩散模型的 21.4%。

Conclusion: SDMs 通过在单纯形上保留跨去噪步骤的不确定性，有效缓解信息坍缩，在生成质量与少步数推理效率上均优于现有离散扩散方法。

Abstract: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative modeling for continuous data through the gradual refinement of a belief state. This iterative refinement has not yet carried over to discrete diffusion models, which discard uncertainty at intermediate steps through categorical sampling (information collapse). We propose Simplex Diffusion Models (SDMs), a framework that lifts the diffusion process to the probability simplex to represent beliefs over categories. SDMs admit probability paths with closed-form reverse transitions and can be trained with a simple cross-entropy loss. Contrary to earlier proposals such as Dirichlet Flow Matching which requires integrating an ordinary differential equation, we introduce a DDIM-like sampler with a tunable level of stochasticity. Because SDMs operate on samples on the simplex, they can carry uncertainty across denoising steps, which mitigates information collapse. On OpenWebText, SDMs are competitive with strong Discrete Diffusion baselines, achieving $17.0$ GenPPL at $5.46$ unigram entropy in 64 sampling steps, close to real validation data. Even without Self-Conditioning (SC), SDMs outperform masked and uniform diffusion (with SC or predictor-corrector sampling) on code generation (TinyGSM, $T=0.1$; $49.0\%$ vs. $45.8\%$). Distilled down to 8 steps, SDMs solve $32.1\%$ of GSM8K problems, more than distilled Discrete Diffusion models with 128 steps ($21.4\%$).

</details>


### [772] [Control-Geometry Straightening for Sampling-Based Latent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35603)
*Ziang Fu,Ning Ning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS)，一种仅依赖局部"像素-动作"转移的辅助损失，通过让潜在差分之间的成对余弦相似度对齐动作之间的成对余弦相似度，直接"拉直"控制几何，从而在采样预算有限时提升规划效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）虽能以潜在世界模型进行规划，但仅提高转移预测的准确性并不保证规划目标易于优化；现有方法多关注表征的预测精度或时间拉直，未直接针对"控制几何"塑形，导致采样式规划在有限候选与迭代预算下效率受限。

Method: 提出单一辅助损失 CGS：仅用像素-动作对产生的局部转移，将动作两两之间的余弦相似度匹配到对应潜在差分两两之间的余弦相似度，从而直接拉直控制几何。该损失可接口端到端学习或预训练表征，并可跨多种世界模型架构应用。理论层面在线性动力学假设下，将目标与时间拉直及全规划时域上更均衡的终端代价曲率建立联系。

Result: 理论上给出 MPPI 的有限预算保证、CEM 的局部收缩结果，以及梯度下降的收敛界。实验覆盖四个控制环境与多种规划器：在每次更新 128 个候选的采样式规划设置下，成功率相较 LeWorldModel (LeWM) 与其时间拉直变体 (LeWM+TS) 分别最高提升 20 与 12.6 个百分点，并在更少采样候选与精化步数下改善规划。

Conclusion: 探针分析、与 DINO-WM 架构的对比以及规划器侧消融，阐明了潜在运动组织、状态依赖性与动力学上下文如何影响规划行为。结果表明，拉直控制几何能使好的动作序列在有限规划预算下更易被找到。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures enable planning with latent world models, but accurate transition prediction alone does not ensure that the planning objective is easy to optimize. We introduce Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), a single auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly representations by directly straightening control geometry for sampling-efficient planning. CGS matches pairwise cosine similarities among actions to those among corresponding latent differences only using local transitions from pixel-action pairs. The loss can be applied across world-model architectures using end-to-end learned or pretrained representations. Under linear-dynamics, our theoretical analysis connects this objective to temporal straightening and more balanced terminal-cost curvature across the full planning horizon, yielding finite-budget guarantees for MPPI, local contraction results for CEM, and convergence bounds for gradient descent. Across four control environments and multiple planners, CGS improves planning with fewer sampled candidates and refinement steps, achieving success-rate gains up to 20 and 12.6 percentage points over LeWorldModel (LeWM) and its temporal-straightening variant (LeWM+TS), respectively, with sampling-based planners using 128 candidates per update. Probes, comparisons with DINO-WM architecture, and planner-side ablations clarify how latent motion organization, state dependence, and dynamical context shape planning behavior. Straightening control geometry thus makes good action sequences easier to find under limited planning budgets.

</details>


### [773] [When Keywords Drop but Classifiers Hold: Soft Refusals under KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31678)
*Kang Chen,Xiuze Zhou,Hong Chen,Yuanguo Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在长上下文KV缓存压缩场景下，关键词拒绝率会显著下降，而分类器拒绝率与任务准确率基本不变；应使用多评委而非仅依赖关键词率进行安全审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存压缩广泛用于显存受限的长上下文LLM推理，而部署系统常用关键词过滤器或学习型分类器在生成后判定拒绝。这类监控器意在反映模型在实际服务机制下是否拒绝有害请求。但目前尚不清楚：在保持任务准确率不变的匹配压缩条件下，轻量词汇监控器与更强拒绝分类器之间的一致性是否也能被保持。

Method: 采用配对实验协议，n=200条有害提示搭配长填充上下文。每条提示在共享prefill后分别以全量保留和匹配驱逐（matched eviction）各作答一次，同一批回复由关键词启发式、HarmBench Llama-2-13B分类器、辅助LLM评委打分，并由人类对分歧样本进行标注。同时在短填充与配对SnapKV条件下进行对照。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B上，关键词拒绝率从98.0%降至80.5%（McNemar p~1e-8），而分类器拒绝率仍接近上限（99.0%–99.5%），MMLU准确率保持不变（50.0%）；人类标注主要与分类器一致，符合软拒绝（soft refusals）现象。该差距并非普遍存在，在短填充与配对SnapKV下会减弱。

Conclusion: 压缩条件下的安全审计不应只看关键词拒绝率，而应依赖多种与具体服务上下文相匹配的评委方法。

Abstract: KV cache compression is widely used for long context LLM inference under memory constraints, while deployed systems typically score refusals after generation with keyword filters or learned classifiers. Such monitors are intended to indicate whether a model declined a harmful request under the serving regime actually used. However, it remains unclear whether matched compression that preserves task accuracy also preserves agreement between lightweight lexical monitors and stronger refusal classifiers. We study this with a paired protocol on n=200 harmful prompts with a long filler context: each prompt is answered once under full retention and once under matched eviction after a shared prefill, and the same replies are scored by keyword heuristics, the HarmBench Llama-2-13B classifier, an auxiliary LLM judge, and humans on disagreements. On Qwen2.5-3B, keyword refusal falls from 98.0% to 80.5% (McNemar p~1e-8) while classifier refusal stays near ceiling (99.0%-99.5%) and MMLU accuracy is unchanged (50.0%); human labels predominantly follow the classifier, consistent with soft refusals. The gap is not universal and weakens under short fillers and paired SnapKV, so safety auditing under compression should rely on several judges matched to the serving context rather than on keyword rates alone.

</details>


### [774] [HM-ROUTER: Joint Model and Harness Routing for Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32213)
*Hao Mark Chen,Royson Lee,Yasuyuki Okoshi,Dimitris Anastasiou,Wayne Luk,Hongxiang Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HM-Router，一种对每个查询联合选择基础模型与执行harness的路由方法，通过共享表示与CP张量分解式交互项建模二者兼容性，从而利用已观测组合的训练样本预测未观测组合，在293条路由基准上平均路由准确率超最强学习基线7.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent性能同时取决于底层模型与负责工具调用和执行的harness，选择合适组合需考虑二者兼容性；然而训练样本往往仅覆盖不断增长的组合空间的一个子集，导致大量未观测组合无法直接获得监督信号。

Method: HM-Router对每个查询联合选择模型与harness；学习跨路由共享的独立模型表示与harness表示，并引入受canonical polyadic（CP）张量分解启发的交互项，以刻画二者的兼容性如何随查询变化；该共享机制使已观测组合对的训练样本能够为未观测组合提供预测信息。

Result: 基于12个公开agent基准构建了涵盖293条路由、73个模型和25个harness的基准；HM-Router平均路由准确率超最强已评估学习基线7.3个百分点，并在六基准子集的全部七个成本预算下领先；当90%路由的训练结果被遮蔽时，允许未观测组合相较仅限已观测路由的同一路由器将归一化准确率提升15.8个百分点；同时在新路由与新组件上展现出训练样本效率，并对未见基准具有泛化能力。

Conclusion: 联合建模模型与harness选择并显式刻画其查询相关兼容性，可有效利用部分观测的组合空间实现向未观测组合和未见基准的外推，为agent系统的模型-harness组合路由提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Agent performance depends on both the underlying model and the harness that manages its tool use and execution. Selecting a suitable pair requires accounting for their compatibility, yet training samples may cover only a subset of the growing combination space. We introduce HM-Router, a routing method that jointly selects a model and harness for each query. It learns separate model and harness representations shared across routes, with an interaction term inspired by canonical polyadic (CP) tensor decomposition to capture how their compatibility varies with the query. This sharing allows training samples from observed pairs to inform predictions for unobserved combinations. We curate a benchmark from 12 public agent benchmarks, covering 293 routes, 73 models, and 25 harnesses. HM-Router exceeds the strongest evaluated learned baseline by 7.3 percentage points in mean routing accuracy and leads at all seven evaluated cost budgets on the six-benchmark subset. When 90% of routes have their training outcomes withheld, allowing unobserved combinations improves normalized accuracy by 15.8 points over restricting the same router to observed routes. HM-Router has also demonstrated training sample efficiency for new routes and components and generalization to unseen benchmarks. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/hmarkc/HM-Router.

</details>


### [775] [What Can a Leaderboard Certify? Compositional Controllability for Fair Evaluation and Training of Biomedical Literature-Review Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32318)
*Zhaowei Han,Xiang Zhang,Lingxiao Guan,Danqi Hu,Kai Liu,Kevin Chang,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"组合式可控性"(compositional controllability)框架，用于判断长时程智能体(agent)之间的评分比较是否可比，并给出可认证的排序区间；同时发布BioLitBench基准，用其验证SCRITE/SCRIBE在匹配证据条件下的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排行榜仅依据最终输出对长时程智能体排序，但高分并不能说明两个系统是否可比、或差异来自哪个阶段。证据、输入或预算的不对等会影响分数，而统计校正无法消除这种不匹配。因此需要一种在查看分数之前就能判定比较是否可接受的方法，并能定位到具体阶段。

Method: 提出"组合式可控性"：定义比较窗口(comparison window)，可覆盖单个阶段、多个阶段或整个智能体；核心结果是用仅位于窗口之外的干扰项(nuisance)来界定观测分数差与受控分数差之间的差距，由此得到在查看分数前施加的"可接受性检验"(admissibility test)。对不可接受的比较予以拒绝；对可接受的配对，仅当分数差超过采样半径与干扰半径之和时才认证排序，否则记为未定；据此为每个系统给出排序区间(rank interval)。构建BioLitBench基准：2,042篇生物医学文章表示为结构化论点图(claim graphs)。

Result: 在7个已发表流水线中，传统统计分析在21组两两比较中有14组宣告胜者，但排名第一的系统是唯一拿到目标综述参考文献的系统。该检验要求匹配输入与固定骨干模型，拒绝21组中的11组，包括所有涉及该第一名系统的比较；14个传统结论中有7个落入被拒绝配对。相同比较窗口支持阶段级训练：在Qwen3.8-27B上以各阶段出口测得的奖励训练SCRITE。在匹配证据下，SCRITE获得认证排序区间[1,2]，对全部已评估的已发表流水线及已评估的Claude与OpenAI智能体均具认证优势；在同一池内，SCRITE与最强的已发表检索器持平，并认证优于三个已发表流水线。

Conclusion: 仅凭最终分数的排行榜排序不足以保证系统间可比性；组合式可控性通过窗口化检验与排序区间，将"谁更好"转化为可认证或未定的判断，并能暴露因证据不等造成的伪优势。BioLitBench上的实验表明，传统统计结论中相当一部分不可接受，而在匹配证据与固定骨干条件下，SCRITE取得了可认证的领先区间。

Abstract: Leaderboards rank long-horizon agents by their final outputs. Yet a higher score alone does not establish whether two systems are comparable or which stage accounts for the difference. Unequal evidence, inputs, or budgets can affect scores, and statistical corrections do not remove this mismatch. We introduce compositional controllability to address these questions. A comparison window covers one stage, several stages, or the whole agent. Our central result bounds the gap between observed and controlled score differences using only nuisance outside the window. This yields an admissibility test applied before scores are inspected. Inadmissible comparisons are refused. For admissible pairs, an ordering is certified only when the score gap exceeds the combined sampling and nuisance radii; otherwise, it remains undecided. These decisions give each system a rank interval. We introduce BioLitBench, a benchmark of 2,042 biomedical articles represented as structured claim graphs. Among seven published pipelines, a conventional statistical analysis declares a winner in 14 of 21 pairwise comparisons. Yet the top-ranked system alone received the target review's bibliography. To isolate pipeline performance, our test requires matched inputs and a fixed backbone model. It refuses 11 of the 21 comparisons, including every comparison involving the top-ranked system. Seven of the 14 conventional conclusions fall within these refused pairs. The same comparison windows support stage-level training. We train SCRIBE on Qwen3.8-27B using rewards measured at each stage's exit. Under matched evidence, SCRIBE achieves a certified rank interval of [1,2], with certified advantages over all evaluated published pipelines and the evaluated Claude and OpenAI agents. Under same pool, SCRIBE matches the strongest published retriever and is certified above three published pipelines.

</details>


### [776] [Black-Box Auditing of Epistemic Reliability in Multi-Agent Debate Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32361)
*Derui Wang,Zewei Shi,Rayne Holland,Ruoxi Sun,Xingliang Yuan,Jason Xue,Liming Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究辩论蒸馏中的"认知可靠性退化"问题：适应后验证器在受监控任务上保持性能，但在隐藏任务上对正确回答的支持下降。作者提出ER-Audit两阶段黑盒审计框架，通过对比适应前后的冻结验证器检查点，并引入配对监控/隐藏任务基准，配合随时有效的非退化概率下置信界，检测被总体性能提升掩盖的选择性退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辩论蒸馏用多智能体辩论记录微调较弱验证器，可提升其后续辩论判断力，但在监控任务上的收益无法保证其在相关未监控任务上的可靠性。作者关注"认知可靠性退化"：适应可能维持监控性能，却削弱对隐藏任务中正确回答的支持。核心问题包括：这种退化是否仅由灾难性遗忘造成，以及标准评估能否检测到它。

Method: 作者提出ER-Audit，一种两阶段黑盒审计框架，比较适应前后冻结的验证器检查点；并设计两个基准，将监控任务与隐藏任务提示基于共享语境配对。框架通过评估语义有效的改写寻找非退化的反例，若未找到，则用独立改写进行序贯假设检验。作者推导了非退化概率的随时有效下置信界，支持在有限预算内进行数据依赖的停止；并建立固定改写分布下的通用下界，并将其扩展到与混合分布总变差距离有界的分布。此外，考虑一个对抗性辩论者，在维护正确监控回答的同时操纵辩论论据。

Result: 实验表明，更高的隐藏任务准确率可以与更多非退化反例及更低非退化下界同时存在。这种背离挑战了仅由广泛灾难性遗忘所解释的观点，说明审计能够揭示被总体性能提升所掩盖的选择性隐藏任务退化。

Conclusion: 多智能体辩论蒸馏带来的监控任务性能提升并不等同于未监控任务上的可靠性。ER-Audit能够以黑盒、随时有效的方式检测选择性隐藏任务退化，揭示总体性能指标掩盖的可靠性损失。代码与基准已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Debate distillation adapts weaker verifiers using multi-agent debate transcripts to improve their judgement in subsequent debates, but gains on monitored tasks do not establish reliability on related unmonitored tasks. We study epistemic reliability degradation, in which adaptation preserves monitored performance while reducing support for correct responses on hidden tasks. We consider an adversarial debater that manipulates debate arguments while defending the correct monitored response, and ask whether the resulting degradation merely reflects catastrophic forgetting and whether standard evaluation can detect it. To address these questions, we propose ER-Audit, a two-stage black-box auditing framework that compares frozen verifier checkpoints before and after adaptation, and introduce two evaluation benchmarks pairing monitored and hidden task prompts grounded in shared contexts. ER-Audit searches for counterexamples to non-degradation by evaluating semantically valid paraphrases and, if none is found, uses independent paraphrases for sequential hypothesis testing. We derive anytime-valid lower confidence bounds on the non-degradation probability, allowing data-dependent stopping within a finite budget. We further establish a common lower bound across fixed paraphrase distributions and extend it to distributions within a bounded total variation distance of their mixtures. Our experiments show that higher hidden-task accuracy can coexist with more counterexamples to non-degradation and lower non-degradation bounds. This divergence challenges explanations based solely on broad catastrophic forgetting and shows that auditing can uncover selective hidden-task degradation concealed by aggregate performance gains. Our code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/CSIRO-CQS-AI-alignment-Team/Epistemic-Reliability-Auditor.

</details>


### [777] [Activation Flow: Manufacturing Activations for Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32530)
*Hong Kiat Tan,Linh Le,David Williams-King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ActFlow通过对k个正确标签制造激活，无需微调即可解锁沙袋模型，k=40时将锁定模型平均准确率从0.05提升至0.85。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差异均值（difference-in-means）引导需要模型表现出目标行为时记录的激活，而沙袋模型会故意表现不佳从而隐藏这类激活。因此需要一种无需这类激活即可生成引导方向的方法。

Method: ActFlow设定目标logits使每个已标注样本的正确答案排名第一，并在某一层向所有k个残差流加入同一向量x，使logits向其移动。其核心是一族关于x的常微分方程，每个方程对应一种将所需logit变化映射为x速度的规则；最小范数规则精确命中目标，其余规则仅保留雅可比矩阵的顶部奇异方向。

Result: 在三个指令微调模型上测试（分别用沙袋提示与密码锁定LoRA锁定）。k=40时，保留五个奇异方向的ActFlow将六个锁定模型的留出ARC-Easy平均准确率从0.05提升至0.85，接近微调的0.88与诚实模型的0.92；在18种锁定模型与k组合中有16种优于最小范数规则；其引导方向与诚实的差异均值方向近乎正交；并在诚实方向失效的两个LoRA锁上成功解锁。

Conclusion: ActFlow无需微调、仅凭少量正确标签即可高效解锁沙袋及密码锁定模型，且其引导方向与诚实差异均值方向正交，表明其捕捉到不同的机制。

Abstract: Difference-in-means steering requires activations recorded while a model shows the desired behavior, which a sandbagging model withholds by deliberately underperforming. We introduce Activation Flow (ActFlow), which manufactures these activations from $k$ correct labels without fine-tuning. ActFlow sets target logits that rank each labeled item's correct answer first, and moves the logits toward them by adding one vector $x$ to all $k$ residual streams at one layer. ActFlow is a family of ordinary differential equations for $x$, one for each rule that maps the required logit change to the velocity of $x$. The smallest-norm rule lands exactly on the targets, while the others keep only the top singular directions of the Jacobian. We test ActFlow on three instruction-tuned models, each locked by a sandbagging prompt and by a password-locked LoRA. At $k=40$, ActFlow keeping five singular directions raises the mean held-out ARC-Easy accuracy over the six locked models from $0.05$ to $0.85$, against $0.88$ for fine-tuning and $0.92$ for the honest models. Furthermore, it scores higher than the smallest-norm rule in 16 of the 18 combinations of locked model and $k$, and its steering direction is nearly orthogonal to the honest difference-in-means direction. It also unlocks two LoRA locks where the honest direction fails.

</details>


### [778] [Shared Autoregressive Context Can Distort Relationships in Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32546)
*Thomas S. Robinson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在自回归补全中一次生成多条记录（shared-completion batching）会扭曲合成数据中变量间关系：每请求生成10个而非1个受访者，使国家内相关系数平均绝对误差上升48–58%（Qwen3.8-27B）与114–127%（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct）；此前答案作为上下文是因果通道，隐藏可降低相关误差但损害边际准确性，故提示构造本身属于数据生成过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可在一次自回归补全中生成多条记录，使先前回答成为后续记录的上下文。这种共享补全批量生成可能改变合成数据中变量间关系，但该风险尚未被系统刻画。作者希望检验"请求构造"是否本身就是数据生成过程的一部分，并明确合成数据有效性应针对其预期支持的分析来评估。

Method: 以合成调查受访者为受控测试对象：在2,000份欧洲社会调查（ESS）档案上做匹配实验，每请求生成10个 vs 1个受访者，固定档案、示例、问题与解码参数，跨三个随机种子比较；并通过控制干预（在档案与边际分布固定下重新配对相同的前置数值、隐藏前置答案）识别"答案历史"的因果作用；另在社会态度、健康与经济数据上做探索性校正。

Result: 每请求生成10个受访者使国家内相关系数平均绝对误差上升48–58%（Qwen3.8-27B）和114–127%（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct）；扭曲主要表现为关系强度被夸大，但仍与人类相关系数排序保持较高一致性。重配对前置数值会改变后续回答的相关性，证实答案历史是因果通道；隐藏前置答案可降低相关误差，但边际准确性变差。探索性校正显示较低相关误差可与更差的边际分布及回归估计并存。

Conclusion: 请求构造（如批量大小与上下文安排）是数据生成过程的组成部分，会系统影响合成数据的变量关系结构。合成数据有效性不能只看边际分布，必须针对其预期支持的下游分析（相关性、回归等）进行评估；边际准确性与关系准确性之间存在权衡。

Abstract: Large language models can generate several records within one autoregressive completion, making earlier answers available as context for later records. This paper shows that such shared-completion batching can distort relationships among variables in the resulting synthetic data, using controlled tests on synthetic survey respondents. In a matched experiment on 2,000 European Social Survey profiles, generating ten rather than one respondent per request increases mean absolute error in within-country correlations by 48-58% for Qwen3.8-27B and 114-127% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across three seeds, holding profiles, examples, questions and decoding parameters fixed. The distortion primarily reflects exaggerated relationship strength, while retaining substantial agreement with the human ordering of correlations. Controlled interventions establish answer history as a causal channel: re-pairing the same preceding values, with profiles and marginal distributions fixed, changes correlations among subsequently generated responses. Hiding preceding answers reduces correlation error in the tested settings but worsens marginal accuracy. Exploratory corrections across social-attitude, health and economic data likewise show that lower correlation error can coexist with worse marginal distributions and regression estimates. Request construction is therefore part of the data-generating process, and synthetic-data validity must be evaluated against the analyses the generated data are intended to support.

</details>


### [779] [Distance-KV: Exploiting Relative Distance for Efficient Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32663)
*Xianpeng Shang,Canbin Huang,Jiang Li,Tian Lan,Qianyi Cai,Xiaojun Quan,Xiangdong Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Distance-KV通过在层、注意力头、相对距离的联合空间离线学习静态KV保留模式，在冻结LLM的情况下修剪并压缩KV缓存，无需在线重要性打分即可显著降低长上下文推理的内存与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理的内存占用和解码延迟随上下文长度快速增长，现有KV缓存压缩方法基于token重要性或跨头注意力模式差异选择保留状态，但忽略了同一注意力头内部检索能力随相对距离的显著变化。

Method: 提出Distance-KV，在层、注意力头与相对距离构成的联合空间上学习静态KV保留模式。该模式在语言模型冻结条件下离线学习，并可跨输入复用，从而对KV缓存进行修剪与紧凑化，无需在线重要性评分。

Result: 在三个骨干模型与四个长上下文基准上，Distance-KV总体性能持续优于竞争性KV缓存压缩方法，在128K的RULER上超过最强压缩基线最多9.3分；在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的128K设置下，KV缓存内存减少65.4%，相对Dense实现1.66倍解码加速。

Conclusion: 相对距离是理解LLM长上下文信息检索以及设计更高效推理方法的重要结构维度。

Abstract: The memory usage and decoding latency of LLM inference grow rapidly with context length. To reduce these costs, key-value (KV) cache compression methods selectively retain cached states based on token importance or differences in attention patterns across heads. However, we discover that retrieval capability varies substantially with relative distance, even within the same attention head. To exploit this structure, we introduce Distance-KV, which learns a static KV retention pattern over the joint space of layers, attention heads, and relative distances. The pattern is learned offline with the language model frozen and reused across inputs to prune and compact the KV cache without online importance scoring. Across three backbone models and four long-context benchmarks, Distance-KV consistently achieves the best overall performance among competing KV cache compression methods, exceeding the strongest compression baseline by up to 9.3 points on RULER at 128K. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 128K, Distance-KV reduces KV cache memory by 65.4% and achieves a $1.66\times$ decoding speedup relative to Dense. Together, these results identify relative distance as an important structural dimension for understanding how LLMs retrieve information over long contexts and for designing more efficient inference methods.

</details>


### [780] [Understanding and Exploiting Anisotropy in Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32792)
*Samyak Jha,Harshvardhan Saini,Yizhen Liao,Yiming Tang,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示LLM残差流中的各向异性（anisotropy）并非缺陷，而是承担语言建模"连贯性基底"功能的劳动分工；据此提出仅在冻结主干上学习每通道有界增益的SphereGate方法，以极少量参数显著提升推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练结合了SFT（mode-covering的前向KL目标）与RL（mode-seeking的反向KL目标）。频率加权似然训练会产生各向异性：少数残差通道携带异常大的激活。该现象被广泛记录但通常被视为缺陷，其功能及其与后训练的交互机制尚不清楚，因此论文旨在首先分析各向异性的作用，再据此设计训练方法。

Method: 1) 分析层面：提出无标签的离群通道规则（outlier rule），隔离出约5%的残差通道，并通过消融（移除 vs 数量匹配的随机通道）检验其功能；比较SFT与RL对这些通道及互补通道的影响。2) 方法层面：提出SphereGate，在冻结主干上为每个残差通道学习一个有界增益（bounded gain），其激活加权梯度可证明地限制高能量连贯性通道的移动，同时释放其余通道。

Result: 移除约5%的离群通道使困惑度从10升至超过10^6，而数量匹配的随机通道仅为35，说明这些通道对语言建模至关重要；但它们几乎无法区分正确与错误的推理。SFT会重塑这些通道，RL则基本保持其不变并转而适配互补通道。SphereGate仅用0.1M可训练参数，在Qwen2.5（0.5B–7B）与Llama-3-8B上于MATH-500超过参数高效基线2.0–7.3个点，并可媲美或超过全模型GRPO。

Conclusion: 各向异性并非缺陷，而是一种可利用的劳动分工：高能量离群通道构成模型的"连贯性基底"，推理适配发生在其余通道中。基于此洞察的SphereGate以极小参数量实现了高效且有效的推理能力提升。

Abstract: LLM post-training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT), a mode-covering forward-KL objective, with reinforcement learning (RL), a mode-seeking reverse-KL objective. Frequency-weighted likelihood training leaves a well-known signature: \emph{anisotropy}, in which a few residual channels carry disproportionately large activations. Anisotropy is widely documented and usually treated as a defect, yet its function and its interaction with post-training remain unclear. We first analyze it. A label-free outlier rule isolates about 5\% of residual channels that are essential for language modeling: removing them raises perplexity from 10 to over $10^6$, versus 35 for count-matched random channels. Yet they barely distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning. SFT reshapes them, whereas RL leaves them largely intact and adapts the complementary channels. These channels therefore form the model's \emph{coherence substrate}, and reasoning adaptation happens elsewhere. We then exploit this. \textsc{SphereGate} learns one bounded gain per residual channel on a frozen backbone. Its activation-weighted gradients provably limit movement of high-energy coherence channels and leave the remaining channels free. With 0.1M trainable parameters, \textsc{SphereGate} outperforms parameter-efficient baselines by 2.0--7.3 points on MATH-500 across Qwen2.5 (0.5B--7B) and Llama-3-8B, is comparable or exceeds full-model GRPO. Anisotropy is not a defect but a division of labor that post-training can exploit.

</details>


### [781] [Theory of Scene: Breaking the Symmetry Trap in Multi-Agent LLM Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32939)
*Liangqi Yuan,Wenzhi Fang,Shiqiang Wang,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Theory of Scene (ToS)——一种免训练的推理范式，通过让同构LLM智能体读取各自的“公共角色”与共同观察的任务场景，推导出唯一的分工方案，从而将同构性从协调失败的根源转化为解决之道，并在DivvyBench、GovSim、Overcooked三个基准上超越全部六个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统高度同构，不同LLM的智能体行为趋同。当它们无通信地并行行动时，会在需要“分开占有”的目标上撞车、在需要“共同占有”的目标上分散，作者称之为“对称性陷阱”。常用的心智理论（ToM）因同构智能体会对彼此形成相同预测并做出相同反应，无法摆脱该陷阱。

Method: ToS是一种免训练的推理模式：每个智能体读取其公共角色（智能体之间唯一的差异）以及共同观察的任务上下文。其核心由两部分组成——角色门控（role gating）读取角色与场景，判断目标所有权是重叠还是已被划分；任务耦合（task coupling）读取任务上下文，推断团队对每个目标应汇聚、切分还是按阶段轮流处理。

Result: 在作者提出的DivvyBench（目标类型使回合呈现竞争/合作/混合，覆盖桌面、空域、家庭三类场景）以及GovSim与Overcooked两个既有基准上，ToS在所有基准上均优于全部六个基线，且每个基线至少在一种设置下明显落后。与输入相同的ToM相比，ToS将DivvyBench成功率从71.1%提升至99.6%，GovSim总收益从207提升至400，Overcooked关卡归一化吞吐量从1.41提升至1.67。

Conclusion: 同构性并非多智能体协调的固有缺陷；通过显式的角色差异与场景理解，同构智能体可推导出统一分工，使同构性成为协调的基础而非陷阱。ToS无需训练即可在竞争、合作与混合任务中取得稳定且显著的提升。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are largely homogeneous, as their agents behave alike even across distinct LLMs. We show that when such agents act concurrently without communication, they collide on targets they must split and diverge on targets they must take together, a double failure we term the symmetry trap. Theory of Mind (ToM), widely used for coordination without communication, cannot escape this trap, since homogeneous agents form the same prediction of one another and respond to it in the same way. We propose Theory of Scene (ToS), a training-free reasoning schema in which each agent reads its public role, the only difference between the agents, and the task context they all observe. Homogeneous agents thereby derive one division of labor, each taking the part its role fixes, which turns homogeneity from the cause of the trap into the cure. ToS reads the role together with the scene through role gating, which determines whether ownership overlaps or is already divided, and the task context through task coupling, which infers whether the team must converge on each target, divide it, or take its stages in turn. We evaluate on DivvyBench, a controlled environment we introduce, whose target types make an episode Competitive, Cooperative, or Mixed across Tabletop, Airspace, and Household scenarios, and on two established agentic benchmarks, GovSim and Overcooked. ToS outperforms all six baselines on every benchmark, and each baseline falls far behind it in at least one setting. Against ToM given the same inputs, ToS raises the DivvyBench success rate from 71.1% to 99.6%, the GovSim total gain from 207 to 400, and the Overcooked level-normalized throughput from 1.41 to 1.67.

</details>


### [782] [ECG-Scroll: A Long-Horizon, Streaming Benchmark and Agent Environment for Interpretation of Ambulatory Electrocardiograms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33117)
*Haitao Li,Chenglin Li,Zhengyao Ding,Ziyu Li,Yiheng Mao,Zhengxing Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作将长时程心电图（动态/遥测）解读重新定义为长视野在线（流式、因果）序贯决策问题，提出基准与环境 ECG-Scroll：以分块流式方式向智能体输入长时程记录，要求其在不访问未来信号的情况下定位、量化并及时标记阵发性事件，并提供基于规则的可验证奖励及检测延迟指标。发布390个整段记录、共2536小时双导联动态ECG数据，并对信号阈值规则智能体与现成LLM智能体进行在线评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可在标准十秒十二导联ECG上给出有临床依据、经奖励验证的推理，但真实心脏监测场景（动态Holter与遥测）时长从数小时到数天，需边流式到达边读取，且临床决定性发现常为阵发性、短暂、埋藏于整体无异常波形中的事件。这类记录无法在诊断分辨率下整体放入单一上下文，其"未来"尚未发生，因此读取者必须在线工作：决定当前测量什么、在信号流经时把证据写入记忆、并在事件发生时即时报告。现有批式评估范式无法刻画这种在线长视野特性。

Method: 将长时程ECG解读形式化为长视野在线（流式、因果）序贯决策过程，并构建 ECG-Scroll。作为基准：长时程动态记录按块逐步流式输入智能体，智能体须在无未来信号访问条件下定位、量化并及时标记阵发性事件；由于底层信号被保留，每个答案均可对照客观真值检验，从而得到基于规则而非基于评判模型（judge）的奖励，并引入批式评估无法表达的指标——事件起始到智能体记录该事件之间的检测延迟。作为智能体环境：提供固定的 gym 风格交互层，考察单次判读ECG模型从未涉及的三项能力——记忆（Memory）、基于信号测量的工具使用（Tool use，而非读像素）、以及"当前该测什么、何时提交"的规划（Planning）。

Result: 发布390个整段记录实例，覆盖2536小时的双导联动态ECG；在线评测了信号阈值规则智能体与现成LLM智能体，刻画了二者如何使用记忆、工具与规划，并分析了该基准的剩余提升空间（head-room）。

Conclusion: 长时程在线ECG解读应被建模为流式因果的序贯决策任务，需要记忆、信号化工具使用与规划三类能力；ECG-Scroll 通过可验证的规则奖励与检测延迟指标，提供了批式方法无法覆盖的评测维度，并揭示了现有智能体在该设定下的能力边界与改进空间。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now interpret a standard ten-second, twelve-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) with clinically grounded, reward-verified reasoning. Real cardiac monitoring is different. Ambulatory (Holter) and telemetry recordings span hours to days and are read as they stream in, and their clinically decisive findings are paroxysmal, brief episodes buried in an otherwise unremarkable trace. Such a recording cannot be held in one context at diagnostic resolution, and its future has not yet happened, so a reader must work online, deciding what to measure now, committing evidence to memory as it passes, and reporting events as they occur. We recast long-duration ECG interpretation as a long-horizon, online (streaming, causal) sequential decision process and introduce ECG-Scroll. As a benchmark, long ambulatory recordings are streamed to an agent chunk by chunk, and it must localize, quantify, and promptly flag paroxysmal events without access to future signal; because the underlying signal is retained, every answer is checkable against objective ground truth, giving rule-based rather than judge-based rewards, and the streaming formulation adds a metric batch evaluation cannot express, the detection latency between an event's onset and the moment the agent records it. As an agent environment, it is a fixed, gym-style interaction layer that exercises three competencies single-glance ECG models never touch: Memory, Tool use through signal-grounded measurement rather than reading pixels, and Planning of what to measure now and when to commit. We release 390 whole-recording instances spanning 2,536 hours of two-lead ambulatory ECG and evaluate a signal-threshold rule agent alongside off-the-shelf LLM agents online, characterizing how they use memory, tools, and planning and where the benchmark's head-room lies.

</details>


### [783] [Save Your Saturated Data: Learning Beyond Reward Saturation in Group-Based RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33126)
*Ziyuan Yang,Yike Wang,Shangbin Feng,Yulia Tsvetkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究奖励饱和数据在组相对强化学习中的回收利用问题，发现通过在rollout生成阶段引入“高质量但错误”的解作为负样本，可有效恢复学习信号，使GRPO在Qwen3-1.7B和4B上提升6.4%–9.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型能力增强，原有训练数据易出现奖励饱和：同一问题的所有采样回答获得同样高的奖励，组内奖励方差趋零，相对优势估计退化为近零或噪声信号，导致原本有用的数据失效。作者希望探究能否从这类饱和数据中恢复有价值的学习信号，以应对数据日益稀缺的问题。

Method: 作者在组策略RL流程的四个层面（数据、rollout、奖励、优势）设计干预手段，并仅在饱和推理数据上进行大规模RL训练。核心策略是在rollout生成阶段引导策略产出“高质量但错误”的解，从而向饱和组中注入低奖励的负样本，重建非零优势；同时对比提高rollout温度、添加辅助奖励等干预方式。

Result: 标准GRPO在饱和数据上优势几乎恒为零、信号近似噪声。rollout生成层面的干预最为有效且稳定，在Qwen3-1.7B与4B上使GRPO提升6.4%至9.0%。提高温度或添加辅助奖励也能恢复非零优势，但增益一致性较差。分析表明有效负样本需具备信息量丰富的负轨迹；该方法与未饱和数据共用时仍有效，并支持对新饱和样本的迭代回收。

Conclusion: 即便模型能力提升会使更多数据趋于饱和，饱和数据并非无用。通过恰当的干预策略（尤其是引入信息量丰富的错误轨迹作为负样本），可以将其回收为有效的RL训练信号，在数据稀缺环境下具有实用价值。

Abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) relies on reward variation among sampled responses to estimate informative relative advantages. As language models become increasingly capable, existing training data can become reward-saturated: all sampled responses to the same problem might receive equally high rewards, where the group-relative learning signals vanish and leave previously useful data obsolete. In this work, we investigate whether useful learning signals can be recovered from such saturated data. We study interventions at four levels of group-policy RL pipelines---data, rollout, reward, and advantage---and conduct extensive RL training on saturated reasoning data only. While standard GRPO on saturated data would almost always yield near-0 advantages and near-noise signals, diverse interventions successfully recycle and repurpose such data: among the proposed strategies, interventions at rollout generation are consistently most effective: nudging the policy to generate ``high-quality'', incorrect solutions introduces rollouts with poor rewards into saturated groups as negative samples, which turns out to improve GRPO by 6.4% to 9.0% across Qwen3-1.7B and 4B. Other interventions such as increasing rollout temperature or adding auxiliary rewards can also restore non-zero advantages, but yield less consistent gains. Further analyses show that effective negative rollouts require informative negative trajectories, that the method remains effective alongside unsaturated data, and that it supports iterative recycling of newly saturated examples. While increasingly stronger LLMs would render more data as saturated, our results demonstrate that don't waste your saturated data: with the right strategies they can be recycled into useful RL training signals in an increasingly data-scarce world.

</details>


### [784] [AG-CoT: Verified Algorithmic Traces for LLM Program Synthesis on Clifford Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33192)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Chenfeng Cao,Lu Pang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究语言模型生成科学代码时"程序可执行但计算对象错误"的问题，以Clifford电路合成为例，提出目标条件化框架：目标为紧凑带符号稳定子生成元，用精确验证器检查生成的OpenQASM电路，并以验证器校验的AG-CoT轨迹进行监督及验证器过滤的继续训练。结果显示AG-CoT监督使状态等价准确率提升4–6倍，验证器过滤继续训练进一步提升，且Clifford有效性高但状态等价仍低，证明精确验证的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学代码生成可能产出可执行却无法计算目标科学对象的程序。作者希望在一个可精确经典验证的场景（Clifford电路，用于准备量子纠错中的稳定子态）中研究并缓解这一问题。

Method: 采用目标条件化框架：目标以紧凑的带符号稳定子生成元给出，使用精确验证器检查生成的OpenQASM电路；用经验证器检查的Aaronson-Gottesman思维链（AG-CoT）轨迹监督模型，并对验证器接受的模型生成结果进行继续训练。

Result: 在两个独立训练的模型家族（3B与7B）中，AG-CoT监督使贪心解码的状态等价准确率相比仅电路基线提升4–6倍，验证器过滤的继续训练在此基础上还能稳定增益。补充的32B研究显示，监督模型几乎达到完美的语法与Clifford有效性，最强直接模型每目标状态等价率为6.14%，在验证器引导的多候选选择下升至超过10%。

Conclusion: 算法轨迹监督在两个模型家族中带来大幅且统计显著的提升，验证器过滤继续训练还能重复增益；Clifford有效性与状态等价之间的持续差距表明精确验证是必要的——电路可以语法和物理上有效，却准备出错误的量子态。

Abstract: Scientific code generation can produce executable programs that fail to compute the intended scientific object. We study this problem in language-model synthesis of Clifford circuits, which prepare the stabilizer states used in quantum error correction and admit exact classical verification. In our target-conditioned framework, each target is given as compact signed stabilizer generators, and an exact verifier checks the generated OpenQASM circuits. We supervise models with Aaronson-Gottesman chain-of-thought (AG-CoT) traces checked by the verifier, and continue training on model generations that the verifier accepts. Across two independently trained model families (3B and 7B), AG-CoT supervision multiplies greedy-decode state-equivalence accuracy by four to six times over circuit-only baselines, and verifier-filtered continuation training adds a further consistent gain atop both. A complementary 32B study shows that supervised models achieve near-perfect syntax and Clifford validity while the strongest direct model reaches 6.14% state equivalence per target, rising to over 10% under verifier-guided selection with multiple candidates. These results show that algorithmic trace supervision gives a large, statistically significant gain in both model families and that verifier-filtered continuation adds a further repeated gain. The persistent gap between Clifford validity and state equivalence confirms that exact verification is necessary: a circuit can be syntactically and physically valid yet prepare the wrong quantum state.

</details>


### [785] [Teach Yourself Where to Look: On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation for Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33200)
*Safaeid Hossain Arib,Rabeya Akter,Ismam Nur Swapnil,Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi,Md Mofijul Islam,Tasnim Mohiuddin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OPASD，在 on-policy 自蒸馏中引入解条件注意力蒸馏，将教师注意力投影到学生可见位置并重归一化，在多个数学基准上显著提升准确率并降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏仅传递特权教师（可访问已验证解）的稠密 token 分布监督，只迁移了"预测什么"，未直接迁移"关注何处"的上下文注意力信息，监督信号不完整。

Method: 在 token 级监督之外增加解条件注意力蒸馏。由于特权教师可关注学生不可见的已验证解 token，将教师注意力投影到学生可见位置，并对投影后的分布重新归一化，再与学生对齐。

Result: 在 3 种模型规模、4 个竞赛级数学基准上，OPASD 稳定优于仅 token 的 OPSD，平均准确率提升 4.98–8.40 个百分点；避免了仅 token 蒸馏的回复长度膨胀与性能退化，生成 rollout token 减少 73.9%，估计模型计算减少 72.6%，训练加速 1.53 倍。

Conclusion: 解条件注意力提供了互补的监督信号，使 on-policy 自蒸馏更准确、更稳定且更省算力。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation trains reasoning models on their own trajectories using dense token distribution guidance from a privileged teacher with access to a verified solution. This supervision transfers what the teacher predicts without directly transferring where it attends within the preceding context. We introduce On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation (OPASD), which complements token-level supervision with solution-conditioned attention distillation. Because the privileged teacher can attend to verified solution tokens unavailable to the student, OPASD projects teacher attention onto student-visible positions and renormalizes the resulting distribution before alignment. Across three model sizes and four competition-level mathematics benchmarks, OPASD consistently outperforms token-only OPSD, improving average accuracy by 4.98 to 8.40 percentage points. OPASD also avoids the response-length inflation and performance degradation observed with token-only distillation, reducing generated rollout tokens by 73.9% and estimated model compute by 72.6% while training 1.53x faster. These results show that solution-conditioned attention provides a complementary supervision signal that makes on-policy self-distillation more accurate, stable, and compute-efficient.

</details>


### [786] [When Do Models Admit They Are Wrong? Failure Disclosure Is Unstable Under Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33220)
*Steven Y. Feng,Noah D. Goodman,Michael C. Frank,Evan Hubinger,Paul C. Bogdan,Andrew Lampinen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究强化学习（GRPO/PPO）训练后模型的"失败披露"行为：任务准确率稳定，但模型是否承认解题失败却在不同训练run间剧烈波动，且该波动源于训练对其约束过弱，可通过抑制策略漂移来缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于结果的强化学习常被认为只要任务表现一致就可信，但作者关注任务表现之外的安全相关行为是否稳定。核心动机是检验"任务准确率稳定是否等于行为可靠"，为此选取"失败披露"（模型是否承认尝试失败，而非沉默或谎称成功）作为可测量的安全相关行为。

Method: 在仅用结果信号的GRPO下重复训练并对比方差；将现象扩展到第二个推理任务和稳定化PPO；在7B规模和指令条件化的32B设置上验证；通过引入微小浮点与采样差异（固定任务目标与既有训练历史）做因果扰动测试；将失败披露拆解为"检查答案—进入报告—完成承认"三个环节；设置中性对照实验检验弱约束行为的普遍性；并用"在失败但格式良好的响应上抑制策略漂移"的方法尝试降低其变异性。

Result: 失败披露的跨run变异远大于任务准确率，且在第二个推理任务、稳定化PPO、7B及指令条件化32B设置中均复现；微小浮点/采样差异即可在目标与历史不变时改变报告行为；失败披露不是单一决策，检查答案、进入报告、完成承认三个环节可分离，薄弱环节随任务与响应格式变化；中性对照显示被训练弱约束的行为普遍更易跨run波动；抑制失败且格式良好响应上的策略漂移可显著提高报告一致性，但对任务表现的影响依设定而定。

Conclusion: 稳定的任务准确率不能保证安全相关行为的稳定：二者可获得性不同，行为可靠性需被独立测量。研究者应在多次run间直接测量此类行为，并在训练方法设计中显式维持其可靠性。

Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can produce models with similar task performance but very different ways of communicating about their mistakes. We study failure disclosure: whether a model admits that an attempted solution failed rather than staying silent or presenting it as successful. Across repeated outcome-only GRPO training runs, failure disclosure varies far more than task accuracy. The pattern extends to a second reasoning task and stabilized PPO, persists at 7B, and also appears in an instruction-conditioned 32B setting. We also find that small floating-point and sampling differences during training can redirect reporting behavior even when the task objective and earlier training history are held fixed. Additional tests show that failure disclosure is not a single decision: Checking the answer, entering a report, and completing the admission can separate, and the weak point depends on the task and response format. Further, experiments with neutral controls show more broadly that behaviors left weakly constrained by training are especially likely to vary across runs, of which failure disclosure is an example. We can reduce variability in failure disclosure by discouraging the model from drifting from its starting policy on failed, well-formed responses. This makes reporting substantially more consistent, though its effect on task performance depends on the setting. Stable task accuracy therefore does not guarantee stable safety-relevant behavior: Researchers should measure these behaviors directly across runs and design training methods that keep them reliable.

</details>


### [787] [BERT4DTI : BERT-based Model for Predicting Drug-Protein Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33254)
*Thanina Hamitouch,Khadidja Henni,Abdelkrim Arie,Amina Selma Haichour,Neila Mezghani,Lina Abou-Abbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BERT4DTI模型：用ChemBERTa编码SMILES、ProtBERT编码氨基酸序列，通过双向互注意力捕捉配对特异性依赖，再用卷积层与MLP分类，在BIOSNAP/DAVIS/BindingDB上以更少可训练参数取得具竞争力的DTI预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于序列的药物-靶标相互作用（DTI）预测存在三个实际限制：标注交互数据稀缺且分布不均；大规模预训练化学与蛋白编码器端到端微调代价高；独立编码的序列无法捕捉配对特异性依赖。

Method: BERT4DTI：SMILES经ChemBERTa编码、氨基酸序列经ProtBERT编码；在token级表示间施加双向互注意力（mutual attention）；特征经卷积层与多层感知机（MLP）分类。为降低可训练规模，ProtBERT截断至保留18层，且仅微调各编码器最后两层。

Result: 在BIOSNAP、DAVIS、BindingDB上表现具竞争力：BIOSNAP取得最佳ROC-AUC与PR-AUC，三个基准上灵敏度均最高。DAVIS消融实验显示互注意力提升PR-AUC与特异性。可训练参数125M，而完整BERT微调为353M。

Conclusion: BERT4DTI在序列型DTI筛选中提供了性能与参数量的良好权衡；运行时分析、概率校准及防泄漏审计的验证留待未来工作。

Abstract: Understanding how drugs interact with protein targets is fundamental to drug discovery, drug repurposing and the early identification of promising therapeutic candidates before costly experimental testing. Sequence-based DTI models face three practical limitations: labelled interactions are scarce and unevenly distributed, large pretrained chemical and protein encoders are expensive to fine-tune end-to-end, and independently encoded sequences do not capture pair-specific dependencies. We present BERT4DTI, which encodes SMILES strings with ChemBERTa and amino-acid sequences with ProtBERT, applies bidirectional mutual attention between token-level representations, and classifies the resulting interaction features using convolutional layers and a multilayer perceptron. To reduce trainable size, ProtBERT is truncated to 18 retained layers and only the last two layers of each encoder are fine-tuned. On BIOSNAP, DAVIS and BindingDB, BERT4DTI is competitive, achieving the best ROC-AUC and PR-AUC on BIOSNAP and the highest sensitivity on all three benchmarks. An ablation on DAVIS shows that mutual attention improves PR-AUC and specificity. With 125M trainable parameters compared with 353M for full BERT fine-tuning, BERT4DTI provides a favourable performance-parameter trade-off for sequence-based DTI screening, while leaving runtime profiling, calibration and leakage-audited validation for future work.

</details>


### [788] [When to Evict, Not What to Keep: Draft-Guided Eviction for Training-Free KV-Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33334)
*Haeyong Kang,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练KV-cache压缩的新视角：现有方法（SnapKV、H2O、PyramidKV）在prefill结束时即驱逐token，而本文证明该时机本身是性能损失根源。作者提出Draft-Guided Eviction（DGE），将驱逐推迟到用完整缓存草拟前k=2个答案token之后（仅比prefill多一步decode），从而在轨迹信号可用后再做驱逐。DGE不改变每头预算、不修改原有驱逐打分，可直接嫁接于SnapKV/PyramidKV/H2O/StreamingLLM。在六个instruct微调骨干中的五个、所有评测预算下均优于先前方法，LongBench达44.2，逼近FullKV的44.3；仅改变时机的对照DGE-W取得相同分数，证明增益来自“何时驱逐”而非“驱逐什么”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 免训练KV-cache压缩方法（SnapKV、H2O、PyramidKV等）普遍在prefill末尾即驱逐token，其目标是最小化对未来查询注意力质量的扰动，即优化“保留什么”（what to keep）。然而作者实证发现这一目标在两个层面失效：其一为补偿效应（Compensation），即恢复被驱逐的注意力质量可在注意力层面达标，却不能恢复任务质量；其二为选择效应（Selection），即覆盖更多真实decode-query质量时，若恢复的质量是碎片化的、而非集中在连贯span中，反而会损害质量。二者的共同根因是：驱逐发生在决定答案轨迹的查询出现之前。因此需要一种不改变选择打分、仅改变驱逐时机的机制。

Method: 提出Draft-Guided Eviction（DGE）：延迟驱逐，直到使用完整缓存草拟出前k=2个答案token之后（仅比prefill多一个decode step）。由于草稿由答案自身前缀生成，在轨迹信号可用前不丢弃任何缓存条目。每头缓存预算保持不变，DGE可直接应用于SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O与StreamingLLM，无需修改其驱逐打分。与额外前向pass类方法不同，DGE改变的是驱逐发生的时间（when）而非被选中的缓存条目（what）。并设置仅改变时机的对照方法DGE-W（timing-only control）以解耦“时机”与“选择”的贡献。

Result: 在六个instruct微调骨干中的五个、所有评测预算下，DGE均优于先前方法；在LongBench上取得44.2分，几乎追平FullKV的44.3分。仅改变时机的对照DGE-W取得相同分数，表明增益来源于驱逐发生的时机而非所选条目本身——作者将这一效应命名为trajectory anchoring（轨迹锚定）。

Conclusion: KV-cache驱逐的性能瓶颈不仅在于“保留什么”，更在于“何时驱逐”：在答案轨迹确立前驱逐会造成补偿与选择两类失效。DGE通过将驱逐推迟到草拟前k=2个答案token之后，在不改变预算与打分的前提下实现trajectory anchoring，可直接兼容多种主流免训练压缩方法，并在多项长上下文基准上逼近全缓存性能。

Abstract: Training-free KV-cache compression methods such as SnapKV, H2O, and PyramidKV evict tokens at the end of prefill, aiming to preserve the attention mass that future queries are expected to use -optimizing what to keep. We show that this objective fails in two distinct ways. (1) Compensation: restoring the evicted attention mass can recover the attention-level target without recovering task quality. (2) Selection: covering more of the true decode-query mass can hurt quality when the recovered mass is fragmented rather than concentrated in coherent spans. These failures share a common cause: eviction occurs before the queries that determine the answer trajectory exist. We propose Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE), which defers eviction until after drafting the first k=2 answer tokens using the full cache - just one decode step beyond prefill. Because the draft is generated from the answer's own prefix, no cache entries are discarded before this trajectory signal becomes available. The per-head cache budget remains unchanged, and DGE can be applied directly to SnapKV, PyramidKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM without modifying their eviction scores. Unlike extra-pass methods, DGE changes when eviction occurs rather than what cache entries are selected. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGE outperforms prior methods at every evaluated budget on five of six instruct-tuned backbones, achieving 44.2 on LongBench, nearly matching FullKV at 44.3. The timing-only control DGE-W achieves the same score, demonstrating that the gain comes from when eviction occurs rather than what is selected - an effect we term trajectory anchoring.

</details>


### [789] [CalibHyper: Chance-Corrected Relational Hypergraphs for Few-Shot Molecular Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33342)
*Linyu Li,Zhi Jin,Yuanpeng He,Dongming Jin,Huanyu Liu,Huanyao Zhang,Haoran Duan,Heng Tian,Gadeng Luosang,Nyima Tashi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CalibHyper，一种基于联合标签分布的机会校正关系超图方法，用于分子性质少样本预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子性质预测对药物研发和材料发现至关重要，但实验成本高、标注数据稀缺。现有上下文感知方法用辅助测定标签支持少样本预测，并通过标签一致性监督性质关系，然而标签一致性受类别边缘分布影响，且无法直接刻画性质间的依赖关系。

Method: CalibHyper基于联合标签分布进行机会校正：从有序四状态标签分布中减去独立性基线，并依据联合观测数量对残差进行收缩。采用交换等变的关系头估计这些残差，为每个分子选择辅助性质，并确定其超边消息的符号与权重。

Result: 在来自五个基准的十三个数据集上，于1-shot和10-shot设置下，CalibHyper及其消融设置取得的ROC-AUC与已报道的最强结果具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 以联合标签分布的机会校正替代标签一致性，可更直接地建模性质间依赖，在少样本分子性质预测中达到与最强结果相当的ROC-AUC表现。

Abstract: Molecular property prediction is central to drug development and materials discovery, but experiments are costly and labeled data are scarce. Context-aware methods use auxiliary assay labels to support few-shot prediction, and recent work supervises property relations with label agreement. However, label agreement is sensitive to class marginals and does not directly capture dependence between properties. We propose CalibHyper, a chance-corrected relational hypergraph method based on the joint label distribution. CalibHyper subtracts an independence baseline from the ordered four-state label distribution and shrinks the residual according to the number of joint observations. A swap-equivariant relation head estimates these residuals, which choose the auxiliary properties for each molecule and set the sign and weight of their hyperedge messages. On thirteen datasets from five benchmarks, in both 1-shot and 10-shot settings, CalibHyper and its ablation settings achieve ROC-AUC competitive with the strongest reported results.

</details>


### [790] [Decoupling Token Roles in Autoregressive Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33405)
*Suqin Yuan,Runqi Lin,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Junchi Yu,Lei Feng,Chris Russell,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文通过受控损坏实验解耦token的"预测目标"与"上下文"双重角色，发现二者存在反向权衡，并据此解释语言模型生成文本的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归预训练日益依赖异质数据，因此需要理解模型如何从单个token中学习。以往用下一词预测的损失来界定token贡献，但忽略了token同时作为后续内容的上下文这一角色。

Method: 采用受控损坏（controlled corruption）方法，将token作为"预测目标"和作为"上下文"两种角色进行解耦，并对比降低噪声token预测难度对其两种角色损害的影响；同时分析语言模型生成文本中的对应现象。

Result: 发现一种反向效应：使噪声token更容易预测，会减少其作为目标的损害，却增加其作为上下文的损害。在已知损坏位置上，通过上下文施加干预可减少损害，而仅移除token自身损失无法做到这一点。

Conclusion: 理解和控制模型从token中学习的内容，必须解耦其作为预测目标与作为上下文这两种角色。生成文本中，token依前缀拟合被选取，而其上下文角色从未针对独立确定的后续内容受检验。

Abstract: Autoregressive pretraining increasingly draws on heterogeneous data, making it important to understand how a model learns from an individual token. The next-token prediction objective naturally identifies a token's contribution with its own loss. However, each token is not only a prediction target but also context for what follows. Using controlled corruption, we decouple these two roles and find a reversal: making a noisy token easier to predict reduces its damage as a target but increases it as context. The same decoupling helps explain text generated by language models: generation selects each token by its fit to the prefix, while its role as context is never tested against an independently determined continuation, because that continuation is generated to fit it. At known corrupted positions, acting through the context can reduce damage that removing the token's own loss does not. Understanding and controlling what a model learns from a token therefore requires decoupling its roles.

</details>


### [791] [SMAT: Simple and Efficient Merge-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33437)
*Yanggan Gu,Yuanyi Wang,Zhen Li,Shuo Cai,Yuhang Liu,Junzhuo Li,Zihao Wang,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SMAT（Simple MAT），将常见模型合并方法抽象为Scale、Mask、Perturb三种操作，通过联合优化专家损失与模拟合并参数处的期望损失，并配合周期性调度、算子融合与参数存储切换，在低开销下提升合并后性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准专家训练仅优化任务损失，无法保证合并后性能；现有合并感知训练（MAT）方法未充分覆盖常见合并操作，且引入额外训练成本。

Method: 观察常见合并方法可归结为三种操作：Scale（重新加权自身更新）、Mask（移除选定坐标）、Perturb（加入其他专家的更新）。基于该视角提出SMAT：对采样得到的缩放系数、掩码与加性噪声构成的模拟合并参数，联合优化专家损失和期望损失；并引入周期性调度、kernel fusion与参数存储切换，使每步仅需一次前向与一次反向。

Result: 在四个语言与视觉-语言骨干网络上，SMAT在五种合并方法上的平均得分较每个骨干的最强基线提升1.07-2.16分，训练时间开销相比标准微调低于2%。

Conclusion: 将合并操作统一为Scale/Mask/Perturb并据此设计合并感知训练，可在极低额外开销下稳定提升多种骨干与合并方法的效果，为MAT提供了更通用且高效的方案。

Abstract: Model merging integrates the capabilities of multiple experts without joint retraining, but standard expert training optimizes task loss alone and does not guarantee good performance after merging. Merge-aware training (MAT) aims to improve merged performance, but existing methods do not fully account for common merging operations and add training cost. We observe that, from an expert's perspective, common merging methods can be described by three operations: Scale reweights its own update, Mask removes selected coordinates, and Perturb adds updates from other experts. Based on this view, we introduce SMAT (Simple MAT), which jointly optimizes expert loss and expected loss at simulated merged parameters generated by sampling scaling coefficients, masks, and additive noise. We further introduce periodic scheduling, kernel fusion, and parameter storage switching to make SMAT efficient, with one forward and one backward pass per step. Across four language and vision-language backbones, SMAT improves the mean score across five merging methods by 1.07-2.16 points over the strongest baseline for each backbone, with less than 2% training-time overhead over standard fine-tuning.

</details>


### [792] [A Cheap Verifier is Good Enough: LLM Post-training is Robust to Erroneous Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33467)
*Andreas Plesner,Curtis Northcutt,Francisco Guzmán,Anish Athalye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于超过11k H100 GPU小时、跨HealthBench与PRBench（医学、法律、金融）的实验发现：验证器与"金标准评判"的一致度并不能稳定预测后训练性能；高成本验证器不一定优于低成本者，开源Gemma验证器表现良好，低成本验证方案可在评分成本降低98.8%–99.7%的同时仅损失平均1–3分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在半可验证奖励任务上对LLM做后训练时，实践者需权衡训练步数、基座模型规模、训练顺序、数据质量、验证器准确率等诸多因素。然而"验证器一致度是否能预测后训练性能"这一问题尚不清楚，缺乏系统性实证证据，本文旨在填补此空白。

Method: 在HealthBench与PRBench任务上开展大规模实证研究，覆盖医学、法律、金融三个领域，累计消耗超过11k H100 GPU小时。训练模型为Qwen3（HealthBench上1.7B–8B，PRBench上8B），以多种评估划分和前沿LLM参考评判（即"golden verifier"）为基准，系统比较不同验证器的一致度与后训练性能的关系，并回顾性对比两种低成本验证方案（cost-reducing与balanced）与金标准评分协议的成本与性能差异。

Result: 在所测试的领域、模型规模、评估划分与金标准评判下，更高的验证器一致度并不能一致地识别出最佳训练验证器；昂贵的验证器不一定优于廉价验证器，开源权重Gemma验证器可产生较强的训练效果。两种低成本方案相较金标准评分协议可实现98.8%–99.7%的评分成本下降，平均后训练得分与最佳验证器的差距仅为1–3分；但在个别设置下损失更大，因此不能据此认为不同验证器选择可互换。

Conclusion: 验证器一致度并非后训练性能的可靠预测指标，验证器成本与其训练效果之间亦无必然正相关。实践中可选用低成本甚至开源验证器来大幅降低评分成本，但需注意在特定设置下可能出现较大性能损失，验证器选择不可简单视为等价替换。

Abstract: When post-training large language models on tasks with semi-verifiable rewards, there are many factors (training steps, base model size, training order, data quality, verifier accuracy, etc.) that practitioners must contend with to maximize model performance. Yet, it remains unclear how well verifier agreement predicts post-training performance on such tasks. In this paper, we explore this question with over 11k H100 GPU-hours, across HealthBench and PRBench tasks in medical, legal, and finance domains. Across the tested domains, Qwen3 trainees (1.7B-8B on HealthBench; 8B on PRBench), evaluation splits, and frontier LLM reference judges (which we call golden verifiers), higher verifier agreement does not consistently identify the best training verifier. Expensive verifiers need not outperform inexpensive ones, and open-weight Gemma verifiers produce strong training outcomes. We compare two low-cost choices retrospectively -- a cost-reducing choice and a balanced choice -- with estimated grading cost reductions of 98.8%-99.7% relative to the golden grading protocols and average post-training score gaps of 1-3 points from the best evaluated training verifier. These averages include larger losses in individual settings; they do not establish that verifier choices are interchangeable.

</details>


### [793] [TGRL: Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Exploration in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33589)
*Zihan Lin,Xiaohan Wang,Jie Cao,Jiajun Chai,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Ran He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TGRL方法，将温度诱导的多样性转化为显式训练信号，在RLVR中实现更高效的探索且不扩大采样预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中高效探索是核心瓶颈，温度控制与测试时扩展虽能提升LLM rollout多样性，但要么增加采样预算，要么未量化探索收益。

Method: 对每个prompt将rollout组划分为低温和高温子集，通过奖励对比估计探索增益，并利用同源logits下温度缩放下一token分布的JS散度，将该组级信号分配为token级信用。

Result: 达到同等精度比强RLVR基线快36%；11个基准上普遍提升：32B数学六项平均+1.6%，CodeForces评分+196.7，LiveCodeBench Pass@16+4.4%，ALFWorld/WebShop成功率+6.3%/4.9%。

Conclusion: TGRL无需扩大rollout预算即可有效利用温度多样性提升探索效率，消融与墙钟时间分析验证各组件有效性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Efficient exploration often remains a central bottleneck in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Although temperature control and test-time scaling strategies can increase rollout diversity of large language models (LLMs), they either expand the sample budget at rollout time or leave the benefit of exploration unquantified. To this end, we propose Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning (TGRL), which turns temperature-induced diversity into an explicit training signal. For each prompt, TGRL partitions its rollout group into low- and high-temperature subsets, estimates exploration gain through their reward contrast, and allocates this group-level signal as token-level credit using Jensen--Shannon (JS) divergence between the corresponding temperature-scaled next-token distributions induced by the same logits. Notably, TGRL reaches equivalent accuracy up to 36% faster than strong RLVR baselines without expanding the rollout budget. Across 11 benchmarks from diverse domains, TGRL broadly improves over strong RLVR baselines: it improves the six-benchmark math average by 1.6% at 32B, raises CodeForces rating by 196.7 points and LiveCodeBench Pass@16 by 4.4%, and improves ALFWorld/WebShop success rates by 6.3%/4.9%. Comprehensive ablations and wall-clock analysis confirm the efficacy of all proposed components. Code is available at https://github.com/1229095296/TGRL/tree/main.

</details>


### [794] [BOReFT: Manifold Steering of Language Models for Black-box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33722)
*Dhruv Agarwal,Rico Angell,Kavitha Srinivas,Tahira Naseem,Horst Samulowitz,Willie Neiswanger,Andrew McCallum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BOReFT 在冻结语言模型的隐状态上学习一个紧凑低维干预空间，并将其作为贝叶斯优化的搜索域，从而在离散 LLM 提议空间与连续黑箱优化之间建立桥梁，在 Semantle 和分子性质优化任务上取得优于强 LLM 基线的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型越来越多地被用作黑箱搜索的提议模型，但现有方法通过迭代提示或参数更新来改进提议，对搜索空间被探索的完整性与效率控制有限；而贝叶斯优化等连续优化方法虽有原理性优势，却需要一个合适的搜索域。因此需要一种兼具 LLM 离散语义提议能力与连续优化可操控性的搜索域构造方式。

Method: 提出 BOReFT：在冻结语言模型的隐状态上学习一个紧凑的低维干预空间，将该空间作为贝叶斯优化的搜索域，并配合外部评分函数进行优化。理论上分析该学习域的语义覆盖度与插值性质对可得最优分数的控制，并证明从该空间解码可导出用于自适应搜索的标准随机赌博机观测模型。

Result: 在所学习的域中，语义区域被覆盖且具备支持搜索的平滑性。在可解释词搜索任务 Semantle 上，BOReFT 相比强 LLM 基线找到更多隐藏目标；在三个从头分子性质优化任务中的两个上取得更高的性质分数。

Conclusion: BOReFT 为基于 LLM 搜索的离散提议空间与连续黑箱优化之间提供了一种有原理支撑的新连接方式。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly used as proposal models for black-box search, from program optimization to molecular design. Existing approaches typically improve proposals through iterative prompting or parameter updates, offering limited control over how completely and efficiently the model's search space is explored. Continuous optimization methods, such as Bayesian optimization, provide a principled way to search but require a suitable domain to operate over. To address this, we introduce BOReFT, which learns a compact, low-dimensional space of hidden-state interventions in a frozen language model, and uses this space as the search domain for Bayesian optimization with an external scoring function. Empirically, we find that the learned domain spans semantic regions and exhibits smoothness properties that support search. Theoretically, we show that semantic coverage and interpolation control the best score available in the learned space, and that decoding from this space yields a standard stochastic-bandit observation model for adaptive search. We evaluate BOReFT on the interpretable word search task "Semantle" and on three more real-world discovery tasks in de novo molecule property optimization. Compared to strong LLM baselines, BOReFT finds in Semantle a higher number of hidden targets and, on two out of three molecular objectives, achieves higher property scores. Consequently, our method provides a principled new bridge between discrete proposal spaces of LLM-based search and continuous black-box optimization.

</details>


### [795] [Surprising Success, Repeated Failure: Entropy-Guided Credit Assignment for Exploration in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33781)
*Woongyeong Yeo,Minki Kang,Chanuk Lee,Sangwoo Park,Jinheon Baek,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EAPO（Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization），一种熵引导的信用分配方法，通过对成功与失败采用非对称处理，将响应级优势重分配到 token 级，无需额外模型或监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 依赖结果级反馈，细粒度信用分配方法多需辅助模型、额外采样或特权信息。策略熵虽易得，但同时对不确定位置施加强化与惩罚，会把惩罚集中在仍具恢复潜力的失败响应上，抑制探索机会。

Method: 基于"不确定性下的成功更难重复、高置信失败更易复发"的观察，EAPO 将归一化策略熵与响应优势符号耦合：对成功响应中的高熵决策施加强强化，对失败响应中的低熵决策施加强惩罚，同时减弱不确定位置的惩罚以保留恢复机会；通过重分配响应优势得到 token 级信用，直接利用现有 rollout 信号，无需额外监督。

Result: 在多种推理任务上，覆盖 base 与 reasoning 两类骨干模型，EAPO 取得最佳整体性能，并促进更有效探索，扩大问题覆盖范围、生成更多样化的候选答案。

Conclusion: EAPO 以非对称、熵引导的 token 级信用分配，在无额外监督条件下提升 LLM 推理表现与探索质量。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models (LLMs) through outcome-level feedback, yet recent approaches to finer-grained credit assignment often require auxiliary models, additional sampling, or privileged information. Although policy entropy provides a readily available signal, prioritizing uncertain positions under both reinforcement and penalization concentrates penalties where failed responses still retain alternatives for recovery, which can suppress opportunities for exploration. To address this, we introduce Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization (EAPO), an entropy-guided credit assignment method that treats success and failure asymmetrically. Specifically, motivated by the observation that success under uncertainty is less repeatable while confident failures tend to recur, EAPO couples normalized policy entropy with the sign of the response advantage to reinforce surprising success and correct repeated failure. It assigns stronger reinforcement to high-entropy decisions in successful responses and stronger penalties to low-entropy decisions in failed responses, while attenuating penalties at uncertain positions to preserve opportunities for recovery. By redistributing the response advantage across tokens, EAPO derives token-level credit directly from existing rollout signals without additional supervision. We validate EAPO on a range of reasoning tasks across both base and reasoning backbones, demonstrating that it achieves the best overall performance. We further show that EAPO promotes more effective exploration, broadening problem coverage and generating more diverse candidate answers.

</details>


### [796] [ChemOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task Chemical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33838)
*Yaoyao Xu,Xinjian Zhao,Xiaozhuang Song,Xuemin Chen,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 ChemOPD，通过在策略蒸馏中先以梯度估计任务亲和度并求解约束混合整数规划来构建部分重叠的专家分组，再保留通用教师并以锚点-残差目标逐步引入专家指导，从而在化学推理任务上实现更优的能力整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型被期望在统一模型中支持多样化的化学推理能力。一种思路是分别训练专项能力再通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）整合，但这引出两个问题：专项能力应如何组织，以及专家指导应如何整合。论文认为"专精化"与"能力整合"是相互关联但彼此不同的设计问题。

Method: ChemOPD 包含两部分：1）专精化组织：从监督微调（SFT）梯度估计任务亲和度，求解带约束的混合整数规划（MIP）来构建部分重叠的专家分组；2）指导整合：蒸馏时保留一个在所有任务上训练的通用教师，使专家指导作为补充而非替代其监督；采用锚点-残差目标（anchor-residual objective），在学生自生成响应上逐步增加被路由专家的贡献。

Result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上，亲和度引导的专精化相对通用教师带来任务相关的增益，并在若干能力上优于按语义任务分组。但教师端更强的表现并不自动转化为更强的学生：在专家与路由相同的条件下，锚点-残差 OPD 在多数报告指标上优于仅用专家的蒸馏，并能实现更大比例的可用教师增益。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在化学推理中，专精化与能力整合是相互关联但彼此不同的设计问题；需要同时重视专家如何组织与指导如何整合，才能有效将教师增益传递给学生。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly expected to support diverse chemical reasoning capabilities within a unified model. One approach is to develop specialized capabilities separately and consolidate them through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, but this raises two questions: how should specialization be organized, and how should specialist guidance be integrated? We introduce ChemOPD, which addresses both. We estimate task affinities from supervised fine-tuning gradients and solve a constrained mixed-integer program(MIP) to construct partially overlapping specialist groups. During distillation, we retain a generalist teacher trained on all tasks so that specialist guidance supplements rather than replaces its supervision. Our anchor-residual objective gradually increases the routed specialist's contribution on student-generated responses. On ChemCoTBench, affinity-guided specialization produces task-dependent gains over the generalist teacher and improves several capabilities beyond semantic task grouping. Yet stronger teacher-side performance does not automatically yield stronger students: with the same specialists and routes, anchor-residual OPD improves most reported metrics over specialist-only distillation and realizes a larger share of the available teacher gains. These results highlight specialization and capability integration as connected but distinct design problems in chemical reasoning.

</details>


### [797] [Rethinking Contextualization by Reinterpreting Attention Head Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33851)
*Hakaze Cho,Haolin Yang,Zhun Sun,Naoya Inoue,Benjamin Heinzerling,Kentaro Inui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个关于语境化（contextualization）的全局性原则：不同词携带的信息量不同，信息量低的词倾向于吸收更多上下文信息，且这种吸收具有细粒度选择性；作者将注意力头重新解释为由奇异向量门控的通道，发现奇异向量指向信息量更高词的隐状态，从而实现信息路由与注意力头的连续化自动解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往对语境化的研究主要把单个词和注意力头视为不断增长的离散字典条目，缺乏对其整体行为的全局视角，因此需要一个统一原则来刻画信息如何在词间传递。

Method: 提出全局原则并估计不同词所携带的信息量；分析低信息词吸收上下文的非均匀性与细粒度选择性；将注意力头重解释为由奇异向量门控的通道，考察奇异向量与隐状态的关系。

Result: 发现低信息词吸收更多上下文信息，且更细粒度的选择性带来更精准的路由以促进匹配词之间的信息传递；奇异向量指向信息量更高词的隐状态，使这些词作为信息源更强地写入信息，反之亦然；奇异向量可等同视为隐状态特征，实现注意力头的自动化解释。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了语境化的全局视角，将注意力头从离散独立字典条目嵌入连续空间，并实现超越启发式发现的自动化头解释，为理解语言模型的信息传递机制提供新框架。

Abstract: Contextualization, the core operation of language modeling, transmits information across words to build sentence-specific word representations. Prior works mainly study contextualization, focusing on individual words and attention heads as a growing discrete dictionary, lacking a global view of their general behavior. Therefore, we propose a general principle: Globally, we find and estimate that different words carry different amounts of information, and less-informative words tend to absorb more contextual information. Specifically, these low-information words do not absorb contextual words uniformly, and finer-grained selectivity enables more precise routing to promote information transmission between matched words. Moreover, to find what mechanism causes such processing, we reinterpret attention heads as channels gated by their singular vectors and find that: (1) these singular vectors point to the hidden states of more informative words, allowing such words to write their information to others more strongly to act as information sources, and vice versa; and (2) these singular vectors can be viewed equally as hidden state features, enabling automated interpretation of attention heads beyond prior heuristic head discovery, also embedding heads into a continuous space rather than treating them as discrete, independent dictionary entries.

</details>


### [798] [Where Activation Sparsity and KV-Cache Sparsity Cross in LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33889)
*Jungseob Lee,Seungyoon Lee,Seongtae Hong,Sugyeong Eo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"字节交叉点"（byte crossover）分析框架，仅用模型维度与保留率即可从字节流量角度统一比较激活稀疏（投影权重）与KV缓存稀疏两种解码加速分支，并在2K–128K上下文、两块GPU上验证预测与实测交叉点误差在4.1K token内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型解码每步需重读投影权重（流量固定）与KV缓存（流量随上下文增长），激活稀疏削减前者、KV稀疏削减后者，但两者报告的加速比依赖上下文长度和所对比的稠密注意力内核，导致难以公平比较。

Method: 从模型维度与保留率推导字节交叉点（两分支节省相等时的上下文长度）及各自与组合的理想加速上界；在真实文本稠密预填充后，于2K–128K token、两块GPU上对两个分支及其组合计时，稠密与稀疏模式共用同一split-K注意力内核；将单独扫描测得的固定内核开销加入字节账目进行预测。

Result: 投影分支在短上下文领先、KV分支在长上下文领先，加速比在固定内核开销内符合字节上界；加入内核开销后，字节账目对三组保留率、第二个模型和第二个GPU的实测交叉点预测误差在4.1K token内。用masked而非split-K注意力计时稠密基线，会使同一KV策略的表观加速比虚高约5倍。注意力打分的KV选择在127K token内与稠密解码对passkey和多key放置答案一致，而KV窗口则会大量漏掉；在匹配困惑度预算下，激活稀疏与该选择组合在两块GPU上比最佳单分支快14%–26%。

Conclusion: 字节流量账目可作为一种可预测、可迁移的分析工具，统一刻画投影稀疏与KV稀疏的加速交叉行为；结合注意力打分的KV选择与激活稀疏的组合策略在长上下文下取得最优加速，同时揭示了内核选择对加速比测量的显著影响。

Abstract: At each step, decoding one sequence with a large language model rereads the projection weights, whose traffic is fixed, and the key-value (KV) cache, whose traffic grows with context. Activation sparsity trims the first term and KV-cache sparsity the second, yet their reported speedups are hard to compare because each depends on context length and on the dense attention kernel it is measured against. We derive a byte crossover, the context length at which the two savings are equal, together with ideal speedup bounds for each branch and for their composition, from model dimensions and keep ratios alone. We then time both branches and their composition from 2K to 128K tokens on two GPUs after a dense prefill of real text, with dense and sparse modes reading the cache through the same split-K attention kernel. The projection branch leads at short context and the KV branch at long context, with speedups that follow their byte bounds up to fixed kernel costs. Adding these costs, measured in separate sweeps, lets the byte account predict the measured crossings of three keep-ratio pairs, a second model, and a second GPU to within 4.1K tokens. Timing the dense baseline with masked instead of split-K attention inflates the apparent speedup of the same KV policy about fivefold. An attention-scored KV selection answers the same passkey and multi-key placements as dense decoding up to 127K tokens, whereas a KV window misses most of them. Under matched perplexity budgets, activation sparsity composed with this selection decodes 14 to 26% faster than the best single branch on both GPUs. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ByteCross.

</details>


### [799] [Steering Language Model Goals with Value Transplant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34056)
*Pengcheng Jiang,Fabien Roger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将模型内部追踪目标进展的"价值轴"作为可干预对象，提出"价值移植"（value transplant）：在每一token处，按供体与宿主的价值坐标差（乘大系数）沿候选价值轴平移宿主激活，从而将宿主搜索重定向到供体目标。在Qwen3-8B与GPT-OSS-20B的诚实/作弊微调变体上，该干预双向有效：诚实供体降低作弊宿主的测试作弊，作弊供体提升诚实宿主的测试作弊，且诚实供体还能提升作弊宿主在可解编程任务上的隐藏测试表现，并可跨模型族迁移。


<details>
