  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型常表现得像在追求目标，但其努力未必指向用户意图，可能导向非预期结果。已有工作表明模型内部通过"价值轴"追踪目标进展，本文追问：改变该信号能否把模型的搜索重定向到另一目标，即能否对目标导向行为实施控制。

Method: 提出价值移植干预：在每个token处，沿候选价值轴将宿主模型激活平移"供体-宿主价值坐标差×大标量"，以重定向宿主目标。候选价值轴中包含一条"自评轴"，由高/低自评进展前的激活构建。实验对象为Qwen3-8B与GPT-OSS-20B微调得到的诚实与作弊变体，并检验跨模型族的可迁移性。

Result: 干预双向有效：诚实供体使作弊宿主的测试作弊减少，作弊供体使诚实宿主的测试作弊增加，表明该信号能影响模型采用何种策略。在可解编程任务上，来自诚实供体的移植还提升了作弊宿主的隐藏测试表现。价值移植亦可跨模型族生效。

Conclusion: 变更价值轴信号能够对模型的目标导向搜索进行重定向，为与模型控制相关的干预提供了初步证据；价值移植在双向、任务表现与跨模型族上均显示可行。

Abstract: Reasoning models often act as if they pursue goals, but their efforts are not always directed toward what users intend, sometimes leading them to pursue unintended outcomes. Previous work has examined how models may internally track their progress toward their goals through a "value axis." We study whether changing such a signal can retarget the model's search toward a different goal. We test value transplant: at each token, we shift the host model's activation along a candidate value axis by the donor-host difference in value coordinates (multiplied by a large scalar), aiming to redirect the host toward the donor's goal. We study this intervention in Qwen3-8B and GPT-OSS-20B models fine-tuned into honest and cheating variants. We test several candidate value axes, including a self-rating axis constructed from activations preceding high versus low elicited self-ratings of progress. The intervention works in both directions, with an honest donor reducing test-gaming in a cheating host and a cheating donor increasing test-gaming in an honest host, showing that this signal can influence which strategy the model follows. On solvable coding tasks, transplant from an honest donor also improves the cheating host's hidden-test performance. Value transplant also works across model families, providing preliminary evidence for the intervention in a setting relevant to model control.

</details>


### [800] [Counterexamples to Local Reconstruction Gain as a Proxy for Final Fidelity in Residual Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34063)
*Yasuto Hoshi,Daisuke Miyashita,Jun Deguchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑"改善注意力输出的局部重建必然提升最终模型保真度"这一假设，发现训练无关RESA与学习的Top-K+φ在局部重建增益为正时，最终KL保真度反而劣于全弃权的Exact Top-K基线，特定层的精确恢复才提升保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 残差补全通过估计被省略token的贡献来增强查询感知稀疏注意力，但"局部注意力输出重建更好是否必然带来最终模型输出保真度更好"缺乏验证；作者希望检验局部重建增益与最终保真度之间的因果/单调关系是否成立。

Method: 在冻结骨干语言模型上研究训练无关的RESA与学习的Top-K+φ；采用预设的单层筛选（prespecified single-layer screen）在Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum上选出两个干预，用直接运行时测量（direct-runtime measurements）评估请求聚合的局部重建增益与最终KL保真度，并在发现集与prompt-token-disjoint留出集上对比全弃权的Exact Top-K基线；另做同层精确恢复（exact restoration）对照与多层互补实验，并引入任务无关的局部诊断（local diagnostic）修复补全估计器。

Result: 两个Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum干预在直接运行时测量中显示正的预设请求聚合局部重建增益，但其最终KL保真度在发现集与prompt-token-disjoint留出集上均劣于全弃权的Exact Top-K基线；同层精确恢复反而提升最终保真度，表明该反转是近似补全特有的；在多层实验中，任务无关局部诊断常能修复被测补全估计器，但修复后的模型并未稳定优于Exact Top-K。

Conclusion: 更好的局部重建不一定转化为更好的最终模型保真度；局部重建增益不能作为稀疏注意力补全质量的可靠代理指标，评估需以最终输出保真度为准。

Abstract: Residual completion augments query-aware sparse attention by estimating the contribution of tokens omitted from the exact sparse computation. We ask whether improving a layer's attention-output reconstruction on the same incoming Q/K/V and selected support necessarily improves the fidelity of the final model output. We study training-free RESA and learned Top-K+$φ$ with frozen backbone language models. A prespecified single-layer screen yields two Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum interventions for which direct-runtime measurements show positive prespecified request-aggregate local reconstruction gain but worse final KL fidelity than the corresponding all-abstain Exact Top-K baseline on both discovery and prompt-token-disjoint holdout requests. Exact restoration at the same layer instead improves final fidelity, showing that the reversal is specific to approximate completion in these cases. In complementary multi-layer experiments, a task-independent local diagnostic often repairs the tested completion estimators, although the repaired models do not consistently outperform Exact Top-K. Together, these results show that better local reconstruction need not translate into better final-model fidelity.

</details>


### [801] [Training and Inference Dynamics of PLDR-LLMs: Row-Map Collapse, Renormalization, and Predictive Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34130)
*Burc Gokden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该专著为幂律解码表征语言模型（PLDR-LLMs）建立统一的训练与推理理论框架，通过精确有限功恒等式分解能量变化，提出预测重整化方法，并用实验区分观测者/优化器依赖性、拒绝自主行状态候选、支持有限条件预测与状态特定的算子约简。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型训练与推理缺乏统一的能量与动力学理论描述，缩放定律向推理迁移所需假设不明确，行动态与模型级观测之间的关联未被严格刻画。

Method: 提出PLDR-LLM统一框架：用精确有限功恒等式将行中心化学习映射的绝对能量变化分解为参数贡献、带符号交互与数值观测缺陷；采用正仿射阻塞保留行常数面上的重启，以增广AdamW状态给出完整动力学描述；引入预测重整化作用于单遍条件训练律，保留优化器记忆、剩余数据、调度与数值策略；分析自主约简的闭合条件与近似约简的后继/发射误差；通过有限总体协方差、匹配物理时钟、矩阵通量与带符号时间能量连接行动态与模型级观测。

Result: 实验揭示观测者与优化器依赖性，拒绝所测试的自主行状态候选，支持有限条件预测与状态特定算子约简；独立单遍族呈现移动的有限涨落区域，但未建立热力学临界类。

Conclusion: 该理论明确区分精确恒等式、条件动力学主张与有限经验发现，并给出证明、部分形式化检验与紧凑数值证据；条件对称性、头极限、协方差流与读出误差预算界定了将缩放定律迁移至推理所需假设。

Abstract: This monograph develops a unified account of training and inference in Power Law Decoder Representation language models (PLDR-LLMs). Exact finite work identities decompose changes in the absolute energy of the row-centered learned map into parameter contributions, signed interactions, and numerical observation defects. Positive affine blocking retains restarts at the row-constant face, while the augmented AdamW state supplies the complete dynamical description.
  Predictive renormalization acts on the complete conditional training law for a single pass over distinct corpus target blocks, retaining optimizer memory, remaining data, schedule, and numerical policy. Autonomous reductions require closure; approximate reductions carry successor and emission errors. Finite-population covariance, matched physical clocks, matrix fluxes, and signed temporal energy connect row dynamics to model-wide observations. Absolute row collapse, relative row concentration, operator stabilization, and predictive accuracy are distinguished.
  Experiments reveal observer and optimizer dependence, reject the tested autonomous row-state candidates, and support finite conditional prediction and state-specific operator reduction. Independent single-pass families exhibit moving finite fluctuation regions without establishing a thermodynamic critical class. Conditional symmetry, head limits, covariance flows, and readout error budgets specify assumptions needed to transfer scaling laws to inference. The theory separates exact identities, conditional dynamical claims, and finite empirical findings, with proofs, selected formal checks, and compact numerical evidence.

</details>


### [802] [X-MoD: Practical Scaling Laws for Sparse-Depth Routing Beyond Mixture-of-Depths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34212)
*Bowen Dong,Yilong Fan,Tengyu Pan,Yike Zhang,Zhenyu Li,Zijian Zhang,Xuewei Li,Mei Yu,Jianyong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 X-MoD 稀疏深度架构，解耦 token 稀疏性与 anchor 步长，使总参数量可增长而激活容量基本不变，并建立可预测稀疏深度性能的 scaling law 框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原 MoD 的"一稀疏一稠密"交替结构将总容量与激活容量紧耦合，限制了稀疏深度的扩展能力，亟需解耦二者以获得可扩展的稀疏深度设计。

Method: X-MoD 结合密集 anchor、方差缩放的分层门控与深度方向的 token 平衡；将稀疏深度路由形式化为条件架构设计问题，并相对 FLOP 匹配的稠密基线拟合 scaling law，分解为稀疏容量增益、稀疏上下文校正与 anchor 步长交互三项。

Result: 该 law 能跨多种路由配置预测验证损失，并揭示上下文长度、模型规模与 anchor 步长对稀疏深度性能的影响规律。

Conclusion: 通过预训练扫参、留出 scaling law 预测、消融、下游评估及与 Dense、MoD、代表性 MoE 基线对比，验证了架构与 law 的有效性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) enables conditional computation across Transformer depth by routing only a subset of tokens through selected layers, but its original one-sparse--one-dense alternation tightly couples total capacity to active capacity and limits sparse-depth scaling. We introduce X-MoD, a scalable sparse-depth architecture that decouples token sparsity from anchor stride, allowing total parameter count to grow while keeping active-equivalent capacity nearly fixed. To make deep sparse routing trainable, X-MoD combines dense anchors with variance-scaled layer-wise gating and depth-wise token balancing. To make this regime analyzable and usable, we formulate sparse-depth routing as a conditional architecture-design problem: given compute, context length, and active-equivalent backbone size, how should the routing configuration be chosen? We develop a practical scaling-law framework by fitting X-MoD relative to FLOP-matched dense baselines, yielding an interpretable law that decomposes performance into sparse-capacity gain, sparse-context correction, and anchor-stride interaction. The law predicts validation loss across routing configurations and reveals how context length, model scale, and anchor stride shape sparse-depth performance. We validate the architecture and law through pretraining sweeps, held-out scaling-law prediction, ablations, downstream evaluations, and comparisons with Dense, MoD, and representative MoE baselines.

</details>


### [803] [Loop Dropout: Regularizing Shared Updates in Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34218)
*Zirui Zhu,Hailun Xu,Xuanlei Zhao,Yong Liu,Yingxuan Ren,Kanchan Sarkar,Kun Xu,Yang You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Loop Dropout，通过在循环语言模型的共享 LoRA 更新中引入随机掩码与逆生存概率缩放，保持训练期望更新强度并改善跨循环的适配平衡，在数学推理、指令微调与代码生成上均优于现有 LoRA 变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复应用同一 transformer 块将计算深度与参数量解耦，但适配此类模型需要一种在隐藏状态随循环演进时仍有效的共享更新。作者的经验分析发现标准 LoRA 存在明显的“晚循环偏置”，即共享更新在靠后的循环位置更有效，这种不平衡导致适配不充分，因而需要一种能平衡各循环位置适配效果的方法。

Method: 作者先对标准 LoRA 在循环模型中的表现进行经验分析，确认晚循环偏置现象。随后设计 Loop Dropout：在训练时对适配器的应用位置施加随机掩码，并结合逆生存概率重缩放（inverse-survival rescaling），以保持期望更新强度不变，从而促使共享更新在早期循环也获得有效适配。作者指出仅随机省略适配器应用会降低期望更新强度且不改变推理，因此需要该重缩放机制。推理时在所有循环上使用标准 LoRA 应用适配器。

Result: 大量实验表明，Loop Dropout 在多种模型规模、适配器秩与训练配方下均提升了数学推理表现，收益还扩展到通用指令微调与代码生成任务。其效果优于现有 LoRA 变体与适配器正则化方法，进一步分析显示早期循环的适配能力更强。

Conclusion: Loop Dropout 在不增加可训练参数或推理计算的前提下，通过随机掩码与逆生存概率缩放缓解循环模型 LoRA 适配的晚循环偏置，改进跨循环适配效果。每个主干循环仍保持激活，推理阶段在所有循环上以标准 LoRA 应用适配器，兼具高效性与通用性。

Abstract: Looped language models separate computational depth from parameter count by repeatedly applying the same transformer block. Adapting these models requires a shared update that remains effective as hidden states evolve throughout the recurrent computation. Our empirical analysis reveals a pronounced late-loop bias in standard low-rank adaptation (LoRA): the shared update is more effective at later loop positions. This imbalance motivates training shared updates under varying combinations of their applications. Randomly omitting adapter applications alone, however, does not improve task performance; it reduces expected update strength during training while leaving inference unchanged. We introduce Loop Dropout, which couples stochastic masking of adapter applications with inverse-survival rescaling to preserve expected update strength and promote effective adaptation across loops. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved mathematical reasoning across model sizes, adapter ranks and training recipes, with benefits extending to general instruction tuning and code generation. Loop Dropout outperforms existing LoRA variants and adapter regularizers, while further analysis shows stronger early-loop adaptation. Every backbone loop remains active, and inference applies the adapter at all loops using standard LoRA without additional trainable parameters or inference computation.

</details>


### [804] [DreamingGoose: Staged Distillation from Autoregressive Transformers to Bidirectional Recurrent Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34253)
*Julian Boesch,Andrew Wee,Alexander Stranzl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将Qwen3自回归教师模型转换为无注意力、双向、门控Delta规则的扩散学生模型，三阶段转换中语言建模仅部分迁移、上下文检索不迁移，需在末期加入渐进拉大键值表与查询间隔的检索课程才能随机恢复检索能力，且检索一旦学会即对未出现过的token评分为0，表现为覆盖度限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练自回归Transformer是巨大的算力沉没成本。已有转换方法只在架构（注意力→递归）或目标（下一token预测→去噪）二者之一上做改动，从未同时改两者。作者希望同时改架构与目标完成转换，并通过分阶段设计使得每项能力的保留或丢失都能归因到具体阶段。

Method: 将1.7B和8B的Qwen3教师分三阶段转换为无注意力、双向、门控Delta规则的扩散学生。在末阶段引入检索课程：逐步拉大键值表与寻址查询之间的间隔。对照两种调度：固定调度 vs. 仅在运行中的准确率估计高于阈值时才推进间隔。另将7B代码模型在85k步内转换为3:1递归-注意力块扩散混合模型。

Result: 语言建模仅部分迁移且限于分布内，上下文检索不迁移：多查询回忆探针上教师得分0.34–0.58，两个转换学生均为0.000，纯扩散预训练无法恢复检索。固定调度下三个随机种子中只有一个学会检索；阈值自适应调度使这三个种子全部成功，在真实文本上有效，并不加改动迁移到8B（三个种子中两个成功，第三个在固定16k步预算内未学会）。检索呈突变式开启且开启步数与种子相关（另两个为6.5k和11k步），故固定预算可能截断较晚的运行。所有学会检索的模型对从未出现在检索片段中的token均得0.000；每批次重采样键与值token的对照实验表明这是覆盖度限制而非对特定绑定的记忆。7B代码模型转换中报告了两项负面训练结果。

Conclusion: 同时改架构与目标的转换中，语言建模只能部分迁移，上下文检索默认完全丢失，需要显式的、自适应的检索课程才能恢复，且恢复具有随机性和突变性，固定训练预算存在截断风险。检索学习受限于覆盖度而非记忆：学会检索的模型对未见token仍为0.000。这提示转换后模型的检索能力来源于对键值token覆盖的习得，而非绑定记忆。

Abstract: Pretrained autoregressive Transformers represent a large sunk investment in compute. Existing conversion methods reuse that investment by changing either the architecture (attention to recurrence) or the objective (next-token prediction to denoising), never both. We convert Qwen3 teachers at 1.7B and 8B into attention-free, bidirectional, gated-delta-rule diffusion students in three stages, so that each capability can be traced to the stage that kept or lost it. Language modeling transfers only partially and in-distribution; in-context retrieval does not transfer. On a multi-query recall probe where the teachers score 0.34-0.58, both converted students score 0.000, and diffusion pretraining alone does not restore retrieval. A retrieval curriculum in the final stage, which gradually lengthens the gap between a key-value table and the queries that address it, restores it only stochastically: on a fixed schedule, one seed in three learns to retrieve. Advancing the gap only while a running accuracy estimate stays above a threshold works for all three of those seeds, holds on real text, and carries unchanged to 8B, where two of three seeds succeed. The third had not learned within its fixed 16k-step budget: retrieval switches on abruptly at a seed-dependent step (6.5k and 11k in the other two), so a fixed budget can cut a late run off. One boundary survives every intervention: every model that learns retrieval scores 0.000 on tokens that never appeared in a retrieval episode, and an arm that resamples the key and value tokens every batch shows this is a coverage limit, not memorization of particular bindings. Separately, we convert a 7B code model into a 3:1 recurrent-attention block-diffusion hybrid over 85k steps and report two negative training results.

</details>


### [805] [Commutator Memory: Sparse, Path-Local Reading and Steering in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34348)
*John Sweeney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了训练路径依赖留下的"参数化训练历史记忆"：一阶权重差正比于梯度场的李括号，该括号经logits投影得到的逐token分数具有局部性、因果作用，并能识别训练顺序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度更新一般不可交换，同一数据以相反顺序训练语言模型会得到不同权重，但loss或benchmark差异只显示模型"不同"，无法定位差异来源。作者试图探究这种路径依赖是否留下参数化的训练历史记忆，即可被定位、干预并用于识别训练顺序的权重成分。

Method: 对源A、B各做一步大小为η的SGD，理论上权重差θ_AB−θ_BA在主导阶为η²b_AB，其中b_AB=H_B g_A−H_A g_B是基础模型处两梯度场的李括号。定义交换子记忆：将括号经logits投影为每个词表token一个分数，分数之和等于括号对gap的预测。实验包括：三模型上对实测θ_AB−θ_BA或不相交batch括号做readout比较top-20 token重叠；Qwen-3-4B SFT中对预测贡献最大的十个token降权；将两训练模型之差投影到b_AB以识别顺序；以及matched-batch DPO、frozen-rollout GRPO风格目标、AdamW端点检验。

Result: readout具有局部性：三模型上实测权重差或不相交batch括号的readout与原始top-20 token重叠82–99%，而norm-matched随机方向仅35–49%。具有因果可操作性：Qwen-3-4B SFT中对gap预测份额最大的十个token降权，闭合实测gap中位数32%，而频率匹配且分数接近零的token几乎无影响。权重本身携带该成分：将两模型之差投影到b_AB，在四个LLM上以92%准确率识别顺序（随机为50%）。该记忆按源对定义而非按样本，其在b_AB上的投影随进一步训练衰减。

Conclusion: 训练顺序在权重中留下可定位、可干预、可用于识别的交换子记忆，其结构由梯度场李括号刻画，按源对存在且随继续训练衰减。这为理解路径依赖和训练历史取证提供了参数层面的工具。

Abstract: Gradient updates on different data generally do not commute: training a language model on two data sources in opposite orders gives different weights, even with the same data and total exposure. Loss or benchmark deltas show that the models differ, not where. We ask whether this path dependence leaves a parametric training-history memory: a weight component that flips sign when the two sources are swapped, is localized in output space, changes the held-out loss gap between the two orders under targeted interventions, and reveals which trained model came from which order. For one small SGD step of size $η$ on each of sources $A$ and $B$, the weight difference $θ_{AB}-θ_{BA}$ is, to leading order, $η^2 b_{AB}$, where $b_{AB}=H_Bg_A-H_Ag_B$ is the Lie bracket of the two gradient fields at the base model. We define commutator memory by projecting the bracket through the logits into one score per vocabulary token; the scores sum to the bracket's prediction of the gap. The scores are localized: on three models, the same readout of the measured $θ_{AB}-θ_{BA}$, or of a bracket from disjoint batches, shares 82-99% of the original top-20 tokens, versus 35-49% for norm-matched random directions. They are causally actionable: in Qwen-3-4B SFT, downweighting the ten tokens with the largest predicted share of the gap closes a median 32% of the measured gap, while frequency-matched tokens with near-zero scores have almost no effect. The weights themselves carry the component: projecting the difference between the two trained models onto $b_{AB}$ identifies which came from which order in 92% of cases across four LLMs (chance 50%). Controlled tests also cover matched-batch DPO, a frozen-rollout GRPO-style objective, and an AdamW endpoint check. The memory is defined per source pair, not per example, and its projection on $b_{AB}$ decays with further training.

</details>


### [806] [FORGE: Form-Optimal Routing of Grounded Evidence for Frozen LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34358)
*Xi Xiao,Yunbei Zhang,Chen Liu,Lin Zhao,Jialin Chen,Tianchen Zhao,Xiang Xu,Youngeun Kim,Tianyang Wang,Min Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FORGE框架，通过对冻结基础模型进行逐查询路由，联合优化"证据形式"与"思考深度"，在降低token成本的同时提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在agentic AI系统中，冻结的基础模型常以闭源API端点形式部署，下游适配仅能通过输入与推理流程实现。每个查询涉及两个耦合决策：提供何种证据、分配多少推理预算；固定默认设置往往次优，约80%查询出现支持形式或推理深度的错配。

Method: FORGE在支持形式与思考深度构成的联合动作空间上进行逐查询路由。基于熵正则化、成本感知的效用目标，推导出闭式Boltzmann路由目标，并实例化为269K参数的轻量因子化路由器。训练不含权重访问，围绕冻结宿主模型，采用三阶段流程：离线动作枚举、基于Boltzmann目标的监督KL蒸馏、结合宿主反馈的GRPO精调。

Result: 在5个知识密集型基准与8个7B至671B参数的冻结骨干模型上，FORGE在两个主要宿主上以降低42-45%的token成本提升准确率，并可零样本跨宿主迁移且token成本更低，在支持内在思考预算时可与之组合使用。

Conclusion: FORGE表明，针对冻结模型，仅通过输入与推理流程的联合路由即可有效实现成本-质量权衡的优化，兼具高效性、可迁移性与可组合性。

Abstract: In agentic AI systems, frozen foundation models are increasingly deployed as closed-weight API endpoints, making downstream adaptation possible only through the inputs and inference procedures surrounding the model. As a result, for each input query, two coupled decisions largely determine both answer quality and token cost: what evidence to provide and how much reasoning budget to allocate. Fixed defaults along these axes are often suboptimal, misallocating support form or reasoning depth on roughly 80% of queries in our analysis. To address this challenge, we propose FORGE, a unified framework for adapting frozen models through per-query routing over a joint action space that spans both support form and thinking depth. Under an entropy-regularized, cost-aware utility objective, we derive a closed-form Boltzmann routing target and instantiate the policy as a lightweight 269K-parameter factorized router. The routing policy is trained around the frozen host, without any weight access, through a three-stage pipeline: offline arm enumeration, supervised Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation from the Boltzmann target, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refinement with host feedback. Across 5 knowledge-intensive benchmarks and 8 frozen backbones ranging from 7B to 671B parameters, FORGE improves accuracy at 42-45% lower token cost on both main hosts, transfers zero-shot across hosts at lower token cost, and composes with intrinsic thinking budgets where available.

</details>


### [807] [Coding Agent Memory Post-training: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34422)
*Lirui Luo,Kelong Mao,Heming Xia,Rongqing Li,Xinwei Yang,Luyu Chen,Kieran Wong,Yudong Guo,Xinrui Wang,Jiayin Zhu,Simiu Gu,Sulong Xu,Cong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CAMG（跨Shop、Coding、DeepResearch、AutoResearch的长程智能体RL环境套件）与CAMG-RL（全异步PPO联合训练单一策略），让智能体通过可执行shell与持久工作区以文件形式管理记忆，直接从下游任务奖励中学习记忆行为。训练出的CAMG-RL-4B/9B在SWE-bench Verified与MLE-bench Lite上分别可与Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B相比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程任务的交互历史超出模型有效上下文，已有工作用RL将记忆控制纳入策略，但依赖领域特定、较短时域训练环境中的预定义记忆工具，导致学到的记忆行为与基础模型预训练之外的接口绑定、需从零学习，后训练后仍难以在长程任务中使用记忆。

Method: 构建CAMG：覆盖Shop、Coding、DeepResearch、AutoResearch的长程智能体RL环境套件，在原生任务接口之外提供可执行shell访问与回合持久化工作区，使智能体能创建、修改、检索和复用文件作为记忆；并引入CAMG-RL，用全异步PPO在四个环境上联合训练单一策略，从下游任务奖励直接学习基于文件的记忆行为，基于同尺寸Qwen3.5训练CAMG-RL-4B与CAMG-RL-9B。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified与MLE-bench Lite上，CAMG-RL-4B和CAMG-RL-9B分别与Qwen3.5-35B-A3B和Qwen3.5-122B-A10B表现相当（competitive）。

Conclusion: 通过统一的长程环境与全异步联合RL训练，使基于文件的外部记忆行为可由下游奖励端到端习得，小尺寸模型可在代表性长程基准上以显著更少参数达到与大模型竞争的性能。

Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. Recent work has begun to use reinforcement learning to make memory control part of the policy, often relying on predefined memory tools within domain-specific training environments of relatively short horizons. This setup ties learned memory behavior to environment-specific interfaces that lie outside the base model's pre-training and must be learned from scratch, so even after post-training, agents struggle to use memory in long-horizon tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym (CAMG), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, DeepResearch, and AutoResearch. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG provides executable shell access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling agents to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory throughout an episode. We also introduce CAMG-RL, which trains a single policy jointly across all four environments with fully asynchronous PPO, learning this file-based memory behavior directly from downstream task reward, and we train CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B from Qwen3.5 models of matching size. On SWE-bench Verified and MLE-bench Lite, CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B are competitive with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, respectively.

</details>


### [808] [LLMs as Adaptive Meta-Solvers: Strategy-Diverse RL for Industrial-Scale Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34427)
*Shihao Zhang,Weiting Liu,Siyu Shao,Yitian Chen,Jianfeng Feng,Dongdong Ge,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出SDRL框架，训练开源LLM成为自适应优化元求解器，通过策略多样性强化学习应对工业级优化任务，性能超越现有微调方法与前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM优化方法多在小规模、自包含文本问题上评估，且普遍固守求解器集成范式，难以应对实际工业级优化工作负载的规模与结构多样性。将LLM优化从教科书级扩展到真实工业任务是关键未解挑战。

Method: 1) 实证表明求解器集成推理、精确组合算法与启发式搜索在不同问题结构与规模上具有互补优势；2) 提出策略多样性强化学习（SDRL），训练LLM作为自适应优化元求解器，通过正确性门控的层次化多样性奖励促进跨策略及策略内的鲁棒探索，防止策略过早坍塌；3) 引入混合格式训练方案，同时支持自包含文本问题与基于文件的实例。

Result: 在综合评测中，该框架在基准平均表现及工业级优化任务上均优于现有微调方法与前沿模型（如DeepSeek-V4-Pro和GPT-5.5）。

Conclusion: 通过显式利用多种优化策略的互补性并结合正确性门控的层次化多样性奖励，可有效训练开源LLM胜任真实工业级优化任务，为LLM优化从教科书规模走向工业规模提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Scaling LLM-based optimization from textbook-scale instances to real-world, industrial tasks remains a critical open challenge. Existing approaches are predominantly evaluated on small, self-contained textual problems and often commit to a solver-integrated paradigm, limiting their ability to handle the scale and structural diversity of practical optimization workloads. In this work, we propose a practical framework for training open-source LLMs to tackle real-world, industrial-scale optimization. We first show empirically that solver-integrated reasoning, exact combinatorial algorithm, and heuristic search exhibit complementary strengths across different problem structures and scales. Motivated by this, we introduce Strategy-Diverse Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), which trains LLMs as adaptive optimization meta-solvers. SDRL leverages this complementarity through a correctness-gated hierarchical diversity reward that promotes robust exploration across varying strategies and within each strategy, effectively preventing premature strategy collapse. We further introduce a mixed-format training scheme that jointly supports both self-contained textual problems and file-grounded instances. Across comprehensive evaluations, our framework outperforms existing fine-tuned methods and frontier models including DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GPT-5.5, both on average across benchmarks and on industrial-scale optimization tasks.

</details>


### [809] [Low-Confidence Remasking Traps Flexibility: Realizing Arbitrary-Order Potential for Diverse Rollouts in Diffusion LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34509)
*Moongyu Jeon,Dongjae Jeon,Bumjun Kim,Mingyu Kim,Albert No*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 掩码扩散语言模型的多样性损失主要源于低置信度重掩码（LCR）解码规则，而非任意顺序生成本身；用TPP替换LCR可恢复多样性，EGI进一步利用顺序灵活性提升多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究认为掩码扩散模型的任意顺序生成会因延迟高不确定性token而降低输出多样性，但作者认为这一归因不准确，需要重新定位多样性损失的真实来源。

Method: 将多样性损失归因于广泛使用的低置信度重掩码（LCR）：它在每个掩码位置采样token却只提交概率最高者，过滤掉其余样本。作者提出并区分了顶层概率位置选择（TPP）——先选出最可能token概率最高的位置，再从该位置分布直接采样。同时引入熵引导初始化（EGI），在最熵高的位置采样首个token后接续TPP。

Result: 理论分析表明LCR会随竞争位置增多而指数级抑制低概率token，并在LLaDA中观察到同样的抑制现象；TPP可避免该多样性损失，替换后Pass@k与从左到右解码相当。EGI进一步提升了rollout多样性与解的覆盖率，超过从左到右解码，且增益可延伸至下游策略优化。

Conclusion: 报告的多样性损失主要来自LCR的过滤机制，而非优先生成高置信度位置；通过TPP与EGI可有效利用任意顺序生成的潜力，为多样化rollout提供新途径。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models support arbitrary-order generation, suggesting a natural way to produce diverse outputs. However, recent work argues that this flexibility reduces diversity by delaying high-uncertainty tokens that can lead to different generation paths. We trace this diversity loss not to arbitrary-order generation itself, but largely to low-confidence remasking (LCR), a widely used decoding rule. At each step, LCR samples a token at every masked position but commits only the sampled token with the highest probability, filtering out the rest. We show that this mechanism can exponentially suppress lower-probability tokens as more positions compete, and observe the same suppression in LLaDA. In contrast, top-probability position selection (TPP), which has often been conflated with LCR under the shared label confidence-based decoding, avoids this diversity loss. TPP first selects the position whose most likely token has the highest probability, then samples directly from that position's distribution. Replacing LCR with TPP restores diversity and yields Pass@$k$ comparable to left-to-right decoding, suggesting that the reported diversity loss stems largely from LCR's filtering rather than from generating high-confidence positions first. To further exploit order flexibility, we introduce Entropy-Guided Initialization (EGI), which samples the first token at the highest-entropy position and then follows TPP. This simple modification further improves rollout diversity and solution coverage beyond left-to-right decoding, with gains extending to downstream policy optimization, highlighting the potential of arbitrary-order generation for diverse rollouts.

</details>


### [810] [When Can Attention Heads Be Statically Defined?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34650)
*Weixian Waylon Li,Yintao Tai,Marcio Fonseca,Shay B. Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出选择性注意力冻结（SAF）：在预训练中途，将注意力模式方差低的注意力头替换为拟合的后softmax均值模式，并用绝对位置与相对距离偏好将其参数化为线性存储，配合融合核实现普通注意力与替换头协同计算。在124M/4K设置下替换25%注意力头，替换后优化器更新提速1.056倍，困惑度仅上升0.77%；在1B/8K、四卡含通信条件下提速1.068倍，困惑度上升0.51%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分注意力头在不同输入上学习到的注意力模式高度相似，对这些头重复计算query-key分数与softmax造成算力浪费。若能在训练中途将其模式固定复用，可降低训练成本，同时保留对性能影响较小的注意力头。

Method: 通过受控预训练对比，识别出低注意力模式方差的头，在训练过半时将其注意力权重替换为拟合的后softmax均值（Selective Attention Freezing, SAF）。用绝对位置偏好与相对距离偏好表示这些固定模式，使存储量从序列长度的二次降为线性。设计融合核（fused kernel）重建模式，并将普通注意力头与被替换头合并执行。

Result: 在同等训练token预算下，124M参数、4K上下文替换25%注意力头，替换后优化器更新提速1.056倍，困惑度上升0.77%；1B参数、8K上下文在四张GPU（含通信开销）下替换后更新提速1.068倍，困惑度上升0.51%。所得模型还加速长输入微调与因果prefill。经联想召回（associative-recall）适配后，124M、25%替换模型在固定长度下对更多键值对的泛化优于普通注意力及两个剪枝对照组。

Conclusion: 固定低方差的注意力模式可在有限困惑度代价下显著降低训练与推理开销，并可迁移到长输入微调、因果prefill以及联想召回等任务，优于普通注意力与剪枝基线。

Abstract: Some attention heads learn similar patterns across inputs. Reusing these patterns could reduce training cost by avoiding repeated query-key score computation and softmax. Through controlled pretraining comparisons, we identify Selective Attention Freezing (SAF), which selects heads with low attention-pattern variance and replaces their attention weights with fitted post-softmax means halfway through training. We represent these fixed patterns with absolute-position and relative-distance preferences, reducing storage from quadratic to linear in sequence length. A fused kernel reconstructs the patterns and executes ordinary-attention and replaced heads together. At matched training-token budgets, replacing 25% of attention heads gives 1.056x faster post-replacement optimiser updates at 124M parameters and 4K context, with a 0.77% perplexity increase. At 1B and 8K context, post-replacement updates are 1.068x faster on four GPUs including communication, with a 0.51% perplexity increase. The resulting models also accelerate long-input finetuning and causal prefill. After associative-recall adaptation, the 124M model with 25% replacement generalises to more key-value pairs at a fixed length better than ordinary attention and two pruning controls.

</details>


### [811] [Quality Determines Direction, Length Shapes Magnitude: Length Control for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34718)
*Zijun Weng,Zhongan Bi,Xuanang Gao,Xiaohui Hu,Shuangyong Song,Yongxiang Li,Kaidong Yu,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QGLAS方法，通过对质量优势进行非对称的长度奖励塑形，在保持质量的同时显著压缩响应长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在提升语言模型质量的同时会显著增加响应长度，导致token效率下降。在开放式RL中控制长度增长尤为困难：长度与质量相互纠缠；开放式任务缺乏自然的成功边界来判断何时应优先考虑效率；密集的梯度奖励常导致组内质量差距很小，使得质量诱导的优势对奖励层面的长度塑形极为敏感，可能扰动其幅度甚至反转其符号。

Method: 采用非对称原则：质量决定强化方向，长度仅塑造其幅度。具体实现为质量门控长度优势塑形（QGLAS）：先仅从质量奖励计算优势，然后仅对较短的正优势响应添加有界奖励，其余优势保持不变。奖励强度进一步根据组内质量分离度自适应调整——当质量偏好响应彼此相似时，简洁性更重要；当质量差异明显时，简洁性权重降低。

Result: 在不同模型家族、开放式基准和奖励来源下，QGLAS均实现了比代表性基线更强的质量-长度权衡。在约30%压缩率下，QGLAS保留了仅质量RL相对于基模型所获宏观平均质量增益的98.4%-102.0%，而基线在相当压缩率下仅为68.3%-75.5%。

Conclusion: 通过将长度塑形限定为仅对正优势短响应的有界奖励，并自适应其强度，可在不损害质量的前提下有效控制RL引入的长度膨胀，实现更优的质量-长度权衡。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) changes not only what language models say, but also how much they say, often increasing response length at the cost of token efficiency. Controlling this length growth is particularly challenging in open-ended RL because (i) response length is entangled with quality, (ii) open-ended tasks lack a natural success boundary for deciding when efficiency should be prioritized, and (iii) dense, graded rewards often yield small within-group quality margins, making quality-induced advantages especially sensitive to reward-level length shaping, which can perturb their magnitudes and even reverse their signs. We therefore adopt an asymmetric principle: quality should determine the direction of reinforcement, while length should only shape its magnitude. We instantiate this principle with Quality-Gated Length Advantage Shaping (QGLAS), which first computes advantages from quality rewards alone, then adds bounded bonuses only to shorter positive-advantage responses, leaving all other advantages unchanged. The bonus strength is further adapted to within-group quality separation, allowing conciseness to matter more when quality-favored responses are similar and less when their quality differences are clear. Across different model families, open-ended benchmarks, and reward sources, QGLAS consistently achieves a stronger quality--length trade-off than representative baselines. At approximately 30% compression, QGLAS retains 98.4--102.0% of the macro-average quality gains achieved by quality-only RL over the base model, compared with 68.3--75.5% for these baselines at comparable compression.

</details>


### [812] [DivOPD: Spread Wide, Look Close for Asynchronous On-Policy Distillation of Multi-turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34838)
*Hanyang Wang,Zeyuan Liu,Zhengyu Chen,Jingqing Ruan,Chaoxu Pang,Zhongda Su,Wulin Xie,Zhizhao Zeng,Ke Zeng,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DivOPD是一种学习者侧批次选择方法，通过将固定回合预算分散到更多rollout、优先选择师生累积分歧大的回合，缓解异步多轮on-policy蒸馏中的rollout陈旧与浪费问题，显著提升成功率与训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步多轮训练中，按到达顺序组批会使少数早期或长rollout主导学习者更新，而其他有效rollout在使用前已陈旧，导致已生成经验被浪费、训练低效且不稳定。

Method: 提出DivOPD：学习者侧批次选择方法，将固定回合预算分配到更多rollout，并在每个rollout内优先选择师生累积分歧较大的回合；剔除无可用教师反馈的回合。逐回合损失函数与优化器保持不变，选择仅改变哪些学生访问回合获得训练权重。可选扩展：对无进展rollout，短暂交由教师接管后再交回学生。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop三个模拟基准的六组师生设置（学生规模1.5B–7B）中，DivOPD将跨设置平均峰值成功率从77.4提升至84.4，最近五次评估平均成功率从71.5提升至78.6；所有设置特定目标均达成，训练token几何平均加速1.84倍，学习者GPU时间加速1.87倍。加入教师干预后，最近五次平均成功率进一步提升至82.4，同时保持约1.7倍学习者GPU加速。

Conclusion: 合理的批次与回合选择即可显著改善异步on-policy蒸馏的有效性与效率，且无需修改损失或优化器；教师干预可进一步增益。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student agents through teacher supervision on their own interactions with an environment. However, in asynchronous multi-turn training, arrival-order batching can allow a few early or long rollouts to dominate learner updates while other valid rollouts become stale before being used, wasting already-generated experience. To address this problem, we introduce DivOPD, a simple learner-side batch-selection method that spreads a fixed turn budget across more rollouts and, within each rollout, prioritizes turns with larger cumulative teacher-student disagreement. Turns without usable teacher feedback are excluded. The per-turn loss and optimizer remain fixed; selection only changes which student-visited turns receive training weight. For no-progress rollouts, an optional extension briefly hands control to the teacher before returning it to the student. Across six teacher-student settings on the simulated ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop benchmarks, with 1.5B-7B students, DivOPD raises cross-setting mean peak success rate from 77.4 to 84.4 and mean success over the last five evaluations from 71.5 to 78.6. It reaches all reported setting-specific targets with geometric-mean speedups of 1.84x in training tokens and 1.87x in learner GPU time relative to vanilla OPD. Teacher intervention further raises this last-five mean to 82.4 while retaining about 1.7x learner-GPU speedup over vanilla OPD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HanyangWang0418-oss/DivOPD.

</details>


### [813] [Beyond Verbalized Confidence: Calibrating Reasoners with Differentiable Readouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34857)
*Chenxiao Fan,Chongming Gao,Gangyi Zhang,Leyang Shen,Yaxin Gong,Jiamin Wang,Jiakai Wang,Dong Wang,Yang Liu,Fuli Feng,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CREDO方法，用确定性读出替代采样式置信度，通过可微回归在RLVR循环内训练校准，实现准确率与校准性同步提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR虽能让推理模型给出正确答案，但无法保证其表达的置信度得到校准，导致模型系统性过度自信。现有在RLVR循环内训练校准的方法均通过文本采样获取置信度，这一选择带来两个代价：采样引入方差且实际坍缩为少数离散值；采样使置信度不可微，迫使校准损失只能通过标量奖励传递。

Method: CREDO（Confidence REaDOut）用确定性读出替代采样。在RLVR优化正确性的同时，CREDO从模型输出分布中一个专用token对的概率读出置信度，并通过可微回归进行训练。此外，CREDO将训练后的置信度转化为准确性的信号，依据置信度与结果的不一致程度对rollout加权，使准确率与校准性共同提升。

Result: 在数学与代码推理任务上，CREDO取得了最佳的准确率与校准性，且增益可扩展至弃答（abstention）与选择性预测（selective prediction）任务。

Conclusion: 用专用token对的确定性读出取代采样式置信度，并结合可微回归训练，可有效解决RLVR中置信度过度自信问题，在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著改善校准性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models to produce correct answers, but does not ensure that their stated confidence is calibrated. The resulting models are systematically overconfident. Recent methods train calibration inside the RLVR loop by having the model state a numerical confidence alongside its answer, but they all obtain the confidence by sampling it as text. This choice imposes two costs: a sampled confidence introduces variance and in practice collapses to a handful of distinct values, and sampling makes the confidence non-differentiable, forcing the calibration loss through a scalar reward. We propose CREDO (Confidence REaDOut) to replace sampling with a deterministic readout. While RLVR optimizes correctness, CREDO reads the confidence from a dedicated token pair in the model's output distribution and trains it by differentiable regression. CREDO further turns the trained confidence into a signal for accuracy, weighting rollouts by how far confidence and outcome disagree, so that accuracy and calibration improve together. Across mathematical and code reasoning, CREDO attains the best accuracy and calibration, and the gains extend to abstention and selective prediction.

</details>


### [814] [Sample What You Say: Aligning Language Models to Sample the Distributions They State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34929)
*Kasra Arabi,Virginia Smith,Chhavi Yadav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"见证优势"（witness advantage），基于MMD从组内每个rollout单独计算优势，使GRPO能训练模型精确匹配目标分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型常被要求从特定分布采样（如模拟受访者、生成合成数据），但指令微调模型即使能正确陈述分布，仍无法真正从中采样；提示词调整与解码修改只能部分缓解这一偏差，故需用策略优化进行训练。GRPO天然适合此问题，因为它本就对每个提示采样一组rollout，但把整组作为整体打分会导致组内相对中心化后所有优势为零，模型得不到学习信号。

Method: 引入见证优势：基于最大均值差异（MMD）为每个rollout计算独立优势。MMD在模型分布与目标分布之间的见证函数可度量每个结果被过度或不足生成的程度；每个rollout的优势即其对应结果处负见证值的估计，对组内生成不足的结果给予奖励、对过度生成的结果施加惩罚。该优势由组内结果计数闭式求解，并作为GRPO的奖励使用。

Result: 在未见过的目标分布上，使用见证优势训练显著降低了与目标分布的总变差距离，同时基本保留了模型的通用能力。

Conclusion: 将分布匹配目标转化为逐rollout的MMD见证优势，可为GRPO提供有效学习信号，在保持通用能力的前提下提升目标分布采样精度。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly used to sample from a specified distribution, for instance, to simulate survey respondents or generate synthetic data. Instruction-tuned models can state such a distribution correctly and still fail to sample from it. Prompting and changes to decoding reduce this mismatch only partly, which motivates training with policy optimization. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) is a natural fit for this problem because it already samples a group of rollouts per prompt, and the group's empirical distribution can be compared with the target. However, scoring the group as a whole gives every rollout the same reward. Group-relative centering then sets all advantages to zero, and the model receives no learning signal. To give each rollout its own signal, we introduce the witness advantage, a per-rollout advantage derived from maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). It trains a model to match a target distribution over a finite set of outcomes. The MMD between the model's distribution and the target has a witness function that measures how over- or under-produced each outcome is. Each rollout's advantage estimates the negative witness at its outcome, so a rollout is rewarded for an outcome the group under-produces and penalized for one it over-produces. The witness advantage is computed in closed form from the group's outcome counts, and we use it as the reward in GRPO. On unseen target distributions, training with the witness advantage substantially reduces the total variation distance to the target while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.

</details>


### [815] [Don't Forget! Decomposing the Training Dynamics of Memorization in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34933)
*Florian Eichin,Philipp Mondorf,Andrei Mircea,Yupei Du,Barbara Plank,Michael A. Hedderich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过分解记忆序列在训练中的损失轨迹及模型参数，揭示记忆的训练动力学：背诵与回忆均表现为序列级梯度对齐，但背诵因与其他训练影响错位而遗忘，需更高重复度；低层参数主导记忆与遗忘；该方法在预测记忆上优于交叉熵基线，并能通过干预少量高影响参数消除最终模型的记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆被认为是语言模型拟合训练分布尾部的重要机制，但其训练动力学尚不清楚。作者希望细粒度理解记忆如何在训练过程中发展，以便预测和干预记忆行为。

Method: 在Pythia模型家族上，将记忆序列的损失轨迹按训练过程和模型参数进行分解；对比研究重复训练序列（背诵）与罕见序列（回忆）的记忆；分析序列级梯度对齐；识别对记忆和遗忘最相关的模型层；基于分解预测记忆，并干预少量高影响参数。

Result: 背诵与回忆的记忆均表现为序列级梯度对齐；背诵因与其他训练影响错位导致遗忘，说明其需要更高重复度。低层参数参与记忆与遗忘最多。该分解的预测效果优于交叉熵基线，尤其在更大模型和训练早期更明显；干预少量高影响参数可在最终模型中消除记忆。

Conclusion: 研究推进了对记忆在训练中如何发展的理解，为预测和干预记忆提供了新视角，并表明记忆动力学可通过损失轨迹与参数分解进行细粒度刻画。

Abstract: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism to explain how language models fit the tail of their training distributions, but its training dynamics are not understood well. In this work, we take a fine-grained look at memorization by decomposing the loss trajectory of memorized sequences over training and model parameters. Across the Pythia family, we study memorization of duplicated training sequences (recitation) and rare ones (recollection). We find that memorization in both cases is characterized by sequence-level gradient alignment, though recitation suffers from misalignment with other training influences which causes forgetting, explaining the necessity for higher duplication of these examples. We further show that the lower model layers are the most involved in memorization and forgetting. Predicting memorization, our decomposition improves over a cross-entropy baseline, especially in larger models and early in training. Intervening on a small set of highly influential parameters we are able to ablate memorization in the final model. Together, these findings advance our understanding of how memorization develops during training and offer insights for predicting and intervening on it.

</details>


### [816] [See it, Say it, Sorted: Mechanistic Diagnosis and Parameter-Space Mitigation of Emergent Misalignment in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34970)
*Weiqiao Que,Ruizhe Li,Chengyu Wang,Dakan Wang,Emine Yilmaz,Xiaofeng He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对安全对齐大模型中的涌现失配(EM)进行动态二阶几何研究，揭示曲率集中于语义枢轴token、有害-安全间隔扩大源于安全梯度重叠下降，并提出参数级几何缓解框架，正交投影有害梯度子空间以抑制EM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的LLM存在涌现失配现象：狭窄领域微调会意外触发跨无关领域的灾难性安全失效。既有静态分析未刻画训练动态，现有防御依赖启发式且损害模型效用，因此需要从训练动力学与几何角度理解并缓解EM。

Method: 对EM开展动态二阶几何分析：追踪训练轨迹，计算方向性Hessian曲率以定位语义枢轴token；用Grassmannian投影分析有害-安全间隔变化来源。据此提出参数级几何缓解框架，将经验有害梯度子空间从参数更新中正交投影剔除。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-14B-IT上，该防御将自由生成场景的EM抑制最高达80.0%；在四个开放权重指令模型家族中的其余三个(3B–20B)、单层行为EM已接近零的情况下，教师强制评估表明同一有害子空间仍控制冻结EM响应的条件支持，且该子空间在行为EM近零的模型中依然可测量、可操纵。

Conclusion: EM具有可解释的二阶几何结构，集中于枢轴token并由有害梯度子空间主导；参数级正交投影可有效缓解EM且揭示“行为安全”的假象，即行为EM近零的模型内部仍保留可测量的有害子空间。

Abstract: Safety-aligned LLMs can exhibit emergent misalignment (EM): narrow domain adaptation unexpectedly triggers catastrophic safety failures across unrelated domains. Prior static analyses leave training dynamics unmapped, while existing defenses rely on heuristics that degrade utility. We present a dynamic, second-order geometric study of EM. Tracking training trajectories reveals that directional Hessian curvature concentrates sharply on semantic pivot tokens. Grassmannian projections show that, in most settings, harmful-safe gap widens mainly because safe-gradient overlap declines. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a parameter-level Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates. On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, our defense suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80.0%; across the other three of four open-weight instruction-based model families (3B--20B), where single-layer behavioral EM is already near zero, teacher-forced evaluation shows same harmful subspace controls the conditional support of frozen EM responses. Crucially, these diagnostics unmask the illusion of behavioral safety: the same subspace remains measurable and steerable in models where behavioral EM is near zero. Code: https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/mechanistic-emergent-misalignment.

</details>


### [817] [ORPG: Reconciling Multiple Reward Objectives through Objective-wise Policy Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34985)
*Shicheng Fang,Yiwen Zhao,Wenbo Tian,Jiahao Lu,Yining Zheng,Yuxin Wang,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG)，为每个奖励构建独立的裁剪策略目标，并将梯度调和成单次策略更新：相容梯度经余弦相关的部分归一化插值协调，冲突梯度按任务优先级投影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多奖励策略优化需要同时反映学习信号与目标间预期关系的联合更新，而现有方法难以在保持各目标独立梯度信号的同时妥善处理目标相容与冲突两种情形。

Method: 为每个奖励分别构造裁剪策略目标；对相容梯度采用余弦相关的插值，通过部分归一化参考协调各分量贡献并保持其和的范数，并将其刻画为球面方向性折衷的唯一解；对冲突梯度则按任务优先级进行投影。

Result: 在 helpfulness–safety 对齐与数学推理的 correctness–cost 优化中，同一相容规则均有效；ORPG 在两个轴向上的平均 Useful 与 Harmless 分数均显著优于最强外部基线；在数学任务上取得所比方法中最高的全预算平均准确率与三预算 hypervolume，且相较初始策略回答更准确、更简短。

Conclusion: 梯度调和同时适用于地位平等的目标与具有显式优先级的目标；消融与训练动态显示相容协调贡献更大，冲突处理提供互补收益。

Abstract: Multi-reward policy optimization requires a joint update that reflects both the learning signals and the intended relationships among objectives. We introduce Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG), which constructs a separate clipped policy objective for each reward and reconciles the resulting gradients into one policy update. For compatible gradients, a cosine-dependent interpolation coordinates their contributions through a partially normalized reference while preserving the norm of their sum. We characterize this update as the unique solution of a spherical directional compromise. For conflicting gradients, projection follows the task's priorities. We evaluate the same compatible rule in helpfulness--safety alignment and correctness--cost optimization for mathematical reasoning. ORPG substantially improves average Useful and Harmless scores over the strongest external baseline on each axis. In mathematics, it achieves the highest average full-budget accuracy and three-budget hypervolume among the compared methods, with more accurate and shorter responses than the initial policy. Component comparisons and training dynamics show the larger contribution of compatible coordination and a complementary benefit from conflict handling. These results support gradient reconciliation for objectives with equal standing and for objectives with an explicit priority.

</details>


### [818] [TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35224)
*Kasra Arabi,Nir Weinberger,Micah Goldblum,Niv Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TANGO是一种针对掩码扩散语言模型的文本水印方案，通过将新token与附近已解掩码token的颜色绑定，把水印嵌入token对中，避免了固定绿名单在token频率上留下的统计痕迹，从而同时实现可靠检测与抗伪造攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型并行、无序地填充掩码位置，而多数实用文本水印假设从左到右生成，将每个token绑定到其之前的token上，但这些前序token在扩散模型中可能仍处于掩码状态。固定绿名单虽不依赖上下文，却在每个位置偏好相同token，导致水印文本中这些token出现频率偏高；攻击者对比水印与非水印文本的token频率即可恢复绿名单，并伪造能被供应商检测器接受的文本。因此需要一种既适配无序生成、又抗频率攻击的水印方法。

Method: 提出TANGO水印：每个新token绑定到一个附近已经解掩码的token。用秘密密钥把词表划分为颜色类，TANGO根据密钥和邻近token的颜色，将新token偏向某一确定颜色。这样水印被嵌入到token对之中；由于受偏好颜色随位置变化，token频率比固定绿名单更接近未加水印文本。检测仅需文本和密钥，且不假设任何解掩码顺序。

Result: 在两个掩码扩散模型上，TANGO几乎能检测出全部未编辑的水印文本以及多数经过编辑的水印文本；而针对固定绿名单的频

Conclusion: 

Abstract: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.

</details>


### [819] [Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35426)
*Robin Faro,Shyam Sundhar Ramesh,Ilija Bogunovic,Aurelien Lucchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"frontier learning"（前沿学习），一种开放式后训练方法，利用程序化生成器在线持续生成有信息量的训练问题，通过regret信号优先探索"前沿难度"，使训练始终位于模型能力边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习（如GRPO损失）的大语言模型后训练流程，通常在训练前固定一个题目池进行微调。这一方法存在根本性局限：学习信号仅在策略rollout同时包含成功与失败时才会产生，因此随着模型能力提升，固定题池中"有用"的部分会迅速变得陈旧（stale），无法持续提供有效监督信号。

Method: 提出frontier learning开放式后训练方法：使用程序化生成器（procedural generators）在线持续产生有信息量的训练问题；将生成器的任务特定参数视为搜索空间，并利用regret信号对"前沿难度水平"进行优先级排序与探索，从而将训练聚焦在模型不断演化的推理能力边缘。

Result: 在多个推理任务和多种模型家族上，该方法相较固定题池基线（fixed-pool baselines）一致取得更高的相对增益。

Conclusion: 有效的后训练不仅需要"选择"有用的问题，更需要在其能力边缘"持续生成"问题，验证了开放式问题生成相对于固定题池的核心优势。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.

</details>


### [820] [LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35427)
*George Yakushev,Denis Mazur,Vladimir Bartenev,Vyacheslav Zhdanovskiy,Timofey Byzov,Vladimir Kaurkin,Vadim Pastushenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用异步大模型框架，使用户或智能体可定义带重叠记忆状态的推理协程，从而让 Qwen 3.x 模型无需任务专属训练即可处理流式视频理解、电子游戏和监控等并发场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大模型智能体遵循"读取-思考-回复/调用工具-循环"的串行交互模式，但语音助手、具身智能体、监控系统等真实场景需要在思考或执行任务时接收新输入。现有方案依赖语音交互、视频流、机器人 VLA、异步工具调用等专用架构，缺乏对不同并发类型的通用支持。

Method: 作者从各类异步任务推广到通用异步智能体，提出一个异步大模型框架，允许用户或智能体自身定义带重叠记忆状态的推理协程，从而实现对不同并发类型的适配。

Result: 实验表明，Qwen 3.x 模型能够在流式视频理解、电子游戏和监控三类场景中实现异步操作，且无需任何任务专属训练。

Conclusion: 通用异步智能体可借助推理协程与重叠记忆状态，在不进行任务专属微调的情况下胜任多种并发任务，为异步交互提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat. Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task. Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others. In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency. To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.

</details>


### [821] [CLIMB: A Clinical Multimorbidity Benchmark for Diagnosing Co-occurring Conditions through Multiturn Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35462)
*Yusuf Kesmen,Aniruddha Mukherjee,Yena Chang,David Sasu,Trevor Brokowski,Alexandra V. Kulinkina,Kristina Keitel,Akhil Arora,Lars Henning Klein,Mary-Anne Hartley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CLIMB基准，用于评估多轮交互、多标签诊断下的临床推理能力，发现现有前沿模型在共病诊断上表现很差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者常有多种共病，且诊断线索在问诊过程中逐步显现，而现有评估多聚焦单轮、单标签诊断，无法反映真实临床推理需求，因此需要一个兼顾多轮交互与多标签诊断的基准。

Method: 构建CLIMB基准：由医生模型与模拟患者进行多轮问诊，恢复共病真值集合；病例基于临床决策算法与诊断数据集合成，将多病表现根植于结构化临床知识；在六个前沿及开源模型上评测，并进行受控实验，提出单假设追踪的理论参考模型。

Result: 无模型能在超过10%的交互病例中恢复完全正确的共病集合；共病出现时诊断性能下降，即使给出完整病历和真实病种数也一样；交互进一步降低性能。受控实验显示模型表现为单假设追踪：锚定最初线索提示的诊断，围绕其反复提问，只有在当前线索明确指向第二病种时才可能发现，继续追问多产生错误诊断而非补全集合。

Conclusion: 多轮、多标签的临床推理对现有模型仍是重大挑战，模型倾向于单假设追踪，需要新的方法来支持共病诊断；CLIMB基准、生成器与评测代码已公开。

Abstract: Patients often have several co-occurring clinical conditions, and the findings needed to identify and disambiguate them emerge over the course of a consultation. Evaluating clinical reasoning in this setting requires both multi-turn interaction and multi-label diagnosis. We introduce CLIMB, a benchmark in which a doctor model interviews a simulated patient to recover a ground truth set of co-occurring clinical conditions. Cases are synthesized from clinical decision algorithms and diagnostic datasets, grounding multimorbid presentations in structured clinical knowledge. Across six frontier and open models, none recovers the exact set of conditions in more than 10% of interactive cases. Diagnostic performance declines when conditions co-occur, even when models receive the full clinical record and the true number of conditions. Interaction reduces performance further. In controlled experiments, models behave like single-hypothesis trackers: they anchor on the diagnosis suggested by the opening findings, keep questioning around it, and recover a second condition mainly when a finding in view points to it. Questioning them further does not complete the set but adds mostly wrong diagnoses. We formalise this pattern with a theoretical reference model of single-hypothesis tracking. The benchmark, generator, and evaluation code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CLIMB-8340.

</details>


### [822] [Twist, Don't Tilt: Trajectory-Exact Constrained Decoding for Masked Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35609)
*Aditya Thimmaiah,Lara Marinov,Jayanth Srinivasa,Haris Vikalo,Junyi Jessy Li,Milos Gligoric*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的逐步精确约束解码在组合后会产生轨迹偏置，并据此提出自动化机扭曲的序贯蒙特卡洛解码器 TWISTER 来修正该偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束解码需保证生成结果满足指定结构或语法。现有基于自动机的逐步精确采样策略虽然每一步都精确且满足约束，但其复合结果会偏离模型在有效轨迹上的相对概率，产生轨迹偏置，因此需要刻画并纠正该偏置。

Method: 作者推导了轨迹偏置的精确表达式，将其表示为有效延续质量在去噪器重新条件化时变化的比值乘积，并刻画偏置消失的条件；随后提出 TWISTER——首个面向 MDLM 的自动机扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛解码器，以逐步精确解码器作为提议分布，利用 Feynman-Kac 修正实现无偏采样。

Result: 对于正则语言约束，Feynman-Kac 修正可精确计算，扭曲项可借助为逐步精确采样预先计算的量高效获得；证明了所得 Feynman-Kac 模型以条件满足约束下的无偏 Doob h-变换路径律为目标。

Conclusion: 逐步精确的约束采样并不保证轨迹层面的正确性，TWISTER 通过 Feynman-Kac 扭曲校正了轨迹偏置，为 MDLM 的约束解码提供了理论上有保证的无偏方案。

Abstract: Constrained decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) aims to ensure that generated outputs satisfy a specified structure or syntax constraint. MDLMs generate outputs by repeatedly unmasking masked positions present in their current state. Recent strategies for constrained decoding constrain the model's per-step mean-field posterior (which factorizes over masked positions) by enforcing the desired constraint with an automaton. The resulting chain-structured factor graph allows exact constrained sampling via dynamic programming. However, despite each draw being exact and constraint-satisfying, we prove that their composition, in general, tilts away from the model's relative probabilities over valid trajectories, thus leading to trajectory bias. We derive an exact expression for this bias as a product of ratios measuring how valid continuation mass changes when the denoiser is reconditioned, and characterize when the bias vanishes. We then correct the bias by introducing TWISTER, the first automaton-twisted Sequential Monte Carlo decoder for MDLMs, using the step-exact decoder as the proposal. We show that for regular language constraints, the Feynman-Kac correction is exactly computable, with the twists obtained efficiently using quantities pre-computed for step-exact sampling. We prove that the resulting Feynman-Kac model targets the unbiased Doob h-transformed path law conditioned on constraint satisfaction.

</details>


### [823] [SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35629)
*Kyle Lee,Christian Z. Pratt,Ruoyu Fang,Heekyung Lee,Avinash Lohitsa,Ryan Modafe,Kerem Y. Camsari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SANTA++ 是一种免训练的随机注意力方法，通过"团队代表键+重要性采样"在不扫描全部 KV 缓存的情况下近似全缓存注意力，仅用 16%–22% 的 KV 读取即可保留 94%–99% 的稠密注意力分数，并获得 1.69× 的 GPU 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力通常集中在上下文中一小部分 token 上，但这个"重要子集"随查询变化而变化。要利用这种动态稀疏结构，现有方法往往需要扫描全部 KV 缓存来找出重要位置，导致内存读取开销大，无法真正节省带宽。

Method: SANTA++ 是免训练（training-free）的随机注意力方法：1) 将缓存中的 key 组织成若干"团队"（teams）；2) 查询只对每个团队的一个代表键打分，据此决定采样哪些团队；3) 在采样到的团队内部计算精确注意力分数；4) 用团队被包含概率的倒数对每个团队的贡献重新加权，形成重要性采样校正，从而无偏估计全缓存上的注意力；5) 通过采样团队数这一预算参数，在内存读取量与精度之间权衡。方法避免了扫描完整 KV 缓存。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、32K 上下文下：采样 32 或 64 个团队时，SANTA++ 仅使用稠密注意力 16%–22% 的 KV 读取，在 LongBench v2 与 HELMET 的检索增强生成子集上保留 94%–99% 的稠密基线分数，在 RULER 上保留 85%–91%。采样 31 个团队时，其 GPU 实现在 32K 上下文上相对稠密 FlashAttention 基线取得 1.69× 的注意力加速。

Conclusion: SANTA++ 以训练无关的重要性采样框架，用少量 KV 读取实现了接近稠密注意力的精度和实际加速。由于减少了读取的缓存条目数量，它在原理上可与压缩型 KV 表示架构（如多头潜在注意力 MLA）互补。内核代码已开源。

Abstract: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. Remarkably, with 32 or 64 sampled teams, SANTA++ uses 16% to 22% of dense attention's KV reads and retains 94% to 99% of the dense-attention baseline's scores on LongBench v2 and HELMET's retrieval-augmented generation subset, and 85% to 91% on RULER, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context. With 31 sampled teams, our GPU implementation delivers a $1.69\times$ attention speedup over the dense FlashAttention baseline at 32K context. By reducing the number of cache entries read, SANTA++ in principle complements architectures with compressed KV representations, such as multi-head latent attention. Our kernels are available at: https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-kernel-demo.git.

</details>


### [824] [Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35695)
*Qiyao Ma,Junshan Zhang,Zhe Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出百万参数级MLP个性化排序模型，复用生成器内部嵌入，通过测试时对齐与Best-of-N释放个性化生成性能潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准对齐范式面向单一化用户（monolithic users）优化，难以适配多样化的用户偏好，导致个性化生成存在大量未被利用的性能空间（headroom）；而奖励模型（reward models）在个性化场景下校准不佳，且十亿级参数规模使大规模候选池打分开销过高。

Method: 首先通过实证研究揭示测试时对齐（test-time alignment）中个性化生成的可观性能余量，指出个性化生成更适合BoN等测试时扩展方法，本质是候选匹配问题而非生成器能力瓶颈。进而提出参数高效框架：采用百万参数级多层感知机（MLP）排序模型，直接复用基础生成器的内部嵌入，以极低开销打分；并通过扩展训练时数据提供细粒度个性化偏好，使该排序模型能准确评估大规模候选池，并低成本引导生成、减少实体化N个候选的开销。

Result: 在覆盖三类个性化生成设置的九个数据集上，该个性化排序模型有效利用了所发现的性能余量，在每个数据集上均优于十亿参数级通用奖励模型，参数量不到其0.4%，打分延迟低四个数量级。

Conclusion: 个性化生成可通过测试时扩展与轻量级、复用生成器嵌入的排序模型高效实现，以极小参数量和极低延迟超越大规模通用奖励模型，为多样用户偏好对齐提供了参数高效且可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse user preferences is fundamentally hindered by standard alignment paradigms that optimize for monolithic users. In this work, empirical studies are first used to reveal the existence of a massive, untapped performance headroom for personalized generation through test-time alignment. We demonstrate that personalized generation is uniquely suited for test-time scaling methods like Best-of-N (BoN) because it can be viewed primarily as a candidate matching problem rather than a generator capability bottleneck. While reward models could in principle exploit this headroom, they are poorly calibrated for personalization, and their billion-parameter scale makes scoring large candidate pools prohibitively expensive. To overcome this limitation, we propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing million-parameter scale multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ranking models. Our personalized ranking model directly reuses the internal embeddings of the base generator with minimal overhead. By scaling train-time data to provide fine-grained personalized preferences, this million-parameter ranking model accurately scores large candidate pools and can seamlessly guide generation to reduce the cost of materializing N candidates. Extensive experiments on nine datasets spanning three personalized generation settings show that our personalized ranking model effectively exploits the discovered headroom, outperforming billion-parameter generalist reward models on every dataset, with under 0.4% of their parameters and four orders of magnitude lower scoring latency.

</details>


### [825] [How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35751)
*Shouren Wang,Chuang Ma,Mohsen Hariri,Debargha Ganguly,Wang Yang,Xiaoqing Tong,Qianying Liu,Xiaotian Han,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Foil，一种循环稀疏专家（Looped MoE）架构设计方法，通过"展平专家"和"解绑注意力"来回答"如何循环 MoE"的问题，在等参数等计算下显著优于未展平的循环基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复使用同一层块提升固定规模模型的计算利用率；稀疏 MoE 则每次仅激活少数专家。将二者结合的循环 MoE 有望改善专家使用效率，但如何合理地对 MoE 进行循环尚无明确答案，本文旨在解决这一设计问题。

Method: Foil 在保持专家参数与每 token 专家计算量不变的前提下采用两项措施：(1) 展平专家——将专家层数减半、每层专家数翻倍、循环次数翻倍，使每次路由从更大专家池中选择；(2) 解绑注意力——每次循环使用独立的注意力参数，而专家与路由器保持共享。

Result: 20B token 时每个 Foil 模型的预训练损失均低于基线；100B token 时损失随展平程度单调改善，最展平的 Foil 在等参数等计算下损失比基线低 0.012 nat，下游准确率持平或更优；解绑注意力在相同形状下带来更均衡、更自信的路由。消融实验表明循环收益与专家层加宽的收益相互放大，路由置信度比负载均衡更能反映健康的专家使用情况。

Conclusion: 循环与加宽专家层具有相互增强效应，路由置信度是比负载均衡更好的专家使用健康度指标，因此稀疏循环 MoE 应设计为每层使用更多专家、配合更多循环次数。

Abstract: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Foil (1) flattens the experts, halving the expert layers, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared. Experiments show that Foil clearly outperforms the unflattened looped baseline: at 20B tokens every Foil model has lower pretraining loss than the baseline; at 100B tokens the loss improves monotonically with the degree of flattening, the most flattened Foil ending 0.012 nat below the baseline at equal parameters and compute, with downstream accuracy on par or better; untying the attention also yields more balanced and more confident routing at equal shape. Our ablations analyse why Foil works and turn the findings into design guidance for looped MoE: the returns of looping and of widening the expert layers amplify each other, routing confidence tracks healthy expert use better than load balance, and a sparse looped MoE should therefore use more experts per layer and more passes. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/SR-A-W/how-to-loop-moe.

</details>


### [826] [SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32108)
*Aayushi Shrivastava,Xunlan Zhou,Hongrui Zhao,Ziyu Chen,Negar Mehr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAMBAR：一种无需旧任务演示回放的VLA持续学习方法，将微调建模为约束优化并用乘子法求解，配合参数选择性锚定，在LIBERO与真机上实现不遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略需持续学习新任务，但直接微调会导致灾难性遗忘并损害通用能力；主流持续学习方法依赖回放旧任务演示，而这些数据往往无法获得。

Method: 将持续学习形式化为约束优化问题，用乘子法（method of multipliers）求解，通过对偶变量随约束违反累积而提高惩罚，抑制参数偏离旧值；同时仅对关键参数进行选择性锚定以保留旧任务知识，其余参数自由用于新任务学习。

Result: 在LIBERO仿真基准与真实硬件上评估：顺序微调VLA时，所有无回放基线均完全遗忘第一个任务，而SAMBAR保留其学习过的每一个任务。

Conclusion: 对偶变量与选择性锚定相结合，可在无旧任务演示条件下平衡新知识获取与旧知识保留，使VLA持续微调不再发生灾难性遗忘。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale pretraining to ultimately achieve generalist manipulation. Deployed VLA policies must support continual learning to acquire new tasks over time. Teaching a VLA a new task generally requires finetuning it on demonstrations of that task. However, naively finetuning on downstream tasks causes the policy to forget earlier tasks and degrades generalist capabilities. This failure is known as catastrophic forgetting. Most continual learning methods counter it by replaying data from earlier tasks. However, the old task demonstrations are not always readily available. In this paper, we introduce SAMBAR, a continual learning algorithm that prevents catastrophic forgetting during VLA finetuning without requiring access to the demonstrations of any previously learned task. We propose to cast continual learning as a constrained optimization problem and solve it with the method of multipliers. In our approach, the method of multipliers drives the policy to learn the new task without the model parameters drifting far away from their previous values. In contrast to a standard regularization penalty, the method of multipliers raises the penalty as the constraint violation accumulates by using a dual variable. We also selectively anchor the parameters critical to previous tasks to preserve past knowledge, leaving other parameters free for new task acquisition. The combination of dual variable and selective anchoring, therefore, balances knowledge acquisition with knowledge retention. We evaluate our method, SAMBAR, on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and on hardware. When sequentially finetuning on a VLA, every replay-free baseline we compare against completely forgets the first task it learned, whereas SAMBAR retains every task it has learned.

</details>


### [827] [Optimizing H-Graph Hybridization for Diffusion-Guided RRT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32897)
*Omer Talmi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种推理时多样性策略（因子多样性与仅精炼多样性），通过H-Graph混合机制结合，在AntMaze机器人15个场景中显著提升了预训练DiTree模型的轨迹质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散模型的采样运动规划器单次运行即可生成高质量轨迹，但其推理时的随机多样性未被充分利用，存在提升轨迹质量的潜力。

Method: 针对固定预训练DiTree模型，提出两种推理时多样化策略：一是因子多样性，扫描随机种子与Diffusion Goal Bias（DGB）参数；二是仅精炼多样性，扫描控制RRT轨迹编辑程度的扩散精炼强度（RS）。二者通过H-Graph混合机制结合，并在全向AntMaze机器人15个迷宫场景中评估，同时与基于池的统计进行对比。

Result: H-Graph使因子多样性与仅精炼多样性的平均池长度分别提升18.8%与14.5%；最佳单候选长度分别提升9.7%与6.8%；相比成功基线的轨迹长度分别提升18.2%与19.9%。

Conclusion: 推理时参数变化是一种可靠、无需训练的路径多样性来源，H-Graph混合机制能可靠地将这种多样性转化为更短、更高质量的轨迹。

Abstract: Sampling-based motion planners guided by diffusion models produce high-quality trajectories in a single run, yet the stochastic diversity available at inference time is left largely unexploited. We present two inference-time diversification strategies for a fixed, pretrained DiTree model, combined via H-Graph hybridization, and evaluate them on a holonomic AntMaze robot across 15 maze scenarios. The first, factorial diversity, sweeps the random seed and Diffusion Goal Bias (DGB) parameter, the second, refinement-only diversity, sweeps the diffusion refinement strength (RS) that controls how much an RRT-generated trajectory is edited. Because a single-run baseline only partially succeeds, we additionally compare H-Graph results with pool-based statistics. H-Graph improves the mean pool length of the factorial and refinement-only diversities by 18.8% and 14.5%, respectively. In addition, it also improves the best individual candidate's lengths by 9.7% and 6.8%, respectively. And last, compared with the successful baseline's trajectory length, it improves the results by 18.2% and 19.9%, respectively. These results show that inference-time parameter variation is a reliable, training-free source of path diversity, and that H-Graph hybridization reliably converts this diversity into shorter, higher quality trajectories.

</details>


### [828] [Constrained Flow Policy Updates: A Generalized Schrödinger Bridge View](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32952)
*Boyang Li,Matthew Kim,Sylvia Herbert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 RAFALE：一种基于流策略的离策略 actor-critic 安全强化学习算法，直接对增广拉格朗日目标沿生成路径求导、无需估计 score，并利用无密度动能正则化，在七个 Safety-Gymnasium 任务上兼顾奖励与成本预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线安全强化学习需在最大化奖励的同时满足安全约束。奖励与安全目标会使动作分布呈多峰，而主流原对偶方法的 Gaussian actor 易坍缩到单一次优模态，且在非凸拉格朗日景观上优化不稳定。扩散/流策略虽能表达多峰分布，但已有扩散 actor 方法依赖估计并匹配增广拉格朗日目标策略的 score，较为复杂且不稳定。

Method: 1）摒弃 score 估计，直接通过流策略的生成路径对增广拉格朗日目标求导；2）流策略缺少可用的动作对数密度以做熵正则，故借鉴仅面向奖励的 FLAC 的无密度动能正则化；3）提出 RAFALE（Reparameterized Augmented-Lagrangian Flow Actor with Least Energy），一种离策略 actor-critic 安全 RL 方法；4）将其更新形式化为约束的单端广义 Schrödinger 桥，并证明：对每个源样本，该路径空间问题恰为动作空间中的熵正则化问题。

Result: 在正噪声下，其解仅在估计成本超过由拉格朗日乘子设定的阈值处，对纯奖励动作分布进行重加权；噪声趋于零时，最优值收敛到流策略直接优化的最小能量映射（least-energy map）目标。在七个 Safety-Gymnasium 任务上，RAFALE 在每项任务上都实现了具有竞争力的奖励且平均最终成本落在预算内，而强基线方法往往在奖励与成本之间顾此失彼；消融实验支持其增广目标与流 actor 两者的必要性。

Conclusion: RAFALE 通过将增广拉格朗日目标直接沿流策略生成路径求导，配合无密度动能正则化，避免了 score 估计，在理论与实证上均有效；其路径空间问题可归约为动作空间熵正则化，并在多任务上实现奖励与安全的良好权衡。

Abstract: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. Reward and safety can induce multimodal action distributions, challenging the prevailing primal-dual methods: Gaussian actors may collapse onto a single suboptimal mode, and optimization over the nonconvex Lagrangian landscape can be unstable. Diffusion and flow policies can represent such distributions, but recent work with a diffusion actor relies on estimating and matching the score of an augmented-Lagrangian target policy. Instead, we differentiate the augmented objective directly through the generation path of a flow policy, so no score needs to be estimated. Because a flow policy lacks a readily available action log-density for entropy regularization, we build on the density-free kinetic-energy regularizer of FLAC, a recent reward-only method, and propose Reparameterized Augmented-Lagrangian Flow Actor with Least Energy (RAFALE), an off-policy actor-critic method for safe RL. We formulate its update as a constrained one-ended generalized Schrödinger bridge and show that, for each source draw, this path-space problem is exactly an entropy-regularized problem in action space. At positive noise, its solution reweights the reward-only action distribution only where the estimated cost exceeds a threshold set by the Lagrange multiplier. As the noise vanishes, the optimal value converges to that of a least-energy map objective that the flow policy optimizes directly. Across seven Safety-Gymnasium tasks, RAFALE achieves competitive reward with mean final cost within budget on every task, whereas strong baselines trade one for the other; ablations support the necessity of both its augmented objective and its flow actor.

</details>


### [829] [What Must a World Model Distinguish for Planning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33030)
*Rongzhe Wei,Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Peizhi Niu,Yifan Li,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文探讨了世界模型在规划中需要保留多少物理信息的问题，提出机制、响应、决策充分性的层次框架，并主张将查询信息与动作条件模型解耦的模块化设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型用于模拟动作候选的后果，但好的规划并不需要保留所有对精确预测必要的物理区分。现有研究忽视了规划查询、候选集与规划器如何共同决定模型需保留的信息量，也未明确查询信息应进入规划系统的哪个环节。

Method: 将机制充分性、响应充分性与决策充分性形式化为一个层次结构；在碰撞系统、非线性动力学与机器人规划三类场景中研究这些效应；对比查询条件联合生成动作与结果的模型与动作条件世界模型；提出查询决定"看哪里"、动作条件模型预测"会发生什么"的模块化设计。

Result: 在已见目标上，查询条件联合模型比动作条件世界模型后悔更低；但在泛化到未见目标时，这一优势基本消失。规划器常需自适应搜索构建候选，最终选择所不需的信息仍可能是发现优质候选所必需的。

Conclusion: 世界模型需保留的信息取决于查询、候选集与规划器三者的交互。模块化设计使查询决定搜索方向、动作条件模型负责预测，从而实现同一预测在不同目标间复用。

Abstract: World models simulate the consequences of action candidates, but good planning need not preserve every physical distinction required for accurate prediction. We formalize this gap through a hierarchy of mechanism, response, and decision sufficiency. Given a candidate set, the planning query determines which physical variations matter and how precisely they must be preserved: coarse decisions can discard much of the information needed for prediction, whereas fine decisions may require nearly the same resolution. In practice, planners often adaptively search to construct candidates, and information unnecessary for final selection may still be needed to discover good candidates. What a world model must preserve therefore depends on the query, the candidate set, and the planner. We study these effects in a collision system, nonlinear dynamics, and robotic planning. These varying requirements raise a design question: where should query information enter the planning system? A model that jointly generates actions and outcomes conditioned on the query achieves lower regret than an action-conditioned world model on seen objectives, but this advantage largely disappears when generalizing to unseen objectives. Motivated by this, we propose a modular design in which the query determines where to look and an action-conditioned model predicts what will happen, allowing the same predictions to be reused across objectives.

</details>


### [830] [When Does Backpropagating Through Policy Memory Matter? Physical Credit, Optimizer Updates, and Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33169)
*Xingjian Li,Yi Han,Jianhua Z. Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在固定前向计算的前提下只改变反向图的导数边，考察"记忆截断"（丢弃存储历史的梯度、保留其数值）对参数梯度、优化器更新和持续训练的影响。结果表明，截断的代价强烈依赖物理信用分配范围、优化器类型（全局范数裁剪掩盖差异，AdamW放大差异）、噪声水平与截断位置；建议以"从初始化起就带截断训练"来度量其代价，并以优化器实际施加的更新而非原始梯度比较反向图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带记忆的策略可沿两条反向路径学习：其动作产生的物理状态，以及其存储的表示。Transformer-XL 与截断的随时间的反向传播在保留历史数值的同时，切断了第二条路径。作者要回答：这种切割在何时会带来实际影响。已有工作多只看原始梯度，而忽略了优化器与训练过程的作用。

Method: 保持前向计算不变，仅改变导数边（即是否让梯度回传穿过键值缓存），在船舶轨迹模型与四旋翼跟踪策略上测量：参数梯度、优化器施加的更新，以及持续训练表现。对比不同物理信用范围（全历史状态 vs 单步）、不同优化器（全局范数裁剪 vs AdamW）、不同截断位置（切换截断的步）、不同截断段长（两步、八步）以及不同噪声水平（0.20 m/s、0.30 m/s、低噪声）与隐藏速度设置。

Result: 船舶模型：当梯度流经所有早期物理状态时，分离键值缓存使梯度范数降至约十分之一，方向旋转很小；在单步物理信用下几乎不变。在强裁剪区间，决定更新差异的是优化器而非梯度——全局范数裁剪消除了记忆切割图之间的大部分梯度差异，而 AdamW 把切割位置间 2% 的梯度差异在切换步放大为高达 31% 的更新差异。四旋翼（从初始化起训练、0.20 m/s 速度噪声）：去掉记忆使跟踪误差上升 43%，切断记忆梯度使其上升 32%；低噪声下切割的平均代价超过记忆的价值。两步截断段无显著增益，但在隐藏速度下两步窗口可捕获大部分记忆价值；八步段消除了一半到四分之三的代价。仅在训练最后五分之一开启切割，在 0.20–0.30 m/s 下低估其代价约三倍，但在低噪声或隐藏速度下并非如此。

Conclusion: 记忆截断的代价应用"从初始化起即带截断训练"来度量，因为仅末段开启会显著低估代价；比较反向图时应以优化器实际施加的更新为依据，而非原始梯度，因为裁剪与自适应优化会扭曲或放大梯度层面的差异。截断的收益取决于段长、噪声水平与隐藏状态可见性。

Abstract: Policies with memory can learn along two backward paths: through the physical states their actions produce and through the representations they store. Transformer-XL and truncated backpropagation through time cut the second path at stored history while keeping its values. We ask when this cut matters. Holding the forward computation fixed and varying only derivative edges, we measure parameter gradients, the updates the optimizer applies, and continued training in a Transformer vessel-trajectory model and a quadrotor tracking policy. In the vessel model, detaching the key-value cache shrank the gradient to about a tenth of its norm, with little rotation, when gradients flowed through all earlier physical states, but barely changed it under one-step physical credit. In this strongly clipped regime the optimizer, not the gradient, set how far updates differed: global-norm clipping removed most of the gradient difference between memory-cut graphs, whereas AdamW turned a 2% gradient difference between two placements of the cut into update differences of up to 31% at the step where the placement was switched. In a quadrotor trained from initialization with 0.20 m/s velocity noise, removing memory raised tracking error by 43% and cutting memory gradients raised it by 32%; at low noise the cut's mean cost exceeded the value of memory. Two-step truncation segments gave no measurable gain, although with hidden velocity a two-step window captured most of the value of memory; eight-step segments removed half to three quarters of the cost. Switching the cut on only for the last fifth of training understated its cost about threefold at 0.20-0.30 m/s, but not at low noise or with hidden velocity. These results suggest measuring the cost of a memory cut by training with it from initialization, and comparing backward graphs by the updates the optimizer applies rather than by raw gradients.

</details>


### [831] [Safe Score Matching: Diffusion Policies with Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Online Safe Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33337)
*Boyang Li,Matthew Kim,Sylvia Lee Herbert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Safe Score Matching（SSM），将Q-score matching与HJ可达性结合，用双分支分数目标处理硬性逐状态约束，在多个安全RL基准上取得最佳或接近最佳表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全RL多将安全约束松弛为软期望代价约束，仅保证平均意义上的安全；引入硬性逐状态约束虽更严格，但可行域与不可行域目标不同（前者最大化奖励，后者恢复至可行域），导致目标动作分布呈多模态，而现有基于HJ的高斯或确定性actor难以表达该分布，常坍缩到次优模态。扩散策略具备表达能力，Q-score matching为在线RL训练扩散策略提供途径，但仅用于奖励最大化。

Method: 提出SSM，一种离策略actor-critic方法。将Q-score matching适配到硬约束安全RL：用HJ可达性对双分支分数目标进行门控。在可行集内，去噪过程退化为对HJ critic判定为可行动作的Q-score matching；在可行集外，恢复分支使去噪偏向最坏情况违反更低的区域。

Result: 在四旋翼与固定翼轨迹跟踪、稳定与避障基准上，SSM取得最佳或接近最佳的任务性能且假安全率低；而原对偶基线允许更多不安全行为，基于可达性的基线更保守。在Safety-Gymnasium速度任务上，SSM取得最低代价并保持有竞争力的奖励。

Conclusion: SSM通过HJ门控的双分支score目标，将Q-score matching扩展到硬约束安全RL，既能用扩散策略表达多模态动作分布，又能兼顾任务性能与安全性，优于原对偶及可达性基线。

Abstract: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. A popular line of research in safe RL relaxes safety to a soft expected-cost constraint and solves the resulting Constrained Markov Decision Process via primal-dual Lagrangian updates that only enforce safety on average. To address this limitation, hard, state-wise constraints are introduced and often imposed through Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability. Yet such constraints require solving different objectives in the feasible and infeasible regions: reward maximization in the former, recovery toward the feasible regions in the latter. The resulting target action distributions are inherently multimodal, and this structure poses a fundamental challenge for the Gaussian or deterministic actors used in existing HJ-based safe RL, which often collapse onto suboptimal modes. Diffusion policies provide the expressiveness needed to represent such distributions, and recent work on Q-score matching offers a route to training them for online RL by score regression -- but has been applied only to reward maximization. We propose Safe Score Matching (SSM), an off-policy actor-critic method that adapts Q-score matching to hard-constrained safe RL by gating a two-branch score target with HJ reachability: inside the feasible set, the denoising process degenerates to Q-score matching on actions classified as viable by the HJ critic; outside, a recovery branch biases denoising toward regions with lower worst-case violation. On quadrotor and fixed-wing trajectory-tracking and stabilize-and-avoid benchmarks, SSM attains the best or near-best task performance with low false-safe rates, whereas the primal-dual baseline admits more unsafe behavior and reachability-based baselines tend to be more conservative; on Safety-Gymnasium velocity tasks, SSM attains the lowest cost with competitive reward.

</details>


### [832] [Emergence, Not Bandwidth: Physical Coupling and the Limits of Learned Multi-Agent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34373)
*Mihir Chauhan,Aniket Bera*

Main category: cs.LG
