TL;DR: 本文研究速率受限的多智能体通信：在2比特/决策约束下给出速率受限Dec-POMDP的理论刻画，并用MuJoCo实验证明强化学习在部分耦合场景下无法发现成功协议，学习到的协议跨种子互不可读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 涌现通信文献对最优消息应编码什么、压缩在时间跨度上的代价、以及学习到的协议何时足够唯一可被队友读取，仅有经验性回答，缺乏理论保证。

Method: 为速率受限Dec-POMDP推导可达性定理（不依赖具体学习器），在三个MuJoCo场景（零耦合、部分耦合、刚性物理耦合）中统一限制为每决策2比特，并通过关闭物理侧信道构造判别性实验；采用25个种子及七个同速率基线，并做热启动与跨博弈（cross-play）测试。

Result: 通信价值由耦合决定：刚性耦合下任何信道都不优于沉默（+0.001±0.001, p=0.982, n=25）；零耦合下各条件均可求解；部分耦合下工程化2比特发送者达四分位均值1.000，而学习到的仅0.482，与沉默无异（p=0.400）；热启动使同一信道从0.562提升到0.857（p<0.001）。跨博弈显示自博弈0.980降至跨种子0.144，最佳对齐仍留下至少77%的差距。

Conclusion: 强化学习失败的根源不是表示能力或协议维持，而是无法发现协议本身；学习出的协议个体有意义但彼此不可读，跨智能体对齐仍是重大开放问题。

Abstract: Rate-limited multi-agent teams raise three questions the emergent-communication literature has answered only empirically: what an optimal message should encode, what compression costs over a horizon, and when a learned protocol is unique enough for a teammate to read. We answer them for rate-limited Dec-POMDPs, then measure how far reinforcement learning falls short of the optimum. Our theorems fix what is achievable independently of any learner, so a gap between an engineered and a learned sender at the same bit budget is an optimization fact, not an information-theoretic one. We instantiate this on three MuJoCo arenas spanning zero, partial and rigid physical coupling, charging every condition exactly 2 bits per decision, and create the discriminating regime by closing a physical side channel within one arena, holding bodies, task and reward fixed. Communication value is governed by coupling: under rigid coupling through a shared object, no channel beats silence (+0.001 +/- 0.001, p = 0.982, n = 25), since proprioception already carries that information; without coupling, every condition solves the task; under partial coupling, the engineered 2-bit sender reaches an interquartile mean of 1.000 but the learned one reaches 0.482, indistinguishable from silence (p = 0.400, n = 25). With a shared alphabet, bandwidth cannot explain the gap. Warm-starting from an engineered receiver localizes the failure: the same channel reaches 0.857 versus 0.562 cold-started (p < 0.001), so it is neither representational nor one of maintenance; reinforcement learning fails to discover the protocol. Cross-play shows learned protocols are individually meaningful but mutually unintelligible: self-play 0.980 collapses to 0.144 across seeds, and our best constructed alignment leaves at least 77% of that gap. All headline results use 25 seeds per arena and seven published baselines at matched rate.

</details>


### [833] [LRC-JEPA: Disentangling Dynamics and Residual Context for Efficient World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34375)
*Luzhe Huang,Lei Chu,Jingyi Liang,Yuhuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LRC-JEPA是一种轻量端到端世界模型，将信息路由到紧凑预测隐变量z与学习查询的残差上下文嵌入u，仅z用于动力学传播和规划，实现表示充分、最小、 nuisance不变与解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑JEPA世界模型可实现高效隐空间规划，但低维表示在无奖励自监督下需同时编码动作条件动力学与可预测视觉上下文，导致可控状态与高秩 nuisance 外观纠缠，随场景复杂度上升而降低规划性能。

Method: 提出LRC-JEPA：将信息分流为紧凑预测隐变量z和基于学习查询的残差上下文嵌入u；仅z被动力学模型传播并用于规划，u捕捉时间持久信息用于交叉注意力重建；可微残差连接促使隐变量保留互补动态内容。在显式假设下证明表示具备充分性、最小性、nuisance不变性与解耦性。

Result: 在四个仿真控制环境中，平均规划成功率较参数匹配JEPA基线提升9个百分点，并匹配或超越更大的预训练模型；在真实Bridge-v2数据集上，5.5M参数主动编码器优于DINO-WM（22.1M）和V-JEPA2（303.9M）编码器，且规划更快。物理状态探针、重建干预与消融实验验证了解耦有效性。

Conclusion: LRC-JEPA通过分离预测隐变量与残差上下文嵌入，在轻量参数下实现更优规划性能与表示解耦，兼具理论保证与实证优势。

Abstract: Compact JEPA world models enable efficient latent-space planning, but low-dimensional representation trained under reward-free self-supervision must encode both action-conditioned dynamics and predictable visual context. This competition can entangle controllable state with high-rank nuisance appearance and degrade planning as scenes become more complex. We introduce LRC-JEPA, a lightweight end-to-end world model that routes information into a compact predictive latent $\mathbf{z}$ and learned-query residual-context embeddings $\mathbf{u}$. Only $\mathbf{z}$ is propagated by the dynamics model and used for planning, while $\mathbf{u}$ captures temporally persistent information for cross-attention reconstruction; a differentiable residual connection encourages the latent to retain complementary dynamic content. Under explicit assumptions, we show that the resulting representation is sufficient, minimal, nuisance-invariant, and disentangled. Across four simulated control environments, LRC-JEPA improves average planning success over a parameter-matched JEPA baseline by 9 percentage points and matches or exceeds substantially larger pretrained models. On the real-world Bridge-v2 set, its 5.5M-parameter active encoder outperforms DINO-WM (22.1M) and V-JEPA2 (303.9M) encoders while also enabling faster planning. Physical-state probes, reconstruction interventions, and ablations confirm the effectiveness of LRC-JEPA's representation disentanglement.

</details>


### [834] [Learning High-Risk High-Precision Motion Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34851)
*Nam Hee Kim,Markus Kirjonen,Perttu Hämäläinen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT) 深度强化学习算法，用于高风险、高精度的运动控制问题，以计算台球为代表性任务，实现对不可逆动作的精准控制并发现多种击球策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度强化学习（DRL）算法主要在序列决策任务中评估，这类任务中不精确的动作可通过后续动作纠正，因而即使动作带有噪声也能获得高回报。但存在一类研究不足的高风险、高精度运动控制问题，其动作具有不可逆结果，导致状态-动作奖励景观出现尖锐峰值与脊线，传统方法难以应对，因此需要针对性设计算法。

Method: 以计算台球为代表性任务，提出 State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT)，在 advantage-weighted regression (AWR) 基础上引入三项关键改进：1) 仅使用精英样本进行策略优化，使策略更好捕捉罕见的高奖励动作样本；2) 采用专家混合（MoE）策略，依据状态在奖励景观的不同模态间切换；3) 加入距离正则化项与学习课程，鼓励在适应最优样本前先探索多样策略。

Result: 在学习基于物理的台球击球任务中，验证了各改进特征的有效性，实现了高动作精度，并能针对给定球型发现多种击球策略。

Conclusion: SCOOT 通过精英样本优化、MoE 策略以及距离正则化与课程学习，有效处理了奖励景观尖锐、动作不可逆的高精度控制问题，为这类高风险运动控制任务提供了可行方案，并在台球任务中展现出高精度与多策略发现的能力。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms for movement control are typically evaluated and benchmarked on sequential decision tasks where imprecise actions may be corrected with later actions, thus allowing high returns with noisy actions. In contrast, we focus on an under-researched class of high-risk, high-precision motion control problems where actions carry irreversible outcomes, driving sharp peaks and ridges to plague the state-action reward landscape. Using computational pool as a representative example of such problems, we propose and evaluate State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT), a novel DRL algorithm that builds on advantage-weighted regression (AWR) with three key modifications: 1) Performing policy optimization only using elite samples, allowing the policy to better latch on to the rare high-reward action samples; 2) Utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) policy, to allow switching between reward landscape modes depending on the state; 3) Adding a distance regularization term and a learning curriculum to encourage exploring diverse strategies before adapting to the most advantageous samples. We showcase our features' performance in learning physically-based billiard shots demonstrating high action precision and discovering multiple shot strategies for a given ball configuration.

</details>


### [835] [Manifold-Stable Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35454)
*Amirhossein Nazerian,Ali Pezeshki,Jianguo Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MSFM 通过收缩理论将切向输运与法向收缩结合，允许从任意环境先验出发，保证流匹配生成样本的流形不变性与收敛性，在椭圆、Push-T 与 Robomimic Square 任务上显著降低几何偏差并提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何流匹配（Geometric FM）通常假设先验支撑在数据流形上，而这需要难以获取的几何知识；若无此知识，仅降低回归误差并不能保证样本落在流形上。流形依附性既保证生成配置合法，也在经验上与更优任务性能相关，因此需要一种不依赖流形先验、又能保证流形不变性的方法。

Method: 提出流形稳定流匹配（MSFM）：借助非线性动力学中的收缩理论，将学习到的切向输运与预设的法向收缩相结合。对已知流形使用解析投影算子，对未知数据几何使用由主成分分析估计的局部仿射代理。在两类情形下实现收缩理论，从而在指定时间窗内保证流形不变性与向流形的横向收敛。推导了一族兼容概率路径，并将训练损失分解为可学习的切向项与法向残差。

Result: 椭圆实验的终端离流形误差均值达 $10^{-6}$ 量级；Push-T 机器人实验中成功率由 $74\%$ 提升至 $82\%$；Robomimic Square 任务成功率由 $60\%$ 提升至 $72\%$，旋转流形偏差由 $10^{-2}$ 量级降至 $10^{-7}$ 量级。MSFM 的终端几何误差可由所选数值容差控制。

Conclusion: MSFM 实现了更强的几何依附性与更高的任务表现，表明预设法向收缩可作为学习式生成输运的有效补充。

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) learns generative dynamics through velocity regression. Geometric FM variants commonly assume a prior supported on the data manifold, requiring geometric knowledge that is often unavailable. Without such knowledge, low regression error alone does not guarantee manifold adherence. Adherence keeps generated samples within valid configurations and is empirically associated with better task performance. We introduce manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), which can start from an arbitrary ambient prior, not necessarily supported on the manifold. Using tools from nonlinear dynamics, namely contraction theory, MSFM combines learned tangential transport with prescribed normal contraction. The construction uses analytical projectors for known manifolds and local affine proxies estimated by principal component analysis for unknown data geometry. By implementing contraction theory in both cases of known and unknown manifolds, we guarantee manifold invariance and transverse convergence to the manifold within a desired time window (e.g., one second). We derive a family of compatible probability paths and decompose the training loss into a learnable tangential term and a normal residual. An ellipse experiment attains a mean terminal off-manifold error of order $10^{-6}$. In Push-T robotic experiments, MSFM raises success from $74\%$ to $82\%$. In the Robomimic Square task, success increases from $60\%$ to $72\%$, while rotation-manifold deviation decreases from order $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-7}$. The MSFM terminal geometric errors are controlled by the chosen numerical tolerance. These results demonstrate stronger geometric adherence and higher observed task performance, supporting prescribed normal contraction as a complement to learned generative transport.

</details>


### [836] [X-Reset: Scaling Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Embodiment Resets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35715)
*Prithwish Dan,Chenyang Ma,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: X-Reset 利用人类手-物演示进行运动学重定向来生成重置状态，解决无演示强化学习训练通用灵巧操作策略时的探索难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在仿真中用强化学习训练灵巧操作策略虽无需机器人演示，但训练单一通用策略且使用任务无关奖励时面临严峻的探索问题：从零发现接近、抓取并重定向多自由度多样物体的行为极其困难。现有方法依赖高质量机器人演示、逐任务奖励塑形或限制策略行为模式来使探索可行，存在局限。

Method: 提出 X-Reset 框架，以人类手-物演示解决探索问题。不作模仿或跟踪重定向后的人体运动，而是将手-物状态运动学重定向到带噪声的机器人状态，过滤掉仿真中不稳定的状态，将剩余状态作为 RL 训练中的重置采样，配合通用物体中心奖励。所得策略仅依赖物体状态与目标，演示通过重置分布进入训练。

Result: 在 3 种本体（两种机械臂上的 22 自由度手、平行夹爪）上、20 个物体上训练出通用策略，解决了从零强化学习的探索挑战；性能随训练物体数量扩展，可泛化到未见物体，能从有噪声的手部姿态估计中学习，并实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。

Conclusion: X-Reset 表明人类手-物演示可作为一种有效的重置分布来源，替代演示模仿或奖励塑形，实现可扩展、可泛化且可迁移的灵巧操作通用策略学习。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation can train dexterous manipulation policies without robot demonstrations, but training a single generalist policy with task-agnostic rewards faces a severe exploration problem: approaching, grasping, and reorienting diverse objects with many degrees of freedom is difficult to discover from scratch. Prior works make exploration tractable with high-quality robot demonstrations, per-task reward shaping, or by restricting policies to narrow modes of behavior. We propose X-Reset, a framework that instead resolves exploration with human hand-object demonstrations. Rather than imitating or tracking retargeted human motion, X-Reset kinematically retargets hand-object states to noisy robot states, filters out states that are unstable in simulation, and samples the remainder as resets during RL training with general-purpose object-centric rewards. The resulting policy depends only on object state and goal, with demonstrations entering training through the reset distribution. We show that X-Reset trains generalist policies on 20 objects across three embodiments---a 22-DoF hand on two different arms and a parallel-jaw gripper---and resolves the exploration challenges of RL from scratch. X-Reset scales with the number of training objects, generalizes to unseen objects, can learn from imperfect hand-pose estimates, and transfers behaviors zero-shot from sim-to-real.

</details>


### [837] [What Next-Event Accuracy Cannot See: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Emergency Department Trajectory Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31635)
*Zhen Xuen Brandon Low*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出EDSim-Bench，基于MIMIC-IV-ED（425,028次急诊就诊）及外部MC-MED数据，系统评估临床轨迹模拟器在自回归生成（rollout）下的误差累积问题，发现下一事件准确率无法反映闭环模拟质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床轨迹模型通常仅以观测历史上的"下一事件准确率"评估，但真实模拟要求模型以自生成事件为条件，误差会逐步累积。该问题在序列建模中虽已知，但针对临床轨迹模拟器尚缺乏系统性量化。

Method: 构建EDSim-Bench评测协议：从留出的就诊前缀出发，让模型生成就诊剩余部分，从终止、事件构成、时序、条件保真度、占用预测五个维度评估，并以仅用训练集拟合的order-3 n-gram作为参考基线；在Transformer、GRU、LSTM等架构上跨随机种子、rollout准则、模型规模、时间偏移及外部站点进行验证，并测试推理时干预。

Result: 尽管各模型下一事件准确率差异在0.001以内，rollout表现差异巨大：某Transformer配方终止得分在不同种子间从0.43波动到0.96，散度达n-gram的4.2至137倍；无前缀训练的神经模型在终止与事件构成上均未接近n-gram。推理时干预改善终止但无法同时恢复构成与时序。对每个可监督位置（而非仅前缀末位）进行监督，可使Transformer、GRU、LSTM散度降低1-2个数量级，且在模型扩展、时间偏移与外部站点评估下保持稳健。即便如此，最优模型生成的就诊长度仍仅为观测值约一半，且模型排名在占用预测这一下游任务上发生反转。

Conclusion: 下一事件准确率不足以评估临床轨迹模拟器，应开展跨随机种子、多rollout准则与下游任务的闭环评估，并公开评测协议与评分代码。

Abstract: Clinical trajectory models are usually evaluated by next-event accuracy on observed histories. Simulation is different: models must condition on their own generated events, allowing errors to compound. Although this problem is well known in sequence modelling, it has not been systematically quantified for clinical trajectory simulators. We developed EDSim-Bench to evaluate this failure mode using 425,028 MIMIC-IV-ED stays, with external replication on MC-MED, and release the evaluation protocol and scoring code. Starting from held-out visit prefixes, models generate the remainder of each visit and are evaluated on termination, event composition, timing, conditional fidelity, and occupancy forecasting, with a train-only order-3 n-gram as a reference baseline. Despite next-event accuracies within 0.001, three neural architectures behaved very differently under rollout. Across seeds, one Transformer recipe ranged from 0.43 to 0.96 in termination score and from 4.2- to 137-fold the divergence of the n-gram; no prefix-trained neural model approached the n-gram on termination or event composition. Inference-time interventions improved termination but did not jointly recover composition and timing. Supervising every eligible sequence position rather than only the final prefix position was associated with one to two orders of magnitude lower divergence across Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models, with the pattern persisting under model scaling, temporal shift, and external-site evaluation. Nevertheless, even the best model generated visits approximately half as long as observed, and model rankings reversed on occupancy forecasting, a downstream quantity relevant to bed management. These results show that next-event accuracy is insufficient to evaluate clinical trajectory simulators and motivate closed-loop evaluation across seeds, rollout criteria, and downstream tasks.

</details>


### [838] [Energy-aware frugal Bayesian optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31638)
*Gaston Plat,Paul Saves,Nathalie Bartoli,Thierry Lefebvre,Joseph Morlier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在贝叶斯优化框架中引入计算能耗足迹度量，用以引导模型参数配置在预测性能与计算节约之间取得平衡；计算机实验表明最优收敛与能耗之间存在权衡，有时可同时获得更优极值和更低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代设计优化框架以预测精度为首要目标，未兼顾计算开销，导致规模化架构与多学科设计优化问题即便使用样本高效的贝叶斯优化器也难以处理。

Method: 在贝叶斯优化框架内引入一个量化计算能耗足迹的指标，用该指标引导模型参数设置朝向兼顾性能与节约的配置。

Result: 计算机实验揭示了最优收敛与底层能耗足迹之间既有的权衡关系，且部分情况下同时实现了更优的寻优结果与更低的能耗。

Conclusion: 将能耗足迹纳入贝叶斯优化目标可有效平衡性能与节约，为规模化及多学科设计优化提供更可行的路径。

Abstract: Modern design optimization frameworks aim first and foremost for models with the most accurate predictions without balancing computational overhead. It remains a reason why scaled architecture and multidisciplinary design optimization problems are difficult to address, even with sample-efficient Bayesian optimizers. In this paper, a metric quantifying the computational energy footprint is introduced within a Bayesian optimization framework to guide the parameter setting of a model towards configurations that balance both performance and frugality. The computer experiments highlighted existing tradeoffs between optimum convergence and the underlying energy footprint, and sometimes resulted in both a better-found optimum and lower energy consumption.

</details>


### [839] [When Does Domain Adaptation Help on Physical Vibration Sensors? A Held-Out-Bearing Study of Neural-Operator and Convolutional Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31639)
*Kumbha Nagaswetha,Rabi Pathak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在“留出轴承”协议下，滚动轴承故障诊断的源域迁移远弱于常报的99%以上精度（变转速下仅0.36），且输入表征（阶次域 vs 频域）比对齐方法更决定无监督域适应的成败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究报告>99%精度，但评估划分把同一物理轴承同时放进训练集与测试集，导致数据泄漏、性能被高估。论文希望用严格的留出单元协议重新审视该任务的真实迁移难度，并厘清迁移性能由什么因素主导。

Method: 提出held-out-bearing协议，将每个轴承单元整体划入训练或测试；以计算阶次跟踪（轴角重采样，使故障频率固定在恒定轴阶次、与转速无关）作为受控的表征变换，对比频域与阶次域两种表征；比较Fourier Neural Operator与特征维度匹配的卷积网络；用归一化RBF-MMD无监督对齐，并考察小幅标签预算的增益；另在第二个数据集（留出单元为故障直径而非轴承）上验证协议。

Result: 变转速下源域迁移仅0.36，目标域监督上限0.97。FNO将源域迁移从0.36提升到0.61（故障峰移动的转速偏移下），而同维度卷积网络在两种表征中均接近随机水平。相同RBF-MMD损失且无目标标签时，FNO在频域达0.71、阶次域达0.95，距目标域监督上限仅0.02，且在每一留出轴承折上均>0.86。表征正确后，增加少量标签收益很小。第二个数据集显示同一协议能暴露连目标域监督模型都无法避免的失败。

Conclusion: 对该任务而言，决定域适应能否奏效的是输入表征（阶次域）而非对齐方法；一旦表征合适，标签预算影响有限。基于同轴承的随机划分评估会系统性高估性能，应以留出单元协议作为更可信的评测标准。

Abstract: Diagnosing rolling-element bearing faults from vibration is a canonical physical-sensing task and a widely used benchmark for domain adaptation under operating-condition shift. Accuracies above 99 percent are commonly reported, but under evaluation splits that place the same physical bearing in both training and test. We revisit the task under a held-out-bearing protocol, assigning every bearing unit entirely to either the training or the test set, and find that source-only transfer is far weaker than such numbers suggest: on a change of shaft speed it reaches only $0.36$, against a target-supervised ceiling of 0.97. We then study what governs transfer. Treating computed order tracking, a shaft-angle resampling that places fault frequencies at fixed shaft orders independent of running speed, as a controlled change of representation, we find that a Fourier Neural Operator raises source-only transfer from $0.36$ to $0.61$ on the speed shift, where the fault peaks move, while a convolutional network of matched feature dimension stays near chance in both representations. The representation also decides whether unsupervised alignment can work: with the same normalized RBF-MMD loss and no target labels, the operator reaches 0.71 in the frequency domain but 0.95 in the order domain, within 0.02 of the target-supervised ceiling and above $0.86$ on every held-out bearing fold. Once the representation is right, a small label budget adds little. These results indicate that, for this task, the input representation rather than the alignment method decides whether adaptation helps. A second dataset, whose held-out units are fault diameters rather than bearings, shows that the same protocol exposes failures that even a target-supervised model cannot avoid.

</details>


### [840] [Measure Learning at Steady State: A BIRD-SQL Formula 1 Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31640)
*Manoj Bajaj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将上下文学习（ICL）视为单一学习系统，在更长的共享世界日程上评估，发现无界ICL并非理想的学习机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有Continual Learning Bench以短时程增益对比重置基线进行评分，且将朴素全上下文ICL评为最强。但短时程评分可能低估后期节省并忽略成本反转，因此需要更长时间尺度的评估。

Method: 在预设的后期窗口（BIRD-SQL formula-1 174题中的最后40题）上计算相对基线的稳态学习差距，并将得分分解为探索效率（SQL探针）、任务奖励（命中）与交付成本（API费用与上下文规模）。

Result: 在gpt-5.6-luna上，后期探针从4.6–5.6降至0.95，而命中仅小幅上升；ICL上下文增长至约95k tokens，成本约翻倍。

Conclusion: 短时程增益低估了后期探针节省，且遗漏了成本反转，因此无界ICL不是合适的学习机制候选。

Abstract: Continual Learning Bench scores learning as short-horizon gain versus a reset baseline and finds naive full-context ICL strongest among the memories it tested. We treat ICL as one learning system and score it on a longer shared-world schedule. Steady-state learning is the gap versus baseline on a pre-set late window (last 40 of 174 BIRD-SQL formula-1 questions). We split the score into exploration efficiency (SQL probes), task reward (hits), and delivery cost (API dollars and context size). On gpt-5.6-luna, late probes fall from 4.6-5.6 to 0.95 while hits rise only modestly and ICL context grows to about 95k tokens with cost roughly doubling. Short-horizon gain understates the late probe saving and misses the cost inversion, so we find that unbounded ICL is a poor candidate for the learning mechanism.

</details>


### [841] [Information Design Against Gaming and Learning Adversaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31643)
*Madhava Gaikwad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 分析二元分类器弃权机制的两种防御策略：固定比例弃权与边界附近弃权，二者Blackwell不可比，并刻画其查询复杂度与Pareto前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署带弃权选项的二元分类器时，弃权查询的选择取决于对手类型：博弈型对手已知分类器，学习型对手不知分类器并可从弃权信号中推断边界位置。两种自然防御（固定比例弃权、边界附近弃权）之间存在根本张力，需明确其权衡与最优性。

Method: 将两种防御形式化为机制设计问题，证明其在Blackwell意义下不可比（任一方均无法通过后处理另一方响应来模拟）。针对边界重构任务，分别推导两种防御下的查询复杂度下界与上界，并刻画两目标间的Pareto前沿；在七个二元分类任务（表格、图像、语言模型特征）上验证理论速率。

Result: 固定比例弃权下重构边界至误差ε需Õ(d/ε)次查询，边界附近弃权下需Θ(d log(1/ε))次，其中d为分类器族VC维。前者为查询分布上的最坏情况，且在该分布上无算法可缩小差距。实验中label-plus-counterfactual访问比已发表的label-only基线最多减少200倍查询。

Conclusion: 两种防御策略不可比且各有最优场景：边界附近弃权对学习型对手更脆弱但查询效率在温和分布下更高，固定比例弃权在最坏分布下更稳健。Pareto前沿为设计者提供了依据对手模型选择弃权规则的定量指导，并在多类任务上得到实证支持。

Abstract: A principal who deploys a binary classifier with an abstention option must decide which queries the mechanism abstains on. The right choice depends on the adversary. A gaming adversary already knows the classifier and tries to manipulate features across the boundary, so the principal does best by abstaining on queries close to that boundary. The same boundary-localizing rule is the worst possible choice against a learning adversary who does not know the classifier: each abstention now tells the adversary that the boundary is nearby, which is enough to drive a binary search. We analyze this tension. The two natural defenses, abstaining at a fixed rate and abstaining near the boundary, are Blackwell-incomparable: neither can be simulated by post-processing the other's responses. The number of queries needed to reconstruct the boundary to error $\eps$ is $\tildeΘ(d/\eps)$ under the first defense and $Θ(d \log(1/\eps))$ under the second, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the classifier family and $\tildeΘ$ suppresses factors polylogarithmic in $d$ and $1/\eps$. The first rate is a worst case over query distributions; no reconstruction algorithm can close the gap at the distributions that attain it. We characterize the Pareto frontier between the two defense objectives, and confirm both rates on seven binary-classification tasks spanning tabular, image, and language-model-feature inputs: label-plus-counterfactual access extracts the boundary with up to $200\times$ fewer queries than a published label-only baseline.

</details>


### [842] [MaD-RL: Matching Distributions for Calibrating LLMs with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31644)
*Sourabh Kulkarni,Ksheeraj Sai Vepuri,Basar Demir,Jason Bohrer,Emily Shen,Jianfa Chen,Nan Jiang,Ankit Jain,Harihar Subramanyam,Mannat Singh,Chirag Nagpal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于强化学习的分布匹配框架，可将模型输出潜在类别属性的分布对齐到指定目标分布，弥补仅最大化期望奖励的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL后训练（如GRPO）以最大化期望奖励为目标，会降低输出多样性，使策略概率集中于单一模态。合成数据生成、公平性约束满足、策略探索等任务需要控制输出分布而非仅提升奖励。熵正则化与采样温度虽能缓解，但作用局限于token空间且仅趋向均匀分布。

Method: 提出通用的基于RL的分布匹配框架，匹配模型输出中潜在类别属性的分布与指定目标分布；将既有工作识别为L2散度特例，并进一步为KL散度和Jensen-Shannon散度设计奖励函数，辅以理论论证。

Result: 在数学推理与程序编写两类实验上验证了方法的有效性；同时实证表明GRPO等主流后训练方法会削弱输出多样性。

Conclusion: 分布匹配为RL后训练提供了超越期望奖励最大化的通用范式，可灵活支持多种散度度量并有效调控生成分布。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used in language-model post-training to maximize rewards assigned to individual model outputs, such as scores from binary verifiers or reward models trained on human feedback. However, applications such as synthetic-data generation, fairness-related constraint satisfaction, and policy exploration require controlling the distribution of outputs across model generations rather than only maximizing expected reward. We propose a general RL-based framework for \textit{Distribution Matching} allowing matching the distribution of a latent categorical attribute of model outputs to a specified target distribution. Empirically, we demonstrate that dominant post-training recipes such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) reduce output diversity by concentrating policy probability towards a single mode. Entropy regularization and sampling temperature can improve the spread of the distribution but have constrained effectiveness, limited to apply only in token space and toward uniform distributions. We show that prior work in this area is a specific case of Distribution Matching involving the $L_2$ divergence. We then propose reward functions for other divergences such as KL and Jensen-Shannon and motivate them with theoretical justification. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a set of experiments involving mathematical reasoning and programming.

</details>


### [843] [STAR: Adaptive Spatial-Temporal Normalization for Unified Microservice Incident Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31645)
*Xinhua Miao,Linyu Zhu,Bowei Yang,Zhengong Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出STAR框架，通过时空自适应归一化实现微服务多模态可观测数据的鲁棒表征学习，统一支持异常检测、故障分诊与根因定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模微服务系统的自动化事件管理依赖指标、日志、追踪等多模态数据的鲁棒表征。现有自监督框架虽能统一建模AD、FT、RCL三类任务，但难以应对非平稳时序动态与异构服务依赖结构。

Method: STAR包含两个紧耦合机制：时间自适应归一化（TAN）利用多尺度时间上下文动态归一化多变量时间序列；空间自适应归一化（SAN）在服务依赖图上进行结构感知归一化。将归一化建模为可学习、上下文条件化的变换，并将自适应表征集成到统一自监督框架中，端到端无监督支持AD、FT、RCL。

Result: 在两个真实微服务基准上，STAR在所有三项任务上一致超越现有最优基线，取得显著且稳定的提升。

Conclusion: 自适应归一化是复杂软件系统中鲁棒多模态表征学习的一种有原则且有效的机制。

Abstract: Automated incident management in large-scale microservice systems relies on learning robust representations from multimodal observability data, including metrics, logs, and traces. Although recent self-supervised frameworks enable unified modeling for anomaly detection (AD), failure triage (FT), and root cause localization (RCL), they often struggle with non-stationary temporal dynamics and heterogeneous service dependency structures. In this paper, we propose STAR, a Spatial-Temporal Adaptive Representation learning framework that explicitly addresses these challenges through adaptive normalizations. STAR introduces two tightly coupled mechanisms: Temporal Adaptive Normalization (TAN), which dynamically normalizes multivariate time series using multi-scale temporal context, and Spatial Adaptive Normalization (SAN), which performs structure-aware normalization over service dependency graphs. Unlike prior methods that treat normalization as static or task-agnostic, STAR formulates it as a learnable, context-conditioned transformation aligned with the intrinsic properties of microservice systems. The resulting adaptive representations are integrated into a unified self-supervised framework, enabling end-to-end unsupervised support for AD, FT, and RCL tasks. Extensive experiments on two real-world microservice benchmarks demonstrate that STAR consistently outperforms all state-of-the-art baselines, yielding significant and stable improvements across all three tasks. Our results highlight adaptive normalization as a principled and effective mechanism for robust multimodal representation learning in complex software systems.

</details>


### [844] [Typed Temporal Interaction Features for Simulation-Backed Forecasting of Open-Source Game Release Incidents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31647)
*Shayma Alkobaisi,Anas Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot，一个带类型的时间特征流水线，用于预测开源游戏项目未来30天内的发布级质量事件；评估基于仿真数据（模拟5个随机种子世界，每世界120个项目、24个发布），显示 AUPRC 0.520、AUROC 0.673、Brier 0.207、20%测试预算下努力感知召回 29.68%，与最强本地基线差异不显著，推理耗时 0.023 ms/发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源视频游戏质量依赖代码、资产、配置、测试、贡献者与问题工作流之间的交互关系，但传统缺陷预测器往往将这些关系扁平化或直接忽略。作者希望在发布层面上预测30天内的质量事件，并探索带类型（typed）关系特征是否能提升预测能力。

Method: 提出 GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot：带类型的时间特征流水线，包含校准风险估计与努力感知（effort-aware）排序。由于可获取的 OS-SGameBench 材料缺少人工审计的发布日期与爆发标签，评估采用仿真驱动方式：构造5个带随机种子的世界，各含120个项目与24个发布，采用项目不相交验证与未来跨项目测试；并开展消融实验及缺失性、漂移、引擎、项目规模、告警阈值与归因等受控分析。

Result: 达到 AUPRC 0.520、AUROC 0.673、Brier 0.207，20%测试预算下努力感知召回 29.68%。最接近的本地对比方法 Static-Hetero-Reimpl 为 0.522 AUPRC，-0.002 的差异经 Holm 校正后不具统计显著性。推理速度 0.023 毫秒/发布。消融与受控分析揭示带类型交互在何处有效、在何处失效。

Conclusion: 结果支持所提协议的可复现性，而非部署有效性。在期刊投稿或实际运行使用前，仍需完成真实 OS-SGameBench 发布重建、分层标签审计与官方图模型对比。该边界旨在保护研究诚信并支撑可信评估。

Abstract: Open-source video-game quality depends on inter-actions among code, assets, configuration, tests, contributors, and issue workflows, yet conventional defect predictors usually flatten or omit these relations. We investigate release-level forecasting of a quality incident within thirty days using GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot, a typed temporal feature pipeline with calibrated risk estimates and effort-aware ranking. Because the accessible OS-SGameBench materials do not provide manually audited release dates and outbreak labels, the executed evaluation is explicitly simulation-backed rather than an empirical claim about real games. Five seeded worlds each contain 120 projects and 24 releases, with project-disjoint validation and future cross-project testing. The pilot obtains an AUPRC of 0.520, AUROC of 0.673, Brier score of 0.207, and 29.68% effort-aware recall at a twenty-percent testing budget. Its closest local comparator, Static-Hetero-Reimpl, reaches 0.522 AUPRC; the -0.002 difference is not statistically significant after Holm correction. Inference requires 0.023 milliseconds per release in the measured environment. Ablations and controlled missingness, drift, engine, project-size, alert-threshold, and attribution analyses expose where typed interactions help and where they fail. Results support the reproducibility of the proposed protocol, not deployment effectiveness. Real OSSGameBench release reconstruction, stratified label audits, and official graph-model comparisons remain mandatory before journal submission or operational use in practice. This boundary protects research integrity and supports credible evaluation.

</details>


### [845] [Energy Vision--Language--Action: A Controlled Multimodal Benchmark for Intent-Conditioned Residential Energy Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31648)
*Lyes Saad Saoud,Oualid Doukhi,Ehsan Reihani,Saeed Sepasi,Deok Jin Lee,Moussa Ayyash,Reza Ghorbani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EVLA 多模态基准，将住宅电池调度建模为"能量场图像+数值状态+语言目标→16步动作轨迹"的预测问题，实验显示语言模态贡献显著、视觉模态无增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型主要研究于机器人领域，缺乏面向住宅能源管理的受控多模态基准；需要可控环境来分离语义意图与潜在上下文对能源-动作预测的影响。

Method: 将电池调度形式化为多模态轨迹预测：输入 RGB 能量场表征、数值运行状态、自然语言目标，输出 16 步电池动作轨迹，由有限时域采样式参考生成器生成。数据源为公开住宅电力负荷窗口；电价、荷电状态、室内温度、时刻为生成的基准元数据。隐藏运行工况仅编码于能量场纹理中，实现视觉变化配对而数值状态固定。439,203 个基础窗口 × 3 种隐藏工况 × 5 种语言目标 = 6,588,045 个多模态实例。初步研究在 5,000/500/500 固定子集上、3 个随机种子评估 36 种配置。

Result: MobileNet 系列对比：移除处理后语言使轨迹 MSE 从 0.3856±0.0039 升至 0.8628±0.0001；移除视觉为 0.3843±0.0013，与完整模型相当。即模态使用存在显著不对称性——语言通路与预测质量强相关，当前 RGB 通路未带来总体误差优势。结论仅适用于该固定先导子集与所执行协议。

Conclusion: EVLA 为研究语义意图与潜在上下文如何影响住宅能源-动作预测提供了受控实验平台，并揭示模态贡献的不对称性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are studied mainly in robotics, where visual observations and language instructions are mapped to physical actions. This paper introduces Energy Vision-Language-Action (EVLA), a controlled multimodal benchmark for intent-conditioned residential energy management. EVLA frames battery scheduling as a multimodal trajectory-prediction problem in which an RGB energy-field representation, a numerical operating state, and a natural-language objective are mapped to a 16-step battery-action trajectory generated by a finite-horizon sampling-based reference generator. Source windows are derived from public residential electrical-load data, while electricity price, battery state of charge, indoor temperature, and time of day are generated benchmark metadata. A hidden operating regime is encoded only through energy-field texture, enabling paired visual changes while the explicit numerical state is fixed. Crossing 439,203 retained base windows with three hidden regimes and five language objectives yields 6,588,045 multimodal instances. An initial study evaluates 36 configurations over three training seeds using fixed subsets of 5,000 training, 500 validation, and 500 test instances. In the MobileNet-family comparison, removing processed language increases trajectory mean-squared error from 0.3856 +/- 0.0039 to 0.8628 +/- 0.0001, whereas removing vision yields 0.3843 +/- 0.0013, comparable to the full model. The results show strong asymmetry in modality use: the processed-language pathway is strongly associated with prediction quality, while the current RGB pathway provides no aggregate error advantage. These results characterize the fixed pilot subset and executed protocol rather than full-benchmark training. EVLA provides a controlled setting for studying how semantic intent and latent context influence residential energy-action prediction.

</details>


### [846] [Active Causal Discovery Benchmark: Evaluating LLM Agents Under Budgeted Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31675)
*Sagar Deb,Devam Shah,Ashwanth Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 ACDB——一个基于结构因果模型（SCM）的基准环境，用于评估 LLM 智能体在观察数据与预算受限的硬干预下能否恢复因果图结构，并给出六层难度的初步审计结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现评测缺乏统一、可控且预算感知的交互环境，尤其难以衡量 LLM 智能体在"观察—干预—提交"闭环中的主动发现能力；同时缺少能将骨架恢复、DAG 恢复与干预效率分层解耦的评分契约。

Method: ACDB 由三部分构成：(1) 线性-高斯世界生成器（linear-Gaussian world generator）作为 SCM 数据源；(2) 固定 observe-intervene-submit API 作为智能体交互接口；(3) 三层评分契约，分别衡量骨架恢复（skeleton recovery）、DAG 恢复与干预效率（intervention efficiency）。基线对比包括 PC + 贪心主动定向启发式、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4，以及结构盲随机 DAG 与密度探针。

Result: 在六层难度阶梯上，PC + 贪心主动定向为最强非 oracle 方法（有向 F1 42.7%，SHD 4.79），优于 Claude Sonnet 4.6（31.7%，7.25）与 GPT-5.4（22.9%，9.27）。核心诊断来自精确率-召回率分解：PC 高精确率但欠干预，LLM 过度干预且精确率偏低，统计工具访问反而常导致弃权增加而非有效干预。结构盲随机 DAG 基线在稠密 v0 阶梯上达 23.6% 有向 F1，密度探针将其下界降至 16.9%。

Conclusion: 当前结果应被解读为基准审计与校准报告，而非 LLM 已解决主动因果发现的证据；密度探针暴露的基线下界问题促使进行 v1 校准迭代。

Abstract: We introduce the Active Causal Discovery Benchmark (ACDB), an SCM-grounded environment for evaluating whether LLM agents recover causal graph structure from observations and budget-constrained hard interventions. ACDB pairs a linear-Gaussian world generator with a fixed observe-intervene-submit API and a three-layer scoring contract that separates skeleton recovery, DAG recovery, and intervention efficiency. On the current six-level ladder, PC with a greedy active orientation heuristic is the strongest non-oracle method (directed F1 42.7%, SHD 4.79), ahead of Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active (31.7%, 7.25) and GPT-5.4 raw active (22.9%, 9.27). The most informative diagnostic is the precision-recall decomposition: PC under-commits with high precision, LLMs over-commit with lower precision, and statistical-tool access often increases abstention rather than useful intervention. A structure-blind random DAG baseline reaches 23.6% directed F1 on this dense v0 ladder; a density probe lowers this floor to 16.9%, motivating the v1 calibration pass. The current results should therefore be read as a benchmark audit and calibration report, not as evidence that current LLMs solve active causal discovery.

</details>


### [847] [Autonomous Research Project Management as an Agent Skill: A Case Study in Exact Spectral Spatial Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31683)
*Alexander Chen,Jeffrey Meng,Bram Hoex,Tong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作展示了一个智能体技能在消费级硬件上端到端完成自主机器学习研究：用FFT加速的核岭回归（KRR）求解规则网格数据，在2005年NOAA Kaplan SST v2异常场（36×72）上验证，全程CPU（Apple M2 Pro，求解78.7 s，峰值RSS 1.57 GB），跨74个子智能体会话、仅4次人工干预，并倡导可检查状态与可证伪评审门等自主研究治理原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证自主研究型智能体能否在消费级硬件上完整闭环地开展机器学习研究，并探讨由此引出的自主研究治理与科学可信度问题（可检查状态、可证伪评审门、透明报告负面结果）。

Method: 由DeepSeek V4 Flash在DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中经智能体技能套件编排执行；将长时程状态解耦为基于文件的epic与issue追踪基底；以FFT加速的KRR求解器面向规则空间网格，在2005年逐月NOAA Kaplan SST v2异常场（36×72网格）上运行；全程仅CPU（Apple M2 Pro）。

Result: 求解耗时78.7 s，峰值内存1.57 GB；共74个子智能体会话；出现两次失败假设未通过评审门并自动回退至文献检索，修复了自助法（bootstrap）索引缺陷；仅4次离散人工介入事件。

Conclusion: 自主研究在工程上可行且具备闭环科学韧性，但科学可信度依赖可检查状态、可证伪评审门与对负面结果的透明报告；作者呼吁机器学习社区采用对智能体友好的结构化格式，而非静态PDF稿件。

Abstract: This work presents an end-to-end demonstration of autonomous machine learning research conducted by an agent skill on consumer hardware. The demonstration evaluates an FFT-based Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) solver for regular spatial grids using 2005 monthly NOAA Kaplan SST v2 anomaly fields on a $36 \times 72$ grid. This was autonomously executed by DeepSeek V4 Flash, orchestrated by our agent skill suite within DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Experiments were executed on CPU-only hardware (Apple M2 Pro; 78.7 s solver time, 1.57 GB peak RSS). Long-horizon state was decoupled into a file-based epic- and issue-tracking substrate. Across 74 sub-agent sessions, the agent demonstrated closed-loop scientific resilience: routing two failed hypothesis review gates back to literature retrieval, patching bootstrap indexing bugs, and executing with only four discrete human steering events. Finally, we reflect on autonomous research governance, arguing that scientific credibility requires inspectable state, falsifiable review gates, and transparent reporting of negative results, urging the machine learning community to favour agent-accessible structured formats over static PDF manuscripts.

</details>


### [848] [What does FFN compression change downstream? Same-state causal restoration in diffusion language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31685)
*Shaurya Omar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Same-State Causal Restoration（SSR），在压缩模型到达的同一当前输入上恢复原始 FFN，直接测量被移除 FFN 计算对扩散语言模型去噪轨迹的闭环因果影响，并据此指导压缩下的选择性恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）并行生成灵活，但迭代去噪计算开销大，因而需要激进压缩。现有压缩目标主要衡量压缩计算在局部对原始计算的近似程度，但局部误差无法揭示哪些被移除的计算真正影响下游去噪轨迹，导致压缩策略与真实任务性能脱节。

Method: 提出 Same-State Causal Restoration（SSR）：在压缩模型实际到达的当前输入状态上恢复原始 FFN，测量由此引起的轨迹变化，从而直接度量被移除 FFN 计算的同当前输入闭环效应。方法在固定去噪阶段比较 SSR 与局部 NMSE 的状态排序能力，并通过受控干预检验校正结构的作用；进一步采用无任务标签校准，冻结单一恢复窗口用于留出推理。

Result: 在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 与 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上，同去噪阶段下压缩侧状态对下游效应的排序显著优于局部 NMSE；受控干预表明校正结构比幅度更重要。在激进 LLaDA 压缩下，仅恢复四个转移即可挽回 89.9% 的损失精度，同时保留约 36.8% 的整模型 MAC 节省，并优于等预算的局部误差基线。Dream 上进一步显示，恢复稠密行为与修复最终任务结果是两个不同的目标。

Conclusion: SSR 首次直接测量 DLM 压缩中被移除 FFN 计算的同当前输入闭环效应，证明压缩侧状态比局部近似误差更能预测下游去噪影响，并可通过少量、校准冻结的恢复窗口在激进压缩下高效挽回精度，同时揭示恢复稠密行为与修复最终任务并非等价。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible, parallel generation, but their iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, motivating increasingly aggressive compression. Existing compression objectives largely measure how well compressed computation approximates the original locally, but local error does not reveal which removed computations actually matter to the downstream denoising trajectory. We introduce Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR), which restores the original FFN on the exact current input reached by the compressed model and measures how the resulting trajectory changes. To our knowledge, this is the first direct measurement of the same-current-input closed-loop effect of removed FFN computation in DLM compression. Across LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, compressed-side state ranks this downstream effect substantially better than local NMSE at fixed denoising phase, while controlled interventions show that correction structure matters beyond magnitude. Using task-label-free calibration, SSR freezes a single restoration window for held-out inference. Under aggressive LLaDA compression, restoring only four transitions recovers 89.9% of the lost accuracy while retaining an estimated 36.8% whole-model MAC saving and outperforming an equal-budget local-error baseline. Dream further shows that restoring dense behavior and repairing the final task are distinct outcomes.

</details>


### [849] [Same Probe, Different Numbers: Are Activation Probes Robust to Inference-Time Numerical Non-Determinism?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31796)
*Alizishaan Khatri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究测量了推理配置（batch size 与数值精度）变化对 LLM 激活探针（activation probes）的影响，发现探针本身稳定，但聚合准确率会严重低估逐样本判定翻转率，故应改用逐样本一致率进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活探针常用于部署中监控 LLM，但探针通常在某一推理配置下训练，却在实际服务的 batch size 和数值精度下使用。由于 GPU kernel 不具 batch 不变性、浮点格式舍入方式不同，部署时的激活与训练时并不一致，因此需要量化这种配置偏移带来的代价。

Method: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-3-4B 上，跨 batch size（4、8、16）与数值精度（float32、bfloat16、float16）共训练 768 个探针，每个探针在其余所有配置上评估，逐样本比较判定结果，并对比聚合准确率、翻转率、Cohen's kappa、AUROC，以及激活的相对 L2 扰动。

Result: 聚合准确率低估判定变化数达 2–9 倍。提示（prompt）阶段：1,392 次迁移中准确率变动不超过 0.47 个百分点，仅 0.076% 判定翻转；float32 下仅变 batch size 时 201,960 个判定无一翻转。解码阶段翻转率升至 2.8%，但已实现 token 匹配的行仅 0.12–0.15% 翻转，token 分歧的行达 12.9%，说明主因是文本而非算术。bfloat16 下改变 batch size 使 2.1% 行首个生成 token 翻转，到第 20 个 token 时 25% 行处于不同 token。翻转对称，Cohen's kappa 保持 >0.94，AUROC 变动 ≤0.05 点。bfloat16 下 batch size 变化使激活中位相对 L2 扰动约 1e-2，约为 float16 的 8 倍；探针能吸收该扰动，而模型自身的 next-token argmax 不能。

Conclusion: 激活监控器的鲁棒性评估应报告逐样本一致率而非聚合准确率，区分表示噪声与输入变化，并明确说明服务配置。

Abstract: Activation probes are increasingly used to monitor LLMs in deployment. A probe is typically trained under one inference configuration, then used under whatever batch size and numerical precision the serving stack uses. Because common GPU kernels are not batch-invariant and floating-point formats round differently, the activations seen at deployment are not the ones the probe was trained on. We measure what that costs for Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B and Gemma-3-4B across batch sizes 4, 8 and 16 and float32, bfloat16 and float16, training 768 probes on one configuration, evaluating each on every other, and comparing verdicts example by example. Probes are stable, but aggregate accuracy is the wrong instrument for showing it: it understates how many verdicts change by a factor of two to nine. At the prompt, accuracy never moves by more than 0.47 percentage points across 1,392 transfers and only 0.076% of verdicts change; under float32 with only the batch size varied, none of 201,960 verdicts change. During decoding the flip rate rises to 2.8%, but rows whose realised tokens matched flip in only 0.12-0.15% of cases, while rows whose tokens diverged flip in 12.9%: the cause is the text, not the arithmetic. A bfloat16 batch-size change flips the first generated token for 2.1% of rows and leaves 25% on different tokens by token 20. Flips are symmetric, Cohen's kappa stays above 0.94, and AUROC moves by at most 0.05 points. Underneath, activations move about as much as the format's rounding: a bfloat16 batch-size change perturbs them by a median relative L2 of 1e-2, roughly 8x the float16 figure. Probes absorb this; the model's own next-token argmax does not. Robustness evaluations of activation monitors should report per-example agreement rather than aggregate accuracy, separate representational noise from input change, and state the serving configuration.

</details>


### [850] [Deep Reinforcement Learning for Equity Trading: Benchmarking Actor-Critic Methods with Forward Retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31870)
*Bicheng Wang,Xinyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以20只标普500大盘股2000–2020年日度数据为样本，对比A2C、PPO、DDPG、TD3、SAC五种DRL actor-critic交易方法与监督式价格预测基线，检验一次训练与滚动重训两种模式下的收益与风险表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 股票市场具有噪声大、非平稳、仅部分可预测的特点，持续盈利交易困难；需系统比较不同深度强化学习actor-critic方法在端到端交易中的表现，并厘清一次性训练与滚动重训的影响，以及与监督式预测策略的收益-风险权衡。

Method: 选取2000–2020年20只标普500大盘股日度数据，引入趋势跟踪技术指标与对数min-max缩放；训练期2000–2018，回测期2019–2020；对比A2C、PPO、DDPG、TD3、SAC五种DRL actor-critic方法及一个监督式价格预测基线，并对每类智能体分别评估"一次性训练"与"前向滚动重训"（在每个测试窗口前用全部历史数据重新训练）两种设置。

Result: DDPG年化收益最高（55.5%）、Sharpe比率1.38、alpha 0.22，但市场beta也最高（1.24）；TD3与SAC风险收益更均衡，Sharpe分别为1.37和1.33，最大回撤约25%。前向重训提升A2C、PPO与SAC，TD3基本不变，DDPG年化收益由55.5%降至29.8%，与TD3对超参数更稳健一致。预测基线最大回撤最小（9.6%）、beta最低（0.31）。

Conclusion: 端到端DRL交易策略可获得更高收益，但伴随更高市场beta与回撤风险；预测驱动的策略风险更低。滚动重训的效果因算法而异，DDPG对重训与超参数较敏感，TD3稳健性更强，整体体现高收益DRL与低风险预测策略之间的权衡。

Abstract: Consistently profitable trading is difficult because equity markets are noisy, non-stationary, and only partially predictable from historical data. We benchmark five deep reinforcement learning (DRL) actor-critic methods: A2C, PPO, DDPG, TD3, and SAC, that learn trading actions end-to-end from market states, and compare them with a supervised price-forecasting baseline. Using daily data for 20 large-capitalization S&P 500 stocks from 2000 to 2020, enriched with trend-following technical indicators and log min-max scaling, we train on 2000-2018 and backtest on 2019-2020. Each agent is evaluated both when trained once and under forward retraining, in which it is retrained on all data available before each successive test window. DDPG achieves the highest annual return (55.5%), Sharpe ratio (1.38), and alpha (0.22), but also the highest market beta (1.24). TD3 and SAC offer a better risk-return balance, with Sharpe ratios of 1.37 and 1.33 and maximum drawdowns of about 25%. Forward retraining improves A2C, PPO, and SAC, leaves TD3 essentially unchanged, and reduces DDPG's annual return from 55.5% to 29.8%, consistent with TD3's greater robustness to hyperparameters. The forecasting baseline has the smallest maximum drawdown (9.6%) and the lowest beta (0.31), underscoring a trade-off between the higher returns of end-to-end DRL and the lower risk of forecast-driven strategies.

</details>


### [851] [DOHF: Online Diffusion Fine-tuning with Doob's $h$-transform Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31882)
*Zhengyi Guo,Jiayuan Sheng,Wenpin Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出DOHF（Diffusion Online h-guidance Fine-tuning），将Doob h-变换转化为实用的在线训练算法，通过对生成样本分配最优性权重、估计归一化局部修正∇log h并蒸馏进生成模型，实现黑盒、非可微奖励下的扩散模型微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于奖励的扩散微调面临两大实际挑战：一是理想结果罕见（稀疏奖励），二是条件修正的估计代价高昂。现有方法在这些场景下效率低或需要额外网络评估。

Method: 提出DOHF算法：将Doob h-变换转化为在线训练框架。具体地，对生成样本赋予最优性权重，在当前rollout策略下估计归一化局部修正∇log h，并将其直接蒸馏到生成模型中。同时从统一的h-变换视角刻画了总体最优的DiffusionNFT更新以及各类无分类器引导（CFG）方法。框架支持黑盒和非可微奖励，且无需额外网络评估。

Result: 在三种实验场景下取得改进的对齐效果，验证了方法在统计采样与视觉生成任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过低成本的估计与迭代蒸馏来适配概率条件化，能够提升生成学习在统计采样与视觉生成中的表现，为基于奖励的扩散微调提供了统一且实用的理论框架。

Abstract: Reward-based diffusion fine-tuning faces practical challenges when desirable outcomes are rare or conditioning corrections are costly to estimate. In this work, we propose Diffusion Online $h$-guidance Fine-tuning (DOHF), which turns Doob's $h$-transform into a practical online training algorithm. DOHF assigns optimality weights to generated samples, estimates the normalized local correction $\nabla\log h$ under the current rollout policy, and distills it directly into the generative model. Theoretically, we characterize the population-optimal DiffusionNFT update as well as the various classfier free guidance methods through a unified $h$-transform perspective. Methodologically, our framework accommodates black-box and non-differentiable rewards without additional network evaluations. We further show improved alignments under three empirical scenarios. Our work demonstrates how adapting probabilistic conditioning through inexpensive estimation and iterative distillation can improve generative learning across statistical sampling and visual generation.

</details>


### [852] [CyberWorld: World Models for Sample-Efficient Autonomous Cyber Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31893)
*Ryozo Masukawa,Sanggeon Yun,Raheeb Hassan,Hyunwoo Oh,SungHeon Jeong,Mohsen Imani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CyberWorld，一种Dreamer风格的世界模型框架，从向量、图、文本和多模态表示中学习潜在网络攻防动态，实现高样本效率、可扩展的自主网络防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自主网络防御方法多为无模型深度强化学习，需大量环境交互，样本效率低。世界模型通过预测动态与想象轨迹优化策略，在机器人和具身控制中已显著提升样本效率，但将其扩展到网络安全面临核心问题：网络世界模型中的"世界"应由什么构成。

Method: 提出CyberWorld，一种Dreamer风格的世界模型框架，从被防御网络的向量、图、文本及多模态表示中学习潜在网络动态，并基于想象轨迹优化策略。

Result: 在全部四种可评分的CyberWheel攻击策略上，基于图的CyberWorld变体在3.6k–15.8k环境步后即超越策略无关的对照基线，而无模型PPO需数百万步。图结构在拓扑依赖攻击下鲁棒性更强，简单表示在整体性能上仍具竞争力。成功运行的样本中，网络规模从15增至100台主机时，达到对照所需回合数近似恒定。

Conclusion: 学习到的网络动态可作为自主防御中样本高效且可扩展的基础，且世界表示是决定鲁棒性与可扩展性的核心设计维度。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has become a prominent approach to autonomous cyber defense. Existing methods are predominantly model-free and consequently require extensive environment interaction. World models provide an alternative by learning predictive dynamics and optimizing policies through imagined trajectories, yielding substantial gains in sample efficiency in robotics and embodied control. Extending this paradigm to cybersecurity raises a fundamental question: what should constitute the "world" in a cyber world model? We introduce CyberWorld, a Dreamer-style world modeling framework that learns latent cyber dynamics from vector, graph, textual, and multimodal representations of the defended network. Across all four scoreable CyberWheel attack strategies, the graph-based CyberWorld variant exceeds a strategy-agnostic control after 3.6k-15.8k environment steps, compared with millions of steps required by model-free PPO. Across representation choices, graph structure provides greater robustness under topology-dependent attacks, while simpler representations remain competitive in overall performance. Among successful runs, the number of episodes required to reach the control remains approximately constant as network size increases from 15 to 100 hosts. These results establish learned cyber dynamics as a sample-efficient and scalable basis for autonomous defense, and identify world representation as a central design axis for robustness and scalability.

</details>


### [853] [Understanding the Synergy between SFT, RLVR, and OPD in LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31900)
*Emre Can Acikgoz,Yang Li,Zeyu Leo Liu,Srijan Bansal,Dilek Hakkani-Tür,Shafiq Joty,Semih Yavuz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出大模型后训练中SFT、RLVR与OPD组成的多阶段流程不能孤立设计：一个阶段提升当前模型，可能削弱下一阶段效果。作者以Qwen3在数学与科学推理上做受控实验，刻画OPD依赖师生兼容性而非教师规模，并提出教师适配与学生预热可将OPD平均准确率从29.2%提升至43.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM后训练将SFT、RLVR、OPD组合为多阶段流水线，但各阶段通常被单独设计与评估，忽视阶段间的相互影响。作者希望揭示这种组合并非无害：某一阶段提升当前模型，可能改变其对下一阶段的学习接口，使后者效果下降。

Method: 使用Qwen3模型在数学和科学推理任务上进行受控实验；覆盖2x至53x参数比例的九个师生配对来刻画OPD；进一步分析SFT预热、RLVR强化学生、RLVR适配教师对后续OPD的影响；并比较同等准确率下OPD与SFT为下游RLVR提供的初始化质量。

Result: OPD效果取决于师生兼容性而非仅教师规模；SFT预热改善后续OPD，而经RLVR强化的学生在同一教师蒸馏下反而退化；用RLVR适配教师可按其带来的能力增益提升下游OPD准确率；结合教师适配与学生预热，在相同蒸馏步数下将平均OPD准确率从29.2%提升至43.8%，相对提升50%；同等准确率下，OPD为下游RLVR提供的初始化优于SFT，且差距随RL计算量扩大。

Conclusion: 后训练各阶段不应仅按其新增能力来选择，还应考虑它为下一阶段创造的学习接口；阶段间的兼容性与顺序设计对多阶段流水线整体效果至关重要。

Abstract: Modern LLM post-training composes supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), and on-policy distillation (OPD) into multi-stage pipelines, yet these stages are typically designed and evaluated in isolation. We show that this composition is consequential: a stage that improves the current model can make the next stage less effective. Through controlled experiments with Qwen3 models on math and science reasoning, we first characterize OPD across nine student-teacher pairs spanning 2x to 53x parameter ratios and show that OPD effectiveness depends on student-teacher compatibility rather than teacher scale alone. The surrounding stages of OPD reshape this compatibility in three ways: (1) A brief SFT warm-up improves subsequent OPD, while an RLVR-strengthened student regresses under distillation from the same teacher. (2) Adapting the teacher with RLVR raises downstream OPD accuracy in proportion to the capability it adds. Following these two interventions, we find that combining teacher adaptation and student warm-up alone raise average OPD accuracy from 29.2\% to 43.8\% (50\% relative improvement) after the same number of distillation steps, with additional preparatory training. (3) At comparable accuracy, OPD leaves a stronger initialization for downstream RLVR than SFT, with a gap that widens as RL compute scales. Our results suggest that each post-training stage should be chosen not only for the capability it adds, but for the learning interface it creates for the next stage.

</details>


### [854] [ROTE: Benchmarking Neural Memorization on Complexity-Controlled Symbolic Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31918)
*Xinye Chen,Stefan Güttel,Mohammad Mozaffari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ROTE基准协议，用LZW压缩复杂度调控序列，评测多种神经架构的符号记忆与规则外推能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要统一的协议来评估神经序列模型对符号规则的记忆与外推能力，并揭示算法序列复杂度与记忆容量之间的关系及各类架构的权衡。

Method: ROTE将各架构统一训练为相同有限上下文条件预测器，采用teacher-forced单步预测与闭环rollout在留出符号上评估；以LZW压缩调控序列复杂度，对比门控循环、最小循环、注意力及循环-注意力混合模型，并保留其原生计算特性。

Result: 在LZW复杂度扫描下报告预测指标、归一化字符串距离、训练时间、内存占用与参数量，揭示记忆质量、rollout稳定性与计算开销之间的权衡，并建立算法序列复杂度与架构记忆容量的联系。

Conclusion: ROTE提供了可复现的基准协议与实验代码（GitHub开源），用于系统评测神经序列模型的符号记忆与外推能力。

Abstract: We introduce ROTE (RollOut Testing of Exact memorization), a benchmarking protocol for evaluating symbolic memorization of neural architectures. We study memorization and the extension of symbolic rules in neural sequence models by using sequences whose complexity is regulated by Lempel--Ziv--Welch (LZW) compression. Under ROTE, each architecture is trained as the same finite-context conditional predictor and is evaluated using teacher-forced one-step prediction as well as closed-loop rollout on the withheld symbols. Following a shared prediction-and-rollout evaluation routine, the benchmark evaluates gated recurrent, minimal recurrent, attention-based, and hybrid recurrent-attention models with their native computational characteristics preserved. Beyond standard predictive metrics, the benchmark reports normalized string distances, training time, memory usage, and parameter count across an LZW-complexity sweep. The study establishes a connection between the complexity of algorithmic sequences and the memorization capacity of neural architectures, revealing the trade-offs involving memorization quality, rollout stability, and computational expense. Our software and reproducible experimental code can be obtained from https://github.com/nla-group/rote.

</details>


### [855] [VC Dimension and Expressivity of Real-Valued Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31999)
*Gavin Dooley,Andy Yang,Yijia Jessica Zhu,David Chiang,Peter Cholak,Anand Pillay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究实值多层softmax注意力Transformer的VC维与split VC维，得到上界O(n^4)和O(n^6)，下界Ω(n)，并据此给出对称函数表达能力与实数位数访问的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往关于Transformer能力与局限的结果往往对Transformer的定义施加多种限制。本文希望在极少额外假设下，研究作用于实值的softmax注意力多层Transformer，以更一般地刻画其表达能力边界。

Method: 借助实几何（real geometry）中的结果，对softmax注意力、多层、实值Transformer进行VC维与split VC维分析；通过上界证明与具体构造下界实例相结合，并进一步推导对称函数表达与实数位数访问方面的推论。

Result: 得到VC维上界O(n^4)、split VC维上界O(n^6)（n为输入长度）；同时构造具体Transformer给出下界Ω(n)。在对称（置换不变）函数类中，Transformer可一致表达单符号字母表上的所有函数、非一致表达双符号字母表上的所有函数，但即使非一致也无法表达六符号字母表上的某些函数；并证明了Transformer能访问一个实数的位数限制。

Conclusion: 在极弱假设下，实值多层softmax注意力Transformer具有多项式级的VC维与split VC维（上界O(n^4)、O(n^6)，下界Ω(n)），这为其表达能力划定了明确边界，并揭示了对称函数表达与实数信息访问上的本质局限。

Abstract: Whereas previous results on abilities and limitations of transformers have restricted the definition of transformers in various ways, here we study softmax-attention, multi-layer transformers operating on real values, with very few additional assumptions. Applying results from real geometry, we obtain upper bounds on the VC dimension and split VC dimension of such transformers ($O(n^4)$ and $O(n^6)$, respectively, where $n$ is the input length). Conversely, we also construct specific transformers witnessing lower bounds on these quantities ($Ω(n)$ in each case). These results have some notable consequences. For example, within the class of symmetric (permutation-invariant) functions, we show that transformers can uniformly express all functions over an alphabet of one symbol and non-uniformly express all functions over an alphabet of two symbols, but cannot (even non-uniformly) express some functions over an alphabet of six symbols. We also prove limitations on how many bits of a real number a transformer can access.

</details>


### [856] [Is invariance all you need for algorithmic fairness? Removing demographic information can create new bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32004)
*Aditya Parikh,Eike Petersen,Stella Frank,Enzo Ferrante,Melanie Ganz,Aasa Feragen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论和实验两方面证明，强制人口统计表征不变性会妨碍偏见缓解甚至制造新偏见，因此表征不变性既非理想目标也不足以保证公平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部表征中编码的人口统计信息常被视为算法偏见的风险因素，人口统计表征不变性被普遍推崇为理想状态；但作者指出，当人口统计与目标标签相关时，一定程度的编码是必要的，因此需要重新审视不变性假设。

Method: 区分边缘表征不变性与类条件表征不变性，证明二者分别对应人口统计均等与机会均等这两种标准群体公平概念；在五个表格数据集和两个胸部X射线影像数据集上，从理论与实证两方面评估强制两类不变性对预测性能和公平性的影响。

Result: 理论分析表明强制人口统计不变性会损害偏见缓解并产生新的偏见；实验结果与数学论证一致，验证了该结论在表格数据和影像数据上的普遍性。

Conclusion: 人口统计表征不变性既非理想目标，也不足以保证公平；追求不变性可能导致性能与公平性的双重损失。

Abstract: Encoded demographic information in internal model representations is a commonly assumed risk factor for algorithmic bias, with demographic representation invariance often being touted as the ideal state. However, while demographic shortcut learning is a genuine threat, some degree of encoding is necessary when demographics correlate with target labels. Here, we show, mathematically and empirically, that enforcing demographic invariance can actually hamper bias mitigation and even create new biases. We distinguish marginal from class-conditional representation invariance, and show that they imply the standard group fairness notions of demographic parity and equalized odds, respectively. We evaluate the effects on predictive performance and fairness of enforcing both invariance types, both theoretically and empirically across five tabular and two chest X-ray imaging datasets. Our findings support our mathematical argument that demographic representation invariance is neither desirable nor sufficient for fairness.

</details>


### [857] [Interactive Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Learning with General Function Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32048)
*Debamita Ghosh,George K. Atia,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究一般和分布鲁棒马尔可夫博弈（DRMG）的在线学习问题，提出无模型框架 RoMEX-φ，结合均衡探索与对偶拟合学习，在通用函数逼近与 φ-散度不确定集下实现次线性鲁棒遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习中模型误配是核心挑战，策略交互会放大转移动态不确定性；现有分布鲁棒马尔可夫博弈方法依赖强假设，且难以扩展到大规模状态与联合动作空间。

Method: 提出 RoMEX-φ：通过鲁棒多智能体贝尔曼算子的函数对偶表示，利用中心化经验鲁棒差异从名义交互数据中进行可处理的最坏情况价值估计；将均衡探索与对偶拟合学习统一为无模型框架；引入鲁棒多智能体解耦系数（robust MADC）刻画由策略交互与对抗性转移不确定性带来的内在探索复杂度。

Result: 建立了由 robust MADC 控制的次线性鲁棒遗憾界，不再显式依赖状态空间与联合动作空间大小，以内在函数类复杂度替代表格型依赖；在总变差不确定性下的一般和大规模 DRMG 数值实验中，RoMEX-φ 相比非鲁棒版本对转移漂移更具韧性，同时与精确表格鲁棒基线保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 为带通用函数逼近的分布鲁棒多智能体强化学习提供了可扩展的框架。

Abstract: Model misspecification poses a fundamental challenge in multi-agent reinforcement learning, where transition uncertainty can be amplified by strategic interactions among agents. Distributionally robust Markov games (DRMGs) provide a principled framework for addressing such uncertainty, yet existing methods often rely on restrictive assumptions or scale poorly to large state and joint action spaces. We study online learning in general-sum DRMGs with general function approximation and $φ$-divergence uncertainty sets. We propose RoMEX-$φ$, a model-free framework that integrates equilibrium-based exploration with dual fitted learning. Through a functional dual representation of the robust multi-agent Bellman operator, RoMEX-$φ$ enables tractable worst-case value estimation from nominal interaction data using a centered empirical robust discrepancy. We introduce the robust Multi-Agent Decoupling Coefficient (robust MADC) to characterize the intrinsic exploration complexity arising from strategic interactions and adversarial transition uncertainty. We establish sublinear robust regret guarantees governed by the robust MADC rather than explicitly by the state and joint action space sizes, replacing tabular dependence with intrinsic function-class complexity. Numerical experiments on a scalable general-sum DRMG under total variation uncertainty show that RoMEX-$φ$ is substantially more resilient to transition shifts than its non-robust counterpart while remaining competitive with an exact tabular robust baseline. Our results provide a scalable framework for distributionally robust multi-agent reinforcement learning with general function approximation.

</details>


### [858] [When Should a Human Take Back Control? Optimal Delegation under Turbulent AI Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32083)
*Haoze Yan,Julien Roze,Ved Upadhyay,Unal Tatar,Thibaut Mastrolia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个连续时间框架，用于在AI风险具有自激发（事件聚集）特性时学习自适应的“人类监督—委托”策略，并给出Hawkes-PPO策略梯度算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署AI系统时需决策何时委托任务、何时由人类介入监督与缓解风险；当失败事件聚集（一次幻觉或有害输出触发后续错误，形成高风险时段）时，该决策尤为困难。现有监督与委托方法虽以历史为条件，但未建模事件聚集及其受监督努力抑制的机制，也未与委托决策联合优化——本文填补这一空白。

Method: 采用自激发（Hawkes）过程刻画风险事件提高后续事件发生率的动态，使事件时序与历史成为决策核心。将问题建模为随机控制问题，联合人类动作、监控努力，以及在“人机协作运行”与“完全AI委托”之间的切换，权衡运营收益、监督成本、AI失败级联及诱发的uncertainty；人类参与被内生化为风险管理的组成部分，策略同时决定何时需要监督及投入多少努力。研究松弛的切换形式，提出Hawkes-PPO：一种利用观测事件时间的指数滤波器组（bank of exponential filters）的策略梯度方法。

Result: 在合成环境中，该方法取得高于任一固定制度（fixed regime）的风险调整目标，并接近近似全信息oracle。数值仿真展示了级联风险如何影响干预与委托，并说明切换策略与Hawkes-PPO算法能够沿时间高效监控项目，减少动荡风险的发生与成本。

Conclusion: 论文将强化学习与AI系统的自适应人类监督相连接，所提切换策略与Hawkes-PPO在自激发风险环境下有效降低风险与成本，为动态委托—监督决策提供了可行框架。

Abstract: Deploying AI systems requires deciding when to delegate tasks and when humans should intervene to monitor and mitigate risk induced by AI operations. These decisions are challenging when failures cluster: a hallucination or harmful output can trigger further errors, creating periods of elevated risk. We introduce a continuous-time framework for learning adaptive human oversight under such turbulent AI risk. Existing oversight and delegation formulations condition on history but do not model incident clustering, or its suppression by supervision effort, jointly with the delegation decision and this study fixes this gap. The self-exciting dynamics capture how risk events increase the likelihood of subsequent events, making their timing and history central to decision-making. We formulate a stochastic control problem combining human actions, monitoring effort, and switching between human-AI-assisted operation and full AI delegation, balancing operational rewards against oversight costs, and cascading AI-failures and induced uncertainty. Human participation is an endogenous component of risk management: the policy determines both when oversight is needed and how much effort to allocate. We study a relaxed switching formulation and propose Hawkes-PPO, a policy-gradient method that uses a bank of exponential filters of observed incident times. In a synthetic environment it attains a higher risk-adjusted objective than either fixed regime and approaches an approximate full-information oracle. We illustrate our results with numerical simulations by examining how cascade risks influence intervention and delegation, connecting reinforcement learning with adaptive human oversight of AI systems. In particular, we illustrate the benefit of our switching strategy and Hawkes-PPO algorithm to monitor the project efficiently along time, reducing turbulent risks occurrences and costs.

</details>


### [859] [Spectral Reversal: Counteracting Singular Value Bias for Graph Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32143)
*Hanxu Yang,Yuhuan Zhao,Xiaodong He,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出谱偏见（spectral bias）现象，并设计谱反向提示（SRP）框架，通过在谱域重加权贡献实现参数高效的图模型适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练GNN通过自监督学习已成主流范式，但高效适配冻结编码器仍具挑战。图提示（graph prompting）提供了参数高效的替代方案，但现有方法多将预训练模型视为不透明的特征提取器，忽略其内部谱结构。

Method: 识别并定义预训练GNN中的"谱偏见"：预训练优化过程使表示不成比例地对齐到大奇异值对应的方向，低能量方向未被充分探索。基于此提出SRP框架：在谱域应用可学习的软阈值掩码，降低主导方向权重并放大较弱方向；并引入零空间增强模块（null-space augmentation），捕获在冻结编码器下激活极小方向的变化。

Result: 在多个基准上，SRP以极少的附加参数实现了state-of-the-art性能，表明重加权谱分量是参数高效图适配中一种有原则且有效的策略。

Conclusion: 被忽视的低能量谱方向编码了对下游适配（尤其在分布偏移下）有益的信息；重加权谱分量为参数高效图适配提供了原则性且有效的路径。

Abstract: Pre-training Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) via self-supervised learning has become a dominant paradigm, yet efficiently adapting frozen encoders remains a challenge. Graph prompting offers a parameter-efficient alternative to fine-tuning, but existing methods largely treat pre-trained models as opaque feature extractors, ignoring their internal spectral structure. In this work, we identify a systematic phenomenon in pre-trained GNNs, which we term spectral bias: optimization during pre-training disproportionately aligns representations with directions associated with large singular values, leaving low-energy directions under-explored. We show that these underutilized directions can encode complementary information that is beneficial for downstream adaptation, especially under distribution shift. To leverage this insight, we propose Spectral Reverse Prompt (SRP), a prompting framework that rebalances the spectral contributions of frozen GNN encoders. SRP applies a learnable soft-thresholding mask in the spectral domain to down-weight dominant directions while amplifying weaker ones. In addition, SRP incorporates a null-space augmentation module that captures variation in directions with minimal activation under the frozen encoder. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SRP achieves state-of-the-art performance with minimal additional parameters, highlighting that reweighting spectral components is a principled and effective strategy for parameter-efficient graph adaptation.

</details>


### [860] [Uncertainty-Aware Selection of Online Algorithms with Simulator Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32170)
*Yongyi Guo,Zifan Xu,Ziping Xu,Kelly W. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线强化学习中的算法选择问题，提出并分析"不确定性感知选择"方法：通过bootstrap构建模拟器集成，选择在集成上平均表现最好的算法，理论上证明该方法能缓解离线数据有限的影响并获得显著遗憾收益，实验中在机器人控制任务上实现了更可靠的选择和更优的在线表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线RL性能高度依赖设计选择（尤其影响探索的选择），常规做法是拟合模拟器、在模拟器中评估候选算法并部署最优者。但最简单的Plug-In选择规则仅依据拟合模拟器上的最佳表现进行选择，当用于拟合模拟器的离线数据有限时，评估不可靠。

Method: 研究不确定性感知（Uncertainty-Aware）选择：构建模拟器集成（如通过bootstrap重采样获得），并选择在集成上平均性能最好的在线算法。在多臂老虎机设定中对该方法进行形式化理论分析，并在涉及奖励塑形超参数选择的机器人控制深度RL任务上进行实证研究。

Result: 理论上证明集成方法可缓解拟合模拟器时数据有限的影响，相比Plug-In选择在多臂老虎机中具有显著的遗憾（regret）收益；实证上在机器人控制的深度RL实验中，该方法带来更可靠的选择和更好的在线性能。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知选择通过集成模拟器提升了算法选择的可靠性，既在理论上获得了相较Plug-In选择的遗憾增益，也在深度RL机器人控制任务中验证了其有效性。

Abstract: The performance of online reinforcement learning depends critically on design choices, especially those that affect exploration. These choices are often selected by fitting a simulator to offline data, evaluating candidate algorithms in that simulator, and deploying the best-performing one. The simplest Plug-In selection rule simply selects the best performing algorithm on the fitted simulator, making evaluations unreliable when the offline data used to fit the simulator are limited. We investigate Uncertainty-Aware selection, which forms an ensemble of simulators---for example, obtained by bootstrap resampling---and selects the online algorithm with the best average performance across the ensemble. While ensemble-based approaches have been used to mitigate distribution shift and facilitate sim-to-real transfer, we formally show that this approach can mitigate the effects of limited data when fitting the simulator and theoretically has significant regret gains compared to Plug-In selection in multi-armed bandits. We also empirically investigate the Uncertainty-Aware selection approach in deep RL experiments on robotic control tasks that involve selecting reward-shaping hyperparameters, and show that it leads to more reliable selection and improved online performance.

</details>


### [861] [A Solvable Theory of Pre-training Data Poisoning: Regime-Dependent Scaling Exponents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32288)
*Indranil Halder,Rastri Dey,Cengiz Pehlevan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究预训练数据投毒率ε上升时模型在干净数据上性能退化规律，发现Δ≈Cε^a（非整数指数），并从理论上证明该非整数指数源于污染目标函数的奇异结构，在重尾协变量截断岭回归中给出了依赖极限顺序的过量风险标度指数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练数据投毒研究多关注定向后门及其在安全后训练中的存留，而忽略了一个更基础的问题：随着投毒率ε增大，模型在干净数据上的性能如何退化。作者通过OLMo类模型的受控预训练观察到Δ与ε呈幂律关系且指数为非整数，想探究这种幂律在理论上需要什么样的结构才能成立。

Method: 首先证明解析性障碍：当污染目标在非退化干净数据最优点附近关于ε解析时，Δ一般是ε的二次函数，故非整数指数意味着存在真正奇异的结构。随后在可解的截断岭回归中引入重尾协变量（由q_star控制）与标签偏移投毒，分析过量风险标度对极限顺序的依赖；并通过数值模拟验证；最后论证有限训练时间在局部LLM预训练中起到曲率谱截断的作用。

Result: 过量风险标度指数依赖于极限顺序：在高维比例渐近区为ε^{q_star/(q_star+2)}，而先取充足数据极限则为ε^{2-2/q_star}，两个极限不可交换。数值模拟验证了这一预测。在重尾逆曲率谱的建模假设下，有限训练时间对应于曲率谱截断，可导出所观察到的标度律。

Conclusion: 预训练投毒导致的干净数据性能退化呈现非整数幂律，这需要目标函数存在奇异结构而非解析依赖；在重尾协变量与标签偏移投毒的可解模型中，过量风险标度指数依赖极限顺序且极限不可交换；有限训练时间通过曲率谱截断机制解释了LLM预训练中观察到的标度律。

Abstract: Pre-training data poisoning of large language models is usually studied using targeted backdoors and their survival through safety post-training, which leaves open a more basic question: how does a model's clean data performance degrade as the poison rate $\varepsilon$ grows? Motivated by our controlled pre-training runs of OLMo-style models, in which the relative clean data validation perplexity increase $Δ$ between poisoned and clean models matched in architecture, token budget, and optimization schedule is well fit by a power law $Δ\approx C\varepsilon^{a}$ with a non-integer exponent, we ask what such a law requires theoretically. We first prove an analyticity barrier: whenever the contaminated objective depends analytically on $\varepsilon$ around a nondegenerate clean data optimum, $Δ$ is generically quadratic in $\varepsilon$, so a generic non-integer exponent is a signature of genuinely singular structure. We then supply that structure in solvable truncated ridge regression with heavy-tailed covariates, controlled by $q_\star$, and a label-shift poisoning. Our central result is that the excess risk scaling exponent depending on the order of limits: in the higher dimensional proportional regime it is $ε^{q_\star/(q_\star+2)}$, whereas taking the ample-data limit first gives $ε^{2-2/q_\star}$, and the limits do not commute. We confirm this prediction through several numerical simulations. Finally, we argue that finite training time plays the role of truncation on the curvature spectrum in local LLM pre-training, deriving the observed scaling law under heavy tailed inverse curvature spectrum as a modeling hypothesis.

</details>


### [862] [Phase Space Attention:A Hairer Lift Circumvents the Single-Layer Induction Obstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32319)
*Kingsuk Maitra,Shagun Sood Morteza Hosseini,Suman Gunnala,Vikram Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将注意力提升到辛相空间，绕开Sanford-Hsu-Telgarsky单层归纳障碍，给出唯一、精确辛的线性因果双线性设计，并实证观察到归纳能力涌现带。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SHT单层归纳障碍限制了单层双线性注意力实现归纳（induction）的能力。作者不以突破该界为目标，而是试图从前提层面绕开该计数论证的适用条件，为post-RoPE架构下高效、可部署的单层归纳构造提供理论依据。

Method: 将post-RoPE的query/key流提升到辛相空间，施加辛上剪切M_γ:(q,p)↦(q+γp,p)，类比Hairer对Stormer-Verlet的提升。证明该提升在因子化子类中唯一、在算子层面精确辛、且必须置于post-RoPE位置；并在仅含T_4的Gaussian约化下导出闭式双分支归纳相变律。

Result: 闭式相变律在r=0.9876下以零拟合参数被留出验证；但该律仅为可解析求解的极限，恢复T_3通道后d_k=64处γ_c由1.030变为0.569且交叉消失。91.3M参数下超临界扫描显示涌现带：γ=0.80时3/3种子在平均717步形成归纳，而γ=0时为2/3种子、2700步。仅key半提升达0.949，优于对称算子的0.811。

Conclusion: 该辛提升在不改变KV缓存、保留前缀复用与投机解码、每token每层仅增6d FLOPs、INT8余量增加最多log2(1+2γ)位且不增参数的前提下改善归纳形成；但若以归纳精度为目标，key-only半提升是更优构造。闭式相变律并非稳健预测，T_3通道会改变临界行为。

Abstract: We circumvent the Sanford-Hsu-Telgarsky (SHT) single-layer induction obstruction within a linear, one-step, causal, bilinear, symplectically consistent design class on the post-RoPE substrate, by lifting attention onto a symplectic phase space, mirroring Hairer's lift of Stormer-Verlet. The lift exits the premise of the SHT counting argument rather than the bound itself. The reframing exhibits the obstruction as a filter-order gap: a one-layer bilinear score realises a $z$-transform of joint order $(0,0)$, whereas the induction discriminator requires key-side order $\geq 1$. Applying the symplectic upper shear $M_γ:(q,p)\mapsto(q+γp,p)$ to the post-RoPE query and key streams closes it. We prove this lift is unique within the factorised subclass, exactly symplectic at operator level, and requires post-RoPE placement; and in an explicit $T_4$-only Gaussian reduction we derive a closed-form two-branch induction phase transition, held out at $r=0.9876$ with zero fitted parameters. That law is an analytically solvable limit, not a robust prediction: restoring the $T_3$ channel moves $γ_c$ at $d_k=64$ from 1.030 to 0.569 and removes the crossover.
  Deployability follows by exact derivation: the KV cache is unchanged, prefix reuse and speculative decoding are preserved, overhead is $6d$ FLOPs per token per layer, INT8 headroom grows by at most $\log_2(1+2γ)$ bits, fused kernels are unmodified, and no parameters are added.
  At 91.3M parameters a supercritical sweep locates an emergence band: induction forms 3/3 seeds at $γ=0.80$ in a mean of 717 steps, against 2/3 seeds and 2700 steps at $γ=0$. Adverse results are reported as directly: a key-only half-lift reaches 0.949 against 0.811 for the symmetric operator, so if induction accuracy is the objective, the half-lift is the better construction. Forty-one notebooks and result files ship as ancillary material.

</details>


### [863] [Superposed Inference for Hyperdimensional Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32320)
*Quanling Zhao,Nilesh Prasad Pandey,Ye Tian,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SupHDC提出一种共享编码的超维计算推理范式：通过为多个查询分配轻量随机槽键、在编码前叠加键控查询，并用槽特定分类器恢复各自预测，从而将重复的高维投影成本在多个查询间分摊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统超维计算推理对每个查询独立编码，反复承担高维投影的开销，推理效率受限。作者希望利用高维冗余不仅承载鲁棒性，还能作为共享推理的容量，从而降低多查询场景的编码成本。

Method: SupHDC为多个查询分配轻量级随机槽键（slot keys），将键控后的查询叠加后再做共享编码，并用槽特定分类器分别恢复各查询的预测。论文还用随机特征核（random-feature kernel）视角论证了无需精确恢复每个超向量，只需保留决定预测的类别证据。

Result: 在十个数据集上，SupHDC取得1.39倍解析加速且平均精度无损失；最高2.08倍加速时平均精度仅下降2.67个百分点。在Raspberry Pi 5上实测墙钟加速2.01倍，平均预测精度下降2.26个百分点。

Conclusion: SupHDC表明高维冗余可被用作共享推理的容量，而不仅用于鲁棒性，为高效超维计算推理提供了新范式。

Abstract: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) is attractive for efficient and robust learning, but conventional inference still encodes every query independently, repeatedly paying the cost of high-dimensional projection. We introduce SupHDC, a new inference paradigm that processes multiple queries through a shared encoding computation. SupHDC assigns lightweight random slot keys, superposes the keyed queries before encoding, and uses slot-specific classifiers to recover their individual predictions. A random-feature kernel view explains why exact recovery of each hypervector is unnecessary: inference only needs to preserve the class evidence that determines the prediction. Across ten datasets, SupHDC achieves 1.39x analytical speedup with no average accuracy loss, and up to 2.08x speedup with only a 2.67 percentage-point mean accuracy loss. On a Raspberry Pi~5, it delivers 2.01x measured wall-clock speedup with a 2.26 percentage-point loss in mean prediction accuracy. SupHDC shows that high-dimensional redundancy can be used not only for robustness, but also as capacity for shared inference.

</details>


### [864] [Active Feature Acquisition With Incomplete Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32325)
*Reza Rezvan,Valter Schütz,Han Wu,Linus Aronsson,Morteza Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究训练数据不完整情形下的主动特征获取（AFA-ITD），从理论与实验两方面分析三种从不完整数据中学习的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AFA假设训练数据完整，但实际中往往无法获得全部特征，该假设常被违背，因此需要研究不完整训练数据下的AFA问题。

Method: 在MCAR假设下分析一步与多步获取价值的变化，并对比三种学习策略：aliasing（别名化）、filtering（过滤）、generative restoration（生成式修复）。

Result: MCAR下一步获取值不变，多步获取值可能下降；filtering所需训练样本数随维度指数增长，而generative restoration随获取预算指数增长。实验表明缺失主要损害依赖多步获取的方法，生成式修复在多数实验中能恢复损失的性能。

Conclusion: AFA-ITD是一个值得关注的问题，生成式修复是应对不完整训练数据的有效途径。

Abstract: In many prediction tasks, acquiring all features can be a prohibitively expensive or outright impossible task. Further, in many cases a static subset of features may not be enough to solve the problem sufficiently across various instances. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses these problems by formalizing the trade-off between feature cost and predictive performance during sequential feature selection. However, prior AFA work largely assumes access to complete training data, an assumption that is often violated in practice. Here we study AFA with Incomplete Training Data (AFA-ITD), showing that under missing completely at random (MCAR) data, one-step acquisition values remain unchanged, whereas multi-step values can decrease. We analyze three approaches to learning from incomplete data: aliasing, filtering, and generative restoration. We show that filtering can require a number of training instances scaling exponentially with the dimension, whereas generative restoration scales exponentially with the acquisition budget. We empirically test our theory on a controlled experiment and across common AFA datasets and find that missingness mainly damages methods that exploit multi-step acquisitions and that generative restoration is able to recover lost performance in many experiments. Code is available at https://github.com/Linusaronsson/AFA-Benchmark/tree/missing-data.

</details>


### [865] [DiffPTS: Rethinking Diffusion ELBO for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32363)
*Weiwei Ye,Dongyuan Li,Hangchen Liu,Haotong Jiang,Yoshihide Sekimoto,Renhe Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DiffPTS框架，重新审视LSNM下的ELBO，将去噪扩散概率模型的估计器训练统一为联合训练目标，实现ELBO所有组件的端到端优化，在多个基准上达到SOTA，CRPS/MSE平均降低超14.53%/16.55%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率时间序列预测需建模复杂且时变的分布。现有基于DDPM的方法虽通过预训练均值与方差估计器应对分布漂移，但遵循标准DDPM框架、仅考虑ELBO的部分组件，将估计器训练当作独立的回归任务，与变分推断框架分离，缺乏理论统一性。

Method: 在Location-Scale Noise Model（LSNM）下重新推导证据下界（ELBO），发现其自然导出估计器的高斯负对数似然目标，并内在地定义了一个联合训练目标，从而统一了近期用于概率预测的扩散范式；基于此原理性重构，提出DiffPTS通用框架，支持对ELBO内所有组件的端到端优化。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，DiffPTS持续优于近期模型，达到最先进性能；相比现有基于扩散的方法，CRPS与MSE平均分别降低超过14.53%与16.55%。

Conclusion: 通过在LSNM下重构ELBO并统一估计器训练与变分推断，DiffPTS实现了概率时间序列预测中扩散模型组件的端到端优化，验证了该原理性框架的有效性与泛化优势。

Abstract: Probabilistic time series forecasting requires modeling and predicting complex and time-varying distributions. Recently, Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based approaches have shown promise by equipping the dif- fusion process with pretrained mean and variance estimators to accommodate distributional shift. However, these methods typically follow the standard DDPM framework and consider only partial components of the evidence lower bound (ELBO), treating the training of estimators as designed regression tasks separate from the variational inference framework. To address this, we rethink the ELBO under the Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM) and find that it naturally induces a Gaussian negative log likelihood objective for the estimators and inherently defines a joint training objective that unifies recent diffusion paradigms for probabilistic forecasting. Building on this principled ELBO reformulation, we propose Diff- PTS, a general framework that enables end-to-end optimization of all components within the ELBO. Across multiple benchmarks, DiffPTS consistently outperforms recent models, achieving state-of-the-art performance with an average CRPS/MSE reduction of over 14.53%/16.55% compared to existing diffusion-based methods. The code is available at https://github.com/wwy155/DiffPTS.

</details>


### [866] [Measurement Boundaries in LLM Financial Agent Evaluation: Fixed-Tape Execution and Multi-Defect Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32379)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在金融智能体评测框架下开展两项研究：A研究揭示理想化与压力执行条件下，执行规则、模型新响应与组合反馈相互混淆，仅19.8%决策路径一致，压力执行使总收益变化约为基线10.4%，种子聚类无法区分模型排序；B研究通过修正答案键与匹配缺陷任务发现，目标违规召回从单缺陷到双缺陷的下降中位数0.267，但单靠目标召回无法刻画审计质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注LLM智能体评测中执行性能与审计分数的可解释性边界，即需要何种控制条件才能支撑分数所宣称的结论。现有比较往往将执行规则与模型响应、组合反馈混同，而审计评估的目标召回也常被当作审计质量的充分代表，二者都可能产生过度推断。

Method: 研究A：在三个共享同一24天上行阶段的合成设定中，比较理想化与压力执行下的独立运行（450对），随后将存储的响应带重放于两种执行目的地以条件化响应。研究B：修正不完整答案键，用匹配的零、一、二缺陷任务替换旧任务，并采用显式多标签提示；在六种审计器与来源组合中分析召回下降，并进行Holm校正。
