Result: 研究A：决策路径仅在19.8%的配对中一致；条件于固定响应，压力执行使总收益变化-0.0170（95%区间[-0.0230,-0.0117]），占理想化基线10.4%；十个种子聚类未能分辨模型排序。研究B：从单缺陷到双缺陷的目标违规召回下降在六种组合中五组为正（中位数0.267），三组通过Holm校正；但包含两个目标标签最多的审计器微精度为0.149，在98/100零缺陷任务上仍输出发现，仅21/100返回精确双缺陷集。

Conclusion: 两项研究分别界定不同限制：执行比较究竟估计了什么，以及目标召回捕获了什么。固定条件与诊断控制共同限制了分数所能支撑的论断范围，因此执行性能与审计分数需在明确的对照与诊断约束下解读。

Abstract: What controls are needed to interpret execution performance and audit scores in LLM agent evaluations? We study two limits on these interpretations in a financial agent harness. In Study~A, comparing independent runs under idealized and stressed execution on three synthetic settings that share one 24-day upward phase mixes the execution rule with fresh model responses and portfolio feedback: the parsed decision paths agree in only $19.8\%$ of $450$ pairs. Replaying each stored response tape through both execution destinations gives a narrower result. Conditional on those responses, stressed execution changes total return by $-0.0170$ (95\% interval $[-0.0230,-0.0117]$), or $10.4\%$ of the idealized baseline, and ten seed clusters do not resolve the model ranking. Study~B corrects an incomplete answer key and replaces legacy tasks with matched zero-, one-, and two-defect tasks under an explicit multi-label prompt. The drop in target violation recall from one to two defects is positive in five of six combinations of auditor and source (median $0.267$), with three surviving Holm correction. Yet the auditor that includes both target labels most often has micro-precision $0.149$, emits findings on $98/100$ zero-defect tasks, and returns the exact dual-defect set in only $21/100$ cases. Target recall by itself therefore gives a poor account of audit quality on this construction. The studies address different limits: what an execution comparison estimates, and what target recall captures. Together, they show how fixed conditions and diagnostic controls bound the claims a score can support.

</details>


### [867] [TimeES: Probabilistic and Deterministic Time Series Forecasting via Evolutionary Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32384)
*Weiwei Ye,Renhe Jiang,Hangchen Liu,Dongyuan Li,Yoshihide Sekimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出TimeES框架，将非平稳时间序列建模转化为演化谱学习，通过随机变量调制的演化表示实现概率与确定性预测，并利用Hermitian对称与谱能量稀疏性将谱估计复杂度从O(NM)降至O(NK)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实时间序列本质非平稳，趋势、周期模式与不确定性随时间演变。现有深度学习虽借助Fourier域建模，但未显式刻画Fourier谱的演化与随机性，导致难以同时准确预测期望轨迹及其不确定性。

Method: 受演化谱(Evolutionary Spectra, ES)理论启发，推导可参数化的演化谱公式，将非平稳随机过程建模重构为受随机变量调制的演化表示学习；并利用Hermitian对称性和谱能量稀疏性进行频率选择，将谱估计复杂度从O(NM)降至O(NK)，其中K远小于M/2。

Result: 基于简单线性骨干网络，TimeES在确定性与概率预测任务上均取得持续的最优性能，兼具高效率与可解释性。

Conclusion: TimeES作为通用框架，通过演化谱理论统一实现概率与确定性预测，验证了显式建模谱演化与随机性的有效性，并提供了可持续改进的高效、可解释方案。

Abstract: Real-world time series are inherently non-stationary, with trends, periodic patterns, and uncertainty evolving over time. While the Fourier domain offers a natural lens to model time series, current deep learning approaches do not explicitly model evolution and randomness in the Fourier spectra, which limits their ability to accurately predict both the expected trajectory and its uncertainty in non-stationary time series. Motivated by Evolutionary Spectra (ES) theory, we propose TimeES, a general framework that enables probabilistic and deterministic forecasting via the evolutionary spectra theory. Specifically, we derive a parameterizable evolutionary spectra formulation, recasting non-stationary random process modeling as learning an evolving representation modulated by random variables. Furthermore, we reduce the complexity of the estimated spectra from O(NM) to O(NK), where K << M/2, by exploiting Hermitian symmetry and spectral energy sparsity for frequency selection. Based on a simple linear backbone, our proposed TimeES achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across both deterministic and probabilistic forecasting tasks, with high efficiency and interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/wwy155/TimeES.

</details>


### [868] [Rethinking Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning: Where It Arises and How to Correct It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32444)
*Tianrun Yu,Kaixiang Zhao,Shangzhe Li,Yuxiao Yang,Porter Jenkins,Weitong Zhang,Taylor W. Killian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究RLVR中训练-推理引擎概率不一致问题，提出校准重要性采样（CIS），基于logit位移刻画实现置信度感知的截断，理论与实验均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在RLVR中，rollout由推理引擎采样而梯度由训练引擎计算，二者对同一token赋予不同概率，导致训练-推理不匹配，直接使用精确重要性采样会产生无界二阶矩、误差难以控制。

Method: 提出校准重要性采样（CIS）。基于经实证支持的logit位移刻画，将不匹配表示为log-odds中的加性位移ε_t，其分布近似与token置信度无关。据此设计置信度感知截断：对大的正位移在单一常数阈值处截断，映射为随置信度升高而收紧的重要性比上限。

Result: 理论上，CIS将支配精确重要性采样误差的无界二阶矩替换为常数有界项，代价是受截断超额控制的偏差。在3个MoE模型与5个数学推理基准上，CIS在三模型上均取得最高五基准平均。诊断分析显示，CIS对低置信度token施加的截断偏差小于截断重要性采样，而向上裁剪小重要性权重会降低留出准确率。

Conclusion: CIS通过置信度感知截断有效缓解训练-推理不匹配，在理论上有界化误差并在多个模型与基准上取得最优性能，同时表明截断方向与置信度感知设计的重要性。

Abstract: We study training-inference mismatch in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for large language models, where rollouts are sampled by an inference engine while gradients are computed by a training engine, and the two engines assign different probabilities to the same tokens. To account for this discrepancy in policy updates, we introduce calibrated importance sampling (CIS). CIS is motivated by an empirically supported logit-displacement characterization that expresses the mismatch as an additive displacement $\varepsilon_t$ in log-odds, determined by the per-logit perturbation before the softmax, whose distribution is approximately invariant to token confidence. This characterization motivates a confidence-aware truncation: large positive displacements are truncated at a single constant threshold, which maps back to an importance-ratio cap that tightens as token confidence increases. Theoretically, we show that CIS replaces the unbounded second moment that governs the error of exact importance sampling with a term bounded by a constant, at the cost of a bias controlled by the truncated excess. In evaluation across three mixture-of-experts models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CIS achieves the highest five-benchmark average on all three models among the evaluated baselines. Diagnostic analyses show that CIS places less truncation bias on low-confidence tokens than truncated importance sampling, while upward clipping of small importance weights reduces held-out accuracy.

</details>


### [869] [Adapting Nonstationary Multi-output Gaussian Processes to Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32464)
*Zikai Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MOLRN-BO 通过正则化共享谱代理、目标残差、序贯均值校正与退火协方差缩放，并结合 Pareto 局部 qLogEHVI 优化，解决了 MO-LRN 高斯过程在多目标贝叶斯优化中训练拟合好但离线预测偏移与采集过度乐观的失配问题，在 12 个确定性双目标基准上取得最佳平均排名与最强尾部表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）多依赖独立、平稳核的高斯过程，难以刻画非平稳结构且无法在目标间共享信息；而表达力更强的非平稳 GP 未必带来可靠的 BO 决策，存在训练拟合与序贯优化需求之间的失配，尤其 MO-LRN 会出现强训练拟合伴随大离线误差与乐观采集预测的问题。

Method: 提出 MOLRN-BO：采用正则化共享谱代理搭配目标专属残差；引入序贯（prequential）均值校正与退火协方差缩放，进行分层校准；在决策层使用 Pareto 局部 qLogEHVI 优化并辅以周期性全局搜索的局部—全局策略。

Result: 在 12 个确定性双目标基准、9 种算法的对比中，MOLRN-BO 显著优于原始 MO-LRN，在最终归一化超体积与归一化反向世代距离上取得最佳平均问题排名；同时具备最强的逆境尾部性能，并在随时优化（anytime）上保持与领先基线相当。消融实验表明共享谱构造改善离线预测，局部—全局决策策略提升优化性能，分层校准降低系统性候选偏差。

Conclusion: 当非平稳多输出代理的结构与使用方式被显式地适配序贯优化需求时，能够交付强劲且稳健的 MOBO 性能。

Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) commonly relies on independent Gaussian processes (GPs) with stationary kernels, limiting its ability to represent nonstationary structure and share information between objectives. However, expressive nonstationary GPs do not necessarily make reliable BO decisions. We study this mismatch for the multi-output low-rank nonstationary (MO-LRN) GP: strong training fit can coexist with large off-design errors and optimistic acquisition predictions. We introduce MOLRN-BO, which combines a regularized shared-spectral surrogate with objective-specific residuals, prequential mean correction and tempered covariance scaling, and Pareto-local qLogEHVI optimization with periodic global search. Experiments on 12 deterministic bi-objective benchmarks show that MOLRN-BO substantially improves upon the original MO-LRN and achieves the best average problem ranks for final normalized hypervolume and normalized inverted generational distance among nine evaluated algorithms. It also achieves the strongest adverse-tail performance while remaining competitive with the leading baselines in anytime optimization. Ablation studies further show that the shared spectral construction improves off-design prediction, the local--global decision policy improves optimization performance, and hierarchical calibration reduces systematic candidate bias. These results demonstrate that nonstationary multi-output surrogates can deliver strong and robust MOBO performance when their structure and use are explicitly adapted to the demands of sequential optimization.

</details>


### [870] [Bison: Cross-Dataset Learning for Unseen-Compound Perturbation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32467)
*Yunfan Liu,Kasra Ghorbani,Yufei Huang,Zicheng Liu,Jiangbin Zheng,Jingbo Zhou,Shaorong Chen,Chang Yu,Stan Z. Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Bison模型，通过共享基因表征与双离散扩散建模，利用匹配药物对比监督实现跨数据集联合训练，提升对未见化合物的转录响应预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测未见化合物的转录响应受限于化学覆盖碎片化、实验平台与基因面板异质性，且高水平整体响应一致性可能掩盖对药物特异性差异的弱预测能力。

Method: 基于Chem-PerturBridge构建涵盖8个数据集、16,771个化合物的基准，并从所有训练集中留出测试化合物；提出Bison：共享基因表征连接原生基因面板，两个离散扩散模型分别建模上下文依赖响应与通过匹配药物对比监督学习的分子偏差，单模型跨8个数据集联合训练。

Result: 单个Bison模型在全基准上的整体响应和药物对比Pearson相关性均值均最高，优于11种按数据集独立训练的方法；相比同架构的数据集专属训练，联合训练使药物对比相关性均值提升27.4%，在全部8个数据集上均有增益，并改善整体响应预测。

Conclusion: 匹配药物对比可将互补筛选数据转化为共享分子监督，用于未见药物响应预测，同时保留原生基因测量。

Abstract: Predicting transcriptional responses to unseen compounds is limited by fragmented chemical coverage and heterogeneous experimental platforms and gene panels. To assess molecular generalization across these settings, we build on Chem-PerturBridge to benchmark eight datasets with 16,771 compounds, withholding test compounds from every training dataset. This comparison reveals that high overall response agreement can coexist with weak prediction of drug-specific differences, despite reproducible signals across repeated measurements. To exploit complementary chemical supervision while targeting these differences, we introduce Bison: a shared gene representation connects native panels, while two discrete diffusion models compose context-dependent responses with molecular deviations learned through matched drug-contrast supervision. A single Bison model jointly trained across all eight datasets achieves the highest mean overall-response and drug-contrast Pearson correlations on the full benchmark in comparison with 11 methods trained independently per dataset. Compared with dataset-specific training of the same architecture, joint training increases mean drug-contrast correlation by 27.4\%, with gains across all eight datasets and improvements in overall response prediction. These results demonstrate how matched drug contrasts turn complementary screens into shared molecular supervision for unseen-drug response prediction while preserving native gene measurements.

</details>


### [871] [SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32493)
*Huihao Jing,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Zhongwei Xie,Guijia Zhang,Yuxuan Liu,Haoyu Huang,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多教师、多领域蒸馏下的监督微调（SFT），提出软目标微调（SoFT），通过对演示 token 设定最小目标概率并最小化对基座分布的 KL 变化，平衡分布内学习与分布外泛化，在混合领域推理与智能体任务上取得最佳整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将多教师、多领域的专家知识整合进单一学生模型颇具挑战：学生在习得多样能力的同时，还需保持在训练任务之外的泛化性。实验显示不同 SFT 方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间存在不同的权衡，因此需要对该平衡进行更显式的控制。

Method: 提出软目标微调（SoFT）：为每个被演示的 token 设定最小目标概率，同时对基座分布做最小的 KL 改动，使目标函数将演示学习与对基座模型的自适应加权正则化耦合；并进一步使用领域特定的梯度预算来控制该平衡，为每条轨迹确定概率阈值。

Result: 在混合领域推理与智能体任务上的实验表明，SoFT 在所比较方法中取得最佳整体性能，在分布内能力获取与分布外泛化两方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过最小 KL 约束下的最小目标概率设定，可在蒸馏式 SFT 中显式控制能力获取与基座能力保持之间的平衡，从而同时改善分布内学习与分布外泛化。

Abstract: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit control over this balance. To this end, we propose soft-target fine-tuning (SoFT) to balance learning from teacher demonstrations with retaining the Base model's existing capabilities. SoFT sets a minimum target probability for each demonstrated token while making the smallest KL change to the Base distribution. The resulting objective couples learning from demonstrations with adaptively weighted regularization toward the Base model. We further use domain-specific gradient budgets to control this balance and determine a probability threshold for each trajectory. Experiments on mixed-domain reasoning and agentic tasks show that SoFT achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, with improvements in both in-distribution capability acquisition and out-of-distribution generalization.

</details>


### [872] [Rondo: Unsupervised Discovery of Recurring Temporal Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32500)
*Yingtian Shi,Ankith Chandra,Thomas Plötz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无监督方法 Rondo，在连续时间流中显式构建可复用单元及其组合的词汇表，以建模多层级的循环结构，并随流演化持续精炼与扩展发现；在多领域时序数据上优于现有基线，尤其在有限数据与持续流场景优势明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界时序数据常具有多尺度的结构特性（从短小的循环单元到由这些单元构成的复杂序列），无监督发现这些组件与结构有助于构建智能系统、解释时序数据并减少昂贵的人工标注。然而现有方法通常忽略时序中固有的层级结构，将不同时间尺度上的循环模式当作独立结构处理；且大多假设可访问完整序列并将发现视为静态过程，因而无法随着新观测的到来而演化。

Method: Rondo：一种用于在连续时间流中建模循环层级结构的无监督方法。通过显式构建由可复用单元及其循环组合构成的词汇表，捕捉跨复杂时序模式共享的结构，并在流演化过程中对已有发现进行精炼与扩展。

Result: 在涵盖多个领域与数据模态的时序序列上的评估表明，Rondo 优于现有的无监督循环发现基线；在有限数据与持续流（continual-stream）设置下，优势尤为显著。

Conclusion: Rondo 为循环模式发现、可扩展的行为理解以及在长时、无标注时间流上运行的智能系统奠定了更强的基础。

Abstract: Many real-world time series data exhibit structural properties at multiple scales, from short, recurring units to complex sequences composed of these units. Unsupervised discovery of both these components and structure enables the design of intelligent systems that help interpret temporal data, thereby limiting the amount of costly human annotations required. Existing modeling approaches typically overlook the hierarchical structure inherent to many time series, treating recurring patterns at different temporal scales as independent structures. Moreover, most assume access to the complete data sequence and treat discovery as a static process, limiting their ability to evolve as new observations arrive. We introduce Rondo, an unsupervised approach for modeling recurring hierarchical structure in continuous temporal streams. By explicitly constructing vocabularies of reusable units and their recurring compositions, Rondo captures structure shared across complex temporal patterns while refining and expanding its discoveries as the stream evolves. Evaluations on temporal sequences spanning diverse domains and data modalities show that Rondo outperforms existing unsupervised recurrence-discovery baselines, with particularly pronounced advantages in limited-data and continual-stream settings. These capabilities provide a stronger foundation for recurring-pattern discovery, scalable behavior understanding, and adaptive intelligent systems operating on long, unlabeled temporal streams.

</details>


### [873] [What Does a ProcGen Generalization Gap Measure? Action Rules, Convergence, and the Missing Random Floor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32532)
*Abhisek Keshari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出强化学习中的泛化差距缺少参照点，主张以"随机地板"（同关卡、同评测框架下均匀随机策略的回报）作为基准，并据此重新审视ProcGen上的标准指标，同时审计了十二个先前代码库的评测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习泛化研究普遍报告"训练关卡回报减留出关卡回报"的差距，但该数值缺乏参照基准，无法判断差距是否真实、模型是否真正学到可迁移能力；同时社区评测协议（采样还是贪心动作、是否评测固定检查点）不统一，导致结论不可比、可能被高估或误判。

Method: 提出以"测量得到的随机地板"为参照：在同一关卡集与同一评测框架下，用均匀随机策略的回报作为基线。在ProcGen八个环境、相同检查点和关卡上，对比采样动作与贪心（argmax）测试时动作；用原始策略熵衡量收敛度，并通过合并效果相同的动作来修正熵；审计十二个先前ProcGen代码库的留出评测协议（动作规则、是否默认采样、是否评测固定检查点）；并将这些检查应用于作者自身的案例研究。

Result: 在八个环境上，采样与贪心切换会使留出回报双向变化，贪心评测在三个环境中等于或低于随机地板，例如miner中采样策略达地板的4.9倍而argmax低于地板。原始策略熵显示八个环境有七个未收敛，但其中35–65%的熵分布在效果相同的动作上；合并后仅剩一至三个未收敛，且相对地板只有heist没有学到可迁移内容。审计发现十一个含留出评测的代码库中，策略梯度智能体全部采样测试时动作，其中九个是默认而非显式选择，六个报告的是循环内平均而非固定检查点评测。应用于自身案例时，同样的检查会下调一个统计显著的编码器效应，并排除一个编码器内train-vs-test CKA统计量。

Conclusion: 建议任何报告的泛化差距都应说明其动作规则（采样或贪心）、采用匹配且带种子的评测协议，并在训练与留出两个关卡集上都报告随机地板，以保证结论的可解释性与可比性。

Abstract: A generalization gap in reinforcement learning (return on training levels minus return on held-out levels) is usually reported without a reference point. We argue that the missing reference is a measured random floor: the return of a uniform-random policy on the same levels under the same harness. On ProcGen, the floor changes what several standard numbers mean. On identical checkpoints and levels across eight environments, switching between sampled and greedy (argmax) test-time actions moves held-out return in both directions, and greedy evaluation takes three environments to or below the floor: in miner, the sampled policy scores 4.9x the floor on held-out levels while its argmax scores below it. Raw policy entropy places seven of eight environments short of convergence, but 35-65% of that entropy is spread across actions with identical effects; after merging them, one to three remain short, and against the floor only heist has learned nothing that transfers. An audit of twelve prior ProcGen codebases finds that all eleven with held-out evaluation sample test-time actions for their policy-gradient agents, nine by default rather than explicit choice, and six report running in-loop averages rather than evaluating a fixed checkpoint. Applied to our own case study, the same checks grade down a statistically significant encoder effect and rule out a within-encoder train-vs-test CKA statistic. We recommend that every reported gap state its action rule, use a matched and seeded protocol, and report the random floor on both level sets.

</details>


### [874] [Not Every Term Adds New Structure: Sobolev Novelty for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32597)
*Boxiao Wang,Kai Li,Yuheng Jing,Tianyi Liu,Chen Li,Yifan Zhang,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Sobolev Novelty，一种符号回归中的项级结构独立性度量，并基于理论校准阈值用于项剪枝、搜索引导等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号回归需在巨大组合空间中搜索紧凑且具意义的方程，但现有方法多采用拟合误差等表达式级目标，只能整体评估候选方程，无法判断单个项是否带来真正的新结构、抑或与其余项高度冗余。

Method: 提出 Sobolev Novelty：对每个项，利用其在观测输入上的函数值与精确导数构造经验 Sobolev 签名，量化该项行为中无法被其余项重构的部分；并推导理论校准阈值，形成无需调参的判定准则。

Result: 以该阈值衡量，基准真值方程中 92.6% 的项具有充分结构新颖性，而 15 种 SR 方法生成表达式平均仅 38.3%，揭示科学方程与当前 SR 解之间的显著差距；作为轻量插件可支持项剪枝、搜索引导、LLM 反馈与数据选择，并带来一致性能提升。

Conclusion: Sobolev Novelty 提供了原则性、免调参的项级结构独立性度量，适用多种 SR 范式，表明科学方程与现有 SR 方案间存在可观差距，且该度量具备广泛适用性。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover compact and meaningful mathematical equations from data, but searching the vast combinatorial space of symbolic structures remains challenging. Existing methods typically guide this process using expression-level objectives, such as fitting error, which assess a candidate equation as a whole but provide little information about whether an individual term contributes genuinely new structure or is largely redundant with the rest of the expression. We introduce \textbf{Sobolev Novelty}, a term-level measure of structural independence for symbolic equations. For each term, we construct an empirical Sobolev signature from its function values and exact derivatives over the observed inputs, and quantify how much of this behavior cannot be reconstructed by the remaining terms. We further derive a theory-calibrated threshold, yielding a principled and tuning-free criterion for identifying structurally novel terms. Using this threshold, 92.6\% of terms in benchmark ground-truth equations exhibit sufficient structural novelty, compared with only 38.3\% on average for expressions produced by 15 SR methods, revealing a substantial gap between scientific equations and current SR solutions. As a lightweight plug-in, Sobolev Novelty can be incorporated into diverse SR paradigms to support term pruning, search guidance, LLM feedback, and data selection, yielding consistent performance gains and demonstrating broad applicability.

</details>


### [875] [AnchorRep: Defending LLMs Against Cross-Model Adversarial Transfer via Representation Repulsion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32602)
*Gal Wertheizer,Rom Himelstein,Tomer Peretz,Avi Mendelson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AnchorRep：用轻量 LoRA 适配器直接改变被防御模型对有害提示的内部表示几何，使其远离冻结锚模型，从而在无需对抗样本的情况下将跨模型迁移攻击成功率降至 ≤1.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对单个开放权重 LLM 优化的对抗攻击可迁移并越狱架构不同的模型，形成跨模型共享脆弱性；而现有防御并非针对此类跨模型威胁设计，且往往代价高昂（退化良性输出最高 77%，过度拒答增加最高 18%）。作者发现跨模型迁移与共享的内部表示几何对齐相关，因此将表示几何作为防御目标。

Method: AnchorRep 训练一个轻量 LoRA 适配器，在相同有害提示上把被防御模型的内部表示推离一个冻结锚模型的表示；训练仅使用少量有害提示，不使用任何对抗样本。

Result: 在 5 个模型、4 个架构家族上，对 2,000 次迁移攻击将跨模型攻击成功率降至 ≤1.1%（其中两个模型为 0%），Mistral 上降幅最大（36%→1.1%）。同时提出 Benign Garble Rate 指标，量化标准拒答类指标无法捕捉的退化良性输出。

Conclusion: 结果表明，通过塑造表示几何即可实现跨模型鲁棒性，无需针对攻击进行专门训练；同时指出现有防御在降低迁移性时的高代价，并强调需要新的指标来刻画退化良性输出。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks optimized on a single open-weight LLM can transfer to and jailbreak architecturally different models, allowing an attacker with white-box access to one model to compromise independently deployed systems. This creates a shared vulnerability across models, yet existing defenses are not designed for this cross-model threat. We find that cross-model transfer aligns with shared internal representation geometry, making it a natural defense target. AnchorRep targets this geometry directly with a lightweight LoRA adapter that pushes the defended model's internal representations of harmful prompts away from those of a frozen anchor model on the same prompts. Training uses a small set of harmful prompts and no adversarial examples. Across five models and four architectural families, AnchorRep reduces cross-model attack success rate to <=1.1% on 2,000 transferred attacks (0% on two), including the largest drop on Mistral (36% -> 1.1%). Existing defenses can reduce transfer, but only at high cost either inducing up to 77% degenerate benign output or increasing over-refusal by up to 18%. Because such degenerate benign outputs are not captured by standard refusal-based metrics, we introduce the Benign Garble Rate to quantify them. Our results suggest that cross-model robustness can be achieved by shaping representation geometry, without requiring attack-specific training

</details>


### [876] [Intuition vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32619)
*Shahar Haim,Daniel C. McNamee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 冻结的自监督视觉模型（DINOv3、MAE、随机像素投影）的表征几何无需任务微调即可支持隐性规则推理：Bongard 上用最近质心读出接近专用基线，ARC 中的"直觉向量"具备可运算的潜在几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大型自监督视觉模型的表征是否能在不做任务特定微调的情况下迁移到视觉推理任务；假设关系性表征可通过编码视觉输入间的相似性与变换，使隐性推理能以潜在向量算术的形式实现。

Method: 在抽象与自然化的 Bongard 问题、ARC-AGI-1/ARC-AGI-2 及新构建的 ARC-GEN 实例上评测 DINOv3、MAE 与随机像素投影；对冻结嵌入使用简单最近质心读出；以演示输入-输出变换的潜在差分向量（直觉向量）分析其与同任务测试向量的对齐性；用沿直觉向量平移查询的方式做精确输出检索；并在 397,000 个 ARC-GEN 实例（794 个任务）上做留一法任务识别。

Result: 两个 Bongard 基准上，冻结嵌入的最近质心读出准确率与原基准任务专用基线相差在 4 个百分点以内；ARC 中同任务直觉向量与测试向量对齐更强，无关任务向量近乎正交；沿直觉向量平移查询可稳定提升精确输出检索，在 ARC-AGI-2 评测上达 70.7；在 794 个任务的 397,000 个 ARC-GEN 实例上，单对直觉向量识别生成任务的留一法准确率约 87%。

Conclusion: 冻结视觉表征上的潜在向量算术可在多类问题域中支持隐性规则推理，无需生成模型组件；这表明"推断抽象变换"与"生成其具体实例结果"可能是两种可分离的能力。

Abstract: Large self-supervised vision models learn representations that support scene segmentation and the semantic decomposition of physical objects. We ask whether their representational geometry supports transfer to visual reasoning problems without any task-specific fine-tuning. We hypothesized that relational representations may bridge perception and abstract reasoning by encoding similarities and transformations among visual inputs such that an intuitive, implicit form of reasoning may be performed via latent vector arithmetic. Specifically, we examine DINOv3, MAE, and random pixel projections on abstract and naturalistic Bongard problems, ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2, and novel ARC-GEN instances. On both Bongard benchmarks, the accuracy of a simple nearest-centroid readout of frozen visual embeddings is within four percentage points of the task-specific baselines reported with the original benchmarks. In ARC, latent difference vectors summarizing demonstration input-output transformations, which we refer to as intuition vectors, show greater alignment with test vectors from the same task, whereas those from unrelated tasks are near orthogonal. This latent geometry is operational: transporting a query along its intuition vector consistently improves exact-output retrieval, reaching 70.7 on ARC-AGI-2 evaluation. Across 397,000 ARC-GEN instances from 794 tasks, single-pair intuition vectors identify the generating task with approximately 87\% leave-one-out accuracy. These findings suggest that latent vector arithmetic over frozen visual representations supports implicit rule inference across varied problem domains without a generative model component, indicating that inferring an abstract transformation and generating its instance-specific consequence may be separable capacities.

</details>


### [877] [STAMP: Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization without Target Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32672)
*Md Kawsher Mahbub,Milon Biswas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STAMP是一种仅用源域数据、无需目标域标签的OOD性能估计准则，通过配对源域图像计算输出空间相关比η²，在胸片和ImageNet任务上取得高秩相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测训练模型在分布偏移下的泛化能力仍很困难，尤其当目标域数据不可用时。现有方法多依赖目标域数据或标签，缺乏仅用源域即可估计OOD性能的实用工具。

Method: 提出STAMP（语义时序增强模型预测），一种source-only、target-label-free的准则，从配对源域图像估计OOD性能。核心是计算输出空间相关比η²=S_B/S_T，通过对比语义稳定对与随机对实现：η²越高，说明模型输出随语义身份而非干扰变化。另有时序STAMP及类匹配变体、温度缩放STAMP_TS。

Result: 在44个胸片模型（CNN、ViT、MetaFormer、基础模型、SSL/VLM探针）上，时序STAMP与VinDr-CXR、CheXpert、MIMIC-CXR的macro AUROC Spearman相关为0.844–0.855；类匹配变体将单类RSNA从0.311提升至0.663。取得最佳平均source-only医学排序，且无需目标数据即超过ATC和AoTL估计器。在27个ImageNet模型上，温度缩放STAMP_TS在ObjectNet上ρ=0.984，另四种分布偏移ρ≥0.905，控制ImageNet精度后偏相关为0.662–0.949。

Conclusion: STAMP仅需单GPU约12秒/模型，是实用的部署前模型选择与审计工具。

Abstract: Predicting whether a trained model will generalize under distribution shift remains difficult, especially when target-domain data are unavailable. We introduce STAMP (Semantic Temporal Augmented Model Prediction), a source-only, target-label-free criterion that estimates out-of-distribution (OOD) performance from paired source-domain images. STAMP computes the output-space correlation ratio $η^2=S_B/S_T$ by contrasting semantically stable pairs with random pairs: higher $η^2$ indicates that model outputs vary with semantic identity rather than nuisance variation. On 44 chest X-ray models spanning CNNs, ViTs, MetaFormers, foundation models, and SSL/VLM probes, temporal STAMP attains Spearman correlations of $0.844$--$0.855$ with macro AUROC on VinDr-CXR, CheXpert, and MIMIC-CXR; a class-matched variant improves single-class RSNA from $0.311$ to $0.663$. STAMP attains the best average source-only medical ranking and outperforms the target-domain ATC and AoTL estimators without any target data. On 27 ImageNet models, temperature-scaled STAMPTS attains $ρ{=}0.984$ on ObjectNet and $ρ\geq0.905$ on four additional distribution shifts, with partial correlations of $0.662$--$0.949$ after controlling for ImageNet accuracy. Requiring approximately 12s per model on one GPU, STAMP is a practical pre-deployment model-selection and auditing tool.

</details>


### [878] [The Extender: A Log-Structured Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32759)
*Jakob Eriksson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Extender——一种log-structured的Transformer变体，通过引入拼接通道x替代传统残差通道用于kv投影输入，显著降低注意力持久内存占用，同时保持或超越标准Transformer精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer中各层仅通过残差h（superposition channel）与后续层通信，kv投影依赖模型宽度，导致持久注意力内存占用随宽度增长（2Ld_model）。需要一种能在不损失精度前提下大幅压缩注意力内存的结构。

Method: 在标准Transformer基础上增加拼接通道x。每层ℓ同时输出残差更新δ_ℓ（加到h）和一个较小的扩展ε_ℓ（追加到x）。FFN和q以h为输入，而kv投影仅以x为输入。因此完全扩展的x包含所有层kv投影的完整输入，将持久注意力内存从2Ld_model降至Σ|ε_ℓ|。

Result: 当|ε_ℓ|=32时，Extender在199M–924M参数下于短上下文（CORE）任务上精度与Transformer持平；在924M参数下于长上下文（RULER）任务上超过Transformer。对1664宽、924M模型，其持久注意力内存占用比MHA小104倍，且内存节省随模型宽度增加而扩大。

Conclusion: Extender通过log-structured的拼接通道设计，在保持甚至提升精度的同时，大幅降低注意力内存开销，且优势随模型宽度增长，为高效长上下文建模提供新思路。

Abstract: We introduce the Extender, a log-structured variant of the standard Transformer architecture. In a standard Transformer, each layer communicates with subsequent layers exclusively via the residual $\mathbf{h}$, a superposition channel. The Extender adds a concatenation channel $\mathbf{x}$: each layer $\ell$ emits both a residual update $δ_\ell$ which is added to $\mathbf{h}$, and a much smaller extension $ε_\ell$ which is appended to $\mathbf{x}$. While both the FFN and $\mathbf{q}$ see $\mathbf{h}$, the attention $\mathbf{kv}$ projections take only $\mathbf{x}$ as input. As a result, the fully extended $\mathbf{x}$ contains the complete input for the $\mathbf{kv}$ projections of all layers, reducing the persistent attention memory footprint from $2Ld_{model}$ to $\sum|ε_\ell|$. We find that with $|ε_\ell|=32$, the Extender matches Transformer accuracy on short-context (CORE) tasks at 199M-924M parameters, and exceeds Transformer accuracy on long-context (RULER) workloads, again at 924M parameters. For our 1664-wide, 924M model, the Extender's persistent attention memory footprint is $104\times$ smaller than MHA. The memory savings grow with model width.

</details>


### [879] [Continual Learning via Self-Probe Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32771)
*Dongkyu Cho,Rumi Chunara,Sungmin Cha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CPLUS：语言模型通过自探测（self-probing）生成新输入并记录自身预测，利用自探测与过往样本梯度来缩小与先前行为冲突的参数更新，从而在少样本场景下缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将预训练模型适配新数据会导致对已学行为的灾难性遗忘；当过往样本仅剩少量时，持续学习方法获得的关于"应保留什么"的证据稀疏且狭窄。

Method: 利用冻结模型对保留样本进行自探测，生成新输入并记录自身预测。与以往将此类数据作为回放训练样本不同，CPLUS将这些自探测信号与过往样本梯度作为依据，缩放与之冲突的参数更新。

Result: 在4个基准、5个语言模型上验证三点：1）相同探测作为梯度信号比作为回放数据能保留更多先前行为；2）CPLUS在学新数据的同时比现有基线更稳定地减少遗忘，尤其当过往数据稀缺时，且该保护可迁移到未用于训练的基准；3）模型越大CPLUS越有效，在Qwen3系列中可恢复因标准微调导致的遗忘的更大比例。

Conclusion: 证据可由模型自探测扩展，且自探测以梯度形式使用优于回放；CPLUS在少样本持续学习中显著减轻遗忘，并随模型规模增大而更具效果。

Abstract: Adapting pretrained models to new data can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behavior. When only a few past samples remain, they give continual learning methods sparse and narrow evidence about what to preserve. We show that language models can expand this evidence through self-probing, in which the frozen model generates new inputs from the retained samples and records its own predictions on them. Unlike prior work that replays such data as training examples, our method, CPLUS uses self-probe and past-sample gradients to scale down parameter updates that conflict with prior behavior. Experiments with five language models on four benchmarks show three results. First, the same probes preserve more prior behavior as gradient signals than as replay data. Second, CPLUS learns the new data while consistently reducing forgetting more than existing baselines, especially when past data are scarce, and this protection extends to benchmarks not used for training. Third, we observe that CPLUS also becomes more effective as models grow: within the Qwen3 model family, it recovers an increasing share of the forgetting caused by standard fine-tuning.

</details>


### [880] [Transfer Learning for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32849)
*Tyler Bonnet,Marek Rei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对动态文本属性图（DyTAGs）提出leave-one-domain-out（LODO）迁移学习协议，发现现有自监督动态图方法迁移到未见域时表现不佳，甚至不如无序事件的Bag of Events（BoE）基线；进而提出Spatio-Temporal Semantic Alignment（STSA），融合时空编码与对比语义预测目标，取得更优的边分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习可迁移的动态文本属性图表示需要捕捉跨域持续存在的交互动态。现有方法易过拟合于特定域的结构、时间与语义模式，导致分布偏移下边分类性能受限；且此前缺乏系统刻画该问题的迁移评估协议。

Method: 1）形式化建立LODO迁移学习协议用于DyTAGs边分类；2）提出仅使用无序节点与边文本特征序列的BoE基线；3）提出STSA，包含时空编码器，将时间差与节点出现频率的表示融合到统一流形；4）采用Contrastive Semantic Forecasting目标训练，将边表示锚定到由预训练语言模型初始化的多域文本潜空间，提供稳健先验。

Result: 在LODO协议下，先进的自监督动态图学习方法迁移到未见域时表现较差；这些方法甚至不如结构、时间无关的BoE模型；STSA优于BoE及所评估的全部现有方法。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了DyTAGs跨域迁移中的过拟合问题并给出评估协议，表明融合时空信息与文本语义先验的STSA能有效提升分布偏移下的边分类迁移性能。

Abstract: Learning transferable representations for dynamic text-attributed graphs (DyTAGs) requires models to capture underlying interaction dynamics that persist across domains. However, existing methods tend to overfit to domain-specific structural, temporal, and semantic patterns, limiting edge classification performance under distribution shifts. To expose and address this, we formally establish a leave-one-domain-out (LODO) transfer learning protocol for edge classification on DyTAGs. Under this protocol, we demonstrate that state-of-the-art self-supervised methods for dynamic graph learning perform poorly when transferred to unseen domains. Strikingly, existing methods underperform a structurally and temporally unaware Bag of Events (BoE) model we introduce, which inputs only unordered sequences of node and edge text features. Proceeding from the BoE, we propose Spatio-Temporal Semantic Alignment (STSA), which integrates a spatio-temporal encoder that fuses representations of time deltas and node occurrence frequencies into a unified manifold. STSA is trained with a Contrastive Semantic Forecasting objective, which anchors edge representations to a multi-domain textual latent space initialized by a pretrained language model, providing a robust prior that outperforms BoE and all existing methods we evaluate.

</details>


### [881] [Logic Gate Networks and Lookup Table Networks as Lightweight Hardware Classifiers for Inter-patient ECG Arrhythmia Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32854)
*Wout Mommen,Lars Keuninckx,Siddharth Patil,Paul Detterer,Achiel Colpaert,Piet Wambacq*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将可微逻辑门网络(LGN)推广到多输入逻辑门，形成N输入查找表网络(LUTN)，用于MIT-BIH心电图心律失常分类，在四分类任务上达到94.41%准确率，且推理算力仅需2.89k–6.17k FLOPs，并已在Zynq-7000 FPGA上实现低功耗硬件分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CNN、SVM、SNN等方法在心电心律失常分类中精度较高，但算力与功耗开销大，难以满足可穿戴/植入式设备的超低功耗推理需求。逻辑门网络与查找表网络因使用简单二值逻辑运算而非算术运算，具备极低功耗推理潜力，但其可行性尚未在跨患者心电图任务中得到验证。

Method: 将LGN的逻辑门从两输入推广到多于两个输入引脚，从而得到由N输入LUT构成的网络；为可微地训练N-LUT表项，采用2^N:1多路复用器(MUX)的布尔方程，在训练中优化其输入参数。以MIT-BIH数据集开展跨患者四分类心电心律失常实验，并将预处理流水线与6-LUTN分类器部署于Xilinx Zynq-7000 ZedBoard进行硬件验证。

Result: 在MIT-BIH四分类任务上最高达94.41%准确率、jκ指数0.683，性能与现有CNN、SVM、SNN方法相当；含预处理与读出在内仅需约2.89k–6.17k FLOPs，比SOTA方法低三到六个数量级。硬件实现中，完整系统每次推理动态能耗8.25 μJ，其中LUTN分类器仅消耗0.46 nJ。

Conclusion: LGN与LUTN可作为轻量级硬件分类器用于跨患者心电心律失常分类，在保持竞争性精度的同时显著降低算力与能耗，适合超低功耗边缘/可穿戴应用。

Abstract: Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (LGNs) and Lookup Table Networks (LUTNs) offer a promising approach for very low power inference due to their use of simple binary logic operations instead of arithmetic. In this work, we generalize the logic gates of LGNs to more than two input pins, naturally arriving at networks consisting of $N$-input LUTs. To obtain a differentiable expression for training the $N$-LUT entries, we adopt the Boolean equation of a $2^N$:1 multiplexer (MUX) and optimize its input parameters during training. We investigate the applicability of LGNs and LUTNs to inter-patient ECG arrhythmia classification using the MIT-BIH data set. The proposed models achieve up to 94.41\% accuracy and a $jκ$ index of 0.683 on a four-class task, showing a competitive performance compared to existing CNN-, SVM- and SNN-based methods. Our LGNs and LUTNs only require an estimated 2.89k to 6.17k FLOPs, including preprocessing and readout, which is three to six orders of magnitude less than state-of-the-art methods. We verified our design, which consists of the preprocessing pipeline and a 6-LUTN classifier, by implementing it on a Xilinx Zynq-7000 ZedBoard. The complete system consumes a dynamic energy of 8.25 $μ$J/inference, of which only 0.46 nJ is utilized by the LUTN classifier. These results show that both LGNs and LUTNs can be employed as lightweight hardware-based classifiers for inter-patient ECG arrhythmia classification.

</details>


### [882] [Refreshing Less, Selecting Better: Reusing Stale Gradient Features for Efficient Influence-Based Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32888)
*Jianchang Su,Yifan Zhang,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CDIS通过"陈旧分数初筛+局部重算校正"的分层预算回退策略，在保留全量重算选择效果的同时把梯度重算成本降低约3.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度类数据选择方法（如LESS）需在每个新检查点重新计算每样本梯度特征，成本主导整体开销；文中量化了旧检查点缓存特征的衰减程度，发现直接复用会带来明显误差，故需一种可控、有理论保证的缓存复用方案。

Method: CDIS：先在陈旧分数下对排名前比例p的候选重算梯度特征，在重算样本上拟合仿射校准以修正陈旧分数，再在数据来源与长度配额下做多样化选择；并支持将缓存跨4个检查点迭代复用，用陈旧与重算分数的致性作为安全性自检。

Result: 预热后检查点缓存特征在40个优化步后仍保持Spearman 0.952–0.991的排序，但其Top-10%子集漏掉10–22%全量重算所选样本。p=0.3时恢复的Top-k与全量重算在所有设定下完全一致；等预算分层恢复率0.92–1.00，梯度阶段墙钟时间下降3.5–3.6倍。4检查点迭代缓存下Top-k重叠≥0.98，每样本梯度特征数1.9（全量重算为4）。下游：无约束Top-k塌缩到单一数据源，GSM8K比随机低13分；CDIS比随机高12分（配对置信区间不含零），落后全量重算4.3分（约一个训练run标准差），选择成本低3.4倍。

Conclusion: 陈旧梯度缓存配合少量重算与仿射校准，可在理论上保证恢复精确Top-k子集，并在实践中以约3.4–3.6倍更低的选择成本逼近全量重算效果，同时避免无约束选择导致的数据源塌缩。

Abstract: Gradient-based data selection methods such as LESS score each candidate by the alignment between its gradient and a target validation gradient, and recomputing per-example gradient features at every new checkpoint dominates their cost. Across three selection seeds, two model families, two candidate pools, and two target tasks, features cached at a post-warmup checkpoint and paired with fresh validation gradients preserve the ranking 40 optimizer steps later with Spearman correlation from 0.952 to 0.991, while the top-10% subset they induce misses 10 to 22% of the examples that full recomputation selects. We therefore propose Cached Diverse Influence Selection (CDIS), which recomputes gradient features for the top-ranked fraction $p$ of candidates under the stale scores, fits an affine calibration on the recomputed examples, and selects the final subset under source and length quotas. A refresh fraction at or above the selection fraction recovers the exact top-$k$ subset whenever the calibrated stale scores have bounded error, and the budget curves follow this rule: at $p=0.3$ the recovered top-$k$ subset coincides with full recomputation in every setting, allocating the same budget per stratum recovers the stratified subset at 0.92 to 1.00, and gradient-stage wall-clock drops 3.5 to 3.6 times. Iterating the cache over four checkpoints keeps top-$k$ overlap at 0.98 or higher at 1.9 gradient features per example against 4 for full recomputation, and stale-to-recomputed agreement on the refreshed examples provides a free check for unsafe reuse. Downstream, unconstrained top-$k$ selection collapses to a single data source and scores 13 points below random selection on GSM8K. CDIS scores 12 points above random selection with paired confidence intervals that exclude zero and trails full recomputation by 4.3 points, one training-run standard deviation, at 3.4 times lower selection cost.

</details>


### [883] [When Less Compute Is More: Adaptive Early Exit Improves Pretrained Outlier Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32898)
*Tianyang Zhou,Leman Akoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文首次研究面向预训练表格离群点检测模型的深度自适应早退机制。作者发现早退不仅提升效率，还能通过缓解“上下文污染”提升检测性能，并提出可插拔路由器选择数据集特定的退出层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练表格基础模型以固定深度处理所有数据集，推理成本随数据规模增长；且早退通常仅被视为效率手段。作者希望探究早退是否能同时带来检测性能收益，并理解其背后机制。

Method: 系统研究三种预训练基础模型上的深度自适应早退；分析驱动收益的因素并识别“上下文污染”机制（上下文样本中存在离群点）；通过考察近邻上下文样本对查询预测的影响验证检索式视角；预训练一个可插拔路由器，利用仅在训练阶段可用的查询离群标签作为特权信息，事后选择数据集特定的退出层，保持基座模型参数与预测头不变。

Result: 在多个真实基准上，最优中间层退出使检测性能平均提升4.7-7.3%，三种基础模型一致；当上下文污染率与自然离群率匹配时，收益达13-21%；在三个大型真实基准上，干净上下文时路由器可恢复最高45%的oracle收益，实现最高1.8倍加速，且污染增加时收益更大。

Conclusion: 早退在离群点检测中兼具效率与性能双重价值，其机理在于缓解检索到准确但被污染的近邻所带来的负面影响；所提出的即插即用路由器可在不改变基座模型的前提下自适应选择退出层，兼顾加速与检测提升。

Abstract: Pretrained tabular foundation models process every dataset at a fixed depth, with inference costs growing with dataset size. To address this, we present the first study of depth-adaptive early-exit for pretrained outlier detection models. While early-exit is typically motivated by efficiency, we uncover a surprising benefit: exiting at the optimal intermediate layer can also improve detection performance on diverse real-world benchmarks by 4.7-7.3% on average, consistent across three distinct foundation models. First, we investigate the factors driving these gains, and identify a key mechanism: context pollution, i.e., the presence of outliers among in-context samples. Our analysis reveals that nearby in-context samples exert increasing influence on query predictions at greater depths, consistent with a retrieval-based view of these models. In effect, early-exit alleviates the adverse effects of retrieving accurate-yet-polluted neighbors, with gains of 13-21% when context pollution matches the natural outlier rate. Motivated by these findings, we pretrain a plug-in router to select a dataset-specific exit layer, using query outlier labels as privileged information available only during router training. The router operates post hoc, leaving the base model parameters and prediction head unchanged. Experiments on three large real-world benchmarks show that, on clean context, the router recovers up to 45% of the oracle gain with up to 1.8x speedup across three pretrained backbones, with larger gains as context pollution increases.

</details>


### [884] [Allspark: Weak to Strong Transfer via Alternating Chain of Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32913)
*Kaizhao Liang,Junxiong Wang,Chen Liang,Zhendong Wang,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Allspark框架，通过弱教师与冻结同源模型的交替思维链训练，实现无需强模型rollout的弱到强推理能力迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型进展重启了对大规模强化学习的兴趣，但大模型 rollout 生成成本高昂，使 RL 配方测试代价极大。作者希望探究：小弱模型学到的推理改进能否在不使用强模型 rollout 训练的前提下迁移给更大更强的模型。

Method: Allspark 为面向弱到强迁移的训练与推理框架，基于交替思维链。训练时弱教师与同一模型的冻结副本交替进行推理片段，由冻结模型给出最终答案。推理时以更强学生替换冻结训练伙伴，两模型均保持固定。因双方通过文本通信，教师可指导不同模型家族、不同分词器的学生。实验分两个规模：数学与推理的受控 Qwen 实验，以及 ARC-AGI-2 上的大规模 Inkling 实验。

Result: Inkling 实验显示在同家族与跨家族设置下均取得准确率提升，包括向 Kimi 与 Nemotron 的迁移，且收益随推理设置而变化。

Conclusion: 结果支持复用已训练的弱教师于多个强学生，并促使进一步研究由此产生的准确率-令牌（accuracy–token）权衡。

Abstract: Recent progress in frontier models has renewed interest in large-scale reinforcement learning (RL), but the cost of generating large-model rollouts makes even testing RL recipes expensive. We ask whether reasoning improvements learned by a small, weak model can benefit a larger, stronger model without using the strong model's rollouts during training. We introduce Allspark, a training and inference framework for weak-to-strong transfer through alternating chains of thought. A weak teacher is trained alongside a frozen copy of the same model; the two alternate reasoning segments, and the frozen model produces the final answer. At inference time, a stronger student replaces the frozen training partner, while both models remain fixed. Because they communicate through text, the teacher can steer students from different model families and with different tokenizers. We study Allspark at two scales: controlled Qwen experiments across math and reasoning, and larger-scale Inkling experiments on ARC-AGI-2. The Inkling experiments show accuracy gains in within-family and cross-family settings, including transfer to Kimi and Nemotron, with benefits that vary across inference settings. These findings motivate reusing a trained weak teacher across strong students and examining the resulting accuracy--token tradeoff.

</details>


### [885] [The Geometry of Logic: Stratification Induces Semantic Structure and Robust Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32927)
*Cristina V. Lopes,Yuangang Li,Justin Tian Jin Chen,Alberto Krone-Martins,Iris Ma,Md Rakib Hossain Misu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 STRAT 架构，将残差流划分为正交的 Data 与 Type 子空间，并用 Type 驱动注意力与门控，从而提升逻辑机制的可学习性与泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 在符号任务上表现优异，但难以判断其学到的是可泛化规则还是统计捷径。机制可解释性研究表明，稳健推理或需将"值"与"控制其操作的类型"分离，因此本文探究：将这种分离作为架构原语能否提升逻辑机制的可学习性与泛化性。

Method: STRAT（Stratified Registers And Types）：将残差流划分为正交的 Data 与 Type 子空间，并通过基于 Type 的注意力与门控来调控 Data 变换。同时通过受控算术消融实验，识别出三种与 data-control 干扰相关的失败模式：Linear Trap、Gradient Wall 与 Open Gate Trap。

Result: 机制分析显示模型具有可解释的逻辑结构；在算术任务上，STRAT 将中位 OOD 误差相比 Transformer 基线降低 35 倍。在覆盖 10 类任务的 11 个数据集上，两模型均仅用每数据集 10 个基础样本（并施加相同的任务特定增强），STRAT 的平均准确率超出基线 26 个百分点。分布偏移下，STRAT 平均准确率仅下降 2.39 个百分点，而 Transformer 下降 11.75 个百分点。

Conclusion: 将值-类型分离作为架构原语可显著改善逻辑机制的学习与泛化：STRAT 在 OOD 误差、平均准确率与分布偏移鲁棒性上均大幅优于 Transformer 基线，并呈现可解释的内部逻辑结构。

Abstract: Transformer-based language models perform well on symbolic tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they learn generalizable rules or rely on statistical shortcuts. Mechanistic studies link algorithmic behavior to structured internal representations, motivating the hypothesis that robust reasoning benefits from separating values from the types that control their manipulation. Can making this separation an architectural primitive improve the learnability and generalization of logical mechanisms? We introduce \textbf{STRAT} (\textbf{ST}ratified \textbf{R}egisters \textbf{A}nd \textbf{T}ypes), which partitions the residual stream into orthogonal Data and Type subspaces and uses Type-based attention and gating to govern Data transformations. Controlled arithmetic ablations identify three failure modes associated with data-control interference: the Linear Trap, Gradient Wall, and Open Gate Trap. Mechanistic analysis reveals interpretable logical structure, and in arithmetic, STRAT reduces median OOD error 35-fold relative to a Transformer baseline. On each of 11 datasets spanning 10 tasks, STRAT outperforms the Transformer baseline in mean accuracy, by 26 percentage points on average, with both models trained from 10 base examples per dataset using identical task-specific augmentation where applicable. Under distribution shift, STRAT's mean accuracy drops by only 2.39 percentage points, compared with 11.75 for the Transformer.

</details>


### [886] [TwinS-GCN: Spectral conjugate for Spectral Graph Convolutional Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32940)
*Chun Hei Michael Chan,Flavia Petruso,Dimitri Van De Ville*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于谱共轭分解的 TwinS-GCN，用非全纯滤波核在保持位移不变性的同时区分信号流动方向，缓解过平滑并实现长程信息传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图卷积网络通过图位移算子的重复局部聚合传播信息，K 层仅覆盖 K 跳邻域。加深层数虽能捕获长程依赖，却会带来过平滑；而对称位移算子无法区分流动方向，导致远距离传输必然衰减。因此需要一种既能长程传输又保持方向性的位移机制。

Method: 作者指出对位移算子做笛卡尔分解取反对称部分虽能提取纯方向性，但一般与位移算子不可交换，破坏滤波器的位移不变性。改用谱共轭 τ:z↦z̄，即算子在其下的像，该像与位移交换并把算子拆分为耗散与非耗散两部分。由此构造两类滤波器：和滤波器（非耗散分量无能量损失地传输信号）与比滤波器（分量比值而非位移的多项式），二者均源于非全纯核，超出经典谱卷积所在的全纯类。随后通过 Chebyshev 重参数化得到实数系数的稳定顶点域层，即 TwinS-GCN。

Result: 在有向环上，比滤波器成为具有全局冲激响应的 IIR 滤波器，作者证明其相对任意 K 次多项式滤波器存在长程可达性差距。Chebyshev 重参数化带来稳定的顶点域层与实系数。TwinS-GCN 以更浅的深度解决图迁移任务，并在节点分类基准上与最先进图卷积网络相当。

Conclusion: 通过谱共轭分解引入非耗散分量，可在保持位移不变性的前提下实现无衰减的方向性长程传输，为图卷积在深度与过平滑之间的权衡提供了新的滤波范式。

Abstract: Graph convolutional networks propagate information by repeated local aggregation through a graph shift operator; i.e., a $K$-layer network reaches $K$ hops neighborhood. On the one hand, such spreading can lead to oversmoothing. On the other hand, long-range dependencies demand the depth. Transporting information on long distances and without attenuation requires the shift to distinguish a direction of flow, which a symmetric operator cannot perform but a directed one can fulfill. A natural way to extract pure-directionality is to take the skew-symmetric part of the shift operator through the Cartesian split, which, however, generally does not commute with the shift itself, meaning that the filters built on it are not shift-invariant. We instead use the spectral conjugate; i.e., the image of the operator under $τ:z\mapsto \bar{z}$, which commutes with the shift and splits it into a dissipative and a non-dissipative part. Two filter families follow: a sum filter, whose non-dissipative component transports signal without energy loss, and a ratio filter, ratio in the pair of components rather than polynomial in the shift. Both arise from non-holomorphic kernels, placing them outside the holomorphic class underlying classical spectral convolution. On the directed cycle, the ratio filter becomes an IIR filter with global impulse response, for which we prove a long-range reach gap against every degree-$K$ polynomial filter. Chebyshev reparameterization gives stable vertex-domain layers with real coefficients, yielding TwinS-GCN, which solves graph transfer tasks at reduced depth and is competitive with state-of-the-art graph convolutional networks on node classification benchmarks.

</details>


### [887] [Beyond Token Savings: A Systematic Study of Context Compression in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32961)
*Ritul Satish,Prasoon Sinha,Akiho Kawada,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地解耦并评估了LLM智能体中的上下文压缩决策，发现在近35,000次运行中，更少的token并不必然意味着更快或更便宜的执行，且压缩策略的效果高度依赖于任务、模型和工作负载。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体处理更长的任务，其推理、动作和工具输出的历史不断增长，需要进行压缩。但现有智能体框架将"压缩什么、何时压缩、压缩多少"打包成固定策略，缺乏系统性的刻画来区分这些决策各自对任务成功率和执行成本的影响。

Method: 在SWE-bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 1.0两个基准上，使用三个开放权重模型，系统性地变换压缩决策变量，进行了近35,000次智能体运行，并测量任务成功率、token使用量、端到端延迟和估算成本。

Result: 更少的token不一定带来更快或更便宜的执行：在Terminal-Bench上使用Qwen时，token用量约为三分之一的无压缩策略反而可能比不压缩的智能体慢20-80%。总体成功率相近的策略可能解决不同的任务，而同一策略在不同模型上的表现也可能差异很大。

Conclusion: 应通过压缩对智能体执行的实际影响来评估压缩方法，并针对具体任务、模型和工作负载定制压缩策略。

Abstract: As LLM agents tackle longer tasks, they increasingly compress growing histories of reasoning, actions, and tool outputs. Compression can reduce token use, but it also changes the information available for later decisions. Existing agentic harnesses bundle decisions about what to compress, when to compress, and how much to remove into fixed policies. A systematic characterization is needed to disentangle these decisions and reveal how each affects task success and execution cost. We systematically vary these decisions across three open-weight models on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 1.0. Across nearly 35,000 agent runs, we measure task success, token use, end-to-end latency, and estimated cost. We find that fewer tokens need not mean faster or cheaper execution: on Terminal-Bench with Qwen, policies using roughly one-third as many tokens can take 20-80% longer than the uncompressed agent. Policies with similar overall success can solve different tasks, while the same policy can perform quite differently across models. Our results motivate evaluating compression by its effects on agent execution and tailoring policies to the task, model, and workload.

</details>


### [888] [Relative Generalization Invariance of LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33016)
*Fengzhuo Zhang,Shuche Wang,Shenggui Li,Tianyu Ruan,Jianliang He,Ivor Tsang,Tianyu Pang,Chao Du,Tianwei Zhang,Zhuoran Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"相对泛化不变性"（RGI）现象：验证损失在任意两个token之间的差值，在不同优化器和适度架构变化下近似保持不变，而改变训练数据流会显著改变相对泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM预训练性能由优化器、模型架构与训练数据流三者共同决定，但三者各自以何种方式影响性能尚不清楚，尤其是缺乏将它们各自效应分离开来的分析工具。

Method: 提出RGI（Relative Generalization Invariance）度量，即token间验证损失差在不同模型下的不变性；在多种优化器与适度架构变体上进行实验对比，并检验神经正切核（NTK）与平均场（mean-field）机制能否解释该现象，同时在过参数化二次模型上给出理论证明。

Result: RGI在广泛的优化器与适度架构变化下近似成立，说明这些选择对token级损失造成近似一致的平移；相反，改变训练数据流会显著改变相对泛化。RGI无法仅由NTK或平均场机制解释，但可在过参数化二次模型中涌现。

Conclusion: RGI是LLM预训练中的一种新现象，可作为区分优化器/架构效应与训练数据效应的分析工具。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining performance is jointly shaped by three components of the training triplet: the optimizer, model architecture, and training data stream. However, how these components influence performance in distinct ways remains unclear. We take a first step toward isolating their effects by studying relative generalization. We introduce Relative Generalization Invariance (RGI), the invariance of the validation-loss difference between any two tokens across models. We show that RGI approximately holds across a wide range of optimizers and moderate architectural variations, suggesting that these choices induce an approximately uniform shift in token-wise losses. In contrast, changing the training data stream can substantially alter relative generalization. We further show that RGI cannot be explained by the neural tangent kernel or mean-field regimes alone and prove that it can emerge in an overparameterized quadratic model. Overall, our work identifies RGI as a new phenomenon in LLM pretraining that helps distinguish the effects of optimizers and architectures from those of training data.

</details>


### [889] [Łukasiewicz Neural Networks Extended: Residual Architectures and Crystallization Strategies for Interpretable Rule Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33028)
*Carlos Leandro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过引入残差连接使Łukasiewicz神经网络可扩展至任意深度，并分析三种结晶（整数权重）训练策略，以保障符号知识提取与逻辑公式生成的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Łukasiewicz多值逻辑与整数权重、截断恒等激活的前馈网络存在精确对应，可实现符号知识提取（训练输出逻辑公式而非黑箱）。但原方法存在两大障碍：结晶（强制权重为整数）在原Levenberg–Marquardt方案下仅概率性成功；且随网络加深，理论保证失效，限制了其仅适用于浅层结构与小数据集。

Method: 1) 证明残差连接（ResNet式跳连）可将Łukasiewicz网络扩展至任意深度，并通过构造保证合并神经元上的符号对应：Łukasiewicz残差块中的合并神经元自动满足神经元分类命题，与内层权重无关；内层神经元则通过结晶策略训练至可表示状态。2) 分析三种结晶策略：修正的Levenberg–Marquardt、直通估计（STE）与近端正则化，刻画其理论保证、失效模式与可解释性权衡。

Result: 残差连接在构造上保证了合并神经元的符号对应，不依赖内层权重，从而突破深度限制；同时对三种结晶策略给出了理论保证、失败模式及可解释性方面的对比分析。

Conclusion: 残差连接为深层Łukasiewicz神经网络提供了保持符号对应的可扩展架构，结合对不同结晶策略的系统分析，为深层符号知识提取与逻辑公式学习奠定了理论与实践基础。

Abstract: A feed-forward neural network whose weights are integers and whose activation is the truncated identity implements, neuron by neuron, the connectives of Łukasiewicz many-valued logic. This exact correspondence --- established theoretically by Castro and Trillas and developed into a training algorithm by Leandro --- enables \emph{symbolic knowledge extraction}: training produces not a black-box model but a logical formula. Two obstacles have limited the approach to shallow architectures and small datasets: crystallization (forcing weights to integers) succeeds only probabilistically under the original Levenberg--Marquardt training scheme, and the theoretical guarantees break down as networks grow deeper.
  This paper addresses both obstacles. First, we prove that \emph{residual connections} (skip connections of the kind used in ResNets) extend Łukasiewicz neural networks to arbitrary depth while preserving the symbolic correspondence \emph{at merge neurons} by construction: merge neurons in a Łukasiewicz residual block automatically satisfy the neuron-classification proposition, regardless of the inner layer weights; inner-layer neurons are trained toward representability by the crystallization strategy. Second, we analyse three crystallization strategies --- Levenberg--Marquardt (corrected), straight-through estimation (STE), and proximal regularization --- characterizing their theoretical guarantees, failure modes, and interpretability trade-offs.

</details>


### [890] [Zero-Storage Procedural Neural Synthesis via Boundary Dynamics: Formal Verification in Lean 4 and Bare-Metal Gauntlet Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33066)
*Volkan Dağlı,Zerrin Dağlı,Dağhan Dağlı*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对 WERR(Waves & Errors) 与 Phase III 轨道误差动力学(OED)这一非张量决策范式进行形式化验证与裸机实证：用 24 字节坐标种子沿 Mandelbrot 集边界按需程序化合成非线性决策边界，在 Lean 4 中机器验证 10 条定理且无 sorry，并在 40 核服务器上实现 15,397 决策/秒、0 字节 VRAM、15.15 倍加速的推理表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代神经推理依赖存储于高带宽显存(VRAM)的稠密浮点权重矩阵，导致严重的内存墙瓶颈，且无法在 EVM 等确定性虚拟机中原生执行。同时，连续域递归动力系统的终止性与算术不变量验证在 Blum-Shub-Smale 模型下一般不可判定，因此需要一种可形式化验证、内存开销极低且可移植到确定性执行环境的新决策范式。

Method: 将递归 z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c 分别投影到模剩余环 Z/9Z 与定点域 Q_{16.16}；以 24 字节种子 Θ=(c_x,c_y,zoom) 沿 Mandelbrot 集边界 ∂M 按需程序化合成非线性决策边界；在 Lean 4 (v4.34.1) + Mathlib4 中形式化证明各类不变量与终止性；采用向量化 36 迭代 CPU 内核实现推理，并引入 S 型离群门(outlier gate)抑制对抗性尖峰。

Result: 在 Lean 4 中机器验证 10 条定理、零未证猜想(sorry)：包括 I_3={0,3,6}⊂Z/9Z 的理想封闭性、通用燃料受限停机(≤9 与 ≤12 步)、Q_{16.16} 在 2^63-1 以下无平方溢出、边界逃逸灵敏度非常数、参数化 EVM gas 上界(≤22,557 ≤ 24,000 gas)。在 40 核双 Intel Xeon 服务器上，向量化 36 迭代 CPU 内核 6.49 s 完成 100,000 次决策(15,397 决策/秒、0 字节 VRAM、15.15 倍加速)；S 型离群门抑制 100.00% 对抗性尖峰，同时保留 89.60% 干净基线信号。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了非张量、种子驱动的程序化决策范式具备可机器验证的正确性、燃料受限的确定停机性、无溢出的定点算术安全性，以及满足 EVM 约束的 gas 可行性；结合零 VRAM 占用与显著加速，为在确定性虚拟机上原生执行递归动力学推理提供了形式化与实证双重支撑，并通过离群门在鲁棒性与信号保真之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Contemporary neural inference architectures rely on dense floating-point weight matrices stored in high-bandwidth memory (VRAM), incurring severe memory-wall bottlenecks and preventing native execution inside deterministic virtual machines like the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Verifying termination and arithmetic invariants for recursive dynamical systems over continuous domains is generally undecidable in the Blum-Shub-Smale model. Here, we present the formal verification and bare-metal empirical validation of WERR (Waves & Errors) and Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), a non-tensor decision paradigm that procedurally synthesizes non-linear decision boundaries on demand from a 24-byte coordinate seed $Θ= (c_x, c_y, \text{zoom})$ along the boundary of the Mandelbrot set ($\partial\mathcal{M}$). By projecting the recurrence $z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c$ onto the modular residue ring $\mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ and the fixed-point domain $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$, we establish ten machine-verified theorems in Lean 4 (v4.34.1) with Mathlib4 and zero unproven conjectures (sorry): proving $\mathcal{I}_3 = \{0,3,6\} \subset \mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ ideal closure, universal fuel-bounded halting ($\le 9$ and $\le 12$ steps), absence of $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$ square overflow below $2^{63}-1$, non-constant boundary escape sensitivity, and a parametric EVM gas bound ($\le 22,557 \le 24,000$ gas). Evaluated on a 40-core Dual Intel Xeon server, the vectorized 36-iteration CPU kernel processes 100,000 decisions in 6.49 s (15,397 decisions/s, 0 Bytes VRAM, 15.15x speedup), while a sigmoidal outlier gate suppresses 100.00% of adversarial spikes while preserving 89.60% of clean baseline signals.

</details>


### [891] [How Linear Attention Remembers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33093)
*Kichang Lee,JaeYeon Park,Songkuk Kim,JeongGil Ko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将线性注意力的固定大小循环状态作为记忆系统进行研究，揭示其记忆的写入、保持与读取机制及容量限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力用固定大小的循环状态替代标准注意力不断增长的KV缓存，显著降低内存增长，但代价是众多token必须共享并反复更新同一记忆。作者希望理解这种循环状态作为记忆系统时，信息如何被写入、保持和访问，以及它与可寻址KV记忆的本质差异。

Method: 采用解析分解方法，并在预训练的GLA与GDN模型中进行受控因果干预，追踪被召回信息的写入、保持与访问路径；同时通过后续写入的因果干预考察干扰来源，并对比结合循环层与全注意力的混合架构。

Result: 事实特定信息通过集中的、依赖内容的写入进入循环记忆，并经集中的查询时读取路径被访问；多个事实可在同一状态中选择性可访问，但其内部表示存在跨事实因果耦合，而非独立的KV式存储。随着记忆负载增加，召回与定向可编辑性均下降，而在测试范围内单纯上下文长度的影响小得多。干扰受后续写入与已有记忆重叠程度的影响。在混合架构中，直接支持召回运行时记忆主要转移到全注意力的KV状态。

Conclusion: 固定大小循环记忆在共享存储条件下仍能支持选择性召回，但存在干扰与容量限制，这使其区别于token可寻址的KV记忆。

Abstract: Linear attention replaces the growing key--value (KV) cache of standard attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, substantially reducing memory growth with context length. This efficiency, however, changes how past information is stored: many tokens must share and repeatedly update the same memory. We study how this recurrent state functions as a memory system. Using an analytical decomposition together with controlled causal interventions in pretrained GLA and GDN models, we trace how recalled information is written, retained, and later accessed. We find that fact-specific information enters recurrent memory through concentrated, content-dependent writes and is later accessed through concentrated query-time read pathways. Multiple facts can remain selectively accessible within the same state, yet their internal representations exhibit cross-fact causal coupling rather than independent KV-like storage. As memory load increases, both recall and targeted editability degrade, whereas elapsed context alone has a substantially smaller effect within the tested regime. Causal interventions on subsequent writes further show that interference is shaped by their overlap with existing memory. Finally, in hybrid architectures that combine recurrent layers with full attention, the runtime memory directly supporting recall shifts predominantly to the full-attention KV state. Together, these results reveal how fixed-size recurrent memory supports selective recall despite shared storage, while exposing the interference and capacity limits that distinguish it from token-addressable KV memory.

</details>


### [892] [D-JEPA: Design-Recoverable JEPA Representation with Swappable Physics Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33110)
*Nitin Nagesh Kulkarni,Aashwin Anand Mishra,Yin Yu,Peter Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 D-JEPA，以几何为中心学习可复用、可恢复设计变量的紧凑表征，缓解案例级坍缩，实现跨工况的物理预测与可微设计优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数化物理系统中，现有 JEPA 学到的表征会把几何与工况、任务相关物理响应纠缠在一起，难以在不同预测任务间复用，也无法直接支持设计分析。

Method: D-JEPA 仅从几何计算紧凑潜表征，通过轻量级物理专用解码器在不同工况与响应空间复用；引入显式设计可恢复性目标使几何潜变量保留设计变量信息；识别案例级坍缩失效模式，并用案例级变异性约束与辅助目标重建加以缓解。

Result: 在四个三维气动、水动与结构基准上，D-JEPA 保持或提升全场预测精度，设计参数线性可恢复性接近完美；冻结的几何表征可在留出工况下复用，并以更少可训练参数迁移到结构响应任务；表征支持可微设计优化，高保真 CFD 验证保持了候选设计的预测排序。

Conclusion: 将可复用几何表征与物理专用预测分离，可为科学代理建模与设计优化提供实用表征。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide a framework for learning compact representations without directly reconstructing high-dimensional observations. However, in parameterized physical systems, learned representations can entangle geometry with operating conditions and task-specific physical responses, limiting their reuse across prediction tasks. We introduce D-JEPA (Design-recoverable JEPA), a geometry-centric JEPA that computes a compact representation from geometry alone and reuses it across operating conditions and physical response spaces through lightweight physics-specific decoders. An explicit design-recoverability objective encourages the geometry latent to preserve information about the underlying design variables, enabling the representation to support design analysis and optimization. We further identify a case-level collapse failure mode in which target representations become nearly invariant across distinct geometries despite low reconstruction error, and mitigate it using case-level variation constraints and auxiliary target reconstruction. Across four 3D aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and structural benchmarks, D-JEPA maintains or improves full-field prediction accuracy while achieving near-perfect linear recoverability of design parameters. The frozen geometry representation can be reused at held-out operating conditions and transferred to a structural response task with fewer trainable parameters. Finally, the representation supports differentiable design optimization, with designs validated using high-fidelity CFD, preserving the predicted ranking of candidate designs. These results demonstrate that separating a reusable geometry representation from physics-specific prediction provides a practical representation for scientific surrogate modeling and design.

</details>


### [893] [Policy Plasticity Matters in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning: Refitting Offline Policies for Online Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33127)
*Yuheng Huang,Yunpeng Qing,Yixiao Chi,Yilun Kong,Changqing Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从网络可塑性的视角研究离线到在线强化学习（O2O RL），发现离线训练会降低网络可塑性并削弱在线提升，提出REFIT方法通过"新初始化+策略蒸馏"恢复可塑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有O2O方法主要通过价值校准来解决离线到在线的过渡问题，通常将离线训练好的策略视为既定的初始化，较少关注该初始化本身是否仍具备足够的可塑性。作者希望探究离线训练是否损害了策略的在线适应能力。

Method: 通过受控实验验证离线训练与网络可塑性的关系；提出REFIT（Restoring plasticity via Fresh Initialization and policy Transfer），一种轻量的模型级方法：在线微调前，将离线策略蒸馏到一个全新初始化的学生网络中，同时在蒸馏时随机冻结学生网络的一个子集单元，从而把离线学到的行为迁移到更具可塑性的初始化上。

Result: 受控实验表明：在静态离线数据上持续优化会在离线性能基本饱和后仍逐步降低网络可塑性，且可塑性越低，后续在线提升越弱。在D4RL和OGBench上的大量实验显示，REFIT在Cal-QL与IQL两种骨干下均持续取得比现有O2O插件方法更高的总体性能，可塑性诊断与消融实验进一步证实了网络可塑性的恢复。

Conclusion: 从网络可塑性角度切入O2O RL是有效的研究视角；REFIT作为一种即插即用的轻量方法，能恢复离线策略的可塑性，提升在线适应性能，并可推广到不同算法骨干与基准环境。

Abstract: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (O2O RL) has emerged as a practical paradigm that pre-trains the policy using static offline datasets and subsequently adapts the policy through online interactions. Existing O2O methods primarily address the transition through value calibration, while generally treating the offline-trained policy as a given initialization. We instead study O2O adaptation from the perspective of network plasticity, asking whether the offline-trained policy remains sufficiently adaptable for online learning. Controlled experiments show that prolonged optimization on static offline data progressively reduces network plasticity even after offline performance has largely saturated, and that lower plasticity is associated with weaker subsequent online improvement. Motivated by these observations, we propose REstoring plasticity via Fresh Initialization and policy Transfer (REFIT), a lightweight model-level method for the O2O transition. Before online fine-tuning, REFIT distills the offline policy into a freshly initialized student while temporarily freezing a random subset of student units, transferring the learned offline behavior to a more plastic policy initialization. Extensive experiments on D4RL and OGBench demonstrate that REFIT consistently achieves higher aggregate performance than existing O2O plug-in methods across both Cal-QL and IQL backbones, while plasticity diagnostics and ablations provide further evidence of restored network plasticity.

</details>


### [894] [Flow-Matching-Based Protein Structure Tokenizer Made Efficient and Easy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33129)
*Zhe Zhang,Yikai Zhang,Jiangtao Feng,Ya-Qin Zhang,Wei-Ying Ma,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轻量级流匹配分词器ProFiT，通过简单训练策略实现高效训练与语义表征学习，性能媲美或超越更大分词器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质结构分词仍依赖为特定下游任务定制的复杂训练目标和大规模数据集，难以迁移到更广泛的应用场景。

Method: 提出ProFiT，一种轻量级流匹配（flow matching）分词器，采用简单训练策略促进码本（codebook）的健康利用，无需人工语义对齐即可学习语义表征。

Result: 训练高效，重建质量和泛化能力与更大规模分词器相当或更优，并在多种设置下验证其可即插即用地适配多样下游任务。

Conclusion: 研究揭示流匹配分词器范式的巨大潜力，代码已开源。

Abstract: As the bridge between protein modality and discrete modeling, protein structure tokenization still largely relies on heavily engineered training objectives tailored to specific downstream tasks and large training datasets, which hinders its transfer to broader application scenarios. To address this issue, we propose ProFiT, a lightweight flow matching tokenizer. With simple training strategies that encourage healthy codebook utilization, ProFiT can be trained efficiently and naturally learns semantically meaningful representations without any manual semantic alignment, while achieving reconstruction quality and generalization that match or surpass those of substantially larger tokenizers. We conduct extensive evaluations across a wide range of settings and demonstrate that ProFiT is a plug-and-play tokenizer adaptable to diverse downstream tasks. This study further reveals the significant potential of the flow matching tokenizer paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QDKStorm/ProFiT.

</details>


### [895] [Beyond the Training Horizon: Mechanisms and Limits of Length Generalization in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33144)
*Jia Liang,Xi Jin,Liangming Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过机制可解释性方法对比MR-Loop与DR-Loop两种循环Transformer配置，揭示其长度泛化的内部计算机制、失效原因，以及"内容+计算状态"的共性表征原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer能够泛化到比训练时更长的推理链，但支撑该能力的计算机制及其泛化边界尚不清楚。本文旨在机制层面对比不同循环训练方案下的两种配置，厘清其可泛化机制与深度受限的根源。

Method: 对比Matched-Recurrence Looped Transformer (MR-Loop)与Decoupled-Recurrence Looped Transformer (DR-Loop)。在多步迭代、有限状态复合与知识图谱遍历三类任务上，采用注意力分析、中间状态解码与因果干预等机制分析手段，在仅监督最终答案的条件下进行考察。

Result: MR-Loop在固定读出位置更新中间状态，并通过相邻token交互与可迁移的进展线索推进关系选择；DR-Loop则将中间状态沿关系位置传播，形成"推进式计算前沿"。两者在更深的迭代下均不可靠：MR-Loop出现读出状态与进展线索退化，DR-Loop的状态传播可靠性下降；且自纠正能力有限，局部错误会累积。此外，循环状态不仅编码任务相关内容，还编码其计算状态，存在可迁移的"live-consumed"与"fresh-aged"残差方向，可因果性地控制信息能否参与后续计算，并作用于训练长度之外。

Conclusion: 长度泛化并不必然依赖严格的逐步忠实推理；循环Transformer可借助任务结构，无需显式表示每个中间状态。循环状态的"内容+计算状态"双重建模是跨配置的共性表征原则，其退化是深度泛化受限的关键原因。

Abstract: Looped Transformers can generalize to reasoning chains longer than those encountered during training, but the computations enabling this behavior and limiting its extent remain unclear. We mechanistically compare two looped-Transformer configurations, which we call the Matched-Recurrence Looped Transformer (MR-Loop) and Decoupled-Recurrence Looped Transformer (DR-Loop), reflecting their respective recurrence-training schemes. We evaluate polynomial iteration, finite-state composition, and knowledge-graph traversal using detailed mechanistic analysis. Attention analysis, intermediate-state decoding, and causal interventions reveal distinct mechanisms learned under final-answer supervision. MR-Loop updates an intermediate state at a fixed readout while advancing relation selection through adjacent-token interactions and a transferable progress cue. DR-Loop instead propagates intermediate states across relation positions, forming an advancing computational frontier. However, both mechanisms become unreliable at greater depths: MR-Loop exhibits degradation of its readout state and progress cues, while DR-Loop exhibits declining reliability of state propagation. Limited self-correction allows local errors to persist and compound. Across both models, we uncover a common representational principle: recurrent states encode not only task-relevant content but also its computational status, whether that content remains in a form that can support subsequent computation. Transferable live-consumed and fresh-aged residual directions causally control whether represented information can participate in subsequent computation, including beyond the training horizon. We further show that length generalization need not rely on faithful step-by-step reasoning, as Looped Transformers can exploit task structure without explicitly representing every intermediate state.

</details>


### [896] [SMORE: Stability-Promoting Mesh-Agnostic Model Reduction for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33205)
*Yangyuan Li,Weichao Li,Shaowu Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SMORE——一种与网格无关的时序偏微分方程降阶建模框架，其潜动力学采用Lyapunov引导的稳定性正则化训练，以保证长时间推演稳定，并在多个问题上取得优于主流基线的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真时序PDE模拟计算代价高昂，需数据驱动的降阶代理模型支持不确定性量化、设计优化、数据同化与最优控制等多次查询任务；但现有代理模型时序稳定性差，易在长时间多步预测中出现不稳定推演与梯度爆炸。

Method: SMORE采用网格无关的降阶建模架构，潜动力学通过Lyapunov引导的稳定性正则化进行训练，并在给定结构假设下给出理论保证；潜动力学可解释且为线性或线性二次形式，支持从初始条件的稀疏测量预测连续PDE解场。

Result: 在波传播、Navier-Stokes方程和浅水方程等问题上评估，长时程推演的泛化能力与经验鲁棒性均有提升，在相近参数预算下精度与DINo、FNO、CNO、Transolver等基线相当。

Conclusion: SMORE通过稳定性正则化有效缓解降阶代理模型的长期不稳定问题，其可解释的线性/线性二次潜动力学还可服务于数据同化与最优控制等下游任务。

Abstract: High-fidelity simulations of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) are computationally expensive, motivating data-driven reduced-order surrogates for many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, design optimization, data assimilation, and optimal control. However, existing surrogate models often exhibit poor temporal stability, which can lead to unstable rollouts and exploding gradients during backpropagation, especially in multistep long-horizon forecasting. To address this, we propose SMORE, a mesh-agnostic framework for model order reduction of time-dependent PDEs. Its latent dynamics are trained with Lyapunov-guided stability regularization, which promotes stable long-horizon rollouts. We provide theoretical guarantees under the stated structural assumptions. Beyond forecasting PDE evolution, the learned latent dynamics, which are interpretable and linear or linear-quadratic, could bring benefits for downstream tasks such as data assimilation and optimal control. Moreover, our framework is capable of predicting continuous PDE solution fields from sparse measurements of the initial condition. We evaluate SMORE on a range of problems, including wave propagation, the Navier-Stokes equations, and the shallow water equations. Our results show that it improves long-horizon rollout generalization and empirical robustness, and achieves competitive accuracy at comparable parameter budgets relative to competitive baselines including DINo, FNO, CNO, and Transolver.

</details>


### [897] [Domain Generalization under Sampling Pattern Shifts in Irregular Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33279)
*Changhun Kim,Joohyung Lee,Kwanhyung Lee,Donghwee Yoon,Grigorios Chrysos,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出首个针对不规则采样多元时间序列（ISMTS）采样模式偏移的受控基准HAR-C，并揭示采样偏移可显著降低性能、诱导采样捷径且对现有域泛化方法构成挑战；进而提出PRISM框架，在无任务标签下学习特征中心与采样中心的互补表征，再进行跨采样变化的鲁棒监督训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则采样多元时间序列在现实中普遍存在，观测时间与可用测量因领域而异。尽管近期模型利用采样信息做预测，但其在采样模式偏移下的鲁棒性尚未被充分探索；且缺乏受控基准来系统研究该问题。

Method: 1) 构建HAR-C：首个面向ISMTS采样模式偏移的受控基准，用于诊断采样偏移影响；2) 提出PRISM：先以无任务标签方式学习特征中心（feature-centric）与采样中心（sampling-centric）的互补表征，再进行跨多样采样变化的鲁棒监督训练，以抑制脆弱的采样捷径依赖。

Result: 在受控与真实ISMTS基准上的大量实验表明，PRISM对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性一致优于现有方法；同时HAR-C实验显示采样偏移单独即可显著降低性能、诱导采样特定捷径，并使现有域泛化方法仍面临困难。

Conclusion: 采样模式偏移是ISMTS域泛化中被忽视但关键的问题；通过互补表征学习与跨采样变化的鲁棒监督训练（PRISM）可有效提升对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性，HAR-C为该方向提供受控评测基础。代码已开源。

Abstract: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series (ISMTS) are prevalent in real-world applications, where both observation times and available measurements can vary substantially across domains. While recent models increasingly exploit such sampling information for prediction, its robustness under sampling pattern shifts remains underexplored. We introduce HAR-C, to the best of our knowledge the first controlled benchmark for sampling pattern shifts in ISMTS, and show that sampling shifts alone can substantially degrade performance, induce sampling-specific shortcuts, and remain challenging for existing domain generalization (DG) methods. Motivated by these findings, we propose PRISM, a DG framework that first learns complementary feature-centric and sampling-centric representations without task labels, and subsequently performs robust supervised training across diverse sampling variations to discourage brittle shortcut reliance. Extensive experiments on controlled and real-world ISMTS benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently improves robustness to unseen sampling shifts over existing methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PRISM.

</details>


### [898] [BITS: Rethinking Fair and Comprehensive Evaluation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33303)
*Kangjia Yan,Linfeng Wang,Tianen Shen,Xiangfei Qiu,Ruitong Zhang,Hao Miao,Jilin Hu,Chenjuan Guo,Bin Yang,Christian S. Jensen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BITS，一个面向不规则时间序列预测的标准化、可复现、可扩展基准，覆盖九个领域十一个数据集，提供统一的数据预处理、模型集成与评测流程，并同时采用误差与非误差指标进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不规则时间序列预测研究缺乏统一基准，评测常局限于少量数据集，实验协议不一致，且以误差类指标为主，导致方法难以在多样设定下被公平、全面比较，阻碍了领域进展。

Method: 构建 BITS 基准：涵盖十一个数据集、九个领域，并依据缺失率、缺失模式复杂度、采样不规则性与偏度刻画数据集的不规则特性；提供统一的数据预处理、模型集成、评测与报告流水线；在一致设定下同时支持规则与不规则时间序列方法（含时间序列基础模型）；评测同时纳入误差类与非误差类指标。

Result: 实验发现：方法性能随不规则特性不同而差异显著，不存在始终占优的单一建模策略；采用误差类指标与非误差类指标会得到不同的模型排名，说明需要多维度评测。

Conclusion: BITS 为不规则时间序列预测提供了标准化、可复现、可扩展的评测基准，揭示不同不规则特性下的性能差异以及多维度评测的必要性，有助于推动该领域公平比较与后续研究。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in irregular time series forecasting, the field still lacks a unified benchmark for fair and comprehensive evaluation. Existing evaluations are often conducted on a limited set of datasets with inconsistent experimental protocols and predominantly error-based metrics, rendering it difficult to compare and assess methods fairly and comprehensively across diverse settings. To eliminate these limitations and accelerate progress, we propose BITS, a standardized, reproducible, and extensible benchmark for advancing research on irregular time series forecasting. BITS covers eleven datasets from nine domains with diverse irregularity characteristics, and it characterizes the datasets according to their missing rate, missing pattern complexity, sampling irregularity, and skewness. Further, it offers a unified pipeline for data preprocessing, model integration and evaluation, and reporting. It accommodates regular and irregular time series forecasting methods, including time series foundation models, under consistent settings, incorporating both error-based and non-error-based evaluation metrics. Findings include that method performance varies substantially across irregularity characteristics, with no single modeling strategy consistently dominating. We also find that using error-based or non-error-based metrics can yield different model rankings, highlighting the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. The code can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BITS-8F2E/.

</details>


### [899] [ZeroGAR: Benchmarking the Adversarial Robustness of Zero-Shot Graph Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33314)
*Zhongjian Zhang,Xiao Wang,Busheng Zhang,Bo Yan,Xingtong Yu,Yue Gao,Jia Li,Chuan Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对零样本图模型（ZGM）对抗鲁棒性的系统基准 ZeroGAR，揭示强零样本性能不等于强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ZGM 主要在干净图上评估，而图鲁棒性基准多聚焦监督设定，零样本模型在目标图受对抗操纵时的鲁棒性这一根本问题尚未被探索。

Method: ZeroGAR 覆盖 3 类范式共 13 个代表性 ZGM、8 个数据集、4 个领域，涵盖域内与跨域迁移，在结构攻击、文本攻击和节点注入攻击下使用多种扰动预算进行评估，并检验现有图防御在零样本设定下的有效性。

Result: 实验表明强干净零样本性能并不保证对抗鲁棒性，得到三点发现：(1) 脆弱性模式与模型预测机制相关，GNN 类方法更易受结构与节点注入攻击，LLM 类方法更易受文本攻击；(2) 更强的 LLM 骨干引入结构-文本鲁棒性权衡；(3) 现有图防御方法不能持续提升零样本鲁棒性，甚至可能损害干净性能。

Conclusion: ZeroGAR 为 ZGM 安全提供快速、公平的评估平台，期望推动该领域进一步的创新研究。

Abstract: Zero-shot graph models (ZGMs), which learn transferable knowledge from source graphs and directly apply to unseen target graphs without any adaptation, have achieved promising performance and attracted considerable attention. Despite their proliferation, existing ZGMs are predominantly evaluated on clean graphs, while existing graph robustness benchmarks mainly focus on supervised settings, leaving a fundamental question largely unexplored: How robust are ZGMs when their unseen target graphs are exposed to adversarial manipulation? In this paper, we answer this question by proposing ZeroGAR, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating the adversarial robustness of ZGMs. ZeroGAR evaluates 13 representative ZGMs from 3 different paradigms on 8 graph datasets across 4 domains, covering both in-domain and cross-domain transfer under structural, textual, and node injection attacks with multiple perturbation budgets. It further investigates whether existing graph defenses remain effective in the zero-shot setting. Extensive experiments reveal that strong clean zero-shot performance does not guarantee adversarial robustness, with three key findings: (1) Vulnerability patterns are related to model prediction mechanisms: GNN-based methods are particularly vulnerable to structural and node injection attacks, whereas LLM-based methods are more vulnerable to textual attacks; (2) Stronger LLM backbones introduce a structure-text robustness trade-off; (3) Existing graph defense methods do not consistently improve zero-shot robustness and may compromise clean performance. We hope that ZeroGAR will facilitate rapid, equitable evaluation and inspire further innovative research in ZGM security.

</details>


### [900] [Beyond Conservatism: Recoverability-Conditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33336)
*Xuanlin Chen,Ziyue Wang,Xunlan Zhou,Yuan-yih Shang,Qiang Wu,Shenghua Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RECON方法，将保守策略学习与主动数据采集解耦，用"可恢复性"条件化的认知不确定性引导探索，提升模型基模仿学习的交互效率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型基模仿学习（MBIL）虽通过在世界模型上优化策略提升真实环境交互效率，但模型与真实环境的占用分布差异使策略学习对模型误差敏感。保守MBIL虽能抑制策略优化中的模型利用问题，但当真实交互也由同一保守策略采集时，专家分布周围的不确定区域采样不足；而通用不确定性驱动探索又可能把交互浪费在新颖但与任务无关的动力学上。
