Theoretically, for an idealized variant that samples exactly from the tilted distribution, and under regularity, local gradient-dominance, and initialization conditions, we show that DEO learns distributionally robust reasoning ability. In experiments, DEO achieves reasoning performance competitive with R-Zero while using over $50\%$ less wall-clock training time, and improves reasoning accuracy over a no-walk ablation. Replacing the task generator with a frozen API-only LLM further improves the local solver, illustrating a capability enabled by removing challenger training.

</details>


### [935] [One Sequence, Many Decodings: CAGenMol-2 Recasts Drug Design as Masked Molecular Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34301)
*Yanting Li,Enyan Dai,Lei Wang,Wen-Cai Ye,Li Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出CAGenMol-2，一个掩码扩散分子语言模型，将分子、连续标量性质与3D蛋白口袋统一表示为单一包裹序列，用同一预训练checkpoint通过观察/掩码不同区域完成性质预测、条件生成与部分约束设计；并提出免梯度掩码-填充搜索AdaFO，在CrossDocked2020上将成功率从30.2%提升至70.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物设计需耦合性质评估、条件生成、基于结构的设计与局部优化，但现有机器学习系统通常为每种能力训练独立的任务专用模型，缺乏统一接口且需针对下游任务微调，导致能力割裂、复用性差。

Method: 1) CAGenMol-2：掩码扩散分子语言模型，把分子、连续标量性质、3D蛋白口袋编码进同一条包裹序列，形成统一预训练接口；推理时通过选择哪些序列区域被观察或掩码来决定下游操作，无需任务专用架构或骨干微调。2) AdaFO（Adaptive Fragment Optimization）：免梯度的"掩码-再填充"搜索，将掩码解码器转化为迭代式局部分子优化器。

Result: 在CrossDocked2020上，AdaFO将该协议下的成功率（Success Rate）从30.2%提升到70.8%，为目前该协议下已报道的最佳结果，同时基本保持药物相似性与多样性。此外，骨架保持的方向性编辑以及CRBN/VHL案例研究验证了其在局部分子编辑、基于结构的优先级排序与下游基于模拟的筛选等化合物设计工作流中的可用性。

Conclusion: 单一掩码扩散语言模型接口可统一性质预测、条件生成与部分约束设计，并可借助免梯度掩码-填充搜索实现有效的局部优化，展示出覆盖局部编辑、结构导向筛选与实际设计流程的通用性。

Abstract: Drug design couples property evaluation, conditional generation, structure-based design, and local optimization, yet machine learning systems typically address these capabilities with separate task-specific models. We introduce CAGenMol-2, a masked diffusion molecular language model that represents molecules, continuous scalar properties, and 3D protein pockets within a single wrapped sequence. Within this pretrained interface, downstream operations are selected by which sequence regions are observed or masked at inference, allowing one checkpoint to perform property prediction, property- and pocket-conditioned generation, and partial-constraint design without task-specific architectures or backbone fine-tuning. We further propose Adaptive Fragment Optimization (AdaFO), a gradient-free mask-and-refill search that turns the masked decoder into an iterative local molecular optimizer. On CrossDocked2020, AdaFO increases Success Rate from 30.2\% to 70.8\%, the best reported under this protocol, while largely preserving drug-likeness and diversity. Finally, scaffold-preserving directional editing and CRBN/VHL case studies demonstrate its use in compound design workflows spanning local molecular editing, structure-based prioritization, and downstream simulation-based screening.

</details>


### [936] [Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34344)
*Yuchen Cai,Ding Cao,Qixiang Yin,Xin Xu,Kai Yang,Siye Wu,Pengyuan Wang,Jiaxuan Wang,Weijie Liu,Saiyong Yang,Guangzhong Sun,Guiquan Liu,Junfeng Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究RLVR训练动态，通过向量转向发现在激活空间中存在低维有效流形，揭示"有效流形容量"与"控制流形分离"两大几何性质，并据此提出Alpha-Stabler框架以稳定训练、提升RL收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键范式，但参数更新的高维性使训练动力学难以分析，亟需找到可解释、低维的分析视角，并据此改善训练的稳定性与效果。

Method: 采用vector steering方法，在激活空间中识别与RL收益相关的低维有效流形；通过控制容量与注入深度分析几何性质，并跨训练配置与任务考察几何一致性与迁移相关性。基于发现提出Alpha-Stabler：包含预测器（监测主成分子空间入侵，提供早期崩溃预警）与控制器（在反向传播中移除激活梯度的主成分子空间成分，保留正交补）。

Result: (1) 有效流形容量：复现RL收益所需容量可很小但非无限可压缩，极低容量下干预维度与输入相关表达能力成为关键约束，且需求随注入深度变化；(2) 控制流形分离：有效控制方向主要位于激活主成分子空间的低方差补空间。同一任务与基模型下几何结构跨训练配置基本一致，跨任务对齐与能力迁移相关。实验覆盖5个LLM与6个可验证奖励任务。Alpha-Stabler可稳定训练2000步并持续提升RL收益。

Conclusion: RLVR诱导的增益可由低维激活流形刻画，其几何具有容量受限与主成分子空间正交分离的特性；据此设计的Alpha-Stabler作为即插即用框架，可有效稳定并增强后训练，为鲁棒后训练提供实用洞见。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compressible; at extremely low capacity, intervention dimensionality and input-dependent expressiveness become key constraints, and this requirement varies with injection depth. (2) Control Manifold Separation: effective control directions lie mainly in the low-variance complement of the activation principal subspace. Within a task and base model, the learned geometry stays largely consistent across training configurations, and across tasks geometric alignment correlates with capability transfer. Experiments on 5 LLMs and 6 verifiable-reward tasks support these findings. We then propose Alpha-Stabler, a plug-and-play framework with a Predictor that monitors principal-subspace intrusion for early collapse warnings, and a Controller that removes the principal-subspace component of activation gradients during backpropagation while preserving the orthogonal complement. Alpha-Stabler stabilizes training for 2,000 steps and consistently improves RL gains, offering practical insights for robust post-training. Code: https://github.com/caiyuchen-ustc/On_Policy_Vector_Training

</details>


### [937] [MASCIT: A Mask-Aware State Space Classifier for Naturally Irregular Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34409)
*Yoo-Min Jung,Hyeon-Gi Kim,Jonghun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出MASCIT（掩码感知状态空间分类器），通过向编码器提供观测掩码并在门控时间聚合中排除无效步，处理自然不规则时间序列分类问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然不规则时间序列同时具有异步观测、缺失值、长度不等和非均匀采样等特点，而现有的稠密适配器会丢弃时间结构，因此需要一种能够显式处理不规则性的模型。

Method: 提出MASCIT模型，核心是掩码感知机制：将观测掩码输入编码器，并在门控时间聚合过程中排除无效步，从而在选择性状态空间模型框架下实现不规则时间序列分类。

Result: 在34个不规则时间序列数据集上，MASCIT取得最强的聚合点估计，并且是唯一在所有数据集上都有三种子结果的神经模型；在六个重叠的不规则性指标上保持最低点排名；因子消融实验显示部分选择性优于完全选择性。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持选择性状态空间模型作为处理自然不规则时间序列分类的有效且可执行的主干架构。

Abstract: Naturally irregular time series combine asynchronous observations, missing values, unequal lengths, and nonuniform sampling, while dense adapters can discard temporal structure. We propose a mask-aware state space classifier for irregular time series (MASCIT), which supplies observation masks to the encoder and excludes invalid steps from gated temporal aggregation. Across 34 irregular time series datasets, MASCIT yielded the strongest aggregate point estimate and was the only evaluated neural model with three-seed results on every dataset. MASCIT retained the lowest point rank across six overlapping irregularity indicators, while factorial ablations favored partial over full selectivity. These results support selective state space models as effective, executable backbones for naturally irregular time series classification.

</details>


### [938] [SPACE-LoRA: Allocating Activation-Subspace Protection for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34453)
*Seunghyun Yoo,Kiseok Kim,Hyeontae Joo,Junyeop Bang,Hwangnam Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对低秩适配（LoRA）在 lifelong learning 中顺序学习多任务时的灾难性遗忘问题，提出 SPACE-LoRA，通过抑制新残差分支在旧任务重要输入激活方向上的响应，并基于 Fisher 敏感度自适应分配各模块的保护覆盖范围，以缓解加性干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要通过约束参数更新或学习子空间来减少对旧知识的干扰，但未充分考虑"加性干扰"：在固定的历史模型上叠加新残差适配器时，其沿旧任务重要输入方向产生的非零响应会改变原有预测，导致灾难性遗忘。

Method: 提出 SPACE-LoRA：直接抑制新残差分支在旧任务重要输入激活方向上的响应；通过基于 Fisher 敏感度的统一覆盖目标估计各模块的旧任务敏感度，进而在固定 LoRA 秩下自适应确定各模块的保护覆盖范围。

Result: 验证了激活子空间保护在缓解灾难性遗忘方面的有效性，并考察了敏感度引导保护在多样化任务连续学习中的作用。

Conclusion: 在固定 LoRA 秩约束下，SPACE-LoRA 能自适应调整模块级保护覆盖并抑制沿旧任务敏感输入方向的干扰，为高效持续适配提供了一种兼顾容量分配与子空间保护的方案。

Abstract: This study addresses the catastrophic forgetting problem that occurs when sequentially learning successive tasks using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) from a lifelong learning perspective. While existing approaches have primarily constrained parameter updates or learning subspaces to reduce interference with past knowledge, they have not fully considered additive interference. This occurs when a newly added residual adapter on top of a fixed past model generates non-zero responses along input directions important for old tasks, thereby altering previous predictions. To this end, we propose Subspace Protection with Allocated Capacity for Efficient Continual Adaptation (SPACE-LoRA). SPACE-LoRA directly suppresses the responses of the new residual branch along input activation directions that are important for old tasks and adaptively determines the protection coverage for each module based on past-task sensitivity estimated via a common Fisher sensitivity-based coverage target. Under a fixed LoRA rank, this approach adaptively adjusts module-specific protection coverage while suppressing interference along input directions sensitive to old tasks. We assess the effectiveness of activation-subspace protection in mitigating catastrophic forgetting and examine the role of sensitivity-guided protection in continual learning across diverse tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPACE-LoRA-7864.

</details>


### [939] [Causal Routing for Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34475)
*Bardh Prenkaj,Andrea D'Angelo,Davide Mottin,Federico Fontana,Davide Gabrielli,Paola Velardi,Stefano Faralli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出因果路由遗忘方法CRU：通过一次前向传播定位概念相关神经元，仅用小型路由模块门控抑制，实现参数高效、因果可解释的机器遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型无法像删除文件一样"遗忘"信息。文本中习得的知识弥散在数十亿权重中，现有遗忘方法需重写全部权重，且无法指明是哪部分权重导致了行为改变，缺乏因果性与定位性。

Method: CRU（Causal Routing for Unlearning）：1）对遗忘集做一次无训练前向传播，依据神经元激活变化对神经元排序，定位概念表达位置；2）在这些神经元上附加小型路由模块，门控并抑制需遗忘的概念；3）基座模型冻结，行为变化仅由被门控神经元引起，故路由具有因果性；4）参数量仅约基座模型的0.01%。

Result: 遗忘一个概念仅需14 GiB，基线需71 GiB。在TOFU上，CRU与保留模型不可区分（p>0.05，KS检验），且从不被帕累托支配，而所有对比基线在大遗忘批次上只能在效用崩溃时匹配其遗忘效果。在RWKU上，对抗探针召回率为0.052，最强基线为0.250，表明知识被真正移除而非难以访问。

Conclusion: 应在查询时动态决定干预，而非事先固定干预，这是机器遗忘应遵循的方向。

Abstract: LLMs cannot forget the way we delete a file. Strangely, we are asked to remove something that was never put anywhere in particular. What the model took from a piece of text is now smeared across billions of weights. Existing methods rewrite all of them to change one thing, and none of them say which part produced that change. To address this, we introduce Causal Routing for Unlearning (CRU) by asking where the concept is expressed in the model and suppressing only that part. One untrained forward pass over the forget set ranks neurons by how their activations vary. Then, small routing modules on those neurons gate and suppress only the concepts that need to be forgotten. In CRU, the base model is frozen, and any change in behavior is caused only by the gated neurons; hence, why the routing is causal. Due to our parameter efficiency (only ~0.01% as many parameters as the base model), unlearning a concept costs 14 GiB, whereas the baselines require 71 GiB. On TOFU, CRU is indistinguishable from the retained model (p > 0.05, KS test) and is never Pareto-dominated, whereas every compared baseline matches its forgetting on the larger-forget batches only by collapsing utility. On RWKU, it achieves an adversarial-probe recall of 0.052, compared to 0.250 for the strongest baseline, meaning the knowledge is gone, not merely harder to reach. Thus, deciding on the intervention at query time, rather than fixing it beforehand, is the axis along which we argue that unlearning should proceed.

</details>


### [940] [Learn Here, Move Less Elsewhere: Input-Conditioned Plasticity from Retained-Domain Activation Atlases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34478)
*Jiangtao Lin,Bangyang Wei,Yihang Ding,Siyi Liu,Yuhan Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATLAS 将保留域表征转化为输入相关的任务适配规则，在提升编码能力的同时显著减少对原有行为的改写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务特定微调会改写语言模型在训练任务之外的答案，使得既要获得新技能又要保持原有行为变得困难。

Method: ATLAS 利用激活图谱提供局部参考中心与方向滤波器，作用于共享低秩残差；目标监督学习该残差，保留域几何在训练和推理全程约束其作用。

Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，相同编码性能要求下，ATLAS 的保留输出 KL 散度低于全部七个已发表基线，且多种子一致；结构对比确认参考状态与方向条件的作用，答案级分析显示数学答案被改写更少、常识选择更稳定；跨五个骨干与两个保留域均实现编码增益并降低保留输出偏移，存储紧凑、解码开销小。

Conclusion: ATLAS 为在获取专门技能的同时维持既有响应连续性提供了一种实用机制。

Abstract: Task-specific fine-tuning can rewrite a language model's answers beyond the training task, complicating updates that must preserve existing behavior. We introduce ATLAS, which turns retained-domain representations into an input-dependent rule for task adaptation. An activation atlas supplies local reference centers and directional filters to a shared low-rank residual. Target supervision learns the residual, while retained geometry shapes its action throughout training and inference. On Qwen3-8B, ATLAS achieves lower mean retained-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence than all seven published baselines at shared coding-performance requirements, with consistent advantages across multiple training seeds. Structural comparisons identify the contributions of retained reference states and directional conditioning, and answer-level analyses show fewer rewritten mathematical answers and more stable commonsense choices. Experiments spanning five backbones and two retained domains further demonstrate coding gains with reduced retained-output movement. With compact storage and modest decoding overhead, ATLAS provides a practical mechanism for acquiring specialized skills while maintaining continuity in existing responses.

</details>


### [941] [FlexLoop: Depth-Elastic Looped Policies for Adaptive Test-Time Computation in Deep RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34488)
*Xun Wang,Ruishuo Chen,Yu Chen,Zhuoran Li,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FlexLoop 后训练框架，将预训练的固定深度循环策略转化为深度弹性策略，在保持满深度性能的同时支持跨循环深度的可靠推理与自适应计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环架构通过跨循环步复用参数来扩展计算，可提升深度强化学习在长时程任务上的表现。由于循环深度直接控制计算量，直觉上循环策略应天然支持弹性推理，但作者发现预训练循环策略存在严重的"循环深度专门化"：可靠决策集中在接近训练满深度的位置，使部署计算量与满深度绑定，即使更少计算已经足够。因此实现深度弹性（跨循环深度可靠决策+部署时自适应计算）成为关键挑战。

Method: 提出 FlexLoop 后训练框架：(1) 继续在原始 RL 目标上训练，以保留满深度能力；(2) 引入相邻深度策略蒸馏（adjacent-depth policy distillation），将决策质量从较深循环步逐步迁移到较浅循环步。由此得到的策略可在多个循环深度上可靠推理，并借助"循环深度一致性"（recurrent-depth consistency）实现逐状态的自适应推理。

Result: 在 30 个在线与离线长时程目标条件环境中验证：FlexLoop 在保留满深度性能的同时使较浅深度也变得有效；在保持竞争性性能的前提下，平均循环深度最多降低 43%，在压力测试中实现最高 1.34× 的墙钟加速。

Conclusion: 循环策略并非天然具备深度弹性，存在循环深度专门化问题；FlexLoop 通过 RL 目标保持与相邻深度蒸馏，成功将固定深度循环策略转为深度弹性策略，实现自适应计算与推理加速，为循环策略的弹性部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Looped architectures scale computation by reusing the same parameters across recurrent steps, and recent work shows that they substantially improve deep reinforcement learning policies on long-horizon tasks. Since recurrent depth directly controls computation, one may expect looped policies to naturally support elastic inference across recurrent depths. Surprisingly, we find that pretrained looped policies exhibit severe recurrent-depth specialization: reliable decisions are concentrated near the full trained depth, tying deployment computation to this depth even when less computation may suffice. Achieving depth elasticity, i.e., reliable decisions across recurrent depths with adaptive computation at deployment, therefore remains a key challenge. To address this, we propose FlexLoop, a novel post-training framework that converts pretrained fixed-depth looped policies into depth-elastic policies. FlexLoop keeps training on the original RL objective to preserve full-depth capability while performing adjacent-depth policy distillation to progressively transfer decision quality from deeper to shallower recurrent steps. The resulting policy supports reliable inference across recurrent depths and enables state-wise adaptive inference through recurrent-depth consistency. Experiments on $30$ online and offline long-horizon goal-conditioned environments show that FlexLoop preserves full-depth performance while making shallower depths effective. Keeping competitive performance, FlexLoop reduces average recurrent depth by up to $\bf{43\%}$ and achieves up to $\bf{1.34\times}$ wall-clock speedup in a stress test.

</details>


### [942] [Scalable GNN-based Knowledge Graph Representation Learning with Efficient Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34499)
*Huu Tan Mai,Cuong Xuan Chu,Heiko Paulheim,Daria Stepanova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作扩展RSPMM以支持更富表达力的组合函数，实现知识图谱GNN的通用、无损且任务无关的时空复杂度降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN在知识图谱任务上表现优异，但其用户自定义消息传递算法计算复杂度高，难以在大规模KG上推广。现有子图采样等加速方法往往依赖特定任务和模型，且无法可靠保证运行时间/空间的无损缩减。

Method: 将最初为逐点组合函数、构造式消息传递无损降低空间复杂度的关系稀疏矩阵乘法（RSPMM）进行扩展，使其支持更具表达力的函数，如2×2块对角矩阵乘法、Givens旋转和循环相关。

Result: 在知识图谱GNN上实现了显著且任务无关的运行时间与空间缩减，并支持GNN的高效重实现，在具有挑战性的KG任务上以极小计算代价保持接近SOTA的性能。

Conclusion: 扩展后的RSPMM可作为通用加速原语，有效缓解KG上GNN的扩展性瓶颈，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at representation learning on Knowledge Graphs (KGs), achieving stateof-the-art performance on tasks like link prediction or entity classification. However, their high computational complexity, inherent to their user-defined message passing (MP) algorithm, still prohibits their widespread adoption, especially for large KGs. Current efforts to mitigate the scalability bottlenecks of GNNs on KGs, such as subgraph sampling, are often task- and model-specific, and do not reliably guarantee lossless (if applicable) runtime/space reductions. To address this, we extend Relational Sparse Matrix Multiplication (RSPMM), originally designed to losslessly lower the space complexity of composition-based MP with pointwise composition functions, to support more expressive functions (e.g., 2x2 block-diagonal matrix multiplication, Givens rotation, circular correlation). Our method delivers significant task-independent reductions in runtime and space for current GNNs on KGs and facilitates efficient re-implementations of GNNs that maintain near state-of-the-art performance on challenging KG tasks, for a fraction of computational costs.

</details>


### [943] [Shallow Queries, Mature Values: Depth-Asynchronous Self-Speculation for Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34538)
*Guanghao Li,Zihan Su,Hao Yu,Jinyang Jiang,Tao Ren,Zehao Li,Feng Lu,Ming Tang,Chun Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本论文提出深度异步自推测解码（DAS 与 DAS-Wave），通过让浅层草稿查询读取全深度前缀的 value 表示，显著加速循环 Transformer 的自回归解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 复用共享块，每个生成 token 需多次串行循环，自回归解码代价高。现有自推测解码虽在浅层草稿、全深度验证以降低开销，但草稿计算通常绑定于同一循环深度的前缀表示，未能充分利用不同层间信息成熟的时间差异。

Method: 作者发现 query 与 key 比 value 更早接近最终深度表示，并通过受控前缀通道干预证明成熟 value 能显著改善浅层草稿预测。据此提出 DAS，将草稿计算深度与其读取的已验证前缀表示深度解耦；其 Mature-V 原语使浅层 query 无需额外循环计算即可检索全深度前缀 value。进一步提出 DAS-Wave，结合深度异步前缀读取、携带式并行精炼、渐进块增长以及独立全深度验证器。

Result: 在四个循环模型检查点及数学和代码任务上，DAS-Wave 在相同推理栈下相较配对的全深度自回归解码取得 4.00–6.96 倍的平均吞吐加速。

Conclusion: 前缀信息深度是循环自推测解码的一个有效设计轴，深度异步读取成熟 value 表示可在保持验证正确性的同时大幅提升吞吐。

Abstract: Looped Transformers reuse a shared block across recurrent depths, making autoregressive decoding expensive because every generated token requires many sequential recurrent passes. Self-speculative decoders reduce this cost by drafting at an early depth and verifying at full depth, but typically bind draft computation to prefix representations from the same recurrent depth. We find that queries and keys approach their final-depth representations earlier than values, and controlled prefix-channel interventions show that mature values substantially improve shallow draft predictions. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Depth-Asynchronous Self-Speculation (DAS), which decouples the depth of draft computation from the depth of verified-prefix representations it reads. Its Mature-V primitive lets shallow queries retrieve full-depth prefix values without additional recurrent computation. We further develop DAS-Wave, which combines depth-asynchronous prefix reads with carried parallel refinement, progressive block growth, and an independent full-depth verifier. Across four recurrent-model checkpoints and mathematics and code workloads, DAS-Wave achieves 4.00--6.96$\times$ mean throughput speedup over paired full-depth autoregressive decoding in the same inference stack. These results identify prefix-information depth as an effective design axis for recurrent self-speculation.

</details>


### [944] [From Preference to Reciprocity: Decentralized Matching with Empirically Grounded LLM-agent Based Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34679)
*Wangxuan Fan,Xiaoyu Nie,Zhoutian Shi,Xiangcheng Meng,Shipei Zeng,Pin Gao,Yan Hu,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出动态双边匹配框架，将LLM智能体与上下文bandit结合，在模拟中国婚姻市场中通过Logistic-UCB学习互惠接受，实现去中心化、异步、信息有限的匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Gale-Shapley等匹配理论假设偏好完备且集中计算，但现实匹配过程多为去中心化、异步、序贯互动且信息有限，需要新的建模框架。

Method: 用经济学依据的LLM智能体评估本地遇到的候选人，同时为每个智能体训练Logistic-UCB模型，从实际求婚结果中学习互惠接受概率，将"我喜欢谁"与"谁可能喜欢我"两个决策分离，无需事先市场全局偏好排序。

Result: 在多种LLM骨干上验证LLM偏好与经验条件logit参考一致；50×50匹配实验中Bandit-UCB平均互惠福利最高（56.01 vs Gale-Shapley的54.87），性别排名差距更小，阻断对最少；学习到的接受模型呈现可经济解释的性别差异关联；反事实设置未显示先验搜索知识带来系统性单边优势。

Conclusion: 结果支持在信息不完全下采用基于LLM行为建模与在线学习的去中心化匹配，对经济模拟与计算社会科学研究具优势。

Abstract: Bipartite matching is a fundamental problem in game theory and market design. Classical approaches such as Gale--Shapley assume complete preferences and centralized computation, whereas many real-world matching processes are decentralized, asynchronous, and shaped by sequential interaction under limited information. We propose a dynamic bipartite matching framework that combines large language model (LLM) agents with contextual bandits. In a simulated Chinese marriage market, economically grounded LLM agents evaluate locally encountered candidates, while agent-specific Logistic-UCB models learn reciprocal acceptance from realized proposal outcomes. The mechanism therefore separates two decisions---\emph{whom do I like?} and \emph{who is likely to like me back?}---without requiring ex ante market-wide preference rankings. We first validate LLM-induced mate preferences against the empirical conditional-logit reference across multiple LLM backbones. In the $50\times50$ matching experiment, Bandit-UCB achieves the highest mean mutual welfare (56.01 versus 54.87 for Gale--Shapley), a smaller gender rank gap than the classical baselines, and the fewest blocking pairs among the LLM-ABM policies. Learned acceptance models show economically interpretable gender-differentiated associations, while counterfactual setups reveal no systematic unilateral advantage from prior search knowledge. Overall, these results support the advantages of decentralized matching with LLM-based behavioral modeling and online learning under incomplete information for economic simulation and computational social science research.

</details>


### [945] [Predictive Dual Smoothing for Column Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34740)
*Senne Berden,Noah Schutte,Andrea Lodi,Tias Guns*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出预测性对偶平滑（predictive dual smoothing），用学习到的未来对偶预测引导列生成定价子问题，加速大规模线性规划求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 列生成效率受限于对偶解的振荡，经典对偶平滑虽能稳定对偶轨迹，但依赖历史对偶解，无法有效引导定价朝向后续迭代中有用的新变量。

Method: 将当前对偶解与对未来对偶的学习预测相结合，构建预测性对偶平滑；预测器基于标准列生成轨迹提取的监督信号离线训练，仅用于修改定价子问题目标函数；通过精确检验缩减成本与无平滑对偶回退定价保证正确性。

Result: 在切割库存和广义指派问题上，相比标准列生成及现有经典与学习型稳定化方法，显著减少生成列数和运行时间；增益可泛化到分布外规模；与强经典稳定化结合时进一步提升。

Conclusion: 预测未来对偶可更有效地引导定价方向，预测性对偶平滑是一种兼具正确性保证与实用加速效果的列生成稳定化方法。

Abstract: Solving large-scale linear programs efficiently is an important challenge in many optimization settings. A key technique is column generation, which alternates between solving the master problem over a restricted subset of the variables, and using a pricing subproblem to identify new variables to add. The pricing subproblem is guided by the dual solution of the current restricted master problem, but oscillations in these dual solutions can substantially slow convergence. Dual stabilization methods address this issue. Dual smoothing is a common stabilization method, which guides the pricing subproblem using a combination of the current dual solution and duals from previous iterations. However, while past dual solutions can stabilize the dual trajectory, they do not necessarily guide pricing towards useful new variables. We therefore introduce predictive dual smoothing, which instead combines the current dual solution with a learned prediction of future duals to steer pricing towards variables that are more useful in subsequent iterations. The predictor is trained offline using supervision extracted from standard column generation trajectories and is used only to modify the pricing subproblem's objective function, while exact reduced-cost checks and fallback pricing with the unsmoothed duals preserve correctness. Experiments on cutting stock and generalized assignment problems show that predictive dual smoothing substantially reduces generated columns and wall-clock time relative to standard column generation and existing classical and learned stabilization methods. These gains extend to out-of-distribution instance sizes, and predictive smoothing provides further improvements when combined with strong classical stabilization.

</details>


### [946] [No Pain, More Gain: Iterative Merging for Effective Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34745)
*Seonghyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Noah Lee,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)中初始化对能力恢复的影响，发现初始基准性能无法可靠预测良好初始化，并据此提出迭代合并方法IM-MOPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOPD旨在将多个独立训练的领域教师整合进单一学生模型，但由于蒸馏在"学生生成的prefix"上进行，教师能力往往难以完全恢复，而学生初始化对这一恢复过程影响巨大。作者发现：初始基准性能并非良好初始化的可靠指标（例如merge初始化起始性能低于SFT warm-up，但MOPD后最终表现更好），且有效合并同时取决于相对教师贡献与整体合并尺度，一些强配置甚至位于凸参数平均的单纯形之外。因此一次性搜索合并系数十分困难，需要一种能在训练中逐步确定教师贡献的方法。

Method: 作者提出Iterative Merging for MOPD(IM-MOPD)：从均匀合并(uniform merge)初始化出发，在蒸馏过程中针对恢复不足的领域逐步加入任务向量(task-vector)增量，从而在训练中渐进地调整各教师的有效贡献，而非一次性搜索合并系数。

Result: 在5领域(5-domain)设置下，IM-MOPD取得的平均归一化恢复(average normalized recovery)高于采用均匀合并初始化或SFT warm-up的MOPD。

Conclusion: 有效的教师贡献可以在训练过程中渐进地确定；选择良好合并初始化时，不仅要评估其即时性能，还要评估其在MOPD下所促成的学习能力。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) combines independently developed domain teachers into a single student by distilling their predictions on student-generated samples. We study a setting where teachers share a reference model but undergo different post-training procedures, and find that MOPD can struggle to recover some teacher capabilities. Because distillation occurs on student-generated prefixes, the student initialization can strongly affect subsequent recovery. However, initial benchmark performance is not a reliable predictor of a good MOPD initialization. For example, merge initialization can start below SFT warm-up yet finish higher after MOPD. We further find that effective merging depends on both the relative teacher contributions and the overall merge scale, with some strong configurations lying outside the simplex of convex parameter averaging. Thus, selecting a good merge initialization requires evaluating not only its immediate performance but also the learning it enables under MOPD, making one-shot coefficient search difficult. We propose Iterative Merging for MOPD (IM-MOPD), which starts from a uniform merge and progressively adds task-vector increments for under-recovered domains during distillation. In a 5-domain setting, IM-MOPD achieves higher average normalized recovery than MOPD with either uniform merge initialization or SFT warm-up, showing that effective teacher contributions can be determined progressively during training.

</details>


### [947] [Gaussian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34825)
*Peter Kuhn,Victoria Heusinger-Heß*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出高斯神经网络（GaNN），将贝叶斯先验从权重空间扩展到激活空间，通过无监督损失预测前层激活的高斯噪声分布，实现新型正则化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准正则化技术从贝叶斯视角可视为对权重空间施加先验，而激活空间先验的研究相对空白。作者希望探索这一方向以获得更有效的正则化机制。

Method: 将前层激活视为带有高斯噪声的信号，并用额外的无监督损失预测该噪声分布的性质；训练时该无监督损失作为对意外激活的惩罚，从而允许在更不意外的方向上获得更大的权重更新。

Result: 在多种分类与回归任务上，GaNN 优于标准神经网络；同时作者考察了其量化不确定性的能力。

Conclusion: GaNN 通过在激活空间引入高斯先验，提供了一种有效的正则化机制，并在性能与不确定性量化方面展现出潜力。

Abstract: Gaussian neural networks (GaNNs) are proposed as a novel regularization mechanism for neural networks. From a Bayesian perspective standard regularization techniques can be viewed as imposing priors over weight-space. Assuming priors over activation-space remains a largely unexplored possibility. GaNNs assume such priors. They do this by treating activities from earlier layers like signals with Gaussian noise and predicting the properties of the noise distribution using an additional unsupervised loss. While training, the unsupervised loss acts as a penalty on unexpected activities, allowing greater weight updates in less surprising directions. The paper demonstrates the superiority of Gaussian neural networks over standard neural networks on a variety of classification and regression tasks. We also investigate the ability of GaNNs to quantify uncertainty.

</details>


### [948] [Attention-based Hierarchical Variational Information Bottleneck for Robust Multi-Agent Communication under Variable Bandwidth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34860)
*Lukas Koch Vindbjerg,Qi Zhang,Yury Brodskiy,Lukas Esterle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AH-VIB模型，在有限带宽下结合变分信息瓶颈、自回归消息生成与分层鲁棒损失，使前缀截断时消息仍部分可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限带宽多智能体通信不仅要决定"说什么"，还要组织消息结构，使部分传输（前缀截断）仍具信息价值。

Method: AH-VIB：基于注意力的自回归变分通信模型，融合VIB、顺序消息生成与分层鲁棒性损失。在定制的协同物体巡检与占据栅格建图任务上评估，对比MADDPG、CommNet、扁平VIB基线及自回归MLP消融。

Result: 在可变与固定带宽条件下，AH-VIB取得有竞争力的平均回报，并在最受限带宽下显著提升性能可靠性。

Conclusion: AH-VIB提升了带宽约束下学习通信的可靠性与优雅降级能力。

Abstract: Learning-based multi-agent communication under limited bandwidth does not only require deciding what to communicate, but also structuring messages so that partial transmissions remain useful. We study this problem under prefix truncation, where only the first part of each message is received. To address it, we propose \textbf{AH-VIB}, an attention-based autoregressive variational communication model that combines a variational information bottleneck (VIB) with sequential message generation and a hierarchical robustness loss. We evaluate AH-VIB on a custom cooperative object-inspection and occupancy-mapping task, where agents equipped with a limited field-of-view sensor coordinate to scan inspection objects in an occupancy-grid world, under variable and fixed bandwidth conditions, and compare it against MADDPG, CommNet, a flat VIB baseline, and an autoregressive MLP ablation. AH-VIB achieves competitive mean return while improving performance reliability under the most constrained bandwidth conditions.
  These results indicate that AH-VIB improves the reliability and graceful degradation of learned communication under bandwidth constraints.

</details>


### [949] [From Attention Sensitivity to Layer Role: Revisiting Mixed-Precision Quantization of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34866)
*Nafiseh HosseinpourFardi,Negar Alihadi,Mahmoudreza Babaei,Milad Hosseini,Adrian Weller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JAB将量化目标从单权重矩阵拟合改为对Q、K、V联合权重在真实因果掩码注意力输出上的损失，用于权重拟合与块级分配；该方法在Mistral-7B纯注意力量化中有效，但一旦MLP层参与分配便失效，而一个无需敏感度估计的角色感知偏移规则在全模型上更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练后量化流程通常逐矩阵将量化权重拟合到预训练对应权重，很少验证该代理目标是否真正反映注意力块的计算，以及Q、K、V投影误差在softmax内部如何累积。作者认为应直接以注意力输出为优化目标，并将该目标贯穿整个量化流程。

Method: 提出JAB：对一个块内联合的Q、K、V权重定义一个标量损失，直接针对该块真实因果掩码注意力输出评估。该损失被使用两次：一是用于拟合量化权重（GPTQ热启动，随后用带可学习scale的STE），二是用于为多选背包分配方案给块打分。此外提出一种无需敏感度估计的角色感知偏移规则，依据权重所处的矩阵角色进行比特分配。

Result: 在Mistral-7B纯注意力量化中，JAB在3比特下恢复了均匀GPTQ与全精度之间77–90%的差距，其敏感度估计与需73次前向的oracle相差不到一个百分点。引入MLP层参与分配后JAB失效：角色感知偏移规则在GPT-2的MLP和完整Mistral-7B上均优于JAB；在3比特下限下，该规则将96.4%权重以平均4.5比特/参数量化，困惑度6.933，在3.56倍压缩下距全精度6.643仅4.4%，而相同预算下JAB为7.158。此外，块局部重建是端到端困惑度的不可靠代理：一次运行中块自身目标改善4.6倍，困惑度却上升32倍。在纯注意力量化中，微调使权重远离预训练值、却把注意力输出拉近，并获得净增益。

Conclusion: 以注意力输出为目标的联合优化在纯注意力量化下有效，但难以推广到含MLP的完整模型；权重所处的矩阵角色比任何计算的敏感度估计都更重要。块局部重建不能可靠代理端到端性能，因此所有分配均需端到端验证。结果表明训练后量化似乎是在恢复注意力行为而非恢复权重本身。

Abstract: Most post-training quantization pipelines fit each weight matrix to its pretrained counterpart, one matrix at a time. Whether that proxy tracks what an attention block actually computes, or how errors in the Q, K and V projections compound inside the softmax, is rarely checked. We write the objective on the attention output instead, over all three projections at once, and reuse it throughout the pipeline. JAB defines one scalar loss over the joint Q, K, V weights of a block, evaluated against the block's real causally-masked attention output, and uses it twice: to fit the quantized weights (GPTQ warm start, then STE with learnable scales), and to score the block for a multiple-choice knapsack allocation.
  On attention-only quantization of Mistral-7B this works. At 3 bits JAB recovers 77-90% of the gap between uniform GPTQ and full precision, and its sensitivity estimate tracks an oracle costing 73 forward passes to within a fraction of a point. It stops working once MLP layers enter the allocation. A role-aware offset rule needing no sensitivity estimate at all beats JAB on GPT-2's MLP and on the full Mistral-7B model: with a 3-bit floor it quantizes 96.4% of the weights to 4.5 bits per parameter at 6.933 perplexity, within 4.4% of full precision (6.643) at 3.56x compression, against 7.158 for JAB at the same budget. Which matrix a weight sits in matters more than any sensitivity estimate we computed.
  Two things came out sideways. Block-local reconstruction is an unreliable proxy for end-to-end perplexity: one run improved a block's own objective 4.6x while perplexity rose 32x, which is why every allocation here is validated end-to-end. And on attention-only quantization, fine-tuning moved weights farther from their pretrained values while pulling attention outputs closer, with net gains. Post-training seems to recover attention behavior, not weights.

</details>


### [950] [Reference-Tail Trust:Certified Probability Floors for Learned Updates Inside a Deployed Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34904)
*Abdolvahab Khalili Sadaghiani,Jose Nunez-Yanez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Reference-Tail Trust（RTT）框架，在冻结GNN内部进行有约束的局部更新，并通过轨迹验证与独立检查器对实际服务的预测提供认证，实现有预算、可认证的GNN自适应推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN部署后需要利用改进的消息传递提升性能，但不能牺牲已可信预测的可控性；现有方法难以在修改内部计算的同时对最终服务预测给出保证。

Method: RTT将图基提案状态与受限内部优化器耦合：每次位移按其经剩余消息传递层后的最坏终端交叉熵增量计费；用轨迹验证管和独立检查器施加逐节点概率下限约束（p^s_ic ≥ e^{-H_row} p^r_ic）及调用级预算（Σ w_i D_∞(p^r_i‖p^s_i) ≤ H^+），并统一覆盖所有标签。通过注水法推导精确概率下限前沿，刻画架构受限效率，并给出内部传播可利用受限输出校正器无法获得证据的条件；认证通过则无需完整回滚，失败则整调用回退。

Result: 在ogbn-arxiv审计中，RTT每次调用平均增益6.5×10^-3 nats，单侧95%回归率上界0.95%，未检查保留节点集上的95%负翻转上界0.51%；平均增益为交叉拟合后验前沿估计的61%，比最强匹配单遍校正器高+0.9×10^-3 nats。实验覆盖八种提案、六类图基模型、结构与时间图偏移及分子预测，并补充图像与表格评估。

Conclusion: RTT将GNN自适应转化为有预算、可认证的推理决策，而非无条件的模型替换，在保持预测可信度的同时获得可量化增益。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) need to exploit improved message passing without surrendering control over predictions already trusted in deployment. We introduce Reference-Tail Trust (RTT), a framework that admits learned updates inside a frozen GNN and certifies the prediction actually served. RTT couples graph-based proposal states with a constrained internal optimizer: each displacement is charged for its worst-case terminal cross-entropy increase through the incumbent's remaining message-passing layers. A trajectory-validated tube and an independent checker enforce per-node probability floors, $p^{\mathrm{s}}_{ic} \ge e^{-H_{\mathrm{row}}} p^{\mathrm{r}}_{ic}$, and a call-level budget, $\sum_i w_i D_\infty(p^{\mathrm{r}}_i \| p^{\mathrm{s}}_i) \le H^+$, uniformly over labels. Calls whose adapted outputs pass certification require no separate full incumbent rollout; failed certificates trigger whole-call fallback. We derive the exact probability-floor frontier by water-filling, characterize architecture-constrained efficiency, and establish conditions under which internal propagation exploits evidence unavailable to restricted output correctors. In the reported ogbn-arxiv audit, RTT achieves $6.5\times 10^{-3}$ nats of mean gain per call, with a one-sided 95% regression-rate upper bound of 0.95% and a 95% negative-flip upper bound of 0.51% on the uninspected part of the reserved node population. Its mean gain is 61% of a cross-fitted posterior-based frontier estimate and exceeds the strongest matched one-pass corrector by $+0.9\times 10^{-3}$ nats. Reported experiments span eight proposals, six graph-incumbent families, structural and temporal graph shifts, and molecular prediction, with additional image and tabular evaluations. RTT makes GNN adaptation a budgeted, certifiable inference decision rather than an unconditional model replacement.

</details>


### [951] [Drug-Target Interaction Prediction via Hierarchical Sequential Cross-Attention over Chemical and Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34921)
*Khadidja Henni,Hamza Abdelali,Abdelkrim Aries,Neila Mezghani,Brigitte Vannier,Sara Magdouli,Lina Abou-Abbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种仅基于序列的DTI预测架构，结合ChemBERTa与ESM-2预训练语言模型及分层交互模块，在BIOSNAP、Davis、BindingDB上表现优异且参数量仅25.2M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于序列的DTI预测模型通常独立处理药物与蛋白，仅在预测后期融合表征，难以显式建模化学子结构与蛋白序列区域间的跨分子依赖关系。

Method: 采用ChemBERTa编码药物SMILES、ESM-2编码蛋白氨基酸序列提取上下文表征；用1D卷积层压缩局部序列模式；引入受诱导契合启发的双向交叉注意力机制；最后通过注意力池化构建固定尺寸的交互感知向量用于二分类预测。

Result: 在BIOSNAP上取得最佳性能，在Davis上匹配最佳AUROC，在BindingDB上保持竞争力，仅用25.2M可训练参数；消融实验证实CNN与交叉注意力模块的贡献，冷启动实验显示对未见蛋白和药物具有良好泛化能力。

Conclusion: 结合双预训练语言模型与分层交叉注意力交互模块的纯序列架构，能以较低参数量有效提升DTI预测性能与泛化性。

Abstract: Predicting Drug-Target Interactions~(DTIs) is a central task in computational drug discovery, with direct applications in virtual screening, drug repurposing, and therapeutic candidate prioritization. Although recent deep learning methods have improved DTI prediction, many sequence-based models still process drugs and proteins independently and only combine their representations at a late prediction stage. This limits their ability to explicitly model cross-molecular dependencies between chemical substructures and protein sequence regions. In this paper, we propose a sequence-only DTI prediction architecture that combines two pre-trained language models, ChemBERTa for drug SMILES strings and ESM-2 for protein amino acid sequences, with a hierarchical interaction module. The proposed model first extracts contextual representations using pre-trained encoders, then applies 1D convolutional layers to condense local sequence patterns, followed by a sequential bidirectional cross-attention mechanism inspired by the induced-fit view of molecular recognition. Finally, attention-based pooling constructs fixed-size interaction-aware vectors for binary prediction. Experiments on BIOSNAP, Davis, and BindingDB show that the proposed model achieves the best performance on BIOSNAP, matches the best AUROC on Davis, and remains competitive on BindingDB while using only 25.2 million trainable parameters. Ablation results confirm the contribution of both the CNN and cross-attention modules, and cold-start experiments indicate promising generalization to unseen proteins and drugs.

</details>


### [952] [Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint: A Stationarity Dichotomy for Recursive Self-Improvement in Agentic Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34924)
*Sebastian Bobadilla-Suarez,Bob Suh,Ryan Fortin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"平稳性二分法"(stationarity dichotomy)：当智能体可达的编辑集合固定时，迭代式自我修改必然陷入严格收益递减；只有该集合扩张才能突破上限。冻结权重只能保证最终天花板，无法保证过程中的平稳性。审计应针对"脚手架"(scaffold)而非检查点(checkpoint)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前审计实践聚焦于系统权重是否冻结，作者认为这是错误的检验对象。需要一个判据来区分三种常被混为一谈的机制：固定类内的搜索、提升天花板本身的测试时训练(test-time training)、以及居于两者之间的脚手架重写(scaffold rewriting)。

Method: 将"精化/改进(refinement)"解读为对草稿与目标之间残差误差的梯度提升，其中"补丁"即 git diff。随后定位该解读失效之处：(1) 补丁是组合(compose)而非相互并列以待投票;(2) 失败会重叠。通过对 SWE-bench 逐轮改进衰减、以及 401 个生产会话的 churn 几何衰减进行测量。另对 Best-of-k 编排、固定池重咨询、加权投票进行理论分析，并在 30 个同族 worker 上做失败重叠实证。

Result: Best-of-k 编排恰好实现最强 worker 的天花板，宽度只买速率不买预算；固定池重咨询存在可预先计算的地平线，仅由池本身决定。唯一能胜出的加权投票需要真实 worker 所缺乏的多样性：30 个同族 worker 上失败重叠达到最大值，多数投票在 23/55 (42%) 任务上失败。SWE-bench 上逐轮改进趋近于零，401 个生产会话 churn 几何衰减，其形态与一个前 AI 人类基线共享。

Conclusion: 两个失效点(补丁可组合、失败重叠)是工程选择而非关于代码的定律，因此它们共同指出了一个值得构建的 harness。审计重点应从检查点转向脚手架。

Abstract: An auditor who checks whether a system's weights are frozen is checking the wrong thing. Our stationarity dichotomy says that iterative self-modification hits strict diminishing returns whenever the agent's reachable set of edits stays fixed, and can escape only if that set expands. Rewriting scaffolding (tools, verifiers, decomposition) expands what an agent reaches without touching a weight, so frozen weights buy an eventual ceiling but no stationarity along the way. The criterion also separates three regimes usually merged: search within a fixed class, test-time training that raises the ceiling itself, and scaffold rewriting between them. Audit the scaffold, not the checkpoint.
  The same ceiling binds sideways. Best-of-$k$ orchestration realizes the best worker's ceiling exactly: width buys rate, not budget. Re-consulting a fixed pool has a horizon computable in advance, decided by the pool alone, and the one arrangement that would beat it, a weighted vote, needs diversity real workers lack: on 30 same-family workers the failure overlap sits at its maximum, and a majority fails 23/55 (42%) of tasks.
  We obtain the criterion by reading refinement as gradient boosting on the residual error between draft and target, a patch or git diff, and then measuring where that reading breaks: patches compose instead of standing beside each other to be voted on, and failures overlap. What we measure is saturation. Per-round improvement decays toward zero on SWE-bench, and churn decays geometrically across 401 production sessions, a shape shared with a pre-AI human baseline that establishes the regime without identifying its cause. Both breaks are engineering choices rather than laws about code, so together they specify a harness worth building.

</details>


### [953] [Cyclostationary Phase Conditioning for Medical Time Series Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34965)
*Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Michele Copetti,Jorge da Silva Goncalves,Sonia Laguna,Julia E. Vogt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对具有循环平稳性的生理时间序列（心电、脑电等），提出在扩散模型中显式编码循环结构的归纳偏置：平移协变小波表示与基于受损输入的逐样本稠密相位条件，并引入免训练循环平稳性指标及反向轨迹对偶耦合采样策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生理时间序列普遍存在循环平稳性（统计量随潜在周期相位周期性变化）。运动伪影、接触不良与生理干扰会破坏诊断所需形态，因此信号恢复至关重要。现有扩散方法仅以受损观测为条件，需隐式学习周期结构，效率与效果受限。

Method: 提出两种编码循环平稳性的归纳偏置：一是平移协变小波表示，二是从受损输入推断的逐样本稠密相位条件；引入免训练的循环平稳性指数，用于量化相位结构并预测相位条件何时有效；并提出反向轨迹对偶耦合以降低采样方差。

Result: 对偶耦合在采样方差降低的同时，以约五分之一的网络评估次数达到相当性能；跨多种模态的实验表明，显式编码可测的循环结构能提升生理时间序列恢复效果。

Conclusion: 显式建模可测量的周期性结构优于依赖模型隐式学习，是提升生理时间序列扩散恢复的有效途径，且该思路可跨模态推广。

Abstract: Many physiological time series, such as cardiac and brain recordings, exhibit cyclostationarity: their statistics vary periodically with an underlying cycle phase. Corruption from motion, poor contact, and physiological interference obscures morphology needed for diagnosis, making signal restoration essential. Existing diffusion approaches condition on corrupted observations alone and must learn cyclic structure implicitly. We instead propose two inductive biases which encode cyclostationarity: a shift-covariant wavelet representation and dense per-sample phase conditioning inferred from the corrupted input. We further introduce a training-free cyclostationarity index that quantifies phase structure and predicts when phase conditioning will help. Finally, we propose antithetic coupling of reverse trajectories to reduce sampling variance while achieving comparable performance with fivefold fewer network evaluations. Across modalities, our results show that explicitly encoding measurable cyclic structure improves physiological time-series restoration.

</details>


### [954] [Composable Decoding on the Probability Simplex: Theory and Implementation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34992)
*Xiaotong Ji,Ahmed Khaled Khamis,Rasul Tutunov,Matthieu Zimmer,Haitham Bou-Ammar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将解码形式化为概率单纯形上带支撑约束的正则化优化问题，统一已有采样方法并支持组合式新解码器，提出CompoSimplex库并验证组合解码可在单样本质量、多样本质量与多样性间实现新权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型解码多被视为孤立采样策略的集合，缺乏对其诱导行为及内在目标关系的理论理解，也缺少统一框架来构造新解码器（不依赖外部奖励、学习型critic或模型更新）。

Method: 在next-token分布的概率单纯形上构建优化问题：平衡期望模型得分与正则项，并施加支撑（support）约束。通过选择不同正则化器与支撑约束可还原已有解码方法；进一步在同一优化问题中组合多种分布偏好以构造组合解码器。实现CompoSimplex库，提供可配置支撑规则、正则化原语与单纯形求解器，用于构建与评估组合解码器。

Result: 在多个模型与推理任务上评测标准采样器、单一正则化器及其组合，结果显示组合解码能够实现单样本质量、多样本质量与多样性之间的权衡，而单一解码目标无法达到这些权衡。

Conclusion: 解码可统一为单纯形上的约束正则化优化，该视角既解释已有方法又支持组合式新解码器；组合目标可拓展解码性能的权衡前沿，CompoSimplex为该类研究提供可复用的构建与评测基础设施。

Abstract: Decoding for large language models is typically treated as a collection of isolated sampling strategies, with limited theoretical understanding of the behaviours they induce and how their underlying objectives relate. We formulate decoding as an optimisation problem over next-token distributions on the probability simplex, balancing expected model score against regularisation under support constraints. This view recovers familiar decoding methods through choices of regularisers and support constraints; more importantly, it enables new decoders to be constructed by composing distributional preferences within a single optimisation problem without external rewards, learned critics, or model parameter updates. We introduce CompoSimplex, a library with configurable support rules, regularisation primitives, and simplex solvers for constructing and evaluating compositional decoders. We evaluate standard samplers, individual regularisers, and compositions across multiple models and reasoning tasks. Our results show that compositions can realise trade-offs between single-sample quality, multi-sample quality, and diversity that are not attained by individual decoding objectives.

</details>


### [955] [Addressing Spatial Indistinguishability in Spatiotemporal Prediction via Optimal Transport-Guided Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35021)
*Guangyu Wang,Jiawei Tong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自监督框架STOT，利用最优传输引导的结构化掩码解决时空预测中的"空间不可区分性"问题，在六个真实数据集上达到有竞争力的性能并提升可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空预测的核心挑战是"空间不可区分性"：不同节点可能具有相似的历史模式，却朝着发散的未来演化，导致真实传感器网络中的预测性能严重下降。现有基于嵌入和GNN的方法虽能部分检测此类歧义节点，但依赖历史相似性，难以捕捉"未来行为的分化"。

Method: 提出STOT（时空最优传输）自监督框架，将不可区分性视为"消歧"问题：通过同时利用并发的空间相关性及其时变相似性来推断未来状态。具体设计包括：面向动态节点间关系的相似性感知度量；基于最优传输的掩码策略，在预训练中强化歧义位置；批一致性约束以保持语义连贯；以及随机游走掩码机制以促进结构化上下文探索。

Result: 在六个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，STOT在所评估的基准上与最先进基线相比具有竞争力，并通过传输方案可视化提升了可解释性。

Conclusion: STOT通过最优传输引导的结构化掩码，有效缓解了时空预测中的空间不可区分性，兼顾了预测性能与模型可解释性。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal prediction aims to learn discriminative representations from correlated temporal signals over spatial structures for accurate future inference. A central challenge is \emph{spatial indistinguishability}: different nodes may share similar historical patterns yet evolve toward divergent futures, severely degrading forecasting performance in real-world sensor networks. Existing embedding-based and graph neural network (GNN)-based approaches can partially detect such ambiguous nodes but rely on historical similarity, struggling to capture \emph{future behavioral divergence}. We propose \textbf{STOT} (\textbf{S}patio\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{O}ptimal \textbf{T}ransport), a self-supervised framework that resolves spatiotemporal ambiguity via structured masking guided by optimal transport. Our key idea treats indistinguishability as a \emph{disambiguation} problem: future states are inferred by exploiting concurrent spatial correlations and their time-varying similarity. We design a similarity-aware metric for dynamic inter-node relationships and an optimal transport-based masking strategy to emphasize ambiguous positions during pre-training. A batch consistency constraint preserves semantic coherence, while a random-walk masking mechanism promotes structured context exploration. Experiments on six real-world datasets show that STOT performs competitively with state-of-the-art baselines on the evaluated benchmarks and improved interpretability through transport-plan visualizations.

</details>


### [956] [BA-DPO: Bias-Adjusted Direct Preference Optimization for Language Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35044)
*Antonio Ferrara,Alberto Rumi,Francesco Bonchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Bias-Adjusted DPO (BA-DPO)，为每个标注者引入一个针对被声明属性的偏置参数，证明目标函数对偏置参数凸且投票可辨识偏置（至多差一个共享常数），该常数决定对齐模型的属性出现率，可用于对齐参考模型或实现统计平价。在植入偏差语料上，DPO 将属性概率从均衡推至 0.96，BA-DPO 消除 81–95% 的偏移；在 MultiPref 真实标注上消除约一半的 DPO 长度膨胀，且在 0.5B 全量微调与 8B LoRA 下均成立，KL 不高于 DPO 且评判质量无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于偏好的对齐方法（如 DPO）依赖人类标注者的成对偏好数据来微调语言模型，但标注者会对某些属性（性别或族裔线索的名字、人格设定、语言变体、格式惯例、长度等）存在系统性偏置。若不加以处理，这些系统性偏置会在对齐过程中被吸收并放大。现有方法仅针对长度偏置或标注者分歧，无法消除对任意属性的偏置，因此需要一种能够泛化处理任意声明属性的去偏方法。

Method: 提出 Bias-Adjusted DPO (BA-DPO)，是 DPO 的推广：为每个标注者引入一个偏置参数，作用于携带被声明属性的回复。理论上证明目标函数对偏置参数是凸的，且投票能够识别每个标注者的偏置（仅相差一个共享常数）。该剩余常数决定对齐模型的属性出现率：默认设为参考模型的属性率，或设定目标率——作者用后者将带偏策略推向统计平价。方法在 0.5B（全量微调）与 8B（LoRA）规模上验证。

Result: 在植入偏差的语料上，DPO 使属性概率从均衡起点被推至 0.96，而 BA-DPO 消除其中 81%–95% 的偏移；在含真实标注者的 MultiPref 上，BA-DPO 消除约一半的 DPO 长度膨胀。上述效果在 0.5B 全量微调与 8B LoRA 下均成立，且 KL 散度不高于 DPO，评判质量无损失。

Conclusion: BA-DPO 通过为每个标注者引入属性偏置参数，将 DPO 推广至可处理任意声明属性的系统性偏置，并在理论上给出凸性与偏置可辨识性保证；剩余共享常数可控制对齐模型的属性出现率，从而支持对齐参考模型或将带偏策略校正至统计平价。实验表明其在合成与真实数据上均能显著削减 DPO 引入的属性偏移与长度膨胀，同时保持与 DPO 相当的 KL 与生成质量。

Abstract: Preference-based alignment methods such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) use pairwise preferences labeled by human annotators to fine-tune language models. However, annotators carry systematic biases toward some attributes: a name that signals a gender or an ethnicity, a persona, a language variety, a formatting convention, or length. If not properly addressed, these systematic biases can be absorbed and amplified during alignment. Existing methods address length bias or annotator disagreement, but fail to eliminate biases toward arbitrary attributes. To address this limitation, we propose Bias-Adjusted DPO (BA-DPO), a generalization of DPO that adds one bias parameter per annotator toward responses carrying a declared attribute. We prove that the objective is convex in the bias parameters and that the votes identify each annotator's bias up to a shared constant. The remaining constant is what fixes the aligned model's attribute rate: by default the rate of the reference model, or a target rate, which we use to bring a biased policy to statistical parity. On a corpus with planted biases, DPO drives the attribute from a balanced start to probability 0.96 and BA-DPO removes 81 to 95\% of that shift; on MultiPref with real annotators it removes about half of DPO's lengthening. Both hold at 0.5B with full fine-tuning and at 8B with LoRA, at no higher KL than DPO and no loss in judged quality.

</details>


### [957] [TIDE: Teacher-Student Transition via Informative Distillation and Exploration for Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35058)
*Yibin Huang,Xinming Xu,Conghui Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出TIDE，一种在多轮智能体训练中动态协调在线策略蒸馏（OPD）与强化学习（RL）的方法，通过全局退火调度与局部逐轮分配，缓解固定混合比例带来的探索受限与策略漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体需要在长时域上协调信息收集、动作与反馈，而GRPO等算法因轨迹级奖励稀疏，导致小模型早期探索不足。近期方法引入更强教师的在线策略蒸馏，但采用固定的蒸馏-奖励混合比例，隐含假设教师指导与奖励优化在训练全程及各轮次中保持恒定相对作用。该假设在两个尺度上失效：全局上，持续强蒸馏会限制模型超越教师能力；局部上，师生分歧只能反映学生偏离教师，却无法区分这种偏离是有更优结果支撑的探索，还是低质量的策略漂移。

Method: 作者的核心洞见是教师指导与奖励优化应在训练过程中动态再平衡，并在各轮次间联合分配。TIDE据此实现：全局层面，以测得的师生分歧趋势作为调度信号，当分歧下降变慢但仍为正时推进从OPD到RL的交接，并逐步提高RL的相对权重；局部层面，联合调制教师引导更新与奖励驱动更新——用相对动作价值与分歧来确定OPD信号优先级，用相对动作价值提供RL优势，并用归一化分歧在轮次间对其重加权。与全局交接耦合后，TIDE在训练早期给予更强教师指导，后期让奖励驱动更新占更大相对权重。

Result: 在多个基准、不同学生模型规模以及受控消融实验中，TIDE的自适应OPD-RL协调均表现出有效性。

Conclusion: 固定混合比例的OPD与RL结合方式存在全局与局部双重局限，TIDE通过以分歧趋势驱动的全局交接和逐轮联合加权的局部调制，实现了随训练进程与轮次自适应的OPD-RL再平衡，从而提升多轮智能体的训练效果。

Abstract: Effective multi-turn agents require interaction strategies that coordinate information gathering, actions, and feedback over long horizons. GRPO is a reinforcement learning algorithm used to train these agents, but sparse trajectory-level rewards limit early exploration in small models. Recent methods augment RL with on-policy distillation (OPD) from a stronger teacher. However, a fixed mixture assumes that teacher guidance and reward optimization should retain a constant relative role throughout training and across interaction turns. This assumption can fail at two scales. Globally, as training progresses, maintaining strong distillation pressure can constrain the model from moving beyond the teacher's capabilities. Locally, teacher--student disagreement identifies where the student departs from the teacher, but cannot tell whether that departure is exploration supported by better outcomes or low-quality policy drift. Our methodological insight is that teacher guidance and reward optimization should be dynamically rebalanced over training and jointly allocated across turns. We instantiate this insight in \tide. Globally, \tide uses the measured disagreement trend as a practical schedule signal, advancing an OPD-to-RL handoff when discrepancy reduction becomes slow but remains positive and progressively increasing the relative weight of RL. Locally, \tide jointly modulates teacher-guided and reward-driven updates: relative action value and disagreement prioritize the OPD signal, whereas relative action value supplies the RL advantage and normalized disagreement reweights it across turns. Coupled with the global handoff, \tide allocates stronger teacher guidance early and gives reward-driven updates greater relative weight later in training. Experiments across multiple benchmarks, student scales, and controlled ablations support the effectiveness of TIDE's adaptive OPD--RL coordination.

</details>


### [958] [SpikeLite: Lightweight Spiking Neural Networks for Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35097)
*Bang Hu,Changze Lv,Mingjie Li,Xiaoqing Zheng,Wei cao,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SpikeLite是一个轻量脉冲神经网络预测框架，通过频率选择性脉冲编码器（FSSE）与稀疏脉冲通道注意力（SSCA）实现高效时间序列预测，在多个基准上取得最优综合性能并显著降低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期SNN预测器为提升精度不断引入复杂注意力机制或特殊神经元动力学，削弱了SNN轻量化的初衷。本文旨在保持轻量性的前提下提升预测性能。

Method: 提出SpikeLite框架，包含两个模块：(1) 频率选择性脉冲编码器（FSSE），利用LIF动力学的低通滤波特性将输入序列重组为频率敏感分量，并在分解阶段整体保留输入；(2) 稀疏脉冲通道注意力（SSCA），从编码后的通道表示学习二值掩码，在脉冲驱动的自注意力中选择性交换跨通道信息，抑制冗余交互。当无需显式通道交互时采用仅FSSE的通道独立轻量路径。

Result: 在SeqSNN与SpikF两种协议下，覆盖4个标准多变量和8个长期预测基准。SpikeLite在两种协议下均取得最佳综合性能，平均R²为0.790、RSE为0.440；长期预测中最低平均MSE/MAE为0.343/0.345。在ECL数据集上实现已报道的最低能耗。

Conclusion: SpikeLite以轻量脉冲驱动设计在保持能效优势的同时实现领先的预测精度，验证了其在节能时间序列预测中的潜力。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient paradigm for time-series forecasting through spike-driven computation. However, recent SNN forecasters often pursue higher accuracy through increasingly complex attention mechanisms, or specialized neuronal dynamics, weakening the lightweight motivation of SNNs. We introduce SpikeLite, a spiking forecasting framework built around two modules: a Frequency-Selective Spiking Encoder (FSSE) for frequency-sensitive temporal encoding and a Sparse Spiking Channel Attention (SSCA) module for selective cross-channel interaction. FSSE exploits the low-pass filtering behavior of LIF dynamics to reorganize each input sequence into frequency-sensitive components while collectively preserving the input at the decomposition stage. SSCA then learns a binary mask from encoded channel representations and uses it to selectively exchange information within spike-driven self-attention, retaining informative cross-channel interactions while suppressing redundant ones. When explicit channel interaction is unnecessary, SpikeLite uses the lighter FSSE-only channel-independent path. Experiments under the SeqSNN and SpikF protocols cover four standard multivariate and eight long-term forecasting benchmarks. SpikeLite achieves the best aggregate performance under both protocols, with an average $R^2$ of 0.790 and RSE of 0.440, and lowest average MSE/MAE of 0.343/0.345 in long-term forecasting. Moreover, evaluation on the ECL dataset shows that SpikeLite achieves the lowest reported energy consumption, further demonstrating its potential for energy-efficient time-series forecasting.

</details>


### [959] [CTP-FL: Common-Trajectory Gradient Prediction for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35130)
*Junkang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CTP-FL：客户端在共享预测路径上评估全局目标的梯度并取平均上传，实现通信高效且聚合方向可解释为全局梯度估计的联邦优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有本地更新方法在异构数据下各客户端模型在不同位置评估梯度，导致聚合更新难以解释为全局目标的梯度。

Method: 每轮所有客户端由当前全局模型与上一轮聚合方向构造相同查询点序列，沿该序列评估K个随机梯度并上传平均，服务器执行单次全局更新；每客户端K个小批量梯度、每方向一个模型大小向量。

Result: 共享查询点使聚合方向成为沿预测路径的平均全局梯度的无偏估计；路径长度控制与当前模型梯度的偏差，无需有界客户端梯度差异或有界梯度假设；对光滑非凸目标在全参与下得到O(√(LΔσ²/(NKR))+LΔ/R)的平均稳定性界。

Conclusion: 分析揭示可检验的权衡：延长预测路径提供更多前瞻梯度信息但增大了位移偏差。

Abstract: Communication-efficient federated optimization commonly spends several
  gradient evaluations between server updates. Existing local-update
  methods use this computation to advance an independent model on each
  client. Under heterogeneous data, however, these models evaluate
  gradients at different locations, making the aggregated update
  difficult to interpret as a gradient of the global objective.
  We study an alternative use of the same computation budget:
  \emph{evaluate the global objective along a shared, predicted path}.
  We propose Common-Trajectory Predictive Federated Learning
  (\texttt{CTP-FL}). At each round, all clients construct the same
  sequence of query points from the current global model and the
  previous aggregated direction, evaluate $K$ stochastic gradients
  along this sequence, and upload their average. The server then
  performs a single global update. Thus, \texttt{CTP-FL} uses $K$
  mini-batch gradients per client and one model-sized vector in each
  communication direction, matching the per-round computation and
  communication of full-participation FedAvg-M.
  Shared query points make the aggregated direction an unbiased
  estimator of the average \emph{global} gradient along the predicted
  path. The remaining discrepancy from the gradient at the current
  model is controlled by the path length, without assuming bounded
  client-gradient dissimilarity or bounded gradients. For smooth
  non-convex objectives, we establish an
  $\mathcal{O}\!\left(
  \sqrt{LΔσ^2/(NKR)}+LΔ/R
  \right)$
  average-stationarity bound under full participation. The analysis
  isolates a testable trade-off: extending the prediction path provides
  more forward-looking gradient information but increases its
  displacement bias.

</details>


### [960] [Learning to Re-Draft: A Variational Stackelberg Game for Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35166)
*Dmitrii Moor,Federico Tomasi,Paul N. Bennett,Alice Wang,Mounia Lalmas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出变分Stackelberg离散扩散（VSDD），将离散扩散的加噪（腐蚀）过程建模为可学习的leader-follower博弈，从而使去噪器能更好地进行"重草稿"式的token修正。该框架在分子、文本和歌单生成任务上均取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型的核心优势在于可以在生成过程中重新起草、修正早期token，而这一能力取决于前向腐蚀过程（forward corruption）的定义。掩码扩散一旦取消掩码就固定token、无法修改；均匀扩散虽允许修改，但仅依赖均匀随机的token替换，缺乏语义针对性。因此需要一种能够学习"哪些替换对训练去噪器最有价值"的、具备语义感知的腐蚀过程。

Method: 提出VSDD框架，将训练形式化为leader-follower博弈：leader定义由去噪器token嵌入参数化的马尔可夫腐蚀过程；follower在腐蚀过程固定的条件下优化变分去噪目标。leader依据"去噪器学习后的提升幅度"给予奖励，而非依据当前去噪器重建的难易程度。具体地，在固定参考腐蚀过程下度量该提升，用一步梯度更新近似follower响应，并用score-function估计器优化leader。

Result: VSDD在分子、文本和歌单生成任务上进行了评估。相比均匀扩散与掩码扩散，VSDD显著提升了分子有效性；在文本任务上相对均匀扩散降低了困惑度，并与掩码扩散保持竞争力；在离线歌单推荐指标上取得可观提升。

Conclusion: 通过学习语义感知的腐蚀过程，VSDD将离散扩散的"重草稿"能力转化为可训练目标，在多个领域验证了其有效性，为超越固定（掩码/均匀）腐蚀范式的离散扩散训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models offer the ability to re-draft, revisiting and correcting earlier tokens throughout generation. This capability depends on the forward corruption process that defines what the denoiser learns to correct. Masked diffusion models fix tokens once they are unmasked, while uniform diffusion permits revisions but relies on uniformly random token substitutions. We instead learn which substitutions are most useful for training the denoiser to re-draft. We introduce Variational Stackelberg Discrete Diffusion (VSDD), a framework for learning a semantically aware corruption process. VSDD formulates training as a leader-follower game: the leader defines a Markovian corruption process parameterized by the denoiser's token embeddings, while the follower optimizes a variational denoising objective with the corruption process held fixed. The leader rewards corruptions based on how much the denoiser improves after learning from them, rather than on how easily the current denoiser can reconstruct them. We measure this improvement under a fixed reference corruption process, approximate the follower's response with a one-step gradient update, and optimize the leader using a score-function estimator. We evaluate VSDD across molecular, text, and playlist generation. VSDD substantially improves molecular validity over uniform and masked diffusion, reduces text perplexity relative to uniform diffusion while remaining competitive with masked diffusion, and achieves sizable improvements in offline playlist recommendation metrics.

</details>


### [961] [QAM: Quadratic-Accurate Checkpoint Merging via Sequential Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35168)
*Shihao Wang,Rui Kong,Xinran Chen,Hui Wu,Qipeng Qian,Jinman Zhao,Jiashu Zhao,Yuchen Li,Jimmy Huang,Dawei Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究仅凭训练轨迹上保存的检查点能否重构"顺序参考"的终点，刻画了可达精度极限，并提出达到最优阶的 Quadratic-Accurate Merging (QAM) 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保存的检查点只记录了某一训练轨迹上的状态，一般无法确定在不同调度下会访问到的状态的更新量。作者希望搞清楚：仅用这些检查点，能以多高的精度重构按给定更新强度执行的"顺序参考"（sequential reference）的终点，并给出可达最优速率的系数规则。

Method: 在常见局部转移模型下，导出两个"检查点指标矩条件"，刻画所有与该顺序参考在二阶意义下一致的凸合并。据此证明信息极限：对非退化 profile，任何仅使用固定长度、步长 h 的 GD 历史的算法，在一类光滑强凸损失上都无法一致达到 o(h^3) 的终点误差；下界构造源于两个具有相同 GD 检查点历史但顺序参考终点相差 Ω(h^3) 的损失。提出 Quadratic-Accurate Merging (QAM)，其显式系数给出唯一与顺序 GD 参考在所有固定二次目标上精确匹配的 profile 相关合并。

Result: QAM 达到匹配的均匀 O(h^3) 终点误差上界。在两个公开 Adam 检查点轨迹（SmolLM3-3B、OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B）、每模型三个窗口与三种 profile、共 15 个任务上：短窗口结果参差，长窗口相对 Warmup-Stable and Merge (WSM) 总体占优。匹配矩的 GSM8K 诊断表明，仅局部一致性并不能完全决定下游得分。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了已保存训练历史的可重构性极限，给出了达到最优误差阶的系数规则，并评估了其实际效用：QAM 在长窗口合并中优于 WSM，但局部矩一致性不足以保证下游性能。

Abstract: Saved checkpoints record states along a training trajectory, but generally do not determine the updates at states that would be visited under a different schedule. We study how accurately these checkpoints can reconstruct the endpoint of a sequential reference with prescribed update strengths. Under a common local transition model, two checkpoint-index moment conditions characterize all convex merges that agree with this reference through second order. We then prove an information limit that for nondegenerate profiles, no algorithm using only a fixed-length gradient-descent (GD) history with step size $h$ can achieve $o(h^3)$ endpoint error uniformly over a fixed class of smooth, strongly convex losses. The lower bound follows from two losses with identical GD checkpoint histories but sequential reference endpoints separated by $Ω(h^3)$. \textbf{Quadratic-Accurate Merging} (QAM) achieves a matching uniform $O(h^3)$ endpoint error bound. Its explicit coefficients also define the unique profile-dependent merge that exactly matches the sequential GD reference across all fixed quadratic objectives. Across two public Adam checkpoint trajectories (SmolLM3-3B and OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B), three windows and three profiles per model, and 15 tasks, QAM shows mixed results for short windows and broader advantages over \textbf{Warmup-Stable and Merge} (WSM) for longer windows. Matched-moment GSM8K diagnostics further show that local consistency alone does not fully determine downstream scores. These results characterize the reconstruction limits of saved histories, provide a coefficient rule that attains the optimal rate, and assess its practical utility.

</details>


### [962] [Multi-Attractor GNNs: Set-Valued Expressivity Beyond Unique Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35274)
*Jialin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种权重共享的消息传递GNN，通过多重平衡点实现集值等变映射：不同初始化收敛到不同有效解，无需节点标识符或解标签即可学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归与平衡GNN通常强制唯一不动点或对每个图使用单一训练目标。但许多组合与科学问题存在多个同等有效的解，指定单一目标会引入任意的选择规则。此外，对节点重标号不变的任务中，对称图可能有对称的解集却不存在对称解，唯一解假设无法覆盖此类情形。

Method: 方法上，作者构造全局Lipschitz、置换等变的动力学，证明其几乎必然收敛到有效解，并以正概率到达每个解分支。随后用连续分量图的递归消息传递实现近似刻画，更新误差与极限误差可任意小、成功概率可任意高。关键在于：虽然单纯消息传递无法区分对称节点，但演化状态在每一步有限步内保持节点可区分，且无需辅助节点标识符。训练使用问题特定的能量函数，无需解标签。

Result: 在Ising基态、蛋白质图的结构模块检测以及化学反应稳态三类任务上，所学更新均产生多个高质量预测，数值收敛率高。平均解质量优于所测试的唯一平衡、单目标和前馈基线，并与规模大得多的基于扩散的求解器保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 多重平衡使单个权重共享的消息传递GNN能够表示集值等变映射，突破标准通用逼近论证的局限；借助问题特定能量即可无标签学习，并在多类科学与组合任务上取得优于基线的解质量。

Abstract: Recurrent and equilibrium graph neural networks (GNNs) often enforce a unique fixed point or use one training target per graph. Yet many combinatorial and scientific problems admit multiple valid solutions, with no preferred one. A designated target can then impose an arbitrary selection rule. For tasks invariant to node relabeling, a symmetric graph may have a symmetric solution set but no symmetric solution.
  We show that multiple equilibria enable one weight-tied message-passing GNN to represent set-valued equivariant maps: different initializations approach different valid solutions. Under stated regularity assumptions, we first construct globally Lipschitz, permutation-equivariant dynamics that converge almost surely to valid solutions and reach every solution branch with positive probability. We then establish approximate realization by recurrent message passing with continuous component maps, with arbitrarily small update and limiting errors and arbitrarily high probability. This goes beyond standard universality arguments: although message passing alone cannot distinguish symmetric nodes, the evolving state keeps nodes distinguishable at every finite step without auxiliary node identifiers. Such dynamics can be learned without solution labels using problem-specific energies. On Ising ground states, structural module detection in protein graphs, and chemical reaction steady states, the learned updates produce multiple high-quality predictions with high numerical convergence rates. They achieve better average solution quality than the tested unique-equilibrium, single-target, and feedforward baselines, while remaining competitive with much larger diffusion-based solvers.

</details>


### [963] [Teacher-Student Gaps Are Not Enough: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35319)
*Tong Zhang,Zhou Liu,Yihao Liu,Jiahua Bao,Xuchen Li,Honglin Lin,Tao Cheng,Zhihan Yu,Kai Tang,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD)，通过轨迹相对加权与最终任务结果校准教师监督，解决 token 级分布差距与监督收益不匹配的问题，在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上任务成功率较 vanilla OPD 提升 3.6–17.7 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多轮自主智能体的 on-policy distillation (OPD) 常将教师-学生 token 级分布差距视为需要干预的信号，认为差距越大越需纠正。但作者实证发现“监督收益错配”：大差距可能是良性的，小差距却可能决定任务成败。原因是差距只反映当前轮次的差异，而教师指导的价值取决于学生后续与环境交互的结果——学生可能选错动作仍成功，也可能选了教师偏好动作却进入无法完成任务的状态。因此仅凭局部差距无法判断教师指导是否对学生有益。

Method: 提出 Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD)：对教师监督施加轨迹相对加权 (trajectory-relative weighting)，并利用配对的学生续接 (paired student continuations) 的最终任务结果来校准权重。该校准在学生原始轨迹的特定轮次上有选择地加强监督，仅保留能被当前学生转化为更优最终任务结果的教师指导。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 三个环境、多种设置下，OG-OPD 一致优于基线；任务成功率较 vanilla OPD 提升 3.6–17.7 个百分点，较最强基线最高提升 7.0 个百分点。

Conclusion: 教师-学生局部差距不足以决定监督价值，应以学生能否将指导转化为更优最终任务结果为准。OG-OPD 通过结果校准的轨迹相对加权实现有效监督，并在多环境多设置下取得稳定且显著的性能提升。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense teacher supervision. Recent work on OPD for multi-turn autonomous agents often treats large teacher-student token-level distributional gaps as promising intervention points, linking larger gaps to a greater need for correction. Yet, our empirical analysis reveals a supervision-benefit mismatch: large gaps can be benign, while small gaps can be outcome-critical. Teacher-student gaps capture differences at the current turn, whereas the benefit of teacher guidance depends on how the current student interacts with the environment afterward. The student may still succeed despite choosing an action that differs from the teacher's, while a teacher-preferred action may lead to a state from which the student cannot complete the task. Local gaps alone are therefore not enough to determine whether teacher guidance benefits the current student. Effective supervision should instead emphasize guidance that the current student can translate into better final task outcomes. Accordingly, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD), which applies trajectory-relative weighting to teacher supervision and calibrates these weights using final task outcomes from paired student continuations. This calibration selectively strengthens supervision on the student's original trajectories at turns where teacher guidance benefits the current student. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, OG-OPD consistently outperforms baselines under diverse settings. It improves task success rates by 3.6-17.7 percentage points over vanilla OPD and by up to 7.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [964] [Large Language Models for Automated Cross-Domain Machine Learning Task Type Identification: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35335)
*Petros Tsialis,Steffen Limmer,Tobias Rodemann,Martin Heckmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究利用大语言模型（LLM）在仅提供目标特征的情况下，从数据集级信息直接推断数据域与下游预测任务类型，并发布包含625个公开表格与时间序列数据集的标注基准。实验表明LLM方法在表格任务上优于AutoGluon（0.98 vs 0.93 F1 macro），跨域场景最佳模型达0.90，本地小模型达0.75。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习任务类型识别对构建有效的ML流水线至关重要，但实践中通常依赖人工指定。作者希望验证LLM能否自动完成该识别，以降低人工依赖并提升流水线构建的自动化程度。

Method: 提出基于LLM的系统，在用户仅提供目标特征时，从数据集级信息推断数据域和下游预测任务类型。构建并发布包含625个公开表格与时间序列数据集的标注基准。在三种设定下评估：(i) 表格数据集对比既有AutoML启发式方法；(ii) 表格与时间序列数据集间的跨域评估；(iii) 使用更小本地模型的落地部署场景。

Result: LLM方法在表格场景中优于AutoGluon，达到0.98 F1 macro（AutoGluon为0.93）。跨域场景最佳模型达0.90 F1 macro；可本地部署的小模型达0.75，体现出部署可行性与准确率之间的权衡。异构与资源受限场景难度递增。

Conclusion: LLM在任务类型识别上具有一致优势，尤其相比传统AutoML启发式方法；但跨域和本地小模型部署会带来性能下降，需在准确率与部署可行性间权衡。发布的标注基准为该方向提供了评估基础。

Abstract: Machine learning task type identification is essential for constructing valid ML pipelines, yet in practice it is typically specified manually. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can infer both the data domain and the downstream prediction task directly from dataset-level information when only the target feature is provided by the user. Together with our LLM-based system we also release an annotated benchmark comprising 625 public tabular and time series datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach in three settings: (i) tabular datasets in comparison with established AutoML heuristics, (ii) cross-domain evaluation across tabular and time series datasets, and (iii) a practical deployment scenario using smaller local models. The results show consistent advantages for LLM-based task type identification, with increasing difficulty in heterogeneous and resource-constrained settings. LLM-based approaches outperform AutoGluon in the tabular setting, reaching 0.98 F1 macro compared to 0.93. In the cross-domain setting, the best model achieves 0.90 F1 macro, while smaller locally deployable models reach 0.75, indicating a trade-off between deployment feasibility and accuracy.

</details>


### [965] [From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35348)
*Simon Klüttermann,Xueying Ding,Leman Akoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRODiGI 是一个预训练的数据到程序（data-to-program）模型，单次前向即可从有限样本推断出可执行的生成程序，实现快速、可解释的表格生成建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从有限样本估计概率密度通常需要针对每个数据集进行专门的模型拟合，缺乏通用性和效率。

Method: PRODiGI 在"合成数据集-真值程序"配对数据上预训练，通过模板预测与非自回归程序参数解码，支持多样生成族与数据维度；推断出的程序可独立于预训练模型进行采样、密度/score 评估与检查。此外提出程序空间微调，在保持模型参数不变的前提下，通过匹配生成样本与经验样本精调可微程序参数。

Result: 相比现有预训练模型，PRODiGI 取得更低的平均密度 MAE 与 score MAE，并对最接近的竞争对手实现数倍加速；程序空间微调进一步将生成 MMD 降低 84%。

Conclusion: 通过将经验数据转化为显式、可复用的程序，PRODiGI 为快速、可解释的表格生成建模开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Estimating probability densities from a finite set of samples typically requires dataset-specific model fitting. We introduce PRODiGI, a pretrained data-to-program model that infers an explicit, executable generative program in a single forward pass. Pretrained on synthetic datasets paired with their ground-truth programs, PRODiGI accommodates diverse generative families and data dimensionalities through template prediction and non-autoregressive program parameter decoding. Its inferred programs support direct sampling, density and score evaluation, and inspection independently of the pretrained model. We further introduce program-space fine-tuning, which refines differentiable program parameters by matching generated and empirical samples while keeping model parameters intact. Experiments show that PRODiGI achieves lower average density and score MAE than existing pretrained models, while offering multi-fold speedups over its closest competitors. Program-space fine-tuning further reduces generation MMD by 84%. By turning empirical data into explicit, reusable programs, PRODiGI introduces a new direction for fast, interpretable tabular generative modeling.

</details>


### [966] [d-OPD: Future-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35362)
*Ruitao Liu,Qinghao Hu,Song Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 d-OPD，一种面向自回归到块扩散模型转换的未来感知在线蒸馏方法，通过将块内可见未来信息融入 AR 教师分布，纠正教师与学生间的信息错配，从而提升性能并加速训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将预训练自回归（AR）模型通过在线蒸馏（OPD）转换为块扩散语言模型（block dLLM）时，存在监督信息错配：块扩散学生模型在预测时以整个部分去噪的块（含可见未来上下文）为条件，而标准 AR 教师目标仅基于因果前缀定义。这导致蒸馏所用的教师分布与学生实际可见信息不对齐，监督不充分。

Method: d-OPD（未来感知在线蒸馏）：在 AR 到块扩散的转换中，纠正 AR 教师分布，将每个块内可见的未来信息纳入教师监督，使教师分布与学生可见状态更好对齐，提供与学生学习时所用信息相匹配的监督。在 Qwen3 系列模型（0.6B 至 8B）上验证。

Result: 在 Qwen3 0.6B 至 8B 模型上，d-OPD 相比 OPDLM 在六项基准的平均成绩上最多提升 4.0 分，同时训练时间减少 1.35–1.58 倍。

Conclusion: 通过对齐教师分布与学生可见状态，d-OPD 有效解决了 AR 到块扩散转换中的监督错配问题，在提升多基准性能的同时显著缩短训练时间，为高效转换预训练 AR 模型为块扩散模型提供了新思路。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) typically generate text autoregressively (AR), predicting one token at a time. Block diffusion language models (dLLMs) instead generate blocks sequentially while denoising multiple tokens in parallel within each block, offering a promising way to accelerate generation. Rather than training such models from scratch, recent work adapts strong pretrained AR models into block dLLMs through distillation. On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely used for LLM training because it supervises the student on states generated by its current policy, rather than only on fixed offline trajectories. By training on the states the student actually visits, it reduces the mismatch between training and generation and can provide more relevant supervision as the student evolves. Recent work has extended this idea to AR-to-block-diffusion conversion. However, this setting introduces a fundamental mismatch in supervision: the block-diffusion student and the causal AR teacher condition on different information at the same training state. The student predicts from the entire partially denoised block, including visible future context, whereas the standard AR teacher target is defined only from the causal prefix. As a result, the teacher distribution used for distillation is not fully aligned with the information available to the student. We therefore introduce d-OPD, a future-aware on-policy distillation method that corrects the AR teacher distribution to better align with the student-visible state by incorporating visible future information within each block, providing supervision that better matches the information used by the student. Across Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B, d-OPD improves the six-benchmark average by up to $4.0$ points over OPDLM and reduces training time by $1.35$-$1.58\times$. The code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/d-OPD.

</details>


### [967] [Do Temporal Link Predictors Need Learned Memory? A Smoothed-Count Baseline with a Handful of Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35364)
*Lisi Qarkaxhija,Ingo Scholtes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于统计语言建模的时间链路预测器，用转移与共现计数（跨源池化、平滑处理）替代节点嵌入，结合流行度、源历史与近因性的对数线性规则进行预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序链路预测器多依赖学习到的节点表示来总结历史交互；本文考察仅用重复交互模式的简单计数能否在不学习表示的情况下取得有竞争力的预测效果。

Method: 基于统计语言建模的时间链路预测器：跨源池化转移计数与共现计数，以预测源从未形成的链路；使用目的地频率或Kneser-Ney延续计数对稀疏估计进行平滑；采用共享的对数线性规则，将上述估计与流行度、源历史及近因性结合，不使用节点嵌入。

Result: 在TGB与TGB-Seq的16个数据集中的7个上取得最高MRR；在全部16个数据集上优于EdgeBank与Base3，在14个上优于启发式方法族；增益在限制重复边的数据集上依然成立；模型仅有9–13个学习参数。

Conclusion: 仅需少量学习参数的简单计数模型即可作为评估未来神经时序链路预测器的强竞争性基线。

Abstract: Many temporal link predictors summarize past interactions through learned node representations. We examine whether simple counts of recurring interaction patterns can provide competitive predictions without learning these representations. We propose a temporal link predictor based on statistical language modelling. It pools transition and co-occurrence counts across sources to predict links that a source has never formed. We smooth sparse estimates using destination frequencies or Kneser-Ney continuation counts. A shared log-linear rule combines these estimates with popularity, source history, and recency, without node embeddings. In our main evaluation, the model achieves the highest MRR among the compared methods on 7 out of 16 datasets from TGB and TGB-Seq. It also outperforms EdgeBank and Base3 on all 16 datasets and the heuristic family on 14. These gains extend to datasets designed to limit repeated edges. With only 9--13 learned parameters, our model provides a simple and competitive baseline for evaluating future neural temporal link predictors.

</details>


### [968] [The Hidden Ratio in Adam: Stable Structure, Compression, and Sign Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35392)
*Yihe Zhou,Tongtian Zhu,Yingxiao Huo,Satya Prakash Dash,Can Wang,Samuel Kaski,Mingfei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在绑定衰减率（tied-β）设定下研究 Adam 优化器，发现其自适应动态可由一个近似尺度稳定的变换比率刻画，并据此提出 4-bit 状态压缩方案与对 Signum 类方法的统一解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam 是训练现代深度网络的默认优化器，但其一阶与二阶矩指数滑动平均之间的复杂交互导致其自适应行为难以理解。作者希望找到一种更简洁的结构性描述，既能用于理论分析，又能指导高效实现。

Method: 在 tied-β（两个 EMA 衰减率相等）条件下，将 Adam 的自适应动态重写为一个变换比率形式，并经验性地检验该比率的分布稳定性；随后推导该比率的递推式，得到以可压缩状态替代二阶矩的 Adam 参数化形式，并利用其稳定分布设计固定的 4-bit 码本进行状态存储。同时从该比率视角推导 Adam 与 sign-based 方法的关系及学习率迁移规则。

Result: 实验表明，该变换比率在不同任务、模型规模与训练阶段均呈现稳定的重尾分布，而原始矩幅值则波动明显；基于稳定分布的固定 4-bit 码本无需辅助缩放即可存储该状态，性能与全精度 Adam 具有竞争力。理论上，Adam 被化简为受变换比率调制的 sign-based 动量，将该比率替换为常数即得到 Signum 作为极限情形，并据此给出两种方法间学习率迁移的简单规则。

Conclusion: tied-β Adam 的自适应行为背后存在一个简单且近似稳定的比率结构，该结构既为优化器分析提供了新视角，也为高效低比特实现提供了可行依据。

Abstract: Adam is the default optimizer for training modern deep neural networks, yet its adaptive behavior remains poorly understood due to the complex interaction between its first- and second-moment exponential moving averages (EMAs). We study Adam in the tied-$β$ regime, where the two EMA decay rates are equal, and show that its adaptive dynamics can be expressed through a transformed ratio with approximately scale-stable behavior. Empirically, this transformed ratio exhibits a stable, heavy-tailed distribution across tasks, model scales, and training stages, in contrast to the variability of raw moment magnitudes. This empirical stability has both practical and conceptual consequences. First, we derive a recurrence for the transformed ratio, yielding a reparameterization of Adam that replaces the second moment with a compressible state.
