Conclusion: 语言先验在神经证据较弱时最有用，因此对想象言语脑机接口尤为有价值。

Abstract: Decoding imagined speech is an important goal for brain-computer interfaces but remains challenging due to weak neural responses, low signal-to-noise ratio, and limited imagined-speech datasets. Language models provide strong contextual cues for text prediction, but how much they can help neural decoding and whether their contribution differs for decoding perceived and imagined speech remains unclear. To investigate this, we use a paired listened-imagined MEG dataset and incorporate language-model information at two stages. First, we train a contrastive neural decoder that aligns MEG representations with acoustic and contextual language representations, improving cross-subject word decoding for both listened and imagined speech. Second, at inference, we introduce a neural-constrained beam-search framework that combines neural evidence with language-model next-word probabilities. We find that imagined-speech decoding benefits more from the language model than listened-speech decoding. For Imagined speech, the best-performing balance between neural and language-model evidence shifts toward the language model, and the gain over neural-only decoding is larger. Together, these results suggest that language priors are most useful when neural evidence is weaker, making them particularly valuable for imagined-speech BCIs.

</details>


### [1003] [Human Activity Recognition via Ultra-Wideband Data: A Framework for Dimensionality Reduction, Pattern Discovery, and Predictive Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32008)
*Nahid Sahel Gozin,Reza Sedaghat,Prathap Siddavaatam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对UWB雷达HAR数据高维、噪声大、非线性强的问题，提出CPE-IPCA与PPSA两种降维方法，结合频繁模式挖掘与分类器实现高精度活动识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UWB雷达数据具有高维、噪声、复杂和非线性特征，在计算资源受限的实时系统中难以高效处理，亟需在压缩数据规模的同时保留关键模式并保持高分类精度。

Method: 提出两个降维技术：CPE-IPCA（聚类+多项式特征扩展+增量PCA，仅50个成分即保留100%方差）；PPSA（PCA后标准化，80个成分保留99.1%方差）。随后用Apriori与FP-Growth挖掘频繁模式，并用Random Forest与向量空间模型(VSM)进行分类，识别六类活动（Standff、Liedown、Noactivity、Sit、Stand、Walk）。

Result: Random Forest在CPE-IPCA上达100%准确率，PPSA上达99%；VSM在PPSA上精确率、召回率、F1均为100%，在CPE-IPCA上接近完美（精确率1.00，召回率0.98-1.00，F1 0.99-1.00），且压缩率与计算效率优于传统非线性方法。

Conclusion: 该框架构建了一个快速、可解释且鲁棒的HAR系统，适用于医疗健康、辅助生活和智能环境等场景。

Abstract: Recent advances in sensor technology have enabled more effective human activity recognition (HAR), particularly in real-time systems with limited computational resources. However, Ultra-Wideband (UWB) radar data remain challenging due to high dimensionality, noise, complexity, and nonlinear characteristics. This research proposes a framework to efficiently reduce data size, uncover significant patterns, and classify six activity types (Standff, Liedown, Noactivity, Sit, Stand, and Walk) from UWB signals with high accuracy. Two novel dimensionality reduction techniques are introduced in this paper. The first, Clustered Polynomial Expansion with Incremental PCA (CPE-IPCA), combines clustering and polynomial feature expansion with Incremental PCA, preserving 100% of the variance in only 50 components. The second, Post-PCA Standardization Approach (PPSA), standardizes data after PCA and retains 99.1% of the variance in 80 components, achieving superior compression and computational efficiency compared to conventional nonlinear methods. Frequent patterns are identified using Apriori and FP-Growth, which are then classified with Random Forest and a Vector Space Model (VSM). The framework achieves 100% accuracy with Random Forest on CPE-IPCA and 99% on PPSA, while VSM attains 100% precision, recall, and F1 on PPSA and near-perfect performance on CPE-IPCA (precision 1.00, recall 0.98-1.00, F1 0.99-1.00), demonstrating a fast, interpretable, and robust HAR system suitable for healthcare, assisted living, and smart environments.

</details>


### [1004] [Representation Learning for Exact Preimages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32018)
*Konstantin Hess,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TRIO 框架，通过前像分解使前向预测具备表达能力、前像近似精确、且可对前像进行易解的下游全局优化，三者兼得。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多科学与工程任务需要在“逆方向”上推理：给定性能或安全水平，刻画满足该目标的全部输入集合（前像），并在其上优化。然而，对于表达能力强的神经网络预测器，其前像通常没有显式表示，恢复代价高，优化更难，形成“前向表达力—前像近似精度—下游优化可解性”的三难困境。

Method: 提出 TRIO（tractable representations for preimage learning and inverse optimization）。核心是前像分解：前向模型通过非线性径向变换（含神经网络）保持表达力；而在求逆时，每个变换简化为单一标量半径，从而产生简单的几何水平集。由此得到可复用的显式几何表示，用于前像上的下游优化；对线性目标，证明存在闭式全局解。并给出通用逼近定理。

Result: 对线性目标，前像上的全局优化可获闭式解；通用逼近定理表明 TRIO 能任意好地逼近任意连续前向映射及其整个（可能不连通、非凸的）前像族。

Conclusion: TRIO 在设计上同时实现了表达性前向建模、精确前像恢复与易解的全局前像下游优化。

Abstract: Modern neural predictors can model highly nonlinear maps, but many scientific and engineering tasks require reasoning in the opposite direction: given a performance or safety level, the goal is to characterize the preimage, that is, the complete set of inputs which meet the desired target level and optimize over that set. For expressive neural predictors, however, such preimages typically have no explicit representation and are expensive to recover or optimize over. This creates a fundamental three-way challenge between expressive forward prediction, accurate preimage approximation, and tractable optimization over the preimage for downstream tasks. We introduce TRIO (tractable representations for preimage learning and inverse optimization), a framework for learning representations that make these objectives compatible by construction. Our key contribution is a preimage factorization: the forward model remains expressive through nonlinear radial transformations (including neural networks), while, under inversion, each transformation reduces to a single scalar radius, which yields simple geometric level sets. This yields an explicit geometric representation that is reusable for downstream optimization over the preimage, and, for linear objectives, we show that this admits a closed-form global solution. We finally prove a universal approximation theorem which shows that TRIO can approximate any continuous forward map and its entire family of potentially disconnected, nonconvex preimages arbitrarily well. Hence, TRIO combines expressive forward modeling, exact preimage recovery, and tractable global downstream optimization over preimages by design.

</details>


### [1005] [Graph Forward Distribution Matching for Molecular Inverse Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32056)
*Yihan Zhu,Yuhan Liu,Brett Savoie,Tengfei Luo,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 GraphFDM，一种基于图扩散正向过程的在线强化学习范式，通过分布匹配实现多性质分子逆向设计，在保持化学有效性的同时显著降低性质预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子逆向设计需在不牺牲化学有效性的前提下精确控制多个性质，这是核心难题。现有 RL 方法将图扩散模型的逆向采样视为序列策略，用单一终端奖励优化数百个耦合决策，导致训练不稳定、有效性崩溃、性质提升有限。

Method: GraphFDM 在图扩散的正向过程中进行优化，而非逆向采样。它利用有效生成样本定义奖励倾斜的目标分布，针对每个性质条件在图尺寸与分子结构上联合优化；将强化信号融入监督学习，无需存储逆向轨迹。作者推导了唯一最优目标，证明了逐条件的改进保证，并揭示标准图扩散固定图尺寸先验导致的不可约匹配差距。

Result: 在多条件聚合物与小分子生成任务中，GraphFDM 在所有目标性质上取得最低 MAE，相对最强基线最高降低 53.0%，化学有效性高于 0.99；并能泛化到分布外性质组合。

Conclusion: GraphFDM 通过正向分布匹配的在线 RL 范式，规避了逆向策略优化的不稳定性与有效性崩溃问题，为多性质可控分子生成提供了高效且稳健的新框架。

Abstract: Achieving precise control over multiple properties without sacrificing chemical validity remains a central challenge in molecular inverse design. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods fine-tune graph diffusion models by treating **reverse** sampling as a sequential policy, using a single terminal reward to optimize hundreds of coupled decisions. They often suffer from instability, validity collapse, and limited property gains. We introduce GraphFDM (Graph Forward Distribution Matching), a new online RL paradigm for graph diffusion that performs optimization through the **forward** process. GraphFDM uses valid generations to define a reward-tilted target distribution jointly optimized over graph size and molecular structure for each property condition, incorporating reinforcement signals into supervised learning without storing reverse trajectories. We derive the unique optimal target, prove a condition-wise improvement guarantee, and show that the fixed graph-size prior of standard graph diffusion leaves an irreducible matching gap. In multi-conditional polymer and small-molecule generation, GraphFDM achieves the lowest MAE on every target property, with reductions of up to 53.0\% relative to the strongest baselines and chemical validity above 0.99. It further generalizes to out-of-distribution property combinations.

</details>


### [1006] [Depth Laws for the Precision Floor of Trained Neural Networks: Amplification, Residual Scaling, and a Quantization-Aware Training Paradox](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32060)
*Ahmad S. Tarawneh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络在精度崩溃前的精度下限问题，提出预测放大因子G的一阶理论，证明精度下限由η_c=Λ/G决定，且G²随深度线性增长（速率正比于残差分支尺度的平方）。该理论在13个训练架构中的12个及GPT-2（12–48层）得到验证，并揭示残差缩放与预归一化可消除深度惩罚，以及QAT中深度律随深度变陡的悖论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者试图回答一个基础但尚未系统化的问题：网络在精度崩溃之前需要多少比特，以及这一需求如何随深度增长。现有量化研究多关注具体方法的性能，缺乏对"精度下限"（准确率降至随机水平一半时的扰动水平或位宽）随深度变化的理论刻画，因此本文构建一阶理论来解释深度与精度下限之间的定量关系。

Method: 研究覆盖MLP、CNN、Vision Transformer及九个预训练语言模型，在PTQ与QAT两种设定下测量精度下限。理论上引入预测放大因子G，提出η_c=Λ/G的关系，并推导G²随深度线性增长（速率正比于残差分支尺度平方）。进一步分析深度指数关系α_PTQ=ρ、残差分支按1/√D缩放与预归一化的作用，以及量化器步长规则下b_c=(α/γ)log₂D+C的比特-深度律，并检验决策边际、跨层误差抵消与重尾分布是否决定精度下限。

Result: 预测的深度指数等式α_PTQ=ρ在13个训练架构中的12个及GPT-2（12至48层）的95%置信区间内成立，且跨训练架构Λ=1.45±14%。残差分支按1/√D缩放并采用预归一化可消除深度惩罚；各量化器依据其步长规则以固定速率将噪声转化为比特，得到b_c=(α/γ)log₂D+C。QAT存在悖论：噪声感知训练约使浅层网络可容忍噪声翻倍，但增益随深度衰减，导致深度律变陡（两个数据集、各十个种子下α_QAT/α_PTQ=1.45–1.47）。决策边际、跨层误差抵消与重尾分布均不决定精度下限。

Conclusion: 网络的精度下限由单一全精度量——预测放大因子G——通过η_c=Λ/G决定，且深度惩罚源于G²随深度的线性增长，速率正比于残差分支尺度平方。通过1/√D残差缩放与预归一化可消除该深度惩罚。QAT虽提升浅层网络噪声容忍度，但增益随深度递减而使深度律更陡。比特需求与深度满足对数量化关系b_c=(α/γ)log₂D+C，且精度下限并非由决策边际、跨层误差抵消或重尾效应所决定。

Abstract: How many bits does a network need before its accuracy collapses, and how does this grow with depth? We study the precision floor, the perturbation level or bit-width at which accuracy falls halfway to chance, in MLPs, CNNs, Vision Transformers and nine pretrained language models, under post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization- or noise-aware training (QAT). (i) A first-order theory sets the floor through one full-precision quantity, the predictive amplification $G$: $η_c=Λ/G$, and $G^2$ grows linearly in depth at a rate proportional to the squared residual branch scale. (ii) The predicted equality $α_{PTQ}=ρ$ of depth exponents holds within 95% intervals in twelve of thirteen trained architectures and in GPT-2 from 12 to 48 layers, with $Λ=1.45\pm14\%$ across trained architectures. (iii) Residual branches scaled by $1/\sqrt{D}$ and pre-normalisation remove the depth penalty, and each quantizer turns noise into bits at a rate fixed by its step rule, giving $b_c=(α/γ)\log_2 D+C$. (iv) A QAT paradox: noise-aware training roughly doubles the tolerable noise of shallow networks, but the gain decays with depth, so the depth law steepens ($α_{QAT}/α_{PTQ}=1.45$-$1.47$ on two datasets, ten seeds each). Decision margins, cross-layer error cancellation and heavy tails do not set the floor.

</details>


### [1007] [LLM Unlearning Evaluation with TRIAGE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32103)
*Danial Ataee,Peter Triantafillou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出TRIAGE框架，从模型内部表征角度评估机器遗忘造成的参数敏感度与曲率变化，并量化语义近邻知识的"邻接差距"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估主要依赖行为基准，只能判断模型是否"看起来遗忘"，难以揭示遗忘如何改变模型内部机制及对相关知识的影响，因此需要一种模型内部视角的补充评估方法。

Method: TRIAGE（Tripartite Representation-internal Introspection for Adjacency Gap Evaluation）是一个与基准无关的评估框架：利用Fisher信息与Hessian的对角近似测量参数敏感度与局部曲率变化；采用Forget / Adjacent-Retain / Generic-Retain三分区量化语义相关知识的邻接差距；并依据变化的幅度与分布将算法更新分类为no-op、部分局部化、附带损伤主导或全局破坏四类。

Result: 在12种遗忘方法、4个语言模型以及WMDP、TOFU、MUSE三个基准上验证：行为遗忘效果相近的方法可能产生显著不同的内部变化与附带损伤模式；这些内部特征也随模型与基准变化而变化，说明遗忘效果并非仅由算法本身决定。

Conclusion: TRIAGE可与现有遗忘基准配合使用，从模型内部视角补充行为评估，刻画遗忘如何重塑参数空间并影响保留知识。

Abstract: Large language models can memorize private or harmful information, motivating machine unlearning methods that remove targeted knowledge while preserving other capabilities. However, existing evaluations rely primarily on behavioral benchmarks, which assess \emph{whether} a model appears to forget but provide limited insight into \emph{how} unlearning changes the model or affects related knowledge. We introduce \textit{TRIAGE} (\textit{Tripartite Representation-internal Introspection for Adjacency Gap Evaluation}), a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework for characterizing these changes. TRIAGE uses diagonal approximations of the Fisher information and Hessian to measure changes in parameter sensitivity and local curvature, and utilizes a Forget / \emph{Adjacent-Retain} / \emph{Generic-Retain} partition to quantify an \emph{adjacency gap} in semantically related knowledge. Based on the magnitude and distribution of these changes, TRIAGE further classifies each algorithm's update as \emph{no-op}, \emph{partially localized}, \emph{collateral dominant}, or \emph{globally destructive}. Across 12 unlearning methods, four language models, and the WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE benchmarks, we find that methods with similar behavioral forgetting can produce substantially different internal changes and patterns of collateral damage. These signatures also vary across models and benchmarks, indicating that the effects of unlearning are not determined solely by the unlearning algorithm. TRIAGE can be applied alongside existing unlearning benchmarks to complement behavioral evaluation with a model-internal view of how unlearning reshapes the model's parameter space and affects retained knowledge.

</details>


### [1008] [An Attention-Driven Heterogeneous GNN Model for Credit Card Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32106)
*Kathiresan Jayabalan,Sethuraman Radhakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合SMOTE-Tomek数据平衡技术与异构图神经网络（HGNN）的信用卡欺诈检测框架。在Kaggle信用卡欺诈数据集上，该模型实现了99.97%的准确率、99.48%的F1分数、99.15%的精确率和98.97%的召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着全球向无现金经济转型，信用卡成为数字交易的核心工具，但其依赖性上升导致信用卡欺诈风险加剧。信用卡欺诈检测面临三大难点：欺诈模式不断演变、数据高度不平衡、需同时识别合法与欺诈交易。

Method: 研究采用Kaggle信用卡欺诈检测数据集，针对其高度不平衡的特性，使用SMOTE-Tomek技术进行数据平衡；随后采用异构图神经网络（HGNN）模型进行分类。HGNN通过异构图架构表示各类交易，并借助基于注意力的消息传递机制捕捉复杂关系、时间因素与用户行为。

Result: HGNN模型达到99.97%的准确率、99.48%的F1分数、99.15%的精确率和98.97%的召回率。SMOTE-Tomek的集成进一步提升了模型识别欺诈交易的能力，同时降低了假阳性率。

Conclusion: 结果表明该模型有效，可应用于实际信用卡欺诈检测场景。

Abstract: The global transition to a cashless economy has placed credit cards as the key element of digital transactions, acclaimed for their easy use, speed, and acceptance in most places. However, the growing dependence on this payment method has led to an escalation of the risks associated with credit card (CC) fraud. Detecting this type of fraud is a difficult task because the patterns are constantly changing, there is a data imbalance, and it is necessary to identify the legitimate transactions and the fraud ones at the same time. This study addresses this challenge by proposing a credit card fraud detection (CCFD) framework using a data balancing technique and a deep learning (DL) model. The proposed fraud detection model is trained and evaluated by collecting the dataset called Credit Card Fraud Detection from the Kaggle repository. As the dataset is highly imbalanced, we utilized the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE)-Tomek technique to balance the dataset. Further, the balanced dataset is classified using the Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (HGNN) model. The HGNN model represent various transactions using a heterogeneous graph architecture and by using an attention based message passing technique, it managed to consider the complex relationships, time factors, and user behavior. The integration of SMOTE-Tomek in the model further boosted its capacity to identify fraudulent transactions, while lowering the rate of false positives. The HGNN model attained a 99.97% accuracy, a 99.48% F1-score, a 99.15% precision, and a 98.97% recall. The findings indicates that this model is effective and can be applied to real-world CCFD scenarios.

</details>


### [1009] [Handwritten Digit Leakage from Smartphone Motion Sensors Across Unseen Users and Phone Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32117)
*Constantino Álvarez Casado,Erkka Rantahalvari,Matteo Pedone,Matti Matilainen,Manuel Lage Cañellas,Le Nguyen,Simo Hosio,Olli Silvén,Miguel Bordallo López*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在已知书写区间假设下，研究手机运动传感器读数能否跨用户与跨设备预测手写数字（10类任务），基于 HuMIdb 的 19,628 条记录（481 名参与者）比较手工特征+经典机器学习、MiniRocket 核方法与紧凑传感器 patch Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手机运动传感器虽服务于交互应用，但其读数可能在预期用途之外泄露触屏输入信息，存在隐私风险，因此需评估手写数字在跨用户、跨设备条件下的可预测性。

Method: 以 19,628 条 HuMIdb 记录（481 名参与者）为数据，假设已知书写区间，构建 10 类分类问题。在加速度计、线性加速度、陀螺仪与重力信号上，对比手工特征结合经典机器学习算法、MiniRocket 核方法以及紧凑型传感器 patch Transformer；并在未见的 75 名参与者与 9 款未见于训练的机型上评估，同时考察运动强度、对比预训练、数据增强与派生信号的影响。

Result: Transformer 在 75 名未见参与者上取得 57.74% 准确率与 82.64% top-3 准确率；在 9 款未见机型、未见参与者上，3 个随机种子平均为 58.77±0.95%。低运动强度记录仍具信息量，准确率随运动强度并非单调变化；所测试的对比预训练、数据增强与派生信号均未带来一致增益。

Conclusion: 在假定分割条件下，手写数字可跨熟悉用户与机型被预测，表明运动传感器存在潜在隐私泄露；但采集顺序等捷径限制了关于实际隐私暴露程度的结论。代码已开源。

Abstract: Smartphone motion sensors support interactive applications, but their readings may also reveal touchscreen input beyond their intended use. Assuming known drawing intervals, we study whether handwritten digits remain predictable across users and devices, as a 10-class problem on 19,628 HuMIdb recordings from 481 participants. We compare handcrafted features with classical machine learning algorithms, MiniRocket kernels, and a compact sensor patch transformer on accelerometer, linear acceleration, gyroscope, and gravity signals. The transformer achieves 57.74\% accuracy and 82.64\% top-3 accuracy on 75 unseen participants, and 58.77$\pm$0.95\% over 3 seeds for unseen participants on 9 unseen phone models. Low motion recordings remain informative, accuracy is not monotonic in motion level, and the tested contrastive pretraining, augmentation, and derived signals give no consistent gains. Digits are thus predictable beyond familiar users and phone models under assumed segmentation, while acquisition-order shortcuts limit conclusions about practical privacy exposure. Code available at: https://github.com/Arritmic/motion-digit-leakage.

</details>


### [1010] [What Should We Freeze? Guarded Freezing: Connectivity Shapes the Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32124)
*Leonel Aguilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出移除价值(removal-value)与漂移价值(drift-value)两种冻结核心选择准则，并据此构造Guarded Freezing策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调预训练模型时，仅冻结权重未必能保持性能，因为其他参数的更新会改变冻结核心的输入，从而影响整体表现。因此需要更合理的冻结子集选择方法。

Method: 先分析冻结核心可被隔离的情形，提出基于容量的移除价值(removal-value)评分，近似HOPE移除代价在移除顺序上的平均。针对Transformer中共享残差流使通往冻结神经元的路径保持开放的情况，推导漂移价值(drift-value)，在局部更新模型下对每个权重更新的输出扰动进行前向代理。基于此提出Guarded Freezing：当输入路径被切断时用移除价值选择，路径保留时用漂移价值选择。

Result: VGG-8中切断可训练神经元到冻结核心的路径后，该评分使70%冻结相比DEFT在相近新任务精度下多保留5.22±0.51个百分点旧任务精度。语言模型中40轮时该策略在显著遗忘的场景下超过Wanda与RIA冻结评分，与Fisher的差异尚不明确；Qwen2.5-1.5B训练160轮后比静态Fisher多保留0.0433±0.0102。DINOv3视觉Transformer适配点云时，漂移价值保留0.440图像精度，而相同数量随机掩码为0.187。

Conclusion: 结果表明冻结子集的选择应依据输入路径是否被切断：路径被切断时用移除价值，路径保留时用漂移价值，即Guarded Freezing策略。

Abstract: When adapting pre-trained models through fine-tuning, freezing weights alone might not preserve performance, as updates elsewhere can change the inputs to the frozen core, ultimately affecting overall performance. We first analyse the case where a selected frozen core can be isolated and propose removal-value, a capacity-based score that approximates HOPE's removal cost averaged over removal orders. We show that in VGG-8, cutting paths from trainable neurons into a frozen core makes selection using this score useful: $70\%$ frozen preserves $5.22\pm0.51$ percentage points more old-task accuracy than DEFT at similar new-task accuracy. In transformers, shared residual streams leave paths into frozen neurons open. For this case, we derive drift-value, a forward-only proxy for the output disturbance from updating each weight entry under a local update model. In language models, at 40 epochs, this policy exceeds adapted Wanda and RIA freezing scores in settings with substantial retention loss, while its differences from Fisher remain unresolved. After 160 epochs on Qwen2.5-1.5B, it retains $0.0433\pm0.0102$ more than static Fisher. In DINOv3 vision-transformer adaptation to point clouds, drift-value retains $0.440$ image accuracy versus $0.187$ for a random mask of the same count. These results motivate Guarded Freezing: select by removal-value when incoming paths are cut, and by drift-value when they remain.

</details>


### [1011] [Latency-Aware Client Assignment for Parallel Split Learning With Global Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32132)
*Mohammad Kohankhaki,Valentin Rentschler,Anke Schmeink*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出延迟预算并行拆分学习（Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling），通过将池化批次的类别目标与客户端选择解耦，采用流式与贪心两种变体实现延迟感知的样本提供者分配，在保持类别目标不变的前提下降低建模训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在跨孤岛拆分学习中，带全局采样的并行拆分学习在客户端类别分布不同时构建具有代表性的池化批次，但当多个客户端可提供同一类别时，忽略了客户端延迟，导致调度效率低下。

Method: 将每个池化批次的整数类别目标与供给样本的客户端选择分离。流式变体把该分配形式化为整数网络流问题，最小化当前目标下建模的客户端完成时间；快速变体采用贪心次完成规则降低调度构建成本；并设计规划规则，在权衡两种候选调度构建开销后选择变体。两变体均保持目标流不变，且每个 epoch 中每个本地样本仅使用一次。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，流式变体将建模训练时间降低 6.75%，最终准确率下降 0.30 个百分点；在每客户端 20 个候选类别的 Tiny ImageNet 上，快速变体降低建模时间 16.87%，并比延迟不感知基线更早达到全部四个验证目标。在 405 次调度对比中，规划规则在 96.54% 的情况下与较低实际成本的差距保持在 2% 以内。

Conclusion: 延迟感知的提供者分配可在不改变既定类别目标的情况下降低建模训练时间，而优选变体取决于分配收益是否超过调度构建开销。

Abstract: In cross-silo split learning, Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling forms representative pooled batches when class distributions differ across clients, but ignores client delay when several clients can supply the same class. We introduce Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling, which separates each pooled batch's integer class target from the choice of clients that supply its examples. The flow variant formulates this assignment as an integral network-flow problem and minimizes modeled client-side completion time for the current target. The fast variant uses a greedy next-completion rule to reduce schedule-construction cost. Both preserve the target stream and use every local example once per epoch. A planning rule selects between the variants while accounting for the cost of constructing both candidate schedules. On CIFAR-10, the flow variant reduces modeled training time by 6.75%, with a 0.30 percentage-point decrease in final accuracy. On Tiny ImageNet with 20 candidate classes per client, the fast variant reduces modeled time by 16.87% and reaches all four validation targets earlier than the latency-unaware baseline. Across 405 schedule comparisons, the planning rule stays within 2% of the lower realized cost in 96.54% of cases. In our evaluation, latency-aware provider assignment reduces modeled training time without changing the prescribed class targets, while the preferred variant depends on whether assignment savings outweigh schedule-construction overhead.

</details>


### [1012] [Playing to Par: Reinforcement Learning for Provably Optimal Quadrilateral Block Decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32146)
*Arjun Narayanan,Per-Olof Persson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用强化学习智能体直接在半边数据结构上进行局部编辑，生成达到理论基础下界（par）的全四边形网格分解，并通过行为克隆与PPO训练跨越稀疏奖励障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四边形块分解的质量可通过是否完整、单元形状是否良好、以及不规则顶点数量来评判。其中不规则顶点总数存在可证明的下界：离散Gauss-Bonnet恒等式仅根据域的拓扑与角点角度，就对任意全四边形网格的顶点不规则度给出下界。目标是构建能达到该下界的分解（称为par），但达到下界需要克服稀疏奖励带来的探索难题。

Method: 训练一个强化学习智能体来构建达到par的分解。智能体直接作用于网格的半边数据结构，通过局部编辑进行操作；策略网络的卷积沿网格自身连接关系进行，因此可原样应用于比训练中见过的更大域。奖励直接以该下界为目标且稀疏：随机策略在边数超过八的域上均无法达到。为克服探索障碍，先在极易构造的最优网格上进行行为克隆，将其反向walk成演示，再用PPO训练。

Result: 在96个留出域上，智能体在每个域都生成全四边形网格，平均95.7个可用，90个可证明最优；Gmsh在相同单元数下最强配置仅完成51个，38个可用，0个最优，即使单元数增至三到十四倍也从未产生更规则的网格。在64个两倍于训练规模的域上，智能体全部完成，62个可用，相对par的中位超出量低于1，而Gmsh在相同单元数下为39。

Conclusion: 该方法能稳定生成全四边形分解，并在绝大多数域上达到可证明最优，显著优于Gmsh，且具备向训练规模之外域的泛化能力。

Abstract: A quadrilateral block decomposition of a planar domain is judged by whether it is complete, whether its elements are well shaped, and how many of its vertices are irregular. The last has a provable floor: the discrete Gauss-Bonnet identity enforces a lower bound on the total vertex irregularity of any all-quadrilateral mesh of a given domain purely based on its topology and corner angles. We train a reinforcement learning agent to build decompositions that reach this bound, which we call par. It acts directly on the mesh's half-edge data structure through local edits, with a policy network whose convolutions follow the mesh's own connectivity, so it applies unchanged to domains larger than any seen in training. The reward targets the floor directly, and it is sparse: random play reaches it on no domain with more than eight sides. We overcome this exploration barrier via behaviour cloning on optimal meshes that are trivial to construct, walked backward into demonstrations, before training it with PPO. On 96 held-out domains the agent produces an all-quadrilateral mesh on every one, a usable one on 95.7 on average, and a provably optimal one on 90; Gmsh's strongest configuration at the same element count completes 51, is usable on 38 and optimal on none, and even at three to fourteen times the elements never produces a more regular mesh. On 64 domains twice the training size the agent completes all, is usable on 62, and keeps a median excess over par below one against Gmsh's 39 at the same element count.

</details>


### [1013] [CAFE: Counterfactual Prediction via Fast Posterior Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32167)
*Xinyan Han,Xiaoyu Lin,Hao Zou,Xingxuan Zhang,Bo Li,Peng Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CAFE框架，用摊销推理直接逼近贝叶斯反事实后验预测分布，单次前向传播即可预测个体反事实结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实预测通常无法仅凭观测数据识别；即便在完全观测的加性噪声模型类中，不同因果图可生成相同观测分布却蕴含不同个体反事实结果。基于单一估计图的预测忽略了这种结构不确定性。

Method: 目标为融合多个合理SCM预测的贝叶斯反事实后验预测分布。CAFE基于摊销推理：在多样化ANM先验生成的合成反事实任务上预训练一个Transformer模型；给定观测数据集、个体事实观测与干预，单次前向传播逼近相应后验预测分布。

Result: 实验表明CAFE在可识别设定下能准确预测个体反事实结果；在存在观测不可区分因果图导致的结构不确定性时，能较好逼近后验预测分布；在制造业与葡萄种植等真实场景中亦表现稳健。

Conclusion: CAFE以摊销贝叶斯方式处理因果结构不确定性，兼具准确性与泛化性，在训练先验假设之外的真实场景中仍具经验鲁棒性。

Abstract: Counterfactual prediction estimates an individual's outcome under an alternative intervention given their factual observations. Such outcomes are generally not identifiable from observational data without additional assumptions. Even within the class of fully observed additive noise models (ANMs), different causal graphs can generate the same observational distribution yet imply different individual counterfactual outcomes. Predictions based on a single estimated graph ignore this structural uncertainty. We therefore target a Bayesian counterfactual posterior predictive distribution that combines predictions from plausible SCMs. We introduce CAFE (\textbf{C}ounterf\textbf{A}ctual Prediction via \textbf{F}ast Posterior \textbf{E}stimation), an amortized inference framework that directly approximates the Bayesian counterfactual posterior predictive distribution. We pretrain a transformer-based model on synthetic counterfactual tasks generated from a diverse prior over ANMs. Given an observational dataset, an individual's factual observations, and an intervention, CAFE approximates the corresponding posterior predictive distribution in a single forward pass. Experiments show that CAFE accurately predicts individual counterfactual outcomes in identifiable settings and approximates the posterior predictive distribution when structural uncertainty induced by observationally indistinguishable causal graphs exists. Strong performance in realistic manufacturing and viticulture settings further demonstrates its empirical robustness beyond the assumptions of the training prior.

</details>


### [1014] [Efficient Support Recovery of Mixtures of Sparse Linear Classifiers with Less Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32176)
*Xiaxin Li,Arya Mazumdar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究线性分类器混合模型下的支撑恢复问题，提出自适应与非自适应测量方案，在减少测量次数的同时将解码时间从超二次降至亚线性，实现了更优的样本复杂度与解码时间权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在由多个线性决策规则混合生成数据时，识别真正起作用的特征（即恢复 $l$ 个未知 $k$-稀疏向量的支撑）具有重要意义。已有方法在测量次数和解码复杂度上存在不足，尤其解码时间高达环境维度的超二次级别，导致整体效率受限。

Method: 针对由均匀随机选取的 $l$ 个 $k$-稀疏向量之一生成符号测量值（即内积的符号）的模型，作者设计了自适应与非自适应两类测量方案：自适应方案显著降低所需测量数，同时将解码复杂度从超二次降低为关于环境维度的亚线性；非自适应方案则在保持高效解码的前提下改进了先前的测量上界。

Result: 自适应构造相较现有方法大幅减少测量次数，并将解码复杂度由超二次降至亚线性；非自适应方案在维持高效解码的同时改进了先前的测量界限。

Conclusion: 该工作为线性分类器混合模型中的支撑恢复提供了样本复杂度与解码时间之间更高效的权衡，优于此前已知方法。

Abstract: The support recovery problem in mixture of linear classifiers intends to identify which features actually matter when data is generated by a mixture of several linear decision rules. In particular, the aim is to recover the support (nonzero coordinates) of $l$ unknown $k$-sparse vectors from sign measurements. Each measurement is generated by selecting one of the $l$ vectors uniformly at random, and returning the sign of its inner product with a chosen measurement vector.
  In this paper, we propose adaptive and non-adaptive schemes that significantly improve upon prior results by reducing the number of measurements and achieving sublinear decoding time simultaneously. In particular, our adaptive constructions substantially reduce measurements compared to existing approaches, while also lowering decoding complexity from super-quadratic to sublinear in the ambient dimension. We further provide a non-adaptive scheme that improves previous measurement bounds while maintaining efficient decoding.
  Overall, our approach yields a more efficient trade-off between sample complexity and decoding time for support recovery in mixture models than previously known methods.

</details>


### [1015] [Analytic-Walk Rotary Positional Encodings for Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32178)
*Jiaqing Xie,Yuxin Wang,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出AW-RoPE（解析游走旋转位置编码），将旋转放在边上并对所有游走传输特征求和，从而让图注意力能够区分连接两节点的不同路径。含精确变体（可微线性求解）与稀疏变体（有限深度截断），并给出前向与参数导数截断界。合成任务上nRMSE降低15–58%，在多个真实基准上取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图上的旋转位置编码依据谱坐标给每个节点分配旋转，使得两节点间的旋转因子仅依赖端点，无法区分连接它们的不同路径；这限制了注意力对图结构的敏感度。

Method: 提出AW-RoPE，把旋转置于边上，并沿所有游走对传输特征求和，使不同路径的贡献可相互增强或抵消。给出精确变体：通过可微线性求解计算完整求和；稀疏变体：在有限深度截断。二者均作用于投影后的query和key，稀疏递归还可增强消息传递网络。理论上证明固定输入与参数下的前向及参数导数截断界。

Result: 在五个合成任务上，两变体相对最强基线将nRMSE降低15–58%；在真实超像素、肽和OGB基准上，稀疏递归在使用Performer核时于每个数据集取得最佳均值，使用GIN时在十三个数据集中的十二个上最佳。分析表明AW-RoPE能区分仅由两端连接方式决定线索的路径，而节点级旋转编码不能。

Conclusion: 将旋转编码从节点转移到边、并沿游走聚合，可显式编码路径信息，突破节点级编码的表达局限；理论截断保证与广泛实验验证了该方法的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Rotary position encodings make attention sensitive to relative position, but extending them to graphs requires choosing how graph structure enters the rotation. Previous works assign each node a rotation from spectral coordinates, so the rotary factor between two nodes depends only on their endpoints and cannot distinguish the routes connecting them. We introduce \textit{Analytic-Walk Rotary Positional Encodings} (AW-RoPE), which place the rotations on edges and sum the transported features over all walks, so contributions along different routes can reinforce or cancel. An exact variant evaluates the complete sum by a differentiable linear solve, and a sparse variant truncates it at a finite depth. We prove forward and parameter-derivative truncation bounds at fixed inputs and parameters. Both variants act on projected queries and keys, and the sparse recurrence also augments message-passing networks. Across five synthetic tasks both variants reduce nRMSE by $15$--$58\%$ relative to the strongest baseline, and on real superpixel, peptide and OGB benchmarks the sparse recurrence attains the best mean on every dataset with Performer kernels and on twelve of thirteen datasets with GIN. Analysis shows that AW-RoPE can distinguish routes whose only cue is how two endpoints are connected, while node-wise rotary encodings cannot.

</details>


### [1016] [CompassPlay: Rewarding the Proposer for Where It Moves the Solver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32228)
*Sophia Xiao Pu,Ximeng Sun,Jiang Liu,Jialian Wu,Emad Barsoum,Zicheng Liu,William Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CompassPlay：一种通过梯度对齐奖励出题者的自博弈方法，用一阶近似估计学习进度，无需额外训练求解器即可给任务打分，在编码与定理证明任务上提升性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自博弈中出题者生成可验证任务训练求解器，但出题者奖励通常仅依赖求解器成功率；同等难度的任务其训练价值其实不同，仅用难度作为奖励信号无法区分任务的实际学习收益。

Method: CompassPlay 通过梯度对齐奖励出题者：奖励与代表目标能力的参考任务相比，偏好那些使求解器损失梯度与参考任务梯度对齐的任务。方法基于学习进度的一阶近似，对每个合格任务打分，无需额外训练求解器；在编码自博弈中借助小型外部参考集引导任务生成。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 的编码自博弈中，CompassPlay 相比 AZR 的难度奖励，域内编码平均准确率提升 1.5 个百分点，域外数学提升 2.7 个百分点；在 Lean4 定理证明中，以少 40% 的 GPU 小时达到难度基线 150 次迭代的累计覆盖率。

Conclusion: 以梯度对齐替代单纯难度作为出题者奖励，可更有效筛选高训练价值任务，同时提升性能与训练效率，并在跨域迁移和定理证明场景下得到验证。

Abstract: In self-play, a proposer generates verifiable tasks to train a solver. Proposer rewards often depend on the solver's success rate, but equally difficult tasks can differ in their training value. We introduce CompassPlay, a self-play method that rewards the proposer through gradient alignment. The reward favors tasks whose solver loss gradients align with those of reference tasks representing the target capabilities. It draws on a first-order approximation to learning progress and scores each eligible task without additional solver training. Our experiments show gains in performance and training efficiency. In coding self-play with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, a small external reference set guides task generation. CompassPlay improves average accuracy over AZR's difficulty reward by 1.5 percentage points on in-domain coding and 2.7 on out-of-domain mathematics. In Lean4 theorem proving, CompassPlay matches the difficulty baseline's 150-iteration cumulative coverage with 40\% fewer GPU-hours.

</details>


### [1017] ["Where Can I Trust You?": Boundary-Aware Evaluation of Surrogate Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32230)
*Jackson Eshbaugh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 代理模型（surrogate model）的保真度并非单一全局指标：在教师模型决策边界附近保真度显著下降；按置信度分区条件化的评估能更好预测评估集构成变化下的师生一致性；但全局与边界附近一致性相同的代理对基于自身选择的变化响应可能迥异；且独立训练的深度教师边界不稳定，削弱其作为稳定参照区域的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理模型通常仅用"与教师模型在评估集上的总体一致率"来评价，但局部一致率差异（local variation）虽广为人知，其结构（是否系统性集中于教师决策边界附近）与后果（是否提供超越单一全局分数的信息）尚不清楚。作者希望厘清不一致是否系统地集中在教师决策边界，以及保留该结构是否能带来额外信息。

Method: 在多个数据集与多类代理模型上，采用两种识别"近边界样本"的方法，测量教师决策边界附近的代理保真度；将一致性按置信度定义的区域进行条件化，检验其在评估集构成变化时对师生一致性的预测能力；比较全局与近边界一致性相同但基于代理自身选择的样本变化下响应不同的代理；并检验独立训练的深度教师模型之间决策边界的（不）稳定性。

Result: 两种近边界识别方法均显示：教师决策边界附近的保真度显著更低。以置信度定义区域条件化后的一致性，在评估集构成变化时，比单一全局分数更好预测师生一致性。然而，在全局与近边界一致性上表现相同的代理，对基于代理自身选择的变化可表现出极不相同的响应。此外，独立训练的深度教师模型虽在多数预测上一致，却将不同样本判为近其决策边界，说明边界位置不稳定。

Conclusion: 代理保真度不仅取决于代理与教师一致"多频繁"（how often），还取决于这种一致"发生在何处"（where）；对深度模型而言，还取决于教师决策边界在多次训练中的稳定性（how stable）。因此仅用全局一致率评价代理模型是不充分的，需引入边界附近与稳定性维度的评估。

Abstract: Surrogate models are commonly evaluated by how often they agree with their teacher model over an evaluation set. Local variation in this agreement is well known, but its structure and consequences are less clear. We ask whether disagreement is systematically concentrated near the teacher's decision boundary and whether retaining that structure provides information beyond a single global score. Across several datasets and surrogate model classes, we find substantially lower fidelity near teacher decision boundaries under two different methods of identifying near-boundary examples. Moreover, conditioning agreement on confidence-defined regions improves prediction of teacher--surrogate agreement when evaluation-set composition changes, relative to the global score alone. Yet surrogates that agree equally well with the teacher both globally and near the decision boundary can respond very differently to changes selected using the surrogate itself. Finally, we show that independently trained deep teachers can agree on most predictions while identifying different examples as lying near their decision boundaries, complicating the use of those boundaries as stable reference regions for evaluating surrogates. Together, these results show that surrogate fidelity depends not only on how often a surrogate agrees with its teacher, but also on where that agreement holds and, for deep models, how stable the teacher's decision boundary is across training runs.

</details>


### [1018] [Arithmetic Simplicity in Stochastic Gradient Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32240)
*Bin Fu,Pengfei Gu,Jose Nunez,Fabian Vazquez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将 AdaGrad、Adam 和 AdamW 转化为"算术简单"的梯度方法（仅用 +、−、× 及除以 2 的整数幂），给出静态 Adam 的收敛性分析，便于芯片实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度下降方法的算术复杂度影响其在芯片设计中的可实现性。作者希望将常用自适应优化器（AdaGrad、Adam、AdamW）改造为仅依赖简单算术运算的形式，从而易于硬件实现。

Method: 定义"算术简单"：运算仅限 $+,-,\times$ 和 $x/2^t$（$t$ 为整数）。基于 AdamW 的递归 $x_{t+1}=(1-\lambda\eta)x_t-\frac{\eta}{s}m_t$（Adam 为 $\lambda=0$ 的特例），将步长中的 $s$ 转化为静态情形 $s=S(T)$，其中 $T$ 为迭代次数、$S(T)$ 为固定函数，从而构造静态 Adam 等算术简单变体。

Result: 成功将 AdaGrad、Adam、AdamW 转化为算术简单的形式；并针对静态 Adam（同样算术简单）给出了收敛性分析。

Conclusion: 通过在方法中将缩放因子设为与迭代总数相关的固定函数 $S(T)$，可实现算术简单的自适应梯度方法，为芯片级优化器实现提供理论与算法基础。

Abstract: A gradient descent method is arithmetically simple if the operations are limited to $+,-, \times$, and division $x/2^t$ with integer $t$. An arthmetically simple gradient method is easy to implement in chip design. We show how to transform AdaGrad, Adam, and AdamW into arithmetically simple.
  AdamW is based on the recursion $x_{t+1}=(1-λη)x_t-\frac{η}{s}m_t$ and Adam is the special case of AdamW with $λ=0$. We transform them into a static case with $s=S(T)$, where $T$ is the number of iterations, and $S(T)$ is a fixed function. The convergence analysis is given for a static Adam, which is also arithmetically simple.

</details>


### [1019] [Anytime-Valid LLM Leaderboards via Benchmark-weighted and Block-Factorized e-Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32248)
*Hongfu Gao,Songxin Zhang,Zejian Xie,Bingyi Jing,Zhou Wang,Yiming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BB-EDGE框架，将LLM排行榜建模为有向图，通过基准加权与块分解的e-process在图边上认证模型间的成对均值优势，实现随时有效的FWER控制，并支持Top-k认证与同时排名区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM排行榜按固定基准上的平均表现排名模型，但跨运行（多次评估）的结果存在波动，可能导致关于模型优越性的不成立结论，且排行榜更新会加剧这一风险。

Method: 将排行榜表示为有向图，边表示成对的均值表现优势；对每个方向构造经验Bernstein e-process，按协议定义的分块（block）分解证据，并按块权重分配stakes；再用direct e-Holm跨e-process进行多重检验校正。理论上刻画了异构基准平均零假设下的权重比例线性stakes，并证明在任意块内与跨对依赖下的随时FWER控制。框架还可扩展至随时有效的Top-k认证与同时排名区间。

Result: 在合成数据与四个真实基准上实验，BB-EDGE在保持随时FWER控制的同时达到较高效率。

Conclusion: BB-EDGE为LLM排行榜评估提供了原则性的统计框架，能在结果波动与排行榜更新下给出有向成对优势的可认证结论，并兼具FWER控制与效率。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) leaderboards compare model capabilities by ranking models according to their mean performance on fixed benchmarks. However, variability in evaluation outcomes across runs may produce unsupported claims of model superiority on the benchmark, a risk compounded by leaderboard updates. In this paper, we propose BB-EDGE (Benchmark-Weighted and Block-Factorized e-processes for Directed Graph Evaluation), a principled framework that represents an LLM leaderboard as a directed graph whose edges certify pairwise mean-performance advantages, with anytime-valid family-wise error rate (FWER) control. Concretely, for each direction, BB-EDGE constructs an empirical-Bernstein e-process by factorizing evidence over protocol-defined blocks and assigning stakes proportional to the corresponding block weights, then applies direct e-Holm across these $e$-processes to certify directional advantages as edges. Theoretically, we characterize weight-proportional linear stakes under heterogeneous benchmark-average nulls and prove anytime FWER control under arbitrary within-block and cross-pair dependence. BB-EDGE further supports anytime-valid Top-$k$ certification and simultaneous rank intervals. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and four real-world benchmarks demonstrate that BB-EDGE maintains anytime FWER control while achieving high efficiency.

</details>


### [1020] [Representation Editing for Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32263)
*Longfei Huang,Xiangyu Wu,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FIRE（FourIer Representation Editor），一种从表征工程角度出发的多模态测试时自适应方法，通过直接编辑单模态编码器各中间层的语义表征来实现层级校准，并结合频域混合构建结构化低秩编辑子空间与多级自适应目标，在多个多模态基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态TTA方法主要调整融合特征以弥合源-目标差距，缺乏对中间表征错配的显式控制，而中间表征错配正是分布偏移下性能下降的关键驱动因素。

Method: 提出FIRE，在单模态编码器的每个中间层引入表征编辑器，实现逐层校准；每个编辑器通过快速傅里叶变换进行频域混合以构建结构化基，从而提升低秩编辑子空间的多样性与稳定性；并引入多级自适应目标联合优化编辑器，同时促进跨模态语义对齐、源-目标统计对齐与非对称预测一致性。

Result: 在两种广泛使用的多模态基准上、多种损坏类型下的大量实验表明，FIRE优于现有多模态TTA方法。

Conclusion: FIRE通过直接编辑中间语义表征，为融合提供对齐的单模态表征，进而提升预测可靠性，验证了表征工程视角在多模态测试时自适应中的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt a pretrained multimodal model online to distribution shift across modalities using unlabeled test data, showing broad potential in real-world applications. However, existing methods primarily focus on adjusting fused features to bridge the source-target gap, lacking explicit control over intermediate representation misalignment, which is a key driver of performance drop under distribution shift. In this work, we tackle this challenge from the perspective of representation engineering. Unlike previous TTA methods that update fusion weights in place, we propose FourIer Representation Editor (FIRE), a novel multimodal TTA approach that directly edits semantically rich intermediate representations. Specifically, we first adopt representation editors into each intermediate layer of the unimodal encoders, enabling layer-wise calibration of unimodal representations. To further enhance the diversity and stability of the low-rank editing subspaces, each representation editor performs frequency domain mixing via the fast Fourier transform to construct structured bases. Moreover, we introduce multi-level adaptation objectives to optimize these editors, jointly promoting cross-modal semantic alignment, source-target statistical alignment, and asymmetric prediction consistency. In this way, FIRE yields aligned unimodal representations for fusion and further improves prediction reliability. Extensive experiments on two widely used multimodal benchmarks under various corruption types demonstrate the superiority of FIRE over existing multimodal TTA methods.

</details>


### [1021] [When Can Old Evaluations Certify a New Model? Label-Efficient Release Decisions under Evaluator Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32267)
*Joyanta Jyoti Mondal,Mridul Banik,Md. Shifatul Ahsan Apurba,Md Masud Al Mahmud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何在模型更新发布前，用廉价评估器（如LLM评审）结合历史评估误差来控制当前总体风险，提出一种在历史不可信情形下仍有效的序贯认证方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发布模型更新需认证其当前总体风险低于阈值，而可信标签昂贵、廉价评估器（LLM评审）虽能打分但存在误差。复用早期审计的评估器误差证据可降低成本，但仅在特定"历史状态"假设下才可替代当前标签，需要区分何种历史可用于保证有效性、何种只能用于指导取标签。

Method: 提出"portfolio vigilance"：一种序贯认证器，将受历史引导的betting expert与仅从当前标签学习的专家混合；历史只影响如何下注，因此有效性对任意历史均成立。理论上刻画三类情形：误差可不可见地变化时任何无标签检验都无法检测、有效认证器必须以特定速率持续购买标签；假设变化有界时无标签认证有效但有显式误差代价；历史有信息但不可信时采用上述混合方法。

Result: 在CIFAR-10N与DICES-990上，portfolio vigilance所需标签分别为匹配prediction-powered monitor的0.465倍（95% CI [0.327,0.575]）与0.740倍（[0.618,0.877]），未观察到错误认证，且在全部六个外部块上标签更少。历史建议被污染时，其表现与更优组件相差不超过8.0%，而仅信任历史最多耗费1.66倍。在DICES-990与ToxicChat的重复评审实验中，改变固定LLM评审的评分标准会使分数超出运行间波动，此时portfolio所需标签为匹配监视器的0.790倍（[0.667,0.909]）与0.631倍（[0.520,0.770]），且少于仅信任历史。

Conclusion: 核心贡献不在于先验信息下注或专家混合本身，而在于将可进入有效性保证的历史与仅可指导标签收集的历史相分离；在典型模型中，准确历史能缩短决策但不提高证据增长率，陈旧历史则可能破坏增长率。所提方法在经验上稳定优于仅信任历史与匹配监视器。

Abstract: Releasing a model update requires certifying that its current-population risk stays below a threshold. Trusted labels are expensive, while a cheap evaluator, such as an LLM judge, scores every example. Reusing evaluator errors from earlier audits is tempting, but when may such evidence replace current labels? It depends on the status of history. If the errors can change invisibly, no label-free test detects the change, and every valid, useful certifier must keep buying labels at a rate we characterize; if a bound on the change is assumed, label-free certification is valid at an explicit error cost. For the middle ground, where history is informative but untrusted, we propose \emph{portfolio vigilance}, a sequential certifier mixing a betting expert guided by history with one that learns only from current labels; history affects only how it bets, so validity holds for any history. The contribution is not prior-informed betting or expert mixtures, but separating history that may enter validity from history that may only guide label collection. In a canonical model, accurate history shortens decisions but never raises the evidence growth rate; stale history can destroy it. On held-out CIFAR-10N and DICES-990 data, portfolio vigilance needs 0.465 (95\% CI $[0.327,0.575]$) and 0.740 ($[0.618,0.877]$) times the labels of a matched prediction-powered monitor, with no observed false certification, and fewer labels on all six external blocks. Under corrupted advice it stays within 8.0\% of its better component, while trusting history alone costs up to 1.66 times as much. In post-confirmatory repeated-judge experiments on DICES-990 and ToxicChat, changing a fixed LLM judge's rubric moves its scores beyond run-to-run variation; the portfolio then needs 0.790 ($[0.667,0.909]$) and 0.631 ($[0.520,0.770]$) times the labels of the matched monitor, and fewer than trusting history alone.

</details>


### [1022] [Self-Reconstruction Dynamics for Autoencoder Reconstruction Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32268)
*Hitoshi Iyatomi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出自重建动力学（SRD）：对冻结AE反复施加自身重建会形成图像/潜空间轨迹，虽降低保真度但包含样本特定的纠错信息；据此提出SRD-RR，在无需逐样本测试时优化的条件下预测潜校正，显著恢复MSE差距并提升PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准AE推理仅做一次编码器-解码器前向，固定解码器下潜变量未必对每个样本都最优。作者追问：训练好的AE能否从其自身重建过程中暴露有用信息，用于改进自身的重建质量。

Method: 将冻结AE反复作用于其重建输出，得到样本特定的图像与潜空间轨迹（SRD）；提出SRD引导的重建精化（SRD-RR），用短程SRD预测潜空间校正量，AE保持冻结且不做逐样本测试时优化。同时提出MSE-recov指标，即相对于经验性解码器优化参考的MSE恢复比例。还构建了不直接访问原图的SRD伪目标变体。

Result: 六个数据集上，SRD-RR一次转移恢复38.6%的经验可恢复MSE差距，两次转移恢复45.3%；使用SRD伪目标、不接触原图的两次转移变体恢复40.7%，平均PSNR提升1.74 dB。去除轨迹信息会削弱增益，跨样本轨迹分配导致严重退化，证明强样本特异性。非线性SRD条件精化稳定优于固定与训练线性潜校正。在DINOv2基RAE上同样观察到SRD条件化对无轨迹预测器的改进。像素MSE潜精化暴露像素保真度与感知质量的不匹配，而SRD伪目标可缓解该退化。

Conclusion: SRD是一种有效的样本特定精化信号；目标函数决定其如何转化为像素质量与感知质量。

Abstract: Standard autoencoder (AE) inference uses a single encoder-decoder pass, though the latent may not be optimal for each sample under a fixed decoder. We ask whether a trained AE can reveal information for improving its own reconstruction. Repeated application of a frozen AE to its reconstruction produces transient image- and latent-space trajectories, termed Self-Reconstruction Dynamics (SRD). Although this degrades fidelity in the AEs studied here, SRD contains sample-specific information for correcting the reconstruction. We propose SRD-guided Reconstruction Refinement (SRD-RR), which predicts a latent correction from a short SRD with the AE frozen and no per-sample test-time optimization. We also introduce MSE-recov, an MSE recovery ratio relative to an empirical decoder-optimized reference. Across six datasets, SRD-RR recovers 38.6% of the empirically recoverable MSE gap with one transition and 45.3% with two. A two-transition variant trained without direct access to original images, using an SRD-derived pseudo-target, achieves 40.7% recovery and a 1.74 dB average PSNR gain. Removing trajectory information reduces the gain, while cross-sample trajectory assignment causes severe degradation, confirming strong sample specificity. Nonlinear SRD-conditioned refinement consistently outperforms fixed and trained linear latent correction. On a pretrained DINOv2-based representation autoencoder (RAE) with substantially different latent dynamics, SRD conditioning again improves a matched trajectory-free predictor. However, pixel-MSE latent refinement reveals a strong mismatch between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality, while the SRD-derived pseudo-target mitigates this degradation. Overall, SRD is a useful sample-specific refinement signal, while the objective determines how it translates into pixel and perceptual quality.

</details>


### [1023] [Certification Frontiers for Gaussian LoRA: Independent Priors, Posterior Risk, and Prediction-Preserving Balancing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32271)
*Joyanta Jyoti Mondal,Ibne Farabi Shihab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了高斯LoRA后验的PAC-Bayes认证前沿，区分改变先验、改变随机预测器以及仅改变复杂度计数三种干预，给出各向同性KL包络、GL(r)对称性下的闭式KL最小化方法，并在RoBERTa审计与合成任务上验证复杂度降低单独无法实现认证、Chernoff计数显著优于Hoeffding。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事后贝叶斯微调虽能产生围绕低秩适配器的高斯后验，但校准的后验本身并不足以给出有用的泛化认证；只有当采样预测器的损失与其相对可容许先验的KL散度都较小时，后验才能给出有信息量的PAC-Bayes认证。因此需要刻画这一认证前沿，并厘清不同干预手段对认证能力的影响。

Method: 第一，构造精确的各向同性KL包络以消除先验尺度，得到可在采样前排除某些后验宽度的宽度阈值，并用零KL下界识别在给定风险界下无法通过降低复杂度达到的目标。第二，在低秩因子的完整GL(r)对称性上以闭式解最小化KL，保持所有采样适配器乘积不变，并推导当先验中心在独立划分上训练时所需的非中心目标。评估包括小池RoBERTa的567种配置审计（64次抽样摘要）、受控高斯因子任务（20个数据集、1024次抽样），以及刻意变形的合成秩四因子实验（比较矩阵平衡与标量平衡），并给出划分先验的数值场景。

Result: RoBERTa审计中，即使零KL并采用Chernoff计数，64次抽样摘要仍隐含0.7298的认证下界，说明在记录预算下仅降低复杂度无法认证这些后验。在受控高斯因子任务的稳定后验上，Chernoff计数在20/20数据集、1024次抽样下认证风险低于0.1，而Hoeffding无法认证任何数据集。在刻意变形的合成秩四因子上，矩阵平衡相比标量平衡平均额外降低KL达29.3%，且不改变任何预测。

Conclusion: 复杂度计数方式（Chernoff与Hoeffding之别）及因子对称性上的KL最小化对认证能力具有决定性影响；仅靠降低复杂度不足以认证高斯LoRA后验，而利用GL(r)对称性的矩阵平衡可在不改变预测的前提下显著降低KL。数值划分先验场景进一步明确了剩余风险与复杂度预算的权衡。

Abstract: Post-hoc Bayesian fine-tuning places Gaussians around trained low-rank adapters, yet a calibrated posterior does not by itself yield a useful generalization certificate. Such a posterior admits an informative PAC-Bayes certificate only when both the loss of its sampled predictors and its KL divergence from an admissible prior are small. In this research, we characterize this certification frontier for Gaussian LoRA posteriors and separate three interventions: changing the prior, changing the stochastic predictor, and changing only how its complexity is counted. First, an exact isotropic KL envelope eliminates the prior scale and yields a width threshold that excludes posterior widths before sampling, while a zero-KL floor identifies targets that no complexity reduction can reach at a measured risk bound. Second, we minimize KL in closed form over the full $GL(r)$ symmetry of the low-rank factors, leaving every sampled adapter product unchanged, and derive the noncentral objective required when the prior center is trained on an independent split. On a small-pool RoBERTa audit of 567 configurations, the recorded 64-draw summaries imply a certificate floor of $0.7298$ even with zero KL and Chernoff accounting, so reducing complexity alone cannot certify these posteriors at the recorded budgets. For a stable posterior in a controlled Gaussian-factor task, Chernoff accounting certifies risk below $0.1$ on 20 of 20 datasets with 1024 draws, whereas Hoeffding certifies none. On deliberately deformed synthetic rank-four factors, matrix balancing reduces KL by $29.3\%$ on average beyond scalar balancing without changing any prediction. Numerical split-prior scenarios make the remaining risk and complexity budgets explicit.

</details>


### [1024] [Topology-Adaptive Hyperbolic Graph Attention Networks Guided by the Hyperbolic Sombor Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32275)
*Haifang Cao,Boan Tao,Xiyuan Gao,Timing Li,Yu Wang,Pengfei Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出超图Sombor指数（HSO）作为轻量级结构先验，并构建HSO-GAT——一种拓扑自适应的双曲图注意力网络，在八个基准数据集上于节点分类与链接预测任务取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双曲图神经网络多采用共享曲率配置与特征驱动注意力，未能显式利用局部的层次拓扑模式，限制了对层次结构的建模能力。

Method: 引入HSO指数刻画层次指示性的度分层结构；设计两个互补模块：HSO引导的局部曲率自适应（基于聚合的节点级HSO信号进行节点级几何缩放）与HSO门控双曲图注意力（通过特征条件门控实现结构感知的消息传递）。理论上证明边级HSO对度不平衡的单调敏感性，并分析节点自适应双曲映射的有效性与径向缩放性质。

Result: 在八个基准数据集上的大量实验中，HSO-GAT在节点分类与链接预测任务上均持续取得最优（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: 将HSO作为结构先验并实现几何自适应与消息传播的统一，可有效提升双曲图神经网络对层次结构的表达与下游任务表现。

Abstract: Hyperbolic geometry has emerged as a principled space for representing hierarchical graphs. However, existing hyperbolic graph neural networks typically rely on shared curvature configurations and feature-driven attention, failing to explicitly exploit local hierarchical topological patterns. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Hyperbolic Sombor Index (HSO) as a lightweight structural prior for capturing hierarchy-indicative degree stratification. Building on this, we propose \textbf{HSO-GAT}, a topology-adaptive hyperbolic graph attention network that unifies geometric adaptation and message propagation. Specifically, it comprises two complementary modules: HSO-Guided Local Curvature Adaptation, which performs adaptive node-wise geometric scaling from aggregated node-level HSO signals, and HSO-Gated Hyperbolic Graph Attention, which enables structure-aware message passing through feature-conditioned gating. Theoretically, we establish the monotonic sensitivity of edge-level HSO to degree imbalance and analyze the validity and radial scaling properties of node-adaptive hyperbolic mappings. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSO-GAT consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both node classification and link prediction tasks.

</details>


### [1025] [HyperLabel: Multi-Label Classification via Hypergraph-Based Label Correlation Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32276)
*Peiyu Zhang,Heng Ping,Nikos Kanakaris,Yucheng Zhao,Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Xiongye Xiao,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HyperLabel编码器-解码器框架，通过超图神经网络显式建模多标签分类中的高阶标签依赖，在七个基准数据集中取得SOTA，尤其macro-F1显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多标签分类的核心挑战是建模由标签共现模式产生的复杂标签依赖关系。现有方法难以捕获高阶标签相关性，主要通过对比学习目标或成对注意力机制隐式学习，缺乏结构指导。

Method: 两点贡献：(i) 构建标签超图，由样本定义的超边自然编码多路共现模式，提供超越成对交互的显式结构先验；(ii) 提出统一的跨模态学习方法，HGNN+执行双向消息传递以融合特征信息与标签结构，共享的交叉注意力解码器通过互补学习目标处理两种模态。

Result: 在七个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能，macro-F1提升尤为显著（Delicious +10.3%，Bibtex +8.2%），验证了显式超图结构能有效捕获复杂标签关系。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 显式超图结构可有效建模高阶标签依赖，HyperLabel在多标签分类任务上优于隐式依赖建模方法。

Abstract: Multi-label classification (MLC) requires predicting multiple relevant labels for each instance, where a central challenge is modeling complex label dependencies arising from co-occurrence patterns. Existing approaches are limited in capturing high-order label correlations, relying on implicit learning through contrastive objectives or pairwise attention mechanisms without structural guidance. We propose HyperLabel, an encoder-decoder framework that explicitly models label dependencies through hypergraph neural networks. Our contributions are twofold: (i) We construct a label hypergraph where sample-defined hyperedges naturally encode multi-way co-occurrence patterns, providing explicit structural prior knowledge that captures relationships beyond pairwise interactions. (ii) We propose a unified cross-modal learning approach where HGNN+ performs bidirectional message passing to integrate feature information with label structure, and a shared cross-attention decoder processes both modalities through complementary learning objectives. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that HyperLabel achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly significant improvements on macro-F1 scores (+10.3% on Delicious, +8.2% on Bibtex), validating that explicit hypergraph structure effectively captures complex label relationships. The code is available at https://github.com/iZHpy/Multi-label_hypergraph .

</details>


### [1026] [SIMANF: Sample Free Learning of Unnormalized Distributions via Simulated Annealing in Normalizing Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32279)
*Vikas Kanaujia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SIMANF，一种无需目标样本的框架，将模拟退火与归一化流结合，通过渐进式分布变换与分阶段训练提升多模态高维分布的模式覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从高维、多模态的未归一化分布中高效学习并采样，且不使用目标样本，仍是难题。基于反向KL散度的归一化流虽能高效采样，但仅用未归一化目标密度训练时易发生模式崩塌（mode collapse）。

Method: SIMANF将模拟退火与归一化流集成：将目标分布从光滑初始形式逐步变换为原始目标分布，并在各阶段顺序训练流；通过阶段间迁移已学表征促进模式覆盖并逐步捕捉更细特征。退火后进行最终精修阶段，将反向KL散度与重要性加权的正向KL目标结合，所用样本由流自身生成。整个过程无需目标样本，仅使用未归一化密度。

Result: 在Many-Well分布与高维Scalar Phi4格点场论分布上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: SIMANF是一种样本自由框架，通过模拟退火与归一化流的结合，在无目标样本条件下缓解模式崩塌，实现高维多模态未归一化分布的有效学习与采样。

Abstract: Efficiently learning and sampling from high dimensional, multimodal unnormalized distributions without target samples remains a challenging problem. Although normalizing flows can generate samples efficiently, training based on the reverse KL divergence using only the unnormalized target density may suffer from mode collapse. We introduce SIMANF, a sample free framework that integrates simulated annealing with normalizing flows. SIMANF progressively transforms the target distribution from a smooth initial form to the original target distribution and trains the flow sequentially across these stages. By transferring the learned representation between stages, the method promotes mode coverage while progressively capturing finer features of the target distribution. Following annealing, a final refinement stage combines the reverse KL divergence with an importance weighted forward KL objective using samples generated by the flow. SIMANF requires no target samples during training and uses only the unnormalized density. We demonstrate its effectiveness on Many-Well distributions and high dimensional Scalar Phi4 lattice field theory distribution.

</details>


### [1027] [A Journey to the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32290)
*Jaerin Lee,Kyoung Mu Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过按优化器直流增益(dc gain)缩放学习率,不同一阶优化器的损失、锐度、梯度对齐轨迹在很大学习率范围内几乎重合,并据此划分出低、中、高学习率三个不同机制区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究发现在"稳定边缘(EoS)"处,模型最大Hessian特征值稳定在学习率倒数附近;但在到达该机制之前会发生什么尚不清楚,且不同优化器、学习率与模型各自在训练进程中的作用未得到厘清。

Method: 固定一个深度学习问题,对多种一阶优化方法进行密集的学习率扫描,并追踪学习轨迹的三个特征量:损失、锐度(sharpness,即最大Hessian特征值)以及连续梯度之间的对齐度。

Result: 若将学习率按优化器的dc gain进行缩放,来自不同优化器的扫描轨迹在很大学习率范围内几乎完美重合;dc归一化后的优化器还决定了锐度何时从该普适曲线上脱离并进入稳定边缘阶段。

Conclusion: 依据dc调整后的学习率可区分三种机制:低学习率区(轨迹对优化器几乎不敏感)、高学习率区(优化器按EoS倒数规则主导锐度)、中间区(渐进锐化(progressive sharpening)独立于优化器发生)。这区分了优化器、学习率与模型在塑造学习过程中的各自作用。

Abstract: It has recently been found that deep learning often occurs at the "edge of stability (EoS)," where the maximum Hessian eigenvalue of the model is stabilized at a value reciprocal to the learning rate. However, what happens before we reach that regime? We fix a deep learning problem and vary first order optimization methods with dense learning rate sweeps. We then track the characterizing quantities of a learning trajectory: the loss, the sharpness, and the alignment between consecutive gradients. To our surprise, if we scale the learning rate by the dc gain of the optimizer, these traces from the sweeps from different optimizers almost perfectly overlap across a large range of learning rates. The dc-normalized optimizers have another role that only becomes apparent in high learning rates: they select when the sharpness value detaches from this universal curve and enters the edge of stability. Upon this discovery, we specify three distinct regimes with respect to the dc-adjusted learning rate: the low-LR regime where the trajectory is nearly insensitive to the optimizer, the high-LR regime, where the optimizer governs the sharpness according to the EoS reciprocal rule, and the in-between mid-LR regime where so-called progressive sharpening originates independently of the optimizer. This distinguishes the role of the optimizer, the learning rate, and the model in shaping the learning progress.

</details>


### [1028] [FUND: Density Flow for Sampling Unnormalised Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32296)
*Vikas Kanaujia,Vipul Arora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需真实样本训练的玻尔兹曼分布学习算法，将流匹配从"样本轨迹匹配"改为"分布轨迹匹配"，通过迭代重塑目标分布实现全面模式覆盖，在多个基准上优于MCMC与流基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从玻尔兹曼分布高效采样对复杂物理系统建模至关重要。MCMC方法存在临界慢化、高自相关和模式混合差的问题，难以扩展；Boltzmann Generators虽具前景，但受限于昂贵的基于MCMC的训练、低效采样与遍历性不足。因此需要一种无需真实样本、能保证模式覆盖的学习方法。

Method: 算法受flow matching启发，但根本性地从样本轨迹匹配转向分布轨迹匹配。它迭代地重塑目标分布，用模型自生成样本引导学习，从而确保对全部模式的覆盖，且训练过程完全不依赖真实样本。

Result: 在标准基准上验证，包括2D高斯混合、Many-Well分布以及高维标量φ⁴理论。相比传统MCMC与基于流的基线，所提方法在采样性能与准确性上均有提升。

Conclusion: 该工作不仅提升了采样性能与精度，还建立了一种面向复杂物理分布的免样本学习新范式。

Abstract: Efficient sampling from Boltzmann distributions is central to modelling complex physical systems. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods suffer from critical slowing down, high autocorrelation, and poor mode-mixing, limiting their scalability. Recent advances, like Boltzmann Generators, offer a promising alternative but remain constrained by costly MCMC-based training, inefficient sampling, and poor ergodicity. We introduce an algorithm for learning Boltzmann distributions that does not require any true samples for training. Our approach draws inspiration from flow matching but departs fundamentally from sample-trajectory matching to distribution-trajectory matching. The algorithm iteratively reshapes the target distribution, using model generated samples to guide learning and ensure comprehensive mode coverage. We validate our method on standard benchmarks, including a 2D Gaussian mixture, Many-Well distributions, and high-dimensional scalar $φ^4$ theory. The proposed approach not only improves sampling performance and accuracy over traditional MCMC and flow-based baselines but also establishes a new method for sample-free learning of complex physical distributions.

</details>


### [1029] [Refresh or Realize? Compute Allocation in Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32298)
*Sipeng Chen,Xu Zheng,Shibo Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Drifting Models训练中"算力该花在哪"的问题：把额外算力用于更深入地拟合当前目标，还是用于重新计算漂移场（刷新目标）。在ImageNet 256×256上的实验表明，免费额外步数时k=2可降低FID，但在墙钟时间匹配时，把预算用于刷新场比深度拟合取得更低FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Drifting Models通过每轮重算有限样本漂移场并朝漂移目标迈一步优化器来训练一步生成器。但漂移场指示的是样本应如何移动，而优化步是在所有样本共享的参数空间中进行的，网络实际产生的位移未必与给定场一致。由此留下一个基本训练问题：额外算力应投入"更贴近当前目标地拟合"，还是投入"重新计算漂移场"？

Method: 在ImageNet 256×256上，将目标固定k个优化器步并测量实际位移；对比"深度拟合"（固定目标多步拟合）与"刷新场"（重算漂移场）两种算力分配策略；分析有限支撑重采样对方向的影响（与参数更新比较余弦相似度），并比较场空间最优修正与无参数修正的FID。

Result: 固定目标时，更深拟合确实使网络更接近冻结目标；产生净进展所需步数从训练早期的约16步降到后期的1步。额外步数免费时，k=2也能降低FID。但一旦计入成本，在约等墙钟时间下，把预算用于刷新场在两个训练种子上都比深度拟合取得更低FID。重采样有限支撑对方向的旋转远大于参数更新（余弦约0.3–0.6对约0.95），且场空间最优修正未必在FID上稳定优于无参数修正。

Conclusion: 对Drifting而言，"把每个目标拟合好"与"把算力花在刀刃上"是两个不同的目标。在计时的实际场景中，刷新场的性价比高于深度拟合，有限支撑重采样带来的方向变化是刷新场价值高的关键原因。

Abstract: Drifting Models train a one-step generator by recomputing a finite-sample drift field at every iteration and taking an optimizer step toward the drifted target. The field says how generated samples should move, but the step is taken in parameters shared by all samples, so the motion the network actually makes need not match the motion it was given. This leaves a basic training question open: should extra compute go into fitting the current target more closely, or into recomputing the field? We study it on ImageNet 256x256. Holding the target fixed for k optimizer steps and measuring the realized displacement, we find that deeper fitting does bring the network closer to the frozen target, and that the number of steps needed before it makes any net progress drops from about sixteen early in training to one later on. When the extra steps come for free, k=2 also lowers FID. Once they are paid for, the result flips: at approximately matched measured wall-clock, spending the budget on fresh fields gives lower FID than deeper fitting, on both training seeds. The target itself shows why a fresh field is worth so much. Redrawing the finite support rotates its direction far more than a parameter update does (cosine ~0.3-0.6 against ~0.95), and a correction that is optimal in field space is not reliably better in FID than a parameter-free one. For Drifting, fitting each target well and spending compute well are different goals.

</details>


### [1030] [When Does Synergy Help Active Feature Acquisition? A PID-Based Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32301)
*Jie Li,Maruf A. Dhali,Hjalmar R. Bouma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SynAFA，一种状态依赖的主动特征获取（AFA）策略，用部分信息分解（PID）刻画成对联合信息与条件信息的信息结构。实验显示其收益高度异质：仅在低预算的 PhysioNet 上显著，随预算增大优势消失；在 MiniBooNE 与 MNIST-loop 上显著劣于多数基线。合成实验表明优势随协同主导性增强而提高，但局部信息难以转化为有效的获取目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AFA 策略在选择特征时通常不区分交互特征所贡献的信息是冗余、独特还是协同的，缺乏对信息结构的显式刻画，因而可能错失真正有增益价值（协同）的特征对。

Method: 提出 SynAFA：一种状态依赖的 AFA 策略，同时结合成对联合信息与条件信息，并用 Partial Information Decomposition（PID）刻画其信息结构。在五个表格数据集与 MNIST-loop 上评估，辅以置换检验、成对提议消融、受控合成实验（调节协同占比并控制总联合信息），以及非贪心局部搜索的诊断性集合级目标分析。

Result: 性能异质：SynAFA 在低预算 PhysioNet 上增益最强，且协同/冗余特征对获置换检验支持，但优势随预算增加而衰减，且不依赖成对提议方式；在 MiniBooNE 上显著劣于几乎所有基线，在 MNIST-loop 上劣于 CAE。合成实验中，预算内优势随联合信息中协同占比升高而增大（总联合信息近似固定时亦然）。预算依赖的收益衰减无法由非贪心局部搜索解决：局部搜索改善了诊断性的集合级目标，却未提升（甚至常显著恶化）预测性能，且该目标的改进与固定分类器的预测效用仅弱相关。

Conclusion: 成对协同在特定条件（低预算、协同主导的信息结构）下确能提升 AFA，但将局部信息度量转化为有效的获取目标仍是一个持续存在的挑战。

Abstract: Active feature acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects informative features under budget constraints. However, existing policies rarely distinguish whether information contributed by interacting features is redundant, unique, or synergistic. We introduce SynAFA, a state-dependent AFA policy that combines pairwise joint information and conditional information, with Partial Information Decomposition (PID) characterizing its information structure. Across five tabular datasets and MNIST-loop, performance is heterogeneous. SynAFA shows its strongest gains at low budgets on PhysioNet, where synergistic and redundant feature pairs are supported by permutation tests, but its advantage diminishes as budgets increase and does not depend on pair proposals. SynAFA performs significantly worse than nearly all baselines on MiniBooNE, and than CAE on MNIST-loop. Controlled synthetic experiments further show that, within budget, SynAFA's advantage rises as joint information becomes more synergy-dominated, including when total joint information is held approximately constant. Further analyses show that the budget-dependent erosion is not resolved by non-greedy local search, which improves a diagnostic set-level objective but leaves predictive performance no better, often significantly worse, and that improvements in this objective are weakly aligned with the fixed classifier's predictive utility. These findings characterize when pairwise synergy can benefit AFA while exposing a persistent challenge in translating local information into effective acquisition objectives.

</details>


### [1031] [On the Capability and Limitation of Hard Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32302)
*Lijia Yu,Shuaitong Liu,Gaojie Jin,Xinyu Li,Xiao-Shan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统地从理论层面研究硬提示（离散提示），围绕三个核心问题给出结果：硬提示存在性判定是NP完全的、最优硬提示求解是NP难的；硬提示存在本质局限（不完备、短提示增益有限、长提示出现"提示主导答案"现象），而线性硬提示可规避这些局限；并给出提示长度与任务规模之间的紧界，得到可泛化的充要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示工程已能将LLM变为任务专家而无需改权重，但现有理论进展多集中于软（连续）提示，对更实用的硬（离散）提示的理论理解基本空白。本文旨在填补这一缺口，回答硬提示的三个核心理论问题。

Method: 从计算复杂性、表达能力/本质局限、泛化性三个角度对硬提示进行分析：证明存在性判定为NP完全、最优提示寻找为NP难；对比软提示刻画硬提示的局限（不完备性、短提示增益有限、长提示的"提示主导答案"现象）；并分析线性硬提示的特殊性质；进一步推导提示长度与任务规模间的紧界以给出泛化充要条件。

Result: （1）判定变压器是否存在解决下游任务的硬提示是NP完全的，寻找最优硬提示是NP难的，为硬提示的首个计算复杂性结果；（2）硬提示不完备，短硬提示不能显著增强变压器能力，长硬提示会出现"提示主导答案"现象（同长度查询大概率得到同一答案），而线性硬提示不受短/长提示的这些限制；（3）给出以提示长度表示任务规模的紧界，据此得到提示性能从有限任务泛化到整个数据分布的充要条件，为提示领域的首个泛化结果。

Conclusion: 本文提供了关于硬提示的首批理论洞见，揭示了其计算难度与本质局限，并给出可证明可靠的实践指导，有助于真实场景下LLM的可信使用。

Abstract: Prompt engineering has become an indispensable tool for using large language models (LLMs), turning LLMs into task-specific experts without changing their weights. Despite notable theoretical advances in prompt engineering, the theory for the more practical hard or discrete prompts is largely open. In this paper, we try to fill this gap either by providing a complete solution or by making substantial progress on the three core theoretical questions regarding hard prompts. First, we show that determining the existence of a hard prompt for a transformer to solve a downstream task is NP-complete and that finding an optimal hard prompt is NP-hard, which is the first computational complexity result for hard prompting, as far as we know. Second, we show that, unlike soft or continuous prompts, hard prompts have essential limitations: hard prompts are not complete; short hard prompts do not significantly enhance the ability of transformers; and long hard prompts exhibit the "prompt dominating answer phenomenon," meaning that, with high probability, the same answer is given for all queries of the same length. On the other hand, linear hard prompts do not have the limitations of short or long prompts. Third, we provide a tight bound on the size of the task in terms of the prompt length for the performance of prompts on the finite task to generalize to the entire data distribution, leading to a necessary and sufficient condition for generalizability. This is the first result on generalization for prompting, as far as we know. Our findings not only offer the first theoretical insights into hard prompts but also provide provably reliable practical guidance for real-world LLM usage.

</details>


### [1032] [Not All Errors Matter: Decision-Relevant Prediction Error Predicts Planning Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32322)
*Linhao Wang,Yiyan Fan,Dongjin Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出用总预测误差评估世界模型会失效，提出决策相关预测误差（DRPE）与等误差评估协议；实验显示总误差与规划成功率弱相关（ρ=-0.25），DRPE强相关（ρ=-0.84），且1%总误差差异可致60个百分点成功率差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型通常以预测误差训练和评估，隐含"预测越准决策越好"的假设。但该假设可能失效：总误差相近的模型，若误差分布在不同的状态维度上，规划表现可能差异巨大。因此需要区分误差"总量"与误差"位置"对决策的影响。

Method: 提出决策相关预测误差（DRPE），只度量影响决策的状态维度上的预测误差；设计等误差评估协议，在固定总误差的前提下改变误差分配。在状态相关性已知的因子化网格世界中，使用标准化规划器，评估55个受控与学习模型在不同误差水平和分配下的表现，并给出DRPE能正确排序模型而总误差不能的充分条件。

Result: 总预测误差与规划成功率仅弱相关（Spearman ρ=-0.25），DRPE则强预测（ρ=-0.84，受控模型族内-0.98）。总误差仅差1%的模型，规划成功率可相差60个百分点（97% vs 37%）。相关误差依赖任务，同一总误差下模型排序会跨任务反转。更深的想象会放大决策相关误差；学习模型在稀有但决策关键事件上存在系统性偏差。

Conclusion: 预测精度不等于决策质量，评估与训练世界模型应关注误差发生在哪些状态维度，而非仅看总误差；DRPE与等误差协议提供了更贴近规划性能的评估视角，并在一定条件下可证优于总预测误差。

Abstract: World models are typically trained and evaluated by prediction error, assuming that more accurate predictions lead to better decisions. We show that this assumption can fail because models with similar total error can differ substantially in planning performance when their errors occur on different state dimensions. We introduce Decision-Relevant Prediction Error (DRPE), which measures prediction error on the state dimensions that affect decisions. We also develop an iso-error evaluation protocol that varies error allocation while keeping total error fixed. In a factored gridworld with known state relevance and a standardized planner, we evaluate 55 controlled and learned models across different error levels and allocations. Total prediction error is weakly related to planning success (Spearman $ρ=-0.25$), whereas DRPE is strongly predictive ($ρ=-0.84$; $-0.98$ within the controlled family). Models with only a 1\% difference in total error can differ by 60 percentage points in planning success (97\% vs 37\%). The relevant error also depends on the task, with model rankings reversing across tasks at the same total error. Deeper imagination further amplifies decision-relevant errors, while learned models exhibit systematic bias on rare but decision-critical events. We formalize sufficient conditions under which DRPE correctly ranks models and total prediction error cannot.

</details>


### [1033] [Continual Data Unlearning in Diffusion Models via Transition-based Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32328)
*Sunbeom Jeong,Sehwan Kim,Sangwoo Hong,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种持续数据遗忘框架，利用已完成的删除过渡作为方向性参考来正则化后续更新，在扩散模型中实现删除持久性与生成效用的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型数据遗忘旨在移除特定训练样本的影响而不抑制其代表的概念。但当删除请求顺序到达时，新请求的更新会损害生成效用并破坏此前的删除效果，现有方法难以兼顾删除持久性与生成质量。

Method: 为每个请求记录同一固定噪声输入下去噪器响应在遗忘前后的变化，作为方向性参考。不匹配完整删除后响应，而是施加单侧惩罚：相对于删除后参考，抑制沿记录方向的反转，对正交方向的响应变化及超出参考的进展不加惩罚。为保持存储与请求数无关，维护固定容量的代表性过渡记录库，依据沿记录方向的进展对参数更新的局部敏感性来选择记录，使其在惩罚未激活时仍能保留。

Result: 实验表明，随着请求累积，该框架在删除持久性与生成效用之间取得比现有遗忘基线更好的平衡，且仅需很小的过渡记忆。

Conclusion: 基于方向性参考的单侧惩罚与固定容量代表性过渡库，可有效缓解持续遗忘中的效用退化与旧删除失效问题，实现存储高效且性能更优的持续数据遗忘。

Abstract: Data unlearning in diffusion models aims to remove the influence of specific training examples without suppressing the broader concepts they represent. However, when deletion requests arrive sequentially, updates for new requests can degrade generative utility and undermine earlier deletions. We propose a continual data unlearning framework that uses completed deletion transitions as directional references to regularize future updates. For each request, we record changes in denoiser responses on the same fixed noisy inputs before and after unlearning. Rather than matching full post-deletion responses, we apply a one-sided penalty that discourages reversal along the recorded directions relative to the post-deletion references, while leaving orthogonal response changes and progress beyond these references unpenalized. To keep storage independent of the number of requests, we maintain a fixed-capacity bank of representative transition records. Records are selected based on the local sensitivity of progress along their recorded directions to parameter updates, allowing them to be retained even when their penalties are inactive. Empirical evaluations show that the proposed framework achieves a better balance between deletion persistence and generative utility than existing unlearning baselines as requests accumulate, using only a small transition memory.

</details>


### [1034] [When the Merge Coefficient Stops Mattering: Proximity Regularized Merging for Continual LoRA Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32332)
*Yixuan Liu,Yuhao Sun,Sen Song,Jin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出近端正则化合并（PRM），在不改变顺序LoRA写回规则的前提下，仅在任务向量训练阶段加入近端惩罚，使任务向量更“可合并”，从而提升无回放持续学习的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无回放持续学习中使用参数高效适配器时，通常把每个新任务学到的低秩适配器合并进运行模型，可视为一系列任务向量“写回”操作。现有方法主要关注写回多少（系数/合并规则），但任务向量本身是否被训练成易于合并的性质被忽视，因此作者希望从训练端改进任务向量的可合并性。

Method: PRM 是对顺序 LoRA 合并的最小改动：在任务向量（低秩适配器）训练时加入近端（proximal）惩罚项，而后续写回规则保持不变。作者在 Base->+Prox 诊断设置中，跨多种写回规则、骨干网络和类增量场景评估 PRM，并进行匹配前缀范数控制与近端强度扫描等机制分析。

Result: 在报告的 Base->+Prox 诊断中，PRM 在多种写回规则、骨干网络和类增量设置下均提升 AAA；其固定系数变体与强系数基线相比仍具竞争力。机制上，近端训练缩小任务向量半径、降低 Fisher 加权干扰、拓宽系数平台，并显现出稳定性-可塑性权衡。

Conclusion: 顺序 LoRA 合并的有效性不仅取决于写回任务向量的比例（写回规则），也取决于任务向量本身是否被训练得“可合并”。PRM 作为一种鲁棒的任务向量正则化手段，为此提供了简单有效的实现路径。

Abstract: Rehearsal-free continual learning with parameter-efficient adapters can be cast as a sequence of task-vector write-in operations: for each new task, a low-rank adapter is learned and merged into a running model. We propose Proximity Regularized Merging (PRM), a minimal modification to sequential LoRA merging that adds a proximal penalty during task-vector training without changing the subsequent write-in rule. PRM acts as a robust task-vector regularizer: in the reported Base->+Prox diagnostics, it improves AAA across multiple write-in rules, backbones, and class-incremental settings, while its fixed-coefficient variant remains competitive with strong coefficient-based baselines. Mechanistically, matched-prefix norm controls and proximal-strength sweeps show that proximal training shrinks the task-vector radius, lowers Fisher-weighted interference, broadens the coefficient plateau, and exposes a stability-plasticity trade-off. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of sequential LoRA merging depends not only on how much of a task vector is written in, but also on whether the task vector itself has been trained to be mergeable.

</details>


### [1035] [A Comparative Analysis of Attention versus State-Space Models for In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32341)
*Enes Arda,Semih Cayci,Atilla Eryilmaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"信念几何"统一分析框架，从表征能力角度系统比较注意力机制与状态空间模型（SSM），揭示二者在不同序列学习能力上的结构性优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer与SSM是两类主流序列学习架构，但二者的比较多停留在经验层面，现有理论分析往往局限于特定任务或特定架构，缺乏统一、通用的分析视角。

Method: 从上下文线性回归的广义表述出发，以累积贝叶斯遗憾（cumulative Bayes regret）为度量，抽象出序列学习所需的三种能力——证据组装（evidence assembly）、信念维护（belief maintenance）与寻址（addressing），并构造三种可隔离这些能力的特例进行分析。

Result: 在信念维护上，SSM在平稳聚合核上达到最优遗憾；在位置组装上，SSM具有记忆优势；在内容寻址上，softmax注意力相比sigmoid选择性SSM具有指数级宽度优势。基于LLaMA型Transformer与Mamba-2的实验表明这些结论可超越可解析类别与线性回归测试环境。

Conclusion: 信念几何框架为注意力与SSM的表征能力比较提供了统一理论工具，明确了二者在证据组装、信念维护与寻址三方面的架构性差异，且该洞见在真实模型上具有推广性。

Abstract: Transformers and state-space models (SSMs) are two prominent sequential learning architectures, yet their comparison remains largely empirical and existing theoretical analyses are typically task-specific or architecturally restricted. In this paper, we develop belief geometry, a unified analytical framework for comparing the representational capabilities of broad classes of attention and SSMs. Starting from a generalized formulation of in-context linear regression and using cumulative Bayes regret as our measure, we abstract three capabilities required by many sequential learning problems in our belief geometry: evidence assembly, belief maintenance, and addressing. We then study three cases of our formulation that isolate these capabilities and yield sharp architectural lessons: For belief maintenance, SSMs attain the optimal regret over stationary aggregation kernels; for positional assembly, SSMs have a memory advantage; and for content addressing, softmax attention has an exponential width advantage over sigmoid-selective SSMs. Experiments with LLaMA-type Transformers and Mamba-2 show that these architectural insights extend beyond our analytically tractable classes and linear-regression testbed.

</details>


### [1036] [Editable Map-Conditioned Trajectory Generation for Human Mobility Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32360)
*Takayuki Mizuno,Shouji Fujimoto,Mikito Hiruki,Atushi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出"以地图为条件的自回归人类移动生成"任务：用道路栅格图条件化解码器，逐分钟生成31.25米网格单元的移动token，实现无需重训练即可响应地图编辑的移动性模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理空间基础设施干预模拟需要能直接响应地图编辑的移动性生成器，但现有多数数据驱动生成器未将地图作为可编辑条件暴露出来。

Method: 将任务形式化为地图条件自回归生成；道路栅格图条件化解码器，逐分钟输出名义31.25米网格单元token；设计网格局部词表以支持未见地图和本地编辑而不需重训练或改词表。实例化ResNet-50视觉前缀配置与ViT交叉注意力配置，基于日本石川县874个网格、87,400条智能手机轨迹从零训练，其中219个网格留出。以正确地图与同划分内打乱地图的生成对比留出真实轨迹来评估地图敏感性。

Result: 在110网格测试集上，ResNet-50配置下正确地图生成在60%网格上比打乱地图更接近真实轨迹（基于Hausdorff的能量距离，p=0.021），DTW呈方向性但不显著（57%，p=0.074）；与真实密度的相关性正确地图为0.38，打乱地图为0.01。ViT配置轨迹级敏感性更弱、密度增益更小。示意性的桥梁移除编辑在无重训练下改变了生成轨迹。

Conclusion: 结果支持可编辑地图人类移动性模拟的可行性。

Abstract: Geospatial simulation of infrastructure interventions requires mobility generators that respond directly to edited maps, yet many data-driven generators do not expose the map as an editable condition. We formulate this task as map-conditioned autoregressive generation of human mobility: a road raster conditions a decoder that emits nominal 31.25 m mesh-cell tokens at one-minute intervals. The mesh-local vocabulary supports held-out and locally edited maps without retraining or vocabulary changes. We instantiate a ResNet-50 visual-prefix configuration and a Vision Transformer (ViT) cross-attention configuration, trained from scratch on 87,400 smartphone-derived trajectories from 874 meshes in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan; 219 meshes are held out. We evaluate map sensitivity by comparing correct-map and within-split shuffled-map generations with held-out real trajectories. On the 110-mesh test split, for the ResNet-50 configuration, correct-map generations are closer than shuffled-map generations on 60% of meshes under Hausdorff-based energy distance (p = 0.021), while DTW is directional but inconclusive (57%, p = 0.074); correlation with real density is 0.38 with the correct map versus 0.01 with shuffled maps. The ViT configuration shows weaker trajectory-level sensitivity and smaller density gains. An illustrative bridge-removal edit changes generated continuations without retraining. Together, these results support the feasibility of editable-map human-mobility simulation.

</details>


### [1037] [STRIDE: State-Transition Representation via Increment Dynamics and Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32367)
*Yuchen Xiong,Siming Huang,Jianfeng Sun*

Main category: cs.LG
