TL;DR: 提出STRIDE框架，将连续时间序列预测重构为状态转移预测：以导数指纹定义状态，用轨迹卷积估计局部联合转移频率并经POD提取增量轨迹坐标，稀疏动力学联合预报后经历史锚定反演得到未来转移分布，实现连续概率预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统连续预测直接拟合数值序列，难以刻画状态间的转移结构及其长时程演变。作者希望将预测问题转化为状态转移统计（转移分布）的预测，从而更自然地衔接连续概率预测与长时程误差控制。

Method: STRIDE通过导数指纹定义状态，学习状态转移的局部函数（qpairs），把连续预测转为转移预测；用尾部卷积窗估计局部联合转移频率，其后向差分构成高维增量轨迹；对增量轨迹做POD获得坐标路径，以带记忆的稀疏动力学联合预报；重组各坐标预报并用历史锚定反演恢复未来转移分布，采样状态路径选择局部函数生成连续预测。实验用三随机种子，对比14个基线、9个基准族，并用5个独立马尔可夫/隐状态基线覆盖全部230个任务（220个完整全时程配对）；另在64条独立初始化的Aizawa轨迹上做4个匹配对照检验中间表征。

Result: 系统加权后期Energy胜率在190个多步配对上为73.6%–78.5%；对DLinear在72个配对多步任务上为77.3%。匹配对照中，Aizawa轨迹的后期Energy相对4个对照降低约24%–56%，4个预设对比均通过Holm校正。

Conclusion: 结果表明状态转移统计预测可与连续概率预测有效结合，在多步长时程预测上取得显著增益（尤以Aizawa匹配研究为突出）。

Abstract: We introduce STRIDE (State-Transition Representation via Increment Dynamics and Evolution), which defines states through derivative fingerprints and learns local functions for state transitions (qpairs), recasting continuous forecasting as transition prediction. Trailing convolution windows estimate local joint-transition frequencies, whose lagged differences form a high-dimensional increment trajectory. Proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) gives coordinate paths, jointly forecast by sparse dynamics with memory. Recombining their forecasts and applying history-anchored inversion recovers future transition distributions; sampled state paths select local functions to generate continuous forecasts. Three-seed experiments compare STRIDE against fourteen baselines across nine benchmark families. Five independent Markov and hidden-state baselines cover all 230 evaluated tasks, with 220 complete whole-horizon pairs. Against these comparators, system-weighted late-Energy win fractions range from 73.6% to 78.5% on 190 multi-step pairs; against DLinear, the fraction is 77.3% on 72 paired multi-step tasks. Matched controls examine the intermediate representation. On 64 independently initialized Aizawa trajectories, late-Energy reductions against four matched controls range from approximately 24% to 56%, with all four prespecified contrasts passing Holm correction. These results connect transition-statistic prediction to continuous probabilistic forecasting, with substantial long-horizon gains in the matched Aizawa study.

</details>


### [1038] [Attribution Without a Second Pass: Inline Per-Sample Gradient Provenance at ~1% Overhead](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32380)
*Amit Nautiyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Traceprop 通过在训练反向传播中内联记录投影后的逐样本梯度，避免事后重算，用 Kronecker 分解草图实现全层高效追踪，显著降低开销并支持合规审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据归因方法（TRAK、LoGRA、EK-FAC）均为事后方法：训练后需再次遍历训练集重算逐样本梯度，集成时每个检查点都要重复该过程，开销大。作者希望消除这一额外遍历，降低归因存储构建成本。

Method: Traceprop 在训练反向传播时内联记录投影后的逐样本梯度；采用 Kronecker 分解草图（Kronecker-factored sketch），从单层扩展到所有层而无须显式构造稠密投影矩阵。

Result: 在单张 NVIDIA L4 上对 GPT-2 与最大 2.8B 的 Pythia 模型进行 LoRA 微调时，末块范围的内联记录开销为 0.30–1.08% 墙钟时间，追踪 Pythia-1B 全部层仍低于 1%（0.79%）。相比 LogIX，在相同存储下分解草图便宜 2.0–4.1 倍，且差距随追踪范围扩大而增大，各范围均显著，同时在匹配存储下归因质量相当或更优。内联构建归因存储比一次事后遍历便宜 60–242 倍，比五检查点 TRAK 集成便宜 301–1211 倍，记录梯度与自动微分精确一致。因每个存储梯度带源文件溯源，同一过程还可生成 EU AI Act 第 26 条审计追踪。

Conclusion: Traceprop 将数据归因存储的构建内联至训练过程，在保持归因质量与梯度精确性的同时大幅降低时间与存储开销，并天然支持合规审计轨迹生成。

Abstract: Data attribution methods used in practice (TRAK, LoGRA, EK-FAC) are post-hoc: after training they make a second pass over the training set to recompute per-sample gradients, repeated per checkpoint when ensembled. Traceprop avoids that pass by recording projected per-sample gradients inline on the training backward pass. A Kronecker-factored sketch scales from a single tracked layer to every layer without materializing a dense projection matrix. On LoRA fine-tunes of GPT-2 and Pythia models up to 2.8B on one NVIDIA L4, inline logging costs 0.30-1.08% of wall-clock time at last-block scope and stays under 1% (0.79%) even when tracking every layer of Pythia-1B. Against LogIX, the closest inline-capable competitor, the factored sketch is 2.0-4.1x cheaper at equal storage, a gap that grows with tracked scope and is significant at every scope tested, while matching or exceeding LogIX's attribution quality at matched storage. Building the attribution-ready store inline is 60-242x cheaper than one post-hoc pass and 301-1211x cheaper than a five-checkpoint TRAK ensemble, with recorded gradients matching autograd exactly. Because each stored gradient carries source-file lineage, the same pass also produces EU AI Act Article 26 audit trails.

</details>


### [1039] [Using Machine Learning to Investigate Predictors of Fasting Blood Glucose: Insights into Circadian Timing and Age Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32386)
*Viktoriya Bu-Dager,Silvia Cirstea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于NHANES 2017–2020数据构建可解释机器学习框架预测对数空腹血糖，最终10变量的交互增强XGBoost模型在独立测试集上MAE=0.0804、RMSE=0.1148、R²=0.7761，糖化血红蛋白为最主要预测因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 糖调节受损是代谢功能障碍和2型糖尿病的重要驱动因素，需要可解释的预测工具来识别关键风险变量并支持机制性探索。

Method: 合并NHANES 2017–2020大流行前多个子数据集，采用防泄漏流程（仅在划分训练/测试集后及训练折内进行插补、标准化与独热编码）。以对数转换的空腹血糖为结局，纳入94个候选预测因子并构造昼夜节律交互项，比较Elastic Net、LASSO与XGBoost。评价指标包括MAE、RMSE、R²、校准度与SHAP。

Result: 交互增强的XGBoost在独立测试集上表现最优，仅用10个预测因子即达MAE=0.0804、RMSE=0.1148、R²=0.7761。糖化血红蛋白贡献最大，其次为胰岛素、糖尿病诊断、γ-谷氨酰转移酶、年龄、种族与性别。交互项中“睡眠中点×年龄”在重复随机划分中稳定保留，但相对主要血糖预测因子贡献有限。

Conclusion: 可解释机器学习框架能高效预测空腹血糖，昼夜节律与年龄的交互作用值得在代谢健康领域进一步研究。

Abstract: Impaired glucose regulation is a major contributor to metabolic dysfunction and type 2 diabetes. This study developed an interpretable machine-learning framework to predict log-transformed fasting blood glucose using metabolic, hormonal, lifestyle, demographic, nutritional, and circadian variables from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017--2020 pre-pandemic dataset. After merging multiple NHANES sub-datasets, data processing used a leakage-resistant pipeline in which imputation, scaling, and one-hot encoding were performed only after dataset splitting and within training folds. Elastic Net, LASSO, and XGBoost models were evaluated using 94 candidate predictors and engineered circadian interaction terms. Performance was assessed using mean absolute error, root mean squared error, coefficient of determination, calibration, and Shapley Additive Explanations. The final interaction-augmented XGBoost model achieved strong performance on the independent test set, with a mean absolute error of 0.0804, a root mean squared error of 0.1148, and a coefficient of determination of 0.7761, using 10 predictors. Glycohemoglobin was the dominant predictor, followed by insulin, diabetes diagnosis, gamma-glutamyl transferase, age, race, and gender. Among the engineered interaction terms, sleep midpoint multiplied by age was consistently retained in repeated random-split analyses, although its contribution remained modest relative to dominant glycaemic predictors. These findings support further investigation of circadian-age interactions in metabolic health.

</details>


### [1040] [HoTS: Homophily-Aware Temperature Scaling for Graph Neural Network Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32426)
*Inwoo Tae,Yoontae Hwang,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究图节点分类的置信度校准问题，提出基于局部同配性的温度缩放方法HoTS，在多个基准上取得最优ECE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图节点分类中，置信分数（通常为最大预测类概率）常用于排名预测、将不确定节点转人工复核或控制风险，因此需要校准良好的类概率。现有事后校准器要么仅使用全局温度，要么使用缺乏原则性结构形式的图感知模块，未系统研究局部图结构应如何进入节点级校准。

Method: 作者首先论证仅依赖logit的温度规则不足：logit相同但局部同配性不同的节点需要不同的最优温度。随后在一个种群集中式上下文随机块模型（高斯特征、单层线性GCN）中分析，在类均值等距条件下，类模板分数上的贝叶斯后验为温度缩放softmax，其逆温度由依赖同配性的信号强度决定；在正信号同配情形下，温度近似与归一化局部同配性成反比。据此提出Homophily-aware Temperature Scaling (HoTS)：利用基于熵的logit集中度和估计的局部同配性为每个节点分配正标量温度，含三个温度参数，保持预测类别不变，并从校准数据学习结构校正强度。

Result: 在18个节点分类基准、两个GNN骨干和八个校准基线上，HoTS取得了最佳平均期望校准误差（ECE）4.79%、最佳平均排名，并在选择性分类中提供最可靠的置信度排序。

Conclusion: 局部图结构（尤其是局部同配性）应纳入节点级校准时，温度应随同配性变化；HoTS以简洁形式实现这一原则并经验证有效。代码已开源。

Abstract: For graph node classification, calibrated class probabilities are needed when confidence scores, usually the maximum predicted class probability, are used to rank predictions, defer uncertain nodes to human review, or control risk. Existing post-hoc calibrators either apply one global temperature or use graph-aware modules without a principled structural form. We study how local graph structure should enter node-level calibration. Our first results show that a logit-only temperature rule is insufficient when nodes with identical logits but different local homophily require different optimal temperatures. We then analyze a population-concentration contextual stochastic block model with Gaussian features and a one-layer linear GCN. Under equidistant class means, the Bayes posterior over class-template scores is a temperature-scaled softmax whose inverse-temperature is governed by a homophily-dependent signal strength. In the positive-signal homophilic regime, the resulting temperature decreases approximately inversely with normalized local homophily. This law motivates Homophily-aware Temperature Scaling (HoTS), a simple post-hoc calibrator that assigns each node a positive scalar temperature from entropy-based logit concentration and estimated local homophily. HoTS has three temperature parameters, preserves the predicted class, and learns the strength of the structural correction from calibration data. Across 18 node-classification benchmarks, two GNN backbones, and eight calibration baselines, HoTS achieves the best mean Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 4.79%, the best average rank, and the most reliable confidence ranking in selective classification. Code is available at https://github.com/inu0104/HoTS.

</details>


### [1041] [Beyond the Manifold Hypothesis: Hybrid Spectral Parameterizations for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32432)
*Ségolène Martin,Anne Gagneux,Quentin Bertrand,Rémi Emonet,Mathurin Massias*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 流匹配与扩散模型可预测$x_1$、$x_0$或速度$v$，理论等价但性能差异显著。本文识别出两个主因：源-数据信噪比与神经架构的信息瓶颈，并提出"谱混合"参数化，按时间与数据协方差方向自适应，在高斯数据下最优，且跨架构与源尺度稳健、显著加速优化、几乎无额外训练开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管$x_1$、$x_0$、$v$等参数化在理论上等价，实际训练性能却差异巨大，缺乏对这一现象的系统性解释，也不清楚在何种条件下哪种参数化更优。作者希望厘清差异来源，并据此设计自适应参数化以提升训练效率。

Method: 作者从理论上分析两类驱动因素：（1）源-数据信噪比，特别是在每个数据协方差方向上的谱信噪比；（2）神经架构引入的信息瓶颈（压缩）。基于此提出"谱混合"（spectral hybrid）参数化，在时间维和数据协方差方向上自适应地混合不同预测目标，并证明其在高斯数据下最优；同时分析架构压缩对参数化可学习性的影响。

Result: 分析表明，影响最优参数化的最重要因素是各数据协方差方向上的信噪比，而非仅数据内在维度。谱参数化在高斯数据下最优。架构压缩会改变哪种参数化更易学习：$v$-预测比$x_1$-预测对被丢弃方向更敏感。跨架构与源尺度实验显示谱参数化在各机制下均稳健、显著加速优化，且相比标准参数化几乎不增加训练成本。

Conclusion: 参数化选择的关键在于谱信噪比与架构压缩，而非理论等价性。所提出的谱混合参数化可自适应时间与协方差方向，在高斯数据下最优，并在实践中稳健、高效、低开销，为流匹配/扩散模型的参数化设计提供了理论指导与实用方案。

Abstract: Flow matching and diffusion can be trained to predict different quantities, most commonly the data $x_1$, the source noise $x_0$, or the velocity~$v$. Although theoretically equivalent, these can lead to substantially different performances. We identify two main drivers for these differences: the source--data signal-to-noise ratio, and the information bottleneck induced by the neural architecture. We show that, beyond intrinsic data dimension, the factor affecting the optimal parametrization the most is a certain signal-to-noise ratio in each data covariance direction. From this analysis, we introduce new \emph{spectral hybrid} parameterizations that adapt across time and data covariance directions; we show that these are optimal for Gaussian data. We also show that architecture-induced compression changes which parameterization is easier to learn, with $v$-prediction being more sensitive to discarded directions than $x_1$-prediction. Experiments across architectures and source scales show that our spectral parameterizations are robust across regimes, can substantially accelerate optimization, while incurring essentially no additional training cost compared with standard parameterizations.

</details>


### [1042] [Length-Independent State Tracking Under a Parallel Scan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32447)
*Julien Brandoit,Arthur Fyon,Thomas Braipson,Tom Clara,Florent De Geeter,Pierre Sacré,Damien Ernst,Guillaume Drion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文形式化研究了有限精度下的有限状态跟踪问题，证明仿射递归（线性RNN、线性注意力、状态空间模型）在有限精度下最多只能实现确定型自动机，并提出非仿射但可并行扫描的神经有限状态机（NFSM）以实现与长度无关的精确状态跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性RNN、线性注意力和状态空间模型借助仿射递归实现可扩展的并行训练，但其理论表达力保证依赖理想化算术，在有限精度下不成立；而使其高效的并行扫描本身正是扰动来源。因此需要研究有限精度下的有限状态跟踪能力边界。

Method: 1）形式化定义有限精度下的有限状态跟踪，刻画"长度无关性"：在任意序列长度上保持正确，且精度代价不随长度增长。2）论证长度无关跟踪需要单一映射内存在两种竞争动力学：收缩以抑制数值扰动、分离以保持不同状态可区分。3）证明每步仅提供单一速率的仿射递推最多只能实现确定型自动机。4）将扫描兼容性重新解释为计算预算而非更新映射的限制，提出NFSM——一种非仿射、扫描兼容的RNN。

Result: 在涵盖阿贝尔群、非阿贝尔群、不可逆幺半群及文本状态跟踪任务的合成基准上，仿射基线在所有非确定型任务上均失败，多数在数百步内失败；单层NFSM即可学到每个代数任务的精确转移表，从而在测试长度之外也保证正确性；堆叠的NFSM在文本任务的所有测试长度上保持完美准确率。

Conclusion: 仿射递归在有限精度下的表达力受限于确定型自动机，无法胜任一般的有限状态跟踪；NFSM通过引入非仿射、仍可扫描的更新机制，在长度无关的精确状态跟踪上显著优于现有线性/仿射架构。

Abstract: Learning robust and scalable finite-state tracking is fundamental to sequence processing. While linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs), linear attention, and state space models enable scalable parallel training through affine recurrences, their theoretical expressivity guarantees assume idealized arithmetic and do not extend to finite precision, where the parallel scan that makes them fast is itself a source of perturbation. We formalize finite-state tracking at finite precision and characterize length independence: tracking that stays correct at every sequence length, at a precision cost that does not grow with the length. We show that length-independent state tracking requires two competing dynamics within a single map: contraction to suppress numerical perturbations and separation to keep distinct states apart. We prove that affine recurrences, which offer a single rate at each step to serve both roles, realize at most definite automata at finite precision. Instead of treating scan compatibility as a restriction on the update map, we reinterpret it as a computational budget and introduce the Neural Finite-State Machine (NFSM): a nonaffine, scan-compatible RNN built for length-independent finite-state tracking. On synthetic benchmarks spanning abelian and nonabelian groups, noninvertible monoids, and textual state-tracking tasks, affine baselines fail on every nondefinite task, most of them within a few hundred steps. A single NFSM layer instead learns the exact transition tables of every algebraic task, which certifies correctness beyond the tested lengths, and a stack of NFSMs keeps perfect accuracy on the textual tasks at every tested length.

</details>


### [1043] [Write Back the $Δ$: Revisiting the Same Tokens with Fresh Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32457)
*Wencheng Ye,Anning Hu,Xiangdong Zhang,Tianyi Wang,Yikang Li,Hengyu Jin,Bing Li,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReFlux：一种可学习的反馈图，通过将层间增量Δ（而非完整状态）反馈至浅层，实现推理时信息复用，在同步/流式两种模式下提升语言建模与多跳推理性能且几乎不增加主干FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer前向传播严格单向，深层计算无法回头修正浅层表示。现有改进方案要么重复执行深度（增加算力），要么用预定义方向修改残差流（缺乏实例级自适应性）。推理时反馈虽可直接复用内生的深层计算，但"反馈什么"尚不明确。

Method: 论证"深度增量Δ"（两层间新累积的计算量）比完整状态更适合作为反馈信号，因其更有效、可组合、可扩展。据此设计ReFlux——可学习反馈图，动态选择并组合携带增量的路由；支持同步反馈（回写同一token）和流式反馈（写入后续token）。

Result: 在多种模型、语料与基准上：同步ReFlux在10个语言建模语料上一致降低困惑度，准确率提升2.1–2.3点，多跳推理增益达4.7点；流式ReFlux保留大部分增益，同时维持基座模型1倍理论主干FLOPs。

Conclusion: ReFlux是释放LLM潜在计算潜能的高效范式，使模型能以更新后的表示重新审视同一token。代码见 https://github.com/gooogleshanghai/reflux。

Abstract: Transformers process information strictly forward through depth, preventing deeper computation from revisiting and refining earlier representations. To augment the standard forward pass, existing approaches either re-execute depth, incurring additional computation, or modify the residual stream using predefined directions, limiting their instance-level adaptation. Recently, inference-time feedback offers a direct mechanism for recycling endogenously produced computation by writing deeper residual states back to earlier layers, yet what should be fed back remains unclear. We argue that the depth increment Delta, capturing newly accumulated computation between two layers, provides a more effective, composable, and scalable feedback signal than the full state. Building on this observation, we introduce ReFlux, a learnable feedback graph that dynamically selects and composes increment-carrying routes. ReFlux supports synchronous feedback to the same token and streaming feedback to subsequent tokens. Extensive experiments across various models, corpora, and benchmarks show that synchronous ReFlux consistently reduces perplexity across ten language-modeling corpora, and improves accuracy by 2.1-2.3 points, with gains reaching 4.7 points on multi-hop reasoning. Streaming ReFlux further retains most of these gains while preserving the base model's 1x theoretical backbone FLOPs. These results establish ReFlux as an efficient paradigm for unlocking the latent computational potential of LLMs, allowing them to revisit the same tokens with fresh representations. Code implementation can be found at https://github.com/gooogleshanghai/reflux.

</details>


### [1044] [PolyStepOR: Learning to Decide Without Optimal Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32465)
*Viet The Nguyen,Gunther Gust,An Thai Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PolyStepOR 是一种无需最优参考决策和梯度的决策聚焦学习方法，通过对预测器参数施加扰动、评估所得决策并用最优传输偏向低成本方向进行训练，并扩展到约束内预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策聚焦学习（DFL）以提升下游决策质量为目标训练预测器，但通常依赖难以获取的最优参考决策，这构成主要瓶颈。

Method: PolyStepOR 直接利用已实现决策成本训练，无需预计算最优解；通过修复或不可行惩罚扩展到约束内预测。针对分段常数损失，方法扰动预测器参数、评估产生的决策，并用最优传输使更新偏向更低成本方向，全程不使用导数、无需任务特定调参。

Result: 在无需任务特定调参的情况下，PolyStepOR 在经典优化基准上表现强劲，在预测约束问题与真实世界问题上具有竞争力。理论方面刻画了保持决策的扰动与边界检测，给出了对成本误差的敏感性界，并为平滑目标建立了平稳性保证。

Conclusion: PolyStepOR 用前向评估替代最优参考决策与梯度，为决策聚焦学习提供了无需最优解和导数的可行训练范式。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictors for downstream decision quality, but often relies on optimal reference decisions that are expensive to obtain. We present PolyStepOR, which trains directly from realized decision costs without pre-computed optima and extends to in-constraint predictions through repair or infeasibility penalties. To handle piecewise-constant losses, PolyStepOR perturbs predictor parameters, evaluates the resulting decisions, and uses optimal transport to favor lower-cost directions, requiring no derivatives. Without task-specific tuning, PolyStepOR performs strongly on classical optimization benchmarks and competitively on predicted-constraint and real-world problems. Theoretically, we characterize decision-preserving perturbations and boundary detection, bound sensitivity to cost errors, and establish stationarity guarantees for a smoothed objective. PolyStepOR thus replaces optimal reference decisions and derivatives with forward evaluations.

</details>


### [1045] [On the Pitfalls of Verbalized Confidence Priors for Calibrating Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32470)
*Shuoyuan Wang,Beier Luo,Hao Zeng,Chengyao Yu,Songxin Zhang,Zejian Xie,Bingyi Jing,Hongxin Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示大型推理模型的"置信先验"高度集中于少数高值，制约了置信度校准的强化学习探索；提出即插即用的监督微调阶段 CalibSFT，在 RL 前塑造分布广覆盖的校准置信先验，从而提升五种 RL 算法的校准效果并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型在表达不确定性时常过度自信。置信感知强化学习（confidence-aware RL）虽可优化校准，但依赖 on-policy rollout，受限于模型在 RL 前的置信分布（即"置信先验"）。作者发现现成 LRM 的置信先验高度集中在少数高值上，且该现象在 RL 过程中持续存在，形成探索瓶颈。

Method: 理论上证明置信先验集中会抑制对稀有置信值的策略梯度更新，并抬升期望 Brier 风险的下界。为此提出 CalibSFT——一个即插即用的监督微调阶段，在 RL 之前塑造具有宽支撑的校准置信先验：(1) 为每个问题构造结合其成功率与响应级正确性的置信目标，可证明保持 proper scoring 最优性；(2) 在置信谱上平衡训练响应，以支持 RL 期间多样化的置信探索；(3) 引入正确性条件监督——对所有响应监督其置信度，但仅在正确响应上监督推理过程，从而在不模仿错误推理的前提下从错误响应中学习。

Result: 在 16 个数学与通用推理基准上，将 CalibSFT 接入五种代表性 RL 算法后，校准误差降低、判别能力提升，同时保持可比精度；并对下游选择性预测与模型路由带来实际收益。

Conclusion: 置信先验的集中是置信感知 RL 的关键探索瓶颈；通过 CalibSFT 在 RL 前塑造宽支撑的校准置信先验，可有效突破该瓶颈，普适性地改善多种 RL 算法的校准性能而不牺牲准确率。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often suffer from overconfidence when expressing their uncertainty. Confidence-aware reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising way to optimize calibration. However, it relies on on-policy rollouts and is thus constrained by the model's pre-RL confidence distribution, which we term confidence prior. In this work, we reveal that off-the-shelf LRMs exhibit a confidence prior heavily concentrated on a few high values, which persists throughout RL. Theoretically, we prove that this concentration suppresses policy gradient updates for rarely sampled confidence values and inflates the lower bound on expected Brier risk. To overcome this exploration bottleneck, we propose CalibSFT, a plug-and-play supervised fine-tuning stage that shapes a calibrated confidence prior with broad support before RL. For each question, CalibSFT constructs confidence targets combining its success rate with response-level correctness, which provably preserves proper-scoring optimality, and then balances training responses across the confidence spectrum to enable diverse confidence exploration during RL. To learn from incorrect responses without imitating their reasoning, CalibSFT introduces correctness-conditional supervision, guiding confidence across all responses while supervising reasoning only on correct ones. Across 16 mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks, incorporating CalibSFT reduces calibration errors and improves discrimination across five representative RL algorithms while preserving comparable accuracy. Furthermore, CalibSFT delivers practical benefits for downstream selective prediction and model routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/ml-stat-Sustech/verbalized-confidence-training.

</details>


### [1046] [Fast and Precise Learned Charged-Particle Trajectory Regression at the Large Hadron Collider](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32479)
*Jonathan Renusch,Benjamin Huth,Daniel Murnane,Eleni Xochelli,Doğa Elitez,Paul Gessinger-Befurt,Andreas Stefl,Jeremy Couthures,Andreas Salzburger,Lukas Heinrich,Michael Kagan,Markus Elsing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将高能物理探测器数据中的带电粒子轨迹参数回归视为序列建模任务，使用双向门控线性循环编码器，首次实现端到端学习型轨迹拟合达到经典方法的全精度，并借助自定义内核在GPU推理中获得显著吞吐量提升，可大幅降低LHC模式识别的计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典轨迹拟合依赖卡尔曼滤波与线性化最小二乘，通过精细建模探测器几何、物质、探测效应及非均匀磁场下运动方程的数值积分，才能达到10^5分之一的精度。这类方法计算开销大，在大规模对撞机场景下成本高昂，因此需要一种既能保持全精度又能提升计算效率的新方法。

Method: 将带电粒子轨迹参数回归建模为序列建模任务，采用双向门控线性循环编码器（bidirectional gated linear recurrent encoder）进行端到端学习，并设计自定义内核以优化GPU推理吞吐量。

Result: 该方法能够复现经典轨迹拟合技术的全精度（约10^5分之一），同时在GPU推理上相比运行于同等价位多核CPU服务器上的经典拟合软件实现显著更高的吞吐量。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个端到端学习型轨迹拟合在达到全精度的同时还能降低计算成本，这种加速可为大型强子对撞机的模式识别带来可观成本节约。

Abstract: We propose a training recipe that treats charged-particle trajectory parameter regression on high-energy physics detector data as a sequence-modeling task. Kalman filters and linearized least-squares fits have been the classical standard approach for this task: they are optimal estimators for sparsely sampled linear-Gaussian data and are commonly used for trajectory parameter regression (fitting). The classical fitting techniques implemented for this domain reach a final precision of one part in $10^5$ through detailed modeling of detector geometry, material, detection effects and precise numerical integration of the equations of motion through the detector's inhomogeneous magnetic field. With this study, we demonstrate that using a bidirectional gated linear recurrent encoder, one is able to reproduce the full precision of classical track fitting techniques. Using a custom kernel, we also achieve significantly higher throughput during GPU inference, compared to classical fitting software running on similarly priced multi-core CPU servers representing typically employed hardware. Such a speedup would lead to considerable cost savings for the pattern recognition at the Large Hadron Collider. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end learned track fit to reach the full precision and, at the same time, offer the opportunity to reduce the computing costs.

</details>


### [1047] [What Should Federated LoRA Share? FedSAIL via Input-aware Subspace Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32485)
*Junye Du,Shuaida He,Long Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FedSAIL：用输入感知的动作矩阵提取跨客户端共享子空间，正则化本地训练而非聚合权重，提升联邦 LoRA 性能并降低通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦 LoRA 需要识别异构客户端间共享的更新结构。已有工作观察到各客户端训练后的 LoRA 投影矩阵高度相似，但这种一致性很可能来自相同的初始化；在独立初始化下该相似性会退化为随机重叠。此外，仅依赖参数相似性会忽略本地输入分布（input regime）的影响。

Method: 引入输入感知的动作矩阵（action matrix），用本地层输入的二阶矩统计量对适配器更新加权。基于该矩阵的几何性质，提出 FedSAIL（Federated Subspace-Guided Action-Informed Learning）：不直接平均权重，而是估计一个共享动作子空间，以该子空间正则化本地训练，同时保留各客户端的个性化系数。

Result: 在多个基准上，FedSAIL 的预测性能持续优于对比的联邦 LoRA 方法，同时显著降低通信成本。

Conclusion: 参数相似性可能是初始化诱导的假象，并非可靠的共享结构；基于输入二阶统计的动作矩阵，其主右奇异方向在客户端间保持强对齐，且保留任务条件差异并随网络深度自然变化，是更稳健的共享结构载体。据此以子空间正则代替权重平均，可兼顾共享性与个性化，获得性能与通信效率的双重收益。

Abstract: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) requires identifying an update structure that is shared across heterogeneous clients. Prior work reports strong similarity among trained LoRA projection matrices across clients; however, such agreement may be largely induced by common initialization and collapses toward random overlap under independent initialization. More crucially, relying solely on parameter similarity inherently ignores the influence of local input regime. To uncover a more robust shared structure, we introduce an input-aware action matrix that weights the adapter update by the second-moment statistics of local layer inputs. Empirically, while parameter similarity vanishes, the leading right singular directions of this action matrix remain strongly aligned across clients. This shared geometry preserves task-conditioned differences and naturally varies across network depths. Motivated by these findings, we propose Federated Subspace-Guided Action-Informed Learning (FedSAIL). Instead of averaging weights, FedSAIL estimates a shared action subspace to regularize local training while preserving client-specific coefficients. Across several benchmarks, our approach consistently improves predictive performance over competing federated LoRA methods while reducing communication cost significantly.

</details>


### [1048] [Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrids for Train-Once, Export-Many Budgeted Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32486)
*Dachuan Song,Chuchu Chen,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出弹性选择性谱混合模型ESSH，将Hankel谱通道实现为独立循环单元，引入输入依赖的衰减与读写门控，并结合滑窗注意力与两速率容量映射联合蒸馏训练，实现可截断的弹性模型。在1.53B配置下，B300单样本解码1.37ms/token，较Mamba-2/3快2.14-2.80x，较Transformer++快3.03x，同时保持平滑的质量-成本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同计算与延迟预算下部署语言模型需要具有不同质量-成本权衡的紧凑模型。弹性谱状态空间模型提供可截断的有序时序分解通道，但其线性时不变滤波器无法随上下文演化选择性地保留相关信息或遗忘无关信息。

Method: 提出ESSH，将每个Hankel谱通道用拟合的阻尼旋转模式实现为独立循环单元；加入输入依赖的衰减与写/读门控，使时序保留与状态更新随输入变化，同时保留通道级截断与结构化循环；将选择性谱混合器与滑窗注意力结合；通过两速率容量映射按不同速率缩减谱通道数与前馈宽度，并配合全模型蒸馏联合训练多容量模型，支持分块并行训练与融合循环解码。

Result: 满容量下ESSH语言建模质量与同规模独立训练模型相当，较小导出模型呈现平滑的质量-成本权衡；在语言理解、检索、跨域文本与DNA实验中验证了相对独立训练与弹性基线的质量保持与权衡优势；1.53B配置下B300单样本融合解码1.37ms/token，较Mamba-2/3快2.14-2.80x，较Transformer++快3.03x。

Conclusion: ESSH通过选择性谱循环与弹性容量映射，兼顾了语言建模质量、可截断弹性部署与高效解码，在多个任务与硬件上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Deploying a language model under different computing and latency budgets calls for compact models with different quality-cost trade-offs. Towards this end, elastic spectral state space models provide ordered and temporally decomposed channels that can be truncated, but they are associated with linear time-invariant filters that cannot selectively preserve relevant past information or forget irrelevant information as the context evolves. To address this, we introduce the Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrid (ESSH), which realizes each Hankel spectral channel as an independent recurrent unit using fitted damped rotation modes. It also features an input-dependent decay and write/read gates that make temporal retention and state update input-dependent while preserving channel-wise truncation and a structured recurrence for efficient execution. ESSH combines these selective spectral mixers with sliding-window attention and jointly trains multiple capacities by reducing spectral-channel count and feed-forward width at different rates through a two-rate capacity map with full-model distillation. The resulting models support chunked parallel training and fused recurrent decoding while avoiding computation for discarded channels. At full capacity, ESSH achieves language-modeling quality comparable to similarly sized independently trained models, while smaller exports exhibit a smooth quality-cost trade-off. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework using language understanding, retrieval, cross-domain text, and DNA experiments, by assessing quality retention and the trade-off against independently trained and elastic baselines. At the 1.53B model configuration, fused batch-one decoding takes 1.37 ms per token on a B300, providing a 2.14-2.80x speedup over the tested Mamba-2 and Mamba-3 implementations and 3.03x over Transformer++ at matched parameter counts.

</details>


### [1049] [Neural Dynamics as the Composition of Quantized Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32487)
*Jacopo Minniti,Aravinth Kulanthaivelu,Richard Sproat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"量⼦(quanta)"这⼀中间抽象，将训练刻画为可复⽤计算单元的按序获得过程，并推导其获得优先级由"需求"与"条件复杂度"共同决定，从⽽连接微观机制与宏观损失/缩放律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习存在两种解释层次：宏观层⾯⽤缩放律等损失聚合趋势描述，微观层⾯研究神经元、特征与回路，但两者之间如何连接尚不清楚。作者希望找到⼀种中间抽象，解释基础计算如何组合并共同塑造宏观⾏为。

Method: 将训练建模为"量⼦"的有序获得——量⼦是突然获得、按样本⼆值激活以减少损失的可复⽤计算。通过近似种群梯度更新，推导量⼦的获得动态，得到由需求（该计算在多样本中出现频率）与条件复杂度（在已有计算基础上获得的难度）决定的获得优先级。在布尔组合任务上推导获得顺序预测；训练Transformer完成数字到英⽂数词映射，并从检查点轨迹中恢复候选量⼦，据此构建保留原模型⾏为且暴露可解释隐计算与获得动态的模型；另将量⼦结构作为训练⽬标以提升泛化。

Result: 在布尔组合任务中，理论预测了获得顺序，并显⽰交错的离散获得可产⽣平滑的聚合损失，在特定量⼦组合⼏何下可产⽣缩放律。在数字到英⽂数词任务中，从Transformer检查点轨迹恢复出候选量⼦，构建的模型保留了原Transformer⼤部分⾏为，同时呈现可解释的潜在计算与符合理论的获得动态。量⼦结构作为训练⽬标还能改善Transformer泛化。

Conclusion: 量⼦抽象可作为有⽤的计算"原⼦"，⽤于研究多种宏观现象，为连接深度学习的微观机制与宏观规律提供了中间层⾯的解释框架。

Abstract: Deep learning is commonly interpreted at two levels: the macroscopic, through aggregate trends in loss summarized by scaling laws, and the microscopic, through neurons, features, and circuits. A central challenge is understanding how these levels connect, so that we can explain how elementary computations compose and collectively shape macroscopic behavior. To this end, we study an intermediate abstraction in which training is described as the ordered acquisition of quanta: reusable computations acquired suddenly and binary-activated across examples to reduce loss. By approximating population-gradient updates, we derive quanta's acquisition dynamics. This yields an acquisition priority governed by demand, how frequently a computation is required across examples, and conditional complexity, how difficult that computation is to acquire given those already available. In a Boolean compositional task, we derive predictions for acquisition order and show how staggered discrete acquisitions can produce smooth aggregate loss and, under certain geometries of quanta composition, give rise to scaling laws. We then train a Transformer to map numerals to English number names and recover candidate quanta from its checkpoint trajectory. From these units, we construct a model that preserves much of the Transformer's behavior while exposing interpretable latent computations and acquisition dynamics consistent with the theory. Separately, the quanta structure can serve as training targets to improve transformer generalization. Together, these results suggest the quanta abstraction can provide useful computational atoms for studying a variety of macroscopic phenomena.

</details>


### [1050] [Fisher Simplicity in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks and Multilayer Perceptrons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32503)
*Ami Tavory,Meir Feder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究KAN的"架构简单性"（零系数/基函数系数）与Fisher统计意义下的"参数冗余"（Fisher零空间）是否一致。结论是：对死ReLU单元二者一致，但对固定基KAN并不一致——系数大小本身不能作为基于Fisher的剪枝准则，真正决定Fisher零方向的是"有效边暴露"（数据到达基原子且扰动可向下游传播）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN的可解释性叙事常把"小的或零的基系数"视为简单性的证明，类似于MLP中死ReLU标记未使用计算。但这一类比缺乏统计上的严格性。作者引入Fisher零空间（Fisher nullity）作为精确的统计冗余定义：某参数方向是Fisher-简单的，当且仅当沿该方向扰动在任务分布下"不可见"（不改变输出分布）。核心动机是检验：架构层面的简单性信号与Fisher层面的简单性何时一致。

Method: (1) 定义Fisher-简单性为Fisher信息矩阵零空间中的参数方向（扰动在任务分布下不可观测）。(2) 对比分析：死ReLU单元中闭激活区域使相关score方向消失，故架构简洁与Fisher简洁一致。(3) 单层高斯情形：证明系数Fisher矩阵等于输入分布下的基Gram矩阵，且与拟合系数无关——故零系数不蕴含Fisher零方向。(4) 多层KAN：将Fisher简洁性刻画为图路径条件——数据须到达某基原子，且该扰动须经下游网络传播。(5) 将两条件编码为"有效边测度"（effective edge measure），在局部字典独立性与有效测度非退化假设下，证明零有效暴露恰好刻画边内的Fisher零方向。(6) 用受控诊断实验验证理论预测。

Result: 理论上：死ReLU单元中架构简洁与Fisher简洁一致；固定基KAN中二者不一致。单层高斯情形下Fisher矩阵为独立于系数的基Gram矩阵；多层情形下Fisher简洁性由图路径决定，零有效暴露在给定假设下精确等价于Fisher零方向。实验上：受控诊断证实零系数可以在保持秩的同时存在，而有效路径断开则会移除所预测的Fisher零方向——即零系数与Fisher冗余是分离的两种现象。

Conclusion: 系数大小本身不能作为KAN的Fisher-based剪枝准则。KAN的可解释性剪枝需要基于数据到达性与下游传播性的"有效暴露"度量，而非单纯的系数幅值；零系数既非Fisher简洁的充分条件也非必要条件。这为KAN的可解释性与剪枝方法提供了更严格的统计基础。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) are motivated in part by interpretability: their learned edge functions can be inspected, pruned, and reduced to symbolic structure. In a fixed-basis KAN, this makes a small or zero basis coefficient look like a certificate of simplicity, much as a dead rectified linear unit (ReLU) marks unused computation in a multilayer perceptron (MLP). Fisher nullity gives a precise statistical notion: a parameter direction is Fisher-simple exactly when perturbing it is invisible under the task distribution. We study when these architectural and Fisher notions agree.
  For a dead ReLU unit, they agree: the closed activation region makes the associated score directions vanish. For a fixed-basis KAN, they do not. In the single-layer Gaussian case, the coefficient Fisher matrix is a basis Gram matrix under the input distribution and is independent of the fitted coefficients. In a multilayer KAN, Fisher simplicity is graph-path based: the data must reach a basis atom and its perturbation must propagate through the downstream network. We encode these two conditions in an effective edge measure and, under local dictionary independence and effective-measure nondegeneracy, show that zero effective exposure exactly identifies Fisher-null directions within an edge. Controlled diagnostics confirm that zero coefficients can preserve rank while effective path disconnections remove the predicted directions. Coefficient magnitude alone is therefore not a Fisher-based pruning criterion for KANs.

</details>


### [1051] [What Do Latent Predictive Vehicle Representations Retain? Measuring State, Geometry, and Local Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32512)
*Enzo Nicolás Spotorno,Josafat Leal Filho,Antônio Augusto Fröhlich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一套面向"动作条件潜在预测器"的测量协议，通过带物理读出头的评估分别检验保持性、物理邻域组织、预测能力与对指令扰动的局部响应，并以IPG CarMaker数据的时序联合嵌入预测模型为案例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆控制器通常以物理量（位置、横摆角、速度、横摆角速度）定义代价、约束与参考，且优化器需要在相近指令间比较或求导预测结果。因此置于此类控制器中的潜在世界模型必须能恢复这些物理量，并像真实车辆一样随指令改变预测；而仅用潜在目标上的预测误差无法衡量这两点。

Method: 设计一套带物理读出的动作条件潜在预测器测量协议，分离测试四项能力：保持（retention）、物理邻域组织、预测（forecasting）、对指令扰动的局部响应；使用未训练编码器作为参照，并设置三条匹配的响应路径以定位误差来自表征还是预测器。以IPG CarMaker日志信号训练的时序联合嵌入预测模型（temporal JEPA）为案例进行研究。

Result: 表征能够保留所测的平面输出，但同架构的未训练编码器保留得略好；引入未来指令输入改善了一秒预测，且保持性几乎不变；对小幅指令脉冲的响应在潜在坐标中就已偏离模拟器，导致在所有比较中于相邻指令间选择时产生更高的遗憾（regret）。在响应上更新预测器可在局部修正响应，但以预测精度下降为代价。

Conclusion: 分别测量保持性、预测性与局部响应，是判定一个预测性潜在表征能否作为控制候选模型的关键；该协议为其闭环评估提供了基础。

Abstract: Models of vehicle dynamics learned from logged states and commands complement physics-based models, and latent world models, which predict in a learned representation, are used to plan and train controllers in other domains. Vehicle controllers are usually specified in physical terms: costs, limits, and references depend on position, yaw angle, speed, and yaw rate, and the optimizer compares or differentiates predicted outcomes across nearby commands. A latent model placed in such a controller must therefore let these quantities be recovered and must change its predictions with commands as the vehicle does, and prediction error on its own latent targets measures neither. We contribute a measurement protocol for action-conditioned latent predictors with a physical readout that separately tests retention, physical-neighborhood organization, forecasting, and local response to command perturbations, using an untrained-encoder reference and three matched response paths that locate errors in the representation or the predictor. In a case study of a temporal joint-embedding predictive model trained on signals logged in IPG CarMaker, the representations retain the measured planar outputs, though an untrained encoder of the same architecture retains them slightly better; future-command input improves one-second forecasts with retention nearly unchanged; and responses to small command pulses diverge from the simulator already in latent coordinates, raising regret when choosing among nearby commands in all comparisons. Updating the predictor on responses corrects them locally at a cost in forecast accuracy. Measuring retention, forecasting, and local response separately is thus what qualifies a predictive latent as a candidate model for control, and the protocol provides the basis for its closed-loop evaluation.

</details>


### [1052] [Does Transolver really need a Transformer?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32525)
*Shizheng Wen,Siddhartha Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过九个3D流体动力学基准的系统消融，证明Transolver中token注意力可被常数线性映射替代而不损失精度，说明其无需Transformer；真正关键的是slicing/deslicing全局混合操作，并据此提出高效flashslice核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transolver系列神经算子广泛使用physics-attention，但其各组件对性能的具体贡献缺乏系统性的理论与实证分析，作者希望厘清哪些机制真正决定模型表现。

Method: 在九个具挑战性的3D流体动力学基准上进行细致消融：将token注意力替换为常数线性映射、移除全局混合（slicing/deslicing）、仅执行一次全局混合；并结合平均神经算子理论进行解释与验证；同时提出FlashAttention风格的flashslice核，在点上流式执行slice/deslice，避免生成大slice权重张量。

Result: 替换token注意力为常数线性映射不影响精度；移除全局混合或仅做一次会导致性能崩溃；理论上证明仅slicing/deslicing加点式MLP即可实现对连续算子的通用逼近，注意力在该情形下冗余；flashslice核在浮点误差范围内复现最佳实现，并显著节省显存与计算量（尤其在大slice数时）。

Conclusion: Transolver无需Transformer，其性能核心来自slicing/deslicing全局混合；注意力为冗余组件，可被极简线性映射替代，同时可通过flashslice核高效实现。

Abstract: The widely used Transolver family of neural operators is based on physics-attention, which softly assigns the points of an unstructured mesh to a small number of slices, applies self-attention among the resulting tokens, and broadcasts the result back to the points. We provide a comprehensive empirical and theoretical analysis to elucidate the mechanisms which are responsible for model performance. To this end, we perform careful ablations on a challenging suite of nine 3D fluid dynamics benchmarks to find that replacing token attention with a constant linear map does not affect the accuracy. Thus, Transolver does not need a Transformer at all. However, removing the global mixing (slicing/deslicing) or doing it only once leads to performance collapse. We leverage the theory of averaging neural operators to explain and corroborate our findings by showing that just slicing/deslicing, in conjunction with pointwise MLPs, already suffices for universal approximation of continuous operators and attention is redundant in this context. Finally, we provide a novel FlashAttention-style efficient implementation of the key slicing/deslicing module of Transolver. This flashslice kernel streams slice and deslice over the points without materializing the heavy slice-weight tensor, while reproducing the best available implementation to floating point error. At the same time, it leads to very significant memory and compute savings, particularly at large slice counts.

</details>


### [1053] [Prioritizing Repeated LLM Evaluation for Hidden Failure Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32547)
*Keita Broadwater,Akin Broadwater*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将LLM可靠性评估建模为预算受限的失败发现问题，先浅评估再用特征排序优先深评零失败提示，显著提升隐藏失败发现效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规基准仅用少量随机生成样本评估LLM，受推理预算限制，浅评估难以观测低概率但重要的失败，导致存在潜在失败概率的提示被误判为可靠。

Method: 提出预算化发现框架：先对提示集做浅评估，再结合试次级失败结果与提示表示学习基于特征的失败倾向排序；据此优先对浅评估零失败的提示进行深度评估，将预算集中于可能隐藏失败处。

Result: 在AIRBench与StrongREJECT多模型、多系统提示条件下评估。AIRBench上，排名最高10%的未决提示隐藏失败提升为Qwen 2.5 7B 2.54倍、Gemma 3n E4B 1.87倍，分别回收25.4%和18.7%的后续观测隐藏失败（随机分配仅10%）。语义邻域与特征消融表明信号可从多种提示内容表示中恢复。

Conclusion: 浅评估零失败不等于可靠；基于特征排序的预算分配能有效发现隐藏失败，提升LLM可靠性评估的效率与深度。

Abstract: Large language models are commonly evaluated by generating a small number of stochastic responses for each prompt in a benchmark. Because inference budgets are limited, this shallow evaluation may fail to observe low-probability but operationally important failures. A prompt that produces no failures in a small sample may therefore appear reliable despite having a nonzero latent probability of failure under repeated inference.
  We formulate LLM reliability evaluation as a budget-constrained discovery problem in which each prompt is associated with an unknown per-generation failure probability. We propose a budgeted discovery framework that first performs shallow evaluation across the prompt set and then uses trial-level failure outcomes together with prompt-derived representations to learn a feature-based ranking of failure propensity. The resulting scores prioritize prompts with zero observed shallow failures for deeper evaluation, concentrating the deep-evaluation budget where hidden failures are more likely to be discovered.
  We evaluate this approach on AIRBench and StrongREJECT across multiple model and system-prompt conditions. The central empirical test asks whether models fit without access to deep-evaluation outcomes can rank prompts with zero observed shallow failures according to their likelihood of producing failures under deeper evaluation. On AIRBench, the highest-ranked 10\% of unresolved prompts achieves 2.54x hidden-failure lift for Qwen 2.5 7B and 1.87x for Gemma 3n E4B, recovering 25.4\% and 18.7\% of subsequently observed hidden failures, respectively, compared with 10\% expected under random allocation. Semantic-neighborhood and feature-ablation analyses further show that this predictive signal can be recovered from multiple representations of prompt content and relationships.

</details>


### [1054] [Compositional Objectives: Learning Structure in Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32566)
*Pranavchandra Vivekananda,Sumukh Bettadapura,Ajan Subramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究可学习新颖性(epiplexity)的谱近似计算方法，提出固定迹约束下的谱目标及面向组合性(关系与交互)的观测目标，并在ImageNet等基准上比较其表示性质与下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能可被定义为对可学习新颖性的追求，而可学习新颖性依赖于epiplexity（通过有界观测者度量数据中可学习结构的量）。但仅度量结构并不足够，表示还需被组织成对任务有用的特征。谱近似下可能存在"信息弥散但缺乏特征组织"的问题，因此需要考察观测者能看到什么关系、以及这些关系如何影响表示的多样性、可预测性与下游效用。

Method: 1) 提出epiplexity的闭式谱近似，并在固定迹约束下分析其谱质量分布偏好；2) 提出组合式目标，让观测者度量图像各部分之间的关系与交互；3) 与仅使用掩码部分的原始谱目标进行对比；4) 在ImageNet训练及多个图像基准上评估冻结特征分类（线性探针）与留出观测者预测性能。

Result: 固定迹约束下，epiplexity目标偏好更均匀的谱质量分布而非集中于少数方向。使用掩码部分的谱目标产生几乎最大程度弥散的表示，并在多数评测中取得最强的冻结特征分类性能，线性探针精度超过整图基线的两倍。跨多个图像基准，改变观测者所见的输入比加入关系与交互token更重要。同时，面向预测的组合式目标在留出观测者预测上显著更好，但分类性能相对较弱。

Conclusion: 谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用是彼此不同的性质。谱弥散的有用性不仅取决于保留了多少结构，还取决于观测者向目标提供了哪些关系。因此，设计目标时应同时考虑观测者的可见信息范围及其关系组织方式。

Abstract: Intelligence is defined in many ways. One of these definitions defines intelligence as the pursuit of learnable novelty. However, learnable novelty can be meaningless without the ability to compose the learned structures to take action and achieve goals. Learnable novelty builds on epiplexity, which is a way to measure learnable structure in data through a bounded observer. In this paper, we investigate a closed-form spectral approximation to compute epiplexity. We use a fixed-trace constraint and find that the epiplexity objective prefers a more uniform distribution of spectral mass rather than concentrating it in a small number of directions. However, a representation may spread information across many directions without organizing that information into features useful for a particular task. To address this gap, we propose a compositional objective whose observer measures the relationships between the parts and interactions of an image. We compare it with the original spectral objective given only the masked parts. In our ImageNet training runs, the spectral objective with masked parts produces an almost maximally spread representation while achieving the strongest frozen-feature classification performance on most evaluations, more than doubling the linear-probe accuracy of the whole-image baseline. Across multiple image benchmarks, changing what the observer sees matters more than adding relation and interaction tokens. At the same time, our prediction-oriented compositional objective produces substantially better held-out observer prediction but relatively weaker classification, revealing that spectral diversity, predictability, and downstream utility are distinct properties. These results suggest that the usefulness of spectral spreading depends not only on how much structure is preserved, but on which relationships the observer makes available to the objective.

</details>


### [1055] [CAESAR: Clustering via Autonomous Embedding-Space Agglomerative Reorganization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32570)
*Ilan Bacry,Rémi Devaux,Antoine Jardin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CAESAR，通过重组织预训练嵌入空间（拉近互为最近邻的样本、推远非近邻），并全程推断簇数K，从而显著提升聚类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于最近邻图的聚类算法（如FINCH）高度依赖嵌入空间质量，而预训练视觉与语言模型嵌入并非为聚类优化；同时现实无监督场景中簇数K通常未知，但多数强聚类方法需将K作为输入。

Method: 训练一个重组织网络，将互为最近邻的样本拉近、非近邻样本推远，形成更适合聚类的嵌入空间；并将整个CAESAR流程设计为推断K而非假设K已知。

Result: 在文本和图像数据集上，重组织嵌入相比原始空间一致提升聚类效果；在文本上优于所有对比方法，在最难图像基准上取得最佳结果，其余基准保持竞争力（且对比的深度聚类方法被赋予真实K的oracle优势）。

Conclusion: 重组织预训练嵌入是应对真实数据聚类（类别重叠、簇数未知）的简单而有效的途径。

Abstract: Clustering algorithms that operate on nearest-neighbor graphs, such as FINCH (First Integer Neighbor Clustering Hierarchy), depend heavily on the quality of the embedding space they are given. However, pretrained vision and language model embeddings are not optimized for this purpose. We propose CAESAR, a method that reorganizes a pretrained embedding space: a reorganization network is trained to pull mutual nearest neighbors together and push non-neighbors apart, yielding a reorganized embedding space substantially better suited to clustering. CAESAR offers a second major advantage: it never requires the number of clusters $K$. This matters because in realistic unsupervised settings, $K$ is typically unknown and discovering it is often part of the problem, yet most strong clustering methods take it as an input. We therefore design the entire CAESAR pipeline to infer $K$ rather than assume it is known. Empirically, reorganizing the embeddings consistently improves clustering over the raw space on both text and image datasets. Since the few deep clustering methods that also infer $K$ do not release their code, we complement controlled comparisons with methods that infer $K$ on the same embedding space by comparisons with strong deep clustering methods that are given the true $K$, giving them a substantial oracle advantage. Even so, CAESAR outperforms all of them on text, achieves the best results on the most challenging image benchmark and remains competitive on the others. Reorganizing pretrained embeddings thus emerges as a simple and powerful route to clustering realistic data, where classes overlap and the number of clusters is unknown.

</details>


### [1056] [Trapped by Their Own Rollouts: Understanding Aggregation--Rollout Feedback in Federated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32573)
*Jinqian Chen,Jihua Zhu,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦在线蒸馏（Federated OPD），指出其协作收益会被学习率敏感性掩盖，并从理论与方法两方面提出解释与解决方案 FedTOPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在客户端分布提示词的联邦场景下，在线蒸馏能否从协作中获益尚不明确，且实验观察到 FedAvg 在小学习率下不如独立本地训练、在大学习率下才显现优势这一反常现象，需要解释其原因并加以利用。

Method: 将学生模型的双重角色（学习者与未来训练数据生成器）作为分析核心，提出"聚合–轨迹反馈"机制：聚合导致优化滞后，延迟获得有效教师监督，进而拖慢后续学习。在一个具有共同最优解与稳定更新的可解模型中建立理论，刻画学习率的两个耦合作用：学习当前监督与抵达未来监督。基于此提出 FedTOPS：在客户端预测变化约束下，复用当前轨迹上的教师反馈来调节 FedAvg 的更新幅度。

Result: 在六个数学推理基准上，FedTOPS 相较于 FedAvg 将 macro Avg@8 提升 4.56–14.57 个百分点，且该提升在所评估的不同学生模型与本地学习率下均成立。

Conclusion: 联邦在线蒸馏的协作增益受学习率调控，其根源在于聚合滞后与轨迹反馈的耦合；显式调节更新幅度（FedTOPS）可稳定释放协作收益。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach to language-model adaptation, aligning teacher supervision with the student's own generated trajectories. When adaptation prompts are distributed across clients, can this process benefit from federated collaboration? We study federated OPD and find that substantial collaboration gains can be obscured by learning-rate sensitivity: FedAvg can perform no better than independent local training at a small learning rate, yet recover a clear advantage at a larger rate. We explain this phenomenon through the student's dual role as learner and generator of future training data. An aggregation-induced optimization lag can delay access to useful teacher supervision, which in turn slows subsequent learning. Our theory establishes this aggregation--rollout feedback in a solvable model with a common optimum and stable updates, and identifies two coupled roles of learning rate: learning from current supervision and reaching future supervision. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedTOPS (Federated Teacher-guided On-Policy Scaling), which reuses teacher feedback on current trajectories to adapt the FedAvg update magnitude under clientwise predictive-change constraints. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, FedTOPS improves macro Avg@8 over FedAvg by 4.56--14.57 percentage points across the evaluated student models and local learning rates.

</details>


### [1057] [DimPO: Dimensionality Reduction for Attention using Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32579)
*Vojtěch Lanz,Yufei Cui,Prasanna Parthasarathi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DimPO，将 listwise 偏好优化与轻量 top-k 交叉熵结合，对冻结语言模型的 query/key 做低秩线性投影降维。实验表明：仅用成对偏好目标在浅层投影时优于三元组基线；而使用全部 key 的 KL 与 DimPO 在长上下文退化更慢，DimPO 在下游任务上更优，说明降维时保留任务相关注意力的排序与集中度比复现完整注意力分布更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性投影可在不更新预训练模型的前提下降低 query/key 维度，但何种训练目标最能保持模型行为尚不明确。作者希望验证一个猜想：相比用 KL 散度匹配完整注意力分布，对 key 的偏好以及最高权重 key 上的注意力质量是否提供更好的训练信号，尤其在长上下文场景中。

Method: 提出 DimPO：将 listwise 偏好优化与轻量的 top-k 交叉熵项（用于保持头部保真度）相结合。训练为离线方式，基于冻结语言模型的注意力模式进行；每层学习一个投影映射，query 与 key 共享该映射，各层之间独立训练。同时在 LLaMA3.2-3B、LLaMA3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B Instruct 上评测，并与使用完整注意力分布的三元组基线及 KL 基线对比。

Result: 成对偏好目标优于三元组基线，在仅投影最后 40% 层、维度减半时，短上下文任务保留约 98% 原始得分；投影层数增加或用于长上下文 RULER 时性能快速下降。使用全部 key 训练的 KL 与 DimPO 在 8B 模型投影至多 50% 层时，RULER 4k 得分保留约 95%。KL 投影的注意力分布与注意力输出更接近原始模型，但 DimPO 的下游表现更好。投影层数超过 50% 后，DimPO 在 SQuAD、常见词抽取、高频词抽取与变量追踪等任务上逐渐优于 KL。

Conclusion: 在降维条件下，保留任务相关注意力的排序与集中度（偏好式目标）可能比复现完整注意力分布（KL 式目标）更为重要；DimPO 在较大投影比例下体现出这一优势。

Abstract: A linear projection can reduce the dimension of query and key vectors without updating the pretrained model, but it remains unclear which training objective best preserves model behavior. We ask whether preferences over keys and attention mass on the highest-weighted keys provide a better signal than matching the full attention distribution with KL divergence, especially in long-context settings. We introduce DimPO, which combines listwise preference optimization with a lightweight top-k cross-entropy term for head-fidelity. DimPO is trained offline from the attention patterns of a frozen language model, with one map per layer, shared by the query and the keys and trained separately from the other layers. Across LLaMA3.2-3B, LLaMA3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen3-4B Instruct models, pairwise preference objectives outperform the triplet baseline and retain 98% of the original score on short-context tasks when projecting to half the dimension on the last 40% of the layers. With more projected layers or on long-context RULER, they degrade rapidly. In contrast, KL and DimPO, which use every key during training, retain about 95% of the original RULER 4k score on the 8B model when projecting up to 50% of the layers. KL-based projections remain closer to the original attention distribution and attention output, yet DimPO achieves better downstream performance. Beyond 50% of projected layers, DimPO increasingly outperforms KL on tasks including SQuAD, common-word extraction, frequent-word extraction, and variable tracking. These results suggest that under dimensionality reduction, preserving the ordering and concentration of task-relevant attention can matter more than reproducing the full attention distribution.

</details>


### [1058] [Age of Learning: Temporal Persistence of Prediction Errors as a Learning Signal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32593)
*Chenyang Wang,Stefan Forsström,Roger Olsson,Di Yuan,Qing He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“学习年龄”（Age of Learning, AoL）这一学习状态变量，用以刻画预测误差在时间上的持续程度，并为离线与流式场景设计基于AoL的训练策略，在长尾分类中取得与基线相当或更优的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习算法主要依赖损失、间隔、预测置信度等瞬时信号来刻画模型行为，这些信号只能反映当前优化步的预测难度，无法捕捉模型“已经错误了多久”这一时间维度。作者希望研究学习的时间动态，区分持续性的欠学习与瞬时性错误。

Method: 引入AoL作为学习状态变量：误差未解决时AoL持续增长，一旦预测正确则重置。针对离线学习，累积样本级AoL并聚合为类级状态，指导自适应重加权与重采样；针对流式学习（无法访问完整历史），利用当前观测与缓冲观测维护轻量级类级AoL状态。

Result: 在长尾分类设置中，AoL方法达到或超过标准训练基线，且当学习困难持续存在时收益更大。多随机种子的流式实验显示，在时间上稳定的类别不平衡下具有可复现的提升。对类别频率、损失和间隔的分析表明，AoL与常规难度度量相关，但额外捕获了误差持续时间的信息。

Conclusion: 时间持续性为刻画和控制不平衡及非平稳环境下的学习动态提供了有用的补充信号。

Abstract: Current machine learning algorithms primarily rely on instantaneous signals such as loss, margin, and prediction confidence to characterize model behavior. These signals indicate how difficult a prediction is at the current optimization step, but they do not capture how long the model has remained incorrect. We study this temporal dimension of learning and introduce Age of Learning (AoL), a learning-state variable that measures the persistence of prediction errors over time. AoL increases while an error remains unresolved and resets when a correct prediction is achieved, thereby distinguishing persistent under-learning from transient mistakes. We develop AoL-based training strategies for both offline and streaming settings. In offline learning, sample-level AoL is accumulated over training and aggregated into class-level states that guide adaptive reweighting and resampling. In streaming learning, where full historical access is unavailable, we maintain lightweight class-level AoL states using current and buffered observations. Across long-tailed classification settings, AoL improves or matches standard training baselines, with larger benefits when learning difficulty persists over time. Multi-seed streaming experiments further show reproducible gains under temporally stable imbalance. Analysis of class frequency, loss, and margin shows that AoL is related to conventional difficulty measures but captures additional information about error duration. These results suggest that temporal persistence provides a useful complementary signal for characterizing and controlling learning dynamics in imbalanced and non-stationary environments.

</details>


### [1059] [Learning the Graph and the Embedding Together: Classifier-Independent Rewiring for Heterophilic Node Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32613)
*Harshit Kumar,Sujan Chakraborty,Priyanka Saha,Pritam Kar,Saptarshi Bej*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出亲和度引导的图重连方法，交替训练轻量GNN与在模块度目标（含伪标签同质性项）下重加权候选边，输出与分类器无关的重连图与节点嵌入；在六个异质基准、五个下游分类器上30组中23组提升，平均增益5.8点，分类器间精度差异缩小约4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异质图上相连节点常带不同标签，GNN优势大幅下降。图重连是常用补救手段，但现有重连方法通常只用单一分类器评估，难以区分收益来自新拓扑还是该特定配对，因此缺乏分类器无关、可复用的重连产出。

Method: 方法同时估计图结构与节点表示：以期望最大化（EM）思路交替进行——在当前图上训练轻量GNN，并在模块度目标下结合伪标签同质性项对候选边重新加权。候选边来自紧凑候选池，由对比学习得到的节点相似度与邻域分布亲和度共同打分。最终输出两个与分类器无关的结果：重连后的图和在该图上学习的节点嵌入。另有无监督变体，重连过程不使用标签。

Result: 在六个异质图基准与五个下游分类器、使用归一化特征的30个分类器-数据集组合中，23个组合精度优于原图，平均提升5.8个点，并将分类器间的精度离散度缩小约4倍。受控消融显示两个输出均有作用且互补：嵌入贡献主要精度增益，重连图促使不同分类器结果一致；全无监督变体保留大部分提升。重连后的图同质性更高，并改善了标签传播与社区检测效果。

Conclusion: 亲和度引导重连能产出分类器无关的重连图与嵌入，兼顾精度提升与分类器一致性，且在同质性与标签传播、社区检测等任务上具通用增益，无监督变体亦有效。

Abstract: Graph neural networks lose much of their advantage on heterophilic graphs, where connected nodes often carry different labels. Graph rewiring is a popular remedy, but rewiring methods are usually evaluated with a single classifier, which makes it hard to tell whether the gains come from the new topology or from that particular pairing. We propose an affinity-guided rewiring method that estimates the graph and the node representation together. It alternates, in the spirit of expectation maximisation, between training a lightweight graph neural network on the current graph and re-weighting candidate edges under a modularity objective with a pseudo-label homophily term. Candidate edges come from a compact pool scored by a contrastively learned node similarity and a neighbourhood-distribution affinity. The method returns two classifier-independent outputs: a rewired graph and a node embedding learned on it. Across six heterophilic benchmarks and five downstream classifiers, it improves accuracy over the original graph with normalised features in 23 of 30 classifier-dataset combinations, with a mean gain of 5.8 points, and reduces the accuracy spread between classifiers about fourfold. A controlled ablation shows that the two outputs are each useful and play complementary roles: the embedding contributes most of the accuracy gain, while the rewired graph makes different classifiers agree. A fully unsupervised variant, which uses no labels during rewiring, retains most of the improvement. The rewired graphs are also more homophilic and improve label propagation and community detection.

</details>


### [1060] [Stabilizing the Dynamic Low-Rank Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32615)
*Zhonghan Xu,Ling Wang,Junhao Chen,Jianwei Zhao,Jinwei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析DLRT在高压缩下的失效原因，指出其梯度流与最佳秩r近似梯度流之间存在被忽略的曲率耦合项，提出SDLRT：通过轻量补偿缓冲注入被截断的顶部奇异方向并引入截断容差的负反馈，从而稳定动态低秩训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩参数化训练可同时降低训练与推理的内存、计算和存储开销。DLRT无需特殊初始化或事后分解即可在线发现高效子网络，但在高压缩率下无法找到可训练网络，亟需解释并解决该失效问题。

Method: 1) 推导最佳秩r近似的梯度流，证明DLRT的偏差来自高压缩下不可忽略的曲率耦合项；2) 提出SDLRT，维护轻量补偿缓冲，重新注入被截断的顶部被忽略奇异方向；3) 对截断容差施加负反馈以稳定每层秩。

Result: SDLRT在DLRT崩溃的高压缩场景下能可靠找到可训练子网络；作为DeBERTa-v3上的PEFT适配器，在SuperGLUE上取得最佳平均分，参数开销仅比LoRA多2.8%。

Conclusion: 曲率耦合项是DLRT高压缩失效的关键，补偿被忽略奇异方向的轻量缓冲与秩的负反馈控制可有效恢复稳定性，使动态低秩训练在极端压缩与PEFT场景下均具竞争力。

Abstract: Training neural networks directly in a low-rank parameterization is an appealing route to reducing memory, compute, and storage simultaneously during both training and inference. Dynamic low-rank training (DLRT), which confines weights to a rank-$r$ manifold via the Galerkin projection of the gradient flow, is particularly attractive because it identifies efficient subnetworks on the fly without specialized initialization or post-factorization. However, DLRT fails to find trainable networks under high compression. In this paper, we derive the gradient flow of the best rank-$r$ approximation and point out that the offset of DLRT comes from a curvature-coupling term which is large and thus non-negligible under aggressive compression. Guided by this analysis, we propose a stable dynamic low-rank training method, named SDLRT, which maintains a lightweight compensation buffer that reinjects the top neglected singular directions. Additionally, we introduce a negative feedback on the truncation tolerance to stabilize each layer's rank. Experimentally, SDLRT reliably finds trainable subnetworks where DLRT collapses and as a PEFT adapter on DeBERTa-v3, it achieves the best average score on SuperGLUE at only $2.8\%$ parameter overhead over LoRA.

</details>


### [1061] [Extremely Fast and Compact Binary Graph Representations via Randomized Operator Sketching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32641)
*Srajan Agarwal,Megha P,Bikas C Das,Zakaria Laskar,Saptarshi Bej*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种超快、纯代数的图哈希方法，直接从图结构构造二值节点表示，无需节点特征或梯度训练，精度优于现有无特征二值基线且生成速度快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络通常依赖稠密的浮点节点表示，内存与计算开销大。二值图哈希用紧凑比特串编码节点信息作为替代，但现有方法要么为效率牺牲全局拓扑信息，要么生成成本高。作者希望兼顾拓扑保真度与生成效率。

Method: 构造纯代数（非学习）哈希：用受Nyström启发的随机列采样近似高阶结构转移矩阵，结合高效的标签安全语义传播机制；将连续表示按列阈值离散化为紧凑二值码。整个流程不需要节点特征，也不需要基于梯度的训练。

Result: 在十个节点分类数据集上，分类精度一致优于现有无特征二值基线，且在许多数据集上二值码生成时间在亚秒级。所得二值表示天然适合事件驱动计算，兼容神经形态脉冲神经网络与无梯度学习规则。

Conclusion: 简单的代数近似可为离散图表示学习提供一种高效替代学习式流水线的方案。

Abstract: Graph neural networks typically rely on dense, floating-point node representations, which can impose substantial memory and computational costs. Binary graph hashing offers an alternative by encoding node information as compact bit strings. However, existing approaches either sacrifice global topological information for computational efficiency or incur substantial generation costs. We introduce an ultra-fast, entirely algebraic hashing method that constructs binary node representations directly from graph structure, without requiring node features or gradient-based training. Our method approximates a high-order structural transition matrix using randomized column sampling inspired by the Nyström method and combines it with an efficient label-safe semantic propagation mechanism. The resulting continuous representations are discretized through column-wise thresholding to obtain compact binary codes. Experiments on ten node classification datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves classification accuracy over existing feature-free binary baselines while requiring sub-second code generation on many datasets. The resulting binary representations are also naturally suited to event-driven computation, making them compatible with neuromorphic spiking neural networks and gradient-free learning rules. These results demonstrate that simple algebraic approximations can provide an efficient alternative to learned pipelines for discrete graph representation learning.

</details>


### [1062] [Quantization-Aware Pre-Training with Constrained Empirical Weight Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32659)
*Ningfeng Yang,Tor M. Aamodt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CEWT优化方法，通过将权重的经验分布硬约束为零均值高斯分布，无超参数、无内存开销地抑制量化感知预训练中的舍入边界权重振荡，一致提升低精度LLaMA/GPT模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化感知预训练（QAPT）可提升DNN推理效率，但存在"舍入边界权重振荡"问题，会给训练过程引入有害噪声并显著降低收敛速度。现有方法或引入额外超参数与内存开销，或无法稳定提升模型精度，因此亟需一种无额外代价且稳定有效的振荡抑制方法。

Method: 提出CEWT（约束经验权重分布），一种优化器后更新步骤：将权重投影到权重空间中距其最近的点，使得该点的经验分布（直方图）匹配零均值高斯分布。核心洞见在于许多量化器隐含假设待量化数据是零均值高斯样本的排列，而QAPT过程中该假设并不成立；通过以硬约束形式强制实施零均值高斯先验，抑制有害噪声。

Result: 在多种SOTA量化器与超球面优化器组合上验证：CEWT仅增加4%（几何平均）训练时间，即可一致降低低精度（低至1-bit激活与权重、参数最多610M）LLaMA/GPT模型的预训练困惑度，平均降低2.5点、最高降低21点，且不引入任何超参数或存储开销。

Conclusion: CEWT是一种无超参数、无内存开销的振荡抑制方法，通过硬约束经验权重分布为零均值高斯有效抑制QAPT噪声，在低精度大模型上稳定提升性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Quantization-Aware Pre-Training (QAPT) can increase the inference efficiency of DNNs, but a problematic behaviour known as rounding boundary weight oscillation can introduce detrimental noise into the training process and significantly reduce convergence speed. While existing methods can reduce this detrimental noise, they either introduce additional hyperparameters or memory overhead, or cannot consistently improve model accuracy. In this work, we propose optimization with $\textbf{C}$onstrained $\textbf{E}$mpirical $\textbf{W}$eight dis$\textbf{T}$ribution (CEWT), the first hyperparameter-free memory-overhead-free oscillation suppression method that consistently improves QAPT performance: an optimizer post-update step that projects weights to the nearest point in weight space whose empirical distribution (histogram) matches a zero-mean Gaussian. Our key insight is many quantizers are designed with the implicit assumption that the to-be-quantized data are permutations of samples from a zero-mean Gaussian, and this assumption is not true during QAPT. By enforcing the zero-mean Gaussian prior as a hard constraint, CEWT can suppress this detrimental noise. Empirical results on various combinations of SOTA quantizers and hypersphere optimizers suggest, that with a geomean increase of 4% in training time, CEWT can consistently reduce the pre-training perplexity (by an average of 2.5 and up to 21 points) of low-precision (down to 1-bit activations and weights and up to 610M parameters) LLaMA/GPT models without introducing any hyperparameters or storage overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/1733116199/cewt

</details>


### [1063] [Equivariant Neural Primal-Dual Assignment for Maximum Common Edge Subgraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32661)
*Jiaqing Xie,Yanchao Li,Zhuo Yang,Yuxin Wang,Tianfan Fu,Yuqiang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ENPDA 学习一种共享的等变神经原始-对偶匹配策略，用于最大公共边子图匹配，无需重新训练即可用于新图对，查询速度比最强基线快约三个数量级，并在多个分子基准上提升匹配精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子相似性搜索需匹配大量图对，重复查询成本关键；最强基线虽准确，但每对图都需单独训练一个网络，代价高昂。

Method: 提出 Equivariant Neural Primal-Dual Assignment（ENPDA）：学习共享匹配策略，重算候选匹配的精确目标边缘（marginals），学习修正项与步长以更新分数；目标价格在多个源顶点竞争同一目标时作出响应；经四轮更新与匈牙利投影得到部分一对一匹配。并给出对任意网络参数均成立的逐对保证，包括重排序等变性、投影匹配的一对一性、修复价格给出有效 MCES 上界及最优性间隙界定。

Result: 在三个分子基准（训练/验证/测试划分互斥）上，相同更新与投影预算下，ENPDA 比解析对应方法提升 7.4–8.6 个精度点；经 1 秒精化搜索后仍保留 2.5–3 个点增益。无需微调迁移到社交与蛋白质图的边删除任务，提升 9.1–17.6 个点。在需保持芳香环完整的输出匹配中，三个数据集上均恢复更多参考键。证书证明 291 个原生测试对中 60 个达到全局最优。

Conclusion: ENPDA 通过共享等变神经原始-对偶策略实现快速、可迁移且具最优性证书的 MCES 匹配，在准确性、效率与泛化性上优于强基线。

Abstract: Maximum common edge subgraph (MCES) matching finds a partial vertex correspondence between two labeled graphs that preserves as many labeled edges as possible. Molecular similarity search requires matching many graph pairs, making the cost of repeated queries important. The strongest baseline attains accurate MCES solutions but trains a separate network for each pair. We introduce Equivariant Neural Primal-Dual Assignment (ENPDA), which learns a shared matching policy and applies it to new pairs without further training, answering queries roughly three orders of magnitude faster and recovering its training cost after a few dozen queries. The policy recomputes exact objective marginals for candidate matches and learns corrections and step sizes that update their scores. Target prices respond to competition when several source vertices favor the same target. Four update rounds and a Hungarian projection produce a partial one-to-one matching. We prove per-pair guarantees that hold for any network parameters. In exact arithmetic, reordering either graph permutes the assignment and price states, the projected matching is one-to-one, and repaired prices give a valid MCES upper bound. Subtracting the preserved-edge count bounds the optimality gap; combined with structural caps, these certificates prove global optimality for 60 of 291 native test pairs. On three molecular benchmarks with disjoint train/validation/test splits, ENPDA improves over an analytic counterpart with the same update and projection budget by 7.4-8.6 accuracy points; after one second of refinement search, 2.5-3 points of the gain remain. Transferred without fine-tuning to edge-deletion tasks from social and protein graphs, the policy gains 9.1-17.6 points over the analytic counterpart. When output matchings must keep aromatic rings intact, ENPDA recovers more reference bonds than the baselines on all three datasets.

</details>


### [1064] [SIFT: Enhancing Time Series Foundation Models via Semantic Invariance and Structural Fidelity Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32676)
*Yi Tang,Tengxue Zhang,Yang Shu,Chenjuan Guo,Chenchen Sun,Yisheng An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SIFT微调方法，通过语义不变对抗增强与组件级结构保真增强，缓解时间序列基础模型微调中的过拟合与均值预测陷阱，在10个真实数据集上显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）经大规模预训练已具备出色的零样本能力，但时间序列数据维度低、结构模式多样，直接进行朴素微调易导致过拟合，并陷入"均值预测陷阱"（即模型倾向于输出平滑均值而丢失细节）。

Method: SIFT在微调过程中同时保持语义不变性与结构保真性：1）语义不变对抗增强——利用语义谱分解划分语义空间，在非核心语义子空间内生成扰动，以增强模型对扰动的鲁棒性，缓解过拟合；2）基于组件的结构保真增强——引入组件级mixup并施加重构目标，提升模型保持结构保真的能力，缓解均值预测陷阱。

Result: 在具有代表性的TSFMs上覆盖10个真实世界数据集进行的大量实验表明，SIFT能够显著提升TSFMs的性能。

Conclusion: SIFT是一种稳健的微调适配方法，通过语义不变对抗增强与结构保真增强的协同，有效解决TSFM微调中的过拟合与均值预测问题，具备良好的通用性与实用价值。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have achieved remarkable zero-shot performance through extensive pre-training on massive time series datasets. Nevertheless, due to the low-dimensional properties and diverse structural patterns of time series data, performing naive fine-tuning on TSFMs often leads to overfitting and falling into the mean-prediction trap. To address these challenges, we propose SIFT, a robust adaptation method that enhances time series foundation models by preserving Semantic Invariance and structural Fidelity throughout the fine-Tuning process. We employ semantic-invariant adversarial augmentation, which utilizes semantic spectrum decomposition to partition the semantic space and then generates perturbations within the non-core semantic subspace to bolster the model's robustness against these perturbations, mitigating overfitting. We implement a component-based structural fidelity enhancement, which facilitates component-wise mixup and imposes a reconstruction objective to improve the model's ability to preserve structural fidelity, alleviating the mean-prediction trap. Extensive experiments on representative TSFMs covering 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that SIFT can significantly enhance the performance of TSFMs.

</details>


### [1065] [Self-Evolving Time-Series Forecasting Agents with Episodic Memory and Online Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32689)
*Junyi Wang,Yilin Wang,Wen Wu,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FASE：一种反馈感知的自演化预测智能体，通过情节记忆与在线策略学习，将已完成预测实例的延迟反馈转化为经验，在不更新LLM参数的前提下持续自我演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM时间序列预测智能体通常只关注当前预测实例，而真实在线部署中预测原点不断推进，早期实例的真实目标会逐步可用并构成对历史动作的反馈，但现有智能体未保留或利用这些信息来调整后续动作。

Method: 提出FASE框架，将反馈转化为任务特定经验，包含两个核心组件：情节记忆（检索相关的已完成实例）与在线策略学习（把跨实例累积的反馈归纳为排序指导）。该机制在冻结LLM参数的情况下实现智能体的持续自我演化。

Result: 在GIFT-Eval基准中选取的29种数据集配置上评估，FASE在点预测聚合性能上优于所评估方法，相较最佳单一基础模型基线将归一化MAE降低9.1%；随延迟反馈累积，其累积优势进一步增大。

Conclusion: FASE证明智能体可借助已完成预测实例的反馈持续自我演化，而无需更新LLM参数，为在线时间序列预测提供了反馈驱动的适应范式。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used for time-series forecasting because they can organise contextual information, perform multi-step analysis, and guide the sequence of actions required to complete forecasting tasks. Most existing agents focus only on the current forecasting instance. However, in real-world deployments, forecasting commonly operates online, with new forecasts issued from the currently available history as the forecast origin advances and the ground-truth targets of earlier instances progressively become available. These targets provide feedback on the actions taken in earlier instances, yet existing agents generally do not preserve or utilise this information to adapt their subsequent actions. To address this limitation, we introduce FASE, a Feedback-Aware Self-Evolving forecasting agent that converts such feedback into task-specific experience for subsequent forecasting instances. FASE combines episodic memory, which retrieves relevant completed instances, with online policy learning, which summarises the feedback accumulated across instances into ranking guidance. The proposed framework is evaluated on 29 dataset configurations selected from the GIFT-Eval benchmark. Across these 29 configurations, FASE attains the strongest aggregate point forecasting performance among the evaluated methods and reduces the normalised MAE by 9.1% relative to the best individual foundation model baseline. The results further indicate that the cumulative advantage of FASE increases as delayed feedback accumulates. Together, these findings demonstrate that FASE can continually self-evolve through feedback from completed forecasting instances without updating the parameters of the LLM.

</details>


### [1066] [BiasReducer: Adaptive Bias Mitigation for Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32720)
*Shuang Liu,Yongliang Miao,Yanguang Liu,Haoyi Xiong,Mengnan Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BiasReducer，一种仅编辑线性奖励头、并按数据集自适应选择相关偏置编辑的轻量框架，缓解奖励模型对长度、自信等表面属性的偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励模型会偏好长度、自信等表面属性，导致LLM产出得分更高但并非更正确。现有缓解方法要么需要重训练（耗数据与算力），要么需预先指定目标偏置并对该偏置施加固定修正，泛化性差。

Method: 仅编辑线性奖励头：1）用SAE式编码器学习奖励模型敏感的属性（如长度、自信）；2）学习如何降低对每个属性的依赖，即确定奖励头的调整方向与幅度；3）对新数据集按属性对奖励分数的影响力排序，选取相关属性并据此编辑奖励模型。

Result: 在五个奖励模型上持续提升抗偏置鲁棒性；BiasReducer-M在三个基准上平均提升8.3、18.0、6.9个百分点，优于两个基于训练的基线；增益可迁移到下游，减少冗余啰嗦与谄媚，同时保持可比的评判质量。

Conclusion: 通过自适应选择相关属性并仅编辑线性奖励头，可在不重训练、不预设偏置的前提下有效降低奖励模型对表面属性的依赖，并惠及下游LLM行为。

Abstract: Reward models score responses from large language models (LLMs) and guide LLM training toward human preferences. However, reward models can favor superficial attributes such as length or confidence, leading LLMs to produce higher-scoring but not more correct responses. Existing mitigation methods either retrain the reward model or apply a fixed correction to one known bias, such as a preference for longer responses. Retraining requires additional data and computational resources, while existing editing methods require the target bias to be specified in advance and use a fixed edit for that bias. To this end, we propose BiasReducer, a lightweight framework that edits only the linear reward head and selects the relevant edits for each new dataset. First, BiasReducer uses a sparse autoencoder (SAE)-style encoder to learn which attributes (e.g., length and confidence) the reward model is sensitive to. Second, it learns how to reduce the reward model's dependence on each attribute by determining which direction to adjust the reward head and how much to adjust it. Third, for a new dataset, it ranks the attributes by their influence on reward scores, selects the relevant ones, and edits the reward model accordingly. BiasReducer consistently improves reward-model robustness to biases toward superficial response attributes. Across five reward models, BiasReducer-M improves the three benchmarks by 8.3, 18.0, and 6.9 percentage points on average, outperforming the two training-based baselines. The gains transfer downstream, reducing unnecessary verbosity and sycophancy while maintaining comparable judged quality.

</details>


### [1067] [Scaling Properties of Same-Family On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32722)
*Yuntai Bao,Qinfeng Li,Guoqing Jiang,Liwei Chen,Zhiheng Qin,Xuanping Li,Wenqi Zhang,Xuhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在LLM中的跨规模能力迁移规律，发现早期训练存在"有效迁移区"，其中留出准确率随KL散度平方根近似线性上升，并据此拟合幂律预测蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习能激发LLM的推理能力，但这种能力在模型规模间迁移的程度与速度尚不明确，作者希望通过研究OPD的缩放性质来填补这一空白。

Method: 在弱到强、同基座、强到弱三种师生设定下研究OPD的缩放规律；以从学生初始化出发的token级反向KL散度平方根d为轴，分析gold score G的变化；并拟合G峰值及有效迁移区斜率关于师生参数量和教师gold score的幂律。

Result: 早期OPD训练动态普遍呈现有效迁移区，G随d近似线性上升；所有弱到强配对中学生的峰值gold score都超过教师本身，说明紧凑RL专家可通过OPD向更大模型迁移能力；幂律显示峰值gold score仅随教师规模提升到约与学生规模相当为止，且在同gold score下更小的教师迁移效果更好。

Conclusion: 教师分数本身并不决定其监督价值；作者还进一步研究了两种OPD变体、弱到强OPD的自举以及在线策略监督程度的缩放效应。

Abstract: *Reinforcement learning (RL)* can induce substantial reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), but how much of this capability transfers across model scales, and how quickly, remains unclear. We study the scaling properties of *on-policy distillation (OPD)* across *weak-to-strong*, *same-base*, and *strong-to-weak* teacher--student setups. We find that early OPD training dynamics uniformly exhibit a regular *useful-transfer* regime, in which held-out accuracy (the *gold score*, $G$) rises approximately linearly in $d=\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}(π_θ\Vert π_{\mathrm{ref}})}$, the square root of token-level reverse KL divergence from the student initialization. In every observed weak-to-strong pair, the student's peak gold score exceeds its teacher's own, so a compact RL expert can transfer capability to a much larger student via OPD. To estimate OPD outcomes, we fit *power laws* for how $G_{\mathrm{peak}}$ and the slope of the useful-transfer regime scale with student and teacher parameter counts and with teacher gold score. These laws show that peak gold score improves with teacher scale only up to roughly the student's scale, and that at a matched gold score smaller teachers transfer better, so a teacher's score alone does not define its supervision value. We also study the scaling effects of two OPD variants, bootstrapping weak-to-strong OPD, and the degree of on-policy supervision.

</details>


### [1068] [Predicting the Financial Impact of Supply Chain Risk for Major AI-Related Semiconductor Firms: A Heterogeneous Graph Patch Transformer Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32741)
*Jianna Hur,Sagar Samtani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出异构图块变换器（heterogeneous graph patch transformer），在15,186家公司、60个季度的网络上预测半导体AI芯片设计企业财务指标的季度变化，预测提前1–2个季度，并在116家焦点企业上取得最低误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代半导体生产依赖全球分布的多层级供应链，单一企业的财务压力会延迟扩散，最终影响AI芯片设计企业的营收、库存与盈利能力。然而多数企业仅能观察到直接合作伙伴，且既有预测研究主要聚焦市场类风险指标，缺乏将供应链压力映射到财报财务数据的预测工具。

Method: 提出异构图块变换器（heterogeneous graph patch transformer）。模型通过可学习门控融合季度基本面与宏观贸易、事件、灾害信号；在供应商、客户、所有权、总部关系上进行类型化、方向特定的风险传播；并采用基于块（patch）的分词方式编码传播后的历史序列。训练数据为覆盖60个季度的15,186家公司网络。

Result: 在116家焦点半导体企业的初步实验中，模型在两个预测时点上对所有目标均取得最低误差，且盈利能力优势在提前两个季度的时点上进一步扩大。

Conclusion: 该预测方法可在中断反映到财报之前为供应链管理者与投资者提供预警，支持提前决策。

Abstract: Modern semiconductor production relies on a globally distributed, multi-tier supply chain in which financial stress at one firm spreads with a delay and eventually affects the revenue, inventory, and profitability of the companies that design AI chips. Most firms see only their direct partners, and prior predictive research has mainly targeted market-based risk measures, so few tools forecast how supply chain stress will appear in reported financials. In this study, we propose a heterogeneous graph patch transformer that forecasts these quarterly changes one and two quarters ahead. Learning from a 15,186-company network over 60 quarters, the proposed model fuses quarterly fundamentals with macro-trade, event, and disaster signals through learned gates, carries risk across supplier, customer, ownership, and headquarters relations through typed, direction-specific propagation, and encodes the propagated histories with patch-based tokenization. In preliminary experiments on 116 focal semiconductor firms, the proposed model achieves the lowest error on every target at both horizons, and its profitability advantage widens at the two-quarter horizon. These forecasts can help supply chain managers and investors act before disruptions appear in reported financials.

</details>


### [1069] [Benchmarking EEG Foundation Models at Scale: Lessons from 20,000 Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32743)
*Zhige Chen,Shu Peng,Chengxuan Qin,Rui Liu,Rui Yang,Kay Chen Tan,Jibin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出EEG-Arena基准，系统评估30个EEG基础模型与25个监督基线在23个公开数据集57个下游任务上的表现（超2万次评估、5种实验协议），得出5项关键结论并开源评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型虽被寄予"可迁移神经表征"的期望，但其相较强监督基线的优势、以及进一步扩展（scaling）的前景仍不明确，缺乏统一、可复现的评估基准来回答这些问题。

Method: 构建开源基准EEG-Arena，涵盖30个EEG基础模型与25个监督基线，在来自23个公开数据集的57个下游任务上，采用5种实验协议开展超过20,000次评估；评估维度包括下游性能、预训练收益、模型规模扩展、预训练数据规模扩展以及对通道配置的鲁棒性。

Result: (1) EEG基础模型在多数任务上优于强任务特定监督基线，在非双极（non-bipolar）设置下尤为明显；(2) 与架构匹配的从零监督训练相比，预训练同时改善早期优化与最终下游性能，且随下游标注数据增多收益更大更稳定；(3) 现有EEG基础模型的参数量与下游性能之间无一致正相关；(4) 固定架构下，增大预训练数据规模可带来持续的下游增益；(5) 通道灵活（channel-flexible）模型在多数通道配置下绝对性能高于通道受限模型。

Conclusion: 研究证实了EEG基础模型的下游价值，并指出预训练数据扩展是未来进展的有前景方向；同时开源EEG-Arena评估框架，为可复现基准测试、模型比较与社区驱动开发提供共享基础设施。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) promise transferable neural representations, yet their advantages over strong supervised baselines and their prospects for further scaling remain unclear. To address these questions, we introduce EEG-Arena, an open-source benchmark covering 30 EEG FMs and 25 supervised baselines evaluated on 57 downstream tasks from 23 public datasets. Through more than 20,000 evaluations across five experimental protocols, we assess downstream performance, pretraining benefits, model size scaling, pretraining data scaling, and robustness to channel configuration.
