This turns Newton--Schulz orthogonalization into a spectrum-adaptive procedure that responds to differences across both layers and training time. On saved momentum matrices, spectral estimation substantially reduces orthogonalization error at a fixed iteration budget or reaches the same accuracy with fewer iterations, and in GPT pretraining up to 1B parameters it lowers the validation loss of two matrix optimizers. Our results suggest that matrix-function operations inside optimizers need not be designed for a conservative worst-case spectrum: they can cheaply measure the spectrum they are already processing and specialize computations accordingly.

</details>


### [1103] [DevelopmentODE: Structured Neural ODEs for Early Brain Development Dynamics Across a Decade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33048)
*Kaiqiao Han,Haitao Chen,Bryan Quah,Xiaoda Wang,Janelle Liu,John H Gilmore,Wei Gao,Yizhou Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DevelopmentODE，一个结构化连续时间框架，将群体与个体差异组织在共享的发育几何中，并让动力学随年龄演化，用于从稀疏纵向观测预测儿童脑发育轨迹，在纵向fMRI的未来功能连接预测上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童脑发育研究依赖稀疏的纵向观测，每个儿童通常仅在少数不规则时间点被观测，而发育动力学又因个体和年龄而异。通用连续时间模型虽能处理不规则采样，但往往把群体进程、个体变异和发育年龄这些因素都吸收进一个单一灵活的转移函数中，缺乏可供解释和引导学习的结构。

Method: DevelopmentODE在共享发育几何内组织群体与个体变异，同时允许支配动力学随年龄演化。其核心是发育通道（developmental canal）表征群体轨迹，其局部方向为组织个体变异提供参照：个体偏差速度被约束为相对该方向，共享的非线性偏差场刻画个体发育运动而不干扰群体级进程。模型通过有序的年龄依赖形变（ordered age-dependent deformations）对共享向量场建模发育非平稳性，随年龄逐步调整共同动力学结构，而经过的时间决定积分时长。

Result: 在纵向fMRI数据上，以儿童早期观测预测同一儿童未来功能连接为任务，DevelopmentODE在短程和长程预测中均持续优于竞争基线。

Conclusion: 该建模方式利用群体级发育结构引导从稀疏个体轨迹中的学习，同时让动力学随年龄平滑演化，为长期神经发育预测提供了结构化且有效的连续时间框架。

Abstract: Understanding how individual brain development unfolds over childhood requires modeling developmental trajectories from sparse longitudinal observations. Long-term neurodevelopmental forecasting is challenging because each child is typically observed at only a few irregularly spaced visits, while developmental dynamics vary across individuals and age. Generic continuous-time models accommodate irregular timing but often absorb these factors into a single flexible transition function, providing little structure for how population progression, individual variability, and developmental age shape the dynamics. We propose DevelopmentODE, a structured continuous-time framework that organizes population- and subject-specific variation within a shared developmental geometry while allowing the governing dynamics to evolve with age. The model builds this geometry around a developmental canal representing the population trajectory, whose local direction provides a reference for organizing subject-specific variation. Subject deviation velocities are constrained relative to this direction, while a shared nonlinear deviation field captures individual developmental motion without disrupting population-level progression. DevelopmentODE further models developmental non-stationarity through ordered age-dependent deformations of the shared vector field, progressively adapting a common dynamical structure as age changes, while elapsed time determines the integration horizon. This formulation uses population-level developmental structure to guide learning from sparse individual trajectories while allowing dynamics to evolve smoothly with age. We evaluate DevelopmentODE on longitudinal fMRI by predicting future functional connectivity of the same child from earlier observations. DevelopmentODE consistently outperforms competing baselines across short- and long-horizon predictions.

</details>


### [1104] [SketchSSM: Write to the Full State, Read from a Compact Sketch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33051)
*Omin Kwon,JoongWon Shin,Minseo Kim,Kurt Keutzer,Sehoon Kim,Jae W. Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SketchSSM，在混合注意力模型中将线性注意力的全状态读取替换为低秩 sketch 近似，实现约10倍状态访问流量降低并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合注意力模型用线性注意力替代多数 softmax 层以减少 KV-cache 增长，但在大解码批次下循环状态访问成为主要瓶颈。ReplaySSM 通过缓存 keys/values 摊销状态更新，然而每次新 query 仍需全状态读取，尽管状态在两次更新间保持不变。

Method: 作者观察到低秩的状态加权 query 近似能准确保持状态读取输出，且未来 query 未知但用于近似的基向量可离线固定。据此提出 SketchSSM：保留全状态更新，仅近似读取。每次状态更新时读取一次全状态，为固定基向量预计算输出并存入紧凑 sketch；后续每个解码步用 query 相关系数组合 sketch 向量重建输出，无需全状态读取。

Result: 在四种基于 Mamba-2、GDN 和 KDA 的模型上，SketchSSM 将状态访问流量降低约10倍，同时在四个解码基准上基本保持平均精度，并在四个 RULER 检索任务上保持召回率。在单张 NVIDIA B300 上，相对标准 vLLM 基线，线性注意力内核加速分别达到 Mamba-2 7.78x、GDN 5.22x、KDA 5.20x；在 Nemotron 3 Super 上解码吞吐最高提升 2.64x。

Conclusion: SketchSSM 通过将线性注意力的全状态读取解耦为离线固定基向量与在线 query 系数组合，在保持精度的前提下显著降低状态访问开销，为混合注意力模型的高吞吐解码提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Hybrid-attention models replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention, reducing KV-cache growth and enabling larger decode batches where recurrent state access becomes a major bottleneck. ReplaySSM amortizes state updates by buffering keys and values, but each new query still requires a full-state read even though the state remains unchanged between state updates. We observe that low-rank state-weighted query approximation accurately preserves state-read outputs. Although future queries are unknown, the basis vectors used to approximate them can be fixed offline. Based on this observation, we introduce SketchSSM, which preserves full-state updates while approximating reads. At each state update, SketchSSM reads the full state once to precompute outputs for these basis vectors, storing them in a compact sketch. Each subsequent decode step combines the sketch vectors with query-dependent coefficients to reconstruct the output without a full-state read. Across four Mamba-2-, GDN-, and KDA-based models, SketchSSM reduces state-access traffic by approximately 10x while largely preserving average accuracy across four decode benchmarks and recall on four RULER retrieval tasks. On one NVIDIA B300, linear-attention kernel speedups over the standard vLLM baseline reach 7.78x, 5.22x, and 5.20x for Mamba-2, GDN, and KDA, respectively, with up to 2.64x higher decode throughput on Nemotron 3 Super.

</details>


### [1105] [Deep Learning Techniques for Phoneme Recognition in Italian Children' s Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33060)
*Nicola Barbaro,Cristina Gena,Francesco Petriglia,Andrea Meirone,Alessandro Mazzei,Arianna Viotti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Broca：基于Conformer的语音转国际音标（IPA）深度学习系统，预训练于8天成人语音，微调于165分钟意大利儿童语音，在意大利语上取得13.36%的加权音素错误率（PER），为当前最优，且仅用不足3小时儿童数据，适用于低资源临床场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言治疗师在诊断发音障碍时缺乏高效工具将语音转写为国际音标（IPA），导致诊断困难。本文旨在为儿童语音评估与诊断提供更可及、数据高效的工具，尤其在低资源临床环境下。

Method: 提出Broca系统，采用Conformer架构。先在8天成人语音上预训练，再在165分钟的意大利儿童语音数据集上微调，该数据来自针对3.5–6.5岁儿童的多种标准化诊断测试。模型针对儿童语音的音系变异性进行优化，涵盖声调、口音与发音错误。转写为词汇无关（vocabulary-independent）的语音到IPA映射。

Result: 在意大利语上达到13.36%的加权音素错误率（weighted Phoneme Error Rate），为当前最优（SOTA）水平；且仅使用不足3小时的儿童特定数据即取得该性能，体现出模型在低资源临床环境下的效率与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 研究表明，准确且词汇无关的语音到IPA转写可在极少数据条件下实现，为更可及、数据高效的语音评估与诊断工具奠定基础。

Abstract: Speech therapists often face difficulties diagnosing impairments due to the lack of efficient tools for transcribing speech into the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). This work addresses this challenge with Broca, a Conformer-based deep learning system pretrained on 8 days of adult speech and fine-tuned on a 165-minute dataset of Italian child speech collected through a range of standardized diagnostic tests for children aged 3.5-6.5. Broca was optimized to handle phonetic variability in children's speech, including tone, accent, and speech errors, and achieved a state-of-the-art weighted Phoneme Error Rate of 13.36% on Italian speech. Remarkably, this performance was obtained using less than three hours of child-specific data, underscoring the model's efficiency and robustness in low-resource clinical settings. This work demonstrates that accurate, vocabulary-independent speech-to-IPA transcription can be achieved with minimal data, paving the way for more accessible, data-efficient tools to support speech assessment and diagnosis.

</details>


### [1106] [KernelZero: Co-Evolving Proposer and Coder for Continuously Improved GPU Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33074)
*Changxin Ke,Rui Zhang,Zixiang Fang,Zhenghong Li,Yuanbo Wen,Jiashuo Shen,Shuo Wang,Jiaming Guo,Ling Li,Qi Guo,Yunji Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KernelZero是一个协同进化框架，通过Proposer与Coder两个专用模型交替优化，并结合正确性感知的CA-GRPO，持续提升GPU内核生成能力，7B模型在CUDA与Triton上超越多个强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能GPU内核是现代机器学习系统的关键，但自动生成既正确又高效的内核仍具挑战。现有基于LLM的方法存在两大局限：与模型当前能力对齐的高质量训练数据稀缺，以及内核正确性与性能之间的内在权衡。

Method: 提出KernelZero协同进化框架，包含两个专用模型：Proposer从API集合生成Torch模块，Coder将其转换为CUDA或Triton内核。采用前沿驱动的模块生成机制，根据Coder当前弱点持续产生能力对齐的训练模块；引入正确性感知组相对策略优化（CA-GRPO），仅在正确性足够可靠后优化性能；通过交替优化Proposer和Coder形成自动课程学习。

Result: KernelZero-7B在CUDA上超越Claude-4.5-Sonnet，在Triton上超越DeepSeek-V4-Pro。在KernelBench Level 1和2上，CUDA的pass@1分别为75.8%和69.6%，pass@10达100%和97%；Triton的pass@1分别为77.2%和72.5%。

Conclusion: KernelZero通过协同进化的双模型架构与CA-GRPO策略，实现了针对性且训练高效的能力提升，验证了自动课程学习在GPU内核生成任务中的有效性，并以较小模型规模取得领先性能。

Abstract: High-performance GPU kernels are essential to modern machine learning systems, yet automatically generating kernels that are both correct and efficient remains challenging. Existing LLM-based approaches face two major limitations: the scarcity of high-quality training data aligned with the model's current capabilities, and the inherent trade-off between kernel correctness and performance. To address these challenges, we propose KernelZero, a co-evolution framework that continuously improves GPU kernel generation through two specialized models: a Proposer that generates Torch modules from API sets and a Coder that translates them into CUDA or Triton kernels. KernelZero uses a frontier-driven module generation mechanism to continuously produce capability-aligned training modules based on the Coder's current weaknesses. It further introduces Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO), which optimizes performance only after correctness becomes sufficiently reliable. By alternating the optimization of the Proposer and Coder, KernelZero forms an automatic curriculum that enables targeted and training-efficient capability improvement. Empirically, KernelZero-7B surpasses Claude-4.5-Sonnet on CUDA and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Triton. On KernelBench Level 1 and 2, it achieves CUDA pass@1 scores of 75.8% and 69.6%, respectively, with pass@10 reaching 100% and 97%. On Triton, it achieves pass@1 scores of 77.2% and 72.5%, respectively.

</details>


### [1107] [The limits of exactness: On the failure of automatic differentiation in physics-informed machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33078)
*Ameya D. Jagtap*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场性（position）论文，主张自动微分（AD）虽然能让神经网络以机器精度计算控制方程导数，但数学意义上的"精确"不等于物理意义上的"忠实"：AD 本身不含解必须遵循的物理结构，因此"导数可以数值完美却仍是错误的导数"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前物理知识机器学习（PIML）普遍将 AD 视为计算骨干，并默认其导数精确性等价于物理正确性。作者认为这一默认掩盖了一个被低估的风险：AD 按构造不携带任何物理结构先验，因而可能系统性地给出与物理不相容的导数，进而误导下一代 PDE 神经代理模型的构建方向。

Method: 这是一篇观点/论证型（非实验型）论文，采用概念性论证与举例归纳的方法：以对流及其方向性、扩散、色散等作为最直观的反例，并将问题推广到守恒律、热力学一致性、对称性、辛结构、正性、单调性、有界性等横跨计算科学与工程各分支的物理性质，从而重构问题的边界。

Result: 提出的核心判断是：AD 给出的导数在数值上是机器精度精确的，但可能对所求解的具体问题而言是"错误的导数"。对流-扩散-色散只是这一更广泛缺陷最显眼的表现，同类问题涵盖守恒、热力学一致性、对称、辛结构、正性、单调性与有界性等一长串性质。

Conclusion: 认识这一更广泛的"数学精确性—物理忠实性"鸿沟，需要重新框定该领域的研究议程：构建下一代 PDE 驱动的神经代理模型时，不应仅追求导数的数值精确，而应将物理结构约束显式地嵌入模型与训练过程。

Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) lets neural networks compute derivatives of governing equations to machine precision, and this precision has made it the computational backbone of physics-informed machine learning. Yet exactness in the mathematical sense is not the same as fidelity to the physics. Here I argue that a derivative can be numerically perfect and still be the wrong derivative for the problem at hand, because AD, by construction, has no notion of the physical structure a solution must obey. Convection and its associated directionality, diffusion, and dispersion are only the most visible instances of a much longer list that spans all branches of computational science and engineering, including conservation, thermodynamic consistency, symmetry, symplectic structure, positivity, monotonicity, and boundedness. Recognizing this broader gap reframes how the field should build the next generation of PDE-driven neural surrogates.

</details>


### [1108] [From Constitutions to Control: Interpretable Rewards for Aligning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33086)
*Johann D. Gaebler,Calvin Isley,Max Lamparth,Stephen Casper,Sharad Goel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于评分量表（rubric）的对齐框架，将通用宪法转化为可解释、可调节的奖励模型，通过宪法引导的AI反馈估计各维度权重，并重加权以定向调控模型行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐方法存在可解释性与可控性不足的问题：基于偏好的方法将多重考量压缩为聚合的人类判断，掩盖了奖励的驱动因素；基于原则的方法虽指定高层价值，却未将其充分操作化。因此需要一个既能保留高层原则、又能明确控制各维度奖励的框架。

Method: 构建基于评分量表的框架，将通用宪法拆解为若干评分项（rubric items）；利用宪法引导的AI反馈估计各项初始权重；随后通过重加权这些维度构造修改后的奖励用于训练。实验覆盖政治对齐与安全-有用性权衡，并对偏好判断中的标签偏差（讨好倾向、人口统计偏差）进行检验。

Result: 重加权单个维度可可预测地改变目标行为，且各维度作用基本相互独立，同时能驾驭冲突对齐目标间的权衡。同一框架可通过降低标签偏差对训练奖励的影响，缓解偏好判断中编码的讨好倾向与人口统计偏差。

Conclusion: 宪法衍生的可解释奖励能把高层对齐原则转化为更透明、更可控的模型行为，为对齐中的可解释性与定向调控提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Current approaches to aligning language models often make it hard to know what behavior is being rewarded or to change that reward in a targeted way. In particular, standard preference-based methods collapse multiple considerations into aggregate human judgments, obscuring what drives the resulting reward, while principle-based methods specify high-level values without fully operationalizing them. To address this gap, we develop a rubric-based framework to transform a general-purpose constitution into an interpretable and tunable reward model, using constitution-guided AI feedback to estimate initial weights for the constituent rubric items. We then reweight those dimensions to construct modified rewards for training. Across experiments on political alignment and safety-helpfulness tradeoffs, reweighting individual dimensions predictably changes targeted behaviors largely independently while navigating tradeoffs between conflicting alignment objectives. We show that the same framework can mitigate label bias encoded in preference judgments -- including sycophancy and demographic bias -- by reducing their influence on the training reward. Our results demonstrate that constitution-derived, interpretable rewards can translate high-level alignment principles into more transparent and controllable model behavior.

</details>


### [1109] [Geometry-Aware Operator Families for Structured Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33089)
*Zuyuan Zhang,Fei Xu Yu,Tian Lan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GIOF框架，从固定几何结构直接导出传播算子族，并依据上下文动态选择算子，在理论保证与交通预测任务上均验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在表示的几何结构决定哪些组件应交互以及信息如何传播，因此几何感知的算子设计是结构化深度表示学习的核心。但现有神经架构多依赖通用算子模板或针对特定几何的构造，缺乏统一框架，既能从固定结构信息导出可行算子，又能适应变化的上下文。

Method: GIOF（Geometry-Induced Operator Families）：先将几何导出的交互通道转化为可复用生成基，再通过上下文相关的选择器与自适应传播尺度进行组合，最后借助稳定的连续时间传播和瓶颈残差层实现所选算子。

Result: 理论上给出了参数压缩、可识别性、稳定性、局部性、组合结构与过平滑行为的保证；受控实验验证了各机制。在PEMS-BAY和METR-LA上，所有报告的区域性传感器失效设置下取得最低平均MAE，在30%传感器缺失时相较最强保留基线提升2.4%–8.8%。

Conclusion: GIOF提供了一种统一的几何感知算子设计范式，将固定几何与上下文自适应选择结合，兼具理论可证性质与实证性能优势，适用于结构化深度表示学习中的传播算子构造。

Abstract: The geometry of latent representations governs which components should interact and how information should propagate, making geometry-aware operator design a fundamental ingredient of structured deep representation learning. However, existing neural architectures typically rely on generic operator templates or geometry-specific constructions, creating a need for a unified framework that can derive admissible operators directly from fixed structural information while remaining adaptive to changing contexts. We introduce \emph{Geometry-Induced Operator Families} (GIOF), a general framework that converts fixed geometry into a structured family of propagation operators and dynamically selects an appropriate member of this family according to the current context. GIOF first transforms geometry-derived interaction channels into reusable generator bases, then combines them through a context-dependent selector and adaptive propagation scale, and finally realizes the selected operator through stable continuous-time propagation and a bottleneck residual layer. We establish theoretical guarantees covering parameter compression, identifiability, stability, locality, compositional structure, and oversmoothing behavior, while controlled experiments validate these mechanisms and experiments on PEMS-BAY and METR-LA achieve the lowest mean MAE across all reported regional-outage settings, improving over the strongest retained baseline by 2.4\%--8.8\% at 30\% missing sensors.

</details>


### [1110] [CARVE: Breaking Data Barriers in Chip Placement by Harnessing Reusable Expertise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33106)
*Jiefu Zhang,Haixiang Sun,Yang Xu,Vaneet Aggarwal,Zishen Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CARVE 框架，将累积经验表示为冻结基础策略、不可变专家和经本地验证的任务凭证，实现宏放置策略的可靠复用与持续适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练宏放置策略可减少重复优化，但部署时若原始训练数据不可用，策略会面对陌生设计。反复微调单一服务模型会覆盖早期改进，而单纯保存检查点也无法确定其可靠复用位置，因此需要一种能安全累积并复用已验证经验的机制。

Method: CARVE 采用“复用优先”流程：将累积经验表示为冻结基础策略、不可变专家及通过本地验证获得的任务专属凭证；对新任务先检查现有专家，仅当无专家合格时才从冻结基础策略训练新专家。在固定任务分布与可控制累积误差的验证规则下，建立重复复用的期望性能保证；对有界损失，推导可靠复用所需本地样本数的匹配最坏情况界。

Result: 在宏放置任务中，复用优先的后续流程将记录的训练时间由 9.66 小时降至 4.01 小时，减少 58.5%，而平均 HPWL 增益仅从 8.41% 变为 7.86%。在模拟接收部署中，导入的专家在七个新 IBM 电路中的六个上被复用且接收端无需训练，取得 5.76% 的平均 HPWL 增益。导航研究为修复保持与重复适应提供了补充证据。

Conclusion: CARVE 通过冻结基础策略、不可变专家与本地验证凭证，在保证预期性能的前提下实现已验证经验的高效复用，显著降低训练时间且性能损失很小，并支持接收端零训练部署。

Abstract: Pretrained macro-placement policies can reduce repeated optimization across circuits, but deployment often exposes them to unfamiliar designs when the original training data are unavailable. Repeatedly fine-tuning a single serving model can overwrite earlier improvements, while simply saving checkpoints does not determine where they can be reliably reused. We introduce Continual Adaptation through the Reuse of Validated Expertise (CARVE), a framework that represents accumulated expertise as a frozen base policy, immutable specialists, and task-specific credentials obtained through local validation. For a new task, CARVE first checks existing specialists and trains a new specialist from the frozen base only when none qualifies. Under fixed task distributions and validation rules that control cumulative error, we establish expected-performance guarantees for repeated reuse. For bounded losses, we also derive matching worst-case bounds on the local samples needed for reliable reuse. In macro placement, a reuse-first follow-up reduces recorded training time by 58.5% (9.66 to 4.01 hours), while mean HPWL gain changes only from 8.41% to 7.86%. In a simulated receiving deployment, imported specialists are reused on six of seven new IBM circuits with no receiver-side training, achieving a 5.76% mean HPWL gain. Navigation studies provide complementary evidence on repair retention and repeated adaptation.

</details>


### [1111] [Mycelium: A Generalizable Cross-Grid Multi-Task Model for Electrical Distribution Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33120)
*Zhengyang Wei,Shourya Bose,Helgi Hilmarsson,Elena Carnio,Dhruv Suri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出统一电网建模框架Mycelium，用异构图表示配电网并基于物理仿真数据训练，可跨任务、跨未见网络泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配电网运行需要从稀疏、含噪、不完整的时序测量中推理，且数据跨越异构网络；现有方法难以在统一模型中兼顾多任务推断、物理规律约束与对未见网络的泛化能力。

Method: 1) 定义统一电网本体，将变规模配电网表示为异构图，保留原始拓扑、资产类型与电气关系；2) 构建物理驱动数据仿真流水线，结合参考网络与程序化生成网络，涵盖网络重构、故障场景与可配置感知条件；3) 提出Mycelium——异构图表征Transformer，具备结构感知通信边、编码网络位置与标称相位的电气参考特征，以及任务特定时序读出层以生成各任务输出；在参考与合成电网上训练，并在完全排除于训练/验证的基准网络上评估泛化。

Result: 在多数报告的基准指标上，Mycelium优于任务特定的神经网络基线；消融实验与泛化研究表明其能够学习底层物理表征，从而提升跨任务性能。

Conclusion: Mycelium通过异构图统一本体、物理仿真数据与结构感知架构，实现了面向配电网多任务推断的统一模型，并缓解了统一电网模型中的跨任务与跨网络泛化难题。

Abstract: Electrical distribution grid operations require inference across heterogeneous networks from sparse, noisy, and incomplete time series measurements. In this work, we identify challenges and explore solutions towards a unified model that can perform diverse tasks grounded in the physics of the electric grid and generalize to unseen distribution networks. We define a unified grid ontology that represents variable sized distribution networks as heterogeneous graphs while preserving native topology, asset types, and electrical relationships across networks. We develop a physics based data simulation pipeline that combines reference and procedurally generated distribution networks with network reconfigurations, fault scenarios, and configurable sensing conditions. We present Mycelium, a heterogeneous graph transformer with structure aware communication edges and electrical reference features that encode network position and nominal phase orientation, together with task specific temporal readouts which generate per task outputs. We train Mycelium on reference as well as synthetic grids, and study its generalization on benchmark networks completely excluded from training and validation. Mycelium is observed to outperform task specific neural baselines on most reported benchmark metrics. Architectural ablations and the aforementioned studies reveal Mycelium's capability to learn representations of the underlying physics which serves to enhance cross-task performance, thereby addressing a significant challenge in unified grid models.

</details>


### [1112] [ILP-BO: Integer Linear Programming-Based Black-Box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33131)
*Hyakka Nakada,Shu Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ILP-BO，将离散域上基于核的代理优化精确转化为整数线性规划问题，实现带最优性证书的候选选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准黑盒优化（如贝叶斯优化）中，基于代理模型的采集准则优化通常依赖非线性优化或启发式搜索，难以保证候选选择的全局最优性。

Method: 以二元one-hot辅助变量在有限离散距离层级上精确表示非线性核函数，将非线性代理目标转化为线性目标加线性约束与二元变量；引入汉明距离间隔以排除已观测点邻域，保持线性结构以兼顾探索；对多种标准核推导该形式，并基于二值搜索空间的测度给出汉明距离阈值的解析上界。

Result: 转化后的候选选择问题可由整数规划求解器求解并提供最优性证书；在合成与离散优化基准上，ILP-BO的优化性能与实用贝叶斯优化方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: ILP-BO为离散域黑盒优化提供了透明、可证明最优性的准贝叶斯优化框架，具有作为高透明度黑盒优化方法的潜力。

Abstract: Black-box Optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for optimizing expensive objective functions or unknown functions with a limited number of evaluations. A central step of standard BO such as Bayesian optimization is the optimization of a surrogate-based acquisition criterion, which is commonly performed using nonlinear optimization or heuristic search. Therefore, conventional black-box optimization generally does not guarantee global optimality in candidate selection. In this study, we propose Integer Linear Programming-based Black-box Optimization (ILP-BO), a quasi-Bayesian optimization framework that transforms kernel-based surrogate optimization over discrete domains into an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) problem. The key idea is to represent nonlinear kernel functions exactly on finite discrete distance levels by introducing binary one-hot auxiliary variables. This transformation converts the nonlinear surrogate into a linear objective with linear constraints and binary variables. To incorporate exploration while preserving the linear structure, we further introduce a Hamming-distance margin that excludes neighborhoods around previously observed points. We derive the proposed formulation for several standard kernels and obtain an analytical upper bound on the Hamming-distance threshold based on the measure in the binary search space. The resulting candidate-selection problem can be solved by integer programming solvers with certificates of optimality. Thus, our methodology has the potential to serve as a highly transparent black-box optimization framework. Experiments on synthetic and discrete optimization benchmarks show that ILP-BO achieves competitive optimization performance compared with practical Bayesian optimization methods.

</details>


### [1113] [Leaky Students: Membership Inference against On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33136)
*Zhexi Lu,Mingzhi Zhu,Stacy Patterson,Lei Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次系统研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的成员推断问题，提出 Leaky 方法，通过采样新轨迹并对比 token 对数概率与多个参考模型的最大值来检测成员信号，在十五个目标上平均 AUROC 达 0.875，显著优于最强基线的 0.614。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD 中学生需在自生成轨迹上匹配教师的下一 token 分布，但教师端获得的特权信息可能包含敏感数据。学生是否会在蒸馏过程中泄漏这些记录的信息尚不清楚，需要系统研究该场景下的成员推断风险。

Method: 提出 Leaky 方法：从目标模型采样新轨迹，将其 token 对数概率与多个"匹配参考模型"（未使用候选记录训练）的最大值进行比较；对得到的差值应用 Leaky ReLU，保留正差值、对负差值降权，以近似修正非成员中偶然出现的正差值。

Result: 在涵盖数学、医学问答与代码生成的十五个目标上，Leaky 优于所有评估基线，平均 AUROC 0.875；主评测中每个目标上最强基线平均为 0.614。在相同采样轨迹上，最强基线平均 AUROC 为 0.826。

Conclusion: 通过 OPD 训练的学生模型会暴露用于教师监督的记录的成员信息，即使固定参考答案损失几乎无法提供成员证据，该隐私风险依然存在。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated trajectories. However, privileged information supplied to the teacher for OPD training may contain sensitive data. Whether the student leaks private information about the records supplied to the teacher during distillation remains poorly understood. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first systematic study of membership inference in this setting. We find that fresh student trajectories expose sparse membership signals that fixed reference-answer losses often miss. These signals are mixed with probability changes caused by training on other records. We introduce Leaky, which samples fresh trajectories from the target model and compares its token log-probabilities with the maximum across matched reference models trained without the candidate records. It applies Leaky ReLU to the resulting gaps, preserving positive gaps and downweighting negative gaps as an approximate correction for incidental positive gaps in non-members. Across fifteen targets spanning mathematics, medical question answering, and code generation, Leaky outperforms all evaluated baselines and achieves mean AUROC 0.875, compared with 0.614 for the strongest baseline on each target in the main evaluation. On the same sampled trajectories, the strongest baseline achieves mean AUROC 0.826. These results show that students trained through OPD can expose the membership of records used for teacher supervision, even when fixed reference-answer losses provide little evidence of membership.

</details>


### [1114] [CFLoRA: Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs with Complementary Factors for Error-free Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33147)
*Yanan Ma,Qiyuan Chen,Zihan Fang,Xianhao Chen,Yuguang Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CFLoRA联邦LoRA方案，通过每轮将潜在LoRA通道划分为互补子集，消除双线性项，实现无聚合误差的精确联邦平均，同时支持异构秩预算，收敛率达O(1/√T)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦LoRA的分解更新在联邦平均中存在结构性错配：分别平均两个LoRA因子不等于其乘积的平均。现有精确方法依赖冻结整个因子或跨轮交替更新因子，无法在不产生聚合误差、不扩大通信秩的情况下同时更新两个因子。因此需要从根本上解决这一矛盾。

Method: CFLoRA在每个通信轮将潜在LoRA通道划分为两个互补集合，保证列与行在不同因子间互补，从而在矩阵乘法中消除双线性项，使联邦聚合精确。框架还支持客户端异构秩预算。并从理论上分析其收敛性。

Result: 收敛分析证明，在同构秩情形下CFLoRA对原始LoRA目标达到O(1/√T)收敛率。在GLUE基准上用RoBERTa、在常识推理任务上用LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct的大量实验表明，CFLoRA在性能和训练效率上均优于现有最先进联邦LoRA基线。

Conclusion: CFLoRA通过通道互补划分消除了联邦LoRA聚合中的双线性误差，实现了因子同时更新与精确聚合，并兼容异构秩，在理论与实验上均验证了其有效性与优越性。

Abstract: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables collaborative fine-tuning of large language models without centralizing private client data. Its factorized update, however, creates a structural mismatch in federated averaging: averaging the two LoRA factors separately does not equal averaging their products. Existing exact methods resolve this issue mainly by freezing an entire factor or alternating factors across rounds, but none can update factors simultaneously without aggregation errors or expanding communication ranks. To address this fundamental problem, we present \texttt{CFLoRA}, a federated LoRA scheme that partitions latent LoRA channels into two complementary sets in every communication round. By ensuring that columns and rows are complementary across factors, we eliminate bilinear terms in matrix multiplications, making federated aggregation exact. Crucially, our framework also supports clients with heterogeneous rank budgets. Convergence analysis validates \texttt{CFLoRA} achieves $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence rate of the \textit{original} LoRA objective in homogeneous-rank cases. Extensive experiments with RoBERTa on the GLUE benchmark and with LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct on commonsense reasoning tasks demonstrate that \texttt{CFLoRA} achieves superior performance and training efficiency compared to state-of-the-art federated LoRA baselines.

</details>


### [1115] [Convergence of Practical Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33152)
*Haonan Wang,Yu Wu,Minghui Liwang,Xinlei Yi,Yiguang Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为实用Muon优化器提供优化视角的解释，并首次在随机非凸设定下建立收敛保证，速率为O(T^{-1/4})，比AdamW最优速率在维度依赖上改进√d倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon作为AdamW在大规模神经网络训练中的潜在替代方案受到关注，但现有理论分析常简化或忽略两个关键组件：(i) 采用经验调优多项式系数(3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315)的实用Newton-Schulz迭代；(ii) 解耦权重衰减正则化。理论理解不完整。

Method: 将实用Muon解释为对原始损失进行右预条件优化，并引入随接近平稳点而消失的动态加权ℓ2正则项，使优化目标仍为原始目标；联合考虑Newton-Schulz迭代与解耦权重衰减两个组件进行分析。

Result: 首次给出实用Muon在随机非凸设定下的收敛保证，以期望Frobenius范数梯度衡量达到O(T^{-1/4})的收敛速率，相比已知最优AdamW收敛速率在维度依赖上改进√d倍（T为迭代步数，d为参数维度）；实验支持理论结果。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了实用Muon理论分析的空白，证明其在收敛速率维度依赖上优于AdamW，为Muon的实际应用提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Muon is emerging as a promising alternative to AdamW for large-scale neural network training, yet theoretical understanding of its practical implementation remains incomplete, as existing analyses often simplify or omit two key components: (i) practical Newton--Schulz iterations with empirically tuned polynomial coefficients $(3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315)$; and (ii) decoupled weight decay for regularization. In this paper, we provide an optimization interpretation and establish convergence for practical Muon, jointly accounting for both components. Specifically, we interpret practical Muon as right-preconditioned optimization of the original loss with a dynamic weighted $\ell_2$ regularizer that vanishes as stationarity is approached, so that the optimization target remains the original objective. We then establish, to our best knowledge, the first convergence guarantee for practical Muon in the stochastic nonconvex setting, with an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate in terms of the expected Frobenius norm of the gradient, improving the dimension dependence of the best known AdamW's convergence rate by a factor of $\sqrt{d}$, where $T$ is the iteration horizon and $d$ is the parameter dimension. Experiments further support the theoretical convergence results.

</details>


### [1116] [Downstream-Aware Context Selection for Online In-Context Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33166)
*Ruihan A. Li,Shangtong Zhang,Rohan Chandra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出有界历史上下文管理框架，通过预测删除历史交互的下游影响来指导历史选择并确定决策相关上下文预算，在SUMU驾驶和ScienceWorld中大幅降低token消耗且保持性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文强化学习(ICRL)使大模型智能体无需更新参数即可利用交互历史适应新环境，但反复以不断增长的历史为条件会导致显著的token开销。

Method: 以完整滚动历史为参考，预测器评估删除效应并定义删除排序，应用共享选择准则在每个决策点确定应保留多少历史，从而决定决策相关的上下文预算。

Result: 在闭环SUMO驾驶的分布内、未见域和未见路径三种设定下，相较全上下文基线token用量分别减少25.7%、25.8%、23.2%，闭环驾驶性能相当；在ScienceWorld持续ICRL协议下，较全上下文减少52.1%，较Recent和Similarity基线分别少用30.2%和37.8%的token，同时保持性能。

Conclusion: 有界历史上下文管理可在不牺牲ICRL性能的前提下显著降低token成本，具备跨任务与跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables large language model agents to adapt to new environments using their interaction history without updating model parameters. However, repeatedly conditioning on growing histories can lead to substantial token cost. We propose a bounded-history context-management framework that predicts the task-dependent downstream effect of removing historical interactions to guide history selection and determine a decision-dependent context budget. Formally, our framework uses the full rolling history as a reference. The predictor evaluates removal effects, defines a deletion ordering, and applies a shared selection criterion to determine how much history to retain at each decision. We evaluate the method in closed-loop SUMO driving under held-out in-distribution, unseen-domain, and unseen-route settings, and in ScienceWorld under a continual ICRL protocol. Relative to a baseline using the full context, our method reduces total token usage by 25.7%, 25.8%, and 23.2% across the three driving settings while maintaining comparable closed-loop driving performance. In ScienceWorld, it reduces total token usage by 52.1% compared to full context and uses 30.2% and 37.8% fewer tokens than the Recent and Similarity baselines, respectively, while maintaining performance.

</details>


### [1117] [Apparent Compression, Real Stability: The Intrinsic Dimension of Learning a Quantum Wavefunction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33193)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Chenfeng Cao,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者测量了变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）训练的内在维度，发现小维度可能具有误导性，但其带来的训练稳定性是真实的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内在维度刻画了训练达到目标精度所需的最少随机方向数，小维度值曾推动LoRA等参数高效方法。VMC是检验该问题的严苛且有揭示性的场景：网络自生成训练样本、梯度噪声大，且精确解已知、每次运行均可评分。

Method: 仅训练一个小潜在向量，由冻结的随机映射转换为网络权重，不改变标准自然梯度优化器；在具有困难符号模式的磁体上，对比符号不可表示与符号可学习的情形，并跨量子相变测量维度变化。

Result: 在符号无法表示的网络上，最佳能量仅出现在28642个方向中的8个，但这只是因为此类网络无法降得更低；一旦符号可学习，符号与幅度都不廉价。维度在量子相变处上升，能以远低于拟合标度律的计算量追踪态难度，但即使基态近乎平凡也不会低于随机子空间自身设定的下限。子空间训练在实验中从未发散，而相同设置的全参数训练会发散，匹配求解器的对照将差异归因于维度降低。

Conclusion: VMC的内在维度并非廉价性的可靠指标，小值可能误导；但受限子空间训练带来的稳定性真实存在，且维度可作为态难度的低计算量探针，同时存在由随机子空间决定的下限。

Abstract: How many directions in weight space does training need? The intrinsic dimension answers this with the smallest number of random directions in which training still reaches a target accuracy, and small values have motivated parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA. We measure it for variational Monte Carlo (VMC), which trains a neural network to represent the ground state of a quantum many-body system. VMC is a demanding test, because the network generates its own training samples and every gradient is noisy, and a revealing one, because the exact answer is known and every run can be scored. We train only a small latent vector that a frozen random map turns into the network's weights, with no change to the standard natural-gradient optimizer. We find that a small dimension can be misleading, while the stability it brings is real. On a magnet with a hard sign pattern, a network that cannot represent signs reaches its best energy in 8 of 28,642 directions, but only because no such network can go lower; once signs are learnable, neither the signs nor the magnitudes are cheap. The dimension rises across a quantum phase transition, so it tracks how difficult a state is at far less compute than fitting a scaling law, yet it never falls below a floor set by the random subspace itself, even where the ground state is nearly trivial. Training in the subspace, in contrast, never diverged in our experiments, whereas full-parameter training with the same settings did, and a control with matched solvers attributes the difference to the reduced dimension.

</details>


### [1118] [Orthogonal Witness Control for Muon Optimization via Sigmoid Spectral Reshaping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33194)
*Dat Phi Van,Ngo Vu Minh,Tuc Nguyen,Thin Nguyen,Ngoc-Thanh Dinh,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Soren是一种矩阵值优化器，通过有界单调sigmoid变换压缩梯度奇异谱而非完全展平，保留奇异子空间，并提供收敛性保证与无需SVD的Soft Newton-Schulz多项式实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有矩阵值优化器（如Muon）利用Newton-Schulz正交化处理更新的谱结构，但近乎展平奇异谱，丢弃了不同梯度模态间的相对幅值信息，损失了谱相对结构。

Method: 提出Soren优化器：保留梯度的奇异子空间，对奇异值施加有界单调sigmoid变换，平滑压缩主导模态而不完全展平。将其解释为正定预条件梯度方法，在相对光滑性与度量Polyak-Łojasiewicz几何下建立收敛保证；并开发有限深度Soft Newton-Schulz（SNS）多项式实现该sigmoid谱映射，刻画其谱近似对收敛几何的影响。

Result: 在LLM预训练、监督微调及直接偏好优化实验中，Soren相较现有优化器展现出有效性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Soren在保留奇异子空间的同时以sigmoid变换压缩奇异值，兼具理论收敛性与实用高效实现，实验验证其对主流优化器的有效性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Matrix-valued optimizers such as Muon exploit the spectral structure of neural network updates through Newton--Schulz orthogonalization, but their near-flattening of the singular spectrum discards relative magnitude information across gradient modes. We introduce \emph{Soren} (\textbf{S}pectral \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{Re}shapi\textbf{n}g), a matrix-valued optimizer that preserves the singular subspaces of the gradient while applying a bounded, monotone sigmoid transformation to its singular values. This smoothly compresses dominant modes without fully flattening the spectrum. We interpret Soren as a positive-definite preconditioned gradient method and establish convergence guarantees under relative smoothness and metric Polyak--Łojasiewicz geometry. To avoid explicit singular value decomposition, we further develop a finite-depth Soft Newton--Schulz (SNS) polynomial realization of the sigmoid spectral map and characterize how its spectral approximation affects the induced convergence geometry. Experiments across LLM pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and direct preference optimization demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of Soren against established optimizers.

</details>


### [1119] [RMB: Reward Model Boosting Mitigates Reward Hacking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33221)
*Jiabin Fan,Dezhi Ye,Yongchang Hao,Lili Mou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Reward Model Boosting (RMB)，通过多样性正则化训练多个奖励模型并用boosting聚合，缓解RLHF中的reward hacking问题，提升奖励准确性与RLHF性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF用于将LLM与人类偏好对齐，但代理奖励模型不完美，导致reward hacking：策略优化提升代理奖励，却损害相对于真实人类偏好的表现。需要增强奖励信号的鲁棒性与可靠性。

Method: RMB分两步：1）用多样性促进正则化训练一组奖励模型，使各模型学习奖励景观中互补的方面；2）按boosting原理学习一个轻量级聚合器，将多样奖励模型的输出聚合为更准确、更鲁棒的奖励信号。

Result: 大量实验表明，RMB在分布内与分布外数据集上均显著提升奖励准确率，明显缓解reward hacking，并最终提升RLHF性能。

Conclusion: RMB通过多样奖励模型与boosting聚合有效提高奖励信号质量，是对抗reward hacking、改善RLHF的有效方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a powerful technique for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. However, it often suffers from the reward hacking issue, where policy optimization improves the proxy reward model while actually degrading performance with respect to the true human preference, due to the imperfection of the proxy. To address this, we propose Reward Model Boosting (RMB), a novel approach that enhances the robustness and reliability of the reward signal for RLHF. RMB first trains a set of reward models with a diversity-promoting regularizer. This encourages each model to learn complementary aspects of the reward landscape. Then, RMB learns a lightweight aggregator in the principle of boosting to aggregate the outputs of the diverse reward models into a more accurate and robust reward signal. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that RMB significantly improves reward accuracy on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets, substantially mitigating the reward hacking issue and ultimately improving RLHF performance.

</details>


### [1120] [The Price of Locality: Why Forward-Forward Underperforms Backpropagation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33240)
*Zhaoxian Wu,Haichuan Liu,Tianyi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文诊断了前向-前向算法（FFA）相比反向传播（BP）性能随深度恶化差距的两个结构性失效模式：一是同步逐层局部更新导致的优化误差下限，二是局部更新机制导致的层级表示几何坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FFA以逐层局部对比目标替代BP，省去了反向传播和中间激活存储，但与BP存在持续性能差距，且随网络深度加深而恶化。作者旨在从优化与表示两个角度揭示这一差距的结构性根源。

Method: 理论分析。优化方面，证明FFA损失在每一层满足Polyak–Lojasiewicz不等式，但同步的层间更新引发层级表示分布漂移，使每层在移动的输入分布上优化并产生误差下限。表示方面，分析层级表示的成对相似性核随深度增加呈指数收缩至秩一，导致逐层误差信号多样性坍缩。

Result: 表示坍缩对FFA的有效学习容量（衡量跨层梯度信息多样性）形成与深度无关的上界；而BP的链式法则信号保持逐层多样性，其容量随深度增长。

Conclusion: FFA的性能差距源于并发局部更新带来的优化误差下限与表示几何坍缩共同导致的容量受限，这为理解并改进前向-前向算法提供了理论依据。

Abstract: The Forward-Forward Algorithm (FFA) replaces backpropagation (BP) with layer-wise local contrastive objectives, eliminating the backward pass and the need to retain intermediate activations, yet suffers a persistent performance gap with BP that worsens with depth. This paper diagnoses two structural failure modes: an optimization floor arising from concurrent local updates; and a geometric collapse of layer representations driven by the local update mechanism. On the optimization side, we prove that the FFA loss satisfies the Polyak--Lojasiewicz inequality at each layer; however, simultaneous layer updates induce inter-layer representation-distribution drift, so each layer optimizes against a moving input distribution and incurs an error floor. On the representational side, the pairwise similarity kernel of layer representations contracts exponentially toward rank one as depth increases, collapsing the diversity of per-layer error signals. This collapse bounds FFA's effective learning capacity, which measures the diversity of gradient information across layers, independently of depth, whereas BP's chain-rule signal preserves per-layer diversity, yielding a capacity that scales with depth.

</details>


### [1121] [Feedback-Robust AI for Patient Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33248)
*Mohammed Sameer Syed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ClosedLoopBench，用29条由物理、药理或临床实践固定符号的关系和负对照动作流评测患者知识图谱；发现相关性与Granger类估计器易把临床医生的治疗策略误判为生理因果，并给出反馈稳健的图谱构建方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 床旁监测得到的患者知识图谱需要为其关系赋予类型，并说明数据是否支持其符号。在麻醉与重症监护中， clinicians 依据生理状态滴定药物与通气，因此时间关系混杂了患者反应与临床医生策略，导致基于相关性的图谱可能学到的只是治疗政策而非生理机制。

Method: 构建ClosedLoopBench基准：在3,442例VitalDB手术病例（12,653小时）上设定29条符号已知的关系（符号由物理学、药理学或临床实践固定），并引入负对照动作流——将某患者的动作替换为另一患者的动作。评估12种估计器，其中6种在未校准与校准后仍会给出显著但符号错误的关系估计。提出反馈稳健的患者图谱方法：结合概念节点与证据指针、以负对照准入的带类型关系，以及搏动级耦合。同时比较患者特异性与人群水平的慢反应估计。

Result: 在负对照流下，反馈稳健图谱每张图仅含0.06–0.10个错误的concept-level关系实例，而相关性构建为10–12个。未校准下6/12估计器在19–29个不同关系估计中平均有11–18个被判显著；校准后交叉相关与Granger检验仍把呼吸机频率→呼气末CO2赋予临床医生策略的符号。11个慢速药物与通气反应的患者特异性估计在预测后续数据上不优于人群估计；而脉搏到达时间-收缩压斜率在2,884例中94.3%为负，且具患者特异性（早-晚相关0.67 [0.63, 0.70]）。

Conclusion: 床旁患者知识图谱需要显式关系类型与符号验证，并应以负对照抗反馈偏倚；相关性/Granger方法会把临床医生的闭环策略误当作生理因果。反馈稳健图谱能大幅降低虚假关系，且应区分患者特异性与人群共享的生理关系（如脉搏到达时间-收缩压斜率具患者特异性，而多数慢反应不具特异性）。

Abstract: Patient knowledge graphs from bedside monitoring should type their relations and state whether the data support their signs. In anesthesia and intensive care, clinicians titrate drugs and ventilation in response to the physiology, so temporal relations mix the patient's response with the clinician's policy. We introduce ClosedLoopBench: 29 relations with signs fixed by physics, pharmacology or clinical practice, on 3,442 VitalDB surgical cases (12,653 h) with negative-control action streams. When each patient's actions are replaced by another patient's, six of 12 estimators declare on average 11-18 of their 19-29 distinct relation estimates significant without calibration, and after calibration cross-correlation and Granger tests still assign ventilator rate -> end-tidal CO2 the sign of the clinician's policy. We propose feedback-robust patient graphs that combine concept nodes with evidence pointers, typed relations admitted against negative controls, and beat-level couplings. On VitalDB under null streams, our graphs contain 0.06-0.10 false concept-level relation instances per graph, versus 10-12 for correlational construction. Patient-specific estimates of 11 slow drug and ventilator responses predict later data no better than population estimates, whereas the pulse-arrival-time-systolic-pressure slope is negative in 94.3% of 2,884 cases and patient-specific (early-late correlation 0.67 [0.63, 0.70]).

</details>


### [1122] [Two Heads Are Better Than One: Aggregating Weaker LLMs for Better Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33257)
*Cheng Peng,Ruixi Luo,Zhi Chen,Wei Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究"弱到强预测聚合"问题：能否用较弱的LLM预测者聚合出超过最强单一预测者的效果。基于ForecastBench，对70个LLM、16个比较组、1121个弱模型对进行实验，发现学习式线性池化在16组中11组可匹配或超越最强单体，全部16组差距在5%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用于预测现实事件，但获取最强单体预测者可能成本高昂或受其他条件限制。因此作者探究是否可以通过聚合较弱的LLM预测者来超越更强的单体预测者，即"弱到强预测聚合"问题。

Method: 使用ForecastBench（Karger等，2025）评估70个LLM预测者，构成16个比较组，每组共享超过1000个子问题，得到1121个弱模型对。在每个组内用测试Brier分数确定最强单体，评估仅由较弱预测者组成的聚合体，聚合权重在独立训练数据上学习。

Result: 发现弱到强提升的有力证据。学习式线性池化在16组中的11组找到匹配或超越最强单体的弱模型对，并在全部16组中Brier分数差距在5%以内。这些提升不依赖于包含接近最优的成员，且通常伴随良好的校准。额外分析显示增加更多模型并不能持续提升性能，在实际约束下仍可获得有竞争力的弱模型聚合。

Conclusion: 聚合较弱的LLM预测者可以超越最强单体预测者，弱到强预测聚合是可行且稳健的，为在无法获取最强单体时提供了有效的替代方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events, but access to the strongest individual forecaster may be costly or otherwise constrained. We study weak-to-strong forecast aggregation: can individually weaker LLM forecasters be aggregated to outperform a stronger forecaster? Using ForecastBench (Karger et al., 2025), we evaluate 70 LLM forecasters across 16 comparison groups, each with more than 1,000 shared subquestions, yielding 1,121 weaker-model pairs. Within each group, we identify the strongest individual by test Brier score and evaluate aggregates composed exclusively of weaker forecasters, with aggregation weights learned on separate training data. We find substantial evidence of weak-to-strong improvement. Learned linear pooling identifies a weaker pair that matches or outperforms the strongest individual in 11 of 16 groups and comes within 5% of its Brier score in all 16 groups. We also find that these improvements do not rely on having a near-best constituent and are generally accompanied by good calibration. Additional analyses show that adding more models does not consistently improve performance, and competitive weaker-model aggregates also remain available under practical constraints.

</details>


### [1123] [GTRL: Grounding Divide-and-Conquer Value Learning with Temporal Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33259)
*Abdul Monaf Chowdhury,MD Sameer Iqbal Chowdhury,Shifat E Arman,Md Mehedi Hasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Grounded Transitive RL (GTRL)，一种离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）价值学习算法。它在分治式组合更新中引入单步 TD 目标，使所有状态-目标对都能获得更新值，并通过重加权纠正后见之明重标注带来的偏差。在 19 个 OGBench 任务上取得最高平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线 GCRL 中，分治策略通过子目标拼接两段较短轨迹以扩展到长视界。但在随机动力学下存在两个问题：(1) 该规则的基础情形会偏向数据中最"幸运"的轨迹，对价值估计产生偏差；(2) 子目标必须位于同一条轨迹上，若某状态-目标对没有轨迹连接，则完全得不到价值更新。这两点限制了分治方法在随机环境与稀疏连通场景下的有效性。

Method: GTRL 在分治式组合更新中"接地"一个单步 TD 目标：单步内 TD 是正确的，因为其目标对所有后继状态取平均，且无需子目标。GTRL 将该 TD 目标加到组合项上而非替换它，从而保证每个状态-目标对都能获得更新，同时组合项仍承载长视界信息。此外，针对后见之明重标注（hindsight relabeling）引入的偏差，GTRL 依据目标从其他后继状态的可达性对每个目标进行重加权校正。

Result: 在涵盖随机、确定性与拼接（stitching）环境的 19 个 OGBench 任务上进行评估，GTRL 取得最高的平均成功率。代码将随后发布。

Conclusion: 通过在分治组合中增补单步 TD 目标并对后见重标注偏差进行重加权纠正，GTRL 同时解决了随机动力学下的乐观偏差与状态-目标对无法获得更新的问题，在多样化 OGBench 基准上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: In offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), divide-and-conquer scales to long horizons by joining two shorter segments at a subgoal. However, under stochastic dynamics, the base case of this rule values the luckiest trajectories through the data. The subgoal must also lie on a shared trajectory, so a state-goal pair that no trajectory connects gets no value update at all. To address both, we present Grounded Transitive RL (GTRL), an offline GCRL value learning algorithm that grounds the divide-and-conquer update with a one-step TD target. Over a single step, TD is correct, as its target averages over the successors and needs no subgoal. GTRL adds this target to the composition rather than replacing it, so every pair receives an update, and the composition still carries the long horizon. GTRL also corrects the bias from hindsight relabeling by reweighting each goal against how reachable it was from other successors. We evaluate our algorithm on nineteen OGBench tasks spanning stochastic, deterministic, and stitching environments, where it achieves the highest average success rate. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [1124] [Towards Identifiable Representations under Misspecified Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33273)
*Yuke Li,Yujia Zheng,Ziyi Chen,Kun Zhang,Heng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究潜在变量相关噪声下的可辨识性，突破观测在给定潜变量下条件独立的传统假设，引入更一般的“误设定结构”，并给出精确与近似的可辨识性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可辨识性结果依赖于给定潜变量时观测之间的条件独立性。当噪声依赖于潜变量、条件分解不成立时，这些结果失效，因此需要一个更一般的误设定框架来刻画并恢复潜变量。

Method: 将结构误设定建模为受扰动的因子分析问题：在谱分离与受控扰动下建立子空间可辨识性，再在结构稀疏性下获得逐分量可辨识性；当精确条件不满足时推导近似子空间可辨识定理，并据此设计无监督变分估计器恢复潜变量。

Result: 得到了精确的子空间可辨识性和逐分量可辨识性保证，以及近似子空间可辨识性定理；实验验证了所提框架在恢复潜变量方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 在噪声依赖潜变量、条件独立性不成立的一般误设定结构下，仍可通过谱分离、受控扰动与结构稀疏性获得可辨识性，并借助无监督变分估计器有效恢复潜变量。

Abstract: The presence of noise that depends on the latent variables poses a fundamental challenge to identifiability. Existing results rely on conditional independence among the observations given the latent variables. We study a more general \emph{misspecified structure}, where this conditional factorization does not hold, and establish both precise and approximate identifiability guarantees. We characterize structural misspecification as a perturbed factor analysis problem. For precise identifiability, we establish subspace identifiability under spectral separation and controlled perturbation, followed by component-wise identifiability under structural sparsity. When the precise condition is not guaranteed, we derive an approximate subspace-identifiability theorem. Based on these results, we develop an unsupervised variational estimator for recovering latent variables. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [1125] [Direct Hidden-State Alignment: Mapping and Controlling Preference Expression in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33298)
*Fansheng Zhang,Shengran Guo,Zexiao Wang,Liang Yuan,Jiyuan Chen,Ruikun Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Residual Competition Maps（RCMs）刻画偏好行为在原模型残差计算中的因果效应结构，并据此提出Direct Hidden-State Alignment（DHSA）与CAST方法，在冻结基座模型的情况下用极少参数实现推理时可控的偏好对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练往往不必从零构造目标行为，基座模型已能产生该行为但不可靠。这使偏好对齐的一部分从"能力获取"转向"行为表达"控制。作者希望回答：指定偏好在原生模型计算中如何表示、是什么阻碍目标支持计算稳定主导生成、以及该结构能否直接指导控制。

Method: 提出Residual Competition Maps（RCMs），将行为偏好映射为原生残差计算的有符号因果效应；据此提出Direct Hidden-State Alignment（DHSA），把推理时隐状态而非基座权重作为直接适配空间，并通过RCM引导的Causal Activation State Transition（CAST）在少量偏好相关接口处做局部状态干预，同时冻结基座模型。

Result: RCMs跨偏好域揭示共存的"支持目标"与"竞争目标"效应、随输入变化的组件角色，以及单一原生组件干预即可逆转偏好结果的案例。DPO会显著重组这些效应，可削弱对抗效应但无法保证其被消除。CAST仅用256–16,384个控制器参数，在三个偏好域上达到与DPO相当的工作点，可补充DPO训练模型，并能在推理时启用或移除。

Conclusion: 偏好对齐可被理解为对原生计算中支持与竞争效应的调控问题；以隐状态为适配空间、配合RCM引导的局部干预，能以极小参数代价实现有效且可插拔的偏好控制，为偏好对齐提供新的因果分析与轻量控制范式。

Abstract: In many settings, post-training need not create the target behavior from scratch: the base model can already produce it, but not reliably. This shifts part of preference alignment from capability acquisition to behavioral expression. We ask how a specified preference is represented in native model computation, what prevents target-supporting computation from reliably dominating generation, and whether this structure can directly guide control. We introduce Residual Competition Maps (RCMs), which map a behavioral preference onto signed causal effects of native residual computation. Across preference domains, RCMs reveal coexisting target-supporting and target-competing effects, input-dependent component roles, and cases where a single native-component intervention reverses the preference outcome. DPO substantially reorganizes these effects and can weaken opposition without guaranteeing its removal. We then propose Direct Hidden-State Alignment (DHSA), which treats inference-time hidden states rather than base-model weights as the direct adaptation space. RCM-guided Causal Activation State Transition (CAST) implements DHSA through local state interventions at a small number of preference-relevant interfaces while freezing the base model. With only 256-16,384 controller parameters, CAST reaches DPO-competitive operating points across three preference domains, can complement DPO-trained models, and can be enabled or removed at inference time.

</details>


### [1126] [RAEGL: Risk-Aware Evidence-Gated Learning for Selective Contextual Routing under Temporal Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33340)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RAEGL风险感知证据门控学习框架，通过分离候选选择与门控校准，对偏置修正的随机显著性、实际增益和时间稳定性进行联合评估，实现选择性上下文预测，避免有害的上下文部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文专业化能提升预测精度，但在时间分布漂移下，基于某一历史区间选出的修正可能失效。因此需要一个可在部署前评估证据强度、有选择地激活上下文残差、并能审计的机制，以规避验证驱动的上下文选择风险。

Method: RAEGL默认保留经校验的全局预测器，仅当部署前证据支持时才激活上下文残差。框架将候选选择与门控校准分离，联合评估三项证据：随机化显著性、实际有意义的增益、时间稳定性；并扩展了稳定性与支持度感知的门控机制。

Result: 在重建的Our World in Data审计中，精确回退避免了两个验证选择修正导致的RMSE退化（0.0960与0.0239）。在封存的世界发展指标评估中，区域修正虽通过随机化检验，但因增益仅0.000092、按国家聚类的95%置信区间跨零、仅0.02%的自助抽样达到实用阈值而被拒绝启用。在受控面板中，稳定性与支持度感知扩展在强稳定上下文运行中激活率达97.2%，同时拒绝所有高漂移设置。

Conclusion: RAEGL是一种可审计、基于证据的上下文部署风险管理机制，可作为验证驱动上下文选择的保守替代方案，在防止有害上下文部署的同时显式呈现保守机会成本。

Abstract: Contextual specialization can improve forecasting accuracy, but a correction selected on one historical interval may become unreliable under temporal distribution shift. To address this issue, we propose RAEGL, a Risk-Aware Evidence-Gated Learning framework for selective contextual forecasting. RAEGL retains a validated global predictor by default and activates a contextual residual only when pre-deployment evidence supports its use. The framework separates candidate selection from gate calibration and jointly evaluates randomization significance, practically meaningful gain, and temporal stability. Experiments on real-world audits and controlled panels show how RAEGL can prevent harmful contextual deployment while making conservative opportunity costs explicit. In a reconstructed Our World in Data audit, exact fallback avoids RMSE degradations of 0.0960 and 0.0239 caused by two validation-selected corrections. In a sealed World Development Indicators evaluation, a region-based correction passes the randomization test but is withheld because its gain is only 0.000092, its country-clustered 95% confidence interval crosses zero, and only 0.02% of bootstrap replicates reach the practical threshold. In controlled panels, the stability- and support-aware extension activates in 97.2% of strong, stable-context runs while rejecting all high-drift settings. These results support RAEGL as an auditable, evidence-based mechanism for managing contextual deployment risk and as a conservative alternative to validation-driven contextual selection.

</details>


### [1127] [MultiEcho: An Experimental Science of Learned Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33347)
*Meng Zhu,Airui Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MultiEcho框架，通过对学习到的世界模型进行受控反事实干预，估计其"响应律"，并区分响应可预测性、干预可读性与物理准确性三个独立维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型可被视为具有自身响应律的实验系统，但现有研究常将"可预测响应"与"符合物理规律"混为一谈。作者希望建立一个实验基础，独立于物理定律、并相对于物理定律来研究学习到的世界定律。

Method: MultiEcho通过受控反事实干预估计世界模型的响应律并界定其适用范围，同时单独检验其物理对应性。方法采用三参考估计器预测完整干预响应并恢复干预参数；估计器选择仅使用发现集数据，冻结拟合在验证和确认情境上评估。实验设计涵盖九种模拟物理系统和七种冻结模型配置，包含幅度扫描、精确重置的材料实验等。

Result: 三参考估计器能预测完整干预响应并恢复干预参数。实验区分出响应可预测性、干预可读性与物理准确性：响应可局部描述但可能与同一目标坐标下的物理效应匹配不佳；事件窗口、可见性和相机干预揭示了条件适用性；配对生成器配置在更强引导的场景提示下可读性降低；幅度扫描显示小图像误差伴随大的相对效应误差；精确重置材料实验在匹配位置和速度下，将已登记的可见响应成功与固定读出失败分离；精确有限尺度恒等式解决了奇偶响应误差，一阶余项界指明了精化校准收敛的条件。

Conclusion: MultiEcho为在独立于物理定律、并与之相关联的框架下研究学习到的世界定律提供了实验基础。

Abstract: World models can be studied as experimental systems with response laws of their own. We introduce MultiEcho, a framework for estimating these laws through controlled counterfactual interventions, delimiting their applicability, and separately testing their physical correspondence. Across nine simulated physical systems and seven frozen model configurations, three-reference estimators predict complete intervention responses and recover intervention parameters. Estimator selection uses discovery data only; frozen fits are evaluated on validation and confirmation contexts. The experiments distinguish response predictability, intervention readability and physical accuracy. Responses can be locally describable yet poorly match physical effects in the same target coordinates. Event-window, visibility and camera interventions reveal conditional applicability, and paired generator configurations show reduced readability under a scene prompt with stronger guidance. Magnitude sweeps expose small image errors alongside large relative effect errors. An exact-reset material experiment separates registered visible-response success from fixed-readout failure on material-dependent futures at matched positions and velocities. Exact finite-scale identities resolve odd and even response errors; first-order remainder bounds specify when refined calibration converges. MultiEcho provides an experimental basis for studying learned-world laws independently of, and in relation to, physical laws.

</details>


### [1128] [How Much Imprecision is Enough Imprecision in my Classifier? A Practical Elicitation Procedure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33352)
*Victor F. Lopes de Souza,Sébastien Destercke,Abdelhak Imoussaten*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可操作的用户引导（elicitation）程序，用于度量用户在接收预测时对集合值预测（即不精确性）的接受倾向，并在表格与图像基准数据集上验证了迭代引导程序收敛到目标参数值的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集合值分类器（源于精确概率加代价函数、凸集加稳健推断机制，或保形方法）已成为提升预测稳健性与可信度的常规手段，但缺乏操作性工具来度量用户为换取更高准确率愿意放弃多少精确性，即用户对集合值预测的接受倾向。识别决策者面对不精确性时的最优行为对实际应用很重要。

Method: 提出实用且可操作的用户引导（elicitation）程序，用于度量用户对集合值预测的倾向；采用迭代式引导流程逐步逼近目标参数值，并在来自标准机器学习基准的表格数据集与图像数据集上进行验证。

Result: 迭代引导程序能够收敛到目标参数值；同时该程序向用户呈现的实例数量较少，体现出方法在真实应用中的实用性。

Conclusion: 所提引导程序可有效度量用户对集合值预测的接受倾向，且交互成本低，适用于在面临不精确性时识别决策者最优行为的现实场景。

Abstract: Set-valued classifiers, whether derived from precise probabilities and an adapted cost function, from convex sets with a robust inference mechanism, or from conformal methods, are routine options to obtain more robust, trustworthy predictions. However, there is a lack of operational tools to measure how robust or imprecise a given user is ready to be when receiving predictions, that is how much precision he/she is ready to let go in exchange of more accuracy. This is why we propose, in this paper, practical and operational elicitation procedures to measure the user proneness to set-valued predictions. The effectiveness of the iterative elicitation procedure in converging to the target parameter value is demonstrated on both tabular and image datasets drawn from standard machine learning benchmarks. The results show that the procedure also presents the user with a small number of instances, highlighting the practicality of the approach for real-world applications aimed at identifying the decision maker's optimal behavior when faced with imprecision.

</details>


### [1129] [The Selection Rule Decides the Winner: A Pre-Registered Audit of Open-Set Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33370)
*Farhan Shahriyar Hossain,Taufikur Rahman Fuad,Md Abrar Jahin,Md Rizwan Parvez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文质疑开放集图异常检测中三项通行实验约定（测试集最优epoch取分、直接沿用旧论文基线数值、将少数类重标为异常）对报告排名的影响，并通过重跑DEMO、NSReg与自建OUTPOST（8个图、10个种子、双重评分规则）进行检验。发现最优epoch规则会改变领先者，其收益在重标类图上为0.045–0.080 AUC-ROC而在真实欺诈图上仅0.002–0.014，伪标签仅在重标类图有效；预注册的40项预测中有12项被证伪，并给出报告清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放集图异常检测文献普遍存在三项实验约定：在测试集最优epoch读取分数、基线数值直接沿用旧论文、多数"异常"实为重新标注的少数类。作者希望量化这些约定究竟在多大程度上决定了已报告的排名，从而揭示当前评测结论的可靠性问题。

Method: 在同一协议下重跑DEMO与NSReg，并构建小型一阶检测器OUTPOST作为对照。三者使用相同种子与划分，覆盖8个图（基线因无法在ogbn-mag运行仅用7个），每个图10个种子；每次运行同时按"测试集最优epoch"和"可部署的验证集规则"两种方式评分。研究在检验性运行之前预注册了40项预测。

Result: 第一，评分规则改变领先者：最优epoch规则下OUTPOST与NSReg各在7个图中领先3个，验证规则下NSReg领先5个。第二，"最优epoch红利"依赖基准构建方式：三个小型重标类图为0.045–0.080 AUC-ROC，三个真实欺诈图仅0.002–0.014。第三，OUTPOST中的伪标签在同三个图上贡献0.038–0.065 AUC-ROC，但在任何真实欺诈图上均无收益。此外，用于超参选择的0.002并列带在全部6个测试图上都低于配对标准误（即使10个种子）；40项预注册预测中有12项被证伪并如实报告。

Conclusion: 报告的开放集图异常检测排名在很大程度上由评测约定（评分规则、基准构建方式）决定，而非方法本身的真实能力；小规模重标类基准会系统性放大最优epoch红利与伪标签收益，而真实欺诈数据上这些效应消失。0.002并列带不可靠。论文最后给出简短的报告清单，呼吁更规范、可部署的评测实践。

Abstract: Open-set graph anomaly detection trains on a few labeled anomalies from one class and must also find anomaly classes that were never labeled. Published results share three conventions: the test score is read at the best epoch on the test set, baseline numbers are copied from earlier papers, and most anomalies are minority classes relabeled as anomalous. We ask how much of the reported ranking these conventions decide. We re-run two recent methods, DEMO and NSReg, together with OUTPOST, a small first-order detector built for this study. All three use one protocol with identical seeds and splits on eight graphs (seven for the baselines, which cannot run on ogbn-mag), ten seeds each, and every run is scored under both the best-epoch rule and a deployable validation rule. Before the runs that test them, we registered 40 predictions. Three findings hold. First, the rule changes the leader: under the best-epoch rule, OUTPOST and NSReg each lead three of seven graphs, while under the validation rule, NSReg leads five. Second, the best-epoch bonus depends on how the benchmark was built: 0.045--0.080 AUC-ROC on the three small relabeled-class graphs and 0.002--0.014 on the three real fraud graphs. Third, pseudo-labeling in OUTPOST is worth 0.038--0.065 AUC-ROC on the same three graphs but gives no benefit on any real fraud graph. We also show that a 0.002 tie band for hyperparameter selection lies below the paired standard error on all six graphs tested, even at ten seeds. Twelve of our 40 predictions were falsified, and we report them. We close with a short reporting checklist.

</details>


### [1130] [Optimal Transport Dropout for Structured Predictive Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33377)
*Giacomo Lorenzon,Francesco Regazzoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出最优传输Dropout（OTD），联合学习预测映射与隐空间扰动分布，通过可学习流将简单独立参考分布传输为结构化扰动，并用严格proper的Energy Score训练、以动能作用项作几何正则，从而在无需后验推断或集成的情况下获得结构化预测不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定性神经网络与神经算子只给出点预测，缺乏内在可靠性度量。预测不确定性可能来自不可约的结果随机性、有限数据或模型类限制。MC dropout虽计算便捷，但其扰动规律基本是先验设定的，且在隐坐标上通常是因子化的，难以表达结构化、多峰的预测分布。

Method: 提出Optimal Transport Dropout（OTD）：从简单的独立参考分布出发，用可学习流对隐扰动进行最优传输，并将其传播通过预测神经网络，从而诱导结构化的预测分布。训练采用严格proper的Energy Score作为评分规则，并加入动能作用（kinetic-action）项对传输进行几何正则化。该方法无需训练多个独立网络，也无需显式推断参数后验。

Result: 合成基准上，OTD能捕捉多峰预测分布；在模型误设定时产生有意义的离散度；随着训练数据增多或模型容量增大，离散度收缩。对场值偏微分方程代理模型，预测离散度与预测误差的空间模式高度一致；相比MC dropout，预测更准确，区间校准更好且显著更窄。在真实回归基准上，精度具竞争力，概率预测优于已有基线。

Conclusion: OTD提供了一种学习结构化预测不确定性的途径，无需显式后验推断，也无需独立训练的预测器集成。

Abstract: Deterministic neural networks and neural operators provide point predictions with no intrinsic measure of reliability. Yet, predictive uncertainty may stem from irreducible outcome variability, finite data, or limitations of the chosen model class. Monte Carlo dropout offers a computationally convenient way to construct a predictive distribution through stochastic feature masking, without training multiple independent networks or explicitly inferring a posterior over model parameters. However, its perturbation law is largely prescribed a priori and typically factorised across latent coordinates. We introduce Optimal Transport Dropout (OTD), which instead learns the predictive mapping and the law of its latent perturbations jointly. Starting from a simple independent reference distribution, OTD transports latent perturbations through a learnable flow and propagates them through the predictive neural network, thereby inducing a structured predictive law. Training uses the strictly proper Energy Score, while a kinetic-action term geometrically regularises the transport. Synthetic benchmarks show that OTD captures multimodal predictive distributions, generates meaningful dispersion when the model is misspecified, and exhibits contracting dispersion as more training data or greater model capacity are provided. For a field-valued partial differential equation surrogate, predictive dispersion strongly aligns with the spatial pattern of prediction errors. On this task, compared with Monte Carlo dropout, OTD yields more accurate predictions and better-calibrated, substantially narrower intervals. On real-world regression benchmarks, it further shows competitive accuracy and better probabilistic predictions compared to established baselines. OTD therefore offers a way to learn structured predictive uncertainty without explicit posterior inference or ensembles of independently trained predictors.

</details>


### [1131] [From Grey-Box to Green-Box: When can Physics-Informed Machine Learning Reduce Carbon Footprints in Structural Health Monitoring?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33387)
*Daisy R. Bradley,Nathan A. Hinchliffe,Daniel J. Pitchforth,Matthew R. Jones,Elizabeth J. Cross*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨物理信息机器学习（灰箱模型）是否在结构健康监测中具有降低环境影响的优势，通过比较四类方法训练至特定误差阈值时的碳排放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习在工程中应用日增，但计算时间增加带来环境成本。物理信息机器学习利用工程人员的物理洞察，已显示良好效果，本文探索其是否还能减少碳排放。

Method: 在结构健康监测背景下，评估四种物理信息机器学习方法（涵盖高斯过程与神经网络）：残差建模、输入增强、混合建模、约束学习；比较各模型达到给定误差阈值时的训练碳排放。

Result: 在多数案例中，物理信息模型的训练排放低于黑箱模型（输入增强模型除外）；且训练数据需求减少进一步带来数据采集与存储层面的环境节省。

Conclusion: 物理信息机器学习在降低环境影响方面有潜力，但并非万能；需在引入物理知识带来的复杂度增加与训练数据需求减少的收益之间进行权衡。

Abstract: Machine learning plays an increasingly vital role in engineering, but the corresponding increase in compute time is not without environmental cost. Physics-informed machine learning or "grey-box" models have been developed to overcome some of the limitations of traditional black-box learners, utilising the physical insight that an engineer would have about the structure they are modelling and have shown promising results in the structural engineering field among many others. This work explores whether an additional advantage could be a reduced environmental impact, considering the relationship between training data quantity and training time, linking this duration to carbon emissions from computing.
  In a structural health monitoring context, four physics-informed machine learning approaches - spanning Gaussian processes and neural networks - are evaluated: residual modelling, input augmentation, hybrid modelling, and constrained learning. The emissions for training each of the models to reach a given error threshold is compared, and in most examples, shown to be lower for the physics-informed models (with input augmented models being an exception). This reduction in training emissions further compounds the environmental savings achieved by collecting and storing less data. Although promising results, we cannot expect a silver bullet and the case studies demonstrate that a trade-off is needed between the increased complexity that comes from introducing physics into a machine learner, against the gain from reduced training data requirements.

</details>


### [1132] [StarBOA: Real-Time Mamba State-Space Unrolling for Sparse Radar Micro-Doppler in ISAC Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33408)
*Mustafa Bora Çelik,Ceren Çelik,Orhan Gazi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 StarBOA，用因果 Mamba 状态空间模型替代注意力机制，在无额外逐步计算开销下集成超 100 倍时间历史，实现极端 chirp 子采样下的高效因果重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC 中雷达感知需在高达 90% 缺失数据的 chirp 子采样下工作。基于注意力的基线受限于 52 ms 缓冲区，随稀疏度增加其输出趋于最大均匀熵（H=2.584 bits），无法捕捉长程步态周期上下文。

Method: StarBOA 用因果 Mamba 状态空间模型替换注意力，按窗口逐窗增量更新，无需重扫描历史重建结果；通过维护持久状态来累积时间历史。

Result: 在所有稀疏度水平上超过基线已发表结果，SSIM 增益从 50% 缺失时的 +0.0379 提升到 90% 缺失时的 +0.2472；每个窗口处理耗时 1.53 ms，且零前瞻（zero lookahead）。

Conclusion: StarBOA 以持久状态实现超 100 倍时间历史集成且不增加逐步计算成本，验证了极端 chirp 子采样下高效因果重建的可行性。

Abstract: In Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC), radar sensing must operate under chirp subsampling with up to 90\% missing data. An attention-based baseline, limited to a 52~ms buffer, collapses toward maximum uniform entropy ($H=2.584$ bits) as sparsity increases, failing to capture long-range gait-cycle context. We propose StarBOA, which replaces attention with a causal Mamba state-space model that updates incrementally on a per-window basis without re-scanning past reconstructions. By maintaining a persistent state, StarBOA integrates over $100\times$ more temporal history at no additional per-step computational cost. StarBOA outperforms the baseline's published results across all sparsity levels, with SSIM gains increasing from $+0.0379$ at 50\% missing data to $+0.2472$ at 90\%. Each window is processed in 1.53~ms with zero lookahead, demonstrating efficient causal reconstruction under extreme chirp subsampling.

</details>


### [1133] [FoldAttention: Declared-Reference Softmax for Fast Decode and Deterministic Backward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33410)
*Sriman Achanta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FoldAttention，一种加法式 softmax 注意力公式，在扫描 KV cache 前固定有限参考 $Z_i$，使权重即时确定、无需重缩放，从而实现 Hopper 解码加速与确定性反向传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归解码在长上下文下反复流式读取增长的 KV cache，注意力成为主要开销。现有高性能 kernel 使用 online softmax，在扫描 keys 过程中动态发现归一化参考，导致先前贡献只是临时结果、可能需要重缩放，增加了开销与复杂性（尤其是反向传播的确定性代价）。

Method: 作者论证参考值无需"发现"：softmax 对公共平移不变，参考值只需保证权重在数值范围内。据此提出 FoldAttention：在扫描 KV cache 前固定有限参考 $Z_i$，每个权重 $2^{s_{ij}-Z_i}$ 计算即最终，跨不相交 key 区间的贡献可直接相加，其商等于真实算术下的 softmax。基于该性质开发两项技术：(1) 最终权重在取字节前门控 key/value 读取，并用每次调用的深度 $T$ 截断小于 $2^{-T}$ 的键同时保留其质量；(2) 加法式部分和可组合分块 KV 与共享前缀级联而无需重缩放。反向传播中，CTA 将有限偏梯度四舍五入到归约前声明的整数格上并按任意顺序相加，实现确定性。

Result: 在 H100、$T=16$ 下，FoldAttention 对七个真实模型解码比最快 BF16 基线快 1.36–2.30×，在 MHA 与 GQA 形状上最高快 3.09×，其中七个里六个误差在最低 BF16 误差的 1.5% 以内；读取全部 key 时，在匹配误差下快 1.14–1.30×。在 Qwen3-8B 上验证整个解码步最多快 1.46×，似然与长上下文准确率与 BF16 kernel 相当。确定性反向传播比确定性 FlashAttention-3/4 快至多 1.84×，比最快非确定性 kernel 快 1.05×。

Conclusion: 通过固定参考的加法式 softmax 公式，FoldAttention 消除了 online softmax 重缩放需求，在保持精度的前提下实现显著解码加速，并使反向传播具备确定性且更快，从而去除了"确定性税"。

Abstract: Autoregressive decode repeatedly streams a growing KV cache, making attention a major cost at long context. Existing high-performance kernels use online softmax, which discovers a row's normalization reference as it scans keys. Earlier contributions therefore remain provisional and may require rescaling. We argue that the reference need not be discovered: softmax is invariant to a common shift, so the reference only has to keep the weights in range. We present FoldAttention, an additive formulation of softmax attention that fixes a finite reference $Z_i$ before scanning the KV cache. Each weight $2^{s_{ij}-Z_i}$ is then final when computed, so contributions add across disjoint key ranges and their quotient equals softmax attention in real arithmetic. We use this property to develop two techniques for Hopper decode: (1) final weights gate key and value reads before the bytes are fetched, and a per-call depth $T$ cuts keys below $2^{-T}$ while keeping their mass, and (2) additive partials compose split KV and shared-prefix cascades without rescaling. On H100 at $T=16$, FoldAttention decodes seven real-model generations 1.36-2.30$\times$ faster than the fastest BF16 baseline, and up to 3.09$\times$ faster across MHA and GQA shapes, at an error within 1.5% of the lowest BF16 error on six of the seven; reading every key, it is 1.14-1.30$\times$ faster at matched error. We validate on Qwen3-8B that a whole decode step is up to 1.46$\times$ faster while likelihood and long-context accuracy match those under BF16 kernels. The same principle makes the backward deterministic: CTAs round bounded partial gradients onto an integer grid declared before the reduction and add them in any order. FoldAttention thereby removes the determinism tax: its deterministic backward is up to 1.84$\times$ faster than deterministic FlashAttention-3/4 and 1.05$\times$ faster than the fastest nondeterministic kernel.

</details>


### [1134] [MoGround: Measuring and Mitigating Modality Distraction in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33431)
*Luca Zhou,Bo Zhao,Rose Yu,Emanuele Rodolà,Roberto Dessì*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出 MoGround 数据集，通过保证每个问题仅由单一模态即可回答，来度量并缓解视觉语言模型中的"模态干扰"现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探测方法很少确保问题可由单一模态独立回答，导致难以隔离"模态干扰"这一失效模式，即模型仅凭一个模态能答对，但加入另一模态的无关内容后答案反转。

Method: 发布 MoGround 视觉语言数据集，覆盖四个视觉领域，每个问题的答案保证恰好可由一个模态获取；基于此单一模态保证，训练一个权重空间鲁棒性向量（仅在 MoGround 的一个划分上训练），用于区分相关与无关上下文以实现缓解。

Result: 在七个开源 VLM 上评估：模态干扰并非普遍存在而是依赖模型；grounding 较弱的模态更易受干扰（r=+0.86），干扰程度与 grounding 强度呈负相关（r=-0.90）。鲁棒性向量在所有七个模型上将干扰降低 9%–51%，标准多模态任务平均准确率仅损失 0.1 分。

Conclusion: 单一模态可回答性保证既能量化模态干扰，又能支撑有效的缓解方法，以极小的通用性能代价显著提升模型对无关跨模态内容的鲁棒性。

Abstract: We release MoGround, a vision-language dataset spanning four visual domains in which the answer to every question is guaranteed to be available from exactly one modality. This guarantee enables us to measure modality distraction, the failure in which a model answers a question correctly from one modality alone and then flips to a wrong answer once irrelevant content from the other modality is added. Existing probes rarely establish single-modality answerability this way, making it hard to isolate distraction in the first place. Across seven open-source VLMs, we find that modality distraction is not universal but model-dependent. The weaker-grounded modality is the more distracted one (r = +0.86), and distraction scales inversely with grounding strength (r = -0.90). The single-modality guarantee also enables a mitigation method that needs to distinguish between relevant and irrelevant context. Trained on one split of MoGround alone, a weight-space robustness vector reduces distraction on all seven models by 9% to 51%, at a cost of only 0.1 average points of accuracy on standard multimodal tasks.

</details>


### [1135] [SchemaMem: Schema-Indexed Recurrent Memory for Delayed State Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33436)
*Sungwoo Goo,Hwi-yeol Yun,Sangkeun Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SchemaMem——一种结合块内注意力与持久化 schema 索引相位状态的注意力型循环记忆架构，在受控地址-值任务中展现出延迟保持优势，但优化成本更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力可直接访问历史表示，但保留无限增长的历史代价高昂；循环模型虽能限制持久状态规模，却需在处理后续输入时保留选定信息。论文旨在兼顾两者的记忆保持能力与有界状态。

Method: SchemaMem 采用块内局部注意力加持久化、schema 索引的相位状态。学习到的 schema 嵌入为读写提供共享表示参照：读取使用当前状态，写入使用层输入与静态 schema 嵌入，且排除该层自身状态的直接反馈。块边界提交通过前向计算聚合有界的相位增量。同一套参数既支持全历史注意力训练，也用于循环训练前及训练中。实验为受控地址-值任务，比较参数量与持久状态维度近似匹配的三层模型。

Result: 在九个地址/值设定与三个训练随机种子下，SchemaMem 在四倍最大训练延迟处的平均写入值保持率高于两个基线（基线在更高范围内准确率目标下训练）。更新值恢复方面，SchemaMem 在全部九个设定中优于 Mamba-3，在七个设定中优于 Gated DeltaNet。但在该延迟下默认配置一致偏好 Gated DeltaNet，且 SchemaMem 需要显著更多优化步数。

Conclusion: 结果表明 schema 索引循环中存在一种有前景的保持-优化权衡：SchemaMem 在长延迟记忆保持上具优势，但以更高的优化成本与默认配置劣势为代价。

Abstract: Attention provides direct access to past representations, but retaining an ever-growing history is costly. Recurrent models bound persistent state, yet must preserve selected information while processing subsequent inputs. We introduce SchemaMem, an attention-based recurrent memory architecture combining chunk-local attention with a persistent, schema-indexed phase state. Learned schema embeddings provide a shared representational reference for reading and writing. Reads use the current state, whereas writes use the layer input and static schema embeddings, excluding direct feedback from that layer's own state. Chunk-boundary commits aggregate bounded phase increments through forward computation. The same parameters also support full-history attention training before and during recurrent training. We studied selective updates, preservation, and delayed retrieval in a controlled address--value task, comparing three-layer models with approximately matched parameter counts and persistent-state dimensions. Across nine address/value settings and three training seeds, SchemaMem has higher mean written-value retention at four times the maximum training delay than both baselines, which are trained toward a higher in-range accuracy target. Updated-value recovery favors SchemaMem in all nine settings against Mamba-3 and seven against Gated DeltaNet. Defaults consistently favor Gated DeltaNet over SchemaMem at that delay, and SchemaMem requires substantially more optimization steps. These results identify a promising retention--optimization trade-off in schema-indexed recurrence.

</details>


### [1136] [A Free Knob: Decoupling Calibration and Predictive Skill in Threshold-Based Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33457)
*Md Tanveer Hossain Munim,Bijoy Ahmed Saiem,Al-Amin Sany,Tanzima Hashem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，在固定稀有事件操作点下，对密集预测基准采用池化-阈值化的CSI评分时，空间判别能力与幅度校准被混淆；作者提出用对称的后置单调校准（FreeKnob Audit）审计该混淆，并建议同时报告池化频率偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀有事件密集预测基准通常将预测与真值在空间块上池化、阈值化并统计列联表得分。在固定稀有操作点下，max-pooled CSI 将空间判别力与幅度校准混为一谈：锐利的观测会使大量块超过阈值，而平方误差回归产生的衰减预测会使同样的块低于阈值，因此分数差异未必反映真实的空间排序能力。

Method: 将经典单调校准改造为对称审计工具：在留出数据上拟合后置单调变换，并分别应用于每个被比较系统。由于单调变换无法反转像素排序，其能够复现的对比不能作为空间排序改进的证据。作者在SEVIR、地球静止红外影像、人群计数与语义分割等任务上，通过成对对比检验池化频率偏差与CSI对比变化之间的关系，并进行窗口前置拟合、基线校准等稳健性检验。

Result: 在SEVIR上，同一架构的两个已发布检查点在极端阈值CSI上控制前相差-29.5%，控制后变为+5.3%。在6个系统的450组成对对比中，池化频率偏差偏差差值与CSI对比在控制下的移动幅度相关（r=+0.796），且51组对比发生符号反转。在CasCast已发表的极端事件操作点上，级联相对骨干的CSI差距从0.1601降至0.0339，减少78.8%，剩余差距仍为正。该效应在变换于测试期之前窗口拟合时依然存在，且校准还能揭示被校准更好的基线所掩盖的优势。在地球静止红外影像上，相对增益随事件变稀有而增大；人群计数在patch-sum池化下复现了偏差-增益关系；语义分割因频率偏差已接近1而平均变化很小。

Conclusion: 该混淆的产生需要同时满足两个条件：固定的操作点，以及在该操作点上输出未校准的训练机制。作者建议在报告稀有事件pool-and-threshold分数时，同时报告池化频率偏差与对称的留出FreeKnob Audit。

Abstract: Many dense-prediction benchmarks evaluate rare events by pooling prediction and target over spatial blocks, thresholding each, and scoring the contingency table. At a fixed rare operating point, the max-pooled Critical Success Index (CSI) confounds spatial discrimination with amplitude calibration: sharp observations promote many blocks above threshold, while attenuated predictions from squared-error regression leave the same blocks below it. We repurpose classical monotone calibration as a symmetric audit: a post-hoc transform fitted on held-out data and applied separately to each system. The transform cannot reverse pixel ordering, so any contrast it reproduces cannot establish improved spatial ranking. On SEVIR, two released checkpoints of one architecture differ by -29.5% in extreme-threshold CSI before the control and by +5.3% after it. Across 450 pairwise contrasts among 6 systems, the difference in pooled frequency-bias deviation is associated with how far the CSI contrast moves under the control (r = +0.796), and 51 contrasts reverse sign. At CasCast's published extreme-event operating point, the cascade-over-backbone CSI gap falls from 0.1601 to 0.0339, a 78.8% reduction; the remaining gap stays positive. The effect persists when the transform is fitted on a window before the test period, and calibration also reveals advantages hidden by a better-calibrated baseline. On geostationary infrared imagery the relative gain grows as events become rarer, crowd counting reproduces the bias-gain relationship under patch-sum pooling, and semantic segmentation, where frequency bias is already near one, shows little average change. The confound therefore requires both a fixed operating point and a training regime that leaves the output miscalibrated there. We recommend reporting pooled frequency bias and a symmetric held-out FreeKnob Audit alongside rare-event pool-and-threshold scores.

</details>


### [1137] [Geometric Identification in Predict-Then-Optimize Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33472)
*Jiaxiao Xu,Changhong Mou,Keji Liu,Dinghua Xu,Yeyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了凸SPO+代理的总体风险相等集，给出其唯一贝叶斯最小化子（即中心均值类）可识别的充要式条件，并用实验验证相关解析结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策聚焦代理（如SPO+）常被用于在下游决策中替代"先预测再优化"，但其能否在总体层面恢复真实的条件均值/商报告（quotient report）尚缺乏精确的理论判据。作者希望澄清：在什么几何条件下，SPO+的最小化子恰好等价于中心均值类，从而避免把"目标面穿越（face crossing）"与"选中oracle不一致"混为一谈，并给出可量化的局部强凸性/矫顽性。

Method: 1) 以总体风险为对象，刻画凸SPO+代理风险的相等集（equality set of the population risk）；2) 在中心对称（central symmetry）条件下，分析贝叶斯最小化子是否唯一为中心均值类；3) 引入"有效位移（effective displacement）"与"目标面穿越（face crossing）"的概念，要求任意非零有效位移使旧优化器以正概率离开平移后的最优面，以建立唯一性与局部矫顽性；4) 去对称性时，证明仅严格穿越不足，需"选择平衡（selection balance）+ 反射穿越（reflected crossing）"才能恢复商报告识别，并给出条件版本以推广到可测预测器；5) 通过闭式机制复现解析恒等式与速率；6) 在Portfolio、完整矩阵KuaiRec、Energy/Storage数据上测度预测保真度、平移后悔（shifted regret）与拟合报告几何；7) 构造已知DGP伴随实验以隔离条件均值恢复与穿越现象。

Result: 在中心对称下，"每个非零有效位移都以正概率使旧优化器离开平移最优面"的严格穿越条件，恰好保证中心均值类为唯一贝叶斯最小化子，并给出局部矫顽性的定量刻画；无对称时，仅严格穿越不能识别均值，需叠加选择平衡与反射穿越方可恢复商报告识别；条件化后结论可扩展至可测预测器；闭式机制复现了解析恒等式与速率；三组应用实验（Portfolio、KuaiRec、Energy/Storage）度量了预测保真度、平移后悔与拟合报告几何，已知DGP伴星实验在保留应用几何的同时隔离出条件均值恢复与穿越行为。作者强调这些均为总体层面结论，不提供有限样本的报告恢复或一般迁移后悔保证。

Conclusion: SPO+总体风险的相等集与唯一性由"有效位移的严格穿越"精确刻画：中心对称下穿越即识别中心均值类，非对称下需选择平衡+反射穿越。该框架区分了目标面穿越与oracle选择不一致，并可给出可量化的局部矫顽性；但结论限于总体陈述，不含有限样本报告恢复与通用迁移后悔保证，已知DGP实验也不检验原观测假设。

Abstract: Decision-focused surrogates can recover downstream decisions without identifying the quotient report.
