We characterize the equality set of the convex Smart Predict-then-Optimize surrogate (SPO+) population risk. Under central symmetry, the centered mean class is the unique Bayes minimizer exactly when every nonzero effective displacement makes the old optimizer leave the shifted optimal face with positive probability. This condition separates face crossing from selected-oracle disagreement and gives quantitative local coercivity. Without symmetry, strict crossing alone need not identify the mean; selection balance with reflected crossing restores quotient-report identification, and conditional versions extend the result to measurable predictors. These are population statements, without finite-sample report-recovery or generic transfer-regret guarantees. Closed-form mechanisms reproduce the analytic identities and rates. Portfolio, complete-matrix KuaiRec, and Energy/Storage studies measure predictive fidelity, shifted regret, and fitted-report geometry. A known data-generating process (DGP) companion retains their application geometries while isolating conditional-mean recovery and crossing, without testing the original observational assumptions.

</details>


### [1138] [How Synthetic Labels Improve Conformal Prediction: A Perspective on Conditional Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33482)
*Qianyi Chen,Bo Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"预测驱动分位数学习"（prediction-powered quantile learning），利用廉价合成标签（领域模型或通用语言模型）在仅有少量可信样本时改进条件覆盖，保持边缘有效性并得到更紧凑的预测集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测虽能提供分布无关的有限样本边缘覆盖，但事后校准数据往往过少，无法学习不确定性如何随输入变化（条件覆盖）。而大量协变量可通过领域模型或通用语言模型廉价地获得标签，因此需要研究这些合成标签能否在仅有小规模可信样本时提升条件覆盖。

Method: 基于分数-分位数回归（score-quantile regression），提出预测驱动分位数学习：用合成标签池估计 pinball 风险，用配对的可信与合成结果校正其偏差，再用独立可信划分做最终共形化。通过对标量修正的 pinball 风险做剖面分析，发现总体条件覆盖误差是其函数梯度；对应 Hessian 可消除全局偏移，并以边界密度对剩余形状误差加权。将该几何结构与预测驱动学习结合，得到"三资源扩展"及合成数据的收益—成本规则。

Result: 在八个回归基准上，合成驱动的分位数学习显著改善下游条件覆盖，同时保持边缘有效性，并产生更紧凑的预测集。一项人类评分研究发现，来自外部LLM标签也能获得类似增益，并揭示了质量—数量—成本的权衡。

Conclusion: 合成（预测）标签可在仅需少量可信数据的前提下有效提升共形预测的条件覆盖质量，但需在标签质量、数量与成本间权衡；所提出的几何刻画为合成数据的收益—成本分析提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free finite-sample marginal coverage, but post-hoc calibration data may be too scarce to learn how uncertainty varies across inputs. Meanwhile, abundant covariates can often be labeled cheaply by domain models or general-purpose language models. We study whether these synthetic labels can improve conditional coverage when only a small trusted sample is available. Building on score-quantile regression, we introduce prediction-powered quantile learning: a synthetic-labeled pool estimates pinball risk, paired trusted and synthetic outcomes correct its bias, and an independent trusted split performs final conformalization. Profiling pinball risk over scalar corrections reveals that population conditional-coverage error is its functional gradient; the corresponding Hessian removes global shifts and weights remaining shape error by boundary density. Composing this geometry with prediction-powered learning yields a three-resource expansion and a benefit--cost rule for synthetic power. Across eight regression benchmarks, synthetic-powered quantile learning substantially improves downstream conditional coverage while preserving marginal validity and producing more compact prediction sets. A human-rating study finds similar gains from external LLM labels and exposes a quality--quantity--cost tradeoff.

</details>


### [1139] [What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33487)
*Pierre Guetschel,Bruno Aristimunha,Yassine El Ouahidi,Arnaud Delorme,Thomas Moreau,Michael Tangermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地隔离并消融了EEG基础模型预训练中的时空掩码策略，在MAE与JEPA两种自监督框架下训练58个模型并于OpenEEGBench的12个数据集上线性探测评估，发现两框架在最优掩码配置与失效模式上一致，且识别出JEPA特有的"偏差膨胀崩溃"现象；合理掩码可使流水线以远低于REVE的预训练算力达到其下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型有望实现可扩展的脑信号解码，但其预训练流水线缺乏系统理解。设计选择中掩码策略尤为关键——它决定网络预测什么、依据何种上下文预测，然而现有研究从未对其进行单独消融，因为每个新模型都把新的掩码策略与新的骨干网络和目标函数捆绑在一起，导致掩码的影响无法被剥离评估。

Method: 作者首先形式化了时空掩码策略的设计选择空间；随后在统一的单一预训练流水线下，跨两种自监督框架（MAE与JEPA）以不同掩码配置训练出58个预训练模型；最后在OpenEEGBench的12个数据集上通过线性探测（linear probe）进行系统性评估。

Result: 两种框架对最优掩码配置及共同失效模式达成一致；在此最优配置之外，性能表现稳健——11种MAE配置与9种JEPA配置与最佳结果在统计上无显著差异；此外识别出一种JEPA特有的新失效模式，称为"偏差膨胀崩溃"（bias-inflation collapse），该模式无法被标准检测器发现。

Conclusion: 掩码策略的选择对EEG基础模型预训练效果具有决定性影响且可被独立评估；采用精心选择的掩码，该流水线能以仅为REVE一小部分的预训练算力达到REVE级别的下游性能，表明掩码设计优化是提升EEG自监督预训练效率的关键杠杆。

Abstract: EEG foundation models hold promise for scalable brain-signal decoding across clinical and cognitive neuroscience applications, yet their pre-training pipelines remain poorly understood. Among design choices, the masking strategy is particularly critical: it determines what the network must predict and from which context. Yet it has never been ablated in isolation, as each new model bundles a new masking strategy with a new backbone and objective. In this paper, we formalize the design choices for spatio-temporal masking strategies and train various models with a single pipeline under varying masking configurations across two SSL frameworks (MAE and JEPA). We then systematically evaluate the resulting 58 pre-trained models on the 12 datasets of OpenEEGBench under a linear probe. Both frameworks agree on an optimal masking configuration and on shared failure modes. Outside these, performance is robust: 11 MAE and 9 JEPA configurations are statistically indistinguishable from the best. We further identify a novel JEPA-specific failure mode, tagged bias-inflation collapse, invisible to standard detectors. With a well-chosen mask, our pipeline reaches REVE-level downstream performance at a fraction of REVE's pre-training compute.

</details>


### [1140] [Predicting Block-Coordinate Performance via Cross-Curvature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33489)
*Shengkun Zhu,Jinshan Zeng,Zhiqiang Kou,Yongxin Tong,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一理论比较Jacobi、Gauss-Seidel及部分顺序确定性块梯度更新的损失差异，用跨块曲率刻画单步损失差异（余项O(η³)），并给出K步后的带符号损失比较公式（误差O(Kη³)）。在神经网络、联邦学习、LoRA轨迹上验证，500步内预测更低损失方法的准确率分别达98.0%、83.4%、97.6%，逐步应用损失递推后提升至100.0%、93.2%、99.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同时更新与顺序块更新是机器学习（如神经网络训练、联邦学习、低秩适配）中的两种基本优化策略，但二者孰优取决于目标几何与迭代次数，选择困难，缺乏统一的理论指导。

Method: 建立统一理论框架，比较Jacobi（JC）、Gauss-Seidel（GS）及部分顺序确定性块梯度更新；用跨块曲率表达单步损失差异，含O(η³)余项；在正则性条件与ηK≤T（T固定）下，推导K次迭代后的带符号损失比较，误差为O(Kη³)。

Result: 在神经网络、联邦学习、LoRA三种设置的实际训练轨迹上评估：500次迭代内，理论正确识别更低损失方法的比例分别为98.0%、83.4%、97.6%；若每步用实测参数差应用损失递推，则提升至100.0%、93.2%、99.6%。

Conclusion: 该统一理论能够基于跨块曲率和迭代次数对JC、GS及部分顺序块更新做出可验证的损失比较，预测精度高，为块更新策略的选择提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Simultaneous and sequential block updates are two basic optimization strategies used across machine learning, such as neural-network training, federated learning, and low-rank adaptation. Choosing between them is difficult because their relative advantage depends on both the objective geometry and the number of iterations. We develop a unified theory for comparing Jacobi (JC), Gauss--Seidel (GS), and partially sequential deterministic block-gradient updates. Our analysis expresses the one-step loss difference through cross-block curvature, with an $O(η^3)$ remainder, where $η$ is the learning rate. We derive a signed loss comparison after $K$ iterations with $O(Kη^3)$ error under regularity conditions and $ηK\le T$ for fixed $T$, identifying the better method when the predicted difference exceeds this error. We evaluate these formulas along observed training trajectories across different machine learning settings. Over 500 iterations, our theory correctly identifies the lower-loss method in 98.0\% of iterations for the neural network, 83.4\% for federated learning, and 97.6\% for LoRA. Applying the loss recursion at each step using the measured parameter difference raises these rates to 100.0\%, 93.2\%, and 99.6\%, respectively.

</details>


### [1141] [Hamiltonian JEPA: Action-Conditioned World Models with an Inherited Control State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33497)
*Tamim Zoabi,Ameen Ali,Lior Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 H-JEPA，将感知编码与控制的隐空间解耦：宽感知编码经 Bures-Wasserstein 先验正则化为各向同性几何，取固定正交切片作为控制状态，配合相位条件耗散端口-哈密顿动力学与端口逆一致性（PIC），在四个像素控制基准上以 ≤10 轮训练超越无重建基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于像素的规划仅靠稳定、可预测的隐空间是不够的，规划器所评分的状态还须按动作如何驱动系统来组织。现有动作条件 JEPA 让同一嵌入同时承担感知与控制，导致表征目标冲突。

Method: H-JEPA 将感知与控制分离：宽感知编码以 Bures-Wasserstein 先验正则化为良尺度各向同性几何；取其固定的正交切片作为控制状态，无需自身目标即继承编码协方差。状态在相位条件耗散端口-哈密顿动力学下演化，其输入端口列正交。端口逆一致性（PIC）通过端口转置反读执行动作，被证明等价于将 rollout 误差投影到端口方向，是预测误差的无参数重加权，而非辅助动作解码器。

Result: 在四个基于像素的控制基准上，训练至多 10 轮即匹配或超越无重建基线（含动作解码的 Delta-JEPA），最大增益在 OGB-Cube（91.9% vs 79.3%）。解耦读出与端口会破坏该恒等式并损失约一半增益。PushT 与 OGB-Cube 上的消融分离了结构化预测器、PIC、预测时域、状态秩与抗坍缩先验各自的贡献。

Conclusion: 将感知嵌入与控制状态解耦、并让动作读出与动力学端口严格对应，可在不重建像素的前提下显著提升基于像素的规划效率与性能，PIC 的可解释恒等式是性能提升的关键来源。

Abstract: Planning from pixels needs more than a latent space that is stable and predictable. The state the planner scores must also be organized by how actions move the system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid pixel reconstruction by predicting future representations, but existing action-conditioned JEPAs ask one embedding to serve both perception and control. We introduce H-JEPA, which separates the two. A wide perceptual code is regularized toward a well-scaled isotropic geometry with a Bures-Wasserstein prior, and a fixed orthonormal slice of that code is the control state, which inherits the code's covariance without any objective of its own. The state evolves under phase-conditioned dissipative port-Hamiltonian dynamics whose input port has orthonormal columns. Port-inverse consistency (PIC) reads the executed action back through the transpose of that port. We show that this readout is exactly the rollout error projected onto the port directions, so PIC is a parameter-free reweighting of prediction error and not an auxiliary action decoder. Untying the readout from the port breaks this identity and loses half of the gain. H-JEPA matches or exceeds reconstruction-free baselines, including the action-decoding Delta-JEPA, on four pixel-based control benchmarks after at most $10$ training epochs, and its largest gain is on OGB-Cube ($91.9$ against $79.3$ percent). Ablations on PushT and OGB-Cube separate the contributions of the structured predictor, PIC, the prediction horizon, the state rank, and the anti-collapse prior.

</details>


### [1142] [The cost of useful natural gradient updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33499)
*Subhransu S. Bhattacharjee,Dylan Campbell,Rahul Shome*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在总体KL预算下，即使自然梯度方向已知，确定"移动多远"（步长）仍需大量样本，且在最坏情况下是NP-hard的；步长而非方向承载了更新的全部成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然梯度方法通常关注方向的计算，但一个有用更新还需要知道如何将方向转化为可行的有限步长。本文追问：在给定总体KL预算下，把自然梯度方向转化为"有用步长"需要多少信息，以及这一过程的计算/样本代价由什么决定。

Method: 构造一个四状态指数族：各分布共享相同的初始梯度、标量Fisher信息和自然梯度，但其中两个分布的"有用步长集"互不相交。在精确给定这些量、而分布仅通过采样获知的情形下，分析其最坏情况样本复杂度。并研究事件倾斜（event-tilt）模型、二参数logistic族的NP-hard性，以及阻尼Fisher解、仿射分类器的样本界与总体KL证书。

Result: 该族的最坏情况样本复杂度为Θ(log(1/δ)/(pε²))（ε较小），其中p反映稀有状态概率，δ为失败概率；由于预算固定且最优增益有下界，成本来自步长而非方向。对简洁描述的事件倾斜模型，即使给定精确自然梯度和高效精确采样，返回有用步长仍是NP-hard；将单位自然梯度恢复到常数误差在Fisher条件数不超过3的二参数logistic族中也是NP-hard。文中还给出事件倾斜的匹配样本界、阻尼Fisher求解的样本界、仿射分类器的总体KL证书。在冻结特征分类器头中，于采样KL边界处停止约有一半试验成功，而10%的KL裕度可将联合成功率提高到93%以上（KL预算0.01）。

Conclusion: 知道往哪个方向移动是不够的：移动多远可能承载更新的全部代价。自然梯度的方向信息无法替代对步长/预算的精确估计，后者在样本与计算上都可能极其昂贵。

Abstract: What information is needed to turn a natural-gradient direction into a useful finite update? Under a population Kullback-Leibler (KL) budget, we call a step useful if it is feasible and loses at most a fraction $\varepsilon$ of the best feasible gain along the direction. We construct a four-state exponential family whose laws share their initial gradient, scalar Fisher information and natural gradient, yet two laws have disjoint useful-step sets. With these quantities supplied exactly and the law otherwise known only through draws, the family's worst-case sample complexity is $Θ(\log(1/δ)/(p\varepsilon^2))$ for small $\varepsilon$, where $p$ scales rare-state probabilities and $δ$ is the failure probability. The budget is fixed and the optimal gain stays bounded away from zero, so the step length, not the direction, carries this cost. For succinctly described event-tilt models, returning a useful step is NP-hard even with the exact natural gradient and efficient exact sampling. Recovering the unit natural gradient to constant error is also NP-hard even in a two-parameter logistic family with Fisher condition number at most 3. We also give matching sample bounds for event tilts, sample bounds for damped Fisher solves and a population-KL certificate for affine classifiers. In frozen-feature classifier heads, stopping at a sampled KL boundary succeeds in about half of the trials, and a 10% KL margin raises joint success above 93% at a KL budget of 0.01. Thus, knowing where to move is not enough: how far to move can carry an update's entire cost.

</details>


### [1143] [Pulseflow: PPG Counterfactual Generation Via Latent Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33501)
*Hung Manh Pham,Dong Ma,Bin Zhu,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PulseFlow 是一个源条件反事实生成框架，通过条件表示学习与可逆潜在传输，将源心律编辑为目标心律，用于缓解房颤（AF）标注数据稀缺问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPG 已成为连续心血管监测（含 AF 检测）的重要模态，但在许多临床场景中带标签的 AF 记录有限，仅有少量目标数据时模型适配困难。生成建模可合成 AF 信号以缓解稀缺，但现有方法主要生成匹配目标条件的样本，未显式建模"如何将观测到的源记录进行变换"，因而难以利用来自特定人群或队列的大量源记录做定向增强。

Method: 提出 PulseFlow：一个源条件（source-conditioned）反事实生成框架，将条件表示学习与可逆潜在传输（invertible latent transport）相结合，在编辑心律的同时保留源记录信息。

Result: 在两个临床队列上的实验表明：能够有效实现心律变换，具有可度量的源对应性（source correspondence），并在有限标签条件下提升了 AF 分类性能。

Conclusion: 源条件反事实生成可在标签稀缺时利用特定队列的丰富源记录进行定向增强，实现心律编辑并提升下游 AF 检测效果。

Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) has become an important modality for continuous cardiovascular monitoring, including atrial fibrillation (AF) detection. However, labeled AF recordings remain limited in many clinical settings, making model adaptation difficult when only limited target data are available. Generative modeling offers a natural way to alleviate this scarcity by synthesizing additional AF signals. Existing approaches, however, mainly generate samples that match the target condition without explicitly modeling how an observed source recording should be transformed, making it difficult to leverage abundant source recordings from a specific population or cohort for targeted augmentation. We introduce PulseFlow, a source-conditioned counterfactual generation framework that combines conditional representation learning with invertible latent transport to edit cardiac rhythm while retaining information from the source. Experiments across two clinical cohorts demonstrate effective rhythm transformation, measurable source correspondence, and improved AF classification under limited labels.

</details>


### [1144] [LLM4Trust: Exploring the Capabilities of Large Language Models for Trust Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33521)
*Jie Wang,Yanbo Sun,Zheng Yan,Jiahe Lan,Elisa Bertino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM4Trust，首个系统评估大语言模型（LLM）在信任评估中能力的基准框架，涵盖基本信任属性理解、真实数据集验证、鲁棒性与效率改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的信任评估方法虽准确率高且自动化程度高，但依赖大量真实标签、训练效率低、缺乏对基本信任属性的支持且可解释性有限。LLM 具备强零样本/少样本推理能力与广泛知识，因而被视为有潜力的替代方案，但其在信任评估中的能力尚缺乏系统探索。

Method: 构建多样化的信任图以建模五种基本信任属性，并设计相应的属性理解任务；在九种提示（prompt）方法下评估八种代表性 LLM 对上述属性的理解能力；筛选最有效的 LLM-prompt 组合并应用于五个真实数据集；提出两种从大规模信任图中提取关键信息的策略，以缓解 LLM 的上下文窗口限制。

Result: 实验表明 LLM 能有效理解基本信任属性，在真实场景信任评估中潜力显著，尤其在监督有限的条件下表现良好；但 LLM 对针对信任图及少样本提示示例的攻击较为脆弱，且推理成本较高。

Conclusion: LLM 可用于信任评估且优势明显，但存在鲁棒性与效率短板。为此提出一种防御机制与批量推理（batch inference）来提升基于 LLM 的信任评估的鲁棒性和效率，源代码已公开。

Abstract: Trust evaluation plays a critical role in cybersecurity by supporting risk mitigation and decision-making. A variety of trust evaluation methods have been proposed, with learning-based approaches offering high accuracy and automation. However, they often require substantial ground truth, suffer from low training efficiency, lack support for basic trust properties, and provide limited explainability. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a compelling alternative due to their strong zero-/few-shot reasoning abilities and broad knowledge. To this end, we propose LLM4Trust, the first benchmark framework that systematically explores the capabilities of LLMs for trust evaluation. We first construct diverse trust graphs to model five basic trust properties and design corresponding property understanding tasks. We then assess the ability of eight representative LLMs to understand these properties under nine prompt methods. Based on this exploration, we identify the most effective LLM-prompt combinations and apply them to five real-world datasets for validating LLMs' trust evaluation capability. During this process, we propose two strategies to extract key information from large-scale trust graphs, addressing the context window limitations of LLMs. Extensive experiments show that LLMs can effectively understand basic trust properties and have great potential for real-world trust evaluation, particularly under limited supervision. However, they remain vulnerable to attacks targeting trust graphs and demonstration examples used in few-shot prompting, and incur high inference costs. Accordingly, we propose a defense mechanism and batch inference to improve the robustness and efficiency of LLM-based trust evaluation. The source code of LLM4Trust is available at https://github.com/Jieerbobo/LLM4Trust

</details>


### [1145] [Discovering Symmetries in Neural Network Parameter Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33527)
*Bo Zhao,Nima Dehmamy,Robin Walters,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了数据依赖的参数对称性，用无穷小条件刻画损失不变性与群作用公理，并借助子网络构造与自动发现框架，系统识别出多种架构（含预训练Transformer）中此前未知的参数对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数空间对称性对理解神经网络的损失景观、训练动力学与泛化至关重要，但如何系统性地识别这些对称性仍是难题。

Method: 将数据依赖的参数对称性形式化，通过无穷小条件刻画损失不变性与群作用公理，从而为联合学习群生成元与非线性作用映射提供目标函数；进一步建立子网络对称性扩展到完整模型的条件，并据此构造出一族显式的有限批量对称性；结合无穷小刻画与子网络构造，实现参数对称性的自动化发现框架。

Result: 该框架系统性地揭示了参数对称性，其中包括此前未知的对称性；在多种架构上成功发现了对称性，包括预训练Transformer模型。

Conclusion: 所提出的无穷小刻画与子网络构造为参数对称性的分析与自动发现提供了统一框架，既能给出解析例子，也能扩展至大型乃至预训练模型。

Abstract: Parameter space symmetries are important for understanding neural networks' loss landscape, training dynamics, and generalization. However, systematically identifying these symmetries remains a challenge. In this paper, we formalize data-dependent parameter symmetries and characterize loss invariance and the group-action axioms through infinitesimal conditions, which provide objectives for jointly learning group generators and nonlinear action maps. Our framework systematically uncovers parameter symmetries, including previously unknown ones. To study larger networks, we establish conditions under which subnetwork symmetries extend to the full model. The same construction gives an explicit family of finite-batch symmetries, providing both analytical examples and a foundation for discovery through small subnetworks. Using the infinitesimal characterization and subnetwork construction, we implement a framework for automated discovery of parameter symmetries, and successfully uncovered symmetries in various architectures, including pretrained transformer models.

</details>


### [1146] [Does Execution Require Target KV Fidelity? A Mixed-Fidelity KV Runtime for LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33536)
*Jiantong Jiang,Yue Yang,Peiyu Yang,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ElasticKV 提出一种混合保真度 KV 运行时，通过引入紧凑中间 KV 状态并将保真度作为运行时管理的执行属性，缓解 LLM 服务中的 KV 缓存显存压力，在高并发下显著降低 TTFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 服务日益受限于 KV 缓存占用的 GPU 显存。现有压缩、驱逐、卸载技术虽能缓解压力，但运行时通常仅将配置的目标 KV 表示视为可执行状态；在显存压力下，这种"仅目标"契约会使 KV 短缺演变为请求停滞与抢占。作者观察到目标保真度不必然需要作为执行的门槛，因而寻求将保真度解耦为运行时可管理的属性。

Method: ElasticKV 引入一个紧凑的中间 KV 状态，使保真度成为运行时管理的执行属性。为在分页服务运行时中实现该状态，其结合三项技术：(i) 成对结构化布局，将保真度降低转化为可复用的 GPU 容量；(ii) 双模式注意力后端，可直接消费紧凑状态，同时保留原生"仅目标"路径；(iii) 压力感知的保真度管理，根据显存压力自适应调整 KV 保真度。

Result: 在多种工作负载、模型族与规模以及 GPU 平台上进行广泛评估，验证了 ElasticKV 的有效性与通用性。高并发场景下，相较 vLLM，ElasticKV 实现 3.8–4.0× 更低的 TTFT 以及 9.1× 更低的 P90 TTFT，同时保持生成质量。

Conclusion: ElasticKV 表明，将 KV 保真度从执行前置条件解耦为运行时管理属性，可有效缓解显存压力、避免请求停滞与抢占，并在保持生成质量的同时大幅提升高并发下的服务性能，具备良好的通用性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly constrained by the GPU memory consumed by key-value (KV) caches. Existing compression, eviction, and offloading techniques alleviate this pressure, but serving runtimes typically treat only the configured target KV representation as execution-ready. Under memory pressure, this target-only contract can turn KV shortage into request stalls and preemptions. We present ElasticKV, a mixed-fidelity KV runtime built on the observation that target fidelity need not gate execution. ElasticKV introduces a compact intermediate KV state, making fidelity a runtime-managed execution property. To realize this state in a paged serving runtime, ElasticKV combines (i) a pair-structured layout that turns fidelity reduction into reusable GPU capacity, (ii) a dual-mode attention backend that directly consumes the compact state while preserving the native target-only path, and (iii) pressure-aware fidelity management that adapts KV fidelity to memory pressure. Our extensive evaluation across diverse workloads, model families and scales, and GPU platforms demonstrates the effectiveness and generality of ElasticKV. Under high concurrency, ElasticKV achieves 3.8-4.0$\times$ lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) and 9.1$\times$ lower P90 TTFT than vLLM while preserving generation quality.

</details>


### [1147] [Fine Until Fine-Tuned: Repeated Solutions Make Reasoning Fragile](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33559)
*Ely Sheikh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 低数据重复式推理训练（如 s1、LIMO）在训练结束时看似无害，但会使模型推理对后续训练阶段变得脆弱；这种损伤源于重复看到相同文本，而非问题数量少，且可通过少量推理训练或格式训练低成本恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: s1、LIMO 等配方通过将同一批（千条以内）已解题目多次重复展示来教模型推理，且仅在训练结束时评估，因而重复看似无害。然而推理模型常会被再次训练，作者希望探究这种重复是否会给下一阶段训练埋下隐患，即便下一阶段与推理无关。

Method: 在 Qwen3.5-9B-Base 上用自己的竞赛数学正确解进行微调：一种是对几百道题各重复约八次（drilled），另一种是展示更多题目但只各看一次（once-trained），保证总训练量相同。随后施加普通指令微调等后续训练，并对比不同后续阶段、不同模型与任务、以及不同变体（如每次访问都用新解法的第三个模型、无重复但同等锐化的模型）。

Result: 同量训练下，两种模型在留出题上均约解出 95%。一次普通指令微调后，once-trained 模型保持原水平，drilled 模型降至 86.0%，更严苛的后续阶段进一步降至 59.3% 或更低。第三个模型访问次数相同但每次都是新解法，则未受损，说明损伤来自重复看到相同文本而非题目少。该现象在更强模型的轨迹、更多训练运行、其他模型与任务上重复出现。损伤可低成本撤销：推理只是被抑制而非抹除，五次推理训练更新即可几乎全部恢复，简短的无数学推理格式训练同样有效。新解法可预防损伤，在后一阶段更温和地重放 6.25% 原始解法也可预防。仅锐化不能解释该损伤。对于基座模型在 token 预算内无法完成的技能，重复主要损害学习效果。

Conclusion: 重复式低数据推理训练会在后续训练中造成推理脆弱性，其根源是重复接触相同文本，而非数据量少或锐化；该损伤可被少量推理或格式训练廉价逆转，且可通过使用新解法或适度重放原始解法加以预防。因此该结论适用于没有此类重放的后续训练。

Abstract: Recipes such as s1 and LIMO teach a model to reason with little data by showing it the same thousand or fewer worked solutions many times over. Judged when that training ends, the repetition looks harmless. But reasoning models are often trained again, and we find that repetition leaves their reasoning fragile to that next stage, even when the stage has nothing to do with reasoning. We fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B-Base on its own correct solutions to competition math problems, either drilling a few hundred of them about eight times each or showing many more once; with the same amount of training, both solve about 95% of held-out problems. A single pass of ordinary instruction tuning leaves the once-trained model where it was, while the drilled one falls to 86.0%, and harsher later stages take it to 59.3% or below. A third model that visited the drilled problems just as often, with a new solution at every visit, was unharmed, so the damage comes from seeing the same texts again rather than from having few problems. The break recurs with a stronger model's traces, in further training runs and on other models and tasks. It is also cheap to undo: the reasoning is suppressed rather than erased, and five updates of reasoning training bring almost all of it back, as does brief training on the reasoning format with almost no mathematics. Fresh solutions prevented the damage, and so did replaying 6.25% of the original solutions in a gentler later stage, so our claim concerns later training without such replay. Sharpening alone does not explain the break, since a model sharpened three-quarters as much without repetition was unharmed. On a skill the base model could not perform within a token budget, repetition mainly cost learning.

</details>


### [1148] [GraphSelect for Budgeted Representation Selection in Multimodal Graph Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33561)
*Xu Wang,Xunkai Li,Yinlin Zhu,Rong-Hua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出预算化表示选择任务，在文本与图像各自的容量约束下选取候选向量子集以保持多模态图预测；提出GraphSelect，通过联合评估的交换细化子集，在六个图上实现更高的目标恢复率，仅保留20%表示即可维持分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图预测器结合文本、图像与关系来分类相连实体，但完整输入代价高。核心问题是一个表示的重要性依赖于其他被选输入，且图传播会把其影响扩散到其他节点，导致现有归因/解释方法难以直接用于在模态容量约束下选择表示子集。

Method: 形式化"预算化表示选择"任务：在每种模态独立的容量下选取候选文本与图像向量子集，以完整候选输入的预测作为待保持的目标。实证分析表明：候选排序随已选输入变化；类别稳定后预测概率仍具信息量；更新分数可改善选择；即使容量已满，交换输入仍能改进子集。据此提出GraphSelect：从单个候选增益出发初始化，通过联合评估的交换迭代细化子集，筛选有潜力的删减与新增候选，当交换降低预测损失时接受并更新分数。

Result: 在六个图上，GraphSelect的平均目标恢复率高于六种适配到选择任务的归因与解释方法。在两个图上的九种已训练架构中，每模态仅保留20%候选表示，相对完整候选输入的平均准确率仅下降0.10个百分点，即以显著更少的文本与图像表示保持了分类性能。

Conclusion: 表示选择需考虑候选间交互与图传播带来的非局部影响；基于联合评估交换的GraphSelect能有效逼近完整输入下的预测，并在大幅压缩表示数量时保持分类性能，为多模态图模型的高效推理提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Multimodal graph predictors combine text, images, and relations to classify connected entities. How much of this input is needed to preserve their predictions? We study budgeted representation selection, which chooses a subset of candidate text and image vectors under a separate capacity for each modality. Predictions from the complete candidate input define the classes to preserve. The challenge is that a representation's contribution depends on the other selected inputs, while graph propagation extends its effects across nodes. Our empirical study shows that candidate rankings change with the selected input, while predicted probabilities remain informative after the class stops changing. Updating scores improves selection, and exchanging inputs can improve a subset whose capacity is already filled. These findings lead to GraphSelect, which starts from individual candidate gains and refines the subset through jointly evaluated exchanges. It screens promising removals and additions, accepts an exchange when it reduces the prediction loss, and updates the scores. Experiments on six graphs show higher mean objective recovery than six attribution and explanation methods adapted to the selection task. Across nine trained architectures on two graphs, retaining 20% of the candidate representations per modality gives a mean accuracy drop of 0.10 percentage points relative to full candidate input, preserving classification performance with substantially fewer text and image representations.

</details>


### [1149] [HiLoRe: What to Store, Compress, or Recompute for Efficient GRPO Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33570)
*Xinrui Chen,Mengyang Li,Ou Wu,Ji Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HiLoRe，将GRPO的策略更新暴露度形式化，并据此在高精度存储、低精度压缩与确定性重计算之间分配激活状态恢复策略，在受限显存下显著提升actor更新吞吐且几乎不损下游分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO训练中学习端激活是显存与计算的主要瓶颈；梯度检查点虽通过重计算降低激活显存，但固定调度在48-GB GPU上仍可能闲置约18 GB且重计算开销大。现有激活管理方法依据执行成本、张量属性或通用压缩敏感度设定状态保真度，未显式利用GRPO的解析更新结构来分配保真度。

Method: 作者将这种依赖形式化为策略更新暴露度，把当前GRPO损失系数与状态级近似敏感度关联起来；这些系数在反向传播前即可获得，无需额外反向传播。提出HiLoRe，基于测得的恢复效用与更新条件近似风险，将图属性恢复单元分配给高精度存储、低精度压缩和确定性重计算三类策略，并在校准的风险预算下组合三者。

Result: 在五种模型-任务设置、2K响应、且每GPU actor更新峰值显存低于GC的1.10倍条件下，HiLoRe的actor更新吞吐较GC提升达13.5%，较评估中最快基线提升7.9%，配对下游分数差异低于0.6个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式将GRPO解析更新结构纳入状态保真度分配可有效缓解激活显存-计算瓶颈，在近乎不变的显存预算与下游性能下获得可观吞吐提升。

Abstract: Group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) makes learner-side activations a major memory-computation bottleneck: gradient checkpointing reduces activation memory through recomputation, but fixed schedules can leave roughly 18 GB unused on a 48-GB GPU despite substantial recomputation overhead. Existing activation-management methods set state fidelity from execution cost, tensor properties, or generic compression sensitivity, without explicitly incorporating GRPO's analytic update structure into state-fidelity allocation. We formalize this dependence as policy-update exposure, linking the current GRPO loss coefficients to state-level approximation sensitivity. These coefficients are available before backward without an additional backward pass. We introduce HiLoRe, which allocates graph-attributed recovery units among high-precision storage, low-precision compression, and deterministic recomputation using measured recovery utility and update-conditioned approximation risk. It combines high-precision storage and deterministic recomputation with low-precision recovery under a calibrated risk budget. Across five model-task settings with 2K responses and memory < 1.10 times GC's per-GPU actor-update peak, HiLoRe's actor-update throughput gains reach 13.5% over GC and 7.9% over the fastest evaluated baseline, with paired mean downstream-score differences below 0.6 percentage points.

</details>


### [1150] [Approximating Softmax in Pretrained LLMs: Model Sensitivity and Kernel Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33586)
*Shangzhen Zhu,Muyan Hu,Tomasz Kozlowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作分析预训练Transformer推理时softmax的真实需求，提出以行最大值为锚点的粗粒度对数权重表示Rowmax-PoT及硬件特化Rowmax-H15，在B200上实现注意力加速并保持困惑度小幅变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在NVIDIA Blackwell B200上，张量核吞吐量比特殊函数指数吞吐量高出两个数量级以上，使得融合注意力核中的指数求值成为瓶颈；但预训练Transformer可能并不需要对每个元素都精确求值softmax。

Method: 在十个冻结的decoder-only模型（0.5B-72B）上进行推理期softmax近似，刻画模型所需的softmax特性；据此提出Rowmax-PoT（以每行最大值为锚点的粗粒度对数权重表示）及其在FlashAttention-4中的硬件特化Rowmax-H15。

Result: softmax分配概率的位置数量和行内分辨率可大幅削减，但对相同位置做均匀加权有害；固定分辨率预算的放置位置与大小同等重要，靠近行最大值处始终更受偏好；标量失真匹配的扰动会产生模型相关且符号相反的响应。B200上，补丁后的FP8注意力前向在因果8K下快12.4%，非因果8K下快25.8%；因果16K下每次前向的板级能耗下降8.4%。在BF16内核路径2K下单独测量，Rowmax-H15使五个模型（三个家族）的困惑度上升0.091-0.492%。

Conclusion: 预训练模型对softmax精度需求具有结构性偏好，将分辨率集中于行最大值附近的粗粒度对数权重表示可在几乎不影响困惑度的前提下显著提升注意力计算效率并降低能耗。

Abstract: On NVIDIA Blackwell B200, tensor-core throughput outpaces special-function exponential throughput by more than two orders of magnitude, exposing exponential evaluation in fused attention kernels. A pretrained Transformer, however, may not need it evaluated accurately at every element. We characterize what a pretrained model does need by approximating softmax at inference in ten frozen decoder-only models (0.5B-72B). The number of positions the softmax map assigns probability to and within-row resolution can be cut substantially, yet uniform weighting of the same positions is damaging. Where a fixed resolution budget is placed matters as much as its size, with resolution near the row maximum consistently favored. Perturbations matched on scalar distortion produce model-dependent responses of opposite sign. These findings motivate Rowmax-PoT, a coarse logarithmic weight representation anchored at each row maximum, and Rowmax-H15, its hardware specialization in FlashAttention-4. On B200, the patched FP8 attention forward is 12.4% faster at causal 8K and 25.8% faster at non-causal 8K in host-side call-latency measurements; board energy per forward falls by 8.4% at causal 16K. Measured separately on the BF16 kernel path at 2K, Rowmax-H15 increases perplexity by 0.091-0.492% across five models from three families.

</details>


### [1151] [Pretraining Transformers with Quantized Softmax in Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33591)
*Shangzhen Zhu,Muyan Hu,Tomasz Kozlowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究低精度Transformer中近似softmax的量化方案，提出K-interval attention（用K+1个网格值近似指数函数），系统比较逐行标定、插值vs硬舍入、直通代理位置等设计选择，并推导相应反向传播规则，在匹配的预训练实验中给出验证损失差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度Transformer系统越来越多地对注意力矩阵乘法进行量化，但softmax通常保持较高精度。训练时近似softmax不仅改变前向计算，还改变用于训练模型的梯度。作者希望理解这种前向与反向的交互作用，从而指导量化设计选择。

Method: 提出K-interval attention：用K+1个网格值近似指数函数。变化三个维度：（1）逐行网格标定（min-max标定 vs 固定窗口标定）；（2）插值 vs 硬舍入；（3）直通代理（straight-through surrogate）相对归一化的位置（归一化前 vs 归一化后）。推导包括标定导数在内的反向传播规则，并在模型、数据、优化器匹配的预训练实验中比较各选择。

Result: 分离（detach）行极值不改变前向计算，但导致验证损失延迟上升。K=4硬舍入时，min-max标定与归一化前代理产生较大损失差距；改变任一选择可显著减小差距。124M参数、2.5B训练token下，固定窗口标定+归一化后代理在K=4时相对softmax的验证损失差距为+0.019 nats；归一化前代理在K=16时为+0.004 nats。

Conclusion: 近似softmax的前向与反向设计选择显著影响预训练质量。标定方式与代理位置是关键因素：固定窗口标定配合归一化后代理可在较低K下获得较小损失差距，而提高K（至16）配合归一化前代理可将差距进一步缩小至+0.004 nats。梯度层面的设计（标定导数、代理位置）与前向近似同等重要。

Abstract: Low-precision Transformer systems increasingly quantize attention matrix multiplications, while softmax often remains at higher precision. During pretraining, an approximate softmax changes the gradients that train the model as well as its forward computation. We study this interaction with K-interval attention, which approximates the exponential using K+1 grid values. We vary per-row grid calibration, interpolation versus hard rounding, and the placement of a straight-through surrogate relative to normalization. We derive the corresponding backward rules, including calibration derivatives, and compare these choices in pretraining experiments matched on model, data, and optimizer. Detaching the row extrema leaves the forward computation unchanged but produces a delayed increase in validation loss. With hard rounding at K=4, min-max calibration and a pre-normalization surrogate incur a large loss gap; changing either choice substantially reduces it. At 124M parameters and 2.5B training tokens, fixed-window calibration with a post-normalization surrogate yields a validation loss gap of +0.019 nats relative to softmax at K=4, and with a pre-normalization surrogate yields +0.004 nats at K=16.

</details>


### [1152] [Short-Length Code Designs for Integrated Sensing and Communications: A Deep Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33605)
*Muah Kim,Shuangyang Li,Tayyebeh Jahani-Nezhad,Rafael F. Schaefer,Giuseppe Caire*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自编码器（AE）的非相干ISAC波形设计框架：先推导多目标时延估计的修正Cramér-Rao界与非相干相关衰落下的最大似然译码规则，揭示通信与感知目标间的结构联系与权衡，再由AE学习联合优化两类功能的波形表示，并通过可调参数控制权衡；仿真表明该方案在短块长与衰落条件下优于传统方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC虽可共享波形同时实现通信与感知，但两类目标存在固有折衷，信号设计困难，在短块长（short blocklength）场景下尤为突出；且非相干、相关衰落条件下的波形设计缺乏针对性的理论分析支撑。

Method: 1）理论分析：推导多目标时延估计的修正Cramér-Rao界（modified CRB），并分析相关衰落信道下非相干通信的最大似然译码规则，据此刻画通信与感知目标之间的结构联系与权衡；2）算法设计：构建自编码器（AE）框架，学习联合优化通信与感知性能的波形表示，引入可调参数以控制两目标的折衷。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提设计在通信可靠性（communication reliability）与感知精度（sensing accuracy）两方面均优于传统方案，在短块长与衰落条件下优势尤为明显。

Conclusion: 基于AE的波形设计框架能够有效处理非相干ISAC中的通信—感知折衷，实现两类功能的联合优化，并为短块长、衰落环境下的ISAC波形设计提供了可行的分析与设计范式。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables joint communication and sensing using a shared waveform, but its signal design is challenging due to the inherent trade-off between the two objectives, particularly in the short blocklength regime. This paper proposes an autoencoder (AE)-based framework for ISAC waveform design in noncoherent settings.
  We derive a modified Cramér-Rao bound for multi-target delay estimation and analyze the maximum-likelihood decoding rule for noncoherent communication under correlated fading. These results reveal structural connections and trade-offs between communication and sensing objectives in waveform design.
  Based on this analysis, the AE learns waveform representations that jointly optimize both functionalities, with a tunable parameter controlling the trade-off. Simulation results show that the proposed design outperforms conventional schemes in both communication reliability and sensing accuracy, especially under short blocklength and fading conditions.

</details>


### [1153] [Hierarchical Response Preservation for Continual Adaptation of Zero-Shot Graph-Text Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33607)
*Haopeng Zhang,Yuhan Wang,Yubing Su,Yingxin Chen,Xiao Wang,Ruijie Wang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出层次化响应保持方法HiRP，用于图-文本预训练模型的类增量学习，在保持零样本迁移能力的同时学习新类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图-文本预训练模型可对齐图表示与文本语义，支持未见类识别和跨域迁移。但当图数据和类别持续到来时，模型需在从新监督中学习的同时，既保留零样本迁移能力，又保留历史任务知识。由此产生两个挑战：新类别可能推翻历史预测（尽管历史类间区分度仍被保留），以及过度严格的响应保持会阻碍新类学习。

Method: 提出层次化响应保持（HiRP）。该方法用层次化响应刻画竞争关系：保留每个历史类别的概率，并将新类别概率求和，从而在保持历史类间区分度和聚合竞争的同时，允许新类组内部区分度自适应调整。进一步利用该响应诱导的几何结构指导约束更新，在保留有用适应方向的同时控制响应漂移。

Result: 在三种类增量设置下，HiRP相较各设置中最强对比基线在平均准确率上取得1.84–7.95个百分点的绝对提升，同时缓解了零样本迁移性能退化。

Conclusion: HiRP通过层次化响应保持与几何引导的约束更新，有效平衡了新类学习、历史知识保持与零样本迁移能力，验证了其在类增量图-文本预训练场景中的有效性。

Abstract: Pretrained graph-text models align graph representations with textual semantics, enabling recognition of unseen classes and transfer across graph domains. However, as graph data and classes continually arrive, models should learn from new supervision while retaining their zero-shot transfer capabilities and historical task knowledge. Two challenges arise: (i) new classes can overturn historical predictions despite preserved distinctions among historical classes, and (ii) overly strict response preservation can stall learning of new classes. To address these challenges, we propose Hierarchical Response Preservation (HiRP). HiRP represents this competition through a hierarchical response that keeps each historical-class probability and sums new-class probabilities, preserving historical distinctions and aggregate competition while allowing distinctions within the new class group to adapt. It further uses the geometry induced by this response to guide constrained updates, retaining useful adaptation directions while controlling response drift. Across three class-incremental settings, HiRP achieves absolute gains of 1.84-7.95 percentage points in average accuracy over the strongest compared baseline in each setting, while mitigating zero-shot transfer degradation.

</details>


### [1154] [You Only Edit Once: Incentivizing In-Context Capability of LLMs via Local Demonstration Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33609)
*Jiarong Wen,Qi Wang,Yun Qu,Yixiu Mao,Heming Zou,Haoang Chi,Lizhou Cai,Yiqin Lv,Kaiyu Zhang,Yuhang Jiang,Xiangyang Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将演示集选择重构为受限局部搜索问题，提出局部演示编辑（LDE），并训练小模型Jev-LDE通过单次结构化编辑提升大模型上下文学习性能，兼顾效果与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICL效果高度依赖演示集选择，而穷举搜索是组合爆炸问题；现有选择器多依赖相关性或似然代理间接评估ICL质量，需对目标LLM反复查询，成本高昂。

Method: 将演示选择建模为受限局部搜索，从初始检索的演示集出发，用单次结构化编辑探索邻域；把该问题归约为策略搜索，用带可验证奖励的强化学习训练小LLM（Jev-LDE）作为System-1，执行Keep/Delete/Replace动作；测试时仅做一次编辑加一次目标LLM推理。

Result: 在标准分类基准和多种目标LLM上，Jev-LDE作为即插即用模块一致提升ICL性能；无需重训练即可迁移到未见过基准与模型。

Conclusion: LDE为利用目标LLM的ICL能力提供了一种高效且可适配的方法。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is crucial for boosting the inference performance of large language models (LLMs). However, the effectiveness of ICL in LLMs is greatly influenced by the choice of demonstration sets. Exhaustive searches over these sets are combinatorial, and existing selectors often rely on relevance or likelihood proxies to implicitly assess ICL quality. Making repeated queries to the target LLM with these strategies can incur substantial costs. This work simplifies selection by framing it as a constrained local search problem and presents local demonstration editing (LDE). Starting with an initially retrieved set of demonstrations, LDE employs a single structured edit to explore its surrounding neighborhood while balancing performance gains with search costs. Technically, LDE is reduced to a policy search problem, for which we train a small LLM, referred to as Jev-LDE. This model as the System-1 modifies the retrieved demonstration set by performing actions such as \texttt{Keep}, \texttt{Delete}, or \texttt{Replace} elements, all within a framework of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. At test time, Jev-LDE executes a single edit of the retrieved demonstration set, followed by one inference from the target LLM, avoiding the need for iterative context scoring or subset searches. Across standard classification benchmarks, various target LLMs with Jev-LDE as the plug-and-play module consistently improve ICL performance, and Jev-LDE shows transferability to held-out benchmarks and models without retraining. These findings indicate that the LDE approach offers an efficient and adaptable method for harnessing the ICL capabilities of target LLMs.

</details>


### [1155] [Climbing the Hill: Prompt Injection Red-Teaming Against Frontier Models with Curriculum Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33628)
*Chenlong Yin,Xiaolong Jin,Wei Zou,Yanting Wang,Jinyuan Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于课程学习的攻击者LLM训练方法，通过逐级对抗越来越强的目标LLM并配合热启动，解决针对前沿LLM的提示注入红队测试中的冷启动问题，攻击成功率显著优于现有RL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示注入是LLM及LLM应用（如智能体）的主要安全风险。现有基于强化学习的红队方法在攻击前沿LLM时面临冷启动问题：攻击者LLM的所有攻击尝试均失败、奖励恒为零，无法获得有效学习信号。因此需要一种机制让攻击者在强目标上仍能获得非零学习信号。

Method: 采用课程学习策略训练攻击者LLM：让攻击者依次对抗一系列鲁棒性递增的目标LLM，每一阶段从上一阶段得到的攻击者模型进行热启动（warm-start），从而形成渐进式课程。关键在于课程设计——每阶段结束后攻击者需对下一目标取得"部分成功"，即已具备一定成功率，才能从成功攻击中学习；仅对抗弱目标（如GPT-4o-mini）不足以过渡到前沿目标（如GPT-5.6-Terra）。

Result: 在AgentDyn上，该方法对GPT-5.6-Luna和GPT-5.6-Terra的攻击成功率ASR@10分别达93.8%和45.0%，而当前最先进的RL方法RL-Hammer和PISmith在同一设置下ASR均为0%。此外，攻击者LLM具有跨目标迁移能力：针对某一强LLM（GPT-5.6-Terra）训练的攻击者，还能成功攻击另外六个未训练过的前沿LLM（如GPT-6-Luna）。

Conclusion: 课程学习可有效缓解针对前沿LLM红队测试的冷启动问题，显著提升攻击成功率，且学到的攻击策略具备跨模型迁移性，为LLM提示注入安全评估提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Prompt injection is a leading security risk for LLMs and LLM-based applications such as agents. State-of-the-art red-teaming methods for prompt injection leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to train an attacker LLM to generate effective injected prompts. However, when targeting frontier LLMs such as GPT-6-Luna, a major challenge is the cold-start problem: every attack attempt by the attacker LLM fails and thus receives zero reward, providing no signal for learning. In this work, we propose a curriculum learning-based method to address the cold-start problem. In particular, we propose to train the attacker LLM against a sequence of increasingly robust target LLMs, with each stage warm-starting from the attacker LLM obtained in the previous one. However, simply training against a weak target (e.g., GPT-4o-mini) may not sufficiently prepare the attacker LLM to obtain useful learning signals against a frontier LLM (e.g., GPT-5.6-Terra). Instead, we find that the design of the curriculum is critical: after each stage, the attacker LLM needs to partially succeed against the next target LLM such that it can learn from successful attempts to attack the new target. Our extensive evaluation shows that our method can effectively red-team frontier LLMs, achieving an attack success rate (ASR@10) of 93.8\% and 45.0\% against GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-5.6-Terra on AgentDyn, whereas state-of-the-art RL methods such as RL-Hammer and PISmith achieve 0\% ASR under the same setting. Moreover, we find that the attacker LLM transfers across targets, e.g., an attacker LLM trained to defeat one strong LLM (GPT-5.6-Terra) also succeeds against six other frontier LLMs (e.g., GPT-6-Luna) it was never trained on. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/albert-y1n/PIForge}{here}.

</details>


### [1156] [SafeMol: Dual-Modality Safety Alignment for Molecular Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33640)
*Xinmiao Wang,Ruijie Wang,Menghui Wang,Jiawei Chen,Haoyue Deng,Ran Zhang,Xingxuan Zhang,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示分子多模态模型在文本与图条件输入下均存在显著越狱漏洞，提出安全对齐基准SafeMolBench与参数高效框架SafeMol，在降低攻击成功率的同时抑制过度拒答并保持任务效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子多模态模型支持多样理解与生成任务，但在处理危险分子时可能引入安全漏洞；安全鲁棒性需跨输入模态成立，并需兼顾安全性、过度拒答与任务效用之间的平衡。

Method: 构建SafeMolBench基准（3702个样本、618种独特危险分子），划分为hazardous-harmful、hazardous-allowed、utility-replay三类子集；提出SafeMol参数高效安全对齐框架，联合优化文本与图条件输入的轻量模块，采用MMD进行分布级表征对齐以缓解模态差异，并显式建模分子危害性与有害操作意图。

Result: 在SafeMolBench上，SafeMol将攻击成功率降低数十个百分点，同时基本维持较低的过度拒答率并保留分子任务效用。

Conclusion: SafeMol验证了跨模态安全对齐在分子多模态场景下的有效性，为统一评估与提升安全性、过度拒答和效用三者的平衡提供了基准与方法。

Abstract: Molecular multimodal models support diverse understanding and generation tasks but may introduce safety vulnerabilities when handling hazardous molecules. In this work, We reveal substantial jailbreak vulnerabilities under both text-only and graph-conditioned settings. Our analysis further shows that safety robustness must hold across input modalities while balancing safety, over-refusal, and utility. To address these challenges, we construct SafeMolBench, a molecular multimodal safety-alignment benchmark with 3702 samples covering 618 unique hazardous molecules and safe molecular tasks, organized into hazardous-harmful, hazardous-allowed, and utility-replay subsets to support unified training and evaluation of safety, over-refusal, and utility. Based on SafeMolBench, we propose SafeMol, a parameter-efficient safety alignment framework that jointly optimizes lightweight modules across text-only and graph-conditioned inputs, uses MMD for distribution-level representation alignment to reduce modality-induced discrepancies, and explicitly models molecular hazardousness and harmful operational intent. Experiments on SafeMolBench show that SafeMol reduces attack success by several tens of percentage points while largely maintaining low over-refusal and preserving molecular-task utility.

</details>


### [1157] [FuseAlign: Forced Alignment in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33650)
*Mithilesh Vaidya,Stephen Bailey,Sumukh Badam,Matthew Bendel,Xingzhe He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对词级强制对齐评估失真问题，提出改进指标、面向真实ASR转写稿的评分协议和AlignBench基准，并提出FuseAlign对齐器，在多样条件下显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有词级强制对齐评估依赖短时、干净语音、完美转写稿及掩盖关键错误的指标，低估了对齐难度；而真实媒体与数据处理流程面对的是长时、多样录音以及易错的ASR输出，亟需更贴近实际的评估与更强鲁棒的对齐方法。

Method: 提出改进的评估指标、针对真实ASR转写稿的评分协议，以及覆盖说话人、声学和文本多样条件的AlignBench基准；提出FuseAlign，基于大规模伪标注语音训练并结合在线标签纠正的Transformer对齐器，联合上下文化音频与文本以定位粗粒度词，再以毫秒级分辨率细化边界，并在无需词典或Viterbi解码的情况下检测音频中缺失的转写词。

Result: 在AlignBench上，FuseAlign大幅超越所有基线，并在真实ASR转写稿条件下保持稳健；消融实验显示卷积上采样与EMA快照标签纠正比参数量等模型属性更为关键。

Conclusion: 该工作通过更严谨的评估与基准揭示了强制对齐的真实难度，并证明联合音文上下文化、多分辨率边界细化与在线标签纠正是提升对齐鲁棒性的关键，为真实ASR场景下的对齐提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Word-level forced alignment estimates when each transcript word occurs in an audio recording. It underpins text-based media editing, subtitling, speech-data curation, and phonetic analysis. Existing evaluations understate the difficulty of forced alignment by relying on short, clean speech, perfect transcripts, and metrics that obscure consequential alignment errors. In contrast, real-world media and data-processing pipelines operate on long and diverse recordings. Additionally, forced aligners often operate on error-prone automatic speech recognition (ASR) output. We address these gaps with improved evaluation metrics, a scoring protocol for real ASR transcripts, and AlignBench, a benchmark spanning diverse speaker, acoustic, and text conditions. We further introduce FuseAlign, a transformer-based aligner trained on large-scale pseudo-labeled speech with online label correction. FuseAlign performs joint contextualization of audio and text for the localization of coarse words. The model then refines boundaries at millisecond resolution and detects missing transcript words in the audio without lexicon-based or Viterbi decoding. On AlignBench, FuseAlign substantially outperforms all baselines and remains robust under real ASR transcripts. Ablations show that convolutional upsampling and EMA-snapshot label correction matter more than model properties such as parameter count.

</details>


### [1158] [Towards Eliminating Catastrophic Forgetting in the Curriculum Learning of Math Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33655)
*Zengyan Yang,Yangyang Wu,Kai Huang,Pengfei Lyu,Tianyi Zhang,Mengying Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析课程学习中的灾难性遗忘现象，从参数更新动力学角度证明遗忘源于任务最优解的差异且无法完全消除，并提出IV-EWC方法（基于影响函数构建验证集驱动EWC动态正则化）来缓解数学推理场景下的遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 课程学习应用广泛，但其有效性受灾难性遗忘制约，根源在于课程任务间模型参数分布的偏移。作者希望深入探究该训练范式下灾难性遗忘的机理，并在不牺牲课程学习快速收敛优势的前提下缓解遗忘。

Method: 1) 对参数更新动力学进行理论分析，揭示遗忘源于课程任务最优解的差异；2) 提出IV-EWC，将弹性权重巩固（EWC）融入课程学习目标；3) 使用影响函数从课程训练数据中构造具有代表性的验证集，用于驱动训练中的动态正则化；4) 给出扩展理论分析，论证基于EWC的正则化方法可缓解课程学习中的灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在三个骨干模型和三个基准上的实证评估表明：课程学习确实存在灾难性遗忘；IV-EWC缓解了该问题，相较于原始课程学习平均减少162%的遗忘，并产生正向后向迁移（即完成困难任务训练后在更简单任务上性能提升）。

Conclusion: 课程学习中的灾难性遗忘源于任务最优解的分歧，而该分歧正是课程学习快速收敛的必要条件，因此遗忘无法完全消除；IV-EWC通过影响函数驱动的动态EWC正则化有效缓解遗忘，并在数学推理这一典型课程学习场景中实现正向后向迁移。

Abstract: Curriculum learning has found broad application across numerous domains. Nevertheless, its effectiveness is intrinsically curtailed by catastrophic forgetting, driven by the shifts in model parameter distributions between curriculum tasks. In this paper, we investigate the phenomenon of catastrophic forgetting in this training paradigm, building on the established efficacy of curriculum learning. Our theoretical analyses of parameter update dynamics demonstrate that catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning stems from the divergence of task optima, which is generally essential to the faster convergence of curriculum learning; therefore, forgetting cannot be completely eliminated. Based on this finding, we augment the training process and propose IV-EWC, which incorporates Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) into the curriculum learning objective to curb catastrophic forgetting in mathematical reasoning, a prototypical curriculum learning scenario. IV-EWC employs the influence function to construct a representative validation set from the curriculum's training data, which is used to drive dynamic regularization during training. We further present an extended theoretical analysis to show that EWC-based regularization methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning, thereby providing theoretical support for IV-EWC. Empirical evaluations on three backbone models and three benchmarks indicate that curriculum learning exhibits catastrophic forgetting. IV-EWC alleviates this issue, reducing forgetting by 162% on average relative to vanilla curriculum learning and yielding positive backward transfer, as evidenced by improved performance on easier tasks after subsequent training on challenging tasks.

</details>


### [1159] [Scalable Attribution and Control of Model Behavior During Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33667)
*Sleem Abdelghafar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过互信息量化训练批次内样本贡献的相互干扰，提出行为梯度唯一性（BGU）指标及Batch-Space Ghost（BS-Ghost）算法，实现训练循环内高效、可干预的样本贡献归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练中需在下次更新前快速识别每个样本对模型行为的贡献，但同一批次内样本产生相似的行为变化，导致个体贡献难以区分，存在归因模糊性问题。

Method: 用互信息刻画批次内干扰，量化"组合行为变化"揭示单个样本贡献的程度；证明该互信息是BGU的对数函数，为信息度量提供几何解释；提出BS-Ghost算法，通过批空间共享计算实现分数计算，无需存储与模型同规模的逐样本梯度。

Result: 在完整的1,000样本Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct工作负载上，BS-Ghost仅使5.5分钟常规训练增加27秒（8.0%）；删除并重训实验表明BGU能识别因果影响最终行为的数据；每步的带符号信息可判别样本是增强还是削弱目标行为；并可预测样本权重调整对下一次更新的行为影响，用于选择权重以引导行为。

Conclusion: 该框架为训练流程的可扩展监督与验证提供了实用基础，有助于评估者评估模型对齐、理解其在训练中的发展过程，并通过干预引导持续学习。

Abstract: Attributing and controlling model behavior during training requires identifying each example's contribution quickly enough to act before the next update. However, examples in the same training batch can produce similar behavioral changes, making their individual contributions difficult to distinguish. We address this ambiguity through mutual information, accounting for interference within the batch by quantifying how much the combined behavioral change reveals about each example's contribution. We show that this mutual information is a logarithmic function of Behavioral Gradient Uniqueness (BGU). BGU gives the information measure its geometric interpretation. Our Batch-Space Ghost (BS-Ghost) algorithm makes these scores practical inside the training loop through shared computation in batch space, without storing model-sized example gradients. On a complete 1,000-example Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct workload, our BS-Ghost implementation adds 27 seconds (8.0%) to 5.5 minutes of ordinary training. Removal and retraining demonstrate that BGU identifies data that causally shapes final behavior. At each training step, signed information identifies which examples strengthen or weaken the target behavior, explaining how behavior develops during training. Signed information also enables cheap intervention during training: it predicts how changing example weights will affect behavior in the next update. We then use these predictions to choose weights that steer behavior toward a desired target. This makes our framework a practical foundation for scalable oversight and verification of training pipelines and processes, helping evaluators assess model alignment, understand how it develops during training, and guide interventions that shape ongoing learning.

</details>


### [1160] [Reachability is not enough: Diagnosing long-range behavior in GNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33674)
*Filippo Maria Bianchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个框架，量化图神经网络预测对各图距离输入的依赖强度，并区分架构、有限近似、训练与数值执行四类限制，指出"长程能力"取决于学会使用任务所需距离的信息并在计算中保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN常因架构可连接远距离节点而被称作"长程"模型，但架构上的可达性并不等于实际正确使用远距离信息。现有评估缺乏对"距离—影响"关系的量化，也无法定位性能瓶颈来自架构、有限近似、训练还是数值执行，导致低平均误差可能掩盖远距离交互上的失败。

Method: 构建一个分析框架：测量各图距离上的输入对预测的影响强度（距离—影响曲线）；将限制来源分解为架构、有限近似、训练、数值执行四类；在受控任务上对比架构可达性相近、但数学等价的滤波器在可学习性与数值可靠性上的差异。

Result: 局部消息传递会使影响传播缓慢，有限实现可能主要依赖近邻输入，即便理想计算使用全图；数学等价的滤波器在学习难度与运行可靠性上存在差异；架构可达性相近的模型对远距离信息的实际使用差异很大；低平均误差会掩盖远距离交互的失败。

Conclusion: 长程能力并非架构属性，而取决于两方面：学习使用任务所需距离上的信息，以及在计算过程中保持这种使用。评估GNN需超越架构可达性与平均误差，考察实际的距离依赖结构。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are often called long-range because their architecture can connect distant nodes, but this does not show whether they use distant information correctly. We introduce a framework that measures how strongly inputs at each graph distance affect predictions and separates limitations due to architecture, finite approximation, training, and numerical execution. Our analysis shows that local message-passing can spread influence slowly, so a finite implementation may rely mainly on nearby inputs even when the ideal computation uses the whole graph. We also explain why mathematically equivalent filters can differ in how easily they are learned and how reliably they run. Across controlled tasks, models with similar architectural reach use distant information very differently, while low average error can hide failures on distant interactions. Together, these results show that long-range capability depends on learning to use information at the distances required by the task and preserving that use during computation.

</details>


### [1161] [T-MoXAI: A Hierarchical Explainability Framework for Temporal Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33685)
*Ali Inha,Mo Vali,Saaliha Vali,Pietro Liò,Meen-Yau Thum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: T-MoXAI是一个面向时序多模态数据的层次化可解释AI框架，能够同时解释"何时""哪个模态""哪些特征"三个层面的决策依据，在IVF结局预测与小麦产量预测两个真实任务上验证了其有效性与时序建模的关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序多模态AI模型在医疗与农业领域潜力巨大，但模型不透明会限制信任与采纳；同时该领域的可解释性研究较为碎片化，缺乏统一、跨领域的框架。

Method: 提出T-MoXAI层次化框架：(1) 用时序Shapley值解释哪些时间点影响预测；(2) 用注意力分析解释这些时刻哪些模态有贡献；(3) 用基于梯度的归因解释哪些特征或图像区域驱动决策。采用基于Transformer的架构处理不规则时序与异构数据，可在一秒内生成三层解释，支持交互式决策。

Result: 在两个真实任务上评估：基于超声序列与临床测量预测IVF治疗结局（AUC 0.660，类别高度不平衡）；基于时序RGB影像与表型性状预测小麦产量（R² 0.265，环境变异大）。消融实验表明时序建模在两个领域均至关重要，移除后性能降至随机猜测水平；时序ROAR实验为解释反映模型推理过程提供了证据。

Conclusion: T-MoXAI以统一的、领域无关的架构和开源实现，为时序多模态可解释AI提供了基线，缓解了该领域研究碎片化的问题，适用于决策理解与预测精度同等重要的应用场景。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models for temporal multimodal data have potential in healthcare and agriculture, but their opacity can limit trust and adoption. We introduce T-MoXAI (Temporal Multimodal eXplainable AI), a hierarchical framework explaining (1) when timepoints influence predictions, using temporal Shapley values; (2) which modalities contribute at those moments, using attention analysis; and (3) what features or image regions drive decisions, using gradient based attribution. A transformer based architecture handles irregular temporal sequences and heterogeneous data, generating all three explanation levels in under one second for interactive decision support. We evaluate the framework on two real world tasks: predicting IVF treatment outcomes from ultrasound sequences and clinical measurements (AUC 0.660 despite significant class imbalance), and forecasting wheat yield from temporal RGB imagery and phenotypic traits ($R^2$ 0.265 amid substantial environmental variability). Ablation studies indicate that temporal modelling is critical in both domains: removing it reduces performance to the equivalent of random guessing. Temporal ROAR experiments provide evidence that the explanations reflect the model's reasoning process. With a unified, domain agnostic architecture and open source implementation, T-MoXAI provides a baseline for temporal multimodal XAI, addressing fragmentation in the field and supporting applications where understanding decisions is as important as predictive accuracy.

</details>


### [1162] [Geometric Inductive Biases for Semi-Supervised Equalization: The Constellation-Aware Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33695)
*Avi Caciularu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出星座感知Transformer（CAT），将几何归纳偏置显式注入信道均衡过程，用自定义TransFIRmer块以"早期交互"方式协同处理接收信号与理想星座符号，在少导频半监督场景下性能优于VAE与标准Transformer基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一代通信中，在未知信道上以极小导频开销解码信号是关键挑战。现有深度学习方法多依赖通用编码器，难以建模长程时序依赖，也难以从稀缺数据中高效捕捉信道物理特性；同时标准架构存在"不可知估计鸿沟"，需要隐式学习本已已知的星座几何结构。

Method: 提出星座感知Transformer（CAT），将几何归纳偏置显式注入均衡过程。CAT由堆叠的自定义TransFIRmer块组成，采用"早期交互"范式协同处理接收信号与理想星座符号。每个块含分离式前馈网络：一路为受FIR启发的滤波器用于解卷积，另一路为并行MLP用于几何精修。设计在结构上与最优线性（MIMO Wiener）接收机对齐：注意力可实现匹配滤波组，双向FIR分支提供块MMSE均衡所需的非因果滤波。

Result: 在半监督设置下，CAT所需导频少于VAE和标准Transformer基线：在三个ISI信道中的两个上，CAT用64个导频即达到比它们用128个导频更低的SER。

Conclusion: 通过将星座几何与信道物理结构作为归纳偏置显式注入Transformer架构，可在极低导频开销下显著提升均衡性能，并揭示了所提结构与最优线性接收机之间的理论一致性。

Abstract: Decoding signals over unknown channels with minimal pilot overhead is a critical challenge in next-generation communications. Existing deep learning approaches typically rely on generic encoders that struggle to model long-range temporal dependencies or efficiently capture the channel's physical properties from scarce data. We argue that standard architectures suffer from agnostic estimation gaps, as they must implicitly learn the constellation geometry that is already known. We introduce the Constellation-Aware Transformer (CAT), a novel architecture that explicitly injects geometric inductive biases into the equalization process. CAT is composed of a stack of custom TransFIRmer blocks, which use an "early interaction" paradigm to co-process received signals and ideal constellation symbols. Each block features a split Feed-Forward Network that applies a Finite Impulse Response (FIR)-inspired filter for deconvolution and a parallel MLP for geometric refinement. We show that this design is structurally aligned with the optimal linear (MIMO Wiener) receiver: its attention can implement a matched-filter bank, and its bidirectional FIR branch provides the non-causal filtering that block MMSE equalization requires. In the semi-supervised setting, CAT needs fewer pilots than VAE and standard Transformer baselines: on two of our three ISI channels, it reaches a lower SER with 64 pilots than they do with 128.

</details>


### [1163] [A Spectral Theory of Compositional Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33708)
*Hugo Rydel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过分析深度线性网络在结构化合成环境中的学习动力学，建立经验结构与组合推理涌现之间的数学理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究组合推理在学习过程中如何涌现，并解释人类认知中若干与组合推理相关的现象。

Method: 对深度线性网络的学习动力学进行数学分析，并在结构化合成环境中训练网络，推导连接经验结构与组合学习的理论。

Result: 理论 predicts 组合推理何时涌现、是否可从现有证据中辨识，以及新的连接证据如何快速解锁先前不可用的推理；并解释了三类认知现象。

Conclusion: 这些发现建立了经验统计结构与组合推理发展之间的数学联系。

Abstract: How does compositional reasoning emerge during learning? We address this question by mathematically analyzing the learning dynamics of deep linear networks. We train these networks in structured synthetic environments and derive a theory linking the structure of experience to compositional learning. Our theory predicts when compositional inferences emerge, whether they are identifiable from the available evidence, and how new linking evidence can rapidly unlock previously unavailable inferences. These results provide a qualitative explanation for several phenomena observed in human cognition. They account for why a composition can fail despite knowing its premises, why similar compositions can emerge at different times, and how a single linking fact can suddenly enable many new inferences. Taken together, these findings establish a mathematical link between the statistical structure of experience and the development of compositional reasoning.

</details>


### [1164] [DuoOPD: Learning from Joint Teacher-Student Outcomes for Multi-Task On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33711)
*Ao Yu,Weibo Gao,Heng Zhou,Linan Yue,Rui Li,Suyi Liu,Yu Yan,Yizhong Zhang,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DuoOPD，用学生结果决定蒸馏反馈方向，用师生联合结果决定教师支持方式，统一规则覆盖四种结果组合，在 Qwen3 与 Llama 上平均宏准确率超越五个基线，较 OPD 分别提升 2.58 与 5.98 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation（OPD）仅依赖 token 级教师反馈，忽略了作答结果信息：教师可能在学生已答对的题目上出错，且各模型在不同任务上的成功率差异较大。OPD 对这些结果不敏感，平均而言会压低学生本已正确的回答；而以学生正确性对反馈做门控虽能修正方向，却仍无视教师是否成功，对教师的利用方式没有区分。

Method: DuoOPD 由两层信号驱动：学生结果决定反馈方向，师生联合结果决定教师的支持方式。四种结果组合由单一规则统一覆盖，无需任务特定设置。当仅教师成功时，将教师已验证答案作为上下文，用于对学生失败回答进行打分；当仅学生成功时，以任务内共享权重强化整段回答。

Result: 在 Qwen3 与 Llama 上，DuoOPD 在平均宏准确率上优于全部五个基线，较 OPD 分别提升 2.58 与 5.98 个百分点；在涵盖科学计算、指令跟随与代码生成的另外两个任务混合上同样领先。消融实验表明，仅基于结果的方向性设计仅接近门控基线，而联合结果设计贡献了大部分增益。

Conclusion: 结果表明，单纯纠正反馈方向收益有限，真正有效的是利用师生联合结果来调节教师的支持强度与形式，从而在多种模型与任务组合上稳定提升蒸馏效果。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses with token-level feedback from a stronger teacher, yet the teacher can fail on questions the student already answers correctly, and how often each model succeeds varies across tasks. OPD ignores these outcomes and, on average, pushes down even the student's correct responses; gating feedback by student correctness fixes the direction but uses the teacher in the same way whether or not it succeeded. We introduce DuoOPD, in which the student's outcome sets the direction of feedback and the joint teacher-student outcome decides how the teacher supports it: when only the teacher succeeds, its verified answer becomes context for scoring the student's failed response, and when only the student succeeds, a weight shared within the task reinforces the whole response. A single rule covers all four outcome combinations without task-specific settings. Across Qwen3 and Llama, DuoOPD outperforms all five baselines in mean macro accuracy, improving over OPD by 2.58 and 5.98 percentage points, and it also leads on two further task mixtures spanning scientific calculation, instruction following, and code generation. Ablations show that outcome-based direction alone stays near the gated baseline, while the joint-outcome designs supply most of the gain.

</details>


### [1165] [Theory Guided and Interpretable Neural Operator Design for Partial Differential Equation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33715)
*Zeyuan Song,Zheyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AFDONet——首个将自适应傅里叶分解(AFD)理论融入VAE结构的神经PDE求解器,用于流形上非线性PDE求解,具备可解释性、高精度与高效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学工程中PDE的高精度数值求解至关重要,而现有神经算子设计多依赖经验"艺术",缺乏数学框架指导,可解释性与数学严谨性不足。

Method: 将神经算子学习与自适应傅里叶分解(AFD)理论首次结合,嵌入专门设计的变分自编码器(VAE)结构,构建AFDONet求解器;其架构与组件设计完全由AFD数学框架指导。

Result: 在多个基准问题上实现出色的求解精度与有竞争力的计算效率;尤其在解决任意黎曼流形上的PDE及具尖锐梯度数据集时表现优越。

Conclusion: AFDONet使神经算子设计从"艺术"转向"科学",展现优异的数学可解释性与理论根基,为设计可解释神经算子框架提供了新范式。

Abstract: Accurate numerical solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) are crucial in numerous science and engineering applications. In this work, we introduce a novel neural PDE solver named AFDONet, which incorporates neural operator learning and adaptive Fourier decomposition (AFD) theory for the first time into a specifically designed variational autoencoder (VAE) structure, to solve a general class of nonlinear PDEs on smooth manifolds. AFDONet is the first neural PDE solver whose architectural and component design is fully guided by an established mathematical framework (in this case, AFD theory), turning neural operator design from an art to a science. Thus, AFDONet also exhibits exceptional mathematical explainability and groundness, and enjoys several desired properties. Furthermore, AFDONet achieves outstanding solution accuracy and competitive computational efficiency in several benchmark problems. In particular, thanks to its deep connections with AFD theory, AFDONet shows superior performance in solving PDEs on i) arbitrary (Riemannian) manifolds, and ii) datasets with sharp gradients. Overall, this work presents a new paradigm for designing explainable neural operator frameworks.

</details>


### [1166] [ALDER: Discovering the Laws of a World by Acting in It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33728)
*Teng Cao,Yu Deng,Quentin Delfosse,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ALDER方法，通过主动设计实验、拟合参数方程、独立验证与结构修订，实现可显式表达、可检验的世界模型发现，并能基于验证后的模型求解逆问题以指导控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的世界模型不仅应预测未来状态，还应以显式、透明、可检验的形式（如方程）表达动作如何改变世界。现有方法存在两类局限：依赖固定轨迹集合的方法无法区分同样优秀的竞争性假设；在固定预定义候选集合上搜索则无法发现初始假设空间之外的方程。

Method: ALDER（Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision）主动提出新实验以检验和修订模型。具体流程包括：提出参数化方程；用数值优化器拟合其系数；由独立验证器在留出数据上测试候选；采用成本与安全感知的选择器查询干预（新实验），以区分竞争性的有效假设；反例更新证据账本并指导下一次结构修订，不兼容的定律被剔除。

Result: 在自建基准、ODE方程发现任务和机器人实验中，ALDER能够发现超出初始公式集的定律，修复失败的模型提议，以更少交互区分固定候选模型，并提升分布外预测能力；此外，给定当前状态和目标，ALDER可通过求解其已验证世界模型所定义的逆问题来选择控制动作。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明，基于显式方程的世界模型可以通过交互进行检验与修订，并能自然地用于指导目标导向的控制。

Abstract: Reliable world models should not only predict future states but express how actions change the world in an explicit, transparent and testable form, such as equations. Yet methods that rely on a fixed set of trajectories cannot distinguish equally good competing hypotheses, while searches over a fixed set of predefined candidates cannot discover equations outside the initial hypothesis space. We introduce ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision), a method that actively proposes novel experiments to test and revise models. Specifically, ALDER proposes parametric equations; a numerical optimizer fits their coefficients; an independent verifier tests these candidates on held-out data. To distinguish between competing valid hypotheses, a cost- and safety-aware selector queries interventions, in the form of novel experiments. The resulting counterexamples update the evidence ledger and guide the next structural revision, while incompatible laws are discarded. Across an in-house benchmark, ODE equation discovery tasks, and robotic experiments, ALDER discovers laws beyond its initial formula set, repairs failed model proposals, distinguishes fixed candidate models with fewer interactions, and improves out-of-distribution prediction. Furthermore, given a current state and a target, ALDER selects control actions by solving the inverse problem defined by its validated world model. Together, these results show that explicit equation-based world models can be tested and revised through interaction, then naturally used to guide goal-directed control.

</details>


### [1167] [PQ-HSA: Reusing Product-Quantized Scores for Hybrid Sparse-Approximate Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33746)
*Kunming Shao,Jierun Chen,Yanli Wang,Ruoyu Wang,Haoli Bai,Kwang-Ting Cheng,Chi Ying Tsui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PQ-HSA（混合稀疏-近似注意力）：用 IVF-PQ 索引对全部 KV 缓存做近似打分排序，被选中 token 用原始 K/V 精确计算，未选中 token（背景）以倒排列表为单位聚合近似分数并乘以列表均值向量后一并进入 softmax。在 128K 上下文、1-2% 预算下精度优于 Quest 与 SnapKV 并接近全注意力，解码注意力调用较 FlashAttention-3 快 1.6 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文解码时，注意力受内存带宽限制。稀疏注意力仅读取少量 key，且多数方法将未读 token 权重置零，导致输出只利用 KV 缓存的一小部分；在小预算下精度下降，尤其在需要跨上下文聚合信息的任务上损失最大。作者希望在不牺牲精度、并能融入现有推理引擎的前提下，既减少读取又保留全局信息。

Method: 在缓存 key 上构建 IVF-PQ（倒排文件+乘积量化）索引，对每个已索引 token 计算近似分数用于排序；排序后这些分数可近似被略去 token 的注意力 logits。PQ-HSA 对选中的 token 使用原始 key 和 value 做精确注意力，对未选中的 token（背景）通过近似分数进入同一 softmax：按倒排列表求和，并乘以该列表的均值 value 向量。实现为 vLLM 插件，无需修改引擎源码。

Result: 在 128K 上下文、1-2% 检索预算下，PQ-HSA 在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上精度高于 Quest 和 SnapKV，宏观精度接近全注意力；同一选择器下，背景项使 8B 模型宏观精度从 0.71 提升至 0.83。在单张 NVIDIA H20 上的 vLLM 中，128K 设置下解码注意力调用比 FlashAttention-3 内核快 1.6 倍，加速随上下文长度增长；基于 8B-30B 拟合的成本模型可给出加速开始的上下文长度。vLLM 插件可在两个引擎版本上运行。

Conclusion: 将未选中 token 以 PQ 近似分数聚合为"背景"项纳入 softmax，可在小预算下显著恢复稀疏注意力的精度，同时借助 IVF-PQ 的廉价打分实现显著的解码加速。方法可即插即用地集成进 vLLM，兼顾精度、效率与工程可部署性。

Abstract: At each decoding step a language model attends over the key-value (KV) cache of every earlier token, so at long context the attention call is bounded by memory bandwidth. Sparse attention reads only a subset of keys chosen by a cheap score estimate, and most methods give the unread tokens zero weight. The output then draws on only a small fraction of the KV cache, and accuracy drops at small budgets, most on tasks that aggregate information across the context. An inverted-file product-quantization (IVF-PQ) index over the cached keys computes an approximate score for every indexed token in order to rank them; after ranking, those scores approximate the attention logits of the tokens left out. PQ-HSA (hybrid sparse-approximate attention) attends the selected tokens with their original keys and values, and the unselected tokens, the background, enter the same softmax through those scores, summed per inverted list and multiplied by the list's mean value. At 128K and a 1-2% retrieval budget, PQ-HSA is more accurate than Quest and SnapKV on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B and stays close to full attention in macro accuracy; with the same selector, the background term raises macro accuracy on the 8B model from 0.71 to 0.83. In the same 128K setting, inside vLLM on one NVIDIA H20, the decode attention call runs 1.6x faster than the FlashAttention-3 kernel; the speedup grows with context length, and a cost model fitted on 8B to 30B models gives the context length at which it begins. A vLLM plugin runs PQ-HSA on two engine versions without changes to the engine source; code is available at https://github.com/KunmingSHAO/pqhsa_release.

</details>


### [1168] [Task-Aware Discretization of Differentiable Logic Gate Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33747)
*Thore Gerlach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出可微逻辑门网络（DLGN）中常用的局部离散化（argmax+置信度/熵准则）即便对全局最优松弛解也可能任务次优，高门置信度无普遍保证；据此推导任务感知门选择与松弛网络中可处理干预的界限，并研究一阶下游任务信息用于渐进离散化的可靠性。实验表明一阶分数在非局部干预下不可靠，但对渐进冻结中的局部argmax决策评估准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准DLGN训练通过松弛离散逻辑门实现梯度训练，再在推理时离散化；但其离散化决策是局部的（argmax选择与置信度/熵收敛准则）。作者要说明这种局部离散化存在根本缺陷：即使松弛解全局最优，局部离散化仍可能任务次优，且高门置信度并不能普遍保证正确性，因此需要任务感知的离散化准则。

Method: 1) 理论分析局部离散化对全局最优松弛解的任务次优性，构建反例并证明高置信度无普遍保证；2) 推导任务感知门选择与松弛网络中可处理干预之间的界限；3) 研究一阶下游任务信息用于渐进离散化，刻画该局部近似何时可靠；4) 在卷积DLGN上进行实验，对比非局部干预与渐进冻结下的局部argmax决策。

Result: 实验显示强烈的位置依赖性：直接在非局部干预上优化时，一阶分数变得不可靠；但在渐进冻结过程中，一阶分数能准确评估局部argmax决策。

Conclusion: 局部离散化准则（argmax与置信度/熵）不足以支撑任务最优的DLGN离散化，高置信度不构成保证。任务感知的一阶信息仅在局部（渐进冻结式）干预下可靠，为设计更优的渐进离散化策略提供了理论与经验依据。

Abstract: Differentiable logic gate networks (DLGNs) enable gradient-based training of highly efficient Boolean networks by relaxing discrete logic gates during training and discretizing them for inference. Standard approaches make this discretization decision locally, typically through argmax selection and confidence- or entropy-based convergence criteria. We show that local discretization can be task-suboptimal even for globally optimal relaxed solutions, with high gate confidence providing no general guarantee, and derive bounds relating task-aware gate selection to tractable interventions in the relaxed network. Motivated by these results, we study first-order downstream task information for progressive discretization and characterize when this local approximation is reliable. Experiments on convolutional DLGNs reveal a strong locality dependence: first-order scores become unreliable when directly optimized over nonlocal interventions, but accurately assess local argmax decisions for progressive freezing.

</details>


### [1169] [ResDiffFRG: Residual Diffusion for Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33749)
*Shizhe Liu,Jiayan Gu,Xiangyu Kong,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ResDiffFRG，将扩散目标定义为说话人行为锚点与合适面部反应(AFR)之间的残差，以此把扩散过程显式锚定在说话人行为上，从而缓解随机高斯初始化导致的去噪轨迹偏移问题，显著提升相关性appropriateness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在二元人-人对话中，听者的面部反应能让说话人准确感知其情绪状态，且人类面部反应具有非确定性，因此生成多样且类人的面部反应对人机交互至关重要。扩散模型天然适合一对多生成，但现有基于扩散的MAFRG方法直接从随机高斯初始化去噪为多个AFR，这些初始化与目标听者反应缺乏对齐，需要复杂去噪轨迹，且容易偏离通往AFR的轨迹范围。鉴于听者与说话人面部行为之间存在固有的模仿性(mimicry)，作者希望利用这一强先验来解决去噪轨迹问题。

Method: 提出ResDiffFRG，一种新的基于扩散的MAFRG框架。其核心是将扩散过程显式锚定到说话人行为：把扩散目标定义为说话人锚点(speaker anchor)与AFR之间的残差。这样去噪器只需建模将该锚点转换为AFR所需的、相对较小且反应特异的残差，而无需从无结构状态重建完整反应。

Result: 大量实验表明，ResDiffFRG在基于相关性的appropriateness指标上较现有方法取得大幅提升。去噪轨迹分析显示，即便在去噪轨迹起点，ResDiffFRG已达到比高斯扩散基线完成60%去噪轨迹时更高的面部反应相关性得分。

Conclusion: 通过利用听者-说话人模仿先验，将扩散目标重构为说话人锚点下的残差建模，ResDiffFRG有效解决了随机初始化带来的去噪轨迹偏离问题，在MAFRG任务上实现了更优的appropriateness与更高效的轨迹收敛。

Abstract: In dyadic human speaker-listener conversations, the listener's facial reactions allows the speaker to accurately perceive the listener's emotional states. Since human facial reactions are non-deterministic, the ability to generate multiple appropriate human-like facial reactions is crucial for realistic human-agent interactions. Although diffusion models are naturally suited to such one-to-many generation, existing diffusion-based Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation (MAFRG) methods attempt to denoise random Gaussian initialisations directly into multiple appropriate facial reactions (AFRs). These random initialisations are usually not well-aligned with the target listener facial reaction, which requires complex denoising trajectories from these initialisations, and subsequently creates substantial opportunities for deviations away from the range of trajectories leading to appropriate AFRs. Given the inherent mimicry between the human listener's and speaker's facial behaviours, we address the above denoising trajectory issue by leveraging this strong prior. Specifically, we propose ResDiffFRG, a novel diffusion-based MAFRG framework that explicitly anchors the diffusion process to the speaker behaviour by defining its diffusion target as the residual between the speaker anchor and an AFR. The denoiser only needs to model the comparatively small, reaction-specific residual needed to transform this anchor into an AFR, rather than reconstructing the complete reaction from an unstructured state. Extensive experiments show that ResDiffFRG achieves large improvements in correlation-based appropriateness over existing methods. Our denoising trajectory analysis showed that even at the start of the denoising trajectory, ResDiffFRG already achieves a higher facial-reaction correlation score than the Gaussian Diffusion baseline does after completing 60% of its denoising trajectory.

</details>


### [1170] [StatD2GAN: When Calibration Masks Generator Quality in Held-Out Evaluation of Synthetic Weather Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33761)
*Mustafa Ozaytac,Ozge Karadag Atas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出多变量天气序列生成模型的常规评估方式（边缘校准后用混合分布指标评价）会导致架构结论失效，并以留出协议重建 StatD2GAN 的评估，提出四项证据性发现与评估建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式多变量天气序列模型常以“先边缘校准、再计算混合分布指标”的方式评估。作者认为这一做法会掩盖架构间真实差异、甚至使架构性结论无效，因此需要更严格的评估协议来重新检验模型组件的作用。

Method: 采用留出（held-out）协议：每个数据集的最后两个日历年作为留出块，并设置 168 小时隔离期（embargo）；校准仅在训练块上拟合，所有指标在留出块上计算。数据覆盖 5 个 Köppen-Geiger 气候区，25 组匹配的（地点, 随机种子）配对，使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验并进行 Holm 校正。评估对象包括 StatD2GAN（三分辨器 GAN，含进化权重自适应）、故意弱化的 RCGAN 基线及秩变换变体。

Result: 1) 保序（isotonic）校准使所有被测架构（含弱 RCGAN 基线）的 KS 距离都降至每地点“噪声-漂移下限”的 2% 以内，故校准后的边缘指标无法区分架构。2) 排序表示判别器是唯一在被移除后显著降低跨变量依赖性的组件（Kendall tau MAE +0.080，Holm p=0.009），且效应依赖气候区：安卡拉近零，迪拜与雅库茨克超过 115%；秩变换变体表明机制是边缘的分位数监督而非 copula 匹配。3) 物理约束违反由校准而非生成器引入，投影可近乎无代价地消除（ΔKS ≤ 0.003）。4) 混合指标掩盖了 TimeGAN 中序列间周均值变异性的崩塌（季节与气候型多样性的代理），该崩塌仅能被序列级统计量揭示。

Conclusion: 建议将“以下限为参照的边缘评估、匹配配对检验、序列级方差分解”作为校准式生成流程的最低评估要求，以避免架构结论被校准与混合指标所误导。

Abstract: Generative models for multivariate weather series are routinely evaluated with pooled distributional metrics computed after marginal calibration. We show this practice can invalidate architectural conclusions, and rebuild the evaluation of StatD2GAN, a three-discriminator GAN with evolutionary weight adaptation, around a held-out protocol: the final two calendar years of each dataset are held out behind a 168 hour embargo, calibration is fitted on the training block only, and all metrics are computed on the held-out block. Evidence comes from 25 matched (location, seed) pairs across five Koppen-Geiger climates, tested with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests under Holm correction. Four results follow. First, isotonic calibration drives the Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance to within 2% of a per-location noise-and-shift floor for every architecture tested, including a deliberately weak RCGAN baseline, so calibrated marginal metrics cannot discriminate between architectures. Second, the sorted-representation discriminator is the only component whose removal significantly degrades cross-variable dependence (Kendall tau MAE +0.080, Holm p = 0.009), with a regime-dependent effect: near zero in Ankara, above 115% in Dubai and Yakutsk. A rank-transformed variant isolates the mechanism as quantile supervision of the marginals rather than copula matching. Third, physical constraint violations are injected by calibration, not the generator; projection removes them at negligible cost (deltaKS <= 0.003). Fourth, pooled metrics conceal a collapse of between-sequence weekly-mean variability, a proxy for seasonal and regime diversity, in TimeGAN that only sequence-level statistics expose. We recommend floor-referenced marginal evaluation, matched-pair testing, and sequence-level variance decomposition as minimum requirements for calibrated generative pipelines.

</details>


### [1171] [Binding Multiple Modalities via Multimodal Wasserstein Barycenter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33800)
*Xiaole Tang,Jiayi Xu,Xiang Gu,Yan Yang,Jian Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BaryBind，将特定模态投影到跨所有模态优化的Wasserstein重心（WB），并引入体积对齐目标，在WB周围构建统一语义空间，在多模态检索、分类、VideoQA及跨模态生成任务上取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态学习常以某一特定模态（如文本）绑定其他模态，容易造成表征空间不均衡，难以在逼近共享语义的同时保持n模态数据的整体几何结构。

Method: 方法包含两部分：1）将特定模态投影到Wasserstein重心，WB最小化到各模态分布的平均Wasserstein距离，作为对齐锚点；2）构建以WB为中心的重心单纯形，以其体积作为全局对齐的相似性度量，从而实现体积对齐目标。

Result: 在文本-视频-音频检索、分类、VideoQA以及跨模态生成任务上取得有竞争力的性能，并在模态缺失时表现鲁棒，且可扩展到三个以上模态。

Conclusion: BaryBind通过Wasserstein重心与体积对齐目标建立了更均衡且尊重整体几何的多模态统一语义空间，验证了其有效性、鲁棒性与可扩展性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal learning beyond two modalities commonly leverages a specific modality (e.g., text) to bind other modalities. However, how to establish a more balanced representation space that approximates shared semantics while respecting the holistic geometry of $n$-modal data remains challenging. In this work, we present BaryBind, which aims to transport the specific modality towards the Wasserstein barycenter (WB) optimized across all modalities and introduces a volumetric alignment objective to establish a unified semantic space around the WB embedding. Specifically, we project specific modalities to the WB, which minimizes the average Wasserstein distances to multimodal distributions and serves as the anchor for subsequent alignment. We then construct a barycenter simplex, whose volume is taken as a similarity metric for global alignment centered at the WB. Experiments show that BaryBind achieves competitive performance in text-video-audio retrieval, classification, videoQA, and cross-modal generation tasks, along with robustness under modality absence and scalability to more than three modalities. Code is released at https://github.com/xl-tang3/BaryBind.

</details>


### [1172] [dOPT: Differentiating Conic Optimization via Geometric Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33828)
*Fengyu Yang,Connor W. Magoon,Tyler Watts,Shahar Z. Kovalsky*

Main category: cs.LG
