TL;DR: 本文提出dOPT，一种求解器无关的可微优化框架：在给定原始-对偶解处将一般锥规划约化为等约束二次规划，保留参考解及其一阶灵敏度，用单次对称线性求解计算解导数，并给出凸NLP、QP、SOCP、SDP的显式约化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将结构化约束与决策问题嵌入学习系统需要对优化层反向求导，但对一般锥规划直接微分具有挑战性（完整锥形式微分复杂、奇异配置下定义不清、且依赖特定前向求解器）。

Method: dOPT与求解器无关：不在完整锥形式上直接求导，而是在计算出的原始-对偶解处将锥规划约化为一个等约束二次规划（EQP），保留参考解及其一阶灵敏度，捕获与微分相关的局部一阶、二阶锥几何，并在奇异配置下仍良定义；随后仅需一次对称线性求解即可得到解导数。作者推导了凸NLP、QP、SOCP、SDP的显式约化。

Result: 数值实验验证了所计算的梯度正确，并显示反向传播（backward-pass）具有良好的可扩展性；随着问题规模增大，相较现有可微锥优化方法取得显著加速。

Conclusion: 通过局部约化为等约束QP，dOPT实现了求解器无关、定义良好且高效的可微锥优化，适用于多种凸锥问题，并在大规模场景下优于现有方法。

Abstract: Optimization layers enable the incorporation of structured constraints and decision problems into learning systems. Training such systems requires differentiating through the embedded optimization problem, which can be challenging for general conic programs. We introduce dOPT, a solver-agnostic framework that, rather than differentiating the full conic formulation, reduces it at a computed primal-dual solution to an equality-constrained quadratic program that preserves the reference solution and its first-order sensitivity. The reduction captures the local first- and second-order conic geometry relevant to differentiation and remains well defined at singular configurations. Computing solution derivatives then requires a single symmetric linear solve, independently of the forward solver. We derive explicit reductions for convex NLPs, QPs, SOCPs, and SDPs. Numerical experiments validate the computed gradients and show favorable backward-pass scalability, with substantial speedups over existing differentiable conic optimization methods as problem size increases.

</details>


### [1173] [QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33848)
*Weiqi Wang,Yuxin Zhou,Mouxiang Chen,Siyuan Zhang,Yi Zhang,Yuyan Luo,Zhiyu Yin,Chencan Wu,Jiemin Jiang,Wentao Yao,Chujie Zheng,JianWei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QwenGyre是一个面向超长时程（xlong-horizon）在线强化学习的端到端框架，通过弹性GPU再分配与轨迹处理，缓解执行方差与轨迹冗余问题，实现训练效率与效果双提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地承担超长时程任务（单次执行可跨越数小时、数百次模型-环境交互、每次rollout近1M token）。将在线RL应用于此类执行面临两大挑战：（1）严重的执行方差与过长的rollout延迟导致大量GPU闲置；（2）复杂的非线性分支产生海量轨迹冗余，严重拖累训练效率。

Method: 提出QwenGyre，一个面向超长时程在线RL的端到端框架。其核心包括：（1）在不中断进行中执行的前提下，在rollout与训练之间弹性再分配GPU；（2）轨迹处理器重建分支历史、对部分进展进行打分，并对冗余路径去重，从而约束训练成本。

Result: 在旗舰模型Qwen 3.8 2.4T上，每次rollout 700K token，QwenGyre在48步内于NL2RepoBench取得6.0%的绝对提升（52.5% → 58.5%）。在多个不同领域训练数据集上的评测中，相较Colocate与Async分别取得最高1.85倍与1.78倍的加速。

Conclusion: QwenGyre通过弹性GPU调度与轨迹去重/重建机制，有效解决了超长时程在线RL中的GPU闲置与轨迹冗余问题，在保持训练质量的同时显著提升训练效率，具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake extreme-long (xlong) horizon tasks, where a single execution can span hours, hundreds of model--environment interactions, and nearly 1M tokens per rollout. Applying online reinforcement learning (RL) to such executions poses two fundamental challenges: (1) severe execution variance and prolonged rollout delays cause massive GPU idling; and (2) complex non-linear branching generates massive trajectory redundancy, crippling training efficiency. To address these, we presents QwenGyre, an end-to-end framework for xlong-horizon online RL. QwenGyre elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting live executions, while its trajectory processor reconstructs branching histories, scores partial progress, and deduplicates redundant paths to bound training costs. Scaled to our flagship model, Qwen~3.8 2.4T, with 700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre yields a 6.0% absolute gain on NL2RepoBench (52.5% $\to$ 58.5%) in 48 steps. Across our evaluations on diverse domains of training datasets, QwenGyre delivers up to $1.85\times$ and $1.78\times$ speedups over Colocate and Async, respectively.

</details>


### [1174] [JET: Justification Evaluation in Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33874)
*Shenghao Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JET 无需额外训练即可在预训练语言与视觉语言模型上完成有限候选答案的选择，并重点评估其决策准确率与执行成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在本地设备上利用现有预训练模型进行决策推理的可行性，兼顾准确率与执行效率。

Method: 直接评估候选答案的似然，并在候选之间共享计算；通过前缀复用、缓存管理及输入准备优化提升执行效率，并考察可选推理带来的权衡。

Result: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在完整 MMLU 测试集上达到 87.48% 准确率，在单独计时的 MMLU 子集上达到 3.69 请求/秒；前缀复用与缓存管理带来 2.18-2.23 倍加速，输入准备优化使进程时间减少 30.8%，输出不变；可选推理呈现任务相关的准确率-吞吐权衡。

Conclusion: 结果支持基于现有模型进行本地决策推理。

Abstract: JET uses pretrained language and vision-language models to select among a finite set of answers without additional training. It evaluates candidate likelihoods directly and shares computation across candidates. Experiments on desktop CPUs and consumer GPUs assess decision accuracy and execution cost. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B achieves 87.48% accuracy on the full MMLU test set and 3.69 requests per second on a separately timed MMLU subset. The accuracy-throughput comparison covers model, hardware, and reasoning choices, with Jev as an external reference. Controlled execution experiments show 2.18-2.23-fold speedups from prefix reuse and cache management, and a 30.8% reduction in process time from input preparation optimizations, with unchanged outputs. Optional reasoning has a task-dependent accuracy-throughput trade-off. These results support local decision inference from existing models.

</details>


### [1175] [Vanilla Policy Optimization Is Both Optimal and Differentially Private for Stochastic Contextual Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33888)
*Idan Attias,Orin Levy,Alexander Ryabchenko,Yishay Mansour,Uri Stemmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 标准指数策略更新（vanilla PO）在可实现性下无需探索奖励或重要性加权即可实现近似最优regret；给出batched版本与隐私变体，并在实验上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究vanilla策略优化（指数权重/乘性更新）在随机上下文bandit中是否需要显式探索机制才能达到近最优regret，并研究其隐私与计算效率扩展。

Method: 在可实现性假设下，采用由离线回归oracle驱动的标准指数策略更新（无探索奖励、无重要性加权）；分析其隐式探索机制；构造仅需O(log T)次回归调用与策略切换的批处理版本；结合私有回归oracle得到跨批次无需组合的差分隐私算法。

Result: 对A个动作、T轮、有限预测类F，vanilla PO取得高概率regret Õ(√(AT log|F|))；有限类下隐私版本达到纯ε_priv-DP，regret为Õ(√(AT log(|F|/δ))(1+ε_priv^{-1/2}))；在有无隐私的oracle-based上下文bandit算法上实验验证了策略优化的实用性与强隐私约束下显式探索的价值。

Conclusion: vanilla策略优化本身具备充分探索能力，可实现近最优regret，并可通过批处理与私有回归oracle自然扩展至计算高效与差分隐私场景。

Abstract: Can vanilla policy optimization explore enough to achieve near-optimal regret in stochastic contextual bandits? We show that standard exponential policy updates driven by offline regression do so under realizability, without exploration bonuses or importance weighting. For $A$ actions, $T$ rounds, and a finite prediction class $F$, vanilla PO achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{AT\log(|F|)})$ regret with high probability. Our analysis reveals an implicit exploration mechanism of independent interest: gradual policy updates prevent actions from losing probability too quickly, allowing the regression oracle to learn their expected losses. We further develop a batched version using only $O(\log T)$ regression calls and policy switches, and show how private regression oracles yield differentially private contextual bandit algorithms without composition across batches. For a finite class, this gives pure $\varepsilon_{\rm priv}$-DP and regret $\widetilde O\left( \sqrt{AT \log(|F|/δ)}(1+\varepsilon_{\rm priv}^{-1/2}) \right)$. Finally, experiments across oracle-based contextual bandit algorithms, with and without privacy, demonstrate the practical effectiveness of policy optimization and the value of explicit exploration under stronger privacy constraints.

</details>


### [1176] [Augmented Feature Boosting for Multicalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33891)
*Ira Globus-Harris,Inbal Livni Navon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了一种无需离散化的boosting范式，通过特征增强（将前一轮预测输出作为额外特征）实现多重校准，避免传统方法中对舍入参数的敏感性，并给出多准确性、多重校准及水平集多重校准的保证层级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准分布性boosting通过反复离散化预测器取值范围、审计并修复水平集来实现多重校准，导致实际保证对舍入参数（rounding parameter）的取值敏感。因此，如何在boosting过程本身避免这种舍入，实现无离散化的boosting，成为一个自然的理论问题。

Method: 采用受Tax等（2026）启发的特征增强boosting范式：每轮在含前一轮预测器输出作为额外特征的假设上调用平方损失oracle；仅对最终预测器进行舍入，使其具有有限水平集，从而提供多重校准保证。通过增强假设类的表达性（expressivity）对该过程进行理论分析。

Result: 增强假设类的表达性产生了一个保证层级（hierarchy of guarantees），涵盖多准确性（multiaccuracy）、多重校准（multicalibration）以及更强的水平集多重校准（level-set multicalibration）。

Conclusion: 该特征增强boosting方法无需在boosting过程中进行舍入，避免了标准方法对舍入参数的敏感性，并在理论上通过表达性刻画了从多准确性到水平集多重校准的保证层级。

Abstract: Multicalibration requires a predictor's residuals to be unbiased not only globally, but also after conditioning on the predictor's own level sets and reweighting by a rich class of test functions. Standard boosting approaches in the distributional setting achieve this by repeatedly discretizing the predictor's range then auditing and repairing the resulting level sets. One consequence is that in practice, the algorithm's guarantees are sensitive to this parametrization of the rounding parameter. A natural theoretical question, then, is how to do discretization-free boosting which avoids this rounding within the boosting process itself. Here, we analyze an alternative feature-augmentation boosting paradigm inspired by Tax et al. (2026): at each round, a squared-loss oracle is called on hypotheses that receive the previous predictor's output as an additional feature, and only the final predictor is rounded to have a finite set of level sets to provide the multicalibration guarantee with respect to. We give a theoretical analysis of this procedure through the expressivity of the augmented hypothesis class, and show how the expressivity of this class yields a hierarchy of guarantees, including multiaccuracy, multicalibration, and the stronger notion of level-set multicalibration.

</details>


### [1177] [MISHAP-Bench: A Hallucination Benchmark for Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33893)
*Zhi Wen Soi,Giulio Segalini,Jian-Jia Chen,Lydia Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 MISHAP-Bench 基准，将音频幻觉分为"上下文幻觉"和"知识幻觉"两类，并配以基于评分标准与人工标注引导的 groundedness judge，对十个先进 LALM 进行评估，发现幻觉问题依然严重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频幻觉基准主要衡量回答的正确性，无法区分模型是"产生幻觉"还是"单纯没听懂音频"，因此需要从"是否有音频依据"的角度重新定义并评估幻觉。

Method: 定义两类幻觉：(i) 上下文幻觉，即主张未以音频为根据；(ii) 知识幻觉，即关于音频相关主题的主张缺乏可外部验证事实的支持。构建 MISHAP-Bench，包含 12,000 个高难度开放式问答-音频对与严格评估流程；提出 groundedness judge，利用参考评分标准和由人工标注引导的评判提示来评估开放式回答；并对十种 SOTA LALM 及四种来自不同领域的缓解方法进行评测。

Result: 即便前沿模型（如 Gemini 3.7 Flash）幻觉率仍达 36.5%，十种模型的幻觉问题普遍显著；四种缓解方法虽有改进，但效果有限。

Conclusion: 音频幻觉仍未解决，有效缓解仍是开放挑战；作者呼吁社区使用 MISHAP-Bench 来评估幻觉并基准测试缓解方法。

Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) produce fluent responses about audio but often hallucinate by making plausible yet ungrounded claims. Existing audio hallucination benchmarks mainly measure response correctness, leaving it unclear whether an LALM hallucinates or simply fails to understand the audio. We challenge correctness-based evaluation by defining two hallucination categories: (i) context, where claims are not grounded in the audio; and (ii) knowledge, where claims about audio-related topics lack support from externally verifiable facts. We introduce MISHAP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark with 12,000 challenging open-ended question-audio pairs and a rigorous evaluation pipeline covering both categories. To evaluate open-ended responses, we propose a groundedness judge that uses reference rubrics and judge prompts guided by human annotations. We extensively evaluate ten state-of-the-art LALMs and show that hallucination remains substantial. Even a frontier model such as Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches a hallucination rate of 36.5%. We further adapt and benchmark four mitigation methods from multiple domains for LALMs. Despite some improvements, effective hallucination mitigation remains an open challenge. Finally, we call on the community to evaluate hallucination and benchmark mitigation methods with MISHAP-Bench.

</details>


### [1178] [No Free Efficiency: Revisiting the Trade-off Between Training Efficiency and Model Vulnerability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33898)
*Yiyong Liu,Jun Sakuma,Michael Backes,Rui Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文首次系统性跨域研究了"效率—脆弱性"权衡：在视觉与语言模型中，效率导向的训练（选择性数据采样、高效预训练、简化RL）会提升对抗攻击与隐私攻击的脆弱性，并伴随更尖锐的损失几何与表征结构变化；简化的"零RL训练"还会加剧灾难性遗忘与过度自信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练效率已成为基础模型进展的核心驱动力，但现有研究普遍关注效率带来的开销降低，忽视了其潜在代价。作者提出一个被忽略的关键问题：效率提升是否以模型的鲁棒性与安全性为代价。

Method: 跨视觉与语言模型的系统性跨域实验；涵盖选择性数据采样、高效预训练、简化强化学习流程等效率策略；通过对内部几何与功能表征的分析刻画脆弱性（损失几何尖锐度、表征结构变化）；并将分析扩展至"零RL训练"范式。

Result: 效率导向训练一致地增加模型对对抗攻击与隐私攻击的易感性；高效变体一致表现出更尖锐的损失几何以及系统性的表征结构改变；采用简化RL配方训练的模型相比常规对齐流程，表现出更强的灾难性遗忘倾向与更明显的过度自信。

Conclusion: 训练效率鲜有"免费午餐"，最小化计算开销的机制可能在不经意间损害安全性。作者呼吁转向多目标训练范式，联合优化性能、成本与安全。

Abstract: Training efficiency has become the central driver of recent progress in foundation models. To overcome the massive computational and data requirements of large-scale training, researchers increasingly adopt strategies such as selective data sampling, efficient pre-training, and simplified reinforcement learning pipelines. While these strategies drastically reduce overhead, they prompt a critical, yet neglected question: Is efficiency achieved at the expense of model robustness and security? To our knowledge, we present the first systematic cross-domain investigation of the efficiency-vulnerability trade-off. Across vision and language models, we show that efficiency-oriented training increases susceptibility to adversarial and privacy attacks. We characterize this vulnerability by analyzing the models' internal geometry and functional representations, demonstrating that the evaluated efficient variants consistently exhibit sharper loss geometry together with systematic changes in representational structure. We further extend our analysis to "zero RL training", finding that models trained using simplified RL recipes exhibit substantially greater susceptibility to catastrophic forgetting and more pronounced overconfidence than those trained through conventional alignment pipelines. Our findings suggest that training efficiency is rarely a "free lunch"; rather, the mechanisms that minimize computation can inadvertently compromise safety. We conclude by calling for a paradigm shift toward multi-objective training that jointly optimizes for performance, cost, and security.

</details>


### [1179] [On the Two Faces of Adam in Separable Linear Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33904)
*Chen Fan,Csaba Szepesvári*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文定量刻画了在可分离线性分类与softmax参数化下,小固定正稳定常数ε的确定性全批量偏差校正Adam的训练动态:分类器先近似最大化max-norm margin,随后才转向近似梯度下降并达到目标欧氏margin。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有结果刻画了Adam在两个极端情形下的隐式偏置:ε=0时趋向max-norm margin最优,ε>0时趋向欧氏margin最优。但对实际使用的“小固定正ε”这一中间情形缺乏定量理解,即max-norm阶段能维持多久、何时转为梯度式更新、以及达到目标欧氏margin需要多长时间。

Method: 研究确定性、全批量、带偏差校正的Adam,在log-loss与softmax参数化的可分离线性分类设定下,针对多项式步长衰减(指数a,1/3<a<1)与逆线性衰减(a=1)分别进行迭代复杂度分析,并辅以实验验证理论预测。

Result: 给出充分条件,使Adam训练的分类器在更新变得近似梯度式之前几乎最大化max-norm margin。对多项式衰减,更新在Θ(log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)})次迭代后近似正比于负梯度,此时分类器仍几乎最大化max-norm margin;而达到高于任一max-norm最优分类器、但低于最优值的目标欧氏margin需ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)}次迭代。对逆线性衰减(a=1),更新转变仅需多项式次迭代,达到目标margin却需指数次。实验支持上述预测。

Conclusion: 在小正ε下Adam呈现两阶段行为:先max-norm margin近似最优,后转向欧氏margin优化,两类时间尺度存在显著分离。训练误差归零后分类器的后续变化可改善或恶化泛化,从而将分析与grokking及其反向现象联系起来。

Abstract: We consider the behavior of deterministic, full-batch, bias-corrected Adam in separable linear classification with softmax parametrization under log-loss. In this setting, under a wide range of conditions Adam is known to approach max-norm-margin optimality when its stability constant $ε$ is zero, while with a positive $ε$, it is known to approach Euclidean-margin optimality. Our main contribution is the quantitative description of Adam's behavior for small fixed positive $ε$. We give sufficient conditions under which an Adam-trained classifier nearly maximizes the max-norm margin before the updates become gradient-like. We also show that the classifier reaches a fixed target Euclidean margin only much later. Specifically, we show that for polynomially decreasing stepsizes with exponent \(a\), where \(1/3<a<1\), the updates become approximately proportional to the negative gradient after $Θ(\log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)})$ iterations. At that time, the classifier still nearly maximizes the max-norm margin. Reaching a fixed target Euclidean margin above that of every max-norm-optimal classifier, but below the optimum,
  is shown to require $ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)}$ iterations. Under inverse-linear stepsize decay (\(a=1\)), the update
  transition takes polynomially many iterations, whereas reaching the target margin takes
  exponentially many. Experiments support these predictions. The later change in the classifier
  can improve or worsen generalization after training error reaches zero, connecting the
  analysis to grokking and its reverse.

</details>


### [1180] [Training Witnesses: Trusting the Training without Trusting the Trainer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33915)
*Houjun Liu,Pratyusha Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Witnesses 方法，将神经网络训练验证的责任从读者转移到训练者，通过行为指纹与偶发重放挑战实现可扩缩、低开销的训练、数据使用与评估认证，并建立自监管的"自动认证"排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习进展速度已超过对其验证的能力。当前论文激增，每个科学主张首先依赖对训练者的信任，导致评估与基线不统一，阻碍可靠进展。传统上验证负担落在读者身上，需复现昂贵的训练过程，但受限于低质贡献激增、方法多样和所需算力巨大，该策略不切实际。因此作者主张将举证责任归还训练者，同时大幅降低整体验证成本。

Method: Witnesses 的核心洞见是：快速行为指纹配合偶发重放挑战足以审计神经网络训练。该方法对训练者附加开销极小、可规模化应用，对验证者成本低廉；能以可放大概率拒绝不良训练运行，并支持对数据包含与排除的精确查询。作者在 100M 至 2B 参数规模的语言模型训练上、跨 DDP 与 FSDP 进行了测试。

Result: 在 100M 到 2B 规模的语言模型训练（跨 DDP 与 FSDP）中验证了该方法，并展示其极小开销；方法能够以可放大概率拒绝不当训练运行，并实现数据包含与排除的精确查询。

Conclusion: 作者提出并验证了 Witnesses 这一训练认证方法，并进一步构建自监管的"自动认证"训练运行排行榜，以实现共享基线与可累积进展，同时邀请社区参与以提升机器学习的可复现性。

Abstract: Progress in machine learning cannot outpace our ability to verify it. With an explosion in papers today, every scientific claim rests initially on trust in the trainer, leading to uneven evaluation, baselines, and forestalling of reliable progress. Traditionally, the burden of verification falls on the reader, who must reproduce expensive training runs. This strategy is impractical due to an explosion in slop contributions, diversity of methods, and the sheer compute required. We put the burden of proof where it belongs, on the trainer, and in the process also cut the overall cost of verification significantly. We introduce Witnesses, a method for certifying training, data usage and evaluation in a neural network training run. Our key insight is that fast behavioral fingerprints with occasional replay challenges are sufficient for auditing neural network training. Our method is applicable at scale with minimal overhead to the trainer, is cheap for the verifier, rejects bad training runs with amplifiable probability, and allows for exact queries of both data inclusion and exclusion. We test our method on language model training runs from 100M to 2B scales, across DDP and FSDP, and demonstrate this minimal overhead. We also introduce a self-regulating leaderboard of "auto-certified" training runs that enables shared baselines and progress. We invite the community to participate in the leaderboard to improve reproducibility in machine learning.

</details>


### [1181] [Optimizing the Phi-2 Small Language Model for Real-time Chatbot Applications Using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) with QLoRA Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33927)
*PhanTan Khanh Nguyen,Ashfaq Ali Shafin,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过PEFT与QLoRA（结合4-bit量化）优化Phi-2小型语言模型，用于实时聊天机器人，在降低内存占用的同时保持或提升响应准确率，ROUGE指标显示摘要任务显著改善，验证了SLM在资源受限环境中的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Phi-2等小型语言模型虽具高性能与低计算开销，但在移动与边缘计算环境中仍受资源约束，需进一步降低内存占用并保持实时交互的响应准确率。

Method: 将参数高效微调（PEFT）与LoRA及4-bit量化结合形成QLoRA，对Phi-2进行优化，并采用ROUGE指标评估模型在摘要任务上的表现。

Result: ROUGE评估显示模型在摘要任务上取得显著提升，同时内存使用大幅降低，准确率得以保持甚至可能提高。

Conclusion: 该方案证实了SLM在资源受限环境中部署的可行性，为实时场景下高效、可扩展、可及的AI应用及相关产业推广提供了新路径。

Abstract: This study explores the optimization of the Phi-2 Small Language Models (SLMs) for real-time chatbot applications through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) and Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA). QLoRA specifically refers to the integration of PEFT with LoRA alongside a 4-bit quantization process, aimed at enhancing computational efficiency. These models, initially designed for high performance with minimal computational overhead, are further refined to address the constraints of mobile and edge computing environments. By integrating PEFT with QLoRA, the research aims to reduce memory usage significantly while maintaining, or potentially improving, the accuracy of model responses in real-time interactions. The effectiveness of these techniques was evaluated using the ROUGE metric system, which showed notable improvements in the summarization tasks performed by the models. This approach not only confirms the feasibility of using SLMs in resource-restricted environments but also opens up new avenues for deploying advanced AI-driven applications in real-time settings. The study's findings have significant implications for the development of efficient, scalable, and accessible AI technologies, paving the way for broader adoption in various industries.

</details>


### [1182] [How Strong Is the Evidence for the Artificial Hivemind? Reevaluating Evidence for the Open-Ended Homogeneity of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33936)
*Rylan Schaeffer,Brando Miranda,Joshua Kazdan,Jessica Chudnovsky,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新检验"人工蜂巢思维"（Artificial Hivemind）论文的三项核心证据，发现其旗舰案例描述与可视化、谱分析、聚类及语言模型标注相矛盾；其同质性度量使用了过于宽松的零假设，且缺乏人类基线与统计零假设；其"推理时干预无效"的结论亦不成立。作者表明该论文并未确立人工蜂巢思维的存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究声称语言模型在开放式生成中表现出显著同质性，并以"人工蜂巢思维"命名，认为其对人类创造力构成长期威胁。本文旨在检验支撑这一论断的实证证据是否可靠。

Method: 作者对原论文的三项关键结果进行复现与再分析：以可视化、谱分析、聚类及语言模型标注重新审视"时间隐喻"案例的簇结构；构建更严格的零假设（同一提示下表达真正不同想法的响应对），并与原论文使用的宽松零假设（无关提示的响应）对比；评估其"模型不可区分性"统计量是否具备零假设与人类基线；最后检验推理时干预（提示）能否提升响应多样性。

Result: 原论文所称"时间隐喻"响应坍缩为两簇，与多种分析手段不符：实际呈一个主导喻体加长尾次要喻体的分布，且"时间"属于多样性最低的主题之一，是有利案例而非代表性案例。在更严格的零假设下，20%–32%的"不同想法"响应对已超过原论文0.8的收敛阈值；原论文同提示响应对超过阈值的频率约为这些"不同想法"对的2–3倍，说明其所谓同质性很大程度源于回答同一提示的共享几何结构。此外，模型不可区分性统计量缺乏零假设，也未收集人类基线。推理时干预（提示）可稳定提升所测得的响应多样性。

Conclusion: 原论文关于"推理时干预不足、需在模型训练层面寻求更通用解决方案"的结论缺乏依据。本文并不裁定人工蜂巢思维是否真实存在，但表明已发表的证据尚不足以确立该现象。

Abstract: Recent research argues that language models exhibit pronounced homogeneity in open-ended generation, framing such behavior as an Artificial Hivemind that poses a long-term threat to human creativity. We examine three of its central results. First, the flagship example is that model responses to "Write a metaphor involving time" collapse into two clusters. Visualization, spectral analysis, clustering, and language model labels all contradict this description. The labels record each response's vehicle, what it compares time to. Our responses and the original authors' own show one dominant vehicle plus a heavy tail of distinct minority vehicles. "Time" is one of our least diverse topics, so the example is a favorable case, not a representative one. Second, the paper measures homogeneity against an undemanding null: responses to unrelated prompts. Under a more demanding null (same-prompt responses expressing genuinely different ideas), 20%-32% of such pairs already exceed the paper's 0.8 convergence threshold. A residual effect survives this null. The paper's same-prompt pairs exceed 0.8 roughly two to three times as often as our different-idea pairs. Much of what the paper calls homogeneity is the shared geometry of answering the same prompt. The remaining measurements lack any null: no human baseline is collected, and the model-indistinguishability statistic has no null. Third, the paper concludes that inference-time interventions are inadequate for combating the Artificial Hivemind, writing that "more generalizable solutions are needed at the model training level." We show that this conclusion is unsupported in three ways, and that an inference-time intervention (prompting) reliably raises measured response diversity. We do not resolve whether the Artificial Hivemind is real. We show that the published evidence does not establish it.

</details>


### [1183] [Behavioral Monitoring of JEPA World Models with Jacobian Centroids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33940)
*Thomas Walker,Randall Balestriero,Richard Baraniuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用质心（centroids，即子成分雅可比行和）来刻画世界模型（WM）的内部表征，从而在规划前检测行为失配与规划失败，并提升分布偏移下的检测与目标重采样能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于世界模型（WM）的规划需要监测模型是否在行为上与当前任务对齐，而这要求研究模型的内部表征。传统基于激活的知识信号不足以刻画行为属性，因此需要一种能有效识别WM行为特征的新视角。

Method: 提出"质心"（centroids）方法：子成分雅可比的行和。质心可通过雅可比向量积高效计算，刻画模型如何组织输入空间的几何结构，提供对内部表征的高效视角，并可用于生成任务相关的显著性图。在连续控制任务上使用JEPA世界模型进行评估，质心方法同时被用作分布偏移检测器。

Result: 实验揭示了一种结构性解离：编码器正确表征目标，但预测器在行为上无响应。这一失效模式能在采取任何动作前直接预测规划失败，从而通过目标重采样（goal resampling）恢复分布外任务的成功。此外，基于质心的方法在分布偏移检测上优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 质心方法构成了一个在分布偏移下可运行且具有实际影响的行为监测栈（behavioral monitoring stack），为世界模型的内部表征分析与规划失败预警提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Detecting failures in World Model (WM)-based planning requires monitoring whether the model is behaviorally aligned with the current task, which in turn requires studying its internal representations. Here, we show that centroids---sub-component Jacobian row-sums---effectively identify the behavioral properties of WMs, complementing traditional activation-based knowledge signals. The centroids of a model are easily computed through Jacobian vector products and characterize how the model organizes the geometry of its input space, yielding an efficient perspective on internal representations, including the generation of task-relevant saliency maps. Evaluated on continuous control tasks using JEPA WMs, this behavioral view reveals a structural dissociation, where the encoder correctly represents the goal while the predictor remains behaviorally unresponsive. This failure mode directly predicts planning failure before any action is taken, allowing for goal resampling to recapture out-of-distribution success. Moreover, centroid-based methods outperform baseline methods as distribution-shift detectors. Together, these tools yield a behavioral monitoring stack that is operational and consequential under distribution shifts.

</details>


### [1184] [DynGraphAgentBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Lifecycle Control in Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33980)
*Yuwei Han,Lingwei Wei,Wooseong Yang,Liangjie Huang,Liancheng Fang,Huanhuan Ma,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DynGraphAgentBench：面向延迟反馈下动态图异常检测的可执行基准，用于评估智能体式生命周期控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态图异常检测中图结构与异常类别流行率持续漂移，需要反复决策；但现有基准通常在已知当前标签后对固定流水线打分，无法评估在延迟反馈下进行生命周期控制的能力。

Method: 基准包含7个时序图数据集（节点级与边级异常任务）、11个可选检测器、每个数据集8个按时间顺序的部署窗口。每个窗口控制器只能看到时间因果的聚合上下文、已注册模型卡与自身成熟历史，必须在当前窗口训练或候选分数出现前选择检测器。沙箱执行器用成熟数据训练所选架构，对隐藏部署窗口打分，并在延迟一个窗口后释放结果。确定性验证器检查决策时序、防泄漏、合法动作、训练范围与持久化产物。采用平均精度和固定审查深度召回衡量检测效用，通过模型切换与算力刻画适应性。

Result: 在两个主控制器和无记忆参考下，于4个数据集完成完整8窗口轨迹；另有3个控制器在3个数据集上运行，暴露了对延迟证据的有用、高代价和无效反应，同时未提供穷尽的当前窗口预言机。

Conclusion: DynGraphAgentBench将动态图异常检测评估从静态流水线打分转向延迟反馈下的可执行智能体生命周期控制，能够揭示不同控制策略的适应成本与有效性。

Abstract: Dynamic graph anomaly detection requires repeated decisions as graph structure and class prevalence drift, yet detector benchmarks usually score a fixed pipeline after current labels are known. We introduce DynGraphAgentBench, an executable benchmark for agentic lifecycle control under delayed feedback. It comprises seven temporal graph datasets with node- and edge-level anomaly tasks, eleven selectable detectors, and eight chronological deployment windows per dataset. In each window, a controller sees only time-causal aggregate context, registered model cards, and its own matured history. It must choose a detector before current-window training or candidate scores exist. A sandboxed executor trains the chosen architecture on mature data, scores a hidden deployment window, and releases the outcome after a one-window delay. A deterministic verifier checks decision timing, leakage guards, legal actions, training scope, and persisted artifacts. We measure detection utility with average precision and capture at fixed review depth, and characterize adaptation through model switches and compute. Complete eight-window trajectories from two primary controllers and a no-memory reference on four datasets, together with three additional controllers on three datasets, expose useful, costly, and ineffective reactions to delayed evidence without granting an exhaustive current-window oracle.

</details>


### [1185] [Future Information-Directed Sampling for Bayesian Nonstationary Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33981)
*Yichen Song,Alessio Russo,Aldo Pacchiano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Future Information-Directed Sampling（FIDS），一种面向贝叶斯非平稳bandit的算法，显式地探索以获取关于未来最优臂的信息，在保持与Thompson Sampling相当（常数因子内）的遗憾的同时，能利用传统探索目标无法捕捉的预测性信息结构，并给出基于监督学习的近似框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索-利用权衡是bandit学习的核心问题。UCB与Thompson Sampling等经典算法在平稳环境中表现良好，但其探索策略主要降低对当前最优臂的不确定性；在非平稳环境中，未来最优臂可能与当前显著不同，这类探索方式因此不足。

Method: 提出FIDS算法，在贝叶斯非平稳bandit中显式地以获取未来最优臂的信息为探索目标；并从理论上分析其遗憾。此外，针对后验推断的实际困难，提出基于监督学习的近似框架，从离线数据中学习FIDS策略。

Result: FIDS的遗憾与Thompson Sampling相当，仅相差一个小常数因子；同时能够利用传统探索目标所无法捕捉的预测性信息结构。基于监督学习的近似框架在合成基准上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将探索目标从"当前最优臂"转向"未来最优臂"，FIDS在非平稳bandit中兼顾了遗憾保证与对预测性信息结构的利用，且其监督学习近似使其具备实际可行性。

Abstract: Exploration--exploitation is a central trade-off in bandit learning. While classical algorithms such as upper confidence bound methods and Thompson Sampling effectively balance this trade-off in stationary environments, their exploration strategies mainly reduce uncertainty about the current optimal arm, which can be insufficient in nonstationary settings where future optimal arms may differ substantially from current ones. In this paper, we propose Future Information-Directed Sampling (FIDS), a new algorithm for Bayesian nonstationary bandits that explicitly explores to gather information about future optimal arms. We show that FIDS achieves regret comparable to Thompson Sampling up to a small constant factor, while being able to exploit predictive information structures that conventional exploration objectives fail to capture. To address the practical difficulty of posterior inference, we further propose a supervised-learning-based approximation framework that learns the FIDS policy from offline data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on synthetic benchmarks.

</details>


### [1186] [From HL to H+L-1 Parameters: A Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33984)
*Chaoqi Zhang,Yu Wang,Haixu Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster (HTF)：基于二阶平稳预测理论，将最小MSE有限窗线性预测器分解为Hankel互协方差矩阵与逆Toeplitz协方差矩阵，用 $H+L-1$ 个自相关即可确定参数，从而以极少参数实现接近稠密线性模型的长期预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性预测器在长期时间序列预测中已能与Transformer类模型竞争，但参数共享策略缺乏理论指导，导致线性预测器仍不够紧凑。作者希望借助经典平稳预测理论来指导参数共享，构造更紧凑且理论可解释的线性预测器。

Method: 针对中心化二阶平稳过程且历史协方差非奇异的情形，证明最小MSE有限窗线性预测器可分解为 Hankel 互协方差矩阵与逆 Toeplitz 协方差矩阵的乘积；利用共享滞后与尺度消去，仅需回看长度 $L$ 与预测时域 $H$ 对应的 $H+L-1$ 个自相关即可确定该预测器。基于新息表示，HTF 学习单一脉冲响应，由其同时定义逆滤波器和预测映射，并使用 $H+L-1$ 个可训练系数，同时保持预测矩阵满秩。文中还刻画了有限历史修正项，并在可和性假设下给出截断真实滤波器的超额风险上界。

Result: 在 $L=336$ 的设置下，于七个基准数据集上，HTF 的时域平均MSE在每个数据集上均与 Dense Linear 相差不超过 1.2%，而可训练参数减少 75–229 倍。

Conclusion: 经典的平稳预测理论能够有效指导线性预测器的参数共享：通过 Hankel–Toeplitz 分解与单一脉冲响应参数化，可在显著压缩参数量的同时维持与稠密线性模型相当的长期预测性能，并具备有限样本超额风险的理论保证。

Abstract: Linear forecasters have shown competitive accuracy against Transformer-based models in long-term time series forecasting. We study how classical stationary prediction theory can guide parameter sharing for more compact linear forecasters. For centered second-order stationary processes with nonsingular history covariance, the minimum-MSE finite-window linear predictor factors into a Hankel cross-covariance matrix and an inverse Toeplitz covariance matrix. Shared lags and scale cancellation specify this predictor using $H+L-1$ autocorrelations for lookback $L$ and horizon $H$. Building on the innovations representation, our Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster (HTF) learns one impulse response that defines both an inverse filter and a forecast map. We characterize the finite-history correction and, under summability assumptions, bound the excess risk of truncating the true filters. HTF uses $H+L-1$ trainable coefficients while allowing a full-rank forecasting matrix. Across seven benchmarks at $L=336$, its horizon-averaged MSE is within 1.2% of Dense Linear on each dataset with 75-229 times fewer trainable parameters.

</details>


### [1187] [ICMAPE: In-Context Multiagent Pure Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33986)
*Xinyi Hu,Alessio Russo,Aldo Pacchiano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ICMAPE 框架，用贝叶斯学习解决去中心化多智能体纯探索问题，将固定置信度识别目标转化为由推理置信度导出的奖励，联合学习集中式神经推理网络与去中心化策略，在合成基准与真实水质监测任务上以更少探索步数达到目标精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中待优化量往往不是外部指定奖励，而是关于环境未知属性的信息（主动序贯假设检验 ASHT）。但 ASHT 文献多聚焦于模型明确、单智能体的有限问题，缺少可实用的多智能体主动序贯检验方法，形成研究空白。

Method: ICMAPE：基于贝叶斯的去中心化多智能体纯探索框架。将固定置信度识别目标转换为由推理置信度导出的奖励，从而可直接套用标准强化学习机制；联合学习两部分：集中式神经推理网络（从全局轨迹数据估计假设上的后验分布）与去中心化策略（依据局部观测历史选择动作，并学习在达到目标置信度时停止采样）。实现为 ICMAPE-TD3。

Result: 在两个合成基准和一个基于真实数据的马里兰硝酸盐浓度监测任务上，ICMAPE-TD3 以更少的探索步数达到目标精度。

Conclusion: ICMAPE 填补了去中心化多智能体主动序贯检验的空白，表明将推理置信度奖励化并联合训练集中式推理与去中心化策略，可在纯探索任务中提升样本效率。

Abstract: In some multi-agent systems, the quantity to be optimized is not an externally specified reward but the information acquired about unknown properties of the environment as done in active sequential hypothesis testing (ASHT) problems. However, the ASHT literature tends to focus on finite single-agent problems with well-specified models, while there is currently a gap for practical multi-agent methods that can perform active sequential testing. We fill this gap with ICMAPE, a Bayesian learning-based framework for decentralized multi-agent pure-exploration driven by inference objectives. ICMAPE converts the fixed-confidence identification objective into a reward derived from inference confidence, so that standard reinforcement learning machinery can be applied to decentralized pure exploration. It jointly learns a centralized neural inference network that estimates a posterior distribution over hypotheses from global trajectory data, and decentralized policies that select actions from local observation histories and learn when to stop collecting data once the target confidence is reached. On two synthetic benchmarks and a Maryland nitrate concentration monitoring task based on real-world data, ICMAPE-TD3 achieves target accuracy with fewer exploration steps.

</details>


### [1188] [ASTRA: ADMM-Accelerated Topology Reconfiguration for Dynamic Satellite Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33993)
*João Norberto,Ricardo Ferreira,Cláudia Soares*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ASTRA框架，结合ADMM离线求解与在线梯度/条件梯度更新，用于大规模卫星星座的动态拓扑重构，在理论上给出强凸性与对数静态遗憾保证，并在合成星座与真实Starlink数据上验证了其高效性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有卫星星座拓扑重构方法多依赖理想化假设（如全星座部署、均匀轨道间距），在部分部署、非均匀间距的真实场景中失效，且约束更新计算代价高，缺乏理论保证。

Method: 提出ASTRA（自适应卫星拓扑与遗憾感知学习）框架：基于在线学习形式化建模，结合ADMM离线求解器与针对在线梯度下降（OGD）和在线条件梯度的高效在线更新，实现低成本约束更新；理论上针对入口逐元素非零的效用矩阵类证明目标强凸，并给出非精确ADMM内循环下的动态遗憾保证。

Result: 在合成星座上，ASTRA的拓扑质量匹配或优于基线，且在计算时间上取得良好折衷；在真实Starlink数据（部分部署、非均匀间距）下仍保持有效性，而理想化结构假设在此类场景中失效。

Conclusion: ASTRA为真实低轨网络中的拓扑重构提供了一种高效且具备理论基础的解决方案。

Abstract: Dynamic topology reconfiguration is central to the reliability and efficiency of large satellite constellations, yet many existing approaches rely on idealized assumptions such as full constellation deployment or uniform orbital spacing. We present Adaptive Satellite Topology via Regret-Aware learning (ASTRA), a theoretically-grounded framework for dynamic satellite topology reconfiguration that builds on an online learning formulation and makes it computationally practical. ASTRA combines an ADMM-based offline solver with efficient online updates for both online gradient descent and online conditional gradient, yielding markedly cheaper constrained updates than generic optimization pipelines. On the theory side, we show that for a relevant class of entry-wise nonzero utility matrices, the objective is strongly convex, which yields logarithmic static regret for online gradient descent, and we further instantiate known dynamic-regret guarantees under inexact ADMM inner loops. Empirically, ASTRA matches or improves topology quality, presenting a good trade-off with computational time on synthetic constellations, and it remains effective on real Starlink data under partial deployment and non-uniform spacing, where idealized structural assumptions break down. These results position ASTRA as an efficient and theoretically grounded approach to topology reconfiguration in realistic Low Earth Orbit networks.

</details>


### [1189] [T-SNN: Temporal Simplicial Neural Network for EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34002)
*Nikita Malik,Shubhajit Roy,Mohit Kataria,Isuru Herath,Suraj Yadav,Inés García-Redondo,Dhananjay Bhaskar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出时序单纯形神经网络（T-SNN），将EEG表示为演化单纯复形序列，联合学习高阶脑区交互及其时间演化，在SEED-VII七类情绪识别任务上优于卷积、循环、图及Transformer方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解码脑状态需同时刻画神经活动的时序演化与脑区群组间交互。现有EEG方法多将记录视为多元时间序列，或用成对图表示功能连接，导致动态高阶交互 largely 未被建模。

Method: T-SNN将EEG记录建模为随时间演化的单纯复形序列，通过结合单纯形卷积（simplicial convolution）与循环更新（recurrent updates），在一个框架内联合学习高阶交互与其时间演化。

Result: 在七类SEED-VII情绪识别任务上，T-SNN在试次级（trial-wise）与跨被试（cross-subject）评估中均优于卷积、循环、图基及Transformer方法；融合眼动特征后性能进一步提升。

Conclusion: T-SNN为动态高阶脑区交互建模提供了有效框架，并在多模态脑状态解码中展现出潜力。

Abstract: Decoding brain states requires models that capture both the evolution of neural activity and interactions among groups of brain regions. Existing EEG methods often treat recordings as multivariate time series or represent functional connectivity with pairwise graphs, leaving dynamic higher-order interactions largely unmodeled. We introduce the Temporal Simplicial Neural Network (T-SNN), which represents EEG recordings as sequences of evolving simplicial complexes. By combining simplicial convolutions with recurrent updates, T-SNN jointly learns higher-order interactions and their temporal evolution. On the seven-class SEED-VII emotion recognition task, T-SNN outperforms convolutional, recurrent, graph-based, and Transformer methods in both trial-wise and cross-subject evaluations. Incorporating eye-movement features further improves performance, demonstrating the framework's potential for multimodal brain-state decoding.

</details>


### [1190] [RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34004)
*Tong Liu,Lanmiao Liu,Xiang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出RICE-Alpha，一个时点（point-in-time）股票评分框架，将历史事件续接信息作为可靠性校准的残差修正，叠加在多视图Base Alpha之上，在美股与港股面板上显著优于现有LLM金融智能体与动量基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 股票相关的信息通过时间上相互依赖的公司事件演化，历史信息只有在建模事件连续性、信息可得性和状态转移可靠性时才有效。现有基于LLM的金融智能体虽引入历史证据，但难以在时点约束下保持发行人特有时间序列，也难以判断历史状态转移是否提供超出当前预测的增量信息。

Method: 方法为RICE-Alpha（Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs），分为两部分：（1）历史感知的多视图Base Alpha；（2）由历史事件续接得到的、经可靠性校准的残差修正。具体组件包括：Multi-Tier Memory Layer，将新闻解读锚定在时间上合格（temporally eligible）的发行人特定历史中；Typed Event Agent，构建事件状态，其后继关系只在发行人体内形成，且仅在有效局部配对后才跨公司池化；成熟的状态转移按其经验可靠性校准，所得图信号对Base Alpha与技术视图做残差化，得到RICE Delta。

Result: 在2024至2026年的纳斯达克100与恒生指数日频面板上，RICE-Alpha在四个预测指标与四个组合层面指标上均取得所评估LLM智能体与动量基线中的最优结果；ICIR超过最强基线两倍以上，美国与香港的净夏普比率分别达1.656与1.725。美国消融实验进一步显示，移除主要组件后，经Holm校正的IC与RankIC均显著下降。

Conclusion: 结果表明，当历史事件续接被时间上锚定、经可靠性校准，并作为多视图预测的残差修正引入时，能够提供增量信息。

Abstract: Equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, making historical information useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled. Existing LLM-based financial agents incorporate historical evidence, yet they provide limited support for preserving issuer-specific chronology under point-in-time constraints and for identifying when historical transitions contribute information beyond the current forecast. We present RICE-Alpha (Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs), a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation. A Multi-Tier Memory Layer grounds news interpretation in temporally eligible issuer-specific history, while a Typed Event Agent constructs event states whose successor relations are formed within issuers and pooled across firms only after valid local pairing. Matured transitions are calibrated by their empirical reliability, and the resulting graph signal is residualized against the Base Alpha and technical view to obtain the RICE Delta. On daily Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels from 2024 to 2026, RICE-Alpha achieves the strongest results among the evaluated LLM-based agents and momentum across four predictive and four portfolio-level metrics. Its ICIR more than doubles that of the strongest baseline, while net Sharpe ratios reach 1.656 and 1.725 in the U.S. and Hong Kong, respectively. U.S. ablations further show significant reductions in IC and RankIC after Holm adjustment when major components are removed. These results indicate that historical event continuation adds incremental information when it is temporally grounded, reliability-calibrated, and introduced as a residual correction to a multi-view forecast.

</details>


### [1191] [Fisher-Informed Recalibration for Feedback-Based On-Policy Self-Distillation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34009)
*Seohyun Lee,Dong-Jun Han,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FIRE框架，通过对正确与错误on-policy输出分别重标定监督信号，缓解反馈式自蒸馏的训练不稳定与性能崩溃问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于反馈的on-policy自蒸馏让LLM在外部反馈下从自身输出学习，单一模型兼任教师与学生，但这类方法存在优化不稳定、训练中易性能崩溃的问题。

Method: FIRE（Fisher-Informed REcalibration）为双分支框架：对正确响应，用重加权的on-policy SFT替代自蒸馏；对错误响应，识别过度影响教师诱导更新的反馈成分，并据此重新标定反馈条件下的目标。两分支均受token级半径调节，该半径部分来自softmax Fisher迹。核心思想是将“反馈应推动模型的方向”与“在该方向上移动的幅度”解耦，同时保持行为良好的反馈监督不变。

Result: 实验表明FIRE显著提升自蒸馏稳定性，同时保持较强的下游性能，尤其在标准反馈条件蒸馏变得不稳定的场景中优势明显。

Conclusion: FIRE通过方向与幅度的解耦式重标定监督，有效解决反馈式自蒸馏的不稳定与崩溃问题，兼顾稳定性与下游表现。

Abstract: Feedback-based on-policy self-distillation has emerged as a promising approach for enabling foundation models, more specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), to learn from their own outputs under external feedback, with a single model serving as both teacher and student. However, such methods can exhibit unstable optimization, conducive to performance collapse during training. To address this limitation, we propose FIRE (Fisher-Informed REcalibration), a dual-branch framework that recalibrates the supervision applied to correct and incorrect on-policy outputs during fine-tuning. For correct responses, FIRE replaces self-distillation with re-weighted on-policy SFT, while for incorrect ones FIRE identifies feedback components that disproportionately influence the teacher-induced update and recalibrates the feedback-conditioned target accordingly. Both branches are influenced by a token-level radius derived in part from a softmax Fisher trace. FIRE separates which direction feedback should move the model from how far the model should move in that direction, while leaving well-behaved feedback supervision unchanged. Our experiments demonstrate that FIRE provides substantially more stable self-distillation while maintaining strong downstream performance, particularly in settings where standard feedback-conditioned distillation becomes unstable.

</details>


### [1192] [LTV-CTDNet: Compositional Turning Decomposition for Short-Term Turning-Movement Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34014)
*Md Atiqur Rahman Mallick,Kamrul Hasan,Robert T. White*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LTV-CTDNet转向交通流预测框架，通过"非负进口道总量+进口道内转向比例"的组合分解结构，在保持竞争力精度的同时保证输出物理可行与内部一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短时转向交通量预测可支撑信号控制与走廊运营，但无约束神经网络可能输出负值等物理不可行的结果，且输出未显式与进口道需求总量对应。研究旨在兼顾预测精度与结构可行性（非负性、各转向分量之和等于进口道总量）。

Method: LTV-CTDNet采用轻量编码器融合近期转向交通历史、周时段嵌入与位置嵌入；核心为组合式转向分解（Compositional Turning Decomposition）框架，分别预测非负的进口道总量与进口道内转向比例，再由二者重构各转向流量。使用田纳西州纳什维尔8个监测走廊位置、7个月的15分钟LiDAR观测数据进行评估。

Result: 在评估的若干预设配置中，LTV-CTDNet的转向级MAE为1.8189、RMSE为3.8072；相较最强序列模型精度提升幅度有限，但未产生任何负预测，而无约束学习模型在约10.6%~29.2%的原始预测单元中生成负值。

Conclusion: LTV-CTDNet通过结构设计天然保证非负输出，并使每个预测的进口道总量与其组成转向之和精确一致，无需截断或一致性校正即可提供可直接解释的预测，实现精度与结构可行性的平衡。

Abstract: Short-term turning-movement forecasts can support signal control and corridor operations, but unconstrained neural networks may produce physically impossible negative counts or outputs that are not explicitly tied to an approach-demand total. This study introduces the Linear Temporal-Variable Compositional Turning Decomposition Network (LTV-CTDNet), a forecasting framework designed to combine competitive accuracy with structurally admissible outputs. LTV-CTDNet was evaluated using seven months of 15-minute LiDAR observations from eight monitored corridor locations in Nashville, Tennessee. Its lightweight encoder combines recent turning-movement history, weekly time-slot embeddings, and location embeddings. The Compositional Turning Decomposition framework separately predicts nonnegative approach totals and within-approach turning proportions, then reconstructs movement forecasts from these components. Among the evaluated predefined configurations, LTV-CTDNet achieved a movement-level MAE of 1.8189 and RMSE of 3.8072. Its accuracy gains over the strongest sequence models were modest, but it produced no negative forecasts, while unconstrained learned models generated negative values in approximately 10.6% to 29.2% of raw forecast cells. The framework enforces nonnegative outputs and exact agreement between each model-predicted approach total and the sum of its component movements by construction, providing directly interpretable forecasts without clipping or coherence correction.

</details>


### [1193] [Vision--Language Signals in Constrained RL: Safety Gains Without Anticipation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34041)
*Samuel Tetteh,Cody Fleming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将冻结CLIP信号通过奖励塑形与增广乘子更新接入PPO-Lagrangian，在MetaDrive Hard上把灾难率从31.6%降到19.4%，但分析未发现CLIP信号具备碰撞预见性，且VLM项对拉格朗日乘子影响可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全强化学习需在满足安全约束的同时最大化任务表现。驾驶基准中碰撞代价仅在碰撞时刻出现，缺乏对临近风险的提前预警；冻结视觉-语言模型虽能提供稠密语义反馈，但其评分能否预见碰撞、以及安全提升究竟由哪个组件驱动尚不明确；此外，回合式代价可能偏好任务进展极少的策略，导致安全与任务性能的错配。

Method: 提出VLM-Safe-RL框架，将冻结CLIP信号整合进PPO-Lagrangian，通过奖励塑形（reward shaping）与增广乘子更新（augmented multiplier update）两个途径引入VLM反馈。

Result: 在MetaDrive Hard（最密集交通与最大地图组合）上灾难率由31.6%降至19.4%。FormulaOne-L2分析未发现CLIP信号能预见碰撞的证据，并显示VLM项对拉格朗日乘子影响可忽略。

Conclusion: 结果仅表明观测灾难率存在条件性下降，缺乏碰撞预见性证据，说明安全增益的驱动机制仍待厘清，需更严谨的归因分析来确认VLM信号的贡献来源。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximise task performance while satisfying safety constraints. In driving benchmarks, however, collision costs typically appear only at the time of collision, providing no advance warning of an approaching hazard. Frozen vision--language models can provide dense semantic feedback, yet it remains unclear whether their scores anticipate collisions and which component drives an observed safety improvement. Episodic cost can also favour policies that make little task progress. To address these gaps, we propose VLM-Safe-RL, a framework that integrates frozen CLIP signals into PPO-Lagrangian through reward shaping and an augmented multiplier update. On MetaDrive Hard, which combines the densest traffic with the largest map, the catastrophe rate falls from 31.6\% to 19.4\%. FormulaOne-L2 analysis finds no evidence that the CLIP signals anticipate collisions and shows that the VLM term has a negligible effect on the Lagrange multiplier. These findings show a conditional reduction in observed catastrophe rate without evidence of collision anticipation.

</details>


### [1194] [PReCache: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents via Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34054)
*Hyesung Jeon,Hyeongju Ha,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练KV缓存共享框架PReCache，含PreLRShared与ReBaseShared，显著加速多LoRA智能体长程推理并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多LoRA智能体共享骨干模型，但每个智能体重复处理增长的共享轨迹并各自构建KV cache，导致长程任务中显著的显存与计算冗余；现有KV缓存共享方法或需额外训练/架构约束，或仍保留大量模型计算；同时直接复用缓存会使当前智能体依赖前一智能体适配器生成的缓存状态，削弱其自身LoRA编码的角色特定行为。

Method: 提出免训练KV缓存共享框架PReCache，包含两个设计：PreLRShared在首次处理共享上下文时为每个智能体预计算紧凑的智能体特定低秩（LR）缓存，使当前智能体直接使用自身LR缓存而无需重处理前一智能体已处理的上下文，从而消除重复prefill；ReBaseShared从无适配器的隐藏状态重建共享基础缓存，减少前一智能体适配表示带来的残留误差，以提升共享精度。为降低重建开销，提出两种推理方案，分别面向单流推理与并发服务，在每轮智能体结束后或与其执行并行进行同一重建。

Result: 在多个模型与智能体基准上，PreLRShared相比无KV缓存共享的推理实现最高3.1倍TTFT加速与2.3倍每请求吞吐提升；ReBaseShared在所有评估的缓存共享方法中总体最能保持精度，相对无缓存共享推理平均仅下降1.1个点。

Conclusion: PReCache作为一种免训练KV缓存共享框架，通过基础缓存与智能体特定低秩缓存的分离与重建，有效缓解多LoRA智能体长程任务中的重复prefill冗余，并在精度与效率之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Multi-LoRA agent systems enable efficient role specialization by sharing a common backbone model. However, each agent repeatedly processes the growing shared trajectory and constructs its own KV cache, introducing substantial memory and computation redundancy in long-horizon tasks. Existing KV cache sharing methods reduce this repeated prefill, but they either require additional training or architectural constraints or retain substantial model computation. Moreover, direct cache reuse causes the current agent to rely on cache states generated by the previous agent's adapter, weakening the role-specific behavior encoded by its own LoRA. We present PReCache, a training-free KV cache sharing framework with two designs, namely PreLRShared and ReBaseShared, that share the base cache computed using the pretrained weights and precompute a compact agent-specific low-rank (LR) cache. To remove repeated prefill, PreLRShared precomputes each agent's LR cache when the shared context is first processed, allowing the current agent to use its own LR cache without reprocessing context processed by previous agents. To improve sharing accuracy, ReBaseShared reconstructs the shared base cache from adapter-free hidden states, reducing the remaining error caused by the previous agent's adapted representation. To minimize its reconstruction cost, we propose two inference schemes tailored to single-stream inference and concurrent serving, performing the same reconstruction after each agent's turn or alongside its execution, respectively. Across multiple models and agent benchmarks, PreLRShared achieves up to a 3.1x TTFT speedup and a 2.3x improvement in per-request throughput over inference without KV cache sharing. ReBaseShared best preserves accuracy overall among the evaluated cache-sharing methods, with an average drop of only 1.1 points relative to inference without cache sharing.

</details>


### [1195] [KVCMAS: Efficient KV cache Correction for Shared Context in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34060)
*Hyesung Jeon,Hyeongju Ha,Seoyoung Lee,Beomseok Kang,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KVCMAS：面向提示特化多智能体推理的在线KV缓存校正框架，用低秩状态表示跨智能体缓存偏差，沿工作流链式校正，无需额外参考预填充，支持动态共享上下文并保留精确的首智能体缓存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示特化多智能体系统中，各智能体的专属前缀导致同一共享上下文的KV缓存不同，每个智能体需重复预填充不断增长的上下文并各自构建缓存，带来高计算与显存开销。选择性重计算仍保留大量模型执行；现有增量校正方法仅支持固定/循环的上下文关系，或为动态上下文维护显存密集的在线校正状态；对首次出现的共享上下文还需在工作流之外构建参考缓存，且首智能体的近似校正会污染后续智能体的输出。

Method: 提出KVCMAS在线KV缓存校正框架：以紧凑低秩状态刻画跨智能体的缓存偏差，沿智能体工作流无缝链式传递校正，无需额外的参考预填充；在支持动态变化共享上下文的同时保持首智能体缓存的精确性。

Result: 在多种语言与视觉-语言负载上，KVCMAS的精度匹配或优于现有KV缓存共享方法，并在高并发服务下取得最低TTFT。受控服务轨迹下，相比无KV缓存共享的推理实现2.0x TTFT加速，相比先前的KV缓存校正方法将峰值GPU显存降低最多3.7x。

Conclusion: KVCMAS为提示特化多智能体服务提供了一种准确且可扩展的KV缓存共享方案。

Abstract: Prompt-specialized multi-agent systems enable multiple agents to share a model while performing complementary roles to solve complex tasks. However, agent-specific prefixes change the KV cache generated for the same shared context, causing each agent to repeatedly prefill the growing context and construct a separate cache with high computation and memory overhead. Selective recomputation reduces this redundancy but still retains substantial model execution, while existing delta correction methods either support only recurring context relations or maintain memory-intensive online correction states for dynamically changing context. For first seen shared context, these methods also construct a reference cache outside the agent workflow, and an approximate correction at the first agent affects the outputs passed to subsequent agents. We present KVCMAS, an online KV cache correction framework that represents cross-agent cache deviations using compact low-rank states and seamlessly chains corrections along the agent workflow without an additional reference prefill. This design supports dynamically changing shared context while preserving an exact first-agent cache. Across multiple language and vision-language workloads, KVCMAS matches or improves the accuracy of prior KV cache sharing methods while achieving the lowest TTFT under highly concurrent serving. Under controlled serving traces, it provides a 2.0x TTFT speedup over inference without KV cache sharing and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 3.7x relative to a prior KV cache correction method. These results establish KVCMAS as an accurate and scalable KV cache sharing approach for prompt-specialized multi-agent serving.

</details>


### [1196] [Beyond One Epoch: Uncertainty-Weighted Sensitivity Regularization for Recommendation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34083)
*Richard Lettich,Shagun Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从"预序原则（prequential principle）违背"的视角解释推荐模型中的 one-epoch 现象，提出"自影响不对称（self-influence asymmetry）"概念，并据此设计不确定性加权敏感度正则化（UWSR）来缓解过拟合、提升泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐模型结合稀疏嵌入与共享 consumer（消费端网络）时常出现 one-epoch 现象：训练进入第二个 epoch 后训练损失持续下降，但泛化性能急剧恶化。作者希望从原理层面解释这一反常现象，并给出针对性且能保留已学嵌入的解决方案，而非仅靠常规正则化或早停。

Method: 1) 以预序原则违背为切入：第一个 epoch 中样本标签尚未影响用于打分的嵌入行，而后续 epoch 中这些嵌入行已包含先前标签更新带来的位移（displacement），使共享 consumer 有动机去利用该位移，导致无法泛化，作者称之为"自影响不对称"。2) 使用精确的标量模型与局部影响分析（local influence analysis），将该错配与嵌入不确定性、consumer 的利用动机建立联系。3) 在深度推荐模型上通过嵌入-消费端-更新三类干预实验验证假设。4) 提出 UWSR：在损失函数中惩罚 consumer 依赖不确定嵌入的行为，同时保留已学嵌入不被改动。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，四轮 UWSR 训练相较 one-epoch 训练将测试交叉熵降低 1.38%–6.78%，AUC 提升 0.0058–0.0231，优于现有补救方法且不改变已学嵌入。

Conclusion: one-epoch 现象可由预序原则违背与自影响不对称解释；通过不确定性加权敏感度正则化可有效抑制 consumer 对不确定嵌入的利用，在保留嵌入的前提下显著改善泛化性能。

Abstract: Recommendation models with sparse embeddings and a shared consumer often exhibit the one-epoch phenomenon: a second epoch lowers training loss while sharply degrading generalization. We present a view based on the violation of the prequential principle. On the first epoch, an example's label has not affected the embedding rows used to score it. On later epochs, those rows contain a displacement induced by the labels earlier update. This creates an incentive for the shared consumer to exploit this displacement in subsequent epochs, which fails to generalize. We call this self-influence asymmetry. Using an exact scalar model and local influence analysis, we connect this mismatch to the uncertainty in the embeddings and the consumers incentive to exploit it in subsequent epochs. We verify this hypothesis using an embedding-consumer-update interventions in deep recommendation models and propose uncertainty-weighted sensitivity regularization (UWSR) which counteracts this mismatch by augmenting the loss function to penalize the consumer for relying on uncertain embeddings. Unlike existing remedies, UWSR preserves the learned embeddings and across three benchmarks, four-epoch UWSR reduces test cross-entropy by 1.38%-6.78% and improves AUC by 0.0058-0.0231 relative to one-epoch training.

</details>


### [1197] [When Is an SAE Feature Interpretable? A Validation Ladder for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34091)
*Yucong Cao,Chenqi Li,Tingting Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以EEG基础模型的稀疏自编码器(SAE)潜变量为例，指出"去除某频带信号后潜变量激活变化大"并不等于该潜变量表征该频带：按去除的谱能量归一化后，alpha移除效应消失（比值0.28，27个设定中无一超过1），并提出语义解释的验证阶梯。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE将稠密激活分解为离散潜变量，使特征看似易于解释，但也容易被误读。在EEG基础模型中，一个诱人的推断是：若去除alpha频带活动会强烈改变某潜变量激活，则该潜变量表征alpha活动。作者希望检验这一推断是否成立，并给出更严格的语义验证流程。

Method: 在3个骨干模型、3个EEG数据集、3种网络深度的27个设定中，比较alpha陷波与其等宽sham陷波对潜变量激活的影响；随后按被移除的谱能量进行归一化，并考察所选潜变量在干净EEG上与相对alpha功率的相关性。基于该反面案例，提出四级验证阶梯：①潜变量是否有响应；②该响应在控制干预移除的信号量后是否仍存在；③该响应是特异性还是广泛脆弱；④所提属性在未扰动数据上是否可见，并单独检验潜变量对任务分类器是否重要的更强命题。

Result: 未归一化时，alpha移除引起的潜变量激活变化是等宽sham陷波的7.3倍（95% CI [6.2, 8.7]），初看支持"alpha探测器"解读；但alpha滤波移除的信号量远多于sham。按移除谱能量归一化后，比值降至0.28（95% CI [0.22, 0.36]），27个设定中无一超过1。所筛选的潜变量在干净EEG上与相对alpha功率呈轻微负相关（平均r = -0.073），不支持简单的alpha探测器解读。

Conclusion: 仅凭扰动敏感性不足以确立SAE潜变量的语义。语义解释需依次通过"响应—控制移除信号量—特异性—未扰动数据可见性"的验证阶梯，并需另行检验其对任务分类器的重要性。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense model activations into discrete latents, making individual features easy to interpret--and easy to misinterpret. In EEG foundation models, this creates a tempting inference: if removing alpha-band activity strongly changes a latent's activation, one might conclude that the latent represents alpha activity. Across 27 settings spanning three backbones, three EEG datasets, and three network depths, this interpretation initially appears compelling: alpha removal changes latent firing 7.3 times more than an equal-width sham notch (95% CI [6.2, 8.7], bootstrapped over settings). However, the alpha filter also deletes far more signal than the sham. After normalizing by removed spectral energy, the ratio falls to 0.28 (95% CI [0.22, 0.36]) and exceeds one in none of the 27 settings. Latents selected for their response to alpha removal are, on clean EEG, slightly anti-correlated with relative alpha power (mean r = -0.073), giving no support for a simple alpha-detector reading. Motivated by this failure case, we propose a validation ladder for semantic interpretations of SAE latents: it asks in turn whether a latent responds, whether that response survives controlling for how much signal the intervention removes, whether it is specific rather than broadly fragile, and whether the proposed property is visible on unperturbed data--while separately testing the stronger claim that the latent matters to a task classifier. Perturbation sensitivity alone does not establish what an SAE latent represents.

</details>


### [1198] [Beyond Correctness: Evaluating Semantic Knowledge in Cross-Table Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34098)
*Seokyong Sheem,Hochang Lee,Suyeong Lee,Daekyum Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出表格学习中常用的语义消融实验可能得出误导性结论：改变语义内容带来的性能变化（内容敏感性）不等于该语义知识本身的预测增益（预测效用）。作者提出区分二者并据此选择合适对照的评估框架，并审计25项比较，发现18项预测效用声明中仅1项对照可清晰隔离所测语义贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义知识被广泛用于连接表格学习中的异构模式（schema），但"该知识究竟带来多少预测提升"缺乏严谨评估。现有研究常用语义消融（修改或抑制语义知识）来回答该问题，然而这类消融会在语义被改变时造成大幅性能差异，即便模型原本从该语义知识中获益甚微，从而将"改变语义导致的性能下降"误读为"原语义有益"的证据，产生误导性结论。

Method: 作者在真实与受控实验中分析语义消融的表现，提出区分两个量：内容敏感性（语义内容被改变时性能的变化）与预测效用（相对一个不含该知识的合适参照，原语义知识带来的增益）。据此建立评估框架：对照（control）的选择应取决于所问问题——改变语义的对照用于评估内容敏感性，而主张"语义知识提升预测"则必须使用合适的参照。作者进一步分析预测效用随参照变化而变化，且当参照更容易从其他输入或标注样本中恢复所测知识时，效用下降。最后对9项研究中的25项语义消融比较进行有限审计。

Result: 改变语义内容即使在模型从该语义知识中获益很小的情况下，也能产生很大的性能差异，说明内容敏感性无法等同于预测效用。预测效用并非固定值，它随不同合适参照而变动，并随参照可更易恢复所测知识而降低。在25项语义消融比较（9项研究）的审计中，18项明确的预测效用声明里只有1项配有能清晰隔离所测语义贡献的对照。

Conclusion: 语义消融的对照应当依据其要回答的问题来选择与解释：评估内容敏感性用改变语义的对照，主张预测增益则需合适的参照。提出简明评估原则——语义消融对照须按其所服务的问题进行选择与解读，以避免将内容敏感性误当作预测效用。

Abstract: Semantic knowledge is increasingly used to bridge heterogeneous schemas in tabular learning, but how much does that knowledge actually improve prediction? Studies in tabular learning commonly answer this question through semantic ablations that modify or suppress the supplied semantic knowledge. We show that these ablations can lead to misleading conclusions about predictive benefit: poor performance under altered semantics may be taken as evidence that the intended knowledge is beneficial. Across real and controlled experiments, altering semantic content can produce large performance differences even when the model gains little predictive benefit from having that semantic knowledge in the first place. To separate these effects, we distinguish two quantities: content sensitivity and predictive utility. Content sensitivity measures the change in performance when semantic content is altered, whereas predictive utility measures the benefit of the intended semantic knowledge relative to a suitable reference without that knowledge. This distinction motivates an evaluation framework in which the control is chosen according to the question being asked: altered controls assess sensitivity to semantic content, whereas claims that semantic knowledge improves prediction require a suitable reference. Even then, predictive utility is not fixed; it varies across suitable references and decreases when the reference can more easily recover the tested knowledge from other inputs or labeled examples. In a bounded audit of 25 semantic-ablation comparisons across nine studies, only one of 18 explicit predictive-utility claims is paired with a control that clearly isolates the tested semantic contribution. Together, these findings motivate a simple evaluation principle: semantic-ablation controls should be chosen and interpreted according to the question they are intended to answer.

</details>


### [1199] [Evolution of fairness in multi-objective reinforcement learning framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34114)
*Jingyi Zhang,Xin Ou,Guozhong Zheng,Shengfeng Deng,Jiqiang Zhang,Li Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多目标强化学习框架，将公平性的演化建模为物质收益最大化与公平驱动道德行为之间的动态权衡，并用双目标Q学习最后通牒博弈仿真揭示了公平压力下的行为反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统博弈论模型依赖"经济人"假设，认为个体纯理性、纯自利，只追求物质收益最大化，忽略了人类决策的多维性——除经济激励外还受其他因素影响。这导致公平这一基本社会规范如何涌现仍是长期难题。

Method: 构建多目标强化学习框架，把公平性演化建模为物质收益最大化与公平驱动道德行为之间的动态权衡，并由"公平压力系数"调节。在双目标Q学习最后通牒博弈上进行仿真，并进一步扩展到非对称情形，即提议者与回应者对两个目标赋予不同权重。

Result: 公平压力增大总体上促进公平结果，符合预期；但在中等压力下出现意外反转：回应者变得"宽容"，接受低额报价，这与日常经验一致。微观分析表明，该策略反转源于收益最大化偏好与公平导向偏好之间的竞争。

Conclusion: 研究将强化学习范式从单目标扩展到多目标表述，为解释更广泛的人类社会行为提供了一个通用工具。

Abstract: Fairness, as a fundamental social norm, continues to pose a longstanding puzzle regarding its emergence. Traditional game-theoretic models largely rely on the assumption of \emph{Homo economicus}, wherein individuals are purely rational and self-interested, acting solely to maximize material payoffs. Such accounts, however, overlook the multidimensional nature of human decision-making, which is often shaped also by other considerations beyond economic incentives. To address this gap, we propose a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that models the evolution of fairness as a dynamic trade-off between material payoff maximization and fairness-driven moral behavior, regulated by a fairness pressure coefficient. Using simulations of a two-objective Q-learning ultimatum game, we find that increased fairness pressure promotes fair outcomes, as expected. Strikingly, however, under moderate pressure, responder behavior reverses: responders become ``forgiving" by accepting low offers -- a pattern in line with our daily experience. Microscopic analyses reveal that this strategy reversal stems from competition between payoff-maximizing and fairness-oriented preferences. We further extend our framework to an asymmetric setting, where proposers and responders assign different weights to the two objectives. Overall, our work expands the reinforcement learning paradigm from a single-objective to a multi-objective formulation, offering a versatile tool for elucidating a broader range of human social behaviors.

</details>


### [1200] [What Does a Stream Model Buy You in Flow Matching?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34123)
*Jian Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对 stream-level flow matching（Gaussian-process stream CFM）进行理论剖析，证明其条件路径并未超出经典 CFM 的参数化范围，GP 核只是一张受约束的参数图，且论文所述机制在发布代码中并未实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GP-stream CFM 声称用高斯过程流替代线性插值后，在 2-Gaussian、MNIST、CIFAR-10 上取得比 ICFM 更低的采样误差。作者质疑这种 stream 模型究竟贡献了什么，希望厘清其真实机制与增益来源。

Method: 通过三条分析路径：(i) 对 stream-level CFM 目标做归约分析，指出目标仅通过逐时刻联合分布 (s_t, ṡ_t) 依赖 stream 律，条件路径仍属 CFM 已参数化的高斯条件路径族；在论文实际使用的逐坐标、共享标量核构造下，设计空间塌缩为两条标量曲线 (m_t, v_t)，跨时间协方差只影响估计方差。(ii) 将 GP 视为该空间的一张受约束参数图，考察单一核同时决定 m_t 与 v_t 的耦合效应，包括收缩 SE 长度尺度对插值性质与覆盖度的影响，并与解耦的 (m_t, v_t) 图作对照。(iii) 对发布代码进行审计，检验状态与速度的相关性是否达到设计意图。

Result: (ii) 单一核同时决定 m_t 与 v_t，论文自身扩大覆盖度所用的"收缩 SE 长度尺度"配方会破坏插值（中点均值权重由 1.03 降至 0.00）；在 2-Gaussian 上 GP 图在高覆盖度下 15/200 次发散，解耦图 0/200（p=6.6×10⁻⁵），且交叉两条曲线显示发散跟踪的是均值而非方差；MNIST 上同扫描不发散且次序反转，说明耦合是否有害依赖基准。共同结论是：该配方没有带来任何收益，无覆盖度水平优于论文自身设定，当 max_t√v_t≈0.6 之后两图均退化。(iii) 释放代码未实现所述机制，状态与速度独立采样（corr=0.00±0.01，而设计意图为 ±0.83–0.99）。

Conclusion: GP-stream CFM 的表达能力可归约到经典 CFM 的高斯条件路径，GP 仅为其设计空间的一张受约束图表；其增大覆盖度的配方既不改善性能又可能破坏插值并引发发散，且耦合利弊依基准而异；发布代码与论文声称的依赖结构不符，该方法的实际贡献缺乏支撑。

Abstract: Stream-level flow matching replaces the linear interpolant of conditional flow matching (CFM) by a Gaussian-process (GP) stream connecting each source--target pair, and reports lower sample error than \icfm{} on 2-Gaussian, MNIST and CIFAR-10 benchmarks. We ask what such a stream model actually contributes. Three results answer the question. (i)~\emph{Reduction.} The stream-level CFM objective depends on the stream law only through the per-time joint law of $(s_t,\sdot_t)$, so the conditional paths a Gaussian stream can reach are exactly the Gaussian conditional paths CFM already parametrises; in the coordinate-wise, shared-scalar-kernel construction gpcfm actually uses, the entire design space collapses to two scalar curves $(m_t,v_t)$, and cross-time covariance affects only estimator variance. (ii)~\emph{The GP is a constrained chart of that space.} One kernel sets both $m_t$ and $v_t$, so the paper's own recipe for widening coverage-shrinking the SE length-scale---destroys the interpolant (the midpoint mean weight falls from $1.03$ to $0.00$). On the 2-Gaussian benchmark this makes the GP chart diverge on $15/200$ runs at high coverage against $0/200$ for a decoupled $(m_t,v_t)$ chart ($p=6.6\times10^{-5}$), and crossing the two curves shows the divergence tracks the mean, not the variance. On MNIST the same sweep does not diverge and the ordering reverses, so whether the coupling is harmful is benchmark-dependent; what holds on both is that the recipe buys nothing---no coverage level beats the paper's own, and past $\max_t\sqrt{v_t}\approx0.6$ both charts degrade. (iii)~\emph{Audit.} The released code does not implement the mechanism it describes: state and velocity are drawn independently ($\mathrm{corr}=0.00\pm0.01$ against an intended $\pm0.83$--$0.99$).

</details>


### [1201] [ExpertoRhythm: Morphology-Aware Learning for Waveform Reconstruction and Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation from Single-Channel PPG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34146)
*Amir Arjomand,Kenneth B. Kent,Georgiy Krylov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ExpertoRhythm——一种注意力增强的一维U-Net，从单通道PPG重建ABP波形并直接得出SBP/DBP；通过形态感知复合损失（范围加权SmoothL1 + 窗口范围正则）提升精度，在UCI数据集（942人）上SBP/DBP MAE为2.46/1.46 mmHg，满足AAMI标准并达BHS A级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于PPG的连续无袖带血压监测对可穿戴与远程医疗具有重要价值，但PPG到BP的映射需保留细微波形形态及随压力范围变化的动态特征，导致准确估计困难；纯MSE等常规目标易造成幅度欠冲/过冲，难以兼顾高压区段精度。

Method: 提出ExpertoRhythm，一种注意力增强的1D U-Net，由单通道PPG重建动脉血压（ABP）波形，并从重建波形直接计算收缩压与舒张压。核心为形态感知复合学习目标：将范围加权SmoothL1重建损失与窗口范围正则项结合，以强化高动态血压段并抑制幅度欠冲/过冲。

Result: 在包含942名受试者的UCI cuff-less BP数据集上，SBP/DBP的MAE分别达2.46/1.46 mmHg；相较纯MSE，在波形重建与血压估计指标上平均相对误差降低30.4%。临床风格评估显示低偏倚、全血压范围一致性好（含最高约200 mmHg的高压窗口），满足AAMI标准并达到BHS Grade A。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基于单通道PPG的形态感知波形重建可为可穿戴与远程护理场景下的连续无袖带血压监测提供准确且实用的技术路径。

Abstract: Continuous cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring from photoplethysmography (PPG) has strong potential for wearable health and telemonitoring, but accurate estimation remains difficult because PPG-to-BP mapping must preserve subtle waveform morphology and pressure-range-dependent dynamics. We introduce ExpertoRhythm, an attention-enhanced 1D U-Net that reconstructs the arterial blood pressure (ABP) waveform from a single-channel PPG signal and derives systolic and diastolic BP directly from the reconstructed waveform. The central contribution is a composite morphology-aware learning objective that integrates range-weighted SmoothL1 reconstruction with a window-range regularizer to emphasize high-dynamic BP segments and reduce amplitude under/over-shoot. On the UCI cuff-less BP dataset with 942 subjects, ExpertoRhythm achieves 2.46/1.46 mmHg MAE for systolic/diastolic BP (SBP/DBP), while obtaining a 30.4% average relative error reduction over pure MSE across waveform reconstruction and BP estimation metrics. Clinical-style evaluation further demonstrates low bias and strong agreement across the BP range, including high-pressure windows up to 200 mmHg, satisfying AAMI criteria and achieving BHS Grade A. These results suggest that morphology-aware waveform reconstruction from a single PPG channel can provide an accurate and practical pathway toward continuous cuffless BP monitoring in wearable and remote-care settings.

</details>


### [1202] [SPINET: Sheaf Protein Inverse Folding Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34153)
*Jens Lundsgaard,Colin Mikulski,Zhixuan Yan,Dhananjay Bhaskar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SPINET，一种以分子动力学轨迹为条件的逆向折叠模型，利用细胞层（cellular sheaves）建模帧内残基相互作用、循环单元整合帧间信息，单次前向预测全部氨基酸序列，在mdCATH和ATLAS上超越静态与集合基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质在行使功能时会发生构象变化，但多数逆向折叠模型仅从单一固定骨架预测氨基酸序列。蛋白质工程的核心挑战之一是设计能发生特定运动的蛋白质，这需要刻画结构随时间的改变，因此有必要开展以蛋白质运动为条件的逆向折叠研究。

Method: SPINET从分子动力学轨迹预测序列：使用细胞层（cellular sheaves）表示每一帧内的残基相互作用，并用循环单元（recurrent units）跨帧整合信息，最终一次前向传播预测全部氨基酸。

Result: 在mdCATH上取得56.7%的top-1序列恢复率，优于最强静态基线（44.5%）与最强集合基线（40.7%）；在mdCATH和ATLAS上均优于所有被评估的静态与集合基线。预测序列与目标轨迹采样的构象兼容，mdCATH上中位TM-score为0.760，且99.5%的测试结构域中，结构恢复更偏好目标构象而非无关诱饵构象。

Conclusion: 以分子动力学轨迹为条件的逆向折叠能够有效提升序列恢复并生成与目标运动构象兼容的序列，表明运动条件建模在蛋白质工程中具有潜力。

Abstract: Proteins change shape as they function, yet most inverse folding models predict amino acid sequences from a single, fixed backbone. A central challenge in protein engineering is to design proteins that undergo specific motions, which requires accounting for how their structures change over time. This motivates inverse protein folding conditioned on protein motion. We introduce SPINET, which predicts sequences from molecular dynamics trajectories. It uses cellular sheaves to represent residue interactions within each frame and recurrent units to integrate information across frames, then predicts all amino acids in a single pass. We evaluate SPINET on mdCATH and ATLAS, where it outperforms all evaluated static and ensemble baselines in sequence recovery. On mdCATH, it achieves 56.7% top-1 recovery, compared with 44.5% for the strongest static baseline and 40.7% for the strongest ensemble baseline. We also evaluate whether the predicted sequences are compatible with conformations sampled along the target trajectory. On mdCATH, they achieve a median TM-score of 0.760, and structural recovery favors target conformations over unrelated decoys for 99.5% of test domains.

</details>


### [1203] [Transfer Calibrated Prediction Powered Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34156)
*Aditya T. Vadlamani,Jae Ho Chang,Srinivasan Parthasarathy,Subhadeep Paul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TC-PPI，通过cross-fitting利用金标准样本将源域预测器适配到目标域，其联合调优估计量Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++在保持无偏性的同时，效率至少不劣于经典推断、PPI和PPI++，从而防止负迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPI与PPI++依赖低残差方差来获得效率增益，但当预测器在源域上预训练时，该假设在目标域可能不成立，导致负迁移。

Method: 提出Transfer Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference (TC-PPI)，利用金标准样本通过cross-fitting将源域预测器适配到目标域，支持稀疏线性校准、LoRA和微调等多种适配方法；并给出联合调优的cross-fit估计量Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++。

Result: Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++保持无偏性，且效率至少与经典推断、PPI、PPI++相当；提供了校准的高维MSE界，并在多个真实应用中相对基线方法取得经验改进。

Conclusion: TC-PPI有效缓解源域预测器在目标域上的负迁移问题，在保持统计有效性的同时实现稳健的效率提升。

Abstract: Prediction-powered inference (PPI) and its power-tuned extension (PPI++) improve confidence intervals by combining a small gold-standard labeled sample with a large AI model's predictions. Its efficiency gain relies on low residual variance, which may not hold if the predictor is pre-trained on a different source domain. We propose Transfer Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference (TC-PPI), adapting the source-domain predictor to the target domain using gold-standard samples through cross-fitting. This approach supports various adaptation methods, such as sparse linear calibration, LoRA, and fine-tuning. Our jointly tuned cross-fit estimator, Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++, maintains unbiasedness and is simultaneously at least as efficient as classical inference, PPI, and PPI++, thereby protecting against negative transfer. We provide high-dimensional MSE bounds for calibration and show empirical improvements over baseline methods across various real-world applications.

</details>


### [1204] [GPARA: Graph-Posterior-Aligned Refinement and Active Acquisition for Grounding Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34172)
*Wangqian Chen,Hao Wang,Yumeng Zhang,Jiajia Guo,Junting Chen,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GPARA，通过在扩散预测残差上学习上下文相关的图代理模型，获得可复用的后验响应算子，实现测量创新向未观测变量的传播与候选测量的加权后验风险下降评估，从而统一主动采集与重建精化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动接地冻结扩散先验需同时决定新测量的采集位置及其用于精化当前重建的方式。现有后验集成方法虽可从生成样本估计采集效用，但随观测累积需反复生成集成，且仅依赖经验统计刻画后验几何，效率与表达能力受限。

Method: GPARA在扩散预测残差上学习上下文相关的图代理模型，导出显式可复用的后验响应算子：该算子将测量创新传播至未观测变量，并通过加权后验风险下降评估候选测量。在匹配代理假设下，同一响应算子同时决定期望单步采集收益，给出与期望重建改进一致的解析排序；引入有界学习残差校准解析效用以补偿代理失配；仅生成一次小型先验集成，通过重条件化更新风险权重，采集过程中无需重复扩散后验采样。

Result: 在两个重建任务（物理场与计算机视觉）上，精化与主动采集性能均持续优于所评估的基线。消融实验进一步支持逐步图精化、自适应风险加权与解析锚定校准三者的互补作用。

Conclusion: 通过学习可复用的后验响应算子，GPARA在匹配代理下统一了采集效用评估与重建改进排序，避免了采集中的重复扩散后验采样，为冻结扩散先验的主动接地提供了高效且具有解析依据的解决方案。

Abstract: Active grounding of a frozen diffusion prior requires jointly determining where new measurements should be taken and how they should be used to refine the current reconstruction. Posterior-ensemble-based methods can estimate acquisition utility from generated samples, but require repeated ensemble generation as observations accumulate and capture posterior geometry only through empirical statistics. This paper proposes GPARA, which learns a context-dependent graph surrogate over diffusion prediction residuals, inducing an explicitly reusable posterior response operator that propagates measurement innovations to unobserved variables and evaluates candidate measurements through weighted posterior-risk reduction. Under the matched surrogate, we show that the same response operator also determines expected one-step acquisition benefit and yields an analytic ranking consistent with expected reconstruction improvement. A bounded learned residual calibrates the analytic utility to account for surrogate mismatch, while a small prior ensemble is generated once and reconditioned to update risk weights without repeated diffusion posterior sampling during acquisition. Experiments on two reconstruction tasks spanning physical field and computer vision show consistent improvements in refinement and active acquisition over the evaluated baselines. Ablations further support the complementary roles of step-wise graph refinement, adaptive risk weighting, and analytically anchored calibration.

</details>


### [1205] [Cardinality-Stratified Interaction Decomposition for Interpretable Pairwise and Higher-Order Structure in Transactional Basket Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34191)
*Hidetoshi Kawase,Toshihiro Ota*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CSID框架，按篮子规模分层将交易数据中的对数几率对比分解为项目集特有成分与基数共性成分，无需拟合全局联合分布，用于可解释地刻画成对与高阶关联结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交易篮子数据中的共现同时混杂了项目间特定关联、篮子规模结构以及未建模的高阶依赖，直接观察到的共现无法区分这些来源，因此需要一个可解释的分解工具来分离项目集特有信号与基数共性效应。

Method: CSID将按剩余项目数分层的对数几率对比分解为项目集特有成分和基数共性成分；采用信息加权、规范约束（gauge-constrained）的岭投影估计成对与三元成分，并诊断高阶项对成对结构的贡献；定位为关联结构的可解释分解而非全分布预测。

Result: 在零成对效应的模拟中，小篮子基数势增强会使普通Ising耦合出现虚假负值，而CSID成对估计仍集中于零附近；检测功效随植入三元效应增强而上升；局部去投影将成对系数RMSE从0.244降至0.073。三个杂货数据集中高信息三元成分跨时间可复现；跨期部分迁移评估中，CSID三元成分与后期分层对比的一致性优于节点对称化的基数感知高阶伪似然基线，加权Lin一致性相关系数提升0.038–0.122。

Conclusion: 结果支持CSID作为交易数据中成对及高阶关联结构的探索性与可解释分解框架。

Abstract: Transactional basket data can reveal associations among items, but observed co-occurrence conflates item-specific relations with basket-size structure and unmodeled higher-order dependence. We introduce Cardinality-Stratified Interaction Decomposition (CSID), an interpretable framework that decomposes log-odds contrasts stratified by the number of remaining items into item-set-specific and cardinality-common components, without fitting a global joint distribution. CSID uses an information-weighted, gauge-constrained ridge projection to estimate pair and triple components and to diagnose higher-order contributions to pairwise structure. CSID is designed primarily for interpretable decomposition of association structure rather than for full-distribution prediction. In a simulation with zero pair effects, increasingly strong small-basket cardinality potentials drive ordinary Ising couplings spuriously negative, whereas CSID pair estimates remain centered near zero. Detection power rises with the magnitude of planted triple effects, and local deprojection reduces pair-coefficient RMSE from 0.244 to 0.073. Across three grocery datasets, high-information triple components are reproducible over time. In the matched cross-period partial-transfer evaluation, transferred CSID triple components show closer agreement with later-period stratified contrasts than the nodewise-symmetrized cardinality-aware higher-order pseudolikelihood comparator, with gains in weighted Lin's concordance correlation of 0.038--0.122. These results support CSID as an exploratory and interpretable decomposition framework for pairwise and higher-order association structure in transactional data.

</details>


### [1206] [Frozen Judges, Moving Agents: Version-Dependent LLM-Judge Error and the Limits of Judge-Assisted Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34198)
*Jiapeng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统检验了“语言模型评委”在比较智能体新旧版本时的可靠性，发现评委错误依赖任务与版本，跨任务迁移校准与仅凭评委的发布决策不可靠，主张采用显式参照标准与配对审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用语言模型评委替代人工或执行型评估来比较智能体升级与其前代版本已成为常见做法，但固定评委可能产生与版本相关的系统性错误，即评委误差并不满足任务条件下的不变性。作者希望量化这种偏差的来源、规模与后果，并检验常见补救手段（沿用旧版本校准、仅依据评委区间做发布决策）是否成立。

Method: 分析三类数据：（1）35个公开编码智能体提交，包含250个SWE-bench Verified问题上的20组预设版本对（主分析含8,743个对齐的智能体—任务单元，因上游故障仅三名评委可用，第四名仅作描述性分析）；（2）两个客服智能体在155个tau-bench任务上的表现；（3）1,106条专家标注的AgentRewardBench轨迹。方法上检验“任务条件下的误差不变性”假设（含多重性校正）、分解评委比较单元中的差分成分、与执行型区间对照、比较校准迁移前后的平均绝对比较误差、用比率自助法考察边界附近的未定义比例，并以调优的配对审计、经典区间收窄幅度及随机三臂实验检验预测效应。

Result: 三个编码智能体评委与四个tau-bench评委在多重性校正后均拒绝任务条件误差不变性。SWE-bench上60个“评委×版本对”单元中有32个存在可检测的差分比较成分；八个仅评委区间宣称的改进无法被执行型区间确证，尽管二者秩相关为0.71–0.79。tau-bench中某评委通过惩罚奖励函数并不在意的流程习惯，自信地反转了九分的参照奖励差距。在给定任务与参照结果条件下，对失败编码补丁的误接受率随智能体能力上升；一个来自AgentRewardBench的任务可解性预测在SWE-bench中符号反转。迁移旧版本校准使SWE-bench的平均绝对比较误差由3.8个百分点升至19.5个百分点，且24.6%的比率自助抽样在修正边界附近未定义。调优配对审计在80个标注任务下仅将经典区间收窄约5%。显示智能体最终报告会提高误接受的预测未获支持（三个Holm校正p值均为1.0）。

Conclusion: 仅凭评委的发布决策与沿用旧版本校准都不可靠，评委误差随任务和版本系统性变化且难以跨设定迁移。应优先采用显式参照标准并对当前输出进行配对审计，而非依赖评委单独给出区间或直接移植旧校准。

Abstract: Language-model judges compare agent upgrades with their predecessors, but a fixed judge can make version-dependent mistakes. We analyze 35 public coding-agent submissions (20 prespecified version pairs on 250 SWE-bench Verified issues), two customer-service agents (155 tau-bench tasks), and 1,106 expert-labeled AgentRewardBench trajectories. An upstream outage left three judges for the primary SWE-bench analysis (8,743 aligned agent-task cells); the fourth is descriptive. All three coding-agent judges and all four tau-bench judges reject task-conditioned error invariance after multiplicity adjustment. On SWE-bench, 32 of 60 judge-by-pair units have a detectable differential comparison component; eight judge-only intervals declare improvements that execution-based intervals cannot establish, despite rank correlations of 0.71-0.79. In tau-bench, one judge confidently reverses a nine-point reference-reward gap by penalizing a procedural habit the reward ignores.
