To address this, we formulate collaborative scientific discovery as evidence transfer between parallel principle-evolution branches. We present COEVOLVE, which realizes this transfer through a coordination core over parallel branches. By integrating value-of-information-gated routing and context-discounted likelihood injection, COEVOLVE enables branches to collaborate through shared measurements while keeping their principle posteriors separate. Across six scientific-discovery tasks under a matched evaluation budget, COEVOLVE attains a mean solution quality of 66.5% versus 57.0% for single-branch principle evolution, with a 1.80x mean wall-clock speedup on the GPT-5.6-Terra backbone; on five auto-research tasks delegated to an autonomous research harness, it is the only arm whose mean stays above the published SOTA anchor on every task. These results establish when evidence sharing accelerates parallel discovery and when transfer safeguards are necessary to limit negative or inert transfers

</details>


### [1310] [Weighting Schedules Govern What and When Score-Based Generative Models Learn from Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35322)
*Jérémie Klinger,Raphaël Urfin,Giulio Biroli,Marylou Gabrié*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过高维精确分析，揭示SNR Λ(t)如何决定多模态目标各特征（模式方向与相对权重）在训练中的习得速率，并解释时间加权调度 w(t) 的设计影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/分数生成模型训练需在时间 t 上以权重 w(t) 积分损失，但 w(t) 设计缺乏理论指导；多模态分布中轨迹会在极窄的“物种化时间”（speciation time）窗口内锁定模式，需理解其学习动力学机制。

Method: 将积分损失按单时间贡献分解，在固定信噪比 Λ(t) 下分析；对不平衡与层次高维高斯混合模型进行训练动力学的精确高维分析；并在图像与人类基因组单倍型生成任务上做数值实验验证。

Result: 高 Λ(t) 时所有模式方向以单一时间尺度同时获得且与幅度无关，相对权重完全学不到；仅当 Λ(t) 约为 1（物种化时间附近）所有特征才可学，各自有独立时间尺度：权重与方向共同习得，方向速率由相对幅度决定。时间积分目标的动力学由权重在物种化时间附近的有效占比决定。图像与基因组实验重现了预测的学习时间尺度层级。

Conclusion: Λ(t) 是控制多模态特征学习速率的关键量；有效学习要求权重集中于物种化时间附近，为 w(t) 设计提供理论依据。

Abstract: Score-based generative models generate new samples by integrating a time-dependent drift that carries Gaussian noise onto the target distribution. In practice this drift is modeled by a neural network, trained on a loss integrated over time $t$ with a weighting schedule $w(t)$. Along the backward dynamics, and for multi-modal distributions, trajectories commit to modes of the target within a narrow time window, the \textit{speciation time}. In this work, focusing on high-dimensional data, we decompose the integrated loss into its single-time contributions and analyze each at fixed signal-to-noise ratio $Λ(t)$: we show that $Λ(t)$ sets the rate at which each feature of a multimodal target - the mode directions and their relative weights - is acquired during training. Crucially, at high $Λ(t)$ all mode directions are acquired together, on a single timescale insensitive to their amplitudes, while the relative weights are not learned at all. Only near the speciation time, where $Λ(t)$ becomes of order one, do all features become learnable, each on its own timescale: the weights are acquired jointly with the directions, and the directions at rates set by their relative amplitudes. For models trained on time-integrated objectives, the learning dynamics is then governed by how much of the weighting effectively sits near the speciation time, which provides insights on $w(t)$ design choices. These results follow from an exact high-dimensional analysis of the training dynamics of unbalanced and hierarchical Gaussian mixtures. Numerical experiments on image and human genome haplotype generation recover the predicted hierarchy of learning timescales in more complex settings.

</details>


### [1311] [Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Algorithm Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35333)
*Yuanqing Ma,Zhenrui Zheng,Chenjun Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RAD（循环算法蒸馏），通过压缩Transformer将长交互历史蒸馏为紧凑隐令牌，供AD Transformer在混合上下文下自回归生成动作，以固定大小隐缓冲解耦历史长度与计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始算法蒸馏（AD）虽能让Transformer在无显式权重更新下进行上下文强化学习，但捕捉长期学习进程需要极长上下文窗口，导致内存开销过大、难以扩展到复杂长时程任务。

Method: RAD采用双组件架构：1）压缩Transformer，将扩展的交互历史蒸馏为紧凑的隐令牌；2）AD Transformer，基于这些压缩记忆与近期转移构成的混合上下文，自回归生成动作。通过维护固定大小的隐缓冲，将有效历史长度与计算复杂度解耦，从而在功能上赋予模型长时程记忆。

Result: 在多种环境的实证评估中，RAD以显著更小的上下文窗口达到了标准AD的渐近性能。

Conclusion: RAD为高效的上下文内决策提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，缓解了长上下文带来的内存与可扩展性瓶颈。

Abstract: Algorithm Distillation (AD) has demonstrated the remarkable ability of Transformers to perform in-context reinforcement learning without explicit weight updates. However, capturing long-term learning progress necessitates expansive context windows, which incur prohibitive memory costs and limit scalability in complex, long-horizon tasks. To address this bottleneck, we propose Recurrent Algorithm Distillation (RAD). RAD employs a dual-component architecture: a Compression Transformer that distills extended interaction histories into compact latent tokens, and an AD Transformer that auto-regressively generates actions using a hybrid context of these compressed memories and recent transitions. By maintaining a fixed-size latent buffer, RAD decouples the effective history length from computational complexity, functionally providing the model with a long-horizon memory. Empirical evaluations across diverse environments demonstrate that RAD matches the asymptotic performance of standard AD with significantly reduced context window sizes, offering a scalable solution for efficient in-context decision-making.

</details>


### [1312] [NeuronDiscover: Agent-in-Twin for Mechanistic Discovery in Neuronal Microenvironments with World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35338)
*Haowei Xu,Wanyi Fu,Hongbin Han,Zhaoheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 NeuronDiscover——一种"孪生体内智能体"（Agent-in-Twin）框架，通过机制驱动的世界行动模型耦合预测、干预提议与观测设计，在联合机制–偏差信念上推理以分离机制性改变与计算孪生误差，并在仿真示踪输运世界与公开电流钳记录上验证其关系辨识效率优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经元微环境中的机制发现需要能够区分溶质输运与神经元响应竞争解释的干预与测量。仅靠预测精度无法判定机制：真实的机制改变与计算孪生中的误差在稀疏观测中留下相同签名（"孪生混淆"），因此必须设计能分离二者的实验。

Method: NeuronDiscover 是 Agent-in-Twin 框架，其共享且机制落地的 World Action Model（WAM）耦合预测、干预提议与观测设计；独立裁决的结果用于修订有作用域的 Mechanism–Intervention–Observation–Outcome（MIOY）图，图中受支持关系编译为携带偏差调整接受界的可执行程序。方法在联合"机制–偏差信念"上推理，实现联合机制–偏差获取与偏差调整验证。

Result: 在独立冻结的更细网格参考求解器裁决的仿真脑液示踪输运世界，以及供体不相交的公开皮层神经元电流钳记录上评估。仅计达到认证终态的关系、并将弃权统一记为未解决，在16次实验/32源单位预算下：NeuronDiscover 每个分配世界解决4.0个关系，最强基线3.4，无图修订3.2；虚假支持率5%，作用域准确率82%。联合机制–偏差获取解决3.8个关系 vs 插件式期望信息增益2.9；偏差调整验证将接受程序失败率从15%降至9%（60%接受覆盖率）；迁移到电流钳记录为每分配世界1.94 vs 1.53。正确性在声明的模型世界与档案记录内裁决。

Conclusion: 机制–偏差的联合建模与偏差调整验证可有效缓解孪生混淆，提升关系辨识效率并降低接受程序失败率，在仿真与真实记录迁移中均优于基线；但结论的正确性限于所声明的模型世界与档案记录范围内。

Abstract: Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. We evaluate on simulated brain-fluid tracer-transport worlds adjudicated by an independently frozen finer-mesh reference solver, and on donor-disjoint public current-clamp recordings of cortical neurons. Counting only relations that reach a certified terminal status, and scoring abstentions as unresolved for every method, at a matched budget of 16 experiments over 32 source units NeuronDiscover resolves 4.0 relations per assigned world against 3.4 for the strongest baseline and 3.2 without graph revision, at 5% false support and 82% scope accuracy. Joint mechanism--discrepancy acquisition resolves 3.8 relations versus 2.9 for plug-in expected information gain; discrepancy-adjusted verification lowers accepted-program failure from 15% to 9% at 60% acceptance coverage; and transfer to the recordings yields 1.94 versus 1.53 relations per assigned world. Correctness is adjudicated within declared model worlds and archival recordings.

</details>


### [1313] [Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35347)
*Xin Li,Hao Jiang,Xin Gao,Annan Wang,Yuchen Xie,Jinghao Guo,Xingwei Qu,Yichi Zhang,Chau Yuen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）中学生受指令跟随反馈主导，未能超越最佳单专家；提出按域方差归一化的 DN-MOPD，恢复数学增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用强化学习可训练出数学、代码、指令跟随等单技能专家模型，但用户需要集所有技能于一身的单一模型。多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）通过路由让对应领域专家逐 token 反馈来合并这些专家，然而路由只决定"谁教"，未决定"反馈影响力多大"。

Method: 作者在三种规模的 Qwen3.5 上诊断 MOPD 的反馈失衡问题，发现指令跟随反馈的离散度是数学反馈的数倍并主导学生更新；据此提出 Domain-Normalized MOPD（DN-MOPD）：保留原有路由机制，按各领域实测反馈离散度对反馈进行重新缩放，以平衡各域对共享学生更新的贡献。并设置固定域权重对照实验。

Result: 在六个公开基准、三个随机种子、两种答案长度限制下，DN-MOPD 在每种模型规模上的平均分均优于 MOPD，并恢复了大部分丢失的数学增益。固定域权重对照表明，增益主要来自调低指令跟随反馈，而非单独调高数学；且与 DN-MOPD 实测权重相近的固定权重表现相当。

Conclusion: 合并多专家时，不仅要决定由哪个专家教学，还要决定其反馈的权重强度；按域归一化反馈尺度是一种简单有效的改进方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. This routing decides which specialist teaches, but not how strongly its feedback moves the shared student. In Qwen3.5 models at three sizes, we find that MOPD's student does not beat one taught by the best single specialist and gains little of the mathematics specialist's advantage. The feedback is unbalanced: instruction-following feedback is several times more spread out than mathematics feedback and dominates the student's updates. We propose Domain-Normalized MOPD (DN-MOPD), which keeps the routing and rescales each domain's feedback by its measured spread. On six public benchmarks, DN-MOPD improves the average score over MOPD at every size, across three random seeds and under two answer-length limits, and recovers most of the lost mathematics gain. Controls with fixed domain weights show that the gain comes mainly from turning down instruction-following feedback rather than turning up mathematics alone, and that fixed weights close to those DN-MOPD measures perform comparably. Combining specialists therefore requires deciding not only which one teaches, but also how strongly its feedback counts.

</details>


### [1314] [Quasi Linear Kernel Attention with Infinite Capacity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35349)
*Nicolaj Rux,Johannes Hertrich,Sebastian Neumayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用"核容量"量化注意力核的表达能力，证明softmax等表达核容量无限，而常见准线性核容量有限；提出基于单变量样条与多项式指数核的可加核，在保持无限容量同时借助排序实现准线性计算，并在长序列上验证了优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: softmax注意力的评估成本随序列长度呈二次增长，核注意力用更一般的核函数替代softmax以降低复杂度。但现有准线性核往往牺牲表达能力，因此需要一个量化表达能力的指标，并设计既保持表达性又能准线性计算的核。

Method: 引入"容量"指标，定义为注意力矩阵能近似单位阵的最大序列长度，容量越高表示表达能力越强。据此分析softmax、Gauss、Laplace等核（无限容量）与有限维特征映射导出的常见准线性核（有限容量）。进而提出由单变量样条核和多项式指数核构造的可加核，证明其容量无限，并通过排序实现准线性计算。

Result: softmax、Gauss、Laplace等表达核具有无限容量；有限维特征映射导出的准线性核容量有限；所提可加样条/多项式指数核具有无限容量且可准线性计算。高效实现可加排序核并与现代softmax后端基准对比，在长序列上展现优势。

Conclusion: 可加核（单变量样条与多项式指数核）能够兼顾softmax类表达性与准线性计算效率，为长序列注意力提供有前景的替代方案。

Abstract: The evaluation cost of transformers with softmax attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Kernel attention addresses this by replacing softmax with a more general kernel function. In this paper, we aim to identify kernels that retain the expressivity of attention while enabling quasi linear computation. To quantify expressivity, we introduce a capacity for each kernel, measuring the maximum sequence length for which the attention matrix can approximate the identity. A higher capacity thus indicates greater expressivity. We show that expressive kernels like softmax, Gauss, and Laplace have infinite capacity. In contrast, common quasi linear kernels, such as those derived from finite dimensional feature maps, exhibit finite capacity. As a solution, we propose additive kernels constructed from univariate spline and polynomial exponential kernels. We prove that these maintain infinite capacity while allowing quasi linear computation via sorting. Finally, we implement additive sorting kernels efficiently and benchmark them against modern softmax backends, demonstrating advantages for long sequences.

</details>


### [1315] [Interference Beyond Geometry in Concept Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35351)
*Valérie Costa,Bahareh Tolooshams*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"有效干扰"概念，将特征几何与编码统计相结合以刻画实际发生的交互，并揭示架构约束通过四种机制塑造干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统研究通常将干扰视为学习特征之间的几何重叠，但该视角忽略特征在实际编码中的使用方式，无法区分建设性与破坏性干扰，也难以分辨频繁的弱交互与罕见的强交互。

Method: 提出有效干扰（effective interference），融合特征几何与编码统计量；在局部固定支撑（local fixed-support）假设下，分析架构约束影响干扰的四种机制：特征正交化、偏置补偿、增益适应以及编码器-解码器分离。并在稀疏自编码器上进行实验验证。

Result: 实验表明，受约束的架构能够选择性地降低共激活特征之间的重叠，同时偏置、增益与编码器自由度允许建设性的交叉贡献得以保留。

Conclusion: 学习表征中的干扰不仅取决于特征几何，还取决于特征的使用方式以及产生其编码的架构。

Abstract: Interference is commonly treated as geometric overlap between learned features. We introduce effective interference, which combines feature geometry and code statistics to capture realized interactions, distinguishing constructive from destructive interference and frequent weak interactions from rare strong ones. Under local fixed-support assumptions, we characterize how architectural constraints shape interference through four mechanisms: feature orthogonalization, bias compensation, gain adaptation, and encoder-decoder separation. Experiments with sparse autoencoders show that constrained architectures selectively reduce overlap among co-active features, while bias, gain, and encoder freedom allow constructive cross-contributions to remain. Together, these results show that interference in learned representations depends not only on feature geometry, but also on how features are used and on the architecture that produces their codes.

</details>


### [1316] [Fiona: Accelerating FHE Inference with Packing-Aware Ternary Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35352)
*Yiteng Peng,Zhibo Liu,Dongwei Xiao,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FIONA，一种离线优化器，可在给定打包布局下选择性对权重进行ternary量化，以减少FHE神经网络推理中的明文-密文乘法开销，在主流模型上大幅减少PMult并显著加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FHE虽支持在加密输入上直接进行神经网络推理，但其速度比明文推理慢数个数量级。服务器明文权重与加密激活之间的PMult占推理时间一半以上。三元量化可将乘法替换为加减法，但在打包执行下，单个PMult对应固定权重组，只有当组内所有权重共享同一ternary值时才可避免乘法；而全部ternarize又会严重损害精度。

Method: FIONA基于ternary转换对模型性能的估计影响，在既定打包布局内选择性ternarize权重。它鼓励每个权重组内共享同一ternary值，并对敏感组保留全精度权重，使ternarized与full-precision路径在同一层内共存。随后精确编译这些混合算子，对累积输入只应用一次公共缩放因子，并在多个输出间复用求和。权重ternarization还可收窄下游多项式的输入范围，FIONA在累积精度预算下拟合更低次数的替代多项式，从而降低乘法深度与bootstrapping需求。

Result: 在VGG11、ViT和BERT上，FIONA分别将PMult运算减少53.4-79.5%，端到端加密推理加速2.38x、1.68x和1.84x，且三个模型的精度损失均小于1%。

Conclusion: 通过选择性ternary量化与混合算子精确编译，FIONA有效缓解了FHE推理中PMult瓶颈，在保持精度近乎无损的前提下实现了显著加速，并可协同降低多项式次数与bootstrapping开销。

Abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables neural network inference directly on encrypted inputs, but it remains orders of magnitude slower than plaintext in- ference. Applying the server's plaintext weights to encrypted activations involves plaintext-ciphertext multiplications (PMult) and accounts for more than half of inference time in recent systems. Ternary quantization can replace these multipli- cations with additions and subtractions, but the savings rarely materialize under packed execution. A single PMult applies a weight group fixed by the packing layout and can be avoided only when all its weights share the same ternary value. Ternarizing all groups, however, largely degrades accuracy.
  We present FIONA, an offline optimizer that selectively ternarizes weights within a given packing layout based on the estimated effect of ternary conversion on the model's performance. FIONA encourages a shared ternary value within each weight group and retains full-precision weights for sensitive groups, so ternar- ized and full-precision paths coexist within a layer. It then compiles these hybrid operators exactly, applying common scaling factors once to accumulated inputs and reusing sums across outputs. Weight ternarization can also narrow the input ranges of downstream polynomials. FIONA fits lower-degree replacements under a cumulative accuracy budget, reducing multiplicative depth and bootstrapping. On VGG11, ViT, and BERT, FIONA reduces PMult operations by 53.4-79.5% and accelerates end-to-end encrypted inference by 2.38x, 1.68x, and 1.84x, re- spectively, with less than 1% accuracy loss across all three models.

</details>


### [1317] [First Learn, Then Memorize: The Spectral Bias of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35377)
*Raphaël Urfin,Tony Bonnaire,Giulio Biroli,Marc Mézard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了扩散模型"先泛化、后记忆"现象背后的机制：score函数训练动力学由含噪训练数据上的NTK Gram矩阵精确支配，多次噪声采样($m$份)将该矩阵谱分为两部分——大特征值块承载全局分布特征（$m=1$即存在），小特征值块由重复加噪在样本特定噪声方向上形成，决定了随训练集规模$n$参数化增长的记忆时间尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在有限数据集上训练时，会先学会生成新颖的高质量样本，很久之后才坍缩到训练集上。作者希望识别这种时间尺度分离背后的机制，并找到能够探测该机制的对象。

Method: 1) 理论上指出score函数训练动力学（精确地、任意宽度下）由含噪训练数据上NTK的Gram矩阵支配，泛化与记忆的时间尺度编码在其谱中。2) 在惰性高维极限下，对线性($n \asymp d$)和多项式($n \asymp d^k$)样本复杂度解析求解谱结构。3) 通过偏差-方差分解证明第一个特征值块最小化近似误差、第二个块驱动记忆相关误差。4) 实验上在CelebA卷积NTK和超出惰性区间的有限宽度U-Net上验证同样的双块结构，并通过秩$r$截断Gram矩阵和针对第二块的$L_2$惩罚做因果验证。

Result: 理论上：Gram矩阵谱被score-matching损失中每样本多个噪声实现($m$个固定噪声水平下的加噪副本)重构为两部分；大特征值块($m=1$即有)承载目标分布全局特征；由重复加噪产生的最小特征值块支撑在与样本特定噪声方向对齐的特征向量上，其记忆时间尺度随$n$参数化增大。实验上：CelebA上的卷积NTK与训练远超惰性区间的有限宽度U-Net均呈现相同的双块结构；截断Gram矩阵至秩$r$可调控泛化-记忆转变；针对第二块的$L_2$惩罚能抑制特征学习U-Net中的记忆。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的泛化与记忆时间尺度分离由NTK Gram矩阵谱中一种在标准核设定下无对应物的结构所决定，该结构由多重噪声采样的score-matching损失塑造，并可通过谱截断或针对性正则进行因果控制。

Abstract: Diffusion models trained on a finite dataset first learn to generate novel, high-quality samples and only much later collapse onto their training set. We identify the mechanism behind this separation of timescales and the object that probes it. The training dynamics of the score function are governed---exactly, and at any width---by the Gram matrix of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluated on the noisy training data, so the timescales of generalization and of memorization must be encoded in its spectrum. We show that they are, and that the structure responsible has no analogue in standard kernel settings. The use of multiple noise realizations per sample ($m$ noised copies at a fixed noise level) in the score-matching loss is what restructures the Gram matrix spectrum into two distinct parts. The first, of large eigenvalues, carries the global features of the target distribution and is present already for $m=1$. The second, which the repeated noising creates, consists of the smallest eigenvalues and is supported on eigenvectors aligned with the sample-specific noise directions; it sets a memorization timescale parametrically larger in the training set size $n$. We establish this picture on two fronts. Analytically, we solve the spectrum in the lazy high-dimensional limit for both linear ($n \asymp d$) and polynomial ($n \asymp d^k$) sample complexities, and prove through a bias--variance decomposition that the first bulk minimizes the approximation error while the second drives the error associated with memorization. Empirically, we show the same two-bulk structure in Convolutional NTKs on CelebA and in finite-width U-Nets trained well beyond the lazy regime, and we make the link causal: truncating the Gram matrix at rank $r$ tunes the generalization--memorization transition, and an $L_2$ penalty targeting the second bulk suppresses memorization in feature-learning U-Nets.

</details>


### [1318] [Identifying Neural Source Dynamics from Unknown Local Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35379)
*Ayana Mussabayeva,Jiaqi Sun,Anuar Aimoldin,Olivier Oullier,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文证明：在已知解剖前向模型但基线实验仅激发部分源状态空间时，未知的局部机制变化（干预）可提供缺失信息，从而无需可达性即可辨识脑源线性动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG 记录的是脑源活动的混合信号。即便已知解剖前向模型，若实验只激发部分源状态空间，源动力学仍不可辨识，且重复实验无法消除歧义。作者希望利用“局部机制变化”这一干预手段来补充缺失信息，突破基线实验的辨识极限。

Method: 考虑固定解剖源之间的线性动力学，源状态初始化模式已知。每次改变一个源在某一转移步的更新规则，会在随后的 EEG 中留下秩一、源特异的签名；通过与匹配基线响应相减将其分离，再由前向模型定位该源并标定其响应历史。将这些历史与初始化响应结合，可在不依赖基线可达性、也无需先辨识干预系数的条件下恢复源间相互作用。文中给出了充分恢复条件、直接估计器以及以源标签正确为前提的噪声敏感度界。并基于 MRI 导出的解剖结构进行仿真 EEG 验证。

Result: 在 12 个源坐标中仅 4 个被基线激发的设定下，8 个未知变化即可在 32/32 个系统中恢复全部动力学；而基线实现、经可逆前向模型的基线回归、以及未暴露被测状态的变化均失败，且可显式构造出与所有基线均值一致的替代动力学。当基线信息充分时，直接重建比匹配信息的谱估计器更可靠。非局部变化与前向模型误差即使在源标签正确时仍会限制精度。

Conclusion: 局部机制变化可作为辨识脑源动力学的额外信息源，弥补基线激发不足导致的不可辨识性，为 EEG 源动力学辨识提供了一条不依赖基线可达性的直接重建路径；其精度受非局部变化与前向模型误差制约。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) records mixtures of brain-source activity. Even with a known anatomical forward model, experiments that excite only part of the source-state space leave the dynamics unidentified, and repetition cannot resolve the ambiguity. We show that unknown local mechanism changes can supply the missing information. We consider linear dynamics among fixed anatomical sources with known source-state initialization patterns. Changing one source's update rule for one transition leaves a rank-one, source-specific signature in subsequent EEG: subtracting matched baseline responses isolates it, and the forward model identifies the source and calibrates its response history. Combining these histories with initialization responses recovers source interactions without baseline reachability and without first identifying the intervention coefficients. We establish sufficient recovery conditions, a direct estimator, and a noise-sensitivity bound conditional on correct source labels. Simulated EEG on anatomy derived from magnetic resonance imaging confirms the information gain: with baseline excitation confined to four of twelve source coordinates, eight unknown changes recover all dynamics in 32/32 systems, whereas baseline realization, baseline regression through an invertible forward model, and changes that leave the tested states unexposed all fail, and explicitly constructed alternative dynamics reproduce every baseline mean. Where baseline information suffices, direct reconstruction is also more reliable than a matched-information spectral estimator. Nonlocal changes and forward-model error limit accuracy even when source labels are correct.

</details>


### [1319] [Inductive Feedback for Mixed-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35390)
*Amir Moeini,Huaijiang Zhu,Daniel Havir,Shangtong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对on-policy distillation的两大缺陷（迁移无关的教师偏好、反馈信息利用不充分），提出以"确认框架"构建目标分布并结合共享 rollout 的对称散度估计器，在多类基准上超越标准on-policy蒸馏及对比式变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型后训练可借助言语反馈（verbal feedback）识别错误并给出修正建议，即使缺少可靠的程序化验证器也能提供监督。常用做法是让强模型生成反馈并以此条件化教师，在on-policy蒸馏中让学生匹配教师在学生自身 rollout 上的预测。但该做法存在两个问题：一是会迁移反馈并未激发的教师固有偏好，二是反馈中的大量指导信息未被利用。

Method: 作者指出两个问题均源于标准on-policy蒸馏目标，即其所最小化的散度以及所采用的目标分布。方法上：(1) 将言语反馈视为"某前缀下某token是否为下一个token"这一假设的正/反证据，采用概率确认框架，由教师接收反馈前后预测唯一确定一个词表排序，并以与该排序一致的确认分数在学生信任域内构造目标分布；(2) 针对学生 rollout 可能未覆盖的指导信息，推导出一个简单的共享 rollout 估计器，用重要性加权双向复用学生与反馈条件化教师的 rollout，以估计学生与目标分布间的对称散度。

Result: 在知识类与智能体（agentic）基准上，该方法优于常见的on-policy蒸馏配方以及近期提出的对比式变体。

Conclusion: 通过重新设计目标分布（确认分数+信任域）与散度（共享 rollout 的对称散度估计），可同时隔离反馈所传达的信息与教师固有偏好，并更充分地利用反馈指导，从而提升语言模型后训练效果。

Abstract: Verbal feedback can identify errors and prescribe corrections, providing rich supervision for language-model post-training even when reliable programmatic verifiers are unavailable. Such feedback, often generated by a capable model, can be used to condition the teacher in on-policy distillation, which trains the student to match the teacher's predictions on student-generated rollouts. However, this approach can transfer teacher preferences that the feedback did not motivate, while leaving much of the feedback's guidance unused. We find that both problems come from the standard on-policy distillation objective, specifically the divergence it minimizes and the distribution it uses as its target. Our proposed method addresses both limitations. First, to isolate the information conveyed by the feedback from the teacher's inherent preferences, we treat verbal feedback as evidence for or against the hypothesis that a particular token comes next at a given prefix. We then adopt a probabilistic confirmation framework which uniquely determines an ordering over the vocabulary based on the teacher's predictions before and after it receives feedback. Using a confirmation score consistent with this ordering, we construct a target distribution within a trust region of the student. Second, to learn from guidance that student rollouts can leave unused, we derive a simple shared-rollout estimator of a symmetric divergence between the student and target distributions over rollouts, reusing student and feedback-conditioned teacher rollouts in both directions through importance weighting. Empirical evaluations show that our method outperforms the common on-policy distillation recipe and a recent contrastive variant on knowledge-based and agentic benchmarks.

</details>


### [1320] [Persistent Partners Raise Prices Among Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35402)
*Paul-Peter Arslan,Yubin Kim,Xiao Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在重复 Bertrand 双寡头平台上，用预注册随机实验考察"平台决定配对对象"是否影响 Q-learning 智能体学到的价格水平，以及价格上升是否伴随"习得性惩罚"。结果：固定伙伴显著提高利润与稳态价格；在对手价格不可见时价格仍上升且持续，说明"只看惩罚"的检验会漏掉这种上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平台（而非智能体）掌握"谁面对谁"的匹配权，但既有算法合谋/多智能体强化学习文献多关注学习规则本身，较少检验平台层面的配对与信息可见性是否因果性地改变学到的价格水平，也少区分"价格上升"与"习得性惩罚"两种机制。作者希望用预注册随机实验把这一匹配选择的作用识别清楚，并厘清价格上升是否必然以可惩罚的偏离为中介。

Method: 在 Calvano 等的 Bertrand 双寡头环境中开展预注册随机实验：定价由表格型 Q-learning 模块完成（而非附带的语言模型），随机操纵三个因素——是否保持同一伙伴、是否能看到对手价格、是否可发送消息。以二十组配对运行作主检验，并用纯表格学习器在另外 25 个 block 复现；用强制偏离探针（forced-deviation probe）度量惩罚，并以静态最优反应者作为对照来剥离非惩罚成分。另在探索性扩展中检验 Qwen2.5 7B/14B 等语言模型。

Result: 固定伙伴使训练期平均利润提高竞争—垄断利润差的 0.27（95% CI 0.20–0.35，20 组配对全为正，为预注册主要结果），稳态价格提高 Nash—垄断区间的 0.17（事后）。纯表格学习器在全部 25 个追加 block 复现；其中永久伙伴比约三个伙伴提升更大（+0.23 vs +0.05，探索性）。对手价格不可见时，定价模块看不到降价因而无法惩罚，但稳态价格上升幅度相同且持续到训练结束；可见时上升随训练变长而缩小（事后）。可见对手下，静态最优反应者可解释强制偏离探针所读"惩罚"的三分之一到一半，扣除后习得性惩罚的预注册检验不结论；只看惩罚的检验会漏掉对手隐藏时的价格上升，而盈利偏离检查却能标记其中多数价格（事后）。语言模型扩展中，Qwen2.5 7B/14B 在省略对手价格的提示下表现该效应，显示对手价格时结果不稳定，7B 可在新 block 复现，另两个模型家族无此效应。

Conclusion: 平台的配对选择与信息可见性因果性地改变了智能体学到的价格水平；但价格上升并不以"习得性惩罚"为前提——在对手不可见、无法惩罚的情境下价格同样上升并持续，因此仅以惩罚为检验目标的实验设计会系统性遗漏这一效应，需要同时检查盈利偏离。

Abstract: When pricing agents meet repeatedly on a platform, the platform decides who faces whom. We ask whether that choice moves the prices the agents learn, and whether a rise comes with learned punishment. In a pre-registered randomised experiment in the Bertrand duopoly of Calvano et al., each agent's price is set by a tabular Q-learning module, not by the small language model attached to it, and we randomise whether each agent keeps its partner, sees its rival's prices and can send messages. Keeping the same partner raises the level of profits, averaged over training, by 0.27 of the gap between competitive and monopoly profit (95% CI 0.20 to 0.35, all twenty paired runs positive), our registered primary result, and the resting price by 0.17 of the Nash-to-monopoly range (post hoc). A plain tabular learner reproduces the effect in all 25 further blocks, and there one permanent partner raises the level more than about three do (+0.23 against +0.05, exploratory). Where rival prices are hidden, the price-setting module cannot see a cut, so cannot punish it, yet the resting price rises as much and the rise lasts to the end of training, while with visible rivals it shrinks with longer training (post hoc). Where the rival is visible, a static best responder accounts for a third to a half of what a forced-deviation probe reads as punishment, on the starts where the rival can see the cut, and net of it the registered test of learned punishment is inconclusive. A test that looks only for punishment would thus miss the rise where the rival is hidden, while a check for profitable deviations flags most of those prices (post hoc). In an exploratory extension, untrained Qwen2.5 7B and 14B models under one prompt show the effect when the rival's price is left out of the prompt and inconsistently when it is shown, the 7B result replicating on fresh blocks, while two other model families show none.

</details>


### [1321] [SOLO: Pretraining Billion-Parameter Language Models with Shared-Output Local Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35440)
*Bojian Yin,Shurong Wang,Yuqi Pan,Guoqi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SOLO用共享的最终模块readout副本替代各模块私有readout，实现十亿参数级Transformer预训练中的局部学习，在精度逼近反向传播的同时解除更新锁定，获得显著显存与吞吐收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反向传播的全局梯度需要协调所有层，迫使各层保存激活并等待梯度逐层回传，造成更新锁定（update locking）。传统局部学习虽通过各模块自身的readout消除锁定，却无法扩展到十亿参数级预训练，其关键缺陷在于私有readout使模块无法获得更深层模块的信息。

Method: 提出Shared-Output LOcal learning（SOLO）：用一个共享的、只读的最终模块readout副本替换各模块的私有readout，该副本是唯一在整网输出上训练的readout，取自上一训练步，从而在不传递模块间梯度、不重新引入更新锁定的前提下传递最终模块的信息。并做了readout消融实验。

Result: 在340M至2B参数、15B token预训练的Transformer上，SOLO的平均零样本准确率与反向传播相差在1个百分点以内，困惑度差距随规模增大而缩小；消融表明性能提升归因于共享机制。因无更新锁定，p个流水线阶段各自只需为O(1)个micro-batch保存激活而非O(p)，释放的显存支持更大micro-batch，吞吐达到同分区流水线反向传播最佳实测值的1.44倍。

Conclusion: SOLO是首个在十亿参数级语言模型预训练中展现显存与吞吐收益的局部学习方法，使局部学习成为大规模预训练中反向传播的实用替代方案。

Abstract: Large language models are trained with backpropagation, whose global gradient coordinates all layers but forces each to hold its activations and wait for the gradient to pass back through every deeper layer. Conventional local learning removes this update locking by training each module to predict the target through its own readout, but has not scaled to billion-parameter pretraining. We identify these private readouts as a key weakness, since they leave each module without information from deeper modules. We propose Shared-Output LOcal learning (SOLO), which replaces them with a shared, read-only copy of the final module's readout, the only one trained on the output of the whole network. Taken from the previous step, the copy transmits information from the final module without passing gradients between modules or reintroducing update locking. SOLO approaches backpropagation on Transformers of 340M to 2B parameters pretrained on 15B tokens, staying within one point in average zero-shot accuracy with a perplexity gap that narrows with scale. Readout ablations attribute SOLO's improvement over private readouts to sharing. Without update locking, each of p pipeline stages holds activations for O(1) micro-batches instead of O(p). The freed memory permits larger micro-batches, which reach up to 1.44x the best measured throughput of pipeline backpropagation on the same partition. To our knowledge, SOLO is the first local learning method to show such memory and throughput gains in billion-parameter language-model pretraining. Local learning thus becomes a practical alternative to backpropagation for large-scale pretraining.

</details>


### [1322] [NeuronSifter: Intervention Planning in CNS Microenvironments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35445)
*Haowei Xu,Wanyi Fu,Hongbin Han,Zhaoheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuronSifter把治疗方案编译为状态条件的目标占据场，通过占据条件扩散算子传播微环境动态，并按对干预损失的期望缩减来选择测量，从而把决策质量视为干预界面的属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中枢神经系统干预的优先级排序需要在部分可观测的微环境中预测剂量、途径与日程的作用，并选择能改变决策的测量。已有动作条件预测器把方案压缩为身份标记或标量暴露，丢弃了靶点被作用的位置与时间；把点估计交给独立规划器则丢弃了使测量有价值的联合不确定性。

Method: 将方案编译为带支持掩码的状态条件目标占据场，用占据条件扩散算子在微环境动态中传播，按干预损失的期望缩减选择测量，并把分型结局同化进同一后验。在声明的合成阿尔茨海默病评测中，用64个配对情景块进行比较。

Result: 占据条件化使轨迹CRPS从0.165降到0.110，干预排序准确率从0.760升到0.880，且所有配对基准对比经Holm校正后仍保持分离。决策导向采集的终末风险为0.160，匹配的数值贝叶斯实验设计规划器为0.166；达到目标风险的成本为早期设计对照的0.796 [0.732,0.873]，而与匹配规划器的比值0.963 [0.907,1.025]未与1分离。点状态与依赖消融界面将风险升至0.220和0.199，全后验外部控制器完全打平。公开发表的AD试验提供了独立的回顾性终点桥接。

Conclusion: 决策质量取决于干预界面而非控制器位置；保持占据条件化与联合后验的界面在合成AD评测中同时改善预测、排序与成本效率，消融这些要素会显著抬高风险。

Abstract: Prioritizing central nervous system (CNS) interventions requires predicting how a dose, route, and schedule act on a partially observed microenvironment, then choosing the measurement that would change the decision. Action-conditioned predictors reduce a regimen to an identity token or a scalar exposure, discarding where and when the target is engaged; handing a point estimate to a separate planner then discards the joint uncertainty that makes a measurement worth running. We therefore treat decision quality as a property of the intervention interface, not of controller placement. NeuronSifter compiles regimens into state-conditional target-occupancy fields with support masks, propagates them through microenvironment dynamics with an occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator, and selects measurements by their expected reduction in intervention loss, assimilating typed outcomes into the same posterior. In a declared synthetic Alzheimer's disease (AD) evaluation over 64 paired scenario blocks, occupancy conditioning lowers trajectory continuous ranked probability score from 0.165 to 0.110 and raises intervention ordering accuracy from 0.760 to 0.880, and every paired benchmark contrast remains separated after Holm correction. Decision-directed acquisition attains terminal risk 0.160 against 0.166 for a matched numerical Bayesian experimental design planner, and reaches the target risk at 0.796 $[0.732,0.873]$ of an earlier design control's cost, while the corresponding ratio against the matched planner, 0.963 $[0.907,1.025]$, is not separated from equality; point-state and dependence-ablated interfaces instead raise risk to 0.220 and 0.199, and a full-posterior external controller ties exactly. Published AD trials supply a separate retrospective endpoint bridge.

</details>


### [1323] [Tetra: Serving Leech-Lattice Quantized LLMs at 2.7 Bits per Parameter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35465)
*Pier-Jean Malandrino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tetra 提出一种基于 Lee 格的量化码本，每权重仅读 2.148 bit 显存，整模型约 2.7 bit/参数，性能接近 4-bit AWQ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Leech 格量化在每权重 2 bit 时质量较好，但码本超过 10^14 个点，无法用查找表实现。此前内核在加载时展开码字，每权重需从 GPU 显存读取 4.804 bit，远高于 2 bit 编码，显存开销过大。

Method: 提出 Tetra 码本，仍使用同一 Lee 格。24 权重块占 48 bit，其中大部分用于索引 Golay 码的 64 状态网格和一个共享 16 KiB 表。内核在矩阵-向量乘积中通过 6 次表加载和 2 次小查找解码一个块。整模型层面，每矩阵行重训一个 scale，将损失最大的矩阵存为 4-bit 整数，并用 4-bit 嵌入表补偿。

Result: Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 整模型分别为 2.73、2.70、2.73 bit/参数。完整 MMLU 得分为 63.37、69.58、75.66，比 4-bit AWQ（5.3–6.0 bit/参数）低 4.76、4.21、2.46 分。引擎生成速度 113.8、95.0、57.2 tokens/s。GSM8K 上经服务内核相比 FP16 分别损失 9.63、4.62、3.26 分。4B 模型比 llama.cpp 的 IQ2_XXS（2.48 bit/参数）高 23.6 分。所有测量均在一张 NVIDIA L40S GPU 上完成，主要实验已预注册。

Conclusion: Tetra 在约 2.7 bit/参数的极低显存读取下，实现了接近 4-bit AWQ 的质量和较高生成速度，显著优于同比特率的 IQ2_XXS。

Abstract: Leech-lattice quantization gives good quality at two bits per weight, but its codebooks hold more than 10^14 points, too many for a lookup table. Our earlier kernel expanded the codes at load time and read 4.804 bits per weight from GPU memory for 2 bits of code. We present Tetra, a new codebook on the same lattice. A 24-weight block still takes 48 bits, most of which index a 64-state trellis of the Golay code and one shared 16 KiB table. The kernel decodes a block with six table loads and two small lookups inside the matrix-vector product, and reads 2.148 bits per weight. For full models, we retrain one scale per matrix row, store the matrices that lose the most as 4-bit integers, and pay for them with 4-bit embedding tables. Our Qwen3-4B, 8B and 14B files hold 2.73, 2.70 and 2.73 bits per parameter over the whole model. They score 63.37, 69.58 and 75.66 on the full MMLU test set, 4.76, 4.21 and 2.46 points below 4-bit AWQ at 5.3 to 6.0 bits per parameter. They generate 113.8, 95.0 and 57.2 tokens per second in our engine. On GSM8K, through the served kernel, they lose 9.63, 4.62 and 3.26 points to FP16. At 4B our file scores 23.6 points above llama.cpp's IQ2_XXS (2.48 bits per parameter). Every number we measured for a table or figure comes from one NVIDIA L40S GPU. We preregistered the main experiments.

</details>


### [1324] [An analysis of Mirror-Descent Soft Actor-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35466)
*Denis Zorba,Michal Valko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为采用少量 actor 步更新的 SAC 类熵正则强化学习提供收敛性保证，以策略镜像下降作为目标策略，并刻画其与经典 Gibbs 目标的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际 SAC 实现中 actor 仅向演化目标做少量步更新，其收敛性缺乏理论保证；需要说明目标策略构造方式（镜像下降 vs. Gibbs）对收敛与跟踪误差的影响。

Method: 将目标策略设为策略镜像下降解，借助 Legendre 微分算子通过 Q 函数估计的曲率刻画 actor 目标的强凸性与光滑性，推导充分条件并分析有限时间收敛速率。

Result: 在 actor 与 critic 近似误差范围内得到 O(N^{-1/5}) 的最优迭代有限时间收敛率；镜像下降步长 λ 可直接控制目标漂移及由此产生的 actor 跟踪误差，而对应的 Gibbs 界中包含非消失的跟踪项。

Conclusion: 镜像下降目标相比经典 Gibbs 目标在跟踪误差控制上更具优势，λ 可作为调节目标漂移与跟踪误差的有效机制。

Abstract: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is widely used for entropy-regularised reinforcement learning with continuous action spaces, and practical implementations perform only a few actor steps towards an evolving target. In this work, we prove convergence guarantees when the target policy arises from policy mirror descent and compare it with the classical Gibbs target. We derive sufficient conditions for the strong convexity and smoothness of the actor objective, characterised by the curvature of the $Q$-function estimate through the Legendre differential operator, and establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{-\frac{1}{5}}\right)$ best-iterate finite-time convergence rate up to actor and critic approximation errors. Moreover, the mirror-descent step size $λ$ directly controls the target drift and hence actor tracking error, whereas the analogous Gibbs bound contains a non-vanishing tracking term.

</details>


### [1325] [Physics-Guided Conditional Diffusion Model for Rare Event Synthesis and Diagnosis for the Water-Gas Shift Reaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35499)
*Md Abrar Rafid Siddique,Bibek Aryal,Qiugang Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理引导的条件扩散模型，用于生成水煤气变换反应的稀有事件轨迹，以缓解异常工况数据稀缺问题，并结合危险分数提升反应健康诊断性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水煤气变换反应是重要的工业制氢过程，但严重结垢、催化剂劣化和热失控等异常事件会降低反应动力学性能、影响过程安全并减少氢气产率。这类事故罕见，导致异常工况下的过程数据难以获取，从而限制深度学习诊断模型的训练。

Method: 将条件去噪扩散概率模型（CDDPM）与反应的控制方程相结合，构建物理引导的条件扩散模型；通过条件特征生成训练分布之外的稀有事件域高质量合成轨迹；利用生成轨迹扩充原始数据集，使正常与异常工况分布更均衡；并基于运行轨迹提出危险分数以评估工况风险严重程度；最后用增强数据集训练深度学习模型进行反应健康状态诊断。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的物理引导扩散模型在合成数据质量和稀有事件诊断性能方面均优于纯数据驱动模型。

Conclusion: 物理引导的条件扩散模型能够有效生成物理一致的稀有事件轨迹，缓解异常数据稀缺问题，并通过数据增强与危险分数评估提升水煤气变换反应的健康诊断能力。

Abstract: As the world moves towards sustainable energy sources, hydrogen (H2) can be treated as an eco-friendly alternative to fossil fuels due to its high energy density and zero carbon emissions. The water-gas shift (WGS) reaction is a widely used industrial process for hydrogen production by converting carbon monoxide and steam into hydrogen and carbon dioxide. However, occurrences like severe fouling, catalyst deterioration, and thermal runaway can hamper the reaction kinetics/process safety and decrease the yield of H2. These incidents are rare, and gathering process data under such abnormal conditions is challenging. In this work, we propose a physics-guided conditional diffusion model to generate realistic rare-event trajectories for the WGS reaction. The proposed model integrates a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (CDDPM) with governing laws of the reaction to generate physically consistent process trajectories. The conditioning features allow the model to produce high-quality synthetic profiles for rare-event domains that are typically beyond the training regimes. The generated rare-event trajectories then augment the raw dataset for a balanced distribution between normal and abnormal conditions. We further propose a hazard score to assess the risk severity of the operating condition based on the operating trajectory. Deep learning models are trained with the augmented dataset to diagnose the health status of the reaction. Simulation results show that the proposed physics-guided diffusion model outperforms data-driven models in terms of the quality of synthetic data and diagnosis performance for rare events.

</details>


### [1326] [Structured Latent Modeling for Supervised Multimodal Information Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35502)
*Wanting Huang,Sanvesh Srivastava,Weiran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将中间层对比/掩码目标、源级可逆归一化流与监督低秩潜变量模型结合的多模态预测框架，把联合分布显式分解为共享任务相关变化、模态特定预测变化与任务无关依赖三部分，从而刻画各模态对目标的独立与联合贡献，并在多模态基准上取得稳健的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态预测方法虽促进了更丰富的交互，但缺乏一种有原则的方式，在学习到的连续表示中隔离出相对于预测目标的各种贡献（跨模态重复信息、单模态特有线索、跨模态复杂依赖）。因此需要一种能显式分解这些贡献的框架。

Method: 在中间层施加对比学习或掩码目标；结合源级（source-wise）可逆归一化流；引入监督的低秩潜变量模型。通过该架构将联合分布显式分解为：共享任务相关变化、模态特定预测变化、任务无关依赖。并与现有多模态学习假设建立联系，用以评估模态独立及联合地对目标的贡献。

Result: 在多个多样的多模态基准上进行了实证评估，结果表明预测性能获得稳健提升。

Conclusion: 该框架将中间表示学习与结构化的、基于似然的引导统一起来，为刻画连续多模态交互提供了一种实用的潜变量视角。

Abstract: Multimodal prediction relies on diverse forms of evidence: information repeated across modalities, cues specific to a single source, and complex cross-modal dependencies that emerge only when inputs are considered together. While recent methods promote richer interactions, they lack a principled way to isolate these target-relative contributions within learned continuous representations. We introduce a framework that applies contrastive or masked objectives at intermediate layers, coupled with source-wise invertible normalizing flows and a supervised, low-rank latent variable model. This architecture explicitly factorizes the joint distribution into shared task-relevant variation, modality-specific predictive variation, and task-irrelevant dependence. Drawing connections to prior multimodal learning assumptions, our approach evaluates how modalities independently and jointly contribute to the target. Ultimately, this framework unites intermediate representation learning with structured likelihood-based guidance, offering a practical latent-variable lens for characterizing continuous multimodal interactions. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across diverse multimodal benchmarks, showing robust improvements in predictive performance.

</details>


### [1327] [An RL View of OPD: Least Square Policy Distillation for Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35505)
*Shangzhe Li,Yuxiao Yang,Tianrun Yu,Kaixiang Zhao,Xiaoyun Wang,Taylor W. Killian,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从强化学习视角研究同策略蒸馏（OPD），建立反向KL目标与KL正则化策略优化的联系，提出最少二乘策略蒸馏（LSPD）框架，引入乐观探索与离策略数据复用，理论上达到 Õ(log K) 遗憾界，实验上在六个数学推理基准上平均提升+1.59分并更好保持策略多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同策略蒸馏（OPD）虽广泛用于语言模型蒸馏，但缺乏理论解释，且存在rollout效率低、策略多样性易崩塌的问题。作者希望用强化学习框架统一理解OPD，并借鉴基于价值的RL中的乐观探索与离策略数据复用，提升蒸馏的有效性与rollout效率。

Method: 1）理论联系：揭示OPD中的反向KL目标等价于KL正则化策略优化；2）提出LSPD框架：将基于价值的RL中的乐观探索与离策略数据复用引入策略蒸馏，通过重复学习历史轨迹提升rollout效率；3）理论分析：将LSPD与乐观价值学习关联，证明其理想化形式在在线探索下达到紧的 Õ(log K) 遗憾界；4）实验验证：在六个数学推理基准和多种师生设置下对比现有蒸馏基线，并进行Pass@k（k≤64）与全离策略变体测试。

Result: LSPD在六个数学推理基准和多种师生设置下一致优于现有蒸馏基线，Avg@16平均提升+1.59分；Pass@k（k最大64）评估显示随k增大LSPD性能提升更强，表明其更好保持策略多样性；全离策略变体仅用前25%的rollout批次即可达到与原始OPD相当的性能。

Conclusion: LSPD为OPD提供了强化学习视角的原则性解释，并给出通往更有效、rollout更高效的语言模型蒸馏的实用路径：通过乐观探索保持策略多样性、借助离策略数据复用提升样本效率，理论与实验均验证其优越性。

Abstract: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) through the lens of reinforcement learning, establishing a connection between the reverse-KL objective in OPD and KL-regularized policy optimization. Building on this connection, we introduce Least-Square Policy Distillation (LSPD), an RL-inspired framework that brings optimistic exploration and off-policy data reuse from value-based RL into policy distillation. LSPD preserves policy diversity through exploration while improving rollout efficiency by repeatedly learning from previously collected trajectories. Our theoretical analysis connects LSPD to optimistic value-based learning and shows that its idealized formulation achieves a sharp $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\log K)$ regret bound under online exploration. Empirically, LSPD consistently outperforms existing distillation baselines across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and diverse teacher-student settings, with average gains of +1.59 points in Avg@16. Remarkably, through Pass@k evaluations up to k=64, we found that LSPD better preserves policy diversity by achieving stronger performance as k grows. Its fully off-policy variant achieves comparable performance to vanilla OPD using only the first 25% of rollout batches. Together, these results provide an RL perspective on OPD that offers both a principled interpretation and a practical route toward more effective and rollout-efficient language model distillation.

</details>


### [1328] [One Proposal for Every Margin: Zero-Shot Amortized Sequential Importance Sampling for Binary Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35514)
*Ruishuo Chen,Weijia Li,Xun Wang,Yu Chen,Leheng Cai,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MarginFlow，利用生成流网络（GFlowNet）将二元矩阵固定边际下的均匀采样与计数问题转化为学习理想 SIS 提议分布的问题，并用集合 Transformer 跨边际摊销，实现零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生态学、心理测量学及社会/金融网络分析中，二元矩阵常在给定行和与列和的条件下分析，问题被限制在具有相同边际的有限矩阵样本空间内，核心任务是计数该空间并从中均匀采样。序贯重要性采样（SIS）能同时解决这两个问题，其效率高度依赖提议分布，而现有提议均为解析设计，准确性随边际变化很大。

Method: 作者证明理想 SIS 提议（此时每个权重等于计数、方差为零）恰好等价于在每个满足给定边际的矩阵上给予单位奖励的 GFlowNet 策略。据此提出 MarginFlow 框架，将提议设计转为学习问题：由于任何部分矩阵本身也是具有缩减边际的实例，使用单个集合 Transformer 读取剩余边际即可服务所有边际，从而跨边际摊销。模型在 1904 个边际池上训练，在 1190 个留出边际上零样本评估。

Result: 在从 3×3 到 870×6 的合成与真实边际上，MarginFlow 在 1190 个边际中的 1187 个上追平或超过 31 种解析设计配置事后为每个边际选出的最优结果；有效样本比例中位数为 99.8%。在最优解析配置损失超过 1 nat 有效样本量的 56 个边际上，MarginFlow 全部获胜，并将有效样本比例中位数从 10.3% 提升至 94.1%。

Conclusion: 将理想 SIS 提议视为 GFlowNet 策略，使提议分布设计可被学习并跨边际摊销，MarginFlow 在广泛边际规模上显著优于解析设计方法，尤其在高难度边际上大幅提升采样效率。

Abstract: In ecology, psychometrics, and the analysis of social and financial networks, binary matrices are often analyzed conditional on their observed row and column sums, which restricts the problem to a finite sample space of matrices with the same margins. Two fundamental problems are to count this space and to sample uniformly from it. Sequential importance sampling (SIS) addresses both with independent weighted samples and an unbiased count estimator, but its efficiency depends critically on the proposal distribution. Existing proposals are analytically designed, and their accuracy can vary substantially with the margins. We show that the ideal SIS proposal, under which every weight equals the count and the variance vanishes, is exactly the policy of a generative flow network (GFlowNet) with unit reward on every matrix that has the given margins. We therefore propose MarginFlow, a framework that turns the design of the proposal into a learning problem and amortizes it across margins by exploiting their self-similarity. Every partial matrix is itself an instance with reduced margins, so one set transformer that reads the remaining margins serves every margin. We train MarginFlow on a pool of 1904 margins and evaluate it zero-shot on 1190 held-out margins, synthetic and real, from $3\times3$ to $870\times6$. On 1187 of the 1190 margins it matches or beats the best of 31 analytically designed configurations, chosen post hoc for each margin, and its median effective sample fraction is 99.8%. On the 56 margins where that best loses more than one nat of effective sample size, MarginFlow wins every one and raises the median effective sample fraction from 10.3% to 94.1%.

</details>


### [1329] [Reward-Aligned Reweighting for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35517)
*Haofeng Xu,Junwei Su,Lansong Diao,Wenchao Zhou,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 R²-OPD，一种基于结果一致性与师生分歧大小对教师监督进行动态重加权的在线策略蒸馏方法，在多个推理基准上超越标准 OPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）对所有 token 级蒸馏项均匀加权，隐含地将局部教师偏好当作纠正效用的代理，但某个决策的任务价值取决于学生后续推理如何完成，这种不匹配可能导致模仿压制可行的学生策略或强化学生无法可靠执行的路径。

Method: 提出 Reward-Aligned Reweighting for On-Policy Distillation（R²-OPD），利用结果一致性（outcome agreement）与教师-学生分歧幅度，持续重新分配教师监督；对与奖励对齐的纠正赋予更大相对权重，同时保留稠密反馈，避免均匀模仿与硬过滤。理论上形式化了局部教师偏好与学生延续价值之间的不匹配，并给出重分配相对均匀 OPD 改进一阶任务进展的充分条件。

Result: 在七个数学推理基准上，R²-OPD 在跨尺寸与同尺寸蒸馏中均取得最高的平均准确率；在所有七个基准上优于标准 OPD，对 1.7B 和 4B 学生平均增益分别为 3.5 和 2.4 个百分点。扩展到代码生成任务较标准 OPD 平均增益 1.6 个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果表明显著：以结果为导向的监督分配是将稠密教师反馈转化为更强学生性能的有效方式，且可跨模型规模与任务领域推广。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model with dense feedback from a stronger teacher on student-generated trajectories. Yet standard OPD weights token-level distillation terms uniformly, implicitly treating local teacher preference as a proxy for correction utility. A decision's task value, however, depends on how the student completes the subsequent reasoning. This mismatch can cause imitation to suppress viable student strategies or reinforce paths the student cannot reliably execute. Verified trajectory outcomes provide complementary evidence about continuation quality, but do not directly identify the utility of individual decisions. We introduce Reward-Aligned Reweighting for On-Policy Distillation (R$^{2}$-OPD), which uses outcome agreement and the magnitude of teacher--student disagreement to continuously reallocate teacher supervision. It gives reward-aligned corrections greater relative influence while retaining dense feedback, moving beyond uniform imitation and hard filtering. Our analysis formalizes the mismatch between local teacher preference and student continuation value and establishes sufficient conditions for reallocation to improve first-order task progress over uniform OPD. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, R$^{2}$-OPD achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared training methods in both cross-size and same-size distillation. It outperforms standard OPD on all seven benchmarks, with average gains of 3.5 and 2.4 percentage points for 1.7B and 4B students, respectively. An extension to code generation yields an average gain of 1.6 percentage points over standard OPD. These results highlight outcome-guided supervision allocation as an effective way to translate dense teacher feedback into stronger student performance across model scales and task domains.

</details>


### [1330] [Deep Epistemic Value Functions for Optimistic Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35525)
*Leander Diaz-Bone,Marco Bagatella,Jonas Hübotter,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究深度认知价值函数中的不确定性表示、传播与优化，揭示失效模式并提出DEVOTE算法，实现高效探索与更高回报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习的原则性探索要求量化认知不确定性并主动消解，价值函数不确定性是天然探索信号，但现有深度近似脆弱、表现不稳定，核心挑战在于稳健扩展。

Method: 系统性实证研究深度认知价值函数中不确定性的表示、传播与优化，识别各环节失效模式；据此提出无模型算法DEVOTE，控制不确定性在观测数据之外泛化、稳定时间传播并保持对非平稳探索目标的适应。

Result: 在无奖励探索与困难连续控制任务中，DEVOTE比强无模型与基于模型的探索基线更有效到达新状态，并获得更高任务回报。

Conclusion: 深度认知价值函数是通向可扩展、原则性探索的有前景路径。

Abstract: Principled exploration in reinforcement learning requires an agent to quantify its epistemic uncertainty and act to resolve it. Uncertainty over the value function provides a natural signal for exploration, yet existing deep approximations remain brittle and perform inconsistently. The central challenge is therefore to scale these ideas robustly. We conduct a systematic empirical study of how epistemic uncertainty is represented, propagated, and optimized in deep epistemic value functions, and uncover distinct failure modes along each of these axes. These findings motivate DEVOTE, a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm that controls how uncertainty generalizes beyond observed data, stabilizes its temporal propagation, and preserves adaptation to the resulting non-stationary exploration objective. Across reward-free exploration and challenging continuous-control tasks, DEVOTE reaches novel states more effectively and achieves higher task return than strong model-free and model-based exploration baselines. These results provide evidence that deep epistemic value functions are a promising path toward scalable, principled exploration.

</details>


### [1331] [GeoGAE: Scalable Graph-Level Autoencoding via Hyperball Cloud Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35527)
*Radosław Nowak,Anna Bielawska,Bogusz Stefańczyk,Maciej Sanocki,Paweł Wawrzyński*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将图表示为“超球云”并据此定义节点顺序，构建Transformer自编码器GeoGAE实现整图嵌入与重构，在多个图数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将结构化对象（词、文档、图像块、时间序列、图节点）嵌入欧氏空间已取得广泛成功，但整图嵌入仍是难题：现有方法或保持原始节点顺序、或将输出节点与输入节点一一匹配，均带来可扩展性问题。

Method: 提出以“超球云”（hyperball cloud）作为图表示，从而定义一种特定且通常唯一的节点顺序；基于此构建GeoGAE自编码器，编码端用Transformer将超球云转换为图级嵌入，解码端用Transformer将图级嵌入还原为图，以同时捕获全局图结构与局部关系模式。

Result: 在覆盖多个领域的多个图数据集上进行评估，结果表明该方法在由图嵌入进行编码与重构方面具有有效性。

Conclusion: GeoGAE通过超球云表示与Transformer自编码框架，为整图嵌入提供了一种可扩展的新范式，并在编码与重构任务上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Embedding structured objects into Euclidean spaces has enabled a wide range of successful machine learning applications. Such objects include words, documents, image patches, time series, and graph nodes. In contrast, embedding entire graphs remains a challenging problem. Existing methods either sustain the original order of the graph nodes or match the output nodes to the input ones, both of which create scalability issues. In this work, we propose a graph representation as a cloud of hyperballs, which allows us to define a specific, typically unique, node ordering. Based on this representation, we propose GeoGAE, an autoencoder, in which the Transformer encoder translates a hyperball cloud into a graph-level embedding, and the Transformer decoder translates the graph-level embedding back into the graph. This formulation enables the model to capture both the global graph structure and local relational patterns. We evaluate our method on multiple graph datasets, spanning various domains. The results demonstrate effectiveness of our method in encoding and reconstructing graphs from their embeddings.

</details>


### [1332] [Optimal Networks for Agentic Information Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35537)
*MohammadHossein Bateni,Zahra Hadizadeh,MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi,Mahdi JafariRaviz,Shayan Taherijam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在Kearns-Roth-Ryu网络学习模型下研究信息聚合的极限：自适应设计者与盲设计者两种设定。d≥3且每智能体仅一个父节点时，任何有限深度都无法保证精确聚合；每智能体两个父节点时，盲设计者亦可通过固定结构在深度O(d log d)实现精确聚合，已知分布可降至O(d)，且深度与智能体数上界在常数因子内最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原有工作（Kearns et al., SODA 2026）聚焦于给定图与特征分配下的聚合行为，指出足够深度与特征覆盖可使输出智能体误差逼近全局线性预测器，但深度不足则即使大网络也无法聚合。本文转向模型极限问题：设计者在选择图、特征分配与输出节点时，能否保证对所有分布都实现精确聚合，以及需要多少父节点、深度与智能体。

Method: 在d个特征与共同标签的分布下，智能体按DAG拓扑序学习，各自观测特征子集与父节点预测，拟合最小均方误差线性预测器并仅传递预测值；全局预测器为使用全部特征的最优线性预测器。区分自适应设计者（已知分布，选择图、特征分配与输出节点）与盲设计者（三者先行固定，分布由对手选择）两种设定，每智能体观测一个特征、仅接收有限个父节点预测。定义精确聚合为输出智能体与全局预测器完全一致，并构造实现该目标的结构、分析其深度与智能体规模。

Result: d≥3且每智能体仅一个父节点时，即使设计者知道分布，也不存在有限深度能对所有分布保证精确聚合。每智能体两个父节点时，即使盲设计者设定，固定图、特征分配与输出节点也能对所有分布在深度O(d log d)内实现精确聚合；若已知分布，深度降至O(d)。两种构造均使用O(d²)个智能体，双父节点构造的常数极大。深度与智能体数的界在常数因子内均达到最优。

Conclusion: 精确聚合在单父节点下不可能通过增加深度实现，而双父节点足以在盲设计者设定下普适实现；深度与网络规模的代价存在紧确的阶数下界与上界。

Abstract: We study information aggregation in the networked learning model introduced by Kearns, Roth, and Ryu (SODA 2026). There is a fixed distribution over $d$ features and a common label. Agents learn in topological order on a directed acyclic graph. Each observes a subset of the features and its parents' predictions, fits a linear predictor to minimize mean squared error, and passes only its prediction forward. The global predictor is the best linear predictor using all features. Kearns, Roth, and Ryu show that the output agent's error approaches the global predictor's error along sufficiently deep paths with suitable feature coverage, while insufficient depth can prevent aggregation even in large networks.
  In contrast to their main focus on a given graph and feature allocation, we consider the limits of the model under two settings. In the adaptive designer setting, a designer chooses the graph, feature allocation, and output agent knowing the distribution. In the oblivious designer setting, the designer fixes all three before an adversary chooses the distribution. Each agent observes one feature and receives predictions from a limited number of parents.
  We call the aggregation exact when the output agent matches the global predictor exactly. For $d\ge3$, we show that no finite depth guarantees exact aggregation for every distribution with one parent per agent, even when the designer knows the distribution.
  In contrast, two parents per agent suffice for exact aggregation even in the oblivious designer setting. A fixed graph, feature allocation, and output agent achieve this for every distribution at depth $O(d\log d)$. Knowing the distribution reduces the depth to $O(d)$. Both constructions use $O(d^2)$ agents, with a very large constant for two parents. We show the bounds on the depth and number of agents are all optimal up to constant factors.

</details>


### [1333] [Learning the Robustness Mechanism with Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35541)
*Yiyang Shen,Qihang Lin,Weiran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分布鲁棒学习框架，将定义鲁棒机制的参数从留出数据中学习而非人工调参；通过上下层均为极小极大问题的双层优化，构建了有/无组标签两种实例，并从理论与实验两方面验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分布鲁棒优化中，决定鲁棒机制的参数通常需要大量人工调参（如网格搜索），计算开销大且不够灵活。作者希望让这些参数自动从留出数据中学习，从而在保持泛化性能的同时提升效率，并适应训练集中有无组标签的不同场景。

Method: 采用双层优化（bilevel optimization），其中上层与下层均为极小极大（minimax）问题；基于该结构提出两个框架实例，分别处理训练集有组标签和无组标签的情形，使鲁棒机制参数由留出数据学习得到。

Result: 理论上给出了该鲁棒机制学习范式的样本复杂度分析，证明其泛化保证可与穷举网格搜索相当，但计算上更高效；实验上在组内与组间测试分布偏移同时发生的困难设定下进行评估，展示了方法的有效性与可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将鲁棒机制参数交由留出数据学习是一种兼具理论保证与计算效率的分布鲁棒学习方案，能够应对组内与组间分布偏移并存的挑战性场景。

Abstract: We propose a distributionally robust learning framework where parameters defining the robustness mechanism are learned from held-out data instead of extensively tuned. Using bilevel optimization with both upper and lower level minimax problems, we create two instances of our framework to tackle setups with and without group labels in the training set. Theoretically, we provide sample complexity analysis for our robustness mechanism learning paradigm, showing that it achieves generalization guarantees comparable to exhaustive grid search while being more computationally efficient. Empirically, we evaluate our framework under a challenging setup when both intra-group and inter-group test distribution shifts occur at the same time, thereby demonstrating the efficacy and scalability of our method.

</details>


### [1334] [From Experience to Expertise: Adoption-Aware Memory Learning for Data-Scarce NPU Kernel Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35568)
*Longxiao Fan,Tao Zhang,Han Yan,Jiajun Li,Mingcong Song,Guoping Long,Hongjie Si,Weiwei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAGE——面向NPU内核合成的持续自改进智能体，通过"采纳追踪效用估计"与"效用门控固化"实现采纳感知的信用分配和可复用规则固化，在NPUKernelBench上执行率达95.5%、86.9%已解算子优于torch_npu，稀疏flash attention上相对torch_npu提速43.99x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能算子内核是加速器高效执行的基础，但需专家调优与漫长手工优化。LLM编码智能体虽可自动化，但其CUDA知识难以迁移到数据稀缺的领域专用架构（如NPU），因后者执行模型与存储层次与GPU差异显著。现有后训练方法依赖稀缺专家数据和大量训练算力；记忆学习型智能体虽借助外部记忆适应，却存在两个缺陷：一是统一信用分配使"被采纳"与"未被使用"的经验获得相同奖励目标，可能污染后续检索排序；二是当学习到的价值仅指导检索时，跨算子可泛化的高价值经验必须被反复检索而非驻留上下文，增加检索开销并削弱跨任务指导。

Method: SAGE为持续性自改进智能体，包含两个核心机制：(1) Adoption-Traced Utility estimation（ATU，采纳追踪效用估计）：将显式采纳记录与内核评测结果结合，实现采纳感知的信用分配；(2) Utility-Gated Consolidation（UGC，效用门控固化）：依据正效用与跨算子的重复采纳，筛选并抽象可复用规则，写入有界常驻上下文。

Result: 在NPUKernelBench上，SAGE执行率达95.5%，最强受控基线为84.1%；在已解算子中有86.9%性能超过torch_npu。使用GLM-5.3时，在稀疏flash attention任务上相对torch_npu参考实现取得43.99x加速。

Conclusion: 结果表明，采纳感知的信用分配与选择性固化能让智能体跨任务积累并复用硬件专属知识。

Abstract: High-performance kernels underpin efficient accelerator execution but require expert tuning and lengthy manual optimization cycles. LLM coding agents promise automation, yet their CUDA knowledge transfers poorly to data-scarce domain-specific architectures (DSAs) such as NPUs, whose execution models and memory hierarchies differ substantially from those of GPUs. To address this transfer gap, post-training methods adapt LLMs to NPU programming but depend on scarce expert data and substantial training compute. Memory-learning agents instead adapt through external memory, but their uniform credit assignment gives adopted and unused experiences the same reward target, potentially biasing subsequent retrieval rankings. Moreover, when learned values guide only retrieval, high-value experiences that generalize across operators must be retrieved repeatedly rather than retained in context, thereby increasing retrieval overhead and weakening cross-task guidance. We therefore present SAGE, a persistent self-improving agent for NPU kernel synthesis. Adoption-Traced Utility estimation (ATU) combines explicit adoption records with kernel evaluation outcomes for adoption-aware credit assignment. Utility-Gated Consolidation (UGC) uses positive utility and repeated adoption across operators to select and abstract reusable rules into a bounded resident context. On NPUKernelBench, SAGE achieves a 95.5% execution rate versus 84.1% for the strongest controlled baseline, with 86.9% of solved operators outperforming torch_npu. With GLM-5.3, SAGE achieves a 43.99x speedup over the torch_npu reference on sparse flash attention. These results show that adoption-aware credit assignment and selective consolidation enable agents to accumulate and reuse hardware-specific knowledge across tasks.

</details>


### [1335] [Output-aware Residual Stream Pruning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35579)
*Chayne Thrash,Kevin Chen,Soheil Kolouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种敏感性感知的残差流剪枝方法：以输出KL散度的二阶近似刻画残差流扰动，将子空间选择化为敏感度加权协方差矩阵的特征分解，在多个指令微调语言模型上一致优于仅基于激活重构的剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有残差流剪枝通过压缩隐藏维度降低推理成本，但其维度选择准则是最小化激活重构误差。该准则隐式假设所有扰动方向同等重要，忽略了下游层对扰动的方向依赖性敏感度，因而并非最优。

Method: 从输出KL散度的二阶近似出发，用激活协方差与模型输出的局部敏感度共同刻画残差流扰动的影响。所得子空间选择目标耦合了这两个量，难以直接优化；作者推导出一个可处理的谱上界，把子空间选择归结为敏感度加权协方差矩阵的特征分解，从而保持基于旋转的剪枝方法的高效性与结构简洁性。

Result: 在多个指令微调语言模型族上，相比仅使用激活信息的剪枝，该方法在多种压缩率下均持续降低校准KL散度，并改善困惑度与下游任务表现。

Conclusion: 结果表明，仅保留激活能量对残差流剪枝并不充分；显式考虑扰动如何传播至模型输出，能为选择待移除维度提供更有效的判据。

Abstract: Residual stream pruning methods reduce inference cost by shrinking the model's hidden dimension, but existing approaches typically choose these dimensions by minimizing activation reconstruction error. This criterion implicitly treats all perturbation directions as equally important, ignoring the sensitivity of downstream layers. We introduce a sensitivity-aware approach to residual-stream pruning that directly accounts for this direction-dependent sensitivity. Using a second-order approximation to the output KL divergence, we characterize the effect of a residual-stream perturbation through both its activation covariance and the local sensitivity of the model output. The resulting subspace selection objective couples these two quantities, but is difficult to optimize directly. We derive a tractable spectral upper bound that reduces subspace selection to an eigendecomposition of a sensitivity-weighted covariance matrix, retaining the efficiency and structural simplicity of rotation-based pruning methods. Across several instruction-tuned language model families, our method consistently reduces calibration KL divergence relative to activation-only pruning and improves perplexity and downstream task performance over a range of compression levels. Our results show that preserving activation energy alone is insufficient for residual-stream pruning, and that explicitly accounting for how perturbations propagate to the model output provides a more effective criterion for selecting dimensions to remove.

</details>


### [1336] [Hardware-Aware Features for CUTLASS Kernel Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35587)
*Shriram Chandran,Dominic Rinderer,Yakup Budanaz,Alexandru Calotoiu,Marcin Copik,Torsten Hoefler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种硬件感知表示方法用于CUTLASS核选择，通过静态可计算的硬件行为估计增强候选配置，显著降低选择regret。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUTLASS等GPU库对单一操作暴露数万个语义等价的kernel，穷举自动调优成本高昂且难以无执行选择。现有分析型选择器依赖手工性能规则，而学习型选择器直接作用于原始配置参数，需从数据中推断硬件后果，缺乏有效归纳偏置。

Method: 为CUTLASS kernel选择引入硬件感知表示，用静态可计算的、对候选配置所诱导硬件行为的估计来增强候选特征。构建包含490万个CUTLASS kernel的数据集，训练梯度提升与神经网络learning-to-rank模型，在每个问题内对候选进行排序。

Result: 在留出的穷举评估问题上，硬件感知表示相较结构基线最高降低40%选择regret，相较NVIDIA矩阵乘heuristics降低64.2%。进一步评估CUTLASS GEMM内跨精度与epilogue融合的数据高效迁移，显示显式表示候选诱导硬件行为能提供有效的归纳偏置。

Conclusion: 显式编码候选配置所诱导的硬件行为是学习型kernel选择的有效归纳偏置，可在降低自动调优成本的同时提升选择质量，并支持跨精度与epilogue融合的数据高效迁移。

Abstract: GPU libraries such as CUTLASS expose tens of thousands of semantically equivalent kernels for a single operation, making exhaustive autotuning expensive and execution-free selection difficult. Existing analytical selectors require hand-designed performance rules, while learned selectors operate on raw configuration parameters and must infer hardware consequences from data. We introduce a hardware-aware representation for CUTLASS kernel selection that augments candidate configurations with statically computable estimates of induced hardware behavior. We construct a dataset of 4.9 million CUTLASS kernels and train gradient-boosted and neural learning-to-rank models to rank candidates within each problem. On held-out exhaustive evaluation problems, hardware-aware representations reduce selection regret by up to 40\% relative to structural baselines and 64.2\% relative to NVIDIA's matrix-multiply heuristics. We further evaluate data-efficient cross-precision and epilogue-fusion transfer within CUTLASS GEMM, showing that explicitly representing candidate-induced hardware behavior provides a useful inductive bias for learned kernel selection.

</details>


### [1337] [Attention Graphons: A Graph Limit Perspective on Graph Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35620)
*Caio F. Deberaldini Netto,Moshe Eliasof,Luana Ruiz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究图Transformer的注意力矩阵是否随节点数n增大而收敛到稳定的连续极限。作者借助稠密图极限理论，将注意力矩阵视为某"注意力graphon"的有限采样，在cut-distance下研究其集中性，给出最坏情况方差界与基于非参数估计的正则性感知界，并提出规范化-分块平均流水线估计数据集级注意力graphon及方差诊断。实验表明注意力可稳定到数据集特定的graphon结构，cut-distance与cut-norm方差随n下降，且注意力graphon可迁移到更大图规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图Transformer对每个注意力头产生一个n×n的稠密成对交互矩阵，但其学习到的交互模式是否随n增大收敛到稳定极限对象，还是始终无结构且依赖规模，此前缺乏理论刻画，这构成了论文的核心动机。

Method: 采用稠密图极限理论，将每个注意力矩阵视为底层kernel（注意力graphon）的有限样本，在cut-distance下研究集中性；推导不依赖graphon假设的最坏情况方差界，以及基于非参数估计理论的更紧的正则性感知界；提出规范化-分块平均流水线用于估计数据集级注意力graphon，并设计基于方差的诊断来检验注意力是否具有稳定连续描述。

Result: 在多个图基准实验中：学习到的注意力在若干数据集上稳定到数据集特定的graphon结构；经验cut-distance与cut-norm方差随n增大而下降，与理论界一致；注意力graphon可迁移到更大的图规模，且误差随n增大而减小。

Conclusion: 注意力诱导图在cut-distance意义下具有可收敛的连续极限（注意力graphon），其方差随n下降并可用所提界刻画，且该极限具有跨规模迁移能力，说明注意力交互模式并非无结构或纯粹规模依赖。

Abstract: Graph Transformers produce, for each attention head, a dense $n\times n$ matrix of learned pairwise interactions. We ask a fundamental question: do these attention-induced graphs converge to a stable limit object as $n$ grows, or does the learned interaction pattern remain unstructured and size-dependent? We answer this using dense graph limit theory, treating each attention matrix as a finite sample from an underlying kernel---an \emph{attention graphon}---and studying concentration around this limit under the cut-distance. We derive a worst-case variance bound requiring no assumptions on the graphon, and a sharper regularity-aware bound based on nonparametric estimation theory. To operationalize the theory, we propose a canonicalize-then-block-average pipeline for estimating dataset-level attention graphons, and a variance-based diagnostic for testing whether attention admits a stable continuum description. Experiments across multiple graph benchmarks show that learned attention stabilizes to dataset-specific graphon structure on several datasets; that empirical cut-distance and cut-norm variance decreases with $n$ consistent with our bounds; and that attention graphons transfer to larger graph sizes with error decreasing in $n$.

</details>


### [1338] [Cartridges++: KV Cache Compression without Off-Context Derailment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35621)
*Sonia Laguna,Joao Monteiro,Marco Cuturi,Pierre Ablin,Eleonora Gualdoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究压缩KV表示（CKV，尤其是Cartridges）在部署时的关键问题：能否处理与文档无关的"域外查询"。发现Cartridges虽在文档内查询上表现更好，但会损害模型原有的域外能力（上下文污染、通用知识、指令遵循）；提出Cartridges++（路由器变体与数据混合变体）在极小代价下恢复域外能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 向LLM反复输入长文档代价高昂：计算量随上下文长度增长，KV缓存的内存占用急剧膨胀。CKV表示（如Cartridges）通过一次性压缩KV来模拟文档缓存。现有评估只关注文档相关的"域内查询"是否近似，忽略了部署中的关键问题——CKV能否像原生KV那样处理与文档无关的"域外查询"。

Method: 作者系统评估Cartridges与启发式（drop类）压缩变体在域外查询上的表现，通过三项指标衡量：避免上下文污染、保留通用知识、遵循指令。并据此提出Cartridges++：1）路由器变体（router），在推理时判断查询应使用学习到的长上下文记忆还是普通模式；2）数据混合变体（data-mixing），在训练Q/A中混入一小部分与参考长文档无关的查询。

Result: 发现根本性权衡：Cartridges在域内查询上表现更好，而启发式变体更能保留原始LLM的域外能力。提出的Cartridges++在很小甚至可忽略的代价下恢复了域外能力。

Conclusion: 仅以文档效用评估CKV会掩盖模型更广泛能力的显著退化；但这些问题可通过KV推理或训练上的良性改动（Cartridges++）加以修复。

Abstract: Serving long documents to a Large Language Model (LLM) repeatedly is expensive: computations grow with context length, and the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache balloons. Compressed KV (CKV) representations aim to mimic the cache of a document and are typically computed once and for all, ahead of inference time. Methods to obtain CKVs range from drop mechanisms that reduce their number of columns, to learned approaches. Among the latter, Cartridges have emerged as a leading compression method, learning compact KV representations through distillation on relevant Q/A pairs. While existing evaluations focus primarily on whether Cartridges and other CKVs yield approximately similar responses to document-related, on-context queries, we investigate the crucial deployment question of whether they can handle off-context queries, something the native KV representation is particularly good at, thanks to the mechanics of attention. We observe a fundamental trade-off: while Cartridges perform better for on-context queries, heuristic-variants preserve better the original LLM's ability to operate off-context. We measure this through their capability to avoid context contamination in their response, retain general knowledge, and follow instructions. We propose Cartridges++, simple modifications to cartridges that retain off-context abilities at small or negligible cost. The router variant decides at inference time whether the query should use the learned long-context memory, while the data-mixing variant allocates a small fraction of training Q/As to queries outside the reference long document. Our study shows that assessing CKVs on document utility alone can mask substantial degradation in broader model capabilities, yet those issues can be fixed with benign changes to CKV inference or training.

</details>


### [1339] [Bounding Retraining Equivalence and the Deletion Floor in Materials Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35635)
*Can Polat,Mustafa Kurban,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"删除地板"(deletion floor)概念,即删除请求在特定重训练流程下的期望目标损失,用以消除"删除后预测误差"作为机器遗忘度量的歧义性;理论上给出条件邻居界与岭恒等式,实证显示冗余扫描下中位归一化重训练损失下降约8倍,并主张请求级遗忘评估应同时报告参考损失、预测变化与保留效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在材料机器学习中,存在高度相关的保留结构,即使删除某条特定记录,模型仍能维持准确的性能预测,这使得"删除后预测误差"成为机器遗忘的模糊度量:低误差未必意味着遗忘成功,而可能是数据冗余所致。因此需要一个能够刻画"重训练本身会留下什么"的基准参照,以消除这种歧义。

Method: 1) 定义 deletion floor:在指定重训练流程下,被删除请求上的期望目标损失,作为基准参照;2) 利用标准不可区分性(indistinguishability)约束推导出围绕该基准的目标损失紧致区间;3) 理论上建立条件邻居界(conditional neighbor bound),将低删除地板与保留拟合、预测规律性、局部标签一致性联系起来;4) 推导精确的岭恒等式(exact ridge identity),将残差拟合与记录删除引起的预测变化分离;5) 实验上进行受控冗余扫描,并开展材料项目(Materials Project)配对研究,对比近似更新与原始模型。

Result: 冗余扫描显示:当删除后仍保留一个相关亲属记录时,中位归一化重训练损失下降约8倍。在材料项目的两种不同拟合机制配对研究中,低地板机制在超过50%的共享请求上表现出更大的预测变化。系统对比近似更新与原始模型,成功将"有意的目标抑制"与"保留的整体模型效用"解耦。

Conclusion: 请求级机器遗忘评估应同时报告参考损失(reference loss)、预测变化(prediction change)与保留效用(retained utility),并将删除后准确率对照"重训练本身所留下的结果"来解释,而非孤立地将其视为遗忘效果的度量。

Abstract: In materials machine learning, closely related retained structures can sustain accurate property predictions even after removing a specific record, rendering post-deletion prediction error an ambiguous metric for machine unlearning. To resolve this ambiguity, we define the deletion floor as the expected target loss under a specified retraining procedure at the deleted request. Standard indistinguishability constraints yield a sharp interval bounding an update's target loss around this baseline reference. Theoretically, a conditional neighbor bound links a low deletion floor directly to retained fit, prediction regularity, and local label agreement, while an exact ridge identity isolates residual fit from the prediction change induced by record deletion. Empirically, controlled redundancy sweeps show an $\approx 8\times$ drop in median normalized retraining loss when one retained relative remains after deletion. Across two distinct fitting regimes in a paired Materials Project study, the lower-floor regime also exhibits a larger prediction change on more than 50% of the shared requests. Systematic comparisons against approximate updates and the original model decouple deliberate target suppression from preserved overall model utility. Consequently, request-level unlearning evaluations should report reference loss, prediction change, and retained utility together, interpreting post-deletion accuracy against what retraining itself leaves behind.

</details>


### [1340] [Transferable Mass Spectrum Prediction via Reference-Guided Test-time Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35649)
*Yunhua Zhong,Runting Li,Yifan Li,Pan Liu,Zhiwen Yang,Zikun Wang,Yixuan Tang,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPARC：一种检索引导的测试时特化框架，利用光谱参考库对预训练MS/MS预测器进行校准与持续适配，无需访问测试查询光谱即可在化学空间与采集条件迁移下提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 串联质谱预测在代谢组学、天然产物发现及环境分析中支撑化合物鉴定。然而，预训练预测器在化学空间与采集条件发生偏移时性能显著下降，而为每个领域从零训练专用模型成本高昂。因此需要一个能低成本适配预训练模型到特定领域的方法。

Method: 提出SPARC——检索引导的测试时特化框架。对每个目标查询，从光谱参考库中检索化学相关的参考光谱，在已学习的碎裂空间中重新校准碎片强度。在Transfer阶段，SPARC将参考引导的光谱适配与"可靠性感知一致性"结合，通过检索光谱上的重构行为，在持续特化过程中有选择地保留可信预测。整个流程不访问测试查询光谱。

Result: 在MassSpecGym、NPLIB1及面向应用的GNPS库上，SPARC在多种迁移设定下均提升了光谱预测性能；持续测试时训练在部署阶段提供进一步精化。

Conclusion: 检索引导的测试时特化是一种将预训练MS/MS预测器扩展到特定化学与采集领域的实用策略，结合持续测试时训练可在部署中持续改进。

Abstract: Tandem mass spectrum prediction supports compound identification across metabolomics, natural-product discovery, and environmental analysis. However, pretrained predictors often degrade under shifts in chemical space and acquisition conditions, while retraining domain-specific models from scratch is costly. We introduce SPARC, a retrieval-guided test-time specialization framework that adapts a pretrained predictor using a spectral reference library without accessing test-query spectra. For each target query, SPARC retrieves chemically related reference spectra to recalibrate fragment intensities within the learned fragmentation space. During Transfer, SPARC combines reference-guided spectral adaptation with reliability-aware consistency, using reconstruction behavior on retrieved spectra to selectively preserve trustworthy predictions during continual specialization. Across MassSpecGym, NPLIB1 and application-specific GNPS libraries, SPARC improves spectral prediction under multiple transfer settings. These results establish retrieval-guided test-time specialization as a practical strategy for extending pretrained MS/MS predictors to specific chemical and acquisition domains, with continual test-time training providing further refinement during deployment.

</details>


### [1341] [Provable Benefits of Regularization: Fast Rates for Adversarial Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35698)
*Hanbin Zhou,Shangzhe Li,Alexander Braverman,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对抗模仿学习（AIL），提出双重正则化 AIL 算法，结合 KL 策略正则化与二次奖励惩罚，在有限时域 MDP 与一般函数逼近下证明 \(\widetilde{O}(1/K+1/N)\) 的快速率，并首次同时实现专家演示与在线交互的 \(\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)\) 样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励正则化与基于熵的策略正则化是 GAIL、LS-IQ 等成功 AIL 方法的关键组件，但其有限样本收益尚未被充分理解；本文旨在刻画二者互补的统计优势。

Method: 提出无模型算法 Dually Regularized AIL：将 KL 策略正则化与由专家和学习者占用度加权的二次奖励惩罚相结合；分析上为一般凸奖励类构造在线镜像下降以控制有限专家数据与随机学习者反馈的估计误差，并对乐观 KL 正则化策略学习进行精细分析。

Result: 在 K 个在线回合与 N 条专家轨迹下，固定正则化参数时正则化模仿差距达到 \(\widetilde{O}(1/K+1/N)\) 上界；该算法是首个在该正则化 AIL 目标下同时实现专家演示和在线交互 \(\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)\) 样本复杂度的方法，且适用于随机专家。

Conclusion: 结果为 AIL 中奖励正则化与策略正则化的互补统计收益提供了严格的理论刻画。

Abstract: We study adversarial imitation learning (AIL), in which an agent learns to imitate expert demonstrations by optimizing a policy against an adversarial reward that distinguishes expert and learner behavior. Historically, reward regularization and entropy-based policy regularization are key components of empirically successful methods such as GAIL and LS-IQ, yet their finite-sample benefits remain underexplored. We establish fast rates for jointly regularized AIL in finite-horizon Markov decision processes with general function approximation. Our model-free algorithm, Dually Regularized AIL, combines KL policy regularization with a quadratic reward penalty weighted by expert and learner occupancies. With K online episodes and N expert trajectories, we prove a $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{K}+\frac{1}{N}\right)$ bound on the regularized imitation gap for fixed regularization parameters. Our analysis combines an online mirror descent construction for general convex reward classes to control estimation error from finite expert data and stochastic learner feedback, with a sharp analysis of optimistic KL-regularized policy learning. To the best of our knowledge, Dually Regularized AIL is the first algorithm to simultaneously achieve $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}ε\right)$ sample complexity in both expert demonstrations and online interactions for this regularized AIL objective, even with stochastic experts. These results provide a rigorous characterization of the complementary statistical benefits of reward and policy regularization in AIL.

</details>


### [1342] [MeqMuon: Matrix-Equilibrating Muon for LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35701)
*Chang-Wei Shi,Xu Wang,Wu-Jun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MeqMuon 优化器，通过自动平衡更新矩阵的行与列幅度来改进 Muon，无需人工干预，并在 LLM 预训练中取得优于 AdamW、Muon 等基线的收敛性能，同时减少优化器状态内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型预训练规模与成本持续增长，Muon 在精度和训练效率上表现良好，近期工作通过行归一化平衡更新幅度，但仅行归一化无法适应更新矩阵中不同的不平衡模式。

Method: 提出改进的 Muon 优化器 MeqMuon，通过可自动适配不同不平衡模式的归一化同时平衡行与列幅度，无需人工干预；并消除对 AdamW 二阶矩估计的存储需求。

Result: 实证结果表明，MeqMuon 在 LLM 预训练中相比 AdamW、Muon 及其他基线具有更好的收敛性能，同时降低优化器状态内存占用。

Conclusion: MeqMuon 通过行列联合归一化有效应对更新矩阵的不平衡模式，在提升预训练收敛性能的同时减少内存开销，是一种更优的 LLM 预训练优化器。

Abstract: The success of large language models (LLMs) has been accompanied by continued growth in model size and pretraining costs. Muon offers high accuracy and training efficiency in LLM pretraining. Recent work introduces row-wise normalization into Muon to balance update magnitudes and improve pretraining performance. However, row-wise normalization alone cannot accommodate different imbalance patterns in update matrices. In this paper, we propose an improved Muon optimizer, called \underline{m}atrix-\underline{eq}uilibrating Muon~(MeqMuon), for LLM pretraining. MeqMuon balances both row and column magnitudes through normalization that can be automatically tailored to different imbalance patterns without manual intervention. Moreover, MeqMuon eliminates the need to store AdamW's second-moment estimates, reducing optimizer-state memory usage. Empirical results demonstrate that MeqMuon achieves better convergence performance than AdamW, Muon, and other baselines in LLM pretraining.

</details>


### [1343] [ScAn-Bench: Evaluating Scaling Analysis Methodology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35707)
*Artin Sermaxhaj,Nastaran Alipour,Donat Sinani,Johannes Hog,Neeratyoy Mallik,Jenia Jitsev,Danny Stoll*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出缩放规律（scaling laws）研究缺乏系统性评估，提出基于4524个语言模型与8024个视觉-语言模型检查点的替代基准ScAn-Bench-LLM和ScAn-Bench-VLM，首次跨数据模态系统评估数据获取与推断方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
