Motivation: 机器学习进展依赖大规模基础模型，缩放规律及架构、数据、超参数的最优缩放方案对推进SOTA至关重要；然而目前尚无系统性研究评估不同模型类型下获取缩放规律与方案的方法论，该关键空白亟待填补。

Method: 构建替代（surrogate）基准ScAn-Bench-LLM与ScAn-Bench-VLM，分别基于语言模型和视觉-语言模型流水线的4524个和8024个检查点；在基准上对跨数据模态的缩放分析进行数据获取方法与外推方法的首次系统性评估。

Result: 提供了两个大规模检查点基准（4524个LLM检查点、8024个VLM检查点），并完成了跨模态（语言与视觉-语言）缩放分析在数据获取和外推方法上的首次系统评估。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示并填补了缩放规律方法论缺乏系统评估的盲区，所提出的替代基准为未来缩放规律研究提供可复用的评估平台，推动跨模态缩放分析方法的规范化比较。

Abstract: Recent progress in machine learning is driven by large-scale foundation models, where scaling laws and finding optimal scaling prescriptions for architecture, data, and hyperparameters are key in advancing the state-of-the-art. Therefore, it is surprising that no systematic study evaluates the methodology to obtain scaling laws and prescriptions across different model types. To shed light on this crucial blind spot and facilitate future research, we introduce the surrogate benchmarks ScAn-Bench-LLM and ScAn-Bench-VLM based on 4524 and 8024 checkpoints of language and vision-language model pipelines. On our benchmarks, we perform the first systematic evaluation of both data acquisition and extrapolation methodology for scaling analysis across different data modalities.

</details>


### [1344] [Neural Harmonic Measure Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35752)
*Jinjin He,Sinan Wang,Yuchen Sun,Bo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NHMO是一种针对变形状域上椭圆偏微分方程的神经求解器，通过将调和测度密度参数化为基于Transformer的边界核，用Walk-on-Spheres出口样本监督训练，实现对不同边值/源项无需重训练即可求解Dirichlet与Poisson问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 调和测度仅依赖域几何而与边界数据无关，因此可训练一个与边值解耦的核来复用求解；同时直接评估Poisson问题会遭遇奇异体积积分困难，需避免。

Method: 将调和测度密度参数化为Transformer边界核，用WoS出口样本监督；经经典分解扩展到Poisson，引入辅助网络摊销源项修正，规避奇异体积求积。

Result: 在MCB-B三维变形状Poisson基准上五个类别均优于四个先前基线；在受控二维测试平台上与主流神经算子基线具竞争力。

Conclusion: NHMO通过几何依赖的调和测度核实现一次训练、多边值多源项复用推理，为变形状域椭圆PDE提供高效免重训练求解方案。

Abstract: We introduce Neural Harmonic Measure Operator (NHMO), a neural solver for elliptic PDE problems on variable-shape domains. The harmonic measure of a domain is the boundary probability distribution that, integrated against any boundary data, returns the Dirichlet Laplace solution. It depends only on the geometry, not on the boundary data. NHMO parameterizes the density of this measure as a transformer-based boundary kernel supervised by Walk-on-Spheres exit samples, so one trained kernel handles different boundary values on a shape with no retraining. We extend it to Poisson via a classical decomposition, with an auxiliary network amortizing the source-induced correction and avoiding the singular volume quadrature that breaks direct evaluation. At inference, new boundary values and new sources both yield PDE solutions by re-integration against the fitted kernel and lift, with no retraining. NHMO improves over four prior baselines on the MCB-B 3D variable-shape Poisson benchmark across all five categories, and is competitive with major neural-operator baselines on a controlled 2D testbed.

</details>


### [1345] [Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35763)
*Chi Zhang,Haoyang Shi,Yueyi Liu,Ruichuan An,Junkang Zhou,Chang Li,Xiuyuan Lu,Yichi Zhang,Bo Wang,Yuhang Wu,Sen Cui,Miao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出统一理论框架，将分布训练中的分布建模与匹配差异分离，并通过Wasserstein梯度流连接全局目标与逐点特征更新；据此提出MGFlow，用高斯混合在可调粒度上建模特征分布，在ImageNet 256×256一步生成与文本到图像生成上取得领先效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布训练通过在冻结表示空间中匹配真实与生成特征，为一步视觉生成提供集体监督，但现有方法（如FD-Loss、Gaussian-kernel Drifting）缺乏统一理论解释，分布建模与匹配差异未被清晰区分，且混合模型表达能力本身不足以解决模式坍塌问题。

Method: 提出统一理论框架：将分布建模与匹配差异分离，利用Wasserstein梯度流把全局目标与逐点特征更新联系起来；在该框架下，FD-Loss经高斯最优传输、Gaussian-kernel Drifting经基于核密度的KL匹配分别被恢复。基于框架提出MGFlow：以高斯混合在全局矩与样本级表示之间的可调粒度上建模特征分布，同时支持最优传输与基于分数的匹配，并将质量约束的样本分配与配对分量更新耦合，以缓解模式坍塌。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，MGFlow大幅超越FD-Loss基线，取得最优结果：pMF-H上FDr⁶为1.45，JiT-H上为1.64。在文本到图像生成中，MGFlow将FLUX.2 [klein] 4B后训练为一步生成器，在GenEval与PickScore上均超过原始四步模型。

Conclusion: 该工作通过统一框架厘清了分布训练的目标与匹配机制，说明高斯混合粒度可调建模结合质量约束分配能有效提升一步生成质量并缓解模式坍塌，在类条件与文本条件生成任务上均验证了方法的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: \emph{Distributional training} provides collective supervision for one-step visual generation by matching real and generated features in frozen representation spaces. We introduce \emph{a unified theoretical framework} that separates distribution modeling from matching discrepancy and connects global objectives to pointwise feature updates through Wasserstein gradient flow. Under this framework, FD-Loss and Gaussian-kernel Drifting are recovered through Gaussian optimal transport and kernel-density-based KL matching, respectively. The framework motivates \textbf{MGFlow}, which models feature distributions with Gaussian mixtures at an adjustable granularity between global moments and sample-based representations. MGFlow supports both optimal transport and score-based matching, and couples mass-constrained sample assignment with paired component updates to address mode collapse that mixture expressivity alone does not resolve. On ImageNet $256\times256$, MGFlow substantially surpasses the FD-Loss baseline, achieving state-of-the-art results with \textbf{1.45} $\mathrm{FDr}^6$ on pMF-H and \textbf{1.64} on JiT-H. For text-to-image generation, MGFlow post-trains FLUX.2 [klein] 4B into a one-step generator that outperforms the original four-step model on both GenEval and PickScore. Project page: https://shihaoyang0423.github.io/MGFlow-website/

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [1346] [APEX: An Extensible Model for Agent-Assisted Production Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33430)
*Felix J. Grumbach,Stefan Görlitz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: APEX是一个可扩展生产调度框架，结合通用模型、混合多目标搜索与智能体辅助，在69个公开调度算例上取得最佳综合解质量，并通过24次人机交互与6项编码扩展验证了可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产调度需要贴合实际运行约束的模型，以及能平衡多目标的求解方法；同时落地应用还依赖数据集成、模型适配与专家经验。

Method: 提出APEX框架，核心为通用模型与混合多目标搜索；智能体辅助调度与模型精化，包括自然语言场景探索与编码智能体实现新约束/目标；以共享构造与检查流程连接扩展与调度核心。基准测试对比NSGA-II、SPEA2、MOEA/D、SMS-EMOA，覆盖作业车间、柔性作业车间和置换流水车间共69个实例，评估makespan、总流程时间和计算时间；另开展合成工作流研究（以GPT-6-astra为交互层）与编码扩展评估。

Result: 混合配置获得最佳综合解质量，但最优方法因问题类别与目标而异。24次交互会话全部完成变更并通过独立检查；编码评估产出的6个原生实现（新增目标或硬约束）均通过独立检查且未修改核心。

Conclusion: APEX通过混合多目标搜索与智能体辅助，在保证核心稳定性的同时支持约束与目标的扩展，具备实际可用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Production scheduling requires realistic models that reflect operational constraints and efficient methods that balance competing goals. Putting these methods into use also requires data integration, model adaptation and specialist expertise. We present APEX, an extensible production scheduling framework built around a general model and hybrid multiobjective search. Agent assistance supports both scheduling and model refinement: agents prepare data and explore scenarios in natural language, while coding agents help implement and test new constraints and objectives. Shared construction and checking procedures connect these adaptations to the scheduling core. We benchmark eight APEX configurations against NSGA-II, SPEA2, MOEA/D and SMS-EMOA on 69 public job-shop, flexible job-shop and permutation flow-shop instances, assessing workload completion time (makespan), total job flowtime and computation time. Hybrid configurations achieve the best aggregate solution quality, although the leading method depends on the problem class and objective. A separate synthetic workflow study uses OpenAI's GPT-6-astra as an interaction layer between the human planner and the algorithmic core, testing rule additions, plan and objective changes, and what-if comparisons. All 24 sessions completed the requested changes and passed independent checks of saved models and schedules. A separate coding evaluation produced six native implementations of an additional objective or hard constraint through predefined extension hooks. All passed independent checks without modifying the core.

</details>


### [1347] [Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33439)
*EverMind AI*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出开源多智能体生态系统Raven（"Harness of Harnesses"），自动构建并进化面向特定模型与领域的模块化harness，通过Host Agent、EverOS经验库与Skill Forge实现跨领域编排，在复杂长时程任务上显著超越现有SOTA智能体系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型能力提升使AI智能体从孤立、单一领域任务转向长时程、跨领域工作流。这一转变带来两大挑战：harness复杂度上升导致人工设计难以规模化；harness与特定领域紧耦合制约了通用性。因此核心问题从"如何为单领域设计更强harness"转向"如何自主构建专用harness、通过经验改进并跨领域编排"。

Method: 提出Raven多智能体生态系统，将每个可执行的"模型-harness"对视为可组合的智能单元，自动构建并进化模块化harness。其Host Agent负责目标分解、子任务与专用智能体匹配、执行依赖协调与结果整合；host archive与EverOS跨任务保存经验；Skill Forge将经验转化为可复用流程。此外给出理论，证明在共享资源预算下此类组合可扩展可靠任务覆盖范围的充分条件。

Result: 在复杂与长时程任务上，Raven显著优于当前最先进的智能体系统，推进了可组合智能体智能的前沿。理论上，建立了使组合可靠任务覆盖范围超越单个可用智能体、且在共享资源预算约束下成立的充分条件。

Conclusion: Raven通过自动构建、经验进化与跨领域编排模块化harness，验证了"可组合智能体智能"的可行性与优势，为长时程跨领域任务的自主求解提供了开源框架与理论支撑。

Abstract: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, \emph{The Harness of Harnesses}, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an \emph{All-Domain Collaboration Network}, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.

</details>


### [1348] [EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32049)
*Bhavyateja Potineni,Lohit Giri,Anu Jain,Vadim Kutsyy,Rajasekhar Pentakota*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EngramRAG 是一种基于互补学习系统原理的自适应记忆架构，通过“清醒状态”低延迟反射与异步“梦境状态”巩固循环耦合，解决 LLM 智能体在多会话环境中的联想盲区、脚手架遗忘与静态拓扑停滞问题；在 LoCoMo 基准上显著超越稠密向量 RAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主 LLM 智能体部署于多会话环境，传统记忆架构存在三大缺陷：联想盲区（无法遍历多跳关系依赖）、脚手架遗忘（时间衰减驱逐核心人格不变量）、静态拓扑停滞（图结构不可变、忽略使用动态）。

Method: 提出 EngramRAG，包含：（1）使用调制个性化 PageRank（U-PPR），转移概率经 Hebbian 可塑性自适应，将持久实体提升为高中心性的认知宏枢纽；（2）巩固激活的拓扑衰减（CATD），按拓扑承重而非墙钟新近度缩放保留半衰期，并设冷启动宽限期（N_grace ≥ 4）；（3）有向 SUPERSEDES DAG 过滤，在事实变更时压制过时状态；（4）三源混合检索，经动态 RRF 融合稠密向量、BM25 与 U-PPR。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 基准 10 段长期对话的 1,982 个 QA 对上：Recall@5 相对提升 +38.9%（53.21% vs. 38.29%，p < 0.001），MRR 提升 +43.1%（0.4203 vs. 0.2937），显著优于 Okapi BM25（48.66%）与孤立静态图检索（8.50%）；时序推理 Recall@5 达 62.33%（较稠密向量 +16.67 点）；受控变更测试中 SUPERSEDES 将“裂脑”幻觉从 70.0% 降至 0.0%；90 天模拟显示 100.0% 脚手架保留，交互检索反射延迟 26.21ms。

Conclusion: EngramRAG 通过 CLS 启发的双状态记忆与自适应图拓扑机制，有效缓解多会话智能体记忆的联想盲区、遗忘与静态拓扑停滞，在召回、排序、时序推理、事实变更一致性与长期保留方面均取得显著提升，并保持低延迟交互。

Abstract: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.

</details>


### [1349] [Beyond Dyadic Memory: Interaction-Aware Multimodal Memory with Adaptive Agentic Retrieval for Multi-Party Spoken Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32522)
*Wenxu Jia,Xize Cheng,Zihan Zhang,Dongjie Fu,Linjun Li,Wenshi Chen,Yangyang Wu,Tao Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 VoxPolyMem，一个面向多方口语对话的交互感知多模态长期记忆框架，结合增量说话人识别与三层记忆层级，并通过 EG-GRPO 进行检索决策优化，同时构建 VoxPolyBench 基准，在多项评测上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆研究主要集中于双人文本或图文对话，忽视了多方口语对话场景；该场景需要同时保留对话内容、跨会话识别参与者身份，并追踪“谁对谁说了什么”，因此亟需专门的记忆机制。

Method: 提出 VoxPolyMem 框架：将增量说话人识别与包含交互记忆、事实记忆和参与者画像的记忆层级相结合；把检索建模为序贯决策过程，智能体基于累积证据改写查询并选择检索工具与记忆层；并引入 Evidence-Gain GRPO（EG-GRPO），通过逐轮信用分配鼓励获取互补证据。

Result: 在自建 VoxPolyBench 上总体得分 85.0，超过最强评测基线 23.6 分；在 Mem-Gallery 与 H2HMem-Multi 上分别得分 89.6 与 74.4，均超过最强公开记忆基线 8 分以上。

Conclusion: VoxPolyMem 在多方多模态交互中展现出持久、个性化辅助的潜力，代码与数据集已公开。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables agents to accumulate information and reason across sessions, yet existing research primarily focuses on dyadic text or image-text conversations, leaving long-term memory for multi-party spoken conversations underexplored. This setting requires preserving conversational content, identifying participants across sessions, and retaining who speaks to whom. To this end, we propose VoxPolyMem, an interaction-aware multimodal memory framework combining incremental speaker identification with a memory hierarchy comprising interaction memory, fact memory, and participant profiles. We formulate retrieval as sequential decision-making, where an agent rewrites queries and selects retrieval tools and memory layers based on accumulated evidence to address information gaps. We further introduce Evidence-Gain GRPO (EG-GRPO), which uses round-wise credit assignment to encourage complementary evidence acquisition. We also construct VoxPolyBench to evaluate memory evolution, personalized answering, memory retrieval and reasoning, and interaction reasoning and attribution in multi-party spoken conversations. VoxPolyMem achieves an overall score of 85.0 on VoxPolyBench, surpassing the strongest evaluated baseline by 23.6 points. On Mem-Gallery and H2HMem-Multi, it scores 89.6 and 74.4, respectively, exceeding the strongest evaluated public memory baselines by over 8 points each. These results highlight its potential for persistent, personalized assistance in multi-party multimodal interactions. Code and datasets are available at https://voxpolymem.github.io/VoxPolyBench/demo/

</details>


### [1350] [When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34227)
*Rishabh Sharma,Rishika Lall*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过预注册实验表明：在紧预算下，由Jev选择的原始对话轮次在LoCoMo上不劣于LLM抽取式记忆，且写入成本低3061倍；重排序的收益随预算增大而缩小，这解释了既有文献结论的分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话记忆是否需要LLM抽取的事实，还是只需选对原始轮次？已有发表结果相互矛盾：抽取式系统报告从蒸馏事实中获益，而近期研究认为配合良好排序的原始历史同样有效，但对排序是否重要存在分歧。

Method: 在留出的LoCoMo对话与LongMemEval上进行预注册研究。使用Jev（一种类型化决策模型）单次调用选择原始轮次，与LLM抽取式记忆对比；采用单侧95%置信界与-5分非劣效性边际；辅以盲人工评分；并在第二个回答模型、不同预算及多种排序/遍历基线（LLM重排序器、多调用图遍历）下复核。

Result: LoCoMo紧预算下，Jev选择的原始轮次不劣于LLM抽取式记忆（单侧95%界-3.0分，边际-5分）；盲人工评分缩小差距但不改变结论；原始轮次写入成本低3061倍，结论在第二个回答模型下仍成立。重排序收益随预算增大而缩小：保留30候选中的3个时，LoCoMo提升17.4分、LongMemEval提升9.1分；预算宽松时仅提升1.5和1.1分，且抽取式系统更准。匹配上下文下，Jev与LLM重排序器精度相当（非劣效界-2.0）且延迟仅为其三分之一，优于多调用图遍历；重排序会降低正确弃答率。

Conclusion: 原始轮次配合高质量选择在紧预算下可替代LLM抽取式记忆，且成本极低；重排序的价值高度依赖预算，这解释了文献中结论的分歧。计划、代码与评分答案已公开。

Abstract: Does conversational memory need LLM-extracted facts, or is selecting the right raw turns enough? Published results disagree. Extraction-based systems report gains from distilled facts. Recent studies find raw history with good ranking does as well, but disagree about whether ranking matters. We ran a pre-registered study on held-out LoCoMo conversations and LongMemEval. At a tight budget on LoCoMo, raw turns selected by a single call to Jev, a typed decision model, are non-inferior to an LLM-extraction memory (one-sided 95% bound -3.0 points against a -5-point margin). Blind human grading narrows the margin but does not change the result. Raw turns cost 3,061 times less to write, and the result holds with a second answer model. Within this study, reranking's gain shrinks as the budget grows. It adds 17.4 points on LoCoMo and 9.1 on LongMemEval when three of 30 candidates are kept. At generous budgets it adds 1.5 and 1.1, and extraction systems are more accurate. This suggests why published results disagree. At matched context, Jev selects as accurately as an LLM reranker (non-inferiority bound -2.0) at a third of the latency, and more accurately than a multi-call graph traversal. Reranking lowers correct abstention. Plans, code and graded answers are released.

</details>


### [1351] [Calibrated Uncertainty for Informative Path Planning in Aquatic Environmental Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34577)
*Samuel Yanes Luis,Alejandro Casado Pérez,Alejandro Mendoza Barrionuevo,Dame Seck Diop,Sergio Toral Marín,Saniel Gutiérrez Reina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用深度集成替代高斯过程为信息路径规划提供标定良好的不确定性，可将重构误差降低83%，且不确定性质量会放大规划算法间的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量场重构的信息路径规划依赖预测不确定性引导传感车辆，但高斯过程的平稳各向同性核对油污等非均匀现象存在模型误设，导致不确定性失准，进而劣化规划效果。

Method: 以基于物理的油污模拟数据训练深度集成模型作为共享骨干，比较ε-Greedy、Value Greedy、Uncertainty Greedy、蒙特卡洛树搜索与滚动时域定向问题五种规划策略，并与高斯过程基线对比。

Result: 在留出随机溢油场景上，深度集成使归一化重构误差相对高斯过程降低83%；不确定性标定良好时算法间差距显著，多步前瞻规划器比贪心选择重构误差最多低32%，IoU超过0.85；MCTS与定向问题重构质量相当但计算成本低一个数量级。

Conclusion: 深度集成能提供更优的不确定性信号并显著改善规划结果；不确定性质量与规划算法选择存在交互，标定良好的不确定性使多步前瞻优势凸显，推荐MCTS作为规划器。

Abstract: Informative Path Planning for scalar field reconstruction uses predictive uncertainty to direct sensing vehicles toward maximally informative locations. Gaussian Processes provide this signal but their stationary isotropic kernels are misspecified for non-homogeneous phenomena such as oil spills, producing miscalibrated estimates that degrade planning. We investigate whether replacing the Gaussian Process with a well-calibrated Deep Ensemble improves path planning outcomes, and whether uncertainty quality interacts with the choice of planning algorithm. Five strategies ($ε$-Greedy, Value Greedy, Uncertainty Greedy, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and Receding Horizon Orienteering) share a common Deep Ensemble backbone trained on physics-based oil spill simulations. On held-out stochastic spill scenarios, the Deep Ensemble reduces normalised reconstruction error by $83\%$ relative to the Gaussian Process baseline. Crucially, well-calibrated uncertainty amplifies the importance of the planning strategy: the performance gap between algorithms is negligible under miscalibrated models but becomes substantial under the ensemble, where multi-step lookahead planners outperform greedy selection by up to $32\%$ in reconstruction error and achieve IoU above $0.85$. Monte Carlo Tree Search is the recommended planner, matching Orienteering in reconstruction quality at an order-of-magnitude lower computational cost.

</details>


### [1352] [AX is the New AEO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34951)
*Ido Finder,Assaf Elovic,Gad Shalev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"智能体体验(AX)"是取代AEO的新范式：在智能体联网检索时代，企业网站能否被智能体抓取并读取，比在站外散布引用更能决定其被推荐的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2023年依赖训练知识的模式已转向实时联网检索，AEO建议企业在论坛、榜单和站外引用中"撒面包屑"。但仅被检索呈现已不够：智能体在决策前会打开并阅读结果，且一个买家问题会触发多轮搜索与抓取，因此企业自身站点的可抓取、可读性（AX）成为决定性因素。

Method: 在1,056家真实企业上运行37,927条智能体"旅程"（每条为一个关于某企业的买家问题），跨四个独立测试框架；对企业按知名度、模型先验知识及两个AEO代理指标进行匹配，再按AX水平分组。对比答案来源构成、推荐率、抓取成本与准确率，并在控制企业、框架与问题固定条件下分析站点可读性的影响。

Result: 无论站点是否可读，最终答案仅7-10%来自模型训练知识；AX就绪企业的答案78%由自身页面构建（对照组56%），被明确推荐的频率高1.9倍；关于非AX就绪企业的每条有依据答案使智能体多耗费64%成本。固定企业、框架与问题后，基于站点的答案准确率高41%。主要失败模式并非编造而是遗漏：网页构建的答案有3.7倍概率完全不包含买家所需事实。四个框架基线差异悬殊，明确推荐率随技术栈不同相差七倍，但效应在每个框架中均成立。

Conclusion: 在智能体网络时代，"可被读取"优于"被谈论"；提升站点AX是企业最有力的杠杆。

Abstract: In 2023, AI models answered from training data and hallucinated when it ran out, and businesses were told to seed that knowledge. Models' training knowledge has since given way to live web search, and the advice followed it there: answer-engine optimization, or AEO, now tells businesses to scatter breadcrumbs across forum threads, listicles, and off-site citations, so AI engines are likelier to surface and recommend them. But being surfaced is no longer enough: an agent opens the results and reads them before deciding, and one buyer question sends it through several rounds of search and fetch. What decides the outcome at this drill-down step is whether the agent can fetch and read the business's own site: agent experience (AX). We argue that AX is the new AEO. We run 37,927 agent journeys, each a buyer question about a business, across four independent harnesses over 1,056 real businesses, matched on fame, prior model knowledge, and two AEO proxies, then split based on their AX level. Only 7-10% of the finished answer comes from the model's training knowledge, whether or not the site is readable. Agent-ready businesses have answers built from their own pages 78% of the time against 56% and are clearly recommended 1.9x more often, while every grounded answer about a not-agent-ready business costs the agent 64% more. Holding business, harness, and question fixed, answers built from the site are 41% more accurate. The dominant failure is not fabrication but omission: web-built answers are 3.7x more likely to contain none of the facts the buyer asked for. Baselines differ sharply across the four harnesses, with clear-recommendation rates varying sevenfold from stack to stack, yet the effect holds in every one. In the agentic web era, being readable beats being talked about, and improving a site's AX is the strongest lever a business has.

</details>


### [1353] [5W1H+Which: Context-Valid Semantic Indexing with Progressive Ontology Binding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35184)
*Yaxiao Liu,Pengbo Liu,Yiwen Liu,Yihua Guan,Jiaxing Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出5W1H+Which语义索引设计，将内容抽取与本体绑定分离，以支持可检查的前提推理与增量维护，并提出三组可证伪假设及对照评估计划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始数据转为可查询知识需要尽早抽取可复用信息，同时需要显式类型、关系与适用条件。过早按单一业务模式固化索引会遗漏后续任务所需信息；仅保留开放式文本又使规则推理缺乏可检查前提。

Method: 提出5W1H+Which语义索引：以5W1H问题组织来源可追溯的内容单元；Which指向带版本的本体元素并记录映射关系、作用域与验证状态。时间、地点、系统环境与参与者角色作为约束事实、绑定与规则适用语境的维度。未绑定内容保持可检索，绑定内容经前提检查后进入形式推理路径。区分业务有效时间、系统知识时间与操作轨迹，并用依赖记录支持绑定再验证与派生结论维护。

Result: 通过本地服务器迁移至云环境的示例，说明对世界状态变化、本体版本变化与规则适用性变化的不同处理方式。提出三组可证伪假设，分别涉及跨任务证据覆盖、语境误用控制与增量更新成本。

Conclusion: 贡献在于一个可检验的索引机制，而非新的通用本体或已被证明的性能优势；评估计划包含具有相同证据、时间信息与预算的强类型事实图基线，以检验收益来源于5W1H组织、延迟绑定还是额外信息与工程投入。

Abstract: Transforming raw data into queryable knowledge requires both early extraction of reusable information and explicit types, relations, and applicability conditions for particular tasks. If indexing selects content too early around a single business schema, later tasks may be unable to use information that was omitted. If the index retains only open-ended text, however, rule-based reasoning lacks checkable premises. We propose 5W1H+Which, a semantic indexing design that separates content extraction from ontology binding. The 5W1H questions organize source-grounded content units; Which points to versioned ontology elements and records mapping relations, scope, and validation status. Time, location, system environment, and participant roles are not merely retrieval labels: together, they constrain the contexts in which facts, bindings, and rules apply. Unbound content remains searchable, while bound content enters a formal reasoning path only after premise checks. The method further distinguishes business valid time, system knowledge time, and operational traces, and uses dependency records to support binding revalidation and the maintenance of derived conclusions. A worked example of migration from an on-premises server to a cloud environment illustrates the different treatment of world-state changes, ontology-version changes, and changes in rule applicability. We formulate three groups of falsifiable hypotheses concerning cross-task evidence coverage, control of contextual misuse, and incremental update cost. The planned evaluation includes a strong typed fact-graph baseline with the same evidence, temporal information, and budget, to test whether benefits arise from 5W1H organization, deferred binding, or additional information and engineering effort. The contribution is a testable indexing mechanism, not a claim to a new universal ontology or a demonstrated performance advantage.

</details>


### [1354] [When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32489)
*Tam Le Thi Thanh,Hoang Tran Van,Hong-Hanh Nguyen-Le,Thanh Duc Ngo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究三模态VQA中不可靠辅助文本对答案选择的影响，发现"支持干扰项的文本"（与问题对齐、与图像矛盾、偏向特定错误选项）最有害，并提出了免训练推理干预方法缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三模态VQA中辅助文本常被用于补充视觉与文本输入，但其可靠性不受控制。已有工作研究一般性的模态冲突，但尚不清楚在固定图像-问题-选项情境下，不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何影响答案选择。

Method: 作者提出Textual Reliability Ladder（文本可靠性阶梯），一个受控诊断协议，沿三个维度分解辅助文本：图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持度。基于此在ScienceQA、VCR、A-OKVQA、Causal-VidQA等多个数据集及近期VLM上进行评估，并提出一种免训练的推理时干预方法，通过噪声稳定性引导（noise-stability steering）和动态接地（dynamic grounding）来对抗重定向效应。

Result: 最具破坏性的辅助文本并非事实上最错误的，而是与问题对齐、与图像矛盾且偏向特定干扰项的文本，导致模型预测被系统性地重定向。此类支持干扰项的文本造成最大准确率下降（最高达53.1%），并将错误集中于特定错误选项。所提干预方法能减少被重定向的错误，同时在忠实文本下基本保持性能。

Conclusion: 辅助文本的可靠性应在决策层面理解，而非仅关注事实正确性；该研究为更稳健的三模态推理提供了实用路径。

Abstract: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

</details>


### [1355] [LocalProp: Neuro-Localized Memory-Efficient Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32517)
*Diana-Nicoleta Grigore,Iuliana Georgescu,Radu Tudor Ionescu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 LocalProp，一种局部更新的训练流程，在 I-JEPA 预训练后进行局部权重更新、剪枝与短时微调，在显著降低 GPU 峰值内存的同时取得良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习训练范式无论预训练还是微调都采用端到端反向传播；但整个模型的反向传播既不符合大脑学习高度局部化的生物学合理性，也不具备内存效率。

Method: 提出 LocalProp：采用"预训练后微调"范式，预训练基于 I-JEPA；随后对模型权重进行神经局部化（局部）更新，接着执行剪枝操作，再进行一次较短的最终微调阶段。剪枝的作用是将高层模块的学习信号传递到低层模块。通过调整联合优化的模块数量来改变梯度传播跨度。

Result: 在多个数据集（包括 ImageNet 等大规模基准）上的实验表明，LocalProp 仅需峰值 GPU 内存的一小部分即可达到良好性能；通过改变联合优化的模块数量，梯度传播跨度可作为精度—内存权衡的实际调节手段。

Conclusion: LocalProp 通过局部权重更新结合剪枝与短时微调，在保持良好精度的同时大幅降低训练内存开销，并提供梯度传播跨度作为可调的精度—内存权衡控制变量。

Abstract: The current deep learning training paradigm employs end-to-end backpropagation, regardless of the training stage, i.e. pre-training or fine-tuning. However, backpropagating through the entire model is neither biologically plausible nor memory efficient, since learning inside the brain is highly localized. Therefore, we propose LocalProp, a training procedure that locally updates the weights of a model. Our neuro-localized weight updates follow the "pre-training then fine-tuning" paradigm, where the pre-training is based on I-JEPA. After locally updating the weights, a pruning operation is performed, followed by a short final fine-tuning phase. Pruning helps by sending the learning signal from higher blocks to lower blocks. We perform experiments on several datasets, including large-scale benchmarks such as ImageNet, and empirically show that LocalProp reaches good performance at a fraction of GPU peak memory. By varying the number of jointly optimized blocks, we identify gradient-propagation span as a practical control over the accuracy-memory trade-off.

</details>


### [1356] [Refinement Symmetry in Multimodal Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32669)
*Yuhao Du,Shunian Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究注意力权重对token计数的依赖性，提出"细化对称性"原则：在不改变内容、位置、可见上下文和总质量的前提下拆分表示，应保持其贡献不变；并证明该不变性要求局部质量因子对任意固定正注意力核为线性（在非减条件下），据此给出measure weighting方法，在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上验证了鲁棒性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力权重依赖于token数量，而token数量随信号表示方式变化，导致同一内容的不同表示（如拆分、重采样、合并）会得到不一致的注意力分配，影响模型输出的稳定性与鲁棒性。作者希望从表示层面确立一个原理性约束，使注意力对表示细分保持对称。

Method: 基于proportional attention与quadrature attention，研究"细化对称性"（refinement symmetry）：在保持内容、位置、可见上下文与总质量的前提下拆分表示应保持贡献不变。证明若局部质量因子非减，则拆分不变性强制该因子对任意固定正注意力核为线性。针对表示改变的情形，引入物理耦合（physical coupling），将注意力误差分解为特征变化与权重重新分配两部分。据此构造measure weighting与global count weighting（平均组质量）等加权方案进行对比。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上，将一半视觉token三重复制时，标准注意力在3,586个MVBench答案中改变了255个，而measure weighting在匹配可见性下保持所有答案不变；自然帧重采样下measure weighting降低了分布漂移。在冻结视频编码的二倍合并下，五种子评估显示an all-partition-correct准确率较global count weighting提升1.04个百分点，较标准注意力提升0.93个百分点。在WorldSense上对global count的优势同样成立，但依赖压缩预算。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了一条表示原则（细化对称性），并给出其测量化的实现，在多种分区与表示变换下实证了鲁棒性收益，说明注意力权重应基于质量度量而非单纯token计数。

Abstract: Attention weights depend on token counts, which change with the representation of a signal. We study refinement symmetry: splitting a representation while preserving content, position, visible context, and total mass should preserve its contribution. Building on proportional and quadrature attention, we show that split invariance forces the local mass factor to be linear for any fixed positive attention kernel, provided that factor is nondecreasing. For changed representations, a physical coupling bounds attention error by separating feature change from weight reallocation. In Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, duplicating half the visual tokens threefold changes 255 of 3,586 MVBench answers under standard attention; measure weighting preserves every answer under matched visibility. Under natural frame resampling, it reduces distributional drift. At twofold merging of a frozen video encoding, a five-seed evaluation shows an all-partition-correct accuracy gain of 1.04 percentage points over global count weighting (average group mass) and 0.93 points over standard attention. The advantage over global count also holds on WorldSense but depends on the compression budget. The result is a representation principle with a measured benefit in robustness across partitions.

</details>


### [1357] [Readout is not Recovery: Dissociating Coordinate Emission from Visual-Corruption Repair in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32757)
*Drandreb Earl Juanico*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct单目标COCO定位中"坐标token读出"与"视觉损伤后修复"的分离现象，发现坐标token排序在层24前惰性、层32-35承重、层34达峰，而损伤诱导修复排序在层16-24有害、层35/末层附近有益；物体掩码修复揭示不同rank预算的差异化作用，且遮挡恢复需单独基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM的bounding-box定位兼具语言生成与空间承诺双重性质，bbox_2d等可解析字段虽便于评分，但发射坐标token的维度未必能在视觉证据受损后修复定位。作者希望厘清"读出"与"恢复"这两种能力的关系，探究坐标token路径是否为有效的电路先验。

Method: 在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct上针对单目标COCO grounding，对比干净输入的坐标token读出排序与损伤诱导的修复排序；用物体掩码端点替换实现恢复、干净输入flooring做深度定位；结合Kimi-VL-A3B诊断、物体掩码恢复的rank预算分析（k=250/500/d/2）、部分遮挡扫描、边缘归因patch及RMSNorm准层控制。

Result: 坐标token排序在层24前惰性，层32-35承重，层34达峰；损伤诱导排序在层16-24有害，层35/末层附近有益。Kimi-VL-A3B呈现相似的输出近端转变。物体掩码恢复中k=250表现为必要性，k=500显示Top-k恢复优于随机，k=d/2主要由容量驱动。遮挡扫描显示高重叠坐标token集在k=1000时有害、仅在半宽时有益，群体损伤诱导集无可靠固定修复集。边缘归因patch表明坐标token路径高精度低召回，RMSNorm准层控制无法弥合端点修复差距。

Conclusion: 端点坐标triage是有用的电路先验，但遮挡恢复需要独立的基准来评估。

Abstract: VLM bounding-box localization is both language generation and spatial commitment. Parseable fields such as bbox_2d make localization easy to score, but dimensions that emit coordinate tokens need not repair localization after visual evidence is damaged. We study this readout/recovery separation in Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on single-object COCO grounding. We compare clean coordinate-token readout rankings with corruption-derived repair rankings, using object-mask endpoint replacement for recovery and clean-input flooring for depth localization. In Qwen3-VL, coordinate-token rankings are inert through layer 24, load-bearing from layers 32-35, and peak at layer 34; corruption-derived rankings harm layers 16-24 but become beneficial near layer 35/final. A Kimi-VL-A3B diagnostic shows a matching output-proximal transition despite a different box format. Object-mask recovery separates rank budgets: $k=250$ shows necessity, $k=500$ shows Top-$k$ restoration above random, and $k=d/2$ is largely capacity-driven. Partial-occlusion sweeps reveal that high-overlap coordinate-token sets can hurt at $k=1000$ and help mainly at half-width, while population corruption-derived sets provide no reliable fixed repair set. Edge-attribution patching shows coordinate-token paths are high precision but low recall for detection recovery, and RMSNorm quasi-layer controls do not close the endpoint-repair gap. Endpoint coordinate triage is therefore a useful circuit prior, but occlusion recovery requires a separate benchmark.

</details>


### [1358] [PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32801)
*Junchi Chen,Changtao Miao,Yuxiao Xiang,Zhenchao Jin,Haojie Yuan,Qi Chu,Tao Gong,He Liu,Bo Zhang,Jiansheng Cai,Zhe Li,Nenghai Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PlanGuard，首个在具身任务多步计划执行前评估其在当前环境中物理安全性的检测器；构建MSP-Safe数据集，并提出STAC-OPD蒸馏方法训练紧凑模型，PlanGuard-2B达到约87%的ACC与F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身任务规划器生成的多步计划中，子任务依赖关系及其与环境的交互会在执行中带来物理风险。现有防护措施忽视这种组合性风险：通用护栏关注语义危害，具身安全检测器则孤立评估单个子任务，缺乏对整个多步计划在当前环境下物理安全性的执行前评估手段。

Method: 1) 提出PlanGuard——首个执行前检测完整多步计划物理安全性的检测器；2) 通过配对任务构建、多规划器生成计划、三位评判者安全标注，构建Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe)数据集；3) 在MSP-Safe上做任务导向SFT，建立基础计划安全评估能力；4) 提出STAC-OPD（Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation），在紧凑模型的on-policy轨迹上提供自适应强教师监督，结合强教师微调后的token级分布迁移与概率路由的序列级补偿——当学生倾向参考安全决策时保留学生生成目标，否则使用教师重构目标。

Result: 在所有测试子集上，PlanGuard-2B平均达到87.15% ACC和87.21% F1，表明紧凑模型规模下可有效进行整计划物理风险检测。

Conclusion: PlanGuard为多步具身计划提供了执行前的整体物理安全检测，填补组合性风险防护空白；STAC-OPD使紧凑模型在实时部署约束下逼近大模型性能。代码与数据集将公开。

Abstract: Embodied task planners may produce multi-step plans whose subtask dependencies and interactions with the environment create physical risks during execution. Yet existing safeguards overlook such compositional risks, as general-purpose guardrails focus on semantic harm and embodied safety detectors assess subtasks in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce PlanGuard, the first pre-execution detector that evaluates the physical safety of a complete multi-step plan in its current environment. For training and evaluation, we construct a Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe) dataset through paired task construction, plan generation using diverse planners, and safety annotation by three judges. Task-oriented SFT on MSP-Safe establishes fundamental plan-safety assessment capabilities, yet a substantial gap remains between compact models suitable for real-time deployment and stronger but costlier large models. Accordingly, we propose Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation (STAC-OPD), which provides compact models with adaptive strong-teacher supervision along their on-policy trajectories. It combines token-level distribution transfer from a fine-tuned strong teacher with probability-routed sequence-level compensation, retaining student-generated targets when the student favors the reference safety decision and using teacher-reconstructed targets otherwise. Across all test subsets, PlanGuard-2B achieves average 87.15% ACC and 87.21% F1, demonstrating effective whole-plan physical-risk detection at compact model scale. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

</details>


### [1359] [WorldAgent: Verification-Guided Agentic Physical World Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33208)
*Caoliwen Wang,Mengdi Wang,Yige Chen,Zejia Wu,Bowen Huang,Siyuan Chen,Guanxiong Chen,Lifu Wei,Heng Zhang,Qinghai Zhang,Yin Yang,Guandao Yang,Shiying Xiong,Peng Wang,Chenfanfu Jiang,Peter Yichen Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 WorldAgent 智能体框架，从单条自然语言提示出发、无需用户迭代调试即可验证引导地构建复杂物理世界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从语言构建复杂物理世界需协调大范围 3D 环境、跨空间尺度的结构与物体，以及既定目标与隐含物理约束下的交互过程，现有方法依赖用户反复调试。

Method: 框架含两层：世界构建层将提示扩展为结构化世界规范，利用物理知识搭建场景并进行数值仿真；验证层在每一步后检查场景几何、仿真状态与渲染视图，未通过的检查驱动规范自动修正与受影响步骤重执行，被接受的世界保持可编辑、可重新仿真。

Result: 在提出的 AgenticSimBench 上，WorldAgent 在 7 项指标中的 5 项取得所评估智能体方法中的最佳成绩；26 人用户研究中在全部 4 项标准上获得最高平均评分。

Conclusion: 验证引导的智能体式构建可有效实现端到端、免调试的语言到物理世界生成，并在基准测试与用户主观评价上均优于同类方法。

Abstract: Constructing complex physical worlds from language requires coordinating extensive 3D environments, detailed structures and objects at different spatial scales, and interacting physical processes under both stated goals and implicit physical constraints. We present WorldAgent, an agentic framework for verification-guided physical world construction from a single natural-language prompt, without iterative user debugging. A world construction layer expands the prompt into a structured world specification and uses physical knowledge to build scenes and run numerical simulations. After every step, a verification layer inspects scene geometry and simulation states alongside rendered views. Failed checks guide automatic revisions to the specification and re-execution of the affected steps. Accepted worlds pass the required checks and remain editable for further inspection and resimulation. We introduce AgenticSimBench, on which WorldAgent achieves the best scores among the evaluated agent-based methods on five of seven metrics. In a 26-participant user study, it receives the highest mean ratings across all four criteria.

</details>


### [1360] [Probe to Act: Elevating Browser-Use Agent via Active Visual Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33646)
*Keliang Li,Heng Wang,Chen Hu,Daxin Jiang,Hong Chang,Shiguang Shan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Probe to Act (P2A) 主动探测框架，在决策时刻完成 DOM 符号与截图像素的对齐，并生成基于证据的记忆，提升浏览器智能体任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浏览器智能体接口依赖截图级动作预测或静态 Set-of-Marks 叠加，模型需在每次操作前自行解决密集的 DOM-像素对齐问题，且长程交互中上下文冗余、难以保留关键证据。

Method: P2A 将对齐移入决策时刻，通过按需将符号化 DOM 结构重新渲染为像素，实现符号假设与截图布局之间的非对称桥接。在执行改变状态的操作前，智能体可发起轻量探测：将 DOM 句柄转为像素证据、将屏幕区域映射回 DOM 候选、注册纯视觉目标、提交已验证笔记；交错探测过程自然形成基于证据的记忆，仅保留被探测、被执行或显式提交的观察。可作为专有模型的提示策略（标准 DOM+SoM 接口），也可通过冷启动合成与自举 SFT 蒸馏到开放权重模型。

Result: 在三个浏览器使用基准上，专有模型和微调模型的任务成功率均明显提升。VisualWebArena 上，Gemini-3-Pro 从 54.1% 提升至 61.2%，Qwen3-VL-8B 从 24.6% 提升至 32.9%，同时仅用约 1.2× 的峰值保留输入上下文（相比仅动作历史）即达到约 3× 全观察历史的性能。

Conclusion: P2A 通过主动探测与证据驱动记忆，有效解决浏览器智能体中 DOM-像素对齐与长程上下文效率问题，兼具提示策略与可蒸馏训练方案的通用性。

Abstract: Browser-use agents require seamless alignment between structured web metadata and visual information, while preserving relevant context across long interactions. Existing interfaces often rely on either screenshot-level action prediction or static Set-of-Marks overlays, leaving the model to resolve dense DOM-pixel alignment before every operation. We introduce Probe to Act (P2A), an active probing framework for the browser-agent loop that moves this alignment into decision time. P2A addresses an asymmetric bridge between symbolic DOM hypotheses and screenshot layout by rendering on-demand symbolic DOM structure back into pixels. Before committing a state-changing browser operation, the agent can issue lightweight probes to translate DOM handles into pixel evidence, map screen regions back to DOM candidates, register visual-only targets, and commit verified notes. These interleaved processes naturally produce evidence-based memory: only probed, acted-on, or explicitly committed observations are kept across steps, preserving only decision-critical evidence in long-horizon contexts. P2A can be used as a prompting strategy for proprietary models under the standard DOM+SoM interface, and can be distilled into open-weight models through cold-start synthesis and self-bootstrapped SFT. Across three browser-use benchmarks, P2A shows clear gains on task success rate for both proprietary and fine-tuned models; on VisualWebArena, for example, it improves Gemini-3-Pro from 54.1% to 61.2% and Qwen3-VL-8B from 24.6% to 32.9%, while matching the costly full-observation history ($\sim$3$\times$) at only $\sim$1.2$\times$ the peak retained input context of action-only history.

</details>


### [1361] [A Computer Vision Approach to Visual Fraud Detection in Phishing Websites Using YOLOv8](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34015)
*Basil Sajid Shaikh,Hajar Homayouni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉图像的钓鱼网站检测方法，将网页整页截图作为图像输入，用YOLOv8卷积神经网络依据布局、Logo位置、配色和登录表单结构进行分类，而非依赖URL或HTML文本。系统在留出测试集上达到92%准确率，单张截图处理约100毫秒，并通过针对光照、压缩、缩放的定向数据增强将误报率相对基线降低11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 钓鱼是金融与身份欺诈最常见的入口之一，但现有检测系统多依赖URL、HTML标记或域名注册历史。这些信号易被攻击者轮换或混淆，且几乎无法反映真正让受害者交出密码或卡号的因素——页面的外观视觉呈现。因此需要一种以人眼方式审视渲染网页的视觉检测路径。

Method: 将渲染后的网页整页截图视为图像，训练YOLOv8卷积神经网络进行二分类（钓鱼/合法）。分类依据为版面布局、Logo摆放位置、配色方案以及登录表单结构，而非从页面提取的文本。文中还介绍了数据集构建流程、针对光照、压缩和缩放变化设计的定向数据增强策略，以及模型架构与训练配置。

Result: 在留出测试集上取得92%的分类准确率；单张截图处理耗时约100毫秒；经过专门针对光照、压缩与缩放变化的数据增强后，误报率较增强前基线下降11%。

Conclusion: 该视觉检测器定位为与现有基于URL和内容的防御手段并存互补，而非取而代之。论文讨论了其在整体防护体系中的适用位置，并指出此类视觉信号可补充传统文本与域名特征的不足。

Abstract: Phishing remains one of the most common vectors for financial and identity fraud, and most detection systems still rely on inspecting a page's URL, HTML markup, or domain registration history. These signals are easy for an attacker to rotate or obfuscate, and they say very little about what actually convinces a victim to hand over a password or a card number: the way the page looks. This paper describes a visual, image-based approach to phishing detection that treats a rendered webpage the same way a human eye would, as a picture that either matches a trusted brand or doesn't. A YOLOv8 convolutional neural network was trained to classify full-page website screenshots as phishing or legitimate based on layout, logo placement, color scheme, and login-form structure, rather than on text extracted from the page. The system reached 92% classification accuracy on a held-out test set, processed a single screenshot in roughly 100 milliseconds, and, after a round of data augmentation aimed specifically at lighting, compression, and scaling variation, cut the false-positive rate by 11% relative to the pre-augmentation baseline. The paper walks through the dataset construction, the augmentation strategy, the model architecture and training setup, and the resulting performance, and closes with a discussion of where this kind of visual detector fits alongside, rather than instead of, existing URL- and content-based defenses.

</details>


### [1362] [K-OPSD: Verifiable On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Vision-Language Models on AEC Drawings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34082)
*Yunfei Bai,Enrico Chionna,Akash Amol,Kawaljit Singh KC,Joern Tinnemeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 K-OPSD，一种面向建筑、工程与施工（AEC）图纸理解的视觉语言模型后训练方法，基于可验证监督的在线自蒸馏，在 AECV-Bench 上微调 Qwen3-VL 并取得领先结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与视觉语言模型（VLM）在解读 AEC 图纸时表现不佳，需要针对该专业领域的后训练方法来提升理解能力。

Method: 基于带可验证监督的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）：用模型自身的 best-of-N 生成并经过程级验证器认证来构建教师；对失败提示通过暴露已验证答案的提示进行重采样以挽救；随后用交叉熵内损失在已验证补全上进行在线策略更新，取代在线策略蒸馏中受限的逐 token 广义 Jensen-Shannon 散度（JSD），并用该方法在 AECV-Bench 上微调 Qwen3-VL。

Result: 所得模型取得最高平均评判分数 0.819 与综合准确率 0.738，与开源基线模型相比具有竞争力；方法可迁移到域外 ArchCAD 数据集，其中 8B 模型提升最大。

Conclusion: 作者给出了验证器套件以及持续学习与自改进流程，结果提供初步证据表明验证器引导的自蒸馏是通向更可靠的机器读图的一条有前景路径。

Abstract: Interpreting architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) drawings is hard for general Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce K-OPSD, a VLM post-training methodology for improving AEC drawing understanding. Building on On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) with verifiable supervision, we construct a teacher from the model's own best-of-N generations, certified by a process-level verifier, and rescue failed prompts by resampling under a hint that exposes the verified answer. We then perform an on-policy model update by training on verified completions with a cross-entropy inner-loss, outperforming the bounded token-wise generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) used by on-policy distillation. Using K-OPSD, we fine-tune Qwen3-VL models on the AECV-Bench dataset. The resulting models attain the top average judge score (0.819) and combined accuracy (0.738), achieving competitive results against open-source baseline models. The recipe transfers to the out-of-domain ArchCAD dataset, where the 8B model gains most. We present the verifier suite and the continual learning and self-improving pipeline, our results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-guided self-distillation is a promising route toward more reliable machine reading of architecture drawings.

</details>


### [1363] [SpecRegMatch: Robust Semi-Supervised Regression for Vehicle Interior Noise Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34111)
*Sejin Sim,Jinsoo Bae,Seoung Bum Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SpecRegMatch：一种面向车辆内部噪声预测的单模型半监督回归方法，通过一致性正则化与信息最大化降低计算成本，在标签稀缺场景下达到 SOTA（R²=0.434）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载内部噪声预测中，标注数据采集成本高昂；现有半监督回归（SSR）方法虽能利用无标注数据缓解标签依赖，但因需训练多个模型并进行数据采样，导致计算开销过大。

Method: 提出 SpecRegMatch 单模型 SSR 方法，摒弃多模型训练与多次数据采样；结合一致性正则化与信息最大化，对嵌入向量和预测值施加多种数据增强以实现稳健训练。

Result: 在多种场景下取得 SOTA 性能，即便仅使用单个模型；R² 达 0.434，在标注数据稀缺时表现尤为突出。

Conclusion: SpecRegMatch 以单模型、低成本的方式有效解决了 SSR 的计算瓶颈，在标签稀缺的车辆噪声预测任务中兼具性能与效率，代码已开源。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has observed increased application in predicting vehicle interior noise levels within the automotive industry. However, the collection of labeled data for training models in this context involves significant costs. Previous studies in semi-supervised regression (SSR) have effectively mitigated the reliance on labeled data by incorporating unlabeled data. Nonetheless, these approaches often introduce a high computational cost due to the training of multiple models and data sampling. This study introduces SpecRegMatch, a novel SSR method aimed at addressing the computational cost associated with training by leveraging a single model, thus eliminating the need for multiple data samplings. SpecRegMatch integrates consistency regularization and information maximization to robustly train the model, achieved through various augmentations applied to both the embedding vectors and predicted values. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecRegMatch achieves state-of-the-art performance across various scenarios, even when using a single model. It attains a remarkable performance, as indicated by an R^2 score of 0.434. This is especially noteworthy in scenarios where labeled data is scarce. You can access the code for our proposed method at https://github.com/sejin-sim/SpecRegMatch.

</details>


### [1364] [Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34180)
*Xukui Qin,Youting Wang,Xinjie He,Ziyang Luo,Runxiong Wu,Yan-Syuan Chen,Zhongyao Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在视频文本证据固定的条件下，比较 Jev 类型化决策与三种 Qwen 读出方式；XD 字幕上 Jev Noul 平均精度 75.99%，显著高于 Qwen 概率（48.47%）和序数似然期望（57.81%），但 UCF 上未复现优势，且概率读出 Brier 分数更差。属探索性离线结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者关注一个受控问题：当视频导出的文本证据保持固定时，决策读出（decision readout）方式本身对质量影响有多大；同时检验类型化接口是否带来排序或概率质量上的收益。

Method: 在 UCF-Crime 与 XD-Violence 各取 20 个源组、200 个锚点（共 40 视频、400 锚点，正例分别 10 与 37），以摘要与有序字幕两种呈现形式，评估 Jev 类型化决策与三种 Qwen 读出；原五后端试点需 4,000 次预测，Jev Choice 在严格数值策略下 800 次中仅 776 次有效；另对历史 LAVAD 分数在精确匹配锚点上做审计，区分响应结构与数值一致性。

Result: XD 字幕上 Jev Noul 平均精度 75.99%，优于 Qwen 生成概率 48.47% 与更强的局部序数似然期望 57.81%；后者配对差 18.18 个百分点（95% 源组自助区间 5.53–31.50）。UCF 未显示对应优势：字幕 ROC-AUC 为 Noul 52.26%、序数似然 65.95%；两者 Brier 分数均高于按评估流行率参考值 0.0475（即更差）。Jev Choice 因接口/数值策略失败导致覆盖率不全，无法完成全样本比较。

Conclusion: 这些探索性离线结果刻画了排序、概率质量与接口失败，但既未确立类型化接口的因果收益，也未证明普遍优越性、校准性或端到端加速；缺少二元似然对照。

Abstract: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.

</details>


### [1365] [MoSPR: Histology-to-Gene Expression Prediction with Morpho-Spatial Macrostates and Low-Rank Molecular Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34280)
*Dongmyung Shin,Geongyu Lee,Yesung Cho,Park Jong Bae*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MoSPR是一个线性框架，通过将空间邻接信息融入的组织学表征与低秩分子基耦合，从全切片图像预测基因表达，在三个TCGA癌症队列上取得最优预测性能并具备可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从组织病理学图像预测分子谱面临两大挑战：全切片图像包含空间组织化的异质组织模式，而基因表达包含数千个相关目标。现有方法难以同时刻画这种空间异质性与高维相关输出。

Method: MoSPR将冻结的patch嵌入聚类为形态微状态（morphology microstates），在训练队列中聚合其空间邻接关系，并将邻接模式相似的微状态归并为共享宏状态（macrostates）。每张切片由全局形态表征与宏状态特异的偏差表示，再线性映射到训练所得低秩基因表达基的系数上。该方法无需通路级监督，且为线性形式，可精确分解预测表达谱。

Result: 在来自TCGA的三个癌症队列上，MoSPR在所有评估方法中获得最高的平均基因表达预测分数；其预测表达谱导出的通路分数在三个通路集合的九项比较中八项排名第一。乳腺癌队列的消融实验显示邻接宏状态表征与低秩分子预测带来互补增益；仅用一半训练数据即超过最强基线使用全部数据的基因预测分数。

Conclusion: MoSPR将空间组织化的组织形态与低秩分子基有效结合，实现高精度、数据高效且可解释的基因表达预测，其线性公式可将预测谱分解为全局与宏状态特异的分子贡献，为空间连贯的宏状态区域与其关联分子程序之间提供可解释联系。

Abstract: Predicting molecular profiles from histopathology remains challenging because whole-slide images contain spatially organized, heterogeneous tissue patterns, while gene expression comprises thousands of correlated targets. We introduce MoSPR (Morpho-Spatial Program Regression), a linear framework that couples an adjacency-informed histology representation with a low-rank molecular basis. MoSPR clusters frozen patch embeddings into morphology microstates, aggregates their spatial adjacencies across the training cohort, and groups microstates with similar adjacency patterns into shared macrostates. Each slide is then represented by global morphology and macrostate-specific deviations, which are linearly mapped to coefficients of a training-derived low-rank gene-expression basis. Across three cancer cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas, MoSPR achieves the highest mean gene-expression prediction scores among all evaluated methods. Without pathway-level supervision, pathway scores derived from its predicted expression profiles rank first in eight of nine comparisons across three pathway collections. Ablation studies on the breast cancer cohort show complementary gains from adjacency-derived macrostate representation and low-rank molecular prediction. Moreover, with half of the training data on this cohort, MoSPR exceeds the full-data gene-prediction score of the strongest competing baseline. Finally, its linear formulation enables exact decomposition of each predicted expression profile into global and macrostate-specific molecular contributions, providing an interpretable link between spatially coherent macrostate regions and their associated molecular programs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Radisen-Panthera/MoSPR.

</details>


### [1366] [Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34768)
*Shuxing Zhang,Yongquan Ni,Zhenyu Ding,Yawen Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出跨模态教师-学生框架，将商用单芯片毫米波雷达从稀疏点云提升到逐帧全身度量级3D网格重建，并给出逐关节不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用单芯片毫米波雷达点云极稀疏（平均约6.5点/帧，约28%空帧），隐私保护性好但信息量有限，导致既有工作只能做身体部位关键点或离散动作分类，无法实现全身度量级重建。

Method: (1) 网格基础模型教师：用 SAM 3D Body 从单张RGB帧零训练生成全身MHR真值（70关节、18,439网格顶点），大幅降低标注成本；(2) StudentPoseFormer：集合编码+掩码注意力池化、时序Transformer、CVAE多假设头，同时输出姿态均值与逐关节方差；(3) 多阶段真值质量流水线（置信度门控、深度验证、时序平滑、骨长一致性、坏帧剔除）及信息杠杆消融实验。

Result: 公开MM-Fi基准（同款TI IWR6843、跨被试）上完整配置达7.45 cm 12关节MPJPE；消融显示点累积（k=3，-0.34 cm）、多普勒（-0.85 cm，快速动作下手腕处-2 cm）、速度损失（-0.27 cm）均有因果价值。自建同步雷达+RGB-D语料上块级留出分割端到端为21.47 cm（关节层级从髋部4.8 cm到手腕34.7 cm，符合物理信息极限），约30k多样样本可提升至15 cm；扩展律表明样本多样性而非数量是瓶颈。部署推理仅用雷达，无需相机与图像。

Conclusion: 跨模态教师-学生框架首次实现商用毫米波雷达的逐帧全身度量级3D网格重建，并诚实输出逐关节不确定性；性能受物理信息极限与样本多样性约束，雷达单模态部署兼具隐私保护与实用性。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pipeline (confidence gating, depth validation, temporal smoothing, bone-length consistency, bad-frame rejection) plus systematic information-lever ablations. On the public MM-Fi benchmark (same TI IWR6843 sensor, cross-subject), our full configuration reaches 7.45 cm 12-joint MPJPE, with ablations proving the causal value of point accumulation (k = 3, -0.34 cm), Doppler (-0.85 cm; -2 cm at the wrist on fast actions), and velocity loss (-0.27 cm). On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint. Deployment inference is radar-only - no camera, no image.

</details>


### [1367] [JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35032)
*Zhixi Cai,Fucai Ke,Sukai Huang,Maria Garcia de la Banda,Peter J. Stuckey,Gholamreza Haffari,Hamid Rezatofighi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 JRDB-AVR 基准，用于评估具身视觉推理中的主动证据获取能力，涵盖答案准确率与证据准确率两个维度，并给出参考方法 JRDB-AVR-Agent。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂具身视觉推理场景中，智能体视野有限，回答问题所需证据可能分布在时间、视角和交互对象之间。模型可能给出貌似合理但未观测到相关对象的答案。现有基准多评估被动观测与最终答案，忽视了主动推理与证据获取。

Method: 基于真实 JRDB 机器人数据，通过结构化问题生成引擎构建 JRDB-AVR 基准。智能体接收视觉推理问题后，按时间戳与视角请求有界观测，评估最终答案及其支撑的视觉证据。基准包含跨多个真实环境、涉及时间搜索、视角选择与以人为中心的组合推理问题。同时提出参考方法 JRDB-AVR-Agent，维护显式的、以观测为基础的图结构世界模型，并通过求解进行回答。

Result: 实验显示当前基线在答案准确率与证据准确率之间存在显著差距，表明当前 VLM 可产生无证据支撑的正确答案，主动的证据感知评估对具身视觉推理是必要的。

Conclusion: JRDB-AVR 将主动证据获取纳入具身视觉推理评估，揭示了答案正确不等于证据充分的缺陷，说明需要证据感知的评估范式。代码与基准已开源。

Abstract: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.

</details>


### [1368] [Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35110)
*Yitong Li,Jincheng Yu,Junsong Chen,Haopeng Li,Shuchen Xue,Haozhe Liu,Ping Luo,Song Han,Enze Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该工作面向视频扩散模型 MiniMax-H3（330 亿参数）的推理瓶颈，提出算法与算子协同的全栈推理流水线，实现最高 30 倍端到端加速与 20% 内存下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MiniMax-H3 是生产级开源视频扩散模型，但 330 亿参数与多步迭代去噪带来巨大计算开销：云端部署（如 NVIDIA-GB200）受生成延迟制约，边缘设备（如 DGX-Spark）受严格内存限制，从云到端的异构硬件瓶颈阻碍其实际生产落地。

Method: 算法层面提出跨分辨率两阶段生成调度器，利用扩散的逐步特性：早期低分辨率步快速建立全局布局，后期高分辨率步专注局部与感知细节的精修；两阶段间由学习得到的 latent-to-latent 映射模块连接，完全消除跨分辨率切换时昂贵的 VAE 解码-重编码循环。算子层面部署递归自我改进（RSI）循环，搜索核融合与内存布局，同时以延迟和数值一致性作为评估指标。

Result: 优化合计带来最高 30 倍端到端加速与 20% 内存降低：在 8xGB200 节点上，5 秒 1344x768 带音频视频的生成速度比实时快 3.5 倍；在单台 DGX Spark 上可在不到一分钟内完成且完全驻留内存。

Conclusion: 通过算法调度与算子实现的联合优化，可有效缓解视频扩散模型从云端到边缘的延迟与内存瓶颈，实现高分辨率带音频视频的高效生成。

Abstract: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement. Together, these optimizations deliver up to 30x end-to-end speedup and 20% lower memory: a 5-second 1344x768 video with audio is generated 3.5x faster than real time on an 8xGB200 node, and in under a minute fully memory-resident on a single DGX Spark.

</details>


### [1369] [TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35336)
*Shengqin Wang,Jie Jin,Yu Cheng,Yihang Chen,Weilin Luo,Yuan Xie,Zhizhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TMCS，一种工具接地的多智能体推理框架，将组合化学问题求解形式化为可解释的工具增强工作流，通过任务级专用智能体与工作流级闭环流水线，显著提升开源与闭源模型的化学推理性能并达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在计算化学中具有潜力，但严格的组合化学问题仍具挑战性，因为其需要定量约束的分子修饰、候选验证以及失败后的系统性修正。现有工具增强的化学智能体虽具备一定的规划与工具使用能力，但缺乏统一的、面向性质驱动的分子优化与工作流级组合的闭环机制。

Method: 提出TMCS（Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving），一个逐步式多智能体框架，将化学问题求解形式化为可解释、工具增强的工作流。任务级上，专用智能体利用外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆与结构化反思来迭代精化解；工作流级上，TMCS将生成、理解、编辑、描述与优化串联为闭环流水线。

Result: 在多个化学任务上的评估表明，TMCS能在开源与闭源基座模型上一致地增强化学推理能力，并取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: TMCS通过任务级与工作流级的双重多智能体设计，弥合了工具增强化学智能体在统一闭环优化与工作流组合方面的空白，验证了工具接地多智能体推理在组合化学问题求解中的有效性。

Abstract: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [1370] [Verifiable Visual Rewards Transfer from Synthetic Scenes to Natural Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35641)
*Shuyue Stella Li,Xiaochuang Han,Yulia Tsvetkov,Luke Zettlemoyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出可验证视觉奖励（VVR）框架，用程序化确定性验证器为图像生成提供奖励，并发布VVRBench基准；以VVR为RL奖励可将Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium在VVRBench上的准确率从2.8%提升至28.3%，且具备易到难泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像生成中的精确指令遵循（如满足物体数量与空间关系）仍是未解难题，部分原因在于训练依赖不可靠的奖励模型，如目标检测器和视觉语言模型，这些模型本身存在噪声与偏差。

Method: 提出VVR（可验证视觉奖励）框架，用程序化方式生成可验证的图像奖励。每个VVR任务是由几何物体及其关系构成的场景，由此同时推导出提示词与确定性验证器，因此任务可按任意数量和任意复杂度生成。发布VVRBench（含32类约束、10,000个任务）与VVRBench-Challenge（720个更复杂任务），并将VVR分数作为强化学习奖励（RLVVR）用于训练。

Result: 所评估最强模型GPT-Image-2.5仅解决VVRBench-Challenge的21.4%；使用RLVVR后，Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium在VVRBench上的准确率从2.8%升至28.3%，并展现一致的由易到难泛化；增益还扩展到域外基准，且将VVR混入现有目标可进一步提升整体性能与人类偏好。

Conclusion: VVR将可验证奖励引入图像生成后训练流程，训练于其上可泛化到自然提示，并能提升域外表现与人类偏好，因此值得纳入标准图像生成后训练方案。

Abstract: Precise instruction following in image generation, such as satisfying object counts and spatial relations, remains an open challenge at least in part because it is learned using unreliable reward models such as object detectors and vision-language models. We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, and show that training on it generalizes to natural prompts. Each VVR task is a scene of geometric objects and relations among them, from which we derive both the prompt and a deterministic verifier, so tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity. We release VVRBench, with 10,000 tasks over 32 constraint types, and VVRBench-Challenge, with 720 more complex tasks; the strongest model we evaluate---GPT-Image-2.5---solves 21.4% of VVRBench-Challenge. Using VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) raises the accuracy of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium on VVRBench from 2.8% to 28.3% and demonstrates consistent easy-to-hard generalization. These gains extend to out-of-domain benchmarks, and mixing VVR into existing objectives further improves overall performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes.

</details>


### [1371] [SpeechCritic: Learning a Diagnostic Speech Judge from Limited Human Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34582)
*Mingyue Huo,Shivam Mehta,Bhavin Jawade,Yinghong Lan,Haoqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SpeechCritic：仅用约 300 条人工标注对比，通过参考条件下的跨语言校准前沿音频语言模型，构建可诊断的语音评判器，输出维度级偏好与声学线索依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动语音质量评判多将语音压缩为单一自然度分数，丢失情感、音色、说话人身份等感知信息；而直接提示前沿音频语言模型生成标注不可靠，存在明显错误与指令遵循不稳定问题，且专家标注成本高。

Method: 在参考条件下的跨语言设定中学习诊断式评判器：以约300条人工成对比较标签对前沿模型进行校准。针对每个感知维度，筛选与人类判断一致的声学测量，将其映射为 A/Tie/B 概率，并作为非约束性提示与音频一并输入模型。随后用该监督信号训练 7B 评判器，比较 SFT、OPD 与 RL 三种训练信号的作用。

Result: 相对无提示的同一模型，维度级人类一致性提升 6.3 个百分点，与人类 Tie 率的偏差降低 10.4 个百分点。不同训练信号塑造不同评判行为：SFT 建立任务能力，OPD 迁移教师的维度级强弱项，RL 在人类评分者一致的明显对比上收益最大；人类听者认为 RL 使理由引用更具体、更局部的声学线索，尽管并未直接对理由文本施加奖励。该流程在英-日与英-西上均可实例化。

Conclusion: 结果表明，可从有限的人类偏好数据出发，构建具备维度诊断能力与可解释声学依据的语音评判器，且该流程与语言对无关。

Abstract: Human speech conveys rich perceptual information, such as emotion and speaker identity, yet most automatic speech quality judges reduce it to a single naturalness score. We study diagnostic speech judges: given two candidates, a diagnostic judge decides which is better, along which perceptual dimensions (e.g., timbre, emotion, timing) they differ, and which audible cues support its decision. Learning such judges is challenging: expert annotation is costly, and simply prompting a frontier audio-language model to produce labels is unreliable: our probing reveals substantial errors and unstable instruction following. We introduce SpeechCritic, which learns a diagnostic judge in a reference-conditioned cross-lingual setting from only about 300 human-labeled comparisons. Rather than replacing the frontier model, SpeechCritic calibrates it with these labels: for each dimension, it selects the acoustic measurements that agree with human judgments, maps them to A/Tie/B probabilities, and passes these to the model as non-binding hints alongside the audio. Compared with the same model labeling without hints, this raises dimension-level agreement with humans by 6.3 points and cuts the mismatch with human Tie rates by 10.4 points. We then train a 7B judge on this supervision and find that different training signals shape different judge behaviors: SFT establishes the task, OPD transfers the teacher's dimension-level strengths and weaknesses, and RL helps most on clear-cut comparisons where human raters agree. Notably, human listeners also find that RL makes rationales cite more specific, localized acoustic cues, although it never directly rewards rationale text. Finally, we show that the pipeline is language-pair agnostic by instantiating it on both English-Japanese and English-Spanish. Together, these results demonstrate a path from limited human preferences to a diagnostic speech judge.

</details>


### [1372] [From Human Narrative to Harmonic Structure: A Human-Centered Investigation of Algorithmic Music Generation through the Chord Wheel Diagram](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34735)
*Josef Pavlíček,Petra Pavlíčková,Irena Štrausová*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究以六首叙事驱动的流行歌曲为对象，将人类原创和声与可解释计算和声器的输出对比，发现高旋律—和弦兼容性并不等于保留人类原有的和声决策模式，并提出"叙事条件化和声结构"作为计算音乐分析的补充视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代AI音乐生成已能满足调性与音乐连贯性的形式要求，但音乐表达能否仅由数学性质描述仍是根本问题。人类作曲家的和声决策与偏离既定模式的行为受个人与文化语境影响，因此需要考察生成系统是否只追求"正确性"而忽略结构性身份与创作意图。

Method: 选取Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash、Ritchie Valens的六首叙事驱动流行歌曲，将人类原创和声与在相同旋律、且未接触原和弦进行的条件下运行的可解释计算和声器输出进行对比。分析和声词汇、功能持续性、重复、非自然音事件与张力—解决模式，并使用Chord Wheel Diagrams与基于BPMN的表示方法。

Result: 高旋律—和弦兼容性并不必然意味着保留原有人类和声决策模式。部分生成和声保留了参照的简约结构，另一些则改变了和声多样性或抑制了标志性事件，同时仍与旋律保持兼容。

Conclusion: 该研究并非量化艺术质量，而是引入"叙事条件化和声结构"作为计算音乐分析的补充视角。结果表明生成系统除建模和声正确性外，还应建模结构身份、语境与人类创作意图。

Abstract: Contemporary AI-based music generation can produce compositions that satisfy formal requirements of tonality and musical coherence. However, whether musical expression can be described by mathematical properties alone remains a fundamental question. Human composers operate within personal and cultural contexts that influence harmonic decisions and deliberate departures from established patterns. This study investigates six narrative-driven popular songs by Bob Dylan, Johnny Cash, and Ritchie Valens. Original human harmonies are compared with outputs of an explainable computational harmonizer operating on the same melodies without access to the original chord progressions. We examine harmonic vocabulary, functional persistence, repetition, non-diatonic events, and tension-resolution patterns using Chord Wheel Diagrams and BPMN-based representations. Results show that high melody-chord compatibility does not necessarily imply preservation of the original human harmonic decision pattern. Some generated harmonizations retain the economical structure of the reference, while others alter harmonic diversity or suppress distinctive events while remaining compatible with the melody. Rather than quantifying artistic quality, the study introduces narrative-conditioned harmonic structure as a complementary perspective for computational music analysis. The findings suggest that generative systems may benefit from modeling not only harmonic correctness, but also structural identity, context, and human compositional intention.

</details>


### [1373] [What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32002)
*Babak Barazandeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出，在硬性逐因子范数预算下，LoRA 的秩 r 并不控制模型容量：可达更新恰为核范数球内秩≤r 的矩阵，而所有分析的复杂度与位移泛函都在秩一更新处取最大，故秩上限从不生效。秩的真正作用是决定可达更新集合与抵消预训练主奇异方向的代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 的秩 r 通常被当作容量控制手段，认为越小越简单、泛化越好。作者希望检验这一直觉是否成立，并厘清秩在 LoRA 中究竟起什么作用。

Method: 在硬性逐因子范数预算（对实际权重衰减与范数控制的理想化）下分析可达更新集合；研究线性读出模型类的 Rademacher 复杂度、源分布位移上界；并对比联合预算（对乘积的整体预算）下的数据相关复杂度界；最后从谱角度界定抵消预训练权重主奇异方向所需的最小秩。

Result: 可达更新恰为核范数球内秩≤r 的矩阵，所有复杂度与位移泛函的最大值都由秩一更新取得，秩上限从不紧；线性读出模型类对任意 r≥1 完全相同，Rademacher 复杂度不依赖 r，分布位移有紧的秩无关上界；改用联合预算可恢复数据相关、对秩敏感的复杂度界，但仅对分布良好的特征有效，最坏情况仍秩无关；谱上，实现源-目标对齐需同时具备足够秩与预算，在双侧谱衰减下给出的最小秩上下界相匹配。

Conclusion: 秩并非控制 LoRA 的容量，而是决定哪些更新可达以及抵消预训练主导奇异方向的代价。这一重新表述将秩的角色从"容量旋钮"转为"可达性与代价参数"。

Abstract: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.

</details>


### [1374] [Retrospective Distillation Attribution via Normalized Response Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32749)
*Minwoo Jang,Jaechang Kim,Minhyeon Oh,Jeongyeon Hwang,Jungseul Ok*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCOUT，一种仅基于输出文本、无需模型权重与历史检查点的蒸馏溯源方法，通过聚合句法模式并校准距离，实现对蒸馏来源的识别与弃权判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型蒸馏通过商业API收集的教师响应进行SFT，引发模型来源（provenance）问题。现有蒸馏归因方法多在学生模型刚完成SFT时评估，但实际发布前模型还会经历进一步SFT、偏好优化或强化学习；且审计者往往无法获得参考式归因所需的蒸馏前检查点。因此需要一种仅依赖当前文本的溯源方法。

Method: SCOUT为output-only方法：聚合反复出现的句法模式（syntactic patterns）形成候选画像；过滤低对比度模式；并将学生—候选距离相对候选间距离进行校准。仅使用当前文本，不需模型权重、token似然或历史检查点，支持归因与弃权。

Result: 在覆盖多种后训练目标、公开发布的蒸馏模型后代上进行审计，SCOUT一致地识别出蒸馏来源；沿训练轨迹追踪教师相关句法特征，发现这些特征在蒸馏阶段出现，并在后续偏好优化与强化学习中得以保持。

Conclusion: SCOUT为缺乏检查点条件下的蒸馏溯源提供了可行方案，且教师句法签名可作为跨后训练阶段持续存在的稳定溯源证据。

Abstract: Model distillation transfers capabilities through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher responses, often collected from commercial APIs, raising questions of model provenance. Existing distillation attribution methods have been largely evaluated on students immediately after the SFT step. However, a distilled model may undergo further SFT, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning before release, while an auditor may lack access to the pre-distillation checkpoint required by reference-based attribution. To close this gap, we propose SCOUT, an output-only method that aggregates recurring *syntactic patterns* into candidate profiles, filters low-contrast patterns, and calibrates student--candidate distances against inter-candidate distances. SCOUT supports attribution and abstention using only current texts, without model weights, token likelihoods, or historical checkpoints. Auditing publicly released descendants of distilled models spanning diverse post-training objectives, SCOUT consistently identifies the distillation source. Furthermore, tracing teacher-associated *syntactic signatures* along training trajectories reveals that they emerge during distillation and persist through subsequent preference optimization and reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [1375] [CoeF-SFL: Preserving Collaborative Server-Client Learning with Enhanced Communication Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34360)
*Junwoo Bae,Jin-Hyun Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CoeF-SFL，一种无需辅助网络、保留端到端目标且每轮仅交换一次smash数据和梯度的通信高效SFL框架，通过对陈旧梯度进行曲率补偿提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原生SFL每批次交换数据与梯度通信开销大；现有借助客户端辅助网络降开销的方法使客户端优化目标偏离端到端目标，从根本上限制了协同训练。

Method: CoeF-SFL每轮仅交换一次smash数据与梯度并在本地训练中复用；因复用导致梯度陈旧，在激活空间做基于曲率的校正，给出两种变体：CoeF-D用对角梯度外积近似Hessian，CoeF-J利用上界替代损失的可解Jacobian型Hessian，并提供理论分析。

Result: 在视觉与语言任务、不同模型容量、切层和数据分布下，相同通信频率时CoeF-SFL显著优于基于辅助网络的方法，视觉任务提升尤为突出。

Conclusion: CoeF-SFL在不引入辅助网络的前提下兼顾通信效率与端到端优化目标，为SFL提供了一种更有效的通信压缩范式。

Abstract: Split Federated Learning (SFL) enables resource-constrained clients to participate in collaborative training, but vanilla SFL exchanges smashed data and gradients at every batch, which incurs significant communication overhead. Recent methods reduce this overhead with an auxiliary network at the client-side cut layer. However, we identify that this approach makes the client optimize a local objective that differs from the end-to-end objective, which fundamentally limits the collaborative training between the client and the server. We propose Compensated Feedback based SFL (CoeF-SFL), a communication-efficient framework that retains the end-to-end objective without any auxiliary network. In CoeF-SFL, the client and the server exchange the smashed data and the gradients once per round and reuse them during local training. Since this reuse makes the gradients stale on the client side, we compensate them with a curvature-based correction in the activation space and develop two variants. CoeF-D approximates the Hessian with a diagonal gradient outer product, while CoeF-J exploits the tractable Jacobian-based Hessian of a surrogate loss that upper-bounds the true loss. We provide the theoretical background of each method, characterizing its compensation. Across vision and language tasks, model capacities, cut layers, and data distributions, CoeF-SFL significantly outperforms auxiliary-network-based methods under the same communication frequency, and the improvement is most substantial on vision tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CoeF-SFL-2686/README.md

</details>


### [1376] [IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31871)
*Liang Ding,Zhiang Xu,Yuyang Sheng,Bin Chen,Songlin Bai,Run Zhu,Dingjun Wu,Hui Xu,Yandi Wang,Fulin Shi,Leilei Gan,Linlin Yu,Qihuang Zhong,Keqin Peng,Yalong Li,Chengfu Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出工业采购领域语言模型IndustryLLM，基于Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base，通过失败驱动的CPT+SFT适配流程与证据门控三值约束评估接口，在离线采购查询结构化与生产环境在线A/B实验中均获显著收益，模型权重已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业采购场景要求语言模型在严格安全容差下，弥合非正式买方行话、稀疏的商品属性描述与权威工程标准之间的鸿沟。通用文本规模扩展难以应对这一领域特有的术语不规范、事实脆弱与语域不匹配问题。

Method: 以Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base（35B总参数、每token约3B激活，视觉编码器冻结）为基座。采用失败驱动的适配方案：CPT使用约100B token语料（5B国家/行业标准如GB/T及技术档案、10B去标识化真实交易与询盘记录、60B通用回放）；并通过多语域改写（10种体裁、8种风格）、置信度路由的最小化事实编辑与错误定向QA合成，重构约20B token领域子集，解决口语化拼写（如"42-luo-mu"→42CrMo）、歧义编码扩展（如"16674"→GB/T 16674）与尺寸规格冲突。部署层形式化"证据门控约束评估接口"，采用三值逻辑，未验证的产品证据判为unknown而非satisfied。

Result: 离线评估在采购查询结构化任务上取得一致提升，No-Think模式下精确匹配+2.97个百分点（95% CI [2.11, 3.86]）；生产环境随机在线A/B实验显示GMV+4.25%、满意询盘+8.3%，延迟从6-7秒降至1.5秒。

Conclusion: 面向工业采购的领域适配与安全约束设计可显著提升语言模型的结构化理解与业务指标，同时大幅优化推理延迟；模型权重与配置已开源于Hugging Face。

Abstract: Industrial procurement requires language models to bridge informal buyer jargon, sparse marketplace attributes, and authoritative engineering standards under strict safety tolerances.
