Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective signal on delegation. We call this behavioral response Nudgeability and measure it along two dimensions: sensitivity, how strongly confidence and doubt change delegation rates, and targeting, whether delegation increases for problems the model cannot solve unaided and decreases for those it can.
  Across nine small-to-medium open-weight reasoning models from three families (Qwen, Gemma, and GLM) and two tasks, models are consistently sensitive: doubt increases delegation and confidence decreases it, with a median confidence-to-doubt swing of 20.6 percentage points, and 53 to 70 points for the larger provider-served models. This responsiveness is poorly targeted: a median 42% of induced flips are well-targeted, only a +2 percentage-point lift over a random-selection baseline. Confidence language is thus a strong control surface for delegation, but current models use it only weakly in accordance with their actual competence. Nudgeability offers a simple, post-training-free way to evaluate both sensitivity and targeting as endogenous self-reflection mechanisms mature.

</details>


### [1409] [After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34603)
*Yanfei Zhang,Xu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文实证检验"修复失败经验是否使其成为更好的可复用记忆"。通过将同一失败源任务（修复前/后）迁移到固定目标任务并与独立执行对比，3300次运行覆盖ThinkingBox与APEX各100对、十一种条件。结论：修复带来的收益主要来自更差的未修复基线，而非更好的修复后记忆；修复价值与复用价值相互独立，记忆更新需同时具备"旧版本参照"与"全新起点参照"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心动机是区分两个通常被混为一谈的问题：修复一段失败经验（repair）是否有价值，以及修复后的经验是否比未修复经验更适合被复用（reuse）。作者希望验证"被接受的修复即更优记忆"这一隐含假设是否成立。

Method: 采用受控迁移实验：把同一个失败源任务在"接受修复前"与"接受修复后"两种状态下分别迁移到固定目标任务，并设置独立执行（independence）作为对照；ThinkingBox按Full/Skill/Hybrid三种修复策略、APEX按两种机制，区分是否继承源状态（source-state inheritance），共十一种条件、3300次运行、各100对任务。辅以动作层面证据分析工作流收益、可复用义务与约定冲突。

Result: ThinkingBox的Full/Skill/Hybrid修正在准确率上分别提升44/29/32个百分点，修复后性能比独立执行高25/22/18个百分点；但推理能力在任务族层面减弱。Full相对Skill多出的15个百分点修正差距中，有12个百分点来自更差的未修复性能而非更好的修复后记忆；Full的46次向上跃迁中有22次只是恢复已观测到的基线成功。APEX两种机制均未显示可比的总体修正收益。文本APEX接受执行的52%高于其摘要的40%，但不具稳健的全局/组级优势，也未建立对独立执行的稳定优势。更小的交接减少输入但增加调用次数。

Conclusion: 修复经验的价值与复用经验的价值是两回事：修复后的经验并不必然成为更好的记忆。评估记忆更新必须同时引入"上一版本参照"和"全新起点参照"两个基准，否则会把基线劣势误判为记忆增益。

Abstract: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.

</details>


### [1410] [SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34736)
*Vasilis Perifanis,Nikolaos Pavlidis,Symeon Symeonidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SeLMRoute路由框架，将查询语义证据抽取与候选模型性能学习、部署目标应用解耦，在LLMRouterBench上取得优于最强固定候选和其他表示的平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由器多直接从查询嵌入、模型表示、偏好数据或相似样例聚类中学习决策，但所用表示很少显式说明查询究竟需要什么，缺乏可解释性与可迁移性。

Method: SeLMRoute分离三个环节：(1)决策模型对查询回答一组可解释问题（如推理需求、外部知识使用），每个判断保留为概率分布，形成与候选模型无关的概率语义状态；(2)轻量监督路由器基于该语义状态估计各候选模型性能；(3)在性能估计之后应用路由目标，使同一语义状态可支持性能导向与成本感知决策。

Result: 在LLMRouterBench（15个数据集、20个候选模型、11,481条查询）上，平均准确率72.08%±0.45，分组五折折外评估达72.64%，对比最强固定候选69.23%；在语义、稠密、词法、领域级表示中平均性能最高。另在13模型性能-成本设置下，五个分组划分均提升性能，平均PerfGain为2.66%。

Conclusion: 显式、候选无关的概率语义表示能有效支撑LLM路由，并在性能与成本目标间灵活复用，验证了解耦式路由设计的有效性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to select the most suitable model for each incoming query. Most existing routers learn this decision directly from query embeddings, model representations, preference data, or clusters of similar examples. Such approaches can be effective, yet the representation used for routing rarely states what a query actually requires. We introduce SeLMRoute, a routing framework that separates the extraction of candidate-independent semantic evidence from the learning of candidate performance and the application of deployment objectives. A decision model first evaluates a set of interpretable questions about the query, such as its reasoning requirements and use of external knowledge, with each judgment retained as a probability distribution. The resulting probabilistic semantic state is used by a lightweight supervised router to estimate candidate model performance. Routing objectives are applied after performance estimation, which allows the same semantic state to support performance-oriented and cost-aware decisions. On the LLMRouterBench (15 datasets, 20 candidate models, 11,481 queries), SeLMRoute achieves an average accuracy of $72.08\% \pm 0.45$, while grouped five-fold out-of-fold evaluation reaches $72.64\%$, compared with $69.23\%$ for the strongest fixed candidate. The representation achieves the highest mean performance among the evaluated semantic, dense, lexical, and domain-level representations. In a separate 13-model performance-cost setting, SeLMRoute improves performance in all five grouped splits, with a mean PerfGain of $2.66\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/SeLMRoute.

</details>


### [1411] [When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34771)
*Tianyi Guan,Jianhui Chen,Liangming Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过匹配评估比较了行为安全防护（DPO对齐、文本监控器）与表征工程方法（表征引导、表征探针）在安全控制与安全监控两方面的相对优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠AI防护需要控制机制（减少不安全行为）和监控机制（检测安全风险），但行为方法与表征工程方法通常在不同设置下评估，导致相对优势不明确，因此需要统一的匹配评估。

Method: 采用两条轨道的匹配评估：安全控制上，对比DPO与三种表征引导方法在鲁棒性、实用性、粒度上的表现；安全监控上，对比表征探针与微调及开放权重文本监控器在全响应检测、早期检测和计算成本上的表现；并测试监控引导干预的效果。

Result: 安全控制方面，DPO总体控制最强，随训练数据增加一般改善，但后续良性微调后安全性可能下降；表征引导主要在低数据场景（尤其高质量对比数据）具竞争力。安全监控方面，专用文本监控器检测准确率最高，表征探针在边际成本显著更低时仍具竞争力。监控引导干预可恢复DPO经良性微调后损失的大部分安全性，且额外过度拒答很少。

Conclusion: 表征工程通常不能取代行为安全防护，但在特定条件下具实用优势，并可提供互补的安全收益。

Abstract: Reliable AI safeguards require both control mechanisms that reduce unsafe behavior and monitoring mechanisms that detect safety risks during model interactions. Established behavioral safeguards include alignment methods that optimize model outputs and text monitors that assess interaction text. Representation engineering instead reads or modifies internal model states, but the relative strengths of these approaches remain unclear because they are often evaluated under different settings. We present a matched evaluation across two tracks. For safety control, we compare DPO, a behavioral alignment method, with three representation steering methods across robustness, practicality, and granularity. DPO provides the strongest overall control and generally improves with increasing training data, although its safety can degrade after subsequent benign fine-tuning. Representation steering remains competitive primarily in low-data settings, particularly with high-quality contrastive data. For safety monitoring, we compare representation probes with fine-tuned and open-weight text monitors across full-response detection, early detection, and computational cost. Specialized text monitors achieve the strongest overall detection accuracy, while representation probes remain competitive at substantially lower marginal cost. Finally, monitor-guided interventions recover much of the safety lost by DPO after benign fine-tuning, with little additional over-refusal. Overall, representation engineering does not generally replace behavioral safeguards, but offers practical advantages under specific conditions and can provide complementary safety benefits.

</details>


### [1412] [BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34832)
*Suyoung Kim,Jahyun Koo,Hyeonjin Kim,Inhyeok Bang,Seunghyun Lee,Hyunjae Oh,Baeseong Park,Dongsoo Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Block Verification-aware loss（BV loss），一种面向块验证机制的扩散 drafter 训练目标，直接最大化起草序列的期望接受长度，从而在推理流程不变的前提下提升推测解码的接受 token 数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推测解码虽已发展到序列级起草与验证，但训练目标仍主要围绕 token 级验证设计，导致 drafter 训练目标与推理时的块（序列）级验证机制存在不匹配。

Method: BV loss 直接由块验证接受规则推导得到，将 drafter 的训练目标与序列级验证机制建立原则性联系，用于训练块扩散 drafter（如 DFlash、DSpark），无需改动推理流程。

Result: 在数学、代码与对话基准上，基于 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，BV loss 相比交叉熵训练将块验证下每次验证调用的平均接受 token 数提升 13.0–21.0%；同时优于 TV loss、LK loss 等 token 级接受目标，且增益可扩展至 token 验证与贪心解码。

Conclusion: 以序列级验证对齐的目标训练块扩散 drafter，比逐 token 独立优化更有效，验证了训练目标与验证机制一致性的重要性。

Abstract: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by proposing multiple tokens in parallel. Despite recent advances in speculative decoding through sequence-level drafting and verification, existing training objectives remain largely designed around token-level verification. To address this mismatch, we introduce Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss), a training objective designed to maximize the expected acceptance length of a drafted sequence. BV loss is directly derived from the block verification acceptance rule, providing a principled connection between the drafter training objective and the inference-time verification mechanism at the sequence level. Across math, code, and chat benchmarks, BV loss increases the mean number of tokens accepted per verification call under block verification by 13.0--21.0\% over cross-entropy loss training for DFlash and DSpark with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B without changing the inference procedure. BV loss also outperforms tokenwise acceptance objectives such as TV loss and LK loss, and its gains extend to token verification and greedy decoding. These results demonstrate the benefit of training block diffusion drafters with an objective aligned with sequence-level verification, rather than optimizing each token independently.

</details>


### [1413] [One Readout, Many Repairs: Diffusion-Guided Hierarchical Search for Tool-Agent Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34879)
*Xiang Xia,Cheng Yan,Fan Xu,Zhijun Fan,Shuyuan Zhang,Wuyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将工具代理修复建模为对"操作支持集"的层次化搜索，提出免训练、扩散引导的 ReCommit 框架，通过复用掩码扩散语言模型单次并行读出的操作类型分数，在减少重复计算的同时保留对操作与实现方式的探索，在企业基准上实现更高的恢复率与更低的修复耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具代理虽能成功执行调用，但用户请求仍可能未被满足，因此需要修复：找到既执行成功又能完成原始请求的替代调用序列。完整序列再生成成本高，且当失败仅源于操作的具体实现方式时，再生成仍会重复操作选择过程，造成浪费。核心挑战是在减少这种重复的同时，仍能探索替代的操作及其实现。

Method: 将修复形式化为对"操作支持集"（一组允许的操作类型，定义可复用的搜索区域）的层次化搜索。提出免训练、扩散引导的 ReCommit 框架：通过对掩码扩散语言模型进行一次并行读出，获得操作类型分数，并在多次修复尝试间摊销操作级提议计算；这些分数用于引导支持集上的搜索，实现搜索则在每个支持集内探索实体绑定、参数与动作组合的替代方案。

Result: 在 Agent-Diff 基准的四个企业服务真实失败上，相对最强 8B 对比方法，修复预算 B=3 和 B=13 时分别取得 75.9% 与 63.2% 的相对恢复增益，平均全预算修复时间分别降低 61.3% 与 51.3%；与所评估的 32B 模型相比也表现出更优的恢复—成本权衡。

Conclusion: ReCommit 通过层次化搜索与操作分数复用，在减少修复重复计算的同时保持探索能力，实现了良好的恢复率—成本权衡，适用于工具代理的故障恢复。

Abstract: Tool agents use large language models to act through external tools, yet successfully executed calls can still leave user requests unfulfilled. Tool-agent repair seeks alternative call sequences that execute successfully and fulfill the original requests. However, repair requires exploring both operation choices and their concrete realizations, making complete-sequence regeneration costly. Moreover, regeneration repeats operation selection even when failure arises from how those operations are realized. The resulting challenge is to reduce this repetition while preserving exploration of alternative operations and realizations. Therefore, we formulate repair as hierarchical search over operation supports, which we introduce as sets of permitted operation types that define reusable search regions for concrete tool-call sequences. We propose ReCommit, a training-free, diffusion-guided framework for improving tool-agent failure recovery while reducing repair computation. ReCommit amortizes operation-level proposal computation across repair trials by reusing operation-type scores from a single parallel readout of a masked diffusion language model. These scores guide search across supports, while realization search explores alternative entity bindings, arguments, and action composition within each support. Experiments on real failures across four enterprise services in the Agent-Diff benchmark show 75.9\% and 63.2\% relative recovery gains with 61.3\% and 51.3\% reductions in mean full-budget repair time at repair budgets $B=3$ and $B=13$, respectively, over the strongest evaluated 8B comparison method. ReCommit achieves a favorable recovery--cost trade-off, including in comparisons with the evaluated 32B models.

</details>


### [1414] [WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35026)
*Anton Emelyanov,Maria Tikhonova,Zaven Martirosian,Sergei Averkiev,Alena Fenogenova*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 WebPageBench，一个基于接口事件日志验证 Web Agent 任务成功与否的开放评测框架，包含 152 个任务、通用 runner 与公开排行榜，并揭示 agent 自报完成率与日志确认成功率之间最高达 41 分的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Web Agent 评测通常依赖模型裁判或对渲染页面进行抓取来判断任务是否完成，判定标准不稳定且难以精确复现；同时，任务对界面形式（如控件实现方式、浅色/深色模式）的敏感度缺乏在任务规格固定条件下的可测量手段。

Method: 每个任务由接口自身的事件日志验证：六个去除品牌标识的插桩模拟站点（市场、书店、生鲜服务、铁路售票、酒店搜索、文档柜）在用户或 agent 操作时发出带参数的强类型事件；任务声明所需事件，成功由事件匹配决定，不使用裁判模型，也不抓取渲染页面。同一套插桩支持受控 UI 变体：一个配置开关可在提示与成功条件完全不变的前提下，用单一控件的不同实现重新渲染任务，从而在固定任务规格下测量对界面形式的敏感度。

Result: WebPageBench 发布包含三部分：152 个任务（65 个规范场景 + 87 个浅色/深色 UI 模式下的控件变体）；一个在 6 种浏览器/DOM harness 配置与 5 类仅截图 GUI-agent 家族上评估的通用 runner；以及 24 组模型-harness 配对的公开排行榜。在公开 152 任务排行榜上，agent 宣称完成与日志确认之间的差距达 41 分，其中一个配置宣称所有任务均完成，而实际满足条件的仅占 59%。

Conclusion: 事件日志驱动的验证可提供无裁判、无页面抓取的确定性成功判定，并支持在固定任务规格下开展受控界面变体实验；公开结果说明 agent 的自我完成报告显著高估真实成功率，WebPageBench 为 Web Agent 的可复现评测与界面敏感性分析提供了统一基准与排行榜。

Abstract: We present WebPageBench, an open framework for evaluating web agents in which every task is verified from the interface's own event log. Six instrumented mock sites with brand identifiers removed (a marketplace, a bookstore, a grocery service, rail ticketing, hotel search and a document cabinet) emit typed events with parameters as a user or an agent acts. A task declares the events it requires, and success is decided by matching them, with no judge model and no scraping of rendered pages. The same instrumentation supports controlled UI variation: one configuration switch re-renders a task through a different implementation of a single control while the prompt and the success conditions stay completely identical, so sensitivity to interface form can be measured under a fixed task specification. The WebPageBench release consists of three components: 152 tasks, divided into 65 canonical scenarios and 87 control variants across light/dark UI-modes; a common runner evaluated with six browser/DOM harness configurations and five screenshot-only GUI-agent families; and a public leaderboard of 24 model-harness pairs. On the public 152-task leaderboard the gap between what agents declare finished and what the log confirms reaches 41 points (one configuration declares every task finished and satisfies the conditions on 59%).

</details>


### [1415] [EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35290)
*Shihan Dou,Shaofan Liu,Zhonghang Lu,Jiahang Lin,Shichun Liu,Binghai Wang,Jiajie Jin,Guanting Dong,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoIn框架，通过"进化-内化"桥接，将进化得到的决策流程注入模型自身推理能力，实现无需进化harness的持久改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作通过联合进化harness与模型来提升agent，但采用"大杂烩"方式，将新工具、新决策流程与模型适配混为一谈。本文聚焦于如何让agent改进其决策流程这一单一维度。

Method: EvoIn分三步：1) 分析agent执行轨迹，进化并验证新决策流程（临时在harness中实例化）；2) 用验证后的流程引导agent生成改进的推理轨迹；3) 将轨迹改写为自包含形式，去掉对harness指令的显式引用，把诱导出的决策逻辑表达为模型自身推理，最后在改写轨迹上微调模型以完成内化。

Result: 在多个基准上一致提升agent决策能力，域内通过率提升10.9分，域外提升9.2分；内化的决策流程可泛化到未见任务；案例显示agent能"先决定如何解题再解题"（如根据文档长度选择全文阅读或搜索）；在另一模型族上同样有一致改进。

Conclusion: EvoIn将进化与内化有效桥接，使改进的决策流程固化于模型内部，推理时无需进化harness即可保持性能，且具备良好的泛化性与跨模型适用性。

Abstract: Recent work has explored improving agents by jointly evolving their harnesses and models, but often takes a ''potpourri'' approach that bundles together new tools, new decision-making procedures, and model adaptation to the evolved harness under a single notion of agent improvement. In this paper, we instead investigate how agents can improve their decision-making procedures. In particular, we propose EvoIn, an agent fine-tuning framework that bridges evolution and internalization. EvoIn first analyzes agent execution traces to evolve and validate new decision-making procedures by temporarily instantiating them in the harness. The validated procedures guide the agent to generate improved reasoning traces. These traces are then rewritten into self-contained reasoning traces, removing explicit references to harness instructions while expressing the induced decision logic as the model's own reasoning. Finally, EvoIn fine-tunes the model on the rewritten traces, internalizing these procedures so that the improved decision-making persists without the evolved harness at inference time. We evaluate EvoIn on diverse benchmarks and find that it consistently enables agents to learn stronger decision-making procedures, raising the pass rate by 10.9 points in-domain and by 9.2 points out-of-domain. Results further show that the internalized decision procedures generalize to unseen tasks. Case studies show that agents can learn to decide how to solve a task before solving it, for example by checking a document's length to choose between reading it in full and searching it. EvoIn is also broadly applicable, showing consistent improvements on another model family.

</details>


### [1416] [Jailbreaks for Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35350)
*Lucas Biechy,Cédric Eichler,Adrien Boiret,Nicolas Anciaux*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对大推理模型（LRMs）在强化学习对齐后普遍出现的系统性过度自信问题，研究黑盒不确定性量化（UQ）。作者提出提示级松弛算子，从理论上证明其可改善校准，并据此设计了基于越狱的 UQ 技术 J4U。在 3 个数据集、4 个 LRMs（含闭源生产模型）上，J4U 显著优于最强的黑盒 UQ 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型经强化学习对齐后往往产生系统性过度自信；在生产环境中 logits 可能不可用，因此需要稳健的黑盒不确定性量化来保障可信性与安全性。而现有的黑盒方法（如基于改写的自一致性和置信度口头表述）相比简单重复采样几乎没有提升，说明对齐抑制了有用的输出多样性。

Method: 提出提示级松弛算子（prompt-level relaxation operators），通过近似使用更强 KL 正则化参数所得最优策略的效果（即更接近参考模型）来拓宽模型的有效输出分布；理论上证明松弛能改善校准；并据此提出 Jailbreak for Uncertainty（J4U），一种由越狱衍生出的 UQ 技术，可在经验上复现松弛理论所预测的行为特征。

Result: 在 3 个数据集和 4 个 LRMs（包括一个闭源生产模型）上，J4U 相对重复采样的提升在达到统计显著的 LRM-数据集-指标设置数量上，最多是最强黑盒 UQ SOTA 基线的 6 倍，平均 ECE 降幅最高达其 5 倍。

Conclusion: 该工作为黑盒 LRM 部署中的不确定性量化提供了实用工具，表明通过提示级松弛（以 J4U 实现）可有效缓解对齐导致的过度自信并改善校准。

Abstract: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning, alignment through reinforcement learning often induces systemic overconfidence. In production environments, where logits may be unavailable, robust black-box uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for trustworthiness and safety. Focusing on question-answering for LRMs, we show that existing black-box methods, such as paraphrase-based self-consistency and confidence verbalization, offer little to no improvement over simple repeated sampling, suggesting that alignment suppresses useful output variability. We introduce prompt-level relaxation operators that broaden the model's effective output distribution by approximating the effect of an optimal policy obtained with a stronger KL-regularization parameter, hence closer to the reference model. Theoretically, we demonstrate that relaxation improves calibration. We propose Jailbreak for Uncertainty (J4U), a jailbreak-derived technique for UQ that empirically reproduces the behavioral signatures predicted by our relaxation theory. Across 3 datasets and 4 LRMs, including a closed-source production model, J4U's improvement over repeated sampling achieves statistical significance in up to 6 times more LRM-dataset-metric settings than the strongest black-box UQ state-of-the-art baseline we evaluate, with average ECE reductions up to 5 times larger. These results provide a practical tool for UQ in black-box LRM deployment.

</details>


### [1417] [Self-Adapting Group of Experts for Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35412)
*Mohammad Atif Quamar,Nurbek Tastan,Karthik Nandakumar,Junpei Komiyama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架SAGE，通过答案一致性、前缀一致性与互评选择"策略供体"，将其推理策略迁移给其他智能体，并用动态稀疏DAG进行信息路由，在多骨干与推理基准上取得更高平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体框架通常只改变输入上下文来调整协作，而各智能体的系统提示（推理策略）保持固定，难以适应需要不同技能的问题。作者研究智能体的初始回答是否能识别出更适合当前问题的策略，并将其迁移给其他智能体。

Method: 提出SAGE（Self-Adapting Group of Experts），免训练框架：利用答案一致性（answer agreement）、前缀一致性（prefix consistency）与互评（reciprocal peer review）选出策略供体（strategy donor）；仅使用各智能体原始系统提示完成策略迁移，不访问问题或已生成解答，同时保留原有角色；策略适配后，智能体通过动态稀疏有向无环图（DAG）交换回答，将信息从高分智能体路由至低分智能体。

Result: 在多种智能体骨干模型与多个推理基准上，SAGE的平均准确率优于所评估的基线方法。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 智能体的初始回答可用于识别更适配当前问题的推理策略，并可跨智能体迁移；结合动态稀疏DAG路由，无需训练即可提升多智能体系统的整体推理性能。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems bring together language model agents with different roles to propose, review, and refine solutions. Each agent's response depends on its model's capabilities, the reasoning strategy defined by its system prompt, and the information in its input context. Existing frameworks often adapt communication by changing this context while leaving individual prompts fixed, even when a problem calls for different skills. We study whether agents' initial responses can identify a strategy better suited to the current problem and guide its transfer to other agents. To address this, we introduce SAGE (Self-Adapting Group of Experts), a training-free framework that uses answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review to select a strategy donor. SAGE transfers the selected donor's reasoning strategy to the other agents while preserving their original roles. This transfer uses only the agents' original system prompts, without access to the problem or generated solutions. After strategy adaptation, agents exchange responses through a dynamic, sparse directed acyclic graph that routes information from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. Experiments across multiple agent backbones and reasoning benchmarks show that SAGE achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/atifquamar07/sage.

</details>


### [1418] [Representation Alignment as a Bottleneck in LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35571)
*Hyunwoo Yoo,Cassie Huang,Haebin Shin,Li Zhang,Gail L. Rosen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出LLM在化学符号规划中表现受限，提出将逆合成任务分解为分子映射、反应映射与PDDL生成三步中间抽象，实验证明分解式流程在端到端方法失败之处成功率高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在通用推理上有潜力，但在化学符号规划中仍是瓶颈。直接"SMILES-to-PDDL"方法要求模型同时处理化学分析与规划语言结构化，易失败。作者推测该失败源于缺少中间抽象，而非模型能力不足。

Method: 将逆合成规划分解为三个阶段：分子映射（molecule mapping）、反应映射（reaction mapping）与PDDL生成，并据此开展结构化分析，比较分解式流程与端到端方法的成功率。

Result: 在端到端方法失败的任务上，分解式流程实现了较高的成功率；结构分析表明中间表示在逆合成规划中不可或缺。

Conclusion: 化学规划的主要瓶颈在于表示对齐（representation alignment）而非原始模型容量，未来系统应重视以表示为中心的设计。

Abstract: While LLMs show promise in general reasoning, symbolic planning in chemistry remains a bottleneck. Direct ''SMILES-to-PDDL'' attempts fail because they force models to juggle chemical analysis and planning-language structuring simultaneously. We hypothesize that this failure stems from a lack of intermediate abstractions rather than insufficient model capacity. By decomposing retrosynthesis into molecule mapping, reaction mapping, and PDDL generation, we achieve high success rates where end-to-end approaches fail. This provides evidence that a primary bottleneck lies in representation alignment rather than raw model capacity. Our structural analysis demonstrates that intermediate representations are essential in retrosynthesis planning, highlighting the importance of representation-centric design in future systems.

</details>


### [1419] [Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35576)
*Sidharth Pulipaka,Ansh Sharma,Stanislau Hlebik,Leonidas Raghav,Vyas Raina,Ivaxi Sheth,Mario Fritz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出并研究"制品介导传播"（artifact-mediated propagation）这一新兴失效模式：攻击者通过共享制品将对抗内容写入助手持久记忆，随助手新生成制品被下游助手读取而自我复制扩散，实验显示攻击可跨多个独立助手传播，在大规模模拟环境中覆盖60-80%的智能体、传播链达八跳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型正被部署为有状态助手，能跨交互保留信息并借助工具读写、创建持久化制品。这些制品在用户之间共享，构成独立助手之间的间接通信通道，可能被滥用于自传播攻击。作者希望揭示该通道被忽视的安全风险，即持久化制品可成为对抗状态的长期载体，使攻击超越单次交互、跨越相互隔离的助手扩散。

Method: 提出"制品介导传播"（artifact-mediated propagation）的攻击范式：对抗内容经制品（如报告）引入→被存入助手持久记忆→在随后创建的制品中复现→被后续读取该制品的另一助手获取，形成自我延续链条。构建"时间性人-智能体宇宙"（temporal human-agent universes）模拟独立运营助手之间随时间的制品交换，量化攻击在连续交接中的存活性、跳数（hops）与传播广度；并在更大规模模拟环境中（含 GPT-5.6 Luna）进行验证。

Result: 攻击可跨多个相互独立的助手传播，并在长交互序列中持续存在。在更大规模模拟环境中，即使 GPT-5.6 Luna 也表现出显著扩散，波及60-80%的智能体，传播链最长延伸至八跳。

Conclusion: 持久化制品可作为对抗性状态的耐久载体，使攻击行为超越单次交互生命周期，并在彼此隔离的助手之间扩散。这表明当前有状态、工具增强的助手架构存在系统性安全漏洞，亟需针对制品共享通道的传播检测与防御机制。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as stateful assistants that retain information across interactions and use tools to read, modify, and create persistent artifacts. As these artifacts are shared between users, they form an indirect communication channel between otherwise independent assistants. We study a failure mode in which this channel enables self-propagating attacks. We introduce artifact-mediated propagation, where adversarial content introduced through an artifact (e.g. a report), is stored in an assistant's persistent memory, reproduced in a subsequently created artifact, and acquired by another assistant that later reads it. We evaluate this process in temporal human-agent universes that model artifact exchange between independently operated assistants over time, measuring whether an attack survives successive hand-offs, how many hops it reaches, and how broadly it spreads. We find that attacks can propagate across multiple independent assistants and persist over extended interaction sequences. In larger simulated environments, even GPT-5.6 Luna exhibits substantial spread, reaching 60-80% of agents with propagation chains extending to eight hops. These results show that persistent artifacts can act as durable carriers of adversarial state, allowing attacks to outlive individual interactions and spread across isolated assistants.

</details>


### [1420] [TCSAlgBench: Benchmarking Automated Proving for Research-Level Theoretical Computer Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35606)
*Chutong Yang,Xiyuan Zhang,Yu Huang,Boran Han,Soonho Kong,Shuai Zhang,Vihang Prakash Patil,Zhen Han,Michael Bohlke-Schneider,Bernie Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 TCSAlgBench，一个可复用的自然语言数学证明发现基准与流程，收录 138 篇 STOC/COLT 2026 论文中的 398 个定理级挑战，用于评估大模型在研究级理论计算机科学推理中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在竞赛数学上表现优异，但在研究级推理上缺乏系统性评估手段。理论计算机科学（TCS）将算法设计与显式保证和根本极限相连接，其证明可被人类检验是否真正论证了计算改进，因此适合作为评估场景。

Method: 构建 TCSAlgBench：由专家设计规则补全论文特定上下文，保留计算假设与定量保证；当"发现算法"本身属于任务时，隐匿相关构造。每项任务向证明系统提供定理陈述及被引前置工作。流程支持从新发布论文生成带版本号的新批次挑战。评估方面：对来自 4 个家族的 10 种模型配置，在直接推理与"证明者-验证者"讨论两种模式下比较；另在匹配模型调用机会条件下比较 4 种智能体工作流。所有评估均使用完整基准。

Result: 模型对比中，GPT-5.6 Sol max 经 10 轮讨论后取得最高五轮验证者接受覆盖率 23.6%；讨论与重复采样可提升覆盖率。在采用 GPT-5.5 xhigh 的独立智能体对比中，任务分解优于讨论，且智能体规划取得最高五轮验证者接受覆盖率 25.4%。

Conclusion: TCSAlgBench 提供了一个可刷新的测试平台，用于衡量模型推理进展，并研究智能体工作流如何支持研究级证明发现。

Abstract: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.

</details>


### [1421] [Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35706)
*Priyanka Kargupta,Silviu Cucerzan,Shweti Mahajan,Allen Herring,Jiawei Han,Ryen W. White,Sujay Kumar Jauhar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AI Night-Scientist智能体框架，用强化学习（GRPO）沿着动作、过程、结果三个认知轴训练模型，使LLM突破低熵偏置，生成更多样、原创且有用的科学构想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在结构化、可验证任务上表现优异，但其低熵偏置导致输出同质化、可预测，限制了在开放式科学构想中的价值。而有效的科学发现需要从结构化"日科学"到松散、偶发的"夜科学"的完整创造谱系，现有模型难以覆盖这一谱系中超出常规的构想。

Method: 提出AI Night-Scientist智能体框架，以认知科学为基础，将创造力沿三个轴建模：动作（做什么及多大创造性）、过程（何时探索vs利用）、结果（构想的novelty与usefulness）。基于这三轴用GRPO训练模型，在训练中让模型接触不同程度和形式的创造力，并通过语义引导指定应追求的创造力类型。

Result: 相较基座模型，研究方向的多样性范围扩大27.8%，贡献类型增加14.9%；预测引用影响提升最高32.0个百分点，原创性提升66.2点。这些提升无法仅通过提高解码温度复现，语义引导（指定追求何种创造力）是关键。

Conclusion: 创造力是一种可学习的多层次能力，可以被塑造以帮助研究者触及超出LLM常规探索范围的构想，而非仅靠采样随机性获得。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured, verifiable tasks, but their low-entropy bias can produce homogeneous and predictable outputs, limiting their utility for open-ended scientific ideation. Effective discovery, however, spans a broader creative spectrum: from structured day science to loosely structured, serendipitous night science that reaches ideas beyond those typically considered. We introduce AI Night-Scientist, an agentic framework that uses reinforcement learning to teach models when and how to depart from predictable reasoning. Grounded in cognitive science, we model creativity along three axes: action (what to do and how creatively), process (when to explore versus exploit), and outcome (the novelty and usefulness of the resulting idea). We use these axes to train models with GRPO, exposing them to varying degrees and forms of creativity throughout training. This produces substantially more diverse scientific proposals, expanding the range of research directions by 27.8% and contribution types by 14.9% over the base model. It also improves predicted citation impact by up to 32.0 percentage points and originality by 66.2 points. These gains cannot be reproduced by simply increasing decoding temperature; instead, we find that semantic guidance specifying what kind of creativity to pursue is critical. Overall, our results suggest that creativity is a learnable, multi-level ability that can be shaped to help researchers reach ideas beyond those typically explored by LLMs.

</details>


### [1422] [Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35741)
*Jonathan Light,Christopher Zhang Cui,Jeonghye Kim,Roger Creus Castanyer,Emiliano Penaloza,Zhengyan Shi,Alessandro Sordoni,Marc-Alexandre Côté,Xingdi Yuan,Minseon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT)，一种仅用语言模型自生成回顾性解释进行微调的最小化在线流程，在软件工程任务上验证了"仅训练解释即可改进后续行为"的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类不仅通过重复成功动作学习，还通过叙述和解释自身经验、修正理解来指导未来行为。作者希望探究语言模型智能体是否也能仅通过对自身经验解释的训练来提升未来行动能力，即能否隔离并验证"解释到行动"的迁移效应。

Method: 设计 ROFT 流程：智能体尝试任务、观察反馈、生成回顾性解释，仅对解释 token 使用下一 token 预测损失进行微调。该流程不使用外部教师，也不使用基于奖励的策略更新。实验使用 Qwen3.5-4B，在成功与失败尝试混合的软件工程问题上训练，并在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Pro 上评估。

Result: 在 held-out SWE-bench Verified 与 Pro 上，经 20 次更新的 ROFT 在无验证器条件下分别达到 49.2% 和 26.8% 解决率；对比 GRPO 经 40 次更新为 48.0% 和 25.3%。ROFT 在训练时间与采样尝试数上早期进展更快，并能学会解决全部 64 次基座模型采样均失败的任务，表明无需初始成功轨迹也能开始学习。

Conclusion: 行为分析表明，ROFT 间接实现了对动作的信用分配，鼓励正确动作、抑制错误动作；提示回顾强调更直接的解法还能在无显式长度惩罚下缩短后续尝试。研究说明"学会解释"也能促进"学会行动"，确立了自生成回顾作为有用训练目标，并推动对解释到行动迁移的进一步研究。

Abstract: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, generates a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with a next-token prediction loss on the explanation tokens alone. The procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained on problems with mixed successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts. On held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro, it reaches 49.2% and 26.8% solve rates after 20 updates without using a verifier, compared with GRPO's 48.0% and 25.3% after 40 updates in the evaluated runs, and makes faster early progress in training time and sampled attempts. It also learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, showing that learning can begin without any initially successful trajectories. Behavioral analyses find that ROFT indirectly assigns credit to actions, encouraging good actions and discouraging incorrect ones. Moreover, prompting retrospections to emphasize more direct solutions yields shorter subsequent attempts even without an explicit length penalty. Together, these findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do, establishing self-generated retrospections as useful training targets and motivating further study of explanation-to-action transfer.

</details>


### [1423] [ConflictVLA-Bench: Benchmarking Behavioral Responses of Vision-Language-Action Models to Premise Conflicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31792)
*Liyu Hou,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究VLA模型在无效任务前提下的行为响应，提出"失败性坚持"（Failed Persistence）现象，并构建ConflictVLA-Bench基准，发现仅凭终端任务失败无法区分行为脱离与持续执行后出错。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在操作任务上表现优异，但其对无效任务前提的响应尚缺乏研究。现有评估多关注终端任务结果，而任务失败本身无法区分"行为脱离"与"继续追求目标后执行出错"这两种本质不同的行为模式。

Method: 提出ConflictVLA-Bench基准，基于LIBERO构建，包含2,826个提示条件化冲突任务，覆盖四个冲突族、四种结构配置与两种提示条件。将冲突rollout与前提一致的参考rollout配对，同时评估结果与执行过程，并测试显式前提检查的效果。

Result: 在全部八种VLA模型上，无效前提使原始目标完成率至少下降17.3个百分点，OpenVLA下降达56.2个百分点。即使模型在一致任务上成功、在匹配冲突任务上失败，它们仍常继续接近原始目标、保留早期轨迹结构、动作幅度抑制有限，"失败性坚持"普遍存在。显式前提检查未能产生一致的选择性与协调性行为改变。

Conclusion: 仅凭终端失败既无法断定行为脱离，也无法断定拒绝行为，单一结果指标不足以评估VLA模型。基准与实验数据已公开。

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform strongly on manipulation tasks, their responses to invalid task premises remain underexplored. Existing evaluations of premise conflicts often focus on terminal task outcomes, yet task failure alone cannot distinguish behavioral disengagement from continued pursuit followed by an execution error. We call the latter pattern Failed Persistence. To study this phenomenon, we introduce ConflictVLA-Bench, which pairs conflict rollouts with premise-consistent reference rollouts and evaluates both outcomes and execution processes. Built on LIBERO, the benchmark contains 2,826 prompt-conditioned conflict tasks spanning four conflict families, four structural configurations, and two prompt conditions. Across all eight VLAs, invalid premises reduce original goal completion by at least 17.3 percentage points, with the reduction reaching 56.2 percentage points for OpenVLA. Crucially, even when models succeed on premise-consistent tasks and fail on their matched conflict tasks, they often continue to approach the original targets, retain early trajectory structure, and show limited action magnitude suppression. Failed Persistence therefore recurs across the evaluated models. Explicit premise checking does not consistently produce selective and coordinated behavioral changes. These findings show that terminal failure alone establishes neither behavioral disengagement nor refusal and that outcomes alone are insufficient for VLA evaluation. Experimental data and additional details are available on the project page: https://github.com/EmbodiedAISurvey/ConflictVLA-Bench

</details>


### [1424] [Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31868)
*Royson Lee,Fady Rezk,Titouan Parcollet,Timothy Hospedales,Cristina Cornelio*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Metro-WM通过检索真实观测状态（图顶点）而非生成无约束潜变量来给出子目标，缓解JEPA短视界问题，长程成功率最高提升37.33个百分点，速度快10.9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于JEPA的模型预测控制具备零样本目标到达能力，但仅适用于短规划视界；现有分层方法用宏规划器预测潜空间中间子目标，然而这种无约束的潜子目标预测存在根本缺陷——评估发现领先的宏规划器常输出物理不可实现的子目标。

Method: 提出Metro-WM分层框架：以离线专家演示或随机动作轨迹中的观测帧为图顶点构建图，跨回合连接帧并拼接成通往目标的路线，从而检索真实状态作为子目标；全程在图上规划，使系统对执行误差鲁棒，微规划器偏离时可即时从当前状态重新寻优路径。

Result: 长程任务成功率较次优分层方法最高提升37.33个百分点，速度快至10.9倍，离线计算量减少13–56倍，且需调超参数更少；额外分析表明其路径比离线演示更短，性能优于依赖查询自身演示的oracle，并在极度稀疏数据条件下保持稳健。

Conclusion: 无约束潜子目标预测在原理上不可靠，应以经验检索的真实状态子目标替代；Metro-WM在成功率、效率、鲁棒性与数据稀疏适应性上全面优于现有分层方案。

Abstract: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner. In this work, we demonstrate that unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction is fundamentally flawed. A rigorous evaluation reveals that a leading state-of-the-art macro planner routinely emits physically unrealisable sub-goals. To resolve this, we introduce Metro-WM, a hierarchical framework that issues sub-goals by retrieving genuine states from prior experience rather than generating ungrounded latent vectors. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the next best hierarchical approach while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. Additional analysis reveals that Metro-WM finds shorter paths than the offline demonstrations, outperforms an oracle relying on the query's own demonstration, and maintains robust performance under extremely sparse dataset conditions.

</details>


### [1425] [Are Vision-Language-Action Models Robust to One-Step Observation Perturbations?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32550)
*Shojiro Yamabe,Jun Sakuma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究单步观测扰动对VLA模型的安全性威胁，提出CARE根据动作块一致性动态选择执行长度以提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在物理世界部署需理解其安全风险；现有安全研究主要关注持续施加于整个回合观测的持续性扰动，而回合内短暂、严重的瞬时观测污染（momentary observation corruption）这一安全威胁尚未被充分探索。

Method: 研究每回合在单个时间步施加的单步扰动（one-step perturbations）下的鲁棒性；实验发现该扰动显著降低VLA性能，且影响程度取决于动作块执行长度（action chunk execution length）。据此提出CARE，基于与先前预测动作块的一致性动态选择执行长度。

Result: 单步扰动会大幅削弱VLA性能，其影响受执行长度影响；CARE在扰动下通过选择更短的执行长度提升鲁棒性，计算开销低，同时保持干净条件下的性能。

Conclusion: CARE以低计算开销提升VLA对瞬时观测扰动的鲁棒性，并在无扰动时保持原有性能，为VLA物理部署安全性提供了一种有效策略。

Abstract: Understanding the safety risks of vision-language-action (VLA) models is essential for their deployment in the physical world. Existing safety research has mainly considered persistent perturbations that are applied continuously to observations throughout an episode. However, momentary observation corruption, in which observations are severely perturbed only briefly within an episode, remains an underexplored safety threat. To address this gap, this work investigates robustness to one-step perturbations applied at a single time step per episode. Our experiments reveal that these perturbations substantially degrade VLA performance and that their impact depends on the action chunk execution length. Based on them, we propose CARE, which dynamically selects the execution length based on consistency with the previously predicted action chunk. CARE improves robustness with low computational overhead while preserving clean performance by selecting shorter execution lengths only under perturbations.

</details>


### [1426] [Feedback Makes Perfect: A Closed-Loop Framework for NL-to-STL Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33287)
*Bowen Ye,Xiang Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将自然语言到信号时序逻辑(STL)的翻译重构为闭环反馈过程:系统将生成的STL公式回译为自然语言供用户核验,用户用自然语言修正直至接受,实验证明闭环可将强模型准确率从约89%提升至98.0–99.2%,弱模型提升超30个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STL可对信息物理系统进行严格验证与控制,但撰写正确规约需要专业知识,而多数需求提出者并不具备;LLM虽可做NL-to-STL翻译,但仅靠增强翻译器会遭遇精度上限。作者认为瓶颈在于任务设定本身:一次性、开环翻译是某种不良定义的任务,因为自然语言存在歧义,且人写出的内容未必等于其真实意图,目标规约并未完整包含在输入文本中。

Method: 将NL-to-STL翻译重新表述为闭环反馈过程:每次生成的公式被回译为自然语言供用户检查,自然语言修正驱动迭代修订,直到用户接受规约,用户全程不读写形式语法。该框架依托反馈控制理论中的不对称性——前向路径(歧义语言到形式逻辑)困难且易错,反馈路径(结构化STL回语言)可做到高度精确,精确的反馈路径使不精确的前向路径获得精确的闭环行为。实验在500条专家撰写的需求与7个LLM上进行,并包含消融、专家审计与280场用户研究。

Result: 回译解释与专家判断的一致率达99.5%;闭环精炼将强模型从约89%的开环准确率提升至98.0–99.2%,弱模型提升超过30个百分点(如17.6%→48.0%)。消融显示增益来自反馈的语义内容而非重复尝试。专家审计与280场会话的用户研究进一步证实闭环的可靠性,同时识别出一个能力阈值,超过该阈值后反馈不再带来帮助。

Conclusion: NL-to-STL翻译应从一次性开环任务转为闭环反馈过程,借助高精度的回译反馈路径实现精确的闭环性能,从而突破单靠增强翻译器所面临的准确率上限;该方法对强弱模型均有增益,但存在反馈失效的能力阈值。

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) enables rigorous verification and control of cyber-physical systems, but writing correct specifications requires expertise that most requirement holders lack. Large language models can translate natural-language (NL) requirements into STL, yet stronger translators alone approach an accuracy ceiling. We argue that this ceiling stems from how the task is posed: one-shot, open-loop translation is somewhat ill-defined. Natural language is ambiguous, and, more fundamentally, what a person writes may not always be what they intend, so the target specification is not fully contained in the input text. We therefore reformulate NL-to-STL translation as a closed-loop feedback process. Each generated formula is translated back into natural language for the user to check, and natural-language corrections drive revision until the user accepts the specification. Users never read or write formal syntax. This framework rests on an asymmetry familiar from feedback control theory. The forward path, from ambiguous language to formal logic, is hard and error-prone. The feedback path, from structured STL back to language, can be made highly precise, and a precise feedback path lets an imprecise forward path achieve precise closed-loop behavior. Experiments on 500 expert-authored requirements and seven LLMs support this view. Back-translated explanations agree with expert judgments in 99.5\% of cases. Closed-loop refinement raises strong models from about 89\% open-loop accuracy to 98.0--99.2\%, and yields gains of over 30 percentage points for weaker models (e.g., 17.6\%$\rightarrow$48.0\%). Ablations show these gains come from the semantic content of the feedback rather than from repeated attempts. An expert audit and a 280-session user study further confirm the reliability of the loop. We also identify a capability threshold above which feedback no longer helps.

</details>


### [1427] [Does Adversarial Training Improve Generalization in Multi-View VLAs? Revealing and Mitigating View Collapse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33707)
*Futa Waseda,Shuhei Kurita,Isao Echizen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了对抗训练（AT）对多视角VLA模型在自然分布偏移下泛化能力的影响，发现其效果是选择性的，并揭示了“视角崩溃”这一失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽在分布内表现优异，但在部署偏移下常退化。对抗训练提供了一种无需预知具体偏移的模型自适应鲁棒性方法，但其对多视角VLA自然分布偏移泛化的影响尚不明确。

Method: 使用直接改编自预训练VLM的多视角VLA，在LIBERO-Plus的七个偏移轴上评估泛化能力；采用直接AT、受控视角干预以及View Swap干预并重新评估AT。

Result: 直接AT显著改善相机视角和传感器噪声两类仅影响第三人称视角的偏移，但对其他偏移效果混合或为负。受控视角干预揭示了“视角崩溃”：AT使策略过度依赖手腕视角，暴露了“鲁棒性捷径”——表面鲁棒源于减少使用该视角而非更鲁棒的感知。使用View Swap后，AT进一步改善相机视角、传感器噪声和机器人初始状态，但其他偏移仍为混合效果。

Conclusion: 多视角鲁棒性需要区分改进感知与改变跨视角依赖；对抗训练提供的是选择性而非通用的分布偏移收益，并提出鲁棒感知与鲁棒融合的区分。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for closed-loop robot control, transferring their perceptual and semantic capabilities to action prediction. Despite strong in-distribution performance, however, VLAs often degrade under deployment shifts. Adversarial training (AT) offers a model-adaptive approach to robustness without explicitly anticipating individual shifts, but its effect on natural distribution-shift generalization in multi-view VLAs remains unclear. We study this question using a multi-view VLA directly adapted from a pretrained VLM and evaluate generalization across seven LIBERO-Plus shift axes. Direct AT substantially improves Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise, the two shifts affecting only the third-person view, yet produces mixed or negative effects on other shifts. Controlled view interventions reveal a surprising failure mode that we term view collapse: Direct AT can shift cross-view reliance so strongly that the policy becomes dominated by the wrist view. This exposes a \textit{robustness shortcut}: apparent robustness to a shifted view can arise from reduced use of that view rather than more robust perception of it. This motivates a distinction between robust perception, extracting reliable information under within-view shifts, and robust fusion, adapting reliance across views according to their reliability. To reduce fixed view reliance, we use a simple View Swap intervention and then re-evaluate AT. With View Swap, AT further improves Camera Viewpoint, Sensor Noise, and Robot Initial State, while its effects remain mixed on other shifts. Our results show that multi-view robustness requires separating improved perception from changes in cross-view reliance, and that AT provides selective rather than generic distribution-shift benefits.

</details>


### [1428] [SMARtCARE: Privacy-Preserving Agentic AI Systems for Bounded-Autonomy Clinical Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31763)
*Srini Ramaswamy,Deveeshree Nayak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SMARtCARE提出四状态（Stable/Meta-cognitive/Assisted/Regulated）临床决策支持架构，用有损六通道指纹识别历史病情模式复发，在上下文缺失时触发元认知升级、由医生触发完整检索，实现可追溯且隐私保护的“中段上下文”风险提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文临床AI系统在既往入院记录落在活跃推理上下文之外时，会遗漏相关病史。ICU场景下，早期生命体征漂移可能因此被判定为“非特异”，即使其与既往恶化模式相似，从而延误识别。现有做法缺少在不自动调取全部历史记录前提下的风险提示机制。

Method: 提出SMARtCARE四状态架构：Stable、Meta-cognitive、Assisted、Regulated（Revoked）。不自动检索既往记录，而使用患者既往轨迹的有损六通道指纹；当当前漂移匹配该指纹且既往记录不在上下文时，触发Meta-cognitive升级供临床医生审阅；仅当医生在Assisted状态下采取行动才执行完整检索。另设患者身份守卫，在数据加载、日志与审计层强制正确归属。评估采用合成蒙特卡洛研究（验证状态转移逻辑与估计量稳定性，非临床性能）加MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV Demo真实数据运行。

Result: MIMIC-III中14名两次入院患者中识别出1例既往模式复发；MIMIC-IV中同样流程在9名两次入院患者中未产生指纹匹配，显示出固定规范模式库的关键局限。两次运行中所有记录的决策均完全可追溯且归属正确。

Conclusion: 结果支持SMARtCARE作为一种可追溯、隐私感知的“中段上下文”风险提示机制，而非临床疗效主张。固定规范模式库的泛化能力有限，需进一步扩展模式表示。

Abstract: Long-context clinical AI systems can miss relevant patient history when prior admissions fall outside the active reasoning context. In ICU monitoring, this can cause early vital-sign drift to appear nonspecific even when it resembles a prior deterioration pattern. SMARtCARE addresses this gap through a four-state clinical decision-support architecture: Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated (Revoked). Rather than automatically retrieving prior records, SMARtCARE uses a lossy six-channel fingerprint of the patient's prior trajectory. When current drift matches that fingerprint and the prior record is absent from context, the system raises a Meta-cognitive escalation for clinician review; full retrieval occurs only through clinician action in the Assisted state. A patient-identity guard is designed to enforce correct attribution across data loading, logging, and audit layers. Evaluation combines a synthetic Monte Carlo study that validates the state-transition logic and estimator stability, not clinical performance, with real-data runs on both the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos. On MIMIC-III, one prior-pattern recurrence was identified among 14 two-admission patients; on MIMIC-IV, the same pipeline produced no fingerprint matches among 9 two-admission patients, which illustrates a key limitation of a fixed canonical pattern library. Across both runs all logged decisions were fully traceable and correctly attributed. The results support SMARtCARE as a traceable, privacy-aware mechanism for surfacing middle-context risk; they are not a clinical efficacy claim.

</details>


### [1429] [Witeness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31784)
*Siyuan Li,Haoxuan Zeng,Xin Luo,Fernando Jia,Florence Li,Zhengyang Geng,Zico Kolter,Tai Sing Lee,Tianqin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无需提示、无需训练的白盒"见证重叠"测试，通过引入同族第三检查点作为见证比较局部几何，实现检查点之间的方向性溯源（判断亲子先后关系）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重模型常被微调、对齐、合并后重新发布，溯源审计不仅需判断检查点是否相关，还需确定谁先谁后（方向性）。现有方法多基于基模型已知的审计设定，其证据（表示相似度、权重相似度、行为指纹、相关统计）本质对称，能检测相关性但无法定向关系。

Method: 提出局部几何比较：不直接比较两个检查点，而是引入第三个同族检查点作为"见证"，比较各候选端点的邻域几何；通过判断哪个候选更像"分支父节点"来推断方向。基于此及经验观察到的"父锚定与子锚定见证重叠分布的 asymmetry"，提出 Witness Overlap——一种无需提示、无需训练的白盒方向性溯源测试。

Result: 在来自16个家族的176个LLM检查点上，单见证测试利用 Frobenius 余弦对95.3%的亲子判定成功定向。进一步评估了根节点识别、兄弟区分、向VLM与扩散模型家族的泛化以及链式排序；该信号对权重噪声与稀疏剪枝稳健，提出的SVD权降维变体比 Frobenius 余弦更具稳健性。

Conclusion: 通过引入见证的局部几何比较，可将原本对称的相关性证据转化为方向性证据，实现高效、稳健的方向性溯源，并具备跨模态、跨架构的泛化能力。

Abstract: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. Direction is inferred by asking which candidate behaves more like a branching parent. Motivated by this idea, and by the empirically observed asymmetry between parent-anchored and child-anchored witness-overlap distributions, we propose Witness Overlap, a prompt-free, training-free white-box test for directional provenance. On 176 LLM checkpoints from 16 families, our one-witness test orients 95.3\% of parent-child decisions using Frobenius cosine. We further evaluate root identification, sibling discrimination, generalizations to VLM and diffusion families, and chain-structured ordering. The signal is robust to weight noise and sparse pruning, with a proposed SVD weight reduction variant showing greater robustness than Frobenius cosine.

</details>


### [1430] [CP-Agent: A Harness-Engineered Agent for Crystal Plasticity Simulation Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31790)
*Samuel Onimpa Alfred,Abhishek Kumar,Veera Sundararaghavan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CP-Agent——基于LLM与ReAct范式的晶体塑性建模自动化智能体，通过"框架工程"实现从自然语言任务到完整CP工作流的自主执行，并在四个案例中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 晶体塑性（CP）模拟虽能预测多晶金属力学行为，但其常规应用受限于配置异构工具、编排多步数据流水线、以及针对实验标定本构参数所耗费的大量人工，这些瓶颈阻碍了系统性参数研究的生产率，因而需要自动化工作流。

Method: 提出CP-Agent，一个经"框架工程"（harness engineering）设计的LLM智能体。其运行于ReAct范式下：推理工具选择与执行顺序，同时将数值搜索交给成熟优化器。其框架由最小系统提示、类型化工具定义、调度器以及带安全边界的迭代循环构成，通过工具schema而非硬编码逻辑编码领域知识。

Result: 四个案例研究：(1) 针对增材制造316L不锈钢拉伸数据标定四个滑移参数；(2) 对照已发表铜基准验证工作流，复现应力-应变与织构演化；(3) 反演铜的初始晶体织构，智能体正确识别出弥散初始织构；(4) 复现Mg-Zn-Ca合金多道次轧制织构演化，智能体串联五次变形道次并恢复实验观察到的弱化、分裂基面织构。所有案例中智能体均能从任务描述推断正确执行顺序，且在重复运行中保持稳健，并给出物理可解释结果。

Conclusion: 本研究确立了框架工程作为自动化CP建模工作流的系统性方法，同时通过可见的推理轨迹保持物理可解释性与可审计性。

Abstract: Crystal plasticity (CP) simulations predict the mechanical behavior of polycrystalline metals, yet their routine use is hindered by the manual effort of configuring heterogeneous tools, orchestrating multi-step data pipelines, and calibrating constitutive parameters against experiments. These bottlenecks impede productivity in systematic parameter studies, motivating interest in automated workflows. This study presents CP-Agent, a harness-engineered LLM-based agent that autonomously executes complete CP modeling workflows from natural-language tasks. Operating under the ReAct paradigm, the agent reasons about tool selection and sequencing while delegating numerical search to established optimizers. The harness comprises a minimal system prompt, typed tool definitions, a dispatcher, and a safety-bounded iteration loop, encoding domain knowledge through tool schemas rather than hard-coded logic. CP-Agent is demonstrated on four case studies: calibrating four slip parameters of additively manufactured stainless steel 316L against tensile data; validating the workflow against published copper benchmarks, reproducing stress-strain and texture evolution; recovering the initial crystallographic texture of copper, where the agent correctly identifies a diffuse initial texture; and reproducing the multi-pass rolling texture evolution of a Mg-Zn-Ca alloy, where the agent chains five deformation passes and recovers the experimentally observed weakened, split basal texture. In all cases, the agent inferred the correct execution sequence from the task statement, robustly across repeated runs, and delivered physically interpretable results. This work establishes harness engineering as a systematic approach to automating CP modeling workflows while maintaining physical interpretability and auditability through visible reasoning traces.

</details>


### [1431] [Working with AI: A Design Framework for Human-AI Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31793)
*Yuqian Lu,Regina Lee,Rui Zhou,Lixin Jiang,Andrew McDaid,Amy Lawrence*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本白皮书提出一个用于设计人-AI协作的实践性框架，涵盖人、AI系统、任务、组织及社会环境的五个层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI（尤其是GenAI）在工业场景中可辅助决策、自动化例行工作、增强人类并提升生产率，但AI能否成功落地不仅取决于技术能力，还取决于人的体验与协作方式。因此需要回答：如何设计人-AI协作，才能同时兼顾人与组织的效益。

Method: 构建一个多层级的人-AI协作设计框架，包含人、AI系统、任务、组织与更广泛社会环境五个维度；框架阐释有效协作的表现形态、影响因素、需满足的要求及组织应考虑的设计决策，并配以一个含协作机器人（cobot）的人-AI协作装配系统用例，展示设计需求如何转化为具体协作特性并通过案例研究进行评估。

Result: 框架在实践中被应用于人-AI协作装配系统用例，使设计需求可转化为具体的协作功能，并在案例研究中得到评估，验证了框架的可操作性。

Conclusion: 本白皮书旨在为设计有效、以人为本且负责任的人-AI协作提供清晰、实用的指导。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly GenAI, is becoming an increasingly important part of modern work. In industrial settings, AI can support decision-making, automate routine activities, assist humans, and improve productivity. However, successful AI adoption depends on more than what the technology can do. It also depends on how people experience and work with it. This raises an important question: how should human-AI collaboration be designed so that it works well for both people and organisations? This white paper addresses that question by presenting a practical framework for designing human-AI collaboration. The framework considers the human, the AI system, the task, the organisation, and the wider societal environment. It explains what effective collaboration looks like, what conditions influence it, what requirements should be met, and what design decisions organisations should consider. The report also includes a human-AI collaborative assembly system with cobot use case to demonstrate how the framework can be applied in practice. The use case shows how design requirements can be translated into specific collaboration features and evaluated through a case study. The aim of this white paper is to provide a clear and practical guide for designing human-AI collaboration that is effective, human-centred, and responsible.

</details>


### [1432] [DriveHierarchy: A Benchmark for Diagnosing VLM Driving Capabilities from Open-Loop Understanding to Closed-Loop Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31814)
*Chengkai Xu,Jiaqi Liu,Yicheng Guo,Peng Hang,Jian Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 DriveHierarchy，一个将 VLM 自动驾驶能力划分为感知定位、上下文记忆、心智推理与闭环执行四个层级的层次化基准，统一了开环问答评测与闭环仿真评测，并验证其能刻画结构化且非冗余的能力差异、建立开环理解与闭环驾驶的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 自动驾驶能力具有复合性，需兼顾目标与风险定位、跨视角跨时间上下文整合、未来演化推理及闭环交互下的合理行动。现有基准多只评测开环理解或闭环驾驶，缺乏结构性框架来解释这些能力如何组织、如何相互关联，以及对模型诊断与改进的指导价值有限。

Method: 提出 DriveHierarchy 层次化基准，将 VLM 自动驾驶划分为四个层级：感知定位、上下文记忆、心智推理、闭环执行。开环部分整合多个开源自动驾驶数据集，构建含 76,798 个问答对、覆盖 84,279 帧的统一基准；闭环部分搭建基于真实路网的交互式场景构建仿真平台，筛选出 100 个驾驶场景用于具身评测。

Result: 在 15 个 VLM 上进行实验，结果显示 DriveHierarchy 能捕捉结构化但非冗余的能力差异，建立开环理解与闭环驾驶之间的关联，并为模型诊断与基准引导优化提供实用依据。

Conclusion: DriveHierarchy 可作为评估与改进 VLM 自动驾驶系统的统一框架，项目已在 GitHub 匿名发布。

Abstract: Evaluating VLM-based autonomous driving remains difficult because driving competence is composite, where a capable system must ground traffic participants and hazards, integrate context across views and time, reason about future evolution, and act appropriately under closed-loop interaction. Existing benchmarks usually assess either open-loop understanding or closed-loop driving but provide limited structure for explaining how these abilities are organized, how they relate, and how they may inform model diagnosis and improvement. We present \textsc{DriveHierarchy}, a hierarchical benchmark that organizes VLM-based autonomous driving into four ranks, spanning perceptual grounding, contextual memory, mental reasoning, and closed-loop execution. To instantiate this hierarchy, we integrate multiple open-source autonomous-driving datasets into a unified open-loop benchmark with 76,798 question-answer pairs over 84,279 frames and develop a closed-loop simulation platform with interactive scenario construction on a real-world road network, from which 100 driving scenarios are curated for embodied evaluation. Experiments on 15 VLMs show that \textsc{DriveHierarchy} captures structured but non-redundant capability variation, relates open-loop understanding to closed-loop driving, and provides a practical basis for diagnosis and benchmark-guided optimization. \textsc{DriveHierarchy} therefore serves as a unified framework for evaluating and improving VLM-based autonomous driving systems. An anonymized project has been released on https://github.com/PerfectXu88/DriveHierarchy

</details>


### [1433] [LLM Judge Validation Under Sparse Overlap: From Inference to Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31857)
*Junxuan Li,Arko Mukherjee,Soumyabrata Pal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文证明标注重叠稀疏性是LLM-as-a-judge部署决策错误的一阶决定因素，并提出重叠数量与分配两个可操作杠杆来缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证LLM-as-a-judge需要估计其与人类的一致性，但标注预算往往无法对每个样本进行多次标注，导致重叠稀疏，从而可能引发错误的部署决策。作者希望量化这种错误并给出可行的改进方案。

Method: 论文形式化分析了重叠稀疏性对部署决策的影响；针对重叠"数量"推导了最小重叠公式，指出ρ≥0.25即可满足非临界评判者；针对重叠"分配"提出零成本分层抽样方案，并在10个LLM评判者、四类评估矩阵（涵盖视觉评估、因果推理、摘要）上进行验证。

Result: 在5%成对重叠下，错误决策率达25%，在十个候选中选出错误最佳评判者的概率为65%；ρ≥0.25 对非临界评判者足够，而临界情形本质上仍困难；当分层信息有效时，分层方案相较随机抽样可将错误拒绝率减半。

Conclusion: 重叠稀疏性显著影响LLM评判者部署决策的正确性，通过控制重叠数量（最低重叠阈值）与优化重叠分配（分层抽样）可有效降低错误决策与错误拒绝率。

Abstract: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge requires estimating its agreement with humans, yet annotation budgets rarely allow every item to be multiply labeled. We prove that this \emph{overlap sparsity} is the first-order determinant of wrong deployment decisions: at 5\% pairwise overlap, wrong-decision rates reach 25\% and the probability of selecting the wrong best judge among ten candidates is 65\%. The two actionable levers are overlap \emph{quantity} and \emph{allocation}. For quantity, we derive a minimum-overlap formula showing $ρ\geq 0.25$ suffices for non-borderline judges while borderline cases remain fundamentally hard. For allocation, a zero-cost stratified scheme halves false-rejection rates relative to random sampling when strata are informative. We validate on 10 LLM judges across four evaluation matrices spanning visual assessment, causal reasoning, and summarization.

</details>


### [1434] [COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31874)
*Hongji Pu,Ruixiang Tang,Yongfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COUNTERMEM：一种通过可执行世界模型构造并复用「经验证的反事实记忆」的强化学习框架，在12个基准上平均提升ReAct/Reflexion 12.6个百分点，并降低任务运行token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆框架主要通过智能体与事实世界的交互来构建记忆（如记住动作反馈以改进后续任务），但很少在记忆构建时追问「如果当初采取不同动作，反馈是否会改变、这种反馈能否成为有用记忆」。而在真实活跃环境中直接获取此类反事实反馈代价高昂，且会改变用于对比的状态。

Method: COUNTERMEM在失败动作后，从原始状态的副本或重置状态出发，借助可执行世界模型（测试、证明检查器、求解器等）评估局部替代动作；存储改进信息，包括原始动作与修正动作、经验证的结果以及复用条件。学习一个「记忆使用策略」，决定检索某条记录或跳过记忆，以平衡任务成功率与交互成本，而基础LLM保持固定。在留出评估中，记忆与策略均被冻结。

Result: 在六个领域共12个基准设置上评估。使用gpt-oss-120b时，COUNTERMEM在全部12个基准上同时提升ReAct与Reflexion，相较未增强版本平均提升12.6个百分点；在两个骨干模型、四个领域的对比中，任务运行token减少7.7%–42.0%（不含离线选择器训练成本）。进一步分析显示：去除验证或持久化存储会削弱增益，而将经验证的修正应用到不合适的决策上则可能使增益反转。

Conclusion: 通过可执行世界模型验证并持久化存储反事实记忆、并配以学习式记忆使用策略，能在不更新基础LLM的前提下稳定提升智能体任务表现并降低交互成本；验证与持久化存储是增益的关键来源，记忆复用需与决策情境匹配。

Abstract: Existing agent memory frameworks mainly create memory through an agent's interaction with the factual world, e.g., remembering feedback from actions taken to improve performance on future tasks. However, these frameworks seldom ask the "what if" question during memory construction: what if a different action had been taken, would the feedback have changed, and how could this feedback become useful memory? Obtaining such feedback directly in an active environment can be expensive and can alter the state needed for comparison. In this work, we introduce COUNTERMEM, a reinforcement-learning framework for constructing and using verified counterfactual memory across tasks. After a failed action, COUNTERMEM evaluates local alternatives from a copy or reset of the original state using executable world models, such as tests, proof checkers, and solvers. It stores improvements with the original and corrected actions, checked outcomes, and conditions for reuse. A learned memory-use policy selects a retrieved record or skips memory to balance task success and interaction cost, while the base LLM remains fixed. Both memory and policy are frozen during held-out evaluation. We evaluate COUNTERMEM on 12 benchmark settings across six domains. With gpt-oss-120b, COUNTERMEM improves both ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a gain of 12.6 percentage points over their unaugmented versions. In the four-domain comparison across two backbones, task-run tokens decrease by 7.7-42.0%, excluding offline selector-training costs. Further analyses show that removing verification or persistent storage weakens the gains, while applying verified corrections to unsuitable decisions can reverse them. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [1435] [Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31897)
*Haorui Ma,Zehua Zang,Jiangmeng Li,Yi Li,Fanjing Xu,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 NashEval，一个从离线反馈中学习上下文相关纳什均衡的鲁棒框架，用于上下文依赖的智能体评估。它构建去偏的上下文收益矩阵估计，并用定制的正交损失学习"上下文到均衡"的映射，理论证明扰动函数误差仅通过高阶项影响均衡的可利用性（exploitability），实验表明其提升了均衡学习鲁棒性并能稳定识别各上下文下的最优智能体集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多应用需要在上下文信息（如提示、任务或用户群体）下评估智能体。现有基于分数的模型（如 Bradley-Terry）强制施加传递性偏好排序，当人类判断异质时无法反映集体偏好；同时从离线日志学习上下文相关均衡很困难，因为每个上下文只揭示对部分智能体的反馈，朴素插值估计器会产生偏差。

Method: 受社会选择理论启发，将评估建模为两名玩家之间的上下文博弈，每名玩家选择智能体上的分布作为策略以获得更高的集体偏好，纳什均衡的支撑集定义了上下文相关的获胜者集合。提出 NashEval 框架：(1) 构建刻画该博弈的上下文收益矩阵的去偏估计；(2) 用定制的正交损失学习上下文到均衡的映射，避免为每个上下文单独求解博弈。

Result: 理论上证明，估计收益矩阵底层扰动函数时的误差仅通过高阶项影响所学均衡的风险（即可利用性）。在多组实验中，NashEval 提升了均衡学习的鲁棒性，并持续识别出跨上下文表现最佳的智能体集合。

Conclusion: 将上下文相关的智能体评估形式化为上下文博弈并学习其纳什均衡，是一种在异质人类判断下反映集体偏好、且对离线反馈偏差鲁棒的有效途径；NashEval 提供了理论基础与实证支持。

Abstract: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.

</details>


### [1436] [EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31906)
*Mukul Singh,Mansi Uniyal,Devin Devlin,Wen Xie,Big Thadawasin,Ritam Dutt,Vivian Lai,Hyeonsu B. Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 EmailBench，一个包含 206 个邮件与生产力场景、16 类任务的基准，采用类型化邮件 API、确定性合成语料与混合评估协议；八个 LM 配置中最佳仅通过 33.5% 场景，而工具调用无故障率达 99.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业邮件智能体需综合信息检索、结构化状态变更、时间推理与多步协作。现有智能体基准虽涵盖生产力任务，但少有聚焦封闭环境中的类型化邮件工作流，因此缺乏端到端评测手段。

Method: 构建 EmailBench：耦合类型化邮件 API 规范（供应商中立的命名）、确定性合成 Enron 风格语料，以及主题选取参考交互原型聚合任务意图遥测的场景套件；评估采用混合协议，由 258 条可执行静态断言与 211 条 LLM 评分量表组成；在固定单用户语料上评测八种 LM 配置。

Result: 最佳配置仅通过 33.5% 的场景，尽管其 99.7% 的工具调用未出现可观测的 API 失败；通过率在不同任务类别间差异显著。该差距表明工具调用有效执行不等同于任务完成。

Conclusion: EmailBench 为端到端邮件智能体评测提供了自包含环境；未来工作包括扩大工具覆盖、多角色（multi-persona）测试与重复运行评估。

Abstract: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.

</details>


### [1437] [BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31939)
*Xingbo Du,Fadli Aulawi Al Ghiffari,Leonard Song,Loka Li,Duzhen Zhang,Zixiao Wang,Xiuying Chen,Le Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BioDyad 通过蒙特卡洛图搜索中的科学层级与工程层级，将生物医学证据发现与可执行程序搜索耦合，在 BioXArena 76 任务基准上取得最优分数与成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体式生物医学机器学习系统虽已连接证据获取与程序搜索的部分能力，但在整个程序搜索过程中难以协调二者：新证据需指导候选构造，执行结果需反哺后续发现与复用，验证需求又须匹配搜索预算。

Method: 提出 BioDyad，在蒙特卡洛图搜索（Monte Carlo graph search）框架内设置两个层级。科学层级将先验生物医学指导与迭代发现结合，并把生物医学方案与执行结果关联存储于记忆中以供跨候选复用；工程层级将候选程序依次推进：冒烟执行（smoke execution）→ 训练/验证评估 → 全数据重训练。

Result: 在 76 任务的 BioXArena 基准、每任务两小时预算、三种匹配 LLM 后端设置下，BioDyad 在四种智能体方法与一个一次性（one-shot）基线中，均取得最高惩罚化全任务分数与任务成功率。

Conclusion: 协调生物医学发现与机器学习工程，可将外部知识整合进可执行程序，并在异构生物医学任务中稳定生效。

Abstract: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.

</details>


### [1438] [Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31963)
*Ben Rachmut,Ning Zhang,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,William Yeoh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出符号引导分类法（SGT），将LLM智能体的自主性从开放式自然语言推理到完全规定的算法执行划分为不同等级，实验表明中等自主性（部分伪代码引导）在多智能体分布式协调中表现最优，优于完全无引导和完全规定执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益作为自主智能体部署于多智能体系统，但其可靠执行分布式协调协议的能力尚不清楚。在AgentsNet等基准中，赋予智能体完全推理自主权往往导致复杂领域中的性能不一致甚至下降。作者假设通过来自成熟算法的符号引导来规管智能体自主性可以改善协调效果。

Method: 提出符号引导分类法（Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy, SGT），刻画从开放式自然语言推理到完全规定的算法执行的自主性谱系，中间等级提供部分伪代码引导。基于AgentsNet基准框架开展实验，比较不同自主性等级下LLM智能体的分布式协调表现。

Result: 实验结果显示，中等自主性等级持续优于无引导的智能体和完全规定性（完全规定执行）的规格说明。这表明确立自主性规管是LLM分布式协调的关键设计原则。

Conclusion: 通过符号引导来调节智能体自主性是提升LLM多智能体分布式协调的有效设计原则，适度的伪代码引导（中等自主性）优于极端自主或无自主的两种方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains.
  We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

</details>


### [1439] [Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31980)
*Xiangyang Ju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过仓库级案例研究，验证通用编码智能体（Codex、Claude Code）能否自主开展严格的科学性能工程，结果显示其可在无代码变换预设下完成CUDA内核优化并取得可复现加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体已能跨多轮工具调用追求持久目标，但缺乏证据表明通用智能体能胜任严格的科学性能工程（scientific performance engineering）。论文拟填补这一空白。

Method: 采用仓库尺度（repository-scale）案例研究：以粒子追踪中的固定半径最近邻（FRNN）搜索为任务。初始实现依赖PyTorch的CUDA代码。给智能体一个可执行目标声明，其中规定精确正确性测试、性能剖析（profiling）要求与验收标准，但不规定任何代码变换。智能体据此自主移除PyTorch依赖，并开展假设驱动的优化实验。随后由独立重跑使用不同的假设序列进行优化。

Result: 主要顺序轨迹产出独立C++/CUDA库，精确复现目标参考结果；其同步NumPy接口在包含主机传输开销的情况下，相对原GPU常驻PyTorch接口取得1.6倍加速，并在不同GPU架构与软件栈上观察到类似加速。独立优化重跑走不同假设路径，在目标任务上取得更优性能。

Conclusion: 目标持久的编码智能体可充当实验性性能工程师；可执行科学契约（executable scientific contracts）既是引导其优化的必要手段，也是验证优化正确性的必要手段。

Abstract: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.

</details>


### [1440] [CSI-Agent: LLM-Assisted Few-Shot Adaptation for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi CSI Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31990)
*Tianya Zhao,Chuan Liu,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CSI-Agent，将跨域Wi-Fi CSI感知适配重构为部署期决策问题，利用LLM代理基于类级证据为每个类别决定保留默认或触发专门动作，在1-shot适配下跨四个数据集平均Macro-F1提升约16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi CSI无设备感知模型在跨域部署中脆弱，用户或环境变化会导致错误预测。现有方法多将其视为离线模型设计问题（预训练更强表征或对整个目标域应用固定适配方法），忽略了标注目标数据稀缺、且同一域偏移下不同类别的失效方式可能不同这一现实。

Method: 核心方法为CSI-Agent，一个证据驱动的LLM代理。它不处理原始CSI、也不做样本级预测，而是将目标域行为汇总为有感知依据的类级证据；从互补的CSI视图建立强目标自适应默认方案，再由LLM规划器判断每个类别应保留默认还是调用专门动作；并引入确定性验证与有界执行以抑制不可靠干预。

Result: 在四个公开数据集、五种跨域划分（设备、用户、环境及组合偏移）上评估。1-shot适配设置下，CSI-Agent在所有划分上取得最佳目标域性能，平均Macro-F1较最强基线提升约16%。

Conclusion: 将跨域CSI适配视为部署期决策问题、以类级证据驱动LLM规划器进行选择性干预，是缓解CSI感知模型跨域脆弱性的有效途径，显著优于固定适配策略。

Abstract: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) has enabled device-free sensing applications such as human activity recognition. However, CSI sensing models remain brittle in cross-domain deployment, where changes in users or environments can produce incorrect predictions. Existing solutions usually treat this problem as an offline model-design problem, by pretraining a stronger representation or applying one fixed adaptation method to the entire target domain. In practice, labeled target data are scarce and different classes may fail in different ways under the same domain shift. To address this, we propose CSI-Agent, an evidence-seeking LLM agent that reformulates cross-domain CSI adaptation as a deployment-time decision-making problem. Rather than processing raw CSI or making sample-level predictions, CSI-Agent summarizes target-domain behavior into sensing-grounded class-level evidence. It establishes a strong target-adaptive default from complementary CSI views and uses an LLM planner to determine whether each class should retain the default or invoke a specialized action. Deterministic verification and bounded execution further reduce unreliable interventions. We evaluate CSI-Agent on four public datasets using five cross-domain splits covering device, user, environment, and compositional shifts. Under 1-shot adaptation, CSI-Agent achieves the best target-domain performance across all splits and improves the average Macro-F1 by about 16\% compared to the strongest baseline method.

</details>


### [1441] [SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32000)
*Tianya Zhao,Chuan Liu,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SenseAgent，一种 LLM 引导的传感智能体，用于跨域 IMU 活动识别。它将 LLM 作为运行时规划器，在无标签目标诊断报告基础上决定保留原始推理或调用重力感知传感、原型迁移、风格归一化等工具，并通过验证器保证安全性，从而把固定推理流水线转变为闭环传感过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IMU 模型在跨用户、跨设备、跨佩戴位置时可靠性显著下降。现有方法把跨域问题当作静态模型设计任务（预训练更强表示、数据增强或部署前选定一种自适应方法），但实际场景中目标域逐渐显现、标签稀缺，且不同域偏移需要不同的传感动作，单一固定策略难以应对。

Method: SenseAgent 不让 LLM 直接分类原始 IMU 信号，而是把 LLM 用作运行时规划器，统筹传感工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆与验证器。智能体从目标流构建无标签诊断报告，据此决定保留原始推理或调用专门工具（重力感知传感、原型迁移、风格归一化）。验证器在采纳高风险工具决策前检查源域校准、目标记忆可靠性与无害性准则。方法支持有限反馈，且无需重训练骨干或替换无标签路径。

Result: 在多个 IMU 数据集与部署偏移上评估，验证后的路径选择提升了跨域传感性能，在更困难的佩戴位置偏移与复合偏移下尤为明显，并能从有限的用户反馈中进一步获益。

Conclusion: 该设计将跨域 IMU 传感从固定推理流水线转化为闭环传感过程：诊断目标偏移、选择合适传感动作、拒绝不安全自适应，为跨域 IMU 活动识别提供了动态、可验证的解决思路。

Abstract: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition.
