Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route. This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.

</details>


### [1442] [Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32019)
*Valeriy Vyaltsev,Anton Andreychuk,Taisia Zlotnikova,Konstantin Yakovlev,Aleksandr Panov,Alexey Skrynnik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DMM 用多轮通信中的离散迭代意图精炼替代一次性采样，在去中心化 MAPF 中实现更优的联合动作协调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化多智能体路径规划（MAPF）在部分可观测下需通过通信实现无碰撞到达各自目标。基于专家数据训练的可学习策略虽有效，但当同一情境存在多种协调有效的联合动作时，各智能体独立采样会产生局部有效但在联合层面不兼容的动作组合；即使各智能体动作分布学习正确，最终采样机制仍可能导致失败。

Method: 提出 DMM（Decentralized Master-Mind），受扩散模型去噪思想启发，将一次性动作采样替换为跨通信轮次的离散迭代动作意图精炼：智能体先初始化随机动作意图，再通过局部通信逐步精炼，在最终承诺前耦合彼此选择。先用模仿学习在专家 MAPF 解上预训练，再用 MICPO（一种面向多智能体、多轮动作精炼的无 critic 组相对强化学习方法）进一步优化。

Result: DMM 总体成功率更高、解成本更低。在 1,600 个 MovingAI 任务上，经 MICPO 微调的 DMM 解出 1,598 个，覆盖率在所评估方法中最高，解成本接近最强基线；并可扩展至障碍丰富环境中超过一百万同时行动的智能体。

Conclusion: 轮级意图精炼可在保持去中心化执行的同时改善联合动作协调，是解决去中心化 MAPF 联合动作不兼容问题的有效途径。

Abstract: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.

</details>


### [1443] [A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32020)
*Noah L. Schroeder,Yessy Eka Ambarwati,Yuji Zhang,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个对齐NGSS标准、覆盖初中与高中科学的综合性基准，并系统评估了9个开源权重LLM的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在K-12科学教育中的应用日益广泛，但现有基准多评估通用语言能力或高阶科学推理，缺乏与中学科学课程内容直接对齐的评估工具，导致教育者难以判断模型的教学适用性。

Method: 采用严格的合成数据管道构建NGSS对齐基准，结合多评判者验证与题目层面心理测量分析；对9个开源权重LLM进行系统评估；并引入人在回路，由人工审查LLM生成的题目与NGSS标准的一致性。

Result: 若干体量较小、可本地部署的模型在多个科学领域和题型上达到较高准确率；模型规模并不能稳定预测表现；人工审查发现合成生成题目与NGSS标准并非完全对齐。

Conclusion: 教育场景中的模型选择需要有意识地依据基准评估而非参数规模；人在回路的题目开发仍具价值；未来需探索内容知识与教学法知识的交叉，并扩展基准以评估LLM在交互式、基于证据的反馈方面的能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards. The human review indicated that synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with the NGSS standards, indicating the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development, the need to explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge, and the need to extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.

</details>


### [1444] [Reasoning Concentrates Errors, and Self-Consistency Never Notices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32035)
*Asaad Althoubi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 固定权重下仅切换推理模式，跨5个基准、74,944个样本发现：推理会"集中"模型错误（两个独立错误答案重合概率在10/10数据集-规模比较中上升，p=0.00098；限定各自做错的题目后9/9成立），但置信度加权投票无法超越普通多数投票。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性（self-consistency）的假设是：模型不确定时独立采样会给出分歧，因此答案一致即正确性证据。论文要检验这一假设在开启/关闭推理模式、权重固定时是否成立，以及基于置信度的加权投票能否真正利用这一信息做出更好决策。

Method: 保持权重固定，仅切换推理模式；覆盖5个基准、74,944个样本；统计两个独立错误答案的重合概率（10个数据集-规模比较，并限定到各自做错的题目）；在无界与有界答案空间下分别分析答案多样性（不同答案数之比0.43-0.65、选项集不变而质量集中）；在8个模型、5个基准、280个方法-数据集-模型组合上比较普通多数投票与多种置信度加权方法；检验信号方向是否可在固定权重下反转（答案对数概率在不开推理时预测正确、开启后预测错误）；并测试学习式六信号组合的域内/域外表现。

Result: 推理确实集中错误：错误重合概率在所有10个数据集-规模比较中上升（p=0.00098），限定到各自错题后9/9成立；无界答案空间下推理把不同答案数降至非推理的0.43-0.65，有界空间下选项集相同但质量更集中，且固定权重下位置先验无法解释。总体代价小于机制预测，因为推理也把可用多样性起作用的题目集合缩小了2.7倍（10/10单元）；按可用余量归一后两种模式域内均只转化约四分之一。置信度加权无法挽回剩余损失：280个组合无一在多重校正后超越普通多数投票；加权投票与多数投票在98.5%的题目-方法对中一致，其余仅56.3%正确；信号方向可在固定权重下反转；学习式六信号组合域外无增益。

Conclusion: 自一致性所依赖的"分歧即不确定"假设在推理模式下被削弱：推理集中错误、压缩答案多样性，使一致更可能是同源错误。基于置信度的信号在当前聚合方式下无法转化为更优决策，280个组合中无一优于普通多数投票，跨域学习也无收益。因此置信度信号应在其实际决策收益（decisions）上评估，而非仅看其区分能力（discrimination）。

Abstract: Self-consistency assumes that independent samples disagree when a model is unsure, so agreement is evidence of correctness. Holding weights fixed and toggling only a reasoning mode, over five benchmarks and 74,944 samples, we show that reasoning concentrates a model's errors: the probability that two independently drawn wrong answers coincide rises in all ten dataset-scale comparisons (p = 0.00098), and in nine of nine after restricting both arms to the problems each gets wrong. Where the answer space is unbounded, reasoning cuts the distinct answers produced to 0.43-0.65 of the non-reasoning count; where it is bounded, both arms hold an identical option set and reasoning concentrates mass on it instead, which no positional prior can explain at fixed weights. The aggregate cost is smaller than the mechanism predicts, because reasoning also shrinks the set of problems where answer diversity can decide anything, in ten of ten cells and by 2.7x; normalized for available headroom, both arms convert a quarter of it in domain. Confidence weighting does not recover what is left. Across 280 method-dataset-model combinations on eight models and five benchmarks, not one beats plain majority voting after correction; weighted voting agrees with it on 98.5% of problem-method pairs and is right 56.3% of the time on the rest; and a signal's direction can invert within fixed weights, with answer log-probability predicting correctness when reasoning is off and error when it is on. A learned six-signal combination gains nothing out of domain. Confidence signals should be evaluated on decisions, not on discrimination.

</details>


### [1445] [Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32046)
*Maximillian Rossi,Prajwal Raghunath,Haoqing Xuan,Yusen Zhang,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出CacheBack，一种无需训练、基于发送方注意力权重的"接收方条件化通信"方法，用于压缩多智能体间传输的KV缓存，在FanOutQA上以Qwen 3移除75%状态、提升14.7个百分点准确率并将中位延迟降低3.2倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统需跨智能体分发大上下文并相互通信。文本消息紧凑但需解码，且可能遗漏接收方所需证据；近期流行的潜在通信（传输KV缓存）虽避免文本生成、提升准确率与延迟，但完整KV缓存随单智能体上下文长度和协调智能体数量线性增长，带来内存与上下文开销，往往远超可用GPU资源与上下文窗口限制。

Method: 核心观察是"接收方条件化通信"：智能体只需发送接收方完成其本地任务所需的信息。接收方智能体向发送方提供关于其信息需求的简短描述，据此对发送方的KV缓存进行过滤与压缩。CacheBack是该思想的一个简单、鲁棒、免训练的实例，基于发送方的注意力权重实现。

Result: 在FanOutQA上，CacheBack配合Qwen 3可移除原本会传给接收方的75%状态，相比文本通信准确率提升14.7个百分点，中位任务完成延迟降低3.2倍。在覆盖稠密Transformer、Mamba-注意力混合及滑动窗口注意力的多种模型家族中均展现出相当程度的改进。

Conclusion: 通过接收方条件化通信压缩KV缓存，CacheBack在免训练条件下同时改善了多智能体通信的准确率与延迟，并具备跨模型架构的泛化性，为缓解潜在通信的内存与上下文成本提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems distribute large contexts across agents that communicate to solve a task. Text messages are compact but require decoding and may omit evidence the receiving agent needs. Recent latent communication instead transfers KV caches. This avoids text generation and can improve accuracy and latency. However, a full KV cache grows linearly with both the context an individual agent processes, and the number of agents that coordinate together. This raises memory and context costs, often far exceeding available GPU resources and context window sizes. Our key observation is that agents need only send what the receiving agent requires for its local task -- which we call receiver-conditioned communication. The receiver agent passes the sender a small description of its information needs, which serves to filter and compress the sender agent's KV cache. CacheBack is a simple, robust, training-free instance of receiver conditioning based on the sender's attention weights. On FanOutQA, CacheBack with Qwen 3 removes 75% of the state the agent would otherwise receive, improving accuracy by 14.7 percentage points and reducing median task-completion latency by 3.2x relative to text communication. We show comparable improvements across model families that span dense Transformers, Mamba-attention hybrids, and sliding-window attention.

</details>


### [1446] [Contract monitoring: governing AI via separation of powers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32061)
*Enric Boix-Adsera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于合约的AI安全框架：用合约限定工作智能体的允许行为，通过监控者与裁判的分工及计算资源不对称来落实与规约，并可实证度量统计安全保证，适用于代码安全与"逃逸盒子"等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体自主行动范围扩大，如何约束其行为、并在部署前获得可度量的安全保证，是AI安全的核心需求。现有研究多停留在原则或定性层面，缺少可规约、可执行、可量化度量的统一框架。

Method: 核心是"合约"机制：为工作智能体（worker）绑定一份明确列出其被允许动作的合约。实现上做两类设计：一是职责分离，将合约的指定与执行分别交给监控智能体（monitor）与裁判（judge），形成相互制衡的监督链；二是资源不对称，使监控者相对工作智能体拥有不对称的计算资源（如更强的算力或更多检测时间），从而在检测能力上取得优势。由此把安全从原则转化为可实证测量的统计量。

Result: 该框架支持对安全保证进行经验性（统计）度量，即能在实验中给出可量化的安全指标，而非仅有定性论证；并证明其可迁移到多种应用场景，涵盖代码安全与"逃逸盒子"（限制智能体接触外部环境）两类典型设定。

Conclusion: 通过合约、监控者—裁判分工与计算资源不对称的组合，可在多类场景下实现可度量、可执行的AI行为约束，为AI安全提供可操作、可评估的工程化路径。

Abstract: We propose an AI safety framework that binds worker agents to contracts specifying their permitted actions. We show how these contracts can be enforced and specified by assigning distinct responsibilities to monitor agents and judges, and asymmetric computational resources to monitors and workers. Our framework allows us to empirically measure statistical safety guarantees. The framework applies to a wide range of settings, including code security and escape-the-box scenarios.

</details>


### [1447] [Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32081)
*Dhananjay Ashok,Jesse Thomason,Jonathan May*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 PAU 基准，要求模型仅通过黑盒 API 交互（探索性输入+观察输出）来推断 Python 代码片段的真实功能，研究无监督工具理解问题；发现前沿模型表现不佳且过度自信，并借鉴非对称 Actor-Critic（AAC）范式进行后训练，使 8B 模型达到 GPT-5-mini 水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码生成与理解系统依赖对相关代码的读取权限，但在处理外部 API 时该假设不成立。作者希望研究更一般的"无监督工具理解"问题：仅通过交互（而非阅读源码）来理解以 Python 方法形式实现的外部工具。

Method: 1) 构建 PAU（Python API Understanding）基准：向模型提供代码片段的黑盒、API 级访问权限，模型需用探索性输入查询 API 并依据输出推断片段真实功能；2) 分析模型的常见错误模式；3) 借鉴机器人学习中常用的 Asymmetric Actor Critic（AAC）范式，对模型进行交互式代码理解的后训练。

Result: 即使是前沿模型在 PAU 上表现也较差，最好的模型 Claude-4-Opus 在 PAU 测试集上有超过 45% 无法理解。错误模式分析显示模型过度自信，常高估当前假设质量，导致探索不足和过早终止。经 AAC 后训练的模型对 API 进行更主动的探索，AAC 调优的 Qwen3-8B 性能与 GPT-5-mini 相当。

Conclusion: 仅靠交互理解黑盒 Python API 仍是难题，前沿模型受限于过度自信与探索不足；借鉴 AAC 范式后训练能有效提升交互式代码理解能力，使小模型达到大模型水平，表明交互策略优化是提升无监督工具理解的关键方向。

Abstract: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting outputs, with the goal of describing the snippet's true functionality. By treating the code snippets as external tools that must be understood via interaction alone, PAU studies the more general problem of unsupervised tool understanding, specifically for tools implemented as Python methods. Despite recent progress in coding agents, even frontier models struggle to achieve high performance on PAU, with the best model (Claude-4-Opus) failing to understand over 45% of the PAU test set. An investigation into the common error modes reveals that models are overconfident; they often overrate the quality of their current hypothesis, leading to insufficient exploration and premature termination. Finally, we take inspiration from the Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) paradigm, frequently used in robot learning, to post-train models for interactive code understanding. Models trained with AAC conduct more active exploration of the APIs, with an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B model matching the performance of GPT-5-mini.

</details>


### [1448] [Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32091)
*K. R. Jayaram,Vatche Isahagian,Vinod Muthusamy,Gegi Thomas,Punleuk Oum,Gaodan Fang,Ashwath Vaithinathan Aravindan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将"智能体内存"重新定义为中间件问题，主张内存应成为一等、可插拔的层，并提出六大系统挑战，同时给出参考实现 ALTK-Evolve。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体默认跨会话无状态，导致"操作性失忆"：每次会话都缺乏对以往失败、修复、偏好与成功策略的持久知识，从而重复错误、丢弃经验。主流做法是"定制化内存"——把检索、持久化与学习逻辑硬编码进单个智能体并绑定单一存储引擎，造成内存无法替换、共享、隔离或独立推理的碎片化格局。

Method: 作者以"中间件视角"重构该问题，类比数据访问、消息传递与持久化成为中间件关注点的历史，提出智能体内存应作为可插拔中间件层。通过六个系统挑战展开论述：双向可插拔性、宿主原生介入（interposition）、多租户隔离、写路径一致性、带溯源信息的联邦共享、生命周期治理。并给出 ALTK-Evolve 作为面向自改进智能体的内存中间件参考实现。

Result: 论文以 ALTK-Evolve 参考实现验证了内存中间件思路的可行性，并据此引出关于未来内存中间件的更广泛研究议程。

Conclusion: 智能体内存应被视作独立的中间件层，以实现可替换、可共享、可隔离与可独立推理；ALTK-Evolve 为这一方向提供了参考实现，并推动后续研究议程。

Abstract: AI agents are stateless across sessions by default and therefore operationally amnesic: each session begins with little durable knowledge of prior failures, repairs, preferences, or successful strategies. As a result, agents repeat the same mistakes and discard hard-won experience. The dominant fix is \emph{bespoke memory}---retrieval, persistence, and learning logic hand-wired into one agent and bound to one storage engine. This creates a fragmented landscape where memory cannot be swapped, shared, isolated, or reasoned about independently of the agent that owns it. We argue that this is a middleware problem: agent memory deserves a first-class, pluggable layer, just as data access, messaging, and persistence each became middleware concerns.
  We develop this vision through six systems challenges: two-sided pluggability, host-native interposition, multi-tenant isolation, write-path consistency, federated sharing with provenance, and lifecycle governance. We present ALTK-Evolve, a reference implementation of memory middleware for self-improving agents, and use it to motivate a broader research agenda for future memory middleware.

</details>


### [1449] [GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32093)
*Dhananjay Ashok,Adam Shen,Aslan Huo Feng,Chinmay Khanna,Jun Rui Huang,Raghav Sarmukaddam,Surendira Balaji Natarajan,Xiaotong Cui,Xincan Zhang,Thomson Yen,Hongseok Namkoong,Jonathan May,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 GameBoyWorlds 测试平台，用于评估智能体在无演示、无文档、无奖励条件下通过自主探索实现自我改进的能力，包含 GameBoyWorlds-Execution 与 GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough 两套基准。结果显示前沿模型及现有自我改进方法均表现不佳，凸显该任务的高难度与开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体虽能在专家指导下于交互环境中运行，但能否从自身经验中自主学习尚不明确；缺乏合适的测试平台来评估这类自我改进方法。

Method: 构建 GameBoyWorlds 测试平台：GameBoyWorlds-Execution 基于 5 个不同游戏系列，智能体仅可访问专用训练游戏，无演示、文档或奖励，需通过自主探索和从自身经验推断可操作知识进行环境接地，并在未见游戏中完成短程任务；GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough 在两款粉丝自制宝可梦游戏上测试端到端通关，智能体需自主学习并全程自我改进。同时对比评估现有自我改进方法（世界建模、自主技能发现、基于好奇心探索撰写指南等）以及具备多模态记忆和分层子目标的复杂智能体流水线。

Result: 前沿模型在 500 个任务中完成不足 50%，主要受多模态接地失败影响；现有自我改进方法均不足，世界建模与自主技能发现失败，好奇心探索写指南的方法仅部分成功；在 Playthrough 中，尽管前沿模型接触过官方版本如 Pokémon Red，但缺乏测试平台游戏的关键信息，复杂智能体流水线在兩款游戏中均未达到第一个主要里程碑。

Conclusion: GameBoyWorlds 表明自主自我改进仍是极具挑战的目标，为自我改进智能体设定了高难度基准，并揭示当前方法在多模态接地、自主探索与经验学习方面的明显不足。

Abstract: Powered by expert guidance, agents can operate in interactive environments; however, it is unclear whether they can learn autonomously from their own experience. To evaluate such self-improvement methods, we introduce GameBoyWorlds, a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games. GameBoyWorlds-Execution evaluates task execution on a collection of 5 distinct game series. Agents are allowed access to dedicated training games but are provided no demonstrations, documentation, or rewards. Agents must ground themselves in the environment through self-directed exploration and by inferring actionable knowledge from their own experience. At test time, agents must complete short-horizon tasks that evaluate their ability to navigate, interact, and engage with game-specific mechanics in unseen games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of the 500 tasks due to failures in multimodal grounding, establishing that self-improvement methods have room to push performance. We demonstrate that contemporary approaches to self-improvement are lacking, with world modelling and autonomous skill discovery failing, and a novel strategy that uses curiosity-based exploration to write guides achieving only partial success. GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough tests end-to-end game completion in two fan-made Pokémon games. We show that while frontier models have been pre-exposed to official releases such as Pokémon Red, they lack essential information on the games in our testbed. Instead of relying on their parametric knowledge to succeed, agents must learn from their own experience and autonomously improve over the course of the playthrough. We show that a sophisticated agentic pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach even the first major milestone in both games, establishing GameBoyWorlds as an ambitious target for self-improving agents.

</details>


### [1450] [Residual Streams Read, Recurrent States Remember: The Global Workspace in Mamba Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32102)
*Wenlong Wang,Fergal Reid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文检验全局工作空间理论能否推广到状态空间语言模型，通过对Mamba系列模型的残差流与循环状态拟合Jacobian透镜，发现状态单独即可作为工作空间内容的互补载体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局工作空间解释此前主要在Transformer表征上验证，尚不清楚该解释能否推广至状态空间语言模型（如Mamba系列），需要检验循环状态是否也承载可读取、可干预的工作空间内容。

Method: 对Mamba-1、Mamba-2、Mamba-3的残差流与循环状态拟合Jacobian透镜，沿用原始1000条提示词配方；采用联合残差-状态读出（含归一化联合读出）；开展时间映射与词表实验；并提出sign-guarded steering（符号守护引导）与坐标交换作对比的匹配言语报告试验。

Result: 联合读出在每个Mamba检查点的至少六类任务中的五类上优于残差透镜；Mamba-2上状态单独读出在全部六类任务上超过残差与logit透镜，归一化联合读出在五类上优于两个单独分量。时间映射与词表实验显示早期内容随残差可见性变化仍保持状态可读性。sign-guarded steering在五个模型的匹配言语报告试验中提升目标top-5成功率。但收益未能一致推广到关系型答案：守护编辑常输出被编辑概念本身，Mamba-3的联合编辑可破坏成功的状态单独重定向。

Conclusion: 循环状态提供了工作空间内容的互补载体，其恢复、持续性与因果用途需分别测量；该结论提示状态空间语言模型的工作空间解释在言语可及层面成立，但在关系型答案层面存在明显局限。

Abstract: Can the global-workspace account of transformer representations extend to state-space language models? We fit Jacobian lenses to the residual streams and recurrent states of Mamba-1, Mamba-2 and Mamba-3, using the original 1000-prompt recipe. Joint residual--state readouts improve recovery of known intermediate concepts over the residual lens on at least five of six task families in every tested Mamba checkpoint. On Mamba-2, state alone exceeds residual and logit lenses on all six families; a normalised joint readout improves on both components on five. Temporal maps and word-list experiments show earlier content remaining state-readable as residual visibility changes. We also propose sign-guarded steering, which improves target top-five success over coordinate exchange on matched verbal-report trials in five models. Recurrent state alone supports this verbal access. These gains do not extend consistently to relational answers: guarded edits often output the edited concept itself, and Mamba-3's joint edits can disrupt successful state-only redirection. Recurrent state thus provides a complementary carrier of workspace content, whose recovery, persistence and causal uses require separate measurements.

</details>


### [1451] [Escaping Alignment: A Physical Trap Model of Best-of-N Jailbreaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32116)
*Marco Biroli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战Best-of-N越狱攻击成功率服从幂律的既有观点，提出一个含四个可解释参数的热激活势垒模型，刻画完整的(N, M)攻击面及其对温度的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作认为BoN攻击成功率随N服从幂律，但本文发现该幂律指数随N漂移，存在指数交叉，属于对抗数据集的有限尺寸效应；且此前研究未系统探索完整的双预算(N, M)攻击面及其对生成温度T的依赖。

Method: 提出一个简单的势垒模型：每个提示具有基线安全水平，每次增强对应一个随机热激活势垒；由四个各自由可解释安全机制支撑的数字决定整个(N, M)攻击面。

Result: 模型可将N≤100的预测外推至N=10^4，将五个不同模型坍缩到同一标度函数上，并可由拟合温度预测其他温度下的攻击成功率。

Conclusion: BoN攻击成功率并非简单幂律，势垒模型以四个可解释参数统一描述了攻击面对N、M和温度T的依赖，具备外推与跨模型泛化能力。

Abstract: Best-of-$N$ jailbreaking (BoN) bypasses safeguards of aligned models by drawing $N$ independent augmentations of an unsafe prompt and sampling $M$ completions of each. Previous works have shown that the attack success rate (ASR) seems to follow a power-law in $N$, which we challenge. The exponent drifts with $N$, with an exponential crossover which is a finite-size artifact of the adversarial dataset. Little work has been done to explore the entire two-budget ($N, M$) attack surface as well as its dependence on the generation temperature $T$. We introduce a simple barrier model where each prompt has a baseline safety level and each augmentation a random thermally activated barrier. Then four numbers, each backed by an interpretable safety mechanism, determine the entire ($N, M$) attack surface. They extrapolate predictions from $N \leq 100$ to $N = 10^4$, collapse five distinct models on the same scaling function and predict ASR at different temperatures from the one they were fitted at.

</details>


### [1452] [READ-Bench: Benchmarking Historical Instance Retrieval for Time-Series Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32123)
*Gerardo Pastrana,Haojun Li,Dhruv Mehta,Anoushka Vyas,Sina Khoshfetrat Pakazad,Henrik Ohlsson,John Paparrizos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: READ-Bench：面向多元时间序列的历史案例检索基准，按故障/事件类型而非信号形状定义相关性。统一协议下评测显示，预训练表征在检索阶段无明显优势，少量已解决案例监督的GPR重排是关键，据此提出RRF融合+GPR重排方案，在12个数据集上均提升NDCG@10。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列诊断系统很少依赖检索相关历史案例，即便使用检索也仅通过下游预测间接评估，缺乏直接的检索评测基准与对相关性定义的共识；同时尚不清楚预训练表征是否真正优于经典检索方法，以及何种监督最有价值。

Method: 提出READ-Bench：覆盖12个诊断数据集、以多元时间序列为核心的历史案例检索基准，将相关性定义为共享故障或事件类型（相同故障的不同波形视为相关，不同故障的相似波形视为不相关）。将检索解耦为基检索器+重排器，统一协议下评测经典距离、符号检索器、自监督与基础模型嵌入及其融合，以及标签感知与语言模型重排器，并在监督、污染与语料规模变化下做显著性检验。最后以互逆秩融合（RRF）结合标准化残差评分嵌入器与DTW分支，再用高斯过程重排器（GPR）进行重排。

Result: 在通道无关的统一接口下，预训练表征用于单纯检索时相对强经典与符号基线无统计显著优势；决定性因素是重排阶段少量已解决案例监督：GPR通过在嵌入空间传播少量邻居标签，效果远超更复杂表征或语言模型推理，且在污染与全规模语料下稳健。最终方案在全部12个数据集上相较其自身检索阶段提升NDCG@10，重排带来+0.11，相较最强单一基检索器提升+0.16。

Conclusion: 历史案例检索的价值主要来自重排阶段的少量已解决案例监督，而非更强的表征或语言模型推理；以故障/事件类型定义相关性并以检索指标直接评测，可更真实反映诊断检索能力，READ-Bench与RRF+GPR方案为该方向提供了可复用的协议与强基线。

Abstract: Time-series diagnostic systems rarely rely on retrieving relevant historical cases, and when they do, retrieval is evaluated only indirectly through downstream prediction. We introduce READ-Bench, a benchmark for historical-case retrieval across 12 diagnostic datasets, centered on multivariate time series, that defines relevance by shared fault or event type rather than signal shape, so visually different traces of the same fault count as relevant while similar-looking traces of different faults do not. Treating retrieval as a base retriever followed by a reranker, we evaluate classical distances, symbolic retrievers, self-supervised and foundation-model embedders, and their fusion, plus label-aware and language-model rerankers, under one protocol that varies supervision, pollution, and corpus scale with significance testing. Under a common channel-independent interface, pretrained representations offer no statistically detectable advantage over strong classical and symbolic baselines for search alone. The decisive factor is a small amount of resolved-case supervision at reranking, namely a Gaussian-process reranker that propagates a few neighbor labels in embedding space, which helps far more than more sophisticated representations or language-model reasoning and holds under pollution and at full corpus scale. Guided by these findings, we fuse a normal-residual-scored embedder with a dynamic time warping leg via reciprocal-rank fusion, then rerank with the Gaussian-process reranker, improving NDCG@10 over its own search stage on all 12 datasets, by +0.11 from reranking and +0.16 over the strongest single base retriever.

</details>


### [1453] [PastForward: Faster On-Device GUI Agents via Computational Experience Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32166)
*Taehwan Park,Changmin Lee,Hayeon Lee,Taesik Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PastForward通过验证式细粒度复用历史计算经验来加速边缘端GUI agent，实现1.63-2.36倍延迟加速且不损失任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在边缘设备上运行GUI agent可保护屏幕与交互隐私，但每步动作的全量VLM推理计算成本过高，难以部署。现有系统要么每步做完整VLM推理，要么复用与历史任务匹配的粗粒度知识，而动态移动环境和用户任务使这种粗粒度复用受限，需额外微调或任务相关离线探索。

Method: PastForward在解码阶段检索历史输出序列作为设备自适应的多token提议，并在单次VLM前向中验证；跨动作步骤利用历史GUI转换，在当前动作执行时预先启动下一步推理，仅当预测屏幕与观测屏幕匹配时保留早期计算，并前移可复用的KV状态。

Result: 在基于真实移动使用模式构建的AndroidWorld工作负载上，使用多种VLM骨干并在服务器与边缘平台评估，设备端动作步骤延迟加速1.63-2.36倍，同时保持任务成功率。

Conclusion: 通过验证式、细粒度的计算经验复用（多token提议验证、跨步屏幕预测与KV状态前移），PastForward在边缘设备上显著降低GUI agent推理延迟且不牺牲成功率，为隐私保护的本地部署提供可行方案。

Abstract: Running GUI agents on edge devices can keep sensitive screens and interaction histories local, but the computational cost of inference at every action step makes deployment challenging. Existing GUI agent systems either perform full vision-language model (VLM) inference at each action step or reuse coarse-grained knowledge matched to prior tasks. However, dynamic mobile environments and user tasks make it difficult to fully utilize prior task executions without additional fine-tuning or task-specific offline exploration. To address this challenge, we present PastForward, a system that accelerates GUI agents through validated, fine-grained reuse of computational experience accumulated during ordinary task execution. During decoding, PastForward retrieves prior output sequences as device-adaptive multi-token proposals and verifies them in a single VLM forward pass. Across action steps, it uses prior GUI transitions to begin next-step inference while the device executes the current action, retains the early computation only when the predicted screen matches the observed screen, and carries reusable KV states forward. We evaluate PastForward on AndroidWorld workloads derived from real mobile usage patterns using multiple VLM backbones across server and edge platforms. On device, PastForward achieves action-step latency speedups of 1.63-2.36$\times$ while maintaining task success rates.

</details>


### [1454] [Noisy Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32172)
*Xikai Yang,Hieu Trung Nguyen,Dunyuan Xu,Yuzhi Zhao,Jinpeng Li,Wenao Ma,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NTRL-Code框架，利用测试阶段的无标注噪声数据实现代码大模型的鲁棒自进化，通过自去噪、AST结构聚合与混合奖励优化，显著提升多类扰动下的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实用户指令常模糊且含错误，而现有鲁棒性微调依赖成对的干净-噪声样本，标注成本高且需复杂噪声模拟技术，因此需要一种无需配对数据、可在测试阶段利用无标注噪声数据的鲁棒自进化方法。

Method: NTRL-Code框架包含三部分：1）保守自去噪，获得更干净的目标估计语义锚点；2）基于抽象语法树（AST）的结构聚合机制，从多个候选程序中估计代理目标；3）以原始噪声提示为输入，采用融合格式有效性、代码相似性与抗重复信号的混合奖励优化策略。

Result: 在三个基准上进行字符级、词级与段落级扰动实验，NTRL-Code均取得鲁棒且一致的性能提升，有效稳定了多种基座模型的预测结果。

Conclusion: NTRL-Code证明仅用测试阶段的无标注噪声数据即可实现代码大模型的鲁棒自我进化，为降低对配对干净数据依赖、提升真实场景鲁棒性提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various code-related tasks. However, unlike carefully curated datasets that are typically high-quality and error-free, real-world user instructions are often vague and error-prone, posing significant challenges to the robustness of code LLMs. Furthermore, robustness-oriented fine-tuning relies on paired clean-noisy samples, which are costly to curate and require sophisticated noisy simulation techniques. To address these challenges, we propose the Noisy Test-time Reinforcement Learning framework (NTRL-Code), which enables robust self-evolution of code LLMs using only unlabeled noisy data during the testing stage. Specifically, NTRL-Code uses conservative self-denoising to obtain a cleaner semantic anchor for target estimation, and employs an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-based structural aggregation mechanism to estimate a proxy target from multiple candidate programs. The policy is then optimized on the original noisy prompts with a hybrid reward that combines format validity, code similarity, and anti-repetition signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks, each incorporating character-level, word-level, and paragraph-level perturbations, demonstrate that NTRL-Code yields robust and consistent improvements, stabilizing the predictions of various base models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xikai97/NTRL-Code.

</details>


### [1455] [AI Harness: Certification under Proposal-Conditioned Information for Foundation-Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32184)
*Hailin Zhong,Shengxin Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了基础模型智能体的认证问题：当运行时仅在模型给出语义提案（proposal）后介入时，把"历史条件下的提案过程"塌缩为仅依赖状态的提案包络，虽然能保持提案覆盖率，却会破坏可认证性。作者刻画了塌缩无损的充要条件（每个提案条件下的塌缩纤维存在共同鲁棒安全介入），并将单步结论推广到时序上的安全与可达性不动点，区分了"无限可运行性"与"有限最坏情况可验证进展"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署中的基础模型智能体并非简单的"状态→动作"策略：运行时往往在模型输出语义提案之后才介入，因此提案既是动作候选，又是历史条件过程产生的决策时刻观测。既有做法常将这一结构塌缩为仅依赖状态的提案包络，作者旨在揭示这种塌缩在保持覆盖率的同时可能破坏认证性，并给出其成立与失效的边界条件。

Method: 作者构造有限鲁棒接口模型，分别定义历史增广模型与塌缩（状态仅依赖）模型的可行核（viability kernel），证明塌缩模型的核包含于历史增广核的物理投影中；证明塌缩无损当且仅当每个"提案条件下的塌缩纤维"保留共同的鲁棒安全介入动作。进一步借助精确有限信念与标准安全/可达性不动点，将单步结论推广到多步时序，区分无限期可运行可行性与有限最坏情况可验证进展，并用受控的 model-in-the-loop 实验验证理论预测。

Result: 即使提案字母表与历史字母表规模恒定，塌缩带来的可行核差距也可达到最大。同一"共同动作"条件还给出对偶结论：当观测当前提案能够分离出需要不兼容介入的潜在模式时，观测量提案可恢复鲁棒可行性。受控 model-in-the-loop 测试在移除遥测或效果验证、或限制介入权限时，复现了所预测的阻碍现象。

Conclusion: 论文的贡献不在于提出新的不动点演算，而在于刻画了模型—工具边界上"提案—历史相关性"何时对认证是必要的：只有当提案条件下的塌缩纤维存在共同鲁棒安全介入时，状态仅依赖的塌缩才是无损的，否则必须保留提案与历史的关联信息才能实现认证。

Abstract: Foundation-model agents are often modeled as policies over an observed state. In deployed systems, however, a runtime may intervene only after the model has emitted a semantic proposal, making the proposal both an action candidate and a decision-time observation generated by a history-conditioned process. We show that collapsing this structure into a state-only proposal envelope can preserve proposal coverage while destroying certifiability. In a finite robust interface, the viability kernel of the collapsed model is contained in the physical projection of the history-augmented kernel, and the collapse is lossless exactly when every proposal-conditioned collapsed fiber retains a common robust-safe intervention. This gap can be maximal even with constant-size proposal and history alphabets. The same common-action condition yields a dual result: observing the current proposal can restore robust feasibility when it separates latent modes requiring incompatible interventions. We extend these one-step results over time using exact finite beliefs and standard safety and reachability fixed points, separating indefinite operational viability from finite worst-case verified progress. Controlled model-in-the-loop tests reproduce the predicted obstructions when telemetry or effect verification is removed or intervention authority is restricted. Thus, our contribution is not a new fixed-point calculus, but a characterization of when proposal--history correlation at the model--tool boundary is necessary for certification.

</details>


### [1456] [CoMemBench: Benchmarking Collaborative Memory Boundaries across Multi-Agent Workflow Topologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32192)
*Sen Zhao,Ruiqi Kong,Zuyu Zhang,Lifeng Shen,Xinyu He,Ding Zou,Xu Zhang,Qinghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CoMemBench 基准，用于评测多智能体工作流拓扑下"协作记忆边界"（任务相关信息的共享与隔离）问题，包含四个领域 800 个复合工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体工作流既需跨智能体共享任务相关信息，又须隔离无关、过时、未验证或不兼容的信息，这一"任务条件化信息范围"被称为协作记忆边界。该边界受工作流拓扑影响（决定哪些中间产物对哪些下游工作者适用、何时失效），但现有记忆基准侧重留存与检索、多智能体基准侧重协调与端到端完成，拓扑条件化的记忆边界未被有效度量。

Method: 构建 CoMemBench：基于有据可依的依赖图，跨四个领域生成 800 个复合工作流，配以节点局部规范、可验证的产物交接、原生评测器以及配对的隔离挑战；度量工作流完成度、经核验的节点进展、必需交接可靠性、隔隔离鲁棒性与 token 成本。

Result: 实验揭示共享—隔离权衡：更宽的上下文提升信息可用性，却可能削弱隔离；系统排名在不同拓扑与产物违规条件下发生变动。

Conclusion: CoMemBench 将协作记忆边界作为可度量的结构维度，表明拓扑与产物违规会改变系统排序，提示未来多智能体记忆评测需同时关注共享收益与隔离成本。

Abstract: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated. We call this task-conditioned scope of information a collaborative memory boundary. Workflow topology determines which intermediate artifacts are applicable to which downstream workers and when they cease to be valid, thereby providing a structural stress dimension for sharing and isolation. Existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate retention and retrieval, whereas multi-agent benchmarks emphasize coordination and end-to-end completion, leaving topology-conditioned memory boundaries largely unmeasured. We introduce CoMemBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for collaborative memory sharing and isolation across multi-agent workflow topologies. It constructs 800 composite workflows across four domains from source-grounded dependency graphs, with node-local specifications, verifiable artifact handoffs, native evaluators, and matched isolation challenges. CoMemBench measures workflow completion, verified node progress, required-handoff reliability, isolation robustness, and token cost. Experiments reveal a sharing-isolation trade-off: broader context improves information availability but can weaken isolation, while system rankings shift across topologies and artifact violations.

</details>


### [1457] [Instruct, Not Answer: Using Instruction Privileges in On-Policy Context Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32201)
*Hantao Yu,Sandy Han,Udaya Ghai,Ferhat Erata,Joe Lilien,Aman Goel,Ali Torkamani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用通用指令（针对学生常见错误设计）替代实例级gold答案/示例作为On-Policy Context Distillation的特权信息，在多个推理/自动形式化任务上显著提升OOD准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OPCD研究通常将实例专属的gold答案或gold示范作为默认特权信息，但该做法在分布外（OOD）场景下会损害训练性能，亟需一种更具可迁移性的特权设计。

Method: 从训练样本中学生常见错误出发，设计仅含数句、对所有训练样本统一施加的通用指令作为特权信息，用它条件化教师模型，并在学生生成token上最小化教师与学生的KL散度（即OPCD框架）；在自动形式化任务及ProverQA、ProofWriter、ProntoQA数据集上，以Qwen3-Thinking与Olmo3-Thinking系列模型进行验证。

Result: 在8组实验中的7组，匹配的指令型特权在OOD准确率上比gold高4–17个点，同时在域内性能与gold持平；自动形式化任务中，匹配格式指令作为特权在OOD准确率上大幅超越gold。

Conclusion: 通用指令虽信息量远少于实例级gold，却能同等适用于源域与目标域样本，比实例级gold在OPCD中更具可迁移性，且在域内性能不下降，说明特权信息的设计原则应从"实例专属"转向"通用错误针对性"。

Abstract: On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) has recently emerged as a powerful technique for transferring context to student models and for self-improvement. In OPCD, the teacher is conditioned on privileged information, and the goal is to minimize the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the privileged teacher and the student, evaluated on student-generated tokens. Many existing studies show that using instance-specific gold answers or gold demonstrations as the default privilege can hurt training performance, especially out-of-distribution (OOD). In this work, we instead design general instructions that target common student mistakes observed on the training samples, and show that such simple instructions can outperform gold as the OPCD privilege. In autoformalization tasks, using a matched formatting instruction as the privilege could outperform gold in OOD accuracy by a large margin. In 7 out of 8 experiments using ProverQA, ProofWriter, and ProntoQA as datasets, and Qwen3-Thinking and Olmo3-Thinking families as models, matched instruction privileges outperform gold in OOD by 4 to 17 points, while remaining on par with gold in-domain. Each instruction is only a few sentences (and thus contains much less information compared to all instance-specific gold) and is applied uniformly to every training sample. These results indicate that a general instruction, which applies equally to source and target domain examples, can be substantially more transferable than instance-specific gold in OPCD while maintaining in-domain performance.

</details>


### [1458] [Witness: Discovery, Deciphering, and Epiphany in Interactive Puzzle Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32208)
*Guanghan Ning,Ping Liu,Linyi Li,Huangjie Zheng,Arjun Neervannan,Huu Nguyen,Michael Sklar,Deniz Zorlu,Nicolai Ouporov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WITNESS，一个具有真值ASCII观测与受控规则访问的2D网格交互式规则发现谜题环境，并构建WitnessGym（RL训练套件）与WitnessBench（公开验证集+私有测试集），系统评估语言模型在隐藏规则发现与执行上的能力边界及RL的迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化科学需要智能体通过与环境交互推断陌生环境的规则。交互式规则发现谜题提供了研究该能力的受控场景，但当前语言模型在该任务上的瓶颈尚不明确，RL能否提升对训练外规则的性能也缺乏实证。

Method: 提出WITNESS环境：2D网格谜题，提供真值ASCII观测并可控地暴露规则。通过agentic pipeline自动生成游戏，形成WitnessGym（RL训练）与WitnessBench（公开验证集与私有测试集）。验证集分别测试已训练规则原语的新组合与训练中未出现的原语。在统一harness下评测18个前沿闭源与开源模型，并做规则提供消融与RL训练实验，同时在四个外部发现类基准上测试迁移。

Result: 18个模型中最优者在私有测试关卡槽位仅解出24%，得分对观测接口与智能体配置敏感。提供真值规则后Opus-5的验证RHAE-L5从59.9升至97.8，而27B开源模型仅提升2.1分且即便给出规则仍受限。WitnessGym上RL使27B模型私有测试RHAE-L5从2.1升至5.4，并在四个外部发现基准上平均提升4.1分。

Conclusion: 规则获取是前沿模型（如Opus-5）的主要难点，较小模型在规则执行层面进一步受限；在隐藏规则谜题上做RL可迁移到更广泛的规则任务与真实世界任务，表明该训练范式具有泛化价值。基准已开源。

Abstract: Automated science needs agents that can work out the rules of an unfamiliar environment by interacting with it. Interactive rule-discovery puzzles offer a controlled setting for studying this ability: an agent infers hidden rules through experimentation and uses what it has inferred to reach a stated goal. We ask what limits current language models on these puzzles and whether reinforcement learning (RL) improves performance on rules held out from training. To study both, we introduce WITNESS, a 2D grid-based puzzle environment with ground-truth ASCII observations and controlled access to rules. An agentic pipeline generates games for WitnessGym, the RL training suite, and WitnessBench, comprising public validation and private test games. The validation set separately tests new compositions of trained rule primitives and primitives absent from training. Under a shared harness, the best of 18 frontier proprietary and open-weight models solves only 24\% of private test level slots, with scores sensitive to the observation interface and agent configuration. Providing ground-truth rules raises Opus-5's validation RHAE-L5 (relative human action efficiency over the first five levels) from 59.9 to 97.8, whereas a 27B open-weight model gains only 2.1 points and remains limited even with the rules provided. RL on WitnessGym raises the 27B model's private test RHAE-L5 from 2.1 to 5.4 and yields a mean gain of 4.1 points on four external discovery benchmarks. Together, these results point to rule acquisition as a major difficulty for frontier models like Opus-5 while smaller models further struggle on rule-based execution, and indicate that RL on hidden-rule puzzles transfers to broader rules and real-world tasks beyond training. Benchmark is available at: https://witnessbench.ai

</details>


### [1459] [Fracast-0: Fractal Weight Sharing for a Time Series Foundation Model with Only 85K Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32209)
*Tianxiang Zhan,Huanyao Zhang,Yuanpeng He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Fracast-0 是一个仅 85,001 参数的概率时间序列基础模型，利用跨尺度权重复用实现多域、多尺度概率预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型需同时保持多域广度、概率输出与多时间尺度建模能力，但为每个尺度单独设计表示会导致参数量急剧膨胀，难以压缩。

Method: 利用时间自相似性在尺度间复用一个算子：用无参数检测器提取显著季节结构；编码器在几何膨胀阶梯上应用共享局部块并进行尺度条件化；解码器将上下文聚合状态与显式季节未来状态结合，并在另一条阶梯上复用第二个块，最终输出九个分位数；在六个语料库上预训练。

Result: 在 97 个 GIFT-Eval 配置上无需逐数据集微调：Fracast-0 是 28 个评测检查点中最小的，在参数-精度聚合平面上保持非支配，MASE 0.808、WQL 0.564；比 TinyCast 少 42.0% 参数，而 MASE 与 WQL 分别仅低 4.2% 和 3.3%。

Conclusion: 跨尺度权重复用是进一步压缩时间序列基础模型的可行路径。

Abstract: Time series foundation models must preserve multi-domain breadth, probabilistic output, and multiple temporal scales, but parameter count grows when each scale receives a separate representation. We introduce Fracast-0, a probabilistic forecasting foundation model that exploits temporal self-similarity to reuse one operator across scales. A parameter-free detector extracts significant seasonal structure. The encoder applies a shared local block along a geometric dilation ladder with scale conditioning, while the decoder combines context-gathered states with an explicit seasonal future state and reuses a second block along another ladder before emitting nine quantiles. Pretraining across six corpora preserves multi-domain breadth within 85,001 parameters. On 97 GIFT-Eval configurations without per-dataset fine-tuning, Fracast-0 is the smallest of 28 evaluated checkpoints and remains non-dominated in the aggregate parameter-accuracy plane with MASE 0.808 and WQL 0.564. It uses 42.0% fewer parameters than TinyCast, whose MASE and WQL are 4.2% and 3.3% lower. These results support cross-scale weight reuse as a practical route to further time series foundation model compression.

</details>


### [1460] [A bilingual AI audiologist built through rubric-guided playbook induction outperforms human audiologists in a blinded evaluation of simulated cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32220)
*Linkai Li,Changgeng Mo,Hanlin Yu,Congxi Lu,Shangqiguo Wang,Matthew B Fitzgerald,Shan X Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出双语AI听力学家，在未微调大模型主干的情况下，通过评分表引导的“剧本”归纳、多模态听力图解读与检索增强，实现了超越人类听力师的模拟问诊表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 听力学问诊需要结构化病史采集、听力图判读与以患者为中心的沟通，但真实病例材料稀缺，制约了相关系统开发与评测。

Method: 将通用大语言模型与评分表引导的剧本归纳、多模态听力图解读、检索增强接地相结合，不微调语言模型主干；基于21项评分表与AI患者模拟器，从73例训练病例（43英、30中）归纳出19条问诊策略，并在58例独立模拟病例（30中、28英）上以预先设定、来源盲法的方式与17名执业听力师对比。

Result: AI听力学家在每一例上均优于人类听力师（58/58；5分制复合评分平均配对Δ=+1.35，Cohen's d=1.84，P=4.5×10⁻²⁰），并在21项评分表中的20项及中英双语中均占优；消融实验显示“剧本”组件贡献最大。

Conclusion: 评分表引导的剧本归纳是性能提升的主要来源，为低数据医疗领域的专科问诊智能体提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Audiology consultation requires structured history-taking, audiometric interpretation and patient-centred communication, yet real-world case material is scarce. We present a bilingual AI audiologist pairing a general-purpose large language model with rubric-guided playbook induction, multimodal audiogram interpretation and retrieval-augmented grounding, without fine-tuning the language-model backbone. Using a 21-item rubric and an AI patient simulator, we induced a 19-rule consultation policy from 73 training cases (43 English, 30 Chinese) and evaluated the system on 58 independent simulated cases (30 Chinese, 28 English) in a pre-specified, source-blinded comparison with 17 practising audiologists. The AI audiologist outperformed human audiologists on every case (58/58; mean paired $Δ$ = +1.35 on a 5-point composite, Cohen's d = 1.84, $P = 4.5 \times 10^{-20}$), on 20 of 21 rubric items and in both languages. Component ablation identified the playbook as the largest contributor, offering a practical route to specialist consultation agents in low-data medical domains.

</details>


### [1461] [RAO-Nav: Probing Omni-Language Models for Zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32224)
*Qilang Ye,Meng Liu,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAO-Nav，一种面向零样本语义音频视觉导航（SAVN）的全能语言模型（OLM）部署管线，并设计测试时隐式导航推理（LNR）模块，无需训练数据即在公开基准上超越现有最优方法，同时提出全局导航指令新设定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有专用模型即便经大量任务特定训练，仍难以实现通用多模态导航；本文探索能否将全能语言模型（OLM）直接用于零样本语义音频视觉导航。

Method: 提出 RAO-Nav 部署管线，利用 OLM 中隐含的丰富音频-视觉知识，使具身智能体能够"听""看""推理""行动"；并设计可无缝集成到解码空间的测试时隐式导航推理（LNR）模块，引导模型检索更多目标相关观测并做出有效导航决策。

Result: 在公开 SAVN 基准上，无需任何训练数据即超越现有最优基线；此外提出新的全局导航指令设定，用于进一步评估 OLM 作为具身导航智能体的能力。

Conclusion: OLM 结合 LNR 可有效实现零样本 SAVN，展现通用多模态具身导航潜力，代码已开源。

Abstract: We explore whether Omni-Language Models (OLMs) can be directly applied to zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation (SAVN). Recent work demonstrates that even state-of-the-art specialized models still struggle to achieve generalist multimodal navigation, despite extensive task-specific training. In this paper, we introduce RAO-Nav, short for Reasoning All-in-One OLM, a deployment pipeline for zero-shot SAVN. By leveraging the rich implicit audio-visual knowledge encoded in OLMs, the embodied agent is enabled to ``hear'', ``see'', ``reason'', and ``act'' in the environment. To further elicit the built-in thinking ability of OLMs, we propose a test-time Latent Navigation Reasoning (LNR) module that can be seamlessly integrated into the decoding space. LNR encourages the model to retrieve more target-relevant observations and make effective navigation decisions. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that our framework surpasses existing state-of-the-art baselines on public SAVN benchmarks without using any training data. Moreover, we introduce a new \emph{Global Navigation Instruction} setting to further evaluate the ability of OLMs to serve as embodied navigation agents. Code: https://github.com/rikeilong/OmniAV\_Nav.

</details>


### [1462] [Certifying Interventional Agreement Among Observationally Equivalent Causal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32247)
*Sourena Khanzadeh,Daniel Platnick,Marjan Alirezaie,Hossein Rahnama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出干预分离选择（ISS），用可容许干预反复查询真实系统来缩减候选因果模型集合，直至无法在成本约束内再分离，从而在没有真值时给出对所有可容许干预一致的证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观测等价并不等于干预等价：干预会引入观测数据中从未出现的输入，因此纯观测学习器无论看多少数据都无法区分这些模型，需要能够主动干预并给出保证的方法。

Method: ISS 迭代地在幸存候选模型存在分歧的可容许干预上查询真实系统，剔除与结果矛盾的候选；当在成本界内不存在可分离干预时停止。停止条件是仅依赖幸存者的，因此无需真值即可检验；对连续变量，候选构成无限版本空间，用混合整数线性规划在所有候选上精确判定停止条件，一致性在容差范围内成立。

Result: 在三位数彩色 MNIST 因果抽象任务（墨色色调指示数字大小）上，普通卷积网络达到零留出误差，但在 26% 的单数字编辑上与基于形状的标签不一致，和基于色调标签的不一致率相当。ISS 以平均每图 13.6 次干预为每个网络的因果抽象出具证书，且当网络真实抽象在候选集中时证书对每个可容许干预均成立。当网络绕过所有候选抽象都依赖的某个单元时，覆盖该单元干预的证书可能静默失效，二十个随机验证干预即可驳斥其中 69%。

Conclusion: ISS 相比观测学习器能提供更强的干预级保证，并可用于审计仅在观测图像上训练的网络所感知到的因果抽象；但证书存在静默失效风险，需针对被绕过的单元进行验证。

Abstract: Observationally equivalent causal models can still disagree about what happens under intervention, because interventions create inputs that never occur in observational data. We introduce Interventional Separation Selection (ISS), which repeatedly queries the true system with an admissible intervention on which the surviving candidate models disagree, discards the candidates the outcome contradicts, and stops once no intervention within a cost bound separates the survivors. If the true system is among the candidates, this stopping condition certifies that every survivor agrees with it on every admissible intervention within the bound, a guarantee that no observational learner can give, however much data it sees. The stopping condition depends only on the survivors, so it can be checked without knowing the truth. For continuous variables the candidates form an infinite version space, and mixed-integer linear programs decide the stopping condition exactly over all of it, with agreement holding up to a tolerance. On a three-digit colored MNIST causal abstraction task in which ink hue tracks digit size, plain convolutional networks trained on examples reach zero held-out error, yet disagree with shape-based labels on 26% of single-digit edits, as often as hue-based labels do. Auditing the causal abstractions of networks observed only on such images, ISS certifies what each network perceives with 13.6 interventions per image on average, and each certificate, checked against every admissible intervention, holds whenever the network's true abstraction is among the candidates. When a network bypasses a unit that every candidate abstraction relies on, certificates covering interventions on that unit can be silently void, and twenty random validation interventions refute 69% of them.

</details>


### [1463] [Why Directly Learning Periodic Trajectories Can Fail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32254)
*Kaixin Zheng,Anita Layton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 周期性解的算子学习受数据记录与表示方式显著影响：未对齐轨迹难以学习，固定物理时间窗模型对训练范围外周期误差大；根因是频率差随时间累积导致相位随参数快速变化。将“对齐归一化波形”与“周期”解耦学习可避开该误差下限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 周期性解的算子学习需要决定仿真数据如何记录与表示。直觉上应积分足够久使瞬态衰减，并记录宽到至少包含所有轨迹一个完整周期的窗口，但这种“保守”做法可能使轨迹难以学习，即使周期轨道随参数规则变化。作者希望解释这些失败机制并给出可学习的表示。

Method: 1）分析两类失败：未对齐轨迹的分布内泛化差；固定物理时间窗模型对训练周期范围之外的轨迹误差大。2）提出共同机制：频率差异随时间累积，目标相位随参数快速变化，无法跟踪该变化的预测器产生群体MSE下限；对固定窗预测进一步推导逐样本下界。3）研究简单表征：分离学习“对齐、归一化的波形”及其“周期”，在ODE假设下证明解耦目标的正则性，并在ODE系统与一个PDE案例上实验验证。

Result: 未对齐轨迹即使在训练分布内也泛化很差；相位对齐显著改善分布内泛化，但基于固定物理时间窗训练的模型在周期超出训练范围的轨迹上仍有较大误差。作者用统一的相位随参数变化过快机制解释两种失败，并给出群体MSE下限及固定窗的逐样本下界。解耦学习对齐归一化波形与周期的方法在ODE系统和PDE案例中避免了这两类失败。

Conclusion: 周期性解的数据表示不应简单采用“长积分+宽窗”的保守策略；相位对齐是必要但不充分的，固定物理时间窗受周期外推限制。将波形与周期解耦学习是一种简单且具正则性保证的替代表示，能同时规避相位漂移导致的误差下限与周期外推失败。

Abstract: Operator learning of periodic solutions requires deciding how simulation data should be recorded and represented. A natural choice is to integrate long enough for transients to decay and record a window wide enough to contain at least one full period of all trajectories. We find that these conservative choices can make the resulting trajectories difficult to learn, even when the underlying periodic orbits vary regularly with system parameters. Unaligned trajectories generalize poorly even within the training distribution. Phase alignment substantially improves in-distribution generalization, but models trained on a fixed physical-time window still have large errors on trajectories with periods outside the training range. We explain both failures through a common mechanism: frequency differences accumulate over time, so the target phase varies rapidly with the parameters. Predictors that cannot track this variation incur a population MSE floor in both settings; for fixed window prediction, we also derive a per-sample lower bound. We then study one of the simplest representations that escape these floors: learning an aligned, normalized waveform and its period separately. We establish regularity of the decoupled targets under ODE assumptions and show experimentally that this approach avoids both failures in ODE systems and a PDE case study.

</details>


### [1464] [LAM: Efficient Lossy Agent Memory Framework With A Retrieval-Score Error Bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32256)
*Baixi Sun,Le Chen,Anjir Ahmed Chowdhury,Xiaolong Ma,Chih-Hsuan Yang,Mingze Xia,Syed Zawad,Sheng Di,Rajkumar Kettimuthu,Huihuo Zheng,Rajeev Thakur,Venkatram Vishwanath,Feng Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LAM（Lossy Agent Memory）系统，通过确定性去重规则、保留缓存前缀并重叠压缩的内存管理器、以及部署前估算压缩代价的性能模型，在600条Agent轨迹上移除22.47%观测token并保留99.984%的gold-patch证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent记忆随读取输入、推理和工具调用不断增长，过长的历史会提高推理成本并最终超出上下文窗口。基于LLM的摘要虽能压缩历史，但增加延迟且对信息损失没有明确界限。

Method: LAM包含三个组件：（1）确定性去重规则，附带检索分数的替换界（对分数扰动的上界，而非排序不变的保证）；（2）内存管理器，保留已缓存前缀并将压缩与推理重叠；（3）性能模型，在部署前估计压缩代价。

Result: 在600条Agent轨迹上，LAM移除22.47%的观测token，同时保留99.984%的测得gold-patch证据。在固定删除集合下，性能模型预测：在prefill前移除记录相比从已prefill上下文中删除，可获得71.4倍至91.6倍的端到端加速。

Conclusion: 该收益主要来自调度方式而非去重规则本身，且适用于任何保持前缀的测试。

Abstract: Agent memory grows as agents read inputs, reason, and call tools. Longer histories increase inference cost and eventually exceed the context window. LLM-based summarization reduces this history but adds latency and provides no explicit bound on information loss. We propose LAM, a Lossy Agent Memory system with three components: a deterministic deduplication rule with a substitution bound on retrieval scores - a bound on score perturbation, not a certificate of unchanged ranking; a memory manager that preserves the cached prefix and overlaps compaction with inference; and a performance model that estimates compaction costs before deployment. On 600 agent trajectories, LAM removes 22.47% of observation tokens while retaining 99.984% of the measured gold-patch evidence. At a fixed deletion set, the performance model predicts a 71.4x-91.6x end-to-end speedup from removing records before prefill instead of deleting them from a prefilled context. That benefit comes from the schedule rather than the rule and applies to any prefix-preserving test.

</details>


### [1465] [Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32259)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Woosang Lim,Haneul Yoo,Sungjoo Yoo,Murali Annavaram,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HeteroFold：一种免预填充的跨模型家族 KV 缓存传输方法，保持发送方与接收方参数冻结。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统常用异构模型承担专门角色，但文本通信要求接收方重新预填充发送方已处理的共享上下文，造成冗余计算。直接复用发送方 KV 缓存可避免重复预填充，然而跨模型家族传输面临分词、模型深度、KV 表示差异等障碍。

Method: HeteroFold 统一保持发送方与接收方冻结：1) 对齐模型结构；2) 将发送方缓存映射到接收方空间；3) 进行校准以保持接收方行为。

Result: 在六个传输方向上，HeteroFold 在四个长上下文基准上均取得最佳缓存传输性能，在多数短上下文设置中亦最佳；在多智能体基准上匹配文本通信效果。32K 上下文下，Llama-3.1-8B→Ministral-3-14B 传输比 Native Prefill 快 10.7 倍，比 SOTA 免预填充基线 Dense Latent 与 KV Ridge 快 1.18–1.47 倍。

Conclusion: HeteroFold 无需接收方预填充即可实现高效的跨模型家族 KV 复用。

Abstract: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. However, text-based communication requires each receiver to prefill shared context already processed by the sender. Reusing the sender's key-value (KV) cache avoids this redundancy, but prefill-free transfer across model families must handle differences in tokenization, model depth, and KV representations. To address these issues, we propose \textit{HeteroFold}, a prefill-free cross-family KV cache transfer method that keeps both the sender and receiver frozen. HeteroFold aligns model structures, maps the sender cache into the receiver space, and calibrates it to preserve receiver behavior. Across six transfer directions, HeteroFold achieves the best cache-transfer performance on all four long-context benchmarks and most short-context settings. It also matches text-based communication on the multi-agent benchmark. At 32K context length, Llama-3.1-8B$\rightarrow$Ministral-3-14B transfer is $10.7\times$ faster than Native Prefill and $1.18$--$1.47\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art prefill-free baselines, Dense Latent and KV Ridge. These results show that HeteroFold enables efficient cross-family KV reuse without receiver prefill.

</details>


### [1466] [When Does a Skill Add Value? Task-Conditional Gain Prediction for Selective Skill Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32274)
*Anjie Xu,Zhiyu Zhang,Ruiqing Ding,Fengli Xu,Leye Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SkillDelta 框架，通过同一智能体在有/无技能条件下的配对执行历史，预测任务条件下的技能增益，从而在行动前判断技能是否有效，避免无效技能带来的性能下降与额外 token 开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能本应提升任务表现，但实践中常无收益，甚至损害性能并增加 token 成本。因此需要一种在智能体执行前预测技能能否带来收益的方法。

Method: SkillDelta 利用同一智能体在同一任务上“使用技能/不使用技能”的配对执行数据来估计技能增益；采用局部预测器将历史增益迁移到新任务，无需重新训练智能体；并在显式迁移假设下，从支持覆盖率、表示不匹配和执行噪声三方面分析预测误差与决策后悔。

Result: 在 5 个基准、3 个目标智能体上共 15 种设置中，配对历史在 12 种设置中相较仅用技能辅助结果提升了观测增益排序；在匹配期望技能使用率下，SkillDelta 在全部 15 种设置中均优于随机激活，平均绝对成功率提升 4.3%；该优势主要来自任务组间分配；组内选择收益在 ToolQA 上最明显，其他场景较弱。

Conclusion: 技能效益可被任务条件化预测；配对执行历史能有效指导技能的选择与分配，其中跨任务组的分配是主要收益来源，而细粒度组内选择的增益具有场景依赖性。

Abstract: Agent skills are expected to improve task performance. Yet we find that they often provide no benefit, and can even hurt performance while incurring additional token costs. Can we predict whether a skill will help before the agent acts? We introduce SkillDelta, a framework for predicting task-conditional skill gains from paired executions of the same agent with and without the skill. A local predictor transfers these historical gains to new tasks without retraining the agent. Under explicit transfer assumptions, our analysis links support coverage, representation mismatch, and execution noise to prediction error and decision regret. Across five benchmarks and three target agents, paired history improves observed-gain ranking over skill-assisted outcomes alone in 12 of 15 settings. At matched expected skill-use rates, SkillDelta improves success over random activation in all 15 settings, with an average absolute gain of 4.3%. Most of this advantage comes from allocation across task groups. Evidence for additional within-group selection value is strongest on ToolQA and weaker elsewhere. Code is available at https://github.com/TankTechnology/skilldelta.

</details>


### [1467] [GLIDE: Generalized Layer-wise Intrinsic Distributional Evaluation for Heterogeneous LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32295)
*Wei Zhu,Yiming Wang,Rui Wang,Lixing Yu,Kun Yue,Zhiwen Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GLIDE，一种面向LLM智能体的广义层级内在分布评估方法，从逐层残差一致性提取步骤级内在证据，经生成智能体近期分数分布校准后转为悲观奖励，用于MCTS分支选择与自适应分支，无需外部验证器或任务特定监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体需要可靠的步骤级评估以比较候选分支并有效分配计算，但轻量评估困难：外部验证器带来额外推理开销，而智能体自产的置信度或自评估分数可能失准，尤其在候选由异构智能体生成时。

Method: GLIDE从层级残差一致性中提取内在步骤证据，衡量局部残差更新是否一致支持候选步骤引起的全局残差变化；将该证据针对生成智能体的近期分数分布进行校准，转化为同时考虑绝对残差证据与智能体相对位置的悲观奖励；该奖励为MCTS分支选择提供跨智能体价值信号，归一化预测不确定性则指导自适应分支。

Result: 在多跳推理、序列决策与符号逻辑任务上，GLIDE提升了任务表现、步骤级排序质量和计算效率，且无需外部验证器或任务特定监督。

Conclusion: GLIDE以层级内在分布证据实现轻量、跨智能体的步骤级评估，为LLM智能体的分支比较与计算分配提供有效且高效的价值信号，具备跨任务通用性。

Abstract: LLM agents require reliable step-level evaluation to compare candidate branches and allocate computation effectively. However, lightweight evaluation remains challenging. External verifiers introduce additional inference cost, while agent-produced confidence or self-evaluation scores can be miscalibrated, especially when candidates are generated by heterogeneous agents. We propose \textbf{G}eneralized \textbf{L}ayer-wise \textbf{I}ntrinsic \textbf{D}istributional \textbf{E}valuation (\textbf{GLIDE}) for LLM agents. \textsc{GLIDE} derives intrinsic step evidence from layer-wise residual coherence, which measures whether local residual updates consistently support the global residual change induced by a candidate step. It calibrates this evidence against the recent score distribution of the generating agent and converts it into a pessimistic reward that jointly accounts for absolute residual evidence and agent-relative standing. The reward provides a cross-agent value signal for MCTS branch selection, while normalized predictive uncertainty guides adaptive branching. Experiments on multi-hop reasoning, sequential decision making, and symbolic logic show that \textsc{GLIDE} improves task performance, step-level ranking quality, and computational efficiency without external verifiers or task-specific supervision.

</details>


### [1468] [Train4Merge: A Controlled Single-Teacher Study of RL vs. SFT Teachers for OPD-Based Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32303)
*Jingyuan Huang,Zuming Huang,Yucheng Shi,Zhongzhi Li,Xiaoming Zhai,Wei Chu,Ninghao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究on-policy distillation (OPD)中教师模型构建方式的选择：对比SFT教师与RL教师对学生的指导效果，发现同等性能下RL教师显著更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师OPD通常将领域专家蒸馏合并为单一模型，但一个上游关键选择长期未被检验：构建各专家时应用监督微调（SFT）还是强化学习（RL）。由于性能相当的教师未必是同样好的教师，需探究哪种教师更利于学生。

Method: 采用受控的单教师OPD实验（多教师OPD的基本单元），在Agentic、Reasoning、Perception三个任务上，从Qwen3.5-9B出发分别训练性能相当的SFT教师与RL教师，各自指导学生（学生同样由该共享checkpoint初始化）。

Result: 在各自最优checkpoint下，RL指导的学生在Agentic、Reasoning、Perception上分别比SFT指导学生高4.27、1.50、0.86个百分点，并更多地恢复了教师相对基座的性能增益。Agentic中差距最明显：SFT指导学生仅恢复教师增益的44.44%，而RL指导学生恢复115.00%，甚至超越教师。

Conclusion: RL教师比SFT教师更靠近共享初始化（参数空间上偏离更小），因此更易于被学生跟随，这解释了RL-guided OPD的显著优势。

Abstract: Domain experts trained from a shared checkpoint can be merged into one model through on-policy distillation (OPD), where they act as teachers supervising a student on its own trajectories. One upstream choice is rarely examined: whether to build each expert with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL). Yet equally strong teachers need not be equally good teachers. We probe this choice through controlled single-teacher OPD, a building block of multi-teacher OPD: in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, comparably performing SFT and RL teachers are trained from Qwen3.5-9B, each guiding a student initialized from it. At their best checkpoints, RL-guided students outperform SFT-guided students by 4.27, 1.50, and 0.86 percentage points in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, respectively, and recover more of their teachers' performance gains over the base model. The contrast is clearest in Agentic, where the best SFT-guided student recovers only 44.44% of its teacher's gain, whereas the best RL-guided student recovers 115.00%, surpassing its teacher. Our analysis points to an explanation: RL teachers stay much closer to the shared initialization in parameter space than SFT teachers and are therefore easier for their students to follow.

</details>


### [1469] [PhiFold: Towards Dynamic Protein Design with Physics-Structured Covariance Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32309)
*Yutian Liu,Mujie Lin,LanqianZhang,Meng Fan,Chang Liu,ZhiweiNie,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhiFold 提出了一种联合生成蛋白质骨架及其二阶动力学（残基位移协方差）的框架，通过将动力学分解为局部柔性、低秩集体运动表示和残基级集体参与度三个可解释成分，避免了直接预测二次规模的完整协方差，并实现了物理约束下的紧凑平衡动力学表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质生成模型通常将动力学视为结构生成后的下游属性，通过模拟或预测来估计；而直接以MD轨迹作为生成目标又不理想，因为随机、路径依赖的轨迹会过度指定潜在的平衡系综。因此需要一种能显式、紧凑地表征平衡动力学的方法。

Method: PhiFold 将动力学分解为三个可解释成分：局部柔性、低秩集体运动表示以及残基级集体参与度；随后将这些成分组装为具有精确边缘一致性的正定协方差矩阵，从而以紧凑且物理受限的形式表示平衡动力学。

Result: 在生成的蛋白质中，PhiFold 提升了对局部涨落和长程残基耦合的恢复能力，同时在主导集体运动子空间上保持竞争力；它还支持残基柔性的双向控制，并保持骨架可设计性。

Conclusion: PhiFold 将结构生成与平衡动力学的显式表示统一起来，为不仅按“外观”而且按“运动方式”设计蛋白质奠定了基础。

Abstract: Protein design is moving beyond structural correctness toward function-aware design, yet existing generative models typically treat dynamics as a downstream property estimated through simulation or prediction after structure generation. Using MD trajectories as a generative target is also undesirable because stochastic, path-dependent trajectories over-specify the underlying equilibrium ensemble. We introduce PhiFold, a framework for jointly generating protein backbones and their second-order dynamics, represented by residue-displacement covariance. Rather than predicting the quadratically sized full covariance, PhiFold decomposes dynamics into three interpretable components: local flexibility, a low-rank collective-motion representation, and residue-wise collective participation. These components are assembled into a positive-definite covariance matrix with exact marginal consistency, yielding a compact and physically constrained representation of equilibrium dynamics. Across generated proteins, PhiFold improves recovery of local fluctuations and long-range residue coupling while remaining competitive on dominant collective-motion subspaces. It further enables bidirectional control of residue flexibility while preserving backbone designability. By unifying structure generation with an explicit representation of equilibrium dynamics, PhiFold lays a foundation for designing proteins not only by how they look, but also by how they move.

</details>


### [1470] [Delayed Supervision for Test-Time Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32312)
*Jinha Kim,Taksh Kothari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"延迟监督"作为测试时记忆的后训练目标：在长时间无关事件后提问并监督回答，提升LaCT、DeltaNet、RWKV-7的长程记忆能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时语言模型在序列处理中维护紧凑记忆（如LaCT的快速权重、DeltaNet的delta-rule、RWKV-7的广义delta-rule状态更新），但现有下一词预测训练并不显式要求某个事实在多次记忆更新后仍可访问，因此需要研究针对该记忆的监督方式。

Method: 后训练阶段采用延迟监督：在长时间无关事件之后才提问由模拟器支撑的问题，并将其答案监督与普通下一词预测联合训练；问题在一次性分支上评估，答案不进入后续事件流；构造上区分"保持"（事实在延迟中持续有效）与"修正"（需给出最新值）两类情形。

Result: 在TextWorld轨迹上训练、共享BABILong与RULER评测：相比仅事件训练，延迟QA使LaCT的BABILong提升5.48个百分点、DeltaNet提升1.32点；单针RULER分别提升1.45与3.27点；RWKV-7对比在其自身面板上提升4.60与7.00点。

Conclusion: 延迟语义监督可作为提升测试时记忆可用性的实用外层训练目标；但收益中有多少具体来自"延迟"本身、而非一般问答与答案终止监督，仍有待进一步厘清。

Abstract: Test-time language models adapt a compact memory while processing the input sequence. This
  perspective encompasses nonlinear fast-weight learning in LaCT, associative delta-rule
  updates in DeltaNet, and generalized delta-rule state updates in RWKV-7. Training these
  models to predict the next token does not explicitly require a fact to remain accessible
  after many subsequent memory updates. We study delayed supervision for this test-time memory:
  during post-training, ask a simulator-grounded question only after a long interval of
  unrelated events, and supervise its answer alongside ordinary next-token prediction.
  Questions are evaluated on disposable branches, so their answers never enter the continuing
  event stream. The construction distinguishes retention from revision: a retained fact must
  remain valid throughout the delay, whereas a revised fact must be answered with its latest
  value. We evaluate this approach on LaCT-760M and plain DeltaNet-1.3B using TextWorld
  training trajectories and shared BABILong and RULER evaluation panels, and include a
  separately reported RWKV-7 comparison. Relative to event-only training, delayed QA improves
  BABILong by 5.48 percentage points for LaCT and 1.32 points for DeltaNet, and single-needle
  RULER by 1.45 and 3.27 points, respectively. The RWKV-7 comparison reports gains of 4.60 and
  7.00 points on its own panels. These results support delayed semantic supervision as a
  practical outer training objective for usable test-time memory, while leaving open how much
  of the benefit derives specifically from delay rather than general question-answering and
  answer-termination supervision.

</details>


### [1471] [RLHarness: Co-evolving Procedural Skills with Reinforcement Learning for Long-horizon Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32326)
*Ziqiao Shang,Zian Xu,Ji-Chen Yan,Weiming Wu,Ziyi Jia,Jie Meng,Tao Huang,Shan Huang,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RLHARNESS，将技能、选择与执行协议、少样本演示和任务契约统一为可版本化的Harness，并让Harness演化与策略学习交替进行，在四个多模态推理任务上显著提升准确率与F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态推理需在长决策链中保留视觉证据并跨场景规则选择合适流程；仅靠终端验证器的强化学习只告知答案对错、不告知如何产生，导致策略需在学会执行的同时发现可复用推理流程，形成"程序冷启动"问题。技能虽可外化成功流程、减少重复探索并提供可检查指导，但固定Skill Bank假设指导始终与演化中的策略兼容，而仅更新技能又会使其触发器、执行协议与演示过时或不一致。

Method: 将技能、选择与执行协议、少样本演示及任务契约组织为统一且带版本的Harness（RLHARNESS），交替进行Harness演化与策略学习。Exploration-Distillation Harness构建初始Harness及版本对齐的已验证轨迹用于SFT与DAPO I；首个RL块后，Post-RL Reconstruction Harness基于新的成功-失败rollout重建技能、协议与演示，再由DAPO II使策略适配重建后的程序。

Result: MetroMap/TravelMap准确率由16.25%/27.50%提升至62.00%/50.00%；Fee-VL/Cancel-VL的F1由37.13%/45.50%提升至65.81%/65.51%。四个任务均仅在重建与DAPO II之后达到最佳结果。

Conclusion: 演化的Harness通过持续更新策略所学执行的外部程序，与RL形成互补；固定技能库不足以支撑策略演化，必须同步重建技能、协议与演示才能真正释放RL的推理能力。

Abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires models to preserve visual evidence through long decision chains while selecting appropriate procedures across diverse scenarios and rules. When learning is guided only by terminal verifiers, reinforcement learning (RL) reveals whether a final answer is correct but not how it should be produced. The policy must therefore discover reusable reasoning procedures while learning to execute them, creating a program cold-start problem. Skills can externalize successful procedures, reduce repeated exploration, and provide inspectable guidance. However, a fixed Skill Bank assumes that this guidance remains compatible with an evolving policy, while updating Skills alone can leave their triggers, execution protocols, and demonstrations stale or mutually inconsistent. We introduce RLHARNESS, which organizes Skills, selection and execution protocols, few-shot demonstrations, and task contracts into a unified, versioned Harness and alternates Harness evolution with policy learning. An Exploration-Distillation Harness builds the initial Harness and version-aligned verified traces for SFT and DAPO I. After the first RL block, a Post-RL Reconstruction Harness rebuilds Skills, protocols, and demonstrations from fresh success-failure rollouts, and DAPO II adapts the policy to the reconstructed program. RLHARNESS improves Accuracy from 16.25%/27.50% to 62.00%/50.00% on MetroMap/TravelMap and raises F1 score from 37.13%/45.50% to 65.81%/65.51% on Fee-VL/Cancel-VL. All four tasks achieve their best results only after reconstruction and DAPO II, showing that an evolving Harness complements RL by continually updating the external program that the policy learns to execute.

</details>


### [1472] [HyperReCo: Retrieving and Connecting Evidence with Hypergraph Neural Networks for LLM Multi-hop Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32327)
*Zicheng Zhao,Linhao Luo,Junnan Dong,Haoran Luo,Xiaoli Li,Shirui Pan,Chen Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HyperReCo框架，用超图神经网络（HyperGNN）实现查询依赖的证据检索与显式连接，并通过梯度引导超路径解码（GGHD）为LLM提供可解释的超路径以支持多跳推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于超图的检索器依赖预定义的结构扩展或扩散，可能漏掉识别相关证据所需的查询依赖交互；同时检索到的证据之间的连接是隐式的，需要LLM自行重构这些连接后再进行推理。

Method: 将每篇文档表示为其抽取实体上的超边，共享实体连接各超边；通过超图消息传递，并联合对文档与实体进行监督，使HyperGNN学习查询依赖的交互以检索互补证据。进一步提出梯度引导超路径解码（GGHD），利用梯度归因解释所学交互，并将其转化为显式超路径，帮助LLM组合互补事实进行多跳推理。

Result: 在六个基准上实验，HyperReCo在三个多跳QA数据集上均取得优于对比方法的最佳检索性能，并具备较强的下游QA性能；案例研究与进一步分析证明了所解码超路径在连接检索证据方面的有效性。

Conclusion: HyperReCo通过查询依赖的超图消息传递与梯度引导的超路径解码，将隐式证据连接显式化，提升了多跳检索与下游QA表现，并增强了检索证据连接的可解释性与可用性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities, with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supporting complex multi-hop reasoning by retrieving evidence distributed across documents. Graph-based approaches exploit connections among evidence, and hypergraph-based retrieval further preserves higher-order entity associations within documents and connects documents through shared entities. However, existing hypergraph retrievers often rely on predefined structural expansion or diffusion, which may miss query-dependent interactions needed to identify relevant evidence. They also leave connections among retrieved evidence implicit, requiring LLMs to reconstruct these connections before reasoning. Therefore, we propose HyperReCo, a framework for retrieving and connecting evidence with a hypergraph neural network (HyperGNN). We represent each document as a hyperedge over its extracted entities, with shared entities connecting the hyperedges. Through hypergraph message passing with joint supervision over documents and entities, the HyperGNN learns query-dependent interactions to retrieve complementary evidence. We further introduce Gradient-Guided Hyper-Path Decoding (GGHD), which uses gradient attribution to interpret the learned interactions and translate them into explicit hyper-paths that help LLMs combine complementary facts for multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on six benchmarks show that HyperReCo achieves the best retrieval performance among the compared methods on all three multi-hop QA datasets, together with strong downstream QA performance. Case studies and further analyses demonstrate the utility of decoded hyper-paths for connecting retrieved evidence.

</details>


### [1473] [Enabling Timely Guidance before Skill Retrieval: Retaining Helpful Warm Tips in Agent Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32339)
*Feng Liang,Yupeng Li,Runhao Zeng,Francis C. M. Lau,Xiping Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TipsWarm机制，通过维护预算受限的"热提示"池并选择性注入每轮对话上下文，使技能指导在智能体决策前即可获得，在三个编码与迭代任务基准上取得最高成功率且保持时间高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体虽可复用技能解决复杂任务，但需在投入无效方法前获得指导。现有技能机制通常仅暴露元数据、按需加载完整内容，导致有用指导在智能体决定检索前不可用；通用记忆方法维护开销大，而将指导保留在对话上下文中又会反复暴露无关或有害建议。

Method: TipsWarm作为现有技能机制的补充，维护一个预算受限的、由技能衍生的关键点池（即"热提示"），选择性地注入到每一轮消息的上下文中。该方法将事件触发的LLM评估与低成本的逐轮筛选相分离，从而在控制维护成本的同时使可迁移的技能指导随时可用。

Result: 在三个编码与迭代任务执行基准上，与近期技能方法和通用记忆基线相比，TipsWarm取得了最高的任务成功率，同时保持时间高效。

Conclusion: 通过预算化关键点池与逐轮低成本筛选的分层设计，TipsWarm实现了技能指导的即时可用性与维护成本的平衡，是现有技能机制的有效补充。

Abstract: Reusable skills help LLM-based agents solve complex tasks, but the agent must receive guidance before it commits to an ineffective approach. Existing skill mechanisms often expose only metadata and load full content on demand, leaving useful guidance unavailable until the agent decides to retrieve it. General memory methods can incur substantial maintenance overhead, while keeping guidance in conversation context risks repeatedly exposing the agent to irrelevant or harmful advice. We propose TipsWarm, a mechanism that complements existing skill mechanisms by maintaining a budgeted pool of skill-derived keypoints, or \textit{warm tips}, for selective injection into the context of every message turn. By separating event-triggered LLM assessment from inexpensive per-turn screening, it makes transferable skill guidance readily available while controlling maintenance costs. In three coding and iterative task-execution benchmarks, TipsWarm achieves the highest task success rate while remaining time-efficient, compared to recent skill and general memory baselines.

</details>


### [1474] [ALLOT: Budgeted Hybrid-Memory Routing for Knowledge Updates in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32344)
*Shanfeng Huang,Zhou Fang,Song Xiao,Hai Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出ALLOT混合记忆路由框架，将学习到的写入优先级与硬性参数预算解耦，在检索充足时避免昂贵的参数适配，通过单一排序支持多种写入预算并在外部记忆中保留全部事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的参数适配成本高昂，而在检索已经足够的情况下这种适配往往是浪费的；现有做法倾向于将每个事实更新都视为同等价值的训练目标，缺乏按增量价值分配适配容量的机制。

Method: ALLOT将学习到的写入优先级与硬性参数预算分离。记忆感知路由器融合冻结的文本表示、检索置信度和关系元数据；单一排序支持多种写入预算，同时将所有事实保留在外部记忆中。在CounterFact数据集上使用Qwen3-4B进行验证。

Result: 在CounterFact与Qwen3-4B上，ALLOT在20%参数写入预算下达到0.760准确率，恢复78.4%的预算匹配oracle增益，参数写入量比逐事实双写少80%。该预算下联合加入检索与关系特征使归一化oracle增益提升6.2个百分点。Qwen3-0.6B共享存储实验以6-14.5%参数写入达到双写水平准确率，跨基准迁移保留约88%的域内增益。

Conclusion: 结果支持按照增量价值分配适配容量，而非将每个事实更新都视为同等价值的训练目标，从而在检索充足时显著降低参数适配成本。

Abstract: For large language models (LLMs), parametric adaptation is costly when retrieval already suffices. We introduce ALLOT, a hybrid-memory routing framework that separates learned write priority from a hard parametric budget. A memory-aware router combines frozen text representations, retrieval confidence, and relation metadata; a single ranking supports multiple write budgets while preserving all facts in external memory. On CounterFact with Qwen3-4B, ALLOT reaches 0.760 accuracy at a 20% parametric-write budget and recovers 78.4% of the budget-matched oracle gain, with 80% fewer parametric writes than dual-writing every fact. At this budget, jointly adding retrieval and relation features to text improves normalized oracle gain by 6.2 percentage points. Complementary Qwen3-0.6B shared-store results achieve dual-write-level accuracy with 6-14.5% parametric writes, and cross-benchmark transfer retains approximately 88% of in-domain gain. These results support allocating adaptation capacity according to its incremental value rather than treating every factual update as an equally valuable training target.

</details>


### [1475] [From Trajectories to Grounded Preferences: Process Preference Synthesis via Interaction Element Graphs for Web PRMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32351)
*Yangzhe Peng,Xiaoyang Wang,Yiyang Zhao,Lijun Wu,Kun He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SURFPRM，用交互元素图合成对比负动作，将GMCP比例从24.19%提升至74.60%，训练的Web过程奖励模型在多项基准与下游任务中显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对比式过程奖励模型（PRMs）的偏好训练数据由多策略采样合成，导致"接地最小对比对"（GMCP）极度稀缺——在WebArbiter基线中仅占24.19%。这使PRM训练偏向元素幻觉、动作类型不匹配等浅层捷径，而非真正的上下文决策语义。

Method: 提出SURFPRM图引导的过程偏好合成框架：将Web演示构建为持久化的"交互元素图"，作为环境接地的负动作提议机制，沿空间、时间、时空三类混淆轴系统合成对比负动作，从而构建SURFPRM-DATA数据集。

Result: GMCP比例从24.19%升至74.60%；在6个开源骨干（3B–9B）上训练的PRM于WEBPRMBENCH上平均优于基线模型并媲美领先闭源LLM；在WEBARENA-LITE的奖励引导轨迹搜索中，为GPT-4o（+14.21%）与GPT-4o-mini（+12.83%）策略提供步级指导，显著提升复杂Web任务成功率。

Conclusion: 以环境接地的交互元素图合成GMCP可有效缓解偏好数据捷径偏置，提升对比式Web PRM的决策语义质量与下游引导性能。

Abstract: Comparative Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide critical step-level guidance for autonomous web agents by evaluating state-conditioned preferences between candidate actions. However, existing preference training data synthesized via multi-policy sampling suffers from a severe scarcity of Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)-where competing candidates target genuine on-page elements with identical action types. In representative baselines preference data (namely, WebArbiter), GMCPs account for merely 24.19%, biasing PRMs during training to rely on shallow shortcuts (such as element hallucinations and action type mismatches) rather than acquiring genuine contextual decision semantics. To address these challenges, we propose SURFPRM, a graph-guided process preference synthesis framework for comparative Web PRMs. SURFPRM structures web demonstrations into a persistent Interaction Element Graph that acts as an environment-grounded negative action proposal mechanism, systematically synthesizing contrastive negative actions across spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal confusion axes. This elevates the GMCP proportion from 24.19% to 74.60%, producing the curated SURFPRM-DATA dataset. Across six open-source backbones (3B to 9B parameters), PRMs trained on SURFPRM-DATA outperform baseline-trained models on average on WEBPRMBENCH and rival leading proprietary LLMs. In downstream reward-guided trajectory search on WEBARENA-LITE, SURFPRM provides step-level guidance for both GPT-4o (+14.21%) and GPT-4o-mini (+12.83%) policies, yielding substantial improvements in complex web task success rates.

</details>


### [1476] [AuthorityLens: Rethinking LLM-Based Agent Systems Through the Lens of Authority](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32378)
*Shaojin Chen,Huihao Jing,Wun Yu Chan,Wenbin Hu,Jiaxing Li,Wu Pandy Pui Ching,Kshitij Bhatia,Xinlei He,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AuthorityLens，一个从"权限组合"出发测量 LLM 智能体系统实际权威结构的框架，沿系统权威、权威分离、主体权威三个维度刻画，并应用于 Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 的 13 种运行配置，揭示名义配置与实现权威之间的错位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多地在真实系统中被赋予对重要资源和决策的权限，并与人类及其他 LLM 参与者共享不同形式的权威。然而工作流角色、权限设置与审查机制并不必然反映实际运行中实现的权威，现有工作缺乏统一的度量手段来刻画"名义权限"与"实现权威"之间的差距。

Method: 提出 AuthorityLens 框架：以权威组合（authority portfolio）为起点，在可采纳的运行时状态中，从"足以实现某一结果的最小参与者组合"出发，沿三个维度进行测量——System Authority（系统被授予做什么）、Authority Separation（行使该权威所需的联合参与程度）、Principal Authority（各参与者所持权威大小）。并将其应用于 Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 三种系统的 13 种运行配置，在共同的智能体操作组合上做对照分析。

Result: 名义配置与实现权威不能清晰对应。Codex 中 Full Access 仅使 System Authority 边际变化，却显著将权威集中于执行型 Assistant；OpenCode 的 Build 与 Plan 配置尽管工作流和 root 级权限不同，其 System Authority 与 Authority Separation 相同；Gemini CLI 中基于模型的审查提高了 Authority Separation 但不改变 System Authority。Principal Authority 进一步区分了权威复制与权威分离：被派生或委派的智能体可成为同一权威的替代持有者，而不增加所需联合参与。
