Conclusion: AuthorityLens 提供了一个统一框架，用于测量与比较不同智能体系统中实际实现的权威结构，表明仅凭名义配置无法推断真实权威分布，需以运行时最小参与者组合为度量基础。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed with authority over consequential resources and decisions in real systems. These agents often operate alongside human and LLM-based participants who hold different forms of authority. Yet workflow roles, permission settings, and review mechanisms do not necessarily reflect the authority realized in practice. We introduce AuthorityLens, a framework for measuring a system's authority structure. Starting from an authority portfolio, we evaluate a system along three dimensions: what the system is authorized to do (System Authority), how much joint participation is required to exercise that authority (Authority Separation), and how much authority each participant holds (Principal Authority). We derive these measurements from the minimal combinations of participants sufficient to realize each outcome across admissible runtime states. We apply AuthorityLens to Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI across 13 operating configurations over a common portfolio of agent operations. We find that nominal configurations do not map cleanly onto realized authority. In Codex, Full Access changes System Authority only marginally while substantially concentrating authority in the executing Assistant. OpenCode's Build and Plan configurations have the same System Authority and Authority Separation despite different workflows and root-level permissions. In Gemini CLI, model-based review increases Authority Separation without changing System Authority. Principal Authority further distinguishes authority replication from authority separation: spawned or delegated agents can become alternative holders of the same authority without increasing the required joint participation. Together, these results demonstrate that AuthorityLens provides a unified framework for measuring and comparing realized authority structures across agent systems.

</details>


### [1477] [Reward Hacking and Agent Containment Failure: A Monte Carlo Study Based on the 2026 Hugging Face Incident](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32390)
*Murat Ozer,Bulent Erenay,Ibrahim Berber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个五阶段概率风险模型（奖励黑客→突破隔离→可用访问→持久化→检测失效），用10万次蒙特卡洛模拟比较四种控制配置，结果表明分层控制显著优于单一网络隔离或监控，最后主张将具备网络攻击能力的智能体评估环境视为敌对安全区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2026年7月Hugging Face生产基础设施入侵事件表明，当有能力智能体遇到薄弱隔离边界时，奖励黑客行为可演变为外部网络安全事件，因此需要量化从奖励黑客到外部事故的风险传导链条及各控制措施的相对效用。

Method: 构建五阶段概率风险模型（奖励黑客、隔离逃逸、可用访问、持久化、检测失效）；对四种控制配置各进行10万次蒙特卡洛模拟；输入分布用于表征显式不确定性并作比较分析，而非预测真实频率；对模型全部系数做±25%独立扰动、300次抽样以检验排序稳健性；并开展敏感性分析。

Result: 在既定假设下，分层控制对模拟外部事故概率的降低幅度显著大于单独使用网络隔离或监控，且该排序在全部系数±25%独立扰动、300次抽样下依然成立；敏感性分析显示，智能体能力以及监控、授权与凭证控制方面的薄弱环节对模型风险影响最大。

Conclusion: 应将具备网络攻击能力的智能体评估视为敌对安全区，间接外联通道、共享基础设施、凭证与评估产物必须处于智能体的有效权限之外；人类时间贴现与指标博弈仅作为短视优化的行为学类比，研究不推断AI智能体具有人类式满足感或动机。

Abstract: The July 2026 intrusion into Hugging Face production infrastructure showed how reward hacking can become an external cybersecurity incident when a capable agent encounters weak containment boundaries. This study develops a probabilistic risk model linking five stages: reward hacking, containment escape, usable access, persistence, and failure of detection. A Monte Carlo simulation evaluates 100,000 runs under each of four control configurations. Input distributions represent explicit uncertainty and are used for comparative analysis rather than real-world frequency prediction. Under the stated assumptions, layered controls reduce simulated external-incident probability substantially more than network isolation or monitoring used alone, an ordering that holds under independent plus/minus 25% perturbation of every coefficient in the model across 300 draws. Sensitivity analysis shows that agent capability and weaknesses in monitoring, authorization, and credential control exert the greatest influence on modeled risk. Human temporal discounting and metric gaming provide a behavioral analogy for short-horizon optimization, but the study does not infer that AI agents experience gratification or human motivation. The results support treating cyber-capable agent evaluations as hostile security zones in which indirect egress, shared infrastructure, credentials, and evaluation artifacts must remain outside the agent's effective authority.

</details>


### [1478] [SCLATE: a Substrate for Continual-Learning Agent Training and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32391)
*Youngmok Jung,Sirajul Salekin,Henry Tran,Javier Movellan,Zhao Huang,Manjot Bilkhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SCLATE，一个面向持续学习智能体的执行底座与 rollout 引擎，统一调度基准与智能体事件，把长达一个月的场景压缩到数小时，并支持对未修改的 harness 与记忆系统进行公平对比与后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习智能体由模型、harness 与记忆构成，需在长跨会话中把任务与智能体侧事件（会话启停、cron、记忆巩固）交织执行。但现有基准与训练框架只调度自身事件，导致每个"基准—智能体"组合都要自建调度循环，难以公平对比与训练。

Method: SCLATE 作为执行底座，基准与未修改的智能体都通过 adapter 向同一个开放事件调度器注册事件；采用混合模拟时钟在共享时间线上运行，智能体工作时实时流动、空闲间隙被跳过；同时作为 rollout 引擎，通过容器内代理记录每次模型调用的 token 与 log probability，从而在零修改条件下运行任意 harness 与记忆。作者移植 7 个基准，在 10 个模型上对比 10 种未修改的 harness 与记忆配置，并通过未修改的 harness 与记忆系统对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行后训练。

Result: 对比显示：额外加装的记忆系统并不稳定优于 harness 原生记忆；不同模型在使用同一 harness 与记忆时差异显著。后训练方面，模型学会同时使用 harness 与记忆：读取文件行数减少 6.8 倍，SWE-bench Verified 通过率提升 16.7 个百分点，并写出更丰富的记忆记录，留出的 MetaClaw 准确率最高提升 11.8 个百分点。

Conclusion: SCLATE 以统一事件调度和可回放的 rollout 机制解决了持续学习智能体评测与训练中的调度碎片化问题，为跨基准、跨模型的 harness 与记忆研究提供了可复现的公共底座，并证明通过未修改 harness 进行后训练能有效提升智能体的记忆使用与任务表现。

Abstract: Continual-learning agents are systems of models, harnesses, and memory operating over long multi-session horizons. Evaluating and training them requires interleaving tasks with agent-side events such as session stop and start, crons, and memory consolidation. Yet existing benchmarks and training frameworks schedule only the benchmark's own events, leaving each benchmark and agent pair to build a custom scheduling loop. We present SCLATE, an execution substrate where benchmarks and unmodified agents each add their events to one open event scheduler through an adapter. A hybrid simulated clock runs these events on a shared timeline, flowing in real time while the agent works and skipping idle gaps, which compresses a month-long scenario into hours. SCLATE also serves as a rollout engine that runs any agent's harness and memory unmodified, recording the tokens and log probabilities of every model call through an in-container proxy. We port seven benchmarks to SCLATE and compare ten unmodified harness and memory configurations head to head on ten models. The comparison shows that an added memory system does not reliably beat the harness's native memory and that models differ widely in how they use the same harness and memory. We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through unmodified harnesses and memory systems. The model learns to use both, reading 6.8x fewer file lines with a 16.7-point higher SWE-bench Verified pass rate, and writing richer memory records, while its held-out MetaClaw accuracy rises by up to 11.8 points.

</details>


### [1479] [Beyond Scripted Search: Sample-Efficient Reward Discovery via Agentic Black-box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32394)
*Minghao Li,Rui Tan,Ruihang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ARBO框架，用LLM智能体在运行时基于评估历史构建黑盒搜索策略，提升稠密奖励函数搜索的样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为低层强化学习控制设计稠密奖励函数仍很困难。现有方法用LLM在脚本化搜索算法中迭代生成与精炼奖励函数，但每个候选奖励都需完整RL训练才能评估，导致样本效率成为复杂控制任务上奖励搜索的核心瓶颈。

Method: 提出Agentic Reward Black-box Optimization（ARBO）框架：LLM智能体在运行时从作为持久工作区的评估历史中构建搜索策略。评估历史含两部分：（1）评估预言机维护的观测，包括候选得分、逐项训练曲线与错误回溯；（2）智能体维护的信念，记录诊断与下一步意图。智能体通过工具查询二者并批量生成下一轮奖励候选，而非从固定提示一次性生成。

Result: 在四个控制域上，共享评估预算下相较基线均值，操作任务成功率提升29.9%，电网评分提升192.8%。消融实验考察了各组件贡献及对主干模型选择的敏感性。

Conclusion: 以智能体驱动的黑盒优化替代固定脚本搜索，可有效提升奖励函数搜索的样本效率与最终控制性能；评估历史与信念的双重结构及运行时候策略构建均为关键，但对主干模型选择存在敏感性。

Abstract: Designing dense reward functions for low-level reinforcement learning (RL) control remains difficult. Recent work uses large language models (LLMs) to iteratively generate and refine reward functions using policy-training feedback within scripted search algorithms. However, evaluating each candidate requires a full RL training run, making sample efficiency a central challenge for reward search on complex control tasks. To address this limitation, we propose an Agentic Reward Black-box Optimization (ARBO) framework, in which an LLM agent builds the search strategy at run time from an evaluation history maintained as its persistent workspace. The evaluation history comprises two components: observations maintained by the evaluation oracle, including candidate scores, per-term training curves, and error tracebacks; and an agent-maintained belief that records diagnoses and intended next steps. The agent queries both with tools and generates the next batch of reward candidates, rather than generating them in a single pass from a fixed prompt. Across four control domains, ARBO achieves gains of 29.9% in manipulation success rate and 192.8% in power-grid score over baseline means under a shared evaluation budget. Ablations examine each component's contribution and sensitivity to backbone choice.

</details>


### [1480] [Memory as a cache: Exact context reuse and deletion by construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32395)
*Shengyao Wang,Jiang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SMem 通过块局部编码器与交叉注意力读取器，使上下文表示本身即为可精确组合、可精确编辑的缓存，摆脱 KV cache 的前缀纠缠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 transformer 的 KV cache 将每个 token 的表示与其整个前缀纠缠：一段文本编码后无法在不同前缀下复用，也无法在不重算后续内容的情况下删除，导致精确缓存复用仅限共享前缀的场景。

Method: 提出 SMem 架构：块局部编码器独立于其他块地把每个块映射为 memory 行；读取器通过 cross-attention 在它们的并集上条件化生成。由此，对任意参数设置，memory 在固定块索引处精确组合，删除一个 b-token 块是精确的 O(b) 更新，且 memory 状态与编辑路径无关。该架构还可与 RoPE 组合。

Result: 在 4 倍训练上下文下，SMem 在超出任何训练长度窗口外检索植入 needle（距离 31 和 63 块时精确匹配 0.14-0.28），而 learned-position、RoPE 与 Block-Attention 式 transformer 最高仅 0.02。全缓存上下文仅需单独计算一个块（约 3.1-6.2 ms，近常数），冷 prefill 则随上下文增长；批量解码少存 34-38% 的 KV 行，带宽受限时快 1.4-1.7 倍；512 块时删除比后缀重算快 8.5 倍，4096 块时快 452 倍。代价为相对参数匹配、同位置方案的 transformer，其困惑度差异为 -4.7% 至 +2.8%（负值有利于 SMem），在 160M-1.5B、两种 recipe 与学习率搜索下于 FineWeb-Edu 上验证。与 RoPE 组合后，160M 和 410M 下组合模型匹配或领先对照 transformer，并缩小了 SMem 相对 RoPE transformer 差距的 29-59%。

Conclusion: 消除前缀纠缠可在保持困惑度可比的同时，使缓存具备精确可组合与可编辑性。

Abstract: The KV cache of a transformer entangles every token's representation with its entire prefix: a passage encoded once cannot be reused under a different prefix or removed without recomputing everything after it, so exact cache reuse is limited to shared prefixes. We present SMem, an architecture whose context representation is a cache by construction. A block-local encoder maps each block to memory rows independently of other blocks, and a reader conditions generation on their union through cross-attention. For every parameter setting, memory composes exactly at fixed block indices, deleting a block is an exact $O(b)$ update for $b$-token blocks, and the memory state is independent of the edit path. At $4\times$ the training context, under the shared recipe, SMem retrieves planted needles beyond any trained-length window (exact match 0.14-0.28 at distances of 31 and 63 blocks), where learned-position, RoPE, and Block-Attention-style transformers all score at most 0.02. A fully cached context is served by computing one block alone at a near-constant 3.1-6.2 ms, whereas cold prefill grows with context; batched decode stores 34-38% fewer KV rows and runs 1.4-1.7$\times$ faster when bandwidth-bound; and deletion beats suffix recomputation by 8.5$\times$ at 512 blocks and 452$\times$ at 4096 blocks (32-256$\times$ the trained length, probing the cost model rather than a served regime). The cost is a perplexity gap of -4.7% to +2.8% (negative favors SMem) against a parameter-matched transformer with the same positional scheme, at 160M-1.5B on FineWeb-Edu across two recipes and a learning-rate search. SMem also composes with RoPE: at 160M and 410M the composite matches or leads the matched transformer and closes 29-59% of SMem's gap to a RoPE transformer. Dropping prefix entanglement thus keeps perplexity comparable while making the cache exactly composable and editable.

</details>


### [1481] [Function Over Form: Distributional Orthogonalization in Mixture-of-Experts with Replica Expert Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32398)
*Jinfan He,Yunzhuo Liu,Kai Zhang,Weidong Han,Key,Rayying*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出分布正交化损失（DO-loss）与副本专家机制（REM），从动态路由行为层面缓解专家坍缩与表示冗余，提升MoE模型容量利用率，并在4.8B-A0.5B与30B-A3B模型上优于所评估的路由算法，保持相当训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构虽能解耦激活计算量与总参数量，但其效能常受专家坍缩与表示冗余制约，导致模型容量利用不足。现有方法多关注静态权重多样性，难以有效刻画动态路由行为。

Method: 1）提出DO-loss辅助正则化：将每个专家的token分配历史表示为高维二值负载签名，通过惩罚签名重叠来防止专家坍缩并促进功能特化；2）引入REM机制，采用两级负载均衡策略——全局批级别调整副本专家放置，微批级别进行实时token调度，以兼顾算法设计与系统效率。

Result: 在4.8B-A0.5B与30B-A3B两类MoE模型的下游任务上，所提方法优于所评估的路由算法，同时保持相当的训练效率。

Conclusion: 通过将正则化目标从静态权重多样性转向动态路由行为，并结合系统级负载均衡机制，可有效缓解专家坍缩与表示冗余，提升MoE容量利用率与下游性能。

Abstract: The scaling of LLMs increasingly relies on MoE architectures to decouple active computation from total parameter count. However, the efficacy of MoE is often constrained by expert collapse and representation redundancy, both leading to underutilization of model capacity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes Distributional Orthogonalization Loss (DO-loss), an auxiliary regularization that shifts the focus from static weight diversity to dynamic routing behavior. By representing each expert's token assignment history as a high-dimensional binary load signature, DO-loss penalizes signature overlap to prevent expert collapse while encouraging functional specialization. To align this algorithmic design with system efficiency, we further introduce the Replica Expert Mechanism (REM), which improves load balancing through a two-tiered strategy: adjusting replica expert placement at the global-batch level and performing real-time token dispatching at the micro-batch level. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms the evaluated routing algorithms on downstream tasks for both 4.8BA0.5B and 30BA3B MoE models, while maintaining comparable training efficiency.

</details>


### [1482] [Opening LLM Judges: Recovering Preference Signals Beyond the Final Verdict](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32407)
*Sourabrata Mukherjee,Sunayana Sitaram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM评判者的错误是否源于信息缺失，通过在64个开放权重评估器、14个数据集（含41个模型的激活干预）上分析，发现错误往往不是因为模型内部缺乏正确判断信息，而是信息未反映在输出中；简单的激活探针可显著恢复判断信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评判者广泛用于评估模型输出，但其判断可能不可靠，会因位置、长度等表面特征而偏向更差的答案。核心问题是：当评判者出错时，正确判断所需信息是模型内部根本不存在，还是存在于内部表征中却未被输出反映？

Method: 研究覆盖64个开放权重评估器和14个数据集，包括对41个评判者进行因果干预（在运行中编辑激活以观察判断是否改变）。在LLMBar等表面上更好实则更差的基准上，比较评判者输出与人类标签的一致性，并在相同激活上训练小型探针（无权重更新），同时残差化长度、位置等表面特征，并测量表面特征单独预测人类标签的能力作为诊断指标。

Result: 在LLMBar上，50个评判者的判断与人类标签仅0.456一致（即使平均两种答案顺序）；而同一激活上的小型探针达到0.846，残差化表面特征后为0.686（打乱标签时为0.507）。该差距在八个基准和多个模型家族中成立，但非普遍：表面特征单独预测人类标签的分数可预测增益大小（Spearman rho = 0.90）。在逐条评分、无表面线索可利用的评分量表任务上，读取内部表征没有优势。干预还显示，网络中段编辑激活即可改变判断，并能定位携带位置和长度偏差的路径。

Conclusion: 错误的判断并不意味着评判者缺乏信息；相同标签预算下，恢复的信号能让评判者标记可能出错的情况，并为偏好学习提供更好的标签。一个简单诊断可判断何时值得恢复内部信息。

Abstract: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate model outputs, but their verdicts can be unreliable: a judge may favor the worse answer for its position, length, or other surface features. When a judge is wrong, is the information needed to judge correctly absent from the model, or present in its internal representations but not reflected in the output? We study this across 64 open-weight evaluators and 14 datasets, including causal interventions on 41 judges (editing activations mid-run to see whether the verdict changes). On LLMBar, built so the superficially better answer is the worse one, the verdicts of 50 judges agree with human labels only 0.456 of the time, even after averaging both answer orders. Yet a small probe on the same judges' activations, with no weight updates, reaches 0.846, and 0.686 once surface features such as length and position are residualized out (0.507 with shuffled labels). The gap holds across eight benchmarks and model families, but is not universal: a score of how well surface features alone predict the human label, computed before any probe is trained, predicts the size of the gain (Spearman rho = 0.90). On rubric tasks that score one answer at a time, leaving no surface cue to exploit, reading the internals gives no advantage. The interventions also show that editing activations mid-network already changes the verdict, before it can be read off directly, and locate the pathways carrying position and length bias. At the same label budget, the recovered signal lets a judge flag cases where it is likely wrong and yields better labels for preference learning. A wrong verdict, then, does not mean the judge lacks the information, and a simple diagnostic shows when it is worth recovering.

</details>


### [1483] [Carnator: Fast Text-to-Video Generation with Generation-Native Compatibility-Guided Cross-Request Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32420)
*Xingkun Yin,Xuebin Tang,Mingkun Xu,Hongyang Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Carnator 跨请求加速框架，从模型内部扩散状态提取"生成原生"兼容性证据，实现更精准的缓存复用决策，在三个文生视频骨干上最高达 2.17× 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 生成质量高，但迭代去噪带来巨大推理延迟，限制交互式与大规模服务。现有加速方法多针对单请求，仅利用单条生成轨迹内部的冗余；近期跨请求复用虽提供额外节省空间，但通常以粗粒度语义相似度推断可复用性，混淆了"语义相关"与"生成级计算兼容"，导致激进复用接受不兼容历史计算、保守复用又浪费大量加速机会。

Method: Carnator 直接从模型演化的内部状态中提取"生成原生"兼容性证据：先做轻量级早期探测，基于内部扩散状态构建 Early Signature，通过风险感知的兼容性决策判断复用是否有效；同一证据进一步用于刻画复用范围——定位目标特定计算，并引导历史隐轨迹与稀疏注意力连接性的联合复用。

Result: 在三个文生视频骨干网络上，Carnator 尽管缓存接受更保守（更选择性），仍比所评估的跨请求基线取得更高的缓存命中端到端加速，最高加速 2.17×，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。

Conclusion: 以生成级计算兼容性（而非粗粒度语义相似度）作为跨请求复用的判据，可同时提升复用的有效性与覆盖面；从内部状态提取的兼容性证据既能做接受决策，又能界定复用范围，为视频扩散推理加速提供了新思路。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers produce high-quality videos, yet iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency, limiting interactive and large-scale serving. Most existing acceleration methods focus on individual requests, thereby restricting efficiency gains to redundancy within a single generation trajectory. Recent cross-request reuse offers an additional source of savings, but existing approaches often infer reusability from coarse semantic similarity. This conflates semantic relatedness with generation-level computational compatibility, so aggressive reuse may accept incompatible historical computation while conservative reuse leaves substantial acceleration unrealized. We present \emph{Carnator}, a cross-request acceleration framework that addresses this challenge by extracting and using generation-native compatibility evidence directly from the model's evolving internal states. Specifically, \emph{Carnator} performs a lightweight early probe to construct an Early Signature from internal diffusion states, assessing reuse validity through risk-aware compatibility decisions. The same evidence characterizes reuse scope by localizing target-specific computation and guiding joint reuse of historical latent trajectories and sparse attention connectivity. Across three text-to-video backbones, Carnator consistently achieves higher cache-hit end-to-end acceleration than the evaluated cross-request baselines despite more selective cache acceptance, reaching up to 2.17$\times$ speedup while maintaining competitive generation quality.

</details>


### [1484] [MergeHEIR: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations as the Tax of Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32422)
*Jinyu Li,Hao Fang,Zhiming Zhang,Jiawei Kong,Bin Chen,Shu-Tao Xia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 模型合并会带来"合并税"，即合并后的模型比各专家平均幻觉更高；提出MergeHEIR后合并适配框架，通过零空间投影在缓解幻觉的同时保留继承的专家能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将任务特化专家合并为单一可部署模型时，会出现幻觉率上升的"合并税"：在8种模型合并方法中，合并后的检查点幻觉率均高于其组成专家的平均值。直接将现有幻觉缓解方法用于合并模型会破坏继承能力，造成幻觉缓解与专家能力保留之间的张力。

Method: MergeHEIR：一种后合并适配框架。利用小型专家任务校准集，从合并检查点采集任务相关激活，通过SVD构建逐层零空间投影器；周期性地将累积的后合并位移投影到所得零空间上以保留继承的专家能力。

Result: 理论上给出最小失真与最大维度保证，刻画了受阈值控制的适配-保留权衡，并将扰动保证推广到有限校准数据之外。在3种MLLM配置、8种模型合并方法的24组配对比较中，MergeHEIR持续缓解幻觉且基本保留继承的专家能力，展现出更优的幻觉-保留权衡。

Conclusion: MergeHEIR能够在后合并适配中减轻合并税，在缓解幻觉与保留继承专家能力之间取得更有利的权衡，并在多种配置与合并方法上得到一致验证。

Abstract: Model merging consolidates task-specialized experts into a single deployable model. However, we show that such capability consolidation incurs a merging tax of increased hallucination: across 8 model-merging methods, every merged checkpoint exhibits a higher hallucination rate than the average of its constituent experts. An intuitive approach is to adapt existing hallucination-mitigation methods to the post-merge model, yet this unconstrained adaptation disrupts inherited capabilities, creating a tension between hallucination mitigation and expertise retention. To tackle this challenge, we introduce MergeHEIR, a post-merge adaptation framework designed to reduce this merging tax while preserving expertise inherited from initial experts. Using small expert-task calibration sets, MergeHEIR constructs layer-wise null-space projectors via SVD from task-specific activations collected from the merged checkpoint, and periodically projects the accumulated post-merge displacement onto the resulting null spaces to preserve inherited expertise. Theoretically, we establish minimum-distortion and maximum-dimensionality guarantees, characterize the threshold-controlled adaptation-retention trade-off, and extend perturbation guarantees beyond finite calibration data. Across 24 paired comparisons spanning three MLLM configurations and 8 model-merging methods, MergeHEIR consistently mitigates hallucination while largely preserving inherited expertise, demonstrating a more favorable hallucination-retention trade-off.

</details>


### [1485] [PluginRSI: Recursive Improvement of Agent Harnesses with Reusable Plugins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32423)
*Yaorui Shi,Yuchun Miao,Yuxin Chen,Jiayuan Zhang,Yueqing Sun,Xierui Song,Xiang Wang,An Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PluginRSI，将语言模型智能体的harness表示为原子化插件的组合，通过插件库的独立改进与重组实现harness进化，在软件工程、命令行交互和问答任务上优于现有harness优化方法，且可迁移、可加速后续优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: harness（包围语言模型的框架）是决定智能体性能的核心因素。现有harness优化方法在完整程序空间上搜索，导致单个机制难以被单独隔离和复用。

Method: 将harness表示为若干原子化插件（atomized plugins）的组合，围绕插件组织harness进化：每个插件被独立优化并累积到一个共享插件库中，然后在每次迭代时重组为新的harness。

Result: 在软件工程、命令行交互和问答任务上优于现有harness优化方法；所得harness迁移到其他求解模型时无需额外优化仍保持优势；进化出的插件库可从初始harness加速后续优化，在未见任务上收敛更快、性能更高。

Conclusion: 累积可复用的机制（插件）为harness的持续改进提供了有效基础。

Abstract: The harness surrounding a language model is a central determinant of agent performance. Recent methods optimize harnesses by searching over complete programs, where individual mechanisms are difficult to isolate and reuse. We introduce PluginRSI, which represents a harness as a composition of atomized plugins and organizes harness evolution around these plugins. Individual plugins are improved independently and accumulated in a shared library, then recombined into new harnesses at each iteration. PluginRSI improves over existing harness optimization methods across software engineering, command-line interaction, and question-answering tasks. The resulting harnesses retain their advantage when transferred to other solver models without further optimization. The evolved plugin library accelerates subsequent optimization from the initial harness, which helps faster and higher convergence on unseen tasks. These results show that accumulating reusable mechanisms provides an effective basis for continued harness improvement.

</details>


### [1486] [Authorization Closure Graph: Minimal Repair for LLM Agents with Evolving User Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32428)
*Qingzhuo Wang,CaiYi Wang,Jinglu Meng,Ruiyang Qin,Kunyu Peng,Zhihua Wei,Wen Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于授权-闭包图（ACG）的框架，将授权及其依赖表示为可演进、带版本的状态，实现指令部分变更时的选择性授权更新与最小修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用的LLM智能体执行需用户授权的状态变更动作，但现有方法无法在指令仅部分变更时提供有原则的选择性授权更新机制，导致授权陈旧或不必要的授权请求。

Method: 构建Authorization-Closure-Graph（ACG），将授权及其依赖建模为演化、版本化的状态；选择性失效受修订影响的权限，保留未受影响部分，并计算最小修复，仅识别执行所需缺失的证据或权限。

Result: 在两个自然任务、三种先进LLM上评估，ACG一致提升动作安全率与任务成功率。

Conclusion: ACG使智能体能在适应修订指令的同时避免陈旧授权与不必要的授权请求，代码已开源。

Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents increasingly perform state-changing actions that require user authorization. Yet existing approaches do not provide a principled mechanism for selectively updating prior authorization when only part of an instruction changes. To this end, we propose an Authorization-Closure-Graph (ACG)-based framework that represents authorization and its dependencies as an evolving, versioned state. ACG selectively invalidates authority affected by a revision while preserving unaffected portions of the authorization state, and computes a minimal repair that identifies only the missing evidence or authority required for execution. This enables agents to adapt to revised instructions while avoiding stale authority and unnecessary authorization requests. We evaluate ACG across three advanced LLMs in two natural tasks, and ACG consistently improves action safety rate and task success rate. Code is available at https://github.com/weiliang822/ACG.

</details>


### [1487] [PrismQuant: Optimal Null-Space Rotations for Grouped Quantizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32429)
*Yanlong Chen,Yining Chen,Song Zhang,Amirhossein Habibian,Yawei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PrismQuant 提出量化器感知正交旋转框架，将激活主特征子空间与非对称分组 INT4 的常数组子空间对齐，以闭式解实现 W4A4KV4 低比特量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活离群值更小并不必然带来更好的低比特量化，关键在于其与量化器的对齐关系。现有方法多聚焦于抑制离群幅度，而忽视了激活能量分布与量化分组结构之间的匹配问题。

Method: 将旋转设计建模为 Ky Fan 迹最大化问题，把激活主特征子空间与分组非对称 INT4 的常数组子空间对齐；仿射偏移在该子空间内承载能量而不扩大组内动态范围；推导出对目标可证明最优的闭式解；采用紧致 Householder 变换及其 compact-WY 表示实现无梯度构造与高效部署；提出预测性范围定律，将未对齐激活能量与组大小同量化相关变化联系起来。

Result: 在 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 上验证，覆盖至 70B 稠密模型与 30B MoE 模型。W4A4KV4 下 Llama-3.2-3B 困惑度与准确率达同类最优；Llama-3.1-70B 取得 3.85 困惑度和 72.46% 平均零样本准确率，仅比全精度低 0.22 个百分点；Llama-3.1-8B 部署实现 1.51 倍 prefill 与 1.22 倍 CUDA Graph 解码加速，解码峰值显存降低 56.34%，仅比 Hadamard 多 2.35% Graph 解码延迟。

Conclusion: 激活离群幅度并非低比特量化的决定性因素，对齐量化器的旋转设计更有效；PrismQuant 通过可证明最优的子空间对齐与高效实现，在精度与部署效率上均取得优异表现。

Abstract: Smaller activation outliers do not necessarily imply better low-bit quantization: their alignment with the quantizer matters. We introduce PrismQuant, a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4. The affine offsets represent the energy in this subspace without widening the range within the group. We formulate rotation design as a Ky Fan trace maximization and derive a closed-form solution that is provably optimal for this alignment objective. Compact Householder transformations and their compact-WY representation enable gradient-free construction and efficient application at both foldable and online sites. A predictive range law further connects unaligned activation energy and group size to quantization-relevant variation. Experiments on Llama, Qwen, and Mistral span dense models up to 70B parameters and a 30B mixture-of-experts model. Under W4A4KV4, PrismQuant sets the state of the art on Llama-3.2-3B among the compared methods in both perplexity and accuracy. On Llama-3.1-70B, it attains 3.85 perplexity and 72.46% average zero-shot accuracy, only 0.22 percentage points below full precision. In the deployment study on Llama-3.1-8B, our optimized implementation achieves 1.51x prefill and 1.22x CUDA Graph decode speedups over matched FP16 baselines, with 56.34% lower decode peak memory and only 2.35% additional Graph decode latency over Hadamard. Code is available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PrismQuant.

</details>


### [1488] [Multi-Agent System Search via Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32430)
*Beicheng Xu,Bowen Fan,Weitong Qian,Lingching Tung,Bin Cui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ASPO——一个面向查询级多智能体系统(MAS)搜索的强化学习框架。ASPO通过自适应查询选择机制(AQSM)将训练聚焦于策略能力边界上的查询，辅以发现机制扩大对困难查询的架构探索，并引入子结构级奖励衡量每个动作后裔子图的输出质量增益，从而为PPO提供细粒度反馈。在数学推理、通用问答和代码生成三大领域共六个基准上，ASPO在全部基准上均排名第一，优于十二个基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的多智能体系统能处理复杂任务，但人工设计智能体角色、提示词和通信结构需要大量专业知识与成本，因此需要从执行奖励中学习自动构建针对具体查询的MAS策略。现有方法通常反复遍历固定训练查询集并在工作流层面分配奖励，存在两个缺陷：一是忽略了不同查询学习潜力的动态变化，二是掩盖了哪些子结构真正提升了求解质量。

Method: ASPO包含三部分：(1) 自适应查询选择机制(AQSM)，将训练重点放在处于策略能力边界上的查询，即当前策略能解但尚不可靠的查询；(2) 互补的发现机制，为困难查询拓宽架构探索空间，以区分"探索不足"与"算子能力上限"；(3) 子结构级奖励，度量每个动作后裔子图内输出质量的增益，用以引导近端策略优化(PPO)强化有益的架构改进、抑制冗余或有害的计算。

Result: 在涵盖数学推理、通用问答和代码生成三类任务的六个基准上，ASPO与十二个基线方法相比，在每一个基准上均排名第一。

Conclusion: ASPO通过优先选择可学习的查询并提供子结构级细粒度反馈，实现了有效的MAS架构学习；实验结果验证了该查询级MAS搜索强化学习框架在多个任务领域中的优越性与通用性。

Abstract: LLMs enable multi-agent systems (MAS) to tackle complex tasks, but manually designing agent roles, prompts, and communication structures requires substantial expertise and effort. This motivates learning policies that construct query-specific MAS from execution reward. Existing approaches typically train these policies by repeatedly traversing a fixed set of training queries and assigning rewards at the workflow level. However, this overlooks differences in queries' evolving learning potential and obscures which substructures improve solution quality. In this paper, we propose Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization (ASPO), a RL framework for query-level MAS search. ASPO introduces an Adaptive Query-Selection Mechanism (AQSM) that focuses training on queries at the policy's competence boundary: those it can solve but not yet reliably. A complementary discovery mechanism widens architectural exploration for hard queries, helping distinguish insufficient exploration from operator capability limits. Beyond query selection, ASPO introduces substructure-level rewards that measure output-quality gains within each action's descendant subgraph. These rewards guide proximal policy optimization to reinforce useful architectural refinements and discourage redundant or harmful computation. Together, these mechanisms prioritize learnable queries and provide fine-grained feedback for learning effective MASs. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, general question answering, and code generation, ASPO ranks first on every benchmark against twelve baselines.

</details>


### [1489] [From Latents to Wires: Surgical Post-Editing on Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32434)
*Jiankai Jin,Xiangzheng Zhang,Zhao Liu,Wenzhuo Xu,Dongdong Yang,Deyue Zhang,Quanchen Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出L2W框架，通过Jacobian透镜归因定位与反例引导因果切割，实现对LLM指定语义目标（如身份、拒答）的精准手术式后编辑，同时保留其他能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练后的模型可能含有不希望出现的语义目标（如身份自述、特定拒答行为），而现有方法缺乏"由持有权重者命名目标并精准移除、同时不损害其他能力"的手段。作者希望将"后编辑"确立为对训练后处理（post-training）的补充。

Method: L2W分两步：(1) 定位阶段用Jacobian透镜（J-lens）归因，对模型组件针对命名语义目标打分；(2) 移除阶段针对LLM机制冗余问题，运行反例引导因果切割（CGCC）：先累积关闭模型组件，把每个残留的目标表达当作反例以暴露下一个待关闭组件，随后重新打开部分组件以保留能力。

Result: 在植入行为水印的对照实验中，L2W成功移除水印，且定位落在植入所改变的模型区域；在三种模型配置下，全部九次运行均移除模型元数据（如身份）自述，三次全部移除成人内容拒答，且无留出目标残差；并可在文本到图像模型上组合两次后编辑（一次移除对请求裸露的拒答，第二次移除被前者暴露出的裸体渲染）。

Conclusion: 后编辑可作为后训练的补充：后训练安装偏好行为，后编辑移除被命名的非期望行为。L2W证明了对指定语义目标的定位与手术式移除是可行且可组合的。

Abstract: Given a large language model (LLM), can whoever holds the weights name a semantic target (e.g., the model's identity), locate the model components that produce it, and edit them so that the target no longer appears while other capability is preserved? We call such an edit on a trained model a post-edit. We present L2W (latents to wires), a framework that performs surgical post-edits for named semantic targets. For localization, L2W uses Jacobian lens (J-lens) attribution to score components against the semantic target. For surgical removal, because LLM mechanisms are redundant (i.e., a semantic target may have multiple components producing it), L2W runs Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut (CGCC) until the target no longer appears. CGCC first cumulatively closes model components, treating each surviving expression of the target as a counterexample that exposes the next components to close, and then reopens some of them to preserve capability. In a controlled experiment with an implanted behavioural watermark, L2W removes the watermark, and its localization lands on the model region the implant changed. Across three model configurations, L2W removes model-metadata (e.g., identity) self-claims in all nine runs, and adult-content refusal in all three, with no held-out target residual. L2W further composes two post-edits on a text-to-image model: one removes the refusal of requested nudity, and a second removes the nude rendering the first exposes. The results support post-editing as a complement to post-training: post-training installs preferred behaviours, and post-editing removes named unwanted ones.

</details>


### [1490] [Controllable GNN Explanations via Multi-Metric Preference Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32436)
*Rachit Verma,Yashraj J. Deshmukh,Anirban Dasgupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种优化GNN解释的方法，同时兼顾保真度、可解释性（motif）与稳定性，并可通过权重控制三者的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN解释方法大多仅在稀疏约束下优化保真度，忽视了可解释性（由熟悉的motif模式构成）与稳定性（结构扰动下保持不变），这在高风险场景中不利于建立信任与缓解偏见。

Method: 提出一种新方法，在保真度、可解释性与稳定性三个指标上联合优化GNN解释，并将各指标的相对权重作为可控参数暴露出来；进一步利用包含领域标准motif的motif库确定各motif在生成解释中的相对重要性，并据此改进解释质量。

Result: 在MUTAG、BA-2Motif、BAMultiShapes、PROTEINS等真实数据集上，该方法在MUTAG与PROTEINS的所有评估预算下、以及BA-2Motif的较大预算下，保真度均高于SOTA基线，并在小解释预算区间速度更快；同时通过诱导的权衡曲面考察了不同指标间的关系及其对motif库性质的依赖。

Conclusion: 联合优化保真度、可解释性与稳定性可产生更高质量的解释，motif库可用于衡量motif重要性并提升解释质量，各指标间存在可刻画的权衡关系。

Abstract: Mechanisms for generating GNN explanations are crucial for building trust and mitigating biases in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), especially in high-stakes scenarios. Most current methods optimize only for fidelity under the sparsity constraint. However, this discounts the need for interpretable explanations (those that consist of familiar motif patterns) and stable explanations (those that remain unchanged under structural perturbations). We propose a novel approach that optimizes GNN explanations across these metrics, exposing their relative weighing as a control. Experiments on various real-world datasets, including MUTAG, BA-2Motif, BAMultiShapes, and PROTEINS, suggest that our method produces higher-fidelity explanations than a state-of-the-art baseline on MUTAG and PROTEINS across all evaluated budgets, and on BA-2Motif at larger budgets, while being faster in the regime of small explanation budgets. We also explore how, given an input motif library containing standard motifs for the corresponding domain, the method can be used to determine the relative importance of those motifs in generating the explanations, and how this information can be used to further improve the quality of the output explanations. We also examine the relationship between different metrics through their induced tradeoff surface, and explore its dependence on the nature of the motif library.

</details>


### [1491] [VPEvolve: A Self-Evolving Virtual Process Engineer for Computational Lithography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32473)
*Tianyi Li,Wenxuan Dong,Donger Luo,Nan Wang,Yanpeng Chen,Jiaqi Liu,Xinyun Zhang,Hao Geng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 \system，将虚拟工艺工程师（VPE）框架与经验技能库（Skill Bank）结合，在冻结语言模型上通过实测反馈进行 OPC 配方优化，显著降低边缘放置误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPC 配方随局部规则不断累积而膨胀，规则之间可能相互干扰；商业工具试验中获得的经验分散在代码与日志里，难以系统沉淀与复用。

Method: 将 VPE 框架与 Skill Bank 结合：框架为冻结语言模型提供工艺手册、版图分析、配方编辑与商业工具评估能力；Actor 提出全局参数、局部定向规则或诊断试验的修改；每次评估后由 LLM 反思器与策展器将实测响应转为证据关联的判断，Actor 在下次试验前检索这些判断；可行改进更新保留配方，所有实测试验均写入 Skill Bank，模型权重保持冻结。

Result: 在基于 FreePDK45 的基准上，每案例进行十次商业工具评估：Poly 层平均每案例最大边缘放置误差由 18.294 nm 降至 5.361 nm，Metal1 层由 22.052 nm 降至 15.692 nm；所有最终配方均满足预定质量约束，且最大误差至少改善 0.1 nm。

Conclusion: 实测驱动的经验积累机制可在不更新模型权重的前提下有效优化 OPC 配方，并稳定满足质量约束，实现显著误差降低。

Abstract: Optical proximity correction (OPC) recipes grow as engineers add local rules to repair newly discovered lithography hotspots. Each correction can interact with existing rules, while lessons from commercial-tool trials remain scattered across code and logs. \system combines a Virtual Process Engineer (VPE) harness with a Skill Bank of measured engineering experience. The harness equips a frozen language model with process manuals, layout analysis, recipe editing, and commercial-tool evaluation. The actor proposes changes to the global parameters, local targeted rules, or diagnostic trials. After each evaluation, an LLM reflector and curator turn the measured response into evidence-linked judgments. The actor retrieves them before its next trial. Feasible improvements update the retained recipe; every measured trial informs the Skill Bank that guides the next edit. The model weights remain fixed. On a FreePDK45-derived benchmark with ten commercial-tool evaluations per case, \system reduces the mean per-case maximum edge placement error from 18.294 to 5.361 nm on Poly and from 22.052 to 15.692 nm on Metal1. Every final recipe satisfies the predefined quality constraints and improves the maximum error by at least 0.1 nm.

</details>


### [1492] [From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32482)
*Ruikang Zhang,Xiao An,Xuli Shen,Jiaxing Sun,Xiaoyi Yu,Jin Zeng,Jiang Wu,Tong Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SURE框架，将高层策略与具体推理分离，学习策略的相对效用并用其辅助强化学习，在多个骨干模型上提升pass@1，且GRPO阶段计算开销更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有带可验证奖励的强化学习只关注最终答案正确性，难以单独评估高层策略（如定理选择、子目标分解）的质量，因为策略质量与其后续执行效果被混淆。因此需要一种能区分并利用策略效用的方法。

Method: 定义策略效用为在给定执行器下策略支持正确下游解的概率。构建SURE框架：将高层策略与详细推理分离；基于策略条件化的rollout与教师生成的对比构造成对偏好，训练一个策略奖励模型（Strategy Reward Model）估计相对策略效用；在RL阶段使用冻结的奖励模型，仅读取抽取出的策略，其分数与正确性、格式奖励在序列级GRPO目标中结合。

Result: 与仅用结果和格式的GRPO基线相比，SURE在三个策略骨干上平均pass@1分别提升1.87%、2.64%和2.93%；同时相比更强的奖励基线达到相当或更好的准确率，且GRPO阶段计算量显著更低。

Conclusion: 将高层策略从执行中解耦并学习其相对效用，可以作为一种有效且计算高效的奖励信号，提升数学推理强化学习效果。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially improved mathematical reasoning. However, terminal correctness alone provides limited insight into the quality of high-level strategies, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, when considered separately from their subsequent execution. This paper studies strategy utility, which is defined as the likelihood that a strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor. We introduce SURE, a framework for learning and leveraging relative strategy utility. In this framework, high-level strategies are separated from their detailed reasoning. Based on the pairwise preferences constructed from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, a Strategy Reward Model is learned to estimate relative strategy utility. During reinforcement learning, the frozen reward model reads only the extracted strategy, whose score is combined with the correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Compared with outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, experiments show that SURE improves average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% across three policy backbones. Our method also achieves competitive or better accuracy than stronger reward baselines while requiring substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.

</details>


### [1493] [Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32483)
*Jiaying Wang,Shouqian Shi,Yutong Chen,Xu Yang,Jie Chen,Xingyu Pan,Lei Zhang,Sheng Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DMD-EEG双视角多尺度形变框架，将头皮传感器空间的诊断专家与源空间病灶表征解耦，源状态建模为健康神经动力学先验的低秩稀疏迭代形变，在MDD、FEP、PD上实现可读的ROI-频率-滞后归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于EEG的闭环神经调控需要受试者特异的结构化状态（哪些脑区异常、何种频率、何种滞后），而非单一疾病概率。然而传感器空间模型保留最强诊断证据但缺乏解剖信息，源空间模型提供解剖定位却损失预测信号，事后归因又游离于预测之外。现有方法试图将二者强行压缩为单一表征，本文选择将其分离。

Method: 提出DMD-EEG，包含两个分离的专家：固定的头皮频谱诊断专家，以及在46个ROI×5频率×4滞后（自相关时间尺度）空间中，将源空间疾病相关表征建模为健康神经动力学先验的低秩、稀疏、迭代形变。两个专家仅在固定决策层融合，源状态在架构上与头皮专家分离。

Result: 在MDD、FEP和PD上，决策层融合在MDD与FEP上匹配最强单专家，在PD上超越源分支；FEP中源专家为最强分支，也是形变贡献最大的任务。源状态是跨导联共享源坐标系下显式的ROI-频率-滞后归因，高显著性坐标与已知疾病环路吻合（MDD的额-边缘-颞区、PD的运动皮层beta），MDD状态还能按秩迁移到不同导联的未见队列。

Conclusion: 将预测与解剖归因分离为双视角专家、仅在决策层融合，可在不牺牲诊断性能的前提下获得可直接读取、可生成假设的解剖协调预测表征，并具备跨导联迁移能力，为闭环神经调控提供结构化状态依据。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.

</details>


### [1494] [Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32484)
*Zailin Ma,Quzhe Huang,Yujun Li,Congyuan Rao,Yaodong Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)，通过杠杆分数迭代选样以最大化嵌入数据的行列式体积，兼顾质量与多样性，实现最高 72× 加速、Vendi 多样性提升 9.2%，并在多任务与代码数据上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型预训练数据选择存在质量与多样性的根本张力：质量过滤虽经验有效，但易导致多样性坍缩，系统性排除欠代表领域数据；而多样化选择方法要么仅间接提升多样性（覆盖导向目标），要么通过昂贵的协方差矩阵重计算直接优化多样性，难以扩展。

Method: 提出 Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)：一种迭代式选样方法，选取能最大程度扩展嵌入数据行列式体积（determinantal volume）的样本，采用杠杆分数作为计算高效的选择准则，省去矩阵重计算，从而支持可扩展的数据选择。

Result: 相比强多样化基线 DiSF，Lev 最高实现 72× 加速，Vendi 分数衡量的多样性提升 9.2%；在 CommonCrawl 上，七个下游任务准确率最高提升 1.31%；在 StarCoderData 上，所选子集 bits-per-byte 相比 DiSF 降低 3.08%。此外发现质量过滤的跨域坍缩：经 DCLM-fastText 过滤的 CC 数据无法保留足够代码相关内容，代码性能劣于 Lev 所选数据。

Conclusion: 主张在质量过滤中融入多样性感知实践，以实现语言模型预训练中更有效的数据策展。

Abstract: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.

</details>


### [1495] [RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32490)
*Yuchen Song,Andong Chen,Wenxin Zhu,Muyun Yang,Tiejun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出渐进式规格化任务（progressively specified tasks）这一新问题设定，并构建基准 ProgSpec 与多智能体框架 RepoMAS，通过“Issues”机制在求解过程中修订任务规格与执行结构，在 ProgSpec 及五个现有基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统普遍假设任务需求在执行前已被充分明确，但真实用户请求往往不完整，部分需求只有在推理、工具调用或执行过程中才逐渐显现。因此需要系统性地研究这类“渐进式规格化任务”。

Method: 1）构建 ProgSpec 基准：以初始请求中显式陈述的需求，以及可由任务证据支持的新增需求为评价依据，评估最终输出；2）提出 RepoMAS 框架：借鉴开源项目管理，将新发现的需求、冲突与失败记录为结构化 Issues，并据此在求解过程中修订任务规格与执行结构。

Result: 在 ProgSpec 与五个现有基准上，RepoMAS 均取得最优性能；进一步分析表明，其 issue 驱动的修订机制与仓库维护机制对性能提升有一致贡献。

Conclusion: 多智能体系统不应只修订“如何求解任务”，还应在执行过程中修订其对任务需求的显式表示；这一能力对处理渐进式规格化任务至关重要。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks.
  To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving.
  Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.

</details>


### [1496] [Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32492)
*Haoran Shou,Haoyue Liu,Yu Huo,Kun Zeng,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SPARO框架，通过反事实评估和概率责任分配，联合优化任务指令、可复用技能块与路由规则，在五个基准和五个模型上优于仅优化提示或技能的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法只聚焦设计空间的单一环节（单独优化整体提示，或独立地从模型轨迹中归纳与精炼技能），缺乏在失败时判断应更新哪个组件的原则性机制，也极少在统一框架中同时优化提示、技能与技能使用策略。

Method: SPARO（Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization）联合优化三部分：任务指令、可复用技能块、路由规则。其流程为：进行受控的反事实评估；将各样本的影响转化为对提示、技能、路由三类组件的概率责任分布；从该分布中采样一个组件；对该组件施加针对性的变异（mutation）。

Result: 在五个基准和五个worker模型上，SPARO一致性地超过以提示为中心和以技能为中心的优化基线。

Conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不仅取决于发现有用的任务知识，还取决于决定该知识应存储在何处以及何时被激活；优化应从全局提示重写走向结构化、可复用、可选择性激活的任务知识。

Abstract: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.

</details>


### [1497] [DAAF: From Failure Localization to Editable System Assets in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32498)
*Xiaoyang Yuan,Qi Liu,Yubin Ruan,Xinyi Mou,Zhuomeng Zhang,Wenjin Wang,Hanying Jiao,Di Wu,Mingye Xu,Yi Bin,Ke Feng,Zixun Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出检测感知归因框架 DAAF，将失败定位从执行位置转向可编辑的版本化系统资产，通过学习属性替换效应实现部署时诊断。在 tau^2-bench Telecom 上达到 80.72% 属性 Hit@1、62.65% 失败执行恢复率、仅 3.23% 干净任务回归、71.93% 整体任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有失败定位方法只能识别错误在智能体或执行轨迹中的显现位置，但修复需要做出不同决策：应修改哪个可编辑系统资产，以及该修改是否预期能改善任务结果。这一"定位到修复"的鸿沟尚未被有效填补，因此需要面向组件-属性的失败归因研究。

Method: 提出 Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF)。其诊断目标为版本化、可寻址的组件属性项，而非执行位置。框架结合稀疏且带噪声的失败信号判断是否需要干预；通过由可执行任务结果评估的受控重放，学习按组件类型条件化的替换效应；并在具有相容干预响应的请求间共享监督。诊断阶段仅使用观测到的执行、已注册候选集和可用失败信号，无需反事实重放或任务奖励，输出为 no_change、修复目标或证据不足时的未决决策。

Result: 在留出的 tau^2-bench Telecom 任务上，DAAF 取得 80.72% 的属性 Hit@1，恢复 62.65% 的失败执行，同时将干净任务回归限制在 3.23%，整体任务成功率达 71.93%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基于干预的属性归因能够将失败定位与可执行的系统修复连接起来，为可版本化、可编辑系统资产的部署时诊断提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Deployed LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent, versioned system assets such as routing rules, knowledge segments, prompt instructions, and reusable skills. Failure-localization methods can identify where an error manifests in an agent or execution trace, but repair requires a different decision: which editable system asset should be changed, and is that change expected to improve the task outcome? We study this gap through component-attribute failure attribution, where diagnosis targets versioned, addressable items rather than execution locations. We propose the Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF), which learns the effects of valid attribute replacements and amortizes this intervention evidence into deployment-time diagnosis. DAAF combines sparse and noisy failure signals to decide whether intervention is warranted, learns component-type-conditioned replacement effects from controlled replays evaluated by executable task outcomes, and shares supervision across requests with compatible intervention responses. At diagnosis time, DAAF uses only the observed execution, registered candidates, and available failure signals; it requires neither counterfactual replay nor task reward and returns no_change, a repair target, or an unresolved decision when evidence is insufficient. On held-out tau^2-bench Telecom tasks, DAAF achieves 80.72% attribute Hit@1, recovers 62.65% of failed executions while limiting clean-task regression to 3.23%, and reaches 71.93% overall task success. These results show that intervention-grounded attribute attribution can connect failure localization to executable system repair.

</details>


### [1498] [TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32502)
*Ruiqing Sun,Sen Yang,Dawei Feng,Bo Ding,Yijie Wang,Huaimin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TreeRef树状分子表示与TreeRef-BFN模型，无需预采样分子尺寸或等变架构即可联合生成分子拓扑与局部3D几何，支持无条件及可变尺寸条件生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D分子生成方法存在两类局限：一是预采样分子尺寸并生成笛卡尔坐标，难以支持可变尺寸的条件任务（如片段补全、骨架装饰），且多依赖等变架构；二是内坐标方法虽避免刚体冗余，但通常需要已知分子图或自回归构建，易累积误差。

Method: 提出TreeRef树状分子表示：以天然可变尺寸的树结构编码分子拓扑及依赖拓扑的局部3D几何；RingRef节点编码环闭合同时保持树结构，Null节点使分子尺寸直接由节点占用情况决定。基于TreeRef构建TreeRef-BFN——采用标准Transformer骨干的贝叶斯流网络，全局耦合局部定义的变量，联合生成离散分子变量与连续局部几何。单一预训练模型仅通过掩码即可支持无条件和可变尺寸结构条件生成，无需重训练。

Result: 实证研究表明该模型具有强化学有效性、分子稳定性与多样性，局部几何分布准确，采样速度快，并在性质条件生成上具有竞争力。

Conclusion: TreeRef-BFN确立了作为一种高效且灵活的3D分子生成框架的地位。

Abstract: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors. We propose TreeRef, a tree-based molecular representation that assigns molecular topology and topology-dependent local 3D geometry to a naturally variable-size tree. RingRef nodes encode ring closures while preserving the tree structure, while Null nodes allow molecular size to emerge directly from node occupancy. Based on TreeRef, we develop TreeRef-BFN, a Bayesian Flow Network with a standard Transformer backbone that globally couples these locally defined variables and jointly generates discrete molecular variables and continuous local geometry. A single pretrained TreeRef-BFN supports unconditional generation and variable-size structure-conditioned 3D generation through masking alone, without retraining. Empirical studies demonstrate strong chemical validity, molecular stability, and diversity, accurate local geometric distributions, fast sampling, and competitive property-conditioned generation, establishing TreeRef-BFN as an efficient and flexible framework for 3D molecular generation.

</details>


### [1499] [Learning from Others, Acting for You: Cross-User Memory Sharing for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32511)
*Jinming Hu,Haodong Zhao,Qi Jia,Die Chen,Tianhang Zhao,Sufeng Duan,Gongshen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ShareMem：一种在接收方用户偏好约束下共享可复用经验的记忆架构，通过两阶段固化与范围优先检索，在多任务多模型上超越用户本地记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体服务不同用户时任务常相关，但各自独立的用户历史使可复用经验无法互通。直接汇集记忆虽扩大访问范围，却可能把与接收方用户需求冲突的偏好一并迁移。

Method: 共享经验只指示"如何行动"及"应参考哪些偏好"，具体取值由接收方用户自身记忆提供；采用两阶段固化，先在本地精炼经验，再将接受的编辑并入共享池；执行时用范围优先检索，在统一条目预算下联合选取本地与共享经验，并设用户绑定通道支持初始及智能体主动发起的偏好检索。

Result: 在Mind2Web（网页导航）、VitaBench~2.0（在线个性化交互）、MemoryCode（多会话编程）三类任务、四种基座模型上，分别提升步骤成功率、平均任务成功率与对话宏平均编程分。消融显示两阶段固化在更小共享池、更低诱导token消耗与更好下游性能上更优，且经验指导与主动偏好检索具互补性。分析表明本地相关经验稀缺时共享收益最大，来源质量与跨用户偏好干扰限制有效迁移。

Conclusion: 通过将共享经验的作用限定为"行动指南与偏好索引"、由接收方记忆提供具体偏好值，ShareMem在保留用户个性化约束的同时实现跨用户经验复用，验证了共享与个性化的可兼容性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents serving different users often solve related tasks, yet separate user histories can leave reusable experience inaccessible to other agents. Pooling memories expands access but risks transferring preferences that conflict with the receiving user's requirements. We introduce ShareMem, a memory architecture that shares reusable experience while grounding its application in the receiving user's own preferences. Shared experiences indicate how to act and which preferences to consult; the receiving user's memory supplies their concrete values. Two-stage consolidation refines experience locally before integrating accepted edits into a shared pool. During execution, scope-first retrieval jointly selects local and shared experiences under a common entry budget, while a user-bound channel supports initial and agent-initiated preference retrieval. We evaluate ShareMem across web navigation (Mind2Web), online personalized interaction (VitaBench~2.0), and multi-session coding (MemoryCode) with four backbone models. It improves step success, average task success, and dialogue-macro coding scores, respectively, over matched user-local memory across all four models. Ablations favor two-stage consolidation for smaller shared pools, lower induction token usage, and better downstream performance, and support complementarity between experience guidance and active preference retrieval. Further analyses show that sharing helps most when relevant local experience is scarce, while source quality and cross-user preference interference limit useful transfer.

</details>


### [1500] [From Anomalies to Failures: Constructing Causal Error Graphs for Agentic Trace Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32514)
*Shu-Xun Yang,Yidong Wang,Zhuoer Feng,Bosi Wen,Jiayi Gui,Dayong Yang,Wenbo Yu,Haoke Zhang,Jie Tang,Cunxiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出CEG-Agent，一种工具增强的智能体轨迹因果诊断框架，通过显式区分异常/错误/失败并构建因果错误图，结合CEG-Bench基准，实现SOTA的失败归因性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的智能体在复杂应用中广泛部署，长轨迹使失败难以诊断。现有轨迹诊断方法混淆anomaly、error与failure，导致诊断目标模糊；且缺乏对因果相关错误如何传播并放大为最终任务失败的结构化建模，造成失败归因不可靠。

Method: 提出CEG-Agent工具增强智能体框架：引入anomalies、errors、failures的显式分类法；构建Causal Error Graphs (CEGs)，一种统一类型化表示，通过因果关系连接执行事件、诊断节点与失败结果。同时构建CEG-Bench基准，采用Adversarial Agentic Adjudication Protocol (AAAP)获得高置信度、共识导出的标注，并与专家人工金标准验证一致性。

Result: 自动标注与专家人工金标准高度一致；在CEG-Bench上，CEG-Agent在语义宽松与结构精确两种评估标准下均达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: CEG-Agent通过显式分类与因果错误图实现可靠的智能体轨迹失败归因，并配套高质量基准CEG-Bench，验证了方法的有效性，代码已公开。

Abstract: LLM-driven agents are increasingly deployed in complex applications, where long agentic traces make failures difficult to diagnose. Existing trace diagnosis methods often conflate anomalies, errors, and failures, making diagnostic targets ambiguous; they also lack structured modeling of how causally relevant errors propagate and amplify into final task failures, resulting in unreliable failure attribution. To address these problems, we propose CEG-Agent, a tool-augmented agentic framework for causal diagnosis of agentic traces. Specifically, CEG-Agent introduces an explicit taxonomy of anomalies, errors, and failures, and constructs Causal Error Graphs (CEGs), a unified typed representation that links execution events, diagnostic nodes, and failure outcomes through causal relations. To evaluate causal trace diagnosis, we further construct CEG-Bench, a fully agent-annotated benchmark with high-confidence, consensus-derived CEG annotations obtained through an Adversarial Agentic Adjudication Protocol (AAAP). We validate the resulting annotations against an expert-curated human gold set, which shows close agreement with the automatic annotations. Experiments on CEG-Bench demonstrate that CEG-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance under both semantically relaxed and structurally exact evaluation criteria. Our code is publicly available.

</details>


### [1501] [STR: Supervised Transcoder Replacement for Reducing Steering Side Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32519)
*Haonan Yu,Junhao Liu,Zhenyu Yan,Haoran Lin,Xin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出监督式转码器替换（STR），通过替换转向层MLP计算来减少模型转向的副作用，在保留目标控制的同时显著降低非目标行为退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型转向方法在强化目标行为时会损害其他有用行为，且即使是不带保护目标的转向方法也存在此副作用，需要一种通用的缓解手段。

Method: STR学习一个替代转向层多层感知机（MLP）计算的模块，通过三类监督信号训练：目标控制、非目标保持、无转向时的保真度；随后在冻结的替换模块上，各转向方法仍按原有拟合目标拟合转向方向。在Gemma与Llama模型上评估三种转向方法，使用Corrigibility偏好与四个有害请求安全数据集；SALAD-Bench提供保护训练数据及独立同分布评测划分，HarmBench、AdvBench、StrongREJECT用于分布外测试。

Result: STR在同分布评测上大幅降低转向副作用，并将保护效果扩展到未见安全数据集，同时保持有效目标控制。仅目标监督的转向向量下，Gemma-3-4B的分布外池化攻击成功率从42.46%降至14.42%，Gemma-3-12B从34.97%降至12.91%。

Conclusion: 替换模块训练可使未带保护目标的转向方法同样受益，说明STR是一种通用的转向副作用缓解方案。

Abstract: Model steering can strengthen a target behavior while degrading other useful behaviors. We introduce Supervised Transcoder Replacement (STR) to reduce these side effects for existing steering methods, including those fitted without a protection objective. STR learns a replacement for the multilayer perceptron (MLP) computation at the steering layer through supervision for target control, non-target preservation, and fidelity without steering. Selected steering methods then fit directions on the frozen replacement while retaining their own fitting objectives. We evaluate three steering methods across Gemma and Llama models using Corrigibility preferences and four harmful-request safety datasets. SALAD-Bench supplies protection training data and a separate in-distribution evaluation split; HarmBench, AdvBench, and StrongREJECT are reserved for out-of-distribution testing. STR substantially reduces steering side effects on the in-distribution evaluation and extends this protection to the unseen safety datasets while retaining effective target control. For target-only supervised steering vectors, pooled out-of-distribution attack success rate falls from 42.46% to 14.42% on Gemma-3-4B and from 34.97% to 12.91% on Gemma-3-12B. These results show that replacement training can benefit steering methods fitted without protection objectives.

</details>


### [1502] [MemAgent: Learning to Manage Heterogeneous Memory Providers for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32521)
*Yongxian Wei,Yilin Zhao,Runxi Cheng,Xinrui Chen,Chun Yuan,Yaoru Wang,Jiahong Yan,Dian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将智能体记忆管理建模为路由问题，提出MemAgent——一种内容感知的路由架构与相配套的训练数据合成流程，在三个基准上平均准确率提升10.0%，路由开销低于0.3%，平均任务步数减少12%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体在跨任务时基本处于“无状态”状态，难以从先前交互中持续改进，而记忆对长时程智能体行为至关重要。已有记忆方法虽试图复用过往经验，但大多依赖单一记忆表征（如轨迹、反思、技能、结构化知识），其有效性随任务分布变化而波动。作者重新审视该设计空间，评估13种记忆方法后发现没有任何单一方法能在各基准上普遍适用，从而揭示出管理异构记忆提供者的潜力。

Method: 作者将智能体记忆形式化为路由问题：由记忆智能体决定从哪个记忆提供者检索、是否注入短期记忆、以及由哪些提供者存储新产生的经验。据此提出MemAgent，包含内容感知的路由架构与训练数据合成流程。路由架构整合了检索前的内容感知探测、执行中的短期记忆门控以及选择性的多提供者存储；训练流程则针对路由决策合成阶段特定的监督信号。

Result: 在GAIA、WebWalkerQA和xBench-DS上，MemAgent平均准确率提升10.0%，并在三个基准上均优于任何一种单一记忆方法。这些增益仅带来不到0.3%的路由开销，同时平均任务步数减少12%。

Conclusion: 将智能体记忆视为异构提供者间的路由问题，而非依赖单一记忆表征，能够有效提升长时程智能体的持续改进能力；MemAgent验证了该范式的有效性，在低路由开销下实现跨基准的稳定增益与更高效率。

Abstract: Current agents remain largely stateless across tasks, limiting their ability to continually improve from prior interactions and making memory essential for long-horizon agentic behavior. Existing memory methods seek to reuse past experience, but most rely on a single memory representation (e.g., trajectories, reflections, skills, structured knowledge) whose effectiveness varies across task distributions. Rethinking this design space, we evaluate 13 memory methods and find that no single method generalizes across benchmarks, revealing the potential of managing heterogeneous memory providers. We formulate agent memory as a routing problem in which a memory agent decides which memory provider to retrieve from, whether to inject short-term memory, and which providers should store the resulting experience. Based on this perspective, we propose MemAgent, featuring a content-aware routing architecture and a training-data synthesis pipeline. The routing architecture combines content-aware probing before retrieval, short-term memory gating during execution, and selective multi-provider storage, while the training pipeline synthesizes phase-specific supervision for routing decisions. Across GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DS, MemAgent improves average accuracy by 10.0% and outperforms every individual memory method across all three benchmarks. These gains come with less than 0.3% routing overhead and a 12% reduction in average task steps.

</details>


### [1503] [AmbiModBench: Benchmarking Gene Perturbation Prediction Beyond Shared Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32527)
*Sikai Huang,Zhiwen Yang,Kai Yu,Jiayuan Chen,Stan Z. Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出AmbiModBench基准，从特异性、基因分辨、覆盖度三方面评估单细胞基因组扰动响应预测模型，揭示现有高分多源于共享背景而非目标特异性学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单细胞基因组实验无法穷尽测量，需计算模型预测遗传扰动的细胞响应，但现有评估存在三项缺陷：绝对指标无法区分目标特异性预测与共享背景响应；常用指标在基因打乱下仍保持高分，基因级准确性未被验证；单一训练规模下的得分无法反映覆盖度（依赖表征空间邻近性与响应约束力）。

Method: 提出AmbiModBench：特异性感知、基因分辨、覆盖度感知的基准。为每个得分配备同一划分上拟合的训练均值参照；通过基因坐标置换筛选每个readout；将嵌入距离与响应变异关联。

Result: 在K562、RPE1和Norman数据集上，强绝对得分主要反映共享背景而非目标特异性学习；广泛使用的readout追踪的是响应幅度分布而非受影响基因；可检测增益随表征空间覆盖度而非训练集规模变化。在RPE1上，该协议在五个额外划分与三个基因选择下产生可复现的目标特异性增益，而绝对得分单独无法将其与共享背景区分。

Conclusion: 评估扰动响应预测需同时考察特异性、基因分辨与覆盖度；绝对高分易被共享背景混淆，AmbiModBench可揭示真正的目标特异性增益。

Abstract: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations helps prioritize experiments in single-cell genomics, where exhaustive measurement is infeasible. While computational models increasingly predict these responses, three evaluation deficiencies obscure what their scores demonstrate. First, absolute metrics cannot separate target-specific predictions from a shared background response. Second, common metrics remain high under gene shuffling, so gene-level accuracy is never verified. Third, a score at one training size says nothing about coverage, which depends on representation-space proximity and response-constraining power. We propose AmbiModBench, a specificity-aware, gene-resolved and coverage-aware benchmark. It pairs every score with a training-mean reference fitted on the same split, screens each readout by gene-coordinate permutation, and links embedding distance to response variation. Across K562, RPE1 and Norman, strong absolute scores largely reflect shared background rather than target-specific learning. Widely used readouts track response magnitude distributions rather than the affected genes. Detectable gain follows representation-space coverage rather than training-set size. Nonetheless, on RPE1 the protocol yields a reproducible target-specific gain across five additional splits and three gene selections, which absolute scores alone cannot distinguish from shared background.

</details>


### [1504] [Fail Loudly: An Auditable Runtime for Agentic Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32528)
*Hanxu Yan,Langxuan Deng,Zhengle Wang,Yibo Wang,Chunwei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RADAR：一种可审计的运行时框架，通过证据保留探索、类型化算子记录与运行时校验，使LLM数据科学代理的分析选择可检视、可修订，从而将"静默错误"转化为显式失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的数据科学代理虽能自动化多步骤异构文件分析，但在数据源、作用范围或统计定义上的错误选择常导致"静默错误"——计算成功执行却输出看似合理但错误的结果，无法回答真正的问题。因此需要让代理的分析选择可被检视并可通过执行反馈修订。

Method: RADAR包含三个核心机制：(1) 证据保留探索模块，在检索任务相关内容时保留来源位置与观测覆盖度；(2) 类型化算子，用于记录代理声明的输入、操作参数与产生的观测；(3) 运行时校验，将拟议操作与已有观测进行比对，发现冲突时拒绝该操作或提供诊断反馈，使代理在错误传播前修正选择。语义解释仍交由LLM完成。

Result: 在KramaBench上，RADAR完整来源检索下总体得分0.723，提供gold sources时为0.747，相对最强基线分别提升35.9%和28.8%；在DA-Code上相对提升14.0%，DABStep上相对提升59.3%。

Conclusion: RADAR通过可审计运行时让代理"响亮地失败"，在多种代理式数据分析工作流中展现出一致且显著的性能提升与良好泛化性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled data-science agents to automate multi-step analyses over heterogeneous files. However, incorrect choices regarding data sources, scope, or statistical definitions often lead to silent errors: computations execute successfully but produce plausible yet incorrect outputs that fail to answer the intended question. To mitigate this, we present RADAR, an auditable runtime that makes an agent's analytical choices inspectable and supports their revision through execution feedback. RADAR operates through three core mechanisms. First, an evidence-preserving exploration module retrieves task-relevant content while retaining source locations and observation coverage. Next, the runtime uses typed operators to record the agent's declared inputs, operation arguments, and resulting observations. Finally, runtime validation checks proposed operations against these observations. When a conflict is detected, the runtime rejects the operation or provides diagnostic feedback, allowing the agent to revise its choices before errors propagate. This design enables agents to fail loudly while leaving semantic interpretation to the LLM. On KramaBench, RADAR achieves overall scores of 0.723 with full source retrieval and 0.747 with gold sources supplied, corresponding to relative gains of 35.9% and 28.8% over the strongest baselines. Beyond KramaBench, RADAR achieves relative performance gains of 14.0% on DA-Code and 59.3% on DABStep, demonstrating its applicability across diverse agentic data-analysis workflows.

</details>


### [1505] [LLMAdBench: A Human Preference Benchmark for Advertising in LLM Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32533)
*Rui Ai,Yuqing Liu,Sitao Qiu,Yun Qiao,Yuhan Wang,Jessica Xiwen Wang,Yiqi Yang,Lihong Huang,Ruiyao Sun,Kaifeng Zhang,Shengze Ding,Jiaqi He,Xinman Wang,Tianhao Gao,Jimmy Qin,Jianghao Lin,Chonghuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LLMAdBench，一个用于研究LLM生成内容中广告插入位置的人类偏好基准，包含超18000条人类判断，用于评估八个前沿LLM作为偏好评判者的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在面向消费者的LLM输出中插入广告正成为新兴商业模式，但目前缺乏关于如何评估此类广告插入及其对用户偏好影响的共享证据。

Method: 构建LLMAdBench基准，隔离广告位置这一决策变量：给定用户对话、LLM回复与匹配广告，比较仅在广告位置不同（其他条件如用户查询、基础答案、广告内容及披露条件均固定）的回复对。人类标注者从广告主与用户双视角依据六项标准评估每对回复。基准涵盖两种披露条件（明确标注为赞助广告、无披露直接融入回复），共含18000+条人类判断。并用其评估八个前沿LLM作为偏好评判者的表现，同时微调Qwen3-8B。

Result: 前沿LLM无法可靠替代人类评估：即使最稳定的模型在交换呈现顺序后会推翻约四分之一的判断，模型间一致性低，其位置偏好与人类标注者存在系统性差异。基准本身含有显著可学习信号：基于人类偏好微调的Qwen3-8B较其基础模型大幅提升，并在留出预测任务上超越所有零样本前沿评判者。

Conclusion: LLMAdBench不仅提供模型评估手段，还量化了广告主—用户权衡关系，并表明赞助披露会系统性改变用户对广告位置的偏好。

Abstract: Inserting advertisements (ads) into consumer-facing LLM output is emerging as a new business model, but there is little shared evidence on how such ad insertion should be evaluated or how it affects user preferences. We introduce LLMAdBench, a human-preference benchmark for studying advertising in LLM-generated content. The benchmark isolates a simple but practically important decision: given a user conversation, an LLM response, and a matched advertisement, where should the ad be placed? Our dataset compares pairs of responses that differ only in ad position while holding all other conditions fixed including the user query, base answer, advertisement, and disclosure condition. Human annotators evaluate each pair based on six criteria from both advertiser's and user's perspectives. The resulting benchmark contains more than 18000 human judgments across two disclosure conditions: explicitly labeling the ad as sponsored and merging it into the response without disclosure. We use LLMAdBench to evaluate eight frontier LLMs as preference judges and find that they are not reliable substitutes for human evaluation. Even the most stable models reverse roughly one quarter of their decisions when the presentation order is swapped, agreement across models is low, and their placement preferences differ systematically from those of human annotators. Moreover, LLMAdBench contains substantial learnable signal. In particular, a Qwen3-8B model fine-tuned on the human preferences improves substantially over its base model and outperforms all zero-shot frontier judges on the held-out prediction task. Beyond model evaluation, LLMAdBench provides quantitative evidence on the advertiser-user trade-off and shows that the sponsorship disclosure systematically changes users' preference over ad placement.

</details>


### [1506] [Interpretable Physics Informed WiFi Indoor Localization: Learning an Effective Access Point Geometry and Using It to Prune](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32539)
*Arshia Eftekhari zadeh,Rezvan Nasiri,Hadi Moradi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出分层深度学习框架用于WiFi指纹室内定位，在预测用户位置的同时从RSSI与标注位置中学习AP几何结构，实现可解释的AP排序与剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习室内定位精度高，但其黑箱特性限制了可解释性与已学信息的复用；同时AP几何信息（坐标）常在指纹库中缺失，导致难以进行有效的AP选择。

Method: 采用分层（chained）深度学习框架，通过物理信息驱动的解码器，从RSSI测量值和带标签的用户位置直接推断AP几何关系，训练时无需真实AP坐标；随后利用该几何结构对AP进行排序与剪枝，并结合Fisher信息进行AP排名。

Result: 在UJIIndoorLoc数据集上，链式模型平均3D定位误差为7.07 m，较基线降低26%–36%；同官方划分下已发表方法误差高出10.6%–31.0%。剪枝35%或50%的AP仅造成很小的精度损失；推断的几何支持在无实测AP坐标时的Fisher信息AP排序。在Tampere/TUT与UTSIndoorLoc数据集上，几何引导的AP选择与基于标注数据构建的选择器性能相当。

Conclusion: 物理信息驱动的可解释性既能提升室内定位精度，又能支持有效的特征（AP）选择，为可复用、可解释的WiFi指纹定位提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Deep learning models can achieve high accuracy for indoor localization, but their black-box nature limits interpretability and the reuse of learned information. We propose a hierarchical deep learning framework for WiFi fingerprint-based indoor localization that jointly predicts user location and learns an effective geometry of the surrounding access points (APs). Physics-informed decoders infer this geometry directly from RSSI measurements and labelled user positions, without requiring the true AP coordinates during training. The learned geometry is then used to rank and prune APs.
  On the UJIIndoorLoc dataset, the proposed chained model achieves a mean 3D localization error of 7.07 m, reducing error by 26% to 36% compared with baseline models. Previously published methods evaluated on the same official split report errors 10.6% to 31.0% higher. Pruning 35% or 50% of the APs causes only a small loss in localization accuracy. The inferred geometry also enables Fisher-information-based AP ranking even when fingerprint databases do not contain surveyed AP coordinates. Experiments on the Tampere/TUT and UTSIndoorLoc datasets show that geometry-guided AP selection performs comparably to selectors built directly from labelled data. These results show that physics-informed interpretability can improve indoor localization while also supporting effective feature selection.

</details>


### [1507] [Porimon: An LLM-Based Pokémon Battle Agent Enhanced by Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32544)
*Dongyin Zhuo,Fengjunjie Pan,Nenad Petrovic,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文以宝可梦对战为案例，提出LSTKAG机制与Porimon智能体结构，使LLM无需微调即可利用当前任务历史状态与相似任务经验摘要，并结合外部伤害计算API，在15000场对战实验中显著优于PokéLLMon与规则启发式玩家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究如何在需要"对手感知规划"（opponent-aware planning）的任务中，无需额外微调即可提升基于LLM的智能体性能。宝可梦对战具有不完全信息、需预测对手策略的特点，是理想测试场景。

Method: 提出LSTKAG（长/短期知识增强生成）机制：利用当前任务的历史状态，并基于当前状态从相似的历史任务实例中检索经验摘要。基于该机制设计Porimon——面向宝可梦对战的LLM智能体结构。优化方面引入外部API进行精确伤害计算，并提供更详细的游戏信息（游戏信息检索扩展）。

Result: 开展包含15000场对战的锦标赛式评估，涵盖超参数优化、消融实验与性能评估。经超参数优化后的Porimon玩家显著优于先前研究提出的PokéLLMon及规则启发式玩家；消融实验表明Porimon各变体优于未做游戏信息检索扩展的版本（证明该扩展有贡献），但长期KAG（Long-Term KAG）的贡献尚无法从当前结果得出定论。

Conclusion: 引入外部资源、当前任务的历史状态信息以及相似历史任务实例的经验摘要，能够提升面向"对手感知规划"任务的LLM智能体性能。长期KAG的作用仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: In this paper, we use Pokémon Battles as a case study to investigate how to improve the performance of LLM-based agents in tasks that require opponent-aware planning without additional fine-tuning. We propose Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation (LSTKAG), a mechanism that enables LLM-based agents to leverage past states of the current task and retrieve experience summaries from similar previous task instances based on the current state. Based on LSTKAG, we design Porimon, an LLM-based agent structure for Pokémon Battles. For optimization, we introduce an external API for precise damage calculation and more detailed information about the game. We conduct tournament-like evaluation experiments comprising 15,000 battles for hyperparameter optimization, ablation studies, and performance evaluation. The results indicate that Porimon-based players with hyperparameter optimization significantly outperform players based on PokéLLMon, an LLM-based agent structure proposed in previous research, and the rule-based heuristic player. Furthermore, our ablation study shows that Porimon variants outperform the one without extension in game information retrieval, which shows the contribution of that extension. However, the current experiment results are inconclusive regarding the contribution of Long-Term KAG. These results suggest that introducing external resources, information from previous states of the current task, and experience summaries from similar previous task instances could elevate the performance of LLM-based agents designed for tasks requiring opponent-aware planning.

</details>


### [1508] [Artificial intelligences and human scientists exhibit complementary strengths in theory building](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32562)
*Ke Li,Spyros I. Zoumpoulis,Phanish Puranam,Philip Parker,Matthew Eshbaugh-Soha,Izzy Gainsburg,Michael Gilead,Igor Grossmann,Britt Hadar,Yoel Inbar,Almog Simchon,Robb Willer,Rui Ai,Ruicheng Ao,Gavin J. Bala,Matthew Bidwell,Shuang Cai,Kai Chang,Skyler Y. Chen,Cory J. Clark,Irmak Dai,Abhinandan Dalal,Connor Douglas,Alexis Du,Zhehang Du,Leyun Feng,Isabel Fernandez-Mateo,Linnea Gandhi,Cyrille Grumbach,Anmol Gupta,Vansh Gupta,Maria Hademer,Jay H. Hardy,Chen Kai Huang,Jacob Xiangyu Jin,Ufuk Keskin,Na Hyun Kim,Mert Kobaş,Byounghoon Koh,Gabrielle Lamont-Dobbin,Gregory Lanzalotto,Sun Young Lee,Dingzhe Leng,Chenjun Li,Weiyuan Li,Zeyuan Li,Zhongyuan Liang,Ning Liu,Peihong Liu,Yuhan Liu,Jiuyao Lu,Wanteng Ma,Nicolas Martinet,Natnael Mulat,Christina A. Nguyen,Khai Nguyen,Quang Minh Nguyen,Naja Pape,Chanwoo Park,Stefanos Poulidis,Jeffrey Sanchez-Burks,Michael Schaerer,Isabelle Solal,Yanbo Song,Junghyo Sun,Qingyao Sun,Rui Sun,Roderick Swaab,Kevin Tan,Dequn Teng,Michelle A. Vaccaro,Robin Vigerbaeck,Xiaomeng Wang,Randol H. Yao,Duygu Yilmaz,Shun Yiu,Ecem Yucesoy,Allen Zang,Ruijia Zhang,Xilan Zhang,Yichi Zhang,Zhanhao Zhang,Eric Luis Uhlmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究让25个大语言模型与13位资深研究者、60位博士生在社会科学的性别与种族不平等议题上完成理论构建、新结果预测与理论修正任务，发现AI在多数任务上单项表现优于多数人类，但其理论复杂性部分流于装饰、预测效率不及人类，且人类理论更具多样性并在聚合后带来更大预测增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究AI（尤其是大语言模型）在社会科学高层认知任务（理论构建、对新实证结果的预测、依据新证据进行理论修正）上相对于人类科学家的有效性，以判断AI能否胜任此类创造性科研工作。

Method: 以"性别与种族不平等"的学术讨论为研究领域，对比25个大语言模型、13位资深研究者与60位博士学者的表现；对其生成的理论进行独立且盲评的质量评定，并考察理论多样性、聚合后的预测准确度增益、理论复杂度与预测准确率的关系，以及面对新证据时的理论修正行为。

Result: AI在多数任务上单项表现优于大多数人类个体；人类理论更多样，且经聚合后预测准确度的提升更大；AI生成的理论更为详尽（包含更多理论路径与潜变量），盲评质量也高于人类理论，但这种复杂性部分只是装饰性——并未带来对数据中实证模式更准确的预测，人类以更简洁的理论实现了更高的预测效率；AI比人类更倾向于根据新证据修正理论，而人类则表现出对先验预测误差敏感的、选择性的信念更新。

Conclusion: AI更强的处理能力使其尤擅处理高复杂度任务，但人类观念的更大多样性对"智慧群体"与集体创造力仍不可或缺。

Abstract: We investigate the effectiveness of artificial intelligences (AI)-specifically large language models (LLMs)-relative to human scientists at high-level cognitive tasks in social science such as theory formulation, predictions of novel empirical results, and theory revision in response to new evidence. The research domain was academic discourse regarding gender and race inequality. Our findings, comparing 25 LLMs with 13 senior researchers and 60 doctoral scholars, reveal that the AIs outperformed most humans individually on most of the present tasks, while human theories were more diverse and exhibited greater gains in predictive accuracy from aggregation. AI-generated theories were more extensively elaborated, involving additional theoretical paths and latent variables, and were rated as higher quality than human theories by independent raters blinded to source. However, this theoretical complexity was in part ornamental, in that it was not associated with more accurate predictions about empirical patterns in data; in contrast, human scientists achieved greater predictive efficiency with simpler theories. The AIs were significantly more likely than human scientists to revise their theories to incorporate new evidence; human scientists updated their beliefs in a selective way that is sensitive to prior prediction errors. We speculate that the superior processing capacity of artificial intelligences makes them especially well-suited to tasks requiring grappling with complexity, but that the greater diversity of human ideas is essential to wise crowds and collective creativity.

</details>


### [1509] [ProTTT: Learning to Learn Semantic User Memory with Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32564)
*Sejun Park,Hyoungjo Bhang,Hyein Jeong,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProTTT 是一个基于用户画像监督的元学习框架，学习可随用户历史增长而持续更新的语义用户记忆，在多种基准上优于全历史 ICL 和参数化基线并显著降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
