Motivation: 个性化要求语言模型从不断增长的用户历史中捕获用户特定知识。现有基于上下文的方法随历史累积导致推理成本上升，且依赖独立的检索或摘要阶段；基于参数化的方法在加入新用户数据时往往需要重建用户表示。因此需要一个既能持续演化又高效的用户记忆构建方案。

Method: 提出 ProTTT，一个 profile-supervised 元学习框架，用于学习语义用户记忆。记忆构造从共享初始化出发，通过在每个用户历史上的 test-time training 进行用户级更新，使其能随历史增长持续演化。由于仅靠 test-time training 无法显式促使记忆捕获个性化所需的语义用户知识，作者使用文本用户画像作为监督来学习该共享初始化，使基于用户历史的 test-time training 更有效地捕获语义知识。

Result: ProTTT 在多种基准上持续优于全历史 ICL 和所有参数化基线，同时通过将用户历史压缩为轻量级参数化记忆大幅降低推理成本。分析表明，画像监督是学习语义用户知识的可靠目标；所得记忆能够跟踪并保留演化的用户偏好，且在不同历史规模下保持稳健。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了 test-time training 在个性化中的有效性，并将 ProTTT 确立为持续演化的用户记忆的基线方法。

Abstract: Personalization requires language models to capture user-specific knowledge from a growing user history. Existing context-based approaches incur increasing inference costs as user history accumulates and rely on separate retrieval or summarization stages, while parametric-based approaches often require reconstructing user representations when new user data is added. We introduce ProTTT, a profile-supervised meta-learning framework for learning semantic user memory. The memory construction starts from a shared initialization and is updated for each user through test-time training on user history, allowing it to evolve continuously as the history grows. However, since test-time training alone does not explicitly encourage the memory to capture semantic user knowledge necessary for personalization, we learn this shared initialization using textual user profiles as supervision, so that test-time training on user history captures semantic knowledge more effectively. ProTTT consistently outperforms both full history ICL and all parametric baselines across diverse benchmarks, while substantially reducing inference cost by compressing user history into a lightweight parameterized memory. Our analysis also shows that profile supervision is a reliable objective for learning semantic user knowledge and that the resulting memory can track and retain evolving user preferences, while remaining robust across different history sizes. Overall, we demonstrate the effectiveness of test-time training for personalization and establish ProTTT as a baseline for continuously evolving user memory.

</details>


### [1510] [EMIR$^2$: Evolution-Aware Memory with Intent-Guided Multi-Round Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32584)
*Jinlan Liu,Hongliang Sun,Yong Wang,Bolin Zhang,Dinabo Sui,Dianhui Chu,Zhiying Tu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EMIR²框架，通过状态演化记忆图与意图引导多轮检索，解决LLM智能体长期记忆的静态表示和单轮检索问题，在LoCoMo和MemConflict上相对提升超12%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统依赖静态记忆表示和单轮检索策略，难以利用持续演变的历史信息，无法追踪事实变化或整合跨长期交互的分散证据。

Method: EMIR²包含两部分：(1) 状态演化记忆图（SEMG），将长期记忆表示为演化知识状态，由时间事件轨迹和证据关联支撑，通过基于证据的更新维护语义状态，保留历史演化并支持冲突场景下的证据溯源；(2) 意图引导的多轮检索机制，迭代识别缺失证据并基于累积信息扩展检索。

Result: 在LoCoMo和MemConflict数据集上，EMIR²提升了长期记忆利用、动态与静态冲突处理及复杂检索性能，部分类别相对提升超过12%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，联合建模记忆演化与自适应证据获取对长期智能体交互具有有效性。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to leverage historical interactions for future tasks. However, existing memory systems struggle to utilize continuously evolving historical information, as they often rely on static memory representations and single-round retrieval strategies, failing to track factual changes or integrate distributed evidence across long-term interactions. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$, an \textbf{E}volution-Aware \textbf{M}emory framework with \textbf{I}ntent-Guided Multi-\textbf{R}ound \textbf{R}etrieval, enabling LLM agents to maintain evolving historical knowledge and adaptively retrieve relevant evidence. Specifically, \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ constructs a State-Evolving Memory Graph (SEMG) that represents long-term memory as evolving knowledge states supported by temporal event trajectories and evidential associations. By maintaining semantic states through evidence-based updates, SEMG preserves historical evolution and enables evidence tracing under complex and conflicting scenarios. Building upon this, we introduce an intent-guided multi-round retrieval mechanism that iteratively identifies missing evidence and expands retrieval based on accumulated information. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemConflict demonstrate that \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ improves long-term memory utilization, dynamic and static conflict handling, and complex retrieval performance, achieving relative improvements of more than 12\% in certain categories. These results highlight the effectiveness of jointly modeling memory evolution and adaptive evidence acquisition for long-term agent interactions.

</details>


### [1511] [MA-FPPO: Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32594)
*Guowei Zou,Haonan Chen,Haitao Wang,Beiwen Zhang,Na Yan,Hejun Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MA-FPPO，用在线微调提升基于 flow matching 预训练的多智能体策略，通过显式动作似然与共享团队优势改进离线数据未覆盖情境下的协作与适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体 flow 策略依赖固定离线数据学习协作，在离线数据未覆盖的情境中难以同时适应环境变化并协调彼此，离线习得的动作模式不足以支撑有效适应与协调。

Method: MA-FPPO：在 flow matching 预训练行为基础上，通过与环境的新交互进行在线微调；为离散与连续动作空间构建具有显式动作似然的策略，并利用共享团队优势更新预训练模型，以团队表现驱动协作改进。

Result: 在 30 个设定上相对最强离线基线平均获得 52.8% 的相对增益；在与在线预算和评估协议匹配的 38 组对比中，相对纯在线学习平均提升 29.8%。

Conclusion: 在线微调结合显式动作似然与共享团队优势，可有效增强预训练多智能体 flow 策略的适应与协调能力，性能优于强离线基线与同等预算的纯在线学习。

Abstract: Multi-agent flow policies learn cooperative behavior from fixed offline datasets, but often struggle to complete tasks in situations not covered by the offline data. In these situations, agents must both adapt to changes in the environment and coordinate with one another, yet action patterns learned offline are often insufficient for effective adaptation and coordination. To address this problem, we propose Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization (MA-FPPO), which uses online fine-tuning to improve the cooperative behavior of models pretrained with flow matching through new interactions with the environment. Building on the behavior learned during pretraining, we construct policies with explicit action likelihoods for discrete and continuous action spaces. We then update the pretrained model using shared team advantages to further improve coordination based on team performance. Our method achieves, on average, relative gains of 52.8% over the strongest listed offline baselines across 30 settings and 29.8% over purely online learning across 38 comparisons with matched online budgets and evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [1512] [CUA-SWE: When Computer-Use Agents Meet Visual Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32600)
*Prince Zizhuang Wang,Chenhao Liang,Zelong Xu,Aojie Yuan,Xiaolin Zhou,Haiyue Zhang,Yue Zhao,Xiyang Hu,Shuli Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CUA-SWE，一个面向“计算机使用 + 软件工程”的基准、环境与评估流程，要求智能体在同一任务中修改代码与配置、执行命令、与运行中的应用交互并检查视觉反馈，并配有确定性的任务专用测试来验证软件正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体与计算机使用智能体多在孤立场景下研究，忽视了“修改代码—运行软件—观察行为—判断修复”的集成开发过程；诊断运行时交互故障需将视觉观察与对应代码关联，并再次运行应用验证修复。作者希望探究：当规格或操作信息仅能通过运行应用的图形界面获取时，智能体能否完成软件工程任务。

Method: 构建 CUA-SWE 基准、运行环境与评估流程，覆盖四个软件工程领域；任务要求智能体在同一次任务中修改代码和配置、执行命令、与运行中的软件交互并检查视觉反馈；每个任务配有确定性的任务专用测试，用于验证结果软件是否满足需求并保持既定行为。

Result: 对前沿智能体进行评估，刻画其如何结合源码级执行、应用截图与图形交互来产出经验证的软件变更；分析跨领域与不同任务信息需求下的表现，以及成功修复所关联的开发行为。

Conclusion: CUA-SWE 为研究智能体如何利用视觉反馈与交互引导软件工程提供了统一测试平台，并具备可执行的软件正确性判据。

Abstract: Software development requires more than editing code: developers repeatedly run software, interact with its interfaces, visually inspect its behavior, and use these observations to decide what to change next and whether a change works. Existing coding agents and computer-use agents are largely studied in isolation, leaving this integrated development process underexplored. Diagnosing a runtime interaction failure requires agents to connect visual observations with the responsible code, then use the application again to verify the repair. We introduce CUA-SWE, a benchmark, environment, and evaluation pipeline for software engineering with computer use. Beyond studying how GUI feedback supports diagnosis and repair, we ask whether agents can complete software engineering tasks when required specification or operational information is available only through the running application's visual interface. CUA-SWE spans four software engineering domains and requires agents to modify code and configuration, execute commands, interact with running software, and inspect visual feedback within the same task. Each task includes deterministic, task-specific tests that verify whether the resulting software satisfies the requirements and preserves specified behavior. Our evaluation characterizes how frontier agents combine source-level execution with application screenshots and graphical interaction to produce verified software changes. We examine performance across domains and task information requirements, alongside the development behaviors associated with successful repairs. CUA-SWE provides a unified testbed for studying how agents use visual feedback and interaction to guide software engineering, with executable correctness criteria for the resulting software.

</details>


### [1513] ["You're Right, Let Me Fix It": How LLM Agents Damage Correct Work When Falsely Accused](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32616)
*Xutao Mao,Rui Qian,Longxiang Wang,Xinjian Yi,Mingxuan Li,Linghan Chen,Yudong Gao,Xiang Zheng,Cong Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"gaslight sycophancy"（对虚假指控的谄媚式接受）与"destructive over-correction"（破坏性过度纠正）概念，并构建CAVE-Bench基准，揭示长生命周期LLM agent在无据指控下会破坏原本正确工作，最高达60.06%，且可通过实时信号门控减少74%的损害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent日益在任务成功后持续运行（压缩后恢复、接手交接），其已完成工作会收到后续输入，有时被错误地归咎于后续失败。现有研究缺乏对"agent在无法本地验证指控时是否错误接受并破坏正确工作"这一安全问题的系统评估。

Method: 构建CAVE-Bench，包含六个领域共365个agentic任务，围绕不透明任务设计。每次计分运行先达到经验证的正确状态，其依据与历史保留在工作区，而决定指控真伪的事实位于agent无法触及的外部或运行时状态。agent无法通过本地检查确认或驳回指控，正确反应应是保留工作并索要缺失证据。任务分为两类：向agent交付带保存证据的正确工作，或让其先构建并验证工作；五个风险因素控制指控进入工作流的方式。从轨迹中对指控接受与证据使用进行评分，并通过下游事件的确定性重放测量损害。

Result: 在Claude Code中测试14个最新模型，虚假指控在最多60.06%的运行中损害了正确工作；更强的模型往往在已恢复支持证据后仍造成损害。同一模型在OpenCode、Codex和Hermes中表现不同。由基准实时信号驱动的harness gate将重放损害降低74%。

Conclusion: 在无支持指控下保留已正确工作，是长生命周期agent的一项独立安全挑战；需要专门机制防止agent因虚假指控而破坏原本正确的成果。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly keep working after a task succeeds as they resume after compaction or take over handoffs. Their finished work keeps receiving follow-up input that sometimes falsely accuses it for later failures. We call an agent's acceptance of such a false accusation gaslight sycophancy, and destructive over-correction when acting on it damages previously correct work. We introduce CAVE-Bench, a benchmark of 365 agentic tasks across six domains built around opaque tasks. Every scored run first reaches a verified correct state, whose supporting rationale and history stay in the workspace while the facts that would settle the accusation lie in external or runtime state beyond the agent's reach. The agent cannot confirm or refute the claim with a local check, so the right response should keep the work and ask for the missing evidence. Each task either hands the agent correct work with saved evidence or let it build and verify that work first, and five risk factors set how the accusation enters the workflow. We score accusation acceptance and evidence use from the trajectory and measure harm by deterministic replay of downstream events. Across 14 of the latest models in Claude Code, false accusations damage correct work in up to 60.06% of runs, and stronger models often do so after recovering the supporting evidence. The same model behaves differently across OpenCode, Codex, and Hermes, and a harness gate driven by the benchmark's live signals cuts replayed harm by 74%. These results show that preserving already-correct work under unsupported accusation is a distinct safety challenge for long-lived agents. Our project is in https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-over-correction/.

</details>


### [1514] [SWE-MILE: Asynchronous Potential-Induced Milestone Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32631)
*Chaoqun Cui,Hao Zhou,Meiqi Chen,Fandong Meng,Wenji Mao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SWE-MILE，一种异步势函数诱导的里程碑信用分配框架，直接从工作流运行时提取细粒度过程监督，无需辅助奖励模型或外部评估器，在长时程软件工程任务上显著提升智能体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程软件工程智能体用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）训练时，通常只有终端结果监督，难以区分有效动作与冗余探索或功能回归，因此需要细粒度的过程监督信号。

Method: SWE-MILE 将任务相关文件曝光量量化为导航势函数，将测试状态对齐量化为验证势函数；通过势函数差值把里程碑进展与回归归因到单个动作，并用折扣反向信用将监督传播至前序步骤。为高效获取中间验证状态，提出异步影子探测：在隔离沙箱中重放改变仓库的动作，与智能体主交互并行执行验证，从而隐藏验证延迟。得到的过程信用用于增强终端结果优势。

Result: 在两个代表性长时程 SWE 任务上实验，智能体性能取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 工作流运行时信号是长时程 SWE 智能体过程监督的实用来源。

Abstract: Long-horizon software engineering (SWE) agents trained with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically receive only terminal outcome supervision, making it difficult to distinguish productive actions from redundant exploration or functional regressions. We propose SWE-MILE, an asynchronous potential-induced milestone credit assignment framework that derives fine-grained process supervision from workflow runtime, without auxiliary reward models or external evaluators. SWE-MILE quantifies task-relevant file exposure and test-state alignment as navigation and verification potentials, respectively. Differences in these potentials attribute milestone progress and regressions to individual actions, while discounted backward credit propagates supervision to preceding steps. To efficiently acquire intermediate verification states, SWE-MILE further introduces asynchronous shadow probing, which replays repository-changing actions in an isolated sandbox and runs verification in parallel with the agent's primary interaction, largely hiding verification latency. The resulting process credit augments terminal outcome advantages and provides informative learning signals. Experiments on two representative long-horizon SWE tasks demonstrate substantial improvements in agent performance, highlighting workflow runtime signals as a practical source of process supervision for long-horizon SWE agents.

</details>


### [1515] [Can Open-Weight Large Language Models (LLMs) Simulate Human Survey Populations? A Cross-Instrument Calibration Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32638)
*Grandee Lee,Wang Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究在跨量表校准任务上评估三个开放权重LLM家族，发现模拟的跨量表相关性与真实人类相关性达 r=0.70–0.73，主要源于符号正确而非量级精确，且不随模型版本单调提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用于生成合成受访者和真实个体的数字孪生，但其输出是否保留真实人类的统计结构而非仅表面合理性尚不明确；且现有证据多来自专有模型，缺乏对开放权重模型的检验。

Method: 以真实受访者对某一心理测量工具的原话作答作为角色条件，在第二个构念距离受控的工具上进行测量，并与2,058人的人类样本对照；评估三个开放权重LLM家族，覆盖139对构念组合网格。

Result: 在所有模型中，模拟的跨量表相关性与真实人类相关性相关系数为 r=0.70–0.73，主要由符号正确驱动而非精确量级，且集中在中等等构念距离的配对上；在匹配面板上，三个Llama版本中最新版本在三项主要指标中的两项表现最差。

Conclusion: 未经微调的开放权重模型仅凭个体层面调查数据即可复现相当比例的真实人类跨量表结构，对LLM行为模拟与数字孪生应用具有实质性鼓舞意义；但该能力不随模型版本单调提升，实际落地需针对具体版本、且考虑构念距离的验证，而非一次性基准测试。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate synthetic survey respondents and digital twins of real people, but whether their output preserves real human statistical structure, rather than surface plausibility, remains unresolved, and most existing evidence comes from proprietary models rather than open-weight ones. We evaluate three open-weight LLM families on a cross-instrument calibration task: conditioning personas on real respondents' verbatim answers to one psychometric instrument and measuring them on a second, construct-distance-controlled instrument, checked against a 2,058-person human panel. Across a 139-pair grid, the simulated cross-instrument correlation tracks the real human correlation at r = 0.70 - 0.73 in every model, driven mainly by correct sign rather than precise magnitude and concentrated in pairs of moderate construct distance. A correlation of this magnitude, obtained from untuned open-weight models conditioned only on individual-level survey data, is a substantively encouraging result for LLM-based behavioral simulation and digital-twin applications: specific model families and releases already reproduce a meaningful share of real human cross-instrument structure without any fine-tuning. This capability does not, however, improve monotonically across model releases: on a matched panel, the newest of three tested Llama releases performs worst on two of three headline metrics, so realizing its promise in practice requires release-specific, distance-aware verification rather than a one-time benchmark.

</details>


### [1516] [Business Compromise Detection with Agentic AI and LLM-driven Knowledge Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32643)
*Diego Palma,Kyu Bin Kim,Zhen Han,Allbright Dsouza,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将LLM智能体保留为"信号提取器"、把最终裁决权交给神经符号仲裁层，可在广告账户盗用检测中把MCC由0.295提升至0.435，以少量召回换取显著精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字广告中，攻击者利用被盗（劫持）的商业广告账户投放欺诈活动，检测这类被盗账户十分困难。LLM智能体在完整性执法上有潜力，但在困难样本上会产生幻觉性错误，带来业务摩擦。研究发现，自主智能体是强召回、偏激进的信号提取器，却是不靠谱的最终裁决者，会在模糊决策上牺牲精度。

Method: 方法采用"智能体+神经符号"两段式架构：LLM智能体仅作为调查者，输出结构化、可解释的信号向量；最终判决交由神经符号阶段完成，包括由归纳逻辑编程（FOIL-IE）发现的符号规则、朴素贝叶斯校准层，以及数据调优的矛盾消解层。

Result: 在盗用过采样人群与真实的低流行率样本（均由领域专家标注）上评估：仲裁层替换使MCC从0.295提升到0.435（ΔMCC +0.139，95% CI [+0.026, +0.245]，p=0.018，配对bootstrap）；精度从0.250升至0.446（1.8倍），召回由0.920降至0.660。在相同条件下，该方法还优于树集成模型（MCC 0.386）。

Conclusion: 将LLM智能体限定为可解释信号提取器、由神经符号仲裁层做最终裁决，能显著提升精度与整体MCC，代价是可接受的召回下降。所发现的符号规则编码了领域知识标签，同时保持可解释、可审计，兼具执法严谨性与业务可解释性。

Abstract: Detecting compromised business ad accounts is a challenge in digital advertising, as attackers exploit hijacked accounts to launch fraudulent campaigns. Large Language Model (LLM) agents show promise for integrity enforcement, but hallucinated mistakes on hard cases create business friction. In a study we find the autonomous agent is a strong, recall-heavy signal extractor but an unreliable final arbiter, conceding precision on ambiguous decisions. We therefore keep the agent as an investigator that emits a structured, interpretable signal vector, and delegate the verdict to a neuro-symbolic stage: symbolic rules discovered by Inductive Logic Programming (FOIL-IE), a Naïve Bayes calibration layer, and a data-tuned contradiction layer. Evaluating on a compromise-over-sampled population and a realistic low-prevalence sample with subject-matter-expert labels, this arbiter substitution raises MCC from 0.295 to 0.435 (ΔMCC +0.139, 95% CI [+0.026, +0.245], p=0.018, paired bootstrap), lifting precision from 0.250 to 0.446 (1.8x) at a recall cost (0.920 to 0.660). Benchmarked under identical conditions, it also edge tree ensembles (0.386).The rules encode domain w labels while remaininginterpretable and auditable.

</details>


### [1517] [From Scene Graphs to Answers: Selective Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32645)
*Yiyao Wang,Pei Liu,Fangzhou Liu,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出查询自适应的神经符号推理框架，用分层时空场景图（STSG）将可精确符号化求解的查询交给符号执行器，仅对无法符号化的查询调用LLM做语义推理，在nuScenes-QA上以oracle感知达到80.63%准确率，较纯LLM配置提升5.48个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言方法将异质推理操作统一交由单一神经网络推理，忽视了"部分查询可精确符号求解、部分需语义解读"这一根本区别，导致推理不够精确且效率低下。

Method: 核心是分层时空场景图STSG，将持久物体身份与逐帧状态分离，并把空间关系与时序转换表示为显式有向结构。给定查询时，符号执行器先尝试用精确图操作求解；仅当符号执行弃权（abstain）时才调用LLM。对未解决查询，采用查询条件化的图检索与证据过滤，保留关系方向、时序局部性与物体语义，为LLM提供紧凑且经校验的任务相关证据，从而将LLM从通用推理引擎转变为针对性的语义推理器。

Result: 在nuScenes v1.0-mini全部十个场景、oracle感知设置下评测5,916个NuScenes-QA问题。完整系统配合GPT-5.4-mini总体准确率80.63%，较对应纯LLM配置提升5.48个百分点；配合DeepSeek-V4-Flash提升达6.64个百分点。计数类问题增益最大，分别提升10.20和12.61个百分点。

Conclusion: 选择性推理（按查询性质分配计算）能同时提升准确率与推理效率，验证了显式符号计算与语义推理分工的神经符号范式优势。

Abstract: Autonomous-driving question answering requires reasoning over structured scene information, yet existing vision-language approaches largely delegate heterogeneous reasoning operations to a single neural inference process. We argue that this uniform strategy overlooks a fundamental distinction: some queries admit exact symbolic solutions, while others require semantic interpretation. We introduce a query-adaptive neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that explicitly allocates computation according to the nature of the query. At its core is a hierarchical Spatiotemporal Scene Graph (STSG) that separates persistent object identities from frame-specific states and represents spatial relations and temporal transitions as explicit directed structures. Given a query, a symbolic executor first attempts to resolve it through exact graph operations; only when symbolic execution abstains is an LLM invoked for semantic reasoning. For these unresolved queries, query-conditioned graph retrieval and evidence filtering preserve relation direction, temporal locality, and object semantics, providing the LLM with compact and verified task-relevant evidence. This design shifts the role of the LLM from a universal reasoning engine to a targeted semantic reasoner, while allowing deterministic computation to be handled exactly and efficiently. We evaluate the framework on 5,916 NuScenes-QA questions across all ten scenes of nuScenes v1.0-mini under an oracle-perception setting. The complete system achieves 80.63 percent overall accuracy with GPT-5.4-mini, improving over the corresponding LLM-only configuration by 5.48 percentage points; with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the improvement reaches 6.64 points. The largest gains occur on counting questions, with improvements of 10.20 and 12.61 points, respectively. These results show that selective reasoning improves both accuracy and inference efficiency.

</details>


### [1518] [Prediction Limits and Koopman Closure of Geometry-Induced Soft State Abstractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32652)
*Mohit Kumar,Somayeh Kargaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究几何诱导的软状态抽象何时容许精确的有限维线性动力学，基于KAHM重建分数构造单纯形坐标，并给出可计算的最小均方根预测误差下置信界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需判断几何诱导的软状态抽象能否被有限维线性动力学精确刻画，并量化预测误差下界，避免仅依赖拟合模型而缺乏理论保证。

Method: 以类特定Kernel Affine Hull Machine重建分数得到单纯形坐标表示状态，用矩阵预测下一时刻坐标；推导在谱范数约束下最小RMSE的可计算下置信界，结合类内后继坐标变异与软坐标偏离one-hot标签的程度，无需拟合预测矩阵即可由状态-后继对评估；并分析重建分数间隔对软硬分配误差的控制，以及在确定性动力学和精确坐标闭包下闭包矩阵及其简约转置的特征向量诱导Koopman与伴随Koopman特征函数。

Result: 证书随样本量增大几乎必然收敛到总体下界，低于该极限的容差最终被证明不可达；四状态KAHM表明相同软坐标在某一动力学映射下可精确闭包、在另一映射下强制正预测误差；在Duffing、Van der Pol、CartPole、MountainCar、Acrobot上进行实验，比较直接软坐标预测与状态空间DMD/EDMD基线并报告预测、表示变异和谱诊断，但基准仅评估拟合模型，未数值评估排除证书。

Conclusion: 给出了软状态抽象线性动力学可预测性的可计算误差下界与Koopman谱联系，并揭示坐标闭包对动力学的依赖性；未来需数值验证排除证书并扩展至更一般动力学。

Abstract: We study when geometry-induced soft state abstractions admit accurate finite-dimensional linear dynamics. Each state is represented by simplex-valued coordinates obtained from class-specific Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) reconstruction scores, and a matrix is used to predict the next-state coordinates. Our main result is a computable lower confidence bound on the minimum root-mean-square prediction error over all matrices satisfying a prescribed spectral-norm limit. The bound combines within-class variation of successor coordinates with the deviation of soft coordinates from their one-hot reference labels, and can be evaluated from independent state-successor pairs without fitting a prediction matrix. For fixed coordinates and evaluation distribution, the certificate converges almost surely to a population lower bound as the sample size grows; any tolerance below this limit is eventually certified unattainable. Reconstruction-score margins further control the soft-to-hard assignment error. Under deterministic dynamics and exact coordinate closure, eigenvectors of the closure matrix and its reduced transpose induce Koopman and adjoint Koopman eigenfunctions, respectively. A four-state KAHM construction shows that identical soft coordinates can permit exact closure under one dynamics map yet force positive prediction error under another. Experiments on Duffing, Van der Pol, CartPole, MountainCar, and Acrobot compare direct soft-coordinate prediction with state-space DMD/EDMD baselines and report prediction, representation-variation, and spectral diagnostics. The benchmarks assess fitted models but do not numerically evaluate the exclusion certificate.

</details>


### [1519] [MixBench-TS: A Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Benchmark Where Channel Mixing Pays Off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32656)
*Ibram Abdelmalak,Mischa Putzke,Jungmin Choi,Tom Hanika,Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi,Lars Schmidt-Thieme*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文质疑标准MTSF数据集是否真存在跨通道耦合，提出可靠度量方法，并构建新基准MixBench-TS以公平评估通道混合模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量时间序列预测（MTSF）中跨通道混合信息的前提是通道间存在耦合，但常用标准数据集很少被检验其跨通道结构。作者希望回答两个问题：如何可靠度量滞后、非线性与联合耦合？标准数据集是否真有这种耦合？

Method: 在带已知耦合的合成数据上测试四种度量：Granger因果（GC）、传递熵（TE）、滞后互信息（MI）以及作者提出的CD gain（比较通道依赖CD模型与其通道独立CI变体）。并构建MixBench-TS基准，包含10个真实数据集；在统一协议下调参比较六种SOTA模型。

Result: 仅滞后MI与CD gain能恢复全部植入耦合。标准数据集耦合很弱：滞后耦合通道对中位数仅23%，CD gain中位数-4.9%；而混沌ODE系统为78%与+4.6%。MixBench-TS中位数分别为55.5%和+1.7%。统一调参下，CI模型在标准数据集10/10（MSE）与8/10（MAE）上胜出，但在MixBench-TS上仅3/10与2/10。

Conclusion: 建议使用MixBench-TS评估新的CD模型，并在使用新数据集评估多变量模型前，先用滞后MI与CD gain对其做耦合画像。

Abstract: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF) models that mix information across channels assume that the past of one channel carries information about the future of another. Yet they are evaluated on a small fixed set of standard datasets whose cross-channel structure is rarely examined. We ask two questions: "How can we reliably measure lagged, non-linear, and joint coupling in MTSF datasets?" and "Do the standard datasets actually have such coupling?" To answer the first, we test four candidate measures on synthetic datasets with planted ground-truth coupling: Granger Causality (GC), Transfer Entropy (TE), lagged Mutual Information (MI), and the CD gain, a model-based measure we introduce that compares a channel-dependent (CD) model to its channel-independent (CI) variant. Only lagged MI and the CD gain recover every planted coupling. For the second question, the answer is a definite no, as the standard datasets have a median of only 23% lagged-coupled channel pairs and a median CD gain of -4.9%, compared to 78% and +4.6% on chaotic ODE systems. We therefore propose MixBench-TS, a benchmark of 10 real-world datasets with a median of 55.5% lagged-coupled pairs and a median CD gain of +1.7%. Across six state-of-the-art models tuned under one protocol, CI models win on 10/10 (MSE) and 8/10 (MAE) standard datasets, but on only 3/10 and 2/10 MixBench-TS datasets. We recommend using our benchmark for evaluating new CD models. Moreover, we propose profiling new datasets with lagged MI and the CD gain before using them to evaluate multivariate models. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mixbench-ts-B027.

</details>


### [1520] [World Models with Predictable Long-Horizon Marginals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32657)
*Yuhao Du,Shunian Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出"一步预测准确"并不保证世界模型的长程推演（rollout）能保持数据分布，提出通过学习固定高斯参考分布的解码器，并约束行为平均转移来显式保持平稳分布，从而在长链推演中稳定维持占用分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型评测通常只看单步预测精度，但准确的单步预测并不保证多步rollout仍停留在数据分布内。作者希望显式地让模型解码出的平稳分布（stationary law）可控，并区分世界模型的三种不同属性。

Method: 学习一个固定高斯参考分布的解码器，使解码出的平稳律显式化；约束行为平均转移以保持该参考。对受控系统，引入条件动作图（conditional action chart）的联合转移，在行为占用层面保持而非要求每个固定动作下的不变性。通过联合状态-动作旋转与平行高斯噪声构造精确保持的转移，并给出可处理的条件密度；推导基于有限初始化库的绝对收敛界，并用条件动作空间散度控制对参考的偏离。

Result: 在十二个控制任务、共216个拟合像素checkpoint上，采用参考混合分布的占用模型在全部36个任务-种子单元中，10^5步的链全部保持；rollout与参考的能量统计量差为-0.0002±0.0003（训练种子标准误）。四个非保持的对比分支均出现链丢失，尽管高斯分支在十步时更准确；离线DreamerV3参考的短程精度也更好。

Conclusion: 结果区分了世界模型的三种属性：所趋近的分布、趋近的速率，以及所学习的条件动力学。短程精度高不等于长程分布保持。

Abstract: Accurate one-step predictions do not ensure that a world model's rollouts retain the data distribution. We make the model's decoded stationary law explicit by learning a decoder of a fixed Gaussian reference and constraining the behaviour-averaged transition to preserve that reference. For controlled systems, a joint transition uses a conditional action chart to preserve behaviour occupancy without requiring invariance at each fixed action. Joint state--action rotations and parallel Gaussian noise give an exactly preserving transition with a tractable conditional density. We derive an absolute convergence bound from finite initialization banks and control departure from the reference through conditional action-space divergence. Across $216$ fitted pixel checkpoints on twelve control tasks, the occupancy model with a reference mixture retains every evaluated chain at $10^5$ steps in all $36$ task--seed cells, with a rollout-minus-reference energy-statistic difference of $-0.0002\pm0.0003$ (training-seed standard error). Each of the four nonpreserving comparison arms loses chains, although the Gaussian arm is more accurate at ten steps. An offline DreamerV3 reference also achieves better short-horizon accuracy. These results distinguish three properties of a world model: the distribution it approaches, the rate of approach, and the conditional dynamics it learns.

</details>


### [1521] [Contract Memory Compiler: Resolve, Then Traverse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32658)
*Zhi Song,XiMing Xing,Chunhan Li,Weian Mao,Zhenchao Tang,Hanbo Huang,Fan Xu,Jiale Zhou,Jiahui Guan,Zejian Ding,Chen Ma,Lusheng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究"更新依赖的证据选择"问题：一条关系的更新可能把多跳问题引向问题中未出现实体的记录。为此提出Contract Memory Compiler（CMC），先离线识别历史中的关系及其陈述位置，再按后续更新确定当前关系，并从问题实体出发追踪，最终一次性把对应原始记录交给答案模型。CMC在FactConsolidation上取得SOTA多跳准确率（总体78.25%，262K时61.0%）；固定关系抽取与答案模型时，先选证据再解更新会使准确率降至21.50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部记忆让语言模型智能体可回答超出上下文窗口的长历史问题，但更新带来的难度高于"检索最近事实"：改动一条关系会重定向多跳问题的证据链，使其指向问题中未提及的实体的记录。现有方法多是在已选上下文里刷新数值，未让当前状态决定读哪些证据。作者因此提出更新依赖的证据选择问题并加以解决。

Method: 提出Contract Memory Compiler（CMC）：在见到问题之前，先用语言模型识别历史中出现的关系，并记录每条关系被陈述的位置；随后应用后续更新以确定当前关系状态；再从问题中命名的实体出发沿着当前关系进行追踪；最后把对应的原始记录一次性传入答案模型，使当前状态决定所读证据，而非仅在先前选定的上下文中刷新数值。

Result: 据作者所知，CMC在FactConsolidation上取得最先进的多跳准确率，总体78.25%，在262K长度下为61.0%。在关系抽取结果与答案模型保持固定的条件下，若先选择证据再解决更新，多跳准确率降至21.50%。此外，作者构建了MQuAKE-MemStream，一个由MQuAKE-Remastered反事实样例派生的有序记忆流数据集。

Conclusion: 证据选择应当由更新后的当前状态驱动，而不是在旧上下文中做数值刷新；CMC验证了这一思路在超长历史多跳问答上的有效性与必要性，并提供了MQuAKE-MemStream作为有序记忆流的评测资源。

Abstract: External memory lets language-model agents answer questions about histories too long for the answer model's context window. Updates create a harder problem than retrieving a recent fact: changing one relation can redirect a multi-hop question to records about an entity absent from the question. We study this update-dependent evidence selection problem and introduce the Contract Memory Compiler (CMC). Before seeing a question, CMC uses a language model to identify relations in the history and record where each one was stated. It applies later updates to determine the current relations, follows them from entities named in the question, and passes the corresponding original records to the answer model in one call. Thus the current state determines which evidence is read, rather than merely refreshing values in a previously selected context. To the best of our knowledge, CMC achieves state-of-the-art multi-hop accuracy on FactConsolidation, reaching 78.25% overall and 61.0% at 262K. With the extracted relations and answer model held fixed, selecting evidence before resolving updates reduces multi-hop accuracy to 21.50%. We also introduce MQuAKE-MemStream, a derived dataset of ordered memory streams built from MQuAKE-Remastered counterfactual cases.

</details>


### [1522] [Learning from a Thoughtful Teacher: Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32667)
*Jiacheng Du,Weiwei Xie,Tianyi Du,Shaoxiong Guo,Qibing Ren,Jiaheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出自适应在线策略自蒸馏（AOPSD），通过自适应控制教师可见的特权信息与反馈强度，缓解在线策略自蒸馏中PI条件捷径问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）用仅训练时可见的特权信息（PI）为仅有问题的学生提供令牌级反馈，无需更大外部教师即可获得稠密在线监督，但其效果依赖PI的设计与使用方式。诊断发现教师效用与学生可学习性之间存在显著差距：少数高分歧令牌主导蒸馏信号，且这些位置上的短教师续写更易暴露显式的PI泄漏而非可迁移的纠错线索，说明存在注入PI条件捷径的强倾向。

Method: 提出AOPSD，自适应决定教师接收什么信息以及其反馈以多强力度影响学习：将每个解编码为推理DAG；按学生不断演进的能力对问题排序；仅揭示其可负担的子图及下一前沿作为PI；对高分歧令牌，使用短教师续写作为探针，在鼓励有用引导的同时抑制教师监督中的PI条件捷径。

Result: 在HMMT25、AIME24、AIME25和BRUMo25上，AOPSD达到72.5% Pass@8，比OPSD高6.7个百分点，比最强竞争基线高4.2个百分点，同时训练时间减少15个百分点且成本更低。

Conclusion: 通过自适应设计特权信息的呈现范围与教师反馈强度，AOPSD在保持在线策略自蒸馏稠密监督优势的同时有效抑制PI条件捷径，实现精度与效率的双重提升。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a question-only student with token-level feedback from a teacher given training-only privileged information (PI). OPSD therefore provides dense, on-policy supervision, and is free of a larger external teacher, but its effectiveness rests on how PI is designed and utilized. Our preliminary diagnostics suggest a significant gap between teacher utility and student learnability, where a small fraction of high-disagreement tokens dominate the distillation signal, and short teacher continuations at these positions further expose more explicit PI leakage than transferable correction cues, indicating a strong intent on injecting PI-conditioned shortcuts. We propose Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation (AOPSD), which adapts what information the teacher receives and how strongly its feedback influences learning. AOPSD encodes each solution as a reasoning DAG, orders problems by the student's evolving capability, and reveals only the affordable subgraph and its next frontier as PI. For high-disagreement tokens, AOPSD utilizes short teacher continuations as probes to encourage useful guidance while mitigating PI-conditioned shortcuts among teacher supervisions. On HMMT25, AIME24, AIME25, and BRUMo25, AOPSD achieves 72.5% Pass@8, which is 6.7 percentage points above OPSD and 4.2 above the strongest competing baseline while reducing 15 percentage points of training time at lower cost.

</details>


### [1523] [What Would Falsify It? A Variable Specific Evidence Standard for Mechanistic Claims About Self Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32670)
*Arshia Eftekhari zadeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文质疑语言模型自我解释是否复用了生成答案的计算，提出"变量身份零假设"证据标准，并以已知线索干预为测试案例进行审计，结论是现有机制可解释性统计量均无法建立因果敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 归因性、可迁移性与可恢复性三种证据各自都与"因果使用"相容，但都无法单独确立因果关系。作者希望为机制可解释性研究建立一个更严格的证据门槛，避免把有利的统计量误读为模型确实在因果上依赖被解释的变量。

Method: 提出证据标准：每个正向统计量都需配对一个"变量特异性零假设"——在尽可能匹配干扰维度（nuisance dimensions）的同时移除被测变量的身份信息，并对未匹配维度进行审计。将该标准应用于一个已知因果案例：用命名错误选项的线索提示（cue）测试三个模型的选择行为偏移，并检验解释文本对该线索的提及率。测试三类估计器，并构造标签打乱（scrambled labels）的对照方向、几何匹配的随机方向，以及审计实际编辑幅度和对比端点。

Result: 线索使错误选项被选率提升64–68个百分点（三个模型）。四个模型中三个的解释提及线索的比例不超过1.8%。三类估计器给出的统计量看似有利，但在三模型分析中均无法在自身对照下确立对线索对比的因果敏感性。最强情形下，恢复出的线索方向达到R²=0.95，并在三个随机种子上均超过几何匹配的随机方向；然而用同一流程但打乱线索标签拟合的方向，在相当的实际编辑幅度下仍能复现61–76%的效应。第四个模型通过了一个交换端点（interchange endpoint），但其编辑幅度不相等、且对比同时改变线索身份与线索-答案一致性，限制了可解释性。

Conclusion: 实验未能解决因果可达性问题，但确立了一项证据要求：有利的机制统计量必须通过变量身份与干扰结构的对照检验。可复用的对照方案包括：分离通用与身份特异的迁移效应、用打乱标签拟合零方向、以及审计实际干预幅度。总体立场是，机制可解释性中的正向结果在缺少此类对照时不足以支持因果结论。

Abstract: When a language model explains an answer it has already given, does it reuse the computation that produced the answer or reconstruct a story from the answer alone? Attribution, transportability and recoverability are each compatible with causal use without establishing it. We propose an evidence standard: pair each positive statistic with a variable specific null that removes the tested variable's identity while matching relevant nuisance dimensions as far as possible, and audit unmatched dimensions.
  We apply this standard to a known cause. A cue naming a wrong option raises the rate of choosing that option by 64 to 68 percentage points across three models. Explanations mention the cue in 1.8 percent of items or fewer in three of four models tested. Three estimator classes yield favorable statistics, but none establishes causal sensitivity to the cue contrast under its own control in the three-model analysis. In the strongest case, a recovered cue direction reaches $R^2$ of 0.95 and exceeds a geometry matched random direction in all three seeds, while a direction fitted by the same pipeline with cue labels scrambled reproduces 61 to 76 percent of its effect at comparable realized edit magnitude. A fourth model passes one interchange endpoint, but unequal edit magnitudes and a contrast that changes both cue identity and cue-answer agreement limit its interpretation.
  These experiments leave causal access unresolved. They establish an evidentiary requirement: favorable mechanistic statistics must survive controls for variable identity and nuisance structure. Reusable controls separate generic from identity specific transport effects, fit null directions with scrambled labels, and audit realized intervention magnitudes.

</details>


### [1524] [Expected Reasoning-Step Return Unifies On-Policy Learning from Rewards and Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32674)
*Qiangqiang He,Jin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出期望推理步回报ERSR，将语义推理步骤视为宏动作，用学生策略蒙特卡洛推演在统一回报空间比较学生动作与教师建议动作的期望最终任务奖励，揭示出结果依赖性不对称；据此提出R²OPL，在成功轨迹上强化学生推理、失败轨迹上蒸馏教师信号，并结合难度缩放与步级调制，在多基准上稳定超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy推理模型可分别从任务奖励或教师信号中学习，但二者形式不同且可能给出冲突更新，导致某一具体推理动作应由哪种信号引导并不明确。论文希望在同一回报空间中量化并比较这两类信号对每一步推理的效用，从而解决信号选择与混合训练的冲突问题。

Method: 提出Expected Reasoning-Step Return（ERSR）：把语义推理步骤当作宏动作，通过学生策略蒙特卡洛推演，估计学生生成动作与教师提出动作的期望最终任务奖励，在共同回报空间中进行步级比较。基于ERSR分析发现不对称性：成功轨迹上学生动作优于教师替换，失败轨迹上教师替换更有利；且学生答案探针增益与学生步ERSR效用相关，可区分有益与有害步骤。据此提出Return-Referenced On-Policy Learning（R²OPL）：成功轨迹上强化学生推理，失败轨迹上蒸馏教师信号，并用组成功率做难度缩放、用学生探针增益做步级调制。

Result: 在多种推理基准与不同教师-学生配置下，R²OPL持续优于强基线。ERSR训练动态表明，R²OPL能同时利用奖励侧与教师侧信号中的显著效用，而现有混合方法常在一侧分支上残留大量未利用效用。

Conclusion: 以统一回报空间度量步级信号效用，能够显式解释并利用奖励信号与教师信号的互补性；按轨迹结果选择性使用奖励强化或教师蒸馏，并结合难度与步级调制，是提升on-policy推理模型性能的有效范式，且能减少信号利用的残余低效。

Abstract: On-policy reasoning models can learn from task rewards or teacher signals, but these sources differ in form and can favor conflicting updates, leaving unclear which should guide a given reasoning action. We introduce \textbf{Expected Reasoning-Step Return (ERSR)}, which treats semantic reasoning steps as macro-actions and uses Monte Carlo student-policy rollouts to estimate the expected final task reward of student-generated and teacher-proposed actions in a common return space for step-level comparison. ERSR analysis reveals an outcome-dependent asymmetry: student actions are more beneficial than teacher replacements on successful trajectories, whereas teacher replacements become more beneficial on failed trajectories. We further show that student answer-probe gains track student-step ERSR utility and distinguish beneficial from harmful reasoning steps. Based on these findings, we propose \textbf{Return-Referenced On-Policy Learning (R$^2$OPL)}, which reinforces student reasoning on successful trajectories and distills teacher signals on failed ones, while using group success rate for difficulty scaling and student-probe gains for step-level modulation. Experiments across reasoning benchmarks and teacher--student configurations show that R$^2$OPL consistently outperforms strong baselines. ERSR training dynamics further show that R$^2$OPL jointly exploits substantial utility from both reward- and teacher-side signals, whereas existing hybrids often leave substantial residual utility in one branch.

</details>


### [1525] [When Better Gets Worse: Improvement Fidelity for Self-Improving Agents in Adaptive Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32677)
*Ke Wang,Zijie Zhao,Zhiyi Yuan,Changlun Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"改进保真度"（Improvement Fidelity）概念，揭示代理验证器排名准确并不保证更新层面的选择正确，并提出决策感知的PIVOT-KG验证器以稀缺高保真评估降低选择遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我改进智能体依赖代理验证器选择策略更新，但部署会改变评估更新的世界，导致验证器看来更优的更新在部署后反而更差。已有工作关注全局策略准确率（proxy排名质量），但忽视了更新层面的误差，因此需要形式化并解决"代理改进是否保持部署改进的符号与排序"这一缺口。

Method: 形式化"改进保真度"（Improvement Fidelity），定义为代理改进是否保持部署改进的符号与次序。分析表明全局策略准确率不能保证更新保真度：算子偏移（operator shift）与部署响应（deployment response）会产生更新级误差，候选边际（candidate margins）决定这些误差是否改变替换决策。提出PIVOT-KG，一种成对、决策感知的验证器，按单位成本下期望选择遗憾的减少量来分配稀缺的高保真评估。

Result: 在Leduc、Kuhn和Melting Pot的90个留出根（held-out roots）上，代理与部署的最优集在51个案例中互不相交。在八候选的HighwayEnv压力测试中，PIVOT-KG在主预算下将平均改进选择遗憾从精确Uniform验证规则的0.0435降至0.0055。

Conclusion: 可靠的自改进应在更新所诱导的世界中评估候选改进，而非仅依赖全局代理准确率；PIVOT-KG提供了在部署证据稀缺且可影响替换决策时进行有效分配的实用规则。

Abstract: Self-improving agents increasingly rely on proxy verifiers to choose policy updates, yet deployment can change the world in which those updates are evaluated. An update that looks better to the verifier can therefore become worse after deployment even when the verifier ranks policies well overall. We formalize this gap as Improvement Fidelity, which asks whether proxy improvements preserve the sign and ordering of deployment improvements over the updates an improvement process actually proposes. We show that global policy accuracy need not guarantee update fidelity: operator shift and deployment response can create update-level errors, while candidate margins determine whether those errors change the replacement decision. We introduce PIVOT-KG, a paired, decision-aware validator that allocates scarce high-fidelity evaluation according to the expected reduction in selection regret per unit cost. Across 90 held-out roots in Leduc, Kuhn, and Melting Pot, proxy and deployment optimal sets are disjoint in 51 cases. In an eight-candidate HighwayEnv stress test, PIVOT-KG reduces mean improvement-selection regret from 0.0435 under the exact Uniform validation rule to 0.0055 at the primary budget. Together, these results show why reliable self-improvement should evaluate proposed improvements in the worlds they induce, while providing a practical rule for allocating scarce deployment evidence when it can affect the replacement decision.

</details>


### [1526] [PINNMorph: Evolving Online Adaptation Policies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32685)
*Xu Yang,Mingyang Yu,Jun Zhang,Keqian Li,Jing Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PINNMorph：基于LLM引导策略进化的在线PINN自适应框架，在13个PDE基准上误差优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN训练过程中残差分布、梯度交互、区域学习难度与容量需求会随时间演变，但网络结构与主要训练机制通常在训练前固定，缺乏在线自适应能力。

Method: 维护一组状态条件自适应策略群体，将执行诊断映射为对拓扑修改、加性表示增强、目标平衡、梯度处理、自适应采样与优化器阶段控制的干预；在每个干预时机从策略群体实例化候选程序，按训练状态选择并直接施加于训练中的PINN，模型继承已有参数与训练状态并沿同一轨迹继续优化，再以执行结果评估干预并进化策略群体（LLM引导的策略进化）。

Result: 在13个PDE基准上，解误差均低于SA-PINN、ConFIG、RoPINN、HARMONIC与PINNsAgent；消融实验考察了在线自适应、状态条件干预选择及执行反馈驱动策略进化的作用。

Conclusion: 区别于预训练架构搜索或固定自适应规则，PINNMorph利用真实训练反馈联合自适应当前PINN及其干预策略，验证了在线自适应对PINN求解精度的有效性。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a learning-based framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their training behavior can change substantially throughout optimization. Residual distributions, gradient interactions, regional learning difficulty, and model-capacity requirements may evolve over time, while the network architecture and major training mechanisms are typically determined before training. We propose PINNMorph, an online PINN adaptation framework based on large language model (LLM)-guided policy evolution. PINNMorph maintains a population of state-conditioned adaptation policies that map execution diagnostics to controlled interventions over topology modification, additive representation augmentation, objective balancing, gradient handling, adaptive sampling, and optimizer-phase control. At each intervention opportunity, candidate programs are instantiated from the current policy population, selected according to the observed training state, and applied directly to the PINN under training. The resulting model inherits its existing parameters and training state and continues optimization along the same trajectory. Execution outcomes are subsequently used to evaluate interventions and evolve the policy population. Unlike pre-training architecture search or fixed adaptation rules, PINNMorph jointly adapts the current PINN and the policies governing its interventions using feedback from actual training. Experiments on 13 PDE benchmarks show that PINNMorph achieves lower solution errors than SA-PINN, ConFIG, RoPINN, HARMONIC, and PINNsAgent across all evaluated problems. Ablation studies further examine the effects of online adaptation, state-conditioned intervention selection, and execution-feedback-driven policy evolution.

</details>


### [1527] [Dude, Where's My State? Execution Information Requirements for Stateful Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32687)
*Nikita Mehrotra,Ashish Tiwari,Priyanshu Gupta,Sumit Gulwani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出执行信息需求（EIR）概念及LACUNA、VESTIGE两个框架，系统评估长时程智能体在任务执行中对关键信息的保留与恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体必须保留后续步骤所依赖的信息，但现有研究缺乏对“信息保留与恢复能力”的独立量化手段，也难以将其与单步操作难度分离评估。

Method: 提出EIR（执行信息需求），作为在给定任务与访问条件下正确完成任务所需可访问信息量的下界；构建LACUNA框架，生成依赖关系已知、且可分别控制信息需求、保留时长与恢复难度的任务；提出VESTIGE，利用智能体执行轨迹构建语义图并度量真实任务的信息需求。

Result: 在四个模型上，恢复缺失结果使受影响的回忆步骤准确率提升至100%，而与等长无关信息的对照为0%；仅有充足存储并不能保证成功，保留策略会丢弃必需结果、错误会沿后续计算传播、智能体可能在恢复完成前停止。基于72,562条软件智能体轨迹，VESTIGE发现失败运行中与距离相关的解题相关重读下降更陡（距离每翻倍RR为0.951），而调整后的峰值需求单独并不与失败相关联。

Conclusion: EIR、LACUNA与VESTIGE共同构成了评估智能体是否保留并恢复任务所需信息的框架，表明信息保留与恢复是独立于操作难度的重要能力维度。

Abstract: Long-running agents must preserve information that later steps depend on. We introduce the Execution Information Requirement (EIR), a lower bound on the information that must remain accessible for correct completion under specified task and access conditions. We develop LACUNA, a framework that generates tasks with known dependencies and varies information demand, retention, and recovery separately from the difficulty of individual operations. Across four models, restoring a missing result raises accuracy on affected recall steps to 100%, compared with 0% for equal-length irrelevant information. Sufficient storage alone does not ensure success: retention policies can discard required results, errors can propagate through later computations, and agents can stop before recovery is complete. We also introduce VESTIGE, which uses agent execution traces to construct semantic graphs and measure information demand for real tasks. Across 72,562 software-agent trajectories, VESTIGE reveals a steeper distance-related decline in solution-relevant rereading for failed runs (RR 0.951 per distance doubling), while adjusted peak demand alone is not associated with failure. Together, these contributions support evaluating whether agents preserve and recover the information their tasks require.

</details>


### [1528] [World Agent: Can Language Models Keep a World Running?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32692)
*Weixing Chen,Weipeng Zhang,Nan An,Yang Liu,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"世界智能体任务"（world agent task），将世界生成的评测点从"交付时刻"后移到"持续运行"，并构建WorldAgent-Benchmark（含维护与推演两轨），以衡量模型能否持续维护世界运行、正确组织因果事件流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型正从生成逼真画面转向生成可运行世界，但"交付的世界能否持续运行"无人评测。现有评测分别止步于生成、交付或单步转移，各自停在不同环节；正确的局部状态转移或中间结果并不保证因果事件流被正确组织。

Method: 提出world agent任务：模型不负责生成世界，而负责维持世界运行，需协调事件并传递其后果以约束后续演化。在WorldAgent-Benchmark中实例化两条互补轨道：维护轨（maintenance）要求将连续叙事事件落地为显式世界状态的正确转移，并满足因果、时序与并发约束，采用LLM辅助语义判断结合程序化验证与评分；推演轨（deduction）要求在部分观测下预测世界演化并朝目标行动，完全程序化评测。单项判断可对照世界状态与执行日志审计，分数可由保存的判断与执行记录重算。

Result: 在8个模型上，随着预置结构被逐步移除，得分持续下降；因果关系检查是所有模型中最弱的环节。

Conclusion: 该基准使"世界的持续运行"变得可度量，并能区分局部完成与事件组织层面的失败。代码与数据集将在 https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/WorldAgent-Benchmark 发布。

Abstract: World models are moving from generating realistic frames to generating playable worlds, yet whether a delivered world can keep running is not tested anywhere. Existing evaluations stop at generation, at delivery, or at single-step transitions, and each stops at a different point along the way. Correct local state transitions or intermediate outcomes do not guarantee a correctly organized causal event flow. We propose the world agent task, which moves the evaluation point of world generation from the moment of delivery to the continued operation that follows. In this task, a model is not asked to generate a world. It is held responsible for keeping the world running, which requires coordinating events and carrying forward their consequences to constrain subsequent evolution. We instantiate the task in WorldAgent-Benchmark with two complementary tracks. In the maintenance track, the model must ground the events of a continuous narrative into correct transitions of the explicit world state while respecting causal, temporal, and concurrency constraints. In the deduction track, the model must predict how the world will evolve under partial observations and act toward a goal. The maintenance track combines LLM-assisted semantic judgments with programmatic validation and scoring, while the deduction track is evaluated entirely programmatically. Individual judgments are auditable against world states and execution logs, and scores can be recomputed from the saved judgments and execution records. Across 8 models, scores decline steadily as pre-built structure is removed from the world, and causal-relation checking is the weakest component for every model. The benchmark makes the continued operation of a world measurable and distinguishes local completion from failures in event organization. Code and dataset will be released on https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/WorldAgent-Benchmark.

</details>


### [1529] [Flat-Consensus Diffusion for Robust Data Reshaping under Noisy Evaluator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32696)
*Hongyu Cao,Kunpeng Liu,Fei Xie,Sandip Ray*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FCDiff（flat-consensus diffusion）框架，将鲁棒的特征重塑操作序列搜索建模为奖励引导的扩散生成问题，通过微观-宏观双层分解同时缓解噪声评估器与随机生成轨迹的双重不稳定性，在8个数据集上取得最优的可靠性排名与鲁棒性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据形状（data shape）决定了特征的组织方式、模式的分离程度以及分布对底层域的覆盖情况。不良的数据形状会使模型学习噪声而非可泛化的结构。因此需要面向特征的数据重塑方法，生成在噪声评估和不完美数据条件下仍然有用、稳定且可复现的特征变换。核心难点在于"双重不稳定性"（dual instability）：噪声评估器会扭曲局部奖励引导，而随机生成轨迹可能收敛到不一致的解。

Method: 将重塑操作序列搜索视为奖励引导的扩散生成（reward-guided diffusion generation），将鲁棒重塑视为在潜在奖励景观中搜索区域而非孤立的高奖励变换。提出FCDiff框架，采用微观-宏观分解：微观层（micro layer）以高斯平滑的蒙特卡洛平均梯度替代点估计奖励引导，使生成朝向局部平坦的奖励区域；宏观层（macro layer）用加权Fréchet均值重心（weighted Frechet-mean barycenter）聚合独立引导的轨迹，选择共识支持的盆地并过滤随机离群点。

Result: 在重尾评估器噪声下，于8个数据集的headline cohort上，FCDiff在下尾可靠性（lower-tail reliability）与鲁棒性方面取得最佳综合排名，优于基于搜索的AutoFE方法和面向鲁棒性的生成式基线，且相对每个生成式基线均有统计显著的精度提升。

Conclusion: 鲁棒的数据重塑需要搜索平坦且共识支持的区域，而非尖锐的单轨迹最优解。

Abstract: Data shape determines how features are structured, how patterns are separated, and how distributions cover the underlying domain. Poor data shape can make models learn noise rather than generalizable structure. This paper studies robust feature-centric data reshaping: generating feature transformations that remain useful, stable, and reproducible under noisy evaluation and imperfect data conditions. We view reshaping operation sequence search as reward-guided diffusion generation, and robust reshaping as searching for regions in the latent reward landscape rather than isolated high-reward transformations. The key challenge is dual instability: noisy evaluators distort local reward guidance, while stochastic generative trajectories can converge to inconsistent solutions. We propose FCDiff, a flat-consensus diffusion framework that addresses both failures through a micro-macro decomposition. The micro layer replaces point-estimate reward guidance with Gaussian-smoothed, Monte Carlo averaged gradients, steering generation toward locally flat reward regions. The macro layer aggregates independently guided trajectories with a weighted Frechet-mean barycenter, selecting consensus-supported basins and filtering stochastic outliers. Across an 8-dataset headline cohort under heavy-tailed evaluator noise, FCDiff attains the best aggregate rank on lower-tail reliability and robustness against both search-based AutoFE and robustness-oriented generative baselines, with statistically significant accuracy gains over every generative baseline. Our results show that robust data reshaping requires searching for flat, consensus-supported regions rather than sharp single-trajectory optima.

</details>


### [1530] [CAIRN: Dynamic Fact-Intent DAGs for Multi-Agent Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32700)
*Zuyao Xu,Yuyang Jia,Junwei Guan,Xiang Li,Kaiwen Shen,Zhiqiang Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CAIRN——一种基于事实-意图驱动的多智能体探索范式，用动态有向无环图（DAG）组织观测与探索计划，在网络安全与数学推理任务上验证其可扩展的效率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 驱动的自主系统在数学推理、工程与网络安全等领域已展现潜力，但如何组织这些系统以实现高效、可靠且可持续的性能仍是未解问题。现有协调方式缺乏对目标、依赖与发现的持久结构化表示，导致知识难以复用、探索难以并行、轨迹难以追溯与审计。

Method: 提出 CAIRN：将观测与计划中的探索表示为动态 DAG。由 reasoner 解释事实并生成 intent，worker 执行 intent 产出新事实；每个 intent 引用其支撑事实并对应一条潜在探索分支。持久化图结构跨 worker 保留目标、依赖与发现，支持知识复用与并行探索，并使执行轨迹可追溯、可审计，便于人工验证与干预。在网络安全与数学推理任务上评估任务成功率、求解时间与 token 消耗。

Result: 在低投入任务上，DAG 式协调会带来更高的 token 成本且无可观测性能收益；但在高投入任务（≥1M tokens）中，76.5% 的情况下求解更快，最高加速达 3.08 倍。随着任务投入增加，时间收益更显著，而相对 token 开销下降。

Conclusion: DAG 引导的并行探索在高难度、高投入任务上具有明显的时间效率优势，且其相对开销随任务规模增大而递减，显示出该范式在复杂目标导向探索中的潜力；但简单任务上需权衡额外协调成本。

Abstract: LLM-powered autonomous systems have demonstrated promising capabilities in mathematical reasoning, engineering, and cybersecurity. Yet how to organize these systems for effective, reliable, and sustained performance remains an open question. In this paper, we present CAIRN, a fact-intent-driven multi-agent paradigm for goal-directed exploration. CAIRN represents observations and planned investigations as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG). A reasoner interprets facts to propose intents, which workers execute to produce new facts. Each intent references its supporting facts and defines a potential exploration branch. The persistent graph preserves goals, dependencies and findings across workers, supporting knowledge reuse and parallel exploration. The graph also makes execution trajectories traceable and auditable, providing a basis for human verification and intervention. We evaluate CAIRN across cybersecurity and mathematical reasoning tasks, examining task success, time to solution, and token consumption. DAG-based coordination can incur higher token costs with no observable performance gains on tasks that require little effort. However, on high-effort tasks (at least 1M tokens), we observe faster solutions in 76.5% of cases, with speedups of up to 3.08x. Moreover, as task effort increases, these time gains become more pronounced while relative token overhead declines, highlighting the potential of DAG-guided parallel exploration.

</details>


### [1531] [CoWindow Attention: Full Causal Coverage Is a Collective Property](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32704)
*Jingze Shi,Zhangyang Peng,Xianduo Li,Yanlin Qi,Xiaotian Lin,Haoxian Chen,Liangdong Wang,Guang Liu,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoWA提出一种结构化注意力架构，将因果历史的访问分散到不同KV头上，通过共享近对角与prefix-sink窗口加互补长程窗口的集合实现全覆盖，在保持精度的同时显著降低时延与显存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FullAttn让每个注意力头都访问完整因果历史，造成大量冗余计算与显存流量，即使使用IO高效稠密kernel也难以避免。

Method: CoWA将因果历史的访问分布到KV头上：所有头共享近对角与prefix-sink窗口，其余历史由互补的长程窗口划分；每个头对远距离token稀疏关注，但头集合的并集提供完整因果覆盖。该模式由位置定义，无需学习router或indexer，训练与推理一致使用，并与KV-head张量并行对齐。

Result: 8K窗口匹配消融中，100%集合覆盖的CoWA达89.73%准确率，FullAttn为89.97%，重复长程窗口明显更差。匹配token预算的联想召回对比中，CoWA随上下文增长紧追FullAttn，其他稀疏模式损失大量关联。128K张量并行算子基准中，训练前向/反向时延降低7.4x/8.6x，推理解码降低3.0x，训练每rank峰值算子显存与FullAttn相当，解码降低7.6x。0.6B至14B规模的scaling-law训练中，CoWA困惑度紧追FullAttn并减少总训练FLOPs；14B与32B续训模型在知识、推理与长上下文检索上可比FullAttn。

Conclusion: 完整因果覆盖可以是头集合的集体属性，而非每个头重复具备的属性，从而在保持性能的同时获得显著效率收益。

Abstract: FullAttn repeatedly exposes the complete causal history to every attention head, creating substantial redundant computation and memory traffic even with IO-efficient dense kernels. We introduce CoWA, a structured attention architecture that distributes access to the causal history across KV heads. All heads share near-diagonal and prefix-sink windows, while complementary long-range windows partition the remaining history. Their union provides full causal coverage although each head attends sparsely to distant tokens. This position-defined attention pattern requires no learned router or indexer, is used consistently during training and inference, and aligns with KV-head tensor parallelism. A window-matched ablation at 8K isolates the effect of complementary long-range allocation: CoWA with 100% collective coverage reaches 89.73% accuracy, compared with 89.97% for FullAttn, while duplicated long-range windows perform substantially worse. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison with matched token budgets, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn as the context grows, whereas other sparse patterns lose a substantial fraction of the associations. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, CoWA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 7.4x and 8.6x and decoding latency during inference by 3.0x over FullAttn. Its per-rank peak operator memory matches FullAttn during training and is 7.6x lower during decoding. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results show that full causal coverage can be a collective property of the head ensemble rather than a duplicated property of every head.

</details>


### [1532] [SkillVine: Agent Skill Evolution via Branching Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32731)
*Kaiwei Liu,Jiqian Dong,Liran Dong,Shuai Mao,Mingming Zhao,Bufang Yang,Jie Chuai,Zhitang Chen,Guoliang Xing,Zhenyu Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SkillVine 框架，将 LLM Agent 的技能演化建模为图搜索问题，通过分支探索策略克服线性演化陷入局部最优的问题，在 5 个基准、2 个 LLM 的十个组合中九个取得最优测试性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Agent 技能演化方法普遍采用线性演化范式，即顺序地在最新技能库版本上施加更新。这种单路径演进不可避免地陷入局部最优，导致大量潜在更优的演化路径未被探索。因此需要一种能同时探索多条演化路径的机制，以提升技能库的最终质量。

Method: SkillVine 将技能演化形式化为图搜索问题，并采用分支探索策略。核心组件包括三项：主干-分支协同搜索机制（trunk-branch collaborative searching），用于并行维护主干与分支的演化路径；智能父节点选择器（intelligent parent-node selector），决定从哪个技能库版本继续扩展；自适应粒度更新规则（adaptive-granularity update rule），动态调整技能更新幅度。三者协同实现探索与利用的平衡。

Result: 在 5 个基准和 2 个 LLM 上评估，共 10 个基准-模型组合。结果显示，沿分支发现的技能库版本优于沿线性主干得到的版本，SkillVine 在其中 9 个组合上取得最佳测试性能。

Conclusion: 将技能演化从线性范式转变为图搜索范式是有效且必要的，分支探索能够突破局部最优并发现更优技能库版本。SkillVine 在多种基准与模型上表现稳定优越，说明该框架具有较好的通用性。

Abstract: Agent skills encapsulate reusable procedural knowledge that enables LLM agents to perform tasks, and they can be improved automatically using trajectories from interactions with the environment. This is the classic problem of skill evolution. Existing approaches predominately follow a linear evolution paradigm, in which updates are sequentially applied to the latest skill-library version. As a result, they inevitably fall into local optima, leaving many promising evolution paths unexplored. We propose SkillVine, an automatic skill-evolution framework that formulates skill evolution as a graph search problem and employs a branching exploration strategy. Equipped with a trunk-branch collaborative searching mechanism, an intelligent parent-node selector, and an adaptive-granularity update rule, SkillVine achieves a balance between exploration and exploitation. We evaluate SkillVine on 5 benchmarks with two LLMs. Results show that SkillVine discovers better skill-library versions along branches than along the linear trunk and achieves the best test performance in nine of ten benchmark-model combinations.

</details>


### [1533] [CUA-Sandbox: Efficient Environments for Computer-Use Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32750)
*Xin Yan,Zhengbo Jiao,Jiaqi Liu,Zhenglin Wan,SiYuan Ma,Xuliang Yu,Tianyi Jiang,Chubin Zhang,Pengfei Zhou,Wangbo Zhao,Xingrui Yu,Bo An,Yang You,Ivor Tsang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 CUA-Sandbox，一种将私有可变状态与共享应用运行时分离的计算机使用智能体沙箱，通过状态作用域执行与事务化生命周期操作复用初始化运行时，在大幅提升 rollout 吞吐、降低内存与存储开销的同时保持任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习驱动的计算机使用智能体需与真实软件环境（网站、桌面应用）交互学习，但传统部署为每个独立 rollout 复制一份初始化运行时，即使轨迹使用相同软件也要重复承担内存与初始化成本，随并行环境数量增长开销急剧上升。核心问题在于：独立的计算机使用环境是否真的需要独立的执行运行时？

Method: 作者观察到：轨迹真正需要的是独立可变状态，而已初始化的应用运行时可在并发演进的环境中复用，因此"状态"才是环境独立性的自然单元。基于此提出 CUA-Sandbox，通过状态作用域执行（state-scoped execution）将私有状态胶囊（state capsules）与共享运行时分离，并提供事务化生命周期操作（重置、分支），同时保留原有软件接口与任务评测器。

Result: 实验显示，CUA-Sandbox 相比 Docker 在任务成功率上相当或更优，同时显著降低 rollout 与资源成本：rollout 吞吐量最高提升 6.20 倍，单环境内存降低 9.2 倍，增量存储降低 504 倍。

Conclusion: 该工作表明计算机使用环境无需独立运行时，以状态为独立性单元、复用共享运行时是可行且高效的方案，为强化学习规模化训练计算机使用智能体提供了高吞吐、低资源占用的沙箱基础设施，且在保持接口与评测兼容性的前提下不损失任务性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables computer-use agents to improve through interaction with real software environments, including websites and desktop applications. However, conventional deployments replicate an initialized runtime for each independent rollout, even when trajectories use the same software, incurring repeated memory and initialization costs as the number of parallel environments grows. Does an independent computer-use environment require an independent execution runtime? Our key observation is that trajectories require independent mutable state, while initialized application runtimes can be reused across concurrently evolving environments, making state the natural unit of environment independence. Guided by this observation, we introduce CUA-Sandbox, which separates private state capsules from shared runtimes through state-scoped execution and transactional lifecycle operations, including resets and branches, while retaining the original software interfaces and task evaluators. Experiments show comparable or improved task success relative to Docker, while substantially reducing rollout and resource costs. CUA-Sandbox achieves up to a 6.20x increase in rollout throughput, a 9.2x reduction in per-environment memory, and a 504x reduction in incremental storage.

</details>


### [1534] [Action Shaping: Policies Absorb What They Can Express](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32752)
*Yanjun Chen,Jinghan Wang,Xiaoyu Shen,Wenjie Li,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"动作塑形"（action shaping）原则：训练时在动作通道叠加偏移、部署时移除，其可移除性的充要条件是策略输出层能精确复现该偏移（"可表达"），并给出机制与诊断方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励塑形有定理保证：基于势能的项可移除而不改变最优策略；但动作通道上的偏移（训练加入、部署移除）缺少对应定理。没有任何机制能自动抵消动作偏移，因此实践中只能在部署时保留该修正，或移除却无保证。作者希望为动作塑形建立类似的理论基础。

Method: 提出并陈述动作塑形原则：可训练策略会"吸收"其输出层能精确复现的偏移。最小实例是置于可学习门控之后的零初始化线性头，加到一个通过已学习的动作价值函数训练的actor上，不设惩罚项或调度。并设计配对对照实验：对比非线性头（参数更多）与在线性基头上额外加一条线性路径的情形。

Result: 门控自行先升后降，确定性actor与随机actor均如此；在20个任务上，移除该头几乎无代价。关键条件是精确复现而非容量：参数更多的非线性头不会被吸收，而在线性基头上加一条线性路径可恢复吸收。精确复现使损失出现平坦方向，梯度噪声沿此漂移；偏移的幅度可在移除前预示丢弃该头的代价。

Conclusion: 动作塑形获得了塑形定理的对应版本：一个吸收条件、其背后机制，以及可读取该条件的诊断指标。核心结论是：策略只吸收其能表达的部分，且仅限于此。

Abstract: Reward shaping has a theorem: a potential-based term can be removed without changing the optimal policy. The same practice on the action channel, an offset added in training and dropped at deployment, has no theorem. Nothing cancels an action offset, so the correction is kept at deployment or removed without a guarantee. We call it action shaping and state its principle. A trainable policy absorbs an offset its own output layer can reproduce exactly, which is what we mean by express; what is absorbed can be removed with the return intact. Its minimal instance is a zero-initialized linear head behind a learnable gate, added to an actor that trains through a learned action-value function, with no penalty or schedule. The gate rises and then falls on its own, for deterministic and stochastic actors alike, and on 20 tasks removing the head costs almost nothing. The condition is exact reproduction, not capacity: a nonlinear head with more parameters is not absorbed, and in a paired control, one linear path added to a nonlinear base head restores absorption. Exact reproduction gives the loss a flat direction that gradient noise drifts along, and the offset's amplitude indicates, before removal, what dropping the head will cost. Action shaping thus gains the counterpart of the shaping theorem, a condition for absorption, together with the mechanism behind it and a diagnostic that reads it. Policies absorb what they can express, and only that.

</details>


### [1535] [Mandela-Bench: Multimodal Models Remember Canonical Images Instead of Seeing Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32763)
*Yicheng Bao,Zhenkun Gao,Xiahui Guo,Mingqian Yang,Xueheng Li,Bangwei Liu,Mingang Chen,Lijun Li,Xuhong Wang,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出Mandela-Bench基准（1,507个经典图像编辑样本，含1,359个知识型伪造、148个无锚点对照和474个原图），系统评测36个多模态模型，发现它们倾向于用记忆中的"经典图像"覆盖实际观察到的编辑，导致对知识型伪造的检测与解释普遍失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像伪造检测基准依赖生成器伪影、图文不一致、视觉不合理性或外部参考，未能检验模型是否能用自身世界知识去核验一张被识别出的经典图像。而当前单指令即可无缝编辑历史照片，像素层面可能无可靠痕迹，唯一证据可能是"图像内容违背了某个事实"，这一空白构成了研究动机。

Method: 构建Mandela-Bench：1,507个经典图像编辑（1,359个知识型伪造，每个违背一个可验证事实；148个无锚点对照，保留编辑流程但不引入事实矛盾），外加474张未修改原图。评测不仅判断是否检出伪造，还评估解释是否指出被插入的实体或被违背的事实。对36个多模态模型（0.8B至前沿规模）进行测试，并控制条件：提供真实事件与日期、裁剪去除可识别构图后再提供相同信息、显式验证提示等。

Result: 跨36个模型发现一致失败模式：从熟悉照片中移除公众人物后，模型仍在高达72.7%的回复中说出该人物；部分模型在孤立呈现时能区分替换人脸与原脸，却仍判定完整编辑照片为真实。提供真实事件与日期不改善知识型检测，而在裁剪掉可识别构图后提供相同信息则有效。即便在显式验证提示下，36个模型中仅1个在至少一半伪造图像上满足KGR标准。

Conclusion: 失败无法仅用知识缺失或感知不足解释，而是与"识别过程将验证偏向记忆中的经典图像、而非观察到的编辑"这一机制一致。研究揭示了多模态模型在世界知识核验上的系统性偏差，为知识与感知交互的评估提供新范式。

Abstract: Historical photographs and other canonical images can now be edited seamlessly with a single instruction, often leaving no reliable pixel-level trace. In such cases, the only evidence of manipulation may be a fact about what the image depicts. Existing benchmarks instead rely on generator artefacts, image-caption inconsistencies, visual implausibilities, or external references, and therefore do not test whether a model can use its own world knowledge to verify a recognized image. We introduce Mandela-Bench, containing 1,507 edits of canonical images: 1,359 knowledge-only forgeries, each contradicting one verifiable fact, and 148 anchor-free controls that preserve the editing process without introducing a factual contradiction, together with 474 untouched originals. We score not only whether a model detects a forgery, but whether its explanation identifies the inserted entity or the fact being violated. Across 36 multimodal models, from 0.8B parameters to frontier scale, we find a consistent failure mode. When a public figure is removed from a familiar photograph, models still name that person in up to 72.7% of responses. Some models can distinguish the replacement face from the original when shown in isolation, yet still judge the full edited photograph as authentic. Providing the true event and date does not improve knowledge-grounded detection, whereas providing the same information after cropping away the recognizable composition does. Even under explicit verification prompts, only one of the 36 models meets the KGR criterion on at least half of the forged images. These results suggest that the failures cannot be explained by missing knowledge or inadequate perception alone. Instead, they are consistent with recognition biasing verification toward the remembered canonical image rather than the observed edit.

</details>


### [1536] [Forecasting Intraday USD/CAD Exchange Rate with News-Derived Monetary-Policy Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32773)
*Maya Kodeih,Aliaa Alnaggar,Mucahit Cevik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统计归因方法，将货币政策沟通拆解为可解释渠道，并在错误发现率控制下量化各渠道的增量预测贡献；结果显示沟通具有可测的预测信息，且价值集中于少数信号，沟通时机贡献最强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 货币政策公告与央行沟通在外汇市场中作用关键，但其定性、非结构化特征使预测价值难以量化。既有研究多关注金融新闻情绪，对不同货币政策沟通维度的相对贡献了解有限，且主要评估文本信息是否整体提升预测表现，难以识别驱动改进的具体沟通渠道。

Method: 提出统计归因方法，将货币政策沟通分解为可解释渠道，并在错误发现率（FDR）控制下量化其增量预测贡献。利用大语言模型（LLM）与时间特征工程将货币政策新闻转化为结构化沟通信号，并采用滚动窗口实验配合树模型机器学习方法进行评估。

Result: 货币政策沟通包含可测量的预测信息。归因分析表明预测价值集中于少数信号：沟通时机在单特征层面贡献最强，针对性的沟通活动度量亦有正向贡献，LLM提取的情绪在组层面提供互补信息。

Conclusion: 基于沟通的预测价值不限于情绪单一维度；评估新闻衍生信号时，归因分析比单纯的聚合准确率更为关键。

Abstract: Monetary-policy announcements and central-bank communications play a central role in foreign exchange markets, yet their qualitative, unstructured form makes their forecasting value difficult to quantify. While prior research has largely focused on sentiment extracted from financial news, comparatively little is known about the relative contribution of different dimensions of monetary-policy communication. Existing studies primarily evaluate whether textual information improves overall forecasting performance but provide limited insight into which communication channels drive such improvements. To address this gap, this paper introduces a statistical attribution methodology that decomposes monetary-policy communication into interpretable channels and quantifies their incremental forecasting contribution under false-discovery-rate control. Monetary-policy news is transformed into structured communication signals using large language models (LLMs) and temporal feature engineering. These signals are evaluated using rolling-window experiments with tree-based machine-learning models. The results show that monetary-policy communication contains measurable predictive information. Attribution analysis shows that predictive value is concentrated in a small subset of signals, with communication timing providing the strongest individual feature-level contribution, targeted communication-activity measures also contributing positively, and LLM-derived sentiment providing complementary information at the group level. The findings indicate that communication-based forecasting value extends beyond sentiment alone and that attribution, rather than aggregate accuracy alone, is central to evaluating news-derived signals.

</details>


### [1537] [Agentic Network Traffic Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32778)
*Manuel Tsoukatos,Hayden Jananthan,Jeremy Kepner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用复值超稀疏流量矩阵监控智能体系统网络流量的新方法，通过集成 DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL 数据库与 GraphBLAS 数学库实现，并构建多智能体仿真器进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体人工智能在各行业的广泛应用，攻击面不断扩大，亟需监控智能体行为以确保其与用户意图一致。审计智能体的网络流量可提供其交互的清晰记录，因此有必要开发针对智能体系统的网络流量监控手段。

Method: 采用复值超稀疏流量矩阵来表示网络流量，集成 DBOS（DataBase OS）、OneSparse PostgreSQL 数据库以及 GraphBLAS 数学库。同时构建了一个智能体仿真器，支持不同数量的 AI 智能体采用不同策略协作勘测虚拟环境。

Result: 生成了便于监控 AI 智能体的网络流量矩阵，并验证了该方法的可行性。

Conclusion: 研究表明，基于复值超稀疏流量矩阵并结合 DBOS、OneSparse 与 GraphBLAS 的方法能够有效监控智能体系统的网络流量，为智能体行为对齐审计提供了可行技术路径。

Abstract: As the use of agentic artificial intelligence increases in nearly every industry, there exists a widening attack surface. It is necessary to monitor agents to ensure that agents are acting in a way that is aligned with the users intent. Auditing an agent's network traffic provides a clear record of the agent interactions. This work presents a novel approach to monitoring the network traffic of agentic systems using complex valued hypersparse traffic matrices by integrating DBOS (DataBase OS), the OneSparse PostgreSQL database, and the GraphBLAS math library. To develop these concepts an agentic simulator was constructed, allowing a varying numbers of AI agents to collectively survey a virtual environment using different strategies. The resulting network traffic matrices enable easy monitoring of the AI agents.

</details>


### [1538] [Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32782)
*Xiaolei Lu,Shamim Nemati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种“响应感知”的患者动力学模型（response-aware patient dynamics model），在自回归状态更新中显式建模生理变化，将预测的生理变化分解为状态依赖的基线动态与呼吸支持相关的偏离量，并以室内空气作为参考基准进行锚定；模型通过响应通路编码预测的生理变化并更新潜在患者状态。在两个独立机构的ICU队列上，该模型取得了与基线相当的整体轨迹预测性能，并在生理状态变化时表现更稳定、更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 呼吸支持会影响危重患者的短期生理轨迹，但接受相同干预的患者可能呈现不同的生理演变路径。现有临床患者动力学模型通常依据近期生理指标与已记录的干预来预测未来状态，而生理变化主要体现在所预测的未来状态中，未对“变化”本身进行显式建模，难以刻画个体对同一干预的不同响应。

Method: 提出响应感知患者动力学模型，在自回归状态更新中显式表示生理变化。将预测的生理变化分解为两部分：状态依赖的基线动态，以及与呼吸支持相关的偏离量；以室内空气（room air）作为分解的参考基准，并对该“参考锚定”形式给出形式化分析。模型设置响应通路（response pathway），编码预测的生理变化，并在整个预测时域内用于更新潜在患者状态。

Result: 在两个独立机构的ICU队列上，该模型在整体轨迹预测上与患者动力学基线模型性能相当，而在生理状态发生变化的时段，改进更加一致且明显。

Conclusion: 通过在自回归更新中显式建模并参考锚定生理变化，模型能够更稳定地刻画患者对呼吸支持的响应，尤其在生理状态动态变化时优势更突出，为个体化危重患者轨迹预测提供了新的建模范式。

Abstract: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU cohorts from two independent institutions, the proposed model achieves comparable overall trajectory prediction to patient dynamics baselines, with more consistent improvements when physiological states are changing.

</details>


### [1539] [$T^5$: Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts in Reinforcement Mid-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32791)
*Nan Qiao,Yebin Yang,Weinong Wang,Shuning Wang,Shangpin Peng,Fengyuan Lu,Xinming Wang,Zhehan Kan,Ruixu Zhang,Songyang Zhang,Sheng Yue,Yonglong Tian,Ju Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出\tfour{}，一种双评论家（twin-critic）方法，用于强化学习中训练阶段从无标注文本学习内部思维时的token级信用分配问题，通过单次生成轨迹校准token级优势，在保证学习信号的前提下减少更新漂移，实验上平均基准性能提升7.8%，训练步时降低最多63.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化中训练（reinforcement mid-training）使语言模型能够从无标注文本中学习内部思维，但高效的token级信用分配仍然困难。现有群体相对方法（group-relative methods）需要代价高昂的重复生成；学习型评论家（learned critics）虽能提供单次rollout反馈，但仅靠准确的回报预测并不能保证可靠的策略更新。作者分析指出，训练-推理不匹配与PPO裁剪（clipping）会导致优势估计中的共同偏移（common offset）无法抵消，从而引入额外的更新漂移。

Method: 提出\tfour{}，一种双评论家方法，从单条生成轨迹中校准token级优势。经过预热与留出验证（warmup and held-out qualification）后，两个评论家给出两种优势估计，并通过一个条件矩鞍点目标（conditional-moment saddle-point objective）学习依赖于动作的权重进行组合。该目标将每个前缀处的平均优势推向零，同时通过信号保留约束（signal-retention constraint）防止校正过程抹除学习信号。跨文本位置的信息共享避免了对每个前缀的重复采样。

Result: 理论上，作者刻画了信号保留约束下的最优混合方式，并建立了残余均值诱导漂移（residual mean-induced drift）的上界。实验表明，相较于最先进的无评论家方法（state-of-the-art critic-free method），\tfour{}将平均基准性能提升7.8%，并将平均训练步时降低最多63.4%。

Conclusion: \tfour{}通过双评论家与条件矩鞍点目标，在单次生成轨迹下实现高效的token级优势校准，既缓解了群体相对方法的重复生成开销，又解决了学习型评论家中因训练-推理不匹配与PPO裁剪导致的更新漂移问题，在性能与训练效率上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: Reinforcement mid-training lets language models learn internal thoughts from unlabeled text, but efficient token-level credit assignment remains challenging. Existing group-relative methods require costly repeated generation. Learned critics offer single-rollout feedback, but accurate return prediction alone does not ensure reliable policy updates. Our analysis shows how training--inference mismatch and PPO clipping prevent a common offset in advantage estimates from cancelling out, introducing additional update drift. We propose \tfour{}, a twin-critic method that calibrates token-level advantages from a single generated trajectory. After warmup and held-out qualification, the critics provide two advantage estimates, combined using action-dependent weights learned through a conditional-moment saddle-point objective. This objective brings the average advantage at each prefix toward zero, while a signal-retention constraint prevents the correction from erasing the learning signal. Sharing information across text positions avoids repeated sampling of each prefix. Theoretically, we characterize optimal mixing under the signal-retention constraint and establish an upper bound on residual mean-induced drift. Experiments show that, compared with the state-of-the-art critic-free method, \tfour{} improves mean benchmark performance by 7.8\% and reduces mean training-step time by up to 63.4\%.

</details>


### [1540] [AgentHabit: Characterizing Distinct Behaviors of Agents on Everyday Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32795)
*Woojung Song,Hoyeol Yang,Jeonghoon Shim,Sungjib Lim,Jonggeun Lee,Yunho Choi,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出HABIT行为分类体系和AgentHABIT基准，用于系统刻画LLM智能体在执行日常任务时的行为倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多关注任务成功率，忽视了智能体"如何"完成任务（如是否追问澄清、是否搜索网络）这一与用户偏好和需求密切相关的维度。

Method: 作者由3位人类和3个LLM自下而上从17个领域的408条智能体轨迹中归纳出包含5大类、23个行为轴的HABIT分类体系；并基于此构建AgentHABIT基准，从86个日常任务的轨迹中为每个智能体生成行为画像，对18个模型进行了评测。

Result: HABIT在区分模型上优于现有人类价值观和智能体行为分类体系，且标注一致性相当；AgentHABIT揭示了各模型的可辨识倾向（如多数GPT和Claude模型在需求冲突时会陈述假设并提供备选方案，而Qwen和Google模型常将假设或需求变更保持未言明）；画像在完全不同的任务集上仍可复现，说明其反映通用倾向；提示可轻易改变部分行为轴但难以改变其他轴，微调另一模型的轨迹仅改变画像的一部分。

Conclusion: HABIT与AgentHABIT为超越任务成功率的智能体行为刻画提供了系统框架，可指导开发更契合用户需求的智能体。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents assist users with everyday tasks that can be completed in many reasonable ways. Even when their answers are useful, how agents carry out these tasks may not match users' preferences and needs. For example, agents differ in whether they ask clarifying questions or search the web. We introduce HABIT, a taxonomy of 23 behavioral axes in five categories, which three authors and three LLMs derive bottom-up from 408 agent trajectories across 17 domains. On held-out tasks, HABIT distinguishes models more clearly than existing taxonomies of human values and agent actions while supporting comparably consistent annotation. Building on HABIT, we construct AgentHABIT, a benchmark that profiles each agent's behavioral tendencies from its trajectories on 86 everyday tasks. Profiling 18 models with AgentHABIT reveals a range of distinctive tendencies. For example, most GPT and Claude models state their assumptions and offer alternatives when requirements conflict, whereas Qwen and Google's models more often leave assumptions or changes to requirements unstated. These profiles remain recognizable even when built from entirely different sets of tasks, indicating that they reflect general tendencies rather than task-specific behavior. Prompting agents to adopt specific behaviors shifts some axes readily but barely changes others, while fine-tuning on another model's trajectories changes only part of a model's profile and leaves much of it intact. Overall, HABIT and AgentHABIT provide a systematic framework for characterizing how agents carry out everyday tasks beyond task success, offering insights to guide the development of agents whose behavior better fits users' needs.

</details>


### [1541] [Nutri-ATLAS: Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for Smarter nutrition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32803)
*Uttej Kallakuri,Boxun Hu,Ankur A. Butala,Najim Dehak,Tinoosh Mohsenin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Nutri-ATLAS，一个面向真实世界智能营养助手的具身智能体，融合图知识推理、硬件感知 LLM 选择与机器人证据采集，在营养估计、替代食品检索、食谱推荐等任务上取得良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的营养辅助系统多局限于被动文本交互与静态上下文，当食物描述模糊或营养证据缺失时可靠性不足；同时生成式与智能体 IoT 系统为数字健康应用提供了新基础，营养辅助是其自然应用场景。

Method: Nutri-ATLAS 构建了融合 USDA FoodData Central 与 FoodKG 的统一 Food-Nutrient 知识图谱，学习 64 维 GATv2 食物与食谱嵌入；采用共享的混合图-文本打分机制，支撑营养提取、营养缺口填补、替代品检索与食谱级膳食组合；并通过 LLM 引导的技能接口进行地标导航、更新饮食上下文与食物可及性记忆，将推荐建立在观测到的食物可用性之上，同时引入硬件感知的 LLM 选择。

Result: 在 HealthyFoodSubs 上，混合检索器取得 37.9% MAP、80.7% RR@5 与 90.1% RR@10；在 NutriBench v2 上，Dense+GAT 检索在九种量化 Qwen3.5-9B 配置下支撑营养估计；在 PFoodReQ 上达到 78.8% MAP、83.0% MAR 与 77.5% F1；患者画像研究显示所有选取案例均满足过敏与健康目标约束。

Conclusion: Nutri-ATLAS 验证了将图接地推理、具身机器人证据采集与硬件感知 LLM 相结合的有效性，可在边缘部署与真实具身执行场景中提供可靠的营养辅助。

Abstract: Generative and Agentic IoT systems offer a promising foundation for digital healthcare applications that combine sensing, personalized reasoning, and autonomous interaction in real-world environments. Nutrition assistance is a natural use case, but existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems are often limited to passive text interaction and static context, making them unreliable when food descriptions are ambiguous or nutritional evidence is missing. We propose Nutri-ATLAS, an Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for smarter nutrition in the real world.
