Abstract: Reasoning models generate long chains of thought before they answer, yet it is debated whether the content of these chains does real computational work or is largely decorative. We study this question by viewing a transformer as a shallow circuit. One forward pass through a fixed number of layers has constant depth, so any procedure that runs the model a constant number of times is a shallow circuit. We call the best accuracy that a shallow circuit can reach on a task the ceiling of the task, and a task is serial if its ceiling lies below one. We prove three results on serial tasks that hold for every transformer, no matter how it was trained. Necessity: replacing the chain by anything that does not depend on its content, such as filler tokens or a restatement of the question, drives the accuracy down to the ceiling, and on a maximally serial task down to chance. Depth: no shallow computation can write the chain of a model whose accuracy exceeds the ceiling, not even approximately. Locality: the answer is one shallow pass away from the finished chain, so all of the serial reasoning happens in the chain. On word problems of finite groups, whose ceilings are known, small transformers trained from scratch, with or without reinforcement learning, attain the predicted numbers: chain-trained models solve every input length and fall to chance when the chain is erased, chainless models collapse to the ceiling as the input length grows, and open-weight reasoning models given the same problem in words return to the baseline without their chain. On MATH-500 and AIME, erasing the chain costs open reasoning models 0.52 to 0.82 accuracy, a sentence shuffle is harmless, and a token shuffle is as harmful as erasing; the same holds for checkpoints trained by GRPO with a correct or a random reward. The ceiling of a task therefore answers when a transformer can succeed without its chain of thought.

</details>


### [1574] [On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33141)
*Moghis Fereidouni,Anthony Arnold,Sumit Gulwani,Mark Marron,A. B. Siddique*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出将自然语言到操作（NL-to-Action）任务从生成式问题转化为基于端侧操作缓存的分类式问题，使智能体系统能在本地处理高频操作类别，从而降低延迟、增强隐私并减少成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体AI多依赖企业级（1000亿+参数）或前沿大模型，需要云端推理，导致额外的网络延迟、数据隐私问题以及高昂的运行成本。因此需要一种能减少云端依赖、降低成本与延迟的方案。

Method: 通过端侧操作缓存（on-device operation caches），将NL-to-Action问题由生成式任务重构为以分类为中心的形式，使高频操作类别可完全在设备端处理。并以经典NL-to-Formula任务（根据用户请求生成Excel公式）进行验证。

Result: 与仅依赖云端、基于模型路由的推理相比，该方法将总推理成本降低56%；在缓存命中情况下，响应延迟降低至原来的1/5（即5倍加速）。

Conclusion: 将NL-to-Action转化为分类式缓存命中问题是一种有效手段，可在保证功能的前提下显著降低推理成本与响应延迟，同时提升隐私性，为端侧智能体部署提供可行路径。

Abstract: Agentic AI is increasingly being embedded in software applications to provide natural language interfaces to features and functionality. In most cases these agents are powered by enterprise (100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that require substantial computational resources run and depend on cloud hosted inference to handle the task of transforming natural language inputs into actionable software operations. This reliance on cloud-hosted inference introduces substantial network latency on top of LLM inference times, creates data privacy concerns, and, given the costs of running these models, can rapidly escalate expenses associated with supporting agentic features.
  This paper introduces a novel means of converting the NL-to-Action problem from a generative one into a classification-centric formulation via on-device operation caches. These caches allow an agentic system to handle frequently occurring classes of actions completely on-device -- reducing latency, enhancing privacy, and lowering operational costs. We show that for a classic NL-to-Formula task, generating Excel Formula in response to user requests, this approach reduces total inference cost by 56% when compared to cloud-only model-routing based inference and, on cache hits, reduces the latency to response latency by 5x.

</details>


### [1575] [LiteEvo: Automated, Cost-Efficient Harness Evolution for Generalization to Unseen Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33146)
*Euntae Choi,Sumin Song,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LiteEvo 提出一种轻量级 LLM 智能体 harness 自动演化算法：无需手工初始 harness、不使用工具型元智能体、不暴露基准名称，仅通过对轨迹挖掘可复用组件并构建版本化组件库来组合每轮 harness，在五个基准上以更低成本取得优于 HarnessX 复现的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体由模型权重与外围组件构成的 harness 共同定义，但 harness 目前仍依赖手工设计。已有的 HarnessX 虽能自动演化 harness，却存在三点局限：每个基准都需从手工 harness 起步、仅在演化过的任务上报告收益、且每个基准消耗 1 亿–1.75 亿元智能体 token，成本高昂且泛化性不明。作者希望实现一种更轻量、更通用、可跨任务泛化的 harness 演化方法。

Method: LiteEvo 是一种轻量级 harness 演化算法。其元智能体不使用工具，通过挖掘智能体运行轨迹来提取可复用组件，将组件整理为版本化组件库，并在每一轮从该库中组合生成当前 harness。所有基准均从同一个中性（neutral）初始 harness 出发，且演化过程中从不显式提及基准名称，从而实现统一的、与任务无关的演化流程。实验在五个智能体基准的评分任务上进行，模型为冻结的 Qwen3.5-9B。

Result: 在五个智能体基准上，LiteEvo 将 pass@2 提升 10.5 至 67.7 个百分点；与 HarnessX 的复现相比，平均 pass@2 达到 71.0 对 67.3，并且平均 API 成本低 13.0 个单位。在训练任务上演化得到的 harness 在四个基准的未见测试任务上保持了收益。此外，LiteEvo 还能将基于 Sonnet 4.6 的 Claude Code 性能提升 1.2 至 71.4 个百分点。

Conclusion: LiteEvo 证明 harness 演化无需手工初始 harness、无需工具型元智能体、也无需暴露基准身份，即可在多个基准上以更低成本获得与 HarnessX 相当或更优的性能，并具备跨任务泛化能力和对真实智能体系统（如 Claude Code）的迁移增益，为轻量、通用、低成本的 harness 自动演化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: An LLM agent is defined by two things: the weights inside its model and the harness of components assembled around it. Harnesses are still handcrafted, and HarnessX, which evolves them automatically, starts each benchmark from a handcrafted harness, reports gains on the tasks it evolved on, and budgets 100 to 175 million meta-agent tokens per benchmark. We propose LiteEvo, a lightweight harness-evolution algorithm whose tool-free meta-agents mine agent trajectories for reusable components, curate them into a versioned library, and compose each round's harness from it, starting every benchmark from the same neutral harness and never naming the benchmark. Evolving on the graded tasks of five agentic benchmarks with a frozen Qwen3.5-9B, LiteEvo lifts pass@2 by 10.5 to 67.7pp and reaches comparable or higher pass@2 than a reproduction of HarnessX (71.0 against 67.3 on average) at 13.0 lower mean API cost. Harnesses evolved on train tasks keep their gains on unseen test tasks of four benchmarks, and LiteEvo also lifts Claude Code with Sonnet 4.6 by 1.2 to 71.4pp.

</details>


### [1576] [Not Too Hard, Not Too Easy: Learning from Intermediate States for LLM Structured Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33149)
*Hongbo Chen,Guohua Lu,Ting Dang,Hong Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将"学习应处于当前能力前沿"的原则用于结构化推理任务，提出带循环更新器的语言模型与FOCUS数据筛选法，在数独和迷宫任务上取得显著提升，并观察到向数学与代码任务的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有效学习的常见原则是在既不已掌握、又非难到无法进步的"前沿"状态上练习。结构化推理任务（如数独、迷宫）中模型可反复修正候选解，其轨迹上的中间状态天然分为已解决、无法修复、以及处于能力前沿三类；尚不清楚预训练语言模型能否学会修正这些状态，以及在前沿状态上训练是否能更广泛地提升推理能力。

Method: 将预训练语言模型主干与一个循环更新器耦合，在每个更新步用相同参数反复修正显式的解状态；并提出FOCUS（Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories），从当前模型自身生成的轨迹中选取训练状态，通过测量模型在固定次数循环更新内对每个状态的改进幅度，优先选择能带来实质进展的状态。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B上，FOCUS在Sudoku-Extreme达到64.4%精确求解准确率，Maze-Hard达91.1%；在1.7B至8B参数的五个Qwen与Llama主干部署上均观察到类似增益。此外，即便禁用循环更新器且不做下游微调，适配后的LLM仍对数学推理与代码执行表现出零样本迁移。

Conclusion: 结果表明预训练语言模型可学会修正结构化推理状态，在前沿状态上训练能有效提升推理表现并具备跨任务泛化能力，为将"能力前沿"学习原则应用于结构化推理提供了可行方案。

Abstract: A common principle of effective learning is to practice material that is neither already mastered nor too difficult to permit progress. We ask how to apply this principle to structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. In these tasks, a model can repeatedly revise an incomplete or incorrect candidate solution until it satisfies the problem's constraints. The intermediate candidate solutions along this trajectory provide natural training examples: some are already solved, some cannot yet be repaired by the model, and others lie at its current frontier of achievable progress. We therefore investigate whether pretrained language models can learn to revise such states and whether training on states at this frontier improves reasoning more broadly. To achieve this, we couple a pretrained language-model backbone with a recurrent updater that repeatedly revises an explicit solution state, using the same parameters at every update step. We further introduce Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories (FOCUS), which selects training states from trajectories generated by the current model. FOCUS measures how much the model improves each state within a fixed number of recurrent updates and prioritizes states from which it can make substantial progress. With Qwen3-1.7B, FOCUS achieves 64.4% exact solve accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme and 91.1% on Maze-Hard, with similar gains observed across five Qwen and Llama backbones spanning 1.7B to 8B parameters. We further observe zero-shot transfer in the adapted LLM to mathematical reasoning and code execution, even when the recurrent updater is disabled and no downstream fine-tuning is performed.

</details>


### [1577] [Unlocking Latent Personalization in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33182)
*Wei Chen,Guanghui Zhu,Zhongliang Cai,Yihua Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 LatentPersonal 框架，将大模型个性化视为共享潜在适配空间中的导航，用少量用户样本推断紧凑潜表示引导个性化适配，并以 LoRA 实现，显著降低适配开销且少样本/单样本性能优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型日益需要适配个体用户，但当仅有少量用户特定样本时，个性化仍具挑战。作者提出替代视角：预训练 LLM 可能已具备潜在个性化能力，因此少量样本或许足以以极小的用户特定适配引导模型对齐用户行为。

Method: 提出 LatentPersonal 框架，将个性化建模为共享潜在适配空间中的导航：从少量用户样本推断紧凑潜表示，引导用户特定模型适配，并用变分信息瓶颈正则化以鼓励紧凑偏好表示。用 LoRA 实例化，利用其低秩参数化作为天然低维适配空间；通过在共享低秩因子之间插入用户特定引导向量，在轻量推断紧凑表示下实现个性化适配导航，且不更新共享 LoRA 参数。

Result: 在多个个性化数据集上，LatentPersonal 大幅降低用户特定适配开销，同时仅凭少量用户特定交互即可实现有效个性化，在单样本（one-shot）场景下性能尤为突出。

Conclusion: 预训练 LLM 已具备潜在个性化能力，将个性化转化为共享潜在空间导航可有效利用少量样本；结合 LoRA 低秩空间与引导向量的轻量推断，可在不更新共享参数的前提下实现高效、少样本友好的个性化适配。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to adapt to individual users, yet effective personalization remains challenging when only limited user-specific samples are available. In this work, we take an alternative perspective: pretrained LLMs may already possess latent capacity for personalization, and a few user samples may therefore suffice to guide the model toward user-aligned behavior with minimal user-specific adaptation. From this perspective, we propose LatentPersonal, a framework that formulates personalization as navigation in a shared latent adaptation space. LatentPersonal infers a compact latent representation from a few user samples to guide user-specific model adaptation, regularized with a variational information bottleneck to encourage compact preference representations. We instantiate LatentPersonal with LoRA, leveraging its low-rank parameterization as a natural low-dimensional adaptation space for personalization. By simply inserting a user-specific guidance vector between the shared low-rank factors, the model can navigate toward personalized adaptations through lightweight inference of this compact representation, without updating the shared LoRA parameters. Experiments across multiple personalization datasets demonstrate that LatentPersonal substantially reduces user-specific adaptation overhead while achieving effective personalization from only a few user-specific interactions, with particularly strong performance in the one-shot regime.

</details>


### [1578] [Are Benchmarks Reliable? Toward Structural Diagnosis via Sample-Level Capability Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33196)
*Haiquan Hu,Yuzhu Liang,Weicheng Tang,Yanzeng Li,Yao Shi,Tian Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BSDProbe，从样本级能力边界诊断基准结构，揭示基准可靠性依模型轴而异，并可筛选高判别力子集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评测主要依赖基准总分（排行榜分数），但聚合指标会掩盖样本是否稳定支撑模型比较，无法反映评测结构的可靠性。

Method: BSDProbe基于有序模型轴上的重复响应轨迹估计样本的能力边界，用四个指标刻画样本：边界位置、边界宽度、边界信号有效性、顺序一致性；再聚合为基准级结构画像，并据此选择紧凑高价值子集。

Result: 在六个基准上，可靠性依模型轴而变且异质：GSM8K与MATH测量结构最稳定，MMLU与TriviaQA相对稳定但异质，GPQA与PopQA轴条件风险更强；该画像在Qwen3、Qwen2.5及跨模型轴上保持一致；筛选子集的模型判别力最高达全基准的8.58倍。

Conclusion: 可靠使用基准需超越排行榜分数，考察样本级能力边界；BSDProbe为基准结构诊断与高效子集选择提供样本级框架。

Abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) relies heavily on benchmark scores, yet aggregate metrics can obscure whether benchmark samples reliably support model comparison. We introduce \textbf{BSDProbe}, a sample-level framework for \emph{benchmark structural diagnosis} that estimates capability boundaries from repeated-response trajectories along ordered model axes. BSDProbe summarizes samples by boundary position, boundary width, boundary-signal validity, and order consistency, then aggregates them into benchmark-level structural profiles. Experiments on six benchmarks show that benchmark reliability is axis-conditioned and heterogeneous: GSM8K and MATH exhibit the most stable measurement structures, MMLU and TriviaQA are relatively stable but heterogeneous, while GPQA and PopQA show stronger axis-conditioned risks. These profiles remain consistent across Qwen3, Qwen2.5, and cross-model axes. BSDProbe further selects compact high-value subsets whose model discriminability reaches up to $8.58\times$ that of the full benchmark. These results suggest that reliable benchmark use requires examining sample-level capability boundaries beyond leaderboard scores.

</details>


### [1579] [CodeSkill: Latent Skill Abstraction for Long-Horizon Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33243)
*Song-Li Wu,Jingyi Wang,Zhaocheng Du,Weinan Gan,Weiwen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeSkill 框架，将层次化潜在技能建模引入代码智能体领域，把强化学习从 token 级探索转向经验/行为级推理，从而提升长程优化效率与行为一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码智能体需要面向复杂交互轨迹进行长程决策，但现有 RL 方法通常在 token 级优化行为，导致底层生成与高层行为推理不匹配，进而在稀疏奖励下出现探索低效、信用分配薄弱的问题。此外，大规模智能体轨迹中虽存在可复用的多步行为模式，但其噪声较大的 token 级表示阻碍了经验复用。

Method: CodeSkill 采用层次化潜在技能建模：首先利用教师模型将成功与失败轨迹蒸馏为多层级文本抽象；随后结合时序变分推断与强化学习，将这些离散语义映射为连续潜在变量；并通过自适应边界机制，依据执行反馈动态控制技能切换。学到的技能以潜在语义前缀形式注入冻结的 LLM 策略，使优化在紧凑语义空间而非原始 token 序列上进行。

Result: 大量实验表明，CodeSkill 在多种通用与工业编码基准上相较强开源基线取得极具竞争力的性能；同时所学技能展现出较强的可迁移性与稳健的跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 显式的行为抽象对可扩展的智能体化代码生成具有显著有效性，CodeSkill 通过经验级推理改善了优化效率与长程行为一致性。

Abstract: Code agents require long-horizon decision-making over complex interaction trajectories. However, existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches typically optimize behavior at the token level, creating a mismatch between low-level generation and high-level behavioral reasoning. This limitation leads to inefficient exploration and weak credit assignment under sparse rewards. Moreover, while large-scale agent trajectories often contain recurring multi-step behavioral patterns, their noisy token-level representations hinder effective experience reuse. To address these challenges, we propose CodeSkill, a framework that adapts hierarchical latent skill modeling to the code agent domain. CodeSkill first leverages a teacher model to distill both successful and failed trajectories into multi-level textual abstractions. It then integrates temporal variational inference with reinforcement learning to map these discrete semantics into continuous latent variables, while an adaptive boundary mechanism dynamically gates skill transitions based on execution feedback. The learned skills are injected into a frozen LLM policy as latent semantic prefixes, enabling optimization in a compact semantic space rather than over raw token sequences. By shifting RL from token-level exploration to experience-level reasoning, CodeSkill improves optimization efficiency and long-horizon behavioral coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodeSkill achieves highly competitive performance against strong open-weight baselines across diverse general and industrial coding benchmarks. Furthermore, the learned skills exhibit strong transferability and robust cross-domain generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit behavioral abstraction for scalable agentic code generation.

</details>


### [1580] [ActiveMem: Dynamic Latent Memory Trees for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33244)
*Song-Li Wu,Jingyi Wang,Zhaocheng Du,Weinan Gan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ActiveMem，一种分层记忆框架，将智能体经历递归组织为依赖感知的潜在执行树，并通过强化学习学习记忆扩展、检索与剪枝策略，显著提升任务完成度、推理稳定性与记忆效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体的外部记忆系统通常将历史轨迹或摘要作为独立上下文片段进行检索，忽略了多步执行背后的过程性依赖。随着记忆规模扩大，这种扁平检索会带来上下文碎片化与跨任务干扰，导致推理轨迹结构不一致。

Method: ActiveMem 将轨迹抽象为可复用的子任务节点，同时显式保留执行转移关系，从而支持以当前执行状态为条件的连贯推理路径检索。为实现持续适应，ActiveMem 通过强化学习学习动态的记忆扩展、检索与剪枝策略。

Result: 在多种智能体基准上，ActiveMem 相比现有基于记忆的智能体在任务完成度、推理稳定性和记忆效率方面均取得一致提升；并使紧凑的开源权重模型达到可与显著更大的专有系统竞争的性能。

Conclusion: 过程性依赖建模与依赖感知的分层记忆结构是提升 LLM 智能体长程推理能力的关键；结合强化学习的记忆管理策略可兼顾性能与效率，缩小开源模型与专有系统间的差距。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to support long-horizon reasoning and decision making. Existing memory systems typically retrieve historical trajectories or summaries as independent context fragments, overlooking the procedural dependencies underlying multi-step execution. As memory scales, such flat retrieval introduces context fragmentation and cross-task interference, leading to structurally inconsistent reasoning trajectories. We propose ActiveMem, a hierarchical memory framework that recursively organizes agent experiences into dependency-aware latent execution trees. ActiveMem abstracts trajectories into reusable subtask nodes while explicitly preserving execution transitions, enabling coherent reasoning-path retrieval conditioned on the current execution state. To support continual adaptation, ActiveMem further learns dynamic memory expansion, retrieval, and pruning policies through reinforcement learning. Experiments across various agent benchmarks demonstrate that ActiveMem consistently improves task completion, reasoning stability, and memory efficiency over existing memory-based agents. Moreover, ActiveMem enables compact open-weight models to achieve competitive performance with substantially larger proprietary systems.

</details>


### [1581] [CORTEX: A Verified Experience Layer for Generalist Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33260)
*Garapati Keerthana,Manik Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CORTEX 框架，通过可验证经验的复用、适配与淘汰，使智能体系统在不改变模型权重的前提下获得可增长的隐性能力层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体在任务复现时面临事实、工具与治理知识的变化，现有系统虽能检索文本或回忆对话，却缺乏判断旧解是否仍有效、何时需适配、何时应弃用的原则性机制。

Method: CORTEX（Contextual Orchestration and Reuse of Task EXperience）通过外部验证经验层连接专用智能体；每个 episode 记录任务条件、来源与工具状态、决定性谓词、证明轨迹、验证器与结果；元控制器在精确重放、受检适配、全新合成、升级四种策略间选择；被接受的 episode 经挑战驱动开发循环转化为任务模式与程序化策略；形式化精确重放与来源版本分离的系统契约，并推导复用节省计算的条件。

Result: 在受控双域实现中，精确重放核心于 1,000 个合成案例上测试；完整族留出在八个临床与政策划分的 1,000 个新族案例上测试程序迁移，具备完整的新证据接地，并对无关字段与插入顺序扰动实现完美不变性；迁移轨迹揭示了已验证策略执行所需的工作量。

Conclusion: 该结果确立了通过可复用流程、类型化经验与发展性迁移走向通用智能的初步路径。

Abstract: An agent can solve a task today and face the same task under new facts, tools, or governing knowledge tomorrow. Most agent systems can retrieve relevant text or recall prior conversations, but they lack a principled way to decide when a previous solution is still valid, when it must be adapted, and when it should be discarded. We introduce CORTEX (Contextual Orchestration and Reuse of Task EXperience), a general AI systems framework that connects specialized agents through an external layer of verified experience. Each episode records its task conditions, source and tool state, decisive predicates, proof trace, verifier, and outcome. A meta-controller chooses exact replay, checked adaptation, fresh synthesis, or escalation. Accepted episodes can become task patterns and procedural strategies through a challenge-driven development loop. This gives the system an implicit competence layer that can grow without changing model weights. We formalize system contracts for exact replay and source-version separation, and derive when reuse saves computation. A controlled two-domain implementation tests the exact-replay core on 1,000 synthetic cases. Complete-family holdouts test procedural transfer on 1,000 new-family cases across eight clinical and policy splits, with complete fresh-evidence grounding and perfect invariance to irrelevant-field and insertion-order perturbations. The transfer trace exposes the work required for verified strategy execution. These results establish an initial path toward general intelligence through reusable procedures, typed experience, and developmental transfer.

</details>


### [1582] [LSTMem: Hierarchical Long Short-Term Online Memory for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33268)
*Xianglong Shi,Ruijie Yang,Sirui Zhao,Shukang Yin,Zihao Bian,Tinghao Yi,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LSTMem为冻结LLM的每一层配备LSTM式双矩阵状态，将记忆累积与记忆读取解耦，并通过跨层传播与重建梯度组织层级化在线记忆，在多个记忆基准上超越原始骨干。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为长时程助手/智能体需跨交互累积信息，并在后续请求依赖时提供相关部分。现有紧凑在线记忆用单一持久状态同时承担历史累积与读取功能，导致"存储什么"与"向当前计算暴露什么"无法分离控制。

Method: 受LSTM启发的在线记忆机制：为冻结LLM每层设置两个矩阵值状态——累积历史的cell state与用于读取的hidden state，后者读出门对骨干注意力进行校正；由输入门和遗忘门控制cell存储内容，输出门独立控制经hidden state暴露的内容。跨深度通过前向隐状态传播与block-end反馈连接记忆，并利用高层重建梯度在由浅至深重建hidden state前细化低层cell state。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct上，LSTMem在MemoryAgentBench、LoCoMo和HotpotQA上均较原始骨干有一致提升；LSTM式记忆公式优于联想记忆方案；移除跨层隐记忆传播会导致性能下降。

Conclusion: 将记忆累积与记忆表达分离、并按模型深度进行层级化记忆组织具有明确收益。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as long-horizon assistants and agents, where they must both accumulate information across interactions and make the relevant parts available when later requests depend on them. Existing compact online memories typically use a single persistent state both to accumulate history and to serve readout, so what the memory stores cannot be controlled separately from what it exposes to the current computation. We propose LSTMem, an LSTM-inspired online memory that instead equips each layer of a frozen LLM with two matrix-valued states: a cell state that accumulates history and a hidden state whose readouts correct the backbone's attention. Input and forget gates control what the cell stores, while an output gate separately controls what the cell exposes through the hidden state. LSTMem further connects memory across depth through forward hidden-state propagation and block-end feedback, and uses higher-layer reconstruction gradients to refine lower-layer cell states before rebuilding hidden states from shallow to deep layers. Across memory benchmarks on Qwen3-4B-Instruct, LSTMem consistently improves MemoryAgentBench, LoCoMo, and HotpotQA over the plain backbone. Comparisons further show that the LSTM-based memory formulation outperforms an associative-memory counterpart, while removing cross-layer hidden-memory propagation degrades performance. These results demonstrate the benefits of separating memory accumulation from memory expression and organizing memory hierarchically across model depth. The code is available at https://github.com/Longchentong/LSTMem.

</details>


### [1583] [Structured Sparse Memory for Recurrent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33270)
*Zixuan Zhao,Samuel Wheeler,Neil Getty,Xiaotian Duan,Rick Stevens,Fangfang Xia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究结合任务条件记忆、合成数据与推理时聚合的紧凑混合ARC模型CHARM，提出组合稀疏嵌入CoSE，在ARC-AGI-1/2上分别达到84%和46.7%的pass@2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于小型循环主干网络的研究框架忽视了任务条件记忆和合成增强数据这两个系统关键组成部分，而任务条件记忆实际提供的容量远超主干网络本身。

Method: 构建紧凑混合ARC模型CHARM，融合循环推理、结构化任务记忆、合成数据和推理时聚合；提出组合稀疏嵌入CoSE用于任务条件化；分析循环深度与学习视野的平衡。

Result: CoSE将任务记忆参数减少90%以上并提升pass@2；循环深度仅在与学习视野平衡时有效；ARC-AGI-1达84% pass@2，ARC-AGI-2达46.7% pass@2，结构化记忆优势可迁移至未见解谜及其他领域。

Conclusion: 任务条件记忆与合成数据是ARC风格推理系统的关键，结构化记忆可显著减少参数并提升性能，且具备跨域泛化能力；代码、数据集与模型权重已开源。

Abstract: Recurrent models trained from scratch have recently become competitive on ARC-style reasoning tasks, but the usual framing around small recurrent backbones overlooks two important parts of the system: task-conditioned memory and synthetic augmentation data. We study this regime through CHARM, a compact hybrid ARC model that combines recurrent reasoning with structured task memory, synthetic data, and inference-time aggregation. In existing approaches, task-conditioned memory supplies a large hidden source of capacity, reaching more than 30x the size of the recurrent backbone. We introduce a compositional sparse embedding (CoSE) for task conditioning that reduces learned task-memory parameters by over 90% while improving pass@2 in controlled ARC ablations. For the recurrent backbone, recurrent depth helps only when balanced with learning horizon. Combining these ingredients, our system reaches 84% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 and 46.7% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2 public evaluation. The benefits of structured memory also generalize to unseen puzzles and other domains. Our code, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/water-vapor/charm.

</details>


### [1584] [Next Thoughts Are Distributions: Generative Autoregressive Reasoning in the Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33271)
*Yang Li,Yi Wang,Shiyuan Huang,Yang Liu,Hao Wang,Chengzhi Mao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF)，将"下一个连续思维"建模为多模态分布，用因果自回归模型做推理计算、用轻量扩散头生成下一步思维，从而在潜在空间中支持多路径的连续推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理问题通常存在多种有效解法，而现有的连续推理（continuous reasoning）方法将计算从语言 token 迁移到紧凑的潜在空间时，难以表示多种可能的"下一步思维"，往往把预测坍缩为单一结果，损失了推理路径的多样性。

Method: 提出 Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF)：由因果自回归模型执行推理计算，并由一个轻量扩散头基于所得条件生成一个可行的下一个连续思维，即把 next continuous thought 建模为多模态分布。采样得到的思维被反馈回模型，使连续推理可以展开可变步数，同时保持预训练骨干网络不变。

Result: 在数学推理任务上，ATF 以紧凑的潜在轨迹提升了准确率，并能从强化学习和额外测试时思考中获益；多采样评估显示其解覆盖范围更广，说明多模态预测捕捉到了推理路径间有用的多样性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，当多种可能的下一步思维被保留、而非坍缩为单一预测时，连续推理会更有效。

Abstract: Reasoning problems often admit multiple valid ways to proceed. Continuous reasoning promises to move computation beyond language tokens into a more compact latent space, but representing several plausible ways to think next remains difficult. We introduce Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF), which models the next continuous thought as a multimodal distribution. A causal autoregressive model performs the reasoning computation, while a lightweight diffusion head generates a plausible next thought from the resulting condition. The sampled thought is fed back into the model, allowing continuous reasoning to unfold for a variable number of steps while preserving the pretrained backbone. Across mathematical reasoning tasks, ATF improves accuracy with compact latent traces and benefits from reinforcement learning and additional test-time thinking. Multi-sample evaluation shows broader solution coverage, indicating that its multimodal predictions capture useful diversity among reasoning paths. Our results suggest that continuous reasoning is more effective when multiple possible next thoughts remain available rather than being collapsed into a single prediction.

</details>


### [1585] [ChronoFlow: Hierarchical Flow Matching for Irregular Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33276)
*Changhun Kim,Sunguk Jang,Jeongjun Lee,Juhwan Choi,Sangchul Hahn,Grigorios Chrysos,Eunho Yang,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ChronoFlow，一个分层流匹配框架，按统计粒度将不规则时间序列生成分解为观测数量/特征频率、观测时间与共观测模式、数值生成三个子问题，并配以多维评估指标，在五个基准上显著提升生成保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型多假设规则时间网格，或仅关注给定采样结构下的特征动态，无法在原生形态下生成不规则时间序列。完整的不规则序列生成不仅要建模特征值，还需刻画观测发生的数量、时间以及哪些特征被共同观测，这是一个异构联合生成问题，缺乏针对性方法与评估手段。

Method: ChronoFlow为统一的层级式流匹配（flow matching）框架，按统计粒度组织并遵循粗到细层次：首先生成观测数量与各特征频率；其次联合生成观测时间与特征共观测模式；最后在已实现的观测模式条件下生成数值。该分解将复杂联合生成难题转化为结构对齐的子问题，同时保留子问题间依赖。评估方面提出覆盖样本真实性、采样结构、数值保真度以及时间与跨特征依赖的互补指标，并通过受控污染实验进行验证。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上，ChronoFlow相较现有基线在生成保真度上取得显著提升，消融/因式分解研究支持所提出的层级设计。

Conclusion: ChronoFlow为原生不规则时间序列的完整生成提供了统一的分层流匹配方案，并将生成问题按统计粒度分解以兼顾结构对齐与依赖保持；配套的多维评估体系填补了该任务评估空白，实验验证了方法有效性与层级分解的合理性。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative modeling have substantially improved time series generation, yet most existing methods either assume a regular temporal grid or focus on feature dynamics under a given sampling structure. This makes them illsuited for generating irregular time series in their native form, where a model must capture not only feature values, but also how many observations occur, when they occur, and which features are observed together. To address this heterogeneous generation problem, we propose ChronoFlow, a unified hierarchical flow matching framework organized by statistical granularity. Following a coarse-to-fine hierarchy, ChronoFlow first generates observation counts and feature-wise frequencies, then jointly generates observation times and feature co-observation patterns, and finally generates values conditioned on the realized pattern. This turns a complex joint generation problem into structurally aligned subproblems while preserving their dependencies. To evaluate complete irregular time series generation, we introduce complementary metrics spanning sample realism, sampling structure, value fidelity, and temporal and cross-feature dependencies, and validate them through controlled corruptions. Across five benchmarks, ChronoFlow achieves strong improvements in generation fidelity over existing baselines, while factorization studies support the proposed hierarchy. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ChronoFlow.

</details>


### [1586] [Multi-Dimensional Comparative Scale Construction for Efficient Personalized Subjective Judgment in High-Traffic Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33282)
*Xianglong Shi,Shifeng Liu,Sirui Zhao,Shengming Yuan,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出成对比较框架用于多维主观强度量表构建，并设计SubJudge模型实现个性化打分，将量表构建复杂度从O(N²)降至O(NK)、推理复杂度降至O(1)，在PluriHarms与iNews上9B模型媲美或超越前沿LLM，推理延迟较Qwen3.5-9B提速约1.29×~261×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观判断广泛存在于高流量应用中，但主观强度难以量化，且个体间感知差异显著，现有方法难以同时捕捉细粒度强度与个体差异并支持实际高并发部署。

Method: 提出成对比较框架：沿案例与画像两个维度比较case-person对，构建相对量表；量表构建阶段结合稀疏Elo比较与多评委投票，将候选对象两两比较成本由O(N²)降至O(NK)（N个对象、每个对象K个对手），并降低对单一评委的依赖；推理阶段提出SubJudge——一个System One个性化打分模型，采用Batchwise Preference Optimization（BPO），基于Bradley-Terry比较学习相对排序，模型在首个响应位置由数字token概率读出连续分数，每个评价标准仅需一次前向传播，推理复杂度O(1)。

Result: 在PluriHarms与iNews数据集上，9B模型在多项指标上达到或超过所评估的前沿LLM；在H100 GPU上，SubJudge在不同思考预算下相比Qwen3.5-9B取得约1.29×至261×的平均推理延迟加速。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了成对比较框架结合SubJudge可在保证评测质量的同时显著降低量表构建与推理开销，为主观强度的可扩展、个性化量化提供了可行路径，代码已开源。

Abstract: Subjective judgments are central to many high-traffic applications, but subjective intensity is difficult to quantify and perceptions vary substantially across individuals. To address these challenges, we propose a pairwise comparative framework for multi-dimensional scale construction. By comparing case-person pairs along case and profile dimensions, the framework constructs relative scales that capture both fine-grained intensity and individual variation. To support practical high-traffic deployment, we optimize both offline scale construction and online inference. For scale construction, we combine sparse Elo comparisons with multi-judge voting, cutting the comparison cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(NK)$ for $N$ objects and a budget of $K$ opponents per object, while limiting reliance on any single judge. For inference, we propose SubJudge, a System One model for personalized scoring with Batchwise Preference Optimization (BPO). Using Bradley-Terry comparisons, BPO trains the model to learn relative orderings, and SubJudge reads a continuous score from digit-token probabilities at the first response position, requiring only one forward pass per criterion and reducing the inference complexity to $O(1)$. Experiments on PluriHarms and iNews show that our 9B models match or surpass the evaluated frontier LLMs on multiple metrics. On the H100 GPU, SubJudge achieves an approximately $1.29\times$ to $261\times$ speedup in mean inference latency over Qwen3.5-9B with different thinking budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/Longchentong/SubJudge.

</details>


### [1587] [RINI: Seeing the Prior Is Not Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33284)
*Hongyi Du,Tianyi Zhang,Heng Wang,Zhelun Gao,Yimei Liu,Ambrose Luo,Annie Hao,Jiayan Ni,Jiawei Han,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究考察"提供先前文献能否纠正研究提案中不成立的贡献声明"，发现单纯提供文献无显著整体效果，进而提出RINI方法审计贡献声明，在需修正样本上修复成功率达72.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究提案可能把已有机制描述正确，却声称是自己的贡献（unsupported novelty）。作者关心：如果向生成系统（或人类）提供更早的相关论文，是否能纠正这类贡献声明，从而检验"提供证据即可纠错"这一假设是否成立。

Method: 三个受控实验，对比"带贡献声明的先前论文"与"同主题对照"生成提案。对人类可解释的被暴露提案进行人工分析（175篇）。提出Research Idea Novelty Inspection（RINI）：对照证据审计贡献声明、核查剩余区别、进行局部修订。由5位标注者对3种方法的1,080组原文-修订对进行评估，研究任务等权。

Result: 提供先前论文并未带来不成立新颖性的整体显著下降。175篇中137篇识别出先前论文相关性，但仅61篇正确归属既有贡献；71项所提剩余区别中37项已被同一先前论文覆盖。在240篇被判定需修正的原文上，修复成功率：Self-Revision 11.7%，Retrieve-and-Revise 39.1%，RINI 72.2%；相较同证据直接修订提升33.0个百分点。修订后提案保留原有研究问题与技术方法。

Conclusion: 仅提供文献不足以纠正贡献声明，需要显式的贡献归属审计与局部修订；RINI有效提升修复率且不破坏研究问题与方法，说明在使用文献生成和修订研究提案时应引入显式贡献归属机制。

Abstract: A research proposal can describe an established mechanism correctly while claiming to introduce it. We study whether providing the earlier paper corrects such contribution claims. Three controlled experiments compare proposals generated with a contribution-bearing prior and a same-topic control. Providing the prior yields no clear aggregate reduction in unsupported novelty. Human analysis of 175 interpretable exposed proposals finds that 137 recognize the prior's relevance, but 61 correctly attribute the established contribution. Of 71 proposed remaining distinctions, 37 are covered by the same prior. We introduce Research Idea Novelty Inspection (RINI), which audits contribution claims against evidence, checks the remaining distinction, and applies local revisions. Five human annotators evaluate 1,080 original-revision pairs across three methods. On the same 240 originals judged to require correction, successful repair is 11.7% for Self-Revision, 39.1% for Retrieve-and-Revise, and 72.2% for RINI, with research tasks weighted equally. The improvement over same-evidence direct revision is 33.0 percentage points. The revised proposals retain their research questions and technical methods. These results motivate explicit contribution attribution when using literature to generate and revise research proposals.

</details>


### [1588] [Learning to Sell: Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Large Language Model Agents in Multi-Product Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33289)
*Shuze Daniel Liu,Claire Chen,Jiuqi Wang,Thorsten Joachims*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自主LLM智能体在多商品市场中作为卖方进行多物品议价的问题，将其建模为POMDP并采用RLVR后训练方法，使智能体在信息不对称与沟通预算受限下有效匹配买家与商品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多商品市场中，自主LLM智能体需在信息不对称和资源约束下做序贯决策。现有卖方需同时与多个独立买家就可替代商品进行议价，买家估值私有且异质，每名买家至多购买一件商品；同时卖方沟通轮次有限，需在匹配合适商品与分配有限交互预算之间权衡，这是现有方法难以有效解决的挑战。

Method: 将问题形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），采用结构化四部分消息协议，将自然语言映射为可解析、受约束的决策空间；基于该形式化设计使用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的后训练方法；并构建多维指标套件，量化约束遵守、卖方剩余提取和分配质量。

Result: 训练后的卖方智能体学会更有效地将有限库存匹配给买家，在卖方剩余提取和买家—商品分配质量上达到或超越万亿参数前沿模型；且学到的策略能稳健泛化到未见过的市场结构、相关估值分布和训练中未遇到的价格区间。

Conclusion: 结构化消息协议与RLVR后训练相结合，可有效训练LLM智能体在多物品议价中充当卖方，并在信息不对称与沟通预算受限下实现高质量匹配和剩余提取，同时具备较强的分布外泛化能力。

Abstract: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents operating in multi-product markets must make sequential decisions under information asymmetry and resource constraints. We develop a machine learning approach for training such agents to act effectively as sellers in a multi-item bargaining environment, where a seller concurrently negotiates a catalog of substitutable assets across a pool of independent buyers. Buyers hold private, heterogeneous valuations across products, and each can purchase at most one item. Facing limits on total communication turns, the seller must dynamically match buyers with the most profitable products considering their private valuations, while strategically allocating its limited interaction budget toward combinations of greater potential value. We formalize this problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process using a structured, four-part message protocol that maps natural language into a parsable and regulated decision space. Using this formalization, we design a post-training method using Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). To evaluate this framework, we construct a multidimensional metric suite that quantifies constraint adherence, seller surplus extraction, and allocation quality. Our trained seller agent learns to match limited inventory to buyers more effectively, matching or outperforming trillion-parameter frontier models in both seller surplus extraction and buyer-product allocation quality. Finally, these learned strategies generalize robustly to unseen market structures, correlated valuation distributions, and price ranges not encountered during training.

</details>


### [1589] [The Error You See Is Not the Error You Made: Progression-aware Reasoning Origin for Reasoning Error Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33297)
*Yiguo Wang,Ziyuan Yang,Yi Zou,Dan Lin,Rongsheng Li,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将推理验证重新定义为"进展感知的错误源头定位"问题，提出免训练框架 PRO，联合建模前向支持与后向兼容信号并通过干预式证据归因，实现首错定位，在多种推理任务上超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有验证方法存在两类局限：整体性方法缺乏位置证据；前向顺序验证常将首个被拒绝步骤当作错误源，但在错误传播下，早期错误可能局部看似合理，只通过下游后果才显现，导致该假设失效。因此需要更忠实于推理过程的验证范式。

Method: 提出免训练框架 Progression-aware Reasoning Origin（PRO）：1）联合建模来自前文语境的"入向支持"与对后续推理的"出向兼容性"；2）对两种信号不一致的区域进行选择性精化；3）执行检测器条件下的源归因，利用基于干预的证据区分真实错误源与其传播表现。同时形式化了前向拒绝与结构性暴露之间的差距，说明仅有入向证据的不足。

Result: 在开放形式、医学及结构化推理任务上的实验表明，PRO 相较强验证基线取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 进展感知的源归因是一种更忠实的推理验证表述，可有效定位错误源头而非仅判断轨迹正确与否。

Abstract: Verifying multi-step LLM reasoning requires more than determining whether a trace is correct: a useful verifier should identify where the reasoning first goes wrong. However, existing holistic methods provide little positional evidence, while forward sequential verification often treats the first rejected step as the error source. Under error propagation, this assumption can fail, since an earlier mistake may remain locally plausible and become observable only through its downstream consequences. We therefore rethink reasoning verification as a progression-aware error-source localization problem: rather than asking only where a reasoning trace first appears inconsistent, we ask which earlier step best explains how that inconsistency emerges along the trajectory. Based on this view, we propose Progression-aware Reasoning Origin (PRO), a training-free framework for first-error localization. PRO jointly models incoming support from the preceding context and outgoing compatibility with subsequent reasoning, selectively refines regions where these signals disagree, and finally performs detector-conditioned source attribution with intervention-based evidence to distinguish the true error origin from its propagated manifestations. We further formalize the gap between forward rejection and structural exposure, showing why incoming-side evidence alone is insufficient for reliable localization under error propagation. Experiments across open-form, medical, and structured reasoning tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong verification baselines, supporting progression-aware source attribution as a more faithful formulation of reasoning verification.

</details>


### [1590] [PhysAlign: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Role Alignment in Multimodal Physics Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33319)
*Kecheng Liang,Haoyang Liu,Zexin Chen,Zirong Liu,Weixing Chen,Qiufeng Wang,Yang Liu,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出PhysAlign基准，用于评估多模态模型能否将物理示意图中识别出的信息正确对应到其物理角色，揭示感知能力与物理角色绑定之间的系统性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理示意图理解的核心挑战在于将视觉信息与它描述的物理实体、关系和条件正确关联。即便局部元素被准确识别，若将其错误地分配给错误的实体或作用范围，也会扭曲物理前提并导致推理错误。然而现有评估多停留在答案层面，难以揭示这种对应关系错误。

Method: 提出PhysAlign基准，通过局部探针与受控变体，将视觉识别与物理角色分配相解耦，从而把对应错误与识别失败分离。基准包含覆盖986道物理题的3,341个人工验证探针，并引入五种互补评估指标，包括CAcc、GAcc和JAcc，分别衡量模型识别图内容、建立正确物理对应以及求解物理问题的能力。

Result: 在多个多模态模型上，PhysAlign揭示了局部视觉识别与物理角色绑定之间存在一致差距：即使所查询内容被正确识别，条件对应错误率在GPT-6-Astra上仍为13.8%，在InternVL3.5-8B上则升至约50.6%。

Conclusion: 强大的感知能力本身不足以保证可靠的物理解释，存在一个被答案级准确率 largely 掩盖的独特绑定瓶颈，凸显未来模型需更好地将识别到的视觉证据与其物理含义对齐。

Abstract: A key challenge in physics diagram understanding is correctly associating visual information with the physical entities, relations, and conditions it describes. Even when a value, symbol, or other local element is accurately recognized, assigning it to the wrong entity or scope can distort the underlying physical premise and lead to incorrect reasoning. To systematically study this challenge, we introduce \textbf{PhysAlign}, a benchmark designed to assess whether multimodal models correctly associate information recognized from physics diagrams with its intended physical role. By disentangling visual recognition from physical-role assignment through localized probes and controlled variants, PhysAlign isolates correspondence errors from recognition failures. It contains 3,341 human-validated probes spanning 986 physics problems, enabling systematic evaluation of visual recognition and physical-role correspondence at scale. We further introduce five complementary evaluation metrics, including CAcc, GAcc, and JAcc, which provide a comprehensive assessment of models' ability to recognize diagram content, establish correct physical correspondences, and solve the underlying physics problem. Across our evaluated multimodal models, PhysAlign reveals a consistent gap between local visual recognition and physical-role grounding. Even when the queried content is correctly recognized, the conditional correspondence error rate remains 13.8\% for GPT-6-Astra and rises to about 50.6\% for InternVL3.5-8B. These findings indicate that strong perception alone does not ensure reliable physical interpretation, exposing a distinct grounding bottleneck that is largely hidden by answer-level accuracy and highlighting the need for future models to better align recognized visual evidence with its physical meaning.

</details>


### [1591] [Agentic Multi-Turn Reasoning: A Fairness Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33323)
*Thanh-Dat Truong,Sankalp Pandey,Hugh Churchill,Jackson Cothren,Marios Savvides,Khoa Luu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization（Fair-MPO/Φ-MPO），一种面向智能体学习的偏好优化框架，通过多级偏好优化与公平多级目标，同时解决长时程信用分配和数据分布不平衡两大挑战，并在智能体推理基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统虽能通过多轮规划、工具使用、验证与记忆更新完成复杂任务，但其学习面临两个根本挑战：(1)长时程信用分配——监督信号仅存在于最终结果；(2)数据分布不平衡——主导性数据模式偏置优化过程，削弱对稀有但信息量大的推理行为的适应能力。

Method: 提出Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization（Fair-MPO，记为Φ-MPO）框架。首先论证Multi-Level Preference Optimization为长时程推理提供了有原则且计算效率更高的框架；随后引入Fair Multi-Level Objective以应对智能体学习中的数据不平衡问题，并给出完整的理论分析。

Result: 在智能体推理基准上的实验表明，该方法达到State-of-the-Art（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: Fair-MPO/Φ-MPO通过多级偏好优化与公平多级目标，从理论与实验两方面同时缓解长时程信用分配与数据不平衡问题，验证了其在智能体学习中的有效性与先进性。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems capable of solving complex tasks through multi-turn planning, tool use, verification, and memory updates. However, learning agentic systems remains difficult due to two fundamental challenges, i.e., (1) long-horizon credit assignment, where supervision is available only at the final outcome, and (2) imbalanced data distributions, where dominant data patterns bias optimization and weaken adaptation to rare but informative reasoning behaviors. In this paper, we propose Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO or $Φ$-MPO), a new preference optimization framework for agentic learning. We first show that Multi-Level Preference Optimization provides a principled and more computationally efficient framework for long-horizon reasoning. Then, we introduce a Fair Multi-Level Objective that addresses imbalance in agentic learning. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis demonstrating that our approach addresses both long-horizon reasoning and data imbalance. Our experiments on agentic reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SOTA) performance.

</details>


### [1592] [ANTMAN: Adaptive Need Tracking for Multi-Agent Navigation in Large Information Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33326)
*Jerry Wang,Haibo Jin,Xiaopeng Yuan,Peng Kuang,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ANTMAN——以"未解决的信息需求"为协调单元的自适应多智能体协调框架，通过可修订的 Need Graph 动态控制工作节点选择、路由与恢复，避免协调开销随空间静态切分增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信息搜寻智能体面对的信息空间过大、无法穷尽处理，但许多多智能体系统仍围绕信息空间的静态划分来组织计算，导致协调成本随"信息被如何切分"增长，而非随"查询仍需要什么"增长。这种 partition-driven 方式在大规模上下文下协调开销急剧膨胀，缺乏对未解决需求的动态追踪能力。

Method: ANTMAN 将"演化的未解决信息需求"作为运行时协调的基本单元，维护一个可修订的 Need Graph，记录未解决的需求、已积累的证据、既往尝试与搜索进度；并据此状态控制工作节点（worker）选择、路由以及任务局部恢复。通过将协调策略与底层搜索接口解耦，使同一需求条件化机制可跨不同信息空间运行。实验覆盖多文档问答、可控长上下文扩展与真实结构化导航三类任务。

Result: ANTMAN 在多种设置下均保持有效，包括将执行委托给显著更小的工作模型时。在可搜索上下文扩大 16 倍的条件下，ANTMAN 的活跃协调仅增加 1.23 倍，而 partition-driven 基线增加超过 15 倍，同时保持良好的答案质量。

Conclusion: 以未解决需求为中心的动态协调优于基于静态空间划分的协调，能显著抑制长上下文下的协调开销增长，并具备跨信息空间与跨模型规模的通用性。

Abstract: Information-seeking agents increasingly operate over information spaces that are too large to process exhaustively. Yet many multi-agent systems organize computation around static partitions of the available space, causing coordination to grow with how information is segmented rather than with what the query still requires. We introduce ANTMAN, an adaptive coordination framework that treats evolving unresolved information needs as the unit of runtime coordination. ANTMAN maintains a revisable Need Graph that tracks unresolved requirements, accumulated evidence, prior attempts, and search progress, and uses this state to control worker selection, routing, and task-local recovery as new evidence is discovered. By separating the coordination policy from substrate-specific search interfaces, the same need-conditioned mechanism can operate across different information spaces. Experiments across multi-document question answering, controlled long-context scaling, and realistic structured navigation show that ANTMAN remains effective across settings, including when execution is delegated to substantially smaller worker models. Under a 16x increase in searchable context, ANTMAN increases active coordination by only 1.23x, compared with more than 15x for partition-driven baselines, while preserving strong answer quality.

</details>


### [1593] [Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching for Sign Language Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33339)
*Jiayi He,Shengeng Tang,Sisi You,Yanbin Hao,Lechao Cheng,Richang Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SignNMFlow，从流形传输视角重新审视手语生成（SLP），通过自然度引导的流形流匹配构建流形上的条件路径，提升生成手语动作的保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件流匹配方法通过线性插值构建条件路径，但人体关节的旋转几何将有效旋转约束在嵌入欧氏空间的流形上，线性插值会脱离该流形并忽略其上的动作分布。

Method: 提出自然度引导的流形流匹配框架SignNMFlow：直接在建模动作流形上构建条件路径，同时考虑几何效率与动作分布。利用流形内在几何，引入动作自然度度量刻画动作分布，并在该度量下最小化动能，学习一种自然度引导插值——将提供几何高效传输的闭式测地线与融入动作分布的可学习偏差相耦合。

Result: 大量定性与定量评估证明了该工作的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过在动作流形上构建自然度引导的条件路径，SignNMFlow有效提升了生成手语动作的保真度。

Abstract: Sign Language Production (SLP) aims to generate sign motions from text. Conditional Flow Matching methods have achieved strong performance in SLP by constructing conditional paths that transform a source distribution into a target distribution. However, existing methods construct these paths via linear interpolation, whereas the rotational geometry of human joints confines valid joint rotations to a manifold embedded in Euclidean space. Consequently, linear interpolation between two sign motions leaves this manifold and ignores the motion distribution on it. In this paper, we revisit SLP from the perspective of manifold transport and propose a Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching framework, termed \textbf{SignNMFlow}, which constructs conditional paths directly on the motion manifold by jointly considering geometric efficiency and the motion distribution. Specifically, we exploit the intrinsic geometry of the manifold and introduce a motion naturalness measure to characterize the motion distribution. By minimizing the kinetic energy under this measure, we learn a naturalness-guided interpolation that couples a closed-form geodesic, which provides geometrically efficient transport, with a learnable deviation that incorporates the motion distribution, thereby significantly improving the fidelity of generated sign motions. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of this work.

</details>


### [1594] [QuPID: Quantum Parameter-Efficient Input-Dependent Retrieval Adaptation for Medical RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33351)
*Hyojun Ahn,Emily Jimin Roh,Soohyun Park,Walid Saad,Hyung-Chul Lee,Joongheon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuPID通过数据重上传使量子检索电路输入依赖，并以局域Pauli期望读出替代态比较，用仅60个参数将冻结图像特征适配到本地档案库，在医学影像检索上优于冻结编码器、适配器与LoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于保真度的量子检索中，固定编码后接一个与输入无关的共享酉变换不改变查询态与档案态之间的保真度，因此训练该电路无法改变检索排序。为在数据受限条件下把冻结图像特征适配到本地档案库，需要一种极低参数预算且真正输入依赖的适配方法。

Method: 提出QuPID：1）通过数据重上传使电路输入依赖；2）不再比较量子态，而是比较测量读出——局域Pauli期望构成的向量；3）得到一个小规模读出层，用于将冻结图像特征适配到本地档案库；训练阶段经典模拟电路，推理阶段在GPU上以固定学习参数运行。理论上刻画该电路类为输入调制二次特征映射的结构化分解，界定其重上传通道的频率支撑，并给出参数计数泛化界以解释其小预算的合理性。实验采用共享冻结骨干与无标签协议。

Result: 在共享冻结骨干和无标签协议下，QuPID仅用60个参数即在ChestX-ray14与MURA上取得高于冻结医学编码器、以及参数量高达525万的适配器和LoRA的precision-at-5（P@5）。在ChestX-ray14上，相对冻结编码器的P@5提升为+0.116；在512个适配样本时对重调适配器的领先最大（+0.040）；相对同样紧凑的经典旋转平面头的全预算优势为+0.023，95%区间不含零。医学影像为主要测试场景，该模式在两个非医学基准、报告生成以及模拟门噪声与有限采样读出下同样重现。

Conclusion: 输入端无关的酉变换不改变保真度排序，故必须引入输入依赖性；QuPID以数据重上传加局域Pauli期望读出实现输入依赖适配，在极小参数预算（60个参数）下显著优于冻结编码器与大得多的适配器/LoRA，并在非医学基准、报告生成与噪声条件下保持稳健。

Abstract: Fidelity-based quantum retrieval ranks candidates by the fidelity between query and archive states. Applying a shared input-independent unitary after fixed state encoding leaves that fidelity unchanged, so training the circuit cannot alter the ranking. Quantum parameter-efficient input-dependent retrieval adaptation (QuPID) repairs this by making the circuit input-dependent through data re-uploading and by comparing measurement readouts, vectors of local Pauli expectations, rather than states. The result is a small readout for adapting frozen image features to a local archive with limited data: training simulates the circuit classically, and inference runs on a GPU with fixed learned parameters. We characterize the class as a structured factorization of input-modulated quadratic feature maps, bound the frequency support of its re-uploading channel, and give a parameter-count generalization bound that motivates its small budget. Under a shared frozen backbone and a label-free protocol, QuPID's 60 parameters give higher precision-at-5 (P@5) on ChestX-ray14 and MURA than frozen medical encoders, and than adapters and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with up to 5.25 million trainable parameters. On ChestX-ray14, the P@5 gain over the frozen encoder is +0.116, the lead over retuned adapters is widest at 512 adaptation examples (+0.040), and the full-budget margin over an equally compact classical rotation-plane head is +0.023 with a 95% interval excluding zero. Medical imaging is the primary testbed; the pattern recurs on two non-medical benchmarks, in report generation, and under simulated gate noise and finite-shot readout.

</details>


### [1595] [Unmask the State: When Does State Adaptation Matter for Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33355)
*Injin Kong,Sunghwan Choi,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究掩码扩散语言模型(MDM)推理时反掩码策略的适应性，提出"策略反转"分析视角，将MDM推理分为五个维度，并证明"选择性适应"优于均匀适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MDM允许灵活生成顺序，反掩码策略成为推理决策，现有方法在优先位置、并行度控制、选择区域、预测修订、去噪规划上各不相同，但不清楚这些选择何时应在生成过程中改变。作者希望回答"何时应调整策略"这一根本问题。

Method: 作者通过"策略反转"(替代动作优于固定选择)来研究该问题，将MDM推理组织为五个轴：score(打分)、cardinality(基数)、region(区域)、commitment(承诺)、planning(规划)；定义"适应机会"为最佳候选动作相对验证集选定的固定动作的一步效用优势，并基于验证提示校准轻量级检测器以识别高机会状态。

Result: 在三个MDM和十个任务上，适应机会高度异质，部分情境呈现集中且可预测的一步收益。在LLaDA-8B约束JSON填充任务上，仅适应top 10%状态即可捕获候选集oracle机会的56.9%。

Conclusion: 转换层面的结果表明，状态适应在被选择性应用时最有用，而非均匀地应用于所有状态。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDMs) admit flexible generation orders, making the unmasking strategy an inference decision. Existing methods vary in how they prioritize positions, control parallelism, restrict selection regions, revise predictions, or plan future denoising, yet it remains unclear when these choices should change during generation. We study this question through strategy reversals, where an alternative action becomes preferable to a fixed choice. We organize MDM inference into five axes--score, cardinality, region, commitment, and planning--and define adaptation opportunity as the one-step utility advantage of the best candidate action over a validation-selected fixed action. This view shows that adaptation value depends on both the frequency and magnitude of such reversals. Across three MDMs and ten tasks, adaptation opportunities are highly heterogeneous, with some regimes exhibiting concentrated and predictable one-step gains. This motivates selective adaptation: lightweight detectors calibrated on validation prompts identify high-opportunity states, capturing, for example, 56.9 percent of the candidate-set oracle opportunity by adapting only the top 10 percent of states on LLaDA-8B constrained JSON filling. Our transition-level results suggest that state adaptation is most useful when applied selectively rather than uniformly.

</details>


### [1596] [Long-Horizon Analog Design Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hours-Long Analog and Mixed-Signal Circuit Design Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33356)
*Analog Design Bench Team*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Analog Design Bench，一个由17位芯片设计师贡献50个晶体管级任务的长时间跨度智能体基准，用开源仿真器和隔离验证器按电气规格评估电路；在15种智能体配置、2250次两小时尝试中，全规格通过率为8.0%–78.0%，主要失败原因是没有合法性拒绝但未通过电气验收，即电气收敛是核心难点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体已能维持数小时的工具驱动循环，但其将长时间跨度的模拟与混合信号电路推进到电气规格的能力尚未被测量，缺乏针对该能力的标准化评测手段。

Method: 构建 Analog Design Bench：50个晶体管级设计任务，由17位芯片设计师贡献；智能体使用开源仿真器工作，隔离验证器通过基于规格的电气测试评估提交电路。对15种智能体配置进行2250次两小时尝试，并设置时间、推理强度、智能体框架、提供设计知识等干预变量。

Result: 全规格通过率为8.0%至78.0%；编码基准表现与模拟结果相关，但无法解释大部分性能差异。失败分析显示多数未成功提交没有记录到合法性拒绝，却在电气验收上失败，说明电气收敛是主要终点挑战。更长预算和更高推理强度提升表现；通用技能文档帮助有限，有时甚至降低表现；提供任务匹配的参考拓扑使 DeepSeek V4 Pro 提升18.7个百分点，对 GPT-5.6 Sol 主要是加速作用。

Conclusion: 电气规格收敛而非语法/合法性是模拟电路智能体的主导瓶颈；增加预算与推理强度有效，通用知识迁移收益有限，而任务匹配的电路IP检索式参考拓扑是显著有效的干预方向。

Abstract: Coding agents now sustain hours-long, tool-driven loops, yet their ability to carry long-horizon analog and mixed-signal circuits to electrical specification remains unmeasured. We introduce Analog Design Bench, a long-horizon agentic benchmark of 50 transistor-level design tasks contributed by 17 chip designers. Agents work with an open-source simulator, while an isolated verifier evaluates the submitted circuit using specification-based electrical tests. We evaluate 15 agent configurations across 2,250 two-hour attempts and observe full-specification pass rates from 8.0% to 78.0%. Coding-benchmark performance correlates with analog results but leaves much of the performance spread unexplained. Our failure analysis shows that most unsuccessful submissions have no recorded legality rejection but fail electrical acceptance, identifying electrical closure as the dominant endpoint challenge. We test time, reasoning effort, agent harness, and supplied design knowledge as interventions. Longer budgets and higher reasoning effort improve performance, while general skill documents provide little benefit and sometimes reduce performance. Supplying a task-matched reference topology, an idealized form of circuit-IP retrieval, raises DeepSeek V4 Pro by 18.7 percentage points and mainly accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol.

</details>


### [1597] [DISCERN: Can AI Agents Work Like Scientists and Guide Discovery?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33357)
*Nan Huang,Mario Tapia-Pacheco,Kun Zhou,Yiming Huang,Kevin José Barrientos Díaz,Tiffany Amariuta,Jingbo Shang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DISCERN基准，基于真实公开数据集评估自动化研究工作流的三个层级：数据完整性、分析验证、假设生成与修正，覆盖203个任务、8个生命科学赛道和8个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多单独评估分析任务完成度或假设生成，未能检验可靠证据是否支撑有效且新颖的结论；自动化研究需先审查数据、验证分析、并生成有据可依的假设。

Method: 构建DISCERN受控基准：Level 1检验混杂因素与工具陷阱下的数据完整性；Level 2检验分析验证；Level 3在对抗性评审下测试假设生成与修正，包含证据与真实数据及已有科学现象一致、却与既有预期冲突的反事实案例，以推动替代解释与可检验假设。

Result: 在203个任务、8个赛道、8个模型中，Level 1满分率60.8%，Level 2为34.2%，Level 3仅0.6%；扣分源于拒绝可靠数据、未将已知局限性纳入结论、假设产出波动大。按token与代码使用量的跨赛道排名比按证据判断的排名稳定得多。

Conclusion: 当前智能体在计算投入上较一致，但证据推理一致性不足，尚不能实现可靠的自主分析与发现；应定位为有监督的科学辅助工具。

Abstract: Reliable automated research requires agents to vet data, verify analyses, and generate hypotheses grounded in trustworthy evidence, potentially reducing routine scientific workload while allowing scientists to focus on interpretation and discovery. Existing benchmarks often only assess analytical task completion or hypothesis generation separately rather than testing whether reliable evidence supports valid and novel claims. We introduce DISCERN (Data Integrity and Scientific Capability: Evidence, Reasoning, and Novelty), a controlled benchmark on real, publicly available datasets that evaluates three key levels of an automated research workflow. The first two levels test data integrity and analysis verification under confounds and tool traps, while the third tests hypothesis generation and revision under adversarial review, including counterfactual cases in which evidence consistent with real data and documented scientific phenomena conflicts with established expectations, motivating alternative explanations and testable hypotheses. Across 203 tasks, eight life-science tracks, and eight models, DISCERN shows that strong aggregate performance can mask level-specific weaknesses. Agents earn perfect scores in only 60.8% of Level 1, 34.2% of Level 2, and 0.6% of Level 3 evaluations, with penalties attributed to rejection of sound data, failure to carry recognized limitations into conclusions, and wide variation in hypothesis production. Cross-track rankings by token and code use are substantially more stable than rankings by evidence judgment, suggesting greater consistency in computational effort than in evidence-based reasoning. These profiles identify opportunities for supervised scientific assistance, but current agents do not yet demonstrate reliable autonomous analysis or discovery. Code and data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/discern-bench-anon/discern-benchmark

</details>


### [1598] [DrafTS: Time-Aware Decomposition with Residual Correction for Time Series Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33368)
*Yiqiu Liu,Siru Zhong,Zhiguang Wang,Qingsong Wen,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DrafTS：一种模型无关框架，通过时间感知分解与残差校正降低噪声同时保留演化动态，在四类时序任务上提升六个骨干模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界时序包含不断演化的底层动态，其不规则变化缺乏稳定时间模式，常被视为噪声。现有方法要么通过频率滤波、要么抑制含噪观测来处理这种混合信号，但前者忽视时间演化，后者可能抑制有用动态。

Method: DrafTS采用时间感知分解与残差校正：利用瞬时幅度和瞬时频率导出的特征，引导将信号分解为主成分（用于捕获底层动态）；任务特定骨干网络对主成分建模；轻量级校正模块利用残差信息对骨干输出进行校正。

Result: 在四类时序建模任务上，DrafTS提升了六种不同的骨干网络，验证了其有效性。代码开源。

Conclusion: DrafTS是一种模型无关的降噪框架，能同时保留演化动态并通过残差校正补偿信息，具备良好的通用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Real-world time series contain evolving underlying dynamics with irregular variations that lack stable temporal patterns and are often referred to as noise. Existing methods address this mixture by filtering frequencies or suppressing noisy observations. They either miss temporal evolution or risk suppressing useful dynamics. We propose DrafTS, a model-agnostic framework that aims to reduce noise while preserving evolving dynamics through time-aware Decomposition with ResiduAl correction For Time Series. DrafTS uses features derived from instantaneous amplitude and frequency to guide decomposition into a primary component intended to capture underlying dynamics. A task-specific backbone models the primary component, while a lightweight correction module uses residual information to correct the backbone output. Across four time series modeling tasks, DrafTS improves six diverse backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is at https://github.com/Autumn61q/DrafTS

</details>


### [1599] [Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising for Video Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33394)
*Xinzhe Li,Youzhi Tu,Kong Aik Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CTCLD框架，通过条件潜空间去噪实现跨模态翻译，用于视频深度伪造检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频深度伪造威胁日增，检测亟需多模态信息。音视频信号不仅各自是真实性线索，其内在依赖关系也是重要检测依据。但现有方法常忽略跨模态对应关系，阻碍域间信息传递，导致关键检测线索未被利用。

Method: 首先基于贝叶斯框架分解音视频联合分布；随后提出CTCLD，将不同模态在潜空间中的异构分布相连接，以彼此为条件进行双向潜空间去噪翻译，从而捕获被篡改信号中的细微不一致性。

Result: 实验表明CTCLD实现了全面的域对齐，形成稳健的视频深度伪造检测方法，性能具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过跨模态潜空间翻译与条件去噪，可有效利用音视频互补信息与依赖关系，提升视频深度伪造检测的鲁棒性与性能。

Abstract: The growing threat of video deepfakes necessitates multimodal detection. Beyond serving as independent indicators of authenticity, audio and visual signals have intrinsic dependencies that also provide an essential criterion for detection. Previous methods often overlook the cross-modal correspondences, hindering information transfer between domains and leaving crucial detection cues unexplored. To address this challenge, we propose a framework called Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising (CTCLD) for video deepfake detection. It connects the distinct distributions of heterogeneous modalities in latent spaces, enabling smooth cross-domain information transfer to improve detection performance. We first establish a Bayesian foundation by decomposing the audio-visual joint distribution. Subsequently, CTCLD translates both modalities via bidirectional latent denoising conditioned on each other, effectively capturing subtle inconsistencies in the manipulated signals. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CTCLD enables comprehensive domain alignment, resulting in a robust video deepfake detection approach with competitive performance.

</details>


### [1600] [CoViST: Visual Token Compression via Composable States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33397)
*Qi Zhang,Xiandong Meng,Ronggang Wang,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架CoViST，将压缩图像表示为可组合视觉状态，融合代表特征、原位置、有效贡献权重与可复用选择元数据，在固定压缩与前缀解码器内渐进压缩两种设置下均保持近乎无损性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token压缩方法将视觉token压缩为一个精简集合，但每个token所承载的视觉证据量及其原始空间上下文是隐式的；压缩表示未显式编码每个代表token携带多少视觉信息、位于原图何处。该局限在单次压缩后即存在，跨解码器层反复压缩时更严重。

Method: CoViST为免训练框架，将压缩图像表示为可组合视觉状态：状态融合代表特征、原始位置、有效贡献权重和可复用选择元数据。通过覆盖率引导的选择与基于守恒的贡献合成构建该状态，并将贡献与位置信息显式注入解码器注意力。各组件在连续压缩下保持可解释性，同一公式支持prefill前的固定压缩与解码器内的渐进压缩。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B的七个基准上：CoViST-Fixed在192、128、64 token时分别保留未压缩性能的99.9%、99.5%、98.1%；CoViST-Pro在对应层平均预算下分别保留99.8%、99.9%、99.1%，在各自预算设置下优于现有最优方法。

Conclusion: CoViST通过显式编码视觉token的贡献与空间位置，解决了现有压缩表示信息隐式、重复压缩退化的问题，在固定与渐进两种压缩模式下均实现接近无损的性能，代码将公开。

Abstract: Visual token compression lowers the inference cost of vision--language models by representing images with fewer tokens. However, most existing methods compress visual tokens to a reduced set, leaving the amount of visual evidence represented by each token and its original spatial context implicit. Therefore, the compressed representation does not explicitly encode how much visual information each representative carries or where it lies in the original image. This limitation arises even after a single reduction and becomes more pronounced when compression is repeated across decoder layers. To address this issue, we propose CoViST, a training-free framework that represents a compressed image as a composable visual state. Specifically, the state combines representative features with original positions, effective contribution weights, and reusable selection metadata. CoViST constructs this state through coverage-guided selection and conservation-based contribution composition, and explicitly incorporates its contribution and positional information into decoder attention. Each component of the state retains its interpretation under successive reductions, enabling the same formulation to support both fixed compression before prefill and progressive compression within the decoder. Experimental results on seven LLaVA-1.5-7B benchmarks show that CoViST-Fixed retains 99.9\%, 99.5\%, and 98.1\% of uncompressed performance at 192, 128, and 64 tokens, respectively, and CoViST-Pro retains 99.8\%, 99.9\%, and 99.1\% at the corresponding layer-average budgets, outperforming state-of-the-art methods under their respective budget settings. Code will be released publicly.

</details>


### [1601] [COEVO: Co-Evolving Context and Parameters for Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33398)
*Siwei Chen,Xinping Bao,Xinyu Cai,Yuan Cao,Wan Jiang,Shaohong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出将递归自我改进（RSI）建模为参数-上下文协同演化问题，并给出COEVO框架，用策略熵与提示条件注意力信号驱动模型参数与学习上下文在共享反馈回路中相互适应，实验表明其优于固定上下文强化学习并提升对系统提示变化的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RSI研究分为两条独立路线：在线学习更新模型参数，以及通过搜索、反思和提示优化改进外部上下文。二者通常被割裂研究，忽视了关键交互——上下文塑造模型学习所依赖的经验，而演化中的模型又会对同一上下文作出不同解读与利用。

Method: 将RSI形式化为参数-上下文协同演化问题：模型参数与学习上下文在共享反馈回路中共同适应。提出COEVO框架：一方面从on-policy经验更新模型参数，另一方面依据演化策略的状态自适应调整上下文引导；采用策略熵与提示条件注意力作为互补信号来指导该自适应过程。

Result: 实验显示COEVO在任务性能上持续优于固定上下文的强化学习方法，并产生对系统提示变化更鲁棒的策略。

Conclusion: 外部上下文不应仅被视为大语言模型的固定接口，而应作为递归自我改进中可自适应的组成部分。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to move large language models beyond static training pipelines toward systems that can participate in improving their own future behavior. Existing approaches largely follow two directions: updating model parameters through online learning, or improving the external context through search, reflection, and prompt optimization. Although both mechanisms can support continued improvement, they are typically studied independently. This separation overlooks an important interaction: the context shapes the experience from which a model learns, while an evolving model may interpret and utilize the same context differently over time. We therefore formulate RSI as a problem of parameter--context co-evolution, where model parameters and the learning context adapt within a shared feedback loop. We introduce COEVO, a framework that updates model parameters from on-policy experience while adapting contextual guidance according to the state of the evolving policy. Policy entropy and prompt-conditioned attention are used as complementary signals to guide this adaptation. Experiments show that COEVO consistently improves task performance over fixed-context reinforcement learning and produces policies that are more robust to changes in system prompts. More broadly, our results suggest that external context should be viewed not merely as a fixed interface to a large language model, but as an adaptive component of recursive self-improvement.

</details>


### [1602] [Temporal Graph Learning of Wearable Actigraphy and Sleep Traces for Modelling Adolescent Crystallized Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33428)
*Md. Tanvir Rahman,Nabil Anan Orka,Asaduzzaman Khan,Mohammad Ali Moni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SATURN模型，用21天Fitbit睡眠-活动数据构建时序图预测青少年晶体智力Gc，R²=0.2783，优于GB和BiLSTM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴活动记录仪可提供可扩展、生态效度高的评估方式，替代间歇性临床测评。但从这类数据预测青少年连续晶体智力（Gc）存在两大难点：设备依从性不规则导致的数据缺失，以及行为-环境交互复杂。

Method: 基于ABCD研究（Release 5.1）中6,091名青少年21天Fitbit日汇总数据。SATURN（Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network）将参与者表示为21节点时序图，编码每日行为与时间邻接关系；前向传播中动态剪枝无效日边以避免插补伪影；用残差GATv2层精炼节点嵌入，经掩码注意力池化聚合，再与社会人口学协变量融合。采用家庭控制、年龄-性别-BMI分层的交叉验证。

Result: SATURN取得R²=0.2783±0.0127，优于扁平化机器学习（Gradient Boosting，R²=0.2372）与序列深度学习（BiLSTM，R²=0.2688）。可解释性分析显示轻度活动、代谢当量和睡眠时长是主导预测因子；蒙特卡洛dropout与亚组分析证实跨社会人口学层次的公平性。

Conclusion: SATURN为数字认知表型建立了严谨的计算框架，通过刻画宏观行为异常，提供可扩展途径来补充传统测评。

Abstract: Wearable actigraphy offers a scalable, ecologically valid alternative to episodic clinical assessment. However, predicting continuous adolescent crystallized intelligence ($G_c$) from such traces remains challenging due to irregular device adherence and complex behavioral-environmental interactions. We address this using daily summary data derived from 21-day Fitbit records of 6,091 adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (Release 5.1). We propose SATURN, a Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network. It represents participants as 21-node temporal graphs encoding daily behaviors and temporal adjacency. To prevent imputation artifacts, invalid-day edges are dynamically pruned during forward passes. Node embeddings are refined via residual GATv2 layers, aggregated through masked attention pooling, and fused with sociodemographic covariates. Under family-controlled, age-sex-BMI-stratified cross-validation, SATURN achieves $R^2 = 0.2783 \pm 0.0127$, consistently improving upon flattened machine learning (Gradient Boosting, $R^2 = 0.2372$) and sequential deep learning (BiLSTM, $R^2 = 0.2688$) baselines. Explainability analyses identify light activity, metabolic equivalents, and sleep duration as dominant predictors, while Monte Carlo dropout and subgroup analyses confirm equitable performance across sociodemographic strata. Ultimately, SATURN establishes a rigorous computational framework for digital cognitive phenotyping, offering a scalable pathway to complement traditional assessments by highlighting macro-level behavioral anomalies.

</details>


### [1603] [MAC-Net: A Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Modeling Cognitive Function From Task-Based fMRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33440)
*Md. Tanvir Rahman,Nabil Anan Orka,Asaduzzaman Khan,Mohammad Ali Moni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出协变量感知的深度学习框架MAC-Net，从区域tfMRI中建模个体认知功能，通过分离神经通路与晚期融合协变量，在6500名ABCD参与者上实现优于基线的认知预测，并定位工作记忆相关脑区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于任务的fMRI进行个体级认知预测对神经康复具有重要意义，但神经特征与人口学、扫描仪相关变异共存，导致个体预测困难，且主导性协变量容易抑制高维临床表征的学习。

Method: MAC-Net将tfMRI特征隔离到专门的神经通路，并将参与者变量限制在末端晚期融合通路。使用家庭感知交叉验证，在6500名ABCD研究参与者的基线数据上评估，与线性模型、随机森林及其他深度架构进行基准比较；采用Integrated Gradients、DeepLIFT和Input Gradient进行特征归因。

Result: N-back加Monetary Incentive Delay配置对流体、晶体和总认知的R²分别为0.174、0.238和0.277，优于仅协变量基线（0.178）和其他深度模型（0.217）。N-back范式信息量最高，加入Stop Signal Task略微降低性能。三种归因方法高度一致，定位于工作记忆相关额叶、顶叶和扣带皮层区域。

Conclusion: 协变量感知的多任务建模可产生可重复的认知功能估计，为临床转化建立了稳健的神经工程框架。

Abstract: Objective cognitive assessment from neural signals supports neurorehabilitation, but individual-level prediction from task-based fMRI (tfMRI) remains difficult because neural features coexist with substantial demographic and scanner-related variation. We present the Multi-task Activation and Contrast Network (MAC-Net), a covariate-aware deep learning framework for modeling individual cognitive function from regional tfMRI. By isolating tfMRI features into a dedicated neural pathway and restricting participant variables to a terminal late-fusion pathway, MAC-Net prevents dominant covariates from suppressing high-dimensional clinical representations during feature learning. Evaluating baseline data from 6,500 Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study participants under family-aware cross-validation, MAC-Net was benchmarked against linear models, random forests, and alternative deep architectures. The N-back plus Monetary Incentive Delay configuration achieved $R^{2}$ values of 0.174, 0.238, and 0.277 for fluid, crystallized, and total cognition, outperforming covariate-only baselines (0.178) and alternative deep models (0.217). N-back was the most informative paradigm, whereas incorporating the Stop Signal Task marginally degraded performance. Feature attributions via Integrated Gradients, DeepLIFT, and Input Gradient were highly concordant, localizing working-memory-related frontal, parietal, and cingulate regions. These findings demonstrate that covariate-aware multi-task modeling yields reproducible cognitive-function estimations, establishing a robust neural engineering framework for clinical translation.

</details>


### [1604] [What Shared Prefixes Hide: Trajectory Dropout for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33455)
*Zzizhuo Lin,Quanling Liu,Yi Yang,Yawei Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文发现on-policy distillation中存在"前缀诱导监督衰减(PISA)"现象，并提出Trajectory Dropout训练干预方法，通过随机丢弃学生部分推理轨迹、同时让教师观察完整轨迹进行token级监督，强化被衰减的学习信号，在多个模型规模和数学推理基准上稳定提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy distillation(OPD)让学生模型在自己生成的轨迹上，接受更强教师模型的密集token级反馈。由于每次更新都基于学生已生成的推理前缀，前缀会影响教师反馈转化为学习的效率。作者发现共享前缀会导致token级更新信号减弱，提出并命名这一现象为Prefix-Induced Supervision Attenuation(PISA)。其出现在两类常见情形：(i)学生高置信度时，即使教师持不同意见，纠正梯度依然偏弱；(ii)依赖早期推理的token，其学习信号可能与简单的局部延续一样弱，导致监督不足。

Method: 提出Trajectory Dropout，一种简单训练时的干预方法：学生先进行标准全上下文rollout生成完整轨迹；训练时随机丢弃学生推理轨迹的一定比例，同时教师仍观察完整轨迹进行token级监督。该机制强化对过度自信预测的纠正，并在前缀敏感位置引入额外监督。

Result: 在不同规模的教师-学生模型对、六个数学推理基准上，Trajectory Dropout一致提升平均性能，并在两个域外基准上也有增益；可灵活集成到现有OPD变体中，计算开销可忽略，并进一步提升其表现。

Conclusion: Trajectory Dropout提供了一种简单机制，能够在不同模型规模和OPD目标下强化token级监督，验证了其有效性与通用性。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own trajectories using dense token-level feedback from a stronger teacher model. Since each update is conditioned on the reasoning prefix already generated by the student, the prefix also shapes how effectively teacher feedback is converted into learning. We find that shared prefixes can lead to weak token-level updates, a phenomenon we call Prefix-Induced Supervision Attenuation (PISA). This attenuation arises in two common cases. (i) High student confidence can weaken corrective gradients even when the teacher disagrees. (ii) Tokens that rely on earlier reasoning can receive learning signals as weak as those for simple local continuations. To solve this problem, we propose Trajectory Dropout, a simple training-time intervention that exposes these weakened signals. The student first performs a standard full-context rollout to generate a complete trajectory. During training, we randomly drop a certain proportion of the student's reasoning trajectory, while the teacher continues to observe the complete trajectory for token-level supervision. This intervention strengthens corrections for overconfident predictions and introduces additional supervision at prefix-sensitive positions. Trajectory Dropout consistently improves average performance across teacher--student model pairs of different scales and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while also yielding gains on two out-of-domain benchmarks. It can also be flexibly integrated into existing OPD variants with negligible computational overhead, further improving their performance. These results demonstrate that Trajectory Dropout provides a simple mechanism for strengthening token-level supervision across model scales and OPD objectives.

</details>


### [1605] [When Does the Concept of "Dog" Emerge in an Audio LLM?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33458)
*Zhe Wang,Shiqi Liu,Ruiyun Zhong,Tiechong Zhu,Yihua Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究用Jacobian lens读出与方向性干预，考察Qwen2.5-Omni-7B对狗吠声的内部表征及其对输出决策的因果影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型能回答音频问题，但其如何表征听觉语义并据此决策尚不清晰，限制了对回答形成机制的理解。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B中研究狗吠声，采用J-lens读出定义"狗方向"隐状态向量，并通过添加或移除该方向分量进行方向性干预。任务涵盖物种分类、发声分类和声音描述。

Result: 该信息无需狗/吠提示线索或动物识别要求即可解码；方向性干预改变回答倾向及部分最终答案，效应集中在生成前的后层状态（尤以L22、L24最稳定），但在动物/其他分类上狗方向相对对照无优势。

Conclusion: 因果干预证据表明，狗方向以任务依赖方式影响输出分数，且在生成前紧邻层表现最一致。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models answer audio questions, but how they represent auditory semantics and use them in decisions remains unclear, limiting our understanding of response formation. We study dog barking in Qwen2.5-Omni-7B using Jacobian lens (J-lens) readout and directional interventions. We define the dog direction as a J-lens-derived hidden-state vector associated with dog; adding or removing its component modulates dog-related information. We find this information decodable without dog/bark prompt cues or animal-identification requirements. Directional interventions change response tendencies and some final answers, with effects concentrated in late-layer states immediately before generation across species classification, vocalization classification, and sound description. The dog direction shows no comparable advantage over controls in animal/other classification. These results provide causal-intervention evidence that the dog direction affects output scores in a task-dependent manner, most consistently at L22 and L24 immediately before generation.

</details>


### [1606] [LiveOption: Evaluating LLM Agents in Structured Option Trading with Nonlinear Payoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33470)
*Haochen Luo,Yifan Li,Binh Minh An,Xiaolong Luo,Zhengzhao Lai,Yuan Zhang,Chen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LiveOption，一个面向LLM智能体期权交易的评估框架，将期权交易建模为受执行与资金约束的结构化序贯决策问题，包含三类任务套件和分层指标体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM与多智能体系统的金融决策评估主要集中于股票交易，且多评估方向性预测，忽视了衍生品市场的结构复杂性。期权交易具有非线性收益与多腿策略构建等根本不同挑战，需要结构化决策而非简单方向性押注。

Method: LiveOption将问题形式化为现实执行与资金约束下的结构化序贯决策，提供可复现环境与标准化交互协议；构建三个任务套件：组合叠加、事件驱动财报交易、0DTE日内交易；并提出分层指标套件，评估动作有效性、决策质量、风险特征与结果层面表现。

Result: 实验表明，当前智能体在多数场景下难以取得有竞争力的收益。

Conclusion: LiveOption为超越结果导向指标的结构化决策评估提供了有原则的测试平台。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in financial decision-making, yet existing evaluations focus on equity trading and primarily assess directional prediction, overlooking the structural complexity of derivative markets. Option trading introduces fundamentally different challenges, including nonlinear payoffs and multi-leg strategy construction, requiring structured decisions rather than simple directional bets. We introduce LiveOption, an evaluation framework for LLM-based agents in option trading. LiveOption formulates the problem as structured sequential decision-making under realistic execution and capital constraints, and provides a reproducible environment with standardized interaction protocols. The framework includes three task suites covering portfolio overlays, event-driven earnings trading, and 0DTE intraday trading. We further propose a hierarchical metric suite that evaluates action validity, decision quality, risk characteristics, and outcome-level performance. Experiments show that current agents often fail to achieve competitive returns in most scenarios. LiveOption offers a principled testbed for evaluating structured decision-making beyond outcome-based metrics.

</details>


### [1607] [Just Let Linear States Forget the Distant Past: Prefix Caching via Suffix Replay for Hybrid LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33477)
*Yirui Liu,Ruoling Qi,Xuaner Wu,Yuxin Jin,Jian Chen,Penghang Liu,Yafei Huang,Jiawei Shao,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SuffixReplay 是首个无需物化循环状态检查点、即可让混合 LLM 在任意缓存支持页边界重用前缀的 prefix caching 系统：它利用线性注意力的衰减/门控特性，仅通过重放近期后缀来近似匹配边界处的状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合 LLM 交错使用 full-attention 层与 linear-attention 层以降低长上下文推理成本，但该结构使 prefix caching 变复杂：full-attention KV cache 可按 token 寻址，而 linear-attention 层维护的循环状态无法回滚到任意前缀边界。现有系统通过物化循环状态检查点来解决，只能把前缀复用限制在检查点对齐位置。

Method: 核心洞察是让线性状态遗忘久远过去：现代线性注意力用循环衰减与门控削弱旧输入影响，因此无需为每个前缀边界做检查点，只需重放该层输入隐状态的近期后缀（作为 anchors）即可近似匹配边界处的状态。算法层面结合层级与 token 级 anchor 稀疏化，并用有界 replay 预算控制存储、计算与质量；系统层面采用独立管理的 anchor sidecar 与流水线化 replay 路径，将 anchor 搬移和状态重建与原生 serving 流程重叠。

Result: 在 OLMo-Hybrid-7B、Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 三个混合 LLM 上评估：在 LongBench 与 RULER 上平均保留 full-prefill 质量的 91.4–100%，每 token 摊销存储仅为 SGLang 默认 8192-token 检查点缓存的 0.36–0.51x。集成到 SGLang 后，在分支负载上 median TTFT 降低 15–70%，工作集超过 HBM 时吞吐为 SGLang 的 2.3–4.3x，并在高命中续写流量上与 SGLang 持平。

Conclusion: SuffixReplay 通过 suffix replay 近似循环状态，消除了混合 LLM prefix caching 对检查点对齐的依赖，在质量、存储、时延与吞吐上均优于现有检查点方案，是首个支持任意缓存页边界前缀复用的混合 LLM prefix caching 系统。

Abstract: Hybrid LLMs interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce long-context inference cost, but this structure complicates prefix caching. Full-attention KV caches are token-addressable, whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. Existing systems materialize recurrent-state checkpoints, restricting prefix reuse to checkpoint-aligned positions.
