  We present SuffixReplay, the first prefix caching system that lets hybrid LLMs reuse cached prefixes at every cache-supported page boundary without materializing recurrent-state checkpoints. Our key insight is to just let linear states forget the distant past. Modern linear-attention mechanisms use recurrent decay and gating to attenuate the influence of old inputs. Therefore, instead of checkpointing every prefix boundary, SuffixReplay approximates the state at a matched boundary by replaying only a recent suffix of the layer's input hidden states, which we retain as anchors. At the algorithmic level, SuffixReplay combines layer-wise and token-wise anchor sparsity with a bounded replay budget to control storage, computation, and quality. At the system level, it uses an independently managed anchor sidecar and a pipelined replay path to overlap anchor movement and state reconstruction with the native serving pipeline. We evaluate SuffixReplay on three hybrid LLMs: OLMo-Hybrid-7B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.6-27B-FP8. Across these models, SuffixReplay retains 91.4-100% of full-prefill quality on average across LongBench and RULER, while using only 0.36-0.51x the amortized per-token storage of SGLang's default 8192-token checkpoint cache. Integrated into SGLang, SuffixReplay reduces median TTFT by 15-70% on branching workloads, sustains 2.3-4.3x SGLang's throughput when the working set exceeds HBM, and matches SGLang on high-hit continuation traffic.

</details>


### [1608] [Federated Multi-Modal Human Activity Recognition using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33492)
*Debasmita Dey,Tanmay Sen,Himel Mallick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于多智能体强化学习的自适应、成本感知多模态人体活动识别框架，并扩展为联邦版本FedMHAR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法对传感器流分配固定等权，忽略了模态重要性、采集成本和传感器质量差异（受运动、错位或临时遮挡影响）。

Method: 集中式设定将多模态融合建模为协作式MARL问题，每个传感模态对应一个PPO智能体，学习逐样本融合权重；联邦设定提出BiFL-PPO双向联邦优化策略，服务器端PPO策略学习客户端特定信任权重并反馈以调整本地学习率和近端正则化，采用密集批次级奖励替代轮级优化。

Result: MEx Rehabilitation与UTD Multimodal Human Action数据集上，集中式框架准确率分别达87.30%和94.98%，优于传统融合方法及SOTA HAR模型；FedMHAR联邦设定下达79.74%和77.49%，持续超越FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN、FedNova和AdaFedProx，且性能更稳定并降低传感器采集成本。

Conclusion: 该框架通过自适应成本感知的多模态融合与双向联邦优化，在提升HAR精度的同时降低采集成本并增强异构数据下的训练稳定性。

Abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from heterogeneous wearable sensors is fundamental to the Internet of Health Things (IoHT), supporting rehabilitation, elderly care, and smart healthcare. Existing multimodal fusion methods often assign fixed equal weights to sensor streams, overlooking differences in modality importance, acquisition cost, and sensor quality, which can vary due to movement, incorrect placement, or temporary blockage. We propose an adaptive and cost-aware multimodal HAR framework based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for centralized HAR and extend it to federated learning as FedMHAR. In the centralized setting, multimodal fusion is formulated as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem, where each sensing modality is assigned a PPO-based agent that learns per-sample fusion weights, enabling the model to emphasize informative modalities while down-weighting costly sensors when cheaper alternatives provide sufficient information. In the federated setting, we introduce BiFL-PPO, a bidirectional federated optimization strategy in which a server-side PPO policy learns client-specific trust weights and feeds them back to adapt local learning rates and proximal regularization. Unlike round-level optimization, BiFL-PPO uses dense batch-level rewards for more frequent feedback and stable training under heterogeneous client data. Evaluation on the MEx Rehabilitation and UTD Multimodal Human Action datasets shows that the centralized framework achieves 87.30% and 94.98% accuracy, respectively, outperforming conventional fusion methods and state-of-the-art HAR models. FedMHAR achieves 79.74% and 77.49% in the federated setting, consistently surpassing FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, FedNova, and AdaFedProx, while providing more stable performance and reducing sensor acquisition cost.

</details>


### [1609] [RelaxKV: Recomputation Guided by the Query with Sparse Context Attention for Efficient KV Cache Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33503)
*Ruoling Qi,Yirui Liu,Xuaner Wu,Yuxin Jin,Jian Chen,Jiayu Qin,Yin Chen,Jiawei Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RelaxKV，将选择性 KV 缓存修复建模为"修复目标 + 重算上下文"的联合分配问题，在查询引导下进行层特定目标选择并限制重算上下文，从而在降低注意力计算的同时恢复跨块交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨请求 KV 缓存可降低 RAG 的 prefill 开销，但传统前缀缓存严重限制请求间的缓存复用。位置无关缓存（PIC）通过复用独立 chunk 解除该限制，却丢失了跨 chunk 交互；现有方法虽通过选择性重算 token 状态来恢复交互，但重算预算主要用于"选择重算哪些状态"，而将重算上下文固定为完整因果前缀，导致冗余计算。

Method: 将选择性缓存修复形式化为对"修复目标"与"重算上下文"的联合分配问题。以用户查询为指导，识别各层特定的修复目标，并将其重算限制在与查询相关的上下文内，从而减少注意力计算量。

Result: 在四个解码器模型上，15% anchor 比例下 RelaxKV 的 LongBench 聚合性能全面优于 ProphetKV。在 Qwen3-14B 上，5%–30% anchor 比例的扫描中，RelaxKV 提供了优于 ProphetKV 的质量-TTFT 权衡，并在 16K 与 32K 上下文长度下于 RULER-MV 和 LV-Eval 上取得最佳选择性结果。消融实验进一步验证了重算上下文选择的重要性。

Conclusion: 重算上下文的选取与修复目标的选取同等重要；将二者联合优化可在保持甚至提升生成质量的同时显著降低重算与注意力开销。

Abstract: Cross-request KV caching reduces the prefill cost of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), but conventional prefix caching severely limits cache reuse across requests. Position-Independent Caching (PIC) removes this constraint by reusing independent chunks, but their KV states miss cross-chunk interactions. Existing methods selectively recompute token states to recover these missing interactions, but primarily allocate the recomputation budget to selecting which states to recompute, while fixing the recomputation context to the full causal prefix. We introduce RelaxKV, which formulates selective cache repair as a joint allocation problem over repair targets and recomputation context. Guided by the user query, RelaxKV identifies layer-specific repair targets and restricts their recomputation to a query-relevant context, reducing attention computation. Across four decoder models, RelaxKV at a 15% anchor ratio improves aggregate LongBench performance over ProphetKV on all models. On Qwen3-14B, RelaxKV provides a stronger quality-TTFT trade-off than ProphetKV across a 5%-30% anchor-ratio sweep, and achieves the best selective results on RULER-MV and LV-Eval at 16K and 32K context lengths. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the importance of recomputation context selection.

</details>


### [1610] [When Evidence Changes the Subject: Subject-Typed Claim Licensing for Learned Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33505)
*Jian Chen,Zixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"主体类型化声称许可"（subject-typed claim licensing），在证据到声称的方法中引入"科学主体"这一新维度，以解决组合式学习系统中归因错位的问题，并在SCOPE-Routing实例中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代学习系统日益将学习组件与搜索、修复或外部求解器相结合。基准测试通常评估端到端系统，而科学结论可能只针对其中某一个组件，由此产生"归因问题"：证据可能无法支持所请求的组件级结论，却仍能支持关于更大系统的正面结论。既有证据到声称的方法主要只校准声称强度（claim strength），难以处理这类复合系统。

Method: 作者主张复合系统需要第二个维度——科学主体（scientific subject），并提出"主体类型化声称许可"，将关于所请求主体的较弱结论与关于另一主体的正面但非替代性（non-substitutive）信用区分开来。该方法被实例化为SCOPE-Routing，用于偏好条件下的多重图路由（preference-conditioned multigraph routing）。

Result: 非作者可复现地应用所声明的语义；留出评审（held-out review）相较无结构评审产生更少的相对参考的向上偏差，但与强证据清单的差异尚未解决；一项受控路由研究表明，分数最优方法与声称合格方法可以不同，同时有效的混合系统信用得以保留。

Conclusion: 结果表明，应将声称强度与科学主体视为基于证据的评估中两个相互独立的维度。

Abstract: Modern learned systems increasingly combine learned components with search, repair, or external solvers. Benchmarks often measure the resulting end-to-end system, while scientific claims may concern only one component, creating an attribution problem: evidence can fail to support the requested component-level claim while still supporting a positive conclusion about the larger system. Existing evidence-to-claim methods primarily calibrate claim strength. We argue that composite systems require a second dimension: scientific subject. We address this problem with subject-typed claim licensing, which separates weaker conclusions about the requested subject from positive but non-substitutive credit about another subject. We instantiate this idea in SCOPE-Routing for preference-conditioned multigraph routing. Non-authors reproducibly apply the declared semantics; held-out review yields fewer reference-relative upward deviations than unstructured review, while the difference from a strong evidence checklist remains unresolved; and a controlled routing study shows that score-optimal and claim-eligible methods can differ while valid hybrid-system credit is preserved. These results motivate treating claim strength and scientific subject as distinct dimensions of evidence-based evaluation.

</details>


### [1611] [What Happens During Autonomous Deep Research After the User Steps Away?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33509)
*Yimin Liu,Yijia Zhang,Yanmin Li,Tangwen Luo,Yuze Li,Ziling Yao,Zhi Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 DRaligned 反事实行为评估框架（基于 PDR-Bench），通过固定其他上下文、仅变化一个任务相关用户因素，比较自主深度研究智能体的信息获取请求、工作草稿与最终报告，揭示用户信息如何影响过程与推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在自主深度研究中，用户仅提供一次任务与背景后便不再介入，因此需要理解初始用户信息如何贯穿中间行为并最终体现在推荐中，以及"过程"与"结果"之间的关系。

Method: 构建 DRaligned 反事实行为评估框架，基于 PDR-Bench；采用单因素变化（控制其余上下文固定）的设计，比较获取请求、工作草稿和最终报告；使用基于来源的抽取、盲评本地判断与确定性聚合，得到粗粒度方向性度量，对歧义案例不作定论。

Result: 强用户特异性交付可以来自高度共享的研究过程：智能体探究大体相似的问题但请求分配不同，最终推荐比显式请求更清晰地区分用户条件；报告能整合获取阶段未同时可见的用户因素；在可读的草稿—报告比较中，推荐在大量重写后仍多保留粗粒度用户特定方向；方向性差异在测试的智能体模型、执行框架与评估模型间复现，尽管执行路径各异。

Conclusion: 研究刻画了初始用户信息如何塑造自主研究，并阐明了智能体所遵循的过程与其交付推荐之间的关系。

Abstract: In autonomous deep research, a user provides a task and relevant background, then leaves the agent to conduct an extended investigation without further human intervention. We study how this initial user information is reflected in intermediate actions and how these actions relate to final recommendations. We introduce DRaligned, a counterfactual behavioral evaluation framework built on PDR-Bench. By varying one task-relevant user factor while keeping the remaining context fixed, we compare acquisition requests, working drafts, and final reports. Source-grounded extraction, blinded local judgments, and deterministic aggregation yield coarse directional measurements while leaving ambiguous cases unresolved. Our experiments show that strong user-specific delivery can emerge from a largely shared research process: agents investigate similar broad questions but allocate requests differently, and final recommendations distinguish user conditions more clearly than explicit requests do. Reports can also integrate user factors that were not jointly visible during acquisition. In readable draft-to-report comparisons, recommendations often retain their coarse user-specific direction despite substantial rewriting. Final directional differences recur across tested agent models, execution harnesses, and evaluator models, even as execution paths vary. These findings describe how initial user information shapes autonomous research and clarify the relationship between the process an agent follows and the recommendations it delivers.

</details>


### [1612] [PPG-LM: A Photoplethysmography-Language Model with Multi-Level Clinical Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33516)
*Xiaoda Wang,Minxiao Wang,Maxwell A Xu,Patrick Langer,Kaiqiao Han,Defu Cao,Xiao Luo,Yuzhe Yang,Yan Liu,Xiao Hu,Yizhou Sun,Wei Wang,Carl Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PPG-LM，首个从信号监督与EHR临床上下文学习的PPG-语言模型家族，通过自动字幕生成与两阶段对齐框架实现多尺度跨模态表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPG被广泛记录，具备大规模生理评估潜力，但现有PPG基础模型依赖任务专用预测头，而大语言模型的医学知识未必能迁移到波形理解，且缺乏对EHR临床上下文的对齐利用。

Method: 构建自动字幕生成流程，从信号测量与结构化EHR记录中生成片段级、事件级和就诊级描述；采用两阶段框架：先通过对比学习与波形条件字幕建立片段-语言对应，再通过时间感知聚合与时间陈述匹配将对齐扩展到事件与就诊层面；在约73k小时PPG上预训练。

Result: 在MC-MED、MIMIC-III、VitalDB上，检索与字幕事实性优于语言模型基线，并在多项临床预测任务上超越PPG与时间序列基础模型。

Conclusion: PPG-LM支持基于语言的识别、跨模态检索与片段字幕生成，验证了以临床上下文对齐多尺度PPG表征的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely recorded by clinical monitors and consumer wearables, providing a scalable source of continuous physiological information. These recordings offer an opportunity for physiological assessment at scale, but realizing this potential requires models to learn from both signal-derived physiological supervision and broader clinical context captured in electronic health records (EHRs). This involves aligning information spanning local observations, care events, and entire visits with PPG representations at corresponding temporal scales. However, existing PPG foundation models primarily rely on task-specific prediction heads, while the medical knowledge of large language models does not necessarily translate into waveform understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce PPG-LM, the first PPG-language model family to learn physiological representations from both signal-derived supervision and broader clinical context captured in EHRs. To construct clinically grounded captions, we develop an automatic captioning pipeline that generates segment-, event-, and visit-level descriptions from signal measurements and structured EHR records. We then learn from these pairs through a two-stage framework that first establishes segment-language correspondence through contrastive learning and waveform-conditioned captioning, then extends alignment to events and visits through time-aware aggregation and temporal statement matching. Pretrained on approximately 73k hours of PPG, PPG-LM supports language-based recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and segment captioning. Experiments on MC-MED, MIMIC-III, and VitalDB show improved retrieval and caption factuality over language-model baselines and gains over PPG and time-series foundation models on multiple clinical prediction tasks.

</details>


### [1613] [EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33524)
*Siyuan Li,Jiangfeng Zhang,Rui Yao,Weihua Qiu,Mingyang Xu,Zixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EverMine 框架，将长程 alpha 挖掘的研究状态分解为历史（Hist）、当前因子组合（Frontier）与可复用能力（Cap），用受控实验评估自演化研究能力的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化智能体旨在把研究反馈转化为可复用的技能、工具与规则，但这些累积能力能否持续提升后续研究，需要受控评估。长程 alpha 挖掘具有状态依赖性：新因子进入组合后，已覆盖的预测信息发生变化，同一候选因子或经验的价值会随时间改变。

Method: 在匹配资源限制下，比较固定 Cap 与演化 Cap 的完整运行；在固定 Hist 与 Frontier 的前提下替换 Cap，估计累积能力的条件价值；并结合完整轨迹与历史状态回放，考察基于经验的决策如何影响候选选择与组合结果。

Result: 18 条长程轨迹的端到端比较未显示 Cap 演化带来一致增益；48 个共享 Hist 与 Frontier 的延续分支中，累积 Cap 也未稳定优于初始 Cap。对已有因子结构做参数调优仍能改善组合。对某条 Evolving 轨迹两个筛选批次进行探索性回放时，部分被筛掉的候选在原状态下具有正边际价值，但将全部被筛候选顺序提交后，两个批次的最终组合 IC 均略有下降。

Conclusion: 候选因子的价值取决于不断演化的组合与提交顺序，因此应从端到端结果、条件能力价值以及基于经验决策的后果三个角度评估自演化研究能力。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents aim to turn research feedback into reusable skills, tools, and research rules. Whether these accumulated capabilities continue to improve later research requires controlled evaluation. Long-horizon alpha discovery provides a state-dependent setting: once a new factor enters the portfolio, the predictive information already covered changes, so the value of the same candidate or experience may change over time. We introduce EverMine, an empirical framework for studying self-evolving research capabilities in long-horizon alpha discovery. EverMine decomposes the research state into history (Hist), the current factor portfolio (Frontier), and reusable capabilities (Cap). Under matched resource limits, we compare complete runs with fixed or evolving Cap, and replace Cap while holding Hist and Frontier fixed to estimate the conditional value of accumulated capabilities. We also combine full trajectories with historical-state replay to examine how experience-based decisions affect candidate selection and portfolio outcomes. Across 18 long-horizon trajectories, end-to-end comparisons show no consistent gain from Cap evolution. Across 48 continuation branches from shared Hist and Frontier states, accumulated Cap also does not consistently outperform the initial Cap. Parameter tuning of existing factor structures can still improve the portfolio. In an exploratory replay of two screening batches from one Evolving trajectory, some screened-out candidates have positive marginal value at the original state, yet submitting all screened-out candidates sequentially slightly lowers final portfolio IC in both batches. These results show that candidate value depends on the evolving portfolio and submission order, and motivate evaluating self-evolving research capabilities through end-to-end outcomes, conditional capability value, and the consequences of experience-based decisions.

</details>


### [1614] [Reasoning on the Simplex: Geometric Fixed-Point Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33540)
*Talgat Daulbaev,Ilya Glazkov,Maxim Rakhuba,Ivan Oseledets*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出几何不动点推理（GFPR），将迭代状态设为预测本身的类别信念场（单纯形积上的分布），使残差小即意味着接近不动点，并在多个推理任务与语言模型上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环推理器通过迭代权重共享映射消耗测试时算力，但在无约束隐空间中，小的残差不代表状态是不动点。作者希望让迭代状态具有明确的几何与语义结构，使"收敛"这一概念真正对应于答案的稳定，从而获得可解释且可靠的不动点推理。

Method: GFPR 把迭代状态定义为预测本身——即单纯形积上的类别信念场，每一步的 argmax 即为答案。由于状态是信念，可通过紧凸松弛引入任务结构：或作为结构化读出，或直接作用于循环状态。当结构直接嵌入循环状态时，更新仍是连续自映射，因此对任意参数都保证不动点存在。语言模型版本中每个位置的状态是词表上的分布，用 Picard 迭代进行推断。

Result: 在约 7M 参数规模下，GFPR 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 95.1% 精确匹配，Maze-Hard 上 92.0%，S_5 长度 128 上 100% 序列准确率，均超过同规模已发表的 FPRM 结果。同一更新机制还用于训练 201M 的 FineWeb-Edu 语言模型，经 24 步 Picard 迭代后在四个零样本多项选择任务上超过 GPT-2 small，在 ARC-Easy 上超过 GPT-2 medium。

Conclusion: 将迭代状态约束为具几何结构的信念场，可使循环推理的不动点语义变得严谨，并在小参数量的推理任务与大规模语言模型上均带来性能提升，表明几何固定的不动点推理是一种通用且有效的测试时算力分配范式。

Abstract: Looped reasoners spend test-time compute by iterating a weight-tied map, but a small residual does not mean the state is a fixed point when that map lives in unconstrained latent space. We propose Geometric Fixed-Point Reasoning (GFPR), in which the iterated state is the prediction itself: a field of categorical beliefs on a product of simplices, whose argmax is the answer at every step. Because the state is a belief, task structure can be imposed through compact convex relaxations, either as structured readouts or directly in the recurrent state; in the latter case the update remains a continuous self-map, so a fixed point exists for any parameters. At about 7M parameters, GFPR reaches 95.1% exact match on Sudoku-Extreme, 92.0% on Maze-Hard, and 100% sequence accuracy on S_5 length 128, above the published FPRM numbers at the same scale. The same update also trains a 201M language model on FineWeb-Edu in which each site is a distribution over the vocabulary; with 24 Picard steps it is above GPT-2 small on four zero-shot multiple-choice tasks and above GPT-2 medium on ARC-Easy.

</details>


### [1615] [OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33543)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Rui Chen,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出观察安全反事实耦合（OSCC）框架及选择器OSCC-Select，在保证安全约束下通过梯度感知准则降低策略梯度噪声，并在Leduc实验中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耦合式rollout可降低反事实动作比较的噪声，但标准公共随机数构造存在两大问题：其一，无效耦合可能泄露隐藏状态、同步内生策略随机性或使分歧后机会事件错位；其二，多动作策略优化中，更低的回报对比方差并非相关目标，优化器实际依赖经局部策略梯度几何投影后的回报协方差矩阵。

Method: 提出观察安全反事实耦合（OSCC）框架，通过边际保持、信息状态安全、分支局部策略随机性、语义事件对齐及先迹后预言重放定义可接受耦合类。推导梯度感知耦合准则：对边际保持耦合，策略梯度噪声变化由策略雅可比加权的非对角回报协方差决定。基于此提出OSCC-Select，一种仅需校准的选择器，利用独立的安全与增益证书在独立、仅根、仅延续和全耦合rollout间选择；其增益目标结合投影梯度噪声与实测物理采样成本，当同时下置信界未认证改进时退回独立采样。

Result: 在100,000次固定根Leduc比较中，全耦合CP-GRPO实例将回报对比方差从41.1158降至18.1441（降低55.87%），同时保持声明的分支边际。在三动作情形下，OSCC-Select选择延续耦合，获得梯度噪声迹0.0783，优于回报方差选择的0.0917。校准从64增至2,048组时，认证率由0.327提升至0.995。

Conclusion: OSCC框架为不完全信息环境中的耦合rollout提供了通用学习原语，其梯度感知选择器可在保证安全性的前提下有效降低策略梯度噪声，并随校准量增加显著提高认证率。

Abstract: Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. We introduce observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC), a framework that defines an admissible class through marginal preservation, information-state safety, branch-local policy randomness, semantic event alignment, and trace-before-oracle replay. We derive a gradient-aware coupling criterion showing that, for marginal-preserving couplings, policy-gradient noise changes are determined by policy-Jacobian-weighted off-diagonal return covariance. This motivates OSCC-Select, a calibration-only selector that chooses among independent, root-only, continuation-only, and fully coupled rollouts using separate safety and gain certificates. Its gain target combines projected gradient noise with measured physical sampling cost and falls back to independent sampling whenever a simultaneous lower confidence bound does not certify improvement. On 100,000 fixed-root Leduc comparisons, the fully coupled CP-GRPO instantiation reduces return-contrast variance from 41.1158 to 18.1441, a 55.87% reduction, while preserving the declared branch marginals. With three actions, OSCC-Select chooses continuation coupling and attains gradient-noise trace 0.0783 versus 0.0917 for return-variance selection. Increasing calibration from 64 to 2,048 groups raises certification from 0.327 to 0.995.

</details>


### [1616] [Dr. Free: You Don't Need Difficulty Rewards for Self-Evolving Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33565)
*Zhipeng Qian,Zihan Liang,Yufei Ma,Jie Ma,Ben Chen,Huangyu Dai,Lingtao Mao,Xinyu Sun,Tong zhao,Xuxin Zhang,Qingpeng Cai,Peng Jiang,Qibin Hou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Dr. Free，首个消除基于难度的提议者奖励、直接优化"证据必要性"的自进化搜索框架，并在七个开放域QA基准上超越先前无数据搜索智能体与监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无数据自进化搜索智能体训练方法依赖基于难度的提议者奖励，将求解器难度作为问题质量的代理指标。然而，难度无法区分需要跨段落证据的问题与可通过捷径回答的问题；同时难度测量需对每个候选问题反复执行求解器 rollout，计算成本高昂。

Method: Dr. Free 从知识图谱中采样关系链，并与对齐的段落配对，为问题生成提供显式的多跳结构。生成的问题仅在"完整证据段落下目标答案的似然度超过所有被评估捷径上下文下的最大似然度"时，才获得正向信息增益奖励。该信号由 teacher-forced 似然度计算，无需通过率估计。

Result: 在七个开放域 QA 基准上，Dr. Free 优于先前的无数据搜索智能体与监督基线，在多跳 QA 基准上提升尤为显著；同时将提议者训练时间减少 7 倍以上。

Conclusion: 用"证据必要性"替代"难度"作为提议者奖励可更准确地筛选高质量问题，且基于 teacher-forced 似然度的奖励计算更高效，为无数据自进化搜索智能体训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: A central limitation of current data-free self-evolution methods for training search agents is their reliance on difficulty-based proposer rewards. These methods reward a proposer for generating questions that challenge a co-evolving solver, using solver difficulty as a proxy for question quality. Yet difficulty alone is insufficient to distinguish questions that require cross-passage evidence from those that are answerable via simpler shortcuts. In addition, measuring difficulty demands repeated solver rollouts for every candidate question, leading to substantial computational costs. In this paper, we introduce \methodname, the first self-evolving search framework that eliminates difficulty-based proposer rewards and directly optimizes for evidence necessity relative to shortcut contexts. Dr. Free samples relational chains from a knowledge graph and pairs them with aligned passages, giving question generation an explicit multi-hop structure. A generated question receives a positive information-gain reward only when the likelihood of the target answer under the complete evidence passages exceeds the maximum likelihood under all evaluated shortcut contexts. Because this signal is computed from teacher-forced likelihoods, it removes the need for pass-rate estimation and reduces proposer training time by over $7\times$. Experiments on seven open-domain QA benchmarks show that Dr. Free outperforms prior data-free search agents and the supervised baseline, with large improvements on multi-hop QA benchmarks.

</details>


### [1617] [OpenFC: Learning Verification Policies towards Open-Search Fact Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33579)
*Xinming Wang,Kaixiang Qiu,Yansong Lin,Chunji Lv,Yi Chen,Boran Wang,Hong-Ming Yang,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出OpenFC，将开放搜索事实核查建模为序列决策问题，通过两阶段训练把Qwen3-8B后训练为统一的下一步动作控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放搜索事实核查系统把检索、证据获取、停止等决策分散在预设流水线或独立提示的模块中，未作为统一的任务特定策略来学习，而在该问题中每次查询、来源访问与停止决策都会重塑可用证据。

Method: OpenFC为统一验证策略训练框架，将Qwen3-8B后训练为覆盖推理、证据获取与停止的紧凑下一步动作控制器，分两阶段：阶段一为Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start（SCCS），由强训练期监督者对初始推理后的推理、工具使用与停止提议在执行前进行审查，从而在无金标准结论条件下生成可靠轨迹用于监督微调；阶段二为Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning（VA-RL），通过预算感知工具奖励、标签感知优势重加权与局部响应掩码，在未解决声明上改进冷启动策略。

Result: 在六个事实核查基准上，OpenFC取得70.39%平均准确率和63.30%宏F1，为所评估方法中最高整体平均；分阶段消融显示SCCS与VA-RL带来互补增益，支持两阶段训练框架设计。

Conclusion: OpenFC是面向开放搜索事实核查的强有效框架，作者将开源代码并发布模型检查点以支持可复现性。

Abstract: Open-search fact checking is not merely retrieval followed by classification, but a sequential decision problem in which every query, source visit, and stopping decision reshapes the evidence available for verification. Yet existing systems often distribute these decisions across predefined pipelines or separately prompted modules rather than learning them as a unified task-specific policy. We introduce \textbf{OpenFC}, a unified verification-policy training framework that post-trains Qwen3-8B as a compact next-action controller over reasoning, evidence acquisition, and stopping. OpenFC learns this policy in two stages. \textbf{Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start (SCCS)} uses a strong training-time supervisor to review post-initial reasoning, tool-use, and stopping proposals before execution, producing reliable trajectories for supervised fine-tuning without access to gold verdicts. \textbf{Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning (VA-RL)} then improves the cold-start policy on unresolved claims through budget-aware tool rewards, label-aware advantage reweighting, and localized response masking. Across six fact-checking benchmarks, OpenFC achieves 70.39\% average accuracy and 63.30\% macro-F1, the highest overall averages among the evaluated methods. Stage-wise ablations further show that SCCS and VA-RL provide complementary gains, supporting the design of the two-stage training framework. These results position OpenFC as a strong and effective framework for open-search fact-checking. We will open-source our code and release the model checkpoints to support reproducibility.

</details>


### [1618] [JustQuant: You Don't Need Smoothing, SVD, or Rotation for 4-Bit Activation Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33601)
*Kaicheng Yang,Kaisen Yang,Chunyu Liu,Xianglong Yan,Haotong Qin,Junyi Wu,Tianao Zhang,Xun Zhang,Shaoqiu Zhang,Youbang Sun,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 JustQuant 框架及 Theseus QAD 量化感知蒸馏方法，将低比特量化的复杂性从部署阶段转移到训练阶段，从而在仅使用普通低比特算子的情况下提升量化质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型推理成本持续增长，模型量化是压缩与加速推理的有效途径。但在4比特下，激活量化远比权重量化困难。现有 PTQ/QAT 方法虽在4比特激活量化上取得进展，却依赖平滑、SVD分支、旋转、混合精度或 NVFP4 等高级格式，这些额外算子与数据类型对推理引擎和硬件提出苛刻要求，限制了低精度模型的广泛采用。因此作者追问：能否仅用普通低比特算子实现量化。

Method: 提出 JustQuant 框架，把低比特量化的复杂性从部署时算子移入训练过程。首先从知识蒸馏视角重新审视模型量化，指出既有 PTQ 与 QAT 方法失败的关键原因在于仅在单一层级利用监督信号。据此提出 Theseus QAD（量化感知蒸馏），借鉴"忒修斯之船"的逐步替换过程，渐进地施加多层级监督。

Result: 在 DiT 与扩散大语言模型上的实验显示两种不同范式：对较小模型，Theseus QAD 可作为轻量预热阶段，显著改善后续使用普通算子的 QAT，而朴素 QAD 在相同设置下可能崩塌；对较大模型，Theseus QAD 提供了比普通 QAD 更强的蒸馏训练路径。

Conclusion: 在两种范式下，JustQuant 均提升了低比特量化质量，同时规避了许多现有 PTQ 方法所需的复杂算子，为低精度模型的广泛部署提供了更简洁可行的方案。

Abstract: Recent generative models have become increasingly powerful, but their inference cost continues to grow. Model quantization offers a promising way to compress these models and accelerate inference. However, at 4 bits, activation quantization is substantially more challenging than weight quantization. Recent post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) methods have made progress in 4-bit activation quantization by introducing smoothing, SVD branches, rotations, mixed precision, or advanced formats such as NVFP4. These additional operators and data types impose demanding requirements on inference engines and hardware, limiting the broad adoption of low-precision models. Can quantization be achieved using only plain low-bit operators? To answer this question, we propose JustQuant, a simple yet effective framework that moves the complexity of low-bit quantization from deployment-time operators into the training process. We first revisit model quantization from the perspective of knowledge distillation and show that a key reason existing PTQ and QAT methods fail is that they typically exploit supervision at only a single level. We then introduce Theseus QAD, a quantization-aware distillation method that progressively applies multi-level supervision, analogous to the gradual replacement process in the Ship of Theseus. Extensive experiments on DiT and diffusion large language models show two distinct regimes. For smaller models, Theseus QAD can serve as a lightweight warm-up stage that substantially improves subsequent QAT with plain operators, while naive QAD may collapse in the same setting. For larger models, Theseus QAD provides a stronger distillation training path than ordinary QAD. Across both regimes, JustQuant improves low-bit quantization quality while avoiding the complex operators required by many existing PTQ methods.

</details>


### [1619] [Supervision Recovery for Time Series Anomaly Detection via Context-Anchored Pairing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33610)
*Yifei Gao,Tian Lan,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Wenjun He,Yijie Li,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CAPS（Context-Anchored Pair Supervision）监督恢复框架，通过在同一时间上下文下构造正常—异常配对来恢复缺失的异常监督信号，在九个数据集上的四项指标中取得最优综合性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测面临两大难题：异常标签稀缺，且时间异常高度依赖上下文。现有方法多依赖无监督目标或替代性异常模式，难以为上下文相关的正常—异常区分提供有效监督。本文的动机是将理想异常监督视为同一时间上下文下正常与异常结果的配对比较，并在无目标域异常标签的条件下恢复这种监督。

Method: CAPS利用模拟的正常—异常配对，通过重建、背景一致性以及配对内反事实重组来学习结构与异常语义表示；所得异常表示构成具有粗模态的连续语义空间，并诱导出可采样的多模态先验；CAPS以残差形式将采样语义条件化地实现于目标参考轨迹上，从而生成上下文锚定的正常—异常对应样本，为判别式检测器学习提供时间监督。

Result: 在九个数据集上的实验表明，CAPS在四项评价指标上均取得所有对比方法中最强的综合性能；消融实验与迁移分析进一步验证了上下文锚定、语义解耦与条件实现三者的作用。

Conclusion: CAPS通过监督恢复范式，在没有目标域异常标签的情况下构造上下文锚定的正常—异常配对，为时间序列异常检测提供了有效的监督信号，并取得了领先的综合性能。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) remains challenging not only because anomaly labels are scarce, but also because temporal anomalies are highly context-dependent. Existing methods often rely on unsupervised objectives or surrogate abnormal patterns, providing limited supervision for context-dependent normal--anomalous distinctions. We propose Context-Anchored Pair Supervision (CAPS), a supervision-recovery framework for TSAD. CAPS views ideal anomaly supervision as a matched comparison between normal and anomalous outcomes under the same temporal context, and seeks to recover such supervision without target-domain anomaly labels. Using simulated normal--anomalous pairs, CAPS learns structure and anomaly-semantic representations through reconstruction, background consistency, and within-pair counterfactual recombination. The resulting anomaly representations form a continuous semantic space with coarse modes and induce a sampleable multimodal prior. CAPS conditionally realizes sampled semantics as residual-form effects on target reference trajectories. The resulting context-anchored normal--anomalous counterparts provide temporal supervision for discriminative detector learning. Experiments on nine datasets show that CAPS achieves the strongest aggregate performance across all four evaluation metrics among the compared methods, while complementary ablations and transfer analyses support the roles of context anchoring, semantic disentanglement, and conditional realization.

</details>


### [1620] [EAT: Expert Account Tracker for Efficient MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33614)
*Yuexian Li,Yifei Yang,Zouying Cao,Hai Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出专家账户跟踪器(EAT),结合历史感知指标与自适应阈值动态选择重要专家,在维持性能的同时减少激活专家数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MoE架构中大量专家被不必要地激活,导致推理低效;现有减少激活专家的方法普遍忽略了各专家的历史表现信息。

Method: EAT利用历史感知指标(history-awareness metrics)刻画专家的历史贡献/表现,并采用自适应阈值动态筛选最重要的专家,从而在减少激活专家数的同时保持模型性能;剪枝后模型可通过OPD仅用9K数据高效恢复。

Result: 在多个模型和数据集上,EAT优于现有基线Top-P方法:相比原始方法平均减少超过25%的激活专家数量,且token生成速度快于基线;剪枝后性能可通过OPD仅用9K数据高效恢复。消融实验表明,过度减少激活专家会显著损害性能,专家重要性随层变化,高层专家通常更关键。

Conclusion: EAT通过历史感知与自适应阈值实现更高效的专家动态选择,兼顾效率与性能;专家重要性具有层次差异性,减少激活专家数需权衡性能损失。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as a revolutionary method to scale Transformer models. However, traditional MoE architecture still suffers from inefficiency since a large number of experts are unnecessarily activated. Existing approaches for reducing the number of activated experts often overlook the historical performance of each expert. In this paper, we propose EAT, a novel method called Expert Account Tracker (EAT), which utilizes history-awareness metrics and adaptive thresholding to dynamically select the most important experts, thereby reducing the activated expert number while effectively maintaining the model performance. Experiments show that EAT outperforms the existing baseline Top-P method across multiple models and datasets, achieving over 25% an average reduction compared to the vanilla method in the number of activated experts and performing better token generation speed compared to the baseline. Furthermore, the performance of pruned models can be efficiently recovered via OPD using only 9K data. Additionally, through ablation studies, we find that excessively reducing the number of activated experts can significantly harm model performance, and the importance of experts varies across layers, with higher-level experts being generally more critical.

</details>


### [1621] [Trajectory Unlearning on LLM-based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33639)
*Yingdan Shi,Ren Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"轨迹级遗忘"（trajectory-level unlearning）这一新问题，要求LLM智能体在长程任务中移除特定动作轨迹而非事实知识，并提出GiRPO方法及其基准与评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有LLM遗忘研究主要针对特定知识（有害事实、隐私数据、版权内容）的移除，但LLM越来越多作为自主智能体部署，出现被忽视的关键问题：智能体不仅应抑制"知道什么"，更不应通过动作轨迹重现不当行为。现有知识遗忘方法无法处理动作层面的遗忘需求。

Method: 指出轨迹遗忘与知识遗忘的两大根本挑战：(1)遗忘目标是智能体"做什么"而非"说什么"；(2)轨迹是顺序依赖的动作序列，无法在不丢失跨步结构的情况下分解为孤立的prompt-response对。为此提出Group-injected Relative Policy Optimization（GiRPO）：将遗忘轨迹注入策略rollout组并施加惩罚性奖励，同时隔离归一化统计量，从而产生稳定有界的遗忘信号，不破坏正常任务轨迹的梯度更新。并构建了家居任务（ALFWorld）和在线购物（WebShop）两个场景的轨迹遗忘基准，设计三项互补指标评估遗忘质量与模型效用。

Result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop上的实验表明，GiRPO能有效遗忘目标任务轨迹，同时保持任务成功率，在遗忘质量和任务效用两方面均优于现有知识遗忘基线。

Conclusion: 轨迹级遗忘是智能体部署中一个基础且此前被忽视的新问题；GiRPO通过组内注入与归一化隔离实现了稳定有界的遗忘信号，验证了在长程智能体任务中兼顾遗忘与效用的可行性。

Abstract: Existing large language model (LLM) unlearning has focused primarily on removing specific knowledge, such as harmful facts, private data, or copyrighted content. However, as LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, a fundamental yet overlooked problem emerges: beyond suppressing what an agent knows, an agent should not reproduce undesired behaviors through its action trajectories. In this work, we introduce trajectory-level unlearning, a new problem formulation that targets the removal of specific action trajectories in long-horizon agentic tasks, rather than factual knowledge. We identify two fundamental challenges that distinguish trajectory unlearning from knowledge unlearning: (1) our unlearning target is what the agent \emph{does}, not what it \emph{says}; and (2) trajectories are sequentially dependent action sequences that cannot be decomposed into isolated prompt-response pairs without losing inter-step structure. To address these challenges, we propose Group-injected Relative Policy Optimization (GiRPO), which injects forget trajectories into the policy rollout group with penalized rewards and isolates the normalization statistics, yielding a stable and bounded unlearning signal that does not corrupt gradient updates for normal task trajectories. We construct trajectory unlearning benchmarks from two application scenarios, household tasks (ALFWorld) and online shopping (WebShop), and design three complementary metrics for evaluating forgetting quality and model utility. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that GiRPO effectively unlearns target trajectories while preserving task success rates, outperforming existing knowledge-unlearning baselines on both forgetting quality and task utility.

</details>


### [1622] [Scalable and Data-Driven Decision Support in the Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33641)
*Houkun Zhu,Helena Ebel,Dominik Scheinert,Florian Schmidt,Jens Altenkirch,Odej Kao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出智能专家系统（SES），通过机器学习为铸造燃气轮机部件的维修（MRO）全流程提供决策支持，并用行业真实数据验证其可行性与架构稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业将MRO原则应用于产品全生命周期管理。以铸造燃气轮机部件为例，频繁修复可延长寿命预期、比新造部件更具成本效益，并可在修复周期中改进零件设计；同时修复还关乎可持续性，因产品常含稀有材料，修复过程的排放通常低于重新采矿与铸造新部件。为进一步优化维修流程，需要为工程专家提供贯穿维修流程的决策支持。

Method: 提出智能专家系统（SES），以机器学习为基础，在维修全流程中为工程专家提供决策支持；阐述其IT架构，并针对代表性MRO用例给出所采用的机器学习模型。

Result: 使用一家领先燃气轮机公司的真实行业数据对SES进行评估，结果表明其明显满足在整体决策支持适用性及所依托IT架构稳定性方面设定的要求。

Conclusion: SES能够以机器学习驱动的决策支持有效辅助铸造燃气轮机部件的维修流程，兼顾成本效益与可持续性，并在真实工业数据上验证了决策支持适用性与IT架构稳定性。

Abstract: Several businesses apply maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) principles to the life-cycle of their existing products. In cases like casted gas turbine component Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), repairing components in frequent intervals can extend the lifetime expectation of the product, provide higher cost efficiency compared to newly produced components, and even improve the part design during the repair cycle. Another aspect of repair concerns sustainability, as products often contain rare materials. The emissions produced by the repair process are usually smaller than mining materials and casting new components.
  To optimize the repair process further, we propose the Smart Expert System (SES), which assists engineering experts with machine learning-based decision support throughout the repair process. We elaborate on its IT architecture and present machine learning models employed for representative MRO use cases. The SES is evaluated using actual industry data from a leading gas turbine company and demonstrably fulfills formulated requirements concerning the suitability of the overall decision support and the stability of the enclosing IT architecture.

</details>


### [1623] [AgentBoundary: Counterfactual Evaluation of Safety in Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33658)
*Tianzhuo Yang,Zirui Mi,Yantao Huang,Guoxi Zhang,Jiawei Chen,Yaodong Yang,Jingwei Yi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentBound——首个面向工具型智能体的四元反事实生成与评估框架，通过独立操纵"表象风险"与"行动许可性"来区分过度拒答与不安全合规，并训练轻量运行时校准模块改善该权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话场景的安全对齐多被简化为"回答还是拒绝"，但在智能体场景中，模型需在执行过程中依据许可相关证据决定"是否行动"。此时表象风险、行动许可性与任务能力三者容易混淆，导致智能体的过度拒答与普通任务失败难以区分，缺乏可控的诊断与评估手段。

Method: 提出 AgentBound 四元反事实生成与评估框架：对同一可执行工作流独立改变"表象风险"与"行动许可性"，从而受控对比"看似危险但已授权"与"看似常规但未授权"两类任务，在控制任务能力的前提下同时诊断过度拒答与不安全合规。实例化为经人工验证的 4,000 任务评测套件，采用基于轨迹与基于后置状态的判定。此外训练一个轻量运行时校准模块，用于在权限相关执行证据出现时校准行动决策。

Result: 在 17 种模型与 harness 配置上，高安全性常与授权任务完成度低并存：GPT-5.5 阻断 99.5% 看似常规但未授权的行动，却仅完成 28.7% 看似危险但已授权的任务。所训练的运行时校准模块在 10 个配置上平均将授权任务完成率提升 18.2%，同时将不安全行动阻断率平均提升 5.4%。

Conclusion: 有效的智能体对齐要求行动决策跟踪与许可相关的执行证据，而非仅依赖拒答强度；AgentBound 为受控诊断过度拒答与不安全合规提供了可复用的框架与评测基准。

Abstract: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) in conversational settings is largely framed around whether to answer or refuse a request. In agentic settings, however, the same models must decide whether to act as permission-critical evidence emerges during execution. This creates a distinct challenge: apparent risk, action permissibility, and task competence are easily confounded, making agentic over-refusal difficult to distinguish from ordinary task failure. To address this, we introduce AgentBound, the first four-way counterfactual generation-and-evaluation framework for tool-using agent safety. AgentBound transforms the same executable workflow by independently varying apparent risk and action permissibility, enabling controlled comparisons of risky-looking but authorized tasks and routine-looking but unauthorized tasks. These comparisons jointly diagnose over-refusal and unsafe compliance while controlling for task competence. We instantiate AgentBound as a human-validated 4,000-task evaluation suite with trajectory-based and post-state-based judgments. Across 17 model and harness configurations, high safety frequently coexists with poor authorized-task completion: GPT-5.5 blocks 99.5\% of routine-looking unauthorized actions yet completes only 28.7\% of risky-looking authorized tasks. We further train a lightweight runtime calibration module that improves authorized-task completion by 18.2\% on average across 10 evaluated configurations, while improving unsafe-action blocking by 5.4\% on average. These show that effective agentic alignment requires action decisions to track permission-relevant execution evidence, rather than refusal strength alone.

</details>


### [1624] [CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33665)
*Xiao-Wen Yang,Weiyi Xu,Wen Da,Hang Xu,Canwei Li,Hong-Jie You,Pusen Dong,Yucheng Zeng,Zhaokai Luo,Yu-Feng Li,Yao Hu,Mu Chuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CompoWorld 通过组合可复用服务扩展任务空间，结合 SFT 与Completion-Focused Rubric Reward 强化学习，显著提升通用智能体的跨服务任务能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动生成环境主要在单一环境内生成任务，而真实工作流要求智能体跨多个服务连接信息与动作，任务空间受限、信息流动不足。

Method: 提出 Compositional Environment Scaling (CompoWorld)：由编码智能体将工具规范转化为带类型状态与共享接口的已验证服务，对无法可靠实现的工具用世界模型处理；通过随机游走按依赖图连接服务，生成并验证需跨服务信息流动的任务；用已验证轨迹做 SFT，并以 Completion-Focused Rubric Reward（强调每个 rollout 组内低通过率标准）引导 RL 实现任务完整完成。

Result: 构建 448 个服务、暴露 10,130 个工具，用 3K SFT 轨迹与 1K RL 任务训练 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B；在八个基准上平均较主干提升 9.17 分，在 AutomationBench 上超越 Claude Opus 4.6 等前沿模型，并领先所有对比的 35B-A3B 智能体专用模型。

Conclusion: 组合式服务编排可有效扩展跨服务任务空间，配合针对性奖励设计，能显著提升通用智能体的跨服务信息流与任务完成能力。

Abstract: Automatically generated environments provide a scalable source of interaction data for training general agents. However, existing approaches mainly generate tasks within a single environment, while real-world workflows require agents to connect information and actions across multiple services. We introduce Compositional Environment Scaling (\textbf{CompoWorld}), which expands the task space by composing a finite library of reusable services. Coding agents turn tool specifications into verified services with typed states and shared interfaces, while a world model handles tools that cannot be reliably implemented. A random-walk procedure connects services through dependency graphs, enabling the generation and verification of tasks that require information to flow across services. Verified trajectories support supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while our Completion-Focused Rubric Reward guides reinforcement learning (RL) toward full task completion by emphasizing criteria with lower pass rates within each rollout group. We construct 448 services exposing 10,130 tools and use 3K SFT trajectories and 1K RL tasks to train Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Experimental results show that CompoWorld improves on its backbone by 9.17 points on average across eight benchmarks. On AutomationBench, it surpasses frontier models such as Claude Opus 4.6 and leads all compared agent-specialized 35B-A3B models.

</details>


### [1625] [RSD-Poker: Structure-Adaptive and Shift-Robust Risk-Utility Certification for Residual Policies in Imperfect-Information Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33669)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Peng Zhang,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RSD-Poker框架：冻结残差族与尺度，在独立结构划分上学习策略可见分组并在校准前冻结，为每个候选-组对给出加权同时上/下证书，并在部署组比例不确定集上选择鲁棒映射，实现混合鲁棒的风险预算与效用证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 残差策略适配虽能轻量修改强参考策略，但共享尺度与固定子群划分会掩盖异质退化，且在部署信息状态混合比例变化时变得脆弱。

Method: 冻结一组残差族与尺度；在独立结构划分上学习策略可见划分，并在加入校准标签前冻结该划分；对每个候选-组对计算锚相对风险的加权同时上证书与弱响应效用的下证书；在预先声明的部署组比例不确定集上选择鲁棒组到候选映射；在校准单元独立、候选库与划分在校准前固定、组内条件不变的条件下给出概率保证。信息契约支持教师支撑变换与无教师纯观测学生两种形式。

Result: 保留的确定性24状态审计可精确复现：经验零选择α=0.08，弱响应代理从4.2082升至4.2889，12个留出阈值0次越界。分层留出状态上，学习划分的对偶选择器将弱效用从全局对偶认证的4.4074提升至4.4936，留出违规率从0.0215降至0.0078；其混合鲁棒变体违规率达0.0059。五个纯观测检查点上，风险校准残差弱效用4.3659±0.0177，违规率0.0178±0.0057。

Conclusion: RSD-Poker通过结构自适应划分与偏移鲁棒认证，缓解固定划分与共享尺度带来的异质退化隐藏问题，并在部署混合比例变化下提供混合鲁棒的风险与效用保证，同时兼容教师支撑与纯观测两种信息契约。

Abstract: Residual policy adaptation provides a lightweight way to modify a strong reference policy, but a shared scale and a fixed subgroup partition can hide heterogeneous degradation and become fragile when the deployment mixture of information states changes. We introduce RSD-Poker, a structure-adaptive and shift-robust certification framework that freezes a bank of residual families and scales, learns a policy-visible partition on an independent structure split, and freezes that partition before calibration labels are joined. Each candidate-group pair receives a weighted simultaneous upper certificate for anchor-relative risk and a lower certificate for weak-response utility. A robust group-to-candidate map is then selected over a predeclared uncertainty set of deployment group proportions. Under independent calibration units drawn from each frozen group's law, a candidate bank and partition fixed before calibration, and invariant within-group conditionals, the selected map satisfies its declared mixture-robust risk budget and utility certificate with probability at least $1-ζ_{risk}-ζ_{util}$. The information contract supports both a teacher-backed transform and a teacher-free observation-only student. The retained deterministic 24-state audit remains an exact replay diagnostic: empirical-zero selects $α=0.08$, raising the weak-response proxy from 4.2082 to 4.2889 with $0/12$ held-out threshold crossings. On stratified held-out states, the learned-partition dual selector raises weak utility from 4.4074 under global dual certification to 4.4936 and lowers held-out violation from 0.0215 to 0.0078; its mixture-robust variant reaches violation 0.0059. Across five observation-only checkpoints, risk-calibrated residuals attain weak utility $4.3659\pm0.0177$ and violation rate $0.0178\pm0.0057$.

</details>


### [1626] [SWE-Game: Can Coding Agents Build the Games We Want?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33678)
*Xiaoyu Chen,Lai Wei,Jin Wang,Xiangyu Zou,Ruochen Fan,Enze Luo,Mingzhe Yao,Jiahui Zhu,Yuhua Wen,Linghe Kong,Weiran Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SWE-Game基准，包含247个基于41款可执行Godot游戏（覆盖13类2D/3D玩法）的任务，涵盖从简述开发、设计文档实现、骨架补全、故障修复到引擎移植五类任务，并采用运行时状态校验、参考输入回放与视觉评分相结合的方式进行评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏开发是综合性强的软件工程活动，涉及需求理解、机制实现与可玩性呈现，但现有基准难以完整刻画代理在真实游戏开发全流程中的能力，缺乏可执行参照、独立实现与多维度评估手段。

Method: 构建SWE-Game基准：247个任务、41款可执行Godot参考游戏、13类玩法、2D与3D；五类任务分别为简述到游戏、设计文档到实现、骨架补全、83个注入故障的修复、Godot到Unity的移植。参考材料规定预期玩法，通过共享插桩接口让评测方驱动的执行器与探针在独立实现的游戏上执行动作并观测。评测结合引擎状态检查、经认证的参考输入回放、代理自撰功能演示，评估机制正确性、可玩性和修复后的行为恢复与保持；另用游戏专属视觉语言评分标准评估表现效果。

Result: 在六个模型上，Opus5在全部五类任务中取得最高总分。三类构建任务的最佳总分均低于100分中的60分，Brief-to-Game为50.38。对提交内容的分析显示，需求遗漏和玩法逻辑错误是主要实现问题。在100款代理构建游戏的人工标注行为上，可执行检查达到92.59%的平衡准确率，而基于视频的VLM评判为78.41%。基于评分标准的视觉得分与200段游戏视频的人工评分达到0.829的Spearman相关。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了当前代理在各类游戏开发活动中的能力水平，并支持将运行时证据与视觉评估相结合，作为更可靠的游戏开发代理评测范式。

Abstract: We introduce SWE-Game, a benchmark of 247 tasks grounded in 41 executable reference Godot games spanning 13 gameplay categories in 2D and 3D. Five task types cover development from a brief, implementation from a game design document, skeleton completion, repair of 83 injected-fault cases, and Godot-to-Unity porting. Reference materials specify the intended gameplay, while a shared instrumentation interface lets evaluator-owned drivers and probes execute actions and observe independently implemented games. Evaluation combines engine-state checks, certified reference-input replay, and agent-authored feature demonstrations to assess mechanic correctness, demonstrated playability, and behavioral restoration and preservation after repairs. Game-specific vision-language rubrics separately assess presentation. Across six models, Opus5 achieves the highest overall score in all five task types. Best overall scores remain below 60 out of 100 across the three construction tasks, with Brief-to-Game reaching 50.38. Analysis of reviewed submissions identifies requirement omissions and gameplay logic errors as predominant implementation problems. On human-labeled behaviors from 100 agent-built games, executable checks achieve 92.59% balanced accuracy, compared with 78.41% for a video-based VLM judge. Rubric-based visual scores reach a Spearman correlation of 0.829 with human ratings of 200 gameplay clips. Together, these results characterize current agent capabilities across game-development activities and support combining runtime evidence with visual assessment.

</details>


### [1627] [TopoMamba: A Load-Support Relation-Guided Multi-Directional State-Space Model for Topology Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33688)
*Bin Lou,Yuxuan Cheng,Huaizhi Zong,Junhui Zhang,Bing Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TopoMamba框架，将载荷-支撑关系引导的多方向状态空间模型（Mamba）与SIMP方法耦合，用于拓扑优化中高性能材料分布预测，在二维基准上取得更优的预测精度、分布外泛化能力和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习拓扑优化方法难以准确捕捉载荷传递信息，导致分布外泛化能力受限；同时其模型架构往往带来较高的计算成本。

Method: 构建TopoMamba框架：将物理场与载荷-支撑关系（load-support relation）耦合以建模力学依赖；设计载荷-支撑关系引导的空间自适应融合机制，根据空间条件动态调整多方向扫描特征；将Mamba与固体各向同性材料惩罚法（SIMP）耦合，在保持计算效率的同时提升结构力学性能。

Result: 在两个二维拓扑优化基准上，TopoMamba在拓扑预测精度、分布外泛化和计算效率方面均优于当前最先进模型。

Conclusion: 所提出的载荷-支撑物理引导框架可实现对更复杂结构系统的高效优化。

Abstract: Deep learning has emerged as an efficient alternative for predicting high-performance material distributions in topology optimization. Existing methods struggle to accurately capture load-transfer information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization, while their model architectures often incur high computational costs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes TopoMamba, a topology prediction framework incorporating a load-support relation-guided multi-directional state-space model. Coupling physical fields with load-support relations enables more effective modeling of mechanical dependencies. A load-support relation-guided spatially adaptive fusion mechanism dynamically adjusts multi-directional scan features according to spatial conditions. Mamba is coupled with the solid isotropic material with penalty method to enhance structural mechanical performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Results on two-dimensional topology optimization benchmarks demonstrate that TopoMamba achieves superior topology prediction accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art models. The proposed load-support physics-guided framework enables efficient optimization of more complex structural systems.

</details>


### [1628] [One Latent, Many Tokens: Jointly Learning Compressed Embeddings for Efficient Language Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33698)
*Yulin Yuan,Ying Zhang,Xiangming Meng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: JPEG-DLM 通过联合训练压缩器、流匹配模型与解码模块，学习更易建模和可靠解码的压缩嵌入，实现高效扩散语言模型生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续扩散语言模型在每个采样步对每个 token 处理一个隐位置，生成开销大；两阶段方法虽通过缩短隐序列长度降低成本，但在训练扩散模型前固定压缩嵌入空间，导致该空间的嵌入难以用扩散建模且难以可靠解码为 token，从而限制压缩后的生成质量。

Method: 提出 JPEG-DLM（Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model），联合训练压缩器、流匹配（flow matching）模型与解码模块，通过联合嵌入预测学习更结构化、更易被扩散建模且可可靠解码为 token 的压缩嵌入。

Result: 在 LM1B 与 OWT 上，JPEG-DLM 取得近期扩散与流模型中最低的平均 Gen-PPL 和最高吞吐量；在 OWT 上压缩率为 0.5 时，Gen-PPL 达 34.52，吞吐量约为 ELF 的 2.3 倍。

Conclusion: 联合学习压缩嵌入为高效扩散语言建模提供了有前景的路径，代码将很快发布。

Abstract: Most continuous diffusion language models process one latent position per token at each sampling step, making generation expensive. Two-stage methods lower the cost by reducing the latent length, but they fix the compressed embedding space before training the diffusion model. Embeddings from the fixed space can be difficult to model with diffusion and decode reliably into tokens, which limits generation quality after compression. To address this problem, we introduce JPEG-DLM (Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model), which jointly trains a compressor, a flow matching model and a decoding module. With joint-embedding prediction, JPEG-DLM learns compressed embeddings that are more structured, easier to model with diffusion and reliably decodable into tokens. JPEG-DLM achieves the lowest mean Gen-PPL and highest throughput among recent diffusion and flow models on LM1B and OWT. At a compression rate of 0.5 on OWT, it reaches a Gen-PPL of 34.52 and approximately 2.3 times ELF's throughput. These results suggest that jointly learning compressed embeddings offers a promising path toward efficient diffusion language modeling. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [1629] [SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33699)
*Feilian Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SpecRead v2.1 是一个将"规格理解"与"代码生成"解耦的硬件设计LLM基准，含385题与82条控制项，用小型模型进行了初步表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有硬件设计LLM基准评测的是生成产物（RTL、断言、测试平台等），失败原因具有歧义性：无法区分模型是误读了规格说明，还是理解了规格但写不出代码。因此需要一个隔离"规格理解"能力的基准。

Method: SpecRead v2.1 基于10个开源 OpenTitan IP 模块构建385道题，覆盖四类任务：精确检索、跨章节推理、变异规格中的矛盾检测、规格-RTL一致性检查；另设82条控制项（41条干扰项、41条一致RTL）。其中Type-4题目由真实RTL变异构建，仅保留经Icarus Verilog仿真证明确实改变可观测行为的变异。采用有规格/无规格消融实验，并以确定性检查自动评分；对灰色地带案例在主评分中按保守计错处理。Type-3题目可通过变异注入再生，全部使用公开来源。

Result: 有规格与无规格消融显示题目确实依赖给定摘录（无规格时t1/t2子集准确率仅3/20），但对源文本的记忆仍可能有帮助。以 Ministral-3B 作初步表征：总体33.2%（128/385，宏平均39.0%），检索类55.2%、跨章节推理51.7%；两类矛盾题按"判定+定位"衡量分别为48.0%（t3）与63.3%（t4），干扰项假阳性率51.2%，一致RTL控制项上100%。分层评分显示模型定位矛盾表现较好（定位准确率78.9–81.6%），但对其类别判定得分较低（43.9–49.7%）。结构化"规则表"提示干预除t2（持平）外降低了所有题型准确率。

Conclusion: SpecRead 将规格理解能力从生成能力中剥离，提供了可自动、确定性评分的硬件设计LLM基准，并通过变异注入支持再生、全部基于公开来源。初步结果表明小模型在检索类任务明显优于跨章节推理与矛盾类别判定，且结构化提示未必带来增益。

Abstract: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails such a benchmark, the failure is ambiguous: it may have misread the specification, or it may have understood the specification and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.1 contains 385 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, contradiction detection in mutated specifications, and spec-RTL consistency checking, plus 82 controls (41 distractor, 41 consistent-RTL). Type-4 items are built from real RTL mutations; we retain only mutations that Icarus Verilog simulation shows to change observable behavior. A with-spec vs. without-spec ablation suggests the questions require the excerpt, not training recall alone (without-spec accuracy 3/20 on the t1/t2 subset), though memorization of the source text may still help spot mutations. As an initial characterization with a small model, Ministral-3B scores 33.2% overall (128/385; macro average 39.0%): 55.2% on retrieval, 51.7% on cross-section reasoning. On the two contradiction-focused types, the verdict-plus-location measure gives 48.0% (t3) and 63.3% (t4), with a 51.2% false-positive rate on distractors and 100% on consistent-RTL controls. Layered scoring shows the model locates contradictions well (78.9-81.6% location accuracy) but scores lower on their category (43.9-49.7%). A structured "rule-table" prompting intervention lowers accuracy on every question type except t2 (tied). SpecRead is automatically scorable by deterministic checks, with gray-zone cases counted wrong under the conservative main scoring. The benchmark is regenerable for type-3 items via mutation injection, and built exclusively from public sources.

</details>


### [1630] [BIRD: Distilling Decision Boundaries into Rationales for MLLM Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33713)
*Anglin Liu,Yanlin Wu,Ruichao Chen,Yuting Zhang,Qingyuan Zeng,Pengxiang Cai,Ziqi Gong,Muchen Li,Jintai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 BIRD 框架，利用模型自身的混淆样本定位未决决策边界，并将能真正改变答案偏好的证据蒸馏为 rationale 用于微调，在医学与图表 VQA 上优于现有 rationale 增强方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将通用多模态大模型适配到专业领域时，需要学习领域特有的决策准则，而这些准则常取决于视觉上极为细微的差异。现有 rationale 增强方法通过额外观察或样本间比较来暴露证据，但视觉上有效的线索未必对决策相关：它可能只描述样本差异，却不改变模型对候选答案的相对偏好，因此无法真正提升模型判断。

Method: BIRD 为自提升的边界感知 rationale 蒸馏框架。首先利用目标 MLLM 在自身表征空间中为每个样本检索候选近邻，并依据模型的答案偏好选出最易混淆的邻居；然后从其视觉差异中生成"答案盲"的候选证据；接着进行功能性验证，筛选出最能增强模型对正确答案偏好、且不会在该样本对上产生不当迁移的证据；最后将验证过的证据蒸馏为单样本 rationale，用于标准监督微调。

Result: 在医学和图表 VQA 任务上，BIRD 在两种目标 MLLM 上均优于竞争的 rationale 增强方法；进一步分析显示其能更好地区分易混淆答案，且模型匹配的监督带来的增益更强。

Conclusion: 有效的 rationale 必须具备决策相关性，而非仅视觉有效性。以模型特有的混淆为线索定位局部决策边界，并通过功能验证筛选证据，可显著提升领域适配性能，且与目标模型匹配的监督信号价值更大。

Abstract: Adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to specialized domains requires learning domain-specific decision criteria, which often hinge on subtle visual distinctions between otherwise plausible answers. Rationale augmentation aims to expose such evidence through additional observations or inter-sample comparisons, yet a visually valid cue is not necessarily decision-relevant: it may describe how samples differ without changing the model's relative preference between competing answers. We therefore introduce BIRD, a self-improving Boundary-Informed Rationale Distillation framework that uses model-specific confusions to locate unresolved local decision boundaries and distills the evidence that resolves these confusions into rationales. For each sample, BIRD retrieves candidate neighbors from the target MLLM's own representation space and selects the most confusable one according to its answer preferences. It then generates answer-blind candidate evidence from their visual differences and functionally verifies which evidence most effectively strengthens the model's preference for the correct answer while avoiding inappropriate transfer across the pair. The verified evidence is then distilled into a single-sample rationale for standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on medical and chart VQA show that BIRD outperforms competing rationale-augmentation methods across two target MLLMs, while further analyses demonstrate clearer separation of confusable answers and stronger gains from model-matched supervision.

</details>


### [1631] [Self-Designed Evaluators and Warm Memory for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33717)
*Saeid Asgari,Emre Kiciman,Leonardo de Oliveira Nunes,Ranveer Chandra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SelfSuite：在无奖励的长任务流中，让智能体用自身基座模型基于公开资料自动设计并冻结一套加权评判器与小规模任务简报评测套件，用以门控"保留最优"的重试并标注带类型、追踪结果的内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长任务流中的工具使用语言模型智能体得不到奖励信号，因而无法判断任务是否成功、无法安全重试、也无法为改进标注经验。现有方法（如 ACE）依赖代码执行等直接成功信号或大量专家标签，在无标签、无奖励场景下受限。

Method: SelfSuite 由智能体自身基座模型仅依据世界的公开材料，设计一套小型评测套件（加权 judges 与有依据的 per-task briefs），并将其冻结；用该套件门控 keep-best 重试，并对带类型、结果追踪的记忆进行标注。在 tau2-bench 与 AppWorld 上进行五次重复的匹配基准测试，并开展消融实验；另模拟领域专家为每个环境标注十个入门任务，用于校准评测器或预热 ACE 记忆；还在第二个模型家族上做单轮验证。

Result: 在 tau2-bench 与 AppWorld 的五次重复基准上，SelfSuite 在不使用任何标签时得分高于普通智能体；在 tau2-bench 上达到使用十个专家标签方法的水平；在 AppWorld 上（代码执行可提供直接成功信号）略逊于 ACE。消融实验中，SelfSuite 在每次重复中均高于无标签 ACE；门控的第二次尝试是唯一移除后每次重复都受损的组件。用专家标签校准评测器带来小幅且稳定的增益；用其预热 ACE 记忆可使 ACE 追平校准后的 SelfSuite。第二个模型家族的单轮研究显示相同排序。

Conclusion: 智能体可仅凭公开材料自建并冻结评测套件，在无奖励、无标签条件下实现自我评判、门控重试与经验标注，性能可比肩部分使用专家标签的方法；门控重试是核心组件，评测器校准与记忆预热均能带来一致增益，且结论在另一模型家族上具有可复现性。

Abstract: A tool-using language-model agent deployed over a long stream of tasks receives no reward, so it cannot tell whether it succeeded, cannot safely retry, and cannot label the experience it needs to improve. We present SelfSuite, in which the agent's own base model, given only the world's public materials, designs a small evaluation suite of weighted judges and grounded per-task briefs, freezes it, and uses it to gate a keep-best retry and to label a typed, outcome-tracked memory. On matched five-repeat benchmarks over tau2-bench and AppWorld, SelfSuite scores above the plain agent without any labels, matches methods given ten expert labels on tau2-bench, and trails Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) on AppWorld, where code execution gives a direct success signal. In an ablation campaign run on the same tasks, it is above label-free ACE in every repeat, and the gated second attempt is the only component whose removal hurts in every repeat. We also simulate a subject-matter expert who grades ten onboarding tasks per world. Using those labels to calibrate SelfSuite's evaluator gives a small, consistent gain, and using them to warm up ACE's memory lifts ACE to tie calibrated SelfSuite. A single-run study on a second model family shows the same ordering.

</details>


### [1632] [Robust Biomolecular Complex Design Across Protein Conformational Landscapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33726)
*Qingyuan Zeng,Zongqi Xu,Anglin Liu,Ziqi Gong,Pengxiang Cai,Zixin Guan,Yunan Chen,Sen Gao,Min Zhou,Jintai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlexEvo是一个模型无关的进化框架，可在推理阶段基于单一靶标构象对候选进行适配，提升其与未见天然构象的兼容性，无需重训练或构象集合。该方法将跨状态适配形式化为几何约束的双目标优化，在九类结合体上把类别均衡的平均相对性能退化从47.8%降至4.4%，每样本仅增加1.4–3.1分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于结构的生物分子设计通常针对单一靶标构象优化候选分子，但蛋白质实际以构象集合形式存在。因此，适配某一构象的候选在靶标切换到另一构象时可能丧失有利相互作用或产生空间位阻，导致跨构象鲁棒性差。现有方法要么需要构象集合，要么需要重训练，缺乏实用性与通用性。

Method: FlexEvo将跨状态适配建模为几何约束的双目标优化：一目标保持输入状态下的原有相互作用，另一目标提升对合理构象扰动的鲁棒性。通过几何推导的FlexBoxes划分三类区域——保护性锚点区、可局部探索的适配区、用于避免空间位阻的禁区，从而压缩搜索空间并减少无效结构编辑。采用统一的全原子表示支持跨多种结合体类别的拓扑保持适配，并以Pareto选择保留两目标上的非支配候选。整个适配只在推理阶段对候选进行一次性调整，无需重训练源模型或依赖构象集合。

Result: 在多个生成基线模型和覆盖不同分子尺寸与拓扑结构的九类代表性结合体上进行评估，FlexEvo将类别均衡的平均相对性能退化从47.8%降至4.4%，每样本仅增加1.4–3.1分钟的适配时间。

Conclusion: 单状态下的推理阶段适配可作为实现跨蛋白质构象景观的稳健生物分子复合物设计的实用途径。

Abstract: Proteins populate conformational ensembles, yet structure-based biomolecular design typically optimizes candidates against a single target conformation. Consequently, a candidate that fits one state can lose favorable interactions or develop steric clashes when the target adopts another. We introduce FlexEvo, a model-agnostic evolutionary framework that adapts candidates once at inference time from a single target conformation to improve compatibility with alternative natural conformations unseen during adaptation, without retraining the source model or requiring a conformational ensemble. FlexEvo casts cross-state adaptation as geometry-constrained bi-objective optimization, balancing preservation of input-state interactions against robustness to plausible conformational perturbations. To limit the search space and reduce invalid structural edits, geometry-derived FlexBoxes define protected anchor regions, adaptable regions for local exploration, and forbidden regions for clash avoidance. A unified all-atom representation supports topology-preserving adaptation across diverse binder categories, while Pareto selection preserves nondominated candidates across the two objectives. We evaluate FlexEvo across multiple generation baselines and nine representative binder categories spanning diverse molecular sizes and structural topologies. FlexEvo reduces the category-balanced mean relative performance degradation from 47.8% to 4.4%, while adding only 1.4--3.1 minutes of adaptation per sample. These results establish single-state inference-time adaptation as a practical route toward robust biomolecular complex design across protein conformational landscapes.

</details>


### [1633] [HTN Planning as a Coordination Layer for Multi-Server MCP Tool Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33731)
*Eliott Jacopin,Éric Jacopin,Koichi Takahashi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于HTN规划的跨MCP服务器协调架构：由LLM驱动的HTN规划器一次性生成可验证的跨服务器计划，再由运行时中间件确定性地执行，并通过${context.X}模板机制在运行时绑定跨动作数据依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP协议在设计上隔离各服务器，跨服务器工作流只能由host编排。当host为大语言模型时，编排结果具有非确定性、不可复现性，且每次工具调用都要消耗一轮推理开销。

Method: 构建分层任务网络（HTN）规划与运行时中间件相结合的协调架构：规划阶段一次性生成可验证的跨服务器计划；执行阶段由中间件确定性地在多个MCP服务器上执行。每个复合任务分解为服务器本地的原子动作，符合MCP的隔离约束；跨服务器数据流通过运行时绑定的JSON-path输出提取器与${context.X}模板替换机制实现。

Result: 在涵盖实验室机器人、生物信息学与多尺度建模的五个HTN领域上实例化该架构，并通过浏览器端计划控制器实现对八个真实第三方MCP服务器的端到端执行，查询真实生物学数据库。

Conclusion: 该架构在不破坏MCP隔离约束的前提下，将跨服务器编排从非确定性LLM编排转变为一次性可验证、可复现的确定性执行，降低了逐工具调用的推理开销，并在真实生物数据库场景中验证了可行性。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) isolates servers by design: only the host can orchestrate cross-server workflows. When the host is a large language model, the resulting orchestrations are non-deterministic, non-reproducible, and pay one inference round-trip per tool call. We present a coordination architecture in which a Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planner generates a verifiable cross-server plan once, and a runtime middleware executes it deterministically across multiple MCP servers, binding cross-action data dependencies via a template mechanism (\verb|${context.X}|) substituted at execution time. The architecture mirrors MCP's isolation constraint: each compound task decomposes into server-local primitive actions, and inter-server data flow is bound at execution time via JSON-path output extractors. We instantiate the architecture on five HTN domains spanning laboratory robotics, bioinformatics and multiscale modelling, and demonstrate end-to-end execution from a browser-based plan controller against eight live third-party MCP servers querying real biological databases.

</details>


### [1634] [Skill2Env: Capability-Oriented Environment Synthesis from Skills for General Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33772)
*Weiyi Xu,Xiaowen Yang,Wen Da,Hang Xu,Canwei Li,Hongjie You,Pusen Dong,Yucheng Zeng,Zhaokai Luo,Mu Chuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Skill2Env 框架，从技能出发、以能力需求驱动任务与环境合成，并配合迭代任务加固，生成 1.5K 高质量轨迹用于监督微调，在多个智能体基准上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可执行环境对需要工具使用与多步交互的智能体后训练至关重要，但可执行任务及其环境的构建难以规模化。技能虽提供可复用的领域知识、操作流程与工具使用说明，但技能信息与具体、有挑战性且具备完整可执行环境的任务之间仍存在显著鸿沟。

Method: Skill2Env 是面向能力的框架：以智能体能力需求引导任务与环境合成，用可复用的难度模式表征需求，并实例化为任务蓝图，明确目标、挑战、环境事实、信息边界与验收标准；蓝图指导围绕源技能联合构建任务指令、执行基座、工作空间与基于评分量规的评估器。进一步提出迭代任务加固（Iterative Task Hardening），利用求解器执行证据识别挑战性不足的任务设计，强化或扩展其难度模式实例，并修订相应蓝图与环境。

Result: 使用 Skill2Env 环境生成的 1.5K 高分轨迹进行监督微调，在广泛的智能体基准上观察到一致性的性能提升。

Conclusion: 结果验证了面向能力的可执行环境合成对智能体后训练的有效性，为规模化构建技能驱动的任务与环境提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Executable environments are critical for post-training agents on tasks that require tool use and multi-step interaction, but constructing executable tasks together with their environments remains difficult to scale. Skills provide reusable domain knowledge, operational procedures, and tool-use instructions, but a substantial gap remains between the information contained in a skill and a concrete, challenging task with a complete executable environment. To address this gap, we introduce Skill2Env, a capability-oriented framework that starts from a skill and uses agent capability demands to guide task and environment synthesis. Skill2Env represents these demands through reusable difficulty patterns and instantiates them into task blueprints that specify objectives, challenges, environment facts, information boundaries, and acceptance criteria. These blueprints guide the joint construction of task instructions, execution substrates, workspaces, and rubric-based evaluators around source skills. We further propose Iterative Task Hardening, which uses solver execution evidence to identify insufficiently challenging task designs, strengthen or extend their difficulty-pattern instantiations, and revise the corresponding blueprints and environments. Using 1.5K high-scoring trajectories generated from Skill2Env environments for supervised fine-tuning, we observe consistent improvements across a broad range of agent benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of capability-oriented environment synthesis for agent post-training.

</details>


### [1635] [Learning Strategies to Break Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33773)
*Guruprerana Shabadi,Aaditya Naik,Rajeev Alur,Mayur Naik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"智能体引导"的方法，通过对抗性变异与策略蒸馏，系统性地寻找并解释数学推理智能体评审器（judge）的可解释失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体性能超越人类，设计者难以直接评估智能体并理解其失效模式，于是大量部署智能体作为评审器来评判模型轨迹，由此产生了关键问题：如何信任评审器本身。

Method: 聚焦数学推理，分两阶段：第一阶段部署对抗性智能体，对一组正确证明注入错误进行变异，试图误导评审器（即注入其无法察觉的错误）；第二阶段将这些尝试蒸馏为一小批变异策略，用以分析评审器的失效模式。为避免过拟合，将蒸馏出的策略应用于留出（held-out）证明集并重新询问同一评审器进行验证。实验在GPT-5.6-sol与Claude Opus 5及其编排器Codex和Claude Code上进行，它们同时充当变异器和评审器。

Result: 在所有被测的智能体评审器上，均能蒸馏出可稳定绕过其评估的变异策略，从而确定可操作的失效模式。分析还发现评审器可靠性在前沿领域下降：奥林匹克级证明或研究生级数学文本中的错误被更稳定地检出，而研究级手稿中的缺陷更易逃逸检测。

Conclusion: 智能体评审器存在系统性的、可解释的失效机制，且其可靠性随任务难度前沿而下降；所提方法可有效暴露并刻画这些弱点，为评估与信任智能体评审器提供依据。

Abstract: As AI agents surpass human performance, it becomes exceedingly hard for system designers to evaluate them directly and understand their failure modes. Consequently, agents themselves are being deployed extensively to evaluate, judge, and provide feedback on model traces. But this raises an important question: how can we trust the judge? In this work, we propose an agent-guided method to find weaknesses of agentic judges that expose interpretable failure mechanisms. Our method focuses on mathematical reasoning and proceeds in two stages: first, we deploy adversarial agents to mutate a set of sound proofs by introducing errors, attempting to misguide judges---in other words, injecting errors that judges are unable to catch. Then, we distill these attempts into a small set of mutation strategies which allow us to analyze the failure modes of the judges. To ensure that these strategies are not overfit to the initial set of proofs, we evaluate them by applying the mutation strategies to a held-out set of proofs and querying the same judge. We deploy our method on GPT-5.6-sol and Claude Opus 5, paired with their agent orchestrators, Codex and Claude Code, respectively. These are used both as mutators to introduce errors and as judges to evaluate correctness of mathematical reasoning. We find that across all the agentic judges, we are able to distill mutation strategies that consistently bypass their evaluations, thereby enabling us to ascertain actionable failure modes. Our analysis also reveals that judge reliability degrades at the frontier: errors in Olympiad-level proofs or graduate-level mathematical texts are detected more consistently, whereas flaws in research-level manuscripts are more likely to escape detection.

</details>


### [1636] [Evidence-Inference Reconstruction: When The Evidence Is Recalled But The Reasoning Goes Wrong](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33778)
*Megan Diehl,Ser-Nam Lim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR)，用结构化状态引导单条检索轨迹并累积证据，将证据检索与最终答案生成解耦，从而在相关证据已收集的情况下，即使混入错误证据，也能单次调用模型生成正确答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳 LLM 智能体内置中间推理步骤纠错机制，但纠错多采用重试步骤或重跑推理轨迹的方式，代价高昂，且本文表明这类重试往往并非必要。

Method: EIR 以结构化状态引导一条检索轨迹，在过程中累积来源证据；将证据检索与最终答案模型调用分离，仅当相关证据已收集后，通过一次最终模型调用生成答案，可容忍错误中间步骤引入的错误证据。

Result: 在 Haiku 4.5 与 GPT-4.1 Mini 上，于 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 各 1000 题匹配子集评测：Answer F1 较 baseline 提升 8.3--32.8 点，较 Agentic SSR 提升 10.6--29.1 点，较 Reflexion 提升 1.1--15.9 点；平均每题 4.85 次模型调用，Agentic SSR 为 35.29 次，Reflexion 为 12.41 次。

Conclusion: 结果支持 EIR 的核心前提：将证据检索与最终答案模型调用分离，可在显著降低计算量的同时提升答案准确率。

Abstract: Modern multi-hop LLM agents are equipped with built-in mechanisms to detect errors in intermediate reasoning steps. Such errors trigger corrective actions from these agents, which mostly follow the paradigm of retrying the steps or the reasoning trajectories. Not only are these retries expensive, we present in this paper that they are also potentially unnecessary. To this end, we introduce Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR), which uses structured state to guide one retrieval trajectory, accumulating source evidence in the process. We show that as long as the relevant evidence has been collected, EIR is capable of generating the correct answer in a single final model call even if erroneous evidence has been mixed in due to incorrect intermediate reasoning steps. In one evaluation, using Haiku 4.5 and GPT-4.1 Mini, we evaluate EIR on matched 1,000-question subsets of HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, showing that EIR improves Answer F1, the overlap between the model's and the correct answer, over the baseline by 8.3--32.8 points, Agentic SSR by 10.6--29.1 points, and Reflexion by 1.1--15.9 points. Additionally, we show that EIR averages 4.85 total model calls per question, compared with 35.29 for Agentic SSR and 12.41 for Reflexion. Together, these results corroborate EIR's central premise: separating evidence retrieval from the final answer model call can improve answer accuracy while utilizing substantially less computation.

</details>


### [1637] [Is your uncertainty map wrong, or is its target? Exact diagnostics for the Tweedie diagonal, and a gradient-free alternative](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33786)
*Vicent Ribas,Anna Oliveras Tous*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文先以精确计算Tweedie后验协方差对角线为基准，检验扩散模型不确定性图的可靠性，发现限制来自目标而非估计器；随后提出无梯度的T-PT探针，并在脑MRI与肺CT上与蒙特卡洛集成对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床需要逐体素的预测可信度图，但此类图多以Tweedie后验协方差对角线的近似为目标和评价标准，导致无法分辨误差源于估计器还是目标本身；同时全分辨率下基于Jacobian的估计器面临内存瓶颈。

Method: 在14种模型-语料条件、6个checkpoint上精确计算Tweedie后验协方差对角线，并与Hutchinson（M=200）及去噪误差对比；提出Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT)——无梯度残差探针，反复扰动单个模型支持的预测并测量去噪器响应的逐体素方差；在脑MRI全分辨率与肺CT上与二十链/五十链蒙特卡洛集成对比。

Result: Hutchinson在M=200时与精确对角线秩一致性≥0.92；14种条件中4种精确对角线与去噪误差反相关，低至-0.13，且均为真实图像条件，在生成样本上不出现。T-PT的精确二阶形式在对角线反转处仍与对角线同序，但三十次探针时不稳定，而Hutchinson在M=5即可复现该排序。脑MRI上T-PT在8个组织内终点中5个领先二十链集成、无一落后，网络评估少16倍；全脑范围集成领先，五十链可缩小组织内差距；肺CT上集成全程领先。

Conclusion: 限制这些不确定性图的是目标而非估计器；在生成样本上评估会高估该族方法。T-PT定位为一种可用工具而非更优近似，在内存受限的全分辨率场景具备优势，但所有方法在变化发生区域判别力大幅下降，该问题仍待解决。

Abstract: A diffusion model can predict a follow-up medical scan from a baseline, but a clinician needs a per-voxel map of where that prediction can be trusted. Many such maps approximate the diagonal of the Tweedie posterior covariance, and are evaluated against another approximation of it, so whether the estimator or the target limits them is unclear. We compute the exact diagonal on six checkpoints across fourteen model-corpus conditions. Hutchinson at M=200 tracks it at rank agreement of at least 0.92 everywhere, yet in four of the fourteen the exact diagonal is anti-correlated with the denoising error, reaching -0.13, so a faithful estimator reproduces that reversal. All four are real-image conditions; on the models' own samples the reversal does not appear, so evaluating on generated samples flatters this family. What limits these maps is the target, not the estimator.
  We then introduce Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT), a gradient-free residual probe that corrupts one model-supported prediction repeatedly and measures the voxel-wise variance of the denoiser's response. T-PT reads a different functional of the same Jacobian, and its exact second-order form ranks with the diagonal wherever the diagonal reverses; at thirty probes it returns a map too unstable to reproduce that ranking, while Hutchinson at M=5 already reproduces it, so T-PT there is not evidence against the reversal. We offer it as an instrument, not a better approximation. On brain MRI at full resolution, where every Jacobian-based estimator we test runs out of memory, T-PT leads a twenty-chain Monte-Carlo ensemble on five of eight endpoints inside tissue and trails it on none, at 16x fewer network evaluations; over the whole volume the ensemble leads, and fifty chains close the tissue gap. On lung CT the ensemble is ahead throughout. Both lose most of their discrimination where the change is, which remains open.

</details>


### [1638] [Dual-Vocabulary Language Model for Cross-Tokenizer Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33816)
*Kedi Chen,Chen Lin,Yutao Sun,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出双词表语言模型DVLM，通过平行分词序列(PTS)与混合前缀注意力(HPA)解决师生分词器不一致带来的输入分词与输出logits错位问题，实现全维度学生logits与分布对齐的蒸馏监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏(OPD)需衔接教师监督与学生行为，但师生分词器不同会导致两处错位：(#1)输入分词不一致；(#2)输出logits维度不匹配。现有方法或用同文本跨度匹配、字节转换，损失细粒度token信息或破坏原生token范式；或在logits上采用排序、填充、关键token选择，仅保留共享维度，造成大量分布信息损失。

Method: 提出DVLM：用新的学生词表投影头替换教师LM head，获取全维度学生logits(解决#2)；以平行分词序列(PTS)为输入，将原始教师分词序列与每个学生token独立转成的教师token组重新分词序列拼接(解决#1)；混合前缀注意力(HPA)将重分词组限制在其对应教师前缀内，以其末状态聚合原学生token表示并投影到学生词表空间，避免与原始教师token的推理不一致。

Result: DVLM教师的收敛损失与原始教师模型相近，并在六项推理任务上提升学生模型性能。

Conclusion: PTS与HPA结合可使DVLM教师提供与学生输入分词、输出logits分布对齐的监督，兼顾完整分布信息与原生token范式，有效缓解跨分词器在线策略蒸馏的错位问题。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) bridges teacher supervision and student behavior, but different teacher-student tokenizers introduce misalignment in both input tokenization (#1) and output logits (#2). Existing approaches address the former by matching same-text spans or converting tokens to bytes, often losing fine-grained token information or disrupting the native-token paradigm, while for the latter, strategies such as ranking, padding, or key-token selection retain only shared logit dimensions, resulting in much distribution loss. In this paper, we propose Dual-Vocabulary Language Model (DVLM), which replaces the teacher's LM head with a new student-vocabulary projection head and obtains full-dimensional student logits (for #2). To support student tokens (for #1), it takes a Parallel-Tokenized Sequence (PTS) as input, which concatenates the original teacher-tokenized sequence and a re-tokenized sequence formed by independently converting each student token into a teacher-token group. To avoid inference inconsistency with the original teacher tokens, the Hybrid-Prefix Attention (HPA) further restricts re-tokenized groups to their corresponding teacher prefix and uses its last state as the aggregation of the original student-token representation for projection into the student vocabulary space. Similarly, via the combined use of PTS and HPA, the DVLM teacher can provide distribution-aligned supervision with the student's input-tokenization and output-logit during OPD. Experimental results demonstrate that our DVLM teacher has a similar converged loss as the original teacher model and enables student models to improve performance across six reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [1639] [Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33822)
*Jayant Parashar,Eugene F. Douglass,William C. Bastian,Suchendra M. Bhandarkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Vestrum 通过将执行轨迹中的失败转化为"范围受限的"harness 改动，在不训练任务模型的前提下自动改进 agent harness，并在五个场景中提升了冻结 harness 的留出集表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: agent harness 决定语言模型如何获取信息、使用工具、保存记忆与自检，但每次评估都需与环境进行长程交互，导致改进该软件的成本极高。作者希望找到一种低成本、无需训练任务模型的 harness 自动优化途径。

Method: Vestrum 的核心过度假设（overhypothesis）是：同类任务可能反复出现可识别的失败模式，且其补救措施可在同类内迁移。方法上，将失败表达为可识别的失败类别，在验证、检索、任务分解与知识综合四个维度提出改动，先筛查改动的作用范围，再以"打包"形式统一评估；同时维护一个持久的 lessons file 用于指导后续提案生成。

Result: 在五个设置、两个基线 harness 上，冻结 harness 的留出集表现均有提升：UltraHorizon 在 GAM 上由 47.6 升至 59.8；Terminal-Bench 4 Hard 在 Claude Code 上、8 个留出任务、1.03 倍测试成本下，检查通过率由 63.7% 升至 70.3%；单张切片留出区域上的细胞类型注释一致度由 67.5% 升至 77.8%；LoCoMo 与 AMA-Bench 上亦有增益。三个记忆基准上，Vestrum 在每一组配对评估中均高于所评估的 GEPA 配置。此外发现：基于证据的验证对中间步骤和最终答案均有帮助，且中间步骤成本更低；而被要求重构已完成答案的 critic 造成的破坏大于其修复。

Conclusion: Vestrum 表明，harness 层面存在可跨任务迁移的失败补救规律，可将轨迹失败转化为范围受限的改动并组合评估，从而在冻结任务模型、控制成本的前提下稳定提升 agent 性能；同时提示"基于证据的验证"优于"事后重建式批判"。

Abstract: An agent harness controls how a language model accesses information, uses tools, preserves memory, and checks its work. Improving this software is costly when each evaluation requires a long interaction with an environment. We introduce Vestrum, a framework that turns failures in execution traces into scoped harness changes without training the task model. Its organizing overhypothesis is that tasks of a shared kind may exhibit recurring failures whose remedies transfer within that kind.
