Vestrum expresses failures as recognizable classes, proposes changes across verification, retrieval, decomposition, and knowledge synthesis, and screens their scope before evaluating them as a bundle. A persistent lessons file informs subsequent proposals. Across five settings and two baseline harnesses, the frozen harnesses improve held-out performance: UltraHorizon rises from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM, Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks passed over Claude Code on eight held-out tasks at 1.03x test cost, and cell-type annotation agreement from 67.5% to 77.8% on held-out sections of one slide, alongside gains on LoCoMo and AMA-Bench. Across our searches, verification grounded in evidence helped both intermediate steps and final answers, at lower cost at intermediate steps, while critics asked to rebuild finished answers broke more than they repaired. On the three memory benchmarks, Vestrum also scores above the evaluated GEPA configurations in every paired evaluation.

</details>


### [1640] [How code helps different tasks? A decompositional lens on LLM post-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33845)
*Zheng Yu,Yiwei Li,Yishen Chen,Xiang Li,Jiale Han,Benyou Wang,Jingbang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"分解视角"研究代码数据在LLM后训练中的价值：将执行验证的代码语料按解法计算模式分解为可解释类别，通过受控微调实验比较单类别与均衡混合，发现类别收益依模型与任务而异；据此构建的紧凑混合（约全语料10-15%）在部分模型-任务对上超越最佳单类别与全语料训练，呈现"少即是多"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将代码数据视为单一语料会掩盖"哪类代码数据对哪些模型与下游任务有益"。有效的数据选择既需了解各类别的独立收益，也需知道这些收益在类别组合后是否依然存在。

Method: 1) 按解法的计算模式将执行验证的代码语料分解为可解释类别；2) 在指令微调模型上，围绕问答、数学、代码生成三类任务，用受控微调实验比较单类别与均衡混合，绘制"响应图"；3) 依据响应图构建紧凑混合，检验单类别收益在联合训练下是否持续。

Result: 响应图显示问答平均性能有可复现的增益；同一类别可能提升某一模型或任务却损害另一者；最佳类别随起始模型与目标任务变化。在部分模型-任务对上，由各自提升目标任务的成分组成的混合，既优于其最佳单成分，也优于全语料训练，且仅用约10-15%的全语料。

Conclusion: 这是探索性发现，呈现"less is more"模式；代码数据在后训练中的价值取决于为哪个模型、哪个任务组合了哪些类别，而非语料规模本身。

Abstract: Evaluating code data as a single corpus can obscure which types of code data benefit which models and downstream tasks. Effective data selection requires understanding both the benefits of individual categories and whether these benefits persist when categories are combined. We introduce a decompositional lens for studying these effects in LLM post-training. We first decompose an execution-verified code corpus into interpretable categories based on the computational patterns of its solutions. Through controlled fine-tuning experiments, we compare individual categories with a balanced mixture across instruction-tuned models on question answering, mathematics, and code generation. The resulting response maps reveal recurring gains in average question-answering performance, while the same category can improve one model or task and degrade another. The best-performing category also varies with the starting model and target task. We then compose compact mixtures guided by these results and examine whether benefits observed in individual categories persist under joint training. On selected model--task pairs, mixtures whose constituents each improve the target task outperform both their best constituent and full-corpus training while using roughly 10--15\% of the full corpus. These exploratory findings illustrate a \emph{less is more} pattern and highlight how the value of code data in post training depends on which categories are combined for which model and task.

</details>


### [1641] [R$^2$ Flow: Recursive Self-Improvement via Recursive Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33867)
*Mingda Zhang,Qiang Huang,Yanjin Li,Zijia Wang,Qika Lin,Xiaoying Tang,Tiesunlong Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: R² Flow：以递归自我改进框架，将策略学习、独立验证与版本化技能库更新交替进行，解决 flow 训练的三大障碍并提升多任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体通过复用与修订技能实现自我改进，flow-based training 契合该循环（按奖励采样过程、用 flow 归因技能）。但存在三障碍：flow 训练在树状历史上出现策略坍缩；非负 flow 归因把高频使用误当收益；技能库编辑依赖策略优化的任务奖励。

Method: 提出 R² Flow：在共享状态编排图上交替进行策略学习、独立验证与版本化技能库更新。图合并仅顺序不同的等价历史，使 flow 训练跨等价执行汇聚证据；用对反向策略不变的 flow-share 读出与单独的带符号效用排序决定改哪些技能；由验证器证据决定编辑是否成立；以残差方差平台期决定何时更新。已提交的编辑会重塑下一轮策略学习所依赖的图，实现递归技能演化。

Result: 在问答、数学推理、交互式决策与代码生成任务上，R² Flow 相比启发式编排、强化学习与技能演化基线，提升了任务准确率与技能库编辑精度，并可跨执行器迁移。代码见 https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow。

Conclusion: R² Flow 通过共享状态编排图与验证驱动的版本化技能库更新，缓解策略坍缩与信用误归因问题，实现可靠的递归自我改进，并在多任务与多执行器上展现泛化性。

Abstract: LLM-based agents can improve themselves across tasks by reusing and revising the skills they orchestrate into executable procedures. Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. The graph merges histories that differ only in the order of independent steps, allowing flow training to pool evidence across equivalent executions. A flow-share readout of the trained flow, invariant to the backward policy, and a separate signed utility rank which skills to change, verifier evidence decides whether an edit is warranted, and a residual-variance plateau sets when to update. Committed edits reshape the graph the next policy learns on, realizing recursive skill evolution. Across question answering, mathematical reasoning, interactive decision making, and code generation, R$^2$ Flow improves task accuracy and library-edit precision over heuristic orchestration, reinforcement learning, and skill-evolution baselines, and transfers across executors. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.

</details>


### [1642] [When Successful Strategies Fail: Adaptation to Environmental Novelty in Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33870)
*Janvijay Singh,Vaishnavi Shrivastava,Dilek Hakkani-Tur,Ece Kamar,Asli Celikyilmaz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AGNI流水线，通过提取轨迹相关假设、注入针对性环境变化并验证新任务可解性，研究LLM agent对"环境新颖性"的适应能力，揭示了任务能力与适应能力之间的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent在解决长时程任务时，其策略依赖于对环境资源、工具位置与行为的假设。当这些假设不再成立时，可靠agent必须检测变化并调整策略以维持同一目标。然而，现有研究缺乏对"环境新颖性"下适应能力的系统性评测与训练手段。

Method: 提出AGNI自动化流水线：提取轨迹相关假设、注入针对性环境变化、验证新任务仍可解。在三个终端（terminal）基准上生成涵盖资源、接口、约束与执行语义的多样新颖性，并对多个LLM agent进行评估与轨迹分析，最后进行面向环境新颖性的后训练。

Result: 在三个终端基准上生成了多样化的新颖任务；多个LLM agent在基础任务与新任务之间存在显著适应差距。轨迹分析表明agent常遇到变化的证据，却无法诊断原因并修正策略。面向环境新颖性的后训练不仅提升了对留出新颖任务的适应能力，也改善了基础任务表现。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了任务胜任力与适应能力之间的差距，说明环境变化应作为agent训练与评估的核心维度。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks by autonomously interacting with their environment. In doing so, their strategies rely on assumptions about that environment: which resources and tools exist, where they are located, and how they behave. When these assumptions no longer hold, reliable agents must detect the change and adapt while pursuing the same goal. We study this adaptation capability through environmental novelty: a change that keeps the task objective fixed while invalidating an assumption underlying an otherwise successful trajectory. We introduce AGNI, an automated pipeline that extracts trajectory-relevant assumptions, injects targeted environmental changes, and validates that the resulting novel tasks remain solvable. Across three terminal benchmarks, AGNI produces diverse novelties spanning resources, interfaces, constraints, and execution semantics. Evaluating multiple LLM agents reveals a substantial adaptation gap between base and novel tasks. Trajectory analysis suggests that agents often encounter evidence of the change but fail to diagnose its cause and revise their strategy. Finally, post-training for environmental novelty improves adaptation to held-out novel tasks while also improving performance on base tasks. Our results highlight a gap between task competence and adaptive capability and motivate environmental variation as a core dimension of agent training and evaluation.

</details>


### [1643] [Curating Merchant-Matching Training Data with Two Confidence-Gated Local LLM Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33878)
*Donghao Huang,Jinling Pei,Zhaoxia Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 商户匹配任务中，双本地大模型裁判一致性可提升伪标签可靠性，但正负标签需分别设阈并审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练标签的核心难点在于区分"教师弃权"与"确实不存在可接受实体"：错误的 no-match 标签会污染伪标注数据，而过度保守标注又会降低覆盖率。作者试图检验双裁判一致性是否能提升伪标签可靠性。

Method: 采用两名本地大模型裁判（Muse Glimmer 30B、Gemma 4 31B）的一致性机制，仅在两裁判一致时保留标签，并分别对"选中"与"弃权"设置独立的有序阈值，以保证正负标签集合互斥。在 2,000 条专家标注查询上做回溯式回放，并进行折半检验、对称阈值对照及五种同模型内推理强度对比。

Result: 阈值 (0.86, 0.80) 下两模型共同标注 1,633 条（覆盖率 81.7%），总体纯度 96.88%，正、负纯度分别为 99.47% 与 93.38%，比任一单模型在同阈值下高逾 2 个百分点（覆盖率更低）。折半检验仅 0.14 个百分点的阈值选择乐观偏差。对称阈值 0.86 会新增 40 个错误 no-match 标签；即便不设置信阈值，仍有 46 个错误弃权。五组同模型对比中，提高推理强度未带来明显 F0.5 收益，但中位延迟增加 1.8–5.0 倍。

Conclusion: 结果支持对正、负伪标签分别设阈并审计。本研究验证的是标签纯度而非学生模型效用，真正证明下游价值仍需新数据标注与学生模型微调。

Abstract: Merchant matching resolves a noisy payment descriptor to a retrieved merchant entity or returns no match. A key challenge in curating training labels is distinguishing teacher abstention from evidence that no acceptable entity exists: false no-match labels contaminate pseudo-labeled data, while conservative labeling reduces coverage. We investigate whether agreement between two local large language model judges improves pseudo-label reliability. A label is retained only when the judges agree, with separate ordered thresholds for selections and abstentions that guarantee disjoint positive and negative label sets. Retrospective replay on 2,000 expert-annotated queries shows that higher selection thresholds can improve positive-label purity, whereas higher abstention thresholds increase false no-match labels. At thresholds (0.86, 0.80), Muse Glimmer 30B and Gemma 4 31B jointly label 1,633 queries (81.7% coverage) at 96.88% purity; positive and negative purities are 99.47% and 93.38%. This exceeds either constituent model at the same thresholds by more than two percentage points, with lower coverage. A split-half check finds only 0.14 percentage points of threshold-selection optimism. A symmetric threshold of 0.86 adds 40 erroneous no-match labels, while 46 false abstentions persist even with no confidence threshold. Across five matched within-model comparisons, higher reasoning effort yields no clear F0.5 gain and increases median latency by 1.8-5.0 times. These results motivate separate thresholding and auditing for positive and negative pseudo-labels. The study establishes label purity, not student utility; fresh-data curation and student fine-tuning remain necessary to demonstrate downstream value.

</details>


### [1644] [When Consent Outlives Context: Residual Authority Replay in Long-Lived Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33910)
*Zhihao Zhang,Chao Wang,Rujia Li,Qingze Wang,Xiaoyan Sun,Jun Dai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文揭示长期运行的LLM智能体存在"残留授权"（residual authority）问题：跨任务/会话持久化的用户授权会脱离其原始正当上下文，在对抗性执行中被重放复用，显著提升攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体越来越多依赖运行时用户授权来批准安全敏感操作，而这类授权本应绑定于特定任务与执行上下文。但在长期运行的智能体中，授权决策需要跨任务或跨会话持续有效，这种连续性可能超出最初支撑该批准的上下文，形成可无需重新征得同意即可复用的"残留授权"，从而构成安全风险。

Method: 作者通过一种"纵向攻击"（longitudinal attack）暴露该失效模式：从目标安全敏感操作出发，识别执行它所需的权限，诱导合法获得该权限的良性交互，随后在对抗性执行阶段重放残留授权。在受控与真实环境中验证该攻击，并采用生产环境导出的授权语义，在六个LLM家族上评估508个AgentDojo攻击案例；同时在三个真实生产级编码智能体上对55个Terminal-Bench案例进行实时的上下文重绑定攻击。

Result: 在残留授权存在时，相比全新的授权状态，攻击成功率（ASR）最多提升35.1个百分点。在三个真实生产编码智能体的55个Terminal-Bench案例实时上下文重绑定攻击中，残留授权重放平均使ASR提升24.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究结果揭示了长期运行LLM智能体中持久化授权与用户同意上下文本质之间存在根本性错配，残留授权重放在实际中确实存在并能大幅放大提示注入与上下文重绑定攻击的成功率。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on user approval to authorize security-sensitive actions at runtime. Such approvals are granted within a specific task and execution context. In long-lived agents, authorization decisions may need to persist across tasks or sessions. We find that this continuity can outlive the context that originally justified the approval, creating residual authority reusable without renewed consent. We expose this failure mode through a longitudinal attack that starts from a target security-sensitive action, identifies the authority required to execute it, induces benign interactions that legitimately obtain that authority, and later replays the residual authority during adversarial execution. Across controlled and live settings, we demonstrate that residual-authority replay arises in practice and substantially increases the success of prompt-injection and context-rebinding attacks. We evaluate 508 AgentDojo attack cases across six LLM families using production-derived authorization semantics. With residual authority, attack success rate (ASR) increases by up to 35.1 percentage points compared with a fresh authorization state. In live context-rebinding attacks on 55 Terminal-Bench cases across three real-world production coding agents, residual-authority replay increases ASR by 24.9 percentage points on average. These findings expose a fundamental mismatch between persistent authorization and the contextual nature of user consent in long-lived LLM agents.

</details>


### [1645] [HyperMCTS: Hypergraph-Augmented MCTS for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33920)
*Tingsong Xiao,Nithish Balachandar Moudhgalya,Chandrayee Basu,Lichao Wang,Luyang Kong,Benjamin Z. Yao,Zhe Jiang,Jie Hao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HyperMCTS：一种免训练方法，在有序MCTS树上叠加跨轨迹超图，通过HyperUCT选择规则聚合重叠超边证据，实现轨迹反馈复用，提升长时程任务规划效率与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程任务要求LLM智能体在整个解空间约束下协调决策。MCTS可通过探索替代动作轨迹实现测试时扩展，但模型计算与环境交互使搜索代价高昂，需高效复用轨迹反馈。标准MCTS仅维护前缀特定统计，未显式累积跨路径重复出现的决策组的回报结果。

Method: 提出免训练的HyperMCTS：在有序MCTS树上增加跨轨迹超图。超边表示规范决策组，累积当前任务中观测到的回报；超图引导的HyperUCT选择规则将重叠超边的证据聚合为动作先验，使某一前缀下收集的结果可指导另一前缀下的选择，同时在树中保留执行历史。

Result: 在DeepPlanning上，对三个骨干模型，平均规划准确率较最强基线提升2.3–7.3个百分点；使Qwen3.6-27B在Shopping Planning上超越Claude Opus 4.6（max），且相比所评估的MCTS基线具有更高准确率、更少LLM调用与输出token。SealQA实验进一步显示问答性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过跨轨迹超图复用决策组回报，HyperMCTS以更低的搜索成本提升长时程规划与问答表现，验证了轨迹反馈跨前缀复用的有效性。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate decisions under constraints that span an entire solution. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) offers a promising approach to test-time scaling by exploring alternative action trajectories, but model computation and environment interaction make search costly. Efficient search therefore requires effective reuse of trajectory feedback. Standard MCTS maintains prefix-specific statistics, without explicitly accumulating outcomes for decision groups that recur across different paths. To fill this gap, we propose HyperMCTS, a training-free method that augments an ordered MCTS tree with a cross-trajectory hypergraph. Hyperedges represent groups of canonical decisions and accumulate their observed returns within the current task. Our hypergraph-guided HyperUCT selection rule aggregates evidence from overlapping hyperedges into an action prior, allowing outcomes collected under one prefix to inform selection under another while preserving execution histories in the tree. On DeepPlanning, HyperMCTS improves average planning accuracy by 2.3--7.3 percentage points over the strongest baseline for each of three backbone models. It enables Qwen3.6-27B to outperform Claude Opus 4.6 (max) on Shopping Planning, while achieving higher accuracy with fewer LLM calls and output tokens than the evaluated MCTS-based baselines. SealQA experiments further demonstrate improvements in question answering.

</details>


### [1646] [Designing Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge Measurement Systems for Multi-Turn Business Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33955)
*Kaiwen Luo,Ming Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一套面向生产级多轮业务智能体的综合评测方法论，涵盖评测规范、模块化LLM评审器、意图保持的用户模拟与人工介入治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-judge评测多针对固定任务定义下的固定输出，而生产多轮业务智能体中正确性依赖业务事实与流程、结果跨轮次涌现、失败须先归属为智能体能力欠缺或业务知识缺失才可行动，因此需要可维护的测量系统。

Method: 整合四部分：1）评测规范定义会话级终态与可归属的失败责任；2）原子化评审器共享带版本证据并输入显式聚合图；3）用户模拟器仅在通过任务保持性与稳定性检查后发布；4）独立人工审计估计测量保真度、更新分层参考集，并将分歧路由至标签修正、指南修订或评审器改进。

Result: 生产研究显示：系统级保真度在重复审计中提升；共享反馈闭环下人工审核者与自动评审器共同改进；在两种已报告的任务完成设定中，人机组合流程的描述性表现最强。因研究为观察性且人工参考本身需修订，结果体现运营实用性而非因果或普适优越性。

Conclusion: 贡献是一套实用框架，使多轮智能体测量在被评系统及其证据演进过程中保持可靠、可行动与可维护。

Abstract: Many LLM-as-a-judge evaluations score fixed outputs under a fixed task definition. Production multi-turn business agents instead require a maintained measurement system: correctness depends on business-specific facts and procedures, outcomes emerge across turns, and failures must be attributed to either agent capability or missing business knowledge before they are actionable. We present an integrated methodology spanning evaluation specification, modular LLM judges, intent-preserving user simulation, and human-in-the-loop governance. The specification defines conversation-level end states and actionable failure ownership. Atomic judges share versioned evidence and feed an explicit aggregation graph. The simulator is released only after task-preservation and stability checks. Independent human audits estimate measurement fidelity, renew tiered reference sets, and route disagreements to label correction, guideline revision, or judge improvement. Production studies show that system-level fidelity improved across repeated audits, that human reviewers and automated judges improved together under the shared feedback loop, and that their combined workflow had the strongest descriptive performance in both reported task-completion settings. Because the studies are observational and the human reference itself required revision, these findings demonstrate operational usefulness rather than causal or universal superiority. The contribution is a practical framework for making multi-turn agent measurement reliable, actionable, and maintainable as the evaluated system and its evidence evolve.

</details>


### [1647] [EHRAdapt: Adapting Pretrained Language Models to Electronic Health Records with Semantic Priors for Rare Clinical Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34007)
*Andre R Goncalves,Vincent Liu,Priyadip Ray*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EHRAdapt 适配器，将 EHR 的 (时间, 模态, 编码) 元组直接映射到冻结语言模型的嵌入空间，通过语义先验与证据残差两条路径学习事件向量，仅训练 0.1–0.6% 参数即可在多个下游任务上超越文本化 LLM 与计数基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子健康记录（EHR）本质是 (time, modality, code) 元组，而预训练语言模型只接受文本 token。将 EHR 序列化为文本会拉长序列长度并冗余编码结构信息。核心难点在于临床词表呈长尾分布，稀有事件的观测样本过少，难以可靠地学习其事件向量。

Method: 提出 EHRAdapt 适配器，将元组直接映射到冻结 LLM 的嵌入空间：模态使用可学习嵌入，时间间隔通过可学习注意力偏置注入，事件编码使用专属向量。事件向量表示为"语义先验 + 证据残差"之和：先验为生物医学语言模型对事件临床描述的冻结嵌入，经共享可学习投影映射到模型输入空间，在观测稀缺时提供临床语义；残差为可学习的低秩事件特定修正，随证据累积逐步细化。在约 400 万患者记录上对三个冻结主干（OLMo2 1B、Llama3.2 1B、OLMo2 7B）做继续预训练，仅训练适配器。

Result: 在全部三个主干上，完整适配器在留出集的下一次事件预测中均优于所有消融版本。移除语义路径对稀有事件的损害是最频繁事件的十倍以上；移除残差路径虽降低整体预测性能，却提升了最稀有事件的表现。在需上报传染病与症候群下游分类任务上，EHRAdapt 优于基于文本的 LLM 和基于计数的基线，且两条路径均改善稀有疾病判别。

Conclusion: 语义先验与证据残差两条路径扮演互补角色，该互补性只有在按事件频率细分结果时才能显现，而非平均值所能揭示。

Abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) encode clinical histories as (time, modality, code) tuples, whereas pretrained language models expect text tokens. Serializing them as text inflates sequence length and redundantly encodes structure. We introduce EHRAdapt, an adapter that maps tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space. Modality receives a learned embedding, time gaps enter through learned attention biases, and event codes receive dedicated vectors. Learning event vectors is the central challenge: clinical vocabularies are long-tailed, leaving rare events too few observations for reliable estimates. EHRAdapt therefore represents each event vector as the sum of a semantic prior and an evidence residual. The prior is a frozen embedding of the event's clinical description from a biomedical language model trained on clinical ontologies, mapped into the model's input space by a shared learned projection, so it supplies clinical meaning even when observations are scarce. The residual, a learned low-rank event-specific correction, refines it as evidence accumulates. We run continued pretraining on about 4 million patients' records with three frozen LLM backbones (OLMo2 1B, Llama3.2 1B, and OLMo2 7B), training only the adapter (0.1--0.6% of all parameters). The full adapter outperforms all ablations in held-out next-event prediction on every backbone. Removing the semantic pathway hurts rare events over ten times more than the most frequent ones, whereas removing the residual hurts overall prediction but improves it for the rarest events. On reportable infectious-disease and syndromic downstream classification tasks, EHRAdapt outperforms text-based LLM and count-based baselines, and both pathways improve rare-disease discrimination. The two pathways therefore play complementary roles, visible only when results are broken down by event frequency rather than averaged.

</details>


### [1648] [Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation. Preliminary Results](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34024)
*Alfredo Madrid-García,Beatriz Merino-Barbancho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Jev 1.13 在四项医学基准上与 GPT-6 Sol 对比：研究摘要类问答准确率相当，但考试题与复杂诊断病例明显更低，须按任务验证后方可用于临床。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev 属于非生成式"系统一"模型，只能对预定义选项赋概率、无法回答选项之外的问题，其在医学问答与病例诊断推理上的准确性和校准性此前未知，需要量化评估。

Method: 在 MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ 与 NEJM Case Challenges 四个医学基准上评估 Jev 1.13，以 GPT-6 Sol（含/不含 medium 推理）为参照。主要结局为 top-1 准确率；次要结局为校准性、选择性预测与不可回答问题的识别。共 8,469 次请求。

Result: 全部请求均返回有效答案。PubMedQA 上 Jev 与 GPT-6 Sol（medium 推理）相当（78.4% vs 78.2%）；MetaMedQA 较低（74.8% vs 82.7%）；DiagnosisArena-MCQ（59.8% vs 82.4%）与 NEJM 病例（61.8% vs 82.4%）差距更大。MetaMedQA 上 Jev 校准最好（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），概率≥0.9 的答案（占 52.9%）准确率 93.4%，但 GPT-6 Sol 在接受相近比例问题时准确率相当。DiagnosisArena-MCQ 上 Jev 概率区分度差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768）。162 道正确选项为"我不知道或无法回答"的题目中，Jev 仅 10.5% 选中该选项（GPT-6 Sol 8.6%）。中位延迟 0.27–0.31 s，2,823 题总花费 0.08 美元。

Conclusion: Jev 快速且低成本，在研究摘要类任务上与前沿大模型准确率相近，但在考试题上更低、在复杂诊断病例上明显更低；临床使用前必须进行任务特定验证。

Abstract: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.

</details>


### [1649] [Large Language Models for Structured Clinical Data Analysis: Dual-Agent Grounding and Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34039)
*Erfan D. Dehkalani,Seetha Shankaran,Abbot R. Laptook,C. Michael Cotten,P. Ellen Grant,Yangming Ou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CLEAR-Med 是一个双智能体框架，用于结构化临床数据的自然语言分析，将基于 SQL 的调用与独立验证分离，实现可追溯、可失败关闭的分析流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化临床数据的自然语言分析需要数值结论可追溯、可验证，且不确定情形能安全退出（fail closed），而单一智能体直接生成答案缺乏可靠接地与独立校验机制。

Method: 采用双智能体架构：调用智能体将问题翻译为可执行 SQL，保留已执行查询与数据库结果并生成草稿；确定性检查与跨提供方、独立调用的验证智能体随后接受草稿、请求一次有界修复或弃权。系统被形式化为有界选择性流水线，并在含 532 例去标识化婴儿记录、约 1,300 个变量的 21 中心新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病协调数据表上，用 25 条查询的开发基准评估配置、可扩展性及调用智能体的准确性与一致性。

Result: CLEAR-Med 完成全部六种标称可扩展性配置（含 500×1300）。25 条查询重复 5 次共 125 次回答中，调用智能体正确 83 次（66.4%；查询聚类自助法 95% CI 48.0–83.2%），而未接地 ChatGPT 基线仅 15/125（12.0%；95% CI 3.2–22.4%），配对提升 54.4 个百分点（95% CI 36.8–72.0%）。

Conclusion: CLEAR-Med 提供了结构化临床数据可追溯分析的通用架构：数值性主张始终链接到已执行的 SQL，未解决案例可失败关闭。本轮实验表征了系统配置与可扩展性及调用智能体准确性，形式化分析确立了完整控制流的编码属性保证；验证与弃权阶段的前瞻性全流水线评估是后续工作。

Abstract: Objective: To develop and characterize CLEAR-Med, a dual-agent framework for natural-language analysis of structured clinical data that separates SQL-based invocation from independent validation. Methods: CLEAR-Med uses one agent to translate a question into executable Structured Query Language (SQL), retain the executed query and database result, and produce a draft. Deterministic checks and a separately invoked cross-provider Validation Agent then accept the draft, request one bounded repair, or abstain. We formalized the system as a bounded selective pipeline and evaluated CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability, and the Invocation Agent's accuracy and consistency on a 25-query development benchmark, using a harmonized 21-site neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy table containing 532 de-identified infant records and approximately 1,300 variables. Results: CLEAR-Med completed all six nominal scalability configurations, including 500x1300. Across 25 development-benchmark queries repeated five times, the Invocation Agent answered 83 of 125 responses correctly (66.4%; query-cluster bootstrap 95% CI, 48.0-83.2%), compared with 15 of 125 (12.0%; 95% CI, 3.2-22.4%) for the ungrounded ChatGPT baseline, a paired improvement of 54.4 percentage points (95% CI, 36.8-72.0%). Conclusion: CLEAR-Med provides a general architecture for traceable analysis of structured clinical data: numerical claims remain linked to executed SQL, and unresolved cases can fail closed. The reported experiments characterize CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability and the Invocation Agent's accuracy, while the formal analysis establishes the encoded-property guarantee of the complete control flow; a prospective full-pipeline evaluation of the validation and abstention stages is the next stage of this work.

</details>


### [1650] [Thinking Outside the Box: Retention and Transmission of Information in Sliding-Window KV Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34049)
*Timothy DeLise,Seth Cromelin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过五个开源权重模型（Qwen、Llama、Mistral、Muse Glimmer）实验，考察滑动窗口KV推理中，窗口外信息能否通过滚动KV缓存持续存在并用于检索。结果显示保留已计算状态比重新计算固定窗口的检索效果更好，且Muse Glimmer与Mistral 7B表现出最强的"潜在信息中继"能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 滑动窗口KV推理可在不额外训练的情况下应用于预训练因果Transformer，内存固定。但由于缓存状态在早期token上下文中计算，可能携带超出当前窗口的信息并传递给后续状态，这一潜在现象是否可被利用尚不明确，因此需要实验探究。

Method: 使用五个开源权重模型（涵盖Qwen、Llama、Mistral、Muse Glimmer）进行系列实验：对比保留先前已计算状态与从原始token重新计算最终固定窗口的检索表现；测量该效应的延伸范围，即源token离开缓存后信息能否恢复。

Result: 保留先前计算状态在测试模型上均改善检索效果；Muse Glimmer与Mistral 7B的潜在信息中继最强，即使相关源token已离开缓存仍能恢复信息；这两个模型在其公开架构中均采用滑动窗口注意力。

Conclusion: 窗口外信息可经滚动KV缓存持续并具备检索价值；滑动窗口注意力架构与更强的信息保留存在关联，提示用滑动窗口训练可能促进更可靠的信息保持，但该关联仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Sliding-window KV inference refers to processing a sequence incrementally while retaining only a fixed-size cache of recent key and value states. It can be applied to pretrained causal transformers at inference time without additional training, while its KV-cache memory remains fixed as more tokens are processed. Because cached states are computed in the context of earlier tokens, they may carry information from beyond the current window and transmit it to later states. This study presents a series of experiments using five open-weight models spanning Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Muse Glimmer. We investigate whether information originating outside the immediate context window can persist through a rolling KV cache and remain useful for retrieval. Initial results show that retaining previously computed states improves retrieval across the models tested compared with recomputing the final fixed window from raw tokens. We then measure how far this effect extends and find that Muse Glimmer and Mistral 7B show the strongest \emph{latent information relay}: they can recover information even after the relevant source tokens have left the cache. Both models incorporate sliding-window attention in their published architectures, an association that motivates testing whether training with sliding windows promotes more reliable information retention.

</details>


### [1651] [Towards Certificate-Driven Software Porting: A Self-Improving Agentic Harness for Scientific Program Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34069)
*Piyush Jha,Aishik Ghosh,Vijay Ganesh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出证书驱动进化搜索（CDES），通过对失败候选施加可执行限制来避免重复错误，成功将两个Geant4粒子模拟函数从CPU翻译到GPU，获得13.78x与23.54x加速，证书反馈使通过正确性检查的候选比例从55%提升到90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型科学代码库的升级与重写长期是重大难题。基于大语言模型的进化搜索虽可用于移植和加速遗留代码，但仅在提示中加入修复反馈无法阻止后续候选重复相同错误。

Method: 提出证书驱动进化搜索（CDES）：从失败候选中提取可执行的限制条件，记录为“假设证书、检查器证据、经论证的限制”；其控制逻辑通过拒绝、回溯与定向修复来强制执行这些限制，同时保留兼容性编辑。将CDES应用于Geant4工具包中两个粒子模拟函数的CPU到GPU翻译，并用结合形式化检查、数值比较、物理检查与GPU安全性测试的评测框架进行验证。

Result: 生成的实现相比CPU代码在函数级取得13.78x和23.54x加速（含数据转换与传输）；其中一个函数的GPU吞吐量超出专家实现14.9%，在组合互补组件时达到16.1%。在执行设置下的消融实验中，证书反馈将通过必需正确性检查的候选比例从55%提升至90%。

Conclusion: 将失败经验形式化为可执行的“证书”并对进化搜索过程施加强制约束，能有效避免错误重复，显著提升大型科学代码自动迁移与GPU加速的候选正确率与性能。

Abstract: The upgrade and rewriting of large scientific codebases has traditionally been a major challenge. While evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can port and accelerate legacy code, repair feedback in prompts alone does not prevent subsequent candidates from repeating the same errors. We introduce Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search (CDES), which extends evolutionary search with enforceable restrictions derived from failed candidates, recorded as certificates of assumptions, checker evidence, and justified restrictions. Its control logic enforces these restrictions through rejection, backtracking, and targeted repair while preserving compatible edits. We apply CDES to CPU-to-GPU translation of two particle-simulation functions from the Geant4 toolkit, evaluated with a harness that goes beyond unit tests to combine formal checks, numerical comparisons, physics checks, and GPU safety tests. Generated implementations achieve 13.78x and 23.54x function-level speedups over CPU code, including data conversion and transfers; for one function, GPU throughput exceeds an expert implementation by 14.9%, reaching 16.1% when complementary components are combined. In an ablation over execution settings, certificate feedback increases the fraction of candidates passing required correctness checks from 55% to 90%.

</details>


### [1652] [PhysFieldBench: Can Multimodal Models Understand Physical Fields?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34072)
*Yuezhou Ma,Huikun Weng,Jialong Wu,Chenyi Zhao,Hang Zhou,Haonan Shangguan,Jianmin Wang,Mingsheng Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出PhysFieldBench基准（24任务、1160样本），评估MLLMs对连续物理场的推断能力。结果显示零样本性能低（最佳仅29.3），专用ViT明显更优，错误主要源于视觉模式遗漏与视觉-物理映射错误；对比后训练策略发现答案监督整体最优但迁移弱，CoT+RL泛化最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs被视为科学与工程智能体的核心组件，但其解读物理场的能力尚不明确。现有物理基准多聚焦教科书式解题或直觉物理推理，无法回答MLLMs能否从连续场观测中推断有物理意义的信息。

Method: 构建PhysFieldBench基准，覆盖受控方程场、模拟物理场与观测物理场，包含24个任务、1160个评测样例，考察三类推断：识别物理机制、比较潜在控制变量、预测结果属性。对代表性开源与闭源MLLMs进行零样本评测，并与任务专用有监督ViT对比；通过结构化自我解释分析诊断错误来源；比较监督微调（仅最终答案或思维链监督）与强化学习的后训练效果及跨任务泛化。

Result: 零样本性能普遍偏低：最佳模型机会归一化得分29.3，部分开源模型接近随机水平；任务专用有监督ViT显著更优，说明输入含可学习物理信息。错误主要归因于漏检视觉模式与错误的视觉到物理映射。后训练方面，最终答案监督整体最佳但迁移效果较弱；思维链监督后再进行强化学习获得最佳泛化性能。

Conclusion: 要让MLLMs在科学与工程工作流中可靠解读物理场，需重点提升视觉到物理的接地能力与跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly envisioned as core components of scientific and engineering agents, yet their ability to interpret physical fields remains poorly understood. Existing physics benchmarks largely emphasize textbook problem solving or intuitive physical reasoning, leaving open whether MLLMs can infer physically meaningful information from continuous field observations. We introduce PhysFieldBench, a benchmark comprising 24 tasks and 1,160 evaluation examples across controlled equation fields, simulated physical fields, and observed physical fields. The tasks assess three forms of inference: identifying physical mechanisms, comparing latent control variables, and predicting outcome properties. Across representative open-source and proprietary MLLMs, zero-shot performance is low: the best model achieves a chance-normalized score of 29.3, while several open-source models remain near chance. In contrast, a task-specific supervised vision transformer performs substantially better, demonstrating that the inputs contain learnable physical information. To diagnose these failures, a structured self-explanation analysis attributes most errors to missed visual patterns and incorrect visual-to-physical mappings. Further, to explore whether post-training can improve physical inference and generalize to unseen tasks, we compare supervised fine-tuning with final answers or chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning. Final-answer supervision performs best overall but transfers less effectively, whereas reinforcement learning after chain-of-thought supervision achieves the best generalization. Together, these findings highlight the need to improve visual-to-physical grounding and cross-task generalization for MLLMs to reliably interpret physical fields in scientific and engineering workflows.

</details>


### [1653] [GenoMorph: Pathway-Grounded Genomic Disease Reasoning via Adaptive Latent Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34079)
*Tanmoy Kanti Halder,Akash Ghosh,Arijit Roy,Sriparna Saha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 GenoMorph 多模态基因组推理框架，将疾病预测从基因-疾病关联记忆转向基于通路的推理，在匿名化 KEGG 基准上取得 0.9465 F1，验证了通路推理的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在基因组疾病推断中主要依赖记忆化的基因-疾病关联，而非理解生物学通路。这种捷径学习削弱了模型的鲁棒性与泛化性，且在分子标识符不可用时失效。

Method: GenoMorph 耦合四类组件：冻结的 DNA 基础模型、问题条件化的交叉注意力融合、自适应潜在推理（LatentSp）、残差推理门用于迭代注入基因组证据，以及由层次最优传输（OT）正则化的拒绝采样微调。模型将基因组序列表征与潜在通路动态对齐，而非学习直接的基因-疾病映射；LatentSp 依据推理置信度动态分配计算量。

Result: 加权 F1 从 BioReason 的 0.7863 提升至 0.9412；结合拒绝采样微调与 LatentSp 后达 0.9725，延迟降低近 60%。在匿名化 KEGG 基准上 F1 达 0.9465，显著优于既有系统。

Conclusion: 准确的疾病预测可源于通路推理而非记忆化的基因-疾病关联，匿名化基准有效消除了记忆捷径，验证了框架的鲁棒性与泛化性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in biological reasoning; however, genomic disease inference remains largely dependent on memorized gene-disease associations rather than understanding biological pathways. This shortcut learning undermines robustness and generalization, and breaks down when molecular identifiers are unavailable. We present GenoMorph, a multimodal genomic reasoning framework that shifts disease prediction from associative gene-disease mapping toward pathway-grounded reasoning. GenoMorph couples a frozen DNA foundation model with question-conditioned cross-attention fusion, self-adaptive latent reasoning (LatentSp), a residual reasoning gate for iterative genomic evidence reinjection, and rejection sampling fine-tuning regularized by hierarchical optimal transport (OT). Rather than learning direct gene-disease mappings, GenoMorph aligns genomic sequence representations with latent pathway dynamics, enabling reasoning trajectories that follow molecular interactions before producing disease predictions. LatentSp dynamically allocates computation according to reasoning confidence, reducing unnecessary reasoning steps and improving inference efficiency. We further construct an anonymized benchmark from the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), replacing every gene and molecular identifier with anonymous symbols while preserving sequences and pathway topology, thereby removing memorization shortcuts. GenoMorph raises the weighted F1 from 0.7863 (BioReason) to 0.9412, and rejection sampling fine-tuning with self-adaptive latent reasoning pushes it to 0.9725 while cutting latency nearly 60%. On the anonymized benchmark it reaches 0.9465 F1, substantially outperforming prior systems and confirming that accurate disease prediction can arise from pathway reasoning rather than memorized gene-disease associations.

</details>


### [1654] [A Differentiable Optimization Framework for Registering Sequential Bounding Boxes with Point Cloud Stream](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34103)
*Xuesong Li,Jinguang Tong,Jie Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练联合配准方法：将时序平滑约束并入3D框配准目标，用L-BFGS联合求解全部位姿，但优势随可见性下降而衰减，在近侧视与射线投射仿真下甚至消失或略负。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序精化3D框需同时满足几何精度（高IoU）与时序一致性（低粗糙度），且最好无需训练数据。常规做法将二者解耦：逐帧独立配准后再用Kalman-RTS或Savitzky-Golay滤波平滑。平滑会把框推离几何最优且不再重新优化，等于用精度换平滑。

Method: 将时序平滑约束显式折入免训练的配准目标函数，用L-BFGS对所有位姿进行联合优化，而非"配准+后处理平滑"的两段式流程。把可见性作为实验变量系统研究，并定位方法失效的边界；进一步将失效归因于单一项——朝向对齐项把yaw绑定到估计速度上。最后给出一条无需真值的规则来选择时间尺度。

Result: 可见性充分的轨迹上收益显著：在低粗糙度预算内，联合目标在多种子配对统计上优于两种事后平滑器，并在同等精度下把粗糙度相对逐帧配准降低数倍。随视角单向化，优势单调衰减，近侧视物体上几乎为零；在具有距离相关密度与自车运动的射线投射仿真中略为负值，即紧粗糙度预算下解耦流程反而更优。失效边界可追溯至朝向对齐项：一旦速度估计有噪声，yaw与速度的绑定即失效。无需真值的规则可将每条轨迹控制在粗糙度预算内。

Conclusion: 联合时序配准优于事后平滑，但其收益本质依赖于观测可见性；收益的消失可由朝向-速度耦合项解释。可见性应作为明确的实验变量，并可用无真值规则自适应选择时间尺度，使轨迹始终满足粗糙度约束。

Abstract: Refining a sequence of coarse 3D bounding boxes against a LiDAR point-cloud stream demands tracks that are geometrically accurate (high IoU) and temporally coherent (low roughness), preferably without training data. The usual recipe keeps the two concerns apart: register each frame independently, then smooth the trajectory afterwards with a Kalman~RTS or Savitzky--Golay filter. Smoothing displaces boxes from a geometric optimum and never re-optimises, so it trades accuracy for smoothness. We instead fold the temporal smoothness constraint into a training-free registration objective and solve for all poses jointly with L-BFGS. The payoff depends on how well the object is seen. On well-observed tracks it is large: within the low-roughness budget, the joint objective beats both post-hoc smoothers on paired multi-seed statistics and cuts roughness several-fold relative to frame-wise registration at matched accuracy. Treating visibility as an experimental variable exposes the limit. The advantage decays monotonically as views become one-sided, until it is indistinguishable from zero for near-edge-on objects and slightly negative under a ray-cast simulator with range-dependent density and ego motion, where the decoupled pipeline is in fact ahead at tight roughness budgets. We locate that boundary and trace it to one term: orientation alignment ties yaw to the estimated velocity and fails once that estimate is noisy. A ground-truth-free rule can choose the temporal scale and keep every track inside the roughness budget.

</details>


### [1655] [GUITAR: Structured Failure Diagnosis of GUI Agents via State Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34113)
*Shaoqing Zhang,Kehai Chen,Xuefeng Bai,Zhuosheng Zhang,Pengfei Zhang,Yang Xiang,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GUITAR，一种以状态为中心的结构化失败分析框架，用状态转移图（STG）将视觉多样屏幕映射为共享功能状态，诊断GUI智能体失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI智能体评估依赖step accuracy，将每个屏幕独立对待，忽略GUI环境结构，导致两大盲点：功能等价屏幕被孤立评估而掩盖系统性失败模式；长尾GUI分布使稀有但关键屏幕上的失败被标准指标隐藏。

Method: GUITAR对状态与转移进行结构化失败分析：通过将视觉多样的屏幕映射到共享功能状态，构建状态转移图（STG），从而定位跨屏幕的系统性失败瓶颈。

Result: 在AndroidControl和Mind2Web的8个智能体、6个任务上：60.4%的失败集中在20%的状态中，错误被定位到少量瓶颈；瓶颈定向引导使SR提升2.8%，在三折轨迹留出评估下对7个智能体保持平均1.88%的增益，且STG可全自动构建。

Conclusion: 结构感知评估在所评测的移动与Web任务中具有诊断价值和可操作性，能识别并缓解GUI智能体失败瓶颈。

Abstract: Understanding where and why Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents fail is essential for building more reliable systems, yet current evaluation relies on step accuracy, a metric that treats each screen independently and overlooks the underlying structure of GUI environments. This leads to two critical blind spots: (1) functionally equivalent screens are evaluated in isolation, obscuring systematic failure patterns across shared screens; and (2) the long-tailed GUI distribution renders failures on rare but critical screens invisible under standard metrics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{GUITAR}, a state-centric diagnostic framework that performs structured failure analysis over both states and transitions, using a State Transition Graph (STG) by mapping visually diverse screens to shared functional states. Across 8 agents and 6 tasks from AndroidControl and Mind2Web, GUITAR reveals that 60.4\% of failures occur in 20\% of states, localizing errors to a small set of bottlenecks. Bottleneck-targeted guidance improves SR by 2.8\% and retains a 1.88\% average gain across 7 agents under three-fold trajectory-held-out evaluation with fully automatic STGs. These findings demonstrate the diagnostic and actionable value of structure-aware evaluation within the evaluated mobile and web tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/sqzhang-lazy/GUITAR

</details>


### [1656] [From Attack Success to Attack Severity: Counterfactual Memory Attacks on LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34132)
*Mingxi Zou,Langzhang Liang,Zhuo Wang,Yiyang Zhao,Lizhen Qu,Zenglin Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出反事实记忆遗憾（CMR）作为持久记忆攻击严重度的形式化目标，并设计MemHarm，在预定稀疏语义编辑类内通过离线配对损失反馈筛选攻击候选，从而在保留成功率增益的同时显著放大下游损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益依赖持久记忆以实现长时程与个性化行为，但这也形成了可被恶意记忆写入持续影响的通道。既有持久记忆攻击多以"是否成功"为评价标准，忽略了攻击成功后在持久状态下造成的下游后果差异，即严重度未被作为独立目标研究。

Method: 将严重度形式化为反事实记忆遗憾（CMR），即相对于干净记忆的期望下游损失成对增量。提出MemHarm：预先声明有限的稀疏、具语义基础（grounded）的编辑类；通过正常智能体记忆接口评估候选；利用离线配对损失反馈进行选择；并对在该编辑类内已解析的选择给出认证。

Result: 与以攻击成功率优化为目标相比，CMR引导的选择在获得更大下游损失的同时保留了大部分成功率增益。在两个智能体基准与多种记忆设计下，在相同支持集上，MemHarm取得所评估通用攻击中最高的CMR点估计。因子移除干预将危害归因于所选语义因子，原生智能体部署验证了"写入—新进程"攻击路径。

Conclusion: 攻击的严重度应与成功率区分对待，可通过CMR在有限语义编辑类内被可靠地优化与认证；MemHarm在跨基准、跨记忆设计下均优于通用攻击，并能通过因子移除与原生部署两条途径验证因果归因与攻击可行性。

Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent memory for long-horizon and personalized behavior, they can retain and reuse information across interactions, but this also creates a lasting channel through which malicious memory writes can influence future behavior. Persistent-memory attacks are typically evaluated by whether they succeed, yet successful attacks can leave persistent states with substantially different downstream consequences. We study this severity as a distinct attack-design objective and formalize it with counterfactual memory regret (CMR), the paired increase in expected downstream loss relative to clean memory. We introduce MemHarm, which predeclares a finite class of sparse, grounded semantic edits, evaluates candidates through the normal agent memory interface using offline paired-loss feedback, and certifies resolved selections within that class. Compared with attack-success optimization, CMR-guided selection produces substantially larger downstream loss while retaining most of the success-rate gain. Across two agent benchmarks and diverse memory designs, MemHarm attains the highest CMR point estimates among the evaluated general attacks on identical support. Factor-removal interventions link this harm to the selected semantic factor, and native-agent deployments verify the write-to-fresh-process attack path.

</details>


### [1657] [StateGuard: Analytical-State Management with Validity-Aware Intervention for Long-Horizon Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34134)
*Wenle Liao,Zhao Wang,Jingchao Zhang,Jiajie Jin,Yimeng Xu,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 StateGuard：面向长程数据智能体的分析状态有效性管理框架，通过状态图外化分析进展并结合验证与分层干预，减少陈旧工件继承导致的错误传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在自动化数据分析中能力增强，任务趋向长程、多阶段。分析过程中约束、变量与结论隐式埋在交互历史里，智能体难以追踪哪些分析工件在长跨度与依赖变化下仍然有效，导致陈旧工件被静默继承并将错误传播到下游阶段。

Method: StateGuard 将演进中的分析进展外化为状态图，包含约束、版本化变量、中间结论与跨状态关系，把每个状态视为可执行、可验证、可追踪的对象而非纯文本记忆；通过基于证据的验证与分层干预维护状态有效性。训练上先提出 Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision，用反事实运行时合成构建 3K 状态中心轨迹进行微调，以支持状态维护、验证与修复；再采用 Validity-Guided Policy Optimization，利用运行时有效性证据为协议正确性、状态落地与干预质量提供细粒度学习信号。

Result: 在三个多样化的长程数据分析基准上，StateGuard 持续提升数据智能体性能，同时降低依赖导致的下游错误传播。

Conclusion: 结果体现了显式分析状态管理对可靠长程数据分析的优势。

Abstract: LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities in automated data analysis and are increasingly moving toward long-horizon, multi-stage analytical workflows. However, as the analytical process evolves, constraints, variables, and conclusions remain implicitly embedded in interaction histories, making it difficult for agents to track which analytical artifacts remain valid over increasingly long horizons and changing dependencies. Consequently, stale artifacts may be silently inherited, propagating errors to downstream stages. To address this challenge, we propose StateGuard, an analytical-state validity management framework for long-horizon data agents. StateGuard externalizes evolving analytical progress into a state graph containing constraints, versioned variables, intermediate conclusions, and cross-state relations, treating each state as an executable, verifiable, and traceable object rather than textual memory alone. StateGuard maintains state validity through evidence-grounded verification and hierarchical intervention. To equip StateGuard with these capabilities, we first introduce Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision, which constructs 3K state-centric trajectories through counterfactual runtime synthesis to fine-tune StateGuard for state maintenance, verification, and repair. We then apply Validity-Guided Policy Optimization, using runtime validity evidence to provide fine-grained learning signals for protocol correctness, state grounding, and intervention quality. Experiments on three diverse long-horizon data-analysis benchmarks show that StateGuard consistently improves data-agent performance while reducing dependency-induced downstream error propagation, demonstrating the advantages of explicit analytical-state management for reliable long-horizon data analysis.

</details>


### [1658] [Evo2Team: When Do Evolved Skills Transfer? From Selection to Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34135)
*Renxiang Wang,Jiaming Cui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究跨多智能体系统的技能迁移：在Count-Frequency与AgentsNet中，用4--32个智能体团队及GPT/Qwen模型阶梯评估路由与通信技能的来源进化与迁移，提出Evo2Team选择、适配并确认源技能，28个迁移方向中20个达到正迁移标准，但迁移效果取决于智能体的实际执行行为而非仅技能选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帮助一个多智能体系统的技能库未必改变另一个系统的行为，迁移规则只有在目标智能体成功执行时才有效。因此需要研究技能迁移是否能真正转化为目标团队的行动与任务收益，而非停留在技能选择或确认层面。

Method: 在Count-Frequency与AgentsNet任务上研究路由与通信技能，使用4--32个智能体团队及GPT、Qwen模型阶梯；先让来源进化同时满足质量、成本、模型层级与确认目标；再评估Evo2Team（为目标团队选择、适配并确认源技能），并与六个冻结选择器在28个迁移方向上对比；通过记录执行、任务到达情况及部署成本与质量进行分析。

Result: 来源进化在16个设置中的14个满足联合目标；Evo2Team在每个方向的目标侧探索成本均低于进化新目标技能库；28个留出结果中20个满足正迁移标准（含3个节省的诊断测试）；选择本身无法解释结果，KNN与CORAL在两个AgentsNet方向选择不同技能库却产生相同记录执行；Evo2Team改变执行时收益可达多任务（如某Count-Frequency方向较KNN改善32个任务中的28个）；七个正AgentsNet结果节省6.1--14.6\%部署成本，仅在15个任务中的3--6个使用迁移技能；五个早期接受方向中，使用迁移技能的22条任务记录全部通过三次固定图确认，但四条在新图的记录执行中失败。

Conclusion: 技能迁移必须通过智能体实际采取的行动、这些行动所到达的任务，以及最终部署的质量与成本来评估；仅凭技能选择或静态确认不足以判定迁移成功。

Abstract: A skill bank that helps one multi-agent system may leave another's behavior unchanged. A transferred rule helps only when target agents act on it successfully. We study this path for routing and communication skills in Count-Frequency and AgentsNet, using teams of 4--32 agents and GPT and Qwen model ladders. Source evolution meets a joint quality, cost, model-tier, and confirmation goal in 14 of 16 settings. We then evaluate Evo2Team, which selects, adapts, and confirms source skills for the target team, alongside six frozen selectors across 28 transfer directions. Evo2Team's target-side exploration cost is below that of evolving a new target bank in every direction, even when reused reference evaluations are charged once. Twenty of 28 held-out outcomes meet the positive-transfer criterion, including three saved diagnostic tests. Selection alone does not explain these outcomes: KNN and CORAL choose different banks in two AgentsNet directions but produce identical recorded executions. When Evo2Team changes execution, gains can reach many tasks, as in a Count-Frequency direction that improves 28 of 32 tasks over KNN. Seven positive AgentsNet outcomes save 6.1--14.6\% in deployment cost while using transferred skills on only three to six of fifteen tasks. In five earlier accepted directions, all 22 task records using transferred skills pass three fixed-graph confirmations, but four fail in recorded executions on new graphs. Graphs and model responses change together in this comparison. These results show that skill transfer must be assessed through the actions agents take, the tasks those actions reach, and the quality and cost of the final deployment.

</details>


### [1659] [Waggle: Learning One Anonymous Local Law for Self-Organizing LLM Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34136)
*Mingxi Zou,Wei Zhu,Zhuo Wang,Langzhang Liang,Zhiwen Tang,Yinghui Xu,Zenglin Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出将多智能体协作的学习目标从全局组织（角色、层级、拓扑）转向可复用的局部法则 Waggle，并设计 SCD 训练方法，使同一法则在群体规模与交互条件变化下保持有效、可迁移并支持在线重组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统多依赖显式学习的角色、层级、路由策略或通信拓扑，这类全局组织在智能体数量或交互条件变化时需重新定义，缺乏可复用性与适应性。

Method: Waggle：共享匿名策略，作用于有界局部视野，联合选择任务动作、语义通信与局部承诺更新；通过重复执行同一法则使协调自发形成、维持并在线重组。学习采用 Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD)，结合匿名轨道一致性与基于 rollout 的下一局部协调场预测，且不增加推理期组件。

Result: 在多种协调设置下，同一学习法则在群体规模与交互预算变化时仍有效，保留超过 96% 的基座专属 oracle 质量，并支持无需再训练迁移；SCD 在出现反证后进一步改善重组能力。

Conclusion: LLM 智能体组织可通过反复执行一个学到的局部法则而自发涌现并自适应，无需显式全局组织设计。

Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly collaborate on complex tasks, how to organize their interactions becomes a central design question. Existing multi-agent systems typically learn or adapt explicit roles, hierarchies, routing policies, or communication topologies. We shift the learning target to a reusable local law that can be shared across interchangeable agents and adapt coordination as populations or interaction conditions change, without redefining a global organization. We introduce Waggle, a shared anonymous policy over bounded local views that jointly selects task actions, semantic communication, and local commitment updates. Repeated execution of the same law allows coordination to form, persist, and reorganize online without explicit roles or global topology. To learn this law across interchangeable agents and evolving coordination, we develop Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD), combining anonymous-orbit consistency with rollout-grounded prediction of the next local coordination field, with no added inference-time components. Across diverse coordination settings, the same learned law remains effective as populations and interaction budgets change, retains over 96% of substrate-specific oracle quality, and transfers without retraining; SCD further improves reorganization after counterevidence. Together, these results show that LLM-agent organization can emerge and adapt through repeated execution of a learned local law.

</details>


### [1660] [You Can't Have It Both Ways: Concept Entanglement Limits Diffusion Model Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34137)
*Yian Wang,Ali Ebrahimpour-Boroojeny,Hari Sundaram,Varun Chandrasekaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示文本到图像扩散模型中概念遗忘的失败根源在于概念表示的几何结构，证明目标概念与他概念的重叠量下界约束了稳健擦除对邻近概念的损害，并据此提出应以帕累托前沿评估遗忘方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法要么在间接提示下发生泄漏，要么明显损害其他概念，作者希望说明这些失败模式并非源于特定算法，而是源于概念表示本身的几何结构。

Method: 将概念形式化为激活空间中的区域，从理论上证明目标概念与其他概念的重叠量下界约束了任何稳健擦除必须造成的损害，且该权衡随重叠程度线性增长；并在十三种遗忘方法及SDXL、FLUX模型上进行实证验证，引入重叠度量与κ缩放分析。

Result: 在十三种遗忘方法中无一能同时实现强擦除与强邻近概念保持：STEREO几乎消除间接泄漏但使邻近概念生成下降超过75%，稀疏推理时方法保持邻近概念却发生泄漏；损害随重叠度量单调增加（对STEREO如此），κ缩放现象在SDXL上复现，邻近选择性损害在FLUX上重现。

Conclusion: 对于相互纠缠的概念，"完美遗忘"是错误的优化目标，方法应在该定理所确立的帕累托前沿上进行评估。

Abstract: Concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress a target concept (e.g., \texttt{horse}) while preserving related but distinct content (e.g., \texttt{donkey}), yet existing methods either leak under indirect prompts or visibly degrade other concepts. We show that these failure modes stem from the geometry of concept representations rather than from any particular algorithm. Formalizing concepts as activation-space regions, we prove that the overlap between a target and other concepts lower-bounds the damage any robust erasure must inflict on them, with the trade-off scaling linearly in the degree of overlap. Across thirteen unlearning methods, including methods designed to preserve non-target concepts, no method achieves both strong erasure and strong neighbor preservation: STEREO nearly eliminates indirect leakage but cuts neighbor generation by more than 75\%, while sparse inference-time methods preserve neighbors but leak. Damage increases with our overlap measure, monotonically so for STEREO; the $κ$-scaling reproduces on SDXL, and neighbor-selective damage recurs on FLUX. Perfect unlearning is the wrong target for entangled concepts; methods should be evaluated on the Pareto frontier our theorem establishes.

</details>


### [1661] [Same Tasks, Different Apps: Why Mobile GUI Agents Fail to Generalize?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34139)
*Tien Tran,Namho Koh,Daiki E. Matsunaga,Ayush Jain,Kee Eung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AnyAppBench，一个类别受控的真实 Android 基准，用于评估移动 GUI 智能体在固定用户目标下的跨应用泛化能力，覆盖 10 个功能类别、100 个任务模板、520 个任务-应用对与 52 个应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多将同一任务仅在一个应用中测试，高分可能只反映智能体熟悉特定应用，而非真正理解任务；真实部署需要跨支持相同功能的不同应用工作。

Method: 构建类别受控的 live Android 基准 AnyAppBench，固定用户目标、跨应用配对任务；智能体从原始指令和与应用无关的子目标执行；由 VLM 评判器在固定失败分类体系下标注每次失败，并用人工标注衡量其可靠性；对 13 个智能体进行评测。

Result: 原应用上的成功无法可靠迁移到同目标的新应用；提供高层子目标分解仅带来小幅、依赖类别的变化，无法弥合差距；失败类型分布随目标界面而变化。

Conclusion: AnyAppBench 为推动移动 GUI 智能体稳健的真实世界部署提供了重要基础；代码、数据与排行榜见 https://anyappbench.github.io/。

Abstract: Mobile GUI agents deployed in real settings must work across different applications that support the same functionality. Most existing benchmarks test each task in only one app, so a high score can mean the agent understands the task, or only that it knows that particular app. We introduce AnyAppBench, a category-controlled live Android benchmark that evaluates cross-application generalization while keeping the user goal fixed. It spans 10 functional categories, 100 task templates, and 520 task--application pairs over 52 applications. Agents run from raw instructions and with app-independent sub-goals, and a VLM judge labels every failed run under a fixed failure taxonomy whose reliability is measured by human annotation. We find that, across 13 agents, success on the original application does not transfer reliably to new applications with the same goal. Furthermore, providing high-level sub-goal decomposition produces only small, category-dependent changes that do not close the gap, and the mix of failure types changes with the target interface. Based on those insights, we believe the AnyAppBench benchmark provides an important stepping stone toward robust real-world deployment of mobile GUI agents. Our code, data and the leaderboard can be found at the project website https://anyappbench.github.io/.

</details>


### [1662] [Self-Evolving Agents via Likelihood-Guided Tool-Space Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34151)
*Xuanqi Zhang,Ruinan Jin,Running Yang,Yuxuan Zhang,Minghui Chen,Wenlong Deng,Xiaoxiao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究"工具空间自演化"，提出 LOTS（Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring）：在模型参数固定的前提下，利用历史输出经验为每类重复任务维护持久化工具空间，通过衡量移除某工具观测输出后答案似然的变化来估计工具贡献并排序更新工具空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化智能体可不断改进行为，而工具定义了其与环境交互的可执行动作空间。但将完整工具库暴露给模型会引入大量无关上下文，损害工具使用决策。现有方法存在三点不足：(1) 输出无关的选择，主要依赖工具描述或模型先验而非观测到的工具输出；(2) 跨请求无状态，对每个请求独立选工具，未将历史输出经验整合为持久化的任务特定状态；(3) 推理成本高，对同一任务的后续请求反复进行搜索、排序或推理。

Method: LOTS 通过四项设计应对上述局限：输出感知的工具打分、持久化的任务特定工具空间、摊销式工具选择、以及可跨模型复用的配置。具体地，每次请求后保留模型生成的答案，通过移除某工具已观测输出后测量答案似然的变化来估计该工具的贡献；这些贡献在每类重复任务内聚合，用于对工具排序并更新该任务的持久化工具空间，且模型参数保持固定。

Result: 在三个基准上，LOTS 提升了任务表现，同时显著减少工具上下文。序列实验表明任务特定工具空间能够持续存在并随时间不断改进；跨模型实验表明学到的配置可迁移到不同模型。

Conclusion: 通过输出感知的打分与任务级持久化工具空间，LOTS 实现了低推理成本、持续演化和可跨模型迁移的工具空间自演化，验证了将历史输出经验沉淀为任务特定状态的有效性。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents can continually improve their behavior, while tools define the executable action space through which they interact with the environment. However, exposing the full tool library to model introduces substantial irrelevant context and can impair tool-use decisions. We study tool-space self-evolution, where each recurring task type maintains a persistent tool space which is constructed from accumulated output experience. We identify three limitations of existing methods: (1) output-unaware selection: they rely primarily on tool descriptions or model priors rather than observed tool outputs; (2) statelessness across request: they select tools independently for each request without consolidating prior output experience into persistent task-specific state; (3) inference cost: they repeatedly search, rank, or reason over candidate tools for subsequent requests of the same task. We address these limitations through output-aware tool scoring, persistent task-specific tool spaces, amortized tool selection, and reusable configurations across models. We introduce LOTS (Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring), which evolves an agent's tool space from accumulated output experience while keeping model parameters fixed. After each request, LOTS holds the model's generated answer and estimates each tool's contribution by measuring how much the answer likelihood changes when its observed output is removed. These contributions are aggregated within each recurring task to rank tools and update its persistent space. Across three benchmarks, LOTS improves task performance while substantially reducing tool context. More importantly, sequential experiments demonstrate that task-specific spaces persist and continue to improve over time, while cross-model experiments show that learned configurations transfer across different models.

</details>


### [1663] [TableSeek: Structure-Preserving Agentic Evidence Seeking over Heterogeneous Table Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34157)
*Jiaming Tian,Liyao Li,Wentao Ye,Haobo Wang,Lihua Yu,Zujie Ren,Gang Chen,Junbo Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出结构保持的智能体搜索框架 TableSeek，通过 LLM 智能体迭代追踪稀疏线索、检查模式保持的预览并在单元格/模式层面细化检索，在不依赖检索器训练或预计算语义索引的前提下，于异构表格基准上取得与强检索-重排流水线相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放域表格检索面临语义相关性误导问题：主题相似的表格可能缺失所需事实，携带答案的证据常限于少数单元格，且其含义依赖周边模式与表格上下文；异构模式、值格式与序列化方式进一步削弱一次性匹配的效果。

Method: TableSeek 采用结构保持的智能体搜索框架：不再对表格进行一次排序，而是由 LLM 智能体迭代地追踪稀疏线索、查看模式保持的预览、识别模式层与值层的不匹配并逐步细化调查；以单元格和模式作为证据锚点，同时保留完整表格作为证据单元，实现细粒度定位且不丢失解读与可答性判断所需的上下文。方法不依赖检索器训练或预计算语义索引。

Result: 在异构表格基准上，TableSeek 生成透明的证据寻求轨迹，端到端性能可与强检索-重排流水线竞争，且无需检索器训练或预计算语义索引。

Conclusion: 结果表明，主动的、结构保持的证据寻求是开放域表格检索的一种有前景的新范式。

Abstract: Open-domain table retrieval seeks tables that contain sufficient evidence for answering a question or verifying a claim. Yet semantic relevance is often misleading: topically similar tables may lack the required facts, while answer-bearing evidence is often confined to a few cells whose meaning depends on surrounding schema and table context. Heterogeneous schemas, value formats, and serializations further weaken one-shot matching.
  We present TableSeek, a structure-preserving agentic search framework for heterogeneous table corpora. Instead of ranking tables once, an LLM agent iteratively follows sparse clues, inspects schema-preserving previews, identifies schema- and value-level mismatches, and refines its investigation. TableSeek uses cells and schemas as evidence anchors while retaining complete tables as evidence units, enabling fine-grained localization without losing the context required for interpretation and answerability checking.
  Without relying on retriever training or a precomputed semantic index, TableSeek produces transparent evidence-seeking trajectories and achieves competitive end-to-end performance against strong retrieval-and-reranking pipelines on heterogeneous table benchmarks. These results suggest that active, structure-preserving evidence seeking is a promising paradigm for open-domain table retrieval.

</details>


### [1664] [RoutePrism: Tracing Construction Order Effects in Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34160)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoutePrism 诊断协议：用两种处理顺序从同一源池构建两次记忆，追踪源、编译上下文与答案差异，从而将顺序导致的偏差定位到记忆构建步骤，并验证被挤出的记录是否携带任务相关证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相同记录以不同顺序处理会丢弃不同证据，但仅靠最终答案准确率无法揭示改变了什么、是否重要。现有评估缺乏对记忆构建过程差异的定位与因果验证手段。

Method: RoutePrism 固定记录内容、时间戳、策略与答案模型，仅改变处理顺序，两次构建记忆并逐层对比源、编译上下文与答案；设计匹配的四条件干预：恢复被重排挤出的单条记录、替换为等长但不支持任务的记录等，以检验该记录是否携带任务相关证据。在 PersonaMem-32K（63 主查询、29 用户）与 470 道 LongMemEval-S 题目（历史跨 38–62 会话）上评估，并在五种答案模型上复现核心干预。

Result: 恢复单条被挤出记录可挽回超过 60 个百分点的准确率损失，而等长非支持记录替换无效。幸存者选择（簇保留哪条记录）是源级变化的主要驱动；不同记忆策略（压缩、有界近期、MemoChat 式摘要、A-MEM）在源、上下文与元数据层呈现不同失败特征。

Conclusion: 处理顺序通过幸存者选择显著影响记忆构建，进而影响下游答案；RoutePrism 可将此类差异定位并因果归因，为记忆策略提供分层失败诊断。

Abstract: Processing the same records in a different order can discard different evidence, yet endpoint accuracy alone cannot reveal what changed or whether it mattered. We introduce RoutePrism, a diagnostic protocol that builds memory twice from the same source pool in two processing orders, then traces which sources, compiled contexts, and answers differ. Because record content, timestamps, policy, and the answer model all stay fixed, any observed difference is localized to the memory construction step. A matched four-condition intervention tests whether a record displaced by reordering actually carried task-relevant evidence: restoring that single record recovers over 60 percentage points of lost accuracy, while substituting a non-supporting record of equal length does not. We evaluate the protocol on PersonaMem-32K (63 primary queries, 29 users) and 470 LongMemEval-S questions with histories spanning 38 to 62 sessions, replicating the core intervention across five answer models. Survivor selection, defined as the choice of which record a cluster retains, drives most source-level changes, while different memory policies (compaction, bounded recency, MemoChat-style summarization, A-MEM) produce distinct failure signatures at the source, context, and metadata layers.

</details>


### [1665] [ReplayLens: Auditing Agents' Use of Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34177)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ReplayLens黑盒审计方法，通过逐次改变存储历史中单一关系（分数归属、记录顺序、动作名称、键槽），测量智能体重放决策的变化，从关系层面揭示记忆依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体重用日志经验时，决策改变可能源于记录分数、动作名称或存储位置等多种关系，但标准记忆评测无法区分究竟哪种关系驱动了改变，缺乏关系级审计手段。

Method: ReplayLens为黑盒审计，每次仅改变存储历史中的一种关系并固定其余接口，共四种干预：结果重分配（交换分数与动作的对应）、配对搬运（将完整动作-分数对移至新记录槽）、一致重命名（同步重标记历史与菜单中的动作）、键槽重分配（同时改变分数归属与位置）。并以构造成对分离实验证明该审计的必要性。

Result: 在两个端点准确率相同的记忆写入者上，同一重放产生不同响应，说明传统评测无法分辨依赖关系；在LLM黑盒接口上，交换分数会改变决策而搬运完整配对不会，从而分离分数归属与记录顺序；有限记忆研究揭示端点比较遗漏的摄入顺序敏感性；顺序实验规划中，篡改历史分数会改变探索方向并降低最终效用；密封隐藏测试的代码调试智能体也呈相同模式。

Conclusion: ReplayLens提供关系级审计，可用于判断日志经验能否安全合并、重排或重建索引。

Abstract: When an agent reuses logged experience, a changed decision may reflect the recorded score, the action's name, or the record's position in storage. Standard memory evaluations do not reveal which relationship drives that change. We introduce ReplayLens, a black-box audit that changes one relationship in the stored history at a time, holds the remaining interface fixed, and measures the resulting decision. Four interventions target four relationships. Outcome reassignment swaps which scores belong to which actions. Pair transport moves intact action-score pairs to new record slots. Consistent renaming relabels actions in both history and menu. Key-slot reassignment changes both score attachment and position. A constructive separation shows why the audit is needed: two memory writers with identical endpoint accuracy respond differently to the same replay, so conventional evaluation cannot resolve the underlying dependence. On black-box LLM interfaces, swapping scores changes decisions while moving intact pairs does not, separating score attachment from record order. A bounded-memory study exposes ingestion-order sensitivity that endpoint comparison misses. In sequential experiment planning, altered historical scores redirect exploration and reduce final utility despite fresh measurements. A code-debugging agent with sealed hidden tests shows the same pattern outside model selection. ReplayLens provides a relationship-level audit for deciding whether logged experience can be merged, reordered, or reindexed safely.

</details>


### [1666] [Efficient Reasoning via Constrained Optimization in Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34181)
*Zhinan Hou,XingChen Li,Keyou You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架，将偏离有效推理区域的隐状态通过二次规划投影回集中区域，在减少token生成的同时保持甚至提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型存在"过度思考"问题，生成冗余推理步骤导致大量token消耗；现有方法（抑制反思关键词、强制缩短推理长度）会截断必要步骤，引发"思考不足"，损害性能。

Method: 分析隐表示发现：高效推理步骤在隐空间中自然聚集于一个集中区域，偏离该区域的步骤倾向于产生冗长序列。据此设计二次规划，将偏离的隐藏状态投影回该有效区域，从而将推理约束在区域内部。方法为免训练（training-free）框架。

Result: 在四个模型（1.5B至14B）及六个基准（数学推理、代码、科学问答）上验证有效：准确率最高提升12.1%，同时生成token减少11.8%至52.8%。

Conclusion: 通过隐空间投影约束推理区域，可在不牺牲性能的前提下降低token开销，有效缓解过度思考与思考不足的两难困境。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. To leverage this, we keep reasoning focused within this region via a quadratic program which projects deviating hidden states back into the region. Then we propose a novel training-free framework to achieve efficient reasoning that reduces token generation costs without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 14B, and across six benchmarks in math reasoning, coding, and scientific QA, validate the effectiveness of our method, up to a 12.1\% improvement in accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 11.8\% to 52.8\%. Codes are available at \href{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}.

</details>


### [1667] [CASS: Contribution-Aware Structured Sparsity for Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34184)
*Yan Li,Guiping Cao,Meng Xu,Tao Jiang,Yaguang Song,Ming Tao,Yaowei Wang,Dongmei Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出贡献感知结构化稀疏（CASS）框架，通过结构化掩码识别并保留任务相关注意力头与FFN神经元，减少模型合并中的参数干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多任务模型合并方法多基于权重幅度或随机启发式剪枝任务向量，将Transformer视为无结构参数集合，忽视了其固有的模块化结构，导致冲突任务向量更新引起参数干扰。

Method: CASS核心是贡献感知结构化掩码，识别任务相关的注意力头与FFN神经元。含两种实例：CASS-Merging作为即插即用去噪滤波器用于现有合并算子；CASS-Tuning在可微调场景下用掩码约束梯度，降低任务向量间的结构重叠。

Result: 分析表明任务相关组件稀疏且部分不相交；在视觉（ViT，20任务）与语言（RoBERTa，8任务；Qwen2.5，4任务）基准上，CASS一致提升多种代表性合并基线性能。

Conclusion: 结构化组件级过滤是减少合并干扰的有效途径，验证了Transformer模块化结构在模型合并中的价值。

Abstract: Model merging integrates task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model, but often suffers from parameter interference caused by conflicting task-vector updates. Existing methods typically mitigate conflicts by pruning task vectors based on weight magnitude or random heuristics, treating Transformers as unstructured ``bags of parameters'' and overlooking their inherent modularity. In this paper, we propose \textbf{C}ontribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{S}parsity (CASS), a unified framework that reduces parameter interference by identifying and preserving task-specific components. At the core of CASS is a contribution-aware structured mask that identifies task-relevant attention heads and FFN neurons. We instantiate this mask in two settings: CASS-Merging, the primary post-hoc setting where masks serve as a plug-and-play denoising filter for existing merging operators, and CASS-Tuning, an extension for scenarios with fine-tuning access where masks constrain gradients to reduce structural overlap between task vectors. Our analysis shows that task-relevant components are sparse and partially disjoint, supporting structured component-level filtering as an effective way to reduce merging interference. Extensive experiments across vision (ViT, 20 tasks) and language (RoBERTa, 8 tasks; Qwen2.5, 4 tasks) benchmarks demonstrate that CASS improves a range of representative merging baselines.

</details>


### [1668] [Behavior-Grounded Semantic Enrichment for Financial Fraud Modeling and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34211)
*Linbo Shao,Huilin He,Yating Lou,Dawei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于原始交易行为的多智能体语义丰富框架，构建了保留真实行为的多模态金融欺诈数据集MS-FFSD，并验证语义丰富对欺诈建模与LLM推理的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融欺诈检测中丰富的语义上下文对交易行为建模与欺诈推理很重要，但受隐私限制，真实金融数据集普遍缺乏语义；合成数据集虽可生成语义，却牺牲了行为真实性，且缺乏用于上下文推理的文本描述。

Method: 提出以原始交易行为为基础的多智能体语义丰富框架：通过角色专门化的智能体生成可解释金融语义，并进行一致性精炼；据此构建多模态金融欺诈数据集MS-FFSD，同时包含结构化语义与文本语义，并保留以真实数据为基础的交易行为；随后系统分析语义丰富的质量与效用。

Result: 实验表明语义丰富结果具有统计保真性，框架具备泛化性；更丰富的语义有助于欺诈建模以及上下文感知的LLM推理。

Conclusion: 该工作推动了多模态金融欺诈研究，将新兴的LLM与多智能体能力同实际反欺诈业务相衔接，框架与数据集已开源发布。

Abstract: In financial fraud detection, rich semantic context can provide important evidence for transaction behavior modeling and fraud reasoning. However, public real-world financial datasets often lack rich semantics due to privacy constraints. Consequently, synthetic datasets incorporate generated semantics, but at the cost of behavioral realism; textual descriptions for contextual reasoning remain scarce. We address this gap through a semantic enrichment framework grounded in original transaction behavior to simulate multimodal financial data. We (1) propose a multi-agent semantic enrichment framework that generates interpretable financial semantics grounded in transaction behavior through role-specialized agents and consistency refinement, and (2) newly contribute a valuable multimodal financial fraud dataset, MS-FFSD, enriched with structured semantics and textual semantics while preserving real-data-grounded transaction behavior. Furthermore, we systematically analyze the quality and utility of semantic enrichment. Results demonstrate statistical fidelity and framework generalizability, while showing that richer semantics benefit fraud modeling and context-aware LLM reasoning. Overall, this work advances multimodal financial fraud research and bridges emerging LLM and multi-agent capabilities with operational anti-fraud practice. The framework and dataset are released at https://github.com/AI4Risk/MS-FFSD.

</details>


### [1669] [GlyphBench: A Playground for Language-Model Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34214)
*Roger Creus Castanyer,Marc-Alexandre Côté,Matthew James Sargent,Augustine N. Mavor-Parker,Glen Berseth,Pablo Samuel Castro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GlyphBench：面向语言模型智能体RL后训练的环境套件，含360+任务，将空间观测渲染为二维Unicode网格。实验显示glyph观测优于原生文本与像素，且游戏RL训练比数学/代码训练具更强迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体在强化学习后训练中缺乏统一、可复现且支持高效研究的基准环境，且观测接口、推理投入与智能体框架对性能的影响尚不明确，游戏玩法带来的推理增益是否能超越数学或代码训练的迁移效果也缺乏实证。

Method: 构建GlyphBench环境套件，包含360余个跨多款游戏的任务；将空间观测渲染为二维Unicode字符网格；通过统一接口连接训练、评估与轨迹回放；基于该套件系统研究观测接口、推理努力程度和智能体框架对性能的影响，以及RL配置对学习动态的作用；并在Craftax、BALROG及Reasoning Gym等环境上进行对比实验。

Result: 在Craftax实验中，glyph（字符网格）观测优于原生文本和像素观测，在若干BALROG环境中也有进一步提升；在100个GlyphBench任务上进行RL训练后，Qwen3.5-4B在留出的Reasoning Gym问题上达到63.48%准确率，优于基座模型、数学训练基线和代码训练基线。

Conclusion: 实验提供了实证证据，表明从游戏玩法中获得的推理增益可产生比数学或代码训练更强的迁移效果；GlyphBench可作为系统研究语言模型智能体如何学习、交互与泛化的有效测试平台。

Abstract: We introduce GlyphBench, an environment suite for reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of language-model agents, with over 360 tasks spanning diverse games. GlyphBench renders spatial observations as two-dimensional Unicode grids and connects training, evaluation, and trajectory replay through a unified interface designed to support efficient and reproducible research. We use GlyphBench to study how observation interfaces, reasoning effort, and agent harnesses affect performance, and how RL configurations shape learning dynamics. Our results show that glyph observations outperform native text and pixels in our Craftax experiments, with further gains on several BALROG environments. RL on 100 GlyphBench tasks improves Qwen3.5-4B on held-out Reasoning Gym problems, reaching 63.48% accuracy and outperforming the base model, a math-trained baseline, and a code-trained baseline. These experiments provide empirical evidence that reasoning gains from gameplay can yield stronger transfer than math or code. Together, these results highlight GlyphBench's value as a testbed for systematic research on how language-model agents learn, interact, and generalize.

</details>


### [1670] [Same Winners, Different Success Rates: Evaluating How LLM Agents Recover from Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34215)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于检查点的智能体失败恢复评测常用"集合一致性"度量，但该指标为纯序数度量，在全体动作均失败（奖励全为零）时会产生虚假稳定性。作者形式化了该缺陷，证明集合-路径对称性，并提出用池化成功率等四项诊断量修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估LLM智能体任务中途失败后的恢复能力对于部署可靠的智能体系统至关重要。现有基于检查点的基准通过比较独立运行中被选为最优的动作（即集合一致性）来度量恢复，但该指标是纯序数的，只记录哪个动作获胜而不反映绝对性能水平：当所有动作都失败时它们在零奖励上并列，独立运行高概率产生相同的并列集合，从而制造出掩盖近零恢复成功率的稳定假象。

Method: 1) 形式化该局限：证明"集合-路径对称性"结果——对于等成本伯努利动作，成功率(0.9, 0.8)与(0.2, 0.1)在任意样本量下产生完全相同的最优动作集合分布，任何仅基于"哪个动作获胜"的过程都无法区分这两种情形；2) 进一步证明在有限时间内认证精确的总体并列是不可能的，且结果到检查点的分配携带超出边际结果分布的信息；3) 指出池化成功率是解决序数歧义的缺失标量；4) 在864个冻结的RecoveryBench回合和两个规划队列共3,456个响应上进行实验验证；5) 提出报告四项诊断量（一致性、全零比例、留出成功率、池化成功率）。

Result: 实验证实了理论预测：一致性与留出质量可能朝相反方向变化；置换检查点到动作的绑定会改变8%–13%的单元格级结论。

Conclusion: 集合一致性这类纯序数度量会掩盖失败恢复的真实水平。作者建议报告四项诊断量——一致性、全零比例、留出成功率和池化成功率——它们无需额外数据采集即可暴露该失效模式。

Abstract: Evaluating how LLM agents recover from mid-task failures is central to deploying reliable agentic systems. Existing checkpoint-based benchmarks measure recovery by comparing which action is selected as best across independent runs, a quantity known as set agreement. However, set agreement is a purely ordinal measure that records which action wins without reflecting the absolute level of performance. When all actions fail, they tie at zero reward, and independent runs produce the same tied set with high probability, creating an illusion of stability that masks near-zero recovery success. We formalize this limitation through a set-path symmetry result, proving that for equal-cost Bernoulli actions the success probabilities (0.9, 0.8) and (0.2, 0.1) yield identical best-action-set distributions at every sample size. No procedure based solely on which action wins can distinguish these two regimes. We further prove that certifying exact population ties is impossible in finite time, and that the assignment of outcomes to checkpoints carries information beyond marginal outcome distributions. The pooled success probability is the missing scalar that resolves the ordinal ambiguity. Experiments on 864 frozen RecoveryBench episodes and two planning cohorts totaling 3,456 responses confirm the theoretical predictions. Agreement and held-out quality can move in opposite directions, and permuting checkpoint-to-action bindings changes 8 to 13 percent of cell-level conclusions. Based on these findings, we propose reporting four diagnostic quantities (agreement, all-zero fraction, held-out success, and pooled success) that expose this failure mode with no additional data collection.

</details>


### [1671] [AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34241)
*Yunhao Feng,Yifan Ding,Yuxiang Xie,Zheng Li,Mingrui Lao,Zeyuan Wang,Yanming Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出自适应安全数据集 AdaptiveSafety 与强化学习算法 SafePO，训练出可在推理时接受用户自定义策略的守卫模型 AdaGuard。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有守卫模型依赖固定风险分类体系，无法适应跨应用、跨任务变化的安全需求；在用户自定义策略下，判定违规需同时理解适用规则与智能体行为，因为相同动作在不同策略下可能获得不同判定。

Method: 构建 AdaptiveSafety 数据集（10,939 条训练样本、1,000 条测试样本，策略含 1–100 条规则），融合多来源轨迹与策略、行为反事实样本，配备解释与完整违规规则集合；通过反事实与结构增强（规则重排序、标识符重映射）提供监督。在此基础上提出 SafePO 强化学习算法：使用结构化奖励评估预测正确性，在响应层面保留组相对优势，并用单独训练的价值模型调节解释区与判定区的 token 权重，分别归一化以控制两者贡献；经监督初始化后训练出 0.6B、4B、8B 系列模型 AdaGuard。

Result: 4B 模型在 AdaptiveSafety 上二分类准确率达 89.30%，在 DynaBench 上达 71.82%。

Conclusion: 推理时策略自适应的守卫模型可行，SafePO 结合反事实与结构监督可有效提升违规识别及解释与判定的一致性。

Abstract: Guard models support the safe deployment of language model agents, but fixed risk taxonomies limit their ability to accommodate requirements that vary across applications and tasks. Under user-defined policies, detecting violations requires interpreting both the applicable rules and the agent's behavior, since identical actions can receive different judgments under different policies. To support learning this capability, we introduce AdaptiveSafety, a dataset of 10,939 training examples and 1,000 test examples covering policies with 1--100 rules. The dataset combines trajectories from multiple sources with policy and behavioral counterfactuals, pairing each example with an explanation and the complete set of violated rules. These counterfactuals expose changes that alter compliance, while structural augmentations provide supervision for consistency under rule reordering and identifier remapping. Building on this supervision, we propose SafePO, a reinforcement learning algorithm for refining violation identification while balancing explanatory reasoning and final verdicts. SafePO uses structured rewards to assess prediction correctness, retains group-relative advantages at the response level, and employs a separately trained value model to modulate token weights within explanation and verdict regions. Separate normalization controls their relative contribution to training despite differences in length. Through supervised initialization followed by SafePO, we develop AdaGuard, a family of 0.6B, 4B, and 8B guard models that assess agent trajectories under policies supplied at inference time. Our 4B model achieves binary accuracies of 89.30\% on AdaptiveSafety and 71.82\% on DynaBench. The project repository is available at https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/AdaGuard

</details>


### [1672] [Stashbird: Efficient Speaker-Indexed Memory for Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34242)
*Chidera Biringa,Lucas Yannul,Xiaowen Wang,Marco Ayala,Nicholas Yi,Alex Moyse,Nishant Manchanda,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Stashbird：通过显式溯源将源片段与派生记忆状态关联的智能体记忆系统，支持增量更新与片段级删除，在多个长期记忆基准上实现高准确率与更低的提示词开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体需要跨用户-智能体交互、用户间对话及有无智能体参与的群组对话保留信息，并需在证据变化或被删除时支持记忆更新，现有记忆系统在溯源与生命周期管理上存在不足。

Method: 将记忆组织为情节记录、语义关系、社区摘要与持久化图状态，借助显式溯源链接源情节与派生记忆状态，并提供增量更新与情节级删除的生命周期操作。

Result: 在四个长期记忆基准评测问答准确率与面向模型的工作负载：在 LoCoMo 上，Stashbird 的摄入提示词用量比 Graphiti 少 76.4 倍；相比同基准复现的 Hindsight，检索提示词用量少 8.1 倍，准确率低 1.6 个百分点；在 LongMemEval-S 与 GroupMemBench 上准确率高于 Hindsight，在 EverMemBench 上准确率相当。

Conclusion: Stashbird 通过显式溯源与结构化记忆组织，在保持竞争性准确率的同时显著降低提示词开销，适用于需要可更新与可删除的长时记忆场景。

Abstract: AI agents require memory that preserves information across user-agent exchanges, user-to-user conversations, and group conversations with or without agent participation, while supporting updates as evidence changes or is removed.
