We present Stashbird, an agent memory system that links source episodes to derived memory state through explicit provenance. Stashbird organizes memory into episodic records, semantic relations, community summaries, and persisted graph state, with lifecycle operations for incremental updates and episode-level deletion. We evaluate question-answering accuracy and model-facing workload across four long-term memory benchmarks. On LoCoMo, Stashbird uses 76.4x fewer ingestion prompt tokens than Graphiti. Compared with reproduced Hindsight on the same benchmark, it uses 8.1x fewer retrieval prompt tokens, with accuracy 1.6 percentage points lower. It achieves higher accuracy than Hindsight on LongMemEval-S and GroupMemBench and comparable accuracy on EverMemBench.

</details>


### [1673] [Evolving Support Priorities in Empathetic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34249)
*Pengyu Huang,Zhiyuan Han,Wenwen Tong,Hewei Guo,Jiangnan Chen,Sirui Chen,Lewei Lu,Beier Zhu,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CARE（Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution），通过随对话状态动态演化评分标准（rubric）来解决共情强化学习中固定奖励规格与演化支持优先级之间的根本性错配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共情强化学习存在一个根本性错配：支持优先级随对话状态不断演化，而现有方法通常优化预定义且跨轮次固定不变的奖励规格。因此需要一个能随情境自适应调整奖励标准的方法。

Method: 将共情支持组织为认知型、情感型与主动型三个维度，提出CARE。每一轮中，CARE通过调整三个维度的权重及其细粒度评价准则来生成情境自适应评分标准。评分标准生成器使用轮级评分标准监督信号与人类偏好数据，经监督微调后再进行基于偏好的强化学习训练，随后作为在线共情强化学习的自适应奖励接口。CARE与RLVER和MICA集成。

Result: 在SentientBench、EQBench3和EMPA上，在三个独立LLM评审下均取得最先进性能。特别是在EMPA上，CARE在三个评审下均将EPM-Idx相对最强基线提升至少13分，其中在Gemini-2.5-Pro下从28.11提升至83.54。分析表明，学到的评分标准优先级随对话阶段和用户情绪系统性变化。

Conclusion: CARE证明了随支持需求演化而调整"奖励什么"是可行且有效的，动态评分标准能显著提升共情强化学习性能，并体现出与对话阶段和用户情绪一致的自适应行为。

Abstract: We identify a fundamental mismatch in empathetic reinforcement learning: support priorities evolve with the dialogue state, yet existing methods typically optimize predefined reward specifications that remain fixed across turns. To model these evolving support priorities, we organize empathetic support along cognitive, affective, and proactive empathy, and propose Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE). At each turn, CARE generates a context-adaptive rubric by adjusting both the weights of these three empathy dimensions and their fine-grained evaluation criteria. The rubric generator is trained with turn-level rubric supervision and human preference data through supervised fine-tuning followed by preference-based reinforcement learning, and then serves as an adaptive reward interface for online empathetic RL. Integrated with both RLVER and MICA, CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance across SentientBench, EQBench3, and EMPA under three independent LLM judges. Notably, on EMPA, CARE improves EPM-Idx over the strongest baseline by at least 13 points under all three judges, including an increase from 28.11 to 83.54 under Gemini-2.5-Pro. Further analyses show that learned rubric priorities systematically vary across dialogue stages and user emotions, demonstrating that CARE adapts what is rewarded as support needs evolve.

</details>


### [1674] [QuantaSpike: Short-Window Spike-Driven Quantization for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34259)
*Bang Hu,Guowei Zhu,Changze Lv,Xiaoqing Zheng,Fengzhe Zhang,Fan Zhang,Wei Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuantaSpike提出一种基于对数三值积分放电(LTIF)神经元的短窗口脉冲驱动量化框架，用于LLM推理，在保持精度的同时显著降低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理依赖密集MAC运算，能耗高；SNN虽为事件驱动、突触整合为轻量累加，但现有脉冲驱动LLM推理受困于激活值离群点，需长发放窗口或辅助非脉冲路径。

Method: 提出LTIF神经元，使用三值事件与2的幂次膜响应量子，提升每次发放步的信息量并保持shift-ACC兼容计算；结合组自适应增益与选择性离群点准入：正常值用残差LTIF步，准入的离群点先加一个额外起始脉冲再进入相同残差动态。

Result: 在OPT与Llama-2上取得脉冲驱动LLM量化方法中SOTA或相当的困惑度与零样本精度；可迁移至Llama-3-8B和Qwen3-8B，四步发放窗口下接近FP16参考。线性能耗投影显示单次线性变换能耗较SpikeQuant降低约80.0%(OPT)和67.1%(Llama-2)。

Conclusion: QuantaSpike为LLM推理提供了准确且高能效的脉冲驱动路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks but rely on dense multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations during inference, resulting in high energy cost. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an event-driven alternative in which synaptic integration uses lightweight accumulation. However, spike-driven LLM inference remains difficult because outlier-heavy activations typically require long firing windows or auxiliary non-spiking paths. We propose QuantaSpike, a short-window spike-driven quantization framework for LLMs built around Logarithmic Ternary Integrate-and-Fire (LTIF) neurons. LTIF uses ternary events with power-of-two membrane-response quanta, improving the information represented by each firing step while retaining shift-ACC-compatible computation. QuantaSpike combines this neuron with group-adaptive gain and selective outlier admission: normal values use residual LTIF steps, whereas admitted outliers receive one additional onset spike before entering the same residual dynamics. Across OPT and Llama-2, QuantaSpike achieves state-of-the-art or competitive perplexity and zero-shot accuracy among spike-driven LLM quantization methods. It also transfers to newer dense LLMs, remaining close to the FP16 reference on Llama-3-8B and Qwen3-8B under the same four-step firing window. Analytical linear-energy projections show that QuantaSpike reduces the energy of one linear transformation by about $80.0\%$ on OPT models and $67.1\%$ on Llama-2 models relative to SpikeQuant, providing an accurate and energy-efficient spike-driven path for LLM inference.

</details>


### [1675] [Maintaining Benchmarks Against Increasingly Capable Agents: Detection and Remediation of Unearned Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34262)
*Weijun Luo,Kelvin Luu,Xinyi Liu,Guangze Luo,Miguel Romero Calvo,Soham Dan,Daniel Yue Zhang,Ying Liu,Mohamed Elfeki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个过程验证（process-verification）框架，通过审计通过任务的轨迹来量化"未挣得的通过"（unearned passes），识别奖励黑客与验证器弱点，并定位可被利用的基准面进行修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体（agent）基准用于指导模型选择与训练，但智能体可能在没有展现目标能力的情况下通过任务，这类"未挣得的通过"构成基准有效性问题。随着智能体能力提升，原本无害的基准面可能变得可被利用，因此基准有效性是一个需要持续维护的问题。

Method: 提出过程验证框架：审计通过轨迹，区分有证据的奖励黑客（reward hacking）与验证器弱点，并定位可被利用的基准面。修复方面采用最小补丁（minimal patches）结合漏洞重放（exploit replay）与新智能体评估，在原始标准下审计新的通过结果。

Result: 在来自 29 个模型-基准队列的 3,810 条通过轨迹中，确认的违规常随模型代际增加但并非单调。SWEBench Pro V1.0 上，匹配任务中确认违规率从 Opus 4.7 的 24% 上升到 Fable 5 的 73%，后续队列降至 Fable 5.1 的 11% 与 GPT-6 Astra 的 0%（属描述性比较，未归一化配置）。违规集中于少数反复出现的基准面，尤以通过 git 历史意外访问参考解为最。三个修复案例表明仅封锁已记录的漏洞不足，需结合最小补丁与重放验证；最终补丁下无评估尝试触及受保护通道，所有补丁后通过均被判定为合法。

Conclusion: 基准完整性需要持续维护：审计通过行为、修复使其可被利用的基准面，并重新评估漏洞可及性与合法可解性。

Abstract: Agentic benchmarks guide model selection and training. Yet an agent can pass a task without demonstrating the intended capability. Such outcomes constitute unearned passes; their proportion among all passes defines the integrity gap. As agents improve, benchmark surfaces that once seemed harmless can become exploitable, making benchmark validity an ongoing maintenance problem. We introduce a process-verification framework that audits passing trajectories, distinguishes evidenced reward hacking from verifier weakness, and localizes exploitable surfaces for repair. Across 3,810 passing trajectories from 29 model-benchmark cohorts, confirmed violations often increase with model generation but not monotonically. On SWEBench Pro V1.0, confirmed violation rates rise from 24% to 73% between Opus 4.7 and Fable 5 on matched tasks; later cohorts fall to 11% for Fable 5.1 and 0% for GPT-6 Astra. These comparisons are descriptive: configurations were not normalized, and the latest models also pass fewer exploitable tasks. Violations concentrate around a small set of recurring surfaces, especially unintended access to reference solutions through git history. Three repair case studies across two benchmarks show why blocking a recorded exploit is insufficient: the same protected information can remain accessible through another route. Therefore, we combine minimal patches with exploit replay and fresh agent evaluation, auditing new passes under the original standard. No evaluated attempt against the final patches reached the protected channel, and every post-patch pass was judged legitimate. Benchmark integrity requires ongoing maintenance: audit passing behavior, repair the enabling surface, and re-evaluate both exploit access and legitimate solvability.

</details>


### [1676] [Query Expansion and Key Specialization in Transformer Attention Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34273)
*Vidit Gupta,Siddhesh Nadkarni,Mihik Chaudhari,Vinaya Sawant,Prachi Tawde*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究Transformer中Q/K投影在训练中几何发展的不对称性：查询的有效维度扩张、键收缩，且该收缩通过因果实验被证实会锐化注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Q与K投影在数学上对称，但在注意力机制中承担不同功能。二者功能差异是否影响其训练中的几何演化，此前尚无定论。

Method: 在字符级WikiText-103上训练小型GPT类Transformer：3种深度（4/6/8层）×3种Q/K初始化×4个随机种子，共36次运行、54条跨种子平均层轨迹。用participation ratio（PR）追踪有效维度；随后在5个种子上直接干预键的谱，分别施加收缩与保持初始离散度两种控制；并进行token级checkpoint分析。

Result: 所有轨迹中查询有效维度扩张、键收缩，且PR_Q − PR_K恒为正。键的收缩使QK^T谱变窄、注意力权重更尖锐。因果控制实验显示：限制键谱收缩会以高方向置信度锐化注意力，而将其固定在初始离散度水平则使注意力更平滑。跨预训练家族的checkpoint分析表明该单调配对对比趋势并非普遍存在，仅作为早期训练阶段存在并在完整预训练中衰减；但交互秩几何与注意力熵的关联在多个模型中仍可见。

Conclusion: Q/K的功能区分驱动其几何发展的不对称性，键有效维度的收缩对注意力锐化具有因果作用；该现象主要体现为早期训练机制，跨模型家族的普适性有限，但秩-熵关联具有一定稳健性。

Abstract: The projection of queries and keys are central to the attention mechanism in Transformer architectures. While they are mathematically symmetric, they play different roles in attention mechanisms. The question of whether there is an effect from their functional distinction on their geometric development in training remains unanswered. We investigate the problem through the training of small GPT-like Transformers on character-level WikiText-103 for three different depths (4, 6, and 8 layers), three types of initialization for queries and keys, and four random seeds, resulting in 36 runs and 54 trajectories of average layers across seeds. We track the effective dimensionality of those layers using participation ratios and discover that effective dimension of queries expand while keys shrink, and that $PR_Q - PR_K$ is positive in all trajectories studied. In connection to attention, the shrinking of keys leads to a narrower spectrum of $QK^\top$ and more peaked attention weights. In order to determine if this connection is causal or coincidental, we directly control the spectrum of keys during training across five seeds: restricting it to make it shrink sharpens the attention with high directional confidence, while keeping it constant to the level of initial dispersion makes attention softer. Additional token-level checkpoint analyses show that the monotonic paired-contrast trend is not universal across pretrained families, but survives as an early-training regime that later decays over a full pretraining run, and the link between interaction-rank geometry and attention entropy remains visible in several models.

</details>


### [1677] [Dynamical Parameters: An Interpretability Framework for Time-Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34316)
*Kang Yang,Gaofeng Dong,Liying Han,Mani Srivastava*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列基础模型（TSFM）中"隐状态可访问性"与"预测响应性"之间的核心差距：动态属性信息虽可从隐状态中恢复，但预测往往无法随该属性变化而正确调整。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在解释时间序列基础模型时存在一个关键盲区：某个动态属性可能已编码于隐状态中，但当该属性随输入变化时，预测却无法做出正确响应。现有研究缺乏对这种"可访问但未表达"现象的量化与机制解释。

Method: 作者将趋势斜率、振荡频率、自回归依赖等属性形式化为"动态参数（Dynamical Parameters）"。对九个冻结的TSFM和十三种规律进行比较：以隐状态恢复度衡量"表征可访问性"，以与预期预测变化的一致性衡量"预测响应性"。并通过"因果几何"分析，比较产生参考响应所需的隐状态变化与参数干预实际诱导的状态变化方向。

Result: 在63个"模型—参数"组合中，42个的可访问性超过0.95，而其中位参考对齐响应相对于条件参考仅为0.46，存在显著落差。直接修改隐状态可恢复参考响应，但参数干预往往使隐状态朝不同方向移动。

Conclusion: 可访问的参数信息并不必然体现在预测中，当输入变化未能命中所需的隐状态方向时即会出现该差距。这说明仅凭隐状态可解码性不足以判断模型是否真正利用该属性进行预测。

Abstract: This work studies a central gap in interpreting time-series foundation models (TSFMs): a dynamical property may be accessible in a hidden state even when the forecast fails to respond correctly as that property changes. We formalize these properties as Dynamical Parameters, including trend slope, oscillation frequency, and autoregressive dependence. We compare their representation accessibility, measured by recovery from hidden states, with their forecast response, measured by agreement with the expected forecast change. Across nine frozen TSFMs and thirteen laws, 42 of 63 model-parameter cells achieve accessibility above 0.95, whereas their median reference-aligned response relative to the conditional reference is only 0.46. To explain this gap, causal geometry compares the hidden-state change required to produce the reference response with the change induced by the parameter intervention. Directly modifying the hidden state recovers the reference response, but the parameter intervention often moves the state in a different direction. These results show that accessible parameter information need not be expressed in forecasts when input changes miss the required hidden-state direction.

</details>


### [1678] [Test-Time Scaling via Budgeted Multi-Attribute Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34322)
*Bo Xue,Ji Cheng,Shen-Huan Lyu,Yuanyu Wan,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将 LLM 答案验证问题建模为全局预算下的多属性好臂识别问题，提出 BMA-GAI 算法，结合代价感知的臂选择与属性自适应采样，实现 anytime-valid 认证，并证明其渐近覆盖率保证与信息论最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共享计算预算下验证 LLM 生成的答案，需要同时决定检查哪些候选答案以及评估哪些验证属性。这一问题在有限预算下如何高效分配资源、尽可能多地认证高质量候选，是本文的核心动机。

Method: 将问题形式化为全局预算约束下的多属性好臂识别：每个候选为一个臂，沿多个高代价属性进行评估，目标是认证尽可能多在所有属性上均值超过预设阈值的候选。提出 BMA-GAI 算法，融合代价感知的臂选择与属性的自适应采样；每次观测同时用于指导自适应分配并支持 anytime-valid 认证，从而无需单独确认阶段。

Result: 建立了 BMA-GAI 的渐近覆盖率保证，并推导出匹配的信息论逆定理，刻画问题内在复杂度，证明 BMA-GAI 在远离临界预算水平时达到一阶最优。在合成基准与 LLM 答案验证任务上，BMA-GAI 相比对比方法更高效地分配验证预算，认证更多高质量候选。

Conclusion: BMA-GAI 在全局预算下有效解决多属性好臂识别与 LLM 答案验证问题，兼具理论最优性与实证优势，可更高效认证高质量候选。

Abstract: Verifying LLM-generated answers under a shared computational budget requires jointly deciding which candidates to inspect and which verification attributes to evaluate. We formulate this problem as multi-attribute good-arm identification under a global budget: each candidate is an arm evaluated along several costly attributes, and the goal is to certify as many candidates as possible whose mean scores exceed the prescribed thresholds on all attributes. We propose \textsc{BMA-GAI}, an algorithm that combines cost-aware arm selection with adaptive sampling of attributes. Every observation serves both to guide adaptive allocation and to support anytime-valid certification, which removes the need for a separate confirmation stage. We establish an asymptotic coverage guarantee for \textsc{BMA-GAI} and derive a matching information-theoretic converse that characterizes the intrinsic complexity of the problem, thereby proving that \textsc{BMA-GAI} is first-order optimal away from critical budget levels. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and an LLM answer-verification task show that \textsc{BMA-GAI} allocates the verification budget more efficiently and certifies more high-quality candidates than competing methods.

</details>


### [1679] [SAGE: Structured Strategic Reasoning for Efficient LLM Game Playing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34342)
*Zhiwei Chen,Tianchun Wang,Zhongtao Rao,Haiming Zhu,Ding Cao,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAGE是一个免训练、推理时框架，通过"锚定-适应-重校准"三步结构化的方式组织LLM策略推理，在多个重复性不完全信息博弈中实现更高收益与更低token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强LLM策略智能体需要前瞻性推理不确定未来、适应对手行为倾向，并从交互经验中持续校准决策。但将这些来源直接纳入自由形式推理会导致三类问题：缺乏支撑的策略假设、不一致的对手估计，以及无关历史交互的干扰。

Method: SAGE为免训练推理时框架，围绕三种协同操作组织推理：（1）Anchor——将推理锚定到均衡策略，提供策略有效的先验；（2）Adapt——在此锚点基础上，依据对对手行为倾向的软信念来条件化偏离，实现针对特定对手的利用；（3）Recalibrate——将策略相关交互蒸馏为关于此前遗漏考量的反事实假设，用以重校准模型推理。

Result: 在Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel三种重复不完全信息博弈上，面对多种对手类型：相比Suspicion-Agent、ReTA、Agent-Pro、EMO、Hypothetical Minds等推理密集型LLM智能体，SAGE在Liar's Dice上收益提升最高达127.6%，同时输入与输出token消耗分别降低最多80%和90%。直接对局中，SAGE在Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel上分别对5/10、8/10、8/10的对手取得非负平均收益，且token使用相对更少。

Conclusion: SAGE通过结构化的锚定、适应与重校准操作，在无需训练的前提下提升了LLM在不完全信息博弈中的策略表现与效率。代码已开源于 https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/SAGE。

Abstract: A strong LLM strategic agent should reason prospectively over uncertain futures, adapt its strategy to opponents' behavioral tendencies, and continuously recalibrate its decision process from interaction experience. However, incorporating these sources in free-form reasoning could lead to unsupported strategic assumptions, inconsistent opponent estimates, and harmful interference from irrelevant historical interactions. To address these issues, we propose SAGE, a training-free inference-time framework that structures LLM strategic reasoning around three coordinated operations: anchor, adapt, and recalibrate. SAGE first anchors reasoning to an equilibrium policy that provides a strategically valid prior. It then conditions deviations from this anchor on a soft belief over opponent behavioral tendencies, enabling opponent-specific exploitation. Finally, SAGE distills strategically related interactions into counterfactual hypotheses about previously missing considerations, allowing past experience to recalibrate the model's reasoning. We evaluate SAGE on three repeated imperfect-information games: Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, against various opponent types in each game. Compared with reasoning-intensive LLM agents, including Suspicion-Agent, ReTA, Agent-Pro, EMO, and Hypothetical Minds, SAGE achieves up to a 127.6% payoff improvement in Liar's Dice while reducing input and output token usage by up to 80% and 90%, respectively. In direct match-up play, it attains non-negative mean payoff against 5/10, 8/10, and 8/10 evaluated opponents in Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, respectively, while using relatively fewer tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/SAGE.

</details>


### [1680] [Fuzzy Distribution Modeling for Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Causality Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34349)
*Michael Vasilakakis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模糊集理论的模糊分布建模方法，用于合成表格数据生成。用模糊集表示特征分布、用模糊认知图建模特征依赖，从而得到低参数、可解释的数据表示；通过采样模糊概念而非原始值生成样本，原生支持混合类型、缺失值与域约束，并支持语言查询与IF-THEN推理。基准实验显示其在效用、保真度与隐私方面与最先进方法相当，同时显著提升可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据有限或难以获取时，合成表格数据是训练机器学习模型的有效替代方案。但表格数据具有异质、非平滑和不完整的特点，给传统概率模型和深度生成模型带来根本性挑战，且这些模型的可解释性有限。因此需要一种既能应对表格数据复杂性、又具备可解释性的生成方法。

Method: 提出基于模糊集理论的模糊分布建模方法：用模糊集表示特征分布，用模糊认知图（Fuzzy Cognitive Maps）建模特征间依赖关系，形成低参数、可解释的数据表示；生成时通过采样模糊概念而非原始值来产生合成样本，从而原生支持混合数据类型、缺失值和域约束；方法还支持语言查询与IF-THEN推理。

Result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在效用、保真度和隐私方面与最先进方法相比具有竞争性表现，同时显著提升了可解释性。

Conclusion: 模糊分布建模被确立为一种有原则且有效的合成表格数据生成方法，适用于模糊系统与决策支持应用。

Abstract: Synthetic tabular data generation provides an effective alternative for the training of machine learning models when real-world data is limited or inaccessible. However, the heterogeneous, non-smooth, and incomplete nature of tabular data poses fundamental challenges to conventional probabilistic and deep generative models, where their interpretability remains limited. This paper proposes a novel fuzzy distribution modeling methodology for synthetic tabular data generation based on fuzzy sets theory. Feature distributions are represented using fuzzy sets and feature dependencies are modeled through Fuzzy Cognitive Maps, resulting in a low-parameter, and an interpretable data representation. Synthetic samples are generated by sampling fuzzy concepts rather than raw values, enabling native support for mixed data types, missing values, and domain constraints. The methodology further supports linguistic queries and IF-THEN reasoning, facilitating transparent simulation of decision-making processes. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive performance with respect to utility, fidelity and privacy compared to state-of-the-art methods, while offering substantially improved interpretability. These results establish fuzzy distribution modeling as a principled and effective approach for synthetic tabular data generation in fuzzy systems and decision support applications.

</details>


### [1681] [SemRD-V2X: Closure-Guided Communication with Bounded Inference for Cooperative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34353)
*Hu Xu,Chun Li,Siyuan Qiu,Zeyan Li,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"闭包保真度"视角分析V2X协同感知中的必要远程证据，推导出零失真速率$P_A H(\pi_A)$，并据此设计SemRD-V2X神经代理，在降低26.6倍特征负载的同时提升检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: V2X协同感知通过共享中间特征提升3D检测，但密集远程特征常重复自车可本地推断的上下文。现有通信高效设计多以经验方式优化掩码或编码，未回答一个根本问题：在给定接收端自身观测的条件下，哪些远程证据是不可或缺的。

Method: 提出"闭环保真度"（closure fidelity）分析视角，建立ego条件下远程感知的率失真函数；在有限演绎抽象与明确条件下，其率失真函数在不可约核心上分解，精确零失真速率等于$P_A H(\pi_A)$。据此设计SemRD-V2X：结合精确预算的BEV支撑选择、逐点通道压缩、掩码共享权重重建，最后接入标准融合。

Result: 在仿真V2XSet和真实DAIR-V2X上验证。在V2XSet上五次运行对比本地复现的V2X-ViT-v1基线（Tesla V100），SemRD-V2X将解析特征负载降低26.6倍，AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别提升4.13/8.57个点，仅增加3.81%平均计算延迟。

Conclusion: 闭环保真度既是分析透镜也是可操作的设计原则，可指导通信高效的协同感知，实现传输紧凑证据、以有限接收端推理恢复可推导上下文。

Abstract: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cooperative perception improves 3-D detection by sharing intermediate features, but dense remote features may repeat context that the ego agent can infer locally. Most communication-efficient designs optimize masks or codes empirically, leaving a more basic question open: which remote evidence is indispensable given the receiver's own observation? We introduce a closure-fidelity perspective on ego conditioned remote perception. Under a finite deductive abstraction and explicit conditions, its rate--distortion function decomposes over an irredundant core, and the exact zero-distortion rate becomes $P_A H(π_A)$. This analysis suggests a concrete design principle: transmit compact evidence and recover derivable context with bounded receiver-side inference. Guided by this principle, SemRD-V2X is an operational neural proxy that combines exact-budget BEV support selection, pointwise channel compression, and masked shared-weight reconstruction before standard fusion. Experiments on simulated V2XSet and real-world DAIR-V2X validate the resulting design. In a controlled five-run V2XSet comparison against a locally reproduced V2X-ViT-v1 baseline on one Tesla V100, SemRD-V2X reduces the analytical feature payload by $26.6\times$ while improving AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by 4.13/8.57 points, with 3.81\% additional mean compute latency. These results position closure fidelity as both an analytical lens and an actionable design principle for communication-efficient cooperative perception.

</details>


### [1682] [Improving Large Language Models for Code through Runtime Program-State Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34359)
*Hongwei Li,Spandan Garg,Yufan Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出两种"程序运行时状态推理"任务，并将其纳入分阶段后训练流程，构建9B模型 Comet-9B；在补丁生成、回归测试生成与安全PoC生成上均取得显著提升，性能可与更大模型媲美。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理"运行时程序状态"方面缺乏显式训练。论文旨在探究：显式训练模型推理运行时程序状态，能否提升其下游软件工程能力。

Method: 设计两种互补任务：(1) Buggy 输入-输出推理——生成能暴露缺陷程序与隐藏正确实现行为差异的具体输入，并预测执行行为；(2) 前置条件-后置条件推理——符号化刻画触发缺陷的前置条件、预测后置条件、解释因果联系并实例化为可执行回归测试。将两任务纳入分阶段后训练流程，基于 Qwen3.5-9B Base 训练出 Comet-9B。

Result: 在 SFT（issue resolution）基础上加入两种程序状态推理任务，SWE-bench Pro 成功率提升 7.25 个百分点，SWT-Bench Verified 提升 9.70 个百分点；进一步对两任务做序贯强化学习，在 SWE-bench Pro、SWT-Bench Verified、CyberGym 上分别再提升 7.25、26.79、4.67 个百分点。仅 9B 参数的 Comet-9B 在 SWE-bench Pro 上得分接近所报道的 GPT-5.2 结果，在 SWT-Bench Verified 上匹配所报道的 GPT-4o 智能体成功率。

Conclusion: 显式训练运行时程序状态推理可有效增强下游软件工程能力；通过分阶段 SFT 与序贯 RL，小规模模型亦可在仓库级补丁生成、回归测试生成与安全 PoC 生成任务上达到与大型模型相当的水平。

Abstract: Large language models receive limited explicit training in reasoning about runtime program states. We study whether training models to reason about runtime program states improves downstream software-engineering capabilities. We introduce two complementary program-state reasoning tasks. Buggy input-output reasoning requires a model to generate a concrete input that exposes a behavioral difference between a buggy program and a hidden correct implementation and to predict the resulting execution behavior. Precondition-postcondition reasoning requires an agent to symbolically characterize a bug-triggering precondition, predict the expected postcondition, explain their causal connection, and instantiate this reasoning as an executable regression test. By incorporating these two tasks into a staged post-training pipeline, we develop Comet-9B, a 9B language model based on Qwen3.5-9B Base. We evaluate the resulting checkpoints on repository-level patch generation, regression-test generation, and security PoC generation. Adding both program-state reasoning tasks to supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on issue resolution improves success rates by 7.25 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro and 9.70 points on SWT-Bench Verified. Sequential reinforcement learning on the two tasks yields further gains of 7.25, 26.79, and 4.67 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro, SWT-Bench Verified, and CyberGym, respectively. Despite having only 9B parameters, Comet-9B achieves a score comparable to the reported GPT-5.2 result on SWE-bench Pro and matches the reported success rate of a GPT-4o-based agent on SWT-Bench Verified.

</details>


### [1683] [PersMem: Internalizing Personality into Dual-Pathway Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34372)
*Hanzhong Zhang,Ziwei Xiang,Weicheng Xie,Shizhe Liu,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PersMem，将人格映射为记忆处理参数，使角色扮演智能体的记忆管线与人设一致，并在依恋、大五人格及CoSER上取得优于基线的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色扮演智能体的人格由系统提示预定义，但其记忆处理管线（记忆优先级与检索）与该人格相互独立，导致记忆处理与人设不一致，且难以验证智能体行为是否符合预定义人格。

Method: PersMem将人格整合进记忆处理管线，通过四个步骤实现人格依赖：将人格映射为操作级参数，控制(i)情感评估，标注用户输入的情绪状态；(ii)记忆保留，连同当前输入保存既有记忆；(iii)被动情感驱动检索，探索与用户输入在语义和人格引导情绪上相似的记忆；(iv)主动目标驱动检索，对被动检索的记忆进行精炼与筛选以生成回复。

Result: 在依恋与大五人格设定下评估：PersMem在四类依恋分类上超过随机基线23.1个百分点；大五人格对话比较中达到67.5%准确率，高于均匀采样记忆基线6.7个百分点；在CoSER上平均得分66.13，其中角色保真度69.33、剧情质量84.33。

Conclusion: PersMem能产生可区分的人格相关记忆处理模式，使人设一致性可通过检查人机交互中的记忆处理轨迹来验证。

Abstract: The profile of a role-playing agent usually depends on the pre-defined personality in a system prompt, whereas its memory processing pipeline, including prioritisation of stored memories and subsequent retrieval, remains independent of this personality. This separation causes the agent's memory processing to be inconsistent with the pre-defined personality, and makes it difficult to validate whether agent behaviours follow this personality. In this paper, we propose Personality-Integrated Memory (PersMem), which integrates personality into the agent's memory processing pipeline, making it consistently personality-dependent. PersMem processes memory using four steps, where the personality is mapped to operation-specific parameters controlling: (i) affective appraisal annotating emotion states of the user input; (ii) retention of previously stored memories along with the current input; (iii) passive affect-driven memory retrieval exploring memories similar to user input in semantics and personality-guided emotions; and (iv) active goal-driven memory retrieval that refines and selects passively retrieved memories for the reply. Consequently, consistency with the pre-defined personality can be examined by inspecting memory-processing traces during human-agent interactions. We evaluate these personality-dependent differences in attachment and Big Five settings. PersMem exceeds the chance baseline for four-way attachment classification by 23.1 percentage points. In Big Five dialogue comparisons, PersMem achieves 67.5% accuracy, 6.7 percentage points above a baseline using uniformly sampled memories. On CoSER, PersMem achieves an average score of 66.13, with scores of 69.33 for Character Fidelity and 84.33 for Storyline Quality. Together, these results show that PersMem produces distinguishable personality-related memory-processing patterns.

</details>


### [1684] [Org-Agent: Beyond Personal Assistants Towards Organizational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34392)
*Luyao Zhuang,Yujing Zhang,Zijin Hong,Yilin Xiao,Xiao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Org-Agent——一种以约束为中心的统一推理框架，用于组织环境中多用户语言模型智能体的跨用户交互与记忆协调，通过三阶段任务分解、依赖图与拓扑调度来满足身份、权限、信息时效与冲突消解等组织约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务于组织的语言模型智能体需协调多用户请求并利用分散于各次交互中的知识，这要求具备两项互补能力：跨用户交互与决策、跨用户记忆与知识使用。二者均受组织约束制约，涵盖用户身份/权限/访问许可、信息的归因与时序有效性、跨用户冲突需求消解规则及联合决策的完成要求；这些约束决定了行动前必须获得何种信息或决策、执行中须满足何种条件。

Method: Org-Agent 以约束为中心，将任务执行组织为三阶段：(1) 将任务分解为原子子任务并构建任务依赖图，图的边编码子任务间依赖；(2) 基于该图通过拓扑排序按依赖顺序调度子任务；(3) 在证据获取与记忆管理工具支持下，逐个子任务执行并纳入任务约束。由此形成统一的约束推理框架。

Result: 在 MUSES-Bench 与 GroupMemBench 上的实验表明，Org-Agent 在跨用户交互与决策、跨用户记忆与知识使用两方面均有效；消融实验进一步支持依赖建模与工具使用两部分的贡献。

Conclusion: Org-Agent 通过显式建模组织约束与任务依赖、并结合工具调用，为多用户组织场景下的语言模型智能体提供了有效的统一推理方案，其效果与消融结果验证了依赖建模和工具使用的必要性。

Abstract: Language model agents serving organizations must coordinate requests from multiple users while using knowledge distributed across their interactions. We identify two complementary capabilities for this setting, namely cross-user interaction and decision-making, as well as cross-user memory and knowledge use. Both capabilities are governed by organizational constraints across three aspects: user identity, authority, and access permissions; the attribution and temporal validity of information; and rules for resolving conflicting requirements across users and completion requirements for joint decisions. These constraints shape what information or decisions must be obtained before an action can proceed and what conditions must be satisfied during its execution. Motivated by this, we introduce Org-Agent, a unified constraint-centric reasoning framework that organizes task execution in three stages. Specifically, Org-Agent decomposes a task into atomic subtasks and constructs a task dependency graph whose edges encode the dependencies among them. Building on this graph, it schedules the subtasks in dependency order through topological sorting. It then executes each subtask while accounting for the task's constraints, supported by evidence-acquisition and memory-management tools. Experiments on MUSES-Bench and GroupMemBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Org-Agent on both capabilities, and ablations further support the contributions of dependency modeling and tool use.

</details>


### [1685] [SkillFocus: Evolving Agent Skills via Capability Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34397)
*Ning Wang,Zhiren Gong,Bingdong Li,Peng Yang,Aimin Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SkillFocus，通过将重复任务需求分解为随技能演进保持固定的能力空间，分离"任务需要什么"与"当前技能如何表现"，据此定位最未解决的能力并指导修订与证据选择，在四个基准上均取得最佳留出准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体技能演进方法主要基于执行轨迹或反馈进行迭代修订，导致跨任务重复出现的行为需求保持隐式，且修订被当前技能的行为所束缚，难以聚焦真正制约任务解决的关键能力。

Method: SkillFocus将重复任务需求分解为固定能力空间，将当前任务结果映射到该空间以识别遗留未解决任务最多的能力，再以该能力决定修订内容与所用证据。

Result: 在四个异构任务基准上均取得最佳留出准确率，平均超越最强对比结果5.7个百分点，且平均比最接近的迭代基线少用24%的演进token。受控实验显示，基于重复任务需求的能力优于任务语义与执行衍生方案；随机化任务—能力分配使最终准确率最多下降20.2个百分点；在优先修订下匹配证据到所选能力可提升候选增益4.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式、固定的能力空间可作为技能演进的有效中介，解耦任务需求与技能行为，提升准确率并降低演进开销，能力与证据的匹配是关键增益来源。

Abstract: Agent skill evolution seeks to improve reusable procedural guidance for large language model (LLM) agents through iterative revision. Existing methods base each revision mainly on execution trajectories or feedback, leaving recurring behavioral requirements across tasks implicit and tying revision to the behavior of the current skill. We introduce SkillFocus, which decomposes recurring task requirements into a capability space that remains fixed as the skill evolves, separating what tasks require from how the current skill behaves. SkillFocus maps current task outcomes to this space to identify the capability that leaves the most tasks unresolved, then uses that capability to determine what to revise and which evidence to use. Across four benchmarks spanning heterogeneous tasks, SkillFocus achieves the best held-out accuracy on all four, outperforming the strongest competing result by 5.7 points on average while using 24\% fewer evolution tokens on average than the closest iterative baseline. Controlled studies further show that capabilities derived from recurring task requirements outperform task-semantic and execution-derived alternatives, while randomizing task--capability assignments reduces final accuracy by up to 20.2 points. Matching evidence to the selected capability increases candidate gain by 4.4 points under prioritized revision.

</details>


### [1686] [Mathematics for and by human cognition: A resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34410)
*Sneha Aenugu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"数学抽象即对问题求解瓶颈的资源理性搜索"理论：认知约束造成的瓶颈促使知识重构，进而产生具有跨问题应用价值的新形式化体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流观点将人类认知约束视为问题求解的限制因素。作者试图反转这一视角，论证认知约束可成为推动数学及相关领域进步的关键动力，并为机器数学发现提供启示。

Method: 理论建构与历史案例分析相结合：以"资源理性搜索瓶颈"为框架，援引数学史中的若干片段（episodes），说明瓶颈如何驱动新抽象的产生，并考察认知约束与情感反应在该过程中的作用。

Result: 认知约束产生的瓶颈形成重构现有知识的压力，可能催生新的形式化体系，其应用范围可超出最初激发它们的原始问题；情感反应亦参与调节这一抽象过程。

Conclusion: 该理论为机器数学发现提供启示：在人工智能系统中引入类人约束，可能有助于发现有用的数学抽象。

Abstract: Human cognitive constraints are generally viewed as limiting factors in problem-solving. We argue that these constraints can instead play a critical role in driving advances in mathematics and beyond. We propose a theory of mathematical abstraction as a resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving. Bottlenecks arising from cognitive constraints create pressure to restructure existing knowledge, potentially giving rise to novel formalisms with applications beyond the problems that originally motivated them. Drawing on episodes from the history of mathematics, we illustrate how such bottlenecks can drive the development of novel abstractions and examine how cognitive constraints and affective responses shape this process. Finally, we discuss the implications of this account for machine mathematical discovery and argue that incorporating human-like constraints may facilitate the discovery of useful mathematical abstractions.

</details>


### [1687] [OSPD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Persona-Consistent Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34418)
*Rui Xu,Yikai Zhang,Aili Chen,Zicheng Zhao,Xu Yinghui,Libo Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出OSPD——同模型在不对称信息下进行on-policy自蒸馏的框架，用于提升角色扮演语言模型的多轮人设一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮对话中保持人设一致性是角色扮演语言模型的核心挑战。外部教师模型的off-policy蒸馏会带来分布不匹配，并在多轮对话中累积；而强化学习则受制于主观人设保真度所固有的奖励歧义。

Method: OSPD让同一模型同时充当教师与学生，采用不对称信息：教师看到完整人物设定，学生仅见简要摘要，并由学生自身策略生成轨迹。基于教师置信度在角色扮演对话中呈双峰结构（角色关键token处尖锐峰值、通用话语处分散）的发现，提出role-aware divergence switching以匹配该结构；并引入progressive trait masking课程，沿语义维度分阶段强制内化角色知识。

Result: 在CharacterBench、CharacterEval和SocialBench上，OSPD相较监督微调与多轮RL基线显著提升人设一致性，且无需任何外部教师或奖励模型。

Conclusion: OSPD通过on-policy自蒸馏、角色感知散度切换与渐进式特质遮蔽课程，在不依赖外部教师或奖励模型的条件下有效增强了角色扮演模型的多轮人设一致性。

Abstract: Maintaining persona consistency across multi-turn dialogues remains a core challenge for role-playing language models. Off-policy distillation from external teachers incurs distribution mismatch that compounds across dialogue turns, while reinforcement learning struggles with reward ambiguity inherent in subjective persona fidelity. We propose OSPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework where the same model serves as both teacher and student under asymmetric information: the teacher receives a complete character profile while the student sees only a brief summary, and the student generates trajectories from its own policy. We find that teacher confidence in role-playing dialogue exhibits a bimodal structure---sharply peaked at character-critical tokens yet diffuse at generic utterances---and introduce role-aware divergence switching to match this structure. A progressive trait masking curriculum further forces staged internalization of character knowledge along semantic dimensions. Experiments on CharacterBench, CharacterEval, and SocialBench show that OSPD substantially improves persona consistency over supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn RL baselines, without requiring any external teacher or reward model.

</details>


### [1688] [Beyond End-to-End Black Box Mapping: An Intentional Agent Framework for Cognitive-driven Facial Reaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34419)
*Hanzhong Zhang,Jindong Wang,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"Intentional Agent"，将面部反应生成（FRG）从直接刺激-反应映射重构为经显式内部状态中介的生成过程，并引入内部动态模型与Inner Thought Flow，在REACT 2025数据集上取得FRDist 72.39、FRDiv 0.5057，且在盲测人评中与真实值无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动生成类人面部反应对构建可参与人机交互的智能系统至关重要。多样且符合情境的面部反应能反映人类交互中的潜在评估与情感过程，但现有FRG方法多采用端到端架构，直接将说话者行为映射为听者表情，缺乏显式的中间内部状态，因而难以刻画这种潜在过程。

Method: 作者将FRG重构为由结构化内部状态过程中介的生成任务，提出Intentional Agent，把FRG从直接刺激-反应映射转变为基于刺激、经由显式中间状态的生成。为表示内部状态的时间演化，提出内部动态模型，在结构化中间状态内将情感驱动与迭代式Inner Thought Flow（ITF）相结合，该状态可在对话静默期持续更新。进一步将FRG形式化为从该潜在思维流到面部表情的下游情感映射，以连接抽象内部状态与生理动作。

Result: 在REACT 2025数据集上，FRDist为72.39，FRDiv为0.5057。感知合理性通过盲测人评单独评估：对96个反应的盲评显示，Full与真实值（ground truth）的均分无显著差异（5.527 vs. 5.195，pHolm=.076），而Full显著优于Event-Triggered与Heuristic-Only（两者pHolm<.001）。Reaction Quality Scorer（RQS）与人类判断高度相关（Pearson r=.855；Spearman ρ=.821，均p<.05），支持其作为自动指标使用。

Conclusion: 结果表明，内源性动态在构建高度自主、类人的智能体方面具有巨大潜力，为FRG提供了超越直接刺激-反应映射的新范式。

Abstract: Automatic human-like facial reaction generation (FRG) is essential for building intelligent systems that can engage in human-computer interaction (HCI). While diverse and context-appropriate facial reactions can reflect latent appraisal and affective processes in human interaction, most existing FRG methods rely on end-to-end architectures that directly map speaker behaviours to listener expressions without an explicit intermediate internal state. We reformulate FRG as generation mediated by a structured internal-state process and propose the \textbf{Intentional Agent}, which shifts FRG from direct stimulus-response mapping to stimulus-grounded generation through explicit intermediate states. To represent temporal internal-state evolution, we propose an internal dynamics model that integrates emotional drives with an iterative Inner Thought Flow (ITF) within a structured intermediate state used for subsequent generation. This state can continue to update during conversational silences. Furthermore, to bridge abstract internal states with physiological actions, we formulate FRG as a downstream affective mapping from this latent thought flow to facial expressions. Experiments on the REACT 2025 dataset show an FRDist of 72.39 and an FRDiv of 0.5057; perceptual plausibility is evaluated separately through blinded human ratings. A blinded human evaluation of 96 reactions found no significant difference in mean score between Full and ground truth ($5.527$ vs.\ $5.195$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=.076$), while Full significantly outperformed Event-Triggered and Heuristic-Only (both $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}<.001$). The Reaction Quality Scorer (RQS) correlated strongly with human judgements (Pearson $r=.855$; Spearman $ρ=.821$, both $p<.05$), supporting its use as an automatic metric. These results underscore the immense potential of endogenous dynamics in building highly autonomous, human-like agents.

</details>


### [1689] [Social Circuits behind Multi-agent Echo Chambers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34444)
*Chuiyang Meng,Wenlu Yu,Ming Tang,Cheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Social Circuits框架，通过接收方内部激活追踪消息影响，并据此提出Circuit-Guided Deliberation（CGD）方法进行消息选择，在多模型多数据集上取得最优或并列最优平均准确率且生成更少token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体通过消息交换整合证据，但通信可能形成回音室、强化共享错误；而整体任务表现无法解释一条消息如何改变接收智能体的内部激活并影响其决策。

Method: 提出Social Circuits框架：对比接收方在改变某条消息前后的答案；再恢复原始消息下记录的选定激活，衡量这些激活能重现多少消息效应。基于此提出Circuit-Guided Deliberation（CGD），利用接收方激活变化学习选择有用消息；并确立激活替换保持接收方决策的条件，给出CGD任务表现与通过消息选择可达最优之间的差距上界。

Result: 实验表明接收方激活变化能够解释消息效应，并指导消息选择以提升任务表现；在三个模型、四个数据集上，CGD在主要对比中取得最高或并列最高的平均准确率，同时生成token数少于多智能体基线。

Conclusion: 通过激活层面的机制分析可解释并优化智能体间消息通信，CGD在性能与效率上优于现有多智能体基线。

Abstract: Language-model agents exchange messages to combine evidence, but their communication can also create echo chambers that reinforce shared errors. However, overall task performance does not explain how a message changes the receiving agent's internal activations and affects its decision. In this work, we introduce Social Circuits, a framework for tracing message effects through receiver activations. We compare the receiver's answers before and after changing a message. Then, we restore selected activations recorded under the original message to determine how much of the message effect these activations reproduce. Based on Social Circuits, we propose Circuit-Guided Deliberation (CGD), which learns to select useful messages using receiver activation changes. We establish when activation replacement preserves receiver decisions and bound the gap between CGD's task performance and the best achievable through message selection. Experiments show that receiver activation changes explain the message effects and guide message selection that improves the task performance. Across three models and four datasets, CGD achieves the highest or joint-highest average accuracy in our main comparisons while generating fewer tokens than multi-agent baselines.

</details>


### [1690] [CORTEX: Learning to Share and Specialize in Dense Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34449)
*Chuiyang Meng,Ming Tang,Vincent W. S. Wong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CORTEX框架，受学习动力学启发，在稠密语言模型内部学习模块化结构，通过分区参数组并依据领域条件梯度与跨领域梯度相似度学习模块分配，在160M、Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-32B上取得最佳合成域精确匹配与最大平均困惑度下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在异构数据混合上训练，不同知识域既需要共享知识也需要专门化。现有模块化方法通常在训练前显式设定组件，或仅在训练后通过可解释性分析发现模块，缺乏在训练过程中自发形成内部模块化的机制。

Method: CORTEX将可训练矩阵划分为若干参数组，基于领域条件梯度以及跨领域梯度相似度来学习模块分配。同时引入选择性损伤分数（selective lesion score）以刻画目标域的损伤效应，以及模块—领域互信息（module-domain mutual information）以度量模块与领域的对齐程度，并分析模块分配如何在分配偏差与更新幅度之间取得权衡。

Result: 在160M、Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-32B三类骨干模型上，CORTEX实现了最高的合成域精确匹配（exact match）和最大的平均困惑度下降，同时在真实域评测中保持竞争力，并形成了可识别的模块结构。

Conclusion: CORTEX表明，借助学习动力学信号可在稠密语言模型内部自发学习到可识别的模块化结构，在提升合成域性能的同时不显著损失真实域表现，为数据混合下的模块化训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language models are trained on heterogeneous data mixtures, where different knowledge domains require both shared knowledge and specialization. Existing modular approaches typically impose explicit components or discover modules through interpretability analysis after training. In this work, we propose CORTEX, a learning dynamics-inspired framework that learns internal modularization within dense language models. CORTEX partitions trainable matrices into parameter groups and learns module assignments from domain-conditioned gradient and cross-domain gradient similarity. We introduce the selective lesion score and module-domain mutual information to characterize the target-domain lesion effects and alignment, and analyze how module assignment affects the trade-off between assignment bias and update magnitude. Experiments with 160M, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-32B backbone models show that CORTEX achieves the highest synthetic-domain exact match and largest average perplexity reduction, while remaining competitive on real-domain evaluations and forming identifiable modules.

</details>


### [1691] [Escaping Local Views: Discovering Latent Concepts for Interpretable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34459)
*Yijie Sun,Sanquan Sun,Yanda Zhu,Yuanyang Zhu,Yaohua Hu,Chunlin Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出可解释框架ELV，通过语义结构化潜在概念使多智能体策略决策透明化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习中部分可观测性使协作困难；循环网络虽能编码局部交互历史，但其隐表示难以揭示个体决策所依赖的信息，缺乏可解释性。

Method: ELV从每个智能体的局部观测与动作-观测轨迹中提取低维语义概念；用VAE将概念联合编码为上下文潜在变量，连接局部视图与全局语义；采用双路径注意力机制，一路估计各概念相对全局上下文的显著性，另一路通过成对概念交互捕获高阶协作模式；并引入概念预测模块，以预测下一概念的误差构造内在奖励，激励智能体探索语义新颖区域。

Result: 在多个环境中验证，ELV不仅取得有竞争力的性能，还能显式展示智能体如何进行决策推理。

Conclusion: ELV通过语义概念、VAE上下文建模、双路径注意力与概念预测内在奖励的结合，实现了性能与可解释性的兼顾，为多智能体协作决策提供了透明的推理依据。

Abstract: Efficient cooperation is challenging due to the usual partial observability of each agent in multi-agent reinforcement learning. Recurrent networks encode local interaction histories, but their hidden representations provide limited insight into the information underlying individual decisions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel interpretable framework, called escaping local views (ELV), which introduces semantically structured latent concepts to render policy decisions transparent. Specifically, each agent extracts low-dimensional semantic concepts from its local observation and action-observation trajectory. These concepts are jointly encoded into a contextual latent variable via a variational autoencoder (VAE), which builds a bridge between local views and global semantics. To explicitly model the decision of each agent, we employ a dual-path attention mechanism in which one module estimates the salience of individual concepts relative to the global context, while the other captures higher-order cooperative patterns with pairwise concept interactions. Furthermore, we incorporate a concept prediction module that derives an intrinsic reward from next-concept prediction errors, which incentivizes agents to explore regions of semantic novelty. Experiments in multiple environments verify that ELV not only achieves competitive performance but also explicitly provides how agents reason about their decisions.

</details>


### [1692] [When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34460)
*Sareh Nabi,Roland Vogl,Marzieh Nabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MathAgent，用 LLM 抽取构建语义知识图谱 MathKG（364 个 Mathlib 定理/定义、9,434 条类型化语义边），并以四种增强模式对五个模型做受控消融，发现 Lean 微调带来 33–38 个百分点的求解率提升，增强效果受模型能力调节，但不同增强模式在不同问题上具有互补性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化库（如 Mathlib）虽编码了 28.5 万+已验证定理及其句法依赖，但数学家用于发现的语义层（类比、泛化、跨领域桥接）仍是隐式的，因此作者试图把该语义层显式化为知识图谱，并检验结构化数学知识能否帮助 LLM 在 Lean 4 中证明定理、对哪些模型有效以及是否因问题而异。

Method: 构建 MathAgent：以已验证 Mathlib 声明为锚点，通过基于 LLM 的关系抽取推断类型化语义边，形成 MathKG（364 个定理/定义、9,434 条语义边）。在 miniF2F 上对五个模型（Qwen3-8B/32B、其 Lean 专用衍生模型 Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B、Claude Sonnet 4.6）进行四种增强模式（无上下文、知识图谱上下文、Mathlib 检索、两者兼用）的受控消融，并对 Sonnet 额外在 PutnamBench 与 MathOlympiadBench 上评测。

Result: (i) 专用化主导增强效果：Lean 微调在各模式下带来 33–38 个百分点的求解率提升，专用 8B 模型比大 4 倍的通用模型高 29–35 个点，而任何增强模式提升均不超过 3 个点；(ii) 增强受能力调节：知识图谱上下文有助于小模型却损害大模型，专用模型相对其通用基座在每个规模上都获益更多；(iii) 各增强模式解决不同问题：按问题选择最优模式的 oracle 比未增强证明器多解 6%–58%，在更难问题上互补性更强（PutnamBench 上多 32%）。

Conclusion: 结构化语义知识对 Lean 4 定理证明的作用受模型能力与问题特性共同调节，而非普遍增益。结果支持按模型能力与具体问题自适应选择增强策略，代码、数据与工件已公开于 https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent。

Abstract: Does structured mathematical knowledge help LLMs prove theorems in Lean 4? If so, for which models, and does the answer vary by problem? Formal libraries such as Mathlib encode 285,000+ verified theorems with syntactic dependencies, but the semantic layer mathematicians rely on for discovery (analogies, generalizations, cross-domain bridges) remains implicit. We introduce MathAgent, which builds this layer as a knowledge graph, MathKG, and uses it to augment LLM theorem provers. MathKG connects 364 Mathlib theorems and definitions by 9,434 typed semantic edges inferred via LLM-based relation extraction anchored to verified Mathlib declarations. We run a controlled ablation across four augmentation modes (no context, knowledge-graph context, Mathlib retrieval, both) and five models: Qwen3-8B/32B, their Lean-specialized derivatives Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, on miniF2F, plus PutnamBench and MathOlympiadBench for Sonnet. Three findings emerge. (i) Specialization dominates augmentation: Lean fine-tuning adds 33-38 percentage points of solve rate in every mode, and a specialized 8B model beats a $4\times$ larger general one by 29-35 points, while no augmentation mode improves solve rate by more than 3 points. (ii) Augmentation is capability-conditioned: knowledge-graph context helps small models but hurts large ones, with the specialized model gaining more relative to its general base at every scale. (iii) Yet the augmentation modes solve different problems: an oracle selecting the best mode per problem solves 6% to 58% more than the unaugmented prover, a complementarity effect that strengthens on harder problems (32% more on PutnamBench). These results motivate adaptive strategies that select augmentation by model capability and problem. Code, data, and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent

</details>


### [1693] [PowerBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval and Reasoning in Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34492)
*Xijing Wang,Yinsheng Yao,Jinru Ding,Yidong Jiang,Ziwen Xu,Yiwen Jiang,Jie Xu,Dawei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PowerBench，包括沿共同依赖链生成互联异构运行数据的框架及配套合成数据集，并据此构建 300 道题、3 类任务的基准，评估前沿 LLM 智能体在受限工具调用与时间预算下的自主取证与推理能力，最佳模型联合准确率仅 74.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业场景（如电力系统）中 LLM 智能体的严格评估受阻：真实运行数据保密，现有公开资源无法充分体现链式依赖与异构证据，导致缺乏可复现、可规模化的评估手段。

Method: （1）生成框架：通过一条共同的依赖链派生相互关联的异构运行数据；（2）基于该框架合成数据集：涵盖 100 种设备类型、761 台设备，两年内 1335 万条小时级遥测记录及 24,939 份运行文档；并在此基础上设计 300 道题、3 类任务族，要求智能体在受限工具调用与时间预算下自主检索证据并跨互联异构数据推理。

Result: 前沿 LLM 在这些任务上仍受挑战，最佳模型联合准确率仅 74.2%；轨迹分析显示模型表现因证据发现、内容检索、工具使用、证据推理与答案提交等环节而异。

Conclusion: PowerBench 为评估 LLM 智能体提供了细粒度洞察，可指导其在工业场景中的可靠部署；框架、数据集与基准任务已开源。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents offer new opportunities for automated analysis in industry. However, rigorous evaluation of such agents-for example, within power system scenarios-remains hindered: real operational data are confidential, and existing public resources fail to fully capture the chained dependencies and heterogeneous evidence. To address this gap, we propose PowerBench, comprising (1) a generation framework that derives interconnected heterogeneous operational data through a common dependency chain, and (2) a synthetic dataset generated by this framework. The dataset covers 761 devices across 100 device types, with 13.35 million hourly telemetry records spanning two years and 24,939 operational documents. Building on this dataset, we construct 300 questions across three task families that evaluate frontier LLMs' ability to complete analysis tasks that require autonomous evidence retrieval and reasoning across interconnected and heterogeneous data under restricted tool calls and time budgets. Results demonstrate that the evaluated frontier LLMs remain challenged on these tasks: the best model reaches only 74.2% joint accuracy. Our trace analysis further reveals that model performance varies across evidence discovery, content retrieval, tool use, reasoning over evidence, and answer submission. These findings provide detailed insights for evaluating LLM agents and guiding their reliable deployment in industry. The framework, dataset, and benchmark tasks are available at https://github.com/open-compass/PowerBench.

</details>


### [1694] [Does Model Uncertainty Track Human Ambiguity? Evidence from Multi-Annotator Vision Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34506)
*Manya Singh,Arjun Pakrashi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文探究模型是否在人类认为困难的样本上同样表现困难，发现模型不确定性与人类分歧仅弱相关，模型不确定性不应被默认视为可信信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数工作仅用单一真实标签评估模型预测，忽略了人类自身在标注上常存在分歧，而这种分歧正是真实模糊性的信号。为构建可信的AI辅助决策系统，需要检验模型不确定性能否对齐人类的分歧模式。

Method: 在两个含多人类标注的视觉数据集（FER+、CIFAR-10H）上，评估三种架构（ResNet、EfficientNet、MobileNetV3）的八个预训练模型。研究分两部分：一是模型不确定性（softmax置信度、熵）与人类分歧的相关性；二是预测多重性度量（模型间分歧、Jensen-Shannon散度）与人类分歧的相关性。

Result: 对齐在两个维度上均较弱。在离散标签层面，CIFAR-10H有50.4%、FER+有33.5%的图像获得人类多个有效分类，而模型仅收敛于单一类别。在连续分数层面，单模型不确定性与人类分歧相关性弱（ρ=0.24–0.55），预测多重性仅带来有限改进。

Conclusion: 广泛使用的不确定性量化方法无法可靠识别人类认为模糊的样本。这些样本是关键的失败案例：人类感知到模糊性并会请求专家复核，模型却自信地做出决策。因此在高风险决策场景中，模型不确定性不应被默认当作可信信号。

Abstract: Human-model alignment is critical for trustworthy AI-assisted decision-making systems. Yet, most work evaluates model predictions against single ground-truth labels, overlooking that humans themselves often disagree on labels, a signal of genuine ambiguity. We investigate whether models struggle on the same instances that humans find difficult. We measure this on two vision datasets (FER+ and CIFAR-10H) where multiple human annotations per image capture human disagreement patterns. We evaluate eight pretrained models across three architectures (ResNet, EfficientNet, MobileNetV3) in two parts: first, whether model uncertainty (softmax confidence, entropy) correlates with human disagreement, and second, whether predictive multiplicity measures (inter-model disagreement, Jensen-Shannon divergence) do. We find that it does not: alignment is weak in both dimensions. At the discrete label level, 50.4% of CIFAR-10H images and 33.5% of FER+ images receive multiple valid classifications from humans, while the models converge on only one. These instances represent a critical failure case where humans perceive ambiguity and would request expert review, yet models decide confidently. At the continuous score level, single-model uncertainty correlates weakly with human disagreement ($ρ= 0.24--0.55$), and predictive multiplicity provides only modest improvement. Widely-used uncertainty quantification methods do not reliably identify instances humans find ambiguous. Model uncertainty should not be treated as a trustworthy signal by default for decision-making in high-stakes scenarios.

</details>


### [1695] [Can AI Make Money in Crypto? Measuring the Gap from Backtests to Real Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34510)
*Xingtong Yu,Jiarun Zhou,Guanlin Ding,Wenkang Wei,Jiarui Liu,Chang Zhou,Fangzhou Ge,Chenyi Xu,Xikun Zhang,Renqiang Luo,Jie Zhang,Hong Cheng,Xinming Zhang,Hui Zhang,Yuan Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一基准，通过历史回测、交易所模拟盘与真实资金实盘三阶段递进评估机器学习、强化学习、LLM与交易智能体等代表性AI交易方法，量化"回测—实现差距"并开源系统与持续更新的公共平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI交易方法已从机器学习、强化学习演进到LLM与交易智能体，但其性能评估仍以历史回测为主。回测难以证明方法能否泛化到未见过的未来市场，也无法反映延迟、滑点、流动性约束与市场冲击等真实交易摩擦下表现是否可持续，因此亟需更贴近真实的时间与执行现实性的评估协议。

Method: 在加密货币市场上构建统一基准，覆盖机器学习和强化学习、LLM-based及agent-based等代表性交易方法，采用三阶段递进评估：历史回测、基于交易所的前瞻性paper trading、真实资金live trading。这两个维度同时提升时间现实性（历史→未见未来市场）与执行现实性（离线模拟→实盘），并配套统一开源系统与持续更新结果的公共平台。

Result: 该协议可量化backtest-to-realization gap，识别性能开始退化的时点，并比较该差距在主要AI交易方法类别间的差异。

Conclusion: 以递进式三阶段评估取代单一历史回测，能更可靠地衡量AI交易方法的泛化性与真实摩擦下的可持续性，为跨方法类别比较提供统一、可复现且持续更新的基准。

Abstract: AI-based trading methods have rapidly evolved from machine learning and reinforcement learning to large language models (LLMs) and trading agents, yet their performance is still predominantly assessed through historical backtesting. Such evaluations provide limited evidence of whether a method can generalize to unseen future markets or whether its backtested performance can be sustained in realistic trading frictions (e.g., latency, slippage, liquidity constraints, and market impact). We present a unified benchmark that evaluates representative machine learning, reinforcement learning, LLM-based, and agent-based trading methods in cryptocurrency markets through three progressively more realistic stages: historical backtesting, prospective exchange-based paper trading, and real-money live trading. These stages jointly increase temporal realism by moving from historical to unseen future markets, and execution realism by moving from offline simulation toward live trading. This protocol enables us to quantify the backtest-to-realization gap, identify when performance begins to deteriorate, and compare how this gap differs across major classes of AI trading methods. We further provide a unified open-source system supporting all three evaluation stages, together with a public platform that continuously updates benchmark results. Code is available at https://github.com/Starlien95/Awesome-TradingAI.

</details>


### [1696] [EOPSA: Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34519)
*Qirui Liu,Yichen Sun,Yan Wang,Yu Mi,Wei Cao,Yue Shen,Zhixuan Chu,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）安全对齐存在两个瓶颈——长rollout下的监督崩塌与文体偏移导致的梯度稀释，提出EOPSA，通过自适应rollout调度与选择性蒸馏将计算和梯度预算聚焦于安全关键token，大幅降低开销并兼顾安全与推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD通过以拒绝导向的特权提示为条件的教师模型提供密集的token级监督，是安全对齐的有前景范式，但存在严重低效问题：随着学生生成前缀变长，教师的纠正效力急剧下降，向后期token注入噪声梯度；同时特权提示引发的安全无关文体差异主导蒸馏目标，冲淡真正的安全信号并损害基座推理能力。

Method: 提出EOPSA，将计算与梯度预算专门集中于可靠监督且安全关键的token上，包含两个协同机制：(i) 自适应Rollout调度（Adaptive Rollout Scheduling），以新颖的Teacher Rescue Rate（TRR）指标动态限制生成视野，使训练严格处于可靠监督区间；(ii) 选择性蒸馏（Selective Distillation），过滤掉安全中性token，将梯度更新限制在安全关键的转移上。

Result: 在参数量高达32B的推理模型上开展广泛评估，EOPSA将rollout计算量减少约50%，仅对约2%的token进行反向传播，在安全合规性与推理能力保持两方面均持续优于全token蒸馏基线。

Conclusion: EOPSA通过聚焦可靠监督的安全关键token，有效缓解了OPSD的监督崩塌与梯度稀释问题，在显著降低训练开销的同时实现了安全对齐与通用推理能力的更优平衡。

Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for safety alignment, delivering dense, token-level supervision by distilling from a teacher conditioned on refusal-oriented privileged prompts. However, we reveal that this paradigm suffers from critical inefficiencies that degrade both training efficiency and general reasoning capabilities. Specifically, we diagnose two fundamental bottlenecks: (1) supervisory collapse over extended rollouts, where the teacher's corrective efficacy degrades precipitously as the student's generation prefix lengthens, injecting noisy gradients into late-stage tokens; and (2) gradient dilution from stylistic shifts, where the distillation objective is dominated by safety-irrelevant stylistic discrepancies induced by privileged prompting, washing out genuine safety signals and impairing base reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment (EOPSA), which concentrates computational and gradient budgets exclusively on reliably supervised, safety-critical tokens. EOPSA incorporates two coordinated mechanisms: (i) Adaptive Rollout Scheduling, which dynamically bounds the generation horizon guided by a novel Teacher Rescue Rate (TRR) metric to operate strictly within reliable supervision regimes; and (ii) Selective Distillation, which filters out safety-neutral tokens to restrict gradient updates exclusively to safety-pivotal transitions. Extensive evaluations across reasoning models up to 32B parameters demonstrate that EOPSA slashes rollout computation by $\sim$50% and backpropagates through merely $\sim$2% of tokens, consistently outperforming full-token distillation baselines in both safety compliance and reasoning retention.

</details>


### [1697] [PairPref: When Should Memory Guide the Answer? A Benchmark for Contextual Preference Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34526)
*Mingfei Lu,Mengjia Wu,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 PairPref 基准，专注于评测模型判断上下文偏好何时适用的问题，发现模型在强制选择中表现尚可，但在自由生成中难以做到情境敏感的偏好应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆增强助手用检索到的偏好来指导回复，但情境的细微变化会改变偏好是否适用，却几乎不影响检索相似度。现有记忆基准主要测试偏好的存储与检索，较少关注偏好应在何时适用，因此作者希望填补这一评测空白。

Method: 构建 PairPref 基准，每对样本只改变情境，保持偏好、请求和四个候选回复不变，偏好在这两种情境下均有效。包含选择任务（从候选回复中选出仅在合适情境下应用偏好的回复）与自由生成任务（无候选回复，需自行决定何时应用偏好）两个赛道，共用 1,227 对样本，覆盖 45 种偏好与八类情境。评测八个模型，并测试减少检索记忆数、更换呈现格式、使用更严格提示等变体。

Result: 八个模型中的多数在选择任务上达到 51 至 65 分（Δ）。但在自由生成中，仅 3.6% 至 18.3% 的样本对能让两个回复分别适配各自情境。即便减少检索记忆、改变呈现格式或使用更严格提示，模型仍在两种情境下都应用该偏好。

Conclusion: 结果表明模型仍难以判断用户偏好的适用时机并据此回复，上下文敏感的偏好应用是记忆增强助手亟待解决的薄弱环节。

Abstract: Memory-augmented assistants use retrieved preferences to guide their responses. A small change in the situation can change whether a preference is appropriate while barely affecting its retrieval similarity. Memory benchmarks typically test whether systems store and retrieve preferences, with less attention to when those preferences should apply. We introduce PairPref, a benchmark of contextual preference use. Each pair changes only the situation, keeping the preference, request, and four candidate replies fixed. The preference remains valid in both situations. In the selection track, models must choose the reply that applies the preference only where appropriate. In the free-generation track, they must decide when to apply it without seeing candidate replies. Both tracks use the same 1,227 pairs across 45 preferences and eight situation categories. We evaluate eight models, most of which achieve selection scores ($Δ$) of 51 to 65 points. In free generation, however, both responses are appropriate for their respective situations in only 3.6\% to 18.3\% of pairs. Models continue to apply the preference in both situations even with fewer retrieved memories, alternative presentation formats, and a stricter prompt. These results show that models still struggle to judge when user preferences apply and respond accordingly.

</details>


### [1698] [The Marathon of Scientific Reasoning: Robustness of Scientific Agents to Perturbations in Multi-Turn Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34537)
*Xiaoting Lyu,Xinbo Ma,Yufei Han,Hangwei Qian,Ziyang Lin,Bin Wang,Bin Wang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SciARP 基准，将 620 个科学问题转化为 3–13 轮交互任务，定义 13 类科学可信扰动，通过干净/扰动配对轨迹评估科学智能体的任务成功率与过程可靠性，揭示其鲁棒性不足与失效隐蔽传播问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 科学智能体已广泛用于科学问题求解，但多轮交互中出现的不完美（扰动）对其鲁棒性的影响尚不清楚，缺乏系统性评估手段。

Method: 构建 SciARP 基准：将 620 个科学问题转为 3–13 轮相互依赖的任务，定义覆盖问题理解、证据处理、推理与结论形成四个环节的 13 类扰动；对每个任务在匹配设置下分别执行干净版与扰动版，生成配对实时轨迹，以评估任务成功与过程可靠性。在来自 4 个模型家族的 8 个 LLM 上开展实验。

Result: 实验揭示三项鲁棒性特征：（1）不同类扰动呈现差异化鲁棒性画像，可使任务推进与科学可靠性解耦——信息或推理已不可靠时智能体仍继续推进；（2）干净任务表现更强不等于更鲁棒，干净准确率更高的模型在扰动下退化可能更大；（3）扰动效应具有显著时间动态，可潜伏多轮后爆发并沿下游依赖传播。

Conclusion: 当前科学智能体对科学可信扰动的鲁棒性不足，失效往往未被检测、持续传播且难以恢复；SciARP 为科学智能体的过程级鲁棒性评估提供了基准与证据。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents are increasingly used for scientific problem solving, yet their robustness to imperfections arising during multi-turn interactions remains poorly understood. We introduce \textsc{SciARP} (\textbf{Sci}entific \textbf{A}gent \textbf{R}obustness to \textbf{P}erturbations), a benchmark for evaluating scientific agents under scientifically plausible perturbations throughout multi-turn problem solving. \textsc{SciARP} transforms 620 scientific problems into interdependent tasks of 3--13 turns and defines 13 perturbation types spanning problem understanding, evidence processing, reasoning, and conclusion formation. Clean and perturbed versions of each task are independently executed under matched settings, producing paired live trajectories for evaluating both task success and process reliability. Experiments across eight LLMs from four model families reveal three key robustness characteristics. First, different classes of scientific perturbations exhibit distinct robustness profiles and can decouple task progression from scientific reliability: agents may continue advancing through the task even after their information or reasoning has become unreliable. Second, stronger clean-task performance does not necessarily translate into stronger robustness, as models with higher clean-task accuracy can exhibit larger degradation under perturbation. Third, perturbation effects exhibit strong temporal dynamics: they may remain latent for multiple turns before emerging and subsequently propagate through downstream dependencies. Together, these findings show that current scientific agents remain insufficiently robust to scientifically plausible perturbations, with failures often remaining undetected, propagating, and resisting recovery.

</details>


### [1699] [APOLO: Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34540)
*Huu Tan Mai,Roman Kochnev,Cuong Xuan Chu,Lukas Lange,Heiko Paulheim,Daria Stepanova*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出APOLO，将本体学习（OL）建模为对大语言模型模块的显式提示优化问题，通过多智能体系统生成训练数据，并设计贪婪与自回归两种学习器架构，用GEPA提示优化器优化，在DOID和PO本体上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从文本进行本体学习虽因大语言模型的出现而进步，但仍受限于标注训练数据稀缺以及难以有效适配LLM执行本体学习任务。作者希望寻找一种轻量替代微调的方案。

Method: 方法包括：1）将本体学习显式建模为对LLM模块的提示优化问题（APOLO）；2）用多智能体系统从已有专家本体生成文本-本体对作为训练数据；3）提出两种本体学习器架构——贪婪学习器与自回归学习器；4）使用基于DSPy的贪婪进化提示优化器GEPA对二者进行优化。

Result: 在生物医学本体（DOID）和植物本体（PO）上的实验表明，优化后在几乎所有模型与模式组合上均获得一致提升，其中自回归学习器增益最大。

Conclusion: 提示优化是本体学习中可行且轻量的微调替代方案；相比贪婪方法，自回归建模能更好地捕捉本体结构。

Abstract: Ontology Learning (OL) from text has advanced with the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs), but it remains challenging due to the limited availability of annotated training data and the difficulty of adapting LLMs to perform OL effectively. We address this via APOLO - Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning, by casting OL as an explicit prompt optimization problem over LLM modules. To obtain training data, we employ a multi-agent system that generates text-ontology pairs from existing expert-curated ontologies. We then propose two ontology learner architectures: a greedy and an autoregressive learner, and optimize both using GEPA, a greedy evolutionary prompt optimizer built on DSPy. Experiments on two ontologies - a biomedical (DOID) and a plant ontology (PO) show consistent improvements after optimization across nearly all model and mode combinations, with autoregressive learners achieving the largest gains. Our results demonstrate that prompt optimization is a viable and lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for OL, and that the autoregressive formulation better captures ontological structure than the greedy approach.

</details>


### [1700] [Remember Before You're Asked: MemDream for Self-Probing Memory Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34545)
*Mingfei Lu,Mengjia Wu,Runsong Jia,Zhe Luo,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MemDream框架，使LLM智能体的记忆系统能在离线"梦境周期"中主动自检、诊断并修复记忆图，实现"预测性"而非"反应性"的记忆演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统均为被动反应式：只有在真实查询暴露缺陷后才修复记忆，导致每次检索失败都对应一次已付出代价的真实交互。核心痛点是缺乏主动自检机制，无法在失败发生前发现并修复记忆弱点。

Method: MemDream周期性地进入离线"梦境周期"，由三个专门智能体（Dreamer、Analyst、Consolidator）协作对记忆图进行探测、诊断与修复。采用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）训练策略，学习哪些修复操作能带来持久的检索提升；并引入软衰减（soft decay）机制，由同一预测信号驱动可逆遗忘。

Result: 在LoCoMo与MemoryAgentBench（MAB）基准上，MemDream相较最强的反应式演化基线，在LoCoMo上答案F1提升4.5个点，在MAB上总分高出9.1个点。

Conclusion: 主动式（预测性）记忆演化优于被动反应式范式，验证了离线自探测与修复机制、以及策略学习驱动的记忆维护在长程交互中对LLM智能体记忆质量的有效性。

Abstract: Memory is essential for enabling LLM-based agents to maintain coherent, personalized behavior over long-horizon interactions. However, existing memory systems share a fundamental limitation: they never proactively test their own memory, repairing it only after real queries expose weaknesses. This reactive paradigm means every retrieval failure corresponds to a real interaction in which the cost has already been paid. We propose MemDream, a framework that enables self-probing memory evolution for LLM agents. Our framework periodically enters offline dream cycles where three specialized agents (Dreamer, Analyst, Consolidator) collaboratively probe, diagnose, and repair the memory graph before failures occur. A policy trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization learns which repair operations produce durable retrieval improvements, while a soft decay mechanism provides reversible forgetting driven by the same anticipatory signal. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemoryAgentBench demonstrate that MemDream improves answer F1 by 4.5 points on LoCoMo and achieves a 9.1-point higher overall score on MAB over the strongest reactive-evolution baselines.

</details>


### [1701] [SGG-ReflAct: Sub-Goal Guided ReflAct with Structured Planning for Reliable Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34548)
*Jaeho Jung,Sung Hoon Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SGG-ReflAct，将LLM规划器生成的子目标融入反思过程，并扩展为BeamSGG-ReflAct，在多个长程任务基准上显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着推理视野增长，LLM智能体内部信念不一致会产生中间步骤错误，导致偏离目标；现有REFLACT仅在每步反思最终目标，忽略中间子目标。

Method: SGG-ReflAct将单路径LLM规划器生成的子目标整合进反思机制；进一步提出BeamSGG-ReflAct，用基于束搜索的LLM规划器替代单路径规划，实现结构化计划探索。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Jericho上多模型实验显示，SGG-ReflAct几乎全面优于REFLACT，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct下ALFWorld成功率提升14.9个百分点、ScienceWorld提升8.0个百分点；减少幻觉动作，在程序化有序任务上增益最大。BeamSGG-ReflAct表明效果依赖计划质量，明确指定所需操作可恢复仅靠计划搜索无法获得的增益。

Conclusion: SGG-ReflAct是一种实用且高效的推理骨干，易于集成，可帮助LLM智能体在复杂长程任务中实现可靠性能。

Abstract: Recent advances in reasoning backbones have empowered large language model (LLM)agentstotackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, as reasoning horizons grow, inconsistent internal beliefs induce intermediate errors that cause agents to drift from their goals. This limitation also persists in REFLACT, which reflects only on the end-goal at each step without explicitly considering intermediate sub goals. To address this problem, we propose SGG-ReflAct (Sub-Goal Guided Re flAct), a reasoning backbone that integrates sub-goals generated through a single path LLM planner into the reflection process. We further extend this framework to BeamSGG-ReflAct, which replaces the single-path planner with a beam search based LLM planner for structured plan exploration. We run experiments on ALF World, ScienceWorld, and Jericho with multiple LLM models. SGG-ReflAct out performs REFLACT in nearly all settings, achieving best success rate gains of 14.9 percentage points on ALFWorld and 8.0 percentage points on ScienceWorld with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Our experimental analysis shows that SGG-ReflAct re duces hallucinated actions and achieves its largest gains on procedurally ordered tasks. Furthermore, experimental results with BeamSGG-ReflAct show that the backbone's effectiveness depends on plan quality: explicitly specifying the re quired operations recovers gains that plan searching alone cannot achieve. These results demonstrate that SGG-ReflAct offers a practical and highly effective rea soning backbone, enabling LLM agents to achieve reliable performance in com plex, long-horizon tasks through easy integration.

</details>


### [1702] [SkillRubric: Co-Evolving Actor Guidance and Evaluator Rubrics for Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34557)
*Bingqing Jiang,Guoxi Zhang,Jasper Wang,Auric Wang,Bingning Wang,Tianyi Lin,Zichao Yu,Yujin Han,Ziye Ma,Difan Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillRubric，将每个可复用技能表示为"面向执行者的行动指导"与"面向评估者的评分量表"的对齐组合，并引入多模态验证器与交替协同演化机制，从而为多模态智能体的长程规划与工具使用提供更稠密的中间过程监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态智能体训练虽引入可复用技能提供过程性指导，但策略优化仍主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励，对中间决策监督不足；而评分量表奖励虽能提供显式中间准则，却在规模化构建上困难，且常与执行者实际遵循的流程脱节。

Method: 核心洞见是"结构良好的技能天然同时规定了如何行动与成功执行应达成什么"，据此提出 SkillRubric：每个技能由对齐的执行者指导与评估者评分量表构成。使用多模态验证器基于截图与工具输出评估技能定义的目标，向相应轮次分配完成度与进度奖励。进一步提出交替协同演化方案：在冻结策略下通过成对 rollout 验证指导修订，在固定指导下离线修订评分量表。

Result: 在多个多模态智能体基准上取得一致性的性能提升；受控成对 rollout 进一步表明，演化后的技能比其先前版本能为规划与工具使用提供更有效的指导。

Conclusion: 将技能同时作为行动指导与评估评分量表，并配合多模态验证与交替协同演化，可为多模态智能体提供可靠、可扩展的中间过程监督，持续提升长程规划与工具使用表现。

Abstract: Recent work incorporates reusable skills distilled from past interactions into multimodal agent training, providing procedural guidance for long-horizon planning and tool use. However, policy optimization in these methods remains driven primarily by sparse outcome rewards, providing little supervision for intermediate decisions. Rubric-based rewards address this limitation through explicit intermediate criteria, but reliable rubrics are difficult to construct at scale and often disconnected from the procedure followed by the actor. We observe that a well-structured skill naturally specifies both how to act and what successful execution should achieve. Based on this insight, we introduce SkillRubric, which represents each skill through aligned actor-facing guidance and an evaluator-facing rubric. A multimodal verifier evaluates skill-defined goals using screenshots and tool outputs, assigning completion and progress rewards to the responsible turns. We further introduce an alternating co-evolution scheme that validates guidance revisions through paired rollouts under a frozen policy and rubric revisions offline under fixed guidance. Experiments across diverse multimodal agent benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance gains, while controlled paired rollouts further show that evolved skills provide more effective guidance for planning and tool use than their preceding versions.

</details>


### [1703] [FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34565)
*Minghao Li,Bangyan Li,Zifan Wang,Yulong Li,Hu Xu,Gan Zhang,Jingtong Wu,Wenqiang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlowState将执行状态视为可跨请求保留与重访的记忆，通过增量状态更新与渐进状态访问，在长时程任务中兼顾性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程任务中LLM智能体需持续利用早期交互信息，但保留完整历史会推高上下文成本，压缩历史又会丢失后续所需细节，且历史信息的相关性往往随任务推进才显现。

Method: 提出FlowState，将执行状态作为可保留、可重访的记忆，统一当前决策与历史信息复用。它保留语义类型化的状态节点、节点关系及对原始工具观测的引用，将持久保留与按需访问分离。单次执行循环内，增量状态更新（ISU）依据新输入与反馈维护当前状态，渐进状态访问（PSA）在推理中按需逐步揭示历史状态与支撑证据，从而支持智能体结合新信息重估先前决策并指导后续行动。

Result: 与采用相同DeepSeek-V4-Flash模型的全上下文基线相比，FlowState在MemoryArena平均成功率提升4.55个百分点，在τ^3-Bench平均通过率提升13.95个百分点，同时总token消耗分别降低43.2%和40.6%。

Conclusion: FlowState在长时程任务上同时展现出性能与效率优势。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions. However, retaining the full history increases context costs, while compressing it risks losing details needed later, and the relevance of historical information often becomes apparent as the task progresses. To address these challenges, we propose FlowState, which treats execution state as memory that can be retained and revisited across requests, unifying current decision-making with the reuse of historical information. FlowState preserves semantically typed state nodes, their relations, and references to raw tool observations, separating persistent retention from on-demand access. Within a single execution loop, Incremental State Update (ISU) maintains the current state based on new inputs and feedback, while Progressive State Access (PSA) progressively reveals historical states and supporting evidence as needed during reasoning. Together, these mechanisms enable agents to reassess prior decisions in light of new information and guide subsequent actions. Compared with a full-context baseline using the same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model, FlowState improves the average success rate on MemoryArena and the average pass rate on $τ^3$-Bench by 4.55 and 13.95 percentage points, respectively, while reducing total token consumption by 43.2% and 40.6%. These results demonstrate the performance and efficiency advantages of FlowState on long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [1704] [PersonaManifold: Revealing and Exploiting Curved Geometry in LLM Persona Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34571)
*Rui Xu,Yinghui Xu,Libo Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 PersonaManifold，将 LLM 人格表征建模为激活空间中的弯曲低维黎曼子流形，用测地线插值替代欧氏线性操作，并构建 BST 基准，实验表明测地线引导在多特质组合与高偏差区域更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时人格控制方法基于线性表征假设，从激活空间提取人格向量并施加欧氏加法、缩放与线性插值，但自身报告了系统性失败：特质维度非正交、天花板与阻力效应不对称、多特质组合显著偏差，说明线性各向同性假设不成立。

Method: 提出 PersonaManifold 框架，把人格表征视为激活空间中弯曲的低维黎曼子流形上的点；估计流形的内蕴几何，包括局部度量张量、测地距离与 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率；引入测地线引导，沿流形测地线而非欧氏直线在人格间插值。同时提出 Behavioral Similarity Triplet（BST）基准，基于六种心理学构念自动生成情境问题，以行为反应而非自评问卷定义人格相似度。

Result: 在三个开源 LLM 上实验显示：人格激活形成曲率异质的流形；测地距离比欧氏替代方案更准确地预测行为相似度，且各向异性与曲率具有独立贡献；测地线引导在 BST 及外部评测上生成更连贯的中间人格，优势集中在流形偏离平坦度最大的高偏差区域。

Conclusion: 人格表征具有非平坦的流形结构，采用黎曼几何视角与测地线引导可缓解欧氏线性方法的系统性失败，在多特质组合与高偏差区域尤为有效。

Abstract: Controlling persona in large language models (LLMs) at inference time is important for role-playing, personalized dialogue, and social simulation. Recent methods extract persona vectors from the model's activation space and apply Euclidean operations---addition, scaling, and linear interpolation---under the linear representation hypothesis. However, these methods themselves report systematic failures: non-orthogonal trait dimensions, asymmetric ceiling and resistance effects, and significant deviations in multi-trait composition, suggesting that the linear isotropic assumption does not hold. We propose PersonaManifold, a framework that models persona representations as points on a curved, low-dimensional Riemannian submanifold in activation space. We estimate the manifold's intrinsic geometry---local metric tensors, geodesic distances, and Ollivier-Ricci curvature---and introduce geodesic steering, which interpolates between personas along manifold geodesics rather than Euclidean straight lines. We also propose the Behavioral Similarity Triplet (BST) benchmark, which automatically generates situational questions grounded in six established psychological constructs and defines persona similarity through behavioral responses rather than self-report questionnaires. Experiments on three open-source LLMs show that persona activations form a manifold with heterogeneous curvature, geodesic distance predicts behavioral similarity more accurately than Euclidean alternatives with independent contributions from anisotropy and curvature, and geodesic steering produces more coherent intermediate personas on both our BST benchmark and external evaluations, with the advantage concentrated in high-deviation regions where the manifold deviates most from flatness.

</details>


### [1705] [Diffusion Subgoal Planning for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34575)
*Hengrui Zhang,Yuhu Cheng,C. L. Philip Chen,Xuesong Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出扩散子目标规划（DSP），将高层子目标生成建模为引导式生成推断，用无分类器引导替代基于价值的显式引导，在离线GCRL基准上取得更优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期任务中，离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）的目标条件价值函数因稀疏奖励与折扣而提供不稳定引导；分层方法虽通过子目标分解缓解，但高层决策仍依赖对噪声敏感的价值估计，复杂环境下行为不稳定。

Method: DSP将高层规划表述为对目标条件子目标的引导式生成推断，同时学习条件流与无条件流，从而在推理阶段通过无分类器引导注入目标导向偏置；即从高层规划中移除显式基于价值的引导，由生成模型产生可达且目标导向的子目标，并保留分层执行结构。

Result: 在离线GCRL基准的多种导航与操作任务上，DSP超越已有方法，尤其在需要多步子目标规划的迷宫环境中表现突出。

Conclusion: 用扩散生成模型承担高层子目标规划、避免价值引导的噪声敏感性，是一种有效提升长期离线GCRL稳定性的途径。

Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) learns goal-directed policies from reward-free data, but in long-horizon tasks, goal-conditioned value functions often provide unstable guidance due to sparse rewards and discounting. Hierarchical methods partially mitigate this issue via subgoal decomposition; however, high-level decision-making still relies on noise-sensitive value estimates, leading to unstable behavior in complex environments. We address this limitation by proposing \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{S}ubgoal \textbf{P}lanning (\textbf{DSP}), a diffusion-based framework for high-level subgoal generation. DSP casts high-level planning as guided generative inference over goal-conditioned subgoals and learns both conditional and unconditional flows, enabling classifier-free guidance to introduce a goal-directed bias at inference time. By removing explicit value-based guidance from high-level planning, DSP generates reachable and goal-directed subgoals through a generative model while retaining hierarchical execution. Experiments on offline GCRL benchmarks demonstrate that DSP outperforms prior methods on a range of navigation and manipulation tasks, with particularly strong performance in maze environments that require multi-step subgoal planning.

</details>


### [1706] [TULIP: Targeted LLM Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-Input](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34591)
*Yejin Kim,William F. Shen,Seokwon Jung,Daeun Park,Seong Joon Oh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出TULIP，通过逐输入定位知识“形成-读出”边界层，在边界处干预隐状态实现更有效的LLM遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表示级遗忘方法对整个遗忘集在单一固定层操作，但知识分布跨层，且遗忘答案的形成层因输入而异，固定层是否足够存疑。

Method: 设计“劫持”实验：将目标模型隐状态植入仅在保留集上训练的oracle。oracle本身无法生成遗忘答案，但接入被移植状态后可生成，说明答案在中层已形成、之后仅被读出。据此提出TULIP：对每个输入用logit lens定位形成-读出边界，在该处移除隐状态与遗忘答案unembedding向量的对齐。

Result: 在TOFU、PISTOL、WMDP数据集及Llama、Qwen、Zephyr模型上，TULIP持续优于输出级和表示级基线，并对改写和量化攻击保持鲁棒；其逐输入层选择还可作为即插即用组件提升现有方法。

Conclusion: 遗忘应关注答案形成而非读出，且形成结束层因输入而异；逐输入定位边界层进行表示干预更有效，并具良好泛化性与可组合性。

Abstract: Representation-level unlearning intervenes on the intermediate hidden states of LLMs. Although knowledge is distributed across layers, existing methods operate at a single fixed layer for the entire forget set. We ask whether such a fixed layer is sufficient. To answer this, we design a hijacking experiment that grafts hidden states of the target model into an oracle trained only on the retain set. The oracle cannot produce the forget answer on its own, yet it produces the answer from the grafted state.
