The difference-evidence path injects spatially weighted difference vectors into query-image states at multiple decoder depths, while an auxiliary visual-context path provides fine-grained appearance information to support their interpretation. Experiments on 4 industrial and 2 medical anomaly benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements in few-shot anomaly detection over baselines relying on textual comparative reasoning. These results support mitigating the visual comparison-reasoning gap through the joint design of comparison representations and their integration into the decoder. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [1740] [ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34960)
*Feiming Wang,Daibo Li,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProofLoom 是一个全自动 LLM 智能体系统，面向"证明义务驱动的理论构建"，可从已发表算法、目标定理与源证明出发，自主构建 Lean 形式化模型与配套理论，并在 15 个任务上取得 6.3/7 与 6.4/7 的人类评分（最强基线为 4.9/7、5.0/7）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 Lean 中形式化研究级随机优化，既需要算法模型，也需要把基础库与收敛性证明连接起来的领域理论；而为了恢复可证明性而修改模型，可能改变原数学命题本身。现有工作缺乏对这种"模型修订—证明义务—结论保持"张力的自动化处理机制。

Method: ProofLoom 以开放证明义务驱动定义、接口、引理与证明计划的开发；用签名合约（Signature contracts）记录模型修订的证据与义务；由独立 Judge 拒绝无支撑假设与被削弱的结论；Planner 将已发表论证展开为中间命题，Audit 检验 Lean 证明是否遵循该论证。跨任务积累的 SOptLib 提取、泛化并验证可复用结果，同时记录建模决策与失败证明路径，供后续任务检索复用，形成构建—积累—复用的循环。

Result: 在 15 个教科书与研究论文任务上，ProofLoom 的人类平均评分为 6.3/7 与 6.4/7，而六种基线中最强者仅为 4.9/7 与 5.0/7。在 33 项开发中共生成 490,693 行算法局部 Lean 代码，且不含 sorry。形式化过程还在 22 项开发中发现了源文献中的 28 处错误公式、证明缺口与算法分析不匹配，每处均有经过检查的证据。

Conclusion: ProofLoom 表明，由证明义务驱动的 LLM 智能体可以自动化完成研究级随机优化的 Lean 理论构建，并通过可复用数学资产库实现持续积累；其形式化过程本身还能反向审计并揭示原始文献中的实质性错误。

Abstract: Formalizing research-level stochastic optimization in Lean requires both an algorithm model and domain theory connecting foundational libraries to convergence proofs. Revising a model to restore provability can change the mathematical claim. We introduce ProofLoom, a fully automated LLM-agent system for Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction. Given a published algorithm, target theorem, and source proof, ProofLoom autonomously constructs the Lean model and supporting theory. Open proof obligations drive the development of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans. Signature contracts record evidence and obligations for model revisions; an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims, and Audit checks whether the Lean proof follows it. Across tasks, SOptLib accumulates verified mathematics and construction experience: reusable results are extracted, generalized, and verified, while modeling decisions and failed proof routes are recorded. Later tasks retrieve these results and records and contribute new developments, forming a cycle of construction, accumulation, and reuse. On fifteen textbook and research-paper tasks, ProofLoom obtains mean human ratings of 6.3/7 and 6.4/7, compared with 4.9/7 and 5.0/7 for the strongest of six baselines. Across 33 developments, it produces 490,693 lines of algorithm-local Lean code with no sorry. The formalizations also expose 28 incorrect formulas, proof gaps, and algorithm-analysis mismatches in published sources across 22 developments, each with checked evidence.

</details>


### [1741] [Safe Greenhouse Climate Control Using Lagrangian-Constrained PPO with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34966)
*Hangzun Liu,Yuling Fan,Fang Tian,Zhilong Bie,Zaiwen Feng,Yongliang Qiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将温室气候调控建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），采用RCPO-PPO安全强化学习框架解耦经济优化与累积安全约束，并用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）替代MLP作为策略与价值函数近似器，结合正弦周期时间特征，在40天真实天气的冬季生菜温室模型中实现约束违规与利润的双重改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统强化学习温室控制器依赖固定奖励惩罚项来限制气候约束违规，但此类启发式惩罚无法显式约束长期累积违规：权重设置不当会导致策略过度保守、产量下降，或无法抑制持续气候偏差，进而损害光合作用并诱发作物病害。因此需要一种能够显式处理累积安全约束、且无需人工调参的自适应控制方法。

Method: 将温室气候调节形式化为CMDP，采用拉格朗日安全强化学习框架RCPO-PPO，将经济优化与累积安全约束分离，实现惩罚系数的自适应调整；为应对温室微气候与作物生长间强非线性、时变耦合，使用KAN替代MLP作为策略与价值网络近似器以增强非线性表征；在观测中嵌入正弦循环时间特征以捕捉昼夜环境周期性。仿真采用经典冬季生菜温室模型，并由40天真实天气数据驱动。

Result: 与基于固定惩罚的vanilla PPO相比，所提方法将累积气候违规降低18.65%，生菜经济利润提升2.91%，且违规量稳定维持于安全阈值附近。

Conclusion: 基于KAN策略表示的CMDP解耦优化可缓解长期气候风险并提升种植利润，为精准温室栽培提供了一种约束感知的控制策略。

Abstract: Greenhouse climate control balances economic return with maintaining temperature, humidity and CO2 within crop-adapted growth ranges. Conventional reinforcement learning (RL) greenhouse controllers use fixed reward penalties to limit climate constraint violations, yet such heuristic penalties cannot explicitly constrain long-term cumulative violations. Poorly tuned weights either lead to overly conservative policies and lower yields, or fail to suppress persistent climate deviations that harm photosynthesis and induce crop diseases. To address this issue, we formulate greenhouse climate regulation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and use a Lagrangian safe RL framework RCPO-PPO to separate economic optimization and cumulative safety constraints, enabling adaptive penalty adjustment without manual tuning. To handle strong nonlinear, time-varying coupling between greenhouse microclimate and crop growth, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) as policy and value approximators for improved nonlinear representation. Sinusoidal cyclic time features are embedded in observations to capture diurnal environmental periodicity. Simulations use a classic winter lettuce greenhouse model driven by 40-day real weather disturbances. Compared with vanilla penalty-based PPO, our method cuts cumulative climate violations by 18.65% and raises lettuce economic profit by 2.91%, keeping violations stable near the safety threshold. This decoupled CMDP optimization with KAN-based policy representation mitigates long-term climate risks and boosts planting profits, offering a constraint-aware control strategy for precision greenhouse cultivation.

</details>


### [1742] [Action-Space Shaping for LLM Agents: Measuring and Mitigating Tool-Schema Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34971)
*Yinhong Liu,Zhili Tan,Zilin Wang,Zhijiang Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"schema bias"现象：同一可执行动作的不同等价工具模式表示会导致LLM智能体表现差异巨大（成功率从完全失败到97%），并设计九种算子的模式重写框架系统研究该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM工具使用智能体通常在固定工具模式（tool schema）下评估，但工具模式并非智能体的动作空间本身，而只是其一种接口表示。同一可执行动作可被多种功能等价的工具定义所暴露，真正学会任务的智能体应在这些定义间表现一致。作者发现当前智能体往往不一致，即存在schema bias，因此需系统性研究该现象的规模、表现形式、可预测性及训练能否消除它。

Method: 提出可执行转换框架，用九种算子重写原生工具模式，包括合并与拆分工具、改变单个工具的表达方式、将一个动作分布到多个依赖调用中。任务、可执行动作与可达状态保持不变，因此成功率的任何变化仅归因于接口本身。在多达32种模式变体上评估11个LLM（含两个闭源模型）。

Result: 即使最新模型也存在显著的schema bias，成功率仅因模式不同而从完全失败到97%不等。可靠估计某模式变体的难度，需要运行目标查询的小样本。训练只能修复那些出现在训练数据中的模式变体。

Conclusion: 工具模式作为接口表示会显著影响智能体表现，schema bias是普遍且严重的问题；模式难度难以零成本预测，且训练无法泛化到未见模式，说明需在评估与训练中系统考虑接口表示的影响。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on tool-use agentic tasks when given a fixed tool schema. Yet a tool schema is not the action space of an agent; it is merely one interface representation of it. The same executable action can be exposed through many different, functionally equivalent tool definitions, and an agent that has truly learned a task should behave consistently across them. We show that current agents often do not, a phenomenon we term schema bias. To study this systematically, we introduce an executable transformation framework that rewrites a native tool schema using nine operators, including merging and splitting tools, altering how a single tool is expressed, and distributing one action across several dependent calls. The tasks, executable actions, and reachable states remain fixed, so any change in success is attributable to the interface alone. Evaluating eleven LLMs, including two closed models, on up to 32 schema variants, we ask how large schema bias is, how it manifests, whether the difficulty of a schema variant can be predicted without a full evaluation, and whether training removes it. We find that schema bias is substantial even for the newest models: success rates range from complete failure to 97% depending solely on the schema. To reliably estimate schema difficulty, it requires running a small sample of the target queries. Training repairs a schema variant only when that variant appears in the training data.

</details>


### [1743] [APEX-Voice: Can Voice Agents Complete Professional Workflows Through Full-Duplex Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34973)
*Puneet Mathur,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 APEX-Voice，一个包含 120 个交互式专业工作流的基准，用于评估全双工语音智能体能否将对话能力转化为可靠的职业工作完成能力。五个前沿实时语音模型 Pass@1 均不超过 25%，最佳 Reliable@3 仅 10.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音智能体已能听、说、调用工具并在语音交互中行动，但流畅对话并不保证被委托的专业工作流能被正确完成。现有评测缺乏对语音智能体完成真实专业任务能力的衡量。

Method: 构建 APEX-Voice 基准，涵盖表单填写、企业谈判、协调、咨询、面试等十类工作原型，共 120 个交互式专业工作流。每个工作流在有状态的 Voice Workbench 环境中执行，包含任务专属知识、类型化工具、金标注最终工作产物、授权约束，以及由经验证预编译语音实现支撑的用户模拟策略。评估同时衡量产物字段准确率与端到端工作流成功率（需正确终止状态、有效流程、完成动作及有效最终产物）。

Result: 在五个前沿实时语音智能体（GPT-Live-1、Gemini-3.8-Live、Grok-Voice-Think-2.0、Step-Audio3、GPT-realtime-2.1）上，无一超过 25% 的 Pass@1，最佳 Reliable@3 仅为 10.8%。有状态协调是各系统的主要失败点；需要更多知识检索和语音中途纠正的工作流成功率进一步下降。

Conclusion: APEX-Voice 是首个评估语音智能体能否将对话能力转化为可靠专业工作的基准，揭示了当前系统在专业工作流完成上的显著不足。

Abstract: Full-duplex voice agents can now listen, speak, use tools, and act during spoken interactions, but fluent dialogue does not guarantee correct completion of delegated professional workflows. We introduce APEX-Voice, a benchmark of 120 interactive professional workflows spanning ten work archetypes such as form completion, corporate negotiation, coordination, consulting, and interviewing. Each workflow executes in a stateful Voice Workbench environment with task-specific knowledge, typed tools, gold-annotated final work artifact, authorization constraints, and a user simulation policy backed by validated, pre-compiled speech realizations. We evaluate both artifact field accuracy and end-to-end workflow success, which requires the correct terminal state, valid process, completed actions, and a valid final artifact. Across five frontier real-time voice agents-GPT-Live-1, Gemini-3.8-Live, Grok-Voice-Think-2.0, Step-Audio3, and GPT-realtime-2.1, none exceeds 25% Pass@1, and the best Reliable@3 is only 10.8%. Moreover, stateful coordination is the dominant failure point across systems, while success decreases further on workflows requiring greater knowledge retrieval and mid-speech corrections. Overall, APEX-Voice is the first benchmark for evaluating whether voice agents can translate conversational competence into dependable professional work.

</details>


### [1744] [Before Acting, Change the State: Prospective State Intervention for Web Agents under Deceptive Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34974)
*Ruozhao Yang,Mingfei Cheng,Xiaofei Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Veer，一种干预Web状态而非智能体行为的运行时防御方法，防止LLM Web智能体因欺骗性界面产生未授权后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Web智能体虽能自主完成任务，但欺骗性界面会诱导其产生违背用户利益的结果。现有防御主要干预智能体行为（阻断、引导、重规划），但作者识别出一种不同的失效模式：在特定Web状态下，一个任务有效的动作仍可能实现未授权的后果。因此，需要将任务相关的Web状态本身作为运行时控制目标。

Method: Veer将任务规划留给基础智能体，仅当提议的动作将产生未授权后果时干预Web状态。在修改真实环境前，Veer先构造一条朝向安全任务相关状态的"前瞻性干预轨迹"，并借助运行时接地（runtime grounding）与验证来执行该轨迹。

Result: 在TrickyArena与WebDecept上，Veer在全部三种评测设置中取得最高的安全任务完成率；在TrickyArena-Single和TrickyArena-Multi上分别超出次优防御15.9和25.0个百分点，并将WebDecept上的暗黑模式成功率降至0.3%。这些提升在各类暗黑模式及全部12种智能体、模型与基准配置下均保持一致。消融实验表明，主动状态干预贡献最大，前瞻性推演与时序证据带来额外提升。

Conclusion: 结果确立了"任务相关的Web状态"作为保护Web智能体免受欺骗性后果影响的有效运行时控制目标。

Abstract: LLM-based Web agents can autonomously complete user tasks, yet deceptive interfaces can steer them toward outcomes that conflict with users' interests. Existing defenses primarily intervene on agent behavior through blocking, guidance, or replanning. We identify a distinct failure mode: a task-valid action can still realize an unauthorized consequence because of the current Web state. This motivates treating task-relevant Web state itself as a runtime control target. We introduce Veer, an agent-side runtime defense that leaves task planning to the base agent and intervenes on Web state when a proposed action would produce an unauthorized consequence. Before modifying the live environment, Veer constructs a prospective intervention trajectory toward a safe task-relevant state and executes it with runtime grounding and verification. Across TrickyArena and WebDecept, Veer achieves the highest safe task completion in all three evaluation settings, exceeding the next-best defense by 15.9 and 25.0 percentage points on TrickyArena-Single and TrickyArena-Multi, respectively, while reducing dark-pattern success on WebDecept to 0.3%. These gains persist across dark-pattern types and all 12 agent, model, and benchmark configurations. Ablations show that active state intervention provides the largest gain, while prospective rollout and temporal evidence contribute additional improvements. These results establish task-relevant Web state as an effective runtime control target for protecting Web agents from deceptive outcomes.

</details>


### [1745] [From One-Shot Generation to Incremental Music Composition: Adapting a General-Purpose Instruction LLM for Persistent Symbolic Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34994)
*André Ricardo Ducca Fernandes,Jean-Pierre Briot,Simone Diniz Junqueira Barbosa1,Hélio Côrtes Vieira Lopes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将增量式作曲形式化为对持久化ABC记谱的操作感知状态转移序列，并用LoRA微调Llama 3.1 8B学习这一交互契约，使检查器准入率从29.37%提升至99.37%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音乐生成系统多以"一次性产出完整作品"为框架与评估目标，而真实作曲往往是对共享音乐制品的反复修改。作者希望探索通用指令跟随大语言模型作为"可复用算子"、在持续演化的符号乐谱上进行增量编辑的可行性。

Method: 将增量作曲形式化为对持久化ABC记谱的操作感知状态转移序列，明确每次操作可变与必须保持的内容。交互含两种工件初始化变体与三种编辑操作：和弦添加、修补（inpainting）、移调。用来自爱尔兰传统音乐的496,038条操作感知对话记录，对Llama 3.1 8B Instruct进行LoRA适配；以未微调模型作对照，用于检验该交互契约是否可学，而非主张微调本身的新颖性。

Result: 每个模型500轮对话（共1,750次尝试输出状态）下，检查器准入率由29.37%升至99.37%；准入条件下的合规率由0.7205升至0.9798。可用于参照相对音乐特征分析的严格合格输出由14增至1,548；最长公共子序列分析在指定协议下未显示相对留出基线的高重叠序列系统性增加。

Conclusion: 结果支持"以通用指令LLM进行持久化、操作感知的符号编辑"在技术上的可行性，但并未证明音乐质量更优或人机共创效果更好，这些仍需以音乐人为中心的评估来回答。

Abstract: Most music-generation systems are still framed and evaluated primarily as producers of complete outputs, whereas composition often proceeds through successive revisions to a shared musical artifact. This paper studies a different use of a general-purpose instruction-following large language model: not as a one-shot music generator, but as a reusable operator over an evolving symbolic score. We formulate incremental composition as a sequence of operation-aware state transitions over persistent ABC notation, with explicit requirements on what each operation may change and what it must preserve. The interaction includes two artifact-initialization variants and three editing operations -- chord addition, inpainting, and transposition. We instantiate the formulation by adapting Llama 3.1 8B Instruct with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on 496,038 operation-aware dialogue records derived from Irish traditional music. The comparison with the unadapted model is used to test the feasibility of learning this interaction contract, not to claim novelty for fine-tuning itself. Across 500 dialogues per model (1,750 attempted output states), checker admission rises from 29.37% to 99.37%, while compliance conditional on admission rises from 0.7205 to 0.9798. Strict eligibility for reference-relative musical-feature analysis increases from 14 to 1,548 outputs, and Longest Common Subsequence analysis does not show a systematic increase in high-overlap sequences relative to held-out baselines under the specified protocol. The results support the technical feasibility of persistent, operation-aware symbolic editing with a general-purpose instruction LLM. They do not establish superior musical quality or human-AI co-creativity, which remain questions for musician-centered evaluation.

</details>


### [1746] [Automated feature engineering, AutoML, and decision-focused learning for improved energy consumption forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35013)
*Nasser Alkhulaifi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本论文针对能耗预测（ECF）中对专家特征工程的依赖，提出领域定制的自动特征工程算法 AutoEnergy，并在18个真实能源数据集及电池储能系统优化任务中验证其在预测精度、运行效率与运营成本上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能源成本与需求上升、环境可持续目标给能源管理带来巨大挑战，能耗预测（ECF）可支撑规划；但现有 ECF 的机器学习模型高度依赖专家驱动的特征工程（FE），限制了自动化与泛化能力。

Method: 论文包含三部分贡献：(1) 建立并评估一套面向 ECF 的综合 FE 流程，并研究领域特定特征；(2) 提出领域定制的自动 FE 算法 AutoEnergy，从时间戳与滞后能耗生成可解释特征，并与 AutoML 集成实现端到端 ECF 建模；(3) 将 AutoEnergy 与决策聚焦学习（DFL）结合，用于电池储能系统（BESS）问题，联合预测电价与需求并优化充放电决策。

Result: 在覆盖住宅、商业、工业、可再生与电网领域的18个真实能源数据集上，AutoEnergy 相对基线 AutoML 与已有自动 FE 方法将预测误差降低 19.52%–84.72%，运行速度快 1.31–4.41 倍（增益因数据集而异）；在真实英国物业数据集上，与不含自动 FE 的同类 DFL 模型相比，运行成本降低 22.9%–56.5%。

Conclusion: 领域特定的自动特征工程能减少对手工特征设计的依赖、提升预测精度，并将预测收益转化为可量化的能源管理运营效益。

Abstract: The rising cost and demand for energy, together with environmental sustainability goals, create major challenges for energy management. Energy Consumption Forecasting (ECF) supports planning by predicting future consumption, but Machine Learning (ML) models for ECF often depend on expert-driven Feature Engineering (FE). This thesis addresses that dependence through three contributions. First, it establishes and evaluates a comprehensive FE pipeline for ECF and investigates domain-specific features. Second, it introduces AutoEnergy, a domain-tailored automated FE algorithm that generates interpretable features from timestamps and lagged consumption and integrates with AutoML for end-to-end ECF modelling. Across eighteen real-world energy datasets spanning residential, commercial, industrial, renewable, and grid domains, AutoEnergy reduces forecasting error by 19.52%-84.72% relative to baseline AutoML and established automated FE methods, while running 1.31-4.41 times faster, with gains varying by dataset. Third, AutoEnergy is integrated with Decision-Focused Learning (DFL) for a Battery Energy Storage System problem, jointly forecasting electricity prices and demand while optimising charging and discharging decisions. On a real-world UK property dataset, this approach reduces operating costs by 22.9%-56.5% compared with the same DFL models without automated FE. Overall, the results show that domain-specific automated FE can reduce reliance on manual feature design, improve forecasting accuracy, and translate predictive gains into measurable operational benefits in energy management.

</details>


### [1747] [TermJudge: A Document-Level Metric Judging, Not Counting, Terminology in Machine Translation Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35017)
*Nicolas Dahan,Fran{\cc}ois Yvon,Rachel Bawden*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出文档级术语评估指标 TermJudge，用 LLM-as-judge 两阶段流程区分术语错误与合理变异，在元评估中排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器翻译术语评估指标将任何与固定参考译文的偏差都视为错误，无法区分真正的翻译错误与人工译者常见的合理术语变异。

Method: TermJudge 是文档级术语指标，对每个术语出现给出可解释判定：符合术语表的出现直接确定性判定；偏离情况则在完整文档上下文下由 LLM-as-judge 两步评估——第一步检测并标注术语错误，第二步区分合理的文档级变异与不一致。

Result: 在专家错误标注和文档级人类 MQM 评分验证下，TermJudge 在系统级和片段级元评估中均排名第一，优于术语表一致性基线和质量估计基线。应用于八个系统翻译学术文档的两种提示条件下，术语表注入在所有配对比较中均改善术语翻译，且是通过消除真实错误而非合理变异实现的。

Conclusion: TermJudge 能更准确评估术语使用，区分错误与合理变异，并已开源发布。

Abstract: Existing automatic metrics for evaluating terminological use in machine translation (MT) penalise any divergence from a fixed reference, conflating translation errors with the valid terminological variation that human translators routinely produce. We introduce TermJudge, a document-level terminology metric that assigns an interpretable verdict to every term occurrence: glossary-conforming occurrences are settled deterministically, while divergences are assessed under a two-step LLM-as-judge procedure using the full document context: the first detects and labels terminology errors; the second sorts valid document-level variations from inconsistencies. Validated against expert error annotations and document-level human MQM scores, TermJudge ranks first in both system- and segment-level meta-evaluation, ahead of glossary-conformity and quality-estimation baselines. When applied to eight systems translating academic documents, under two prompting conditions, we observe that glossary injection improves terminology translation in all paired comparisons, by removing genuine errors rather than valid variation. TermJudge is released as open-source code.

</details>


### [1748] [Environmental requirements for the use of social information by artificial life agents using evolved plastic artificial neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35018)
*Hugh Charterton,James M. Borg,Aniko Ekart*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究利用NEAT演化的ANN智能体在多种觅食环境中考察社会信息使用所需的最小环境条件，意外发现存在一种基于最近食物位置的简单网络拓扑可快速达到适应度标准，无需社会信息，说明社会信息的使用需要更复杂的环境才能演化出来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EPANN包含进化、发育与终生学习两个过程，但在社会性学习起源问题上，基于EPANN框架的ALIFE研究很少；且既有研究多采用模仿式师生关系，忽视了观察到的行为可能源于社会信息线索而非直接模仿或教学这一可能性。

Method: 从EPANN的第一个过程（进化）入手，开展一系列实验：以基于ANN的智能体在多种觅食环境中运行，采用NEAT作为进化算法（可同时演化网络拓扑与权重），以达到既定适应度标准所需代数作为社会信息使用是否演化的度量。

Result: 实验意外演化出一种基于最近食物位置的简单网络拓扑，使智能体能够迅速达到适应度标准；在该拓扑下，额外的信息（社会信息或其他信息）并不必要，甚至可能成为障碍。

Conclusion: 若社会信息的使用要能够演化出来，需要环境具备更高程度的复杂性；觅食环境中单纯的最近食物线索即可解决问题，从而抑制了社会信息机制的演化。

Abstract: Evolved Plastic Artificial Neural Networks (EPANNs) consist of two principal processes, the first, evolution, and the second, development and in-life learning. In the context of the origins of social = learning, very few studies have been carried out using ALIFE models based on EPANN requirements. Studies in this field have usually involved an imitative teacher/pupil relationship. This, however, ignores the possibility that the observed behaviour is a consequence of social information cues rather than direct imitation or teaching. Starting with the first of the EPANN processes (evolution), a series of experiments was undertaken using artificial neural network (ANN) based agents in a variety of foraging environments to examine under what minimal environmental conditions the use of social information might have evolved, as measured by the number of generations taken to meet a specified fitness criterion. NEAT (Neuroevolution of Augmenting Topologies) was the ANN used as its evolutionary algorithm would evolve a network's topology as well its weights. Unintentionally, in the experiment there was a simple network topology based on the location of the nearest food item which enabled agents to swiftly meet the fitness criterion. With this topology, additional information, social or otherwise, was not required and could have proved to be a hindrance. However, this does indicate that for the use of social information to have evolved, it would require a greater degree of complexity in the environment to do so.

</details>


### [1749] [AutoDataBench: Can Agents Write the Data That Feeds the Self-Improvement Loop?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35025)
*Haotian Luo,Haoyu Wang,Zeyu Qin,Huanjin Yao,Yibo Wang,Zhuotao Tian,Shuai Wang,Jiaya Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoDataBench是一个评估智能体自主数据合成能力的基准：给定原始任务与目标模型尝试记录，智能体需生成满足有效性、新颖性、难度与行为覆盖等生产级验收标准的新任务；在三个可执行智能体任务基准上，45分钟预算下无一智能体超过20分，延长至4倍时间可显著提分但单条可用任务成本基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能力提升更多来自数据而非架构，但前沿实验室与数据公司的可验证智能体任务生产仍依赖人工与人在回路协作，难以随算力扩展。自动化任务创建可使数据生产随算力而非专家人力扩展、覆盖更多领域，并推进递归自我改进（RSI）的关键一步。现有评估只考察"在智能体产出上训练后模型的表现"，与数据行业逐样本交付、按标准验收的实践不符，缺少对单个任务是否满足数据流水线验收标准的评估。

Method: 提出AutoDataBench：以原始基准任务及目标模型尝试该任务的记录为输入，要求智能体为同一测试套件撰写新任务，并使其在有效性、新颖性、难度和行为覆盖四个维度上达到实际生产流水线的验收标准。评估在三个可执行智能体任务基准上进行，采用默认45分钟时间预算，并对比延长至4倍时间后的表现与单条可用任务成本。

Result: 在三个可执行智能体任务基准上，所评估的智能体在默认45分钟预算下得分均不超过100分中的20分；给最强智能体4倍时间后其得分大幅提升，而单个可用任务的成本几乎不变。

Conclusion: 当前智能体已能写出达到所需质量的训练任务，但效率不足。AutoDataBench提供了对智能体自主数据合成能力的直接度量：逐件产出、按生产流水线标准评判、且无需训练运行。

Abstract: Recent gains in language model capability have come more from data than from architecture. Frontier labs and data companies produce verifiable agentic tasks, which supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning then turn into capability.This production line still rests on human labour and on human-in-the-loop collaboration. Automating task creation would let data production scale with compute rather than with expert headcount, would extend to more domains, and would enable a key step in recursive self-improvement (RSI). Current evaluations of an agent's ability to write such tasks measure how a model performs after training on what the agent produced. That does not match common practice in the data industry, where data is delivered sample by sample and each sample is accepted against a set of criteria rather than put straight into training. No existing evaluation asks whether an individual task meets the acceptance criteria of a data pipeline. We therefore introduce AutoDataBench. Given an original benchmark task and a record of the target model attempting it, an agent must write a new task for the same suite that meets practical acceptance standards on validity, novelty, difficulty and behavioural coverage. Across three benchmarks of executable agent tasks, no agent we evaluate scores above 20 out of 100 at the default time budget of 45 minutes. Giving the strongest agent four times as long improves its score substantially, while the cost of one usable task stays almost unchanged. Current agents can write training tasks of the required quality, but not efficiently. AutoDataBench provides a direct measure of an agent's capacity for autonomous data synthesis: one artifact at a time, judged against the criteria a production pipeline would apply, and without a training run. Code and data are available at https://github.com/StarDewXXX/AutoDataBench.

</details>


### [1750] [Persona Following Is Not Selective Control: The Neutrality Gap in LLM User Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35036)
*Jiashen Ren,Wenlin Zhang,Bohan Zhang,Xiaopeng Li,Zichuan Fu,Wanyu Wang,Junyi Li,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文检验了人格提示（persona prompting）中"指定单一用户属性只改变该属性"的假设，发现LLM存在跨属性影响，并提出三态诊断区分"人格遵循"与"选择性人格控制"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人格提示被广泛用于构建LLM用户模拟，但其依赖一个基本未经检验的假设：指定某一用户属性应只改变该属性本身。作者旨在系统性地检验这一假设是否成立。

Method: 审计8个黑盒LLM，改变目标属性并观察非目标属性的响应变化；结合语义、语境与内部表征分析；进一步测试显式声明非目标属性（有方向 vs 中性）能否恢复选择性控制；设计三态诊断（未指定/有方向/中性），并在独立条目上进行事后分析。

Result: 跨属性影响在所有8个模型中普遍存在（如风险偏好改变影响颜色选择）；有方向声明通常能压制目标属性影响，但中性声明下目标属性仍显著影响选择（5个开放权重检查点均如此），即便模型正确报告了所声明状态；中性声明下51-81%条目对目标敏感，而有方向声明下320组对比中至多1组敏感。

Conclusion: 成功的人格遵循并不等于选择性人格控制；后者还要求保持非目标属性稳定。模型将人格提示视为关于用户的证据并外推至未指定偏好（"特质条件化补全"），中性态可揭示有方向测试所遗漏的控制失败。

Abstract: Persona prompting is widely used to construct user simulations with large language models (LLMs), yet it relies on a largely untested assumption: specifying one user attribute should change that attribute alone. We test this assumption and identify a systematic failure of selective control: across all eight black-box LLMs we audit, changing a target attribute also shifts responses on unspecified, non-target attributes. For example, describing a user as more risk-seeking shifts color choices, even though the prompt never mentions color; we term this cross-attribute influence. Semantic, contextual, and internal analyses collectively suggest that models treat a persona prompt as evidence about the user and extend the inferred profile to unspecified preferences, a process we call trait-conditioned completion. We next ask whether explicitly specifying non-target attributes restores selective control. When a non-target attribute is assigned a clear direction, models generally follow the declaration and suppress the target attribute's influence. However, when the same attribute is declared neutral, the target continues to affect choices across all five open-weight checkpoints, even when the model correctly reports the declared state. This disparity, the neutrality gap, demonstrates that successful persona following does not imply selective persona control, which additionally requires keeping non-target attributes stable. We operationalize this distinction with a three-state diagnostic that leaves the non-target attribute unspecified or declares it directional or neutral; because directional tests can be passed by simply following the stated persona, the neutral state reveals failures they miss. In a post hoc analysis of independent items, neutral declarations leave 51-81% of items target-sensitive, against at most 1 of 320 item-pole comparisons under directional ones.

</details>


### [1751] [What Drives Citations in Production Large Language Models? An Observational Multi-Method Study of Two Million AI Citations Across Ten Thousand Web Pages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35077)
*Ben Moore,Liam Dunne*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于约200万条来自四大商业引擎（ChatGPT、Claude、Google AI、Gemini）的LLM引文观测数据，结合1万页B2B SaaS网页，采用九方法共识框架检验60余项页面特征，发现"提示词-内容对齐"是引文频率的主导页面级预测因子，而AEO清单效应在加入域名固定效应后消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级大模型在生成答案时会检索并引用网页，但预测"某页面被引用频率"的页面级特征仍缺乏系统刻画；既有AEO（答案引擎优化）文献多基于合并数据，可能高估常见清单式特征的作用。

Method: 观测性研究：约200万条LLM引文（四大商业引擎，6个月）与19个B2B SaaS工作区抓取的1万页数据关联；检验60余项特征，使用九方法共识框架——混合效应回归（含域名固定效应）、FDR校正、稳定性选择Lasso、双重机器学习、广义可加模型、时间留出复制等。

Result: 仅四项发现通过全部检验：(1) 提示词-内容对齐（页面token与全工作区提示词语料的Jaccard重叠，含未引用提示词）为最强页面级预测因子（β=+0.37，95% CI [+0.33,+0.41]，q≈10^-73）；(2) 标准AEO清单（FAQ区块、结构化数据、Core Web Vitals）在合并数据中呈正效应，但加入域名固定效应后效应反转或归零，构成对AEO文献有实际影响的辛普森悖论；(3) 域名级AI权威度的平均绝对SHAP值为最强非对齐页面级特征的6倍。

Conclusion: 页面被引用频率的主因是内容与提示词语料的对齐程度及域名级权威，而非传统AEO清单特征；合并数据中的AEO正效应多为域名混杂所致。作者公开分析流水线，作为方法论贡献。

Abstract: Production large language models retrieve and cite web pages alongside generated answers, yet the page-level features that predict citation frequency remain poorly characterised. We present an observational study of approximately 2 million LLM citations from four commercial engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini) over six months, joined to 10,000 crawled pages from nineteen B2B SaaS workspaces. Sixty-plus features are tested using a nine-method consensus framework combining mixed-effects regression with domain fixed effects, FDR correction, stability-selection Lasso, double machine learning, generalised additive models, and temporal hold-out replication. Four findings survive all checks. First, prompt-content alignment (Jaccard overlap between page tokens and the full workspace prompt corpus, including non-citing prompts) is the dominant page-level predictor (beta = +0.37, 95% CI [+0.33, +0.41], q ~ 10^-73). Second, the standard AEO checklist (FAQ blocks, structured data, Core Web Vitals) shows positive effects in pooled data that reverse or collapse to zero once domain fixed effects are applied: Simpson's paradox with practical consequences for the AEO literature. Third, domain-level AI authority exceeds the strongest non-alignment page-level feature by a factor of six in mean absolute SHAP value. We release the analytic pipeline as a methodological contribution.

</details>


### [1752] [When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35088)
*Geonwoo Kim,Brent ByungHoon Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"模式-纪元漂移"(schema-epoch drift)这一失效模式：工具调用在形成时从模型可见接口生成，而实现由主机后续选择，标准调度忽略了描述符与处理器的对应关系，导致同一合法调用在部署、重连或延迟批准时获得不同安全效果。作者提出"形成一致性调度"(FCD)，将实现分析与执行授权绑定，通过经审阅的配置生成来源绑定的效果上近似，并在封闭目标批准策略下由验证器仅当调用效果符合安全契约时才捕获继承者，配以原子准入与末跳围栏保持决策直至生效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准调度未记录描述符与实现之间的绑定关系，使得一个未改变且模式合法的调用在rollout、重连或延迟批准等场景下可能被映射到不同实现，从而产生与形成时不同的安全效果。论文旨在解决这一"模式-纪元漂移"问题，确保调用的安全契约在执行阶段仍被保持。

Method: 作者提出形成一致性调度(FCD)：由经审阅的配置从官方源码产生"来源绑定的"声明范围内效果上近似；在封闭目标批准策略下，验证器将每个已形成调用应用于摘要，仅当效果符合调用的安全契约时才捕获后继者；采用原子准入与末跳围栏将决策传递至最终效果；精确来源保留优先级，捕获的后继者仅在来源退役后生效。

Result: 在stock发布与部署变更中复现了该失效。四个配置覆盖32个官方发布：29个无需特定发布改动，3个需升级处理。冻结的16发布扩展与独立的来源oracle一致。预注册的stock对比中，FCD完成了全部三个效果保持私有的待处理调用，并阻止了全部三个遗漏变为公开的调用；精确固定与全发布拒绝阻止了全部六个调用，全发布批准完成了全部六个但产生了三个公开效果。另有一项生命周期实验将形成时捕获的证书跨来源退役传递，同一安全证书在后续安装后治理新形成而未扩展待处理调用的权限。

Conclusion: FCD通过在形成阶段将实现分析与执行授权绑定，能够在不改变调用本身的前提下防止模式-纪元漂移，兼顾安全性与可用性：既阻止了不应公开的效果，又允许效果保持私有的合法调用完成，并支持证书跨版本生命周期的稳定传递。

Abstract: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.

</details>


### [1753] [Can Generative AI Automate Data Extraction for Meta-Analysis? A Case Study on Intercropping Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35089)
*Zehao Lu,Xingguo Xiong,Wopke van der Werf,Thijs L. van der Plas,Ioannis N. Athanasiadis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估了三种基于LLM的方法（直接零样本提示、分阶段工作流、多智能体系统）在间作文献数据抽取中的表现，使用六个开源模型并与人工标注的真值对比。结果显示直接零样本提示最优，但所有方法均远未达到完全准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业研究（尤其是作物种间混作/间作领域）亟需荟萃分析来综合已有知识，但从文献中提取数据劳动密集、耗时繁琐，且受研究设计、测量单位与术语缺乏标准化的阻碍。尽管已有许多用LLM自动化数据收集的尝试，但往往缺乏针对人工标注真值的严格评估。

Method: 将三种LLM方法（直接零样本提示、分阶段工作流、多智能体系统）与六个开源权重模型组合，用于从间作文献中抽取数据，并以人工整理的真值及下游统计分析进行评估。

Result: 直接零样本提示是最强且最一致的方法，取得最高的相似度调整F1值0.577；但没有任何方法接近完全准确。在下游分析中，多数模型-方法组合能恢复预测变量与结果变量之间的关系方向，但无法准确估计其量级。

Conclusion: 当前基于LLM的数据抽取方法在间作文献荟萃分析中可部分恢复关系方向，但准确度不足，直接零样本提示优于更复杂的工作流与多智能体系统，未来仍需提升抽取的准确性与可靠性。

Abstract: Meta-analysis is the synthesis of information from multiple sources to arrive at an overarching conclusion. There is a large need for meta-analysis in agricultural research to synthesize what is known and analyze overarching patterns. Extracting data from published literature is, however, labor-intensive, time-consuming, and tedious, and is impeded by a lack of standardization in research design, units of measurement, and terminology. These challenges are particularly evident in the domain of crop species mixtures, also called intercropping. With the growing capabilities of LLMs, many recent attempts have focused on building systems and tools to automate data collection, yet rigorous assessment against human-labeled ground truth is often missing. In this research, we evaluate three LLM-based approaches---direct zero-shot prompting, a staged workflow, and a multi-agent system---with six open-weight models to extract data from the intercropping literature. The results are evaluated against the manually curated ground truth and through a downstream statistical analysis. Overall, direct zero-shot prompting is the strongest and most consistent approach, achieving the highest mean similarity-adjusted F1 of 0.577, although none of the approaches is close to fully accurate. In the downstream analysis, most model--approach combinations recover the direction of the relationship between the predictor and outcome variables, but do not estimate its magnitude accurately.

</details>


### [1754] [DoAtlas-2: A Foundation for Self-Evolving Causal Biomedical Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35107)
*Yulong Li,Rong Xia,Yuxuan Zhang,Jianxu Chen,Xiwei Liu,Haochen Xue,Maosheng Li,Yuhang Liu,Yibo Yuan,Yutong Xie,Chong Li,Jionglong Su,Hagai Rossman,Eran Segal,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DoAtlas-2 是一个以因果机制为核心、由人群外部证据驱动的自我演化生物医学发现基础框架，整合 48 国 72 万余名参与者、771 项研究资源与约 470 万条文献证据记录，通过"假设生成—实证检验—再发现"闭环完成 2,031 个研究问题的系统评估，并在 HPP 中筛选 1,079 个通路问题获得 756 项统计支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物医学发现多依赖单一数据源与静态分析流程，难以围绕因果机制组织知识、难以由外部人群证据持续修正机制解释，也缺乏可解释的预测基础。作者希望构建一个能够自主提出研究问题、预注册因果设计并随证据不断自我演化的统一框架。

Method: DoAtlas-2 整合 771 项研究资源，覆盖 48 个国家、逾 720,000 名参与者，数据类型涵盖纵向临床表型、医学影像、连续生理信号及八个分子层面，并构建约 470 万条文献衍生记录的证据网络，涉及 93,566 个概念和 149,383 条候选因果关联。系统从证据空白与未解机制中自主生成研究问题，预先设定因果设计并产出经校验的分析；支持性、挑战性与未定结果持续更新机制解释、因果证据状态与发现前沿，形成闭环自我演化。

Result: 系统已评估 2,031 个研究问题。在人类表型计划（HPP）中，围绕血管、早期血糖与肝脏代谢系统提出 4,014 个候选通路问题，首批筛查的 1,079 个中有 756 个获得统计支持。代表性研究发现血压是连接肥胖、肝脏与脂质表型至血管结局的汇聚节点；肥胖—炎症—血压通路在联合校正 BMI 与吸烟后大幅衰减。所发现的血管网络构成完全可解释的预测基础，支持对每个预测的精确归因与闭式中介效应。

Conclusion: DoAtlas-2 将因果机制发现、人群证据检验与可解释预测统一于一个持续演化的基础框架中，表明以因果机制为中心、由外部人群证据驱动的自我演化发现范式具备可行性，并可提供精确归因与可解释的预测能力。

Abstract: We introduce DoAtlas-2, a foundation for self-evolving causal biomedical discovery that organizes knowledge around causal mechanisms and advances through external evidence from human populations. DoAtlas-2 integrates 771 research resources covering more than 720,000 participants in 48 countries, from longitudinal clinical phenotypes, medical imaging, and continuous physiological signals to eight molecular layers, together with an evidence network of approximately 4.7 million literature-derived records over 93,566 concepts and 149,383 candidate causal relations. DoAtlas-2 autonomously formulates research questions from evidence gaps and unresolved mechanisms, prespecifies their causal designs, and generates validated analyses. Supporting, challenging, and unresolved results continuously revise mechanistic interpretations, the causal evidence state, and the discovery frontier, so that DoAtlas-2 self-evolves within a closed loop of hypothesis generation, empirical testing, and renewed discovery. DoAtlas-2 has systematically evaluated 2,031 research questions. In the Human Phenotype Project (HPP), it formulated 4,014 candidate pathway questions across vascular, early-glycemic, and hepatic-metabolic systems, and screening of the first 1,079 yielded statistical support for 756. Representative studies identify blood pressure as a convergence node linking adiposity, hepatic, and lipid phenotypes to vascular outcomes, and show that an adiposity-inflammation-blood-pressure pathway is largely attenuated by joint adjustment for body mass index (BMI) and smoking. The discovered vascular network constitutes a completely interpretable predictive foundation, admitting exact attribution of every prediction and closed-form mediation effects. DoAtlas-2 thereby unifies causal mechanism discovery, population-evidence testing, and interpretable prediction within one continuously evolving foundation.

</details>


### [1755] [Using Context Is Not Enough: Test-Time Training for Personalized Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35109)
*Bohao Wang,Xiaoyan Zhao,Yang Zhang,Jinghang Guo,Chun Chen,Can Wang,Jiawei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出基于上下文学习（ICL）的个性化奖励模型（PRM）无法有效捕捉上下文偏好对中的偏好关系，提出偏好对齐测试时训练（P-TTT），通过将偏好关系编码为用户特定的快速权重来实现个性化奖励预测，性能显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF 通常只训练单一奖励模型，忽略了用户偏好的个体差异。个性化奖励模型（PRM）通过以用户特定反馈为条件来缓解该问题，主流做法是 ICL，即将用户历史比较作为上下文偏好对输入。但作者发现 ICL 式 PRM 存在关键缺陷：无法捕捉上下文偏好对所传达的偏好关系。

Method: 提出 P-TTT（Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training）：显式地将上下文偏好对中的关系编码为用户特定的快速权重，用于个性化奖励预测。具体引入序列级（sequence-level）的更新与应用操作，以匹配偏好反馈的响应级（response-level）粒度；并提出偏好对齐目标，直接利用成对偏好关系指导快速权重自适应。该方法实现简单、计算高效，可在单次前向传播内完成快速权重更新，无需推理时反向传播。

Result: 大量实验表明，P-TTT 能更有效地捕捉历史偏好关系，并以较大幅度超越当前最优方法。

Conclusion: 通过测试时训练显式建模偏好关系是一种有效且高效的个性化奖励建模途径，P-TTT 在性能与计算效率上均具优势。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) aligns large language models (LLMs) with human preferences, yet most pipelines learn a single reward model that overlooks individual differences in preferences. Personalized reward models (PRMs) address this by conditioning rewards on user-specific feedback, most commonly through in-context learning (ICL), where a user's historical comparisons are supplied as contextual preference pairs. However, we identify a key limitation of ICL-based PRMs: they fail to capture the preference relations conveyed by contextual pairs. To address this, we propose Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training (P-TTT), which explicitly encodes these relations into user-specific fast weights for personalized reward prediction. P-TTT introduces sequence-level update and apply operations to match the response-level granularity of preference feedback, together with a preference-aligned objective that directly uses pairwise preference relations to guide fast-weight adaptation. Notably, P-TTT is simple to implement and computationally efficient, updating fast weights within a single forward pass without inference-time backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that P-TTT more effectively captures historical preference relations and outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

</details>


### [1756] [DuplexCadence: Exact State and Execution from a Speech Model's Declared Timelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35115)
*Haixiao Gao,Yimin Zheng,Linyou Xiao,Zeke Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DuplexCadence 通过向运行时显式声明模型的"原生时钟"（控制推进速率与保留策略的分区计数器），推导出按需状态分配与精确形状图重放两条规则，消除全双工语音模型合成尾部的编排空隙与内存浪费，在保持输出逐位一致的前提下达到原运行时 2.85 倍速度、峰值内存降低 38.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音模型需以严格的一秒节奏同时听与说，每秒输入必须在下一秒到来前转为等长语音。会话内各阶段串行执行，单次调用开销无法通过批处理摊销。剖析显示自回归阶段已能容纳于一个周期内，真正的瓶颈是 token-to-audio 合成尾部：数千个细小规则操作被逐个下发导致 GPU 空等（编排空隙），同时按静态实现常量超额配置状态造成大量内存浪费。现有补救手段（图记录、按需分配）因流式状态动态性违反其前提而失效。根因在于运行时缺少模型的原生时钟——即主导推进速率与保留策略的分区计数器。

Method: 提出 DuplexCadence：将原生时钟显式声明给运行时，并据此推导出两条互相促成（mutually enabling）的规则——(1) 在稳定地址上进行按需大小的状态分配，消除空闲内存并稳定张量指针；(2) 无填充（without padding）的精确形状图重放，在不引入填充开销的前提下消除编排空隙。

Result: 在三种解码器架构、四个已发布模型上评估，输出逐位一致（bit-for-bit identical）：速度达原运行时的 2.85 倍，峰值内存降低 38.8%。在实时全双工路径上，平均 SPEAK 时间由超出 1 秒节奏 14% 降至低于该节奏 2%，使模型能可靠跟上交互式语音，并显著扩展多路（并发）……（原文在此截断）。

Conclusion: 以显式声明原生时钟为核心的 DuplexCadence，把流式状态动态性转化为可被运行时利用的约束，从而同时解决编排空隙与内存浪费两大尾部瓶颈，在不损失输出一致性的前提下显著提升全双工语音服务的实时性与资源效率。

Abstract: Full-duplex speech models support streaming interaction that listens and speaks at the same time. Serving them is governed by a strict, repeating deadline: conversation advances on a one-second cadence, and every second of input must be turned into a second of speech before the next second arrives. Because stages within a session run in strict sequence, per-invocation overhead cannot be batched away. Profiling reveals that the autoregressive stages of a duplex second already fit within the period, whereas the token-to-audio synthesis tail is what causes overruns. This tail stage suffers from orchestration slack where the GPU is left waiting as thousands of tiny, regular operations are issued one by one, while also wasting substantial memory by over-provisioning state at static implementation constants. Existing remedies, such as graph recording and demand-sized allocation, fail because streaming state dynamics violate their prerequisites. The root cause is that the runtime lacks the model's native clocks: the per-region counters that govern advancement rates and retention policies. We propose DuplexCadence, which explicitly declares native clocks to the runtime and derives two mutually enabling rules: demand-sized state allocation at a stable address, and exact-shape graph replay without padding. The former eliminates idle memory and stabilizes tensor pointers, while the latter removes orchestration slack without padding overhead. Evaluated on four released models across three decoder architectures with bit-for-bit identical output, DuplexCadence reaches $2.85\times$ the stock runtime's speed at $38.8\%$ lower peak memory. On the live duplex path, mean SPEAK time falls from $14\%$ over the one-second cadence to $2\%$ under it, enabling models to reliably keep up with interactive speech while markedly expanding multi-

</details>


### [1757] [Tool Mediation Alters Refusal Mechanisms in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35117)
*Abel Rodríguez,Giuseppe Garofalo,Lieven Desmet,Vera Rimmer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 工具介导的交互并不会削弱模型对有害性的内部感知，而是阻碍其转化为拒答：工具场景下拒答阈值更高、拒答计算更脆弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被部署在可访问外部工具的环境中，但相比普通对话交互，工具介导的有害交互更少被拒答。这一拒答行为变化尚未被充分研究，本文旨在揭示其背后的机制。

Method: 在多种开源权重模型上对比对话式与工具介导两种输入模式：分析有害性信息在表征中的编码与跨模式迁移性；结合表征几何与神经元层面分析，考察有害相关计算的分布方式；通过逐步削弱拒答计算，测量两种模式下拒答的干预强度阈值与脆弱性。

Result: 有害性信息仍强编码于模型表征中，并在对话式与工具介导输入间可迁移；两种模式对有害相关计算的分配存在系统性差异。对话式输入在较低的感知有害性水平即可拒答，而工具介导输入需有害性超过显著更高的有效拒答阈值才拒答。工具介导拒答更脆弱：以更低干预强度削弱拒答计算即可破坏该拒答，而良性能力仍保持完好。

Conclusion: 工具介导并非简单降低模型对有害性的内部感知，而是影响其向拒答的转化。工具介导环境本质上可能降低模型对有害请求的鲁棒性，且传统安全评估未必能完全迁移到LLM智能体。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with access to external tools, yet harmful tool-mediated interactions are less likely to be refused when compared to regular conversational ones. As this change in refusal behavior remains underexplored, we investigate its underlying mechanisms across a diverse set of open-weight language models. We find that information about the harmfulness of a request remains strongly encoded in the model's representations and transfers across conversational and tool-mediated inputs. Evidence from representation geometry and neuron-level analysis further indicates that the two interaction modes systematically distribute harm-related computation differently. Crucially, while conversational inputs can be refused at relatively low levels of perceived harmfulness, tool-mediated inputs remain permissive until harmfulness crosses a substantially higher effective refusal threshold. Moreover, tool-mediated refusal is also more brittle: progressively weakening the refusal computation disrupts tool-mediated refusal at lower intervention strengths than conversational refusal, even when benign capabilities remain intact. Together, our findings indicate that tool mediation does not simply reduce the internal perception of harm, but instead impacts its conversion into refusal. Overall, this suggests tool-mediated environments may intrinsically reduce robustness of models to harmful requests, and that conventional safety evaluations may not fully transfer to LLM agents.

</details>


### [1758] [From Migration to Calibration: Preserving Agent Capabilities across Models, Jurisdictions, and Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35149)
*Yaxiao Liu,Pengbo Liu,Yiwen Liu,Yihua Guan,Jiaxing Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"智能体校准"（agent calibration）这一方法论框架：当部署条件变化（如模型替换、跨辖区、跨市场扩展）时，仅靠接口兼容不足以保证能力保持与目标合约满足。作者将校准形式化为跨三个交互层面的约束化行为适配——信息保持、外壳（harness）适配与用户接受——并给出非退化与聚合改进两级目标、评估设计与未来实证方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署条件变化（基础模型转后训练模型、跨司法辖区、跨异质市场与数据源扩展）时，接口兼容并不能证明能力保留或目标合约被满足，因此需要一种系统性的校准方法。

Method: 将智能体校准形式化为跨三层交互的约束化行为适配：信息校准（保留仍适用于目标任务的、经独立验证的源内容）、外壳校准（在语义检查点对齐可观测产物，并通过迭代、工具替换或预算内局部重规划修复）、用户校准（执行接收方特定的输出合约，如模板、模式、章节级偏好）。区分可训练策略与冻结骨干的配置/控制器优化，以及证据验证与相对判断、DPO/GRPO 优化。

Result: 以全球电子商务为例，说明共享标准如何与站点及市场特定适配器和验证共存；并指出近期外壳迁移与评判有效性研究支持：目标原生产执行记录、任务有效性与近似并列排序的分离审计、以及匹配的目标原生优化对照。

Conclusion: 提出面向模型更换、跨境适配与规模化的留出评估方案，包括对源证据与检查点修复的因子检验，以及分组级报告以防止聚合增益掩盖局部失败。本文为方法论提案，实现与实证验证为未来工作。

Abstract: Agents need calibration when deployment conditions change: replacing a driving model, including a foundation-to-post-trained transition; crossing jurisdictions; or scaling across heterogeneous markets and sources. Interface compatibility alone does not establish capability retention or target-contract satisfaction. We formulate agent calibration as constrained behavioral adaptation across three interacting layers: information preservation, harness adaptation, and user acceptance; the layers apply to every scenario, not one-to-one to the three. The basic objective is non-degradation on prespecified capability measures while satisfying target requirements; aggregate improvement is stronger. Information calibration preserves independently validated source content still applicable to the target task. Harness calibration aligns observable artifacts at semantic checkpoints and repairs them through iteration, tool substitution, or local replanning within explicit budgets. User calibration enforces recipient-specific output contracts: templates, schemas, and section-level preferences. A global e-commerce example shows how shared standards coexist with site- and market-specific adapters and validation. We distinguish trainable policies from frozen-backbone configuration or controller optimization, and evidence verification from relative judgment and DPO/GRPO optimization. Recent harness-transfer and judge-validity studies motivate target-native execution records, separate audits of task validity and near-tie ranking, and matched target-native optimization controls. We propose held-out evaluations for model changes, cross-border adaptation, and scale, including a factorial test of source evidence and checkpoint repair and group-level reporting to prevent aggregate gains from masking local failures. This is a methodological proposal; implementation and empirical validation remain future work.

</details>


### [1759] [PEARL: Adaptive Prefill-Decode Execution with Elasticity for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35158)
*Jiaan Zhu,Wei Gao,Youhui Bai,Zewen Jin,Ju Huang,Siran Yang,Jiamang Wang,Lin Qu,Cheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEARL：面向异步Agentic RL的自适应PD执行与弹性资源协调系统，吞吐量达固定资源ROLL的2.17–2.79倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮rollout是Agentic RL的主要开销；异步执行与弹性GPU虽可加速，但增加rollout副本收益递减，且训练GPU在更新间隙闲置。有效资源利用还取决于prefill–decode（PD）配置：colocation与disaggregation的选择及最优PD比随工作负载变化，使资源扩展与PD配置相互依赖，且需在瞬态资源窗口内克服重配置成本实现收益。

Method: PEARL维护统一的GPU–worker–role状态，利用运行时profiling预测rollout批次完成时间（考虑环境导致的decode并发下降）；在当前GPU预算下选择PD模式与比例，并将决策转化为最小化worker与role变更的增量迁移计划；采用成本感知的切换与借用策略，抑制预期收益不足的迁移，同时保证训练GPU及时归还。

Result: 在不同LLM上，PEARL吞吐量达固定资源ROLL的2.17–2.79倍；相比RLBoost+，Qwen3-8B吞吐提升约26.9%，Qwen3-30B-A3B提升约36.3%。

Conclusion: 通过协调外部资源弹性、训练GPU临时复用与自适应PD执行，并配套增量迁移与成本感知策略，可在瞬态资源窗口内有效提升Agentic RL rollout吞吐。

Abstract: Multi-turn rollout dominates the cost of agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Asynchronous execution and elastic GPU resources can accelerate this stage, but adding rollout replicas yields diminishing returns while training GPUs remain idle between updates. We observe that effective resource use also depends on the prefill--decode (PD) configuration. Both the choice between colocation and disaggregation and the optimal PD ratio vary with the workload, making resource scaling and PD configuration interdependent. Exploiting this opportunity requires selecting effective configurations and realizing their benefits within transient resource-availability windows despite reconfiguration costs.
  We present PEARL, an asynchronous agentic RL system that coordinates external resource elasticity, temporary reuse of idle training GPUs, and adaptive PD execution. PEARL maintains a unified GPU--worker--role state and uses runtime profiles to predict rollout batch completion time, accounting for environment-induced reductions in decode concurrency. It selects the PD mode and ratio under the current GPU budget and translates each decision into an incremental transition plan that minimizes worker and role changes. Cost-aware switching and borrowing policies suppress transitions with insufficient expected benefit while ensuring timely return of training GPUs. Our evaluation show that PEARL achieves $2.17$--$2.79\times$ the throughput of fixed-resource ROLL across different LLMs. Compared with RLBoost+, throughput improves by up to approximately 26.9\% for Qwen3-8B and 36.3\% for Qwen3-30B-A3B.

</details>


### [1760] [FONDANT: Strong and Best-Effort Planning via Antichains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35160)
*Benjamin Aminof,Tuan Khai Nguyen,Sasha Rubin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个同时支持 best-effort 规划与强规划的可靠且完备的规划器，其核心是用 ⊆-极小元素表示获胜区域等状态集，并返回统一策略及失败状态的证书；实现为 FONDANT 后，在覆盖率上不劣于乃至优于现有规划器，在大规模实例上墙钟时间更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在完全可观察非确定性（FOND）规划中，强策略（获胜策略）并非总存在，且环境未必对抗；此时需要 best-effort 策略，它总是存在并遵循不应使用被支配策略的决策论原则。然而现有工作缺乏同时对 best-effort 规划与强规划都可靠且完备的规划器。

Method: 算法以 ⊆-极小元素表示获胜区域等状态集合，据此计算 strong-winning、weak-winning 与 losing 状态；返回统一策略：π_t 从每个 strong-winning 状态起为强解，π_w 从每个 weak-winning 状态起为弱解，并为失败状态集合提供证书。实现中加入若干简单优化，称为 FONDANT。

Result: 在由前沿强规划器 PR2、FOND-SAT 及 best-effort 规划器 BeSyftP 评估所用实例构成的基准集上评测：覆盖率在所有领域上至少不劣，并在部分领域更优；墙钟时间方面，在中小规模实例上较慢，在较大实例上更优。

Conclusion: 所提算法结构简单却兼具可靠性与完备性，能统一处理 best-effort 与强规划并给出失败证书；FONDANT 在覆盖率上具竞争力，且随实例规模增大展现出时间优势。

Abstract: A classical solution concept in fully observable nondeterministic (FOND) planning, is the strong policy (aka winning strategy in the closely related area of reactive synthesis), i.e., such a policy ensures that the goal is reached in an adversarial environment. When strong policies are not available or there is no evidence that the environment is adversarial, one can resort to best-effort policies, which always exist, and which follow the classic decision-theoretic principle that an agent should not use a dominated strategy. A typical positional best-effort policy works as follows: from every state, it follows a strong policy if one exists from that state (such states are called ``strong-winning''), else a weak policy if one exists from that state (``weak-winning''), and else is unconstrained (``losing''). In this work, we introduce a sound and complete planner for both best-effort planning and strong planning. The algorithm that underpins the planner is quite simple: it represents certain sets of states, such as the winning regions, by their $\subseteq$-minimal elements. The algorithm returns uniform policies, i.e., it returns a policy $π_t$ that is a strong solution starting in every strong-winning state, and it returns a policy $π_w$ that is a weak solution starting in every weak-winning state, and it provides a certificate for the set of losing states. We implemented the algorithm with some simple optimizations (calling it FONDANT), and evaluated it on a benchmark set consisting of the instances that were used in the evaluation of leading strong planners PR2 and FOND-SAT, and the best-effort planner BeSyftP. On coverage, our implementation is at least as good on all domains, and outperforms on some domains; and on wall time, it is slower on small and medium-sized instances, and outperforms on larger instances.

</details>


### [1761] [Beneath the Tokens: A Performance Engineering Study of Multi-Token Prediction in GPU-Accelerated LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35188)
*Suwesh Prasad Sah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在NVIDIA A10G上进行单请求对照实验，比较双Token多Token预测（MTP）与自回归解码，发现MTP通过摊薄重复GPU执行显著提升推理吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归大语言模型推理每次仅生成一个Token，需反复调用目标模型，使生成过程对GPU显存搬运和顺序执行高度敏感，性能受限。研究旨在评估多Token预测能否在受控单请求场景下缓解该问题并解释其性能来源。

Method: 在NVIDIA A10G GPU上进行受控单请求部署，对比双Token MTP与自回归解码。构建360条请求基准，覆盖纯文本、推理密集和工具调用三类负载；结合运行时遥测、Nsight Systems、PyTorch Profiler及部分Nsight Compute测量，对观测到的性能差异进行剖析。

Result: MTP在所有提示下将输出吞吐提升1.91×至2.19×，首输出时间降低10.0%–14.2%；平均接受长度的中位数为每次验证迭代2.370–2.595个Token。MTP引入了更长更复杂的执行路径（提议、采样、注意力、聚合与归约），但每生成Token所需的重复CUDA Graph执行次数减少56.4%–78.1%。MTP主导的GEMM核并不快于自回归主导的GEMV核，二者部分实例均接近A10G显存带宽上限。

Conclusion: 结果表明MTP通过“摊薄效应”改善推理：更大的Token推进幅度减少了重复GPU执行，其收益超过额外推测执行开销。

Abstract: Autoregressive large language model inference repeatedly invokes the target model to generate one token at a time, making generation sensitive to GPU memory movement and sequential execution. This study evaluates two-token multi-token prediction (MTP) against autoregressive decoding in a controlled single-request deployment on an NVIDIA A10G GPU. A 360-request benchmark covered plain-text, reasoning-intensive, and tool-calling workloads, while runtime telemetry, Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler, and selected Nsight Compute measurements were used to explain the observed performance. MTP increased output throughput by \(1.91\times\) to \(2.19\times\) across all prompts and reduced time to first output by 10.0--14.2\%. Median mean acceptance length ranged from 2.370 to 2.595 tokens per verification iteration. Profiling showed that MTP introduced a longer and more complex execution path, including proposal, sampling, attention, gathering, and reduction operations. However, it required 56.4--78.1\% fewer executions of the selected repeating CUDA Graph per generated token. The dominant MTP GEMM kernel was not faster than the dominant autoregressive GEMV kernel, and selected instances of both approached the A10G memory-bandwidth limit. These results show that MTP improved inference through amortization: greater token progress reduced repeated GPU execution sufficiently to outweigh the additional speculative-execution cost.

</details>


### [1762] [ASCT: Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35215)
*Yang Li,Jinhan Yang,hai liu,Di Wan,Xiyu Chen,Zongsi Xu,Tuo Zhou,Sheng Zhong,Sergey Volkov,Ye Luo,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ASCT框架，将训练时的多步搜索转化为局部动作信用，以提升完整智能体工作流的学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端效用只能评价完整的智能体工作流，但学习需要对工作流内部决策进行信用分配。

Method: 在actor访问的状态上，用辅助树从同一可恢复前缀出发评估替代合法动作；其动作价值表以冻结actor概率为中心，为PPO在actor采样轨迹上提供信用。Uniform、UCT和成本感知AgentUCT可实现该框架。

Result: 在HotpotQA智能体检索增强生成任务上，三种实例均优于轨迹回报PPO和工作流适配的VinePPO；三个种子下ASCT-AgentUCT效用达0.6187，VinePPO为0.5939，并在答案F1和执行成本上均有提升，记录的辅助Qwen token减少50.3%。

Conclusion: ASCT将反事实评估与策略学习连接起来，同时部署时仅需actor；迁移和组件描述研究进一步考察了所学策略在训练设置之外的表现。

Abstract: Terminal utility evaluates a complete agentic workflow, but learning requires credit for the decisions within it. We introduce Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees (ASCT), a framework that turns training-time multi-step search into local action credit. At actor-visited states, an auxiliary tree evaluates alternative legal actions from the same recoverable prefix. Its action-value table is centered by the frozen actor's probabilities and supplies credit for PPO on actor-sampled trajectories. This protocol connects counterfactual evaluation to policy learning while deploying the actor alone. Uniform, UCT, and cost-aware AgentUCT instantiate the framework. On HotpotQA agentic retrieval-augmented generation, all three improve mean held-out utility over trajectory-return PPO and workflow-adapted VinePPO. Across three seeds, ASCT-AgentUCT reaches 0.6187 utility versus 0.5939 for VinePPO, with gains in answer F1 and execution cost, and uses 50.3% fewer recorded auxiliary Qwen tokens. Transfer and component-description studies examine the learned policies beyond the training setting.

</details>


### [1763] [EP-Mem: Elastic Privacy Memory for Social Relationship-Aware LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35233)
*Fengzhou Sun,Yuan Zhang,Xintong Yu,Jinyao Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 EP-Mem——一种弹性隐私记忆架构，将隐私重构为跨社会角色、由用户掌控的边界控制，通过令牌级记忆与可插拔边车隐私引擎实现长时程关系型披露控制，并构建 EP-Bench 基准验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在"人-智能体-人"通信中充当代理时面临严重隐私风险。要防止泄露，智能体须理解用户的社会关系，并遵守依赖语境的社会信息披露边界。现有智能体记忆隐私研究聚焦于瞬时交互，尚未探索长时程、关系型的披露问题。

Method: 提出 EP-Mem 弹性隐私记忆架构，包含两部分：(1) 令牌级记忆，由用户可配置的隐私策略驱动，该策略对人（角色）与事件分层，将领域级默认流通规则与事实级白名单/黑名单例外相结合；(2) 可插拔边车及隐私引擎，在摘要、细节与边界三种粒度上使披露控制与记忆对齐，并在生成、存储与检索全流程强制执行。同时构建 EP-Bench 基准。

Result: EP-Bench 为首个面向策略条件化关系型披露、含跨会话关联事件的长时程多方基准。实验显示 EP-Mem 达到 94.0% 隐私分类准确率，将披露许可判断从 22% 提升至 68%，隐私泄露降低 75.6%，同时保持检索性能与跨基准泛化能力。

Conclusion: EP-Mem 通过用户可控的社会角色边界与多粒度披露控制，有效缓解 LLM 智能体在人-体-人通信中的长时程关系隐私泄露问题，且不牺牲检索与泛化性能，为智能体记忆隐私提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents face critical privacy risks when acting as delegates in human-agent-human communication. To prevent such breaches, agents must understand users' social relationships and adhere to context-dependent social information disclosure boundaries. Current studies on agent memory privacy focus on instantaneous interactions, leaving the long-term relational disclosure problem unexplored. In this paper, we propose EP-Mem, an Elastic Privacy Memory architecture that reframes privacy as user-owned boundary control across social roles. EP-Mem introduces (1) token-level memory driven by user-configurable a privacy policy that stratifies persons and events, combining domain-level default circulation rules with fact-level whitelist/blacklist exceptions; and (2) a pluggable sidecar with a privacy engine that aligns disclosure controls with memory across summary, detail, and boundary granularities, enforced throughout generation, storage, and retrieval. We construct EP-Bench, to our knowledge the first long-term multi-party benchmark with cross-session correlated events for policy-conditioned relational disclosure. Experiments show that EP-Mem achieves 94.0% privacy classification accuracy, improves disclosure-permission judgment from 22% to 68%, and reduces privacy leakage by 75.6%, while maintaining retrieval performance and cross-benchmark generalization.

</details>


### [1764] [Towards Reliable AI Data Scientists: Data Agents with Workflow Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35255)
*Huachi Zhou,Yujing Zhang,Jiahe Du,Jiacheng Cai,Zijin Hong,Chuang Zhou,Zheng Yuan,Qinggang Zhang,Qing Li,Xiao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从"工作流编排（harness）"视角系统综述了数据智能体（Data Agents），提出五阶段分类体系、15条技术路线、四大可靠性开放问题，并梳理任务族、应用场景与评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体被广泛用于数据密集型工作，但可靠的数据分析不能仅靠通用推理与临时性工具调用；端到端数据科学生命周期自动化亟需系统化的编排框架与可靠性支撑，而现有研究缺乏统一的组织视角与问题清单。

Method: 采用以编排为中心的综述方法：一是构建Data Agents及其数据环境的分类体系，围绕感知、规划、执行、验证、修复五个功能阶段组织文献；二是剖析各阶段关键技术路线，归纳出从"数据结构探测"到"数据状态重建"等15种不同方法；三是提炼四大可靠性开放问题；四是汇总横向任务族、纵向应用场景与评测基准，并维护配套开源仓库。

Result: 形成五阶段分类框架与15条技术路线的结构化图谱；识别出四项开放可靠性问题——语义校准失活、澄清缺失、经验迁移缺失、验证-修复资源库缺失；梳理了任务族、垂直应用与基准，并建立社区共享仓库。

Conclusion: 即使各组件单独运行正常，"静默失败"仍会持续存在，根源在于缺乏严格的编排框架与共享的可靠性资源；因此需要以工作流编排为核心推进Data Agents的可靠性建设。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for data-intensive work, yet reliable data analysis requires more than general-purpose reasoning and ad hoc tool augmentation. Data Agents, equipped with workflow harnesses, offer a promising paradigm for automating the end-to-end data science lifecycle. This paper examines Data Agents from a harness-centric perspective. First, we introduce a taxonomy of Data Agents and associated data environments, organizing the literature around five functional stages: perception, planning, execution, verification, and repair. Second, we analyze the key technical routes within each stage, identifying 15 distinct approaches ranging from data structure probing to data state reconstruction. Third, we identify four open reliability problems: inactive semantic calibration, missing clarification, missing experience transfer, and the missing verification-repair repository. These problems explain why silent failures can persist even when individual components function correctly, highlighting the need for rigorous workflow harnesses and shared reliability resources. Finally, we summarize the horizontal task families of Data Agents, examine their vertical application settings, and benchmarks for evaluation, while maintaining a companion repository at https://github.com/DEEP-PolyU/Awesome-Data-Agents.

</details>


### [1765] [Imprint Reader: From Weight-Update Readout to Behavioral Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35261)
*Guanxu Chen,Qihao Lin,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Imprint Reader，通过 Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning (SaRT) 训练模型用自然语言描述冻结的权重更新，并利用其可微代理特性支持 MetaEdit 干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型日益重要，人们希望其能像人类一样反思自身学习过程并借此自我改进；同时训练留下的参数级痕迹原则上可直接检查，但现有模型无法将这些痕迹解码为对所学内容的显式描述。

Method: 提出 Imprint Reader，采用 Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning（SaRT）训练：将每个权重更新挂载到 Reader 上，使用无锚点的元查询（anchor-free meta-query）引出自然语言描述；并用无变化与随机扰动对照抑制无依据的陈述。此外，Reader 提供目标行为与候选权重更新之间差距的可微代理，其坐标对齐梯度支持通过 MetaEdit 进行干预。

Result: 在留出的更新上，联合 Reader 在知识上达到基于评判的 Pass@100 为 2%，在行为上为 16%。在安全维护目标下，以 0.5% 剪枝率进行 Reader 引导选择，将有害提示拒绝率从 57.9% 提升至 64.1%。在不使用目标任务训练数据、仅用行为描述的情况下，MetaEdit 增加了数学推理轨迹中回溯与子目标表达频率，并将 BFCL Overall 从 41.69% 提升至 44.60%。

Conclusion: 结果证明了自然语言读出权重更新的可行性，同时指出跨更新可靠性是下一步需要解决的问题；Reader 作为可微代理可有效支持权重干预与行为调控。

Abstract: As language models take a growing role in AI development, a natural aspiration is for them to reflect on their own learning process, as humans do, and use that reflection to improve themselves. At the same time, these models have an advantage that human learners lack, since training leaves parameter-level traces that can, in principle, be inspected directly. However, current models cannot decode these traces into an explicit account of what they have learned. To this end, we introduce the \textit{Imprint Reader}, a model trained with \textit{Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning} (SaRT) to describe frozen weight updates. SMaRT mounts each update onto the Reader and uses an anchor-free meta-query to elicit a natural-language description, while no-change and random-perturbation controls discourage unsupported claims. On held-out updates, the joint Reader reaches judge-based Pass@100 of $2\%$ for knowledge and $16\%$ for behavior. These results demonstrate the feasibility of natural-language readout while pointing to reliability across updates as the next step. Beyond free-form generation, the Reader provides a differentiable proxy for the gap between a specified target behavior and a candidate weight update. Its coordinate-aligned gradients support intervention through MetaEdit. At a $0.5\%$ pruning rate, Reader-guided selection raises measured harmful-prompt refusal from $57.9\%$ to $64.1\%$ under a safety-maintenance target. Using behavior descriptions without target-task training data, MetaEdit increases the frequency of backtracking and sub-goal expressions in mathematical reasoning traces and raises BFCL Overall from $41.69\%$ to $44.60\%$.

</details>


### [1766] [Textual User Taste: Natural-Language User Context for Foundation-Model Recommender System at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35285)
*Ghazal Fazelnia,Paul Gigioli,Eliza Klyce,Sharon Zheng,Katie Zelvin,Ye Myat Thein,Anurag Deshpande,Seda Davtyan,Kate Remeika,Maya Hristakeva,Erik Franco,Karen Banzon,Peng Ge,Jacqueline Wood,Nandini Singh,David Murgatroyd,Mounia Lalmas,Yves Raimond,Andreas Damianou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"Textual User Taste"系统,从听歌行为、交互信号、内容元数据及用户反馈生成结构化自然语言"品味画像",并部署于Spotify数百万用户,评估其作为生产级用户表征的价值与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型推荐系统需要可被大语言模型消费、推理并支持自然语言交互的用户上下文。传统行为嵌入向量在召回与排序上高效,但对用户不透明,且不天然适配语言模型工作流,因此需要一种可解释、可引导的用户表征。

Method: 从听歌行为、交互信号、内容元数据和可选用户反馈生成结构化自然语言品味画像;构建覆盖生成、评估、优化、维护的端到端工业级生产流程,包括提示词开发与压缩、用户引导(steering)以及与下游个性化系统的集成;由于不存在唯一"真值"画像,提出多层面评估框架,既评估其独立预测信号的贡献,也评估其与行为嵌入融合后的效果。

Result: 品味画像能独立携带用户特定的预测信号;与行为嵌入结合后,未来曲目预测的MRR提升0.6%,搜索排序的NDCG@7提升2.2%。评估还表明画像支持正向自然语言引导,但存在明显局限,如否定表达处理和短期时序适应方面的困难。

Conclusion: 品味画像并非用于替代行为嵌入,而是作为不断演变的用户上下文与基础模型推荐系统之间可解释、可引导的接口。

Abstract: Foundation model recommender systems require user context that can be consumed by large language models, reasoned over, and refined through natural-language interaction. Traditional behavioral embedding vectors remain highly effective for retrieval and ranking, but they are opaque to users and not natively expressed for language model workflows. We present Textual User Taste, a system that generates structured natural-language taste profiles from listening behavior, interaction signals, content metadata, and optional user feedback, and deploys them to millions of Spotify users. We describe the end-to-end production lifecycle required to generate, evaluate, optimize, and maintain these representations at industrial scale, including prompt development and compression, user steering, and integration with downstream personalization systems. Because no unique ground-truth taste profile exists, we introduce a multi-faceted evaluation framework to evaluate taste profiles as a production representation: they carry user-specific predictive signal independently, and when integrated with behavioral embeddings, improve MRR by 0.6% for future-track prediction and NDCG@7 by 2.2% for search ranking. Our evaluation also reveals that taste profiles support positive natural-language steering, while exposing important limitations, including challenges with negation and short-term temporal adaptation. These findings position taste profiles not as replacements for behavioral embeddings, but as an interpretable and steerable interface between evolving user context and foundation-model recommender systems.

</details>


### [1767] [The Argument and the Letterhead: Source-Position Coherence in AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35286)
*Michele Loi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过预注册的描述性实验与后续补充收集，检验AI评估者能否区分“来源引发的意外感”与“论证质量差”，发现来源效应随论证内容变化，支持“来源—立场一致性”解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一个论证来自特定说话者可能令人意外，但这并不意味着论证本身不好。作者关心的是：AI评估者能否将“来源意外性”与“论证质量”这两种判断区分开来，即是否会对同一论证因来源不同而给出条件化的评价。

Method: 开展两项预注册描述性研究及一次后续Jev补充收集，围绕美国AI政策、德国债务刹车和瑞士核能三组主题的六个固定文本，在多种来源归属下呈现，共获得2,976份可用评估。关键比较是：两个来源之间的评分差距是否随论证内容变化而改变；并在不同主题与近期模型配置（含启用推理的配置）中考察交互作用。

Result: 在Sol上，国家安全论证在CODEPINK下均值为0.359、在College Republicans下为0.639；民权论证则为0.742与0.721，说明对某一来源的恒定偏好无法解释该模式。跨主题和较新模型配置中也出现相关交互，但若干比较效应较小。后续欧洲Jev补充得到五个低于所采用绝对参考值0.05的交互；其评分标准不同且收集中断，限制了与聊天系统的比较。部分书面评估明确提到来源与其被归属立场之间的不匹配。

Conclusion: 数值与文本证据共同表明，“来源—立场一致性”是可合理解释该现象的因素之一，但也存在可信度、真实性与任务解读等竞争性解释。论文通过受控比较推进该推断，在附录中报告条件性事后p值，并记录了由AI开展研究背后的人类决策与委托核查。

Abstract: An argument can be surprising coming from a particular speaker without being a bad argument. Do AI evaluators keep these judgments apart? Two preregistered descriptive studies and a later Jev supplement collected 2,976 usable evaluations of six fixed texts about US AI policy, Germany's debt brake and Swiss nuclear energy. Each text was presented under several source attributions. The key comparison asks whether the gap between two sources changes when the argument changes. On Sol, for example, a national-security argument received mean ratings of 0.359 under CODEPINK and 0.639 under College Republicans; a civil-rights argument received 0.742 and 0.721. A constant preference for one source cannot explain that pattern. Related interactions appeared across topics and recent model configurations, including those with reasoning enabled, while several comparisons yielded small effects. The later European Jev supplement yielded five interactions below the adopted absolute reference of 0.05; its distinct rubric and interrupted collection limit comparison with the chat systems. Some written evaluations explicitly invoked a mismatch between a source and its attributed position. Taken together, the numerical and verbal evidence supports source-position coherence as a plausible explanation, alongside competing accounts involving credibility, authenticity and interpretation of the task. The paper develops this inference through controlled comparisons, reports conditional post hoc p-values in an appendix, and documents the human decisions and delegated checks behind an AI-conducted study.

</details>


### [1768] [AbGaze: Attentive Geometric Representation Learning for End-to-End Antibody Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35296)
*Jiashuo Wang,Siqi Fan,Yizhen Luo,Zaiqing Nie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AbGaze是一个端到端抗体设计框架，通过注意力几何表征学习编码抗原表面相对抗体残基局部坐标系的距离、空间方向和表面法向取向，并自适应聚合几何交互；表征在多个CDR协同设计、复合物结构预测和亲和力优化任务间共享，并辅以局部坐标系几何监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算抗体设计需要能捕捉抗原-抗体相互作用几何模式的表征，但现有方法多依赖标量距离或表面内在特征，使跨分子几何信息大多隐含、未被显式建模。

Method: 提出AbGaze端到端框架，基于注意力几何表征学习：编码抗原表面相对于抗体残基局部坐标系的距离、空间方向与表面法向取向，并按界面上下文自适应聚合这些几何交互；学习到的交互表征在多CDR协同设计、复合物结构预测和亲和力优化之间共享，并用局部坐标系几何监督约束表征。

Result: 在三项任务上均优于先前方法：相比第二优方法，六个CDR上氨基酸恢复率平均提升7.1%、结构误差平均降低14.9%，界面对接质量(DockQ)提升6.6%，亲和力改善率(IMP)提升32.5%。

Conclusion: 显式建模跨分子几何关系并结合注意力自适应聚合与局部坐标系监督，可形成可共享的交互表征，统一提升抗体序列设计、结构预测与亲和力优化的性能。

Abstract: Computational antibody design requires representations that capture the geometric patterns underlying antigen--antibody interactions, yet existing approaches often rely on scalar distances or surface-intrinsic features, leaving cross-molecular geometry largely implicit. We present AbGaze, an end-to-end antibody design framework based on attentive geometric representation learning, which encodes distance, spatial direction, and surface-normal orientation of antigen surfaces relative to antibody-residue local frames, and adaptively aggregates these geometric interactions according to their interfacial context. The learned interaction representation is shared across multi-CDR co-design, complex structure prediction, and affinity optimization, with local-frame geometric supervision further constraining the representation. AbGaze outperforms prior methods across all three tasks: relative to the second-best method, it improves amino-acid recovery by 7.1% and reduces structural error by 14.9% on average over the six CDRs, improves interface docking quality (DockQ) by 6.6%, and raises the affinity improvement rate (IMP) by 32.5%.

</details>


### [1769] [Training-Free Clinical Reasoning through Medical Ontologies and Cognitive Mapping: A Symbolic-Probabilistic Knowledge Graph Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35298)
*Surajit Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练诊断范式 CKG Reasoner，将患者观测映射到显式医学知识，通过证据特征节点、信息门控与证据累积实现候选排序，并用无标签 K-means 导出队列级分配；在六个回顾性队列上报告 F1 与准确率，但声明非前瞻性验证或优越性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数临床预测系统仅学习"患者变量—结局"关联，缺乏对显式医学知识的可解释映射与审计能力。作者希望构建一种免训练、可审计、不依赖结局标签的诊断范式，以刻画知识引导的证据分离与敏感性。

Method: CKG Reasoner 包含候选特异证据特征节点、患者—参考匹配、有界信息门控、知识加权证据累积、疾病相似度与决定性临床规则；采用缺失感知归一化与覆盖率审计区分"缺失"与"不可得"证据。候选排序与结局标签无关的 K-means 聚类分离，聚类基于四个派生证据坐标（证据强度、相对幅度、方向相似性、证据完整性），而非原始预测变量或目标；统一的无标签、队列拟合 K=2 协议，使用冻结包与疾病特异知识表示。逻辑回归作为监督基线。

Result: 六个回顾性队列：四种登革热（N=1000、1523、989、1018）、疟疾（N=2190）、流感（N=4569），阳性类 F1 分别为 0.996、0.634、0.936、0.917、0.695、0.842；全记录准确率分别为 0.996、0.558、0.914、0.893、0.707、0.906，并实现完整分区决策覆盖。评分与聚类均不使用结局标签。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了知识根基的证据分离、可审计性与敏感性，而非前瞻性临床有效性或比较优越性；流感纳入确诊分子 PCR，不属独立预检预测；基于 FOL/LLM 的临床解释尚未评估。

Abstract: Most clinical prediction systems learn patient-variable-outcome associations; we investigate a training-free diagnostic paradigm mapping patient observations to explicit medical knowledge. CKG Reasoner integrates candidate-specific Evidence Feature Nodes, patient-reference matching, a bounded Information Gate, knowledge-weighted evidence accumulation, disease similarity, and decisive clinical rules. Missing-aware normalization and coverage auditing distinguish absent from unavailable evidence. Candidate ranking is separate from outcome-label-independent K-means clustering, which uses four derived evidence coordinates (evidence strength, relative magnitude, directional similarity, and evidence completeness), not raw predictors or targets, to derive cohort-level assignments. Across six retrospective cohorts - four dengue (N = 1000, 1523, 989, 1018), malaria (N = 2190), and influenza (N = 4569) - a uniform, label-free, cohort-fitted K = 2 protocol yielded positive-class F1 scores of 0.996, 0.634, 0.936, 0.917, 0.695, and 0.842, and all-record accuracies of 0.996, 0.558, 0.914, 0.893, 0.707, and 0.906, respectively, with full partition-decision coverage using the frozen package and disease-specific knowledge representations. Neither scoring nor clustering uses outcome labels. Logistic regression provides a supervised baseline. Influenza incorporates confirmatory molecular PCR and is not independent pre-test prediction. Results characterize knowledge-grounded evidence separation, auditability, and sensitivity, not prospective clinical validity or comparative superiority. FOL/LLM-based clinical explanation remains unevaluated.

</details>


### [1770] [Narrowing the Horizon: Quantifying Topic Saliency Shifts in Generative Monoculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35302)
*Oriane Peter,Elena Simperl,Kate Devlin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种测量模型家族间主题显著性变化的方法，用于诊断大语言模型在训练过程中出现的"生成单一文化"（generative monoculture）现象。以气候变化话语为案例，揭示了模型对多元解决方案的压缩，并验证专用模型干预可缓解该趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM日益成为获取与分享信息的核心工具，其输出可能逐渐收敛为"生成单一文化"，导致所代表的视角多样性随时间收窄。然而，模型层面的研究往往无法精确定位在此过程中哪些具体主题或观点被边缘化或被放大，因此需要一种更细粒度的测量手段。

Method: 提出一种测量模型家族间主题显著性变化（topic saliency shift）的方法，追踪后训练（post-training）阶段哪些主题获得或失去突出地位。将该方法应用于气候变化话语的案例研究，考察同质化如何影响不同模型对多元解决方案的表征，并进一步测试旨在抵消该趋势的干预措施。

Result: 在气候变化话语案例中，同质化显著影响了不同模型对多元解决方案的表征；干预实验表明，专用（specialised）模型有助于保留更广泛的视角范围。

Conclusion: 监测主题显著性对于诊断单一文化风险、确保AI系统反映思想多元性（pluralism）具有重要意义。数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to how we access and share information, they play an increasingly powerful role in shaping global knowledge. However, as these models evolve, their outputs risk converging into a \textit{generative monoculture}, where the diversity of perspectives they represent narrows over time. Studies at the model level often fail to pinpoint which specific topics or viewpoints are being marginalised or amplified in this process. In this paper, we introduce a method to measure shifts in topic saliency across model families, tracking what gains or loses prominence during post-training. Applying this approach to a case study of climate change discourse, we demonstrate how homogenisation affects the representation of diverse solutions across different models. We also test interventions to counter this trend, showing that specialised models can help preserve a broader range of perspectives. This underscores the importance of monitoring topic saliency to diagnose the risks of monoculture and to ensure AI systems reflect a pluralism of ideas. Data and Code are accessible \href{https://github.com/oriane/topic_saliency_shift}{here}.

</details>


### [1771] [Reliability Engineering for AI Systems: Challenges, Methods, and Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35316)
*Rong Pan,Yili Hong,Min Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将可靠性工程方法（失效定义、运行包络、FMEA、加速测试、现场监测、可靠性增长）迁移到AI系统，提出四层失效诊断框架，并以TEVV、序贯监测和FRACAS构建证据体系，配合SMART统计指南与NIST AI RMF治理框架，用三个案例加以说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统日益自主化，其"功能"已不止于输出正确，还包括检索、记忆、工具调用、权限、人类监督及系统间交互的一致与安全，生成式系统还须保证推理过程可靠。而平均基准准确率只衡量能力，无法量化这种更广义的可靠性主张，因此需要引入成熟的可靠性工程方法来界定和评估AI可靠性。

Method: 将传统可靠性工程方法适配到AI系统，包括失效定义、运行包络（operational envelopes）、FMEA、加速测试、现场监测与可靠性增长。提出四层诊断框架，将失效分为部件级、运行回路级、代理行为级（agentic-conduct）以及网络与治理级失效。以TEVV、序贯监测和FRACAS生成并更新可靠性证据；采用SMART提供测量、分析、评估与测试计划的统计指导，并以NIST AI风险管理框架提供治理、评估、监测与缓解的组织指导。

Result: 通过三个案例展示该可靠性方案的应用：卷积神经网络的对抗测试、感知误差传播分析，以及自动驾驶车辆的脱离（disengagements）事件。

Conclusion: 既有可靠性工程可为AI可靠性提供可用的基础，但由于AI系统具有自演化特性，仍需发展新的测量方法与安全护栏。

Abstract: AI reliability concerns whether an AI system performs its intended function dependably over a stated period and under stated operating conditions, with stated evidence. As these systems become more autonomous, that function includes more than a correct output. Retrieval, memory, tool use, permissions, human oversight, and interactions among systems must operate consistently and safely, and, for generative systems, so must the reasoning process that produces the output. Average benchmark accuracy measures capability; it does not quantify this broader reliability claim. This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods, from failure definitions and operational envelopes to FMEA, accelerated testing, field monitoring, and reliability growth, to AI systems. A four-level diagnostic framework classifies failures as component, operational-loop, agentic-conduct, or network and governance failures. Test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV), sequential monitoring, and FRACAS create and refresh evidence.
