Across ten simulated reef environments and six occupancy backbones evaluated under a single protocol, AquaBEV-Nav reaches 37.48 structure IoU and 53.2 target IoU, 88.95% closed-loop coverage with zero collisions.

</details>


### [1875] [Federated Subspace Guided Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation for Non-IID Multi-Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32239)
*Biprodip Pal,Kaushik Roy,Yanming Zhu,Brendan Tidd,Alan Wee-Chung Liew,Peyman Moghadam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出FedDRMan联邦子空间引导蒸馏框架，通过低秩多模态子空间与动作分布蒸馏、客户端兼容性分组和谱重平衡聚合，缓解异构机器人操作中的表示漂移与更新冲突，在LIBERO上峰值平均成功率80.7%，较最强联邦基线提升11.6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习可让多机器人无需集中训练演示即可共同改进操作策略，但任务与环境的非独立同分布（non-IID）分布会引发表示漂移和机器人策略更新相互冲突，导致朴素参数聚合具有破坏性。

Method: FedDRMan在每轮通信中由服务器模型提供冻结教师用于本地行为克隆，并利用低秩多模态子空间蒸馏与动作分布蒸馏保留全局有用的表示几何与策略行为；聚合层面按更新兼容性对客户端分组，为每个簇维护持久模型，并在服务器端对兼容聚合结果进行谱重平衡，以缓解较弱任务相关策略更新方向的衰减。

Result: 在LIBERO上覆盖多种non-IID设置、异构程度和客户端参与变化，并结合消融与聚合分析，FedDRMan显著改善知识迁移，持续优于强联邦基线，峰值平均成功率达80.7%，较最强评估联邦基线高11.6个百分点。

Conclusion: FedDRMan通过子空间引导蒸馏与兼容性分组谱重平衡聚合，有效应对异构机器人操作中的负迁移与更新冲突，为去中心化多机器人策略协同提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Federated learning offers a natural way for multiple robots to jointly improve manipulation policies without requiring centralized access to training demonstrations. However, non-IID task and environment distributions can induce representation drift and mutually incompatible robot-policy updates, making naive parameter aggregation destructive. We present FedDRMan, a federated subspace-guided distillation framework for heterogeneous robot manipulation. At each communication round, the server model provides a frozen teacher for local behavior cloning, while low-rank multimodal subspace and action-distribution distillation preserve globally useful representation geometry and policy behavior. To address heterogeneous aggregation, FedDRMan groups clients by update compatibility and maintains a persistent model for each cluster. The server then spectrally rebalances each compatible aggregate to mitigate attenuation of weaker task-relevant robot-policy update directions. Extensive experiments on LIBERO across diverse non-IID settings, heterogeneity levels, client participation variation, together with ablations and aggregation analyses, show that FedDRMan substantially improves knowledge transfer and consistently outperforms strong federated baselines achieving a peak mean success rate of 80.7%, 11.6 percentage points above the strongest evaluated federated baseline.

</details>


### [1876] [World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32626)
*Minghui Qin,Yijun Yuan,Weicheng Zheng,Kenan Li,Weibang Wang,Chang Sun,Junhao Huang,Anmin Liu,Yicheng Yao,Hang Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出世界SLAM模型（WSM），将SLAM核心机制内嵌到下游导航中，实现预测未来视觉状态并联合估计相机运动与稠密几何，端到端联合训练，兼顾导航性能与SLAM精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法仅将SLAM视为上游模块，只提供位姿、地图或token，未利用其状态维护与误差修正机制；长时程世界建模与具身交互需要一致的世界状态。

Method: WSM采用SLAM的核心机制：增量状态更新与持久记忆、后端对累积误差的修正。给定当前观测与导航目标，预测未来视觉状态并联合估计相机运动与稠密几何，将视觉预测锚定在演化的空间世界状态上；状态随新观测持续更新，作为动作生成与闭环导航基础；以导航—SLAM联合目标端到端训练。

Result: 实验显示导航性能提升，同时保持较强的SLAM精度。

Conclusion: SLM可作为长时程世界建模与具身交互的内禀机制。

Abstract: We introduce World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that brings the SLAM paradigm directly into downstream navigation. Rather than treating SLAM merely as an upstream module that provides poses, maps or tokens, WSM adopts its core mechanisms, including incremental state updates with persistent memory and backend refinement of accumulated errors, to maintain a consistent world state during interaction. Given the current observation and a navigation goal, WSM predicts future visual states and jointly estimates their camera motion and dense geometry, grounding visual prediction in an evolving spatial world state. This spatial state is continuously updated as new observations arrive and provides the basis for action generation and closed-loop navigation. WSM is trained end-to-end with a joint navigation--SLAM objective, enabling downstream navigation to benefit directly from SLAM-style state maintenance and refinement while preserving accurate geometric estimation. Experiments demonstrate improved navigation performance together with strong SLAM accuracy, highlighting the potential of SLAM as an intrinsic mechanism for long-horizon world modeling and embodied interaction.

</details>


### [1877] [An Empirical Study on What Matters for Viewpoint-Generalizable Policies in Visual Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32762)
*Mino Nakura,Sriram Krishna,Yufei Wang,Shubham Tulsiani,Zackory Erickson,David Held*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实证研究，探究何种设计选择能让视觉运动策略在视角扰动下保持泛化，发现保留密集视觉token并让动作头参与几何推理可显著提升视角泛化，并实现从仿真到真机的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉模仿学习在机器人操作任务中前景广阔，但现有策略对视角扰动脆弱，难以在多样环境中部署。作者希望系统地理解哪些设计选择决定了视觉运动策略的视角泛化能力。

Method: 开展受控实证研究（controlled empirical study），对比不同设计选择对视角泛化的影响；核心发现为保留密集视觉token（dense visual tokens）以及让动作头（action head）参与几何推理（geometric reasoning）。在覆盖广泛相机位姿的仿真任务套件上进行评估。

Result: 采用上述设计选择的策略在广泛的相机位姿范围内保持良好性能；该策略还能在随机相机配置下从仿真零样本（zero-shot）迁移到真实世界。同时指出保留密集视觉token与动作头参与几何推理是提升视角泛化的关键因素。

Conclusion: 视角泛化能力主要由表征密度（保留密集视觉token）与动作头是否参与几何推理两类设计选择决定；这些设计选择不仅提升仿真中的视角鲁棒性，还带来仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移能力，为多样化环境部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Visual imitation learning is a promising approach to training robot manipulation policies capable of completing a wide variety of tasks. However, policies today remain brittle to viewpoint perturbations, making deployment in diverse environments a challenge. We present a controlled empirical study of which design choices allow visuomotor policies to generalize across viewpoints. We find that viewpoint generalization improves when dense visual tokens are retained and the action head participates in geometric reasoning. On a suite of simulated tasks that span a wide range of camera poses, we show that these design choices yield a policy that remains performant across viewpoints. As a practical consequence, a policy trained with these design choices also transfers zero-shot from simulation to the real world under random camera configurations.

</details>


### [1878] [FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32855)
*Khang H. Nguyen,Hoang Pham Quang Nguyen,Ha Phuong Nguyen,Khanh Dinh Binh,Xuan Ha Nguyen,Vien Ngo,Duy Ho Nguyen Minh,Huan Nguyen,An T. Le*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FINE 是一种未来信息导航编码框架，从已有示范轨迹的未来观测中挖掘潜在监督，通过显式地标 token 与隐式未来 token 两类辅助表征增强 VLN 策略，在示范数据受限时收益尤为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将视觉语言导航（VLN）策略迁移到新环境成本高昂，因为每条新增路线与指令都需具身示范。而标准的"观测到动作"训练仅利用了轨迹中已有信息的一小部分，未来观测中关于指令相关地标的语义与 3D 空间布局信息被浪费。作者希望在不增加示范的前提下，从现有示范中榨取这部分潜在监督信号。

Method: FINE 为 VLN 主干网络配备两种互补的辅助表征：(1) 显式地标 token：按指令指定的地标顺序排列，训练其预测未来地标区域，监督同时施加于语义 2D patch 特征空间和视角相关的 3D 几何特征空间；(2) 隐式未来 token：学习区分实际到达的地标状态与由视频世界模型生成的、同一场景下合理的反事实未来。

Result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上，完整训练数据下 FINE 将 InternVLA-N1 的成功率分别提升 2.6 与 4.5 个百分点。示范数据越少收益越大：在 70% 示范预算下，成功率提升 6.8 个百分点，约挽回因减少示范而损失性能的三分之一。

Conclusion: 利用轨迹中未来观测所蕴含的地标语义与 3D 几何监督，可有效提升 VLN 策略的性能与数据效率，尤其缓解低示范预算下的性能退化，为 VLN 的可扩展训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at https://finevln.github.io/.

</details>


### [1879] [TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33000)
*Yuhang Wang,Jingxin Yang,Chuheng Wei,Yuechen Guo,Jinghan Xu,Zhao Han,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 TriDrive，首个联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求的自动化条件转移模型，并在公开基准、自然驾驶数据与实车部署中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作通常孤立建模舱内活动或交通条件下的驾驶员运动，缺乏对驾驶员、车辆与道路场景三者交互演化的联合建模，也难以满足车载实时评估需求。

Method: 构建统一框架 TriDrive，采用自动化条件转移模型；模态专属编码器分别处理驾驶员锚定运动学表示、因果 CAN 总线动力学、冻结 V-JEPA 2 道路隐变量及结构化道路边界；通过有向残差连接使驾驶员与道路上下文精炼车辆预测；并蒸馏道路编码器以支持实时运行。

Result: 在 AIDE 基准上运动学编码方案达 SOTA（All-MPJPE 48.05 对 71.47）；在 197.2 小时 BATON 子集上，有向连接与道路边界将辅助介入下转向起始 PR-AUC 提升 0.084、碰撞时间下降提升 0.286；在 comma four 加外置 8 GB GPU 上，轻量当前状态预警探针以 5 Hz、177 ms p95 延迟更新，AUROC 0.725 优于 openpilot 基线 0.563；14 名驾驶员实车配对研究中，其预警适当性（+1.79）与及时性（+2.67）评分更高。

Conclusion: 联合驾驶员—车辆—道路建模可有效提升预测性能与预警质量，且经蒸馏后可满足车载实时部署要求，为驾驶员监控提供统一且实用的方案。

Abstract: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model. Modality-specific encoders (an anchored kinematic representation of the driver, causal CAN-bus dynamics, and frozen V-JEPA 2 road latents with structured road margins) are connected by directed residual connections through which driver and road context refine vehicle forecasts. We evaluate TriDrive on three downstream tasks. On the public AIDE benchmark, its kinematic encoder recipe sets a new full-set state of the art (SOTA) among published baselines (48.05 versus 71.47 All-MPJPE). On 197.2 hours of naturalistic BATON subset, directed connections and road margins raise assistance-engaged PR-AUC by 0.084 for steering onset and 0.286 for time-to-collision drops. For real-time use, we distill the road encoders and run TriDrive on a comma four with an external 8 GB GPU, where a lightweight current-state warning probe updates at 5 Hz with 177 ms p95 latency while the joint model forecasts concurrently. The probe is above an openpilot-based baseline on human-labeled manual-driving warnings (AUROC 0.725 versus 0.563), and in a paired on-road study 14 drivers rate its warnings as more appropriate (+1.79) and timely (+2.67) than those of openpilot's driver-monitoring system.

</details>


### [1880] [Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33172)
*Sunwoo Park,Wonbin Lee,Seonghyun Jin,Youngmin Kim,Jangho Park,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出动态预测规划（DPP）框架，将动态操作建模为反事实规划，通过解耦规划生成所用上下文与执行所用物理状态，缓解目标响应塌缩，无需动态数据再训练即实现实时动态操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于静态示范训练的世界-动作模型（WAMs）即使已具备所需操作技能，也难以操作运动目标。作者将这一失败归因于"目标响应塌缩"：随着执行推进，策略愈发偏向已学到的当前行为延续，对目标位置变化的响应性下降。核心动机是弥合模型所学内容与基于当前上下文可生成内容之间的差距。

Method: DPP将动态操作形式化为反事实规划，解耦规划生成的上下文与执行的物理状态。首先利用WAM的预测 rollout 估计交互预计发生的时间，并结合观测到的目标运动预测目标未来的交互位置；随后构造反事实观测，将预测的目标位置置于熟悉的机器人上下文中，使模型调用已有操作技能，而非从未见过的机器人-目标构型中生成恢复行为；最后将生成的规划在执行时与机器人实际状态衔接。

Result: DPP无需在动态数据上额外训练，即可在单块消费级GPU上实现实时动态操作。仿真与真实机器人实验表明，在多种目标运动下性能一致提升，仿真性能超越所有评估基线，包括额外在动态数据上训练的方法。

Conclusion: 通过反事实规划解耦上下文与物理状态，DPP有效缓解目标响应塌缩，以低成本（无额外训练、单GPU实时）显著提升动态操作性能。项目页面：https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/

Abstract: World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation.
  To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution.
  DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data.
  Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/

</details>


### [1881] [DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33177)
*Tianyun Jiang,Wenrui Bao,Bingxin Xu,Yu Tian,Yuzhang Shang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DeltaWAM 是一种以“变化”为中心的世界-动作模型：以单个 delta token 作为未来预测单元，编码相邻 DINO 特征图之间的变化，结合预训练潜在世界模型 DeltaWorld 与流匹配动作专家，在 LIBERO 上取得 92.8% 平均成功率，推理 142.1 ms/动作块、峰值显存 3.86 GB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素空间世界-动作模型（WAMs）需重建整幅未来场景，计算开销大且存在严重时空冗余；而物理操作中相邻帧的视觉上下文大多共享，真正需要动作策略预测的是帧间变化。

Method: 提出 DeltaWAM：以紧凑的 delta token 为未来预测单元，每个 token 是一个向量，编码相邻稠密 DINO 特征图之间的变化；基于大规模视频预训练的潜在世界模型 DeltaWorld，自回归地每帧预测一个 delta token；流匹配（flow-matching）动作专家以预测的转移量和当前 DINO 特征（作为空间锚点）为条件，生成动作块。模型 0.725B 参数，在 2 张 H100、256 GPU 小时内训练完成。

Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上达到 92.8% 平均成功率；在 LIBERO-Pro 的过程性扰动下展现出稳健的泛化能力；推理每动作块耗时 142.1 ms，峰值显存 3.86 GB。

Conclusion: 以帧间变化（delta token）替代像素级整帧重建，可显著降低世界-动作模型的时空冗余与计算成本，同时保持高成功率与泛化性，为机器人操作中的高效视觉前瞻提供了一种紧凑有效的建模范式。

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.

</details>


### [1882] [PORTER: Edge-Cloud Residency for Persistent 3D Scene Graph Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33258)
*Yue Chang,Yifan Tian,Jiajing Peng,Dazhi Huang,Rufeng Chen,Zhaofan Zhang,Li Chen,Sihong Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PORTER框架，将3DSG的持久性与驻留性解耦：轻量锚点留在边缘机器人内存，重型对象负载在边缘与云间迁移，并用ISE度量按字节最小边际损失进行预算感知卸载。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任务驱动/即时（just-in-time）3DSG方法仅按任务构建或激活相关信息，能压缩单任务表示，但无法限制机器人全生命周期的板载内存：任务切换时，早期任务积累的负载可能对当前任务无关却对未来任务有用，保留会导致本地内存持续增长，全部丢弃又会在后续重复高成本构建。

Method: PORTER将持久性（persistence）与驻留性（residency）解耦：轻量锚点常驻边缘机器人有限内存，重型对象负载在边缘与云之间迁移。针对"相关性不足以决定驻留"（多个相关负载可能信息冗余）的问题，将每个任务分解为功能需求（functional requirements），提出不可替代支撑擦除（Irreplaceable Support Erasure, ISE）指标，度量卸载造成的需求覆盖损失；ISE对可替代支撑进行折扣，并在某需求剩余覆盖较弱时对损失施加更强惩罚。据此反复卸载单位字节边际ISE最小的负载，构建预算感知的本地工作集。

Result: 在JITOMA-Bench上对四种3DSG构建器进行评估。在渐进压缩（progressive compression）下，卸载91%的负载字节时，汇总相对mR@3仍保持100%。

Conclusion: 将驻留决策从"相关性"转向基于功能需求覆盖的不可替代性度量，可在极端卸载比例下维持任务性能，为长生命周期机器人3DSG的内存受限部署提供有效方案。

Abstract: Recent task-driven and just-in-time 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) methods reduce per-task representations by constructing or activating only task-relevant information. Yet sparse per-task working sets do not bound onboard memory usage over a robot's lifetime: as tasks change, payloads accumulated for earlier tasks may become irrelevant to the current task but can be useful again in future tasks. Over repeated task switches and expanding environments, retaining such reusable payloads causes local memory to grow, whereas discarding them entirely can lead to costly repeated construction of the same payloads later. We introduce PORTER, which decouples persistence from residency: lightweight anchors remain in the limited memory of the edge robot while heavy object payloads migrate between the edge and the cloud. Relevance alone is insufficient for deciding residency because multiple relevant payloads may provide redundant information. We therefore decompose each task into functional requirements and introduce Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE), which measures the loss in requirement coverage caused by offloading. ISE discounts replaceable support and penalizes losses more strongly when the remaining coverage of a requirement is weak. PORTER constructs a budget-aware local working set by repeatedly offloading the payload with the smallest marginal ISE per byte. Experiments on JITOMA-Bench evaluate PORTER across four 3DSG builders. Under progressive compression, pooled relative mR@3 remains at 100% through 91% payload-byte offloading.

</details>


### [1883] [Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33269)
*Arash Akbari,Arman Akbari,Jingwu Luo,Yuhao Lei,Yi Gao,Weiwei Chen,Xuan Zhang,Zhenman Fang,Geng Yuan,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Q-WAM，一种面向 World Action Models 的 4-bit 权重-激活量化方法，通过 Action Observability Gramian 与 Action-Subspace Protection 保护动作敏感通道组合，在仿真与真机上均保持接近 16-bit 的动作生成质量并大幅降低内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: World Action Models 通过迭代扩散联合生成视频与机器人动作，在操作任务上表现优异，但其计算与内存开销极高，难以部署。现有 PTQ 方法（如平滑、旋转）不足以维持动作生成精度，因此需要针对动作生成特性设计新的量化方案。

Method: 1) 提出 Action Observability Gramian (AOG)，度量每层输入通道加权组合的舍入误差经过所有去噪步骤后对最终动作的影响；2) 设计 Action-Subspace Protection (ASP)，将少数最动作敏感的通道组合保留在 16-bit 低秩分支中，其余权重与激活量化为 4-bit，二者均以稠密矩阵乘法在 GPU 上高效执行；3) 通过聚合各专家层中 AOG 导出的动作质量，识别对生成动作最关键的专家，仅对这些专家应用 ASP 以降低开销。

Result: 在三个 WAM 上于仿真和真实部署中评估。RoboTwin 2.0 基准上平均成功率达 89.6–93.0%，与 16-bit 模型相差 1.1 个百分点以内，量化块内存降低 3.1–3.4×；较最强基线 SVDQuant 高出 2.5–8.7 个百分点。在 Unitree G1 人形与双臂 UR3 机器人上，成功率较 SVDQuant 提升 12.8–17.6 个百分点。

Conclusion: Q-WAM 通过动作可观测性与子空间保护实现 WAM 的 4-bit 量化，在保持动作生成精度的同时显著降低内存，并在仿真与真实机器人部署中优于现有 PTQ 基线。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.

</details>


### [1884] [SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33311)
*Chengqun Yang,Tengjie Zhu,Liang Xu,Fulong Liu,Guanzhu Ren,Yitong Xing,Xuefeng Lu,Fei Shi,Siyuan Fan,Weijie Dong,Yao Mu,Xiaokang Yang,Yichao Yan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SocialHumanoid系统，实现类人机器人一步式协同语音动作生成，支持情感控制与低延迟连续生成，并构建AffectMoCap数据集提供情感身体表达监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类人机器人需具备与语音同步、具情感表现力且可实时执行的身体行为。但现有协同语音方法主要面向数字人，缺乏对情感控制和物理实体上低延迟连续生成的联合支持。

Method: 给定响应语音与指定情感条件，单次前向传播生成整段全身动作窗口，并通过动作历史条件连接相邻窗口；将生成的人体动作在线转换为与实体兼容的机器人参考，由全身控制器跟踪执行实现物理执行。同时构建AffectMoCap数据集（由两名专业演员采集的4小时数据，含同步语音、身体动作、精细手部动作及情感标注）以提供情感身体表达的显式监督。

Result: 在BEAT2上，SocialHumanoid在对比生成方法中取得最优FGD，语音-动作同步性具竞争力，相同协议下推理速度约为GestureLSM的6倍。感知评估表明使用AffectMoCap训练可提升从生成身体动作中的情感识别；真实机器人实验展示连续情感条件行为与稳定的长时程执行。

Conclusion: SocialHumanoid通过一步式协同语音动作生成与AffectMoCap数据集，实现了具表现力的类人机器人行为，兼顾情感控制、低延迟连续生成与真实机器人上的稳定长时程执行。

Abstract: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately $6\times$ faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution. Our project page is https://rex0191.github.io/SocialHumanoid/.

</details>


### [1885] [Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33378)
*Seungyeon Kim,Junhoo Lee,Minkyu Kim,Baekseung Kim,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出递归套具蒸馏（Recursive Harness Distillation），将强智能体的故障干预经验蒸馏为可复用手册，供轻量智能体复用并递归精化，无需更新模型参数即可提升操作任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作需跨任务与环境适配。VLA模型虽具备广泛操作能力，但在需要诊断失败并调整行为时表现不足，因此需要将强智能体的干预经验沉淀为可复用知识。

Method: 强智能体通过与VLA策略交互发现有效干预，将其经验蒸馏为供轻量智能体使用的"手册(playbook)"；再依据轻量智能体的执行反馈递归精化该手册，使干预知识在新任务实例中复用而无需更新模型参数。

Result: 真实世界操作成功率由37.3%提升至64.0%；在SimplerEnv Bridge上，携带手册的轻量智能体达66.7%成功率，优于仅用GR00T基线（41.7%）及无手册的强智能体；同一手册也使强智能体提升至79.2%。

Conclusion: 验证了套具蒸馏在机器人领域的可行性：干预经验可被积累、经执行反馈精化，并跨智能体复用，从而提升操作性能。

Abstract: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.

</details>


### [1886] [AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33522)
*Asya Ünal,Amr Okasha,Ege Çırakman,Perin Ünal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍在银线厨房电器工厂落地的AI辅助协作检测单元（AI-PRISM项目）：UR 10e协作机器人+机器视觉负责缺陷检测，Comau Racer-5负责功能测试，基于ROS 2 Humble与Ubuntu 22.04协调，融合视觉、声学与电气安全多模态数据并用Grafana实时可视化，给出工程挑战与解决方案，并以四层人机交互框架分析集成。现场结果表明单件质检时间由82 s降至61 s（约25%），终检资源效率0.75→0.88，人工目检观看时间减少82%，NASA-TLX心理负荷显著下降（p=0.005）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配线上人工目检是长期存在的制造瓶颈：长时间轮班导致操作员疲劳，从而降低缺陷检出率。因此需要以AI辅助的协作检测替代或减轻人工目检负担。

Method: 构建AI辅助协作检测单元：UR 10e协作机器人搭载机器视觉缺陷检测流水线，Comau Racer-5协作机器人执行功能测试；通过ROS 2 Humble在Ubuntu 22.04 LTS服务器上协调。采集并本地记录多模态数据（Basler相机图像、TIA麦克风声学信号、SPS电气安全测量），并用Grafana实时可视化。同时以四级人机交互（HRI）分析框架组织系统集成。

Result: 单件质检时间从82 s降至61 s（约25%）；终检资源效率从0.75提升至0.88；操作员视觉检测观看时间减少82%；NASA-TLX显示心理负荷显著降低（p=0.005）。

Conclusion: 该现场部署验证了AI辅助协作检测单元在真实工厂环境中的可行性与效益，同时总结了近距离安全、眩光与反射下AI鲁棒性、双协作机器人ROS 2命名空间冲突及操作系统与依赖问题等实际挑战及相应工程解决方案。

Abstract: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).

</details>


### [1887] [DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33836)
*Sanjay Acharjee,Md Nazmus Sakib*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DeltaSeek框架，研究演化建筑环境中主动感知的前提问题——机器人感知形态如何限制其可获取的观测，并通过Husky A300+UR5e在IFC基准上对比底盘与腕部RGB-D配置的观测能力与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑环境持续演化带来大幅几何变化，导致静态建图与配准性能下降，需要主动感知让机器人主动选择感知配置以解析环境当前状态。更宏观目标是"在哪、如何、何时观测"的推理系统，但本文聚焦其关键前提：感知形态如何约束机器人可获取的观测。

Method: 形式化定义感知形态的"允许观测集"（permissible observation set）；使用Husky A300搭载UR5e，在IFC推导的基准上评估底盘安装与腕部安装两种RGB-D配置；以几何可见性对观测评分，以可行驶距离衡量代价；在含八处受控变化、四种可观测性条件的房间尺度场景中，对240个允许底盘位姿与五种手臂姿态进行穷举评估。

Result: 八处变化中有两处不存在任何底盘视点，而腕部相机均可解析；对两者均可观测的变化，腕部相机的中位底盘行驶距离为6.0 m，底盘相机为15.2 m。

Conclusion: 结果将"感知局限"与"获取成本"区分开来，明确某一观测究竟是物理上不可能获得，还是仅需更多移动代价，为主动感知中的观测可行性判断提供依据。

Abstract: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.

</details>


### [1888] [ArticulateArena: A Metric for Articulated Kinematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33931)
*Yumeng He,Yongfei She,Huanyu Chen,Chun Yuan,Peihao Li,Joseph Masterjohn,Yin Yang,Ying Jiang,Chenfanfu Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 ArticulateArena，一种表示不变的关节度量，比较单自由度关节诱导的运动而非其参数编码，并将其提升为运动感知的树编辑距离，同时发布 ArticulateArena-20K 数据集与重评估结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有铰接物体重建方法不仅预测几何还预测关节连接与运动，但关节预测评估困难：关节指定的是运动而非形状，运动之间缺乏公认距离。现有协议将关节类型、轴方向、原点、运动限位分开打分，而这些参数共同描述同一物理运动，同一运动可有不同参数表示，导致等价编码之间可能评分极差，且部分分量误差在预测准确处病态或无定义。

Method: 提出 ArticulateArena，作为关节的表示不变 Chamfer 距离对应物，比较单自由度关节诱导的运动而非编码参数。用关节的李代数端点旋量的无序对表示每个关节，证明所得商距离为度量；统一固定、旋转、移动与螺旋关节，并通过紧化将连续关节纳入同一评分；以质量分布加权后其读数为运动部件以米为单位的 RMS 运动。进一步用运动感知的树编辑距离将该度量提升到完整运动学树，以同一运动单位对结构错误（如多余或缺失关节）定价，并在固定内积下保持树在重标号意义下的度量性。

Result: 发布 ArticulateArena-20K：包含 19,977 个具有已验证运动学的铰接物体新套件；并在新度量下重新评估已发表的重建方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为铰接预测提供表示不变、可解释且具度量性质的评估框架，统一多种关节类型并覆盖结构错误，配套数据集支持对现有重建方法的重新基准评估。

Abstract: Modern methods reconstruct or generate simulation-ready articulated objects, predicting not only their geometry but also how their parts are connected and allowed to move. Evaluating the geometry is straightforward, but evaluating the predicted articulation is not, because articulation specifies a motion rather than a shape, and there is no agreed distance between two motions. More specifically, existing protocols score joint type, axis direction, origin, and motion limits separately, although these parameters jointly describe a single physical motion, and the same motion can be written as different parameter values. As a result, a joint can score maximally wrong against an equivalent encoding of itself, and several component errors are ill-conditioned or undefined exactly where predictions become accurate. We propose ArticulateArena, a representation-invariant counterpart of Chamfer distance for articulation that compares the motions one-DOF joints induce rather than the parameters that encode them. It represents each joint by the unordered pair of its Lie-algebra endpoint twists, and we prove that the resulting quotient distance is a metric. It unifies fixed, revolute, prismatic, and helical joints, brings continuous joints into the same score through a compactification, and reads as the RMS motion of the moving part in meters when weighted by its mass distribution. A motion-aware tree edit distance lifts the metric to full kinematic trees, pricing structural errors such as spurious or missing joints in the same motion units as joint errors, and for a fixed inner product it remains a metric on trees up to relabeling. Alongside the metric we release ArticulateArena-20K, a new suite of 19,977 articulated objects with verified kinematics, and we re-evaluate published reconstruction methods on it under the new metric. Project page: https://heyumeng.com/ArticulateArena-web/

</details>


### [1889] [EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33939)
*Diksha Aggarwal,Rutvik Dagadkhair,Sanjana Srivastava,Bradley Denby,Kevin Kochersberger*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种几何推导、无需训练的深度估计方法，利用两幅单目图像与相机位姿，通过极线迁移合成虚拟立体对，将时序对应转化为立体三角测量，在室内外均优于现成学习基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的3D空间理解对自主导航、避障和场景重建至关重要。现有学习式深度估计在分布内精度高，但对新视角和新高度泛化能力差，且需大量训练数据。

Method: 提出几何推导、无需训练的深度估计方法，仅需两幅单目图像和相机位姿估计。利用相机运动合成具有自由选择基线的虚拟立体对，将时序对应转化为立体三角测量任务，同时缓解直接双视图三角测量固有的几何退化问题。

Result: 在户外无人机飞行（最大约90m）和室内OptiTrack环境中以LiDAR为真值验证：室内AbsRel为0.092，δ<1.25为0.940，与直接三角测量（AbsRel 0.073）相当，但在更多困难场景中保持有效深度；显著优于ZoeDepth（AbsRel 0.225）和Depth Anything V2（AbsRel 0.570）等未针对该域训练的现成学习基线。

Conclusion: 该方法无需训练数据，通过虚拟立体对与立体三角测量实现跨视角、跨高度的稳健深度估计，在挑战性场景中比直接三角测量覆盖更广的有效深度，并大幅超越现成学习式基线。

Abstract: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $δ< 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.

</details>


### [1890] [Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33982)
*Ivan Kapelyukh,Yafei Hu,Ran Gong,Brandon May,Tushar Kusnur,Laura Herlant,Karl Schmeckpeper,Edward Johns,Xiaohan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Simify：免训练、测试时框架，通过大规模并行物理仿真进行显式空间推理，从单张RGB-D图像重建仿真资产，用进化搜索优化物体排布，在真实机器人上完成复杂物体重排任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间推理是通用机器人智能的基础，能使机器人完成涉及多物体交互的长时序任务；现有基础模型在空间推理上仍存在不足。

Method: 免训练、测试时框架。从单张RGB-D场景图像出发，利用3D生成模型与视觉语言模型重建可直接仿真的资产；在给定奖励函数（如搭建最高塔）后，于仿真中启动数千条并行rollout，并通过进化搜索优化物体摆放布局。

Result: 在真实机器人硬件上进行定量实验，证明该框架能够端到端执行对先前未见物体的复杂重排任务；相比此前的空间推理基础模型，效果更优，凸显了推理阶段利用大规模并行仿真的有效性；同时表明完整且准确的几何信息对成功的sim-to-real迁移至关重要。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了在测试时显式调用大规模并行物理仿真进行空间推理的可行性与优势，并强调了精确几何重建在仿真到现实迁移中的关键作用。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.

</details>


### [1891] [ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34010)
*Ivan Kapelyukh,Xiaohan Zhang,Stephen James,Laura Herlant,Edward Johns*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ZeroBot 提出一种 real2sim 框架，仅凭单视角图像与目标位姿，通过 image-to-3D 生成模型构建物体网格，并结合几何与价值函数引导的动作空间进行大规模并行强化学习，在数分钟内实现无需人类示范、无需策略预训练、无需已知物体模型的机器人操作学习，真实任务平均成功率 87%，平均训练时间 119 秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作学习通常依赖人类示范、策略预训练或已知物体模型，成本高、泛化受限；本文旨在挑战"零示范、零预训练、零已知物体模型"的极端条件，实现快速、自主的机器人学习。

Method: 输入仅为物体单视角图像与目标位姿；利用 image-to-3D 生成模型生成完整物体网格，并将其导入仿真环境以支持大规模并行强化学习；为加速训练，提出一种利用生成几何与学习到的价值函数来采样机器人-物体接触状态的动作空间。

Result: 在抓取、推动、关节物体交互及多阶段操作等真实世界任务上评估，ZeroBot 取得 87% 的成功率，平均训练时间为 119 秒。

Conclusion: 结果证明了将 image-to-3D 模型用于 real2sim 框架中，可实现快速、自主的机器人学习，凸显生成式三维建模在机器人操作中的价值。

Abstract: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.

</details>


### [1892] [Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34061)
*Xuan Wang,Yinan Wu,Haoran Duan,Jungong Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文将回归与流匹配统一在同一目标下，并扩展出分位数目标，设计Quantile Head在一次前向中预测中位数与正间隔，形成有序边际动作分位数，从而支持多种采样策略并联合监督训练默认中位数策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型常将预训练VLM与动作头结合用于机器人控制，但常见动作头存在明显局限：点回归仅给出动作分布的点估计，而标准流匹配采样器需要昂贵的迭代采样。因此需要一种既能表达分布又采样高效的动作头设计。

Method: 作者将回归与流匹配统一在一个共享目标下，并推导出分位数目标；据此设计Quantile Head，单次前向预测中位数与正间隔，构成有序的边际动作分位数。这些分位数无需重训练即可支持多种采样策略，并被联合监督以训练默认的中位数策略。作者还对联合监督进行了局部分析。

Result: 局部分析表明，在邻近分位数已校准、间隔固定且校正速度匹配时，直接的中位数更新比仅用中位数监督具有更低方差。实验方面，该联合监督的中位数策略在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro及两个真机任务上取得对比方法中最高的平均成功率，并在匹配的LIBERO基线中拥有最短的平均回合时间。

Conclusion: 统一回归与流匹配的分位数目标及Quantile Head为VLA动作头提供了兼具分布表达与高效采样的方案，联合监督的中位数策略在多个基准与真机任务上优于对比方法，代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.

</details>


### [1893] [AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34085)
*Haoran Zhu,Wancong Zhang,Yann LeCun,Anna Choromanska*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了现有 JEPA 类世界模型在端到端自动驾驶中的表现，发现其存在精度与效率的权衡，进而提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，通过 SIGReg 正则化可学习投影器大幅降低计算量并保持规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶需要能够理解物理世界、进行推理与规划并安全运行的世界模型。现有动作条件联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型（LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM）在端到端自动驾驶（E2EAD）中要么规划准确但计算昂贵，要么计算高效但规划能力不足，存在明显的精度-效率权衡问题。

Method: 1) 采用目标条件零样本规划设置，以真值未来观测作为目标，不训练任何驾驶策略，从而将世界模型质量与策略学习解耦，系统评估现有 JEPA 世界模型。2) 提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，在投影后的 patch 嵌入上引入 SIGReg 正则化的可学习投影器，将规划 patch 数量减少 16 倍、嵌入维度降低 4 倍。

Result: AD-E2E-JEPA 实现 100 倍推理加速并保持规划性能，8 帧 rollout 在 256 条候选轨迹上运行时间为 0.8 秒。在未训练任何驾驶策略的情况下，使用 256/8,192 条候选轨迹词表的世界模型 rollout，可在平均 20 米外目标处分别达到 4.0/2.8 米位移。在 NAVSIMv2 基准上，目标条件零样本规划取得 67.3/72.9 EPDMS（含乘法安全指标）和 84.1/86.5 EPDMS†（不含安全指标）。自监督预训练投影器将下游模仿学习性能从 80.2 提升至 85.4 EPDMS。

Conclusion: 通过 SIGReg 正则化可学习投影器，AD-E2E-JEPA 有效缓解了 JEPA 世界模型在自动驾驶中的精度-效率权衡，在零样本规划与下游模仿学习中均取得优异表现，且源代码已公开。

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA

</details>


### [1894] [mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34220)
*Junqiao Fan,Yuxuan Hu,Bofan Lyu,Yanshuo Lu,Pengfei Liu,Jiarui Zhang,Fangqiang Ding,Lihua Xie,Gen Li,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出mmHRI，首个利用毫米波雷达实现隐私保护人机交互的多模态机器人操作框架，在视觉遮挡场景下完成人体动作识别与闭环递送/取回任务，动作识别准确率达85.09%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HRI系统多依赖RGB相机持续观测人体以响应手势等非语言指令，但在医院病房、餐厅等隐私敏感环境中，直接摄像观测受限，存在隐私泄露风险。作者希望借助毫米波雷达可穿透隐私屏障、不产生可识别图像的感知特性，构建隐私保护的HRI方案。

Method: mmHRI针对杂乱机器人操作环境中雷达数据稀疏、时序不一致的问题提出两项设计：(1) 双流架构，从未滤波的原始雷达张量与雷达点云联合学习，同时估计人体动作与3D姿态；(2) 基于记忆的状态空间模型（MSSM），保留历史雷达特征以抑制姿态/动作的突变，缓解信号不一致。估计出的人体状态被转换为结构化文本机器人指令，用于控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现闭环机器人操作与人感知响应。

Result: 评估涵盖人体动作识别与闭环递送、取回任务。在隐私保护的帘幕遮挡设置下，mmHRI动作识别准确率为85.09%，优于现有基于雷达的替代方法。机器人试验进一步证明在视觉遮挡下可成功完成递送与取回，并在未见过的受试者、杂乱配置和环境间保持稳定任务性能。

Conclusion: mmHRI验证了毫米波雷达作为隐私保护HRI感知模态的可行性：通过双流雷达学习与记忆状态空间建模，可在无视觉影像、存在遮挡与杂乱的条件下支撑动作识别与闭环机器人操作，并具备跨受试者、跨环境泛化能力，为隐私敏感场景下的辅助机器人交互提供了新范式。

Abstract: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.

</details>


### [1895] [RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34384)
*Aernaer Akelijiang,Jiannan Li,Zhineng Chen,Jingjing Chen,Bin Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"隐式指称接地"(IRG)这一能力并构建 RoboIRG-Bench 基准,系统评估 VLA 模型在指令信息未显式给出时的表现,发现存在明显的指称鲁棒性缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 基准通常假设任务相关信息已在指令中显式给出,但现实中人类常隐式指代物体、数量和关系,要求机器人从语言与感知语境中恢复目标。该能力此前缺乏系统评估。

Method: 将上述能力定义为隐式指称接地(IRG),基于 RoboMME 构建 RoboIRG-Bench,包含来自 11 个任务的 40 个变体,覆盖直接、推理中介、空间、语境四类指称接地挑战;评测了采用不同记忆机制的代表性 VLA 模型,并在 Franka Research 3 机械臂上进行真实验证。

Result: 评测揭示明显的指称鲁棒性缺口:显式指令下表现良好的模型,在需从语境恢复信息时性能急剧下降;推理中介与空间指称尤为困难;使用外部 VLM 的模型鲁棒性更好但仍存在显著失败;替换为更强 VLM 也无法消除缺口。真实机器人实验中缺口依旧存在,表现为指称接地错误与下游执行失败。

Conclusion: IRG 是可靠机器人指令跟随中一个独立且尚未充分探索的能力,亟需能够稳健整合语言、感知、推理与动作的 VLA 模型。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.

</details>


### [1896] [Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34684)
*Hyungjoon Kim,Wonbin Son,Mi Young Lee,Jun Young Lee,Seungmin Rho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估框架，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型内部表征的预测准确性、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性加以分离，并证明三者提供独立的诊断信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭从VLA模型内部表征中准确解码物体状态，并不能说明预测能忠实响应目标物理状态的变化；自然观测中物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡与任务进度共同变化，上下文线索可能混入预测，导致准确性被高估。

Method: 构建评估框架，采用经物理验证的观测，将目标坐标与机器人上下文进行交叉组合，从而分离预测准确性、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性；并对表征、读出器与训练数据进行对比与干预实验。

Result: 在固定的表征-读出器组合中，高自然轨迹准确性可与微弱的受控目标状态响应性并存；在基于初始状态误差与物理变量的失败预测器中加入响应性与上下文敏感性，可相对指定基线降低新初始化下的策略失败预测误差，同一观测下的受控MAE也具有信息量。

Conclusion: 应 alongside 自然预测准确性一并评估目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性，并进一步考察其与实际策略行为和任务结果的关系。

Abstract: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.

</details>


### [1897] [CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34782)
*Hyunjin Park,Jebeom Chae,Minwoo Park,Sunghyun Park,Hanjun Yoo,Seoyeon Choi,Soochul Yoo,Joohwan Seo,Sarmad Idrees,Jae-Sang Hyun,Jongmin Lee,Roberto Horowitz,Youngwoon Lee,Jongeun Choi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CoHuB，一个面向自我中心视觉下多类人机器人协作的仿真基准，含10个任务（8个双机器人、2个三机器人），并提供多操作员VR遥操作采集的同步演示，实验表明现有视觉运动策略在协调感知与控制上仍面临显著挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类环境中的许多物理任务需要协作（如协助伙伴、共同操作物体），但现有人形机器人基准多聚焦单机器人技能，缺乏在自我中心视觉观测下的多机器人协作评测。

Method: 构建仿真基准CoHuB：设计10个覆盖多种协作模式的任务（8个双人形、2个三人形）；通过多操作员VR遥操作流水线采集同步演示，每位操作员从各自机器人的自我中心视角控制一台人形机器人；并在该基准上评测代表性视觉运动策略。

Result: 实验显示代表性视觉运动策略在多种协调感知与控制形式下均存在显著困难，凸显多类人形协作的挑战性。

Conclusion: CoHuB为多类人形机器人协作策略的开发与评测提供了基础平台。

Abstract: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.

</details>


### [1898] [Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34911)
*Taesung Kwon,Jangho Park,Sunwoo Park,Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的 Action Upcycling 算法，复用被丢弃的动作块，在不损失成功率前提下将策略调用减少 1.2--1.7$\times$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分块策略（chunked policy）从单次观测预测一段未来动作，仅执行前缀后丢弃剩余动作再重规划。执行视界（execution horizon）长度决定反应性与效率的权衡：视界短则反应快但调用频繁，反之效率高但反应迟钝。现有测试时自适应视界方法要么依赖模型内部信号（需针对每种架构设计），要么额外采样（增加成本）。

Method: Action Upcycling 是一种免训练算法：复用策略原本会丢弃的动作，无需访问模型内部或额外采样。核心观察是：只要动作速度（action velocity，即动作序列的平滑度）保持平滑，被丢弃动作与其重规划版本就保持接近。算法据此将执行视界延长至速度开始波动的临界点。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务上，跨多种 Vision-Language-Action 模型（VLA）乃至 World Action Model（WAM），策略调用减少 1.2--1.7$\times$，成功率无损失。

Conclusion: Action Upcycling 可应用于任意分块策略，开销可忽略，且与少步采样、流式动作解码等加速方法正交，为策略加速开辟了新维度。

Abstract: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose *Action Upcycling*, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. Action Upcycling therefore extends the execution horizon up to the point where the velocity begins to fluctuate. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that Action Upcycling reduces policy calls by 1.2--1.7$\times$ with no loss in success rate, across multiple Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) and even a World Action Model (WAM). It applies to any chunked policy at negligible cost and is orthogonal to other policy acceleration methods such as few-step sampling and streaming action decoding, opening a new axis for policy acceleration.

</details>


### [1899] [ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35200)
*Pankhuri Vanjani,Mostafa Hatab,Can Mizrakli,Vaisakh Shaj,Zhuoyue Li,Moritz Reuss,Rudolf Lioutikov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCAT，一种带结构化循环记忆的语言条件策略，通过 Mamba-2 层与因果注意力层构建循环记忆，并用流匹配 Transformer 解码器分别对当前与历史表示做交叉注意力，从而支持记忆依赖型操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆依赖型操作要求机器人利用当前传感器已无法获取的信息做决策，如回忆先前视觉线索、跟踪任务进度、计数重复事件或估计经过时间。现有方法在长时程记忆保持与利用上存在不足。

Method: ReCAT 包含三部分：指令条件编码器从当前观测形成特征；循环记忆通过 Mamba-2 层与一层因果注意力整合观测流；流匹配 Transformer 解码器在每个块中分别对当前表示与历史表示进行交叉注意力。论文还比较了不同记忆更新规则（加性更新、delta-rule 更新）作为机器人记忆的行为差异。

Result: 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 95.3%，在 RMBench 上 62.4%，在九个任务中六项取得最佳或并列最佳。在三个真实机器人任务（空间回忆、事件计数、间隔计时）上，最佳 ReCAT 变体平均成功率 66.7%，而最强短历史基线仅 8.3%。消融显示观测编码器与每块记忆条件化均不可或缺；加性更新在计数与计时上观测成功率最高，delta-rule 更新在空间回忆上更优。

Conclusion: 结构化循环记忆与每块历史条件化显著提升记忆依赖型操作性能，且不同记忆更新规则在不同任务类型上表现各异，说明机器人记忆机制需按任务特性设计。

Abstract: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT

</details>


### [1900] [Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35249)
*Dingsheng Liu,Yangzheng Wu,Mahboubeh Asadi,Zhiyuan Li,Jinbang Huang,Yixin Xiao,Tongtong Cao,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Spatial Grafting：一种轻量通用空间模块，将冻结的稠密重建特征绑定到机器人相对度量几何，生成度量锚定的空间 token，经 cross-attention 注入流匹配动作专家，且不改变宿主感知通路，从而保留预训练收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练机器人操作策略（VLA/WAM）将交互相关的度量几何隐式化；现有空间重建特征只描述局部形状，未给出相对机器人的空间位置，而如何把这些特征有效传给预训练策略尚无定论。

Method: Spatial Grafting 模块：以冻结的重建网络特征为输入，结合机器人相对度量几何构造空间 token，通过 cross-attention 注入 flow-matching 动作专家；宿主感知通路保持不变，且无需针对不同宿主重新设计。验证覆盖 2 个 VLA 与 2 个 WAM、4 个仿真基准（短时程操作、视觉鲁棒性、杂乱场景、长时程移动操作）及 3 个真实平台（单臂与双臂）。

Result: RoboTwin 2.0（双臂）上所有宿主均有提升：π0.5 在干净/随机场景分别提升 11.3% 与 15.6%，达 94.0% 与 92.4%，超过最强已发表 3D 条件策略 WAM4D（93.8% 与 89.9%）。长时程优势更大：BEHAVIOR-1K 六项任务中五项超过 2025 挑战赛冠军，最多领先 0.47 Q-score，并在双方均报告的三项任务上平均超过地图条件空间策略。

Conclusion: 单一 graft 架构可即插即用地增强多种 VLA/WAM，在仿真与真实机器人上一致提升操作性能，并随任务时程延长收益增大，说明将度量机器人相对几何显式注入动作专家是有效且通用的方案。

Abstract: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

</details>


### [1901] [Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35415)
*Zhiruo Zhou,Rigaudiere Z. Li,Chen Xiwen,Yucheng Chen,Xiaojun Zhu,Houde Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出残差感知共形动作过滤（RACF），通过校准固定标称预测器的残差并将分位数转化为操作裕度，实现有限模型动作投影；在无需重训练策略的情况下更新裕度与候选选择。跨2400个控制器-试验单元比较中，Adaptive RACF 回合安全率达94.3%，较标称CBF-QP基线提升19.9个百分点，投影频率由8.11%降至6.63%；受控研究分离出残差裕度注入带来的4.54个百分点增益；匹配硬件评估中，摊销展开时间较 Robust CBF-QP 平均降低21.2%，安全回合161/180对170/180。并刻画了一步残差覆盖与约束满足的联系及安全-计算权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结的ACC策略在部署动力学与训练条件不一致时易违反约束，需在保持策略不变的前提下提升部署安全性并降低计算开销。

Method: RACF：校准固定标称预测器的残差，将其分位数转换为操作裕度，用于有限模型动作投影；利用已完成迁移更新裕度与候选选择，无需重训练策略；采用注册式对比与受控消融，并开展匹配硬件评估。

Result: 2400个控制器-试验单元中，Adaptive RACF回合安全率94.3%，较标称CBF-QP基线提升19.9个百分点，投影频率由8.11%降至6.63%；受控研究显示残差裕度注入贡献4.54个百分点提升；匹配硬件上摊销展开时间较Robust CBF-QP降低21.2%，安全回合161/180对170/180；给出一步残差覆盖与约束满足的关系及安全-计算权衡量化。

Conclusion: RACF可在不重训练策略下显著提升ACC部署安全性并降低投影频率与计算时间，但存在可量化的安全-计算权衡，需结合残差覆盖条件进行部署取舍。

Abstract: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

</details>


### [1902] [Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35439)
*Pengyiang Liu,Junbo Niu,Wenhao Zheng,Xinchen Chen,Canyu Li,Zhongyue Shi,Jiahao Xie,Si Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出可修订时序规划（RTP），将预测的视觉未来作为持续存在的动作条件，并在执行反馈后通过学习到的“修订桥”对视觉规划进行续写式修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: world-action 模型用预测视觉未来来条件化机器人动作，但执行反馈会使部分预测失效，而预测中蕴含的任务结构仍然有用，因此需要一种能在保留有用结构的同时依据反馈修订视觉未来的机制。

Method: RTP 以学习到的修订桥为核心：从视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态恢复，并依据当前观测调整其后续生成；通过视觉与动作监督将修订与后续控制相连；使用时序感知历史提供观测证据；由自适应策略在新噪声下选择“保留、桥接修订或全新重规划”，再解码下一动作。

Result: 在 RoboMME 与 RMBench 上，RTP 的任务平均成功率分别为 48.6% 和 84.8%；匹配对照支持学习式续写的有效性，而 checkpoint 来源与动作前缀效应的估计为正但精度较低。

Conclusion: 该工作将反馈驱动的视觉规划修订与闭环任务性能联系起来，表明在保留任务结构的前提下修订视觉未来可有效提升机器人操作表现。

Abstract: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

</details>


### [1903] [EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35570)
*Rithvik Jonna,Man Namgung,Aakash Gurram,Tinoosh Mohsenin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 EdgeVLN，一种运行时感知、可部署的量化视觉语言导航（VLN）模型，通过量化 StreamVLN 骨干、轻量因果 Transformer 停止头 LATTE 与 llama.cpp VLN 驱动，实现在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB 边缘设备上的高效导航部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLN 模型性能虽好，但依赖高算力平台，难以部署在内存与功耗受限的机器人边缘设备上。仅靠压缩无法判断模型是否满足边缘平台的内存、时延与能耗预算，同时保持导航行为，因此需要一种运行时感知、面向部署的方案来弥合这一差距。

Method: EdgeVLN 将量化后的 StreamVLN 模型与 Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor（LATTE）结合，LATTE 是一个轻量因果 Transformer，通过预测 Stop Action 验证器排名来改进实时停止。两者均通过自研 llama.cpp VLN 驱动执行，驱动在板载重建流式上下文并裁剪内存 token。研究对预训练 StreamVLN 骨干进行 8 至 2 bit 权重量化及多种推理运行时表征，寻找可行工作点；LATTE 复用骨干隐藏状态，无需额外视觉编码器或额外骨干前向传播。在 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen 全部 1,839 个 episode 上评估六种骨干精度与七种候选停止头。

Result: LATTE 在部署的 4-bit 模型上取得最高成功率 58.02%，超过 BF16 基线，每导航步仅增加 0.013 s 时延。四种 4-bit 格式成功率几乎相同，但单步能耗因执行路径相差 36.8 倍。仅 IQ4 NL 在自研 VLN 驱动下适配该板卡，占用 11.35 GB 常驻内存，比存储流式 BF16 快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍。INT2 精度崩溃。

Conclusion: 运行时选择、内存 token 裁剪与量化对于高效边缘部署至关重要。EdgeVLN 证明了通过协同设计量化骨干、轻量停止头与专用运行时驱动，可在资源受限的边缘设备上实现满足内存、时延与能耗预算且保持导航性能的 VLN 部署。

Abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.

</details>


### [1904] [What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31760)
*Jiaming Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 构建自主改进机器人的智能体系统，进行了123轮家庭操作任务迭代，发现能力可自发习得但改进无法累积，瓶颈主要存在于智能体之外的三个方面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索机器人能否像编程智能体改进软件那样自我改进，即无需人工编写机器人代码即可发现缺失能力、编写新技能并迭代测试。

Method: 构建一个智能体系统：观察机器人失败→诊断缺失能力→编写新技能或寻找并安装外部模型→在仿真中测试每次改动→重复迭代。在家庭操作任务上运行123轮改进。

Result: 智能体能自主发现能力（如识别目标超出视野，主动请求主动观察模型并部署搜索技能）；但改进无法累积，目标任务（将调味品放到冰箱顶层）始终未成功。三个外部瓶颈：（1）链式感知模块缺乏关系理解（如SAM 3只能找到货架而非"顶层货架"），智能体用几何规则填补却无法收敛；（2）技能链将学习锁定在首步，长任务多早期失败，导致证据与修复堆积于此，后续技能难以被触及和测试；（3）学习内容由测试框架决定，智能体优化的正是评估器所测量的内容（包括错误之处），弱测试与误导性记忆使活动沦为停滞。

Conclusion: 瓶颈很少在智能体本身，而在其周围的感知、技能链结构与环境反馈机制。研究提炼出构建自我改进机器人系统的具体建议，并为每条建议配套一个可证伪实验。

Abstract: Can a robot improve itself the way coding agents now improve software? We built an agentic system to find out. It watches a robot fail, works out which capability is missing, writes new skills or finds and installs external models, tests every change in simulation, and repeats, with no human writing robot code. We ran it for 123 improvement rounds on household manipulation tasks. This report describes what we learned. The good news is that the agent can discover capabilities on its own: noticing that its targets were out of view, it asked for an active-viewing model, debugged it, and deployed a working search skill. The bad news is that its improvements did not add up. Changes kept passing their tests, yet the target task, putting condiments on the top shelf of a fridge, never succeeded. We found that the agent was rarely the bottleneck. Three things around it were. First, chained perception modules do not understand relations. Segmenters such as SAM 3 find shelves but not "the top shelf", so the agent filled the gap with ever more geometric rules that never converged, when what it needed was a different kind of model. Second, skill chains lock learning onto the first step. Long tasks mostly fail early, so evidence and fixes pile up there, and later skills are rarely reached, tested, or improved. Third, what the agent learns is decided by the harness. The agent optimized exactly what the evaluator measured, including where it was wrong, and weak tests and misleading memory turned activity into a standstill. We distill these lessons into concrete recommendations for building robot systems that improve themselves, each paired with an experiment that could prove it wrong.

</details>


### [1905] [Reduced Cartesian Kinetostatics for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots: Residual-Stabilized Full-Shape Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31771)
*Ke Wu,Fangju Yang,Xiaohui Zhang,Zhengqiang Zhang,Jingang Yi,Jian S. Dai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向平面、轴向可压缩腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR）的降阶笛卡尔框架，沿给定腱力/腱位移轨迹传播平衡构型，实现高效、精确的完整骨架几何预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TDCR的规划与控制任务需要完整的笛卡尔骨架几何，而现有逐点几何变应变（GVS）求解计算代价高，难以满足在线需求，因此需要一种能沿给定驱动轨迹高效传播平衡构型的降阶方法。

Method: 以两个全局位置场表示骨架，基于精确变分构造势能；采用Taylor-Galerkin降阶，将空间属性与分布载荷离线凝聚为矩向量，得到解析的降阶残差与雅可比，避免在线空间积分与数值微分。通过解析微分与残差校正得到一阶速率系统，在分支初始平衡对齐后每次速率评估仅需一次固定维线性求解。

Result: 在四类仿真情形（变腱路由、非均匀几何、轴向压缩及其组合）中，传播得到的笛卡尔形状与分布应变与逐点GVS解高度吻合；残差校正抑制了漂移，仅使未校正Euler的平均更新时间增加约0.98%；平均每次更新0.508 ms，约为逐点GVS求解的11倍加速。位移驱动实验中，骨架位置归一化平均误差最大1.02%，末端执行器位置误差最大0.28%。

Conclusion: 该降阶笛卡尔框架能够在给定驱动路径下实现高效且准确的TDCR完整形状预测，兼顾精度与实时性，适用于规划与控制任务。

Abstract: Many planning and control tasks for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) require the complete Cartesian backbone geometry. We present a reduced Cartesian framework for planar, axially compressible TDCRs that propagates equilibrium configurations along prescribed tendon-force and tendon-displacement trajectories. The backbone is represented by two global position fields. Following exact variation, a Taylor-Galerkin reduction condenses prescribed spatial properties and distributed loads into offline moment vectors, yielding analytic reduced residuals and Jacobians without online spatial quadrature or numerical differentiation. Analytical differentiation and residual correction yield first-order rate systems requiring one fixed-dimensional linear solve per rate evaluation after initial equilibrium alignment on a regular branch. Across four simulated cases covering variable tendon routing, nonuniform geometry, axial compression, and their combined effects, the propagated Cartesian shapes and distributed strains closely match pointwise geometrically variable-strain (GVS) equilibrium solutions. Residual correction suppresses propagation drift across the tested step sizes while adding only about 0.98% to the mean update time of uncorrected Euler. The proposed method requires 0.508 ms per update on average, approximately 11 times faster than pointwise GVS solves. Displacement-driven experiments yield a maximum normalized mean backbone position error of 1.02% and a maximum end-effector position error of 0.28%. These results support efficient and accurate Cartesian full-shape prediction along prescribed actuation paths.

</details>


### [1906] [Timed Rule-Based Supervision of an End-to-End Autonomous Parking Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31773)
*Kejia Gao,Liguo Zhou,Lei Yu,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在固定 CARLA 停车场中，为端到端泊车策略加上人工标定的运行时安全盾（PSS），将目标任务成功率从 85.16% 提升到 97.66%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端泊车策略在闭环运行中会出现反复性失效（越界、制动延迟、停滞或振荡控制），而人工指定的运行时监督器能否修正这些问题及其效果边界尚不明确。

Method: 继承 Yang 等人的视觉 Transformer 架构；本文贡献是定时、基于规则的参数化安全盾（PSS），作用于策略控制输出。PSS 采用人工校准的速度、位置与持续时间阈值，针对已观测失效模式进行干预。评估设定：16 个留出目标车位 × 6 个初始位姿 × 4 轮 = 每配置 384 次尝试。

Result: 目标成功率由重训练策略的 327/384（85.16%）提升至加入 PSS 后的 375/384（97.66%）；成功尝试的平均位置误差 0.21 m，平均朝向误差 0.33 度。

Conclusion: 结果仅表明在该仿真器设定内性能有所改善。所有尝试共享同一地图、车辆与传感器配置，且 PSS 依赖仿真器世界坐标，因此不能证明对其他停车场或真实车辆的泛化能力，也不构成形式化安全保证。

Abstract: We study whether a manually specified runtime supervisor can correct recurring failures of an existing end-to-end parking policy in a fixed CARLA parking lot. The vision-based Transformer architecture is inherited from Yang et al.; our contribution is a timed, rule-based Parametric Safety Shield (PSS) applied to its control outputs. The PSS uses hand-calibrated speed, position, and duration thresholds to intervene in observed failure modes, including boundary exits, delayed braking, and stalled or oscillatory control. In the reported closed-loop evaluation, 16 held-out target slots and six initial poses are each evaluated in four rounds (384 attempts per configuration). Target success increases from 327/384 (85.16%) for the retrained policy to 375/384 (97.66%) with the PSS; mean position and orientation errors among successful attempts are 0.21m and 0.33 degrees. These results show an improvement within this simulator setup. The repeated attempts share one map, vehicle, and sensor configuration, and the PSS uses simulator world coordinates; thus the results do not establish generalization to other lots or real vehicles, or a formal safety guarantee.

</details>


### [1907] [Path Planning with Motion Primitives in Dynamic Environments: SIPP on Lattices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31803)
*Marat Agranovskiy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文将安全区间路径规划（SIPP）扩展到状态格（state lattice）上，使用预计算的动力学平滑运动基元，并将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体积栅格化到网格上，从而在动态共享空间中为差分约束机器人生成平滑可执行的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中与其他移动智能体共享空间时，自主导航访问关键挑战。传统基于网格的规划器虽能高效找到无碰撞路径，但依赖2^k连通网格上的"停止-转向"机制，产生分段线性轨迹，对差分约束机器人在运动动力学上高度次优。

Method: 提出SIPP在状态格上的适配版本，采用预计算的、运动动力学平滑的运动基元；为高效处理动态环境，将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体积直接栅格化到网格上，将网格单元视为空间的原子单位（其分辨率通常由固有定位噪声决定）；并在多种拓扑环境中，将格基方法与2^k连通网格规划器进行对比分析。

Result: 评估涵盖规划时间、路径角性、累积航向变化（角度/长度比）和弯曲能量等多项指标。结果表明，格基搜索扩大的状态空间增加了计算开销，但所生成的轨迹在运动动力学特性上显著更优；该方法达到与高连通网格相当的可达性，同时保证路径平滑、连续且可物理执行。

Conclusion: 格基SIPP在动态环境中以可接受的计算开销换取显著更优的运动动力学性能，生成的平滑连续路径可直接部署于真实场景。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments is a critical challenge, particularly when spaces are shared with other mobile agents whose future trajectories are known. While traditional grid-based planners efficiently find collision-free paths, their reliance on stop-and-turn mechanics over $2^k$-connected grids produces piecewise-linear trajectories that are kinodynamically highly sub-optimal for differentially constrained robots. In this paper, we present an adaptation of Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) that operates on state lattices, utilizing precomputed, kinodynamically smooth motion primitives. To efficiently handle dynamic environments, we rasterize the spatiotemporal swept volumes of moving obstacles directly onto the grid, treating grid cells as atomic units of space, whose resolution is typically dictated by inherent localization noise. We perform a comprehensive comparative analysis between our lattice-based approach and $2^k$-connected grid planners across diverse topological environments. Our evaluation considers a broad spectrum of performance metrics, including planning time, path angularity, cumulative heading change (angle-over-length), and bending energy. The results demonstrate that while the expanded state space of lattice-based search increases computational overhead, it yields trajectories with significantly superior kinodynamic properties. Specifically, our method achieves a reachability comparable to highly connected grids while ensuring smooth, continuous, and physically executable paths ready for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [1908] [Humanoid Badminton: Learning Dynamic Racket Skills from Limited Human Motion Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31840)
*Jingzhi Cui,Zhexiong Wang,Bangjie Xu,Pengyu Zhao,Youyuan Li,Zhi Su,Peng Ren,Mengdi Xu,Chao Yu,Yi Wu,Luyang Wang,Zhongyu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出三阶段分层强化学习框架，实现人形机器人真实场景下的多技能羽毛球对打，包括跳跃回球。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高速球拍运动对人形机器人要求极高：需时敏决策、精准击球与全身动态协调。羽毛球轨迹变化快，要求在短暂接触窗口内精确控制拍姿与速度，并覆盖三维击球空间。人类动作数据可提供先验，但可用羽毛球参考动作有限且不完善：直接跟踪难以覆盖多样球况，纯任务驱动优化又易产生不自然动作。

Method: 提出三阶段分层强化学习框架：（1）任务随机化动作增强，将稀疏标注的击球事件扩展为目标条件化的可执行击球变体，形成连续潜在技能空间；（2）高层规划器根据观测到的球状态在线输出连续潜在技能编码，组合技能；（3）上下文条件对抗正则化器，在保持回球性能的同时促使规划器技能使用更自然。

Result: 在真实人形机器人上部署，实现与人类选手的持续多技能对打，涵盖正手、反手以及高动态跳跃回球。

Conclusion: 该系统为首个在真实世界中展示多技能人机球拍对打（含高动态跳跃回球）的人形机器人拍类运动系统。

Abstract: High-speed racket sports provide a demanding testbed for humanoid robots, requiring time-critical decisions, precise striking, and dynamic whole-body coordination. In badminton, fast-changing shuttle trajectories require timely contact decisions, while successful returns demand precise racket pose and velocity within a brief contact window and across a broad three-dimensional striking workspace. Human motion data provide valuable priors for such athletic skills, but usable badminton references are limited and imperfect. Direct tracking provides insufficient executable variation for diverse shuttle conditions, while purely task-driven optimization may produce unnatural motion.
