To address these challenges, we present a three-stage hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic humanoid badminton. First, task-randomized motion augmentation expands sparse annotated hitting events into executable target-conditioned stroke variations, forming a continuous latent skill space. Second, a high-level planner outputs continuous latent skill codes to compose these skills online according to the observed shuttle state. Third, a context-conditioned adversarial regularizer encourages more natural planner-level skill usage while preserving return performance. When deployed on a real humanoid robot, our system achieves sustained multi-skill rallies with human players, including forehand, backhand, and highly dynamic jump returns. This is the first real-world humanoid racket-sport system to demonstrate multi-skill human--robot rallies including highly dynamic jump returns.

</details>


### [1909] [PHIRL: Aligning Learned Rewards with Task Progress for Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31855)
*Hang Yu,James Staley,Cheng Xi Tsou,Xiujin Liu,Wenchang Gao,Jindan Huang,Shijie Fang,Zhegong Shangguan,Angelo Cangelosi,Reuben Aronson,Elaine Short*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PHIRL联合利用人类演示与进度反馈学习奖励函数，仅需20%演示标注即可显著提升回报与成功率，并具备抗奖励欺骗能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示提供稠密的策略级信息但局部精度不足；人类反馈提供准确的局部评价但稀疏、缺乏直接策略指导。二者互补，如何联合利用以高效学习鲁棒奖励函数是核心动机。

Method: 提出Progress-Heuristicized Inverse Reinforcement Learning (PHIRL)。迭代地通过逆强化学习从演示中推断奖励函数，计算进度标注演示上的学习奖励，并在四个维度上将奖励与进度标注对齐；同时探索用微调视觉语言模型提供进度反馈。

Result: 在真实与仿真机器人任务上，PHIRL显著优于基线，仅用20%演示标注即取得更高环境回报与任务成功率；奖励欺骗场景分析显示其学到的奖励函数可靠、难以被利用。

Conclusion: 联合演示与进度反馈可高效学习鲁棒奖励函数，PHIRL在数据效率、性能与抗奖励欺骗方面均表现优越。

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide dense policy-level information but sometimes lack local precision. Human feedback presents accurate local critiques, but offers sparse evaluations rather than direct policy guidance. We propose Progress-Heuristicized Inverse Reinforcement Learning (PHIRL), a data-efficient framework that learns robust reward functions by jointly leveraging demonstrations and feedback. Specifically, we use progress, a feedback modality that describes cumulative task completion. PHIRL iteratively infers a reward function from demonstrations via inverse reinforcement learning, calculates the learned rewards over the progress-annotated demonstrations, and aligns the rewards with progress annotations over four dimensions. We evaluate PHIRL on real and simulated robot tasks, with additional exploration using a fine-tuned vision-language model to provide progress feedback. Results demonstrate that PHIRL significantly outperforms the baselines, achieving substantially higher environmental return rewards and task success with only twenty percent of demonstrations annotated. Analysis of reward-hacking scenarios demonstrates that PHIRL learned reward functions are reliable against exploitation.

</details>


### [1910] [Efficient Bezier Velocity Optimization for Free-Floating Space Manipulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31880)
*Duo Zhang,Zhizhuo Zhang,Xiaoli Bai,Jingjin Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FAVOR是一种面向无驱动航天器的自由漂浮机械臂规划器，通过优化Bezier关节速度曲线并结合递归灵敏度分析，实现无碰撞到达、跟踪与规定时间预抓取拦截，在成功率与计算效率上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无驱动航天器上的机械臂在运动时会因动量守恒引发耦合的基座-机械臂运动，导致轨迹规划与无碰撞约束求解复杂。现有方法（如逆运动学初始化的位置样条基线、单步QP）成功率低、计算耗时长，难以满足到达、跟踪和预抓取拦截等任务需求。

Method: 提出FAVOR规划器：1）优化Bezier关节速度曲线，并施加线性速度、加速度及连续性约束；2）决策维度独立于rollout分辨率；3）通过解析递归灵敏度计算任务梯度与间隙梯度，处理耦合的基座-机械臂运动；4）采用并行评估、缓存与增量式碰撞发现以降低计算量。

Result: 在七自由度机械臂与五个仿真航天器模型上：点对点任务成功率达99.8%，平均计算1.779 s，而IK初始化位置样条基线仅为62.9%与50.270 s（均值含失败与超时）；跟踪任务完成36例中的30例（单步QP为15例）；拦截任务完成全部36例（样条基线为22例）；消融实验显示有限差分使平均规划时间增加4.7倍。

Conclusion: FAVOR通过Bezier速度参数化与解析递归灵敏度，在耦合基座-机械臂动力学下实现了高成功率、低计算成本的无碰撞到达、跟踪与规定时间预抓取拦截，验证了方法的有效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: We present FAVOR (Free-floating Arm Velocity Optimization with Recursive Sensitivities), a planner for collision-free reaching, tracking, and prescribed-time pre-grasp interception on an unactuated spacecraft. It optimizes Bezier joint-velocity curves with linear velocity, acceleration, and continuity constraints. Decision dimension is independent of rollout resolution. Analytical recursive sensitivities provide task and clearance gradients through the coupled base-arm motion. Parallel evaluation, caching, and incremental collision discovery reduce computation. With a seven-DoF arm and five simulated spacecraft models, FAVOR achieves 99.8% point-to-point success with 1.779 s mean computation, versus 62.9% and 50.270 s for an IK-initialized position-spline baseline. Means include failures and timeouts. FAVOR completes 30 of 36 tracking cases, versus 15 for single-step QP, and all 36 interception instances, versus 22 for the spline baseline. A controlled ablation shows that finite differences increase mean planning time 4.7-fold.

</details>


### [1911] [Differentiable Dynamics for Autonomous Micro-Mobility Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31885)
*Grace Cai,Joey Lee,Nithin Parepally,Laura Zheng,Ming C. Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出可微分动力学模型 DiffKBM 与 DiffGM3，将微出行车辆的动力学建模纳入可微分优化框架，并在开环轨迹拟合与闭环自主导航任务中验证其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微出行车辆（轮椅、滑板车、自行车等）在行人共享空间中具有提升出行可达性和低速安全运输的潜力，但其自主化需要真实且可预测的运动模型。现有自动驾驶技术栈多依赖简化运动学模型，无法刻画轮胎滑移、摩擦及车轮布局等关键特性，限制了真实性与基于梯度的优化。

Method: 构建 DiffKBM，即运动学自行车模型（KBM）的可微分版本；进一步提出 DiffGM3，即通用微出行模型（GM3）的可微分形式，后者是基于轮胎的统一动力学公式，支持多种微出行车辆构型。二者实现端到端可微分优化，便于集成到可微分自动驾驶栈中。评估包含开环与闭环两类设置：开环轨迹匹配中将模型作为 DiffStack 内的动力学层进行优化以复现真实轨迹；闭环自主导航中将模型与可微分 MPC 控制器结合，在 CrowdNav 行人场景中测试。

Result: 开环设置下，DiffGM3 在自行车、滑板车和摩托车模式中复现轨迹的表现优于 DiffKBM，ADE 与 NLL 均有改善，并在自行车和摩托车轨迹上降低了规划损失。闭环设置下，DiffGM3 在自行车模式中将 CrowdNav 的碰撞减少 55%，不适频率降低 75%。

Conclusion: 可微分动力学建模能有效提升微出行系统在轨迹拟合与自主导航中的真实性与安全性，DiffGM3 相较简化模型具有显著优势，适合作为可微分自主栈中的动力学组件。

Abstract: Autonomous micro-mobility vehicles (MMVs) such as wheelchairs, scooters, and bicycles have the potential to improve mobility access and support safe low-speed transportation in pedestrian-shared spaces. Achieving MMV autonomy will require realistic, predictable MMV motion. However, many existing autonomous vehicle stacks rely on simplified kinematic models that fail to capture key MMV characteristics such as tire slip, friction, and wheel layouts, limiting realism and gradient-based optimization. In this paper, we explore differentiable formulations of dynamics models for autonomous micro-mobility systems. We first construct DiffKBM, a differentiable version of the kinematic bicycle model (KBM). Then, we introduce DiffGM3, a differentiable formulation of the General Micro-Mobility Model (GM3), a unified tire-based dynamics formulation for micro-mobility vehicles that supports a wide range of MMV configurations. DiffKBM and DiffGM3 enable end-to-end differentiable optimization through MMV dynamics, making them suitable for integration into differentiable autonomy stacks. We evaluate these dynamics models in both open-loop and closed-loop settings: (1) open-loop trajectory matching, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are integrated as a dynamics layer within DiffStack and optimized to reproduce real-world MMV trajectories, and (2) closed-loop autonomous navigation, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are paired with a differentiable MPC controller in CrowdNav pedestrian scenarios. In the open-loop setting, DiffGM3 outperforms DiffKBM in reproducing trajectories with improvements in ADE and NLL across bicycle, scooter, and motorcycle modes, and reductions in planning loss for bicycle and motorcycle trajectories. We also find that, in closed-loop settings, DiffGM3 improves on DiffKBM's CrowdNav performance by producing 55\% fewer collisions and a 75\% lower discomfort frequency for the bicycle mode.

</details>


### [1912] [Game-Theoretic Control with Constrained Potential Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31901)
*Zhiyuan Zhang,Panagiotis Tsiotras*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种快速通用的内点法求解器，并配合计算高效的二阶修正，用于约束一般和动态博弈，提升收敛到局部GNE的概率并加快求解速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束一般和动态博弈常用于高度交互的多智能体规划，但现有GNE求解器虽在小规模动态博弈中达到实时性能，求解速度仍是瓶颈，且难以控制较多智能体（如超过四个）。此外，聚焦一阶条件的牛顿类求解器容易收敛到非纳什鞍点，削弱了解的有效性。

Method: 提出一种用于约束动态博弈的快速、通用内点法求解器，并设计计算高效的二阶修正步骤，以提高在约束动态博弈中收敛到局部广义纳什均衡（GNE）解的概率。

Result: 在数值基准测试以及涉及缩比赛车的物理实验中评估了所提方法的性能。

Conclusion: 该方法在求解速度与解的有效性方面具有优势，适用于约束一般和动态博弈及多智能体交互规划问题，并通过数值与物理实验验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Constrained general-sum dynamic games are a popular formulation for highly interactive multi-agent planning problems. In recent years, Generalized Nash Equilibrium (GNE) solvers have achieved real-time performance for small dynamic games. However, solution speed still remains a bottleneck, and controlling even a small number of agents (e.g., more than four) in a dynamic task remains elusive. In addition, Newton solvers that focus on the first-order conditions are vulnerable to non-Nash saddle points, limiting the usefulness of the provided solution. In this work, we propose a fast and versatile interior point solver for constrained dynamic games, along with a computationally efficient second-order correction that increases the probability of converging to a local GNE solution in constrained dynamic games. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated on numerical benchmarks and a physical experiment involving scaled race cars.

</details>


### [1913] [GT-VLA: Target-Conditioned Trace Guidance for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31904)
*Ninghan Zhong,Jing-Chen Peng,Sriram Vishwanath*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GT-VLA框架，通过外部通用VLM生成语义引导并转化为2D视觉轨迹，以轨迹条件化方式驱动VLA动作策略，提升机器人操作在未见任务与长程场景下的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作上表现良好，但难以泛化到未见任务、新配置与长程场景，主要问题是过拟合训练场景、无法遵循新语言指令；而现成VLM泛化性强却无法直接控制机器人动作。因此需要结合VLM的常识与VLA的控制能力。

Method: GT-VLA接受外部通用VLM的引导，通过轨迹条件化的动作生成实现可操控性：先由通用模型为当前技能确定语义引导，将其转换为2D视觉轨迹，再把轨迹渲染到观测上作为动作策略的条件输入。该设计将语义目标获取、轨迹生成与底层动作执行解耦，使高层引导能传递至机器人动作。同时采用Mixture-of-Experts架构，配备技能专用的轨迹与动作模块以保证鲁棒执行。

Result: 在LIBERO基准和真实机器人平台上进行评估，相比近期VLA基线方法在两种场景下均取得更好的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 通过引入外部VLM的语义引导并以2D视觉轨迹为中介，GT-VLA有效融合了通用模型的常识泛化能力与VLA的精细控制能力，为提升机器人操作的泛化性提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on robotic manipulation, but they often struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, configurations, and long-horizon settings. A key challenge is that VLAs overfit to training scenes and fail to follow novel language instructions. Off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs) often provide stronger generalization, but cannot directly control robot actions. To combine the common sense of VLMs with VLA control, we propose Guided Trace VLA (GT-VLA), a steerable framework that accepts guidance from an external generalist VLM through trace-conditioned action generation. GT-VLA uses a generalist model to identify semantic guidance for the current skill, converts this guidance into a 2D visual trace, and conditions its action policy on the resulting trace-rendered observation. This design separates semantic target acquisition, trace generation, and low-level action execution, allowing high-level guidance to propagate to robot actions. GT-VLA uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with skill-specific trace and action modules for robust execution. We evaluate GT-VLA on LIBERO and a physical robot platform, showing improved generalization over recent VLA baselines in both settings. The code and additional supplemental materials are available on our project website at https://ivaniz.github.io/gt-vla/.

</details>


### [1914] [End-to-end QP-based policies: A unified perspective on robust control and robot learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31905)
*Fausto Vega,Priyanka Supraja Balaji,Chase Dunaway,Joe Koszut,Jon Arrizabalaga,Zachary Manchester*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种端到端基于QP的策略框架，以极少的领域特定设计实现系统化策略构建，同时保持模型控制的透明性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有策略构建往往依赖大量领域特定设计，且难以兼顾透明性与可解释性；作者希望统一模型控制与学习式策略构建。

Method: 采用端到端QP策略表示，支持两类构建方式：一是面向扰动与模型变化分布的域随机化模型自动调参；二是无需显式状态、输入或系统动力学的黑箱策略构建；并将其与鲁棒控制、多层感知机、机器人学习等范式建立联系。

Result: 在仿真与硬件上验证该框架，覆盖鲁棒性、策略自动调参以及未知系统动力学下的控制等应用。

Conclusion: 该端到端QP策略可作为多种现有策略表示与控制范式的通用抽象，兼顾可解释性与系统性构建能力。

Abstract: We present an end-to-end QP-based policy framework that enables systematic policy construction with minimal domain-specific design, while preserving the transparency and interpretability of model-based control. The proposed policy representation supports both domain-randomized model-based auto-tuning, where policy parameters are optimized over distributions of disturbances and model variations, and black-box policy construction, where the problem is formulated in terms of a (possibly) unknown model without requiring explicit notions of states, inputs, or the underlying system dynamics. We establish connections to existing policy representations and control paradigms, including robust control, multilayer perceptrons, and robot learning, and interpret our end-to-end QP policies as a common abstraction of these approaches. We validate the resulting framework in both simulation and hardware, demonstrating a broad range of applications spanning robustness, automatic policy tuning, and control under unknown system dynamics.

</details>


### [1915] [HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31924)
*Shaoting Peng,Litian Liang,Yixuan Wang,Ming Yang,Katherine Driggs-Campbell,Mark Cutkosky,James Jingxi Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HapticWorld 是一个可交互的世界模拟器，在预测观测的同时预测关节力矩并实时反馈给操作者，从而闭合人与学习世界模型之间的触觉回路，实现大规模力/力矩标注数据采集与策略评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 富接触操作依赖力感知，而力信号难以仅从视觉推断，这对示教采集和策略训练均构成瓶颈。带力标注的数据难以规模化获取：真机采集受硬件限制，物理模拟器的接触力与真实测量存在系统性偏差，学习型世界模拟器虽可扩展且真实但仅支持视觉，导致采集时操作者无触觉反馈、数据也不含 F/T 标注。

Method: 提出 HapticWorld：在学习型交互式世界模拟器中，同时预测关节力矩与观测，并将力矩实时渲染回传给操作者，形成人在回路中的触觉闭环。基于该框架采集带 F/T 标注的示教数据并训练策略，同时把模拟器内的成功率与真实世界评测进行对照。

Result: 在三项富接触任务上，力矩反馈使数据采集吞吐量平均提升 1.6 倍；用 HapticWorld 生成示教训练的策略在真实世界 60 次试验中成功 54 次，接近真实数据上界 56/60，远高于纯视觉基线的 19/60；且 HapticWorld 内部测得的成功率与真实世界评测高度吻合。

Conclusion: HapticWorld 通过触觉闭环提升数据采集效率，其生成数据可训练出接近真实数据水平的策略，并能作为独立的、以 F/T 为条件的策略评估平台。

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation depends on force sensing that is hard to infer from visual signals alone, both for collecting demonstrations and for training policies. Force-annotated data, however, remains hard to obtain at scale: real-robot collection ties every demonstration to physical hardware, physics simulators report contact forces that deviate systematically from real measurements, and learned world simulators, though scalable and realistic, are vision-only, so operators feel nothing during data collection and the data carries no force/torque (F/T) labels. We present HapticWorld, an interactive world simulator that predicts joint torque together with observations and renders it back to the operator in real time, closing the haptic loop between a human and a learned world model. Across three contact-rich tasks, torque feedback raises data collection throughput by 1.6 times on average. Policies trained on HapticWorld-generated demonstrations succeed in 54/60 real-world trials, approaching the 56/60 upper bound of real-world data, and far exceeding the 19/60 success rate of the vision-only baseline. Moreover, the success rates measured inside HapticWorld closely match real-world evaluation, demonstrating that HapticWorld can serve as a stand-alone F/T-conditioned policy evaluation platform.

</details>


### [1916] [Inertia-Corrected Newton Method For Generalized Nash Equilibria in Dynamic Games with Optimality Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31929)
*Zhiyuan Zhang,Panagiotis Tsiotras*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种快速牛顿求解器，用于约束动态博弈，通过KKT矩阵惯性判断局部广义纳什均衡（GNE）的二阶充分条件（SOSC），并引入惯性校正更新步骤提升收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 牛顿法求解动态博弈GNE时速度快，可支持多智能体MPC，但KKT残差小并不能保证解满足局部GNE的二阶充分条件，因此需要高效的最优性验证方法。

Method: 将智能体KKT矩阵的惯性（正负特征值个数）与成本函数约化Hessian在约束零空间投影上的正定性建立联系；并提出惯性校正更新步骤，通过 destabilize 弱跨智能体耦合的严格鞍点来改善收敛。

Result: 通过数值基准测试展示了求解器在实际多智能体规划问题中的运行时间与收敛性能；并在微型自主赛车平台上验证了其实时能力。

Conclusion: 所提求解器能高效检查局部GNE的最优性并具备实时性，适用于多智能体动态博弈与MPC场景。

Abstract: Newton methods efficiently find Generalized Nash Equilibria (GNE) in dynamic games by solving for the KKT necessary conditions. These methods are fast and can support multi-agent Model Predictive Control (MPC) for highly dynamic robots. However, a small KKT residual alone does not certify that the returned solution satisfies the second-order sufficient conditions for a local GNE.
  In this paper, we propose an efficient numerical method to verify the second-order sufficient conditions (SOSC) for a local GNE. We connect the inertia of the agent KKT matrix with the positive definiteness of the reduced Hessian of the cost function, projected onto the null space of the constraints. Furthermore, we introduce an inertia-corrected update step that improves convergence to local GNEs by destabilizing strict saddle points with weak cross-agent coupling.
  Our main contribution is a fast Newton solver for Constrained Dynamic Games that provides efficient optimality checking. Through numerical benchmarks, we demonstrate the proposed solver's runtime and convergence performance in practical multi-agent planning problems. We also validate the solver's real-time capabilities in physical experiments using a platform of miniature autonomous race cars.

</details>


### [1917] [Low Cost Eye Tracking for Vision Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31941)
*Maissa Abir Smaili,Yaman Ismaiel,Zafer Iscan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工程研究评估了在视觉筛查中引入注视辅助数据采集的可行性，比较了基于网络摄像头的Orlosky眼动追踪流程与GC308近红外相机的表现。十名被试在两种条件下完成任务，但报告的数据主要反映采集稳定性而非注视精度或视力测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在视觉筛查（如Tumbling E方向判断）中利用眼动追踪辅助数据采集的可行性，并比较不同眼动追踪硬件（网络摄像头 vs. GC308近红外相机）在采集稳定性方面的差异。

Method: 十名被试在两种采集条件下完成Gaze Quest视觉筛查任务。评估指标包括：Tumbling E方向判断准确率、应用logMAR值、响应延迟（均由键盘响应得出，属行为输出）；GC308眼动追踪的帧间归一化注视向量夹角变化（均值28.2度），有效采样率约8 FPS。GC308数据未进行屏幕目标校准或注视-屏幕映射，因此反映采集稳定性而非相对目标的注视精度。网络摄像头流程依赖25点屏幕校准。

Result: GC308眼动追踪的帧间归一化注视向量夹角变化为28.2度，有效采样率约8 FPS。由于显示分辨率和像素间距未保留在研究记录中，所报告的logMAR值不能作为视力测量指标；GC308数据仅代表采集稳定性，不代表注视精度。

Conclusion: 该研究初步展示了注视辅助数据采集在视觉筛查中的应用潜力，但受限于未进行屏幕校准与显示参数缺失，当前结果仅能反映眼动采集稳定性，无法用于视力评估。未来需完善校准流程并保留显示参数，以获得有意义的注视精度和视力相关测量。

Abstract: This engineering study assesses gaze-assisted data acquisition during visual screening with a Gaze Quest implementation via webcam and GC308 near infrared camera with an Orlosky eye tracking pipeline. Ten subjects performed under both acquisition conditions. Accuracy of Tumbling E orientation, reported application logMAR value,and response latency were determined from keyboard responses and hence are behavioral outputs as opposed toeye tracker screening results. Frame-to-frame change in theangle between successive normalized gaze vectors (28.2degrees) served as the GC308 eye tracker derived diagnostic with an effective sampling rate of roughly 8 FPS. No screen target calibration or gaze to screen translation was done on the GC308 eye tracker output data for the current analysis and hence, these data represent acquisition stability and not gaze accuracy in relation to the target. The webcam pipeline relied on 25-point screen calibration. Because the display resolution and pixel pitch could not be retained in the records of the study, the reported application logMAR values cannot be viewed as measures of visual acuity in any way.

</details>


### [1918] [Grasp2Twist: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Jar Opening by Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32064)
*Mo Xu,Yunfu Deng,Jianuo Wang,Josiah Hanna,Bilge Mutlu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Grasp2Twist 是一个双臂灵巧操作系统，通过强化学习掌握抓取并旋开罐盖的任务，利用几何包络度量与三阶段课程实现统一策略学习、持续扭转与零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习"抓取-旋开罐盖"任务面临三大挑战：多阶段任务的统一策略学习、持续旋拧的维持，以及仿真到现实的迁移。

Method: 提出连续包络度量引导抓取形成，二元包络指标引导从抓取到旋拧的过渡，二者均由物体中心与手掌及指尖构成凸包之间的几何关系推导得出；为应对运动学约束导致的接触受限，采用三阶段课程学习以促进手指接触重构的探索并提升 sim-to-real 鲁棒性。

Result: 学习到的策略展现出手指步态（finger gaiting），通过重构手-物接触维持盖子旋转；策略零样本迁移至物理系统，在六种家用容器（包括花生酱、维生素和速溶咖啡罐）上达到 88% 的任务成功率；消融实验验证了几何包络在抓取形成中的作用以及课程学习在接触重构探索中的作用。

Conclusion: 几何包络度量与课程学习是解决多阶段灵巧操作任务的关键，系统可在真实环境中实现高成功率的零样本部署。

Abstract: This paper presents Grasp2Twist, a bimanual dexterous manipulation system that learns to grasp and twist open jar lids using reinforcement learning. Learning this task raises three challenges: learning a unified policy for a multi-stage task, sustaining lid twisting, and sim-to-real transfer. To address the first challenge, we introduce a continuous enclosure measure to guide grasp formation and a binary enclosure indicator to guide the grasp-to-twist transition for unified policy learning. We derive both from the geometric relationship between the object center and the convex hull formed by the hand's palm and fingertips. Kinematic constraints limit how far the hand can rotate the lid with fixed contacts, so sustained twisting requires finger contact reconfiguration. We use a three-stage curriculum to facilitate exploration of these contact changes and also improve robustness for sim-to-real transfer. With our approach, the learned policy demonstrates finger gaiting, reconfiguring hand-object contacts to sustain lid rotation. It transfers zero-shot to the physical system and achieves an 88% task success rate across six household containers, including peanut-butter, vitamin, and instant-coffee jars. Ablations further validate the roles of the geometric enclosure in grasp formation and the curriculum in contact-reconfiguration exploration.

</details>


### [1919] [Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32069)
*Yuan Fang,Zechu Li,Haolei Tong,Puze Liu,Georgia Chalvatzaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FIND 是一个面向真实世界的智能体式强化学习框架，把"场景理解—弱项感知练习—自评估—策略改进"闭环起来。它不重置环境，而是用 rollout 后的场景决定下一步练什么。配合冻结的 π0.5 VLA 与残差 off-policy RL，在 8 项真实操作任务上把独立人工评估成功率从 55% 提升到 71.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型虽为机器人操作提供了强先验，但通常以冻结策略部署，无法从自身失败中改进。真实世界 RL 是持续提升的路径，但手动重置环境与任务成功标注依赖人类监督，阻碍了自主学习。

Method: 将自主练习重构为"场景条件化、性能感知"的任务选择问题：每次 rollout 后不恢复预设场景，而是利用结果场景决定后续练习内容。由一个视觉—语言智能体从预定义任务库中识别可行任务，优先选择近期成功率较低者，并用执行前/后的配对观测评估结果。具体实例化为冻结的 π0.5 VLA 加残差 off-policy RL。

Result: 在 8 项真实世界操作任务上，独立人工评估的成功率从 55% 提升至 71.9%。一次代表性运行在 6 小时交互内完成 456 个自主回合，仅需 30 次场景恢复干预，且在线学习过程中无需任何人工奖励标签。

Conclusion: FIND 验证了在持久化工作空间中实现自主真实世界 RL 的可行性：通过场景条件化任务选择与自评估替代人工重置和奖励标注，并以消融与系统评估检验关键设计、智能体评估准确性与人工干预需求。

Abstract: Vision--language--action (VLA) models provide strong priors for robotic manipulation but are typically deployed as frozen policies, unable to improve from their own failures. Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to continued improvement, yet manual environment resets and task-success supervision hinder autonomous learning. We introduce \textbf{FIND}, an agentic real-world RL framework that closes the loop between scene understanding, weakness-aware practice, self-evaluation, and policy improvement in a persistent workspace. FIND reframes autonomous practice as a scene-conditioned, performance-aware task-selection problem: instead of restoring a predefined scene after each rollout, it uses the resulting scene to determine what to practice next. A vision--language agent identifies feasible tasks from a predefined library, prioritizes those with lower recent success rates, and evaluates outcomes using paired pre- and post-execution observations. We instantiate FIND with a frozen $π_{0.5}$ VLA and residual off-policy RL. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks, the independent human-assessed success rate improves from $55\%$ to $71.9\%$. A representative run completes 456 autonomous episodes within 6 hours of interaction, requiring 30 scene-recovery interventions and no human-provided reward labels during online learning. Ablations and systematic evaluations further examine key design choices, agent evaluation accuracy, and human intervention requirements. Our website is made publicly available at: FIND.github.io.

</details>


### [1920] [Fiber-Normalized Manipulability and Determinant Proxies: Intrinsic Redundancy Optimization Across and Within Task Fibers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32079)
*Antonio Franchi,Mirko Mizzoni*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文证明行列式型可操作度是固定任务冗余优化的精确目标（同一纤维内仅差正常数，序、极值、梯度方向、临界点与局部最优分类一致），并提出纤维归一化可操作度以实现跨纤维比较与轨迹优化，其无量纲、坐标与度量无关，适用于含指定/自由任务演化与时间耦合的物理可行轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行列式型可操作度依赖任务坐标与任务空间度量（体积测量方式），其作为优化目标的正当性存疑；同时跨任务纤维（不同任务状态）之间缺乏可比且与坐标/度量无关的标量指标，难以支撑跨纤维比较与轨迹优化。

Method: 1) 在正则任务纤维上分析行列式代理、其在任意任务图卡中的表示以及各度量补全可操作度的关系；2) 定义纤维归一化可操作度：内部状态处可达能力除以同一纤维上最优能力，构造无量纲标量及其损失；3) 在平面机械臂与冗余气动分配算例中验证。

Result: 正则纤维上行列式代理、任务图卡表示与度量补全可操作度仅相差正常数，因而诱导相同的完全序、约束极值、梯度方向、临界点与局部最优分类；纤维归一化可操作度在内部状态流形与任务流形坐标变换下不变，且不依赖任务空间度量；算例展示固定纤维等价性、任务相关的跨纤维差异与不变的纤维归一化轨迹优化。

Conclusion: 行列式型可操作度可作为固定任务冗余优化的精确目标；纤维归一化可操作度为物理可行的跨纤维轨迹（含指定或自由任务演化及时间耦合）提供内蕴目标，实现了固定纤维与跨纤维两类问题的统一处理。

Abstract: This work establishes that determinant-based manipulability is an exact objective for fixed-task redundancy optimization, despite its dependence on task coordinates and the choice of task-space metric used for volume measurement. On every regular task fiber, the determinant proxy, its representation in any task chart, and every metric-completed manipulability differ only by positive constants. They consequently induce the same complete ordering, constrained extrema, gradient directions, critical points, and local optimality classifications.
  For comparisons and trajectory optimization across task fibers, this work introduces fiber-normalized manipulability: the capability attained at an internal state divided by the best capability available on the same fiber. The resulting dimensionless scalar is invariant under coordinate changes on the internal-state and task manifolds and independent of the task-space metric. Its associated loss provides an intrinsic objective for physically admissible cross-fiber trajectories, including problems with prescribed or free task evolution and temporal coupling. Planar-manipulator and redundant aerodynamic-allocation examples demonstrate fixed-fiber equivalence, task-dependent cross-fiber differences, and invariant fiber-normalized trajectory optimization.

</details>


### [1921] [Active 3D weaves for load-bearing and damage-resilient locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32099)
*Guowei Wayne Tu,Evgueni T. Filipov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将活性材料集成到三维机织壳体的通用框架，构建兼具高轴向刚度、低弯曲刚度和系统级损伤容忍性的机织机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纺织类系统柔软安全，适合人机交互，但固有柔性限制了承载能力，而承载是许多机器人功能的基础。需要一种既能保持柔性又具备承载与驱动能力的设计方案。

Method: 以三维机织结构的基本单元“机织角”（woven corners）模块化组装机器人；通过特征值计算识别三维机织结构的承载与驱动机制，并据此设计五种可运动的机器人。

Result: 所构建的三维机织机器人可承载约70倍自重的负载进行运动，并在经受极端压缩后仍保持可重复的性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为未来三维机织机器人系统的设计、制造与仿真提供了路径，可同时满足承载、高刚度、主动功能变形、运动与系统级韧性需求。

Abstract: The craft of weaving, where different materials are interlaced, has tremendous potential for creating active and functional systems for use in soft robots, prosthetics, wearables, exoskeletons, and more. These textile-like systems are flexible and safe for human-machine interaction; however, this inherent flexibility limits their ability to carry loads, which is essential for many robotic functions. In this work, we introduce a general framework for integrating active materials into three-dimensional (3D) woven shells to create robotic structures that combine high axial stiffness for load bearing, low bending stiffness for efficient actuation, and system-level resilience for damage tolerance. These woven robots can be modularly assembled from 'woven corners', a fundamental unit of 3D woven structures. We use eigenvalue calculations to identify load bearing and actuation mechanisms of the 3D woven structures, and use that information to make five different robots capable of locomotion. We demonstrate that these 3D woven robots can locomote carrying loads 70 times their self-weight, and can maintain repeatable performance even after being subjected to extreme compression. This work is a pathway toward the design, manufacturing, and simulation of future 3D woven robotic systems where load bearing, high stiffness, active functional deformation, locomotion, and system-level resilience are all needed.

</details>


### [1922] [Residual Denoising Enables Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination on Demand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32129)
*Dayi Dong,Maulik Bhatt,Aayushi Shrivastava,Lasse Peters,Negar Mehr*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ALTER方法，以极少协作数据将预训练单智能体扩散策略适配为多智能体协作策略，在去中心化执行下兼顾协作性能与单智能体技能保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练机器人策略操作能力强，但局限于单智能体场景。如何在少量协作数据下使其适配多智能体协作，同时不损失原有单智能体技能，是本研究动机。

Method: 训练一个协调头（coordination head），预测残差去噪器，将单智能体行为在需要时转化为协作式多智能体行为；执行完全去中心化，各机器人仅依赖自身视觉观测，无显式通信。为保持单智能体能力，在训练残差去噪器时，用基础策略自蒸馏生成的数据增强少量协作演示数据。

Result: 仿真中ALTER的协作成功率高于基线，且源技能保持率显著更高；硬件实验呈现类似趋势，ALTER在协作成功与单智能体技能保持的协同优化上优于基线。

Conclusion: ALTER能以最小协作数据实现"按需协作"：在团队中协同、单独时保持独立作业能力，并在协作性能与单智能体技能保持间取得更优权衡。

Abstract: Pretrained robot policies offer strong manipulation skills but are typically limited to single-agent settings, where a robot acts in isolation. In this work, we study how to adapt pretrained single-agent diffusion policies to multi-agent settings using minimal collaborative data, co-optimizing for two key objectives: high coordination performance and single-agent skill retention. To this end, we introduce ALTER, an adaptation method for coordination on demand: the adapted policy coordinates with other robots when deployed in a team while remaining capable of acting independently when operating alone. Execution is decentralized: each robot acts only on its own visual observations, without explicit inter-agent communication. Our method trains a coordination head that predicts a residual denoiser to transform single-agent behavior into coordinated multi-agent behavior when necessary while also preserving single-agent capabilities. To preserve single-agent capabilities, we augment a small number of collaborative demonstrations with self-distilled data generated by the base policy during training of the residual denoiser. In simulation,ALTER achieves higher coordination success over our baselines while retaining much higher source-skill retention. In our hardware experiments, we find similar trends where ALTER better co-optimizes for coordination success and single-agent skill retention than the baselines

</details>


### [1923] [GAUGE: Planner-Conditioned Active Calibration of Opaque Quadruped Velocity Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32154)
*Tianhao Zang,Zihan Liu,Shanze Wang,Liyou Luo,Xingjian Xie,Chengtai Li,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 GAUGE 框架，用于规划器条件下的 opaque 四足速度接口主动标定：在规划器诱导的命令分布下，以期望认知不确定性下降为准则选择试验，支持验证式停止、有界逆补偿与接口漂移后的任务相关重标定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用四足通常只暴露平面速度命令，底层运动控制器不可访问，命令与实际运动之间存在系统性偏差；而导航规划器通常只使用命令包络中的一个结构化子集，因此需要面向任务、样本高效的接口标定方法，而非全域稠密标定。

Method: GAUGE 维护贝叶斯命令到运动模型，在规划器诱导的命令分布下，按期望后验认知不确定性下降选择授权试验；基于所得后验执行验证式停止、有界逆补偿，并在检测到接口漂移后进行任务相关重标定。

Result: 在三个受控响应族中，GAUGE 相比被动、D-最优和任务无关基线，以更少试验达到任务精度与不确定性的联合准则；在六个留出 Isaac Sim 导航地图上，达到相对稠密标定所声明的非劣性边际。

Conclusion: GAUGE 将主动标定目标与规划器实际命令分布对齐，在保证任务面向精度与不确定性要求的同时显著降低标定试验成本，并对接口漂移具备重标定能力。

Abstract: In this paper, we present a Goal-Aware Uncertainty-Guided Exploration (GAUGE) framework for planner-conditioned active calibration of opaque quadruped velocity interfaces. Commercial quadrupeds commonly expose planar-velocity commands, but the underlying locomotion controller remains inaccessible and can produce systematic discrepancies between commanded and realized motion. A navigation planner typically uses a structured subset of the command envelope. GAUGE maintains a Bayesian command-to-motion model and selects authorized trials according to their expected reduction of posterior epistemic uncertainty under the planner-induced command distribution. The resulting posterior supports validation-based stopping, bounded inverse compensation, and task-relevant recalibration after detected interface shifts. In three controlled response families, GAUGE reaches the joint criterion for task-facing accuracy and uncertainty with fewer trials than passive, D-optimal, and task-agnostic alternatives. Across six held-out Isaac Sim navigation maps, it meets the declared noninferiority margins against dense calibration. Code is available at https://github.com/EurekaZang/CalibAgent.

</details>


### [1924] [RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32155)
*Wenbo Li,Jun Yang,Yiteng Chen,Wei Zhang,Qingyao Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RecastVLA 提出在流匹配视觉-语言-动作策略中，用共享快权重表示可递归更新的策略状态，使动作生成本身成为持久历史状态并用于后续控制，在多个仿真与真实任务中提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 顺序操作要求机器人跟踪已发生的交互，即使当前场景不再体现这些历史。显式历史表示虽可把过去交互作为上下文，但本文追问：动作生成过程本身能否形成用于后续控制的持久状态。

Method: 基于动作侧测试时训练，RecastVLA 在流匹配 VLA 策略内维护自适应策略状态：状态由共享快权重表示，并在整个动作生成过程中保持固定；深度特定接口读取同一状态，跨深度与流评估的特征共同定义下一次策略调用的更新。后续动作损失通过穿越早期状态转移进行反向传播，训练初始化、接口与更新规则；部署时更新仅使用策略自身的动作生成特征，无需专家动作标签。

Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboDojo 及十二个真实机器人任务上，RecastVLA 相对未使用测试时训练的匹配策略提升平均成功率，其中 RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean 提升 10.68 个百分点。受控 RoboTwin 对比显示，保留状态可提升成功率，共享设计比独立训练的分层局部 TTT 高 2.58 个百分点。

Conclusion: 将动作生成特征递归转化为持久策略状态，可在无专家标签的部署条件下增强 VLA 策略的顺序操作能力，且共享快权重设计优于分层独立测试时训练。

Abstract: Sequential manipulation requires a robot to track what has already happened, even when the current scene no longer reveals it. Policies with explicit history representations make past interactions available as context for current decisions. We ask how action generation itself can form a persistent state for subsequent control. Building on action-side test-time training, RecastVLA maintains an adaptive policy state within a flow-matching vision-language-action policy. The state is represented by shared fast weights and remains fixed throughout action generation. Depth-specific interfaces read the same state, while features across depths and flow evaluations jointly define one update for the next policy call. Subsequent action losses train the initialization, interfaces, and update rule by differentiating through earlier state transitions. At deployment, updates use the policy's own action-generation features without expert action labels. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboDojo, and twelve real-robot tasks, RecastVLA improves mean success over a matched policy trained without test-time training, including 10.68 percentage points on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean. In controlled RoboTwin comparisons, retaining state improves success, and the shared design exceeds independently trained layer-local TTT by 2.58 points.

</details>


### [1925] [FutureRay: Control-Aligned Future Range for Agile Quadruped Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32158)
*Tianhao Zang,Shanze Wang,Ziqian Wang,Liyou Luo,Zihan Liu,Xingjian Xie,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 FutureRay，一种联合预测未来各方向距离与遭遇风险的感知模块，用于四足机器人动态避障，在不重训运动策略的前提下提升完成率并减少碰撞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人执行运动指令时，移动障碍物可能突然封锁原本通畅的路径。作者关注两个被忽视的因素：机器人足印尺寸，以及反应与制动所需时间；并探究预测"变化中的净空"能否改进导航决策。

Method: FutureRay 基于深度导出的距离历史与可观测机器人运动，预测不同观察方向在未来时刻的距离范围（range）及遭遇风险（encounter risk）。训练强调近端净空，并惩罚高估可用空间的误差。局部规划器对候选航向查询同一预测结果，与当前观测结合检查足印周边净空；基于模型计算反应—制动限制以指导速度选择，最终速度指令输出给固定的运动策略。

Result: 在60个静态与动态仿真场景的配对评估中，感知、规划与运动保持不变的情况下，FutureRay 完成率93.3%，高于当前距离持续性（persistence）75.0% 与笛卡尔卡尔曼滚降 80.0%，且碰撞次数少于两个基线。真机四足机器人的定性实验显示，机器人能在障碍物接近路径时提前启动避让，随后恢复目标推进。

Conclusion: 联合的距离与遭遇风险预测可在不重训运动策略的条件下改善动态避障性能，验证了将足印与反应—制动约束纳入预测式规划的有效性。

Abstract: Moving obstacles can block a previously clear route while a quadruped robot executes a motion command. We investigate whether predicting changing clearance improves navigation when motion selection accounts for the robot footprint and the time needed to react and brake. We present FutureRay, which predicts ranges across viewing directions and future times, together with encounter risk, from depth-derived range history and observable robot motion. Training emphasizes near-term clearance and penalizes errors that overstate available space. A local planner queries the same forecast for candidate headings and combines it with current observations to check clearance around the robot footprint. Model-based reaction--braking limits guide speed selection, and the resulting velocity commands are passed to a fixed locomotion policy. In paired evaluations on 60 static and dynamic simulation scenes, FutureRay achieves 93.3% completion, compared with 75.0% for current-range persistence and 80.0% for Cartesian Kalman rollout, with perception, planning, and locomotion held fixed. FutureRay also records fewer collisions than both baselines. Qualitative trials on a physical quadruped show avoidance initiated while an obstacle is approaching the route, followed by renewed goal progress. These results show that joint range and encounter-risk prediction can improve obstacle avoidance without retraining the locomotion policy.

</details>


### [1926] [RoboFFT: Finetuning generative robot policy via online reinforcement learning with forward process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32236)
*Yu Li,Shenghe Hu,Yuhan Wang,Yaoxiang Pu,Haotong Zhang,Yuanpei Chen,Yaodong Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboFFT 是一种面向生成式机器人策略的前向过程强化学习微调框架，通过对采样动作施加前向加噪并用加权的分数/流匹配损失构造替代策略比，实现 PPO 式更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯模仿学习训练的生成式机器人策略常受不完美示范与分布偏移影响，进一步提升通常依赖额外专家数据；强化学习可借助环境交互改进，但生成式策略的似然估计不可解，导致有效微调困难。

Method: 提出 RoboFFT 前向过程强化学习框架：对采样动作施加前向加噪，利用加权 score/flow matching 损失构造替代策略比（surrogate policy ratio），进而支持 PPO 式策略更新。

Result: 在主流生成式机器人策略与代表性仿真基准（长程规划、稀疏奖励）上进行了实验；结果表明 RoboFFT 持续提升性能，并具有更好的稳定性与训练效率；进一步集成到真实世界 RL 框架并验证其有效性。

Conclusion: RoboFFT 为生成式机器人策略提供了一种可行且高效的强化学习微调方案，兼顾仿真与真实任务中的性能、稳定性与效率。

Abstract: Generative models, such as diffusion and flow-based models, have shown strong promise for robot policy learning by capturing complex and multimodal action distributions from demonstrations. However, policies trained solely with imitation learning often suffer from imperfect demonstrations and distributional shifts, while further improvement typically requires additional expert data. Reinforcement learning offers a natural solution through environment interaction, but effectively finetuning generative robot policies remains challenging due to the intractability of likelihood estimation. In this work, we propose RoboFFT, a forward-process reinforcement learning framework for finetuning generative robot policies, which applies forward noising to sampled actions and uses the weighted score / flow matching loss to construct a surrogate policy ratio for PPO-style updates. We evaluate RoboFFT with popular generative robot policies on representative simulation benchmarks, including long-horizon planning and sparse reward settings. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate that RoboFFT consistently improves performance while achieving better stability and training efficiency. We further integrate RoboFFT into a real world RL framework and demonstrate its effectiveness in real world tasks. Project website: https://student-of-holmes.github.io/RoboFFT/.

</details>


### [1927] [Affordance-Conditioned Decision Making: Bridging the Semantic-Spatial Gap in Zero-Shot Cross-Floor Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32292)
*Xuekang Yang,Lu Chen,Shuang Luo,Jialing Zhu,Qi Zhang,Yue Gao,Xiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PACE：为冻结的零样本语义规划器增加一个监督式局部执行模块，通过可通行可供性位姿条件化动作生成，并用失败感知偏好精炼实现在线纠错，提升跨楼层VLN成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）依赖通用语义规划器，能产生正确的高层意图，但在空间受限的过渡场景（楼梯、门道、狭窄通道）中，到达过渡点并不意味着可成功穿越；智能体还需确定可执行的交互/通行位姿，并纠正累积的动作误差，即语义意图与物理执行之间存在鸿沟。

Method: 提出PACE（Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution），一个监督式局部执行模块，用于增强冻结的零样本语义规划器。方法将过渡相关语义落地为长时域、以智能体为中心的可通行可供性位姿，并以该空间目标为条件进行短时域动作生成，从而对齐语义目标与物理执行；随后通过失败感知的偏好精炼对PACE进行后训练，利用 rollout 导出的对比样本对（正常或恢复行为 vs 放大偏差的行为）提升闭环纠错能力。

Result: 将PACE集成到六个开源零样本VLN导航器中，在R2R-CE与RxR-CE的跨楼层子集上取得一致提升：平均成功率分别从16.35%提升至27.65%、从4.76%提升至12.06%；真实环境实验进一步验证了PACE在未见环境中的适用性。

Conclusion: 可通行可供性有望弥合语义意图与可靠具身行为之间的差距；作为可插拔的局部执行模块，PACE在多种零样本VLN基线上稳定增益并具备现实场景泛化潜力。

Abstract: Vision-and-language navigation increasingly relies on general-purpose semantic planners, yet translating correct high-level intent into reliable physical execution remains difficult in spatially constrained transitions. Reaching a staircase, doorway, or narrow passage does not ensure traversal; the agent must identify an executable affordance pose and recover from accumulated action errors. We propose PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution), a supervised local execution module that augments frozen zero-shot semantic planners for reliable cross-floor navigation. PACE grounds transition-related semantics into a long-horizon, agent-centric traversable affordance pose and conditions short-horizon action generation on this spatial target, thereby aligning semantic goals with physical execution. We further post-train PACE through failure-aware preference refinement using rollout-derived pairs that contrast normal or recovery behaviors with deviation-amplifying behaviors, thereby improving closed-loop correction. We integrate PACE into six open-source zero-shot VLN navigators and demonstrate consistent improvements on the cross-floor subsets of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, increasing the average success rate from 16.35% to 27.65% and from 4.76% to 12.06%, respectively. Real-world experiments further demonstrate PACE's applicability in unseen environments, highlighting the potential of traversable affordances to bridge semantic intent and reliable embodied behavior.

</details>


### [1928] [MemTransfer: Benchmarking Memory Beyond Matched Experience in Embodied Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32313)
*Haiming Tang,Xianjie Dai,Gujie Shao,Zuyi Guo,Jingguang Li,Kailang Ma,Yihong Tang,Heye Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MemTransfer是一个在冻结VLM策略下比较六种记忆表征的导航基准，揭示记忆保留有用信息不等于在条件变化时能有效使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体虽可通过记忆复用过去经验，但保留有用信息并不保证条件变化时能成功调用。现有评测缺乏对"信息存储"与"决策时使用"两方面鲁棒性的系统比较。

Method: 构建MemTransfer基准，在模拟仓库中涵盖十类任务、100个导航案例，由专家示范提供历史。在统一冻结的视觉-语言模型策略下比较六种记忆表征：一个工作记忆基线与五种过去经验表征（Full-context、Episodic、Summary及两种轨迹记忆）。设置三类比较，分别改变起始位姿、路线可用性，以及历史的数量与任务相关性。

Result: 每任务一条示范时，Full-context与Episodic在原起始点成功率达95.3%与100.0%，但换新测试起点后下降48-49个百分点；Summary在两起点间变化很小，但每任务四示范时，其在路线阻断后保留的成功比例（39.3%）低于Working memory（44.8%）与两种轨迹记忆（56-58%）。新起点下，相关示范由一增至四使Episodic提升14.3个百分点，其他表征提升不超过1.3个百分点。将一半相关历史替换为其他任务经验会降低两种轨迹记忆的成功率。

Conclusion: 对某一类失配的鲁棒性并不意味着对另一类也鲁棒，因此评测记忆需同时考察所存储的信息及其在决策时的使用方式。

Abstract: Memory lets an embodied agent reuse past experience, yet retaining useful information does not ensure that the agent can apply it when conditions change. We present MemTransfer, a benchmark comparing six memory representations, a working-memory baseline and five representations of past experience, under a shared frozen vision-language-model policy. It comprises 100 navigation cases across ten task types in a simulated warehouse, with expert demonstrations supplying the history. Three comparisons vary the starting pose, route availability, and amount and task relevance of history. With one demonstration per task, Full-context and Episodic memory reach 95.3% and 100.0% success at the original demonstration start, but lose 48-49 percentage points at a new test start. Summary changes little between these two test starts, yet with four demonstrations per task it retains a smaller fraction of its unchanged-route success after blocking (39.3%) than Working memory (44.8%) or the two trajectory memories (56-58%). At the new test start, increasing from one to four relevant demonstrations raises Episodic success by 14.3 percentage points, while the other evaluated representations gain no more than 1.3 percentage points. Replacing half of the relevant histories with other-task experience lowers success for both trajectory memories. These results show that robustness to one kind of mismatch does not imply robustness to another, motivating evaluation of both stored information and its use at decision time.

</details>


### [1929] [WSM-Aware HRI: An IoT-Enhanced Framework for Early Detection and Norm-Guided Repair of Failures with LLM Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32336)
*Hanlin Zhang,Yuquan Wang,Tianwei Zhang,Zhenglong Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出WSM-Aware HRI框架，将人机交互失败统一建模为人类指令隐含假设与机器人世界模型之间的"世界状态不匹配"（WSM），借助LLM显式化假设并在意图形成阶段主动检测失配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机交互失败是机器人实际部署的主要障碍。既有工作多将失败视为孤立技术故障，或仅关注事后恢复行为；而现实中许多崩溃源于人与机器人对当前世界状态的假设不一致，缺乏统一、可提前介入的建模与检测机制。

Method: 构建IoT增强的模块化框架WSM-Aware HRI：以多模态感知与数字增强构建机器人接地的世界模型，将人类指令隐含假设与之对照，统一表示为WSM。利用LLM将隐含假设显式化、映射到少量不匹配类型，并指定用于对照机器人世界状态验证所需的证据。将失败处理从执行时恢复前移至意图形成阶段的主动失配检测，干预受安全、规范合规与多用户协调约束并给出透明解释。

Result: 在涵盖视觉失配与潜在状态失配的十个日常案例上评估失配识别，系统能准确产生预期输出结果；消融实验表明可靠识别依赖于恰当的接地表示与面向验证的细化机制。

Conclusion: 将交互崩溃显式视为世界状态不匹配，可更早检测即将发生的失败，并为把外部证据与社会约束整合进人机交互提供了有原则的机制。

Abstract: Human-robot interaction (HRI) failures remain a major barrier to deploying robots in real-world environments. Prior work often treats failures as isolated technical faults or focuses on post-hoc recovery behaviors. In practice, many breakdowns arise because humans and robots operate under inconsistent assumptions about the current world state. We propose WSM-Aware HRI, an IoT-enhanced modular framework that unifies diverse HRI breakdowns as World-State Mismatches (WSMs) between a human's instruction-implied assumptions and a robot's grounded world model built from multimodal perception and digital augmentation. A Large Language Model (LLM) is used to make implicit assumptions explicit, map them to a small set of mismatch types, and specify the evidence needed for verification against the robot's world state. WSM-Aware HRI shifts failure handling from execution-time recovery to proactive mismatch detection during intention formation, enabling interventions guided by safety, norm compliance, and multi-user coordination with transparent explanations. We evaluate mismatch identification in ten everyday cases spanning both visual and latent-state mismatches. The system can accurately produce the expected output results, and ablations show that reliable identification depends on appropriate grounding representations and verification-oriented refinement. These results indicate that treating interaction breakdowns as explicit world-state mismatches enables earlier detection of impending failures and offers a principled mechanism for integrating external evidence and social constraints into human-robot interaction.

</details>


### [1930] [Human Motion Prediction for Human-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32346)
*Placido Falqueto,Elena Basei,Edoardo Lamon,Giovanni Perantoni,Matteo Saveriano,Daniele Fontanelli,Luigi Palopoli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 比较GMM聚类、TransFusion与Graph-Mixer三种人体运动预测方法在人机协作场景中的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体运动预测可提升机器人运动规划能力，通过预判人的动作增强动态环境下的安全性与效率，因此需评估不同预测方法在人机协作中的适用性。

Method: 对GMM聚类、TransFusion和Graph-Mixer三种人体运动预测方法进行对比评估。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或量化指标。

Conclusion: 三种方法均服务于人机协作中的人体运动预测需求，但摘要未明确各方法的优劣结论。

Abstract: This paper compares three human motion prediction methods - GMM-based clustering, TransFusion, and Graph-Mixer - evaluating their effectiveness in human-robot collaboration. These predictions are valuable for improving robot motion planning by anticipating human movements and enhancing safety and efficiency in dynamic environments.

</details>


### [1931] [Proactive Motion Planning for Human-Robot Cooperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32354)
*Elena Basei,Edoardo Lamon,Matteo Saveriano,Daniele Fontanelli,Luigi Palopoli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将基于图神经网络的深度学习人体运动预测模型嵌入规划框架，结合静态路线图与时变A*算法调整UR5e机械臂轨迹，实现主动式人机协作避障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机安全协作需要机器人预先应对人类未来动作，而非仅在检测到冲突后被动反应，因此需把人体运动预测纳入主动式、动态的人因感知运动规划。

Method: 采用基于图的深度学习模型预测人体运动，并将预测结果集成到规划框架；该框架以静态路线图作为基础拓扑，配合时变A*算法对UR5e机械臂轨迹进行重规划。

Result: 摘要指出该方法将精确的运动预测与自适应轨迹规划相结合，显著改善了人机交互效果，并实现了主动式碰撞避免（摘要未给出量化实验指标）。

Conclusion: 面向人机协作的主动与动态人因感知运动规划，可通过图基深度学习预测与时变A*路线图规划的耦合得到有效实现。

Abstract: This abstract addresses the incorporation of human motion prediction into proactive and dynamic human-aware motion planning, with the goal of enabling safe collaboration between humans and robots. A deep learning, graph-based model is used to forecast human motion and is integrated into a planning framework. This framework employs a static roadmap along with a time-variant A* algorithm to modify the trajectory of a UR5e manipulator. This method greatly improves human-robot interaction and enables proactive collision avoidance by combining precise motion forecasts with adaptive trajectory planning.

</details>


### [1932] [RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32416)
*Jiawei Zhang,Xiangrong Zhang,Rui Song,Huanbin Zhou,Chengye Song,Hongzhou Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RE-0与RE-OPD框架：通过对教师在被训练策略失败轨迹上给出的局部修正进行环境反事实验证，仅将经验证有益的干预用于在策略蒸馏监督，使监督位置与教师信度随策略共同演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从"更强但非全局可靠"教师处蒸馏策略的方法，默认教师完整行为即为监督目标，因此在教师同样失败的状态上会被错误分配训练信用（credit misassignment），限制了Code-as-Policy智能体长时程具身任务的持续改进。

Method: RE-0：不假设教师全局优于学生，而是让学生在其自身失败历史状态上向教师请求局部修正，并在环境中验证该修正是否真实有益，验证通过的修正立即带来性能提升。RE-OPD：将验证过的干预转化为在策略蒸馏监督——只有经反事实验证的教师干预才提供分布级监督，并按其实测局部收益加权；所诱导的改进被投影回独立学生策略，使"监督施加位置"与"教师获得多少信用"随学生策略共同演化。理论证明学生的每轮收益下界为其验证干预收益，误差项来自验证误差与投影误差。

Result: 在多个Code-as-Policy具身任务上，RE-0同时提升了教师辅助执行性能与独立学生的性能，并能泛化到新的机器人与场景。

Conclusion: 用"局部请求+环境验证"替代"全局教师模仿"，可缓解教师不可靠导致的信用错配；经验证的干预按局部收益加权并对齐回独立学生，是更稳健且可泛化的策略改进与蒸馏路径。

Abstract: Code-as-Policy agents accomplish long-horizon embodied tasks by generating and executing code, yet continually improving them with teachers that are stronger but not globally reliable remains a key challenge. Existing distillation methods typically treat the teacher's complete behavior as the supervision target and thus misassign training credit on states where the teacher fails. We propose RE-0, a recursively verified policy improvement framework: rather than assuming that the teacher globally outperforms the student, RE-0 requests local corrections from the teacher on the student's own failure histories and checks in the environment whether each correction is genuinely beneficial; verified corrections yield immediate improvement. Building on this, we propose RE-OPD, which turns verified interventions into supervision for on-policy distillation. Only counterfactually verified teacher interventions provide distribution-level supervision, weighted by their measured local benefit, and the improvement they induce is projected back into the standalone student, so both where supervision is applied and how much credit the teacher receives co-evolve with the student policy. We further prove that the student's per-round gain is lower-bounded by its verified intervention gain up to verification and projection error terms. Experiments across multiple Code-as-Policy embodied tasks show that RE-0 improves both teacher-assisted execution and the standalone student, and generalizes to novel robots and scenes.

</details>


### [1933] [DRAM: Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory for Robot Manipulation Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32453)
*Xinyu Zhao,Yixiang Shan,Tao Yang,Runyu Lei,Yiming Zhao,Jiaxin Fan,Zongbao Feng,Peng Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 DRAM（Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory），一种即插即用的记忆模块，可在不改动架构、不重训练主干的前提下，为各类预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆，仅需对记忆模块与动作专家进行任务特定后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作本质上依赖历史信息，但多数预训练策略仅以当前观测或短时窗口为条件。现有赋予长时记忆的方案存在缺陷：多帧观测窗口会显著增加推理成本；依赖预定义语义特征则限制任务通用性，且可能需要重训练主干以适配记忆。

Method: DRAM 采用带门控的 delta-rule 线性注意力维护固定大小的关联记忆，并改进更新方式，使每帧内所有 token 并行写入；同时设计架构无关的读出机制，将历史上下文注入不同策略架构的动作预测。训练时冻结主干，仅后训练记忆模块与动作专家。

Result: 实验表明，DRAM 在冻结的预训练策略上持续优于短上下文基线以及其他紧凑记忆设计，验证了其作为固定大小、后置记忆模块的有效性。

Conclusion: DRAM 证明可在完全冻结主干、无需架构修改的条件下，以固定大小关联记忆为预训练机器人策略高效补充长时程记忆能力，具有良好的通用性与即插即用性。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently history-dependent, yet most pretrained robotic policies condition on only the current observation or a short temporal window. Equipping such policies with long-term memory remains challenging: existing approaches either feed the backbone multi-frame observation windows, which substantially increase inference cost, or rely on pre-defined semantic features, which limit task generality and may also require the retraining of the backbone to adapt to the memory. We introduce DRAM (Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory), a plug-and-play memory module that can be attached to a wide range of pretrained robotic policies, endowing them with long-horizon memory without architectural modification or backbone retraining, requiring only task-specific post-training of the memory module and action expert. DRAM maintains a fixed-size associative memory using gated delta-rule linear attention, with a modified update that incorporates all tokens within each frame in parallel. An architecture-agnostic readout integrates historical context into action prediction across different policy architectures. Experiments show that DRAM consistently improves frozen pretrained policies over short-context baselines and alternative compact memory designs, validating its effectiveness as a fixed-size, post-hoc memory module trained with the backbone frozen.

</details>


### [1934] [GlowTact: Simple and Compact Vision-Based Tactile Sensing with High Sensitivity and Spatial Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32471)
*Yuxiang Ma,Megha Tippur,Pengfei Ye,Sandra Q. Liu,Haonan Chen,Francis Richard Cottrell,Edward Adelson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GlowTact 是一种压力响应型视触觉传感机制，通过单色非定向照明直接可视化接触压力分布，无需几何重建，实现紧凑、可定制的人形指尖触觉传感器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视触觉传感器（VBTS）虽能提供丰富接触信息，但设计难以简化和适配人形指尖的尺寸与约束，需要一种结构简单、紧凑且高灵敏的触觉传感方案。

Method: 提出 GlowTact 压力响应型视触觉传感机制：仅需单色非定向照明，原始触觉图像直接表征压力分布，无需显式几何重建；采用耐用丁腈膜与简易光学设计。

Result: 实现克级接触检测、准确的法向力估计，以及精细接触几何重建（包括 M1 螺纹）。

Conclusion: GlowTact 结合耐用丁腈膜与简单光学设计，兼具高灵敏度与丰富信息，是一种适用于紧凑人形指尖的实用新型触觉传感技术。

Abstract: Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTS) provide rich contact information for robotic manipulation, but existing designs can be hard to simplify and adapt to the size and constraints of humanoid fingertips. We introduce \textbf{GlowTact}, a pressure-responsive vision-based tactile sensing mechanism that directly visualizes contact pressure. \textbf{GlowTact} requires only single-color, non-directional illumination, and the raw tactile image directly represents the pressure distribution without explicit geometry reconstruction. This simple sensing principle enables compact, customizable tactile sensors while preserving high sensitivity and rich spatial detail. We demonstrate gram-scale contact detection, accurate normal-force estimation, and reconstruction of fine contact geometry, including M1 screw threads. These results establish \textbf{GlowTact} as a practical new sensing technology for compact humanoid fingertips, combining a durable nitrile membrane and simple optical design with sensitive and information-rich tactile perception.

</details>


### [1935] [Assisting for Open-Ended Tasks: Goal-Oriented Shared Autonomy as a Particle Filter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32576)
*Mengxue Fu,Ethan Xu,Sam Iyer-Singh,Yinlong Dai,Michael Hagenow,Dylan P. Losey*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于粒子滤波的开放式目标共享自治框架，利用基础模型动态生成候选目标并即时更新信念，实现目标动态变化的辅助控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共享自治方法大多假设可能的human goal集合是预先已知且静态的，这限制了其在非结构化辅助场景中的适用性。论文旨在支持开放式、动态变化的目标。

Method: 将目标导向的共享自治建模为粒子滤波器，粒子表示候选人类目标；与固定目标集不同，其转移模型随交互演化动态提出新候选目标，人类动作实时更新对这些目标的信念。用基础模型（视觉grounding与大型语言模型）实例化：提出上下文相关的语义目标，基于低层技能原语生成目标条件辅助，并从人类纠正中精炼技能。

Result: 通过12名参与者执行多种桌面操作任务的用户研究，与最先进共享自治基线对比，结果表明粒子滤波方法减少了用户遥操作时间并提升了用户满意度。

Conclusion: 粒子滤波式共享自治结合基础模型的语义目标提议与技能学习，可有效应对开放式、动态目标，在辅助操作中兼顾效率与用户体验。

Abstract: A common approach for shared autonomy blends human inputs with autonomous assistance based on the human's likely goal. However, most existing approaches assume that a static set of possible goals is known a priori, which limits the use of such methods in unstructured assistive settings. We instead investigate how to enable shared autonomy with open-ended and dynamically changing goals. We formulate goal-oriented shared autonomy as a particle filter in which particles represent candidate human goals. Unlike conventional approaches with a fixed goal set, our transition model dynamically proposes new candidate goals as the interaction evolves, and human actions update the belief over these goals in real time. We instantiate this framework with foundation models (e.g., vision grounding and large language models) that propose context-relevant semantic goals, generate goal-conditioned assistance from low-level skill primitives, and refine those skills from human corrections. We assess our approach through a user study where 12 participants perform a variety of tabletop manipulation tasks with our method and state-of-the-art shared autonomy baselines. The results show that our particle filter-based approach reduces the amount of time users spend teleoperating the system and improves user satisfaction. User study videos: https://youtu.be/Ii26XuRqm9c

</details>


### [1936] [Think Fast, Plan Selectively: Adaptive Deliberation for Efficient Data-Driven MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32591)
*Yi Xian Goh,Sze Jue Yang,Hao Luan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Fast-TD-MPC框架，借鉴双过程理论在快速策略执行与测试时规划间自适应路由，在103个连续控制任务上保持性能并实现约4倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动MPC虽在连续控制中表现优异，但每步需采样并评估数百条候选轨迹，计算开销大，导致控制频率远低于实时机器人需求。受人类认知双过程理论（System 1快速直觉、System 2缓慢审慎）启发，作者质疑是否每个决策都需要同等程度的计算审议。

Method: 提出Fast-TD-MPC轻量框架，在快速策略执行与测试时规划之间进行自适应路由，仅在最需要的状态上投入昂贵的审议计算。

Result: 在103个连续控制任务上取得具有竞争力的任务性能，推理速度最高提升约4倍；在外部扰动下能选择性回退到规划，保持与原始规划器相当的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 并非所有决策都需要同等计算审议，通过自适应路由可在大幅降低推理成本的同时保持性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Data-driven model predictive control (MPC) combines learned world models with online trajectory optimization, achieving strong performance in continuous control. However, the per-step cost of sampling and evaluating hundreds of candidate trajectories restricts deployment to control frequencies well below what real-time robotics demands. Motivated by the dual-process theory of human cognition, which distinguishes between fast, intuitive processing (System 1) and slower, deliberative reasoning (System 2), we ask whether every decision requires the same degree of computational deliberation. We propose Fast-TD-MPC, a lightweight framework that adaptively routes between fast policy execution and test-time planning, reserving costly deliberation for states where it is most needed. Fast-TD-MPC delivers competitive task performance across 103 continuous control tasks while achieving up to ~4x faster inference. Under external disturbances, Fast-TD-MPC selectively falls back to planning, maintaining robustness comparable to the original planner.

</details>


### [1937] [RECAST: Recasting Vision-Language Semantics into an Actionable Cost Map for Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32595)
*Incheol Cho,Jintae Park,Jinkyu Kim,Jungbeom Lee,Jaegul Choo,Seokha Moon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RECAST是一个机器人导航框架，融合VLM的推理能力与视觉基础模型的空间定位能力，构建可执行的代价地图（Actionable Cost map），在仿真和真实四足机器人上显著提升成功率并降低碰撞率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全鲁棒的机器人导航需要对复杂场景进行高层理解并将其转化为稳定运动。现有学习型模型在训练分布之外会失效，而基于VLM的方法虽具备理解能力，却难以将其落地到场景中，也难以使动作与其对齐。

Method: 先用VLM对机器人前视图像与用户指令进行场景分解，判断可通行表面、风险物体、偏好朝向、可通过间隙四类信息；再用视觉基础模型在图像中将相应的表面与物体进行空间定位，将这四项判断统一空间化重铸为一张紧凑的代价地图。该地图既用于约束轨迹解码器，也用于对其候选轨迹打分以选出执行轨迹。由于VLM输出滞后于实时场景，两个步骤同时利用两个时间点的代价地图：VLM判定的枢轴帧（包含全部四项判断）与当前帧（从当前图像重建地形与碰撞代价）。

Result: RECAST相较于最强先前方法在仿真中成功率提升13.3个百分点，在真实四足机器人上提升31.4个百分点；碰撞率分别降低9.6和14.3个百分点，达到所有方法中最低碰撞率。

Conclusion: 通过将VLM的语义推理与视觉基础模型的空间定位结合为统一的可执行代价地图，并采用双时间帧策略缓解VLM输出滞后问题，RECAST实现了跨多样化环境中更安全、更鲁棒的机器人导航。

Abstract: Safe and robust robot navigation across diverse environments requires a high-level understanding of complex scenes and the ability to carry it into stable motion. Recent works tackle this with learning-based models trained at scale and with approaches built on vision-language models (VLMs). However, learning-based models break down outside their training distribution, while VLM-based approaches bring that understanding but rarely ground it in the scene or align the action with it. To address these limitations, we present RECAST, a robot navigation framework that combines the reasoning of a VLM with the spatial grounding of vision foundation models to build an Actionable Cost map. Given the robot's front view and the user's instruction, we first decompose the scene with the VLM, judging which surfaces are traversable, which objects pose a risk, which heading to prefer, and which gaps are passable. Vision foundation models then ground these surfaces and objects in the image, and all four judgments are spatially recast into one compact cost map. This map both conditions the trajectory decoders and scores their proposals to select the one to execute. As the VLM's answers trail the live scene, both steps draw on cost maps from two points in time: the pivot frame the VLM judged, which carries all four judgments, and the current frame, whose terrain and collision costs are rebuilt from the current image. RECAST improves success over the strongest prior method by 13.3 points in simulation and 31.4 points on a real quadruped, and reduces the collision rate relative to it by 9.6 and 14.3 points, reaching the lowest collision rate among all methods. The project page is available at https://recast-nav.github.io/

</details>


### [1938] [PF-RL: Progress Field Reinforcement Learning via Goal-Conditioned Value Geometry for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32634)
*Yunpeng Qing,Yilun Kong,Sixu Lin,Ming Zhou,Yiming Fei,Shuang Luo,Yixiao Chi,Haoming Gu,Jingyuan Liu,Changxu Wei,Zhi Hou,Changqing Zou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL)，在预训练 VLA 特征上学习结构化、目标条件化的进度表示，并将其转化为密集信用以优化策略，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 及真实双臂操作任务上稳定超越 SFT、RFT 与现有进度感知基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFT 在提升 VLA 策略方面具有潜力，但任务级稀疏结果难以为中间转移提供有效信用，长时程操作尤为突出。建模中间任务进度并用作密集反馈是自然思路，然而现有进度感知方法普遍将进度建模为显式标量预测，对"中间观测如何与任务目标关联"缺乏结构约束，限制了转移级信用分配的效果。

Method: 提出 PF-RL：在预训练 VLA 特征上学习结构化、目标条件化的进度表示，并转换为策略优化的密集信用。具体地，一个轻量共享 Progress Field 头将当前表示与目标表示映射到紧凑进度空间，以几何距离诱导目标条件价值；辅以时序目标与目标结构目标来塑造所学的几何结构。转移级价值变化自然产生密集进度优势，从而支持离线策略改进与在线强化微调的细粒度信用分配。

Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 以及真实世界双臂操作任务上的大量实验表明，PF-RL 相比强监督微调、强化微调及进度感知基线均能持续提升策略性能。

Conclusion: 将任务进度建模为结构化的目标条件进度场，并以几何距离诱导价值，可为长时程 VLA 策略提供有效的转移级密集信用，是一种优于标量进度预测的 RFT 改进范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning~(RFT) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) policies, yet sparse task-level outcomes provide limited credit for intermediate transitions, especially in long-horizon manipulation. A natural approach is to model intermediate task progress and use it as dense feedback for policy improvement. Despite their architectural differences, existing progress-aware methods commonly formulate task progress as an explicit scalar prediction, providing limited structure for modeling how intermediate observations relate to the task goal, which may hinder effective transition-level credit assignment. We introduce Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL), which learns a structured goal-conditioned progress representation over pretrained VLA features and converts it into dense credit for policy optimization. A lightweight shared Progress Field head maps current and goal representations into a compact progress space, where geometric distance induces goal-conditioned value, while complementary temporal and goal-structure objectives shape the learned geometry. Transition-level value changes naturally yield dense progress advantages, enabling fine-grained credit assignment for both offline policy improvement and online reinforcement fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that PF-RL consistently improves policy performance over strong supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement fine-tuning, and progress-aware baselines.

</details>


### [1939] [SEES: A Self-Evolving Embodied System via Failure-Guided VLA Policy Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32698)
*Ziwen Li,Hanlue Zhang,Zhenyang Ren,Tianyu Huang,Runqi Lin,Haoyu Wang,Zhengqing Gao,Yandong Guo,Fakhri Karray,Tongliang Liu,Chris Russell,Mingming Gong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SEES 自进化具身系统，无需额外专家演示，通过分解长程任务、路由至共享 VLA 适配器的原子技能族、在线识别失败瓶颈并用 LLM 构造仿真 RL 任务，迭代提升 VLA 长程任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略在短程任务上泛化良好，但长程任务可靠性差。根本原因在于大规模训练数据偏向廉价的单阶段操作任务，导致某一原子技能薄弱即引发多阶段任务连锁失败。现有改进方法依赖专家定位瓶颈并提供新演示，成本高且部署后难以实施。

Method: SEES 将长程任务分解为原子任务并路由到对应的"技能族策略"，每个族内相关原子技能共享一个 VLA 适配器。执行时自动监控原子任务结果，识别失败最频繁的原子技能作为当前瓶颈；随后在仿真中通过恢复历史状态并由 LLM 生成任务特定的成功判据来构造定制化 RL 任务，用在线 RL 更新共享的族适配器，促进相关技能间的正迁移与跨轮次的累积改进。

Result: 大量实验表明 SEES 可与不同 VLA 主干集成并逐步提升其长程任务性能；同时在未见任务上也观察到持续改进，证明其具有超出进化设定范围的迁移能力。

Conclusion: SEES 提供了一种无需专家介入、从失败中自学习的具身系统框架，有效缓解长程任务中的数据偏置瓶颈问题，并展现出跨任务的正迁移潜力。

Abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies demonstrate promising generalization across diverse short-horizon tasks. However, they remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, partly because the large-scale training data is biased toward single-stage manipulation tasks that are cheaper to demonstrate. A single weak atomic skill can cause failures across multiple multi-stage tasks. To address such failures, existing methods often require experts to identify the bottleneck and provide additional demonstrations, making the improvement costly and potentially impractical after deployment. To this end, we present a Self-Evolving Embodied System (SEES) that learns from failures and improves the VLA policy without additional expert demonstrations. SEES decomposes long-horizon tasks into atomic tasks and routes them to corresponding family policies. Each family consists of related atomic skills that share one VLA adapter. During execution, the system automatically monitors atomic-task outcomes to identify the most frequently failing atomic skills as the current bottlenecks. To overcome these bottlenecks, SEES constructs tailored RL tasks in simulation by restoring previously encountered states and generating task-specific success criteria with an LLM. Online RL updates the shared family adapters to promote positive transfer among related atomic skills and cumulative improvement across evolution rounds. Extensive experiments show that SEES can be integrated with different VLA backbones to progressively improve their long-horizon performance. We also observe continued improvement on unseen tasks, providing evidence of transfer beyond the evolution settings.

</details>


### [1940] [MORPH: Self-Organising Multi-Robot Task Allocation via Neuroplasticity-Inspired Adaptive Topology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32745)
*Xuezhi Niu,Didem Gürdür Broo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MORPH：一种免训练的多机器人任务分配框架，通过4条局部可塑性规则在动态偏好矩阵上在线学习有向配对偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境下的多机器人任务分配存在根本张力：有效协调需要学习到的结构，但条件变化时结构必须适应。现有方法依赖先验任务知识、效用函数、代价矩阵或训练好的策略，在缺乏这些知识或任务分布漂移时表现脆弱。

Method: 提出MORPH（多智能体可塑性引导层级在线重连），无需任务模型、无需竞价计算、无需离线训练。对由运行时共现和任务完成反馈更新的有向配对偏好矩阵，施加突触、稳态、结构与元可塑性4条局部可塑性规则，由局部规则涌现全局分配质量；响应决策使用学到的AGV到拣选员偏好而非固定邻近规则。

Result: 在TA-RWARE仓库基准（8-24智能体、4张地图、每回合800步、5个随机种子）上，N=24时达到全连接吞吐量的110%，仅使用21%的可行协调链路，且随规模单调增长。空间任务分布漂移下，性能退化比邻近方法少3倍，学到的偏好与曼哈顿距离不相关。消融实验证实4条可塑性规则均有可测贡献。无需编程即涌现跨类型偏好主导与渐进式偏好稀疏化两种分配属性。

Conclusion: MORPH在Gerkey-Mataric分类中首次于单任务-单机器人-瞬时分配类别实现有向配对分配偏好的在线学习；学习偏好由任务共现历史而非空间邻近驱动，与生物神经回路发育性精炼相呼应。

Abstract: Multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) in dynamic environments faces a fundamental tension: effective coordination requires learned structure, but that structure must adapt when conditions change. Existing methods resolve this by assuming prior task knowledge, a utility function, a cost matrix, or a trained policy making them brittle when deployed without such knowledge or when task distributions shift. We present MORPH(Multi-agent Online Rewiring through Plasticity-guided Hierarchy), a training-free MRTA framework where global allocation quality emerges from 4 local plasticity rules (synaptic, homeostatic, structural, and metaplasticity) applied to a directed pairwise preference matrix updated from runtime co-occurrence and task-completion feedback. MORPH requires no task model, no bid computation, and no offline training; response decisions use learned AGV-to-Picker preferences rather than a fixed proximity rule. Within the Gerkey-Mataric MRTA taxonomy, MORPH is the first method in the single-task, single-robot, instantaneous-assignment class to learn directed pairwise allocation preferences online. Evaluated on the TA-RWARE warehouse benchmark (8-24 agents, 4 maps, 800 steps per episode, 5 seeds), MORPH achieves 110% of all-to-all throughput at N=24 while using only 21% of possible coordination links as an efficiency advantage that grows monotonically with fleet size. Under spatial task distribution shift, MORPH degrades 3x less than proximity-based methods while its learned preferences remain uncorrelated with Manhattan distance. Systematic ablation confirms all four plasticity rules contribute measurably. Two allocation properties emerge without programming: cross-type preference dominance and progressive preference sparsification, mirroring the developmental refinement of biological neural circuits. Learned preferences are driven by task co-occurrence history, not spatial proximity.

</details>


### [1941] [CLAP: Closed-Loop Alignment with Pressure for Precise Suction Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32767)
*Yixian Zou,Chongyang Xu,Yuling Xin,Ziliang Feng,Fanman Meng,Shuaicheng Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CLAP：将真空压力信号接入VLA策略的可观测性方案，实现吸附加持状态的实时感知与中断重推理，在真实Unitree Z1上多任务平均成功率96.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 堆叠与码垛要求精确放置：单层误差会被下层继承，且平面吸盘缺乏可引导错误位姿的几何特征。自上而下吸附加持适合密集排布，已有工作将吸附加持引入VLA策略，但尚未报道以实测真空信号为条件、或在动作执行中依据该信号中止动作的策略。视觉在此无法判定——关键时刻杯子与其所持表面相互遮挡。

Method: CLAP通过接入真空管路的压力模块使吸附加持状态可观测；将解码读数替代策略本体感知中的吸附加持命令，与视觉特征融合，并终止开环执行窗口使策略基于新观测重新推理。数据方面：在真实机器人上录制目标态拆解过程，离线反转关节状态序列，无需仿真回放。定向阶段演示仅占训练帧的8.3%，覆盖吸附状态转换与被中断抓取留下的构型。

Result: 在真实Unitree Z1上，单个多任务检查点在两种颜色设置下均达96.67%平均成功率，分别高出最强基线16.67和10.00个百分点；单色四块堆叠平均误差15.92 mm。四个消融设置分别落后5.00至13.33个百分点。

Conclusion: 以实测真空压力信号作为策略条件并用于执行中中止与重推理，可显著提升吸附加持堆叠/码垛任务的鲁棒性与精度；代码与训练权重将开源。

Abstract: Stacking and palletising demand precise placement: error left in one layer is inherited by the next, and a flat pad offers no feature to funnel a wrong pose into the right one. Top-down suction suits such dense arrangements, and suction has already been brought into vision-language-action (VLA) policies. What that work does not report, however, is a policy conditioned on a measured vacuum signal, or one that uses it to abandon an action already under way. Vision does not settle the question here, because at the moment it matters the cup and the face it holds occlude each other. We present CLAP, which makes the attachment state observable through a pressure module tapped into the vacuum line. The decoded reading replaces the suction command in the policy's proprioception, is fused with the visual features, and terminates the open-loop execution window so that the policy re-infers from a fresh observation. For data, we record goal-state disassembly on the physical robot and reverse the joint-state sequence offline, without a simulation replay. Targeted phase demonstrations, 8.3% of the training frames, cover the suction transitions and the configurations an interrupted grasp leaves behind. On a real Unitree Z1, one multi-task checkpoint reaches 96.67% average success in both colour settings, 16.67 and 10.00 points above the strongest baseline, its monochromatic four-block successes averaging 15.92 mm of error. Four ablation settings fall 5.00 to 13.33 points short. We will release code and trained weights.

</details>


### [1942] [Copper-Policy: Focus on the Representation for Robust Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32779)
*Zexin Feng,Yixu Feng,Lingyu Xiao,Shang Su,Kexin Zheng,Chang Xu,Mengkai Shi,Shuo Feng,Xintao Yan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Copper-Policy提出用策略联合学习紧凑的世界表示，通过时序联合嵌入预测未来观测嵌入而非重建像素，在保持控制性能的同时显著提升训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过建模未来场景演化获取行为先验，但在像素或潜空间中预测细节未来代价高昂。近期证据显示协同训练收益在无测试时生成的情况下依然存在，这引出一个问题：WAM究竟需要学习什么才能改进控制？现有方法依赖预定义的目标空间，可能并非最优。

Method: Copper-Policy让策略联合学习一个紧凑的世界表示，而非依赖预定义目标空间。它通过时序联合嵌入预测，在任务意图条件下预测未来观测嵌入，无需重建像素。该预测与动作解码共同塑造表示，而策略在执行时保留对当前帧空间细节的访问。

Result: 表示分析表明，所学特征能更好地区分任务驱动变化与扰动，并为控制提供互补信息。紧凑预测目标减少了每样本训练token数，使2B参数模型在8×RTX 5090上9.67小时完成训练，在匹配A100上比Fast-WAM快6倍。Copper-Policy在无具身预训练下优于所有对比方法（RoboTwin），并在LIBERO-Plus上超越若干具身预训练VLA（80.85%）。在三个真实机器人任务上，其表现与π_{0.5}相当，平均得分更高。

Conclusion: Copper-Policy将强控制性能与高效训练相结合，证明了无需预定义目标空间、通过策略联合学习紧凑世界表示是可行且有效的方向。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) acquire behavioral priors by modeling future scene evolution, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space incurs substantial cost. Recent evidence that co-training gains persist without test-time generation raises a question: what must a WAM learn to improve control? We introduce Copper-Policy, which learns a compact World representation with the policy rather than relying on a predefined target space. Through temporal joint-embedding prediction, it predicts future observation embeddings conditioned on task intention without reconstructing pixels. This prediction and action decoding shape the representation jointly, while the policy retains access to current-frame spatial detail for execution. Representation analyses show that the learned features better separate task-driven change from perturbations and provide complementary information for control. Compact prediction targets reduce training tokens per sample, enabling a 2B-parameter model trained in 9.67 hours on 8$\times$ RTX 5090 GPUs and 6$\times$ faster than Fast-WAM on matched A100 GPUs. Copper-Policy outperforms every compared method without embodied pretraining on RoboTwin and several embodied-pretrained VLAs on LIBERO-Plus (80.85%). On three challenging real-robot tasks, it performs comparably to $π_{0.5}$ and attains a higher average score. Together, these results show that Copper-Policy combines strong control performance with efficient training.

</details>


### [1943] [CollisionGAT: Controller-Agnostic One-Step Collision Screening for Multi-Agent Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32783)
*Alan Debbas,Edwin Meriaux,Gregory Dudek*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CollisionGAT：一种图注意力网络，为每个移动智能体输出碰撞风险分数，供控制器决定是否接受、修复、重规划或推迟所提议的步；可与路径跟随控制器及 GATeD 规划器集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人团队在移动前，必须对每个提议步进行与其他机器人及障碍物的碰撞检查，需要一种能结合当前与提议状态、且考虑局部静态障碍的碰撞风险评估方法。

Method: 构建 CollisionGAT 图注意力网络，输入为移动智能体的当前状态与提议状态以及局部相关的静态障碍，输出每个移动智能体一个碰撞风险分数；训练标签由精确几何检查生成，执行步亦由几何检查独立审核。将 CollisionGAT 挂载于连续路径跟随控制器和 GATeD（一种使用类型化否决更新规划图的障碍盲 D* Lite 规划器）上。

Result: 可生成每个移动智能体的碰撞风险分数，并据以对提议步进行接受、修复、重规划或推迟；成功集成到连续路径跟随控制器与 GATeD 规划器中，且执行步经受精确几何检查的独立审核。

Conclusion: CollisionGAT 为多机器人运动中的步级碰撞风险评估提供通用评分机制，可直接嵌入不同控制器与规划器，提升碰撞检查的适应性与安全性。

Abstract: Before a team of robots moves, each proposed step must be checked for collisions with other robots and with obstacles. We present CollisionGAT, a graph-attention network that reads the current and proposed states of moving agents together with locally relevant stationary obstacles and returns one collision-risk score per moving agent. Any controller can use these scores to accept, repair, replan, or postpone a proposed step. We mount CollisionGAT on a continuous path-following controller and on GATeD, an obstacle-blind D* Lite planner that uses typed vetoes to update its planning graphs. Exact geometric checks supply the training labels and independently audit every executed step.

</details>


### [1944] [Towards Kinematic Actionable Infeasibility Detection in Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32806)
*Aayush Rath,Lakshya Jindal,Antony Thomas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于几何驱动、分辨率相关的构型空间拓扑分析框架，利用带符号距离场在构型空间中追踪障碍边界诱导的分隔流形，实现高维空间中的不可行性认证，并配合GPU加速的并行前沿扩展算法完成高效单纯复形重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人运动规划不仅需要计算无碰撞路径，还需在不存在路径时认证不可行性。然而完备方法受限于低维空间，采样式规划器虽可高效扩展却无法提供有限时间内的不可行性证书，该问题在高维空间中基本未解决。

Method: 提出几何驱动的不可行性认证框架，对构型空间拓扑进行显式的、与分辨率相关的分析。基于带符号距离场（SDF）表示，直接在构型空间中追踪由障碍边界诱导的分隔流形，从而检测不可行性并识别具体的几何成因；为应对计算挑战，设计了利用GPU加速的并行前沿扩展算法，用于高维空间中的高效单纯复形重建。

Result: 在4-DOF与5-DOF机器人场景中验证：4-DOF情形可在数秒内完成不可行性认证，5-DOF情形在四分钟以内完成；并进一步讨论了向更高维空间提升可扩展性的途径。

Conclusion: 该工作为高维构型空间中的不可行性认证提供了可行路径，兼具不可行性判定与几何成因定位能力，并借助GPU并行化在中等自由度场景下取得秒级至分钟级性能；未来方向是进一步提升向更高维空间的可扩展性。

Abstract: Motion planning in robotics requires not only computing collision-free paths but also certifying infeasibility when no such path exists. Complete methods are limited to low-dimensional spaces, while sampling-based planners scale efficiently but cannot provide finite-time infeasibility certificates, leaving this problem largely unresolved in high-dimensional spaces. In this letter, we present a geometry-driven framework for certifying infeasibility through an explicit resolution-dependent analysis of configuration space topology. Leveraging signed distance field representations, the proposed method traces separating manifolds induced by obstacle boundaries directly in configuration space, enabling both detection of infeasibility and identification of the specific geometric cause. To address computational challenges, we develop a parallel frontier-expansion algorithm that exploits GPU acceleration for efficient simplicial reconstruction in high-dimensional spaces. We validate the approach on 4-DOF and 5-DOF robot scenarios, certifying infeasibility within seconds for 4-DOF cases and under four minutes for 5-DOF cases. We further discuss avenues for improving scalability to higher-dimensional spaces.

</details>


### [1945] [Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32837)
*Xuesong Li,Shuai Chen,Feng Li,Zhongliang Jiang,Nassir Navab,Yuan Bi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SonoGraph-WM：以场景图表征解剖、动作与目标条件化的世界模型，联合预测未来场景图与探头位姿，用于超声探头的前瞻性导航规划，并由CT标签图生成监督数据。四例留出CT上空间关系F1>93%（20步），胆囊/胰腺闭环导航成功率77.50%/75.00%；体模实验中达73.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声采集高度依赖操作者对解剖的理解及对探头运动所致视图变化的预判能力，而现有多数机器人超声导航方法在选择动作时并未显式预测这些解剖层面的变化。同时，带跟踪与解剖标注的真实超声序列数据稀缺，难以直接监督此类预测模型。

Method: 将解剖表示为场景图（SG），编码可见结构、其几何及空间关系，避免合成超声图像。以SG历史与探头位姿为输入，用统一Transformer联合预测未来SG与位姿。采用滚动时域规划器递归"想象"候选轨迹，选取到达目标图的最短预测路径，并在短执行时域内执行后重新规划。训练数据由CT标签图沿表面约束的探头轨迹生成，得到对齐的SG–位姿样本。

Result: 在四例留出CT上，空间关系F1在20个预测步内持续高于93%；使用标注导出的SG时，胆囊与胰腺闭环导航成功率分别为77.50%和75.00%；在机器人–体模实验中，使用标签图导出的SG，规划器在73.7%的试验中到达目标视图。

Conclusion: 结果支持以CT监督的解剖世界建模用于探头规划，并表明频繁的观测更新对可靠导航至关重要；该方法可减少对真实超声跟踪与解剖标注序列的依赖。

Abstract: Ultrasound (US) acquisition depends on the operator's ability to interpret anatomy and anticipate how the view will change with probe motion. Many robotic US navigation methods select actions without explicitly predicting these anatomical changes. We propose SonoGraph-WM, an action- and goal-conditioned world model for anticipatory probe navigation. The model represents anatomy as scene graphs (SGs), capturing visible structures, their geometry, and spatial relationships without synthesizing US images. Given a history of SGs and probe poses, a unified Transformer jointly predicts future SGs and poses. A receding-horizon planner recursively imagines candidate trajectories, selects the shortest predicted path reaching a goal graph, and follows it over a short execution horizon before replanning from new observations.
