To reduce reliance on tracked and anatomically annotated US sequences, we generate aligned SG--pose training data from computed tomography (CT) label maps along surface-constrained probe trajectories. On four held-out CT cases, spatial relation F1 remains above 93% over 20 prediction steps, and closed-loop navigation achieves 77.50% and 75.00% success for the gallbladder and pancreas, respectively, using annotation-derived SGs. In robot--phantom navigation experiments with label-map-derived SGs, the planner reached the target view in 73.7% of trials. These findings support CT-supervised anatomical world modeling for probe planning and highlight the importance of frequent observation updates for reliable navigation. Project Page: https://noseefood.github.io/us-sonograph-wm/

</details>


### [1946] [RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32862)
*Jingsong Liang,Shuhao Liao,Shizhe Zhang,Diyuan Hou,Yuxin Cai,Xinjian Deng,Chengyang He,Wenhui Huang,Runjia Tan,Zhidong Wang,Lan Yu,Xuesong Tian,Guillaume Sartoretti,Jie Luo,Yao Mu,Wenjun Wu,Wanhua Li,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RoboFoundry，首个将支撑系统本身视为统一策略的具身智能体框架，通过"自演化系统即策略"实现系统级自改进，并在多个基准上大幅超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多优化记忆、上下文、技能或动作接口等单个组件，未将支撑系统视为统一策略；且仅靠交互难以实现自改进，需将执行经验转化为持久、经校验的系统变更。

Method: RoboFoundry将过程形式化为自演化系统即策略：诊断决策与记忆管理的能力缺口，将执行轨迹转化为经验证的任务专用系统更新，并将复现性改进提升为通用系统；演化在两个表面进行——管理活跃内部上下文与持久文件系统记忆的上下文系统，以及组织原子技能、可复用组合与失败条件恢复的分层技能系统；共享语义接口分离具身无关决策与具身相关执行。

Result: EmbodiedBench上达到SOTA，GPT-5.5提升27.8%；使Qwen3.7-Plus接近GPT-5.5（70.3% vs 72.7%）；RoboMemArena长时程记忆任务超越所有基线至少39.0%；LIBERO-PRO上所有扰动类型超越Cap-Agent0达243.8%-679.7%；真实部署中展示跨机器人、跨任务的零样本迁移与在线演化。

Conclusion: 系统即策略的演化可跨基础模型带来一致增益，并支持全自主具身智能体的零样本迁移与在线演化，具有较大应用潜力。

Abstract: A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8%-679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.

</details>


### [1947] [Communication-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Decentralized Multi-Human Multi-Robot Task Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32935)
*Ziqin Yuan,Ruiqi Wang,Baijian Yang,Byung-Cheol Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CommHG——一种通信感知的异构图学习框架，用于去中心化多人类-多机器人任务分配，将分配与通信行为通过合作式多智能体强化学习联合优化，并构建了异构团队基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人类-多机器人（MH-MR）团队需协调稀缺且动态可用的人类支持与分布式机器人执行；有限的机器人间、人机通信会延迟信息交换与监督干预，使任务分配与通信的耦合问题更加复杂。

Method: CommHG以局部图建模人-机器人-任务耦合交互，图结构以信息可用性与信息时效（age）为条件；学习通信动作让机器人决定何时、向哪位操作员查询，以及何时与同伴共享信息；将分配与通信通过合作式多智能体强化学习联合优化，以在有限通信与监督资源下获取有用信息。

Result: 构建了包含异构人类与机器人、动态任务与运行状态、受限机器人间链路及双向人机链路的基准；在最多16机器人、6人类、112任务的异构团队实验中，CommHG随协调规模增大提升及时加权任务完成度，在Large场景中优于最强基线。

Conclusion: 通信感知的异构图学习与分配-通信联合优化可有效提升大规模去中心化MH-MR团队的协同任务分配性能。

Abstract: Multi-human multi-robot (MH-MR) teams combine robotic autonomy with human expertise, but effective task allocation requires coordinating scarce, dynamically available human support with distributed robot execution. Limited robot-robot and human-robot communication further complicates this coupling by delaying information exchange and supervisory intervention. We introduce CommHG, a communication-aware heterogeneous graph learning framework for decentralized MH-MR task allocation. CommHG represents coupled human-robot-task interactions through local graphs conditioned on information availability and age. Learned communication actions enable robots to decide when and which operator to query, and when to share information with peers. Allocation and communication are jointly optimized through cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, allowing the team to acquire useful information while managing limited communication and supervisory resources. We also introduce a benchmark integrating heterogeneous humans and robots, dynamic tasks and operational states, and constrained robot-robot and bidirectional human-robot links. Experiments across heterogeneous teams with up to 16 robots, 6 humans, and 112 tasks show that CommHG improves timely weighted mission completion as coordination scale increases, outperforming the strongest baseline in the Large scenario.

</details>


### [1948] [Learning Geometry-Aware Virtual Fixtures From Sparse Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32958)
*Maximilian Mühlbauer,Marcella Piacentino,Raffaella Mancino,Paolino De Risi,Bernhard Weber,Margarida Campos,Thomas Hulin,Sylvain Calinon,Freek Stulp,Alin Albu-Schäffer,Julian Klodmann,Fanny Ficuciello,João Silvério*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用运动先验与黎曼流形上的线性二次跟踪（LQT）方法，使用户仅需少量via点即可生成虚拟夹具轨迹，并通过协方差估计调节刚度与有效性区域，在dVRK微创手术切割任务中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统概率性从示范学习（LfD）需要大量示范数据，在遥操作应用中往往难以获取。为让操作者仍能直观地创建虚拟夹具（VF）轨迹，需要借助运动先验来减少对示范数量的依赖。

Method: 采用线性二次跟踪（LQT），使用户仅凭少量via点即可定义引导轨迹；为处理姿态引导，将经典LQT重新表述于黎曼流形上并引入额外几何先验；对LQT解进行概率解释，在每个轨迹点导出协方差估计，用以调节夹具刚度，并定义夹具的有效性区域。

Result: 在玩具示例中评估了所提出的黎曼LQT表述，并在da Vinci研究套件（dVRK）上针对需要高精度的微创手术切割任务验证了整个框架；协方差调制实现了via点附近强引导、远离时软引导，且有效性区域允许操作者离开影响区执行未建模任务。

Conclusion: 少样本示范结合运动先验与黎曼LQT可有效构建具有刚度调制和有效性区域的虚拟夹具，框架在微创手术切割任务中具备可行性与实用性。

Abstract: In many teleoperation applications, collecting a large number of demonstrations as required for traditional probabilistic learning from demonstration (LfD) approaches may not be feasible. To still give operators the ability to intuitively create trajectories as Virtual Fixtures (VFs), we propose to leverage a motion prior in the learning process. Particularly, by using Linear Quadratic Tracking (LQT), users are able to define guiding trajectories from the demonstration of just a few via points. To account for orientation guidance, we further reformulate classical LQT on Riemannian manifolds, introducing an additional geometric prior. Through a probabilistic interpretation of the LQT solution, we derive a covariance estimate at each trajectory point which we use to modulate the stiffness of the resulting fixture, resulting in strong guidance around the via points and softer guidance when far away. The covariance information is also used to define a validity region of the fixture, allowing the operator to leave its influence area and conduct unmodeled tasks. We evaluate the proposed Riemannian LQT formulation in a set of toy examples and the full framework on a cutting task requiring high precision in a minimally invasive surgery setting on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK).

</details>


### [1949] [CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33007)
*Shivam Aarya,Zhang Xi-Jia,Chengyue Huang,Junhyun Kim,Huishu Xue,Hrishit Leen,Roman Yakunin,Animesh Garg,Zsolt Kira*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CAPEX框架，用基础模型作为自主演示者，通过执行经验自适应调整模型调用频率来收集机器人演示数据，成功演示数提升4.3倍，单条成功演示成本降低80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习依赖人类遥操作演示，但该过程不直观、难以规模化且本质异步。虽然通用多模态基础模型能生成零样本操作轨迹，但在物理执行中反复调用它们速度慢、成本高，限制了其作为可扩展数据生成器的实用性。

Method: 提出CAPEX（经验条件化演示收集框架）：利用先前尝试的执行经验，自适应调整基础模型必须进行观察、推理和重规划的频率，从而减少调用次数与成本。在RoboCasa任务以及实物Franka和双臂YAM平台评估，测量任务成功率、模型调用次数、token用量、收集时间和成本；并用匹配的人类遥操作演示与基础模型生成演示分别训练Diffusion Policy和ACT进行对比。

Result: CAPEX将成功演示数量提升4.3倍，每条成功演示成本降低80%。基于CAPEX生成数据训练的策略接近匹配人类演示训练的策略性能；延长训练后，从头训练的策略差距基本消失。

Conclusion: 基础模型可作为可扩展、可复用的机器人经验来源，CAPEX为自主演示收集提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: https://capex-paper.github.io/

</details>


### [1950] [Is Online Interaction Necessary for Recovery? A Minimalist Approach to Robust Planning via Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33049)
*Bumgeun Park,Donghwan Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出PARS（扰动增强恢复监督），一种仅用现有示范数据即可提升动作序列策略闭环鲁棒性的训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆在闭环执行中易受协变量偏移影响，微小预测或执行误差会使机器人进入示范数据覆盖不足的状态。现有方法多依赖额外采集纠正示范，需要额外环境交互或专家/参考策略。

Method: PARS扰动机器人本体感知状态，仅将预测轨迹的后段锚定到原始示范，让前段自由生成纠正动作，从而在规划视界内恢复至示范行为。不同于保留整个预测视界监督目标的常规输入噪声增强，PARS提供轨迹级恢复监督。无需额外环境交互或专家查询，仅需对BC目标稍作修改即可适配不同动作序列策略类别。

Result: 在51个RLBench操作任务上，基于流模型、Transformer和扩散策略的实验表明，PARS提升了闭环执行中对协变量偏移的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: PARS是一种简单、数据高效且通用性强的训练方法，可在不增加交互和专家成本的前提下增强动作序列策略的闭环恢复能力。

Abstract: Behavior cloning (BC) is vulnerable to covariate shift during closed-loop execution, where small prediction or execution errors can drive the robot toward states poorly covered by the demonstration data. We focus on action-sequence planning, where a policy predicts a finite-horizon sequence of actions as a reference trajectory for robot execution. Existing approaches to covariate shift often rely on collecting additional corrective demonstrations, requiring further environment interaction and access to an expert or reference policy. We propose Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision (PARS), a simple training approach for improving recovery using only existing demonstrations. PARS perturbs the robot's proprioceptive state and anchors only the later portion of the predicted trajectory to the original demonstration, leaving the earlier portion free to generate corrective motion and recover toward the demonstrated behavior within the planning horizon. Unlike conventional input-noise augmentation, which preserves the original supervision target over the entire prediction horizon, PARS explicitly provides trajectory-level supervision for recovery from perturbed states. PARS requires neither additional environment interaction nor expert queries and can be instantiated across different action-sequence policy classes with only minor modifications to their BC objectives. Experiments on 51 RLBench manipulation tasks with flow-based, transformer-based, and diffusion-based policies demonstrate that PARS improves robustness to covariate shift during closed-loop execution.

</details>


### [1951] [SwingRL: Adaptive Observation Reinforcement Learning with World-Model Prediction for Cable-Suspended Hoisting Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33053)
*Guangming Wang,Xiaoyu Zhang,Yucheng Xin,Wanli Ma,Jiucai Liu,Yunxiang Ma,Joe Ingham,Haibing Wu,Yixiong Jing,Olaf Wysocki,Brian Sheil*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SwingRL，一种残差强化学习框架，结合年龄感知世界模型、经典抗摆先验与循环残差策略，解决吊装插入任务中反馈陈旧与动力学不确定问题，仿真最难关卡成功率达 69.5%（严格）/77.3%（宽松），实物平台无需微调达 90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缆索吊装广泛用于刚体抓取系统难以处理的沉重/笨重载荷（如吊车辅助施工）。但机器人柔性缆索吊装存在三大难题：载荷运动欠驱动、外部扰动多变、视觉观测延迟或丢失导致感知状态在执行时已过时。这些问题在将悬挂载荷的插孔精确套入钢筋销钉（施工中常见任务）时尤为关键。

Method: SwingRL 为残差 RL 框架，包含三个组件：(1) 年龄感知世界模型——利用已执行指令将最新接收的载荷观测传播至当前控制步，在延迟与丢失传感下提供时间对齐的状态估计；(2) 经典抗摆先验——提供标称跟踪与摆动阻尼；(3) 循环残差策略——只学习对先验的有界修正而非完整控制律，以补偿系统参数变化、外部扰动与残余状态估计误差。

Result: 在覆盖系统参数变化、风扰、传感退化与强阵风的累积难度阶梯上，与经典及学习型基线对比：最困难设置下 SwingRL 取得 69.5% 严格成功与 77.3% 宽松成功，分别超越所有基线至少 60 个百分点。世界模型消融实验支持时间对齐状态估计在观测丢失增加时维持插入成功率的作用。最终无需真实机器人微调，SwingRL 在实物平台上达到 90% 成功率。

Conclusion: 结合年龄感知世界模型、抗摆先验与残差策略能有效应对延迟/丢失感知与不确定动力学，显著优于基线，并具备良好的仿真到实物迁移能力（零样本部署达 90% 成功）。

Abstract: Cable-suspended hoisting is widely used to move heavy or bulky payloads that cannot be handled conveniently by rigid pick-and-place systems, for example in crane-assisted construction. Robotic hoisting using flexible cables is challenging because payload motion is underactuated, external disturbances vary, and delayed or lost visual observations can make the perceived payload state stale at control execution. These effects are particularly critical during precise insertion of a suspended payload's sockets onto rebar pins, which is a very common task in construction environments. We present SwingRL, a residual reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that combines an age-aware world model, a classical anti-swing prior, and a recurrent residual policy to address two coupled problems: stale feedback and uncertain dynamics. The world model propagates the newest received payload observation to the current control step using the executed commands, providing a time-aligned state estimate under delayed and lossy sensing. The prior supplies nominal tracking and swing damping. The residual policy learns bounded corrections to the prior rather than the complete control law, compensating for system-parameter variation, external disturbances, and remaining state-estimation errors. We evaluate SwingRL against classical and learning-based baselines across a cumulative difficulty ladder covering system-parameter variation, wind disturbance, degraded sensing, and strong gusts. Under the most difficult setting, SwingRL achieves 69.5% strict and 77.3% broad success, exceeding all baselines by at least 60 percentage points, respectively. World-model ablations support the role of time-aligned state estimation in maintaining insertion success as observation loss increases. Finally, without real-robot fine-tuning, SwingRL achieves 90% success on the physical rig.

</details>


### [1952] [REALM: A Coarse-to-Fine Generative Framework for Embodied Reactive Listening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33095)
*Peizhen Li,Longbing Cao,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出REALM，一种由粗到细的音频驱动反应式聆听人脸运动生成框架，通过历史感知的时间对齐与随机表情细化来应对延迟响应和局部可变事件两大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成具身对话AI中聆听者的反应性面部运动存在两个建模难点：一是需兼顾说话人线索的时间延迟与聆听者自身运动的连续性；二是需同时刻画局部可变的面部事件（如短暂表情、眨眼）与整体运动轨迹。聆听者反应相对线索存在时间滞后，且短时表情与眨眼难以确定性预测。

Method: REALM采用由粗到细框架：以Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion模块，通过延迟中心注意力先验与自适应门控融合聆听者运动历史和说话人音频；粗解码器预测基础运动轨迹，再由音频条件化的随机残差在表情子空间中细化，同时保留粗姿态参数。

Result: 在ViCo与L2L数据集上，多个运动质量指标优于所评估的基线；附加分析考察了延迟敏感性、门控行为与眨眼动态；并在Ameca人形机器人上部署并通过感知用户研究验证了生成行为在物理具身上的适用性。

Conclusion: REALM通过结合历史感知的时间对齐与随机表情细化，有效生成连贯且富有局部变化的聆听者反应性面部运动，并具备向实体机器人迁移的可行性。

Abstract: Generating responsive listener facial motion is an important task for embodied conversational AI. Two modeling challenges are central: accounting for the timing of speaker cues while maintaining continuity with the listener's ongoing motion, and capturing locally variable facial events alongside the overall motion trajectory. Listener responses may follow preceding cues with a temporal lag, while brief expressions and blinks introduce variation that is difficult to predict deterministically. These challenges motivate a framework that combines history-aware temporal alignment with stochastic expression refinement. We propose REALM (Reactive Embodied Audio-driven Listening Model), a coarse-to-fine framework for audio-driven reactive listening. A Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion module combines listener motion history with speaker audio through a delay-centered attention prior and adaptive gating. A coarse decoder predicts a base motion trajectory, which is augmented by audio-conditioned stochastic residuals in the expression subspace while retaining the coarse pose parameters. Evaluations on ViCo and L2L show improvements over the evaluated baselines across multiple motion-quality metrics. Additional analyses examine delay sensitivity, gate behavior, and blink dynamics. Finally, deployment on an Ameca humanoid robot and a perceptual user study demonstrate the applicability of the generated behavior to physical embodiment.
  Code: https://github.com/lipzh5/REALM Demo: https://youtu.be/Tf5mpd5S8VQ

</details>


### [1953] [Humanoids for Robot-Assisted Surgery: Bimanual Base Placement and Tool-Mount Optimization via Capability Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33096)
*Peihan Zhang,Zekai Liang,Florian Richter,Nikita Thareja,Ryan Broderick,Shanglei Liu,Michael Yip*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于能力地图的人形机器人配置优化框架，联合优化基座摆放与器械安装朝向，在考虑器械尖端运动学和远程运动中心（RCM）约束下最大化双臂可达性，并据此量化评估三款人形机器人对三类腹腔镜手术的空间可达性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在医疗与临床任务中的应用兴趣日益增长，但当代人形机器人能否满足机器人辅助腹腔镜手术的运动学需求尚不明确，尤其是机器人最优摆放与配置问题缺乏定量分析。

Method: 构建基于能力地图（capability map）的机器人配置框架，对基座位置与器械安装朝向进行联合优化，以在计入器械尖端运动学与RCM约束的前提下最大化双臂可达性；选取三款具有不同体型与运动学冗余度的人形平台，针对胆囊切除、腹股沟疝修补、袖状胃切除三种代表性普外科手术评估工作空间可达性，并与仅优化基座及启发式基线对比。

Result: 基座与器械安装的联合优化一致优于仅基座优化和启发式基线；在胆囊切除和腹股沟疝修补这类工作空间较小且重叠较少的手术中，人形可达性接近90%；而在袖状胃切除这种更大且多孔臂工作空间相互重叠的场景下，覆盖率显著降低。

Conclusion: 研究定量刻画了人形机器人在部分腹腔镜手术中的近期应用潜力，同时明确了其走向更广泛部署前必须解决的关键局限。

Abstract: Rapid advances in humanoid robotics have motivated growing interest in the application of humanoids for healthcare and clinical tasks. However, it remains unclear how close contemporary humanoids are to meeting the kinematic demands of robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery. In this work, we address the question of optimal robot positioning through a quantitative analysis of workspace and robot setup configurations. We present a capability-map-based robot setup framework that optimizes humanoid base placement and tool mounting orientation to maximize bimanual humanoid reachability while accounting for tool-tip kinematics and remote-center-of-motion (RCM) constraints. We evaluate three humanoid platforms spanning different body dimensions and kinematic redundancy on workspace reachability for three representative general surgery procedures: cholecystectomy, inguinal hernia repair, and sleeve gastrectomy. The proposed joint optimization of base placement and tool mounting consistently outperforms base-only optimization and heuristic baselines. For cholecystectomy and inguinal hernia repair, which are characterized by relatively small and minimally overlapping workspaces, humanoid reachability approached 90%. For the larger, overlapping multi-port arm workspace of sleeve gastrectomy, humanoids yield substantially lower coverage. These results quantify the near-term promise of humanoids for selected laparoscopic procedures and clarify key limitations that must be addressed for broader deployment.

</details>


### [1954] [Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33101)
*Zihan Guo,Shuzhe Zhang,Muhan Li,Peiyang Li,Sam Kriegman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出无预设结构的自由形态机器人演化框架，结合对比学习、自回归发育模型、演化策略与强化学习，自动设计并零样本制造出可灵巧抓取与操作多样物体的机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前对如何人工设计灵巧操作机器人仍知之甚少；从动物操作行为中归纳的设计原则难以被仿生复现，且未必适合人工机器。作者希望摆脱对部件存在性、关节或几何的预设，直接演化自由形态机器人来完成抓取、保持、旋转与使用物体的任务。

Method: 不给身体任何部分预设存在性、关节或几何；使用对比学习构建高可搜索性的设计空间遗传嵌入，用自回归发育模型解码设计，用演化策略搜索优质设计，再用强化学习训练每个演化出的设计；获胜设计自动转换为可制造蓝图并打印、装配、在真实世界零样本测试。

Result: 在性能、多样性和复杂性方面达到演化机器人学的最先进水平；熟悉的前抓握形态（如尾、喙、爪、掌）可在特定条件下自发涌现，同时也发现被忽视或未知的新结构方案。

Conclusion: 去新（de novo）操作器设计既能复现仿生形态，也能揭示更适合具体任务的新结构；所提演化+学习+制造流程可实现零样本真实世界部署，并推动演化机器人学的性能、多样性与复杂性。

Abstract: Little is known about how to manually design agents capable of dexterous manipulation. Some design principles have been inferred from close examination of how animals manipulate objects, but these structures and behaviors have so far resisted biomimicry and may not be optimal for artificial machines. Here we evolve freeform robots to pick up, hold, rotate, and use diverse objects. Unlike other approaches to optimizing robot hands, we do not presuppose the presence, articulation, or geometry of any part of the body. Although familiar prehensile forms such as tails, beaks, paws and claws may emerge spontaneously under certain conditions--and while such conditions could be of interest to evolutionary biologists--de novo manipulator design can also reveal whole new solutions, overlooked or unknown structures which may be better suited for the task at hand. We use contrastive learning to create a highly searchable genetic embedding of design space, an autoregressive developmental model to decode designs, evolutionary strategies to find good designs, and reinforcement learning to train each evolved design. Winning designs were automatically converted into a manufacturable blueprint, printed, assembled and tested in the real world in a zero-shot manner. The results represent the state-of-the-art in evolutionary robotics in terms of performance, diversity and complexity.

</details>


### [1955] [VPTwin: Real-Sim-Real Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33104)
*Zhenghao Xiao,Minting Pan,Nantian He,Dongzhan Zhou,Yunbo Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VPTwin，一种Real-Sim-Real视频预测框架，用真实同步的仿真孪生锚定真实世界未来预测，缓解长时程预测中的累积误差与物理幻觉，并构建预测式规划闭环提升操作任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的动作条件视频预测器在长时程推演中易出现累积误差与违反物理规律的幻觉，严重削弱下游动作规划可靠性；同时未观测物理属性难以直接估计，需要借助仿真先验来约束预测。

Method: 针对目标任务，用VLM从真实演示片段重建可执行数字孪生；为应对未观测物理属性的病态估计问题，在Isaac Sim中对候选动作轨迹在随机化物理配置下进行多组前向动力学推演；以这些推演作为上下文参考，协调真实与仿真两个域，用仿真动力学保证物理合理性，同时从真实视频中捕捉未建模的接触交互；并建立基于VPTwin的预测式规划闭环，对VLM提出的动作进行视觉校验并指导真实执行。

Result: 评估显示视频预测中的物理幻觉显著减少，操作规划性能明显提升。

Conclusion: VPTwin通过真实-仿真-真实的视频预测范式，将仿真动力学与真实观测视频互补结合，可作为可靠的世界模型服务于机器人操作规划。

Abstract: While action-conditioned video prediction provides an intuitive world model for robotics, purely data-driven predictors often suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon rollouts, severely undermining downstream action planning. We propose VPTwin, a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework that anchors real-world future prediction using real-synchronized simulation twins. For a target manipulation task, a VLM reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration episode. To accommodate the ill-posed estimation of unobserved physical properties, Isaac Sim simulates multiple forward dynamic rollouts across randomized physical configurations under candidate action trajectories. Using these rollouts as in-context references, VPTwin harmonizes both domains, using simulation dynamics to enforce physical plausibility while capturing unmodeled contact interactions from real video. Furthermore, we establish a predictive planning loop using VPTwin to visually verify VLM-proposed actions and guide reliable real-world execution. Evaluations show substantial reductions in physical hallucinations during video prediction and marked improvements in manipulation planning performance.

</details>


### [1956] [Multi-Modal Non-Prehensile Estimation of Physical Parameters via Press-and-Pull Tipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33138)
*Steven M. Hyland,Jing Xiao,Cagdas D. Onal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出多模态非抓取交互估计框架，结合滑动与"按压-拉动"翻转动作，无需几何模型即可估计质量、质心高度与摩擦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一非抓取操作无法揭示全部物理参数：平面推动使质量与摩擦耦合，传统翻转无法恢复摩擦且在低摩擦或曲底物体上因滑动/旋转而失败。

Method: 将滑动交互与"按压-拉动"翻转原语相结合；按压-拉动提高物体-桌面滑动阈值并稳定支点，实现可控翻转；融合腕部力/力矩传感、RGB-D感知与机器人本体感知，从两种互补交互模式估计参数。

Result: 在ABB IRB120上对四种几何、质量、质心和摩擦各异的物体实验，相对误差低，并能成功处理在传统前向翻转下失败的曲底物体。

Conclusion: 互补的非抓取交互可在不抓取、无先验物体模型、不依赖学习交互动力学的情况下恢复一组紧凑的物理参数。

Abstract: Recovering physical properties of unknown objects through non-prehensile interaction is challenging because no single manipulation primitive reveals all relevant parameters. Planar pushing couples mass and friction, while conventional tipping cannot recover friction and may fail entirely when low-friction or curved-base objects slide or rotate instead of tipping. We introduce a multi-modal estimation framework that combines a sliding interaction with a press-and-pull tipping primitive to recover object mass, center of mass height, and surface friction. The press-and-pull interaction increases the object-table sliding threshold and stabilizes the pivot, enabling controlled tipping without any prior geometric object model. Wrist force/torque sensing, RGB-D perception, and robot proprioception are fused to estimate the physical parameters from the two complementary interaction modes. Experiments on an ABB IRB120 across four objects with varied geometry, mass, center of mass, and friction achieve low relative error, while successfully operating on curved-base objects that fail under conventional forward tipping. The results demonstrate that complementary non-prehensile interactions can recover a compact set of physical parameters without grasping, a prior object model, or learned interaction dynamics.

</details>


### [1957] [Beyond State-as-Action: Exploiting Command-State Discrepancy for Robot Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33145)
*Peiyan Li,Yueran Tao,Enhao Zhang,Zhixuan Zhao,Chenghao Yue,Hao Wang,Lei Lv,Wentao Zhao,Jiahao Chen,Xin Liu,Kangyao Huang,Yu Luo,Huaping Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究模仿学习中交互约束下"命令-状态差异"（command-state discrepancy）所携带的控制需求信息，提出 Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW) 对命令监督进行连续加权，在三个真实机器人任务上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于实测机器人运动构建动作目标是模仿学习的成熟做法，但在交互约束场景下，命令与状态之间的差异可能反映运动本身无法捕捉的控制需求。作者希望厘清这种信息何时重要、以及如何加以利用。

Method: 首先通过任务级与阶段级分析，考察约束交互下监督差距是否更大，并通过选择性保留命令验证局部命令信息的价值。在此基础上提出 CSDW：考虑机器人响应时间，将后续进展、持续未满足需求与需求变化综合为连续权重，用于命令监督。该方法无需任务阶段标注，也不改变策略架构或推理过程。

Result: 在三个真实机器人任务中，约束交互场景下监督差距更大；选择性命令保留提供了局部有效命令信息的证据；CSDW 在受约束任务上优于均匀命令监督，而在约束较弱任务上两类方法表现相近。

Conclusion: 命令-状态差异在交互约束下包含运动之外的额外监督信号，CSDW 能有效提取并利用该信息，且实现开销低、易集成，为约束场景下的模仿学习提供了新思路。

Abstract: Constructing action targets from measured robot motion is an established approach in imitation learning. Under interaction constraints, however, command-state discrepancy may reflect control demands that motion alone does not capture. We investigate when this information matters and how to exploit it. Across three real-robot tasks, task and phase analyses reveal larger supervision gaps under constrained interaction, while selective command retention provides evidence of locally useful command information. Building on these findings, we propose Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW), which accounts for robot response times and combines subsequent progress, persistent unmet demand, and demand changes into continuous weights for command supervision. The method requires no task-phase annotations or changes to policy architecture or inference. CSDW improves over uniform command supervision on constrained tasks, while methods perform similarly in the less constrained task.

</details>


### [1958] [TimelyDAgger: Timing-Aware Expert Querying for VLA Policy Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33157)
*Zhixuan Zhao,Peiyan Li,Enhao Zhang,Yueran Tao,Hao Wang,Chenghao Yue,Lei Lv,Wentao Zhao,Jiahao Chen,Xin Liu,Kangyao Huang,Yu Luo,Huaping Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TimelyDAgger通过Bridge-PCA监控VLA内部特征并结合反馈引导阈值自适应改进机器人门控DAgger的接管时机，在保持竞争性故障检测的同时提升了训练后策略成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人门控DAgger主要关注"是否需要帮助"的检测，而忽略了接管时机对专家演示内容质量及策略学习价值的影响。

Method: 提出TimelyDAgger：用Bridge-PCA监控视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的内部特征，并基于专家行为进行反馈引导的阈值自适应，以优化接管时机；同时构建连接故障检测、接管时机与策略改进的评估框架，并提出目标对齐监督比(TASR)用于免重训练评估监督质量。

Result: 实验表明接管时机确实影响策略学习；在匹配专家动作预算的多数评估设置下，TimelyDAgger实现了具竞争力的故障检测性能与更高的训练后成功率。

Conclusion: 接管时机是机器人门控DAgger中影响监督质量的关键因素，TimelyDAgger通过监控内部特征与自适应阈值有效改善了时机选择与策略学习效果。

Abstract: DAgger improves robot policies by aggregating expert supervision from states visited during policy execution. Robot-gated DAgger automates expert queries, allowing the robot to decide when to request expert takeover. While existing gates emphasize detecting the need for assistance, takeover timing also shapes the content of these demonstrations and their value for policy learning. We propose TimelyDAgger, combining Bridge-PCA monitoring of internal vision-language-action (VLA) features with Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation based on expert behavior to improve takeover timing. We introduce an evaluation framework linking failure detection, takeover timing, and policy improvement, including Target-Aligned Supervision Ratio (TASR) for assessing supervision quality without retraining. Experiments show that takeover timing affects policy learning, with TimelyDAgger achieving competitive failure detection and higher post-training success in most evaluated settings under matched expert-action budgets.

</details>


### [1959] [Beyond Tasks: A Vision for Reproducing an Animal-like Behavioral Substrate Using Modern Robot Learning Techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33165)
*Samiyuru Menik,Hemadri Jayalath*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出"行为学行为基底"概念，主张将动物持续协调多种行为的能力视为机器人学习的重要研究目标，并以机器人动物伴侣作为研究持续交互与适应的理想场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习虽已产生能力日益增强的具身智能体，但对一种更基础的能力关注不足：当物理、环境与社会需求随时间变化时，智能体仍能保持情境化、响应性与行为连贯性。当前研究多将动物行为视为孤立技能的集合，忽略了其在竞争性需求下持续协调的本质。

Method: 概念性/立场性研究：提出"行为学行为基底"（ethological behavioral substrate）作为分析视角，用以研究人工智能体的这一能力；并提议以机器人动物伴侣（robotic animal companions）作为研究在以人为本环境中持续交互与适应的实验场景。

Result: 论文属于观点性工作，未报告实验数据或定量结果。其贡献在于提出研究框架与场景设定，指出该场景可用于探究社会行为、记忆与持续学习在长期交互中如何发展。

Conclusion: 持续的行为能力（persistent behavioral competence）可对具身智能体的高层能力形成补充，值得进一步研究；该视角为现代机器人学习开辟了欠探索的重要方向。

Abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have produced increasingly capable embodied agents. Yet comparatively less attention has been given to a more basic form of competence that animals exhibit continuously: the ability to remain situated, responsive, and behaviorally coherent as physical, environmental, and social demands change over time. We propose the ethological behavioral substrate as a conceptual lens for studying this form of competence in artificial agents. Rather than treating these behaviors that animals exhibit as a set of isolated skills, we argue that their continual coordination under competing demands constitutes an important and underexplored target for modern robot learning. We further propose robotic animal companions as a useful research setting for studying sustained interaction and adaptation in human-centered environments. Such systems provide an opportunity to investigate how social behavior, memory, and continual learning develop over long periods of interaction. This perspective motivates further investigation of how such persistent behavioral competence may complement higher-level capabilities in embodied agents.

</details>


### [1960] [Multi-Terrain Mastery: A Comprehensive Controller for Bipedal Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33174)
*Oluwami Dosunmu-Ogunbi,Aayushi Shrivastava*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究提出一个面向双足机器人的多地形控制器，在20自由度Cassie机器人上验证，可应对陡峭湿滑起伏草地、沙地、砾石、岩石等柔性地形以及楼梯等受限地形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统双足运动控制器通常在特定地表表现良好，但难以跨越多变环境，限制了实际应用。现实环境不可预测，理想方案是用单一控制器覆盖多种地形，从而免去为每种地形配置专门控制器。

Method: 在既往基于支撑踝关节电机实现斜坡与粗糙地面稳定的工作基础上，扩展控制能力至陡峭湿滑不平草地及柔性地形（沙、砾石、岩石）和受限地形（楼梯）。为此引入新的碰撞映射（impact map），以维持性能与对未见过地形的鲁棒性，并详细讨论面向机器人实时部署的控制结构。

Result: 控制器在20自由度Cassie双足机器人上完成验证。

Conclusion: 所提多地形控制器提升了双足运动的通用性与鲁棒性，单一控制器即可覆盖草地、柔性地面与楼梯等多种地形，具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Advancing bipedal robots to navigate diverse terrains remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional locomotion controllers excel on specific surfaces but struggle across varied environments, limiting their practical applications. Given the unpredictable nature of real-world environments, a single controller capable of handling multiple terrains is ideal, eliminating the need for multiple specialized controllers. We propose a multi-terrain controller to enhance the versatility and robustness of bipedal locomotion. Building on previous work with a stance ankle motor for stability on inclined and rough surfaces, this paper extends capabilities to steep wet uneven grassy slopes, and compliant terrains such as sand, gravel, rocks, and constrained terrains like staircases. To address the unique demands of these terrains, we introduce a new impact map that is essential for maintaining performance and robustness against unseen terrains. We also discuss in detail the control structure for real-time deployment on the robot. We validate our controller on the 20 degree-of-freedom Cassie bipedal robot.

</details>


### [1961] [TAO-DA: Towards Autonomous Operation--A Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33197)
*Yongsheng Zhao,Han Gao,Baoping Cheng,Jingyao Tang,Dian Zhou,Deng Liang,Ji Ge,Xuanzhang Wen,Lei Zhao,Ye Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出对称双臂专家(DAE)架构，基于共享VLM骨干与解耦的臂专属专家塔，配合两阶段双臂意图路由与轻量任务进度预测模块，缓解双臂交叉干扰并支持协同调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏显式机制解耦双臂的状态与意图，导致非预期的跨臂干扰，降低任务执行成功率。

Method: 在共享VLM骨干上构建对称双臂专家(DAE)架构，采用解耦的臂专属专家塔；通过两阶段双臂意图路由选择专家：第一阶段由显式语言指令路由，第二阶段由隐式视觉语义路由；并引入轻量任务进度预测模块，利用pre-chunk时序特征与本体感知、视觉观测的语义表示之间的交叉注意力，逐帧估计任务完成进度。

Result: 实验验证了模型在双臂意图路由与跨臂干扰解耦上的有效性；初步证据表明单臂到双臂（及反向）任务存在涌现式技能泛化，并出现跨臂运动域技能迁移。

Conclusion: 任务进度预测模块支持任务进度同步，从而实现多机器人协作任务的协同调度；DAE架构为双臂操作提供统一且解耦的VLA解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for grounding high-level semantic information into low-level robot actions, enabling scalable robotic manipulation across diverse tasks. However, existing VLA models lack explicit mechanisms to disentangle the states and intents of the two arms, leading to unintended cross-arm interference that degrades task execution success. To address this issue, we propose a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert (DAE) architecture built upon a shared Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with decoupled, arm-specific expert towers. Expert selection is carried out through a two-stage dual-arm intent routing scheme, in which experts are routed either by explicit language instructions in the first stage or by implicit visual semantics in the second stage. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight task progress prediction module that leverages cross-attention between the pre-chunk temporal features and semantic representations of proprioceptive and visual observations to accurately estimate frame-wise task completion progress. This module facilitates task progress synchronization to support coordinated scheduling for collaborative multi-robot tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model in dual-arm intent routing and the disentanglement of cross-arm interference, and further provide preliminary evidence of emergent skill generalization from single- to dual-arm tasks (as well as the reverse), together with cross-arm motion-domain skill transfer.

</details>


### [1962] [Learning with Object-centric Representations of Tactile Interactive Perception for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33235)
*Xinyi Yang,Zilin Si,Zhuowei Xu,Zeynep Temel,Oliver Kroemer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种以物体为中心、上下文感知的操作框架，通过触觉探索学习任务无关的物体表征并用于指导操作策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料、容器内容物、软硬度等隐式物体属性难以从视觉直接推断，需借助触觉感知与探索性交互获取；但触觉信号瞬态且稀疏，提取有效触觉事件并融入机器人操作仍是挑战。

Method: 框架通过触觉探索学习任务无关的物体表征：token learner 自主从长时程探索中选取代表性触觉片段；与描述性文本嵌入做对比对齐，构建能捕捉多种物理属性的潜空间；再将所学表征作为语义上下文，指导以物体为中心的操作策略并依据物体属性自适应调整。

Result: 表征在已知与未知物体上的属性估计准确率分别达93%和84%。在多物体重排、倒液、开箱三个视觉歧义任务上，相比无物体上下文条件的基线策略，任务成功率（全部试验汇总）从41%提升至92%（已知物体）、从19%提升至67%（未知物体）。

Conclusion: 触觉驱动的、任务无关的物体表征可作为语义上下文，有效提升视觉歧义场景下目标选择与属性相关操作自适应性，并在已知与未知物体上均取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Implicit object properties that are difficult to directly infer from vision, such as material, container contents, or softness, can be revealed through tactile sensing and exploratory interactions. However, because tactile signals are transient and sparse, extracting informative tactile events and effectively incorporating them into robotic manipulation remains a challenge. In this work, we present an object-centric context-aware manipulation framework that learns task-agnostic object representations through tactile exploration. A token learner autonomously selects representative tactile segments from long-horizon exploration, while contrastive alignment with descriptive text embeddings enables a latent space that captures multiple physical object properties. These learned representations are then used as semantic context to guide object-centric manipulation policies and adapt strategies based on object properties. Experiments show that the learned representations achieve 93% and 84% property estimation accuracy on seen and unseen objects. Evaluated on three tasks involving visually ambiguous objects, i.e. multi-object rearrangement, pouring, and box opening, the proposed framework improves both target selection and property-dependent manipulation adaptation, raising task success, aggregated over all evaluation trials, from 41% to 92% on seen objects and from 19% to 67% on unseen objects over baseline policies without object-context conditioning. Videos and additional results are available at https://xinyiyxyx.github.io/tactile-object-centric/.

</details>


### [1963] [SurgFlow: 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow for Surgical Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33237)
*Changwei Chen,Xiao Liang,Yinuo Yang,Nicole Shen,Peihan Zhang,Sara Wickenhiser,Zekai Liang,Soofiyan Atar,Michael Yip*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SurgFlow 从立体手术视频中学习 3D 物体中心接触流，无需动作标签，实现自主手术行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配对的视频-动作演示数据稀缺（机器人仅完成约 1% 手术），而纯视频数据丰富。3D 物体流虽与具体本体无关、可利用视频数据，但仅指定物体如何移动，未指定工具应在何处、何时接触物体，这一区别在手术中尤为关键。

Method: 提出 SurgFlow，从立体手术视频中学习 3D 物体中心接触流。对每个物体点预测未来 3D 轨迹与接触分数；通过 3D 跟踪与工具-物体邻近度提取监督目标；训练流匹配生成器进行预测；利用预测接触触发抓取与释放，并从流优化末端执行器运动。

Result: 在 dVRK 上，SurgFlow 在组织牵拉、双臂暴露、拾针与传递等任务中，39 次阶段评估成功 37 次，优于使用同等数据、含或不含动作标签的基线。零样本迁移至人形腹腔镜机器人，在相似与新颖相机视角下平均成功率分别为 85% 与 70%。

Conclusion: SurgFlow 证明可从无动作标签的立体手术视频中学习物体中心接触流，统一建模轨迹与接触时序，实现跨平台零样本泛化，为视频驱动的手术自主提供可行路径。

Abstract: Paired video-action demonstrations enable autonomous surgical behavior, but such data is scarce: robots perform roughly 1% of surgeries, while video-only data is abundant. Learning 3D object flow offers an embodiment-agnostic way to utilize video data, but flow alone specifies how an object should move, not where and when the tool should engage it, a distinction that is critical in surgery. We introduce SurgFlow, a framework that learns 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow from stereo surgical video without action labels. For each object point, it predicts a future 3D trajectory and contact scores. We extract targets via 3D tracking and tool-object proximity, train a flow matching generator to predict them, and use predicted contact to trigger grasp and release while optimizing end effector motion from flow. On the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), SurgFlow succeeds in 37 of 39 stage evaluations across tissue retraction, bimanual reveal, needle pickup, and handover, outperforming baselines trained on equal data with or without action labels. Zero-shot transfer to a humanoid-based laparoscopic robot achieves 85% and 70% average success under similar and novel camera viewpoints, respectively.

</details>


### [1964] [ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33256)
*Namai Chandra,Madhur Thareja,Shriram Damodaran,Addison Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ActionGround 是一种免训练的神经符号运行时层，包裹冻结的 VLA 策略，通过符号相位有限状态机与惯性加权的欧拉-拉格朗日项对控制步进行修正，在多个 VLA 主干上提升成功率、稳定性与轨迹效率，并增强抗噪鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型直接将视觉观测和语言指令映射为机器人动作，但未显式表征操作任务的相位结构，也未建模执行所依赖的刚体动力学。这一缺失限制了其在长时序操作中的稳定性与轨迹质量。

Method: 提出 ActionGround，一个免训练、神经符号的运行时层，无需重训练、微调或访问权重即可包裹冻结 VLA 策略，每控制步开销不足 1 ms。其包含两条并行机制：一是符号化相位感知有限状态机，识别接近、抓取、搬运、放置四个操作相位并施加相位特定的规则化修正；二是常开的惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日项，将机器人运动方程融入每个控制步，其动力学残差仅作为一致性诊断记录，不作为门控条件。

Result: 在 7-DoF Franka Panda 上，针对 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA 与 Generalist-VLA 四种主干，在十个 LIBERO-Spatial 抓放任务中评估：参数跨任务与主干固定，成功率最高提升 6 个百分点，稳定性最高提升 19.3 个百分点，轨迹效率最高提升 15%。在 Robosuite 噪声扫描中，注入动作噪声下轨迹抖动鲁棒性约提升 10 倍。在与真实 Agilex Piper 试验匹配种子的 Robosuite 仿真配套实验中，基线成功率由 35% 提升至 95%。

Conclusion: ActionGround 以极低开销、免训练的方式为冻结 VLA 策略注入相位结构与动力学先验，显著提升操作的稳定性、效率与抗噪能力。当前评估局限于刚体物体抓放操作，且物理硬件实验仅为定性部署演示，真实机械臂的逐试验定量成功率留待未来工作。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but they do not explicitly represent the phase structure of manipulation tasks or the rigid-body dynamics governing execution. We present ActionGround, a neuro-symbolic, training-free runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, adding less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. A symbolic phase-aware finite-state machine identifies the manipulation phase (approach, grasp, transport, or place) and applies a phase-specific rule-based correction. In parallel, an always-on, inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term incorporates the robot's equations of motion into each control step, while its dynamics residual is logged as a consistency diagnostic rather than used as a gate.
  We evaluate ActionGround across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial pick-and-place tasks using a 7-DoF Franka Panda. With fixed parameters across tasks and backbones, ActionGround improves success rate by up to 6 percentage points and stability by up to 19.3 percentage points, while improving trajectory efficiency by up to 15%. In a separate Robosuite noise sweep, ActionGround provides approximately a 10x improvement in trajectory-jerk robustness under injected action noise. In a matched-seed Robosuite simulation companion to a real Agilex Piper trial, simulated baseline success increases from 35% to 95%. The physical-hardware experiment is presented as a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative per-trial success on the real arm is left for future work. Our evaluation is limited to rigid-object pick-and-place manipulation.

</details>


### [1965] [AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33299)
*Cunhao Zhu,Yifeng Wang,Dongliang Xu,Yunzhong Hou,Yue Yao,Chi Harold Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出AquaWAM——首个面向水下具身智能体的世界动作模型，显式建模动作驱动与被动水动力动力学，以紧凑导航状态替代高维视觉预测，在USIM基准20项任务上达72.6%成功率，决策速度较U0快2.7倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下机器人受惯性、浮力、水动力阻力与持续漂移等被动动力学影响，动作结束后运动仍会延续；现有世界动作模型（WAMs）主要预测动作条件下的视觉观测，未显式建模此类被动运动动力学，因而难以适用于水下具身智能。

Method: AquaWAM不预测未来图像，而是同时建模动作条件动力学与被动物理动力学，涵盖推进器死区、超出指令时长的惯性滑行以及环境水流。感知上使用DVL、IMU、压力传感器与关节编码器，相机仅提供理解目标与目标位姿的语义信息；通过建模紧凑导航状态而非高维视觉观测，大幅降低模型规模与计算开销。

Result: 在USIM基准的20项水下任务中，AquaWAM任务成功率达72.6%，优于现有方法；在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上动作决策速度比U0快2.7倍。在部分机载传感器测量缺失时仍有效：无DVL速度测量时成功率61.6%，而U0仅为39.4%。

Conclusion: 显式建模被动水动力学、以紧凑导航状态为核心的世界动作模型，可提升水下具身任务的成功率、推理效率与传感器缺失下的鲁棒性，为水下世界动作模型提供可行范式。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. Specifically, it senses through the DVL, IMU, pressure sensor and joint encoders, while cameras supply only semantics for understanding goals and target pose. By modeling compact navigation states rather than high-dimensional visual observations, AquaWAM substantially reduces the model size and computational cost compared with conventional WAMs. Experimentally, AquaWAM achieves a 72.6% task success rate across 20 underwater tasks on the USIM benchmark, outperforming existing methods while making action decisions 2.7x faster than U0 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Our model also remains effective when some onboard sensor measurements are unavailable. For example, without DVL velocity measurements, our method still achieves a 61.6% success rate, compared with 39.4% for U0.

</details>


### [1966] [CompliantWBC: Whole-Body Compliance for Heavy Humanoids via Force Latent Estimation and Residual Impedance Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33310)
*Tan-Dzung Do,Cuc T. Trinh,Tuan Dat Phuong,Chien Le,Thanh Ly,Vien Anh Ngo,An Thai Le*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CompliantWBC，一个面向重型人形机器人的全身柔顺控制框架，实现任意部位受扰时的全身（含下肢）柔顺响应，并在仿真与真机上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重型人形机器人在人类环境中承载大载荷时需要全身柔顺控制，但现有基于力感知的学习方法仅关注末端阻力、上肢逐连杆弹簧或末端刚度调制，未解决重型平台任意位置扰动且需下肢参与的问题。

Method: CompliantWBC包含三部分：(1) 以多部位全身阻抗参考控制器（将经典笛卡尔阻抗扩展到任意受控连杆）引导，用强化学习训练、以柔顺保真度奖励最大化为目标的基策略；(2) 在冻结基策略之上，用有界残差策略编辑各连杆阻抗平衡点，修正由梯度屏障后协同训练的力编码器提供的粗粒度但结构化的力旋量估计；(3) 采用Phong加权力源采样器与轴解耦骨盆锚点，通过两个可解释参数引入包含下肢的柔顺课程训练。

Result: 在仿真中与柔顺和刚性基线对比，取得最佳柔顺保真度，与解析解的偏差为2.58cm；在真实重型人形机器人上展示了静态/动态受力响应、擦板、负重深蹲和协同载荷搬运等任务。

Conclusion: CompliantWBC有效弥补了重型人形机器人在任意部位扰动下全身包含下肢的柔顺控制空白，兼顾柔顺保真度与真机可行性。

Abstract: Whole-body compliant control is essential for deploying heavy humanoids under high payload in human-centric environments. Most prior force-aware learning-based pipelines focus on end-effector resistance, per-link upper-body springs, or end-effector stiffness modulation, leaving arbitrary-site perturbations on heavy platforms with lower-body engagement largely unaddressed. We close this gap with CompliantWBC comprising: (1) A base policy trained with RL to maximize compliance-fidelity reward, guided by a multi-site whole-body impedance reference controller, extending classical Cartesian impedance to any controlled link; (2) A bounded residual policy that edits the per-link impedance equilibrium over a frozen base, correcting the coarse but structured wrench estimate supplied by a force encoder co-trained behind a gradient barrier; (3) A Phong-weighted force-origin sampler with an axis-decoupled pelvis anchor induces lower-body-inclusive compliance curriculum training via two interpretable parameters. We evaluate CompliantWBC in simulation against both compliant and stiff baselines, achieving best compliant fidelity of 2.58cm deviation from analytical solutions, and demonstrate it on a real heavy humanoid across static/dynamic force reaction, board wiping, squat under payload, and cooperative payload transport. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/compliantwbc/

</details>


### [1967] [Traceable Human-to-Humanoid Sign Language Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33354)
*Ao Liu,Shengeng Tang,Lechao Cheng,Yanbin Hao,Bingkun Bao,Richang Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 HumanoidCSL-20K，一个包含 20,648 条句级中文手语序列的数据集与基准，每条序列含源视频运动、修复后人体运动、直接机器人参考、几何修复机器人参考四个对齐版本，并配套面向手语的运动学参考评估协议，用于追踪“拟合—修复—重定向—执行”各阶段误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手语数据采集成本高、遥操作难以规模化，因此需复用大规模视频语料；但将视频导出的人体运动转换为人形机器人轨迹需保留语言学运动线索，而拟合、人体运动修复、重定向、机器人几何修复与控制各环节误差混在最终轨迹中难以区分。

Method: 构建 HumanoidCSL-20K 数据集：20,648 条句级中文手语序列，每条含四个对齐版本（源、修复人体运动、直接机器人参考、几何修复机器人参考）；采用观测支持的人体局部运动修复、全机器人几何修复与跨表示溯源，使每次变换可追踪；设计配对评估，分别衡量人体运动连续性与内容保持、机器人参考可行性、物理执行；提出手语专用运动学参考协议，在全规划运动上对手形、位置、掌朝向与双手关系打分；并进行控制实验以分离参考可学习性与课程效应。

Result: 全语料结果显示，修复后异常手臂/手部步态更少，双手间及手-身穿透减少；控制实验将参考可学习性与课程效应分离；分项得分揭示仍存在的执行误差。

Conclusion: 该工作通过多版本对齐与可溯源变换，为视频到人形机器人手语生成提供可诊断的基准，能够定位并量化各转换阶段的残余误差，推动手语机器人数据的复用与评估标准化。

Abstract: Sign data collection is costly, and teleoperation scales poorly, motivating reuse of large video corpora. Humanoid signing requires converting video-derived human motion into robot trajectories while preserving linguistic motion cues. Errors from fitting, human-motion repair, retargeting, robot geometry repair, and control are hard to separate from the final trajectory alone. We introduce HumanoidCSL-20K, a dataset and benchmark of 20,648 sentence-level Chinese Sign Language sequences, each with four aligned versions: the source, the repaired human motion, the direct robot reference, and the geometry-repaired robot reference. Observation-supported local human-motion repair, full-robot geometry repair, and cross-representation provenance make each transformation traceable. Paired evaluations measure human-motion continuity and content preservation, robot-reference feasibility, and physical execution. A sign-specific kinematic-reference protocol scores handshape, location, palm orientation, and inter-hand relation over the full planned motion. Full-corpus results show fewer abnormal arm / hand steps and less inter-hand and hand-body penetration after repair. Control experiments separate reference learnability from curriculum effects, while component scores expose remaining execution errors.

</details>


### [1968] [Large Language Models for Model-Based Robot Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33423)
*Andrew Wilhelm,Angelina Zhao,Nils Napp*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个框架，用大语言模型（LLM）构建显式工程模型（含物理关系、兼容性约束和目标），使建模假设可被检视和修正，再进行形式化多目标优化以获得可行性与Pareto最优性保证。在四旋翼与循线机器人选型问题上验证：30次直接LLM设计均无法在最终模型下验证为可行，且建模假设变化显著改变可行与Pareto最优设计集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可为机器人设计提供有用的工程知识，但直接生成的设计依赖隐含假设，既不保证可行性也不保证最优性；不同的合理建模选择会实质性改变哪些设计被预测为可行或最优，因此需要将这些建模选择显式化以供检视。

Method: 提出一个框架：用LLM构建显式工程模型，包含物理关系、兼容性约束与目标函数；在形式化优化前允许对这些建模选择进行检视与修订；模型可用额外的工程、制造商或系统特定信息更新；随后进行形式化多目标优化，给出相对于最终模型和指定设计空间的可行性与Pareto最优性保证。在四旋翼和循线机器人的部件选择问题上进行评估，并与独立开发的专家模型及模型逐步细化阶段进行对比。

Result: 30次直接LLM设计试验中，没有一个能在对应最终模型下被验证为可行；与独立专家模型的对比以及模型细化的各阶段表明，建模假设的变化会显著改变预测的可行设计集和Pareto最优设计集。

Conclusion: 用LLM构建显式工程模型，可使底层设计选择在假设决定优化设计之前被检视和修正；显式建模为结合LLM生成的工程知识、系统特定信息与形式化设计优化提供了接口。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can contribute useful engineering knowledge to robot design, but directly generated designs may rely on implicit assumptions and provide no guarantees of feasibility or optimality. These assumptions are critical because different reasonable modeling choices can materially change which designs are predicted to be feasible or optimal. We therefore present a framework that uses LLMs to construct explicit engineering models containing physical relationships, compatibility constraints, and objectives, allowing these modeling choices to be inspected and revised before formal optimization. The model can then be updated with additional engineering, manufacturer, or system-specific information before formal multi-objective optimization provides feasibility and Pareto-optimality guarantees with respect to the finalized model and specified design space. We evaluate the framework on quadcopter and line-following robot component-selection problems. Across 30 direct LLM design trials, none could be verified as feasible under the corresponding finalized model. Comparisons with an independently developed expert model and successive stages of model refinement further showed that changes in modeling assumptions substantially altered the predicted feasible and Pareto-optimal design sets. Together, these results show that using LLMs to construct explicit engineering models makes the underlying design choices available for inspection and revision before those assumptions determine the optimized designs. Explicit modeling therefore provides an interface for combining LLM-generated engineering knowledge, system-specific information, and formal design optimization.

</details>


### [1969] [VIDEAS: Distilling Explicit Action Semantics from Demonstration Videos for World Models via Prior-Guided Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33464)
*Jianan Wang,Haoquan Zhai,Siyang Zhang,Bin Li,Juan Chen,Jingtao Qi,Zhuo Zhang,Enze Wang,Haoxiang Jin,Chen Qian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VIDEAS数据蒸馏框架，将视频中的连续物理动态转化为显式动作语义，并训练出语言世界模型VIDEAS-WM，在具身动作语义推理上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型虽能预测未来状态并优化动作规划，但仍难以真正内化底层因果物理规律，无法显式推理动作前置条件与后续状态转移。

Method: VIDEAS将视觉演示解构为离散动作轨迹，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）提取包含动作前置条件与效果的结构化知识；引入基于文本环境的先验引导轨迹仿真机制验证知识物理一致性；加入负轨迹提升知识完整性与数据多样性以缓解认知偏差；基于AgiBot-World数据集构建34K高质量样本，训练8B/9B参数的VIDEAS-WM语言世界模型。

Result: VIDEAS-WM在高层具身动作语义推理上取得SOTA性能，展现出深刻的物理理解能力，并在未见场景中具备强泛化性。

Conclusion: 通过数据蒸馏将视频物理动态转为显式动作语义并训练语言世界模型，可有效增强具身智能体的因果物理推理与泛化能力。

Abstract: World models learn internal representations of environment dynamics to predict future states, enabling agents to optimize action plans without physical interactions. However, developing world models that genuinely internalize underlying causal physical laws to explicitly reason about action preconditions and subsequent state transitions remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose VIDEAS, a data distillation framework that transforms continuous physical dynamics from operational videos into explicit action semantics for foundation models. Specifically, it deconstructs visual demonstrations into discrete action trajectories and utilizes advanced vision-language models (VLMs) to extract structured knowledge encapsulating action preconditions and effects. To ensure physical consistency, we introduce a prior-guided trajectory simulation mechanism grounded within a text-based environment to rigorously validate the extracted knowledge. Notably, we incorporate negative trajectories to enrich knowledge completeness and enhance data diversity to mitigate cognitive bias. Furthermore, we present VIDEAS-WM, an 8B/9B-parameter suite of language-based world models trained on 34K high-quality samples derived from AgiBot-World dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIDEAS-WM establishes state-of-the-art performance in high-level embodied action semantic reasoning, exhibiting profound physical understanding and robust generalization across unseen scenarios.

</details>


### [1970] [AMBIT: Anticipatory Multimodal Body Recruitment for Bimanual Tracking on a Humanoid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33484)
*Hanlong Li,Sihan Tan,Takeshi Ashizawa,Benjamin Yen,Kazuhiro Nakadai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AMBIT：用CVAE生成+非学习选择器筛选排序验证+滚动时域迟滞提交的全身协调策略，为5自由度臂人形机器人提供多样性保留的骨盆/腰部招募参考，在MuJoCo与Unitree R1/G1上显著超越纯反应式跟踪器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5-DoF双臂人形机器人无法仅靠手臂跟踪通用双臂末端轨迹，必须调用骨盆与腰部运动，但"哪些运动、何时运动"不唯一确定。任务的动态可行招募策略构成多样连续流形，确定性回归器会模式平均（仅35%有效），需要保留多样性的生成式方法，并支持训练时未知约束的零样本适配。

Method: 1) CVAE基于指令轨迹预览提出候选招募策略；2) 非学习的选择器对候选进行过滤、排序与验证；3) 滚动时域循环配合迟滞机制提交单一策略；4) 提交策略作为全身微分IK QP的参考，由反应式跟踪器保留残余误差的修正权限。硬件验证采用外部支撑的物理R1，超参数不变迁移至Unitree G1。

Result: 在160个存在有效策略的留出回合、完整MuJoCo动力学与力矩控制下：3 cm/15°容差下成功率85% vs 跟踪器74%（置信区间不重叠）；48%的回合在手臂饱和前先招募身体（跟踪器35%）。CVAE单样本有效52%，16样本取最佳达82%。五种零样本偏移下AMBIT全面优于热启动跟踪器，并匹配计算量高17倍的测试时重优化基线。Unitree G1上成功率0.85 vs 0.53。物理R1上五种策略骨盆行程各异，末端轨迹中位误差11 mm（编码器正运动学），验证运动学可实现性（非平衡性）。

Conclusion: 保留招募策略多样性并通过选择机制加以利用，可显著提升人形全身协调的鲁棒性与零样本约束适配能力；选择式框架在无需重训练的情况下即可应对训练时未知约束，且在跨平台与物理硬件上具备可迁移性与运动学可实现性。

Abstract: A humanoid with 5-DoF arms cannot track generic bimanual end-effector trajectories with its arms alone; pelvis and waist motion must be recruited, but which motion, and when, is not uniquely determined. On a Unitree R1 in fixed double support, the set of dynamically valid recruitment strategies (pelvis pose and waist trajectories) for a task is a diverse continuous manifold, and a deterministic regressor trained on it mode-averages into strategies valid only 35% of the time, against 52% for a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and 82% for the best of 16 CVAE samples. We introduce AMBIT: the CVAE proposes strategies from a preview of the commanded trajectory, a non-learned selector filters, ranks and verifies them, and a receding-horizon loop commits to one with hysteresis. The committed strategy is the reference of the same whole-body differential-IK QP a reactive tracker runs, which keeps authority over residual error. On 160 held-out episodes that admit a valid strategy, in full MuJoCo dynamics under a torque controller, AMBIT reaches 85% success at a 3 cm/15 deg tolerance against 74% for the tracker (disjoint confidence intervals) and recruits the body before the arms saturate in 48% of episodes against 35%. Because diversity is preserved, constraints unknown at training time are enforced by selection alone: under five zero-shot shifts AMBIT beats the warm-started tracker on every shift and matches a test-time re-optimisation baseline 17x more expensive. On a Unitree G1, with hyperparameters unchanged, the protocol reproduces the structure of the valid set and widens the gap over the tracker to 0.85 against 0.53. Five selected strategies execute on the externally supported physical R1, distinct in pelvis excursion and tracking the planned end-effector motion to a median of 11 mm by encoder forward kinematics, which establishes kinematic realisability, not balance.

</details>


### [1971] [A Disk-Shaped Magnetoelastic Torque Sensor for Robotic Joints Using Permanent Magnetization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33542)
*Bruno Brajon,Enrico Gasparin,Nicole Yazigy,Lisa Salamin,Florian Copt,Guzmán Borque Gallego,Elias Klauser,Gaël Close*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型盘式磁致伸缩扭矩传感器，轴向厚度约1 cm，采用四磁力计架构与定制磁屏蔽，可在抑制寄生横向力干扰的同时实现50 Nm满量程下1.34 %FS的测量精度，适用于机器人关节集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人领域对直接扭矩传感的需求日益增长：在需要精确控制与交互的场景中，仅依靠电机电流进行扭矩估计已不够充分，因此需要可集成于机器人关节的紧凑型直接扭矩传感器。

Method: 采用盘式磁致伸缩结构，轴向包络紧凑（约1 cm）；使用四磁力计架构测量被应力调制的磁场，并抑制寄生横向力的影响；通过定制设计的磁屏蔽提升扭矩灵敏度并降低外部杂散场（约7倍）。研究涵盖机械设计、磁化工艺与实验验证。

Result: 定制磁屏蔽使外部杂散场降低约7倍并增强扭矩灵敏度；传感器在50 Nm满量程下实现1.34 %FS的扭矩测量精度。

Conclusion: 结果表明该传感器具备面向机器人应用的潜力，兼具紧凑尺寸、抗寄生力干扰能力与较高测量精度。

Abstract: Direct torque sensing is a growing need in the robotics community to enable precise control and interactions where torque estimation from motor current is not sufficient. This paper presents a novel disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor with a compact axial envelope of about 1 cm, suitable for integration in robotic joints. A four-magnetometer architecture is used to measure the field modulated by the stress affecting a narrow magnetized region while rejecting the effects of parasitic cross forces. A custom-designed magnetic shield enhances the torque sensitivity while reducing the external stray fields by a factor 7x. The device measures the torque with an accuracy of 1.34 %FS relative to the 50 Nm full scale (FS). The paper details the development of the sensor through the mechanical design, the magnetization procedure, and the experimental validation. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed sensor for robotic applications.

</details>


### [1972] [Steer2Grasp: Inference-Time Embodiment-Aware Steering for Diverse Physically Feasible Grasp Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33546)
*Vignesh Vembar,Ayush Kaura,A Padmaprabhan,Siddharth Sinha,Kailash Nagarajan,Keshab Patra,Md Faizal Karim,K Madhava Krishna*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Steer2Grasp：一种免训练、与具身无关的推理期抓取引导框架，通过 Feynman-Kac 粒子重加权与重采样，将冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型的采样质量从不可行模式迁移到高奖励模式，实现单/双臂抓取的可达性与碰撞约束满足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抓取扩散模型以物体为中心生成先验，容易违反由具身结构与场景环境带来的运动学与碰撞约束；已有的具身感知方法多依赖梯度引导或优化在生成抓取附近做局部修正，当初始生成落在根本不可行的模式区域时难以恢复。

Method: 1) 免训练、具身无关的推理期引导框架，直接作用于冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型；2) 基于 Feynman-Kac 的粒子重加权与重采样，把种群质量从不可行模式重新分配到高奖励模式，实现种群层面的模式转移，无需修改预训练模型、也不要求约束可微；3) 以可达性与碰撞感知奖励统一处理单臂与双臂抓取；4) 随后进行无梯度的夹爪级局部精修，并保持与原始抓取先验的接近性。

Result: 在多种物体、机器人具身与受限环境下，方法显著提升了可行抓取的生成比例，同时生成的抓取仍保持与底层抓取先验的邻近性。

Conclusion: 通过推理期粒子重加权实现种群级模式转移，可在不训练、不修改扩散模型、不依赖可微约束的前提下有效提升具身可行抓取生成能力，为单臂与双臂抓取提供统一处理思路。

Abstract: Current grasp diffusion models provide rich priors for generation, yet their object-centric approach can violate the kinematic and collision constraints imposed by the embodiment and the environment. Existing embodiment-aware methods primarily perform local corrections around generated grasps through gradient guidance or optimization, making it difficult to recover from fundamentally infeasible modes. We present Steer2Grasp, a training-free, embodiment-agnostic framework for inference-time grasp steering that adapts a frozen Cartesian grasp diffusion model using deployment-specific rewards. Through Feynman-Kac (FK) inspired particle reweighting and resampling, the method reallocates population mass from infeasible to high-reward grasp modes, enabling population-level mode transitions without modifying the pretrained diffusion model or requiring differentiable constraints. The framework enables a unified treatment for single and dual arm grasping through reachability and collision aware rewards, followed by gradient free gripper level local refinement. Across diverse objects, robot embodiments, and constrained environments, our method substantially improves feasible grasp generation while maintaining proximity to the underlying grasp prior.

</details>


### [1973] [FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33551)
*Haowei Shen,Tingai Li,Yumeng Liu,Wenyuan Guang,Xuanze Yang,Qing Fang,Kai Xu,Ligang Liu,Ruizhen Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FoLD：通过显式力引导学习关节物体灵巧操作，从人类演示计算补偿力场，作为先验指导残差策略，在基准与真实平台上均优于SOTA基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示迁移到灵巧机器人时，手部形态与接触动力学差异导致重定向动作难以产生预期的物体行为，因此需要一种能补偿这些差异并满足任务接触要求的方法。

Method: FoLD从人类演示和机器人当前交互状态中计算补偿力场（compensatory force fields），生成促进演示物体运动的力先验；该先验指导一个残差策略（residual policy），将重定向手部动作适配到任务的接触需求。

Result: 在关节物体操作的公开基准上，FoLD在不同任务与不同embodiment上持续优于SOTA基线；并在真实灵巧机器人平台上验证成功实现了人类操作技能到机器人执行的迁移。

Conclusion: 显式力引导可有效弥合形态与接触差异，实现从人类演示到灵巧机器人关节物体操作的成功迁移。

Abstract: Transferring human demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging because differences in hand morphology and contact dynamics often cause retargeted motions to fail at producing the intended object behavior. We present \textbf{FoLD}, a framework for learning dexterous manipulation of articulated objects through explicit force guidance. FoLD compute compensatory force fields from human demonstrations together with the robot's current interaction state, yielding a force prior that promotes the demonstrated object motion. This force prior informs a residual policy that adapts retargeted hand motions to the contact requirements of the task. We evaluate FoLD on a public benchmark for articulated object manipulation, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across tasks and embodiments. We further validate FoLD on real dexterous robot platforms, demonstrating successful transfer of human manipulation skills to robot execution. Here is the link of our project page: https://gghgghgghgg.github.io/FoLD-project-page/.

</details>


### [1974] [SLIP-VLA: Single-Step Latent Imagination for Policy Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33575)
*Tianfu Li,Haoxuan Xu,Wenbo Chen,Haitian Li,Changchuan Yang,Xinhu Zheng,Jun Ma,Yuan Liu,Lujia Wang,Haoang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SLIP-VLA提出"单步潜在想象"框架，用一次去噪更新获得时间密集的未来潜在表示，并通过几何/语义对齐与动作条件世界建模提升其感知与控制充分性，在仿真与真实任务上达到SOTA，单步想象仅需12 ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型多直接从当前观测预测动作，缺乏对未来场景演化的显式建模；引入未来预测的方法中，密集未来建模依赖昂贵的迭代去噪，而单步替代方案性能又不及多步版本，因此需要兼顾高效未来建模与强动作性能。

Method: SLIP-VLA为VLA策略学习框架，通过单次去噪更新获取时间密集的未来潜在表示（Single-Step Latent Imagination）；一方面将中间潜在与未来几何、语义特征对齐以提升感知充分性；另一方面通过动作条件的潜在世界模型与逆动力学建模，显式耦合潜在状态转移与机器人动作，提升控制充分性。

Result: 在多种仿真基准与真实世界操作任务上取得SOTA性能，且单步潜在想象仅耗时12 ms。

Conclusion: 单步潜在想象可在保持高效（12 ms）的同时实现未来感知的动作预测，缓解了密集未来建模的效率与性能权衡问题，验证了感知充分性与控制充分性联合设计的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models are increasingly effective for robotic manipulation, yet most predict actions directly from current observations without explicitly modeling future scene evolution. Recent methods introduce future prediction to improve action generation, but dense future modeling often requires expensive iterative denoising, while one-step alternatives can underperform their multi-step counterparts. To reconcile efficient future modeling with strong action performance, we present SLIP-VLA, a policy learning framework that equips VLA models with a Single-Step Latent Imagination for future-aware action prediction. SLIP-VLA obtains temporally dense future latent representations with a single denoising update, and we improve the perceptual sufficiency of these representations by aligning intermediate latents with future geometric and semantic features. We further improve their control sufficiency through action-conditioned latent world modeling and inverse dynamics modeling, explicitly coupling latent transitions with robot actions. SLIP-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks, while its single-step latent imagination takes only 12 ms.

</details>


### [1975] [Beyond One-Step Accuracy: State-Affine Latent Transition for Reliable Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33595)
*Boyuan Zhang,Yingjun Du,Xiantong Zhen,Ling Shao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SALT（State-Affine Latent Transition），一种动作条件的状态仿射潜空间动力学模型，通过递归多步 rollout 监督训练，显著提升视觉规划闭环成功率，尽管单步预测误差高于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合嵌入世界模型通常在编码状态上做单步预测训练，但规划时递归地将学习到的转移应用于自身预测，导致单步精度无法反映递归 rollout 下的误差传播。作者希望从误差传播角度重新设计动力学模型，使训练与实际使用方式（递归规划）相匹配。

Method: 1) 将多步 rollout 误差分解为各步引入误差及其后续转移传播；2) 证明状态仿射动力学正是雅可比与状态无关的可微转移，可消除非线性传播残差，使误差传播算子仅依赖动作序列；3) 据此设计 SALT：动作同时调制状态变换与加性更新；4) 采用递归多步 rollout 监督训练，将每个预测潜状态反馈回转移中。

Result: 在四个视觉规划环境中，SALT 的单步预测误差比匹配的 LeWM 基线高 1.48–2.19 倍，但闭环成功率平均提升 10.0 个百分点。在 OGBench-Cube 上，执行后模型预测代价剧烈上升而失败的回合比例从 23.3% 降至 2.0%。

Conclusion: 递归规划下的性能并不由单步预测精度决定；通过状态仿射动力学与递归多步监督，可有效抑制误差传播，显著改善闭环规划成功率与失败模式。

Abstract: Joint-embedding world models enable visual planning by learning action-conditioned dynamics in latent space. Yet they are commonly trained for one-step prediction on encoded states, while planning recursively applies the learned transition to its own predictions. One-step accuracy therefore does not capture how prediction errors propagate under recursive rollout. We decompose multi-step rollout error into the errors introduced at individual steps and their propagation through subsequent transitions. We show that state-affine dynamics are precisely the differentiable transitions with state-independent Jacobians, eliminating the nonlinear propagation residual and making the error propagation operators depend only on the action sequence. Guided by this result, we introduce SALT (State-Affine Latent Transition), an action-conditioned state-affine dynamics model in which the action modulates both the state transformation and the additive update. We train SALT through recursive multi-step rollout supervision, feeding each predicted latent state back into the transition so that training matches how the model is used during planning. Across four visual planning environments, SALT exhibits $1.48$--$2.19\times$ higher one-step prediction error than the matched LeWM baseline, yet improves closed-loop success in every environment by $10.0$ percentage points on average. On OGBench-Cube, the fraction of episodes that fail with a sharp rise in model-predicted cost after execution decreases from $23.3%$ to $2.0%$.

</details>


### [1976] [InfraVLA: Extending Vision-Language-Action Navigation with Infrastructure Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33647)
*Lukas Vierling,Benjamin Ramtoula,Luke Robinson,Ronald Clark,Daniele De Martini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 InfraVLA，将预训练导航 VLA 适配到静态基础设施（CCTV）视角：用 CCTV 编码器把外部视图编码为输入序列 token，并采用两阶段训练（反事实上采样演示 + 恢复数据）以促使策略在关键决策点利用外部视角，在仿真与真机上显著优于仅车载视角基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库、办公室、医院等室内环境中已普遍安装摄像头，它们能观察到机器人自身视角看不到的区域，但现有导航策略（含近期 VLA 模型）并未利用这些静态基础设施视角。作者希望让导航策略接入 CCTV 信息，从而获得决策关键但本地不可见的信息。

Method: InfraVLA 是端到端方法：将预训练导航 VLA 适配到静态基础设施视图。用 CCTV 编码器将每个外部视图转为输入序列 token。由于外部视图仅在少数决策点起作用，单纯微调无法让策略学会使用它们，因此采用两阶段训练：先在反事实上采样（upsampled counterfactual）演示数据上训练，再在恢复（recovery）数据上训练。

Result: 在两个仿真仓库任务（按指令寻找指定物体、绕行被堵塞通道）上评估，决策信息常仅对基础设施摄像头可见。分布内测试：InfraVLA 两项任务成功率均达 100%，无 CCTV 输入基线分别为 34.0% 与 73.6%；分布外测试集上为 88.2% 与 88.9%。在真实四足机器人上，用不到 10 分钟演示微调后达到 83.3%，仅车载视角基线为 29.2%。

Conclusion: 利用已部署的静态基础设施摄像头可显著提升导航 VLA 的成功率，尤其在决策信息仅外部视角可见时；但此类视图稀疏使用，需专门的两阶段训练策略才能让模型有效利用。方法在仿真分布内/外及真实四足机器人上均验证有效。

Abstract: Many indoor environments in which robots operate, such as warehouses, offices, and hospitals, already have cameras installed. They observe parts of the building that the robot cannot see from where it stands, yet navigation policies, including recent vision-language-action (VLA) models, do not use them. We propose InfraVLA, an end-to-end method that adapts a pretrained navigation VLA to such static infrastructure views: a closed-circuit television (CCTV) encoder turns each external view into tokens of the input sequence. Because the views matter only at rare decision points, fine-tuning alone did not make the policy use them in our experiments; we therefore train in two stages, on demonstrations with upsampled counterfactual data and then on recovery data. We evaluate on two simulated warehouse tasks, finding an object named in the instruction and rerouting around blocked aisles, where the deciding information is often visible only to the infrastructure cameras. Tested in distribution, InfraVLA reached a success rate of 100% on both, against 34.0% and 73.6% for a baseline without CCTV input. On out-of-distribution test sets it reached 88.2% and 88.9%. On a real quadruped fine-tuned with under 10 minutes of demonstrations, the policy reached 83.3% against 29.2% for the on-board-only baseline.

</details>


### [1977] [Demonstration-Free Success-Probability Reward Learning for Generalist Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33653)
*Duo Wu,Haifeng Wang,Rongwei Lu,Jinghe Wang,Tianyi Xiong,Zhimin Wang,Chao Yu,Shuai Ma,Zhi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出无需专家演示的奖励学习范式：从稀疏任务结果与策略经验中递归学习稠密成功率反馈，并在策略演化中自适应更新奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习依赖稠密奖励，但任务奖励稀疏；现有通用奖励模型依赖专家演示学习任务进度，与策略优化中混合质量轨迹存在分布不匹配，导致对次优与失败行为的估计不可靠。

Method: 理论证明终端任务结果隐式定义中间时间步的稠密成功概率反馈，可经自举递归学习；据此提出 eVTA₀，用时序差分式自举从混合质量策略轨迹学习成功概率，无需专家演示或中间标注；并进一步提出 RLER 闭环框架，随策略演化用新采集轨迹自适应更新 eVTA₀。

Result: eVTA₀ 提供比SOTA奖励模型更具信息量的奖励，在相同RL训练预算下于全部 LIBERO 任务套件取得最佳平均策略性能，成功率较初始策略提升 5.4%-13.8%；真实世界操作中 RLER 将总体成功率提升 20%-26%，分布外条件下提升 35%-36%。

Conclusion: 无需演示的奖励学习以及随策略演化自适应调整奖励是有效的，能显著提升策略性能与分布外鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables generalist robot policies to improve through trial-and-error interaction, yet its effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by sparse task rewards. Existing general-purpose reward models typically alleviate this issue by learning task progress from expert demonstrations, but introduce a distribution mismatch with the mixed-quality rollouts encountered during policy optimization, making their estimates unreliable on suboptimal and failed behaviors from which the policy must learn. In this work, we introduce a demonstration-free reward learning paradigm where dense reward feedback can be learned directly from sparse task outcomes and policy experience. We theoretically show that terminal task outcomes implicitly define dense success-probability feedback at intermediate timesteps, which can be recursively learned through bootstrapping. Based on this insight, we introduce eVTA$_0$, which learns success probabilities from mixed-quality policy rollouts through temporal-difference-style bootstrapping, without expert demonstrations or intermediate annotations. We further introduce RL with Evolving Rewards (RLER), a closed-loop framework that adapts eVTA$_0$ using newly collected rollouts as the policy evolves. Experiments show that eVTA$_0$ provides more informative rewards than state-of-the-art reward models and achieves the best average policy performance across all LIBERO task suites under the same RL training budget, improving success rates by 5.4%-13.8% over the initial policy. In real-world manipulation, RLER further improves overall success rates by 20%-26%, with 35%-36% gains under out-of-distribution conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of demonstration-free reward learning and adapting rewards as the policy evolves. Project webpage: https://duowuyms.github.io/evta0.

</details>


### [1978] [Observability-Informed Optimal Sensor Placement for Soft Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33681)
*Samuel Smocot,James Richard Forbes,Audrey Sedal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出并实验验证了一种基于凸优化最大化的可观测性Gramian指标的软体机器人最优传感器布置方法，在软体连续臂上通过卡尔曼滤波验证其优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软体机器人传感器布置方法要么缺乏跨不同形态的泛化能力，要么未考虑系统动力学特性，因此需要一种通用且考虑动力学的系统化方法。

Method: 采用凸优化求解最优传感器配置，目标函数为基于可观测性Gramian的度量最大化；在软体连续臂上使用位置与应变测量进行实验评估，并以卡尔曼滤波进行状态估计。

Result: 在所有正弦输入试验中，基于最优传感器布置的卡尔曼滤波状态估计重建误差均低于基线，改善幅度为毫米量级。

Conclusion: 该案例表明线性控制理论工具可指导软体机器人的最优传感器布置，提供了一种可解释的传感器布置思路，并有望推广到其他形态。

Abstract: This paper presents the application and experimental evaluation of a systematic method for optimal sensor placement in soft robots. Existing methods either lack generalizability across different soft robot morphologies or do not account for system dynamics. The applied method uses convex optimization to find the optimal sensor configuration that maximizes an observability Gramian-based metric. The framework is experimentally evaluated using position and strain measurements on a soft continuum arm. Kalman filter state estimates using optimal sensor placements yield lower reconstruction error than a baseline across all sinusoidal input trials, with improvements on the order of millimeters. This case study shows that linear control theory tools can guide optimal sensor placement in soft robots, suggesting an interpretable approach to sensor placement that may extend to other morphologies.

</details>


### [1979] [MomWorld: Momentum-Aware Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33737)
*Ziying Song,Shengkai Zhang,Lei Yang,Haozhuang Chi,Yuchen Liu,Jiangtao Su,Lin Liu,Ziyang Liu,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出动量感知的隐式世界模型MomWorld及动量条件流匹配模块MoFlow，实现长时程规划的稳定推演与轨迹精修，碰撞率较MomAD降低12.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程规划需预测场景演化与潜在风险以支撑复杂交互下的安全决策，但现有方法难以将观测历史中的运动趋势传播到未来；基于单一隐状态的长时间rollout会衰减有效动态、保留过时运动模式，并破坏可靠的近期规划。

Method: MomWorld从历史到当前观测中提取场景运动趋势，将隐式动量传播到未来时程，联合预测未来构型状态与动量状态。三点机制：可学习的动量持续性机制保持稳定趋势；场景条件动量更新适应未来动态；场景自适应重置门在突变时抑制过时动量。另提出MoFlow——动量条件流匹配模块，仅需少量积分步即将基础轨迹精修至与预测的未来场景演化对齐，并采用时程感知残差融合，在保留近期规划稳定性的同时允许更强的长程修正。

Result: 在NAVISIM、nuScenes与Bench2Drive上的大量实验表明，MomWorld提升了长时程规划一致性，并在6秒规划时程下将平均碰撞率相较MomAD降低12.2%。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模并传播潜在动量状态，并结合动量条件的轨迹精修，可有效缓解长时程推演中的动态衰减与近端规划失稳问题，提升自动驾驶长时程规划的安全性与一致性。

Abstract: Long-horizon planning enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate scene evolution and potential risks, supporting safe and stable decisions in complex interactions. However, existing methods struggle to propagate motion trends from observed history into the future. Long rollouts based on a single latent state may further attenuate useful dynamics, retain stale motion patterns, and disrupt reliable near-term plans. We introduce MomWorld, a momentum-aware latent world model for long-horizon planning. MomWorld extracts scene motion trends from historical-to-current observations and propagates latent momentum into future horizons, jointly predicting future configuration and momentum states. A learnable momentum persistence mechanism preserves stable trends, scene-conditioned momentum updates adapt future dynamics, and a scene-adaptive reset gate suppresses stale momentum under abrupt changes. We further propose MoFlow, a momentum-conditioned flow-matching module that refines a base trajectory to align with the predicted future scene evolution in only a few integration steps, with a horizon-aware residual fusion that preserves near-term planning stability while permitting stronger long-range corrections. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM, nuScenes and Bench2Drive demonstrate that MomWorld improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 12.2% relative to MomAD over a 6-second planning horizon.

</details>


### [1980] [AnyStep-WAM: Budget-Aligned Distillation and Adaptive Inference for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33748)
*Rui Wang,Xiangyu Wang,Donglin Yang,Yibo Li,Canyang Chen,Zhongrui Wang,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 AnyStep World Action Model 框架，实现可变去噪预算与场景自适应计算分配，在大幅减少去噪步数的同时保持任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 world-action models 依赖固定去噪步数的迭代生成，但操作任务中动作块对生成误差的敏感度不同：关键动作需要精度，低敏感动作可用更少步数快速生成，固定步数造成计算浪费。

Method: 1) 预算对齐的教师轨迹蒸馏：利用显式冻结教师转移与共享低秩适配器训练区间条件 flow maps，支持从单步预测到多步细化的动作生成；2) 轻量风险-收益调度器：基于单次一步预览预测教师曲率难度与特定预算下的学生-教师保真度，选择能满足风险自适应保真度要求的最小预算。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上三种主流 WAM（Motus、FastWAM、LingBotVA）分别减少平均去噪步数 60.2%、49.8%、85.28%，同时保持基线成功率；单步去噪预算下任务成功率分别提升 7.07%、12.08%、8.94%；六个真实操作任务验证有效。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了可调预算的动作预测与场景相关计算分配，显著降低推理成本并提升低预算下的生成质量，具有较强的通用性与实际部署价值。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple predictive visual modeling with action generation, typically relying on iterative denoising with a fixed denoising steps. However, manipulation tasks contain actions chunks with varying sensitivity to generation errors: critical actions require precision, while less sensitive actions allow faster generation with fewer denoising steps. Here we introduce AnyStep World Action Model, a general framework for tunable-budget prediction and scene-dependent computation allocation. Our budget-aligned teacher-trajectory distillation trains interval-conditioned flow maps using explicit frozen-teacher transitions and shared low-rank adapters, supporting action generation from one-step prediction to multi-step refinement.
