Building on this capability, a lightweight risk-benefit scheduler predicts teacher-curvature-based difficulty and budget-specific student-teacher fidelity from a single one-step preview, selecting the smallest budget predicted to satisfy risk-adaptive fidelity requirements. We evaluate our framework on three widely used WAMs Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA using RoboTwin 2.0. Our method reduces average denoising steps by 60.2%, 49.8%, and 85.28%, respectively, while maintaining baseline task success rates. In particular, our AnyStep training substantially improves model performance under a one-step denoising budget, increasing task success rates by 7.07%, 12.08%, and 8.94% on Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA, respectively. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks further validate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [1981] [Principal Steering Subspaces for Online Adaptation of Frozen Generative Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33765)
*Jialeng Ni,Nathan Zhao,Kunpeng Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出主导向子空间（PSS），通过有限差分解码器响应构建固定低维控制基，用SAC仅控制主导响应方向、其余分量按先验重采样，实现对冻结扩散/流匹配机器人策略的高效在线适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式机器人策略（扩散、流匹配）提供了表达性强的行为先验，但通过在线交互更新其大规模模型代价高昂。潜空间强化学习通过控制初始采样噪声来避免更新预训练生成器，然而高维噪声对解码动作的影响具有强烈各向异性，直接在全潜空间控制效率低、不稳定。

Method: 提出Principal Steering Subspaces（PSS）前向查询接口：利用有限差分解码器响应构造固定的低维控制基；由Soft Actor-Critic控制主导响应方向，正交补空间在每次查询时从高斯先验独立重采样。在3个RoboMimic任务上对扩散与流匹配策略验证，并进行Controlled Diffusion-Square消融（对比随机子空间、最低响应子空间）。进一步将PSS接入冻结的闭源3B参数VLA策略，构建具有同步转移采集、重置时优化与延迟感知异步部署的人形学习系统。

Result: 响应谱显示显著集中性。5对匹配的任务-生成器组合中，PSS相比全潜空间控制通常收敛更快、后期训练更稳定，整体最终性能更强。消融表明等维度的主导响应方向优于随机与最低响应子空间。探索性螺丝刀放置评测中，冻结VLA成功率为2/10，SAC+PSS适配后提升至6/10。

Conclusion: 解码器响应几何可作为冻结生成式机器人策略在线适配的实用控制基，PSS在保持预训练生成器不变的前提下实现高效、稳定的策略改进，并具备向大规模VLA策略扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Generative robot policies provide expressive behavior priors, but updating a large diffusion or flow-matching model through online interaction is costly. Latent-space reinforcement learning avoids updating the pretrained generator by controlling its initial sampling noise, yet high-dimensional noise can have strongly anisotropic effects on decoded actions. We introduce Principal Steering Subspaces (PSS), a forward-query interface that constructs a fixed low-dimensional control basis from finite-difference decoder responses. Soft Actor-Critic controls the leading response directions, while the orthogonal complement is independently resampled from the Gaussian prior at each query. On three RoboMimic tasks with diffusion and flow-matching policies, response spectra reveal substantial concentration. Across five matched task-generator pairs, the training curves indicate that PSS generally converges faster and exhibits more stable late-training behavior than full-latent control, while achieving stronger final performance overall. Controlled Diffusion-Square ablations further show that leading-response directions outperform random and least-responsive subspaces of equal dimension. We further integrate PSS with a frozen, closed-source 3B-parameter vision-language-action (VLA) policy in a humanoid learning system with synchronous transition collection, reset-time optimization, and latency-aware asynchronous deployment. In an exploratory screwdriver-placement evaluation, success is observed in 2/10 trials for the frozen VLA policy and 6/10 after SAC+PSS adaptation. These results support decoder-response geometry as a practical basis for online adaptation of frozen generative robot policies.

</details>


### [1982] [CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33807)
*Yiheng Lyu,Xueying Jiang,Wenhao Li,Shijian Lu,Gongjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CodeActionBench 基准，含 25 项操作任务，以 Code-as-Policy 智能体范式评估通用多模态模型将视觉理解与推理转化为可执行机器人操作代码的能力；九种配置共 675 次尝试，成功率 2.7%–73.3%，最佳配置（GPT-6 Astra + Codex CLI）三次尝试内至少完成 22/25 任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测难以回答通用多模态模型能否在不依赖任务专用微调、示范、外部专家感知/抓取模块、特权场景状态或预定义策略的前提下，把视觉理解与推理直接转化为具身操作行为。作者希望建立一个受控测试平台，衡量模型将自身能力迁移为操作行为的水平，并考察其中的典型失败模式。

Method: 构建 CodeActionBench：25 项操作任务，采用智能体式 Code-as-Policy 评测。被测智能体需自行选择视觉证据、形成与任务相关的三维估计、构造操作目标，并迭代执行与修正策略。共享机器人 API 仅提供 RGB 观测、标定几何操作、机器人反馈与有界运动，任务相关决策全部交由智能体。通过固定任务实例、资源预算与隐藏的物理结果验证器，保证不同模型与运行框架配置间的可控对比。

Result: 在九种配置、675 次尝试的评测中，成功率区间为 2.7%–73.3%。最强配置 GPT-6 Astra 配合 Codex CLI 在三次尝试内至少解决 25 项任务中的 22 项，表现最佳，但仍存在明显提升空间。轨迹分析显示，空间对齐、物体保持与完成判定是主要难点，并出现动作已成功完成却判定任务失败的情形。

Conclusion: CodeActionBench 为衡量通用模型如何将其能力转化为操作行为提供了受控测试平台，并可用于分析该过程中的典型失败场景。

Abstract: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.

</details>


### [1983] [Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33832)
*Yuheng Qiao,Ziran Wei,Xiaohan Wang,Daqiang Guo,Yichen Luo,Zhibo Pang,Peng Zhou,Sichao Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将世界-动作模型（WAM）生成的视觉预测视为目标条件视觉提案，利用冻结的动作条件世界模型构建一致性反馈，通过流策略优化（FPO）改进动作头，实现无需在线交互与任务奖励模型的最优策略提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM可联合预测未来视觉观测与机器人动作，但视觉预测与生成动作所隐含的结果之间存在不一致：模型常先给出视觉上合理的任务完成结果，却难以产出可靠达成该结果的动作序列，因此需要一种方式利用这种跨模型预测差异来改进策略。

Method: 将WAM生成的视觉预测作为目标条件视觉提案而非可直接执行的计划；使用冻结的动作条件世界模型预测动作条件后果；基于两种未来预测之间的一致性以及与终端目标的对齐程度构建反馈信号；再利用Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) 优化WAM的动作头。该方法不需要在线机器人交互，也无需额外训练任务特定的奖励模型。

Result: 在四个真实世界UR5操作任务上，平均成功率从43.4%提升至75.1%，对比π0.5的61.4%。

Conclusion: 在被评估的操作任务中，跨模型预测差异可为改进机器人策略提供有效反馈。

Abstract: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $π_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/

</details>


### [1984] [Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33872)
*Sichao Liu,Zekun Wang,Lixuan Tang,Yiming Li,Xiaohan Wang,Hanzhi Zhang,Daqiang Guo,Peng Zhou,Lihui Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Robot-GST 框架，用 3D Gaussian Splatting 与 SAM3D 构建真实到仿真的机器人环境，结合几何感知的时空行为表示与最终状态评估，在动作执行前对候选轨迹进行仿真筛选，从而提升长时序操作的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作策略日益依赖视觉语言模型进行端到端决策，但缺乏对任务结果和最终状态的显式预测与评估机制，导致长时序操作中误差不断累积，真实部署可靠性不足。

Method: 基于 RGB-D 观测，利用 3D Gaussian Splatting 与 SAM3D 构建高保真 Gaussian-SAM 机器人环境，支持"先仿真评估后执行"；融合视觉观测与语言指令，通过大型视觉语言模型进行时空推理以实现长时序任务规划；引入几何采样与基于状态的轨迹规划，实现 Gaussian 感知的最终状态估计，并在执行前于仿真环境中对候选动作序列进行模拟与评估，过滤不可行行为。

Result: 在刚性、柔性与可变形物体的代表性操作任务（方块放置、玩具打包、鸭子重排）上验证，表明几何感知时空推理与状态感知执行能提升不同物体类别下的操作可靠性。

Conclusion: 几何感知重建与高质量渲染仿真的结合，为机器人操作行为的评估提供了一种可扩展方案，能够改善真实世界操作部署的可靠性。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: https://robot-gst.github.io

</details>


### [1985] [DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33882)
*Han Yang,Yian Wang,Yunlong Song,Zhenjia Xu,Chuang Gan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DexTaG，一种触觉引导的强化学习框架，将手套采集的人类触觉接触模式引入策略搜索，实现高自由度机械手的工具使用重定向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手套式动作捕捉可大规模采集灵巧手示教数据，但人手与机器人手存在运动学差异，采集到的人类运动无法直接在机器人上执行，尤其在涉及手内重定向的接触丰富工具使用任务中。已有工作在仿真中通过强化学习或轨迹优化弥合该差异，但难以保留人类接触模式，常产生不自然的操作与不稳定的功能性抓取；且对每条参考轨迹需单独训练策略或求解优化，效率低下。

Method: 提出DexTaG触觉引导强化学习框架。训练时利用手套采集的触觉信号引导策略搜索，使其趋向实测的人类接触模式，降低对精确参考几何进行接触监督的依赖；为提升效率，对同一对象的所有训练轨迹联合训练单一可泛化重定向器；再将重定向器蒸馏为以目标物体轨迹为条件、无触觉输入的学生控制器，用于真实世界部署。

Result: 在马克笔与锤子操作任务上，DexTaG学到自然、接触丰富的行为，而基于距离接触启发式的基线方法无法学到；方法可泛化到同一物体与任务的留出轨迹，并在OakInk2上优于单轨迹基线。

Conclusion: 触觉引导可有效弥补人手到机器人手的重定向鸿沟，保留人类接触模式并生成自然的功能性抓取；单重定向器联合训练加无触觉学生蒸馏的框架兼顾了泛化性、训练效率与真实部署可行性。

Abstract: Glove-based motion capture is emerging as a scalable approach to collecting dexterous-hand demonstration data. However, due to the kinematic gap between the human and robot hand, the recorded human motions cannot be executed directly on the robot, especially for contact-rich tool-use tasks involving in-hand reorientation. Prior work bridges this gap in simulation through reinforcement learning (RL) or trajectory optimization, but the human contact pattern is hard to preserve under such formulations, often producing unnatural manipulation and unstable functional grasps. These methods also train a separate policy or solve a separate optimization for each reference trajectory, which is inefficient. To solve these problems, we propose DexTaG, a tactile-guided RL framework for dexterous manipulation. During training, tactile signals captured by the glove guide policy search toward the measured human contact pattern, reducing reliance on precise reference geometry for contact supervision. To improve efficiency, we train a single generalizable retargeter jointly on all training trajectories of the same object. The retargeter is further distilled into a tactile-free student controller conditioned on the target object trajectory for real-world deployment. On marker-pen and hammer manipulation tasks, DexTaG learns natural, contact-rich behaviors that baselines with distance-based contact heuristics fail to learn, generalizes to held-out trajectories of the same object and task, and outperforms single-trajectory baselines on OakInk2.

</details>


### [1986] [Residual Learning-Based Control of Vehicle Platoons with $\ell_2$ Stability Guarantees via Recurrent Equilibrium Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33892)
*Brian Delgado,Anh-Tu Nguyen,Hamid Taghavifar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于残差学习的异构车队控制框架：以LMI设计的标称控制器与扰动观测器补偿为基础，叠加离线训练的循环均衡网络（REN）作为残差补偿器。REN被约束满足指定ℓ2增益界，从而导出局部闭环稳定性与扰动弦稳定性的充分小增益条件。实验表明其间距与速度误差优于标称控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构车队同时面临参数不确定性与外部扰动，传统基于LMI的标称控制器虽可保证稳定性，但在模型失配与非理想工况下跟踪精度有限；而直接使用学习控制器又难以提供稳定性与弦稳定性的理论保证。因此需要一个兼具性能提升与可证明稳定性保障的控制框架。

Method: 框架由两部分组成：一是通过线性矩阵不等式（LMI）设计的标称控制器并辅以扰动观测器补偿；二是离线训练的循环均衡网络（REN），利用存储的轨迹数据与标称模型预测误差进行残差学习。REN在结构上被约束满足预先设定的ℓ2增益上界，据此建立局部闭环稳定性与扰动弦稳定性的充分小增益条件。

Result: 实验结果表明，相比仅使用标称控制器的方案，该残差学习框架有效降低了车队车辆的间距误差与速度误差。

Conclusion: 将LMI标称控制、扰动观测器补偿与受ℓ2增益约束的REN残差学习相结合，可在异构车队存在参数不确定性与外部扰动时同时实现性能提升与稳定性/弦稳定性的可证明保证，是一种兼顾理论严谨性与实际控制效果的方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes a residual learning-based control framework for heterogeneous vehicle platoons subject to parametric uncertainty and external disturbances. A nominal controller designed via Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs), along with disturbance-observer compensation, is enhanced by a Recurrent Equilibrium Network (REN) trained offline using stored trajectories and nominal-model prediction errors. The REN is constrained to satisfy a prescribed $\ell_2$-gain bound, enabling sufficient small-gain conditions for local closed-loop stability and disturbance string stability. Experiments demonstrate reduced spacing and velocity errors relative to the nominal controller.

</details>


### [1987] [ReSync: Re-Aligning the Two Clocks of Asynchronous World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33944)
*Xi Lin,Feihong Zhang,Yulong Shi,Yanghong Mei,Zuxing Lu,Xiaofan Zhu,Zihao Liang,Zhirui Gao,Zhaowen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文从"双时钟"异步推理视角刻画世界-动作模型中动作流与视频流的调度错位，提出可由采样计划直接读取的"承诺-证据差"（commitment-evidence gap），并据此设计无需改参、无需候选比较的推理方法 ReSync，在RoboCasa等基准上取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型普遍采用动作与视频分调度去噪：动作流少步快速解码以保证控制实时性，视频流多步去噪以保证未来预测清晰。这一设计虽有意为之，却使两流处于不同"时钟"，导致动作已可执行时，支撑该动作的未来画面尚未充分解析。作者希望形式化这种异步推理带来的错位，并回答"额外的世界计算是否总是更优"这一问题。

Method: 作者将异步推理形式化为双时钟视角，并提出承诺-证据差：该量直接从模型自身的采样计划读取，而非通过搜索测量。基于该指标观察候选效用可辨识性与额外候选采样、推进世界流之间的收益交叉关系，进而提出 ReSync 方法——保持动作状态不变，只在"支撑窗口"内推进一步世界流，随后恢复原生去噪流程。方法不改动任何参数，也不进行候选比较。

Result: 承诺-证据差具有预测性：差值扩大时，候选效用更难辨识、额外候选采样收益递减，而推进世界流收益上升，二者存在交叉点；因此更多世界计算并非单调更优，有效区间两端均封闭，且两端均可在 rollout 前由采样计划读出。在冻结的配对 RoboCasa 面板上，ReSync 将成功率提升 4.48 个百分点；而同等算力但仅等待、不推进世界流的对照无提升。同一规则无需重新调参即可迁移到第二个基准与第二个骨干网络。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了世界-动作模型异步推理中动作与视频流时钟错位的本质，用可预读的承诺-证据差刻画有效计算窗口，并以极简的 ReSync 干预在窗口内分配算力，实现跨基准、跨骨干的稳定增益，说明"世界计算越多越好"并不成立。

Abstract: Jointly generating future video and actions has become a standard recipe for world-action models, and the strongest systems denoise the two streams on separate schedules: actions are decoded in few steps so control stays fast, while the video stream runs longer to keep the predicted future sharp. The design is deliberate, but it leaves the two streams on different clocks, and an action can become executable while the future that should justify it is still largely unresolved. We formalize this as a two-clock view of asynchronous inference and introduce the commitment-evidence gap, a quantity read directly from a model's own sampling schedule rather than measured by search. The gap is predictive: as it widens, candidate utility becomes harder to identify and extra candidate sampling buys less, while advancing the world stream buys more, and the two cross. Spending more world computation is therefore not simply better. The useful interval is closed at both ends, and both ends can be read off the schedule before any rollout. ReSync places the computation inside it: hold the action state, advance only the world within the supported window, then resume native denoising. No parameters change and no candidates are compared. On a frozen paired RoboCasa panel this improves success by 4.48 points, while an equal-compute control that waits without advancing the world does not move, and the same rule transfers to a second benchmark and a second backbone without retuning.

</details>


### [1988] [Integrity Detection and Characterization of Malicious Injections in RAVEN II](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33951)
*Xingli Zhang,Diba Afroze,Fei Hu,Xiali Hei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文刻画了RAVEN II手术机器人上恶意注入的检测边界，揭示了注入偏差的时间分布对可检测性的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术机器人集成越来越多传感器、控制器与模型驱动组件，攻击面扩大；一旦完整性被破坏，可能导致非预期行为并威胁患者安全。现有工作缺乏对注入偏差可检测性边界（尤其是时间分布影响）的系统刻画。

Method: 基于公开数据集（RAVEN II遥测数据+外部高分辨率编码器真值），识别跨命令路径与观测路径的三个注入点；设计三种时间弥散度递增的注入模式；在窗口尺度与会话尺度两个时间尺度上执行检测；不采用任意阈值，而是对每个注入点和模式量化在维持手术可接受告警率下可分辨的最小末端执行器偏差。

Result: 可检测性强烈受注入偏差在时间上如何分布的影响：突变的阶跃注入可在远低于1 mm临床容差的偏差下被检测到；而同样的总体偏差若分散到整个窗口或整个会话，则可能躲过单窗口统计的检测。

Conclusion: 注入偏差的时间弥散度显著改变了检测边界，单一时间尺度的统计方法存在盲区；手术机器人完整性监控需结合多时间尺度分析。开源代码已发布于GitHub。

Abstract: The increasing adoption of robotic systems in surgery, together with the expanding range of procedures they can support and the growing level of autonomy they provide, has substantially increased the complexity of surgical robots. As these systems integrate more sensors, controllers, communication interfaces, and model-driven control components, their attack surface continues to expand. A compromise of the integrity of a surgical robot can therefore cause unintended robot behavior and potentially threaten patient safety.
  In this paper, we characterize the detection boundary of malicious injections on RAVEN II using a public dataset that pairs the platform's telemetry with external high-resolution encoder ground truth. We identify three injection points spanning the command and observation paths and evaluate three injection patterns with increasing temporal dispersion. To capture different detection behaviors, we perform detection at two timescales: the window scale and the session scale. Rather than reporting detection rates at an arbitrarily chosen threshold, we quantify, for each injection point and injection pattern, the smallest end-effector deviation that can be resolved while maintaining an alarm rate acceptable for surgical operation. Our results show that detectability is strongly influenced by how the injected deviation is distributed over time. An abrupt step can be detected at deviations well below the 1 mm clinical tolerance, whereas the same overall deviation spread across a window or a session can remain hidden from single-window statistics. The open source code can be found at http://github.com/RAVENIIROS/RAVENIIIntegrity.

</details>


### [1989] [FINGR: Learning Dexterous Hand Control for Real-World Rubik's Cube Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33973)
*Yutong Liang,Quanquan Peng,Matthew Kim,Xiaolong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出FINGR策略，结合手指相对几何表示与多尺度未来交互预测监督，实现单只灵巧手连续转动魔方层，真实手300次尝试成功率99.0%，并配合抓取与桌面辅助重抓完成全部10个打乱二阶魔方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用单只灵巧手操作魔方是持续、接触丰富的控制难题：每次转层需部分手指支撑魔方、其余手指推动活动层、释放接触并为下一动作复位，手指间协调与接触时序要求高，现有策略难以稳定完成连续转层。

Method: FINGR（Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations）：共享点编码器以指尖为参照表达魔方点云并聚合，不依赖小块（cubie）索引；学习得到的future token共享观测编码器，在多个时间尺度上接受接触力变化、转层进度与手指关节位移的监督；所得表征条件化一个flow策略，直接生成手指动作。

Result: 真实灵巧手上300次转层尝试成功率达99.0%，基线flow策略为79.7%；与抓取及桌面辅助重抓集成后，成功解出全部10个打乱的2×2×2魔方，完整系统平均耗时约137秒。

Conclusion: 几何相对表示与多尺度未来交互预测监督能显著提升接触丰富灵巧操作的成功率，并可与抓取、重抓模块组合成端到端系统，完成完整魔方求解任务。

Abstract: Manipulating a Rubik's Cube with a single dexterous hand is a challenging test of sustained, contact-rich control: the hand must execute successive layer turns while keeping the cube secure. Each turn requires some fingers to support the cube while others push a moving layer, release contact, and reset for the next move. To learn this coordination, we introduce FINGR (Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations), a policy that combines finger-relative geometry with future interaction prediction. A shared point encoder expresses the cube relative to each fingertip and aggregates its points without depending on cubie indexing. Learned future tokens share the observation encoder and receive supervision for contact-force changes, layer-turn progress, and finger joint displacement at multiple time scales. The resulting representation conditions a flow policy that directly generates finger actions. On a real dexterous hand, our policy achieves 99.0% success over 300 turn attempts, compared with 79.7% for the base flow policy. Integrated with grasping and table-assisted regrasping, the policy solves all ten scrambled $2\times2\times2$ cubes in a mean complete-system time of approximately 137 seconds. The project website is available at https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/FINGR

</details>


### [1990] [TacGooseBumps (TacGB): Retrofitting Normal-Only Tactile Sensors with Shear Encoding for Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34006)
*Wenjie Li,Binyu Yang,Yuxin Chen,Ambrose Wang,Masayoshi Tomizuka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出被动穹顶薄膜 TacGB，将切向受载机械编码为压力图变化，无需标定剪切测量即可提升接触丰富任务的模仿学习策略表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富任务中，不同物理状态外观相似却需要不同动作：相机难以分辨连接器是否对齐或完全就位，而仅能感知法向压力的触觉传感器容易遗漏垂直于抓取方向的切向交互，该交互恰是区分这些状态的关键。论文追问：学习策略是否需要标定的剪切测量，还是只需要一种可重复、能区分剪切相关接触状态的观测。

Method: 设计 TacGooseBumps（TacGB）——一种被动穹顶薄膜，通过机械方式把切向受载编码为现有传感器压力图中的图案变化。切向力使每个穹顶倾斜，从而在其足印范围内重新分布压力。端到端策略直接消费由此产生的压力图，无需额外电子器件、力重建或逐触元（taxel）级穹顶对齐。在四个模仿学习任务和两种数据采集流程上评估。

Result: TacGB 在目标达成度、效率和接触质量上均有提升：插入成功率最多提高 36 个百分点，且成功插入完成更快；易碎物体放置更轻柔，绘图更连续、更笔直。信号分析、分阶段分析、失效模式分析和轨迹分析表明，这些增益来自视觉与法向压力难以分辨任务相关切向交互的接触状态区间。

Conclusion: 剪切无需被度量式测量即可惠及机器人学习；它可以被机械编码，且不改变底层触觉传感器和策略的压力图输入格式。

Abstract: Contact-rich policies often fail because distinct physical states look alike yet require different actions. Cameras may not reveal whether a connector is aligned or fully seated, while many normal-only tactile sensors can miss the tangential interactions perpendicular to the grasping direction that distinguish these states. We ask whether a learning policy needs calibrated shear measurements, or only a repeatable observation that separates shear-dependent contact states. We introduce TacGooseBumps (TacGB), a passive domed film that mechanically encodes tangential loading as pattern changes in an existing sensor's pressure map. Tangential loading tilts each dome and redistributes pressure across its footprint; an end-to-end policy consumes the resulting maps without added electronics, force reconstruction, or taxel-level dome alignment. Across four imitation-learning tasks and two data-collection pipelines, TacGB improves goal attainment, efficiency, and contact quality: insertion success increases by up to 36 percentage points, and successful insertions are completed faster, while fragile-object placement becomes gentler and drawing becomes more continuous and straight. Signal, stage-wise, failure-mode, and trajectory analyses link these gains to contact regimes in which task-relevant tangential interactions are poorly resolved by vision and normal pressure alone. Together, these results show that shear need not be measured metrically to benefit robot learning; it can instead be mechanically encoded without changing the underlying tactile sensor or the policy's pressure-map input format.

</details>


### [1991] [Estimate, Don't Imitate: Reusing Differentiable State-Based Policies for Visuomotor Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34018)
*Denis Shcherba,Adrian Abel,Eckart Cobo-Briesewitz,Paul Mattes,Wojciech Samek,Marc Toussaint*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种视觉状态估计器训练方法，通过直接状态监督与经冻结可微专家反传的动作一致性损失，实现从特权专家到部分观测部署的高效迁移，在五项操作任务上优于像素到动作的模仿，并在真实Panda机器人上达到76%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真训练的操作策略可依赖特权状态信息学习接触丰富的技能，但部署时只能使用噪声相机图像等部分观测。既有方案（师生蒸馏或仅重构状态）存在冗余学习或目标错配问题：最小化状态估计误差并不等于最小化其引发的下游控制误差。

Method: 复用基于状态的专家策略（保持冻结且可微），仅学习视觉状态估计器作为感知接口。训练目标包含两部分：直接状态监督，以及通过冻结可微专家反传的动作一致性损失。采用调度式目标，先建立物理意义明确的状态估计，再逐步加大影响专家动作的误差权重。

Result: 在五个目标条件操作任务中，保留专家（仅学感知接口）的方案一致优于对同一专家示范语料进行直接的像素到动作模仿。进一步在实体Panda机器人上完成仿真到真实迁移，在未重新训练专家的情况下取得76%成功率。

Conclusion: 通过动作一致性损失将状态估计与下游控制目标对齐，并保留可微特权专家，可在不重训专家前提下显著提升视觉操作策略的样本效率与部署性能，并具备可行的真实世界迁移能力。

Abstract: Simulation-trained manipulation policies can exploit privileged state information to learn effective contact-rich behaviours, but deployment requires acting from partial observations such as noisy camera images. A common solution is teacher-student distillation, in which a visuomotor policy is trained to reproduce the actions of the privileged expert. This requires the student to jointly infer the task-relevant state and relearn the expert's action mapping that is already available. An alternative is to reuse the state-based expert and learn only a perceptual interface that reconstructs its missing state inputs. However, minimising the state estimate error alone does not necessarily minimise the downstream control error induced by these estimates. To bridge this gap, we train a visual state estimator using both direct state supervision and an action-consistency loss backpropagated through the frozen, differentiable expert. A scheduled objective first establishes a physically meaningful state estimate and progressively emphasises errors that affect the expert's actions. Across five goal-conditioned manipulation tasks, retaining the expert consistently outperforms direct pixel-to-action imitation from the same expert demonstration corpus. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on a physical Panda robot, achieving 76% success without retraining the underlying expert.

</details>


### [1992] [Beyond Retrieval Relevance: Scene-Grounded Risk Entailment for Vision-Language Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34145)
*Jiaxin Liu,Ruilin Yu,Liang Peng,Jingkai Wang,Chengxiang Zhao,Zhenxin Zhu,Bing Wang,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye,Hong Wang,Jun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出在VLM决策前引入驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG）与SWRL推理阶段，用结构化感知实例化场景事实并推导事件与有向风险关系，将可触发的规则证据用于条件化VLM与扩散规划器，从而弥合RAG中"相关但不适用"的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG为视觉-语言驾驶系统提供外部安全知识，但检索到的风险规则可能语义相关却不适用于当前场景；VLM需自行完成目标grounding、跨时间实体绑定与关系验证，风险结论的支撑是隐式的，存在"相关性-适用性"鸿沟。

Method: 构建驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG），并在VLM决策前加入SWRL推理阶段：结构化感知实例化场景事实，当前件联合满足时由SWRL规则推导事件与有向风险关系；被识别的事件、绑定后的风险关系及激活规则的语义描述构成紧凑证据，用于条件化VLM与扩散规划器。

Result: 在nuReasoning的匹配对比中，相较基于相关性检索的基线，NPS提升1.30分，NC（非自身过失碰撞分数）提升2.76分。

Conclusion: 结果表明，相比语义检索得到的风险知识，场景可适用的风险证据能更有效地改善以安全为权重的规划表现。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives vision--language driving systems access to external safety knowledge, yet a retrieved risk rule may be relevant without applying to the current scene. A vision--language model (VLM) receiving such knowledge must ground objects, bind entities across time, and verify relations before deciding how to act, leaving the support for risk conclusions implicit. We address this relevance--applicability gap with a Driving-Risk Knowledge Graph (DRKG) and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) reasoning stage before VLM decision-making. Structured perception instantiates scene facts, from which SWRL rules derive events and directed risk relations when their antecedents are jointly satisfied. Recognized events, bound risk relations, and semantic descriptions of activated rules form compact evidence that conditions the VLM and diffusion planner. In matched comparisons on nuReasoning, our method improved the nuReasoning planning score (NPS) by 1.30 points and the non-at-fault collision score (NC) by 2.76 points over the relevance retrieval-based baseline. These gains indicate that scene-applicable risk evidence improves safety-weighted planning relative to semantically retrieved risk knowledge.

</details>


### [1993] [Reliability-Aware Sparse Route Memory for Round-Trip Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34163)
*Bojun Long,Lingfan Bao,Tianhu Peng,Jingcheng Sun,Chengxu Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究连续往返式视觉语言导航（Round-trip VLN），诊断出方向可观测性、偏航恢复与终止稳定性三类失效，并提出了"可靠性感知稀疏路径记忆"方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN通常被评估为单向任务，但实际部署的机器人到达目标后往往需要返回，这一往返场景尚未被充分研究。

Method: 将去程（Outbound）轨迹记录为有序几何锚点，通过结构化提示反向查询这些锚点，并结合动作级仲裁与终止验证，构建在线系统。

Result: 在50个反向配对回合上，仅凭语言的Return成功率为22.0%，本文在线系统达到55.1%；若给定精确路径信息，相同接口可达86.0%。

Conclusion: 有效的返回既需要准确的信息，也需要与该信息一致的动作；剩余在线差距主要源于几何证据可靠性不足而无法授权干预。信息质量、行为一致性与在线可靠性是长时程导航中三个独立的限制因素。

Abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated as a one-way task, although deployed robots may need to return after reaching a goal. We study continuous round-trip VLN and diagnose failures in directional observability, deviation recovery, and termination stability. We propose a reliability-aware sparse route memory that records the executed Outbound trajectory as ordered geometric anchors and queries them in reverse through a structured hint, action-level arbitration, and terminal verification. On 50 reverse-paired episodes using NaVILA and a simulated Unitree Go2, language-only Return succeeds in 22.0% of episodes, while our online system reaches 55.1%. With exact route information, the same interfaces achieve 86.0%, showing that effective Return requires both accurate information and consistent action on that information. The remaining online gap arises mainly from geometric evidence that is too unreliable to authorise intervention. These results distinguish information quality, behavioural consistency, and online reliability as separate limits in long-horizon navigation.

</details>


### [1994] [RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34170)
*Yuhan Chen,Ke Yu,Pengfei Liu,Shuxun Wang,Yi Yang,Linchao Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RAVEL是一个异步推理框架，通过滚动缓冲与VLM编码解耦，降低流匹配VLA模型的推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配VLA模型虽在通用机器人操作中表现优异，但依赖高开销的VLM编码与多步迭代动作生成，导致显著推理延迟，难以在动态环境中快速响应。

Method: RAVEL采用异步推理框架，针对VLM主干与动作专家两方面瓶颈：通过滚动缓冲将部分去噪的未来动作前推，使近期动作仅需一步去噪即可执行；将VLM编码与滚动动作生成解耦，令动作专家持续使用最新可用的VLM上下文；并引入轻量快速观测通路（FOP）直接以当前观测为动作专家提供条件。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务中，RAVEL在保持底层VLA任务能力的同时，持续实现显著更低的响应延迟，支持高频、响应式的闭环控制。

Conclusion: RAVEL通过异步化与滚动去噪有效缓解VLA推理延迟瓶颈，兼顾任务性能与实时控制能力。

Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models are highly effective for generalist robot manipulation, yet their reliance on computationally expensive VLM encoding and multi-step iterative action generation imposes a significant latency bottleneck. The resulting inference latency makes it difficult for robots to respond quickly, especially in dynamic environments. We address this limitation with RAVEL (Rolling Asynchronous VLA Enabling Low-Latency Control), an asynchronous inference framework that addresses the computational bottlenecks of both the VLM backbone and the action expert. To reduce the delay from multi-step action denoising, RAVEL allows near-term actions to be executed after a single denoising step by carrying partially denoised future actions forward in a rolling buffer. To avoid blocking on slow VLM encoding, RAVEL decouples VLM encoding from rolling action generation, allowing the action expert to operate continuously using the latest available VLM context, while a lightweight Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) directly conditions the action expert on current observations. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, RAVEL consistently achieves substantially lower response latency while maintaining the task capability of the underlying VLA, enabling high-frequency and responsive closed-loop control.

</details>


### [1995] [FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34175)
*Peng Yu,Jiacheng Wang,Ziheng Zhang,Xuchong Zhang,Baoting Li,Zhuoyuan Yu,Yuxiang Chen,Tiancai Wang,Hongbin Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FailPatch：一种面向VLA策略的失败驱动残差修补框架，通过解耦动作监督与执行可靠性监督，在冻结策略的动作隐空间注入门控残差专家库，仅0.52%可训练参数即显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略通常依赖成功示范进行适配，虽提供直接动作监督，但极少覆盖易失败状态；部署阶段的失败虽能暴露这些状态，却缺乏传统监督学习所需的纠正动作标注。

Method: 解耦动作监督（成功示范定义应如何动作）与执行可靠性监督（部署轨迹指示行为何时不可靠）。基于动作隐表示在可靠与失败相关状态间具有清晰线性可分性且直接条件化动作生成的观察，在冻结VLA策略的动作隐空间引入Null-gated Residual Expert Bank（空门控残差专家库）。采用统一的Preserve–Redirect–Trust目标：在可靠状态保留原策略，在失败相关状态选择残差专家，并在有界干预下将表示从失败区域重定向至成功相关区域。

Result: 仅0.52%可训练参数，在四项长时程RoboTwin任务上干净评测成功率提升11.0个百分点，干净到随机泛化提升9.5个百分点；在三个真实世界任务上较基线提升16.7个百分点。

Conclusion: FailPatch以极少参数实现失败驱动的有界残差修补，验证了从部署失败中提取可靠性监督、并在隐空间进行表示重定向的有效性，显著提升VLA策略的成功率与泛化能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically adapted using successful demonstrations, which provide direct action supervision but rarely cover failure-prone states. Deployment failures expose these states, yet lack the corrective actions needed for conventional supervised learning. We propose FailPatch, a failure-driven residual patching framework that decouples action supervision from execution-reliability supervision. Successful demonstrations ground how the policy should act, while deployment trajectories indicate when its behavior becomes unreliable. We further observe that action hidden representations exhibit clear linear separability between reliable and failure-associated states while directly conditioning action generation. Building on these insights, FailPatch introduces a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank into the action hidden space of a frozen VLA policy. A unified Preserve--Redirect--Trust objective retains the original policy in reliable states, selects residual experts in failure-associated states and redirects representations from failure regions toward success-associated regions under bounded intervention. With only 0.52% trainable parameters, FailPatch improves success rates by 11.0 percentage points on four long-horizon RoboTwin tasks under clean evaluation, 9.5 percentage points under clean-to-random generalization, and 16.7 percentage points over the baseline across three real-world tasks. Project and code: https://github.com/yupeng-2003/FailPatch.

</details>


### [1996] [Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34182)
*Wenqiao Li,Qianyou Zhao,Jiawen Hao,Xuezhou Zhu,Tengyu Liu,Kaifeng Zhang,Chuan Wen,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出UVTA数据集与统一视觉-触觉-动作模型（Uni-VTA），利用人类触觉演示提升机器人灵巧操作策略，在五项接触密集任务上平均成功率达70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作需要触觉反馈，但机器人触觉演示难以规模化：灵巧手遥操作向操作者提供的触觉反馈有限。相比之下，人类演示是更具扩展性的多样化触觉交互来源。其核心前提是：手可以不同，但交互背后的物理规律不变。

Method: 首先构建同步记录图像、触觉信号与手部动作的触觉动作捕捉系统，据此建立UVTA数据集，覆盖五项接触密集任务、1000个人类演示（涵盖多样交互模式）及每任务150个机器人演示。进而提出统一视觉-触觉-动作模型，将两种具身映射到对齐的触觉与动作表征，并联合预测未来动作与触觉轨迹；该联合目标使人类演示可监督接触感知表征学习，部署时仅执行机器人动作。

Result: 在五项真实机器人任务评估中，方法平均成功率为70%，优于最强视觉-触觉基线（29%）和架构消融版本（42%）。性能随人类演示增加持续提升，在每任务1000个演示时仍未饱和。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了可扩展的人类触觉数据对灵巧操作的有效性，表明借助人类演示实现跨具身的物理规律迁移是提升机器人接触密集操作策略的可行路径。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile feedback.However, robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. Project page is available at https://uni-vta.github.io/.

</details>


### [1997] [WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34199)
*Chuan Qin,Shaoting Zhu,Siyuan Luo,Siqiao Huang,Hongyu Zhao,Hang Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出WB-WAM（世界动作模型），将显式全身动作监督引入生成式视频预训练，通过统一物理动作空间整合异构人体/机器人数据，在仿真与真实机器人上实现高效全身移动操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人的移动操作需要身体与手部协调运动，但传统机器人预训练数据对这类全身运动覆盖有限；同时真实机器人演示数据稀缺，亟需利用异构人体运动数据补充。

Method: 构建共享物理动作空间，统一身体、根节点与灵巧手标注；基于1880.2小时部分标注的视频与运动数据进行视频-动作联合学习；通过PICO中训练精炼先验，并借助辅助前向运动学监督适配机器人任务；构建WB-Datasets，包含重定向的自我中心人类演示与机器人轨迹。

Result: 仿真中HumanoidArena达81.9%，真实世界五项任务平均成功率84.0%；任务对齐的PICO中训练提升下游性能并减少真机演示需求。

Conclusion: 异构全身预训练与人体运动迁移是通往数据高效人形移动操作的一条可行路径。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.

</details>


### [1998] [RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34210)
*Haitong Ma,Chenxiao Gao,Rushi Qiang,Na Li,Bo Dai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RLE-Bench，一个面向机器人学习（robot-learning）的基准测试，覆盖交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计四类开发工作流，用任务特定指标评估编码智能体产出的工件，并汇总为 RLE Index 与能力画像，辅以案例分析揭示能力与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人基准多聚焦单一工件（如策略或控制器）的性能，覆盖面窄，无法衡量编码智能体在真实机器人工程中的更广泛能力：在资源约束下构建、集成、诊断与改进异构工件，并从多模态反馈中推理。因此需要一个能系统评估编码智能体跨工作流工程能力的基准。

Method: 构建 RLE-Bench：设计横跨四类代表性机器人开发工作流——交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计——的机器人学习任务；采用多样的任务特定指标评估智能体提交的工件（成功率达到所训练的策略智能体、所构建的测试装置、所设计的机械结构等）；将这些指标聚合为统一的 RLE Index，并给出按工作流划分的能力画像，以支持跨能力维度的系统比较；同时对代表性任务开展深入案例分析，考察智能体行为。

Result: 给出了可跨能力维度系统比较编码智能体的 RLE Index 排名与工作流特定的能力画像；案例分析刻画了智能体在代表性任务上的行为，既呈现当前能力也暴露局限，并指出机器人任务对未来智能体训练的机会。

Conclusion: RLE-Bench 将机器人评估从单一工件性能扩展到多工作流的工程能力评估，为编码智能体的系统对比与能力诊断提供了统一框架，并揭示机器人任务作为未来智能体训练来源的价值。

Abstract: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics. Existing robotics benchmarks, however, primarily focus on the performance of individual artifacts, such as policies or controllers, offering limited coverage of coding agents' broader engineering capabilities. Real-world robotics extends beyond control: agents must build, integrate, diagnose, and improve heterogeneous artifacts under resource constraints and reason from multimodal feedback. To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed. We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions. Beyond performance ranks, we also conduct in-depth case studies examining agent behavior on representative tasks, highlighting both current capabilities and limitations, and pointing to the opportunities robotics tasks have to offer for future agent training.

</details>


### [1999] [Proprioceptive Force Estimation for Quadruped Locomotion and Human-Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34222)
*Run Wang,Xu Yang,Alapati Tuerxun,Yilin Mo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出将本体感觉历史推断的三维力估计同时用于支撑负载适应与牵引引导，通过联合训练估计器与运动策略实现统一力接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人运动时需承受有效载荷力，同时牵引绳力可用于指定期望运动，作者探究能否用同一共享的牛顿级三维力估计支持这两类任务。

Method: 联合训练力估计器与运动策略，采用监督力与速度输出并学习潜在上下文；估计力用于条件化运动，并通过解析映射生成平面速度与偏航角速率指令以实现牵引引导。

Result: 持续负载仿真扫描中，分量力RMSE时间均值范围为1.44至2.83 N；相较域随机化基线，速度跟踪与基座朝向误差分数分别降低21.6%与46.5%，平均存活率由68.29%提升至94.60%。Unitree Go1实验验证了静止垂直/水平力估计、承载超过70 N训练力上限的8.5 kg负载运动，以及使用同一力估计接口的牵引引导。

Conclusion: 共享三维力估计接口可同时支持负载适应与牵引引导，并在仿真与真机实验中验证了其有效性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Payload forces must be accommodated during locomotion, while leash forces can specify desired motion. We investigate whether a shared three-dimensional force estimate in newtons, inferred from proprioceptive history under sustained loading, can support both tasks. An estimator and locomotion policy are jointly trained with supervised force and velocity outputs and learned latent context. The estimated force conditions locomotion and additionally generates planar-velocity and yaw-rate commands for leash guidance through an analytical map. In sustained-force simulation sweeps, temporal means of componentwise force root mean square error range from 1.44 to 2.83\,N. Compared with a domain-randomized baseline, the framework reduces velocity-tracking and base-orientation error scores by 21.6\% and 46.5\%, respectively, and increases mean survival from 68.29\% to 94.60\% in separate sustained-force tests. Unitree Go1 experiments demonstrate stationary vertical and horizontal force estimation, locomotion with an 8.5\,kg payload whose weight exceeds the 70\,N training force limit, and leash guidance using the same force-estimation interface.

</details>


### [2000] [GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34233)
*Yuefan Wang,Huaicheng Zhou,Xiao He,Zhijie He,Mingchuan Yang,Huayi Zhang,Li Chai,Jinxin Liu,Donglin Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一学习框架GAE，实现通用、低延迟的人形机器人全身遥操作，通过大规模异构人体动作数据、两阶段训练与延迟条件化预测机制，在Unitree G1与Westlake O1上实现多样敏捷动作的平滑复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形化身需通过遥操作机器人延伸人类在场能力，但现有系统难以同时满足多样化动态全身行为与响应式人机同步的需求。

Method: 构建来自视频、动画与动捕的异构大规模人体动作数据集并进行标准化与增强；采用两阶段训练：先训练特权生成器策略在仿真中跟踪人体动作参考并生成可行的机器人轨迹，再训练可部署执行器策略在课程域随机化下跟踪生成轨迹；引入延迟条件化的预判机制自适应补偿端到端延迟。

Result: 在Unitree G1与Westlake O1机器人上的仿真与真机实验表明，GAE可使机器人平滑复现多样、敏捷且富有表现力的人体行为。

Conclusion: GAE为通用低延迟人形全身遥操作提供了统一的学习框架，验证了异构数据与两阶段训练结合延迟补偿机制的有效性。

Abstract: Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors. Project website: https://wangyf0928.github.io/gae-wlrobotics/

</details>


### [2001] [WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34250)
*Panjun Liu,Xiaohan Lei,Shiqi Zhang,Yikun Wang,Yongxin Zhang,Mingyi Hu,Shida Sun,Jiateng Shou,Wengang Zhou,Jiajun Deng,Zhiwei Xiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出WAM-OPD，将on-policy蒸馏用于预训练世界动作模型，并引入prefix-weighted trajectory replay（PWTR）以避免蒸馏过程中重复的环境交互，从而在提升目标任务性能的同时保留预训练技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练世界动作模型具备跨多种机器人操作任务的通用能力，但要在不损害预训练技能的前提下将目标任务性能提升至专家水平仍很困难。传统方法直接让模型拟合狭窄的任务特定数据分布，易造成预训练能力退化。on-policy蒸馏虽能在学生自身诱导分布下迁移教师知识，但在闭环操作中观察历史随策略演化而变化，需反复环境rollout以保持on-policy，这在仿真中代价高昂、在真实机器人上往往不可行。

Method: 作者提出WAM-OPD，采用on-policy蒸馏将任务特定教师知识迁移到预训练世界动作模型。为免除蒸馏期间重复的环境rollout，进一步提出prefix-weighted trajectory replay（PWTR）：使用由初始学生rollout为主、辅以任务特定教师rollout构成的固定轨迹池以拓宽轨迹覆盖；对池中每条轨迹，以连续存储的历史为条件让当前策略生成新的去噪路径，并由任务特定教师沿路径提供监督。由于去噪路径随策略演化而刷新但环境轨迹固定，PWTR利用每个决策点前轨迹前缀上累积的路径分数推导代理重要性权重，对逐决策蒸馏损失重新加权，以缓解历史分布偏移。

Result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，WAM-OPD可在蒸馏期间不进行额外环境交互的情况下实现任务适应。在两种设置下，WAM-OPD均提升了目标任务性能，同时在未纳入适应的任务上保持接近初始的性能。

Conclusion: WAM-OPD结合on-policy蒸馏与PWTR，在不增加蒸馏期环境交互的前提下实现了对预训练世界动作模型的目标任务高效适应，并有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，兼顾性能提升与预训练技能保留。

Abstract: Pretrained world action models (WAMs) provide generalist capabilities across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet improving target-task performance to an expert level without degrading pretrained skills remains challenging. We explore on-policy distillation (OPD) for WAMs and introduce WAM-OPD. WAM-OPD inherits the advantage of OPD methods that transfer task-specific teacher knowledge under the student's own induced distribution, rather than directly fitting the student to a narrow task-specific data distribution. However, in closed-loop manipulation, the observation histories change as the student policy evolves, requiring fresh environment rollouts to remain on-policy. Applying OPD to WAMs entails repeated data collection, which is costly even in simulation and often impractical on real robots. To avoid repeated environment rollouts during distillation, we introduce prefix-weighted trajectory replay (PWTR). PWTR uses a fixed trajectory pool composed primarily of initial-student rollouts, supplemented with task-specific teacher rollouts to broaden trajectory coverage. For each trajectory replayed from this pool, PWTR conditions the current policy on successive stored histories to generate fresh denoising paths, along which the task-specific teacher provides supervision. Although these denoising paths are refreshed as the policy evolves, the replayed environment trajectories remain fixed. PWTR therefore reweights per-decision distillation losses using proxy importance weights derived from path scores accumulated over the trajectory prefix preceding each decision to mitigate the resulting shift in the history distribution. Simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate task adaptation without additional environment interaction during distillation. In both settings, WAM-OPD improves target-task performance while retaining near-initial performance on tasks excluded from adaptation.

</details>


### [2002] [UMR: Universal Manipulation Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34256)
*Song Liu,Linyi Li,Yanshun Zhao,Rxuan Li,Xinrui Xu,Yi Ju,Yahui Deng,Senge Zhang,Guoyu Liu,Yixuan Li,Wuyang Zhang,Yao Li,Congcong Zhu,Jingrun Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一动作表示UMR（世界流+自我轨迹），实例化为0.5B的WEPVLA策略，配合数据高效策略DES，实现从人类演示到异构机器人的零样本技能迁移，仿真与真机均取得高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用具身操作需要跨本体、易扩展的统一动作表示，但现有策略依赖本体特定的动作空间，导致跨本体演示数据难以大规模利用，并限制了向新本体和空间变化的迁移。

Method: 提出UMR，将操作分解为两个功能不同但几何关联的组件：本体无关的World Flow（世界坐标系下任务相关物体运动）与Ego Trajectory（相对当前位姿的末端执行器运动）；以WEPVLA实例化，0.5B参数策略，通过双流Point Action Adapter与统一Point Action Expert在统一几何动作空间学习，并用SE(3)共轭耦合两组件；辅以DES，通过阶段感知的点云编辑丰富物体配置同时保留演示的接触几何。

Result: 仿真中WEPVLA在LIBERO上平均成功率97.5%，在10任务RLBench上85.7%；真机实验中，单一策略仅用DES增强的人类演示训练即可零样本迁移到多样部署条件，每任务约10分钟人类演示、无机器人演示，在六种评测设置下平均成功率91.7%，对比HumanEgo的60.8%。

Conclusion: UMR作为统一动作表示可有效弥合人类演示与异构机器人之间的鸿沟，支持零样本技能迁移，并在仿真与真实环境中显著优于基线，验证了表示设计与数据高效策略的有效性。

Abstract: General-purpose embodied manipulation hinges on a unified action representation that generalizes across embodiments and scales readily. Yet existing policies rely on embodiment-specific action spaces, making cross-embodiment demonstrations difficult to leverage at scale and limiting transfer to new embodiments and spatial variations. To this end, we introduce Universal Manipulation Representation (UMR), a unified action representation that enables zero-shot skill transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots. UMR decomposes manipulation into two functionally distinct yet geometrically linked components: embodiment-agnostic World Flow, which describes task-relevant object motion in the world frame, and Ego Trajectory, which represents end-effector motion relative to the current pose. We instantiate UMR as World--Ego Point VLA (WEPVLA), a compact 0.5B-parameter policy that learns in the unified geometric action space through a dual-stream Point Action Adapter and a unified Point Action Expert, with an $SE(3)$ conjugation coupling the two components. To improve data efficiency, we complement UMR with a Data-Efficient Strategy (DES) that diversifies object configurations through stage-aware point-cloud editing while preserving demonstrated contact geometry. In simulation, WEPVLA achieves average success rates of 97.5\% on LIBERO and 85.7\% on the 10-task RLBench benchmark. In real-world experiments, a single policy trained on human demonstrations augmented by DES transfers zero-shot to diverse deployment conditions. With about 10 minutes of collected human demonstrations per task and no robot demonstrations, it achieves 91.7\% average success across six evaluation settings, compared with 60.8\% for HumanEgo. Code and additional materials are available at https://umr-wepvla.github.io/.

</details>


### [2003] [RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34261)
*Fangcheng Liu,Yeqing Shen,Anda Cheng,Weishi Mi,Chao Tang,Chenyuan Liu,Yushun Xiang,Tingguang Li,Yong-Lu Li,Yehui Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboICL 是一个无需机器人特定参数更新、不依赖学习式 VLA 的上下文机器人控制框架，通过分离“演示上下文”与“交互记忆”并采用共享的 observation–action–receipt–observation 语法，显著提升通用视觉语言模型在精密与长程任务上的零样本/少样本控制性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用视觉语言模型（如 GPT-Astra）在开放式、语言或图像条件操控上表现良好，但在高精度和长程任务上明显较弱。作者希望在不进行机器人特定参数微调、也不训练专门 VLA 的前提下缩小这一差距。

Method: RoboICL 将“演示上下文”（可用的录制示例）与“交互记忆”（模型自身动作及观察结果）分离，二者共享 observation–action–receipt–observation 语法。为跨任务阶段保留经验，框架将采样的演示块与有界锚定记忆结合：固定锚点保留早期 rollout 交互用于上下文学习，最新交互支持即时误差纠正。另在开发任务上引入可选的 Jev 门控动作复用。

Result: 在 30 个 RoboDojo 任务上（Open 用零样本，其余用单演示），RoboICL 相较官方零样本 GPT-Astra 在每个类别提升 20–27 个 progress-score 点；在 Memory 和 Open 上领先排行榜基线，在 Precision 上与最强基线相当，在 Long-Horizon 上保持竞争力。30 任务 Overall 得分为 50.64，最强基线为 33.68。在另一十任务子集上得分 60.60，与 π0.5 + GPT-Astra 混合方法相差 2.00 分以内。三个真实机器人任务中，平均 progress 从零样本 14.45 提升至单样本 63.33、三样本 78.89。两个开发任务上，可选 Jev 门控动作复用将 GPT-Astra 调用减少 33–48%。

Conclusion: RoboICL 证明无需机器人特定参数更新或学习式 VLA，仅通过结构化上下文与交互记忆即可大幅提升通用视觉语言模型的高精度、长程及真实机器人控制能力，并具备良好的少样本扩展性与调用效率。

Abstract: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.

</details>


### [2004] [SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34268)
*Trung Minh Bui,JongSul Moon,YoungOuk Kim,Quang-Ngoc Phung,Se-Woong Jun,Dongin Shin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE（符号动作门控与编辑），一个由单LLM规划器构成的家居智能体框架，包含零token、O(|π|)的符号门控（运行时安全监控，拦截前置条件违规动作）与局部编辑机制（仅重生成失败子目标的后缀）。在无泄漏协议、五个开源模型和75任务AI2-THOR基准上评估：标准基准因饱和而打平层次基线，但在更难的多目标组合上领先+0.06至+0.23；注入执行中故障时以2.4-3.3倍更少LLM调用达到同等恢复率；符号门控作为"先验证后执行"层可提升全部规划器的模拟器步成功率（最高+0.11）。门控无模型调用（0.008 ms/plan），可在边缘设备Jetson AGX Orin上近乎零成本运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已成为具身家居智能体的默认认知核心，但其输出的计划在执行前很少对照环境的接地模型进行校验；同时所报告的任务成功率常在过度饱和的基准上测度，导致各方法难以区分。因此需要一种轻量、可验证、能在边缘廉价运行的安全与规划增强机制。

Method: SAGE由两个轻量机制构成：(1)领域无关的符号门控，约250行Python，零token，复杂度O(|π|)，作为运行时安全监控以带类型理由拦截违反前置条件的动作；(2)局部编辑，仅重新生成失败子目标的后缀，保留已完成与未触及的工作；另用混合种子+实时记忆存储支持冷启动覆盖。评估采用无泄漏协议（留一检索），覆盖五个开源权重模型与75任务AI2-THOR基准，并设计方法无关的多目标组合与注入式中途故障场景。

Result: 标准基准目标完整性饱和（52%实例可被平凡求解），SAGE与强层次基线持平；在更难的方法无关多目标组合上，SAGE完整性领先重新显现，跨四个模型为+0.06至+0.23。注入执行中故障时，SAGE恢复可靠性与全计划重规划器相当，但LLM调用少2.4-3.3倍。作为先验证后执行门控，符号监控在执行前拦截不安全动作，并使每个受测规划器的模拟器步成功率提升（最高+0.11），而该信号验证器从未见过（非循环）。门控无模型调用（0.008 ms/plan），在Jetson AGX Orin上可复制其规划质量，小模型验证在此收益最大。

Conclusion: SAGE以近零成本的安全层形式在边缘运行，兼顾运行时安全监控与高效恢复规划，且验证了其非循环的有效性信号与跨域可移植性。作者开源了基准、无泄漏协议、恢复与安全门控测试框架，以及验证器可移植性研究（在ALFWorld上自动诱导，留出集0.89）。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another. We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|π|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).

</details>


### [2005] [Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34270)
*Huao Li,Carson Sobolewski,Augustinos Saravanos,William Tan,John Karigiannis,Chuchu Fan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种贝叶斯框架，将机器人澄清过程建模为针对接地STL任务规范的主动学习问题，用LLM初始化候选规范并生成澄清问题，用贝叶斯优化估计用户意图不确定性并选择最大信息增益的查询，最终交由形式化规划器生成可验证轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言指令常存在歧义、不完整或欠规范，机器人需要推断并执行人类意图。虽然LLM可作为澄清接口，但完全依赖生成模型驱动多轮对话会引入系统性失败，缺乏对意图不确定性的显式建模与可靠保证。

Method: 将澄清视为对接地STL任务规范的主动学习：LLM用于初始化候选形式化规范，并将信息量大的对比转化为自然语言澄清问题；贝叶斯优化维护对用户意图的不确定性估计，并选择信息增益最大的查询；收敛后，推断出的STL规范输入形式化规划器，合成可验证的机器人轨迹。

Result: 在四个仿真与真实任务领域中，该方法总体取得更高的任务满足度，且相比LLM基线需要更少的澄清轮次；同时能帮助较小模型缩小与更大型推理模型之间的性能差距。

Conclusion: 将LLM的生成能力与贝叶斯主动学习、STL形式化表示及形式化规划相结合，可在减少交互轮次的同时提升意图推断准确性与任务满足度，并获得可验证的机器人行为，为语言驱动的机器人规划提供更可靠的澄清机制。

Abstract: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.

</details>


### [2006] [NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34276)
*Xunyi Zhao,Jian Zhou,Sihao Lin,Gengze Zhou,Zerui Li,Xinyu Yan,Jiajun Liu,Anton van den Hengel,Qi Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: NavHarness 是一个免训练的具身导航框架，将记忆处理嵌入导航循环，跨任务保留地图、任务记录与房屋知识，从而实现终身导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前沿模型在单次具身导航任务中表现良好，但跨连续任务时依赖的演化地图与历史搜索记录可能不完整或与新观测冲突，缺乏跨会话的经验积累机制。

Method: 提出 NavHarness：多轮 agentic 会话在导航中调用地图、任务记录与房屋知识，与观测比对并记录修正以指导动作；通过结果验证与运行结束总结，将经验跨对话保留，供新任务或恢复尝试复用；并对经验传递方式（结构化恢复交接 vs. 等长摘要）与经验整合进行消融分析。

Result: GOAT-Bench 上，相比仅上下文独立会话，使用 Astra 提升 s-SR 18.6 分、Opus 5 提升 22.6 分；采用 SLAM 估计位姿时，GPT-6 Astra 达到 83.7 s-SR / 36.9 e-SR（GOAT-Bench）与 85.9 s-SR（IR2R-CE）的最优任务成功率。结构化恢复交接优于等长摘要；跨房屋部署中经验整合优于仅保留地图与任务记录。

Conclusion: 迈向终身导航的关键在于连续推理会话如何建立在先前经验之上，而不仅依赖单任务能力提升；案例显示 agent 可借助早期经验解读新目标、探究未解问题并恢复失败搜索。

Abstract: Frontier models can now perform well on individual embodied navigation tasks through multi-round multimodal reasoning with simple tools. Across successive tasks, however, an agent must also rely on an evolving map and earlier search records, both of which may be incomplete or conflict with new observations. We present NavHarness, a training-free embodied harness towards lifelong navigation that makes memory processing part of the navigation loop. During navigation, its multi-round agentic session draws on maps, task records, and house knowledge, checking them against observations and recording corrections to guide its actions. NavHarness preserves this experience across fresh conversations for new tasks or recovery attempts, while outcome verification and run-end summaries support its later reuse. On GOAT-Bench, NavHarness improves s-SR over context-only independent sessions by 18.6 points with Astra and 22.6 with Opus 5. Using SLAM-estimated poses, NavHarness with GPT-6 Astra achieves state-of-the-art task success of 83.7 s-SR with 36.9 e-SR on GOAT-Bench and 85.9 s-SR on IR2R-CE. To understand these gains, we examine how experience is carried between sessions and find that structured recovery handovers outperform length-matched summaries. In extended deployments across houses, consolidation improves navigation beyond retaining maps and task records, with case studies showing how agents use earlier experience to interpret new goals, investigate unresolved questions, and resume failed searches. We suggest that progress towards lifelong navigation depends on how successive reasoning sessions build on prior experience, alongside improvements in single-task capability.

</details>


### [2007] [TLC-DiT: Task-Aligned Local Visual Conditioning for Robust Multitask Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34297)
*Xianbo Cai,Hideyuki Ichiwara,Zihang Wang,Yijun Lu,Tetsuya Ogata*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TLC-DiT，一种在多任务扩散Transformer策略上插入显式任务引导局部视觉特征图的插件式扩展，在不改变扩散目标与动作生成流程的前提下提升成功率、鲁棒性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言条件机器人策略在多任务操作上已有进展，但任务相关的局部视觉证据往往隐藏在视觉主干或注意力层内部，导致策略难以被检查，并在视觉变化下表现脆弱——这暗示缺少一条显式的、与任务对齐的局部视觉通道。

Method: 对每个相机视角，用CLIP任务嵌入通过FiLM调制冻结的DINOv2 patch特征，再用轻量CoordConv CNN适配器细化为平滑空间特征图；将其与原始全局图像、语言、关节状态和时间步条件拼接，作为DiT策略的额外条件输入，不修改扩散目标与动作生成过程。

Result: LIBERO上平均成功率93.5%，高于Multitask DiT的86.5%与SmolVLA的79.25%；LIBERO-plus总成功率从54.07%升至57.24%，在相机、背景和传感器噪声变化下增益更大；真实双臂任务中Teabag Putting完成率从44%提升至89%，Match Box Opening性能相当；特征图可视化显示模型在多视角和扰动下聚焦任务相关区域。

Conclusion: 显式任务引导的局部视觉通道能有效提升扩散策略的性能与视觉鲁棒性，并提供可直接检查视觉证据的途径。

Abstract: Language-conditioned robot policies have made clear progress in multitask manipulation, but task-relevant local visual evidence usually stays hidden inside a visual backbone or attention layers. This leaves the policy difficult to inspect and fragile under visual change, two symptoms of a missing explicit, task-aligned local visual channel. We present TLC-DiT, a plug-in extension of the Multitask Diffusion Transformer (DiT) policy that adds explicit task-guided local visual feature maps without changing the diffusion objective or the action-generation process. For each camera view, frozen DINOv2 patch features are modulated by the CLIP task embedding through FiLM and refined by a lightweight CoordConv CNN adapter into smooth spatial maps, which are concatenated with the original global image, language, joint-state, and timestep conditions. On LIBERO, TLC-DiT reaches a 93.5% average success rate, compared with 86.5% for Multitask DiT and 79.25% for SmolVLA. On LIBERO-plus, the total success rate improves from 54.07% to 57.24%, with larger gains under camera, background, and sensor-noise changes. In real-world bimanual tasks, TLC-DiT raises Teabag Putting completion from 44% to 89% while maintaining comparable Match Box Opening performance. Feature-map visualizations confirm that the model attends to task-relevant regions across views and perturbations, providing a direct way to inspect the visual evidence.

</details>


### [2008] [When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34300)
*John Cao,Somil Bansal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种自适应潜空间安全滤波器，利用直接观测到的世界模型误差，通过自适应保形推理构建在线不确定性集，并对学习到的安全值函数进行悲观最小化，从而在模型准确时保持最小保守性、在模型失配时提高谨慎度，并给出有限时间覆盖保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型为高维机器人系统的安全推理提供了强大基础，但其预测可能存在偏差、失准或"自信地错误"。潜空间安全滤波器通常在 world model 动力学上学习 Hamilton-Jacobi 安全值函数，若世界模型有误，值函数会继承其错误并给出过度自信的安全估计。现有方法依赖集成分歧或值目标一致性残差等辅助信号进行自适应，但当世界模型预测偏离观测时，这些信号可能依然很小，无法有效触发调整。

Method: 提出自适应潜空间安全滤波器，直接使用观测到的世界模型误差来校准安全推理。具体而言：利用自适应保形推理（Adaptive Conformal Inference），基于"预测潜状态"与"观测推断潜状态"之间的差异构建在线不确定性集；随后在这些集合上对已学习的安全值函数进行悲观最小化评估。该机制使滤波器在世界模型准确时保持最小保守性，在观测揭示模型失配时变得更谨慎。同时为自适应不确定性半径提供有限时间覆盖保证。

Result: 通过仿真与硬件实验验证，相比当前最先进的潜空间安全滤波器，该方法显著减少了失效次数，同时保持了任务完成率。此外，理论层面给出了自适应不确定性半径的有限时间覆盖保证。

Conclusion: 以直接观测的世界模型误差为驱动信号，结合自适应保形推理与悲观值函数评估，是一种有效且具备理论保障的潜空间安全滤波方案，可在不牺牲任务完成的前提下显著提升高维机器人系统的安全性，弥补了现有依赖间接辅助信号方法的不足。

Abstract: World models offer a powerful substrate for safety reasoning in high-dimensional robotic systems, but they are also fallible: their predictions can be biased, miscalibrated, or confidently wrong. This creates a central challenge for latent-space safety filters, which often learn Hamilton-Jacobi safety value functions on the dynamics of a world model. If the world model is incorrect, the resulting value function can inherit its errors and produce overconfident safety estimates. Existing latent safety filters often rely on auxiliary signals such as ensemble disagreement or value-target consistency residuals for adaptation, but these signals can remain small even when the world model's predictions deviate from observations. We propose an adaptive latent safety filter that calibrates safety reasoning using directly observed world-model error. Our method uses Adaptive Conformal Inference to construct online uncertainty sets from discrepancies between predicted and observation-inferred latent states, then evaluates safety pessimistically by minimizing the learned value function over these sets. This allows the filter to remain minimally conservative when the world model is accurate, while becoming more cautious when observations reveal model mismatch. We provide a finite-time coverage guarantee for the adaptive uncertainty radius. Through simulation and hardware experiments, we show that our method significantly reduces failures relative to state-of-the-art latent safety filters while preserving task completion.

</details>


### [2009] [Predictive Semantic Safety: From Visual Physical Reasoning to Safety-Critical Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34356)
*Taekyung Kim,Salem Fradi,Yanning Dai,Mateusz Ostaszewski,Jürgen Schmidhuber*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出预测性语义安全（PSS）框架，将视觉物理推理与基于备份的安全滤波相连接，使机器人能够规避当前几何环境无法显现的未来危险。MuJoCo中Unitree Go1实验显示，PSS安全回合率达99.3%，显著优于仅依赖当前障碍几何的备份控制障碍函数基线的43.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理交互可能产生无法从机器人当前几何环境中察觉的未来危险。传统基于当前障碍几何的安全方法（如备份控制障碍函数）无法预见此类由物理交互引发的事件，因此需要将视觉物理推理引入安全滤波以确保未来安全性。

Method: PSS使用视觉语言模型（VLM）预测物理事件及其发生时间，或直接预测物体位移；通过显式运动模型将事件假设转换为物体轨迹；采用分裂共形预测（Split Conformal Prediction）跨指定物体、观测时间和未来时间联合校准位置误差；利用几何形状边界将位置区域转换为预测的物体占据空间；针对该占据空间评估预设备份机动，并推导输入仿射约束，在保持机器人动力学与输入限制下备份可行性的同时，最小化修改标称输入。

Result: 在MuJoCo中使用Unitree Go1进行实验，考虑坠落装置、冲击驱动的支撑失稳和接触传播等场景。PSS实现99.3%的安全回合率，而仅使用当前障碍几何的备份控制障碍函数基线仅为43.3%。

Conclusion: PSS通过将视觉物理推理与备份安全滤波结合，有效预见物理交互引发的未来危险，在动态复杂场景中显著提升机器人安全性，验证了语义预测与形式化安全约束融合的可行性。

Abstract: Physical interactions can create future hazards that are not apparent from the robot's current geometric surroundings. We present a framework termed Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), which connects visual physical reasoning to backup-based safety filtering. A vision-language model (VLM) predicts physical events and their timing or directly predicts object displacements. An explicit motion model converts event hypotheses into object trajectories. Split conformal prediction calibrates position errors jointly across specified objects, observation times, and future times; geometric shape bounds convert the resulting position regions into predicted object occupancy. PSS evaluates a prescribed backup maneuver against this occupancy and derives input-affine constraints for minimally modifying the nominal input while preserving backup feasibility under the robot dynamics and input limits. MuJoCo experiments with a Unitree Go1 consider falling fixtures, impact-driven support loss, and contact propagation. PSS achieves a safe episode rate of 99.3%, compared with 43.3% for a Backup Control Barrier Function baseline that only uses current obstacle geometry.

</details>


### [2010] [FutureDuet: Decoupling Observation Access from Future Supervision in World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34362)
*Jie Wu,Yuzhi Huang,Junqi Liu,Weichen Zhang,Haibin Huang,Yin Chen,Jingyan Jiang,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FutureDuet 让主视角与腕部视角采用不同的未来预测目标，通过 ActionDiT 融合任务状态与交互状态，在 RoboTwin50 与 LIBERO 上取得高成功率，且辅助模块仅训练期使用、无推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models 将主视角与腕部视角合并为单一视觉流，并用相同的未来视频目标训练。但两者视觉动态差异显著：主相机稳定，反映场景级任务演进；腕部相机随末端执行器运动，混合了局部交互变化、视角移动与自遮挡。这种预测需求差异说明二者应适用不同的未来目标。

Method: 提出 FutureDuet：控制时保留双视角，但各视觉流接收不同的未来目标。主视角用未来 RGB 建模任务演进，并以交互掩码与机器人骨架将监督聚焦于任务物体与机器人运动；腕部流用未来潜变量预测建模短时程交互变化，无需像素级重建。ActionDiT 联合读取得到的任务状态与交互状态，融合场景级进展与近距离交互证据。所有辅助预测模块仅训练期使用，不增加推理开销。

Result: 在 RoboTwin50 上达到 94.2% 干净环境与 94.1% 随机化成功率，在 LIBERO 上平均成功率为 99.2%。在六个需要精确交互的 RoboTwin50 任务上提升最明显，相较 Fast-WAM 在干净与随机化设置下平均增益分别为 9.2% 与 12.8%。

Conclusion: 消融/对照研究表明，分离腕部通路以及为主视角与腕部视角分别设计未来监督均带来互补增益，验证了双视角差异化未来目标设计的有效性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot action generation with future visual supervision. Existing WAMs commonly fuse main and wrist observations into one visual stream and train both with the same future-video objective, despite their different visual dynamics. A stable main camera reveals scene-level task evolution, whereas wrist cameras move with the end effector, mixing local interaction changes with viewpoint shifts and self-occlusion. These contrasting predictive demands suggest that the two views may benefit from different future objectives. We introduce FutureDuet, which retains both views for control, while allowing each visual stream to receive a different future objective. For the main view, future RGB models task evolution, while interaction masks and robot skeletons focus supervision on task objects and robot motion. For the wrist stream, future latent prediction models short-horizon interaction changes without requiring pixel-level reconstruction. ActionDiT jointly reads the resulting Task State and Interaction State, combining scene-level progress with close-range interaction evidence. All auxiliary prediction modules are training-only, adding no inference overhead. FutureDuet achieves 94.2% clean and 94.1% randomized success on RoboTwin50 and 99.2% average success on LIBERO. The improvements are most pronounced on six RoboTwin50 tasks that require precise interaction, averaging gains of 9.2% and 12.8% over Fast-WAM in clean and randomized settings. Controlled studies further show complementary gains from separating the wrist pathway and designing future supervision separately for the two views.

</details>


### [2011] [Contact-Aware Impedance Controller for Robot-Assisted Ultrasound Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34400)
*MD Miraj Arefin,M Efe Tiryaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于B型超声图像的接触感知方法与接触感知阻抗控制器，实现无需力测量的接触检测与接触点定位，并通过动态更新交互框架提升机器人超声成像的安全性与准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人辅助超声成像需要可靠控制器来检测并定位探头-组织交互。传统方法依赖力/力矩测量，存在残余力偏置且难以在成像过程中持续跟踪物理接触点，因此需要一种独立于力测量的接触感知与定位方案。

Method: 提出基于B型超声图像的接触检测方法，不依赖力测量即可检测声学接触，并实现接触条件下的力/力矩清零以减少残余力偏置。接触期间，连续估计弯曲探头表面上的有效接触位置，并用其更新控制器的交互框架，从而在成像过程中对物理探头-组织接触点进行视觉伺服。

Result: 在琼脂体模实验中，探头滚转角从-15°到15°范围内，接触定位RMSE为1.46±0.14 mm；静态滚动过程中，所提控制器保持与常规固定框架阻抗控制器相当的任务空间跟踪精度，同时将最大压缩交互力从31.56 N降至20.09 N，降低36.3%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，超声图像可作为直接接触反馈，用于安全且准确的机器人辅助超声成像。

Abstract: Safe robot-assisted ultrasound imaging requires a reliable controller able to detect and localize probe--tissue interaction. In this paper, we present a B-mode ultrasound image-based contact perception method and a contact-aware impedance controller for robotic ultrasound imaging. The proposed method detects acoustic contact independently of force measurements, enabling contact-conditioned force/torque taring to reduce residual wrench bias. During contact, the method continuously estimates the effective contact location along the curved probe surface and uses it to update the controller interaction frame, enabling visual servoing of the physical probe--tissue contact point during imaging. Experiments on an agar phantom demonstrated a contact-localization RMSE of $\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm over probe roll angles from $\mathbf{-15^\circ}$ to $\mathbf{15^\circ}$. During static rolling, the proposed controller maintained task-space tracking accuracy comparable to a conventional fixed-frame impedance controller while reducing the maximum compressive interaction force from $\mathbf{31.56}$~N to $\mathbf{20.09}$~N, corresponding to a $\mathbf{36.3\%}$ reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of ultrasound images as direct contact feedback for safe and accurate robot-assisted ultrasound imaging.

</details>


### [2012] [From Language to Task Maps: Compiling Semantic Relations While Preserving Task-Relevant Freedom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34412)
*Jaegyun Park,Jingwang Lee,Jungsoo Lee,Soonwoong Hwang,Wansoo Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出类型化"语义到几何"接口，让语言只指定实体、关系与阶段，由机器人端编译器借助共形几何代数生成可微任务映射并用RMPflow组合策略，从而在保留关系自由度、避免引入意外约束的前提下，把定性语言指令编译为连续控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言操作指令表达的是定性关系，而连续控制器需要可被状态求值的任务量、微分与完成条件。定性关系通常部分未指定相对构型，若强行展开为完整位姿会引入非预期约束，因此需要在语言模型与控制器之间建立一种能同时刻画"关系可见几何"与"保留自由度"的接口。

Method: 提出类型化语义到几何接口：语言规定实体、关系与阶段，每种关系索引一个注册规格，声明其任务相关区分与应保留自由度。机器人端编译器对这些规格进行落地，使用共形几何代数构造关系专属任务映射及一致的微分，并通过RMPflow组合成策略。为评估语言模型与编译器的职责划分，在60条指令上比较仅"语义拓扑"接口与额外要求关系几何规格的接口；并在8种几何关系形式、64次落地评估中检验任务映射的零空间保留、扰动响应、解析方向导数与有限差分一致性及雅可比秩；最后在MuJoCo中用Franka Emika Panda进行三次闭环消融。

Result: 两种接口在41/60例中均产生正确的共享语义内容，但在各自接口要求下出现关键错误分别为19/60与58/60例。64次落地评估显示，任务映射保留注册零方向并对关系相关扰动有响应，解析方向导数与有限差分一致，雅可比秩与注册维度匹配。三次闭环消融中，固定一个关系保留坐标使终端进度误差中位数增加20.24–71.00 mm，而保留关系的误差仍在其评估界内。

Conclusion: 将关系可见几何与被保留自由度一同编译为可组合的连续目标，能够在不引入意外约束的情况下把定性语言指令落地为连续控制策略，并支持语言模型与机器人编译器之间清晰的职责划分。

Abstract: Natural-language manipulation instructions specify qualitative relations, whereas continuous controllers require state-evaluable task quantities, differentials, and completion conditions. Because a qualitative relation generally leaves part of the relative configuration unspecified, expanding it into a complete pose can introduce unintended constraints. We present a typed semantic-to-geometric interface in which language specifies entities, relations, and phases, while each relation indexes a registered specification of its task-relevant distinctions and preserved freedoms. A robot-side compiler grounds these specifications, constructs relation-specific task maps and consistent differentials using conformal geometric algebra, and composes the resulting policies through RMPflow. To evaluate the division of responsibility between the language model and the compiler, we compared a Semantic Topology interface with one that additionally requires relation-specific geometric specifications over 60 instructions. Both produced correct shared semantic content in 41/60 cases, but critical errors under their respective interface requirements occurred in 19/60 and 58/60 cases. Across 64 grounded evaluations spanning eight geometric relation forms, the task maps preserved registered null directions and responded to relation-relevant perturbations; analytic directional derivatives agreed with finite differences, and Jacobian ranks matched the registered dimensions. In three closed-loop ablations using a simulated Franka Emika Panda in MuJoCo, fixing a relation-preserved coordinate increased median terminal progress error by 20.24--71.00~mm while the retained relation errors remained within their evaluation bounds. These results support compiling relation-visible geometry and preserved freedom together into composable continuous objectives.

</details>


### [2013] [From World Models to World Action Models: Rethinking Next-State Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34414)
*Tingyu Yuan,Ziming Ji,Biaoliang Guan,Wen Ye,Wenrui Tian,Zhaopeng Gu,Feihong Zhang,Xu Yang,Yan Huang,Zhaowen Li,Chaoyang Zhao,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CF-WAM，动态采样同一未来的多种投影（视觉/语义/几何/交互）并统一为视频形式监督，突破固定下一状态表示的归纳偏置限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型向世界-动作模型（WAMs）演进时，现有方法在训练前就将下一状态固定为RGB、单一潜特征或预定义目标的静态组合，使动作学习受限于特定表示所保留的归纳偏置，难以学习动作相关的状态转移结构。

Method: CF-WAM动态采样同一未来状态的视觉、语义、几何与交互投影，标准化为统一视频形式，并在这些投影上监督统一的WAM；各投影暴露的动作相关约束随训练步累积，迫使模型捕获支撑同一动作条件未来多重投影的底层状态转移结构。该动态机制同时为人类与机器人学习提供自然的跨本体动力学参考系，使异构人类与机器人经验绕过外观差异，直接贡献共享状态转移学习。

Result: CF-WAM同时提升训练效率与最终控制性能，并将人类经验有效转化为策略增益；在RoboCasa-GR1上平均成功率82.50%（SOTA），LIBERO-Plus上82.65%，真实世界评测最高达84.00%。

Conclusion: 动态多投影的下一状态预测是一种有效的WAM学习范式，可缓解固定表示的归纳偏置，并借助跨本体动力学参考系提升泛化与人类经验迁移效果。

Abstract: Predicting the next state is a core paradigm of World Models for modeling physical dynamics, emphasizing prediction fidelity. As World Models evolve into World-Action Models (WAMs), existing methods still fix the next state before training as RGB, a single latent feature, or a static combination of predefined targets, thereby constraining action learning to the inductive biases preserved by a particular representation. To address this limitation, we propose CF-WAM, a dynamic next-state prediction framework that samples visual, semantic, geometric, and interaction projections of the same future, standardizes them into a common video form, and supervises a unified WAM across these projections. The action-relevant constraints exposed by these projections accumulate across training steps, forcing WAM to capture the underlying state-transition structure that supports multiple projections of the same action-conditioned future. This dynamic mechanism also provides a natural cross-embodiment dynamics reference frame for Human and Robot learning.
