On four tool-use tasks with distinct physical functions, HOT discovers functional structures after evaluating only a small fraction of search spaces containing up to 56 million structures, and the subsequent refinement of their geometry lowers the task loss on all tasks while preserving success, through deformations that are functionally interpretable. Once 3D printed, the tools accomplish all tasks on a real robot with the actions found in simulation. Designing tools from required physical effects, rather than a catalog of known tools, is a step toward the open-ended tool making seen in humans and animals.

</details>


### [2051] [ForVis: An In-Field Dataset and Benchmark for VIO Using Under-Canopy UAV Flights in Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35482)
*Arman Kiani,Masoud Ataei,Elvis Gyaase,Jeffrey Eiyike,Aaron Weiskittel,Prabuddha Chakraborty,Vikas Dhiman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ForVis：面向无人机森林飞行的VI-SLAM现场数据集与基准，含12次飞行、563.8s/1096.8m轨迹数据，评测7个开源系统共504次运行，发现传感器选择对轨迹误差的影响大于算法间差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机VI-SLAM在真实森林环境中难以评估，因为运动、光照变化、重复植被纹理和振动都会影响估计。缺乏涵盖开阔草地、冠层上方与冠层下方的现场数据集与基准。

Method: 构建ForVis数据集：在开阔草地、冠层上方、冠层下方三类条件下共12次飞行，使用Intel RealSense D435i与OAK-D Pro Wide同步采集，并记录惯性数据与飞控数据；在此基础上对7个开源VI-SLAM系统进行504次运行的基准测试。

Result: 共提供563.8s飞行时长、1096.8m轨迹；传感器选择对轨迹误差的影响大于算法间差异，7种方法在OAK-D Pro上的中位误差均低于D435i。

Conclusion: ForVis可用于支持在具有挑战性的森林飞行场景下评估VI-SLAM的速度、精度与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Visual-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) for UAVs remains difficult to evaluate in real forest environments, where motion, illumination changes, repetitive vegetation, and vibration can all affect estimation. We present ForVis, an in-field dataset and benchmark for evaluating VI-SLAM during UAV flight in forest environments. The dataset contains twelve flights across open meadow, above-canopy, and under-canopy conditions in each environment. In total, it provides 563.8s of flight over 1096.8m of trajectory, recorded simultaneously with an Intel RealSense D435i and an OAK-D Pro Wide together with inertial and flight-controller data. We benchmark seven open-source VI-SLAM systems over 504 runs. The results show that sensor choice has a larger effect on trajectory error than the spread between algorithms: all seven methods achieve lower median error on the OAK-D Pro than on the D435i. ForVis is intended to support evaluation of speed, accuracy and robustness for VI-SLAM in challenging forest flight.

</details>


### [2052] [Terrain-Aware Autonomous Planetary Exploration for Exteroceptive-Proprioceptive Mapping with Quadruped Scouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35493)
*Alberto Sanchez-Delgado,João Carlos Virgolino Soares,Victor Barasuol,Claudio Semini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向类月面环境的四足机器人地形感知探索框架，融合外部感知与本体感知建图，实现自主探索与低成本导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主行星探索要求机器人在未知、崎岖地形上评估风险、可通行性与能量消耗。四足侦察机器人适合该任务，因其能穿越不规则地表并在运动过程中获取与移动性相关的信息。

Method: 机载RGB-D相机构建以机器人为中心的高程地图，估计几何可通行性并推导导航代价；本体感知测量提供交互感知地形线索以补充几何评估。局部地图增量配准为全局多层表示，探索模块据此在未探索感兴趣区域选择目标，自主导航系统利用地图与代价层实现避障运动。

Result: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim上的仿真结果显示：实现了自主探索、地图扩展，以及地形几何与机器人-地形交互之间的空间关联；利用该信息进行后续导航的平均运输代价（CoT）低于初始探索阶段。

Conclusion: 融合外部与本体感知的多层地形表示可有效支持四足机器人在类月面环境中的自主探索，并降低后续导航的能量代价。

Abstract: Autonomous planetary exploration requires robots to navigate unknown, uneven terrain while assessing risk, traversability, and energetic cost. Quadruped scouts are well suited for this task because they can traverse irregular surfaces and gather mobility-relevant information during locomotion. This paper presents a terrain-aware exploration framework that combines exteroceptive and proprioceptive mapping for a quadruped robot in lunar-like environments. An onboard RGB-D camera builds robot-centered elevation maps, estimates geometric traversability, and derives navigation costs for autonomous planning. In parallel, proprioceptive measurements provide interaction-aware terrain cues that complement geometry-based assessment. Local maps are incrementally registered into a global multi-layer representation, which is used by an exploration module to select targets in unexplored regions of interest. The targets are reached by an autonomous navigation system that guides collision-aware motion using the available map and cost layers. Simulation results on NVIDIA Isaac Sim show autonomous exploration, map expansion, and spatial association between terrain geometry and robot-terrain interaction. Subsequent navigation using this information exhibits lower average Cost of Transport (CoT) than initial exploration.

</details>


### [2053] [Inspection-SPARS: Task-Oriented Sparse Roadmaps for Inspection Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35516)
*Adir Morgan,Oren Salzman,Kiril Solovey*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Inspection-SPARS，首个面向巡检任务的路线图稀疏化方法，将 POI 覆盖与路径质量保证纳入 SPARS 框架，在保持覆盖的同时将顶点与边数量减少 4-8 倍，使 GIP 求解器得到的最优巡检路径长度最多缩短 25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采样-based 方法将连续巡检规划问题归约为离散路线图上的图巡检规划（GIP）问题。密集路线图能提供多样的巡检视角与运动捷径，解质量更高，但带来的组合搜索空间过大，现有 GIP 求解器在实用时间预算内难以找到好解。稀疏化可缓解该负担，但现有方法要么与巡检任务无关，要么只保证 POI 覆盖而不考虑最终巡检方案的质量。

Method: 提出 Inspection-SPARS。将流行的任务无关稀疏化框架 SPARS 从纯几何准则推广到任务导向准则，引入巡检感知的顶点准入机制，把 POI 覆盖作为与连通性、路径质量并列的一级稀疏化准则，从而在相对密集路线图的意义上同时提供 POI 覆盖保证与路径质量保证。

Result: 在真实感 3D 环境中，Inspection-SPARS 将顶点数和边数减少 4-8 倍且保持覆盖，使 GIP 求解器计算出的巡检路径比使用密集路线图或最先进的巡检路线图时最多短 25%。

Conclusion: Inspection-SPARS 表明稀疏化可以在不牺牲解质量保证的前提下实现任务感知，为巡检路线图稀疏化提供了首个兼具 POI 覆盖与路径质量保证的方案。

Abstract: Inspection planning seeks a minimum-length collision-free robot tour that observes a given set of points of interest (POIs). Sampling-based methods reduce this continuous problem to a graph inspection planning (GIP) problem over a discrete roadmap, which is then solved using combinatorial solvers. Dense roadmaps capture diverse inspection viewpoints and motion shortcuts, and thus admit higher-quality solutions, but they induce large combinatorial search spaces on which state-of-the-art GIP solvers struggle to find good solutions within practical time budgets. Roadmap sparsification---restructuring a dense roadmap into a compact representation that preserves connectivity and path lengths---can alleviate this burden. However, existing sparsification approaches are either agnostic to the underlying inspection task, or strive to ensure coverage of the POIs without accounting for the quality of the resulting inspection plan. We present Inspection-SPARS, which is, to our knowledge, the first inspection-roadmap sparsifier with POI coverage and path-quality guarantees relative to the dense roadmap. To this end, we generalize the SPARS framework, a popular task-agnostic sparsifier, from purely geometric criteria to task-oriented ones, introducing an inspection-aware vertex admission mechanism that treats POI coverage as a first-class sparsification criterion alongside connectivity and path quality. Experiments in realistic 3D environments show that Inspection-SPARS reduces vertex and edge counts by 4-8x while preserving coverage, allowing the GIP solver to compute tours up to 25% shorter than with the dense roadmap or state-of-the-art inspection roadmap. More broadly, Inspection-SPARS shows that sparsification can be made task-aware without sacrificing guarantees on solution quality.

</details>


### [2054] [F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35575)
*Zhuoyuan Yu,Jiacheng Wang,Tianle Liu,Yihua Ren,Peng Yu,Chen Bai,Ziheng Zhang,Yufei Jia,Jindou Jia,Yuhang Zhang,Xinrui Zhang,Shang Yujing,Yuxiang Chen,Chuhao Zhou,Tiancai Wang,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出F4R框架，将真实世界失败转化为定向策略改进，通过real-to-sim-to-real闭环学习提升VLA模型操作成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉-语言-动作模型受限于专家演示覆盖不足及对物理交互理解不充分。常见做法是采集新失败场景的真实演示，但该过程成本高、效率低、存在安全隐患且难以规模化。

Method: F4R包含闭环流程：（1）用智能体从rollout中自动识别并诊断失败；（2）将每次失败重建为保留任务相关空间与物理条件的交互式、以物体为中心的桌面环境；（3）通过失败条件化的仿真-真实协同训练，并在重建环境中进行定向强化学习来精炼策略；（4）改进后的策略重新部署，新观测到的失败持续反馈进入下一轮重建与学习循环。

Result: 在四个真实操作任务上，F4R达到93.75%分布内成功率和90.0%分布外（OOD）成功率；在OOD条件下比预算匹配的Targeted BC基线高出18.75个百分点，且无需采集额外真实纠错演示。

Conclusion: F4R通过将真实失败自动转化为仿真重建与定向学习，实现了无需额外真实纠错演示的高效策略改进，显著提升了OOD泛化性能，验证了失败驱动real-to-sim-to-real闭环范式的有效性。

Abstract: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising (F4R), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.

</details>


### [2055] [CollisionSplatting: Collision-Aware Motion Planning in 3DGS Scenes with Image-Conditioned Objectives and Adjustable Conservatism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35619)
*R. Khorrambakht,Joaquim Ortiz-Haro,Stephan Weiss,Ludovic Righetti*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CollisionSplatting：一种直接作用于 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景的 GPU 加速、概率启发式距离度量，可与学习型图像条件奖励函数结合，实现几何与视觉联合规划，并在 MPPI/RRT 中取得更优效率与实机验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将稠密视觉信息融入运动规划仍具挑战：几何规划器依赖抽象场景表示而丢弃视觉丰富性，学习型视觉模型又缺乏几何可解释性与计算效率。因此需要一种既能利用视觉丰富信息、又具几何可解释性与高效性的规划接口。

Method: 提出 CollisionSplatting：简单、模块化、GPU 加速、概率启发式的距离度量，可直接在标准 3DGS 场景上运算，并具可调保守性。将其与学习型图像条件奖励函数结合，把碰撞感知代价与图像空间目标统一，实现几何与视觉联合规划；并集成到 GPU 加速的 MPPI 与 RRT 规划器中。

Result: 碰撞分类性能与代表性基线相当或更优，同时碰撞检测吞吐显著更高、VRAM 占用显著更低；在真实世界视觉引导导航与操作任务中验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 3DGS 可作为连接丰富感知与实时运动规划的实用桥梁，CollisionSplatting 提供了高效、可解释且可调的碰撞度量方案。

Abstract: Incorporating dense visual information into motion planning remains challenging, as geometric planners rely on abstracted scene representations that discard visual richness, while learned visual models often lack geometric interpretability and computational efficiency. This paper introduces CollisionSplatting, a simple, modular, GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired distance metric with tunable conservatism that operates directly on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. When combined with learned image-conditioned reward functions, this metric enables joint geometric and visual planning by unifying collision-aware costs with image-space objectives. We integrate the metric into GPU-accelerated Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) and Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) planners, and show on-par or better collision-classification performance compared to representative baselines while achieving substantially higher collision-checking throughput and significantly lower VRAM usage. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our metric in real-world vision-guided navigation and manipulation tasks, highlighting 3DGS as a practical bridge between rich perception and real-time motion planning.

</details>


### [2056] [Denoising Multi-Robot Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35651)
*Yuhao Zhang,Keisuke Okumura,Ajay Shankar,Amanda Prorok*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作基于动力学感知的扩散-去噪框架D4orm，构建了面向不同需求的系列多机器人轨迹规划器（解耦、在线滚动时域、分布式），在仿真与真机实验中均优于MPPI及学习型扩散模型方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人轨迹规划具有非凸、多模态、高维特性，传统数值优化方法计算困难；需要一种可扩展、可靠且适配多种运行条件的规划范式。

Method: 以D4orm为核心构建模块：采用基于采样的优化，通过GPU等现代并行架构进行大规模并行采样生成解轨迹；其扩散-去噪结构迭代优化候选控制轨迹的"变形"，生成满足动力学可行且无冲突的轨迹。在此基础上提出三种规划器：提升可扩展性的解耦规划器、带反馈控制的在线滚动时域规划器、面向资源受限场景的分布式规划器。

Result: 在2D与3D环境下的差速驱动与全向机器人评测中，基于D4orm的方法比MPPI等其他基于采样的优化方法及基于学习扩散模型的方法更快、更可靠地找到高质量解。进一步实现十架真实四旋翼在障碍环境中的零样本部署、100个仿真机器人的大规模解冲突，以及六台地面机器人的完全机载分布式"终身"运行。

Conclusion: 结果确立了扩散去噪作为多机器人协调的可扩展且可靠框架。代码与视频见 https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm。

Abstract: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes \textit{deformations} to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm

</details>


### [2057] [MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35652)
*Qiwei Liang,Guangyu Chen,Shaolong Zhu,Zikuan Xiao,Jinxuan Lu,Yifan Xie,Renjing Xu,Wenbo Ding,Tianxing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-ABC 移动操作基础模型，围绕"看、协调、想象"的臂-基座协作设计，通过稀疏多层级 VLM 特征、训练期未来分支监督与 MM-APT 掩码联合注意力机制，实现移动与操作双流的高效协同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动操作使可达工作空间本身可控，但带来两大挑战：连续自我运动下的空间感知，以及异构机械臂与基座动作的协调控制。现有方法多依赖显式 3D 表示或预测式世界模型强化几何，并将移动与操作解耦为独立动作流。作者认为有效移动操作不仅需要解耦，还需支持跨流高效协作的表示。

Method: 提出 MM-ABC 基础模型：(1) 融合稀疏多层级 VLM 特征用于空间感知；(2) 仅训练期使用的未来分支，以世界想象与几何意图作为附加监督，强化感知与操作意图预测；(3) MM-APT 模块，通过掩码联合注意力与干净动作 x-prediction 协调独立的操作流与移动流。

Result: 消融实验中，将干净动作预测替换为速度预测使 RoboCasa365 composite-seen 任务成功率从 32.8% 降至 29.2%，移除未来监督或多层级条件则下降更大。预训练数据超 5,000 小时、40 万+ 回合、12 个数据集、17 种本体。评测涵盖 EBench、RoboCasa365、ManiSkill-HAB、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 及真实世界任务，成功率分别为 EBench 44.71%、RoboCasa365 61.2%、LIBERO 99.1%、LIBERO-Plus 82.8%（无扰动训练）、真实五任务平均 83%。

Conclusion: MM-ABC 表明，移动操作的有效性不仅源于移动流与操作流的解耦，更依赖支持跨流协作的表示；未来想象监督、多层级条件与干净动作预测对性能具有关键作用，并在多基准与真实任务上取得领先表现。

Abstract: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile manipulation requires not only decoupling, but also representations that support efficient cross-stream collaboration. We present MM-ABC, a foundation model built around Seeing, Coordinating, and Imagining Arm-Base Collaboration. MM-ABC combines sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception; a training-only future branch that uses world imagination and geometric intent as extra supervision, strengthening perception and manipulation-intent prediction and improving the overall learning signal; and MM-APT, which coordinates separate manipulation and mobility streams through masked joint attention and clean-action x-prediction. In controlled ablations, replacing clean-action prediction with velocity prediction lowers success on RoboCasa365 composite-seen tasks from 32.8% to 29.2%, and removing future supervision or multilevel conditioning causes larger drops. We pretrain MM-ABC on 5,000+ hours of heterogeneous robot data spanning 400K+ episodes, 12 datasets, and 17 embodiments. Experiments cover EBench, RoboCasa365, ManiSkill-HAB, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world mobile manipulation. MM-ABC achieves 44.71% success on EBench, 61.2% on RoboCasa365, 99.1% on LIBERO, 82.8% on LIBERO-Plus without perturbation training, and 83% mean success on five real-world tasks.

</details>


### [2058] [Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35690)
*Puming Jiang,Tianrun Hu,Haozhe Du,Yibo Li,Zhiwei Xue,Xinhu Li,Harold Soh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL)，将策略的结构性先验同时作为训练约束和组合接口，从而打通技能泛化与组合泛化之间的信息断层，在MetaWorld与长时程ManiSkill任务上提升了分布外技能泛化并实现未见组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从少量示范中学习的机器人需要两类泛化：组合泛化（重组技能解决新任务）与技能泛化（已学策略适应新情境）。二者相互依赖，但组合层与技能层之间的信息在传递中丢失：技能适用范围由其训练时的策略结构决定，而组合层只通过名称、指令或符号算子等描述访问技能，这些描述丢弃了结构信息。核心动机是弥合这一信息断层，使组合层能"知道"每个策略在何处适用。

Method: 关键思想：将每个策略的结构性先验（structural prior）作为组合与技能之间的接口。结构性先验刻画一个行为依赖什么，例如抓取只依赖夹爪相对于物体的位姿。将其嵌入训练可决定策略在何处泛化，用语言表述则可告知组合层策略的适用域。据此提出APPL：由构造智能体（construction agent）将完整示范切分为可复用技能，为每个技能提出若干结构性先验，并针对每个先验训练与验证一个策略；运行时智能体（runtime agent）在这些先验特定策略间选择，并借助其接口面向新任务目标进行组合。

Result: 在MetaWorld和长时程ManiSkill任务上，APPL提升了分布外（out-of-distribution）技能泛化能力，并支持此前未见的技能组合；消融实验表明去掉接口信息会显著降低性能。

Conclusion: 结果支持将训练期的结构性假设作为技能学习与技能组合之间的桥梁，验证了结构性先验作为组合—技能接口的有效性。

Abstract: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruction, or a symbolic operator, that omits this structure. Our key idea is to use each policy's structural prior as part of the interface between composition and the skill. A structural prior states what a behavior depends on, for example that a grasp depends only on the gripper's pose relative to the object. Built into training, it shapes where the policy generalizes; stated in language, it tells composition where the policy applies. We instantiate this idea in Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL). A construction agent segments complete demonstrations into reusable skills, proposes several structural priors for each skill, and trains and verifies one policy per prior. A runtime agent then selects among these prior-specific policies and composes them toward new task goals using their interfaces. Across MetaWorld and long-horizon ManiSkill tasks, APPL improves out-of-distribution skill generalization and enables previously unseen skill compositions; ablating the interface information substantially reduces performance. These results support the use of training-time structural assumptions as a bridge between skill learning and skill composition.

</details>


### [2059] [LQR-ArUco Fusion: Robust Hierarchical Control for Navigation and Asymmetric Manipulation in Two-Wheeled Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35700)
*Anupam Chatterjee,Arpita Kumari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出分层控制框架，用离板视觉导航与在板低延迟扰动抑制双环结构，解决两轮倒立摆机器人非对称物体操作中的动态失稳与导航漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两轮倒立摆机器人机动性强，但持续平衡调节使在板里程计不可靠，难以精确导航；侧装机械臂举升负载会产生无驱动的横向滚转力矩，在非平坦地形上问题被显著放大，因此存在动态失稳与导航漂移的耦合难题。

Method: 采用分层（双环）架构分工：离板视觉系统通过俯视ArUco标记提供高延迟的全局路点导航，绕开里程计漂移；同时在板低延迟控制环利用惯性（IMU）与编码器数据主动抑制物理扰动。

Result: 在物理实验中，该双环方法使自建机器人实现精确导航，能够抑制减速带引起的瞬态冲击、适应动态跷跷板坡道，并在狭窄轮距下安全携带负载而不倾覆。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将高延迟全局视觉导航与低延迟在板扰动抑制解耦分工的分层控制策略，可有效应对TWIP机器人非对称操作与崎岖地形下的耦合失稳与漂移问题。

Abstract: We propose a hierarchical control framework to address severe dynamic instabilities and navigational drift that arise when a two-wheeled inverted pendulum (TWIP) robot attempts asymmetric object manipulation. While two-wheeled platforms are highly manoeuvrable, their constant balancing adjustments make onboard odometry highly unreliable for precise navigation. Furthermore, the addition of a side-mounted robotic arm introduces unactuated lateral roll moments when a payload is lifted, a challenge heavily compounded on uneven terrain. To solve these coupled problems, our architecture divides the workload. An offboard vision system tracks overhead ArUco markers to provide high-latency global waypoint navigation, bypassing odometry drift. Simultaneously, a low-latency onboard control loop rejects active physical disturbances using inertial and encoder data. In our physical experiments, this dual-loop approach enabled the custom-built robot to navigate accurately, reject transient impacts from speed bumps, adapt to a dynamic seesaw ramp, and carry a payload securely without falling over its narrow wheelbase.

</details>


### [2060] [Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35709)
*Wenxin Shao,Siqi Chai,Kun Li,Kerou Zhang,Xinzhou Jiang,Wei Xu,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Holo-M 是首个基于离散动作token的人形机器人全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）VLA模型，通过扩展语言模型词表并采用统一动作分词器与分组离散扩散解码，在SIMPLE基准上取得最优成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散动作token的VLA模型主要面向机械臂操控，而人形机器人全身动作空间（腿、躯干、臂、手）维度更高且异构，带来分词、训练和实时推理上的新挑战，既有VLA方法未能解决这些问题。

Method: 提出Holo-M：(1) 扩展语言模型词表，将动作token内在地纳入语言模型，避免使用独立连续动作专家带来的知识隔离问题；(2) 设计统一动作分词器，将人形动作空间分解为四个身体部位专用分词器——末端执行器、身体、手和运动学，支持人形遥操作、自我中心人类视频和仿真等异构数据源与不同本体的联合训练；(3) 为满足实时控制需求，采用分组离散扩散解码（而非对动作token做自回归解码）来逐部位解码动作token。

Result: 在SIMPLE人形移动操作基准上进行了大量实验，Holo-M在通用（generalist）和专用（specialist）评估中均取得最高成功率，且以显著优势领先第二名。作者将公开全部代码与模型权重。

Conclusion: Holo-M 证明了将离散动作token直接融入语言模型词表的思路可有效扩展到高维异构的人形全身动作空间，结合统一分词与分组离散扩散解码，能够兼顾跨本体/跨数据源训练与实时控制，并刷新移动操作基准的性能上限。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens. In this model, we devise a unified action tokenizer that decomposes the humanoid action space into four body-part-specific tokenizers -- end-effector, body, hand, and kinematics -- enabling training across drastically different embodiments and data sources, including humanoid teleoperation, ego-centric human video, and simulation. By extending the language model's vocabulary with these action tokens, we avoid the knowledge-insulation problem inherent to the models that use separate continuous action experts. To meet real-time control requirements, we decode each body part's action tokens through grouped discrete diffusion decoding, rather than using autoregression on the action tokens. We have conducted extensive experiments on the SIMPLE humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark, in which Holo-M achieves the highest success rates in both the generalist and specialist evaluations, leading the second best by significant margins. We will release all the code and model weights.

</details>


### [2061] [RoboCompiler: Graph-Native Compilation of Closed-Chain Robots for Consistent Modeling, Control, and Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35717)
*Mehdi Heydari Shahna,Joongheon Kim,Jouni Mattila*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RoboCompiler，一种图原生框架，将规范机构图编译为共享机械接口，统一闭链、耦合驱动与变接触机器人的构型、运动、力与动力学建模，并在多平台上验证其力学一致性与加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 含运动学闭环、耦合驱动和变化接触的机器人需要构型、运动、力与动力学的统一模型，但控制与仿真常各自重建接口，导致闭链约束与驱动一致性难以维持。

Method: 以规范机构图为输入，由刚体、关节、坐标系、惯量与驱动端口构建闭链路径与解析残差雅可比，通过秩检验延拓与修正组装可行构型；用切空间提升将独立速度映射到整机与任务运动，配对驱动端口映射保持虚功一致；以约束曲率修正将降维扩展到加速度与投影刚体动力学（含浮动基与支撑模式）；采用环局部求值、生成式雅可比与依赖感知复用实现局部更新。

Result: 在Komatsu挖掘机、Unitree Go2、Franka Panda、Kangaroo与六UPS Stewart平台上评估物理闭环与任务诱导约束；高精度约束动力学与Pinocchio独立校验证实力学一致性，MuJoCo与Isaac Sim/PhysX展示原生接触下的任务性能与模型复用；Kangaroo上编译使残差与雅可比求值时间减少96.7%，闭环rollout墙钟时间减少66.8%，且动力学与控制保持不变。

Conclusion: RoboCompiler通过共享机械接口实现闭链与驱动的统一编译，兼顾力学一致性、模型复用与计算效率，可作为控制与仿真共用的基础层。

Abstract: Robots with kinematic loops, coupled actuators, and changing contacts require consistent models of configuration, motion, force, and dynamics. Yet these interfaces are often reconstructed separately for control and simulation, making closure and actuation consistency difficult to maintain. This paper presents RoboCompiler, a graph-native framework that compiles a canonical mechanism graph into a shared mechanical interface. From bodies, joints, frames, inertias, and actuator ports, it constructs closure paths and analytic residual Jacobians, then assembles feasible configurations through rank-checked continuation and correction. A tangent lift maps independent velocities to full robot and task motion, while paired actuator-port maps preserve virtual work. A constraint-curvature correction extends the reduction to accelerations and projected rigid-body dynamics, including floating-base and support modes. Cycle-local evaluation, generated Jacobians, and dependency-aware reuse enable localized updates when closure inputs change. We evaluate physical loops and task-induced constraints on a Komatsu excavator, Unitree Go2, Franka Panda, Kangaroo, and a six-UPS Stewart platform. High-precision constrained-dynamics and independent Pinocchio checks confirm mechanical consistency; MuJoCo and Isaac Sim/PhysX executions demonstrate task performance and model reuse under native contact. For Kangaroo, compilation reduces residual-and-Jacobian evaluation time by 96.7% and closed-loop rollout wall time by 66.8%, with dynamics and control held fixed.

</details>


### [2062] [DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35761)
*Rui Zhou,Yibo Yuan,Junkai Zhao,Fangyuan Zhao,Xiaoguang Zhao,Shanghang Zhang,Sirui Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexRoam：用消费级VR+头戴立体相机无追踪器采集全身人类示范，经具身/动作语义/时间三阶段对齐，保留全身精细耦合动作，提升VLA策略学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动双臂灵巧操作需在单一轨迹中连续协调运动、全身动作与手指级灵巧性，导致机器人示范采集瓶颈严重。第一视角人类示范可扩展，但既有方法通过简化人类动作来降低迁移难度，恰好丢弃了此类任务依赖的精细、耦合结构。

Method: 提出DexRoam系统：1）无追踪器采集系统，仅用消费级VR头显与头戴立体相机，无需外部相机或动捕设备，可扩展采集全身人类操作示范；2）三个显式对齐阶段——具身对齐、动作语义对齐、时间对齐，将采集动作映射至机器人动作空间，保留精细全身动作结构，使人类与机器人示范可被标准VLA策略联合学习。

Result: 真实世界实验（不同VLA骨干）显示人类示范在多种训练范式下稳定提升策略学习：GR00T N1.7平均成功率29%→56%，pi0.5为32%→57%；以半数机器人示范即可匹配纯机器人训练。消融实验证实每个对齐阶段均为必要。

Conclusion: 在保留精细动作结构的前提下，人类示范可支撑可扩展的全身移动操作学习，验证了该范式对移动双臂灵巧操作的价值。

Abstract: Mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of locomotion, whole-body motion, and finger-level dexterity within a single trajectory, creating a severe robot demonstration bottleneck. Egocentric human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but prior approaches ease the transfer by simplifying human motion, discarding exactly the fine-grained, coupled structure such tasks depend on. We present DexRoam, a complete system for learning mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations, in which whole-body motion remains continuous and coupled throughout the human-to-robot transfer process. To enable scalable collection of whole-body human manipulation demonstrations, we develop a tracker-free capture system using only a consumer VR headset and a head-mounted stereo camera, without external cameras or motion trackers. We then perform three explicit alignment stages---embodiment, action-semantic, and temporal---to map captured motion into the robot action space, preserving fine-grained whole-body motion and allowing human and robot demonstrations to be jointly learned by standard VLA policies. Real-world experiments with different VLA backbones show that human demonstrations consistently improve policy learning across training paradigms, raising average success from 29% to 56% on GR00T N1.7 and from 32% to 57% on pi0.5, while matching robot-only training with half the robot demonstrations. Ablations confirm that each alignment stage is necessary. These results highlight the potential of human demonstrations for scalable whole-body mobile manipulation with preserved fine-grained motion structure.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [2063] [Bridging Stochastic Flow Maps and Boltzmann Generators with Normalizing Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31978)
*Louis Grenioux,RuiKang OuYang,Luhuan Wu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出NF²M（Normalizing Flow Flow Maps），将随机流映射与经典归一化流的精确似然结合构建Boltzmann Generator，在去噪过程中逐步对每个转移重加权，实现高效、可靠的平衡采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子体系的大规模独立平衡采样是计算统计力学的核心难题。Boltzmann Generator通过生成模型加重要性采样获得一致样本，但现有方法多仅在生成末端进行校正，导致被最终丢弃的轨迹浪费大量算力；且其似然多为近似或计算昂贵，削弱了校正的统计可靠性。

Method: NF²M将近期随机流映射的优势与经典归一化流的可处理性相结合。在每个去噪步骤中，用条件归一化流在给定当前含噪状态下提议干净构型（比直接从目标分布采样更简单），其精确似然使该提议能够朝向目标Boltzmann分布的真实去噪转移进行校正，从而在生成过程中逐步重加权。作者进一步证明了校正后转移的一致性，并给出近似误差在采样链中传播的界。

Result: 在肽（peptide）体系上评估，NF²M展现出更高的采样效率和更好的样本质量。

Conclusion: NF²M通过逐步重加权与精确似然校正，避免了无效计算并提升了校正的统计可靠性，为可扩展的Boltzmann Generator提供了一条具有理论保证的有效路径。

Abstract: Generating independent, equilibrium samples of molecular systems at scale remains a central obstacle in computational statistical mechanics. Boltzmann Generators address this by pairing a generative model with importance sampling to obtain consistent samples from the target distribution. We introduce Normalizing Flow Flow Maps (NF$^2$M), which combines the strengths of recent stochastic flow maps with the tractability of classic normalizing flows to build a Boltzmann Generator. Unlike most methods, which correct the generative model only at the end, NF$^2$M reweighs each denoising transition as generation proceeds, avoiding wasted compute on trajectories that are ultimately discarded. At each denoising step, a conditional normalizing flow proposes clean configurations given the current noisy state (a simpler task than sampling directly from the target) and its exact likelihood enables correcting each proposal toward the true denoising transition of the target Boltzmann distribution. This is in contrast to most existing methods, whose likelihoods are approximate or expensive to evaluate, undermining the statistical reliability of the correction. We establish consistency of the corrected transitions and bound how approximation errors propagate through the sampling chain. We evaluate NF$^2$M on peptide systems, demonstrating improved sampling efficiency and sample quality.

</details>


### [2064] [Continuous-Time Trajectory Generation from Discrete Observations with Stochasticity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32026)
*Ruifeng Shang,Shu Liu,Yuhua Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 PhiBE-Flow 框架，从离散观测直接估计 SDE 诱导的概率速度场，无需已知 SDE 系数或 score 估计，并给出收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理系统在时间上连续演化，但状态通常仅在离散时刻被观测。要生成与其概率密度一致的时间轨迹，需要刻画连续时间演化，而非仅学习相邻观测间的转移映射。

Method: PhiBE-Flow 直接估计支配连续时间分布演化的 SDE 所诱导的概率速度场。该方法为无模型（model-free）方法，仅依赖离散观测，既不需要已知 SDE 系数，也不需要 score 估计；并针对时间离散化误差与有限样本误差建立了收敛性保证。

Result: 在复杂度递增的系统上评估，包括受控随机数值系统、Navier–Stokes 动力学以及真实世界视频。结果表明 PhiBE-Flow 能准确恢复随机动力学的概率流、保持多尺度物理统计量，并在视频生成性能上优于代表性基线方法。

Conclusion: PhiBE-Flow 提供了一种从离散观测出发、直接估计连续时间概率速度场的无模型框架，兼具理论收敛保证与实际有效性，可广泛用于随机动力学建模与视频生成等任务。

Abstract: Physical systems evolve continuously in time, yet their states are typically observed only at discrete times. Generating trajectories consistent with their probability densities from such observations therefore requires capturing the continuous-time evolution rather than only learning transition mappings between consecutive observations. We propose PhiBE-Flow, a framework that directly estimates the probability velocity field induced by the stochastic differential equation (SDE) which governs this continuous-time distributional evolution. PhiBE-Flow learns from discrete observations using a model-free approach requiring neither known SDE coefficients nor score estimation. We establish convergence guarantees for the method, accounting for both time-discretization and finite-sample errors. We evaluate PhiBE-Flow on systems of increasing complexity, from controlled stochastic numerical systems to Navier--Stokes dynamics and real-world videos. Our results show that PhiBE-Flow accurately recovers probability flows of stochastic dynamics, preserves multiscale physical statistics, and improves video generation performance over representative baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/R1fe/PhiBE-Flow.

</details>


### [2065] [A Unified Optimism-Agnostic Framework for Linear Bandits over Spherical Action Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32149)
*Arda Güçlü,Subhonmesh Bose,John R. Birge*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化分析框架：若能保证设计矩阵最小特征值增长 ≳√t（推断质量）且动作足够集中（利用），则算法在球面动作集上可达最优高概率 Õ(√T) 遗憾，并证明 UCB 与 TS 的变体均满足该条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性老虎机中推断质量（由设计矩阵特征值刻画）与最优遗憾累积之间的关系尚缺乏显式、算法无关的刻画；经典乐观-椭圆势分析路径较为单一。

Method: 提出算法无关的分析路径：1）建立充分条件——设计矩阵最小特征值随时间增长 ≳√t，同时动作保持足够集中以支持利用，则输出最优高概率 O(√T log T) 遗憾界（球面动作集，时间域 T）；2）验证 UCB 与 TS 的若干变体满足上述推断与集中性质。

Result: 给出替代经典乐观-椭圆势论证的遗憾分析路线；证明满足条件的算法达到最优高概率 Õ(√T) 遗憾；UCB 与 TS 变体满足条件并因此享有最优遗憾率。

Conclusion: 提供一个模块化框架用于分析线性老虎机算法，显式地将参数估计质量与最优遗憾累积相连接。

Abstract: Linear bandits model sequential decision-making problems with noisy rewards that are linear in the decision variable, where an agent must simultaneously learn about an unknown parameter that governs the mean rewards, while maximizing (expected) rewards over time. Two prominent algorithmic families--upper confidence bound (UCB) and Thompson sampling (TS)--achieve a balance of exploration (to estimate said parameter) and exploitation (utilization of knowledge about it) across time. The quality of estimation of that parameter depends on the eigenvalues of a design matrix. In this paper, we begin by showing that if the inference quality obtained from exploration, encoded in the minimum eigenvalue of the design matrix, grows $\gtrsim \sqrt{t}$ with time $t$, while actions remain sufficiently concentrated for exploitation, then an algorithm produces optimal high-probability $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T}\log T)$-regret rate over a time-horizon $T$ for spherical action sets. This analysis is algorithm-agnostic and follows an alternative route to the classical optimism-based elliptical-potential argument for regret analysis. Then, we illustrate that variants of UCB and TS satisfy the inference and concentration properties and in turn, enjoy optimal regret rate. In effect, our results provide a modular framework that can be used to analyze linear bandit algorithms and explicitly connect quality of parameter estimation to optimal regret accumulation.

</details>


### [2066] [FOCUS: Fixed-Confidence Online Causal Learning Using Sequential Adaptive Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32165)
*Haijie Xu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究无历史观测数据、从零样本开始的全在线定置信度因果发现，在学习者序贯选择干预的设定下，同时恢复线性高斯结构方程模型的因果DAG与边权。作者给出实例相关的下界，并提出FOCUS算法，通过在线max-min博弈自适应分配干预，证明其(ε,δ)-正确且期望停止时间在对数依赖上达到下界，实验验证了结构与边权恢复效果及停止时间趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现通常依赖历史观测数据或固定干预设计；在完全在线、零样本起步且无先验数据的场景下，如何以定置信度高效选择干预、同时恢复因果结构与边权仍是待解问题。作者希望刻画该问题的最优样本复杂度并给出达到下界的算法。

Method: 针对线性高斯SEM，提出FOCUS算法：在学习者逐步选择干预的过程中，通过在线max-min博弈自适应分配干预以最大化信息增益。关键技术是构造可计算的集中不等式，用于处理跨干预共享因果参数所累积的KL散度，从而支撑序贯停止与置信判断。

Result: 建立了任意(ε,δ)-正确算法的实例相关下界。证明FOCUS满足(ε,δ)-正确性，其期望停止时间在Θ(log(1/δ))依赖上达到下界（至多相差一个实例相关常数）。实验显示因果结构与边权恢复均有提升，并验证了预测的停止时间趋势。

Conclusion: FOCUS为完全在线、无历史数据的定置信度因果发现提供了理论最优（在对数依赖意义下）且可实现的方案，表明在线max-min干预分配配合共享参数的集中分析可有效逼近实例相关下界。

Abstract: We study fully online fixed-confidence causal discovery without any historical observational data. Starting from zero samples, the learner sequentially selects interventions to recover both the causal DAG and its edge weights under a linear-Gaussian structural equation model. We establish an instance-dependent lower bound for any $(ε,δ)$-correct algorithm and propose \textsc{FOCUS}, which adaptively allocates interventions through an online max--min game. A key contribution is a computable concentration inequality for the accumulated KL divergence involving causal parameters shared across interventions. We prove that \textsc{FOCUS} is $(ε,δ)$-correct and that its expected stopping time matches the lower bound in its $Θ(\log(1/δ))$ dependence up to an instance-dependent constant. Experiments demonstrate improved structure and edge-weight recovery and confirm the predicted stopping-time trend. Our codes are available on https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FOCUS_code-76E5

</details>


### [2067] [Uncertainty Quantification of Next Generation Reservoir Computing with Applications to Memory-Driven Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32169)
*Livia Popa,Sumanta Basu,Martin T. Wells*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究NGRC（下一代储备池计算）中贝叶斯岭回归与保形预测区间的不确定性量化，刻画两者区间宽度何时一致或存在差异，并给出正则化、维度、残差分布等因素影响区间校准与效率的理论框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带记忆的非线性动力系统广泛存在，NGRC作为高效预测方法，其不确定性量化研究仍不充分，需要明确贝叶斯与保形两类预测区间何时一致、何时分歧，以指导方法选择与解释。

Method: 针对NGRC，对比分析贝叶斯岭回归预测区间与保形预测区间；在低维情形推导由残差分布不同统计量决定的渐近宽度，在高维情形分析正则化带来的估计方差、收缩偏差与后验不确定性之间的权衡；进一步推广到二次NGRC特征映射，并给出向时间相关预测窗口迁移的充分条件；辅以仿真与真实数据实验验证。

Result: 低维下两类区间的渐近宽度由残差分布的不同摘要统计量决定，一致性取决于残差形状而非仅维度；高维下正则化导致贝叶斯区间与保形区间宽窄之间存在明确的机制转变；理论预测在仿真与真实数据中得到支持，并展示残差分布、正则化、维度与分布漂移对区间校准和效率的影响。

Conclusion: 该工作为储备池预测中的不确定性量化方法提供了选择与解释的原则性框架。

Abstract: Nonlinear dynamical systems with memory arise across science and engineering, yet uncertainty quantification for efficient forecasting methods such as Next Generation Reservoir Computing (NGRC) remains underdeveloped. We study Bayesian ridge and conformal prediction intervals for NGRC and characterize when their uncertainty estimates agree or differ. In low dimensions, their asymptotic widths are governed by different summaries of the residual distribution, so agreement depends on residual shape rather than dimensionality alone. In high dimensions, regularization introduces a further tradeoff between estimation variance, shrinkage bias, and posterior uncertainty, leading to an explicit transition between regimes where Bayesian intervals are wider or narrower than conformal intervals. We extend these results to quadratic NGRC feature maps and give sufficient conditions for transferring the analysis to temporally dependent forecast windows. Simulations and real-data experiments support the theoretical predictions and illustrate how residual distribution, regularization, dimensionality, and distribution shift affect interval calibration and efficiency. These results provide a principled framework for choosing and interpreting uncertainty quantification methods in reservoir-based forecasting.

</details>


### [2068] [High-Probability Guarantees for SGD under $β$-Heavy-Tailed Gradient Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32195)
*Qijun Tong,Masahiro Ikeda,Ryota Kawasumi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文用Orlicz空间中的Young函数统一刻画SGD梯度噪声尾部，提出β-重尾噪声模型，并给出非凸损失下优化与总体风险平稳性的高概率界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SGD因数据子采样在更新中引入噪声，其高概率保证的强度与适用性关键取决于梯度噪声尾部的建模方式。深度学习中被报道的重尾梯度噪声，促使研究者放宽常用分析中有界噪声与亚高斯假设，以刻画更重尾（如对数正态）的噪声。

Method: 采用Orlicz空间理论中的Young函数描述噪声尾部，选取保持所有多项式矩有限、但尾部可比亚Weibull更重的Young函数，得到由β控制尾重的β-重尾噪声类；建立该类的集中不等式，并与SGD轨迹上经验梯度与总体梯度差的一致界结合，推导光滑非凸损失下优化平稳性和总体风险平稳性的高概率界，同时分析梯度裁剪下的SGD。

Result: 在高概率界中显式反映噪声尾部与学习率schedule的影响，且不限定特定学习率衰减规则；在Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件下给出最后一次迭代的风险界；并给出β-重尾噪声模型下带梯度裁剪SGD的分析结果。

Conclusion: 通过β-重尾建模与Young函数框架，可在弱化噪声假设的同时获得更贴近深度学习实际的SGD高概率收敛与风险保证，并统一覆盖梯度裁剪等变体。

Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is widely used to train machine learning models, but subsampling the training data introduces noise into its updates. The strength and applicability of high-probability guarantees therefore depend critically on how the tails of gradient noise are modeled. Reports of heavy-tailed gradient noise in deep learning motivate relaxing the bounded-noise and sub-Gaussian assumptions commonly used in high-probability analyses of SGD. We use Young functions from Orlicz space theory to describe noise tails in a common framework. We model SGD gradient noise by adopting a Young function that preserves the finiteness of all polynomial moments while allowing tails heavier than sub-Weibull, including lognormal distributions. The resulting class is called $β$-heavy-tailed, with $β$ controlling the tail heaviness. We establish concentration inequalities for $β$-heavy-tailed noise and combine them with a uniform bound on the difference between empirical and population gradients along the SGD trajectory to obtain high-probability bounds on optimization and population-risk stationarity for smooth nonconvex losses under trajectory assumptions. The bounds are not restricted to a particular learning-rate decay rule and make explicit the effects of noise tails and learning-rate schedules. Under the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, we bound the risk at the last iterate. We also analyze SGD with gradient clipping under the $β$-heavy-tailed noise model.

</details>


### [2069] [Overfitting of Spectral Gradient Descent: How Matrix Geometry shapes Generalization and Implicit Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32270)
*Guillaume Braun,Ichiro Hashimoto,Masaaki Imaizumi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究过参数化矩阵分类中含噪声标签下谱梯度下降(SpecGD)的泛化性，揭示捷径几何结构（塌缩 vs 分散）可逆转SpecGD与GD的相对泛化优势，并刻画SpecGD所选择的方向及单步泛化现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解含噪标签下过参数化模型中"捷径"（可记忆但不泛化的样本特定扰动）如何影响一阶/谱方法的泛化，尤其是为何不同训练算法（GD与SpecGD）在不同捷径几何下表现相反，以及算法究竟收敛到哪个方向这一未被理论清楚刻画的问题。

Method: 以共享低秩信号叠加秩一样本特定捷径的矩阵分类模型为框架，对比塌缩捷径（共享奇异方向）与分散捷径（占据不同奇异方向）；通过对其对偶问题的精细分析，结合归一化损失权重的指数梯度(expGD)动力学，确定SpecGD所选择的方向；并分析单步与持续训练的动态。

Result: 仅改变捷径几何即可逆转GD与SpecGD的相对泛化：塌缩捷径有利于SpecGD，分散捷径有利于GD。在分散情形下，捷径与信号严格正交会从晚期SpecGD方向中消除信号；而微小的随机相关性通过二阶效应集体产生对泛化有用的小信号。谱最大间隔问题本身无法确定SpecGD的方向，需结合对偶分析与expGD动力学。此外，单个SpecGD步即可实现插值并良好泛化，而持续训练收敛到泛化明显更差的方向。

Conclusion: 捷径的几何结构（而非仅其存在）支配一阶与谱方法的泛化排序；GD与SpecGD的优劣并非绝对，而依赖捷径奇异方向的塌缩或分散。SpecGD所选方向由对偶结构与权重动力学共同决定，且谱方法存在"早期停止优于收敛"的现象：单步即可泛化良好，继续训练反而恶化。这为理解过参数化下算法隐式偏差与捷径学习提供了新视角。

Abstract: We study the generalization of spectral gradient descent (SpecGD) in overparameterized matrix classification with corrupted labels. Each input combines a shared low-rank signal with a rank-one sample-specific perturbation, referred to as a shortcut, that enables memorization but does not generalize. We contrast collapsed shortcuts, which share a singular direction, with dispersed shortcuts, which occupy distinct singular directions. Changing only this geometry can reverse the relative generalization of GD and SpecGD: collapsed shortcuts can favor SpecGD, while dispersed shortcuts can favor GD. In the dispersed regime, exact shortcut orthogonality eliminates the signal from the late-stage SpecGD direction, while vanishing random correlations collectively generate a small but generalization-relevant signal through a second-order effect. To identify the direction selected by SpecGD, which the spectral max-margin problem alone does not determine, we combine a refined analysis of its dual with the exponentiated-gradient dynamics of normalized loss weights. Finally, we show that a single SpecGD step can already interpolate and generalize well, while continued training converges to a direction with substantially worse generalization.

</details>


### [2070] [AECSF: Adaptive Ensemble Conditional Score Filtering for High-Dimensional Nonlinear Data Assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32411)
*Yangwen Zhang,Shiwei Ni,Xiaoping Zhang,Xiaofei Guan,Lili Ju*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: AECSF：一种免训练的自适应集成条件分数滤波器，通过条件Tweedie恒等式构造可解析的分数估计器，用共享自适应加权提议集成估计条件均值，提升高维非线性滤波后验采样精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维非线性动力系统贝叶斯状态估计存在统计保真度与计算可行性的根本矛盾：粒子权重易退化，高斯集成更新难以捕捉非高斯后验结构。现有免训练分数滤波器多依赖启发式似然修正，忽略了每个含噪反向粒子对应的系统状态不确定性，损害后验精度。

Method: 提出AECSF免训练自适应集成条件分数滤波器。基于条件Tweedie恒等式构造可解析的分数估计器，将含噪后验分数估计转化为"给定含噪反向粒子与观测下系统状态条件均值"的估计。采用共享自适应加权提议集成高效估计这些条件均值，粒子特定的条件权重使每个含噪反向粒子无需单独提议采样即可获得估计；并在同一反向扩散过程中利用反向粒子信息更新提议集成以改善条件均值估计。

Result: 理论上刻画了固定加权提议测度何时给出精确的含噪后验分数；在给定假设下建立了条件均值估计误差与反向采样端点误差之间的界。数值实验表明，在预报集成规模有限的高维问题中，AECSF提升了后验采样与非线性滤波的精度。

Conclusion: AECSF以免训练方式缓解了统计保真度与计算可行性的矛盾，通过条件Tweedie恒等式与自适应加权提议集成实现有效的含噪后验分数估计，在高维有限集成场景下优于依赖启发式似然修正的现有分数滤波器。

Abstract: Bayesian state estimation for high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems entails a fundamental tension between statistical fidelity and computational tractability, as particle weights can collapse, while Gaussian ensemble updates can miss non-Gaussian posterior structure. Score-based diffusion filters offer a sampling-based alternative, but existing training-free score filters often rely on heuristic likelihood corrections, which can compromise posterior accuracy by neglecting uncertainty about the system state associated with each noisy reverse particle. To address these issues, we propose AECSF, a training-free adaptive ensemble conditional score filter. AECSF constructs an analytically tractable score estimator from the conditional Tweedie identity, which recasts noisy posterior score estimation as estimating the conditional mean of the system state given a noisy reverse particle and the observation. To estimate these conditional means efficiently, AECSF employs a shared adaptive weighted proposal ensemble, while particle-specific conditional weights yield an estimate for each noisy reverse particle without separate proposal sampling. The proposal ensemble is updated using reverse-particle information within the same reverse-diffusion run to improve conditional-mean estimation. Theoretically, we characterize when a fixed weighted proposal measure yields the exact noisy posterior score. Under stated assumptions, we establish a bound relating conditional-mean estimation errors to reverse-sampling endpoint error. Numerical experiments demonstrate that AECSF improves the accuracy of posterior sampling and nonlinear filtering in high-dimensional problems with limited forecast ensembles.

</details>


### [2071] [Agnostic Smoothed Online Regression with Adversarial Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32478)
*Xuanyu Chen,Yue Yu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文研究带界对抗响应的平滑在线预测问题，提出Hedge-Cover算法，达到 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F})\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}T})$ 的次线性遗憾，证明了匹配下界，并重新分析了良设定情形下响应噪声对minimax遗憾的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平滑在线预测框架通过平滑参数 $\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}$ 桥接了i.i.d.采样与对抗性协变量选择。已有工作留下一个开放问题：该问题的minimax最优自适应遗憾是多少。本文旨在回答这一问题，并进一步量化良设定情形下响应噪声的影响。

Method: 提出信息论算法Hedge-Cover：构造一族专家，用Hedge聚合，先验将遗憾与一致选择器和目标函数之间的不一致次数相关联；利用协变量平滑性对该不一致次数进行界估计。下界方面，显式构造支撑于相互正交超平面上的困难序列协变量分布，对线性预测器类建立匹配下界。对条件 $\nu^2$-subGaussian 响应，证明minimax期望遗憾下界为 $\Omega((1\vee \nu)\sqrt{(\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}-1)dT})$，并给出ERM的匹配上界。

Result: Hedge-Cover对伪维有界的函数类达到次线性遗憾 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F})\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}T})$；线性预测器类有匹配下界；对VC维为 $d$ 的函数类及条件 $\nu^2$-subGaussian 响应，minimax期望遗憾为 $\Omega((1\vee \nu)\sqrt{(\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}-1)dT})$，且ERM上界匹配该 $\nu$ 依赖。

Conclusion: 本文解决了平滑在线回归minimax最优自适应遗憾的开放问题，给出了上界算法与匹配下界，并揭示了良设定情形下响应噪声对minimax遗憾的影响，ERM可达到匹配的噪声依赖。

Abstract: We study smoothed online prediction with bounded adversarial responses. This widely studied framework bridges i.i.d. sampling and adversarial covariate selection through a smoothness parameter $\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}$, which bounds conditional covariate densities relative to a fixed, unknown base measure. We propose \textsc{Hedge-Cover}, an information-theoretic algorithm that achieves sublinear regret $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$ for function classes with bounded pseudo-dimension. The algorithm aggregates a carefully constructed family of experts using \textsc{Hedge}, with a prior that links regret to the number of disagreements between a consistent selector and a target function. We bound this number by exploiting covariate smoothness. This answers an open problem posed in \cite{blanchard2025agnostic} on the minimax optimal adaptive regret of the smoothed online regression problem. We establish a matching lower bound for the class of linear predictors. The main intricacy of the lower bound lies in explicitly constructing a challenging sequential covariate distribution supported on mutually orthogonal hyperplanes. This construction may be of independent technical interest. Finally, we revisit the well-specified setting and quantify the effect of response noise. For conditionally $ν^2$-subGaussian responses, we extend the existing lower bound under realizable responses by showing that the minimax expected regret is $Ω((1\vee ν)\sqrt{(\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}-1)dT})$ for a function class of VC dimension $d$. A corresponding upper bound for ERM matches this dependence on $ν$.

</details>


### [2072] [Learning What to Evaluate: Correlation-Aware Decoupling for Multiobjective Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32632)
*Ashwin Renganathan,Peter Bachman*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种基于多任务高斯过程的多目标贝叶斯优化方法，通过总相关度量选择每轮需评估的目标与约束子集，实现解耦评估并提升样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOBO方法为各目标与约束维护独立GP模型，并在每轮耦合地评估所有目标与约束，忽略了它们之间的内在相关性，导致评估成本与样本开销较高。

Method: 采用多任务GP联合建模所有目标与约束；提出总相关（total correlation）度量，用于在均匀评估成本下识别每轮应评估的最优子集，实现解耦评估；并设计相应的贝叶斯决策论采集函数。

Result: 理论上证明解耦情形下采集策略具有渐近一致性，且所提解耦子集选择规则在温和条件下最大化未评估任务的后验熵减少期望；实验中优于当前最先进的耦合与解耦基线方法。

Conclusion: 利用多任务GP与总相关度量进行解耦评估，可在不牺牲理论保证的前提下显著提升MOBO的样本效率与优化性能。

Abstract: Multiobjective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) with Gaussian process (GP) surrogates is a sample efficient approach to solving multiobjective optimization problems. In MOBO, a Bayesian decision theoretic acquisition function guides the adaptive selection of new candidate inputs, on which objectives and constraints are evaluated to update the surrogate model sequentially. Existing approaches maintain independent GP models for the objectives and constraints, with new observations evaluating all objectives and constraints in a coupled fashion. However, the objectives and constraints often contain inherent correlations which, if exploited, can enable ${decoupled}$ evaluations where only a subset of them are evaluated at each round. We present a new approach that leverages a multitask GP model to jointly learn all objectives and constraints, and propose a total correlation metric that enables identifying an ${optimal}$ subset of objectives and constraints to be evaluated at every round, even under uniform evaluation costs. Theoretically, we show that our acquisition policy is asymptotically consistent despite decoupling and that our proposed decoupled subset selection rule maximizes the expected posterior entropy reduction about unevaluated tasks under mild conditions. Empirically, we show that our approach outperforms coupled and decoupled baselines in the state of the art.

</details>


### [2073] [Affine Geometry of Gaussian ReLU Networks via Conditional Kac-Rice Formulas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32695)
*Recep Özkan,Christian Hirsch*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究有限宽度ReLU网络在随机初始化时的仿射几何结构，并刻画监督训练对其的重组：给出期望激活开关数与标量扭结数的精确/渐进公式，并在真实数据上验证训练使开关在类内段减少、类间段增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解ReLU网络的仿射分段结构（affine regions）随初始化如何形成、随训练如何变化，是解释网络表达能力与泛化的重要基础。然而缺乏对有限宽度网络中激活开关（activation switch）与输出标量扭结（scalar kink）数量的精确有限宽度理论，且不清楚训练究竟只是"收缩"复杂度还是重新分配复杂度。

Method: 将隐藏层预激活的符号变化零点定义为激活开关，输出不可导点定义为标量扭结。对一维输入，在前置层条件下，每个预激活在随机有限划分的胞腔上呈高斯且仿射，从而导出沿输入区间的激活开关期望数的精确有限宽度条件Kac-Rice公式。固定深度、宽度成比例增长时，开关强度收敛到显式确定性极限；并用可见性估计证明不产生标量扭结的开关数可忽略，得到标量扭结数与仿射区域数的显式主项。对d≥2，用类似的条件曲面公式给出扭结集(d-1)维Hausdorff测度的主项。

Result: 获得精确的有限宽度条件Kac-Rice公式及宽网络下的显式渐进极限；可见性估计表明不产生扭结的开关数可忽略，导出期望标量扭结数与仿射区域数的显式主项公式，以及高维扭结集Hausdorff测度的主项。在Breast Cancer Wisconsin数据上，初始化公式能准确预测留出区间上的开关数；训练后开关数在类内段减少、类间段增加。

Conclusion: 训练对ReLU网络的仿射复杂度是重新分配而非单纯收缩：类内段结构简化、类间段结构增多。提出的Kac-Rice型理论为初始化时的仿射几何提供了精确可预测的描述，并为训练动态下的复杂度变化提供了量化视角。

Abstract: We study how the affine geometry of finite ReLU networks is created at random initialization and reorganized by supervised training. We call a sign-changing zero of a hidden preactivation an activation switch and a point where the scalar network output is nondifferentiable a scalar kink. For one-dimensional input, conditioning on the preceding layers makes each preactivation Gaussian and affine on the cells of a random finite partition. This yields an exact finite-width conditional Kac-Rice formula for the expected number of activation switches along an input interval. For fixed depth and proportionally growing widths, the resulting switch intensities converge to explicit deterministic limits. A visibility estimate shows that the expected number of switches that do not produce scalar kinks is negligible, yielding an explicit leading formula for the expected number of scalar kinks and hence affine regions. In higher input dimensions d >= 2, the analogous conditional surface formula yields the leading expected (d-1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the scalar kink set. On the Breast Cancer Wisconsin data, the initialization formula accurately predicts switch counts along held-out segments. After training, switch counts decrease along within-class segments and increase along between-class segments. Thus, training redistributes rather than merely contracts affine complexity.

</details>


### [2074] [Domain Adaptation with Target Information via Doubly-Anchored Distributionally Robust Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32730)
*David Kepplinger,Anand N. Vidyashankar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出"双锚定"DRO框架：歧义集为源分布φ-散度球与"源补全目标参考律"φ-散度球的交集，推导对偶诱导的对抗式桥几何，并给出KL/HD非对称桥的Lambert-W形式，最后构造桥加权Nadaraya-Watson估计量并进行理论与实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域适应（DA）通常缺乏最坏情形保证；仅基于源数据的分布鲁棒优化（DRO）把歧义集中心锚定在源律，忽略了可利用的目标域结构。本文旨在弥合二者鸿沟，构建既能提供鲁棒性保证、又能利用目标协变量结构的统一框架。

Method: 提出双锚定DRO：歧义集为以源律为中心的φ-散度球与以"源补全目标参考律"（目标协变量律配源条件律）为中心的φ-散度球之交集；推导对称与非对称散度配对下的对偶诱导对抗桥几何，重点引入KL/平方Hellinger（KL/HD）桥；在非协变量偏移、有界重叠条件下为结构化的、损失无关的密度桥风险最小化器建立有限样本泛化界；进一步将该框架转化为桥加权Nadaraya-Watson估计量。

Result: KL/HD非对称桥呈现Lambert-W几何：源侧指数风险倾斜与目标侧Hellinger稳定化以不同项进入，可衰减（而非界定）大似然比的影响。理论方面：在无协变量偏移假设下获得密度桥风险最小化器的有限样本泛化界（但不直接适用于损失感知的DRO最小-最大估计量）；证明源回归函数的一致相合性与逐点渐近正态性，并证明当源、目标回归函数一致（如协变量偏移下）时可恢复目标回归。实验上，在域偏移Fashion-MNIST数据集上，KL/HD非对称桥在严重合成目标协变量污染下表现出良好的有限样本稳定性。

Conclusion: 双锚定DRO通过同时锚定源律与源补全目标参考律，桥接了DA与DRO；KL/HD非对称桥借助Lambert-W结构平衡源侧指数倾斜与目标侧Hellinger稳定化，在理论保证与有限样本稳定性上均具优势，为鲁棒域适应提供了新的几何视角与估计工具。

Abstract: Domain Adaptation (DA) often lacks worst-case guarantees, while Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) based only on source data centers its ambiguity set at the source law and ignores available target structure. To bridge this gap, we introduce a doubly-anchored DRO framework whose ambiguity set is the intersection of $φ$-divergence balls centered at the source law and a source-completed target reference law, the latter pairing the target covariate law with the source conditional law. We derive dual-induced adversarial bridge geometries for symmetric and asymmetric divergence pairings, notably introducing a Kullback--Leibler/squared-Hellinger (KL/HD) bridge. This asymmetric formulation yields a Lambert-$W$ geometry in which source-side exponential risk tilting and target-side Hellinger stabilization enter through distinct terms, attenuating, but not bounding, the effect of large likelihood ratios. Furthermore, without imposing covariate shift, we establish finite-sample generalization bounds for the minimizer of a structural, loss-agnostic density-bridge risk under bounded-overlap conditions; these bounds do not apply directly to the loss-aware DRO min--max estimator. We translate our framework into a bridge-weighted Nadaraya--Watson estimator, proving uniform consistency for the source regression function and pointwise asymptotic normality, with target recovery when the source and target regression functions coincide, as under covariate shift. Finally, an empirical evaluation on a domain-shifted Fashion-MNIST dataset illustrates the finite-sample stability of the asymmetric KL/HD bridge under severe synthetic target-covariate corruption.

</details>


### [2075] [Sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32847)
*Binh Thuan Tran,Khai Nguyen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出切片Orlicz-Wasserstein (SOW)距离，将SW中的L^p范数替换为Orlicz函数诱导的Luxemburg范数，证明其为度量并给出拓扑性质、样本复杂度与minimax最优性、算法与复杂度分析，实验显示SOW比OW更高效且比SW更灵活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SW距离依赖L^p范数，对分布差异的刻画受限于该固定范数；OW距离虽更灵活但计算代价高。因此需要一种兼具灵活性与计算效率的度量。

Method: 提出SOW距离：在切片投影后，用Orlicz函数φ诱导的Luxemburg范数替代L^p范数。证明度量性质（φ(x)=x^p时退化为SW）；推导拓扑性质（SOW收敛⇒弱收敛，紧支撑下反之）；推导距离及其幂泛函的样本复杂度并证明minimax最优性；给出Monte-Carlo估计与二分搜索算法及近似误差和计算复杂度分析。

Result: SOW是有限Orlicz范数测度空间上的度量且可恢复SW；收敛性刻画成立；样本复杂度与幂泛函达到minimax最优；实验表明SOW计算效率优于OW，并在两样本检验和图像生成模型评估中展现比SW更强的分布差异检测灵活性。

Conclusion: SOW统一并推广了SW，提供了完整的理论与算法支撑，在效率与灵活性间取得良好平衡，适用于两样本检验与生成模型评估等任务。

Abstract: We propose sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein (SOW) distance which is a generalization of sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. SOW replaces the $L^p$ norm in SW with a Luxemburg norm cost induced by an Orlicz function $φ$. First, we prove that SOW distance is a metric on the space of measures with finite Orlicz norm, and show that it recovers the SW distance when the Orlicz function is $φ(x)=x^p$. Next, we derive the topological properties of the SOW distance. In particular, we show that convergence under SOW implies weak convergence, and the converse is true under the compact support condition. We then present the theoretical results for estimating the SOW distance. We derive sample complexity for both the distance itself and the powered functional of the distance, and prove their minimax optimality. In addition, we discuss the computational algorithm for approximating the SOW distance by Monte-Carlo estimation and bisection search, as well as the associated approximation error and computational complexity analysis. Our experimental results reveal the superior computational efficiency of SOW compared with Orlicz-Wasserstein (OW) distance. Also, in the experiments, we demonstrate the favorable flexibility of SOW distance over SW in detecting differences between distributions by comparing their performance in two-sample tests and evaluating generative models on image datasets.

</details>


### [2076] [Byzantine-Robust Federated RAG via Aligned Calibration and Fixed-Membership Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33037)
*Prasanjit Dubey,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种面向联邦RAG的拜占庭鲁棒共形预测方法：让所有节点对同一批校准问题打分，中枢仅保留"某个合理的诚实节点组在两步中都会支持"的候选答案，从而在有限样本下保证答案集以指定概率包含正确答案，且集合规模接近最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦RAG中，数据（如病历）因隐私限制无法集中，各节点仅本地打分、由中枢汇总；但部分节点可能是拜占庭节点（被攻破、故障或被文档中隐藏指令误导），在校准与查询阶段均可能谎报分数。现有方法要么假设所有节点诚实，要么只保护校准阶段，无法同时应对两个阶段的恶意行为。

Method: 关键观察是校准阶段与查询阶段的诚实节点集合相同。中枢让所有节点对同一组校准问题打分，并只保留那些"存在某个合理的诚实节点组（规模不超过声明上界），依据其在校准与查询两阶段的自身分数都会保留"的候选答案，以此构造共形预测集合。

Result: 理论证明：在有限样本下，无论拜占庭节点如何报告，所得答案集都以选定概率包含正确答案；且没有使用相同信息的方法能在不冒丢失诚实节点所支持答案风险的前提下返回更小集合，即具备最优性。随机失效情形下，保证仅以"失效节点数超过声明上界"的概率削弱。模拟实验（真实问答任务、含医学考试，以语言模型为节点、部分被劫持）显示：只要异常节点数不超过声明上界，答案集均达到目标覆盖率，而朴素平均法可能失手；且相比同等保护强度的更简单方法，集合显著更小，当声明上界较宽松时优势尤为明显，说明保守上界代价很低。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在联邦RAG的校准与查询两阶段统一处理拜占庭节点，给出有限样本覆盖保证与最优性刻画，并在医疗等真实问答任务上验证了覆盖率与集合效率的双重优势，表明采用宽松的拜占庭上界几乎不增加预测集合的规模成本。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets language models answer questions more accurately by consulting relevant documents. Many valuable collections, such as medical records, cannot be pooled because of privacy rules. Federated RAG leaves each collection with its owner, or node, which scores candidate answers from its own documents; a central hub combines the scores. Some nodes, called Byzantine, may be compromised, faulty, or misled by instructions hidden in documents, and report arbitrary scores. Conformal prediction returns a set containing the correct answer with a chosen probability, using a cutoff set in a calibration step on questions with known answers. An unknown group of nodes, no larger than a declared bound, may misreport both in this step and at query time. Existing methods assume every node is honest or protect only the calibration step. We observe that the honest nodes are the same in both steps. The hub therefore has all nodes score the same calibration questions, and keeps a candidate only if some plausible group of honest nodes, using its own scores in both steps, would keep it. We prove that the resulting sets contain the correct answer with the chosen probability in finite samples, whatever the Byzantine nodes report. No method using the same information can return smaller sets without risking the loss of an answer the honest nodes support. If nodes fail at random, the guarantee weakens only by the probability that more nodes fail than declared. In simulations, on real question-answering tasks including medical exams, and with language models as nodes, some hijacked, our sets reached the target whenever no more nodes misbehaved than declared, while plain averaging could miss it. They were also clearly smaller than those of simpler methods with the same protection, most of all when the declared bound was generous, so a cautious bound costs little.

</details>


### [2077] [Can Tabular Foundation Models Amortize Statistical Inference?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33114)
*Kai Ye,Shijin Gong,Hongyi Zhou,Valentina Zangirolami,Chengchun Shi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出 TabCon，一种基于表格基础模型的摊销推断系统，通过单次前向传播为数据集生成置信区间，实现近名义覆盖与高计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统统计推断通常逐问题开发，需针对特定目标（如处理效应或回归函数）设计专门估计量及不确定性量化程序，成本高且缺乏通用性，作者希望建立一种可摊销、通用的推断范式。

Method: 聚焦置信区间构建这一经典问题，构建 TabCon 系统：基于表格基础模型，核心方法包括稀疏专家混合（MoE）架构与基于强化学习的后训练，用于将生成的置信区间校准至目标覆盖水平。

Result: 在广泛基准数据集上，TabCon 达到接近名义覆盖水平，同时产生较短的置信区间；推断时计算效率显著更高，比经典 bootstrap 程序快 50 倍（即使 bootstrap 仅用 50 个重采样样本）。

Conclusion: TabCon 表明摊销推断可作为逐问题统计推断的替代范式，在保持覆盖精度的同时兼顾区间长度与计算效率，为通用置信区间构建提供新方向。

Abstract: For decades, statistical inference has largely been developed one problem at a time. Given a scientific target, such as a treatment effect or a regression function, statisticians design a problem-specific estimator together with a procedure for quantifying its uncertainty. This paper proposes a different paradigm. We focus on a classical problem in statistical inference, confidence interval construction, and develop TabCon, an amortized inference system built on a tabular foundation model that produces confidence intervals for new datasets through a simple forward pass. The key methodological ingredients of TabCon are a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture and reinforcement-learning-based post-training that calibrate the resulting confidence intervals to a desired coverage level. Across a wide range of benchmark datasets, TabCon attains near-nominal coverage while producing short confidence intervals. At inference time, it also offers considerably greater computational efficiency, running 50 times faster than the classical bootstrap procedure, even when the latter uses only 50 bootstrap samples.

</details>


### [2078] [Which Self-Improvements Should We Trust? Reliable Self-Improvement When Agents Reuse Their Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33180)
*Xiaojing Sun,Yuhan Zeng,Zihua She,Xiao Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出REUSE框架，在递归自我改进中重用固定评估集进行重复自适应决策，同时对真实种群改进提供统计保证，将错误晋升比例从最高20.7%降至0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进依赖有限评估资源（如固定基准）决定保留哪些修改及后续提议。当这些资源被反复复用时，新候选基于同一评估集的反馈产生，搜索轨迹会自适应过拟合，使经验性改进无法反映在底层任务分布上的真实种群改进。现有方法虽考虑多重比较，但假设候选独立于评估集选择，无法控制这种自适应依赖性。

Method: 提出REUSE（Risk-controlled Evaluation Under Sequential Evolution），一种认证式评估与晋升框架，使固定评估集能支持重复自适应决策并提供统计保证。对用户指定错误水平α，以至少1-α概率保证每个被晋升的修改都是底层任务分布上的真实种群改进。REUSE通过严格限制返回给搜索过程的评估反馈，并在误差预算内考虑可能的晋升历史来实现该保证。理论方面，为RSI评估建立了同时误差控制、累积改进的有效下界，以及自适应评估重用基本极限的刻画。

Result: 在实时自我改进实验中，REUSE相比当前RSI系统的评估框架和误差控制基线，显著减少了错误晋升，将错误晋升比例从最高20.7%降至0%，同时最终真实种群性能与最佳基线相当。

Conclusion: REUSE通过限制评估反馈并计入晋升历史，实现了对自适应评估重用的风险控制，在保持竞争性真实性能的同时消除了错误晋升，为RSI中的可靠评估提供了统计保证与理论基础。

Abstract: As recursive self-improvement (RSI) rapidly advances, reliable evaluation becomes critical for guiding adaptive search. RSI typically relies on finite evaluation resources, such as fixed benchmarks, to determine which modifications are retained and what is proposed next. However, when these finite resources are repeatedly reused, new candidates are proposed based on feedback from the same evaluation set, so the search trajectory can adaptively overfit and empirical improvement may not reflect genuine population improvement on the underlying task distribution. Some existing methods account for multiple comparisons but assume that candidates are chosen independently of the evaluation set, and therefore do not control this adaptive dependence. To address this, we propose REUSE (Risk-controlled Evaluation Under Sequential Evolution), a certified evaluation and promotion framework that allows a fixed evaluation set to support repeated adaptive decisions while providing statistical guarantees. For a user-specified error level $α$, with probability at least $1-α$, every promoted modification is a genuine population improvement on the underlying task distribution. REUSE achieves this by strictly limiting the evaluation feedback returned to the search process and accounting for possible promotion histories within the error budget. We develop detailed statistical theory for RSI evaluation in this setting, including simultaneous error control, valid lower bounds on cumulative improvement, and a characterization of the fundamental limits of adaptive evaluation reuse. In live self-improvement experiments, REUSE commits substantially fewer false promotions than evaluation frameworks from current RSI systems and error-controlled baselines, reducing the proportion of false promotions from up to 20.7% to 0%, while achieving final true population performance comparable to the best baselines.

</details>


### [2079] [Offline Policy Evaluation via Mixed Bellman Residuals and Adaptive Critic Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33186)
*Amitakshar Biswas,Yuhan Li,Ruoqing Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究离线策略评估(OPE)，提出用一步与两步Bellman残差的凸组合（固定混合权重）构造混合Bellman目标，并采用基于critic函数的极小极大(minimax)形式求解。与常规固定函数类不同，作者利用预测的未来特征方向构造数据依赖的critic表示，从而诱导一个适配转移动态的核，并配合样本分割控制过拟合。仿真与MetaWorld任务验证了混合参数的作用，表明中间残差组合在困难设定下能改善价值估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线策略评估中，仅用行为策略数据评估目标策略仍是核心难题。现有工作多依赖标准的一步Bellman残差，而在受限值函数类下会存在近似误差，多步重要性加权又会引入方差，二者难以兼顾。因此需要一个能在偏差与方差之间取得平衡的残差目标。

Method: 1) 构造一步与两步Bellman残差的凸组合（固定混合权重），形成混合Bellman目标；2) 采用涉及critic函数的极小极大(minimax)表述来求解该混合残差优化；3) 不依赖固定函数类，而是用预测的未来特征方向构造数据依赖的critic表示，等价于诱导一个适配底层转移动态的核，使critic聚焦于对估计Bellman误差最关键的方向；4) 使用样本分割，在独立数据子集上分别构造critic与估计值函数，以控制过拟合。

Result: 仿真研究与MetaWorld任务展示了混合参数的影响，并表明中间残差组合（即混合权重取中间值）在困难设定下能够改进价值估计。

Conclusion: 混合一步与两步Bellman残差可提供自然的偏差—方差权衡，配合数据依赖的critic核表示与样本分割，能在挑战性场景中提升离线策略评估效果。

Abstract: Evaluating a target policy using data generated by a different behavior policy remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning. While most existing work relies on the standard one-step Bellman residual, we consider a convex combination of one-step and two-step residuals with a fixed mixing weight. In ideal settings, this mixed Bellman formulation can provide a natural bias--variance trade-off between approximation error under a restricted value-function class and the increased variance arising from multi-step importance weighting. To solve this mixed residual optimization, we adopt a minimax formulation involving a critic function. Unlike standard approaches that rely on a fixed functional class, we construct a data-dependent critic representation using predicted future feature directions which effectively induces a kernel adapted to the underlying transition dynamics. This allows the critic to focus on directions that are most relevant for the estimated Bellman error. To control overfitting, we use sample splitting to construct the critic and estimate the value function on separate data subsets. Simulation studies and MetaWorld tasks illustrate the effect of the mixing parameter and show that intermediate residual combinations can improve value estimation in challenging settings.

</details>


### [2080] [Schrödinger--Föllmer Actor--Critic: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Finite-Sample Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33239)
*Yuling Jiao,Lican Kang,Jerry Zhijian Yang,Jincheng Ying*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出SFAC方法，通过条件扩散实现KL正则化策略改进的离线到在线强化学习，用Doob h-变换将优势加权更新表示为参考扩散漂移的修正，并以成对自归一化重要性采样估计，无需critic动作梯度即可训练神经actor。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略能表征多模态动作分布，但优势加权更新未说明如何从所得目标分布中采样，导致KL正则化策略改进缺乏可行的采样与更新机制。

Method: SFAC采用极小极大Bellman critic估计优势函数，定义指数倾斜目标策略；用Doob h-变换将该更新表达为对参考扩散漂移的修正；推导修正的后验均值表示，并用成对自归一化重要性采样(SNIS)估计；以监督回归这些漂移目标更新神经actor，避免critic动作梯度。理论上在小更新区间KL正则化更新沿自然策略梯度方向，Doob修正对应扩散漂移空间中的同一局部变化。

Result: 推导出有限样本界，将critic估计、神经漂移回归、有限样本SNIS、扩散离散化及继承的actor误差对期望平均策略次优性的影响分离。合成实验验证对指定优势倾斜目标的逼近精度及对采样预算的敏感性；在六个离线到在线连续控制任务上，参考锚定实现取得高于对应离线初始化的最终窗口回报。

Conclusion: SFAC为KL正则化策略改进提供了通过条件扩散实现的可计算更新方案，将优势倾斜目标转化为扩散漂移的Doob修正并以SNIS监督回归训练actor，理论上具有自然策略梯度一致性与误差分解保证，实验上在离线到在线连续控制中优于离线初始化。

Abstract: Diffusion policies represent multimodal action distributions, but an advantage-weighted update does not specify how to sample from the resulting target distribution. We propose Schrödinger--Föllmer Actor--Critic (SFAC), an offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) method for Kullback--Leibler (KL)-regularized policy improvement through conditional diffusion. A minimax Bellman critic estimates the advantage function, which defines an exponentially tilted target policy. A Doob $h$-transform expresses this update as a correction to the reference diffusion drift. We derive a posterior-mean representation of the correction and estimate it using paired self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Supervised regression on these drift targets updates the neural actor without critic action gradients. In the small-update regime, the KL-regularized update follows the natural policy-gradient direction, and the Doob correction represents the same local change in the space of diffusion drifts. Under suitable conditions, we derive finite-sample bounds that separate the effects of critic estimation, neural drift regression, finite-sample SNIS, diffusion discretization, and inherited actor error on expected average policy suboptimality. Synthetic experiments assess the accuracy of approximation to prescribed advantage-tilted targets and sensitivity to sampling budgets. On six offline-to-online continuous-control tasks, a reference-anchored implementation achieves higher final-window returns than those of its corresponding offline initialization.

</details>


### [2081] [The Statistical Benefits of Multiple Responses for Learning from Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33291)
*Chandramauli Chakraborty,Cong Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究演示者非最优时，多候选响应（pass@k）对从演示中学习的收益。发现在有限奖励类模型、无奖励反馈下，pass@k（k≥2）将最坏情况对目标精度ε的依赖从1/ε²改善为1/ε；标准评估下对奖励类规模N的依赖从log N改善为log N/log k，且两种效应可分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作表明在演示最优时，pass@k能以log k因子降低样本复杂度；但实际演示者往往并非最优。作者旨在探究演示者质量不受假设时，多候选响应是否仍带来收益，以及收益的形式与评估方式（标准评估 vs. 鲁棒评估）如何影响该收益。

Method: 采用有限奖励类模型，在无奖励反馈条件下分析pass@k与pass@1的最坏情况样本复杂度。分别针对标准评估（训练前固定未知奖励）与鲁棒评估（单个学习策略需同时对奖励类中每个奖励与演示者竞争）建立匹配的上界与下界，并给出一种贪心乘性权重（multiplicative-weights）学习器，在不对演示者质量作任何假设的情况下达到上界。

Result: （1）无奖励反馈下，从pass@1到任意pass@k（k≥2），最坏情况对目标精度ε的依赖由1/ε²变为1/ε，且对演示者质量一致成立；（2）标准评估下，k增大带来额外且不同的收益：对规模为N的奖励类，最优依赖由log N改善为log N/log k；（3）两种效应可分离：鲁棒评估下1/ε的快速依赖仍保持，但1/log k的改进可能消失；（4）给出了相应区间内匹配的上界与下界。

Conclusion: 当演示者不必最优时，多候选响应相比单候选带来定性上更强的样本复杂度收益。该收益包含两种可分离的效应：一是对目标精度的依赖改善（1/ε²→1/ε），在标准与鲁棒评估下均成立；二是对奖励类规模的对数依赖改善（log N→log N/log k），仅在标准评估下成立。所提贪心乘性权重学习器无需演示者质量假设即可达到上界。

Abstract: Many generative systems return multiple candidate responses and are evaluated according to the best one. Recent work shows that, when demonstrations are optimal, pass@$k$ can reduce the sample complexity of learning from demonstrations by a logarithmic factor in $k$. We ask what happens when the demonstrator is not assumed to be optimal. We find that multiple responses provide a qualitatively stronger benefit in this setting. In a finite reward-class model with no reward feedback, moving from pass@$1$ to any pass@$k$ with $k\ge2$ changes the worst-case dependence on target accuracy from $1/\varepsilon^2$ to $1/\varepsilon$, uniformly over demonstrator quality. Under standard evaluation, where an unknown reward is fixed before training, increasing $k$ provides an additional and distinct benefit: the optimal dependence on a reward class of size $N$ improves from $\log N$ to $\log N/\log k$. We further show that these two effects can be separated. Under robust evaluation, where one learned policy must compete with the demonstrator simultaneously for every reward in the class, the fast $1/\varepsilon$ dependence persists, while the $1/\log k$ improvement can disappear. We establish matching upper and lower bounds in the corresponding regimes and give a greedy multiplicative-weights learner achieving the upper bounds without any assumption on demonstrator quality.

</details>


### [2082] [Sharp training-conditional coverage for conformal prediction under covariate shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33456)
*Mehrdad Pournaderi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究加权分裂共形预测在协变量漂移下基于校准数据的条件覆盖性质，给出显式的训练条件界，并刻画了与卡方散度相关的内在尺度与下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加权分裂共形预测虽在协变量漂移下保证边际覆盖，但其在校准数据条件下的覆盖性质尚不清楚；现有界常含未指定常数，且对决定覆盖尺度的量刻画不足。

Method: 基于固定总体分位数处的单一集中不等式给出初等论证，得到显式训练条件界；引入由漂移的卡方散度与似然比在测试总体中概率等于误覆盖水平的最大部分上的均值构成的方差代理；构造两点下界；在校准数据下将加权分位数在显式膨胀水平上运行以获得确定性 PAC 预测集。

Result: 得到无未指定常数的显式训练条件界，表明相关尺度不是似然比上确界而是所述方差代理；两点下界显示根号 m 速率与卡方贡献是漂移内在的；膨胀水平下加权分位数成为确定性 PAC 集；与随机拒绝采样及重要性加权 learn-then-test 比较，通过似然比截断水平的认证选择刻画各自给出更窄有效集的区域；分析可扩展到估计似然比与从无标签源样本估计的尾泛函，给出完全有限样本证书。

Conclusion: 加权分裂共形预测的训练条件覆盖由卡方型方差代理而非似然比上确界主导，存在内在根号 m 速率下界，并可通过显式膨胀水平获得确定性 PAC 集，且在多种方法间给出可认证的适用区域划分。

Abstract: Weighted split conformal prediction reweights calibration scores by the likelihood ratio between the test and training covariate distributions and guarantees marginal coverage under covariate shift. We study its coverage conditional on the calibration data. An elementary argument, based on a single concentration inequality at a fixed population quantile, gives explicit training-conditional bounds without unspecified constants, and shows that the relevant scale is not the supremum of the likelihood ratio but a variance proxy built from the chi-squared divergence of the shift and from the average of the ratio over the part of the test population, of probability equal to the miscoverage level, where it is largest. A two-point lower bound shows that the root-m rate and the chi-squared contribution are intrinsic to the shift. Run at an explicitly inflated level, the weighted quantile becomes a deterministic PAC prediction set. We compare it with randomized rejection sampling and with importance-weighted learn-then-test and, through a certified choice of a clipping level for the likelihood ratio, map the regime in which each gives the narrower valid set. The analysis extends to estimated likelihood ratios and to tail functionals estimated from an unlabeled source sample, which yields a fully finite-sample certificate.

</details>


### [2083] [Domain-Adapted Diffusion Models for Conditional Independence Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33490)
*Yanfeng Yang,Junda Zhao,Yijie Gao,Jiaqi Yang,Xinyu Shi,Ziqi Chen,Shunyu Zhao,Shuai Li,Wei Huang,Eshant English,Kenji Fukumizu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将条件生成建模形式化为域适应问题，提出基于多源域加权的扩散模型DA-Diff，并据此构建条件独立性检验方法DA-CIT，实现渐近第一类错误控制并提升生成质量与检验功效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于条件生成模型的条件独立性（CI）检验依赖估计的条件分布生成随机样本，但其估计误差会累积到第一类错误上界中，且仅靠生成估计器的一致性无法保证渐近第一类错误控制。因此需要提升目标域条件分布的估计精度以改善检验的有效性。

Method: 将条件生成建模视为域适应问题，利用多个源域的辅助数据改进目标CI检验域中的估计。提出DA-Diff：一种基于目标域与源域加权经验风险最小化的多源域适应条件扩散模型框架，并推导其收敛速率，分析可迁移源数据如何通过提升有效样本量改进目标域估计同时控制迁移偏差。在DA-Diff基础上提出DA-CIT条件独立性检验方法。

Result: 理论上，DA-Diff具有可证明的收敛速率；DA-CIT的第一类错误满足 P(p ≤ α) ≤ α + o(1)。实验中，DA-Diff相比迁移学习扩散基线提升了条件生成质量，DA-CIT在保持强第一类错误控制的同时具有具有竞争力的检验功效。

Conclusion: 通过域适应视角整合多源域数据可有效缓解条件生成估计误差对CI检验的累积影响，DA-Diff与DA-CIT在理论与实践上均验证了该思路的有效性。

Abstract: Conditional independence (CI) is a fundamental concept in statistics and machine learning. Recent advances in conditional generative modeling provide flexible tools for generative-model-based CI tests, which rely on an estimated conditional distribution to generate randomized samples. However, errors in estimating this distribution accumulate in existing Type I error bounds, and consistency of the generative estimator alone does not guarantee asymptotic Type I error control. To address this limitation, we formulate conditional generative modeling as a domain adaptation problem and leverage auxiliary data from multiple source domains to improve estimation in the target CI testing domain. We propose Domain-Adapted Diffusion (DA-Diff), a multi-source domain adaptation framework for conditional diffusion models based on weighted empirical risk minimization over both target and source domains. We establish the convergence rate of DA-Diff and show how transferable source data can improve target-domain estimation through an increased effective sample size while controlling transfer bias. Building on DA-Diff, we further propose Domain-Adapted Conditional Independence Testing (DA-CIT) and show that its Type I error satisfies $P(p \leq α) \leq α+ o(1)$. Experiments demonstrate that DA-Diff improved conditional generation quality compared with transfer-learning diffusion baselines, while DA-CIT provides strong Type I error control and competitive power.

</details>


### [2084] [Neural Scaling Laws of Transformer Operator Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33533)
*Haoran Yan,Zhongjie Shi,Yuanzhe Xi,Peng Chen,Wenjing Liao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文为基于Transformer的算子学习建立理论框架，分析其逼近与泛化误差，推导出由输入输出维度、函数正则性及输入函数类内在维度决定的幂律缩放律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer作为物理系统解算子的学习架构，实验上已观察到随数据规模和模型规模增大预测误差下降的神经缩放行为，但针对这类算子学习的缩放律理论理解仍十分有限。

Method: 基于局部到全局（local-to-global）逼近原理，该原理与softmax注意力机制天然契合并能产生离散化不变的输出函数。据此推导Hölder正则算子的通用逼近误差，并建立预测误差与训练数据规模之间的幂律缩放关系。

Result: 得到显式反映输入输出域维度、底层函数与算子正则性、以及输入函数类内在维度的收敛指数；利用内在低维结构获得算子学习的幂律泛化率，区别于前馈神经网络算子学习分析中的对数型幂律率。数值实验验证了预测的幂律缩放，并证实收敛率随输入函数类内在维度系统性变化。

Conclusion: 该工作为Transformer算子学习提供了逼近与泛化的理论刻画，揭示了内在维度对泛化率的决定性作用，并为实验观测到的缩放行为提供理论解释。

Abstract: Transformers have emerged as powerful architectures for learning solution operators of physical systems. Empirically the prediction error has been observed to decrease when the data size and model size increase, suggesting neural scaling behavior. Yet a theoretical understanding of such scaling laws for transformer-based operator learning remains limited. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for characterizing the approximation and generalization errors of transformer-based operator learning.
